column10: That is just a very good flour specially for my Gluten-free goodies.The customers loved the taste of this.Thank you for carrying this Amazon, because it is not easy to find this in my state.Michele Whiteaker

column9: I like it but it's inconsistent.
column10: I've ordered about three boxes of a dozen cans of this from Amazon by now. Each batch has been different. One batch was part liquidy, part solid. The next batch was almost completely solid, and this latest batch is all milky liquid.I can use them no matter what the consistency, but it would be nice if Thai Kitchen had better quality control. I liked the solid batch because I could make a wicked alternative to chocolate mousse with it. You can't do that with the part-liquid or all-liquid consistency coconut milk. But mostly I use it in smoothies and in curries, so no big deal. I like to buy coconut milk in bulk so I'll continue to order this.

This is an excellent product. A very flavorable spinach basil garlic fettuccini. I believe it is a bit over priced but you only get what you pay for. If your into a more healthy and still tasty pasta you may wish to give this a try. I served aldenti with virgin olive oil and italian seasonings.

column4: Antonia M, PhD "The Inner Power Doctor"
column10: I'm not sure why they call these Skallops. There is nothing about them that is even vaguely reminiscent of scallops. But they can easily pass for chicken nuggets in both texture and taste. Maybe this product has been around since before there was such a thing as a chicken nugget. Get yourself some dipping sauce and you've got a winner on your hands.

I really like the Worthington Skallops.  They are high in protein and fiber, low in fat and carbs.  Great for weight loss and a healthy meat substitute.  I think they are on the expensive side, however.  I still buy them, as a treat or when I have extra cash in the food budget.

I agree with previous review - these don't resemble scallops in any way, but they are very good. I don't understand why they are so hard to find.Recipe suggestion: cook ramen noodles, throw in a handful of chopped skallops when the noodles are almost cooked (just long enough to heat them up), drain most of the water then add the spice packet.  Not very classy but good and quick.

column9: not terrible, but a bit on the rubbery side
column10: I've had a great many types of vegetarian meat alternatives from all over the world. Though these have soy  protein as well, they still have a bit of that rubbery texture/mouth feel that seitan "wheat meat" has. The price is for a very large can with quite a bit of product, so I thought that it was competitively priced with other similar products. I emptied the can and froze it for using what I need at a time, which has worked out well. It thaws perfectly. I don't think I will order again unless I need a shelf stable hydrated product. There are better tasting/textured options, including any of the Quorn chick'n tenders available with frozen foods.
I love this product however, the price is extremely too much.  will not buy at that price.
These skallops are so versatile.  I do a three dip batter and deep fry them, the family loves them.  You also can't beat the wonderful price.  I have a subscription so I never run out.

Didn't expect anything like scallops but was pleasantly surprised by the firm texture and rich flavor. I wish I could find these in stores around me (South Florida, California), will try the other Worthington/Loma Linda products in the future.

This is a favorite with my family, especially battered and skillet-fried.  They are delicious and very satisfying, even to meat-eaters.  However, I can get this same huge can for less than half the total price with shipping charged on Amazon at Fiesta Mart in the Austin area.  Go to the Worthington site to see if anyone near you stocks it.  Also, talk to a manager at your favorite store to see if they can get it.  I would love to see this wonderful product readily available everywhere.

Kellogg has a habit of putting objectionable ingredients into things it produces, especially when they have a kosher or vegetarian designation like Worthington and Loma Linda, both Kellogg products. In this case the packing broth has two interesting chemicals that I dare not name, so I emptied the broth down the drain and repeatedly filled the can with water to dilute the stuff. So, with luck, the concentration of broth ingredients has been reduced maybe tenfold. Ah yes, the "skallops" could be called Worthington "white meat", and they taste good with ketchup on pita bread from the Parthenon Amazon storefront.So, the question is whether Kellogg does these things as a cheaper alternative to having their own testing program for these chemicals. I mean, is it cheaper to sell this stuff as "food" to minority clients and deal with potential lawsuits than to run an FDA-approved testing program? Inquiring minds want to know.

My favorite chocolate and strawberry yogurt confection so far. I work at a german deli, and have tried the Milka Strawberry Yogurt, as well as Jogurette, and this is the best. The perfect balance of sweet strawberry and tart yogurt. It has real bits of strawberry and crispy rice bits that give it a little crunch. It is rather refreshing.I ordered this in late spring and  I was a little worried about the chocolate melting, after reading the other review. It was still raining and cold here, so I chose not to expedite, but it arrived in perfect condition. Chocolate starts melting at 72 degrees, so keep that in mind when ordering. If it is hotter than that, either pay extra for the expedited delivery, or wait until it cools down to order.

To the other dude: don't rate a product negatively because the seller's customer service sucks.About Ritter Sport Erdbeer JoghurtRitter Sport's excellent quality chocolate combined with sweet strawberry joghurt creme filling. Amazing stuff, as usual.Remember, the way you open any Ritter Sport is to break it in the middle. If you do it right the package will open properly in the middle of the back of the package. Enjoy!

column9: Very, very sweet, but also very good
column10: This is good stuff, but it is very sweet and very rich.Sweet, soft, smooth chocolate surrounds thick, creamy strawberry filling with a flavor similar to really good strawberry ice cream.The filling also contains little bits of crisp rice and tangy dried strawberries, adding a subtle texture.The 3.5 oz. bar is made to be broken into 18 smaller squares, each of which contains approximately 70 calories.  This stuff is so good that it is easy to overdo it, but a tasty treat if you have the self-control not to snarf it all down at once and make yourself ill!

I ordered this item and several other choclate items from Euro Food Mart and was sorely disappointed in the products I received.  They arrived melted.  I didn't realize that I needed to have them shipped EXPEDITED.  I mistakenly assumed that by paying $12 for shipping, the items would arrive with some kind of coolant.  Previous to placing the order I clicked on the Shipping link for detail, and perused the chart that appeared.  I failed to scroll down and see the information stating that in order to assure the use of ice gels, orders needed to be Expedited.  So, on a $26 order, I would pay an additional $30+ for Expedited delivery.  When I initially received my melted chocolates, I contacted Euro Food Mart and received a very rude and curt reply from Cris in Customer Service informing me that during the checkout process I was offered shipping with ice gels, but I chose to decline it.  Sadly, the melted chocolates did not fair any better after being refrigerated.  They cracked easily and no filling was discernable.  Admittedly, it was my mistake not to notice the note on Expedited shipping, however, the response from Euro Food Mart's Customer Service lacked objectivity.  My rating reflects my entire experience....quality of shipped product and customer service experience.

column9: A nice step up from plain rice cereal
column10: Our nine-month-old daughter is ready for a more substantial breakfast than plain cereals.  We want her to get the nutrients and vitamins she needs (especially iron), so plain fruit or vegetables aren't enough.  This blend of fruit and grains (and, in some cases, yogurt) provides everything she needs for a good breakfast and keeps her full for several hours.  Plus, the flavors are not overly sweet.  One note:  at least two of these flavors include yogurt.  Some babies younger than 1-year may have a reaction to yogurt and other dairy foods, so just watch out for that.

column9: Buyer Beware - Jars break in transit!
column10: My daughter loves Earth's Best food items but after two broken shipments from Amazon, I decided to buy from the grocery store.  I sent an email to Amazon but my issue was never resolved.
My son loves all the food by earths best but would like to mention that it's way cheaper buying in store than amazon. Amazon charges 2 - 3$ more than stores.

We feed our baby this Wholesome Breakfast at any time of the day, not just for breakfast.  We're happy she's getting a good balance of vitamins and minerals.  Most jarred baby food is pretty light on the calories and nutrition, but the plain cereals that are fortified with essential vitamins/minerals are so boring and don't train a baby to enjoy different flavors.  We've been mixing cereal into our baby's food to enhance the nutrition, but that's inconvenient and messy.  This Wholesome Breakfast provides the best of both worlds:  the vitamins/minerals of a fortified cereal but with the stronger flavors of a real food.  We particularly like that this food contains yogurt.  When she was young (~6 months old), our baby loved yogurt but couldn't eat it plain because it would cause a rash around her mouth.  She was never bothered by the yogurt in this food, though, perhaps because it was mixed with other things.  Now that she's older (10 months), our baby can eat all the yogurt she wants without a skin reaction, but for awhile, this variety of Wholesome Breakfast was the only source of her favorite food.

We're not sure why, but this this flavor of Earth's Best Wholesome Breakfast (Peach, Pear, and Barley) is our baby's favorite flavor.  She'll eat this any time of the day, and we're happy she's getting a good balance of vitamins and minerals. We've been mixing cereal into our baby's food to enhance the nutrition, but that's inconvenient and messy.  This Wholesome Breakfast provides the best of both worlds:  the vitamins/minerals of a fortified cereal but with the stronger flavors of a real food.  Also, our baby is a picky eater, so we're thrilled to find something she likes that's more substantial than Puffs!

My daughter loves the entire Earths Best line.  I taste everything before I feed it to her and each item tastes pure and fresh.  Very happy.  We've tasted other popular name brands, and Earths Best is really good in comparison.

My son is lactose intolerant but he's able to eat this for some reason!  Moreover, it's great to start off a day with a nutritious meal versus eating empty calaries with little to no nutritional benefit.  Regardless, I'm very pleased with the quality and taste.  Yes, I tasted this and it is delish!

column9: Fruit, dairy & grains...what more could you ask for!
column10: My little guy just loves this jar. I love the line of breakfast blends.  I am happy with Amazon's "grocery" business. It is great to have the convenience to order these on-line and have home delivery.  I can't imagine going the store and having to get a whole case and go through check out. I try to make him some meals, but I trust Earth's Best and love the flavor combo's and they are so convenient.

column9: Earth's best Organic Pears and apple oatmeal
column10: I tried all kinds of oatmeal to give my LO but this is her favorite one. I also love the fact that it comes on time.

If I had only figured out to order baby food online before.  The price is right on the money and the convenience of the shipping to the house is great.  No need to go to the store and have baby jars flying all over the cart.  This flavor is my baby's favorite.  It's a go to when she is not in the mood for anything else.

I love Earth's Best products and only use them to feed my baby, besides home made foods. I rate this one one star because the seller didn't specify that this product contains milk, which my baby cannot tolerate since he is lactose-intolerant. So for us, it was a waste of money, and I bought two packs...

Maybe I missed that in the description, but in any case, everywhere I've read and according to my pediatrician, you're supposed to avoid cow's milk products before age 1 (why they make formula using cow's milk and not a much more digestible milk like goat baffles me and is a rant for another time--my son drinks the lactose free kind, in any case). My daughter likes it now, but when she was younger she did not want to have it! Go figure! Now she is almost 14 months she digs the flavor.

I bought quite a lot of these in the past. My son loved them. I like the fact that they are organic and the combination of fruits and vegetables in them is just right.

column9: Good breakfast, especially on the go.
column10: We do fruit and cereal for breakfast daily.  This comes in handy when we are on the go, since i dont have to bring cereal long.  I also like that it is 4.5 ounces, since some of the earth's best fruit and cereal combos are only 4 ounces.
My son eats these for breakfast every morning and he seems to really enjoy them. It is a nice alternative to fruit and rice cereal and it has all the nourishment my son needs to start his day.
Price was great, variety, flavor was good, baby likes it! She takes a while to eat, but it's safe and clean to leave in the refrigerator.
Great baby foods!  I like the variety pack.  Much cheaper than buying it from the local grocers or co-op!  I Just wish they came in the squeezie pouches!

column9: Great and easy food for the baby
column10: Right combination. We originally thought our baby had some allergies. However, as we fed these food baby got used to them and she liked them all.
Little one loves these and glass is recyclable forever which plastic (Gerber) is not. About the same price, food is healthier and she's more likely to eat this stuff.
We love the organic baby food. It costs just a small amount more, but it is totally worth it.  Our son loves the different choices.
I love how it's thicker than other Stage 2 baby food. My son gobbles it down! Way better than the lunch or dinner varities!
This was by far my daughters favorite Earth's Best breakfast.  It's nice that it contains organic fruit and whole grains.  Plus the prices on amazon can't be beat, especially with subscribe and save!

column9: My son loves it! Very nutritional!
column10: This is one of my sons favorites. Even though it's called "wholesome breakfast" he usually has this for lunch. It is packed with nutrients, including 35% of his daily iron. This is a staple in our baby's diet!

I paid $55 for a 96 pack of Maggi and was initially excited when it first arrived. However, as I was cooking it I noticed that it had an odd odor to it, and when I tried eating it, I realized the noodles were very stale. I checked to see what the expiration date on the packs was, but there was none listed (conveniently). I opened some other packs, and found each one to be very stale... they must be months over expired--maybe even more than a year. This has been quite upsetting, and I would not recommend it at all.

Day:1 Hmm, I was excited on seeing Amzn.com's offer which pretty much dwarfs the price I pay for noodles at the Indian grocery store...when the box came, I ripped it open to taste the noodles hoping that the taste would be great... hmm not quite.. it had a stale smell, not intolerable, but recognizable.Day:2 I ate two packs and did not get the flavor... something fishy..Day:3 I decided that I am not going to return a 96 pack (rather 94 now) box and decided to stock the noodles in my shelf. Suddenly my eyes fell on the expiry date, it was February 2011.. and what date is it today? August 2011..The idea is not about being able to return products, but to make sure the products are good in the first place.. think about the effort I have to put in now to return it... why does this happen? Is Amazon not reading reviews? Are people who pack the noodles not literate enough to read the expiry date? I am disappointed.

column9: An Ode to the Drink of the Gods...
column10: This Mango Nectar is perfection! It deserves the highest praise, and I feel compelled to be the one to give it.First, it must be understood that this is a true delicacy and thus it is to be sipped and savored slowly, not gulped down indiscriminately like a can of coke. If you really want to get the most out of this true little slice of heaven, you have to address it unhurriedly , preferably with your eyes closed. It is best served refrigerated and I like to drink it straight out of the can, because even the can feels good, with its slim line and nice heft. It's actually quite a bit heavier than one expects... So, can or glass, take a sip and gently roll it around on your tongue, like you would a fine wine. Feel the thick richness of the nectar, dancing its dance of subtle, rich flavors in the hiddenmost recesses of your taste glands. Remember to breath gently through your mouth and nose too, to get the full effect of the subtle hues of this amazing fruit's aromas. Notice the tiniest little hint of bitterness - it really rounds out the "feel" of the mango. It no doubt comes from the pulp and, without it, this juice would not be nearly as delectable as it is.Does this sound like poetry to you? Perhaps it seems like it is a somewhat overdone description of a product that is, after all, "only a fruit juice", right? Well, I invite you to try it yourself and see if it is not deserving of every accolade I have ascribed to it and many others I may have missed.I am having one now and I must add, though it is probably fairly obvious, I feel it enhances my imagination and my creativity too... :)

I was excited to order these based on the reviews and expected a gourmet delight.  I poured it into a heavy cut glass and prepared to enjoy.  Yuck!  Thin, almost no taste at all.  It tasted like a lightly flavored water.I adore juice nectars.  I always sip, not drink them.  This is  a complete waste of my dollars.  It hardly even tastes like a juice of kind any of fruit.  Maybe I got a bad batch, but I will never order this brand again.  YUCK!!!

My husband and I LOVE these. Been drinking them for 4 years now and can't get enough. They are hard to find... We used to buy them at Costco, but moved and our local Costco here does not have them. Boo! Been looking for them for a year. Glad to find them on my favorite shopping site!
excellent but not what I really wanted from this vendor, I wanted MANGO JUICE 100% made by the same company
We love Lavazza Gran Riserva. We have a Jura espresso maker at home, this brand will never disappoint you and the price is reasonable.
The Gran Riserva had consistent crema and an acceptable flavor.  I would put it on par with Lavazza's Crema e Aroma, but behind Lavazza's Pienaroma.

I always read reviews but never write one. The pleasure I had from drinking this coffee forced me to do so. It's the best of all Lavazza. It goes along with il Perfetto. Very deep and rich taste, especially if you make the grind finer. Good caffeine amount. If you are looking for low caffeine, try Pienaroma. Enjoy :)

column9: Average for a Lavazza, good by other standards
column10: I would rate the Gran Riserva below Lavazza's Tierra! and Super Crema for sure. It isn't as flavorful as the Crema e Aroma, but is less acidic. I like(d) it better than the Qualita Oro, which is priced outrageously. For the price, the Gran Riserva also offers less value than the Pienaroma. I don't remember the Gran Riserva's characteristics that well - so it wasn't memorable, I guess. :-) Nothing much wrong with it, either. My expectations must have been high because it's called "Gran Riserva".If it was on sale, I would buy it. It's probably better than most other espresso beans; it is - after all - a Lavazza.
These are addictive! I am a sucker for any fake banana flavored candy, and this is the best! I've gotten my brother and mom hooked too.

column9: Packaging is totally inadequate,I'll never know how it tastes
column10: This arrived in a huge box with very little filler. The bottles were broken and the box had leaked out. What's worse is that grocery items cannot be returned, so I'm not sure I can get my money back. I'll have to make a phone, but wanted to post a review first. Don't buy this.

I love these chips, the flavor is wonderful, not extremely spicy but has a bit of a bite to them.  I was hesitant to try them, my kids liked them, but once I did, I was addicted!  Great on the go snack, I love that they are individually packaged and they are all the same flavor.  I haven't found this flavor packaged in small bags by itself. It usually is with other flavors and this is the one flavor all of us like the best.  I'll keep on buying them!

These are one my favorite kind of Sun Chips. They have a zesty taste that is not too sharp or bland, with just the right "kick", and a nice crisp texture. While these are not a health food, their sodium and fat content is much better than other snack foods. These chips work really well with a dip and vegetables for a pre-dinner snack.Shop for price. The price printed on the 10.5 oz bag that I buy at my local supermarket is $3.79 (and I pay less on sale), so the price on Amazon for 64 1.5-Ounce bags is more expensive. You are paying for the convenience of a single serving size.

As far as salty snacks go, these are a veryclose second to the Meijer Organics cheese puffs. I like the 1.5 ounce bags, they are perfect for an on-the-go snack or in my lunch. The flavor is just like chips and salsa, perfectly seasoned and crunchy! One bag is 210 calories and a whopping 27 grams of whole grains, with 30% less fat than regular potato chips. Life is full of choices, this one is a no-brainer!

column9: Not Fresh - Watch out for some of amazon food lots
column10: Sun chips are good, but now many other healthy snacks are out and they have not improved this product. This was a large quantity but the expiration was in just 60 days and the box came smashed ?? I Love amazon but some of the food buys you got to take your chances that this is not first quality stuff.

I wasn't a real sun chips fan until I discovered the Garden Salsa  I would sometimes choose Sun Chips because with whole grain it was a healthier choice. After trying the Garden Salsa that is my preferred choice because they taste great. They are not too hot just have a nice little bite and a whole lot of flavor. I haven't bought them through Amazon but I have bought a lot of other products and I have not had any problems.

column9: Excellent flavor and texture, quite unique
column10: I spotted this exquisite treat at a local gourmet food store and had to give them a try. Excellent flavor and texture, quite unique. And now I can't find them locally anymore, so glad to see them here.St. Dalfour raisins are not at all like the regular raisins, which are packed dry. These are moist! And tender and truly delightful. The sole ingredient listed on the label is: raisins. No preservatives.These raisins are vacuum packed in glass jars and remain moist and plump. I don't know how St. Dalfour achieves this, but the resulting product is simply delectable. I have also tried their raisin and cranberry mix, which is also excellent.A tasty treat right off the jar, but even better in desserts (ricotta torte, pear and raisin crumble, clafouti, bread pudding).Made in France.
Our dogs are 7 and 11 years so they need the extra vitamins to help them move freely.  This product does the trick.
My dogs suffer from arthritis, and these Senior Biscuits really help them.  My Vet wants me to continue giving them to my dogs.

column9: Crunchy and yummy (as far as I can tell)
column10: My dog isn't much of a food critic (considering his tastes in sidewalk bubblegum), but he sure does like a nice biscuit. These are pretty standard, crunchy ones that he seems to enjoy.  They are easy to bite into, so they aren't too hard on the old guy's teeth.  I can't seem to find this particular kind at Target or Petco in our area though, so Amazon is a good place to stock up.

column9: Nice to find these on Amazon

Glad I read the reviews on this, I too found it listed under the Tassimo T-discs & had it my shopping cart.  I would have been furious to spend that much money & not be able to use it.

column9: Like a kick to the nose (in the good way)!
column10: I've been looking for a horseradish product that really attacks your naval cavity (the kind where you can barely keep your eyes open). column10: My advice is not to let the people who describe this horseradish sauce as mild fool you. I don't know what kind of cast-iron stomachs they have, but too much of this sauce at a time will take your breath away. I mix it with some sour cream to weaken the bite a little. It's good stuff, but it's not mild in the least.
I have use this for years and could  not find it at the place I use to buy it in the large size jar. Was pleased to find it here. It is the best.
The is best horseradish sauce that I have ever tried. It has that zing that goes straight through my sinuses.I will order again. Good price and free shipping.
This came with all the bottles broken and I'm still waiting for a refund! Not very happy

I make tandoori chicken all of the time so when I saw the price on this premixed seasoning I couldn't resist. column9: Fantastic!  I LOVE this stuff! (so does my daughter!)
column10: My just turned 4 year old daughter will NOT, I repeat NOT, eat fruit of any kind.  The last time she ate fruit was baby food.  No joke.  She has food aversions, texture issues, temperature issues, pickiness issues, and has been in feeding therapy for 1.5 years.  She won't drink water unless it's purified (she can tell the difference). I mean this is serious stuff.I bought one of these and gave it to her, explained that it was baby food consistency but wasn't baby food, and was fruit (didn't lie to her) but wasn't a cold smoothie like the kind Mommy makes (which she does NOT like).She slurped the whole thing down!  Tears came to my eyes I was so shocked and excited.  This whole feeding drama is very trying on my patience and I worry so often that she will have long-term problems.She has been devouring them ever since!  This as well as The Red One.  I cannot believe that she is "eating" fruit!!!  I am forever a loyal buyer of Ella's Kitchen products.  When my son is ready for solids, I will feed him Ella's baby food.  I cannot tell you how thankful and happy I am to finally get fruit in my daughter's belly!

column9: My daughter and I both LOVE this!
column10: My just turned 4 year old daughter will NOT, I repeat NOT, eat fruit of any kind.  The last time she ate fruit was baby food.  No joke.  She has food aversions, texture issues, temperature issues, pickiness issues, and has been in feeding therapy for 1.5 years.  She won't drink water unless it's purified (she can tell the difference). I mean this is serious stuff.I bought one of The Yellow Ones and gave it to her, explained that it was baby food consistency but wasn't baby food, and was fruit (didn't lie to her) but wasn't a cold smoothie like the kind Mommy makes (which she does NOT like).She slurped the whole thing down!  Tears came to my eyes I was so shocked and excited.  This whole feeding drama is very trying on my patience and I worry so often that she will have long-term problems.She has been devouring them ever since!  Then she tried these, The Red One.  She likes these just as much!!  I cannot believe that she is "eating" fruit!!!  I am forever a loyal buyer of Ella's Kitchen products.  When my son is ready for solids, I will feed him Ella's baby food.  I cannot tell you how thankful and happy I am to finally get fruit in my daughter's belly!

these were smaller than i expected - not even as big as the average juice box. my 5 yr hated the taste and wouldn't finish 1. my 3 yr old thought they were cool but after 2, it wore off and he didn't actually like the taste. he just liked the novelty of something new.

column9: Great dairy and soy free snack!
column10: My kids love these!!  We have tried the red one, yellow one, and purple one and they love all 3. And he has learned how to suck them down by himself, which is a big plus for me. My 4 1/2 year old loves them too, the challenge with her is keeping her from eating them all at once!  Amazon has a better price than our store, too, plus the only 2 stores that sell these in my area are 30 mins away.  Love Amazon for saving me the gas and delivering to my house!

My daughter currently does not want to eat fruit. I think it has to do with the texture or something. So in order to ensure that she does get her vitamins I give her these as a snack. I think they are all great and that it's a shame that they are not all available for subscribe and save anymore.

All organic with 100% natural ingredients, no pesticides, no chemical fertilizers, no genetic modifications, and no preservatives. The pouches themselves are are BPA and phthalate free.Compare the ingredient list on these snacks to the other fruit pouches and you will quickly see why these are so popular! Pure, real FOOD.

column9: Organic baby food for on the go

When we're out and about and the little guy gets hungry, I just whip out a smoothie and all's good with the world.  Oh, and it tastes like heaven.  Yes I've tried them!

column9: Awesomely delicious. PORTABLE FRUIT for anyone. Organic, low sodium, nothing aritfical, gluten free. We all ages 2 to 84 love.
column10: Awesomely delicious. Portable fruit that does not have to be refrigerated. We keep on shelf in pantyr and in car for quick healthy snack.  Organic, 0 transfat, low sodium, nothing aritfical, gluten free. This is the favorite flavor of our whole family. We all ages 2 to 84 love these.

column9: Great for taking on the go!
column10: We discovered these at Target one day when I'd forgotten to pack a snack for the kiddo. Nummy! And nearly mess-free, if you keep from squeezing the pouch. This means, for babies, no holding the pouch on their own.Organic, all-fruit ingredients, full tummy, and the Amazon subscription price makes it a decent deal. It's not always easy to have organic vegetables and fruits always at the ready, and I think that these are a great way to fit them in when you can't make all your baby's food yourself. column9: Delicious, Healthy, Easy for Kids to Open Snack!
column10: My kids have tried all of the Ella's Kitchen "smoothies" and love them.  (By the way, they make baby food ones, too.)  This is a real blessing for any busy mom who has her hands full.  Or any on-the-go mom.  We brought these on a 4-day roadtrip and they were a lifesaver!  Everytime our kiddos got hungry, we'd hand them back one of these.  They could open and close them themselves, it was a very healthy snack, and it was not at all messy. column9: So Delicious, Safe and Easy Top, Perfect for Traveling!

My little one eats very few purees nowadays.  He likes feeding himself.  However, these smoothies are good for both Baby and Momma.  a) The flavor is FANTASTIC with organic goodness bursting at the seams of your taste buds.  b)  I love, love, LOVE this pouch. I've also found that after a while, my little one likes to hold the pouch and slowly squirt it into his mouth.  Once again, no mess for me to clean up, and Little Guy is very pleased at the food and being able to feed himself.Fabulous product indeed.

Only qualm is, that it's a small snack and will not make you content if you're starved. Good to use in-between meals when not starved though!Update: August 4 2011 - I recently ended up with GERD and a really bad bleeding ulcer, due to stress and grief. I have problems keeping food down and went on a baby food diet for the sake of thriving. This stays down but is beginning to cause some indigestion at times. I'm not saying it would cause you guys to reflux or anything of that sort, but it was really acidic and caused me to choke. My throat now burns a lot, and feels sore, Please be weary if you're having gastrointestinal problems. Babyfood is such a great idea if you're having problems keeping things in, and need to retrain your stomach and intestines. Just be careful, some are more acidic than others.P.S. I like this flavor better than "The Red One".

column9: HUGE Package and a Good Value
column10: I was taken aback when I opened the door and had a box from Amazon that measures 3'2" x 11.5" x 3.5"!! I had no idea how much kombu you get in 35 ounces (1 kg), until I saw this package. The actual package from Emerald Cove is 17" x 6.5" x 3" of 100% kombu. It will last for years if packaged correctly away from moisture.This package has 250 servings using a 1" x 4" piece. I am very happy because I pay almost $7 for a small 2.5 ounce package at my local natural foods store. I use kombu as a flavor additive in soups and stews, and for its rich sea mineral content of potassium, iodine and calcium -- unlike any other food. It does contain MSG naturally found in the sea, which enhances any food. Cooking with kombu doesn't add a fishy or seafood taste in the food - at all. It's surprising.The quality looks good for how I use it (which isn't for kelp salad). I'm very pleased with this purchase.

column10: Contrary to what the sugar industry would love us to believe, fructose is a MUCH healthier sweetener than sucrose (white table sugar, evaporated cane juice). Glucose hits the bloodstream fast and hard, causing blood sugar to rise to very unhealthy levels, which then forces the body to release chemicals (insulin, adrenaline, etc) in order to try and bring blood sugar levels back to normal (this reaction is what causes "sugar highs and lows".  On the flip side, fructose sweeteners are processed by the organs and enter the blood stream slowly and steadily, as needed.  The ONLY time fructose carries health risks is when it's combined in the diet with the HEALTH-DESTRUCTIVE sweetener; sucrose! If you eliminate sucrose (common table sugar/evaporated cane juice) from your diet and replace it with a 100% fructose sweetener (fructose, agave nectar, fruit, fruit juice), you will get to enjoy MANY health benefits, some of which are: stable glucose levels, more balanced energy levels, lower cholesterol, cancer fighter (rather than being a cancer promoter like sucrose), etc.  I speak from the experience of many ... myself and my family included! My husband, prior to switching completely to fructose and staying completely away from sucrose, had type II diabetes, high cholesterol and his triglycerides were through the roof (over 900!!).  He was on medication for his diabetes, but didn't want to take Lipitor. Less than a year after we were married and he was completely away from sucrose, he was able to go off of his diabetes medication and his cholesterol and triglycerides were so low, his doctor stated "you just took one foot out of the grave and now have the cholesterol of a fit teen" Of course, common sense tells us that *all* sweets, even healthy sweets, need to be consumed in moderation ... too much of a good thing is still too much!So don't buy into the fears that the sugar industry PAYS BIG BUCKS to breed ... buy into your health and enjoy this wonderful sweetener! It tastes like sugar and can be used just like sugar in recipes (you use about 25% less, so it's easier on the calories as well).

column9: Intense Ginger Experience and Digestive Aid
column10: *****This Organic Ginger Tea from Yogi Tea is ideal as a digestive aid, and it also purportedly enhances circulation. It's a lovely, intense, all natural herbal tea made from organic ginger root, organic lemon grass, orgnaic licorice root, organic peppermint leaf, and organic black pepper. The taste is exactly like ginger, spicy and peppery, with sweet overtones. It's very nice anytime, but especially after a meal.I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Ginger Organic Tea comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site has a helpful glossary of tea ingredients and is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.Yogi Tea writes this on the box about the tea's benefits: "Our 100% Organic Ginger tea has something to offer to anyone who wants to get or stay healthy. For millennia, herbalists from all over the world have known of the healing, soothing and energizing qualities of this root, considered the "universal medicine."  Organic Ginger (Zingiber officinale) has been used worldwide as a safe and mild home remedy for a variety of conditions, including motion sickness, occasional upset stomach and intestinal gas, as well as minor menstrual cramps. Ayurvedic practitioners have used Ginger for years as a way of activating the body's fire element (Agni), which burns up Ama (the body's toxins, comprised of both undigested food and naturally occurring toxins). When Ama is decreased, the body gains strength, balance and harmony. As a natural warming energizer, Ginger is also known to support the immune system, promote rapid and complete digestion and increase intestinal tone and peristalsis.  Furthermore, it works as an antioxidant and has been shown to safely and effectively relieve nausea associated with motion. Our 100% Organic Ginger tea tastes delicious and provides the highest quality of a timeless remedy."There is a warning on the box that if you have indigestion or heartburn that persists you should see a doctor. There are no other cautions or warnings on the box except the standard disclaimer that the tea is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.Highly recommended.*****

Not my cup of tea. It is a little too overpowering for me. I was looking for something purely ginger and this just wasn't it. It has notes of peppermint & licorice added. I have since tried Traditional Medicinals ginger tea and love it.

This is a good tea to drink in the winter because it is quite warming.  The ginger, licorice root, black pepper, are all very good at warming the body through.  It took me a while to get used to having pepper in my tea, but now that I have I like the little kick of spice it adds.  I don't even add honey anymore.  Some might consider this to be a very "biting" tea.  This is why I say it is good for winter.  I've bought it during the summer and feel it would be more satisfying in cooler weather.  I have to say that I won't buy again because of the pepper, but this reflects a personal preference, not impression of quality.Yogi Tea uses organic ingredients and 100% recycled cardboard for their attractive packaging.  They are a company based out of Oregon.I couldn't say how well it helps with digestion, as I don't drink it on a regular basis.  But we all know that ginger is very good for the body.
Brewing this coffee took me back to my trip to Kona and visiting the coffee plantations.  Drinking a cup of this brew is the next best thing to being there!

I just want to say that my son has a SEVERE nut allergy and it was great to find a product that is safe AND tastes great. The mix was a cinch to whip up and makes yummy cupcakes, kids love them. Be sure to get the icing as well!
This is the best mix for allergen-free cupcakes. Everyone loves them, not just the allergic.  And the cupcakes freeze well too.  I can't help but eat them right out of the freezer.  Very very good!

I made this into cupcakes to take with us to a family dinner.  My son is allergic to peanuts and the dessert being served was not safe for him to eat.  I made the chocolate cake into cup cakes, it made 12 VERY high cupcakes.  Next time, I will make about 15 smaller rise cupcakes.  I used the vanilla icing mix that Cherrybrook makes as well.  They were fabulous!  I love knowing these are allergen free.  I will be recommending these mixes to my sister in law who is allergic to eggs and any other folks I meet that mention allergies!  SUPER deal buying from Amazon.  Just need room to store all this mix until you need it!  I froze 6 of my cupcakes for future visits to familiy functions.

It is such a joy to know that I too can prepare a good chocolate cake my kids feel proud of which does not contain egg, peanuts, or treenuts.  Cherrybrook Kitchen makes this a possibility for the Mom's (in a hurry) of children with severe allergies-a never fail, easy to use Mix!  I highly recommend all the Cherrybrook Kitchen Cakes and cookies and feel great comfort knowing that this company exists as an option to those allergic and their families!!

column9: Lifesaver For My Dairy, Nut and Egg Allergic Child and Delicious!
column10: What can I say except that this cake mix is delicious and a lifesaver. My son is allergic to dairy, nut and egg so he cannot eat the typical cake and has to sit out at cake time at birthday parties. I searched for a substitute for him and for his own parties and came up with some good concoctions but nothing really tasted "normal" enough for all the kids to enjoy.  This, however, is outrageously delicious and makes great cake and cupcakes and I haven't had a single kid notice the difference. I do notice the difference, however, between this and a store made cake and this beats any typical store cake. It uses belgian chocolate, which I think compensates for the lack of egg or dairy. It comes out dense and rich, almost a hybrid of a cake and brownie and we love it and use it for all special occasions. Also, a few tips... I like lowfat stuff and I have started substituting applesauce for the bulk of the oil. I cook it a little longer to firm it up but it comes out awesome. Also, the odd thing is that a number of Pillsbury frostings do not have egg or dairy in them.  Although full of chemicals and a contradiction to the pureness of this mix, I have used them and I think it gives the cupcakes/cake a familiar taste to other kids so that they have no hint that this is a vegan mix.  I, on the other hand, love it without any frosting, still warm, served with either soy ice cream or some lowfat frozen yogurt. Its just great and as I say it has been a lifesaver in that it has brought normalcy to special events that had previously been very challenging in terms of figuring out what to serve that my son could eat.  We've gotten many compliments on this case.

column9: A Really Great Cake Mix For Vegans!
column10: I'm a professionally trained pastry chef, and I have to say I was blown away at the high quality of the product. I'm usually averse to using mixes, but the Cherrybrook Kitchen products do a great job at balancing exceptional flavor with non-dairy ingredients.I've baked out the chocolate cake, yellow cake and brownie mixes several times and they always come out as expected. The frosting mixes are also exceptional and offer room for modulating the ingredients if you prefer to use butter/margarine blends for richness - not vegan, I know, but the flavor isn't lost either way.The sugar content is low, which helps to keep the calorie count down on these cakes - for those dieting, or watching their sugar intake. Overall, I highly recommend these cake and frosting mixes.A note about baking:  home ovens vary in temperature for a variety of reasons. If you suspect that your oven temps are not what they should be, invest in an oven thermometer to make sure you are heating to the proper temps. These mixes absolutely perform as the written instructions provide, but you need to make sure you preheat and reach the correct temperatures, and then maintain them by not opening the oven door constantly.

column9: Best frosted & served right from the pan ...
column10: No worries about having to order ANY of these mixes in bulk lots of 6!  They are great to have in stock and you will want to share them with friends.I do not have any food allergies, yet I have loved this chocolate cake since a friend made one for me years ago.  You might not even need to frost this cake!  I have always served it right from the pan, so I cannot attest to the difficulty or ease of turning the single layer cake out onto a platter.  Leaving it in the pan may also help it set up correctly in the center; I use a 9 inch (not 8) metal (not glass) round pan and am able to follow the suggested cooking times in my electric oven.Added bonus: the graphics on the box are so great I can store these in plain sight on my kitchen hutch!

The box says to cook this for 25 minutes on 350 in a round metal pan until a toothpick comes out clean.  I have cooked 4 of them now.  The first was ruined because I did 25 min. and the toothpick was only wet looking on the tip, so I assumed I hit a chocolate chip.  But, after it cooled when I tipped over the pan to get the cake out, it fell apart and there was a about a layer in the middle towards the bottom that was not cooked.  The second one I kept checking and the toothpick didn't come out clean until 40 minutes.  The cake didn't taste that great, because most of it was overcooked.  I just cooked 2 more for my nieces birthday tomorrow and it also took 40 minutes for toothpick to come out clean.  I am hoping they taste okay.  At least she likes them, but I do wish that it cooked more evenly so that parts of it weren't either overdone or underdone.

column9: Great Food for even Non-allergic families
column10: This cake mix is moist with chocolate surprise morsels inside.  Finally I found a cake that my non-allergic family and friends enjoy and request that I make.  Our son has multiple food allergies and finally we've found a  company that meets his needs.  Thank you Cherrybrook Kitchen.

Because my 2-year-old has a peanut allergy, we keep our home nut-free.  I got this cake mix, and the frosting by the same company, for my stepdaughter's graduation cake, and it exceeded my expectations.  Not only is it nut-free, dairy-free, gluten-free, and whatever-else-free, it tastes GREAT!  Everyone loved this cake!

I believe I prefer this cake mix to the regular ones.  I grew up on home made cakes and am not crazy about cake mixes, but I'm lazy.  I tried this one because its peanut free and we have an allergy in the household.  Much to my surprise I really liked the cake.  It's moist.  I doesn't taste fake like most mixes. column9: Good pasta, not a good value
column10: It's good pasta but not remotely worth the price.  It's just not that special.

column9: Long-lasting flavor in a xylitol gum
column10: I've tried five flavors of Spry gum: peppermint, spearmint, green tea, fresh fruit, and cinnamon. Cinnamon is by far my favorite. The flavor lasts for longer than any of the other Spry flavors. The warming effect of cinnamon oil also offsets the cooling effect of xylitol, making it not feel as strange in the mouth.I really like that the gum is flavored with xylitol. It's great that I can chew this without having intestinal problems.

Has toxic magnesium stearate and titanium dioxide which is carcinogen.This explains WHY the ingredients are not displayed and you need to BUY a product to see what's in it.TRY Ricochet Mints with Xylitol, Peppermint -- it's THE BEST!All natural and has only THREE ingredients: Xylitol, Gum Arabic, and Peppermint Essential Oil.

column9: Yummy way to save your teeth
column10: Let's face it.  No one wants to get bad news from the dentist.  Proper dental care can go a long way to keeping one's teeth for a lifetime.The generation that grew up in the Depression and World War II many times did not have good dental care.  No fluoride, sealants, waterpiks, sonic toothbrushes and the like.  It wasn't uncommon for a person in their 30s to be missing a few teeth.  People generally could look forward to wearing dentures as their teeth became so rotten, the only thing to do was to pull them.Today, we don't have such problems.  And one of the reasons is the use of xylitol to help kill the bacteria that cause tooth decay.  The main reason for dental decay is a bacterium called S. Mutans.  This bug feeds on sugars and starches, secreting acids which destroy tooth enamel, which leads to decay and cavities.  There are various ways to defeat this bug, brushing, fluoride, flossing and sealants all have their place.A more modern addition to the decay-preventing fight is xylitol.  It's a sugar alcohol that S. Mutans cannot digest.  Sucking on mints or chewing gum with xylitol a few times a day is a easy and tasty way to curb this nasty bacteria.I've been chewing xylitol gum and eating xylitol mints for a number of years, and I've noticed that my dental problems have really improved.Highly recommended.  My only complaint is that this gum is so delicious, I tend not to ration it to make it last longer.  Try Spry.  Your mouth will thank you for it.  (Maybe not your dentist, though).

I love the flavor of this sugarless gum.  I just wish that it were made in USA. My dentist recommended it so I tried it.  I have tried both the Spearmint and now the Cinnamon flavors.  Both were wonderful.

Personally, I have read too much and heard too many news reports about the lack of valid oversight in China when it comes to the health and safety of their products and ingredients (from medicines to food to children's toys...) for me to be comfortable with their products. This is a personal decision because for me, health is paramount in life.Here is part of an email I received from Xlear about their products in answer to my questions about the origin of their products:"Good Afternoon,The raw Xylitol comes from China, shipped to Orem, UT and that is where we make the Xlear Nasal Spray.  Our Gum, Mints and Candies are all made in China. The rest of our products are made here in the states.  I hope that was the information you were looking for. Have a nice day!Xlear Inc."I find this especially troubling because the nasal spray has a big red, white and blue shield that says "Made in the USA." So all the ingredients come from China and are put together in Utah. Can this really be legal? To say "Made in the USA" when all the ingredients are from China?If it is 'legal' to say this (yes, we have big problems with our own FDA)...it is still unethical in my opinion. Deceptive, misleading. Sigh...American business and politics. Maybe we should all just move to China. And get jobs in their factories.

We do not use artificial sweeteners, and this is the only gum that we chew!  It's great for your teeth.  The cinnamon is our favorite flavor.  The flavor lasts a long time and freshens your breath.  It is not exactly like regular gum and will not last as long when compared to the artificial sweeteners in other gums.  But there is really no comparison since we don't use these types of gum.  My whole family loves it, from my husband and I to our 6 year old and teenager. Our second flavor is peppermint.

column9: Good for what I needed, but the flavor does not last
column10: I wanted this gum because studies have shown xylitol reduces tooth decay (see Wikipedia quote below).  I put this in my kids' lunch, because they have had some issues with cavities, and despite my begging that they brush at lunch, I am very sure they are not.  I take this gum also, and I chew it after my lunch.  I know my kids will chew this, even if the flavor doesn't last long, because it's gum- and all gum is better than no gum.  On the negatives side, if you are looking for a gum that stays soft and chewy and flavorful for a long time, this isn't it.  I like the flavor- it's not bitter like some cinnamon gums, but I can't say it lasts long.  I chew it, feel it freshens my breath and may help my teeth, and the pretty quickly, when it starts to taste like unflavored rubber, I spit it out.what follows is from wiki:Xylitol is a "toothfriendly" sugar. In addition to not encouraging tooth decay (by replacing dietary sugars), xylitol may actively aid in repairing minor cavities caused by dental caries.[citation needed] Early studies from Finland in the 1970s found that a group chewing sucrose gum had 2.92 decayed, missing, or filled (dmf) teeth compared to 1.04 in the group chewing xylitol gums. In another study, researchers had mothers chew xylitol gum 3 months after delivery until their children were 2 years old. The researchers found that the xylitol group had "a 70% reduction in caries (dmf)." Recent research confirms a plaque-reducing effect and suggests that the compound, having some chemical properties similar to sucrose, attracts and then "starves" harmful micro-organisms, allowing the mouth to remineralize damaged teeth with less interruption. (However, this same effect also interferes with yeast micro-organisms and others, so xylitol is inappropriate for making yeast-based bread, for instance.)Xylitol based products are allowed by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to make the medical claim that they do not promote dental caries.[9]

Xylitol is supposedly good for your teeth, and that's why I bought this product. Is it actually good for the teeth? I don't know, but it's nice to know I'm actively trying to improve my health.The flavor of this gum is quite good, sweet and cinnamony with a little kick, but it lasts for all of 3 minutes. I don't even know why it says chew for at least 5 minutes on the jar if the flavor lasts for less than that.
I got this gum on recommendation from my dentist. Can't beat the price. The taste is great. I just wish the flavor lasted longer and the gum didn't get so hard from chewing after just a few minutes.

I have Sjogrens syndrome, an autoimmune disorder that makes your body attack its moisture producing glands. I have dry mouth very bad and sometimes I have trouble swallowing because of the dryness. This gum has been very helpful with adding moisture and increasing my comfort level. I really like the flavor of the cinnamon gum even though it doesn't last as long as I would like but that's minor in my case.

The gum is OK but I found out that it is made with ingredients from China. No thank you. China has virtually zero health controls over consumable goods. You can get USA made Xylitol gum that uses USA Xylitol called "Xyla" from their web site. Just Google them.

I had to post a review of this because the Spry gum is so ridiculous. I thought I was getting a great deal, but I suppose you get what you pay for. I eat two of these every time and the flavor is gone literally within about one minute (that is probably even a bit generous). I would not recommend this gum to anyone. The cinnamon flavor is amazing initially, but, as I said, the flavor lasts so briefly it is not worth it at all. If you are just getting this because you want to chew on something, go ahead and buy this, but don't expect flavor.

I was so disappointed with the flavor (or lack thereof) that I threw out the remaining pieces. I only tried a few but I just couldn't love it. The cinnamon flavor wasn't strong at all and after a few minutes I felt like I was just chewing rubber. I like gum to give me a 'fresher' feel and this didn't help at all. I will never order again, no matter the price. My order was a complete waste of money.

It was okay for about 30 seconds then most of the flavor had gone and the gum was hard to chew. It also started to get an off taste. I was hoping it was going to be good, I have tried the mints and there pretty good, different but good. I would agree with another reviewer that it's like chewing on a piece of rubber.

I decided to give Spry Cinnamon a chance, reading mostly positives reviews about it. When I first popped a piece in, it tasted great! However, and I am not exaggerating, the flavor was gone in 10 seconds . . . I have never had a gum that the flavor went out so fast in. And like others have said, the gum does turn a little hard and nasty within a minute. I like the idea of it being all natural and helping your teeth, but it's not worth it to me.
Am I really writing a review for gum?Great for the HCG diet. No sugar, cinnaminty... Yum.I love having the big tub of it. What more can I say? I eat the stuff like candy.
flavor doesn't last very long, but its natural gum, so who cares. I love the cinnamon flavor! I buy this stuff all the time! GREAT GUM EVER!!

This gum is nice and cheap, but it's not really that great. Overall even though it's cheap it's not worth it in my opinion. The flavor is alright but is gone in less than a minute and the gum becomes hard and difficult to chew almost immediately. I also bought the 600ct fruit flavor of this same brand and that was better, the flavor lasted longer and the gum stayed soft for a reasonable length of time.

column9: Good Stuff! Make Sure You Keep Away From Dogs!
column10: This has amazing taste! Even though there have been double blind studies showing it reduces cavities xylitol is controversial. I chew it because I have low saliva production. Ten minutes every hour, ten hours a day increases saliva production, which protects gums and teeth. It is thought that mouth bacteria can't ferment it, which is the reason it reduces cavities.Xylitol to dogs is deadly, so I am very careful to keep Xlear Spry gum where they can NEVER get to it, and disposing the used gum into the trash out in the garage. In dogs, Xylitol is toxic. Just 3 grams can kill a 65 pound dog. In about 30 minutes (give or take) of a dog eating something containing xylitol, their blood sugar begins droping to dangerous levels. Symptoms are weakness, lethargy, loss of coordination, collapse and seizures. An IMMEDIATE trip to the vet is needed, otherwise there is little chance your dog will survive. This doesn't affect cats.Another thing to consider with xylitol, is that it does thin the blood in humans. People on blood thinners, such as myself should consult their doctors before consuming Xlear Spry or any xylitol containing items.That said, Xlear Spry gum is really good, I especially like the cinnamon flavor. I love the flavor! Also, there are no Phenylketonurics (known cancer causing ingredients) in Spry.
Enjoyed the cinnamon flavor without all the bad calories. The flavor doesn't last terribly long, but how many gums do? A good value for the price. Will buy again.
I saved 50% off of what I pay for this gum at local health food stores. Great value, it pays to shop around.
Great tasting and healthy alternative.  Don't expect the same texture or for the gum flavor to last as long as the chemical-filled gum on store shelves.
Tiny little pieces of gum that loose their flavor within a couple of minutes. Not a very good cinnamon flavor either.
Love the flavor.Don't love the texture (it gets hard fast).Don't love that it doesn't last too long, but then again, I have the same complaint about pretty much every gum I've ever had.

The flavor (while it lasts) is pretty good but it is so short lived that I will not purchase it again. I love the fact that it is made with xylitol since that is so good for your teeth (and much healthier than sugar or artificial sweeteners). My other "go to" brand has every type of "tol"(manitol, sorbitol etc.) sweetener made and that scares me just a little.  This has a nice peppery, cinnamon flavor to start but only lasts a few minutes.  Maybe this is the true cost of a natural flavoring?  My "go to" brand lasts and lasts but is probably killing me on the inside.  The quest for a true cinnamon gum continues.

Is a more firm gum so it won't stick.  If you like the really soft gums, then this is not for you. Since I am using it for weight loss I like that I have to chew a bit. Perfect cinnamon bite.  Not too hot, but has that little bite.  Average lasting in flavor.
I love the taste of this gum!  It actually holds its taste longer than any other sugar free or sugar gum I have tasted.  It also leaves you mouth feeling fresh after chewing.  Great product!

This is a great gum.  I like the cinnamon flavor best.  The mint flavors would be my #2 choice.  No sugar, and Xylitol is supposed to be good for your teeth, so win-win. I like the mint flavors, but my kids like the fruity ones.

column9: Don't bother, Flavor is gone in 30 seconds...
column10: Intense flavor to begin with, but the flavor disappears within 30 seconds... Don't waste your money. I would have expected this gum to last at least 5 minutes or longer.. but as little time as it did.  There is no value in this item.
this is one of the worst gums I have ever had.  It taste stale and old and the flavor lasts about 1 minute.  warning, do not purchase, if you do you will be sorry.

My husband and I really like this gum. It's one of the flavors we enjoy (also like  Green Tea, Spearmint and fruit which tastes kind of like juicy fruit gum). We chew this after meals and I like that it satisfies my sweet tooth while preventing decay at the same time!
I love this gum. Very tasty and no gluten or nasty sugar alcohols. I had to really search for it but it was worth it. I will definitely buy this again.
If you chew a lot of gum, or want some gum around for awhile, this is the way to buy it, in bulk.

They're supposedly good for your teeth so ill use up my order and possibly order them again if i dont find a better version of this gum.
I'm really glad I got around to trying out this gum. I wish the pieces were bigger and lasted longer but I'm still pelased with it, can't wait to try the other flavors

This gum is good, however, the flavor does not last long. This is not a problem as there are 100 pieces BUT, and I warn you, be cautious when consuming more than a few pieces in a day. You could be in for an eventful surprise.
