Unfortunately, Numi discontinued their bags a while back, and for some reason, their loose tea doesn't seem the equal, which is pretty weird. Still, Numi is quite good, and far better than Twining's pathetic effort.

It is very easy to tell whether you will like Lapsang Souchong.  If you enjoy a good single malt, you'll love it.  If you think drinking iodine would be preferable to Scotch, you'll hate it.  Me?  I love it!
DELICIOUS!:-P  Just the right amount of smokiness in a black tea. My new favorite.

Smoked meats...........................checkSmoked cheese..........................checkSmoking a pipe agrees with me..........checkDrinking a stout single-malt scotch....checkTwinings Lapsang Souchong.......................check againI have never been so overwhelmed by a smoky smell in a long, long, time. Whoever above described this as campfire, was right on target. If you are a fireman, then this will overtake you like the scene of the crime.I love smoked goods, particularly meats, cheeses and scotches. I'm not sure I will be able to handle too many more cups of this, and its not the taste. The taste was great, but the note in the room was overwhelming.I'm going to take the rest of this box to work and share it with my co-workers. I may try and find another variety of Lapsang to compare against, but the Twinings is definately in your face (and pantry).If you want to preserve your sanity and marriage, be sure to get a ziploc freezer bag to contain your Lapsang.
This tea is nice and strong and has a great smoky flavor.  I can't find it in the grocery store, but had gotten hooked on it when a friend purchased some in London.  So glad I could find it again!

The tea is excellent.  I was worried that it wouldn't be as good as Numi's "Smoky Tarry", but it came through, colors flying.  It kind of smells like your in a leather shop where someone's cooking bacon while smoking a pipe, but the taste is surprisingly smooth.  It could be drank alone by itself, but it is strong enough to add milk, if you should so choose.  I couldn't imagine it with sugar in it.  That might be disgusting.  Actually, it probably would be.  Don't put sugar in it.  Some teas were meant to be unsweetened.  Another thing worth mentioning, the flavor comes from the smoking of the leaves over bamboo slats, so after you've used the bag once, you can't really use it again, like with some stronger breakfast teas.  Overall, one of the best teas for just about any time of the day except bedtime.  Serve HOT.m>_<m/

This isn't the best lapsang souchong tea I've ever had, but for a mid-priced supermarket brand it's not bad at all.As others have said, the smoky smell is *very* strong.  But, the taste is fairly mellow; I can brew it strong and it's not overpowering or bitter.  If you don't like the smell, though, you'll probably not enjoy drinking the tea, either.

column9: Tastes like a good, warm campfire smells, wonderful!
column10: This tea is reminiscent of the great outdoors...fresh crisp mountain air, sighing wind in the trees, standing next to the warmth of the campfire holding a steaming mug of Lapsang Souchong tea.  It doesn't get any better than this.  You can have that same feeling as you brew this tea in your home or office, I do, almost daily during the winter and often during late Summer nights out in the back yard in my lawn chair.  This tea is an acquired taste for most, but well worth the effort.  Give yourself several cups to get over the unusually different taste, savor the instant shift to the outdoors, and enjoy a tea that is my favorite of all time and teas!

column9: A delightful tea at a great price!
column10: Lapsang Souchong is one of my favorite teas, but I hadn't seen it in so long I thought Twinings had discontinued it.  I was delighted to find it on Amazon at the same time as there was a special deal on shipping, which brought the total price down lower than Twinings in my local supermarket.  On top of that, it arrived with lightning speed.For those who live in somewhat remote areas not near a lot of shopping, it makes sense to check Amazon for favorite food items that you can't find locally, and I will now be doing this more often.

Lapsang Souchong tea is generally a love-it or hate-it item. As the label indicates, it has a strong smoky flavor which comes from smoking the tea leaves with pinewood smoke as they lay on bamboo trays. As a former pipe smoker, I liken the aroma to that of the Latakia blended tobaccos. I tasted this tea variety at a party once and fell in love with it. No grocery store in my area carries it, so I am glad I can buy it on Amazon for a fair price.

I have to admit that I read several consumer reviews prior to tasting this tea and I was still not prepared for the strong, unusually smokey flavor! It is definitely an acquired taste and if you like smoked products like smoked bacon, almonds or smoked Gouda in particular...you will get used to the unique, smokey taste of this tea.  I began drinking it by itself and then halfway through added some milk, which toned down the intense smokiness a bit.  I can't say I could drink this as easily as I do Earl Grey which I could drink all day long, but there will be days I would definitely be in the mood.  As a final note, all throughout the experience, I wanted to eat smoked almonds! ;-)

I have had Twinging's Lapsang Souchong in the U.K., and this is a totally differrent and inferior product.  There is barely any smokey flavor -- it is as though they have put it through the flaor removing machine.  I suspect it is either very cheap Lapsang Souchong or they are mixing it with an unsmoked black tea.  Definitely inferior.  Try another brand or try to get the UK version in the black box.  Yuck!

I very much enjoy this smoky hard to find tea.  While I would have preferred to buy fewer than 6 boxes, I was just glad to find this at all, and the per box price was low enough that I will come out ahead over local single box prices even if I have to throw away a few boxes because I've had them too long.

column4: Silverfish "Book lover, now learning to listen!"
column10: ... I'm just dropping by to pick up my "fix"!A lot of tea is consumed in this household, and a lot of varieties of tea. Iced tea is a staple all summer, and much of the time it's made with lapsang.  Which is delicious, cooling, and a nice change from straight black tea, green tea, English Breakfast blend, and sometimes Earl Grey.If I remember correctly, Taylors is also good.  But Twinings' lapsang is what's available here in the US, just not in our supermarket here in west Texas.  For those who haven't tried it, I'd also recommend Choice's Genmai cha (tea).  It's made from green tea and roasted brown rice.

Though satisfied with the promptness of delivery, I found the flavor of the tea not up to what I expect from Twinings.  Oddly enough, the aroma of the packages is quite alluring.  I can smell it even in the wrapped box.  It is no doubt Lapsang Souchong, but once it is brewed it tastes like ordinary black tea.  While I intend to enjoy the entire set and try to alter my brewing technique,I will have to choose a different brand next time.
Ordering a very special tea was easy and fast!A great value considering what it costs in a retail store (if you can find it).
This is my favorite tea but is unavailable here since Ukrops closed. It is a smoky tea. thank-you for carrying it.

I'm not too much of a tea drinker, I drink Assam and Gunpowder tea, and now I also drink Lapsang Souchong tea.  If you like single malt scotches from the Islay region (Laphroaig, Bowmore, etc.), you'll LOVE this tea.  A very strong, smoky flavor complements the high quality black tea.  If you like smoky flavor you HAVE to try this!!
I bought this as a gift for my husband. He loves the smokey flavor and drinks at least two cups a day.  I can never find it in stores so I was glad to find it on Amazon.

I know this tea is not for everyone, most people who smell it after I make a cup say "what is that" and not in a nice way. Nonetheless it is very full bodied and goes with many spicey dishes. I make it extra strong and drink it with smoked fish. I have never smoked a cigarette, etc in my life, but I do love this tea.

What a great day it was when I received this tea!! I had been searching in the stores for this smoky, almost hypnotic tea for months and then I decided to look online...there it was Bang Zoom!My mom would have these tea parties every so often at my house growing up and invite a few of her close friends. column9: Not Your Grandma's Cup of Tea
column10: I was first introduced to Lapsang Souchong by a former employer who was a translator for the US Army stationed in China. Although he brewed his tea from loose leaf, Twinings tea bags are an excellent substitute (and less expensive). This is a delicious, full-bodied tea that drips with a delicious, smokey flavor.  It is excellent for a late-afternoon pick-me-up and can be enjoyed without sweetners, lemon or cream. I suggest you buy a tea ball and a small quantity of loose leaf from a tea shop FIRST. If you enjoy this very different tea drinking experience, make the investment and purchase a six-pack of Twinings tea bags.

column9: A wonderful tea, but an acquired taste
column10: When I was first introduced to Lapsang Souchong tea several years ago I have to admit I didn't like it at all. It sort of reminded me of smoked leather - hardly something you'd want to drink! But I found that if I sweetened it up quite a bit (dark brown sugar gave it a nice flavor) and added a lot of milk or cream it was actually not bad. I'm glad I didn't give up, because since then I've come to love it even more than my previous tea favorite, Earl Grey, but it did take quite a while to arrive at this point. Now that I've developed a real taste for it I sweeten it only a little and I don't add much milk, which brings out the smokey flavor more. Maybe eventually I'll take it black.Lapsang Souchong is a very outdoorsy tea. It reminds me of campfires and chilly weather and blowing leaves in autumn. Although it's especially great on a rainy day or in front of a fireplace on a cold night, I actually enjoy it all year long. For those of you that don't like it yet or aren't quite sure what to make of it, keep trying. Try different ways of making it - different strengths, levels of sweetness, and amounts of milk or cream. You just might make a lifelong friend!By the way, one reviewer mentioned that the Twinings brand of Lapsang tasted unnatural, as if they made it using artificial smoke flavor. I must heartily disagree! The Twinings tea does have a more robust smokey flavor than the other brand I tried (Taylors of Harrogate), and maybe that was interpreted as being "artificial", but in comparing the two brands I definitely like Twinings better. There's nothing artificial about it, and the richness of the smokey essence is exactly what I love so much about Twinings. If it's too rich for you maybe the Taylors would suit you better, as it's also an excellent tea. I would urge people to try both brands and make up their own minds.

Lapsang Souchong is a very dark, rich, smoky tea. It's wonderful for relaxing with a book by the fireplace, and equally enjoyable by a campfire on a cool evening. I find it soothing after a tiring day, and often brew a cup to relax with at bedtime. I emphasize the rich, heavy, smoky flavor, because few people enjoy such a flavor. Perhaps it could be compared to excellent Scotch Whiskey,in that not everyone will appreciate it, we who do find it irreplaceable in our cupboards.
What a great product; this tea is tibetan and smoked, my favorite flavors.  I saved a lot of money buying this way from Amazon.

Twinings makes the best tea for folks on a budget, and Lapsang Souchong is no exception.  A great black tea, prepared well and consistently.  I bought 12 boxes up front, so that should tell you how much I love this tea.  :)

I do not like smoked foods (cheese, meats, etc). So, I took a gamble by purchasing this tea because I was looking for new and unique flavors. The description says "golden black tea with a delicate smokey flavor." Delicate could not be farther from the truth! This was shipped to me along with 5 more boxes of different Twinings flavors. When I opened the package, all I could smell was this - despite the fact that each bag is sealed in a paper bag, inside a plastic wrapped box! The smoke smell was overwhelming. When I showed it to my husband, he said it smelled like tobacco. The smell was so bad, I could not even brew a cup.Other reviewers obviously enjoyed this, but for me it was a complete waste of money. I could not even give the tea away.

column9: A nice tea to add to your collection
column10: I used to be a coffee drinker, but I found that I was having issues with my bladder working properly.  I even ended up taking a prescription med for the bladder problem, which helped, but was still there (and the prescription was pretty expensive).  Through a tip from another, I found that coffee could be the real cause.  I switched to tea, and within three days, I could tell a definite difference with the bladder problem.  I stayed 100% with tea for three weeks, all being good, and then drank just ONE cup of coffee, and the bladder problem was noticeable within a couple of hours.  So, I've been on tea ever since, and have come to enjoy all sorts of the many flavors of teas.  And, by the way, I no longer need that prescription medication!Anyway, Lapsang Souchong tea... it's pretty good.  I had first experienced this flavor many years ago, and was fascinated by the smoky flavor.  (the tea is laid to dry over smoldering pine branches)  That tea I first tried was all natural, loose tea, in a tin can.  That loose tea was VERY strong flavored, and you either liked it or hated it.I happened to like it.  Now, to compare this bagged version.  It has the same scent as the loose leaf, but the flavor is NOT any where near as strong.  So for those that may have tried the loose leaf, and didn't like it, you might like this, as it is milder in flavor, yet has that nice scent while you are drinking it.It's a good tea, however not one I would drink every single day, which is why I give it three stars.  (certain very popular brand names, which I will not mention, but names that have been around for 50+ years, I generally rate those teas with only one star... just to give you an idea)Some of my 4 and 5 star teas are:  Earl Grey, Constant Comment, Chai, Jasmine, Ginger, and various assorted green teas, as well as numerous loose leaf teas.  (that should give you an idea of my taste buds)

column9: If your taste buds are gone.......
column10: If your taste buds are gone you may like this tea. I was determined to finish this cup of tea to the last drop but was getting nauseated. Way too smoky flavor for my taste.
I'm not sure who would like this tea. To me it tasted and smelled like burnt charcoal and it burned the back of my throat.

This tea, however, is the most nauseating blend I have ever sampled. I brewed as per directions, and the "stench," not the aroma, almost prevented me from tasting it, but I did. Even when poured down the sink, the odor left behind required some added clean-up. This was given to me as a gift; a very poor choice. column9: Perhaps the best Rooibos in the US
column10: I've imported my rooibos since I couldn't find a decent flavored kind in the US, not even at Teavana, despite their awful prices. This cherry blossom rooibos is almost as good as my imported stuff, I really enjoyed it!

Granulated Domino Sugar - yes, but not a halva. It has a lot more sugar than any other brand and all you can feel are crunchy sugar crystals when you're chewing it. Do not buy!

Halva is not my favorite desert but this halva is very good.  It is so well balanced that as as a piece melts in the mouth only a short lived fragrant smell of something like heavy rose water is senced, which is probably the halawa extract with no sugary or oily aftertaste. and the root extract flavor was stronger than I like.  I've mixed some straight tahini with it, which improves both problems, though it needs to be  really cold to make it more solid.  Still, I really enjoy nibbling it.
Very very dry, but otherwise edible.  I used to love Sadaf brand halvah, too bad it is no longer available!

I bought 3 kinds of Al Wadi halva (this one, pistachio; plain; and with chocolate) and the pistachio was my favorite.  I wanted to find out whether the halawa extract in this product really increases breast milk production and to my delight, I pumped about double my normal amount while I was snacking on the halva a few times a day!  The pistachio flavor goes very well with ground sesame seeds (tahini).  This product is a somewhat dry paste, a little bit oily, and quite sweet.  There is a crunch to it from the nuts and also from the sugar.  The halawa extract has a bit of a bitter flavor that I find pleasant with the sweetness of the sugar and the earthiness of the nuts.  I found myself craving halva rather than Little Debbies or other sweets.  I would buy this product again and definitely recommend it to other breastfeeding mothers!  One note though: this product will give you GAS!  Lots of it!  Buy a bottle of Bean-O at the pharmacy to help combat the gas - the increase in quality & quantity of milk is well worth the extra trouble.
Good product , we also tried the fava beans al wadi, was very good too.will by it again.

It's absolutely amazing how adding a simple dab of sugar can make a cupcake pop! The thing about this product is its vibrance, which quite frankly makes the grocery store brand seem dull. column9: Healthy meal choice for those with limited time
column10: Traditional lentil is a perfect choice for anyone wanting a healthy quick meal.  It has everything I need, like protein and vegetables, and nothing I don't, like excessive amounts of sodium (found in most soups), fat, and sugar.  For those complaining about the taste, I disagree and hope nothing changes about this soup.  This product knows what it is, it's lentil soup, and thankfully the manufacturers didn't mess too much with the natural flavoring of lentils, which taste great to me.  For a vegetarian, this is a great source of protein coming in at 14 grams of protein per a bowl (7g per serving).

column9: Gives Lentil soup a bad name
column10: I would put this in the category of barely edible.  The soup was bland and what flavor there was was not a good one.  The texture was rather bad itself and I would prefer any other lentil soup to this one here.Just awful.

I work nights and there often is not anything to eat. I keep one of these in my locker, you don't need a bowl or plate...you don't need a can opener. Easy open lid and a microwave cover so you don't have to clean your microwave if it bubbles! Tastes great.

I have been drinking tea for about 50 years or so, and Stash makes a great-tasting full-bodied tea.  This tea has a smooth fruity taste (peach).  It is not overbearing, but a nice subtle peachiness.Individually sealed in a paper/foil pouch for added freshness, this tea is listed as having 100 % natural ingredients.  They are, in the order listed, wuyi oolong teaorange peel, lemongrass, and white peach flavor.It has been said that oolong tea was named after the part of Wuyi mountain, in China, where it was originally produced. It is among the most popular types of teas served in typical Chinese restaurants. (I have also found Jasmine tea and varieties of green tea in typical Chinese restaurants¡Xand plum wine.  Yum.)It is also suggested that oolong tea is useful for weight loss.  In my (non-medical) opinion (I am not a doctor), like anything else, it can HELP but won¡¦t carry the load.  Oolong appears to be a diuretic, helping you to loose excess water.  If you lose too much water, you might dehydrate or lose valuable potassium.  So, I suggest that you limit yourself to 24 oz a day.  As with anything else, seek guidance from your health care practitioner.I suggest adding agave cactus juice, unbleached natural brown sugar, or honey, if you want a sweetener.  I like fruity teas often in the evening, and instead of dessert.Darn it!  Now I¡¦m craving Chinese food and am snowed in--in a blizzard¡Xwith over 40 inches of snow on the ground.  I wonder if they will deliver? º

Wow, this is good stuff!  I brew mine up and pour into a mug with 4-5 drops of apricot liquid stevia and a little soy vanilla creamer.  Wonderful to sip as an after dinner treat.  So creamy and tropical...yum!

Generally, I don't like flavored tea. And the experiences I've had with chocolate flavored tea left me convinced it really couldn't be done in any palatable way. I was wrong. I don't know what led me to try Stash's Chocolate Mint Oolong but this tea is outstanding! It does NOT taste like Palmer's chocolate coins dissolved and diluted in too much water, which is what most chocolate tea tastes like to me -- not even a Hershey's kiss, but Palmer's -- yuck! This tea has a very light yet distinct chocolaty flavor followed by sweet mint. It's refreshing in the evening after dinner when I want something sweet but don't want to load up on sugar right before bedtime. And, truth be told, it's a delight any time of day.

This Stash flavor is so deliciously tropical I love it hot or cold.  Made with 100% natural ingredients of :wuyi oolong tea,  orange peel, and flavors of coconut, pineapple, and mango.  It's caffeine free and I like this espeically as a cold drink in the mornings vs coffee in the summer time;  very refreshing and tropical.  Takes 3-5 minutes to steep and if making iced tea Stash recommends using double strength...2 bags per cup.  As with many of the unique Stash brand varieties ; licorice and pure peppermint,  this is difficult sometimes to get at the local stores so I buy either direct from the company or here on Amazon. Delicious. 5 stars to a great brand of Stash.

Love this tea.  Unlike a lot of (supposedly) flavored teas, this one actually has a strong flavor; more coconut "tropical" than mango but really tasty, with a strong smell too.  I think it tastes best with a touch of sweetener (honey, agave, etc.) to further enhance the flavor.  After finding it once, I haven't been able to find this flavor at any of my local grocery stores, so I ordered the box of 6.  Everyone I have shared this tea with has loved it too!.
I drink a lot of tea and Stash's White Peach Oolong is by far my favorite.  It's smooth and has a great flavor.

I like this tea because it has a nice subtle flavor without the bitterness that one often experiences with black teas.  And, I'm told that oolong tea is good for your health too, and that's why I tried it.
This tea has a fresh peach flavor, not artificial-tasting like some others I have tried. It has a natural sweetness, and is refreshing served either hot or iced.

I love this tea!  If you like peach flavored teas, you'll probably like it.  Good amount of peach flavor.  Mild overall - not strong like black and not grassy like green.  Now and then I try other brands but end up always coming back to Stash.  Their blends/flavors are always my favorites - especially their Earl Grey.

This isn't bad - peach but also a bit of citrus.  Was looking for a substitute for Celestial Seasonings white peach and it's not quite what I wanted.  However, a friend of mine whom I gave it to loves the product.  :)  Each to his/her own!

I love drinking different peach tea's during summer. The white peach oolong has a sweet peach flavor that has a slight lemmongrass flavor with a hint of citrus. I drink this tea with milk, sugar, peach bits, then chilled, and the taste really comes together well. Not as strong as Celestial Seasoning Country Passion Peach tea. I've also tried Liptons Peach tea which has a light pina colada flavor, but as far as white peach, it's definitely a great Summer treat for the family picnic.
Works very good for a dry rub on ribs for the smoker. Awesome flavor. I will buy more of this product.
I tried this dry rub on grilled chicken and it came good!I will try it on pork steaks next.

column9: Mrs. Wages Bread'n Butter Pickle Mix
column10: This is an extremely hard to find item in my area. My wife is happy for this item. This mix makes the best home made Bread and Butter pickles on the planet in our opinion. Fast, secure shipping at a fair price.

This really is a very good Parmigiano Regiano and the great thing about this large block is that it can be eaten the way it is supposed to be.  Broadly shave or cut it into irregular pieces and just nibble on it with a fine red wine.  That wonderful "gritty" quality is amazing.By all means use it for all your grating needs as well, but first and foremost it is to be savored in small chunks with a fine red Super Tuscan!

Excellent product and a good value, too. Once you have the real deal from Italy, you will NEVER go back to the green shaker tube. Don't be dismayed if you find that the yellowed crust is too hard to grate. Save it and use it in sauces or soups.<<<<<<UPDATE>>>>>> July 12, 2011. Just received another order, and the quality and packaging is great. This time, I cut the crust into 1/4" cubes, and put in my food processor. It grated easily, and can now be used on spaghetti and other recipes.

I have enjoyed many PR's up to 30-40 dollars a pound and have a very good sense of quality. This is about an 18 month as stated. It is on the mild side which is quite special in itself. It has a fresh wonderful buttery taste of a fresh PR. There is individual merit for the various ages up to 36 months. I personally do not like the 36 months variety.This is a bargain and to be well appreciated.Pay the next day during the hot months.Mt second order 2 weeks later was not fresh, dried out not the young freshness and tenderness of a 18 month - did not taste good. Why!?We really like these cheese. The third shipment was perfect.

I previously purchased a similar product from William Sonoma. I was happy to see a similar product for sale from Amazon at half the price. It's a good product with a good flavor and texture but not quite up to the standards of William Sonoma but at half the price I can make allowances. It was shipped quickly and in good condition and free because of the free shipping offer which was much better than the $10 shipping charged by that previously mentioned company. All in all I'll be purchasing from Amazon again.

This is excellent aged Parmesan.  When it arrived, I cut it up into 3-4 manageable pieces and kept one in my refrigerator's cheese/meat tray and put the others in small plastic bags in my extra storage refrigerator.  When I need some, I just grate it (either fine or regular on my grater).  It is dry enough that it keeps very well - always with a freshly grated taste on wherever I need it.  This product is reasonably priced, and I would definitely buy it again.  Already grated Parmesan from the grocery store cannot compare to this freshly grated parmesan.

From the other reviews, sounds like the cheese is really really good. Unfortunately, I didn't get a chance to find out. When I accepted the package from the FedEx driver, I immediately ran to the kitchen with excitement. That quickly turned to dismay when I opened the box, unsealed the thermal pouch, and discovered a *very* warm brick of cheese.The principles of foil insulation are to ward off conduction, convection and radiation. Used properly, they work quite well. But Amazon killed the entire thermal benefits of the pouch by wrapping both the cheese and the cold packs in heavy bubble wrap before placing into the thermal pouch. Additionally, due to the lack of moisture in the bubble trap they created, I don't think the ice packs were properly frozen to begin with.Hugely disappointing. Amazon, please teach your shipping personnel the proper use of insulated foil pouches. If this practice isn't corrected, I don't think this cheese can ever be successfully (i.e. safely) shipped.

column9: Needs Dry Ice. Plain and Simple
column10: This product came to me late August.  Because the vendor is relatively close by, it was delivered a day early.  When I opened the box, I discovered a thermal pak and two very small ice packs.The ice packs were only a bit cool, and definitely not frozen.  Had I received the package the day it was scheduled to arrive, the entire order would have been ruined.  Word to the wise -- only order in the winter months!

I have loved this cheese for many years. I now live in a location where it is not readily available. I was a bit reluctant about ordering online, worried about he quality, worried about shipping times. I just received the cheese, my worries were without foundation. I paid $3.99 extra to get one day delivery, well worth it, considering the value of the cheese. The cheese was well-packed and in good condition. The taste is sublime - rich, nutty, creamy and yummy. This is a young Reggiano Parmesan, it is a pale creamy color and milder than the well-aged version. I happen to prefer this milder version as I eat it as a snack. However, if you wish to have a strong, dark gold, well-aged version, this is not your cheese.I am well-satisfied with this purchase, the cheese is great and the price is reasonable.
This is an excellent cheese, though expensive compared to what a non-gourman finds at the local grocery store. Treat yourself to this fine cheese. Hope you get to enjoy it!

It seems hard to find a great quality Parmigiano and even harder now that the European Union likes to impose all kinds of rules and regulations upon Italy as to how much and what it can export.  This is a good cheese for the price, but I find it a little dry.  I will order again, unless I find a better cheese.

The cheese is absolutely great and tasty, typical of the original Italian parmiggiano. The 22-month aged cheese has the great flavor and texture that enhances any meals, whether grated on pasta or eaten in chunks as appetizer, especially if followed by a good glass of red Italian wine.

Ocean Spray Craisins Sweetened Dried Cranberries, 25-Pounds PackageI am so happy I found this product.We eat a lot of nuts and fruit at our home and it can get costly. These Ocean Spray craisons are the best. But in the regular (up to 3 pounds) packages, the cost can get just a bit too much for us, and also the constant reordering is a pain. In bulk like this from this supplier, we get a top notch product at an affordable price! They keep just fine, so the quantity is no problem... even if you don't go through them as fast as we do.This gives the best product at the best price.
It was a good product shipped quickly. We use it on oatmeal daily and enjoy it's sweet taste. Have to package it into smaller packages as it is 25lbs bulk, but that is okay.

Delicious tea. Fresh and aromatic. I took a star off because packaging is a little shoddy with lots of loose tea outside the bags and a flimsy box, but for the price it's definitely worth it. It might not make a good gift, though.
I am very pleased with this purchase. I have made tea everyday since it arrived. I will order again when I need more.

column9: Arrived slower than expected, more tea than expected
column10: Although I was initially upset with how slowly the order processed, I was impressed that one order gets you 200 bags of tea rather than the anticipated 100. A (slow) steal!
Love drinking dark hot chocolate in the evening while relaxing with marshmellows in it.  Taste great along side some cookies also.  Great product and good price.

The only drawback to this product is how hard it is to find. Amazon to the rescue...I come here and order several jars to keep on hand. Roasted Chili paste is a key ingredient I use in making a BBQ Tofu dish. I don't like tofu all that much, yet this dish makes it one of my favorites for guilt-free goodness. BTW, this product stores just fine in your cupboard, and when you need a kind of spicy, slightly smokey and unexpected "kick" in any dish, this will do it. Use in making your own BBQ sauce (I combine w/Tamari, lemon zest and sesame oil); add to stir fries, eggs...it's great.

column9: Great cookies at an amazing price !
column10: I love these cookies. I have not been able to find them since I moved here. They are the perfect size for a quick snack or in my case ~ breakfast. They are very fresh. I am not an expiration date decoder but I know freshness when I taste it. They are not too sweet which is something that ruins perfectly cookies in my opinion. As good as the strawberry are, the boysenberry are even better. At $ .37 a package this is a heck of a deal. The boysenberry as a few dollars more but well worth it. Especially for Prime members. I used to buy these for $1 from the work vending machine in 1999.

I love these cookies, but I am very disappointed at Amazon. I bought 2oz package (Pack of 32) and chose Two-Day Shipping. When I got the cookies I found out the expiration date is coming soon. Only "23 days" left. The label is AB091910. If my understanding of expiration date is correct. Can Amazon sell food to people like this??  I even have no right to return it. Very disappointed!!

I had ordered the cookies to be served at an office meeting. Had I known there were 8 cookies in a 2-ounce package, I would have ordered less.  But I'm not really complaining because the extras, I get to share with team members who did not make the meeting.[My best-guess --- the expire-date on this shipment is December 2011.]

column9: Another great product from Knott's BF
column10: I ordered the Boysenberry Shortbread cookies from here.  And I've tried to raspberry from my local grocery store, but they stopped carrying them.  Both were awesome.  They are small, so they make for a great light snack.  The shortbread is perfect to me; it isn't overly sweet or overly buttery.  The only thing I wish Knott's would change, would be the amount of the fruit center.  I know the cookie is small, but I think if the fruit center were larger, it would balance out the cookie nicer.  Plus, without each cookie being individually wrapped, the shortbread crumbles & sticks right to the fruit center, so it covers up the taste even more.  To me that would make it perfect, but as is I'd still highly recommend these to anyone.
Love these cookies. Perfect 3 oz size bags at a great price. I just wish the boysenberry and blueberry varieties were also available in this size.

Qudos to Amazon once again. I have been unable to find these little gems on any grocers shelf in the southeast US. Now, with one click of the button, they can be delivered to my front door. Happiness reigns!

column9: igourmet.com needs to update with amazon
column10: I purchased a smaller version of this gift basket just in time for a family member's birthday and was notified two days after the purchase that the order was canceled.  Apparently, and I checked this later on igourmet.com, the gift basket was out of stock.  So, I decided to purchase this basket.  But, just in case, I checked igourmet.com first.  Well, after checking I saw that this basket is sold out too, but it's not noted here.  My relative's gift will be late now.  So, beware of ordering gifts from igourmet.com here.  The item may be sold out at igourmet and it might not be noted here at Amazon.  So, check igourmet's inventory first at their website, or just order from someone else.
My father thought this was the best cheese ever. The cheese got the cheese just in time for Father's day.  Thanks

I tried this while I was out of state and I'm hooked. I didn't know how available it was in my area, it just takes some searching. The best ginger ale out there. I use this as a treat since it's fairly healthy and mildly sweet. If you don't want to order online, you can usually find it at Whole Foods and Kroger.

When I first started to use IAMS Savory Sauce, my dogs loved it. After a few weeks, they don't seem to care too much for it anymore. They still get a little drizzle in their kibble every once in a while, and will eventually eat it when they are hungry, but they don't consider it to be a treat anymore. I still buy it once in a blue moon when it is on sale because of it contains vitamins and its decently priced, and low calorie. One big negative I have noticed about it is that their face is getting dirty from it. They are white dogs and this product tends to cause increased tear and around-the-mouth stains. I used to buy all different flavors of IAMS Savory Sauce, buy my groomer told me the chicken flavor is best as the beef and pork based flavors can cause an even worse increase in face staining. VitaGravy is a similar product that contains more vitamins, so if your must have some sort of gravy, I recommend VitaGravy a bit more. Or you can also just mix in some warm water with your dog food and let it sit for a bit before you feed it to your dog. This creates a "gravy" like texture and aroma that most dogs love. Not the greatest idea if your dog has dental issues, but a great free solution for picky eaters.
This is the best tea I have ever had.  It is richer and more full bodied then say a cup of lipton.  One teabag makes a nice little pot of tea.

I have always preferred tea for my morning beverage and I like it quite strong, with milk, no sugar--it's a family thing; my grandmother's family was Canadian.  Welsh Brew is the first tea I have found (since Red Rose was bought out by Lipton) that tastes even better than Red Rose used to.  The tea bags are a decent size and the tea, even when strong, is nicely mellow  without any bitterness. When it is brewed strong there is a nice tannic base but again, without the bitterness of a (all) black tea.  It has to be the combination of black and orange pekoe teas in Welsh Brew that makes it so.  RR has gone-in the American market, at least--to an all black tea formulation.  I first bought Welsh Brew at a gourmet shop while on vacation and I liked it so much that I had to locate a more convenient source: the four-pack from Amazon is perfect...enough tea to keep me going for quite a while; I probably drink at least two, if not more, cups of tea a day.

Great buy! I bought for my girlfriend, she LOVES these. We don't own a vending machine or company, we bought for personal use. I swear there are so many, we had to find a storage place for them. She has the whole family eating them. I thought the price was kind of expensive, plus 20 bucks for shipping. Ended up paying almost $90, but overall I was satisfied. My girlfriend loved them and that is all I wanted!

I really like the Hazelnut liquid Stevia.  It has a good nutty taste.  I use it in hot chocolate!  I have even just put some of the drops in my mouth.  I will purchase this flavor again in a few months.

I have tried several flavours of the Liquid Stevia and must admit that I was disappointed in the Hazelnut flavour or lack of.  I use the products in my coffee and while it sweetened the coffee there was no hazelnut flavour.....very bland.  Wouldn't buy it again.

column9: Can't say I liked this one
column10: I didn't like the taste of this hazelnut stevia, It just didn't do it for me at all. I like sweetleaf brand in other flavors but not the hazelnut. To bad as I can't find a good one out there in hazelnut yet.The orange and vanilla taste great.

Horrible product - bitter and tastes like crap honestly.  I paid so much for the shipping it won't pay to return this and I bought 2 !  I decided to buy almond extract and just use non flavored stevia as this was for my coffee.  Don't waste your money.

Don't be fooled by another sweetner, I use this in my coffee every morning.  No other sweetners compare.  Great economic value, a bottle lasts a long time because it takes so little (just a few drops) to satisfy.

I was hoping this would give a nice nutty flavor to my coffee but it just wasn't very good.We had Hazelnut coffee in Europe and it was wonderful but this isn't asnutty flavored as I would like and if I put more in, it just makes the coffee bitter.I use their other flavors and they're very good, Lemon Drop in tea and English Toffee in coffee.

I Love My Coffee Morning With Hazelnut Stevia.I really do!!I need to drop Splenda (For obvious reason), i was searching desperate for a healthy sugar substitute, and i found it on Stevia Sweet leaf, i try many flavors now, i like it all.

I actually prefer CARAMEL POPCORN... when I can get someone tomail it to me.I think,Creamy Caramel Gourmet Popcorn (2 Gallon Bag) from America's Favorite Gourmet Popcorn Company - CornzapoppinandCreamy Caramel Gourmet Popcorn (3.5 Gallon Bag) from America's Favorite Gourmet Popcorn Company - Cornzapoppinare the REAL-DEAL.Two things I know:1.)==============> I sleep better when it's raining.2.)==============> A good movie is BETTER with popcorn!.............................................................................................................................................................You really oughta buy more than one or two... to save on the --- otherwise --- horrible shipping charges..............................................................................................................................................................Remember what the Vulkan says : "Eat popcorn and prosper!"
great, bought it for a party, it was a big hit......can't stop eating it.  It is sweet , so eat in moderation.
It has been hard to find the corn in Costco so figured it would be better to order it. The package came quickly and was great.
I love the Carmel and I love the cheese.  Tried a bag at Costco's and got hooked on them.  Must order more!
Previously I had purchased the Chicago Mix, but decided to try the "Just Caramel" this time.  Great stuff--I highly recommend.

I love this popcorn.  It makes me sad that it's currently out of stock though because Hockey playoffs are coming and I wanted to order another case.  It's just so good, sweet and salty, perfectly crunchy, and it is not overwhelming like some other caramel corns.  This will be my 2nd box of this popcorn and I can't wait, first time I've ever signed up to be notified of shipping too.  I think I might just subscribe to have this stuff delivered every 6 months.

Both my husband and I love this stuff!  It doesn't last the 3 months I thought it would, so now getting an order about once a month. 1 oz of this is 3 Weight Watcher's points, so when I feel like I need a sweet, it's more than one mouthful, it's a whole handful. I am sure I would LOVE the other varieties, but probably more points, so will stick with this for now...if my husband doesn't eat it all.

column9: Easily the best preserves I have ever had.  In a class by itself.
column10: I found Tiptree's Little Scarlet Strawberry Preserves at a fancy hotel at least 20 years ago.  I have kept at least 5 jars of it in my home at all times since then. Some years I had to have it shipped from stores in England because I couldn't find it anywhere in the USA.  I don't care how much it cost, I would buy it.  It is that extraordinary, and nothing comes close.  You name the brand, I have tried it.  Do a google to find the best prices.  I have found it as low at $10.25 recently.Before you die, at least try one jar of this preserve.  Don't get their regular strawberry....it has to be the "Little Scarlet" type.  You can read more about it at their website Tiptree.com, and I have no affiliation with them.  If you have to justify the higher price, pretend to get it as a birthday or Christmas present for a loved one, then make sure you taste it too.  ;-)

Ingredients per the label:"Prepared with 60g of fruit per 100g. Ingredients: sugar, little scarlet strawberries, (pectin & citric acid added when required"Made in England.I agree, this is the best strawberry preserve ever! Just try finding strawberry preserve or jam in a U.S. supermarket with sugar as the ONLY sweetener!
Little Scarlet Strawberries are absolutly the best tasting.  Their preserves are delicious, but it might be questionable to pay the high price.  But if you are looking for the best, look no further.

This is my first experience with "Tiptree", and I chose this particular kind to go with homemade gluten free scones, and "Devon Cream" (or as they call it in the UK-- "cream tea").  ..My family and I absolutely loved it!  The mini whole strawberries are really darling, and DELICIOUS!  I would say this is the BEST strawberry jam/jelly/preserve/conserve I've tried to date!  (FYI: Their 72, 1 ounce jars contain their regular strawberry, NOT "Scarlet" preserves.)In conclusion, I can't wait to order another product from this company!______EDIT:  I have since tried the "Damson" (plum) conserve/preserve, and "Tiptree Strawberry" conserve/preserve-- both with great success!  (And have yet to open their "Tiptree Orange" *medium cut* marmalade.)

column9: Best strawberry jam I've ever had
column10: I'm so glad I found this online! My family for years has always begged people we know who are going to and from the U.K. to buy this preserve (or we look ourselves when we're there). Tiptree's Little Scarlet Strawberry Preserve is the best strawberry jam I've ever had. I don't know if it's because of the specific variety of strawberries they put in there or what, but it's sooooo good.I even have a friend who doesn't like strawberry jams and loves this one.It is a bit pricey, but treat yourself! You won't regret it.

Tiptree Little Scarlet Strawberry Preserves is by far the best tasting strawberry preserves I have ever tasted, and well worth the extra price.  I purchased a case in March and by June, it was all gone (and I live alone!).  There is nothing even close to the deep, sweet strawberry taste of Little Scarlet, with whole, little strawberries bursting with flavor.  Very difficult to find.  Limited supplies. And expensive, well worth the price.  What a wonderful treat on toast, buttermilk biscuits, and in scones, etc., etc.  Made with 60 Gm./100 Gm. of fruit, the highest fruit content available.  Nothing else is even close.  And pure cane sugar.

column9: Delicious and Quick for any Occasion
column10: I found this product to be very tasty.  It only takes two minutes to reconstitute the item into a potato product that can be used in place of mashed potatoes. Used by itself, of course, it is better fried like a pancake or potato paddy, but I have found myself combining it with other ingredients to enhance the taste or texture such as in baked breads.  I would order again.
Every thing was great except the product seems old, not out dated but when mixing the batter just seems old, although the taste was ok. would buy again when this order runs out.

My Mother used to make these when I was growing up.  The potato pancakes were delicious.  I can not make potato pancakes from scratch that have the same taste.  The last time I made the Panni brand, I added a few tablespoons of cornmeal mix.  This gave it a different texture but still had the same great taste.

I am sorry, I have been cooking for over 50 years and have had a lot of potato pancakes both mix and from scratch and these were the worst. They were like eating paste. Did not fry up and were very oily. The favor was ok but the texture was terrible. If that is how they make them in Bavaria then so be it but my Grandma was a little old German lady and I learned from her and this is not what I call potato pancakes. For the price they are twice what I pay for some other brands. Will not try them again.

column9: Very good, but not like homemade.
column10: I should start by saying that I am Bavarian and, although I moved to the US as a child, my mom continued cooking traditional Bavarian food for the rest of her life. I also do a lot of Bavarian cooking, including homemade Bavarian potato pancakes. When I have time, my favorite is still the way Oma (my mom) made them. The Panni (Pfanni in Germany) Potato Pancakes are an acceptable alternative that take a fraction of the time.If anyone is interested in the recipe for the real deal, just leave a comment here, and I'm happy to post it. As I said though, these here are a lot faster and an acceptable alternative. You'll also dirty up fewer dishes in making these than with the original recipe.Either way, "Moizeit!"

column9: there are 2 different ones shredded and Bavarian AND BOTH ARE JUST WUNDERBAR LIKE HOME
column10: I am German and they are for a fast meal just wunderbar , there are 2 kinds Bavarian and shredded for both I take just a little less water then the packet say and then the shredded I make for smoked salmon and horseradich also apple sauce and the bavarien I make with small cut green onion bellpepper and shredded cheese for meat and fish , use good olive oil and back them ... one times the month a wonderful treat ....well can just say my whole friends and neigbour hood is standing on for german kartoffel puffer :-)good appetit you will love love love it and the price here on amazon is very good did buy it in a german store what can I say .. like always.... I love Amazon

column9: My favorite potato pancake mix, great texture and flavor
column10: I'm glad I can find this on Amazon, since only a few stores in my area carry it and only occasionally.  I have a feeling it is not a popular item and it goes out of stock quite often.  If you like Bavarian potato pancakes this is the best brand I've found.  You can make pancakes crispy or chewy, with gradiations in between with a little bit of practice.  Follow the instructions carefully, including allowing the batter to sit for a while to get the texture correct or you will get poorly shaped "lumpy" pancakes.  The flavor has delicious undertones of herbs and just enough salt to make them a great savory snack.  I use olive oil to fry them and it does not significantly change the taste (in case you wanted a healthier oil).  My personal preference is a slightly crispy, more chewy pancake.  They are great with fried eggs and bacon for breakfast, or just plain with sour cream and applesauce.  Curiously, I found they go well with Indian curries.  I serve them as a side with chicken curry if I can't get nan or parathas. It works very well for texture and flavor in combination with the curry.  To save time you can make them in batches and refrigerate them in sealed sandwich bags.  You can re-heat them on a frying pan to make them crisp again.  Not exactly as good as fresh, but they taste just fine.The price is fairly reasonable considering I usually have to go to stores that carry luxury import brands to find this, so the mark-up and taxes is about the same as shipping.  I just wish they shipped less than 12 boxes which is a bit much.  FYI, there are two sealed pouches per box, so you can use half a box at a time if you like.  I hope you enjoy these as much as I do.

If you like potato pancakes, you'll love these. They can be made as thick or thin and crispy as you like. I first found them at a local supermarket about 10 years ago. I was happy as could be because I love these things. Soon, though the store dropped them, but two other local stores started carrying them. Happy again! But soon the other stores dropped them and none were to be found. Even though I asked the store managers, they would'nt carry them. I must have been the only person in southwest Va. buying them. Begins the long drought. I thought I'd never taste them again until my son suggested Amazon because "they sell everything". I don't know about everything but they sell Panni potato pancake mix and I'm now a happy guy. I've tried other mixes and tried from scratch but Panni is the best.'
Fast service and all was in good shape. All in all the service and the shipment went well and we will be ordering again soon.
great product, no problems, much cheaper than in store price, if U can find it. Shipping was good also.
Look at the price.  I always wonder how successful these type of pricing schemes work.  I guess if you aren't paying attention.  Amazing!  I bought in the past, but it was sold by Amazon.
Knowing this China White Tea is good for the body is all that was needed for me to purchase this item.  It blends well for hot or cold tea and I'm happy with the purchase.

This tea is amazingly tasty white tea. For most people they may not know what white tea taste like. Where black tea has the acidic taste of coffee and green tea has a very earth/leafy taste, white tea comes in as you would expect for its color. It is very light tasting with almost a lightly sweet maltiness to it. It doesn't have any of the harshness that you could find in black tea or coffee. And you can't really over brew it to release off-flavors as there is so little to the leaves. I find this tea works best for iced tea, it works well cold and has a much more refreshing flavor that other teas do on a summer day.Of course there are there is the added benefit that it is good for you. If you want to try white tea, this is the product for you.I purchased the organic version before I purchased this one. I saw this one was cheaper so I gave it a try, and I couldn't readily notice any difference. I ended up just mixing the two boxes together and will continue to buy the non-organic in the future as long as it is the cheaper of the two.
Followed Dr Oz, but had an allergic reaction to it. Try a smaller package before committing to the big box.

column9: legends of china white tea 100 bags
column10: the light refreshing taste hot or cold mixed with other teas or alone is what you need on a nice summer day
This Tea tastes like a black tea, mild in flavor, using for a diet plan...2 cups with my lunch. I find it to be a good price for100 tea bags.
I bought the tea to lose weight as on Dr Oz but have not had any results. Would not buy it again.

I eat a lot of pancakes and for health reasons wanted to start using a wheat blend. Tried a few and Hungry Jack is my fav. I typically use a little less water than they recommend as I like my pancakes thick. Also, they recommend leaving the mixed batter to sit for 3 minutes before cooking. THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT as it gives the flour time to rise and creates that light pancake feel that you want. I recommend this to anyone looking for healthier pancakes.

I usually buy Aunt Jemima, but I was craving Pancakes and the store didn't have AJ, so I bought a box of Hungry Jack. Never again. When cooked the pancakes were like I mixed water and flour; they were very chewy and unlike any pancake I've ever had or made.

I was a little worried after the reviews, but mine turned out great. At, first the cookie batter is crumblie, but i just then stirred it with a spatula(i used a beater at 1st) The brownie batter looks like it wnt be enough liquid but it is, mine was not thick at all and all i did was stir it. They came out very good :)

I bought this thinking it would be good & even though I followed the instructions, it was horrible. The brownie mix seemed really dry that I added extra water in hopes off saving it & that didn't work. The cookie mix was looked like clumpy bread crumbs instead of cookie dough. By the this I thought of throwing everything away but my bf was insistent. I greased the pan for the brownie bars & there wasn't enough brownie mix to cover the entire pan & that's considering we used a really small pan! The cookie mix was difficult to place because it was dry and crumb like. After I took it out of the oven it was really hard to take off the pan. I had to really use force with a spatula to take it off. The edible parts tasted ok, the cookie mix didn't really taste like cookies and the brownie mix didn't really taste like brownies, both kinda plain. In the end it wasn't worth the hassel and it was just a complete fail.

This product is delicious!  Whenever I attend a dinner, I always bring a dessert, and the dessert I bring is Nestles Cookie-Brownie Delight.  Everyone, especially chocolate lovers, ask for the recipe. When I tell them it's from a box, and simple to make,they want to go right out and buy it. It's a wonderful treat and goes well with a cold glass of milk.

I love to bake, and I love Nestle Tollhouse, so this would be a great treat for bakesales or roadtrips, right?  NO.  I followed the instructions to make the muffin cup style.  As I was mixing the two batters, the brownie batter came out as dry and hard as paste.  I tried adding a little more water to at least make it mixable, but I still had to scrape it off the spatula and press it down into the muffin cups.The cookie mix - well the instructions said it would be dry & crumbly at one point, but mine never progressed off of dry & crumbly.  Since both the brownie & cookie batters were so dry, I figured that this must be intentional, and that somehow it would magically resolve itself via baking.The muffin pans were thoroughly greased with shortening (not spray), and the "brownie blob with chocolate chip streusel topping" went into the oven.When they came out, they looked great, but they were not coming out of the cups.  I tried loosening them with my trusty loosening spoon, then a butter knife, but they were permanently adhered to the pans (even after leaving them overnight in sheer desperation).The pieces I managed to pry out of the pans just didn't taste good, either.  I had such high hopes for this product, but ended up having to chuck the pans into the trash and buy new ones.  It's a great concept, and I may try to come up with my own version using regular brownie mix and "I measured & mixed it myself" Toll House cookie dough.  What a bummer.

This product is surprisingly good tasting for a fat-free food. I am very pleased with the taste and the obvious health benefits of a fat-free salad dressing. Add this to tuna fish for a healthy meal and good bodily health overall.

I bought these to keep in my candy bowl at work for diabetic colleagues. Normally, I prefer the "real deal", but after trying one of these I think I found a new addition to my favorite sweets. If you read my review on Pillsbury Surgar-Free Bownie Mix, you will see that I'm not always so open-minded to foods that use subsitutes (in case you're wondering, I gave those a 4 star rating). I highly recommend these, even if you are not diabetic.

As every chocolate, this is high in fat and saturated fat. I'm a choco-holic and can't live w/out eating chocolate every day, and since I can't control myself, I ordered these. The taste is really good. If I didn't know it was made with Splenda, I wouldn't have guessed it's made with sugar substitude. The only reason I gave it 4 out of 5 stars is the high price and high saturated fat. But after all, better than eating regular milk chocolate!
This candy might be sugar free but it is VERY HIGH in Carbs. So if you are diabetic and looking for something sweet to eat, this is not the answer.

There were 40 pieces in the bag, 50 cents each bite.  They were OK, but the overwhelming flavor impression was just sweet for the toffee and carmel.  The coconut and mint had flavor more like Mounds and York patties.  They were better than most sugar free candy, but would not be confused with See's chocolates.

I bought these directly from Russell Stover since the shipping cost of two packs was the same as one pack and made them a little less expensive.  All four flavors are quite good-tasting though obviously not as good as the premium brands.  I am not diabetic but wanted a low calorie sweet.  These have about half the calories of regular chocolates.  Here is an approximate breakdown for one piece of candy:  Toffee  0.5 oz.  70 calories  Pecan  0.6 oz.  80 calories  Mint  0.5 oz.  60 calories  Coconut  0.5 oz.  55 calories
These are just too delish. I love the hard toffee best, but they are all rather good. I keep a couple in my drawer at the office in case I have a chocolate emergency. :)
Perhaps it's because I live in a warm climate, but these arrived melted. I'll continue to pay more to buy them at the store to make sure they aren't a melted mess.

The product was so melted upon arrival, we had to throw it out! I would never order food from you again. I have ordered crab cakes from Maryland and cheese cakes from the cheese cake factory, & they were packaged to prevent melting.
I sent this as a gift along with a movie for my father's birthday and he loved it.  It's all the kinds he liked and can eat.

As with other sugar free candy on Amazon's website, I bought this for a diabetic friend who enjoyed it tremendously. The candy is of high quality and extremely good.  I would recommend it highly for anyone who is diabetic.

Were you one of the inventors of the Double Stuf--you know; people who unscrewed their Oreos then combined two? Has sugar become a no-no since those days? Then you might LOVE these Sugar Free Oreos. The chocolate cookie part is just as crunchy as the original recipe and really tastes like an Oreo. The cream center is lighter than an Oreo, feeling like it's a little more whipped. (I resisted the urge to eat it first as I'm no longer a kid... but I was tempted.) It doesn't coat the roof of your mouth with a heavy, oily texture of some cheap cookies. The consistency is still firm and very Oreo-like. The frosting is somewhere between the thickness of the original Oreo and a Double Stuf. They even soak up milk in the same "not really; but yeah, enough!" way as an original Oreo. Wow--is it great! There are 18 cookies in the box. (Don't you hate guessing what you'll get by weight? Now you know.)The bad news: it's still not health food... but you knew that, too (and the package reminds you of this all over it). There's 90 calories in two cookies (and they're approximately the same diameter as the original Oreo), 17g of carbs (1 "carb choice"; 8 in the sugar alcohol of malitol) and 5g of fat. If you're not familiar with the intestinal gasiness and possible laxative effects of malitol--this would have to be your first sugar free goodie, most likely--look it up online. Over eating these WILL have that effect. Three are my limit and have little such effect.
Since being diagnosed diabetic I have searched for "sweets for my sweet tooth".  Although these are never going to be as sweet as the ones with sugar, they are adequate in keeping me quite happy.

We used to get the cookies here locally, but now are unable to find them.  My husband and I are both diabetic and we like sweet treats.  What a thrill to find these online.  I have enjoyed at least one or two a day since they arrived.  Yes, they taste really good.  I do wish they were a little less expensive, though.

These are delicious and addictive! Just like normal Oreos, you won't be able to have just one.There's no after taste and they taste ALMOST like normal Oreos. The cookie tastes a TINY bit different, but if I didn't know they were sugar-free I wouldn't guess they were.If you're a diabetic or just watching your sugar and you're an Oreo lover, definitely buy these

I've been a tea drinker for a long time and I think that "Choice" brand teas are some of the best teas out there. The flavor is simply amazing and even the aroma of the tea bags is very pleasant. When I walk into my kitchen I can smell that familiar fragrant smell. I'm pretty sure it's the bergamot that's added to the tea, but WOW is this a great product. Highly recommended.

column9: Everything you could want in a tea
column10: This tea tastes great, is organic and decaffeinated. It's the perfect combo for me. I don't normally like decaf tea, as it tastes diluted in comparison to caffeinated, but while preggo and nursing, only decaf is acceptable and this tea still manages to have a full, dark taste to it.

I compared the reviews for all of the Earl Grey teas on Amazon, and the reviews said Bigelow (Decaf) was better than Twinings and Stash, so I purchased it.  I also purchased Choice Organic (Decaf) at the same time.I have been comparing the two, and I find that Choice Organic is actually stronger per bag and tastes better.  Even though it is in bags, it almost is as good as loose leaf.  It is a little higher in price, but it seems like it is good quality.  They must've changed the formula since skacleve's review in 2009 below, though not sure.

column9: Not bad, but a little weak for us
column10: My spouse is the one who drinks this most often, as even a decaf Earl Grey affects my sleep.  I'm told that this isn't bad, but it's not strong enough.  Perhaps it's because it's organic, although I don't know that for sure.  Bigelow's is better.Addendum: After a few months of trying four boxes of this tea, we decided its flavor is inferior to Bigelow's Earl Grey Decaf.  Not only is it a bit weaker, but too floral, in a perfumy way.  We won't be buying it again.

column9: wonderful aroma, flavor - and price @ amazon.com!
column10: I've been drinking this tea for a couple of years.Wonderful aroma & doesn't taste like decaf - if you love earl gray tea, it's really worth to try.The price at the local stores rising so much lately, and I attempted to switch to something a bit more reasonable. I don't remember how many different brands I've tried - nothing taste like this earl gray decaf.I'm so glad that I found it here. Great price & I can stock up!
I drink this tea every day when I get to my office.  I love it.  Amazon offers it at a great price.  I don't think I've paid less than $4.50 a box in the store.

I had very hard time switching to decaffeinated since I love the flavor of regular Earl Grey. Fortunately for me, this tea taste just like regular Earl grey and it has pleasant finish, wonderful aroma and no pesticides (organic).
I have such a hard time finding good quality Decaf Earl Grey locally. This one was worth waiting the few days of shipping.

column9: Best lemon herb tea I have ever had
column10: This lemon tea has got the best flavor. I have tried numerous other brands which all did not have a strong enough lemon flavour to satisfy me and lipton brand is the only one I like. I make sun tea in the summer time and hot tea in the winter with it.I would definitely recommend it to anymone that wants a good lemonly flavour.

I love this tea and the local grocery stores Albertsons and Vons have stopped carrying the herbal lemon. They have other herbal flavors but not this one and I prefer your brand over Celestial Seasons.

column9: A Convenient Way to Keep Your Favorite Tea In Stock
column10: My wife loves Lipton Lemon Herbal Tea, but can't always find it in local stores. Amazon's subscription service is a great way to ensure her supply doesn't run out, and it's less expensive than retail!
I couldn't find it anywhere else. It was at a great price and free shipping too. I just had to buy it.
This is the best lemon herb tea. It has a perfect blend of flavors, subtle, but not shy. It's my absolute favorite.

column9: Just what I was looking for
column10: I wanted a citrus herbal tea without cloves or other intrusive spices, and this is perfect.  I found it in the grocery store. It's too pricey to use every day and I was hoping to find it less expensive online.  It's not, plus it's unavailable.  Too bad.

I have used this tea for at least 20 years and had no idea they were disconinuing it even though I bought direct from Lipton for years  when retailers were not carrying it or out of stock. I make an herbal half-caf ice tea and was upset that I could not find it. Here it was on line and just a few pennies more than Lipton direct. Need I say more? I was pleased to find it and it arrived quickly and packed better than Lipton did. I purchased 3 cases that hopefully will last until I can find a replacement product. Thank you!

This lemon-flavored herbal tea surpasses all similar teas of other brands, and I tried them all.  From obscure, expensive boutique teas to grocery store teas.  I am so afraid that Lipton will stop making it.  My favorite products always have a habit of being discontinued, for some reason.  We used to be able to get it in any grocery store, but gradually the tea became harder to find, and currently, it's only available on line.  This tea is full-bodied, fragrant, light, lemony, but not "herby, or grassy or with hay overtones".  I drink it day and night, summer and winter, hot or cold, with no additional sweeteners.  It's perfect the way it is.
Pleasant, no caffeine tea.Good to drink in the afternoon.Much more pleasant, than chamomile.Not available with Meijer Store any more...

I tried this flavor in a mixed package from the grocery store, but I only liked the lemon flavor.  It has a nice blend of lemon and other herbs.  It does not even need to be sweetened.  I am glad that I can order just the lemon herbal tea.
I thought this was one I had gotten oversees, but this was not it. Its too heavy and not light and clear. Did not like this product.

The ranch was ok, the Chipotle is super spicy. But this one is definately my favorite. Great for me while I'm on the HCG diet cuz I tried making my own dressing but it was way too vinegary. This was a good option. Not too fond of the Brands sucrolose aftertaste, but it's worth having a delicious salad once in awhile.

Walden Farms has some good products but this is not one of them.  I am actually not a fan of any of the dressings.  You would be better off making a low calorie, fat free dressing from fresh ingredients. Google "hcg approved salad dressings" and you should be able to find some good low cal, low carb, no sugar and no fat dressings.

I went to Publix earlier today and bought this dressing. Let me start by saying this is absolutely NOT Caesar dressing, at least not by any standard I'm familiar with. There is no flavor here whatsoever, no anchovy, no parmesan cheese, no black pepper, barely any garlic. There is no tanginess either.  The only discernable flavor is that of cheap vegetable oil and bad egg. It tastes as if someone took generic mayonnaise, watered it down, and then added more oil to it. It really is that bad! I have never reviewed anything on here before (although I come here often for good advice), but this dressing was SO AWFUL ,I felt compelled to share my story. You  would be far better off buying any store brand for half the price. Incidentally, we threw the entire salad out, and went back to the store to buy the ingredients to make a new one.

I've been purchasing this brand for years in Grocery stores... but it's getting hard to find (can sometimes be found at Wal-Mxxt.  I ordered the case - no differant than grocery.However, this does have a short expiration date - so if you don't plan to eat Caesar Salad Frequently, a case may not be the way to go for you.

I am very picky about salad dressing.  It is few and far between that I find a dressing that I like.  I must say I could eat this dressing by itself! It is that good.  In the past I have resorted to making my own dressing, as I am that picky.  Another plus is this dressing has no sugar in it.  Buying this at the store is EXPENSIVE!!!  My store sells it for $5+ a botte, so finding it here at this price was awesome.

I love Caesar salads. So when my favorite dressing (Marzetti's refridgerated Caesar vinaigrette) was no longer carried by my local grocery stores, I purchased every bottle of Caesar dressing I could find in order to replace it. I had hoped that because both Cardini and Marzetti are manufactured by the same company that I would be in luck. I did eventually find another I liked, but this one came nowhere near.It tastes like egg salad. Seriously. Just to be sure, I went and tasted it again right before this review. Yup. Egg salad. Which is great for when I want to make egg salad (seasoning in a bottle without having to mess around with mayo and such), but I couldn't eat this on a salad. No way. No how.For a creamy dressing, I actually ended up liking Newman's Own the best. For a vinaigrette (no, it's not traditional but saves on a ton of fat and calories), Girard's Light Ceasar (also made by the same as Cardini's) won out.

column9: Beware--the beans are not whole beans!!!
column10: I ordered this item as it was described "Whole Bean".  My 3 bags came each were in a vacuum sealed foil coffee bag with "Whole Bean" printed on the label.  However, over the "Whole Bean" wording, there was a transparent sticker that said, "Drip Ground".  I found this coffee at King Soopers when I was visiting CO in June, and wanted to keep drinking it at home in my own French Press.  I grind my coffee fresh immediately before I make it.  The coffee is the Nordic Blend, just not whole bean as described.  I contacted Customer service and they were lovely about refunding me (they don't accept returns on food items) and are looking into seeing if this was an error/inventory mistake.  I hope I am able to order this coffee in it's whole bean form in the near future!
I can't find these candies in the store so I had to Find them and buy a case! Love them!

column9: It was only the RANCID smell.
column10: We repeatedly tried Muesli # 11 but it smelled (and tasted) rancid. In response to our complaint, the US distributor confirmed that the smell is due to a problem with an unrefined sunflower oil that was used when toasting: Quote "Now there should not be anything you smell upon opening a bag of the muesli. If you tasted it, even with the smell, you would seethat nothing tasted wrong, old or rancid. It was only the smell." Unquote. Buy it if you don't care about the smell (or taste). We won't anymore.

column9: Great Kit for the price point
column10: I bought this kit along with a Cab Style back in October. I bottled them January 2, 2010. So far the wine is aging nicely. It has started smoothing out considerably. With a couple of more months of aging I expect it to be a very drinkable wine. Considering that it is $40-50 less than other kits I have made, it holds up well against those kits. I bought this one not only for the price point, but also because it is one of the only Dolcetto kits available.I was a little disappointed that no oak was included in this and the Cab kit.All-in-all, one will not be disappointed with the results, and a little tinkering may make it even better.Update 12/20/2011: I have subsequently made another Dolcetto, this time adding oak chips for a week after stabilizing and fining. This has really added some body to the wine and has improved the finished product immensely.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for, and ready to order more!
column10: I love this drink. I used to buy it as Costco but moved and the local Costco doesn't carry it. Have hunted high and low for it and am so pleased that I found this item. Running low and will order more as soon as I finish this. Seller shipped fast also.

I was given this as a gift about 2 years ago by my in-laws.  Now I can't stop buying it.  The only problem is that it is not sold in stores here in TN.  Therefore, I purchase it off Amazon.  The AskDirect seller has always been speedy in their delivery of this product.  The drink can be served hot or cold.  I prefer it hot!  It is SO delicious.  I have tried other brands and this one to me is by far the best!

The D'Amore Frappacino mix is great for those cool coffee flavored drinks that are now so popular. I have been using this product for about a year and have tried making the drinks without it. Not the same. This mix gives the iced mocha drinks a very distinctive and delicious flavor that can't be had without it. As for the price, I believe it to be way too high. Especially considering that the cans are not full (settling during transport I'm sure is part of the reason for that) plus the fact that it does not last long when the drinks are made as often as I make them. I can get this same product in the same size cans for much less at a warehouse market. I will probably order again, though, since I don't have easy access to a warehouse market but I won't buy as often as I would like to. Would be great to get some kind of a deal for repeat orders.

I was very pleasantly surprised when I first tasted one of these cookies!  They were soft and tasty--much like my home-baked peanut butter cookies--only better since I tend to over-bake mine!I have many allergies so it's difficult for me to find pre-made cookies I can safely eat.  Barley and corn starch, which I am very allergic to, find their way masked in many ingredients for pre-made food products.  I was very glad to find the ingredients in these cookies are safe for me:  Peanut Butter;  Molasses; Eggs; Rice Syrup and Grape Juice; Flour Base (Brown Rice Flour, White Rice Flour, Tapioca Starch, Sweet Rice Flour, Xanthum Gum); Dry Roasted Peanut Pieces; Gluten-free Natural Flavor, Baking Soda; Sea Salt. This means they are gluten-free as well.With only 11g of carbohydrates, 7 g of sugar, and 3 g of protein, I can indulge with 2 for a mid-day snack without the guilt!If you are too busy to make home-baked cookies yourself, these are certainly a viable alternative...and they're quite healthy, too!  Highly recommended!

column9: The old receipe was much better
column10: These cookies were awesome until early spring 2009.  As of right now they no longer have a fresh baked oven crispness which melts in your mouth and the espresso flavor is lacking.  I keep trying out different box dates and unfortunately they are not like the original receipe.  Being an ex-addict of these cookies right now, which might be a good thing, I'm so disappointed that they aren't like the original cookies. I'll keep watching the boxes to see if they have the old look again one day.

I love these!  The only thing good about being on a gluten free diet is discovering these cookies!  I'm hooked.  I love the coffee flavor mixed with chocolate.  And for a dessert all the ingredients are pretty good!

I am so happy to have found a place to buy gluten free products for almost 1/2 of what the healthfood stores charge!  Delivery was a bit slow, but they arrived fresh and intact, nonetheless!THANKS AMAZON!

Pamela's products are wonderful. Be careful though.  These cookies have actual pieces of espresso in them.  If you have to question your love for coffee, then these aren't for you.  These have a wonderful texture and great flavor (just like all of Pamela's products).  Easier and better tasting than homemade ones.

When I first tried these cookies, I was both extremely happy and sad at the same time .  Happy 'coz I was blown away by how good they are, and sad because I can already see myself gaining a few pounds.  I love how they overwhelm my mouth my coffee goodness.  Cookies didn't use to be one of the items on my regular grocery list, but now these cookies will be, if my local supermarket can keep them in stock (I always just manage to find the last box of Espresso Chocolate Chunk buried under the other flavors).
My teenage daughter loves these cookies with morning tea.  They smell like coffee and the chocolate chunks taste  much better than those in a cheap chocolate chip cookie.  I will keep these on hand.

This cookie has a wonderful taste and an aroma of fresh coffee. It had a nice amount of espresso flavored chocolate chunks. The cookie was smaller and the box was smaller than the Pamela's Chocolate Chip Cookies I buy in the supermarket. I had no problem with that. They were not mealy or crumbly. They were hard. I had to break them with a sharp knife point in a small dish, but that makes them a good dunking cookie, if you like that style of cookie eating. My supermarket does not carry the espresso cookie anymore so I was delighted to see them available on Amazon. I plan to order more right now.
I was very surprised at how good this cookie tastes.  Can't decide if this or the lemon shortbread is my favorite.  Will definitely be ordering these cookies again.
