I ordered this Tiki Cat Variety Pack to try out. The variety pack is over 1/2 gone but the only flavor my cats would eat so far is the Honolulu Luau Tuna (tuna, rice, crab surimi) in the purple can. They did not like any of the flavors that came in two's in this variety pack. I have 4 flavors left to try - the Waikiki Luau (tuna rice with tilapia), Molokai Luau (tuna rice on calamari), Bora Bora Luau (sardine cutlets) and the Makaha Luau (mackerel & sardine). With my cats, they like the Weruva canned food the best. I also recently tried out a can of Addiction Safari Buffalo Meatloaf Canned Cat Food which they both devoured. None of these canned cat foods stink horribly by the way.

My cat loves Tiki cat, and the flavours in the variety pack are her top favourites. I try to give these to her 1 out of every 4 meals since cats are not supposed to eat a lot of fish.Though I first ordered this from Amazon, I now order it from National Pet Pharmacy as it is listed for $10 there, and with their promo codes and if you're willing to buy in bulk, you can get get a discount on the shipping cost and a great deal for this overall.

I've tried to change my cats' food from one of the questionable protein, full of-by-productmain brands for over two years.  Every time I would try something new, I got the cat version of "ain't gonna happen in any of my 9 life times."Then we tried Tiki Cat Luau varieties.  Now, the cats are ready to put me on a pedestal.  What a nice change from the normal life of the cats' chief of staff.I have five cats. I thought there might be at least one flavor which wasn't appreciated, but I was mistaken.  I have 5 mewling, begging, talking, figure-eighting, how fast can you get it in my bowl, cats each morning. Even my husband noticed the texture and natural ingrediants which are readily identifiable.Five paws up.

Our Local Pet store discontinued carrying this product, and I was happy to see it available on Amazon .  Our 2 cats do back-flips for Tiki cat.  They literally sit & lick their lips for 5 minutes after eating!  I like the fact that it's natural, not loaded with fillers, etc.

I try and feed my cats the good stuff, avoiding fillers, grain etc etc. Having read glowing reviews I felt confident that at least one of my three would enjoy this food (aged 16, 1 year and 16 weeks). Well I have been through most of the flavors and so far, they have walked away from all of them. Packaging is great and the stuff looks almost fit for human consumption !!! But sadly, not for my kitties.

My cats will generally eat this but the last two times the cans came bug infested. It appeared that the cans were damaged as swarms of little black bugs came with the food and I threw both sets out. Why, do you ask, did I buy a second time? I wanted to give the company the benefit of the doubt but the second time the same thing happened, after sitting in pantry, when I went to grab a can there were small black bugs inside the plastic wrap covering the cans.

I feed a small (3 neutered) social colony of feral cats, with an occasional 4th guest. I generally buy cases of Friskies plus of course kibble.  Good dependable food for the crew.I decided to get them a treat and HOLY COW!!  The old man of the colony, Garf (he is a documented 21 years old) heard the back door open and came loping up the porch....I popped the top on the can and he went on RED ALERT and began spinning around my legs....his 2 year old daughter Spook must have radar as she too came flying down the driveway...open another can!When they eat the always leave a bit - for later - even tho' I feed them wet food twice a day---they GOBBLED this day....unfortunately (for them) this is only treat food...the cans are too small to make Tiki part of their regular diet.....but they were sure happy!!!

column9: WOW. First canned cat food I've felt good about feeding to my cat
column10: I bought a 12 pack of the Tuna on Rice with Prawns after reading reviews here on Amazon. If you're still on the fence about trying Tiki brand - do it!The graphic design on the labeling and the whole "Tiki" thing seemed contrived and cliche to me - "Oh, just one more boutique cat food company selling crap out of a pretty can." I was dead wrong.Smells real, looks real; it IS real. I've checked out multiple reviews, review sites, and the company's website. Finally, a cat food company that cares about the environment and our pets as much as we all should.The bowl has been licked clean each time (I mean, spotlessly clean. Even with powder medication sprinkled on top). Frankly, I'm a little embarrassed over how jazzed I am by this product. But it's a wonderful feeling to feed your pet something that's whole, healthy and real.
I bought this cat food as a change and/or treat for my 4 cats.  Unfortunately, none of my cats like it, so I'm now feeding it to the ferals.  I went back to Meow Mix cups which they love.

Neither of my two cats would eat this.  Not sure what is added to these canned products that turns them off so much.  One cat eats mostly raw chicken & liver, with rabbit, bird, & mouse thrown in.  I was hoping she would like this as it seems a little more chunky than most canned cat food, however she just sniffed & refused each variety.  The other cat eats mostly dry, some cooked chicken, mouse, bird, rabbit thrown in from the yard.  I expected him to turn away, which he did.  The search is still on for a canned that he will eat.  Would love to get him off of dry, even to raw chicken, etc...

column9: Good stuff - even my finicky cats liked it!
column10: This seems to be really good cat food. My cats liked it a lot. I like it that it's all real fish, with no grains or fillers. I'll probably buy it again.

column9: Cat likes it more than I do
column10: I bought this to test the various varieties on my cat and to give him a change of pace.  He seems to really like it but I despise the smell (of course, you can't change that tho wouldn't it be nice?).  Frankie especially likes it when I add water and make it soupy which is a win-win for both us since I then know he's getting enough water.

column9: Looks like real food. My cats love it.
column10: Recently, after reading about nutrition for cats, I've started being concerned about the grain content in the food my cats eat. Both are quite healthy and active. To provide good quality protein rich foods for my cats, I was dreading having to cook for them (I don't cook too much for myself either). I visited the local Animal Feeds and Needs to explore other healthy food options. As of now I've found 2 brands that my cats like and are good for them (I think) - Tiki Cat and Weruva. I feed them kibble in the day and keep some out at night too. But at night, I feed them Tiki Cat or Weruva.1. The food in the cans looks like real pieces of shredded fish and a jelly like gravy - not processed chunks of some unrecognizable mush.2. The cats start meowing as soon as I pop a can open and love it. :) :) :)3. I add a little bit of water in and mix it up well with a spoon. I like the idea that they get more liquid in this way.4. I don't need to cook for the kitties. And they still get yummy, healthy food.Perfect.. or should I say Purrrfect!!

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I have a raw fed 6 month old kitty but while transitioning him from dry food and now for a treat I give him a little of the Tiki Cat brand food. One reason I make the exception for this brand because when you open the can, you can identify what it is your cat is actually eating. No "mystery meat", no paying for or having him ingest sketchy fillers - no questioning "what *EXACTLY* is a BY PRODUCT !?! - *shudder*......"Inside the Tiki Cat can you'll find what looks like a tiny restaurant takeout container for kitties - layered nicely, chunks of real seafood, looks and smells good!  There wasn't a single flavor he walked away from. Highly recommended!

I have two adult cats in my house that share a can of Tiki daily. Though the can is small, I quarter it for a morning snack and an evening snack for my girls (they have dry food readily available throughout the day). Opening a can of Tiki is like opening a can of 'real' food. It's amazing. The ingredients are high quality and my girls run for the bowl as soon as they hear the food cupboard open. The variety pack makes it incredibly easy to give my girls a new flavor every few days. They love it and I love it for them!

My daughter gave us two cans of this food for our cat Isabelle and she finally loves something. She's always been a picky eater and we routinely threw away entire cans of Fancy Feast and other brands. Tiki Cat King Kamehameha has hit the spot four our little girl. Yay!

I was hopeful my 2 indoor cats "Hannah & Halley berry" would love this Tiki Cat food, but they smell it and walk away from it, even my outdoor kitty "Rusty" will not eat it. I am going to give it to my daughter and maybe "Miss Kitty" will like it, sorry I can't give this one a good review. I was hopeful!!!!!!!

column9: Variety is the spice of life.
column10: It seems that Tiki Cat food is the only cat food my cat will eat. I have tried other brands that say natural, human grade, etc., but my cat wont eat them. Usually, despite these claims, the food comes in a pate style format which is not "natural". With Tiki, if the label says tuna & chicken, or tuna & prawns, you see actual pieces of the items, not a mish mash pate. My cat looks at her food bowl, then looks up at me and meows for me to give her something else. So, I put back any variety of Tiki, and she eats it. Also, do we eat the same thing every day all day long, so why should your cat? She seems to like the variety, or at least the slight variations. I only wish that Tiki did actually make more varieties than variations on tuna, like turkey.

column9: The fussiest cat on earth loves this!
column10: My 9 year old cat, Lupita, has always been a problem eater.  She'll lap at food, and walk away.  Imagine my surprise when she lapped this food, and then hung around to chew some up!  She continues to do this, with every single kind!  We have five cats, and they are all jealous of the scent, when I feed Lupie.  I let them finish after her, and they're thrilled about it.  If I had more money, I'd feed it to them all.  I wish I could visit the place where they cook this food.  It smells heavenly!  I'm thinking of tasting it ... :)  Thank you, Amazon!

column9: My Stupid Cat Loves This Stuff
column10: Holy crap, this must be what they serve in Kitty Heaven because Princess Fluffball Fishbreath loves this stuff. Ordering another batch right now......

Growing up my cats were raised on grocery store pet food that, upon opening a can, was unrecognizable as food. It just looked like a oozing brown sponge of muck. And it would come with the most horrendous smell that seemed closer to manure than food. Tiki Cat is nothing like that. When I open the can I both recognize the fishy parts and it smells like seafood. There's also plenty of gravy, which my cats lap up. Even though I've mainly switched them to a raw food diet, there's always the once in awhile morning or evening where the raw food hasn't thawed yet or some other mishap. It's good to have quality canned cat food my cats love as a back up.The first ingredient is water. The second is fish, which is good for pet food. They're always ordered by the largest quantity first. It always amazes me when I pick up cat food that doesn't have meat listed first or second. Cats are carnivores! Meat should be the largest percentage of their diet, not grain. I love this pack has a ton of different varieties of fish, not just tuna or salmon, so that my cats get more diversity and nutrients in their diet.
My cats love this food.  Small cans, are more of a treat than a meal.

A mixed review from the cat family... They loved some of the gloppy varieties, but when I opened a can of "cutlets" it freaked us all out as it's big fish chunks, bones and all. I was alarmed picturing that puked up on my bed. My 16-year-old looked at it and me as though I'd gone completely mad and backed away from the dish, as did a younger cat. Noble effort, Tiki Cat, and sorry, but they want their glop. The "cutlets" have gone to the outdoor feral tomcats we care for, who thought it was magnificent, but it's a bit too pricey for them to have regularly.**Added: An enthusiastic 5-stars from the cat family on the salmon-chicken variety:TIKI Cat Canned Food for Cats, Napili Salmon Chicken Recipe  (Pack of 12 2.8 Ounce Cans)

column9: A Cat With Fussy Food Tastes
column10: My cat is a pedigree Birman and she has a very fussy food palette. We feed her the most healthy and natural/organic packaged food for cats that we can find. She loves the Tiki Cat King Kamehameha product!
My cat really enjoys it and I can see why with the large chunks of fish and other goodies I can spot when I feed her. I do feel like i'm making her happy with this product! :)

I have tried numerous healthy cat foods and have looked online at numerous websites stating which other name brands.  After trying this one and having my four month old kitten liking it, I will continue to buy it for him.  Thanks Tiki Cat for producing something that is healthy and tasty to my cat!

I have an exotic Cat Breed and have tried all the expensive organic dry foods as she has a sensitive system. The litter box was horrendous and left us all wanting to leave the house for hours! Plus her BMs were so runny and even had blood in it, which the vet said was due to the harshness of the food. So I went to wet food. Ideally I would love to serve Raw but I just don't have the time, so i started out with the Big Name super market brands, but not only did they make her box worse, they were unappetizing to even look at. just mush! So I went to the local mom and pop pet store and looked around. I found a couple cans of Tiki cat and for under a buck each so I said Why not. I took it home, gave her one and we are hooked! I love that its real fish with no added JUNK. You can see and smell whats in it. My cat meows for this! I did not buy from Amazon but I do get the multipack auto shipped through another site. I wish they would expand their fish flavors though, seems to be mostly Tuna and Sardines (which are rather chunky so she sometimes has an issue chewing them), but Im just happy that her poo is actually normal, virtually smell free, and she seems so much more active and playful!

I might have overlooked the fine print, but this particular pack has only seafood recipes - no chicken.  First ingredient on the latest can fed (Tuna on Rice w/Tilapia) does indeed state Tuna, then water, brown rice, white fish, no by-product. I wouldn't eat "crude protein" or "crude fiber", but this is a step in the right nutritional direction for my cat, away from exclusive dry foods.

I have an older cat and she consistently loves all the flavors in here. I originally bought it as a sampler but she just loves all of them so much that I just keep getting the variety pack. I am on my 5th case and I still have not had any issues with bad cans or too large bones. She loves this food and it looks like what it says on the can when you open it up.

This is a great sampler pack to find out which flavors your cats love-- mine loved them all-- or to keep mixing things up so they don't get bored.My cats go nuts for this stuff. They see me go near the can and they can't help meowing in excitement. It is, on the whole, one of the best brands, but also one of the most expensive. There are a lot of choices, and one of the best parts about it is that they have recognizable pieces of food in there. It's not just nondescript mush. I loved that part!However, when I came home the other night, our apartment smelled like *death* and it took me just a few minutes to discover that the culprit was the open can I had fed them about two hours previously. I've never had that issue with other cat food brands in such a short time. So if you choose to feed your cats this, please remember to rinse the cans as soon as you're done.

i am very happy with this product, it's natural and real iwth no by-products. in fact, humans could eat it too. My cats love it and always lick a place till last drop. This food is good and it's nice to spoil cats once in a while.

I tried a single can of TIKI foods in a few flavors at a local health food store. She want ape-nuts over it.  Will def buy again.  The only flavor she didn't really care for was the sardin something.  The Lanai Luau was her favorite-purple can.  Will but  a case of that one!
Our cat loves the food. We sprinkle his medication on food to make sure he gets it each day.The product is healthy for him.

This stuff is a little pricey for a full-time wet food diet, but if you free-feed your cats on a quality dry food it makes for an excellent dinnertime treat. I recommend you buy the smallest variety package to see which flavors your pets like and then buying those flavors in bulk. My two kittens enjoyed every flavor except the rice/tilapia combo, which was greeted with nonchalance from one and vomiting from the other. But they would beg and try to climb my pantlegs for the sardines and the calamari, so those two will be the ones I order next.

My rescued cat has finally taken to canned cat food, and it's Tiki.  She is at the point where I get "the stare" until she gets her daily fix of Tiki.  She has her dry food out at all times, and Tiki is more a treat then daily maintenance.  We usually get 4 days from 1 can, and hence the cost is spread out......  would highly recommend.

column9: Good variety pace, great cat food
column10: My cats love this mostly grain-free food (it does have some rice in a few recipes but it is visible and meant to be, not hiding corn or by-product meal like in some other foods).  I highly recommend the brand, especially for picky kitties.  The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is that the variety pack doesn't include more of the available flavors.  Cats may not mind but it makes me feel like a better cat mom when I change things up a bit.

This was a new product for my household.  It is REAL fish product in larger chunks, and VERY tasty by all x6 cats reviewed.  I feed this as a treat or when somebody needs extra nutrition (the fleas have been ravenous).  It took a week or so to get it, but the result was VERY happy.

I had been looking for (as natural) type of cat food as possible for my two cats.  I found this and they absolutely love it.  Between the tiki pet food and the evo innova, my older cat is not as grouchy, his fur looks even shinier and he actually sort of plays...well for him in any case.  They loved the sardines.  They loved all the cans.  They will sit at their bowls and meow at me...wanting the canned food (they get the canned food twice a week.)  I got my mom and sister to try their cats on it, and they also love this cat food.  The food has chunks of fish in it and thin strips of different veggies.  Your cat really will love this food.  As close to what they would get in nature as most indoor cats are going to get.  I have been thinking about switching the cats to wet food and delete the dry food altogether.  I am not sure how much wet food they would get in one day.  Seems to me that would be the proper diet, seeing as they are meat eaters in nature, with some grass thrown in every once in awhile.In any case, this cat food is really great.  I will continue to purchase this for my cats.

column4: R. J. Raveling "for the love of music"
column10: I have two boys cats, one is very picky in what he eats.  But they both seem to really enjoy all the flavors ofthis variety pack.  I ordered it again for them along with Weruva Chicken with gravy and they love that too.I'm very happy I found this food for them!
My cats were very happy with this food. They didn't like the sardine varieties, but they enjoyed all the others, and I was happy with the high quality ingredients.

column9: Tiki Cat food  Bella says No Likie
column10: Bella is not a really picky eater. She loves and eats Soulstic canned foods in gelee' and also loves Weruva Marbella Paella. The Tiki cat she walked away from and I could not say I blamed her. The tuna (all of them) was a nasty red dead color and like mash. I guess she is not used to food that looks like or smells like that. Soulstic foods have mostly white meat tuna in chunks not mush, and Weruva is also chunks. Sorry Tiki cat Bella gives you a paws down!Tiki cat King Kamehameha although says it is a variety, however it is mostly tuna flavors, they are juicy and mushy, not chunky and gelled. They do not look appealing.

My cat hated this food , at least I  think she did  because she would not getnear it.  I tried two different cans and she would not eventry it.  I agree with her that  it smelled terrible, not a smellI want in my house.  Gave her a can of her favorite food,Elegant Medleys White Chicken Florentine, which was gonein a few minutes.

Maybe my cat is too spoiled with fancy feast, i wanted him to like something more healthy, he eats a little of this, then comes back and meows for his usual fancy feast. :).. Some of the flavours he eats, some others he refuses to, so I think its ok as long as I figure out which he likes and ones he hates.

column9: Big expectations but cat didn't like it
column10: I loved the write ups & reviews this product had gotten & I wanted to feed my cat better food so I decided to try Tiki Cat.  When I opened the can I was pleasantly surprised because it looked just like a can of tuna but w/ bigger morsels.  In other words, it looked like human food.  The first night my cat loved it, but from the second night on she either didn't finish it or want to eat it at all.  I guess I have a finicky eater.
I know this is a good brand, but my cat will not eat it and that is the only reason I give it 2 stars.

This is just what I wanted: a cheap sample pack of fun, and healthy, new flavors for my cat to try.  I try to feed her mostly chicken and turkey as her base food because I think of fish as more of a treat than a staple, and trying new things encourages her to eat during the day when I leave for work.The first type she tried was the Mackerel and Sardines.  She loved it!  She's partial to the tuna, though- scarfs the tuna down in about 10 minutes.I feel good feeding her real food that she enjoys.  I did find bones in the can, but they break down when you touch them so I'm not worried about her ingesting them (extra calcium? haha).UPDATE 10/18/12She hates the Sardines, but likes every other flavor.

Some of the flavors, it's like the mush the entire fish into the can.Looks gross, smells super strong, and worst of all...My Nana-beans (yes a nickname, not her real name) looked at me like i was retarded when i tried to pass this stuff off to her as food.) I think it had no or only one of the chicken consomme. which is the only tiki cat flavor she'll eat.May I recommend Soulistic cat food, my boobie loves the pumpkin & chicken.
Tried this cat food for Tony the Cat.  He didn't like it so much.  Wouldn't buy it again.

I've always liked Knorr products and this is no exception. The boullion dissolves effortlessly in liquid and the flavor is wonderful. There are a lot of different ways to use boullion as a flavoring agent and I'm not shy about experimenting. It was fortunate, however, that I took a closer look at the ingredients list on the label -- the fourth item on the list is monosodium glutamate! I have no problem with MSG myself but I have friends who suffer different degrees of allergic reaction to it, one in particular who becomes very ill.I'll have to be very careful when and if I use this boullion when I'm having company for meals. Had I known of the MSG content, I wouldn't have made the purchase, much as I like the product otherwise. Given the publicity about MSG sensitivity, I feel Knorr should have shown a clear warning at the point of sale at Amazon. One can't read ingredient labels online, more's the pity. That's why I knocked a star off the score.So count this as a warning: if you or those you'll be feeding can't handle MSG, don't buy this boullion. Otherwise, it's really good.

I was looking for a different style chicken flavoring that was not as artificial as the ones at local stores and decided to try this one. It was only available in cube form at local stores so I was forced to go online for the powder style. It has a much better flavor than the cubes
Product shipped promptly and arrived as described. The same great product I get at the store but by far a better value

I use this (and the beef flavor) more as a seasoning than a soup. Great for stews and such -- even with beef dishes I often use the chicken flavor. Goes in with stuffing recipes. Can replace some or all of the salt for different recipes.I do use the chicken as a soup base -- I usually make the soup with black pepper, dill, and lemon juice as seasonings, and sometimes add a bit of milk for creamier soup. Also sometimes mix in the low-sodium broth powder as well to get great flavor without over saltiness.The granules allow you to use as little or as much as you need. Price here at Amazon is a deal since I do use enough of this for the 12-pack.

Excellent product. I used this stuff to create an entire vest out of flank steak. When my roommate saw what I was doing, he was all "Hey, what are you doing?" And I was like "I'm gluing a bunch of flank steaks together to make a vest. what does it look like I'm doing". The meat glue was easy to use and bonded the separate flank steaks together almost seamlessly. The resulting vest was quite sturdy and surprisingly water proof. I'm not sure if the glue had anything to do with that, or if meat is just naturally water proof. All I can say for sure is that the meat vest served its purpose, and I am happy with my purchase of this product. Anyone looking to glue separate pieces of meat together, for whatever the reason, might consider this product.

I find that the flavor of coffee is improved by using Coffeemate.  Buying it in large containers is fine for around the house, but buying the small envelopes of the stuff is more convenient to carry.  Liquid packets don't taste the same and can be crushed, leading to an unholy mess.  The envelopes or packets are great to carry in a pocket or computer bag (my wife carries them in her purse) for when you go out, and for travel they can't be beaten.  The only bad thing is to find someone who sells them.  The creamer comes in Original, French Vanilla, and Hazelnut, but try to find ONE distributor who carries all three, and good luck!!!Bob Morton

The mango is very good.Tastes exactly like it should.I will buy this product again.I tried the PAPAYA and did not likeit.I believe that the shipping is high.But ships very quickly.bbp 63 okc ok  retired
A few of the flavors taste okay, but most are pretty gross.  It doesn't stay on the popcorn very well either

You'd think that with charging $52.84 for an eight-jar variety pack of popcorn seasoning, that the company might have taken the trouble to list under "Product Description" WHAT THE FLAVORS ARE??!! I'm not ordering a grab bag of who-knows-what for this price.

I grew up in Africa and they sold this delicious curry powder. I'm so happy I can now order it online at amazon since I used to have to order it from Canada. No ingredients are listed but I'm sure it has Coriander, Turmeric, Mustard, Cumin, Chillies, Fenugreek, Pepper and Curry Leaves. At least that is how it tastes. This is the curry I've always used to make curried eggs and curried chicken. Here is a recipe my grandmother taught me to make. The medium curry powder works perfectly in this recipe.Curried Chicken CasseroleTo save time use precooked chicken breast. You can usually find iton the refrigerated isle along with deli meats and cheese.2 (6-ounce) packages oven roasted carved chicken breasts1 large head broccoli, use tops only1 cup sliced mushrooms1/2 cup chopped yellow onion1/4 cup freshly chopped parsley1 can cream of celery soup1 can cream of chicken with herbs soup1/2 cup fat-free milk2 teaspoons curry powder1/4 teaspoon freshly ground Tellicherry peppercorns1/4 teaspoon garlic salt1/4 teaspoon paprika1 teaspoon lemon juice1 cup shredded cheddar cheese2 cups French Fried Onions1. In a 5-quart sauté pan filled with boiling water, cook the broccoli for 10-15  minutes.2. Add the mushrooms, onion and parsley and simmer for another 5-10 minutes.  Drain and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Add the chicken, cut up  into cubes. This is easily done with a scissors.3. Preheat the oven to 350°.4. In a large bowl, blend together the celery soup, cream of chicken soup, milk,  curry powder, pepper, garlic salt, paprika and lemon juice.5. Pour the curry sauce over chicken and vegetables. Stir just until well blended.6. Bake for 30 minutes then top with cheese and French fried onions and bake an  additional 10 minutes.  Makes 4-6 servings

This is an excellent product. The hot is hot ,and unless you have a severe aversion to spicy food ,this medium powder has just the right amount of heat. Don't add straight powder. Mix with olive oil and make a paste first ,or you may have clumping.

The fulfillment was efficient and prompt. Having curry powder in a tin is far better than having a packet in a box. The 2 Pack is great as the sealed content remains fresh. This company has a great range of products and I look forward to supporting them in the future!

My husband is on a strict low sodium diet and was a true salt lover.  This sauce (which is low sodium) has been a wonderful addition to his strict diet and when put on chicken or fish it livens the flavor tremendously. We particularly love it on baked tilapia which has been dipped in Panko crumbs!
While I could do without the hot pepper element, it's still an awesome sauce worthy of five (or more!) stars.

I love this sauce over grilled chicken breast or even over ice cream as the bottle states . I was skeptical about putting this sauce over my vanilla ice cream but I gave it a try and is just great. I love this sauce.
Amazon stopped selling these for awhile.  I just received my order and am quite pleased. These are very fresh and tasty.  I'm glad I ordered them.
Mounds have been a favorite of mine for sixty years. They still taste the way they did back then. You just have to pay more that a dime for one!
These Mounds bars arrived fresh and fast.  If you are in the mood for a succulent treat, you should give these a try

column9: I will never buy regular tortillas again
column10: These are the yummiest flour tortillas I have ever tasted. They taste like they are freshly made at your favorite Mexican restaurant. However the price listed here is ridiculous. After shipping you are looking at $23. Are they worth it? Yes, if you have money to burn and you want fresh tasting tortillas without having to make them yourself. However, I picked these same guys up at Costco for $6.99 or so a package. I bought two packages and stuck one in the freezer. Unless you are desperate skip these guys and find a warehouse store that carries them.

Circle Foods the creators of Tortillaland has added a store locator on their site becasue so many people were asking where they can buy them in addition to Amazon. If there is a location in your town you can find it at [...]. If not you can buy them here.

I used to buy these at Costco when I lived in Denver.  However, in the Midwest they are not available and so I was so happy to finally be able to buy them online because they are hands down the best tortillas I've ever had.  Once you have these, you'll never buy the store ones again.  I freeze them in small batches and just take out what we'd go through in a week or so for the fridge, they freeze wonderful.  They only take a couple minutes to heat and cook on the stove and are well worth it!

These tortillas come in packs of either 44 or 36 and also double packs.  They come frozen and don't leave them in the fridge too long, because they have no preservatives.  You just toss them on an iron skillet with no spray or anything, flip them over after they form bubbles, cook a few seconds more, and you have the closest thing to home made tortillas I have ever tasted.  They are the best.  each the same size and the same thickness.  So yummy I absolutely love these!
I have a yeast allergy along with allergies to mold and soy.  This product has nothing in it that would be harmful to me;  it is also quite delicious.  I only wish my local Costco still carried it.

I have been buying this product from Costco for years. My mother in law introduced me to this product and she had been buying them for years before that. I recently moved to a small city where there is no Costco so I will have to buy this product online soon. I haven't bought it from this vendor yet so I can't say how it will be but I can say this product is AMAZING. Its nothing like the stale precooked tortillas you can but in every grocery store. Best of all it only has a handful of ingredients each one that I can pronounce!

I found these by accident.  I WAS shopping for tortillas, but never dreamed I'd find them in a raw state.  They taste so good when you cook them yourself; rather than simply reheating the store bought, 'cooked' ones.  Why didn't I ever think of this before?  And they freeze wonderfully - although package recommends against it; it worked out well for me.  DON'T microwave however, that's a bad idea. Be patient and cook the tortilla on a griddle or cast iron skillet; it only takes about three minutes to get puffy, big, brown blisters ... how do you say "Yummy" in Spanish?  Well worth the time and money.  They are HOME MADE.  I'll be hard pressed to find a tortilla I like as much.  Muchos Gracias, Tortilaaland!
love these but, could only find them at gelsons in pasadena. they are delicious and a bargain at this price.
Title says it all. Aside from making them at home or getting them from your Abuela, they don't get any better.

This uncooked tortialla used to be our staple food when we lived in Az. But here in NJ, it is not available in Costcos or any other grocery chains (strange!). I even tried to influance Costco to stock it, with no luck. I found this on line. Although it significantly more expensive, ie., 2X (than Costco, when shipping is counted), I am buying it from Amazon, in two's. Throw one in the freezer and one in the fridge. Good tuff!!

We moved from Colorado to Massachusetts and have been in a serious Mexican food withdrawal stage for almost a year.  My husband and I reasoned that if we could get the basic ingredients for a Mexican meal, we could make restaurant-quality food at home.  So, we tried these tortillas in our quest for ingredients resembling those that we could get out west.  These tortillas are so good!  We can't get enough and there's always a package open in our refrigerator (we freeze the unopened ones).  These have helped us cope with our longing for real Mexican food.  They're worth every penny.

Had these tortillas for the first time in Albuquerque several weeks ago and tried to find them in our area once i got home searching in every store but with total disappointment couldn't find them anywhere. Finally, checked online and found them on Amazon!! They are a little pricey online, but totally worth it if you need to appease your craving. None other will compare. Just got them the other day and had to fry a couple for myself right away and drizzled them with honey. YUM - Oh what a delight!!! Totally amazing!! Love them! These are THE best! Thank you Amazon and MexGrocer!

Looked all over the place for these locally and couldn't find them... so I splurged on these and am so glad.  My kids ask for them almost daily and I have no problem heating up the griddle and throwing a few on.  They cook up bubbly and soft and I've used them for tacos, quesadillas, enchiladas, and salads.  Very good and arrived less than 36 hours after I ordered!  I froze one package and have the other in the fridge.

My family ran a Mexican restaurant for 40 years and I can attest that these are GREAT.  Buy a griddle and these tortillas and never look back.Mex Grocer is great too.  On my first order they sent along a few samples of their other products.  I'm hooked.

I first tasted this at a niece's home in Los Angeles and was blown away, and bought 2 frozen packs from Costco. When I returned home. None of the Costco in New Jersey carried it,so I tried Amazon.com and found it. It is more expensive, but I have no choice. Uncooked tortilla can be cooked as crepe with chocholate coating and sliced banana and strawberry, or, cooked for lunch with any of your favorite fillings. My favorite is thinly sliced roast beef, spices, and fresh roman lettuce.

I had bought these Tortillas first at Sam's Club in Yuma, AZ and fell in LOVE with them. When we moved to the East coast I couldn't find them...ANYWHERE. I was so happy to find that Amazon carries them. They are worth every penny you pay for the shipping. Once you have them, it is hard to go back to regular tortillas. One of my favorites is simply cooking one in the pan and then spreading a little butter once it is done....YUM!! I usually split the package and freeze half.

Tortilla Land added sugar to their tortillas recently.  With obesity and diabetes on the rise in this country, I am disappointed Tortilla Land would add sugar to their tortillas.  Tortilla Land can no longer claim their tortillas are healthy.  Tortilla Land have integrity and get rid of the sugar.

I have 10 dogs and am an assistant dog trainer.  I need all sorts of different treats to keep everybody interested.  These have become one of my staple treats.  They are easy to break apart into tiny pieces, they don't crumble in my pocket and the dogs love them.  PERFECT!

Many of us have experienced vodka from our youth, where it was popular for mixed drinks.  Having good taste was about paying a little more to minimize the impact in the morning.  We wouldn't notice the taste differences when used for mixed drinks, or drunk as frozen shots, often drunk quickly.We went to a vodka tasting recently that featured 5 vodkas of varying prices and made from different ingredients.  We sampled them straight up / neat, one at a time.  The best of the lot was the Karlsson Gold.  Yes, it was a tasting sponsored by Karlsson, but it had a good selection of other vodkas, including one we had been buying, but I was impressed enough that we bought a bottle to enjoy at home from the local store (thirty-two dollars).The flavor from the Swedish potatoes is quite good.  There is more flavor than just the vaguely sweet flavor I find in vodka.  It is difficult to describe, but I imagine that someone who appreciates dry brandies might enjoy it.Because this is about flavor, you would not use Karlsson Gold in mixed drinks.  You probably would not taste the difference, and it costs more than less flavorful but otherwise good brands.These are first impressions.  I'll update the review in a few months, or when the bottle goes dry, whichever comes first, and give my thinking then.

That's about all you can say. This has a bit of a bitter aftertaste and I wouldn't recommend eating more than a TEENSY bit at a time to keep it from getting sickening, but it's not downright disgusting--and overall it's worth it to swap out the crazily unhealthy real marshmallow dips/spreads out there!

column9: Good Tasting Sugar Free Dip/Topping - Recommended
column10: The Walden Farms Marshmallow Dip was a good find for me, but perhaps calling this "Marshmallow" was a mistake since it only slightly resembles marshmallow by looks and taste. It should be treated as a dessert dip/topping for dieters or diabetics. Being a Type 2 diabetic, I am always looking for low carb sweets that will not impact my blood sugar levels and this Dip/Topping has no impact at all.I like the flavor and use it on other sugar free foods to round out the dish. This works well with sugar free chocolate ice cream and with peanut butter sandwiches.Recommended, if you set your expectations to match the reality that this is not really marshmallow. You might also want to try Chocolate Dip 12 oz.
This tea is great, It is hard to believe that it is an herbal tea. The smell and taste are both extremely pleasant.

I love this tea, it is very refreshing and the aroma is full as well.i can not believe that i have to resort to ordering it online, as this type is the only one that has a nice rounded taste. The other options, makers, including the organic version taste all watered down to me.Swanson delivered the tea quickly and the package had no damage - good service!

column9: Not a fan of tea but I love this!
column10: Not only am I not a fan of tea, I'm not a fan of licorice but I was open to trying this as a means to help me manage my IBS (I also use fennel and peppermint tea). This tastes so delicious, I want to drink it whether my stomach feels good or not! Yummy! And a cup does sooth my savage stomach.

Over the years I have tried making iced tea out of dozens of different herbal teas and most just end up tasting like lightly-flavored water.  This Yogi Sweet Thai Delight tea is the first I've tried that I will make again.  As a matter of fact, I intend to have a jug of it in the refrigerator all summer!  The taste is amazingly sweet (but not in a sugary way) and a little nutty (actually "coconut-ty.")  I don't use sweeteners or milk in my tea as a rule, but even if I did I wouldn't want to add sugar to this tea, it's perfectly sweet as it is.Since there's no recipe for iced tea on the box, I just winged it and put 8 tea bags into a gallon of boiling water, then turned it down and let it steep covered for about twenty minutes.  You could probably also make it the way my Mom made tea in the summer, by putting the bags in a gallon jar, adding room temperature water, sealing it and setting it in the sunniest place in the yard for the day.However you make it, you really should try this tea iced.  I'm not a huge tea drinker normally, but I'm completely hooked on this one.
India Spice is a great tea if you like your herbal tea with a little kick.  It's strong, flavorful, and aromatic.  Also, the little fortunes are a nice little twist.

column9: THE BEST CHAI GREEN I HAVE TASTED
column10: I first had the opportunity of having this tea about 13 years ago.  The blend used for this tea is very smooth.  I have tried several other chai green tea brands, but none can compare to Yogi Tea.  I have allowed several friends, and co-workers to sample this tea, and all are hooked on it.  I have also tried the redbush chai, and black chai teas from Yogi Tea, all were very good but the taste of the chai green is superb by far.  Follow the directions, allowing the tea to steep, to get the full effect, you won't be disappointed.  I usually use white sugar only as a sweentener, but have also used Equal sweetener.  Thank you Yogi Tea for a wonderful tea.

The product information doesn't tell you that the tea includes processed sweetener (stevia), butterscotch flavoring, and some other processed ingredients.This is not the original recipe for Yogi Tea, though it implies that it is. Even on the Yogi Tea website, it doesn't mention the added artificial ingredients (I know that stevia is from a plant, but it's hightly processed for use as a sweetener).I love the old original yogi tea, but I would never buy this.

column9: This tea is a mixture of different spices
column10: Although this tea is flavorful and tastes fine, I should have read the description more carefully. I was looking for pure licorice root tea. This tea has other spices added to it and the orange peel flavor is dominant and licorice flavor is muted. I am giving it three stars because the name of the tea should include some of the other spices. Read the ingredients listed before you purchase. Here is the description, "Combined with a touch of cinnamon, orange peel and other carefully selected herbs and spices" If you like these other spices then you will be happy. Otherwise, you might opt for a pure licorice tea and the box will say, "Ingredients: Licorice Root". That was what I really wanted, although this tea tastes perfectly good.
Mild, but not boring! Enough sweetness for most, but I still add stevia. I have given several bags away and everybody raves about it!

Really do love the flavor of licorice, with this tea I can get that without the  sugar.  It is naturally sweet. The licorice flavor doesn't intensify with longer steeping time so if you want tht flavor to be more intense you have to use two bags.  My husband hates this tea though, he is Japanese and it reminds him of the herbal tonics they made him drink as a kid! More for me...!I also like the Yogi Throat Cure tea, similar flavor but has cherry bark.

I didn't expect this to be so spicy! It smells great but when you taste it, it's nasty! I sweetened it as much as I could but it just didn't help. This is a shame since I like so many other Yogi teas. I'll have to pawn off the rest to friends and family now :(

I love this tea. Spicy sweet,  If your first pick in the chocolate aisle is the one with the hottest chili nibs, this is your no-calorie alternative.However, we must talk about the price on Amazon.  I'm searching the site because I first encountered the tea while on vacation in New York City.  Fairway carries it for about half the price of listed here.

This Yogi Sweet Thai Delight tea is the first I've tried that I will make again.  As a matter of fact, I intend to have a jug of it in the refrigerator all summer!  The taste is amazingly sweet (but not in a sugary way) and a little nutty (actually "coconut-ty.")  I don't use sweeteners or milk in my tea as a rule, but even if I did I wouldn't want to add sugar to this tea, it's perfectly sweet as it is.Since there's no recipe for iced tea on the box, I just winged it and put 8 tea bags into a gallon of boiling water, then turned it down and let it steep covered for about twenty minutes.  You could probably also make it the way my Mom made tea in the summer, by putting the bags in a gallon jar, adding room temperature water, sealing it and setting it in the sunniest place in the yard for the day.However you make it, you really should try this tea iced.  I'm not a huge tea drinker normally, but I'm completely hooked on this one.
This tea has a nice light coconut flavor.  It's hard to find in the stores where I live so purchaing it at Amazon makes sense.

My husband puts Tabasco on everything eggs to pizza and absolutely loved this Mexican chili tea.  I took one sip and wanted to wash the spice off my tongue, but knew exactly why it appealed to him.  I'm sticking with Earl Grey.

column9: Great warming flavor on a dreary day
column10: My absolute favorite Yogi tea!  Pleasantly spicy, with a hint of rich chocolate.  I much prefer this to the Mayan Cocoa Spice & Sweet Thai flavors.  It's what I reach for when I get a craving for a cup of hot chocolate but don't want the calories.

My mom gave me licorice tea whenever I had a bad throat, and it really was soothing to my throat.  This works just as well!Now, if you really really dislike the flavor of licorice, you might want to stay away from this tea.  I don't typically like licorice (I can tolerate it), but this isn't too bad.  Sometimes I drink it just for the scent and flavor.

I got this as a free sample and I couldn't believe how delicious it is. It sounded so strange so I had to try it right away. It wasn't spicy but had many layers of flavor. I don't even think there are chilis in it!

I'm used to cheap tea (by the way, cheap tea isn't low quality), but this one's awful. It tastes like very spicy water.. water with Tabasco added, essentially. Although I did steep the tea bag for about four minutes, there was no depth to the flavor. I finished the cup, but I certainly wouldn't buy it.

When you read Mexican Sweet Chili, you think hot! Well this tea while being tangy and hot also delivers alot of unique flavors. A great wake-up or finish to a spicy meal.Clove, Cardamon, Cinnamon then black Pepper and Red Chili flavors, a unique cup of tea. Would be excellent Iced or with milk. I will reorder & reorder, this one a keeper.

So I bought this tea thinking it was the same as the Thai tea that is served at Thai Restaraunts but its not. This tea is very coconutty which theres nothing wrong with that but its not the same restaraunt type if thats what youre looking for. You should buy this tea if youre looking for a cinnamon/coconut exotic tea.

I love the Yogi brand of Chai tea...whether it's the Redbush or Green tea.  It has so much more flavor than other brands of Chai tea and I have tried a ton of varieties.  I like to make the tea strong and then add some soy milk to it to make it creamy.  It becomes a Chai Latte without all of the sugar you get from the Chai syrups used in coffee shops.  It's also good cold.

column9: lots of flavours in each sip
column10: A colleague at work just gave me one of these tea bags.I like herbal teas but this one was really unique.There were really nice lingering flavors on my tongue with every sip.First, a tangy orangey sensation followed by a suttle sweetness married with a spicy masala kick shortly after.The sweetness lingers around the back of the tongue afterwords.Nothing really Mexican about it, neither does it have any chilis. The spiciness comes from some common spices used in Masala tea.If this sounds like something you might like, I highly recommend that you try it.

I'm addicted to Yogi Teas and have vowed to try them all.  This Indian Spice tea is delicious. I've found that many of the Yogi teas are not as strong as I want them to be, so the tea bag stays in until I've drank all the tea. Not so with this tea, this tea has a VERY strong Cinnamon taste, which I find enjoyable. In truth, I may have left the bag in too long today, as the cinnamon flavor is burning a little.The directions on the box say to add milk (or milk substitute) and sweetener to the tea. They mean it. I tried to drink it plain, but couldn't, it just didn't taste right. However, I did add a popular flavored coffee creamer, and that worked beautifully.  This is a whole new drink now, doesn't feel like tea, it feels like a treat. Enjoy.
Not my taste. If you like it spicey, you'll probably like it. Me, I like my earl gray. I'm old fashioned like that.

I first tried this sauce at the farmer's market and found myself coming back for more. I prefer the original WildeBerryaki variety and my boyfriend likes the Spicy variety. It goes well on stir-fry or rice. Tastes like teriyaki sauce with a soft blackberry essence - a great summer food! Also - it's gluten free and low in sodium, which is a plus. Will purchase again!

Charlee Bears are small and low calorie, so you can use them en masse for training.  We use them both for standard training (sit, stay, drop it, leave it) and behavioral training (no bark).  They're not stinky or messy, so you can put them in your pocket, purse, or car without worry.  We keep a small bag in the car for travel to reinforce when our puppy doesn't bark at people walking by, one by the door to reinforce when she goes to the bathroom outside, and a bunch of treats in a treat bag for travel.The one downside to these is that because they're not as stinky, it can be harder to use them to get your dog's attention if he or she is distracted, like at the dog park or if you have a bunch of visitors.  Our trick to get around this is that we put some stinky treats in the treat bag with these, and they'll take on some of the scent (We use Pro-Treat Beef Liver, Freeze Dried Dog Treats, 21 Ounce).Our dog loves all flavors.

column9: Actually NICE for sugarfree preserves...I will be ordering MORE in other flavors
column10: I've tried other low-carb, sugar-free spreads/preserves/jams in the past, and I've hated them all. I remember buying Steel's cause a slew of low-carbers recommended it,and I ended up throwing out the jars I got. Horrible. Chemically.This actually made me stop and go, "Wow, this is pleasant."Let's face it, it's not regular, sugar-laden preserves with that thick, luxurious texture. But it's also only 20 cals per tablespoon and doesn't spike your sugar. If you have diabetes, Metabolic Syndrome, insulin issues, or are just a low-carb dieter (or dieter in general), this line of preserves is worth checking out.The Lowdown: I first used it on plain old toast over Smart Balance (I love the combo of fat spread with sweet spread, whether it's cream cheese and grape jelly or butter and jam.) It was very nice. The spread is thinner than I expect preserves to be--like a thickish fruit coulis, fruit puree, sort of thing. The taste is very fruity, apricotty, with an acidic edge. That's the reason I removed a star--the thinnish texture and slightly overacidic bite. However, I don't want to exaggerate either. It was a good flavor and a nice addition to breakfast. Also nice over low-fat waffles and pancakes, if you go for that sort of thing.I want to try the strawberry and blueberry, and I foresee that this might become a staple in my pantry. Finally, a lower carb, sugar-free preserve that I can enjoy.Update: I'm switching my rating to 5 stars. I'm just enjoying this more and more. Maybe my spring allergies affected my perception of the flavor, cause since my congestion eased, this tastes BETTER. I'm almost done with the jar and next time will stock up with 3. Yum.
I am very happy with this product...tastes great, no sugar.  Worth every penny to know that I'm eating something good for me.  Shipping was quick, too.  Will def order again!
Culd not eat it, but the other flavor I ordered was fine, not sure why it was not ok, when the other one was

column9: I don't know what it tastes like
column10: The item arrived open and I discarded it. I was afraid to eat it. The folks I bought the item from has not credited my account or sent me a replacement. I am very disappointed.
Not bad but a little too sweet tasting for me even with Xylitol as sweetener.  Would not purchase again but thought I'd try & take a chance as we have Diabetics in our family.
I love the taste of this preserve, there is no after taste, you won't be able to tell the difference, I rather eat this version than the one with sugar.
Mom loved this as she is diabetic and sweeteners such as Splenda do not work for her.  The downside is that is becoming way too expensive.
I highly recommend this! It is the best low carb jam I have tried. It is real fruit and tastes excellent!

column9: My favorite jams - regardless sugar-free or not
column10: I've searched far and wide for good low carb food stuffs and have only found a few that are truly edible. The Nature's Hollow line, though, is remarkable - not just because it tastes good as a sugar free jam/preserve, but in my opinion the Apricot and, especially the Strawberry flavors are what I'd eat if I didn't eat low carb. The flavors are bold and fresh. The blueberry can be a bit syrupy but the raspberry, strawberry, and apricot are pretty good. Though, I recommend keeping all of them in the fridge. Personally, I combine the preserves with a tablespoon of Trader Joe's Sunflower Seed Butter over a La Tortilla Factory low-carb tortilla and I've got a high-fiber, healthy fat, low carb treat that's tough to beat.

column9: My loud mouth cat loves it.
column10: My Cat is coming up on his 13th year and suddenly when we are home he never stops yowling. There is nothing wrong with him medically, he just began demanding an insane amount of attention (he already gets more attention than most children) and begs for food even when he is not hungry because he wants you to come in the kitchen and pay attention to him. So as much as I love incessant meowing while I am trying to read, type, talk or think.....Anywho we didn't want to reward the yowling with treats or feeding him at times other than his normal meals but ignoring the behavior as per the vet and other people instructed simply did not work. After months of his crying we chalked it up to old age and wound up just giving him treats and snacks of his wet food so we could have a phone conversation without the person on the other line thinking we were killing our animal. He mostly ignored the extra food and would gobble up the treats but we knew it wasn't a perma fix. So we tried the cat milk. He loves it. Laps it up like me at a $2 martini happy hour. It appears to have a soothing effect on him because he stops meowing for a while after he gets it. Plus we feed him premium food and he was still a little flaky. (I think due to the dry heat in our home) The cat milk seems to help with the flakiness and his coat seems smoother. I would definitely limit it to a small serving once a day, I gave him a leetle too much when I first got it and I paid for it the next day when I was scooping the box. Other than the one incident it actually seems to help his poop. cheers!

column9: Great for cats that don't drink enough fluids
column10: My older cat, male, has had issues with dehydration, constipation (I know, too much information), so I tried one of these and he drinks quite a bit, and so I've started to mix a little water in it. He's 14, was getting very thin, and it seems that this has helped him put on a little weight.

My cat kept getting sick and refusing to eat.  He would go anorexic and become lethargic I had to keep taking him to the vet.  The last time it was so bad that he was put on IV's for dehydration.  He also had a high fever and some other weird stuff going on.  I was really afraid he was not going to live very long (he was only about 4 years old).  After he was back home from the vets and feeling better, it started up again within a week.  He stopped eating and became lethargic.  My husband bought Whiskas Milk because we were trying to get him to at least drink something.  I was going to bottle feed him if I had to, but as soon as he sniffed the Whiskas Milk, he cleaned out the dish and he has not been sick since then and it has been about 2 years.  I give him a small amount several times a week or whenever he asks for it.  There must be some kind of nutrition in it that he needed that he was not getting.  If I forget to give it to him, he'll meow in a different tone so I know he wants it.  It's really a miracle, he went from being a very sick cat to very healthy.  I have not taken him to the vets since I started giving him the milk.  My other two cats who are healthy will not drink it at all, but that's okay, they don't need it.
My cats all 4 of them love this milk-Thank goodness it was available here-for some reason no one in town had it-It was actually a pretty good deal!

Several years ago I realized that two of my cats were prone to bladder infections.  I started giving them Whiskas Cat Milk before bedtime just as a means of getting more fluid into their systems, and they love it!  No bladder infections in years, and no other pre-bedtime treat will suffice!

This product and CAT SIP are both really great for any kitty that is underweight due to kidney failure or anything else that has left your kitty not eating or drinking enough.  It's also a nice treat for any kitty but be careful not to give too much at a time or too frequently.

Whiskas has a very-fine formulation, for all felines. It comes in 200mL cartons, and is affordable .. for almost any cat-owner. It's 98% reduced, in lactose ... and contains malt and calcium (of course), for the health of the feline. Use this, and alternate with a helping of "regular" milk, in doses .. and you shouldn't be disappointed with the results.

column9: My picky old cat loves it!
column10: My cat is seventeen and in the early stage of kidney failure. She barely eats anything, mainly justs sucks juice out of her canned food. She barely touches her dry food or treats. She was getting so bony and I worried about her. So I decided to try the whiskas cat milk and she loves it! She also put on weight and looks healthier. She likes it cold from the fridge, I keep it in an empty pb jar and use disposable paper bowls, because she begs for it all day. Yes, if you need some extra nutrition or hydration or just a tasty treat, I'd buy some whiskas cat milk. Dogs love it too!

I bought this one time when PetSmart was out of Cat-Sip Real Milk. My cats wouldn't even try it. They ran up to it excitedly, expecting it to be Cat-Sip. They each sniffed it, and literally turned their noses up! Then they just walked away. It didn't go to waste as my dogs were excited to have it. Passed the dog taste test, but that doesn't mean much. After reading the ingredients, I probably shouldn't have even fed it to my dogs. Full of random stuff: guar gum, corn syrup solids...just to name a couple. And it is completely watered down too. I'm going to stick with Cat-Sip, and I recommend you try that brand as well. Cat-Sip has only 3 ingredients; low fat milk, lactase enzyme (to help the cats break down the dairy as cats are naturally lactose intolerant), and taurine (an essential nutrient for cats). Also, Cat-Sip is usually a few cents cheaper than the Wiskas stuff!

This product was discontinued by my local store so I had to resort to buying it on-line.  I admit I felt foolish buying "cat milk" but our new kitten loved it.  All three of my cats love it so much they have become junkies!  It is probably making my young cat heafty but has been a great supplement for my kitten and old kitty girl.  We love it and will be buying another case.

After buying this once, I realized how full of junk it was, like hydrogenated oil, thickeners like guar gum, and corn syrup solids, plus stuff I can't spell, let alone pronounce.  So now I just buy lactaid milk and it works fine.I was hoping for something that had extra vitamins in it and maybe omega-3s, but no such luck. Whiskas missed an opportunity here.Update:  I've upgraded my kitten lactaid milk to include taurine from capsules (jarrow), and whey based amino acid digest, I think it's called Amino Gold or something, meant for sports people.  I also add a little bit of "miralax" Kirkland LaxaClear, 90 Daily Doses, Polyethylene Glycol 3350 (3 Pack), Compare to Miralax Active Ingredient but only a little bit.  Of all these things, I add a tiny tiny bit.  My cats weigh about 10 lbs each, so figure 20 lbs of feeding, that's about 1/5 of a 100 lb teenager.  I also water it down about 1:3 parts water:lactaid.They LOVE it, beg for it.  Two cups of it is gone in a day.  Be prepared to clean the litterbox every night though.  But it's good for them to be hydrated.  I haven't decided how to get more Omega-3 into this yet.  Maybe add almond milk? I've sampled multiple  brands of dark chocolate and so far my two favorites are this brand and Green & Black's. This chocolate is simply scrumptious. It has just the right level of sweetness, and its texture is smooth and creamy.Over the last four years there have been dozens of scientific studies analyzing and confirming substantial health benefits from a small amount of dark chocolate consumed daily. The original German studies in 2007 that indicated the healing properties of dark chocolate used this particular brand. The latest findings from a Harvard study released in early 2011 indicate that as little as 6 gm. of dark chocolate (about 30 calories) is a sufficient daily "dose." That is equivalent to one of the tiny squares of this chocolate.The health benefits of dark chocolate are due to the flavonoids contained in cocoa. Flavonoids act as antioxidants in the body, which both prevent and reduce inflammation. Over many years of medical research, inflammation has been found to contribute to or directly cause a host of diseases, including high blood pressure, heart disease, and cancer, as well as autoimmune diseases like arthritis.Flavonoids are found in the pigments of fruits and vegetables which give them their color. The darker and deeper the color of a fruit or vegetable, the greater the amount of flavonoids it contains. Cocoa is derived from the dark-brown cacao bean, which is the fruit of the tropical tree, theobroma cacao. In any chocolate product, such as this one, the higher the percentage of cocoa/cacao, the more flavonoids the chocolate contains.Dark chocolate such as this product is better for your health than milk chocolate because it contains more antioxidants, which are good for you, and less sugar, which is not good for you--especially if you have diabetes or are struggling with your weight.

There was also a subtle sweet taste that was somewhat different then Ketchup... which I think is most likely from the dates looking over the ingredients.I was really expecting somthing more like A1 then Ketchup... but I really don't know where I picked up that preconception. Overall I enjoyed it; people into vinegar chips or whatever would really get a kick out of this.

HP sauce is for  those who like a little more zap in & on the food. It is not like salsa or chili sauce with it's zap. A nice product, try it.  It's not like A1 or Heinz 57 sauce either.

The specialty British food store in NYC which always carries HP Sauce is 130 miles away.  Since about everything in the world usually can be found on Amazon I typed in  Amazon.Com and found suppliers.  I now have a year's supply.  Thank you, Amazon.

Visited Canada, went to a resturant ordered steak asked for some steak sauce.  Waiter brought HP Sauce, best steak sauce ever.  Next day went to a supermarket and bought HP Sauce to bring home.  Now that I can order on line and have it delivered to my door I can have the best steak sauce ever anytime I want.

I was sceptical of this sauce, that is to say , I wasn't sure I liked it, even after trying it for the first time. However, I kept trying it on various meats and so forth,...and found it was great on fried chicken. Try it on most anything now ...and really dig it.  Way to go Keith !  Good call !

column9: I Love the sweet/sour taste in General

column10: Coffee is very good and as far as k-cups go it is a very good price.I order them all the time from amazon
A perfectly blended cup of smooth, rich coffee at a fantastic price.  We've found Green Mountain flavors are always as advertised and recommend to anyone with a single cup brewer.
I like this coffee from Green Mountain,some are to strong for my taste and others the K cups dont seem to work right,but these never seem to have a problem and the taste is good
This is a great product.  I love the Keurig and Green Mountain Breakfast Blend is just right for me.
Many of the brands I've tried are too bold. I tried several brands and types and this is the one for me.  I am very pleased with it and will continue to order it.

column9: Not too weak, not too strong, it's juuuuuust right
column10: I found these first at my local supermarket.  I've been looking for a blend that I could use as my standard every-day cup of coffee and, finally, this was it.  I've tried so many of the other blends and brands and they were either harsh and bitter (I know, some people think coffee *should* taste that way!) or too bland and weak. This is smooth but with a nice "coffee" presence you can actually taste.  *Coffee* taste, not burned grounds!I highly recommend this if you're *not* into the "make your hair stand on end" type of coffee. This review is based on using the "medium" size on the coffee machine.  You may get different results if you use the small or large dispenser sizes.

Have tried many varieties of K cups and green mountain is the best. My favorite blend is breakfast blend. Mild coffee, if you like Dunkin Donuts, you will like this.  If you are a starbucks drinker, try a bolder blend.

column9: Green Mtn Breakfast Blend K cups
column10: I'm glad to taste this one; it's ideal for me, not bitter. Taste is smooth, whether adding sugar/cream or black.  I'll order more.

I love this coffee.  As I get older, my stomach can't seem to take the really strong blends.  Breakfast Blend is perfect.  Great flavor without hurting my stomach.  Amazon has the best price with free shipping.  I only wish I could start an automatic refill of my order.Update 9-1-12Yea!!! This coffee can finally be ordered with an automatic refill.  I am always guaranteed the lowest price and don't have to worry about searching for it.  I am one happy Amazon, coffee lover.
This is a good mild coffee for the drinker that doesn't like a strong bold blend in the morning.  I don't like a burnt tasting coffee and this is the one I like the best.

I buy K-cups all the time and it was nice to buy a double pack for less money than I would have paid in the store. The breakfast blend is not a bold coffee. Being rather mellow and not bitter and with no after taste. If you are looking for a mild tasting coffee this would be a good choice.
If you're more of a Dunkin Donuts or Diner-style coffee person, this is great coffee.

Good cup of coffee. If you are looking for a nice cup to wake up to, this is it. Light blend, no overpowering taste. I prefer bolder blends but my husband likes light - so this was our compromise blend, and I enjoy it as much as he does.
My preference is Green Mountain Breakfast Blend.  It is never bitter or too strong.  I like coffee, but those strong ones just don't make it with me.  Give me the mild ones any day.

I love this coffee.  I like light roast, but many of them have little flavor.  Green Mountain Breakfast Blend has a nice smooth, full taste without being harsh.  The flavor of some dark roasts leave me with the impression I could get the same effect by just licking the bottom of a dirty ashtray.  (Sorry, dark-roast lovers - I tend to be overly sensitive to bitterness.)

My favorite blend of coffee for my Keurig. I've tried about 15 different flavors but this is by far my favorite.  Very smooth and not overpowering or bitter.  Was buying at Walmart but they stopped stocking it.  Found it at Amazon for the same price.

You can't make a better cup of regular coffee flavored coffee than Green Mountain Nantucket Blend at home. I had been trying in every way imaginable for nearly forty years to accomplish this. However sometimes I feel like something a tad bit lighter for that first cup in the morning. Enter Green Mountain Breakfast Blend. It's exactly what that first cup calls fall. A slightly lighter version of Nantucket Blend, yet it still has the subtle punch you're looking for.

column9: Best value for a K-cup coffee
column10: Green Mountain Breakfast blend coffee is a mild roast that goes down easy in the morning.  My wife actually runs a cup through the Keurig twice.  Buying it this way breaks down to 50 cents per K-cup versus a dollar at any store.
Love this coffee, it has just the right amount of flavor, is not to strong or to light. I have several cups through the day and enjoy everyone of them.
Green Mountain Breakfast Blend coffee is the best!  I love the smooth, but robust taste!  I can hardly wait to smell and taste my coffee every morning!

This is my every day coffee. It's a smooth coffee with no bitter after taste. This is not the coffee for those who like a strong cup of coffee. This coffee is for those who don't like to drink coffee that has been sitting  on a burner for hours but like the first cup of fresh coffee

This particular k-cup has become my favorite and I've had just about all of them from every k-cup maker.  I still enjoy many others, but this one is perfection. I love, love, love it! Funny thing is it took me about a year to try it. Something about the packaging made me think it might be horrible. I was dead wrong. It's perfect. If you're a k-cupper, and there are lots of us now; don't let this one pass you by.

i've been using these k-cups for months now.  the breakfast blend is perfect for people who don't like a very strong bitter coffee in the morning.  the coffee from the breakfast blend is wonderful... not too strong, not overwhelming, but delicious.

column9: Green Mountain Coffee Keurig Breakfast Blend
column10: I give this 5 stars. This is my favorite of all the K cups I've tried. Trust me I have tried a lot. If you like a mild coffee you will love this one.
Great coffee. Arrives when you folks say it is to be delivered.  Will continue to purchase 2 pack from Amazon when it is on sale. Very easy to place an order.
Good Product.  For heavy coffee drinker it is a little expensive but well worth the price if you only dring 1 or 2 cups a day, Service from vendor was splendid.
This product makes a good cup of coffee at a reasonable price for the Keurig coffee maker and I would recommend it.

This is my favorite K-cup and one my husband and I can agree on (I prefer darker roast, he likes a lighter roast coffee).  It holds up well to the cream and Splenda I add.However, this price is outrageous.  Far more than I pay at the grocery store.
I have tried about a dozen different flavors of the k-cups and this one is just right. The perfect blend.
I just love the breakfast blend.  I hate bitter, strong coffee and rarely made coffee b/c it was awful.  I became a DD lover and now I have the K-cups to drink at home.

I love my Breakfast Blend coffee from Green Mountain. It light without a bitter aftertaste. It is a good everyday morning cofffee for me I would  recommend this to anyone who likes a light not bitter cooffe if you like a really strong cup of joe in the morning this isn't you coffee
This has a really nice flavor.  Would not hesitate to buy it again but probably not from Amazon or its vendors as they are overpriced.
I like this blend but the price is ridiculous. Found them at winn Dixie (and other flavors) $7.99 for a pack of 12.

After pricing out different places to purchase this coffee as a gift, we realized that Amazon was able to provide us with so many K-Cup options but we love Green Mountain it has great flavor for a morning or evening cup. Enjoy!! You will Not be disappointed in this purchase!!

column9: Great for those who don't like strong coffee in the morning
column10: My wife and oldest son don't like a strong coffee, so the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend works great for them. While I myself prefer the Coffee People's Organic, which is darker and more robust - similar to some of the blends found at Starbucks (not their regular blend). The Organic is strong enough for them to re-use once, after I've had the first brew.I also love that we can get the double pack of the Breakfast Blend 24 K-Cups inexpensively from Amazon. We purchase the Coffee People Organic in the 50-K-cup boxes.

Green Mountain Breakfast Blend is an excellent light roast coffee served in a K-Cup.  Smooth, silky,it has a gentle flavor yet enough of a robust coffee flavor to allow a very pleasurable experience.  Highly recommended.
This is my favorite keurig coffee. I prefer it over any starbucks or dunkin or any other coffee. Nice and smooth taste without a usual bitter aftertaste. I's the perfect cup of coffee.
This is the best k-cup coffee I've had.  Its bold smooth flavor is great for bkfst, but just as good to enjoy w/desserts or an afternoon pick-me-up.  I love it!

column9: Lets rate the flavor shall we. The price will always fluctuate.
column10: The price of this has been fluctuating forever on amazon. This listing is the same one that different sellers will use. Some are better than others but the reviews stay with the product regardless of who is selling it at the moment. Until it becomes available as a frustration free 50 count box from amazon this is what we will have to deal with. There is another seller that offers free shipping on the 108 count box every once and a while and its free shipping for everyone not only amazon prime members. when you see it available do not hesitate on getting it. It goes fast because of the free shipping. It is still a little high at about 57 cents per cup but 43 is the lowest I have ever seen.This is our favorite everyday coffee. I would suggest you get this as your free coffee. You will also be offered free shipping with that order. So buy a lot of the 5 pack samplers and get the most out of the free shipping.

It's some good Joe. If you are looking for a mild to medium breakfast coffee to start your engine in the morning, this is the real deal.  It's the kind of coffee that when you inhale the fresh steam before the first sip, you get goose bumps. Definitely full of flavor without any hint of bitterness. Drink it black and enjoy.
K-Cups are great if you only drink one cup a day otherwise it could get expensive.  This flavor is good for the basic coffee drinker, no funky flavors added, just basic coffee.
Green Mountain is one of my favorite coffee brands.  Breakfast blend is mellow and a great way to start your day.

column9: Over a dollar for a K-cup?
column10: The coffee is good but the price is ridiculous($1.25 each K-cup approx).  You can get it from Green Mountain for 75 cents a K-cup (delivered) which is still too much. Buy it for 60 cents a K-cup at Bed, Bath and Beyond or Kohls.

Do not buy this blend if you prefer dark and bold coffee and/or if you like coffee that can hold cream.  It is weak in flavor and best described as tea flavored coffee.  It is, however, not bitter and fairly smooth.
Received this item in a timely manner.  Was what I expected. Gave as a Christmas gift.  Would purchase again.
We were very pleased with this product and the short time in which we received it.

The K cups were loose and not bound in plastic wrap or cardboard box.  I was very happy to see that.  The K cups were not damaged in any way and is at least a little better for the environment given the use of them, by me, is not good for my carbon foot print. So every little bit helps.

I don't like strong coffee but this is so weak and watery, it's like drinking...something other than coffee. I tried brewing a small size, using a different size cup, adjusting my cream and sugar, nothing works! It's really disappointing because I've had other good blends from Green Mountain in the past. I'll stick with Wolfgang Puck's Rodeo Drive or Breakfast In Bed.
For anyone liking a weaker coffee,this brand would be fine, but I prefer a stronger coffee so I wouldn't choose this brand again for that reason.

column9: Good flavor - a little too weak for me
column10: Seems like the Keurig systems lend themselves to dark roasts - however, the near burnt flavor element never worked for me. The coffee gets too weak and watery at any of my regular sizes (middle or right-but-one button on the B70) - this is a coffee that could do with an 'extra bold' rating to up the quantity of coffee in the cup.My current alternative for this is Green Mountain's 'Our Blend' - which does seem to have got it right!
Personally I find this blend to be rather bland.  However, my wife really likes it, so I'll rate it 4 stars.
This is the best way to buy GMC.  Wish I could get it all at this price and have home delivery.
Deceptive ad.  You can buy from Green Mountain for $13.95 a box of 24.  Don't buy from these crooks.

Beware of this vendor.  All other K-Cups are sold 2 packs of 24 for this price.  I ordered several brands in one order assuming that these are the same 2 pack of 24 quantity and was surprised when I only received one box of 24. column4: Theodore "Life is either a daring adventure o...

It doesn't bite you, like many coffees, so if you're looking for a mellow flavor in the morning, this may be for you. Otherwise, steer clear of this one.
13 dollars for 24 cups free shipping over 50 dollars is the going rate. These folks are pulling a swiftie
