I am a big coffee drinker and usually can drink very strong coffee And never have stomach upsets but do with this blend.
I have ordered Breakfast Blend over the last three years.  The last order I received through Amazon was just awful! Bitter, burnt, undrinkable.....what are they doing to my once favorite coffee??

For the price you pay, the pods should make a good cup of coffee. This coffee was watery and bland.  Don't buy. I think Tulley's is the best.

column9: Poor Labeling makes for a rip-off!
column10: I have used this before, and like the coffee. But was not aware of the different strengths. There is no way to make any choice during Amazon Prime buying (one click), or any other way i can find. So I am consuming this expensive stuff twice as fast to get the strength I want. Are you listening, Amazon? This proves to me that the arguments some make that buying in the store is better may have merit. if this were not a food item, already opened, I would return.So: WARNING: don't buy unless you are satisfied with any strength (Ironic a product this expensive would not pay more attention).Very, very disappointed!PS, the box labeling did not match the warning anyway, what I got was "Light Roast". I've fgound the cure for drinking too much coffee inthe morning. Get this one. I have ordered Breakfast Blend over the last three years.  The last order I received through Amazon was just awful! Bitter, burnt, undrinkable.....what are they doing to my once favorite coffee??

column9: Why use a brewer for instant coffee?
column10: This stuff is NASTY.  I don't even think it's particularly good instant.  Why would anyone spend all that money on a keurig coffee maker in order to make instant coffee at home?  You just need a kettle or a microwave.  And what a waste of space in your kitchen and landfill.  The worst part is that you don't know it's instant until you taste it, look carefully at the package, and see that it's "water soluble"-- code words for instant.  Open one up, and you'll see!

This is my favorite coffee out of the 18+ Kuerig cups that I've tried. It's smooth, and not too heavy or bitter.I think this product is priced above it's value, but it's as good as Starbucks for abut 1/3 the cost.

I ordered this coffee and another brand, it seems, about three weeks ago.  I checked this morning, February 8,  and found the deliver is out into March or Apri.  I  paid for the product soon after it was ordered and have been told on checking delivery that it can no longer be canceled.  Wow!!!!!
THIS HAS BEEN MY FAVORITE COFFEE SINCE DAY ONE OF HAVING MY KEURIG. YOU CAN'T MESS IT UP. EVERY CUP IS PERFECT.
I love the Breakfast Blend because it is not real strong and does not have a bitter taste.  Another great blend is the Nantucket Blend.

My husband and I both really enjoy the taste of this coffee.  I tend to like a full robust flavor, and my husband likes his coffee on the milder side, but this coffee satisfies us both.  It is 'just right'!
This coffee is perfect for the morning. Not to strong but it gives you the perfect smooth jolt that we all crave in the AM..highly recommended.

I will admit that I like strong flavorful but not burnt tasting coffee. I give four stars to the Tully House Blend, but this Breakfast Blend is quite weak.After ordering fifty of them, my husband and I in desperation have been trying to use them up by putting a kcup on espresso setting and using 2-3 kcups on Expresso  as needed to fill up our coffee cup. I'm sure it's a  fine Kcup if you like weak coffee, but...
Excellent coffee for someone who wants a medium roast, mild tasting cup of coffee.  I do not like the dark roast, strong, bitter coffees.  This one is perfect.

The only reason I did not give it five stars is the small package (24).  I like to buy in bulk of 108 cups or more in a single box.  Much better price.  Disallowing the smaller package, I must say that the coffee will not disappoint anyone.

column9: This is our favorite k-cup coffee!
column10: We have tried many different types of K-cup coffee flavors and this is the one we keep coming back to.  Neither one of us cares for bitter, strong tasting coffee.  This has a mild, pleasant taste and it never varies from that. Definitely recommend!

column9: On the Light Side of Medium Blend Coffees.  Smooth with No Aftertaste.  Typical Breakfast Blend.
column10: If you like a lighter coffee blend, then this one is a good choice.  It is a breakfast blend, so the flavor will not compete with your food.The blend is smooth, not acidic and doesn't have an aftertaste.  It goes well with cream/sugar.Equal to Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend Medium K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) or Wolfgang Puck Coffee, Breakfast in Bed (Medium Roast), 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2).
The Green Mountain Breakfast Blend coffee is wonderful.  I don't like strong bitter coffee and this is just great for my coffee type.

column9: Green mountain coffee for the Keurig, breakfast blend
column10: Love this coffee. I received it within 2 days and was very happy witheverything.I would recommend this brand and also Donut People coffee.

I recently found this blend available at my local Walmart (sorry Amazon, but it had a great price). It is a light blend such as I prefer, and tastes wonderful.  I could not detect any aftertaste as you get with medium or dark coffee blends. I previously wrote a review for Green Mountain's Nantucket Blend which I recommended to those that prefer medium blends.  However, this particular blend is just right for me.  I highly recommend this blend to fellow Amazon customers that prefer light blends.

I had received a Keurig coffee maker for the holidays and have been hooked since. I am not a real strong coffee person so this morning blend is perfect. Consistant in flavor. The only reason I gave it a four is once you buy the machine you are basically locked into buying the cups.. It does have the reusable pod tho. I believe the prices could come down. In the store the prices are outrageous, but on Amazom they are reasonable somewhat..

I purchased this coffee for my teenage daughter in college.  She said it tasted OK but was weak compared to Starbucks.  She prefers a stronger coffee. It is really hard to tell the strenght of the coffe by the description.
I love this brand of k-cup! Just the right blend for me... not too strong, not too light... just right. Amazon gives you the best value when buying k-cups :)

My favorite to use in my Keurig. The Breakfast Blend is not too strong, but it isn't so weak that I can't taste the coffee after adding creamer. I do not like a dark roast, but I also don't like an incredibly weak roast. This blend is absolutely perfect for those who like a coffee that is just right. :)
Excellent taste, smooth, easy going.  I like a mild drink to start my day and this is it.  Heartily endorse this coffee.
I have tried other mild brews but this is the best by far it meets all of my requirements for this type of coffee.

This is a mild coffee which I really like.  I don't care for a really dark blend as it tends to be bitter, but this breakfast blend is quite good.  I have had a few other blends and I may change and get the columbia blend some time but the breakfast blend is not bitter and so far I like it the very best.  It has a pleasing taste and aroma.

Very dissapionted in this oder.Have had this coffee before from another source,but it wasn't avaliable at the time so I odered it thru ammazon.Not the same coffee.Very stale and weak.My hhusband and I both noticed it.Wish I had not order the 50 count but something smaller

I use all sorts of K-Cups, but this breakfast blend is definately my Go-To blend!! It is perfect - not too light, not too dark. I highly recommend this, as the price for the 50-count box is pretty good!!
Always brews great in my tall cup. Many other coffees tend to be too weak when you use the larger cup settings but not this one... Like I said... Yum!!

Having lots of problems with Green Mountain cups. Coffee is fine, but plastic seems heavier than other brands and does not fully drain into cup, but drips considerably when removing to dispose. Will probably choose other brands in the future instead. Have been using K-Cups for over a year and only have had problems with this brand.
The K-cups are great. This blend was just right. Have to have at least 1 cup  a day. Enjoyed it. The taste was just right. Will definetly buy again.
Good to purchase in a larger quantity! Ease for keeping supplies in stock! Easy to obtain from Amazon without a third party involved.  Got to use my free shipping - yea.

I love this coffee.  I'm a fan of lighter roasts.  I like the lack of bitterness and higher caffeine that comes with them.  This one is my favorite.  For most K-Cups, even lighter roasts, I have to run the machine twice through one K-Cup to get a decent, not overly-strong, cup of coffee.  These come out perfect for me with one run.  I do tend to go through them more quickly because of that, but that's okay. The great coffee is worth it!
Very pleased with this product. This is not the first time I have purchased Green Mountain Coffee and it wont be the last.

I switched to Green Mountain Breakfast Blend after not being able to get Black Tiger as a super saver item.  It was a real disappointment.  Very weak and certainly not something I would want as "breakfast blend"..

column9: Good Blend, but roast was too light.
column10: I like the taste, but the light roast was too light for me.  I find myself brewing smaller cups of coffee, hoping for a stronger taste.  Next time, I'll go for a medium or dark roast.  I think it was the medium that I had before and I really liked it.

My wife has drunk this coffee for several years.  She tried many different brands before settling on this k-cup. It is a mild great tasting brew that you will like if you like a typical donut shop coffee. Not a Starbucks brew, but a regular mild brew. Give it a try.
I love this product. No more measuring coffee in the morning.No more throwing old coffee out. Best Ideal ever.
I searched Google and found these k-cups. The price is reasonable.  Exceptionally fast delivery. I am very pleased and will order again.
Green Mountain Breakfast Blend is the best moderate blend for the Keurig Brewer.  Very good taste and not acidic.
Tried this blend as a change from routine, but did not find it as enjoyable as I had hoped, still, it was good, just not great.Pat

column9: Love Green Mountain Breakfast Blend -- Great Coffee!!!!!
column10: I just recently got my Keurig, and I've been trying the sample pack of coffee that came with it.  So far this is by far my favorite.  I nice mild coffee taste to enjoy in the morning or anytime.  I actually wish they made this coffee in a decaf version also so I could enjoy the great flavor of this one anytime!  I think this will be the main coffee in this house; I've tried some of the others and liked some of them more than others, but this is the runaway favorite.  I tend to put a good bit of cream and sugar in my coffee (can't stand it black!) but the nice flavor of this one comes through the cream and sugar.  (I've found that cream and sugar can't cover up the taste of coffee I don't like!)  I don't care for the bolder coffees at all (I don't feel like getting slapped in the face by my coffee in the morning!)I'd encourage everyone to give this a try if you like a light roast coffee with a mild, pleasant taste in the morning -- you won't be disappointed!!!
Green Mountain Coffee Keurig Breakfast Blend, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)WE LOVE THE BREAKFAST BLEND- WE'VE TRIED MOST OF THEM,THIS ONE IS IT FOR US.
Not too strong,not too weak.This is the coffee I buy my wife for her mornings.It is probably the simplest k cup brew,but sometimes that is all you might want.

These K-cups are either extremely old or they're not authentic Green Mountain K-cups. The coffee is weak and has a bad after-taste. Both my spouse and I have noticed this independently of each other.I tried to contact the seller to ask about this but couldn't figure out who it was.

one of these will keep my puppy busy and content for hours...great for puppies during their chewing stage

column9: Good quality, but pointy, pointy pieces
column10: Overall, I'm pleased with the quality of these chews. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because a number of the strips are cut in such a way that they have sharp slender points. I have 2 Springer Spaniel pups that love these things so much that they try to gulp them down without much chewing. I keep a close eye on my pups while they eat these chews to ensure that they don't get caught in their throats. We have had one get caught in the roof of the mouth. column9: Dogs are happy, therefore I am happy :)
column10: We own two dogs who are drastically different in sizes. I've always preferred the slivers because my smaller dog can manage them better, and I pick out the larger pieces for my bigger dog. I normally get them from the pet store but needed an extra item to add to my order to put it over 25 bucks ( yay for free shipping ). Swelling, raw snouts - always rubbing on the ground - lethargic. So I went to the vet thinking they were sick from something else. She said the pig ears did it! My puppy absolutely loves these! I do recommend watching your pup/dog while they eat these just to make sure they aren't trying to swallow a big piece of it, and not give it too often as it is fattening. But it does make for a delicious, yummy treat!

column9: Made in USA, but Very Sharp Pointy Edges
column10: After reading the reviews here about made in China, I was pleased to find that they must have been mistaken, ..... that the product is clearly labeled, Made In USA.The product is fun for the dog, I have a 3 lb chihuahua, and he loves them.  They are varying sizes, I'm sure ANY size dog could enjoy them.  My worry is that they are VERY pointy - sharp as a knife.  I watch him very carefully.  I have also filed down some of the points with a commercial metal file.  That was an easier option for me than returning, no matter how easy Amazon returns are, I hate to have to return things.I see other Smokehouse products that I can try instead, so all in all I'm happy with the Manufacturer and the product quality.So, while I give the product 5 stars for flavor and appeal, being made in USA, quality fresh when received - I have to deduct 2 stars for having to file down points.For those that want a list of dog-treat/food Companies that are certified MADE IN USA, check this website: [...] and then find the area that is dog-made-in-the-usa.  On the left, they have two brand lists, the top list is for the USA page, refine by company, etc.  Click see more to see the entire list - - the ones they carry that are NOT made in the USA are grayed out.  NOT made in USA, those include Beefeaters and Busybuddy!!!!  - much to my surprise.  I could have sworn Beefeaters said it had it's facilities FDA and HACCP certified on their About Us on their website.  That would say to me that they are USA, but no where on their site does it actually state Made in USA, so hmmmm.  Guess it's good to investigate.

More jerky that is made in China. Unknowing owners are feeding this potential killer to their loved pets. Please research dog treats you feed your pets before you end up heartbroken and with high vet bills.

column9: Makes yummy croquettes for your family,too!
column10: I grew up on croquettes. Salmon,mackerel,even the large Eatwell sardines all make a fine croquette. I hesitated trying these because all the reviews were for using it for dog food! These are quite good. Actually delicious. Add bread crumbs, onion powder,garlic powder and a little seafood seasoning and voila! Breakfast, lunch or dinner is served. Yes, in the south we have them with biscuits for breakfast. For lunch or dinner serve with rice and your favorite green veggie. Do not bother removing the bones. If you mash the fish with a fork before forming into croquettes, they practically disappear and gives you a boost of calcium. So give your dog a can or two but save the rest for your family.  The usual condiments work well with this fish. Tartar sauce,cocktail sauce and my favorite malt vinegar. Bon Appetit. P.S. Do not forget to add an egg to bind your croquettes. Otherwise the croquettes will fall apart when you fry them.

When I opened a can, it spewed a fetid odor. The water literally looked like sewage. Avoid this product. It's made in China and probably contains high levels of toxicity. I'm glad Amazon refunded my money. I'm just surprised that Amazon carried this product in the first place.

My Japanese grandma drinks a homemade mix of apple cider vinegar and bananas for health and this drink is black, pungent and quite frightening. HongCho vinegreat is a great alternative and actually tastes really good! Don't let the "vinegar" scare you off - it is really quite sweet and you just get a little hit of the tang going down. I guess it really depends on how much you dilute it. I believe the package says 1:3 for a strong taste or 1:4 or 1:5 for a lighter taste. I've tried both the Pomegranate and Blueberry flavors and they were both good. You can also mix the concentrate with milk, yogurt or even make a salad dressing out of it.The bottle recommends drinking after a work out, after a bath or before bed. The regular price is $10/bottle so the Amazon price isn't too bad, especially if you don't have a Korean grocery store nearby.

Now the darker shades of salt do have different minerals, depending where they're from.  You need to be careful though , remember these gourmet salts do not have iodine, so make sure you continue to use table salt, though it is hard to do so.  Love this salt on salads and steak,  trust me.

Love this salt.  It has a really nice flavor, not too salty, has a mineral taste that is very good.

The price may seem high compared to table salt, but Amazon's price is low compared to other places I've bought it. Definitely worth it, in my opinion.One thing to note is that this sea salt is very moist, so it doesn't work well in a grinder or shaker.  Sometimes I'll serve it in a salt cellar, but generally I just keep it in a glass jar by the stove for cooking and use regular salt at the table.

The bar is good quality, and certainly what is advertised.  But, if you prefer the typical beef or beef-jerky style taste, this isn't it.  It tastes more like a Slim Jim, which I don't prefer.  If, however, you like Slim Jims, this bar's for you!
12 oz of cranberry and  buffalo...for $36...you do the math.Great taste from the sugar and fat...but unless your a fat cat...stay back!
I am really impressed with the Tanka Buffalo sticks. Great flavor without being too spicy and a great post work out treat! A little dry but otherwise perfect.

We saw on a Diane Sawyer special that these bars are made by the Lakota Sioux.  They worked great on our road trip to Ohio from NM.  We'll be buying more for gifts this Christmas and for road trips next summer!

Tried this berbere after eating Ethiopian food with my wife.  Excellent spice that adds depth to any dish especially Mexican, spaghetti, eggs or any other meat dish that you want a different unique flavor.

column4: J. Martin "just a good looking guy"
column10: Ok Ill just get to the point of why dissapointed1st-- it is not in a vacuum sealed bag inside the can like the green jasmine i bought from the same company which is why i bought from them again thinking they were serious about freshness for it to be sealed twice :)2nd-- there seems to be more lemon grass and whatever else in there than green tea leavesI actually mix it with the jasmine green tea..and its ok mixed together..so dissapointed...as for the taste of this one..the smell is a little overcoming..but all in all it is an OK tasting tea.

column9: Good Tea; Doesn't Taste Like Green Tea
column10: Well I wanted to switch from black tea after it stained my teeth a bit.  Actually, it was the looseleaf chai from the same company that stained my teeth, and my pot, and my mugs, and my spatula, and everything else it touched, but that's another story...So I thought I'd try green tea.  But it turns out I don't really like the taste of green tea, so I drink this.  It provides a small amount of caffeine and tastes yummy - a lot of citrus and lemongrass flavor.  It tastes more like an herbal tea than a green tea, so if you're looking for green-tea flavor, look elsewhere.
Unique taste and is a bit  sweet on its own without adding extra sweetener.

column9: decades later finally have another chew
column10: I thought this gum died out in the 80s/early 90s. Almost all the gum sold in stores today is laced with aspertame (which imo rots your brain). I refuse to even chew a single piece of gum with that garbage in it.OK, so freshen-up isn't exactly devoid of bad stuff either - red #40, BHT and of course, the catch-all, "artificial flavoring" - which could be anything. Oh, and strangely, i notice it says it contains sulfites? hummm...Thanks to the internet, people can still fulfill a long tail niche for stuff we want.I was thrilled to find amazon and other places sell Freshen-up gum which is still made the same way - with good old fashioned rot-your-teeth sugar.  The Cadbury/Adams mfr says it's made in Brazil now and the box says ©2004. So I'm assuming this gum I got in 2011 is 7 years old.However, gum doesn't go bad very quickly when sealed - at least in this case.  If this gum is really that old.I read another review mentioned they felt the gum was stale.  The batch I got seems fine to me.It still is soft and the liquid center is what made this gum unique.Bubble blowing tip:If you chew 2 pieces at a time, it makes for some decent bubble blowing - although, this can be a bad idea as an adult male... Facial hair wasn't an issue as a kid, but now ya need to be clean shaven unless you want to experience what women go through when they wax, lol.SUMMARY - happy with the gum. Would buy again.  I will likely buy spearmint and/or peppermint next time to see how those stand up to memory.

I use to buy this gum years and years ago.Could never find it.Found in Va when I went away.Came home and typed in Amazon and found it.I love this gum.So good.Just brings back good memories of back in the good ole days.
I was happy to find this gum again! Could have been a little fresher, but the seller made it right, and that goes along way. I recommend this product!Cathy

Seriously, $14.99 for this super small jar. It's not gold! Do not buy this product, it's extremely over priced! Why is there no reference to the size of the jar on Amazon's web site? Ridiculous!Wow, just found this product at Honey Baked Ham locally for $6.99. Can't tell you how horrible a deal this is. DO NOT BUY THIS ITEM FROM AMAZON!!!!!

I am a college student and instant noodles are like the life line for everyone. I normally eat the small cup noodles (shrimp flavor) but I bought a pack of these because I felt that the normal cup noodles were too little and repetitive. At first I was not a big fan of the spicy flavor, but when I ate my second cup I realized how much more filling and better it was compared to the cup noodles. I mean sure they are like 2-3 times more expensive, but they are like 1.5-2 servings. Just be warned though, they are like a day's worth of sodium in each one. I never have these as a meal replacement, but just a midnight snack when I'm up studying. The spice also helps keep my awake which is a plus. I cant wait to try out some of the other flavors they have to offer. Definitely a must to have a pack of these in the house sitting around.

At 330 calories and 8g of saturated fat and lots of MSG and preservatives, you can't eat this often. It's a good snack, because there is not much of it. And it's spicy, so it's exciting to eat. It's what you would expect out of a spicy-flavored ramen. except it's conveniently already in a cup. I only wish it was healthier.
If you even remotely like Korean food and or kimchee, this is the noodle for you! It tastes great and has a very strong flavor (in a good way). You can't go wrong! I bought 4 boxes myself!

I absolutely love the 2.64 oz version of Shin, my favorite junk food fix. For those that think it's the same as the big bags, it's not. There are large dried mushroom flakes in here and the dried green onions are also larger and fresher looking than the ones in the large bags. The noodles are slightly thinner and potentially less soggier. I also like the size much better. 4.2 is way too large for ramen and it's a 1.5 servings. I eat the cheaper 3oz bags sometimes because of the inconvenient 4.2 size. I sometimes don't bother making the large shin if I'm alone because I don't want to waste the rest of it especial if I put eggs and veggies in there, so I'll make it if someone else is eating it with me as I can make 2 bags for 3 people or if it's with someone that can eat 1.5 bags. Since this is junk food, I don't think it makes sense to do the economic math anyway, but it's not even that much more expensive than the large bags. Even if the large ones are 4.2oz and cost just $0.20 more per bag, if I have to waste the rest of it I'm not saving money but rather wasting it. Plus it's not like rice where you can save it and reheat it, so I always flush it down the toilet if I can't finish it, so I'm not just wasting the noodles but also the eggs and veggies and sausages. I wish they have more small-sized tasty ramen options. This is why Americans are fat.
These are my most favorite noodles ever! I have traveled around the world and had Thai and Asian dishes everywhere this is still the best quick meal-noodle form ever!

column9: best cup noodle soup i have ever had
column10: so so so good that im never ever gonna buy any other cup noodle soup but NONG SHIM. best cup noodle soup i have ever had
I used to be able to find this at Walmart at cheaper price but somehow they are not restocking them. So I found this online, pretty good deal. delivered with sturdy package. I like this noodle.
The Cup of Noodles are great & very spicy if you are into spicy foods! I give Amazon a thumbs up on selling this product.

It has a very solid kick. Beyond that, it's just a tasty ramen. I currently have 22 cups left sitting on my floor, and I have no doubt that I'll get through all of them pretty quickly. Easy to make like every other ramen cup, but it is spicier than most. Very good.

The Shin noodle cup is wonderful.  Very, very spicy so go carefully at first.  I mostly use it for my bedtime snack.  Sometimes for lunch.  I highly recommend it for people who like peppery spicy food.

As instant noodles, it is essential for the college life. From a cup noodle stand point, the taste is relatively spicy but can be controlled with the flavor packet. It is still not really healthy to live off of these but worth a shot if you are too lazy or busy to cook.

I have been a fan of Nong shim instant noodles but they've really outdone themselves with this one. This cup noodle tastes better than the shin big bowl (the flavor is different), and tastes different from the bagged shin ramyun. But, it just tastes delicious. The mushroom flavor is noticeable and adds depth to the already complex flavor of the spices. WOW!I gave a couple to starving coworkers and they have been scouring the town for this ever since (the supermarkets here only have the nongshim bowl noodles) which they already like. I told them to get it from amazon but they are internet-shy. Their loss!This is by far the most delicious cup noodle ever. Ever!
Tried many (from all over the world) different types of packaged quick-meal type noodles.  These are by far the best I've had.

This is really spicy but totally worth it. The dried mushroom flakes makes it healthier (?) than other ramen on the market. What I like most about it is it only contains 330 calories per cup, which is acceptable for someone who's watching her weight. And I believe the spice in it can help lose weight (well according to my mom).It has the right amount for my occasional spicy ramen cravings late at night, esp. when I'm studying for a test. The spicy soup can keep me awake even w/t coffee. Recommend to every college student!

column9: The Nongshim Shim noodles are great for college snacks!
column10: The save and subscribe feature by Amazon is great for parents and grandparents who send "goodies" to their college kids.  My granddaughter is a freshman and loves receiving her favorite foods - sent to her automatically by Amazon.  She has always loved this Nongshim Shin Noodle Cup and gets to enjoy them in Mississippi.  She tells me that one of the reasons she likes the Shin noodle cup is because she can make it as spicy or non-spicy by the amount of ingredient in the packet she puts in the cup, which then only requires hot water!
It has more dried vegetables and condiments than the shin cup made in Korea does.I love it. I will purchase it again.

If you're looking for outstanding taste, consistency in a convenient package this is the one to order. This ramen is one of the best tasting ramen noddles. Let me just add that is pretty spicy which I like...If you're not into spicy food you won't like it.

I usually bring lunch to work and there are some days I don't have enough time or don't feel like making my sandwich. If this is the case, I just grab one nong shim shin noodle cup and enjoy it at work. Very convenient and tasty!
My family loves these for a quick meal. They aren't something to eat all the time but once in a while is ok.

No instant ramen is ever going to live up to the real, fresh-cooked thing.  This is pretty dang close, though, and very spicy to boot.  I particularly enjoy it on cold days (or when I'm suffering from a cold).

These are pretty good. The package saysdo not put in microwave, but they are totallysafe to put in the microwave. I did, and to me it tastebetter than boiling water and lettin it sit. But yeathese are quick and tasty. I just don't like the mushroomsand the little peices of meat things or whatever. Butother than that, tasty noodles.
I always buy shinn in Korea Supermarket, but it is too hard for me to go there every months.This is the first time i buy it on the internet, i feel soo good about it ,thanks

I have bought 5 or so cases of these over the last few months, they never dissappoint. Cheap easy to use and a nice spicy/hot taste to them. Some days actually makes me break out in a sweat at my desk. O and people can smell them from across the room lol. I just use the water cooler hot water tab to cook them.

column9: Still good, but they changed cup materials...
column10: I'm a little dissapointed that they changed the cups material to paper.  I'm sure its a little more environmentally friendly but probably just cheaper for the US maker.  Oh well, I tried and loved these a few years back and at least the flavor hasn't changed.  Still great... but -1 star for changing cup materials... the styrofoam ones insulated a lot better.
This soup will knock any sickness you have. This is extremely hot (spice) and could possibly cure cancer. Make sure that you use half or less of the flavor pack they include in the soup.
I sent them to him in Iraq, I wish amazon.com would ship their foods like this to apo, I mean why would I buy food online unless I was in a place where I couldn't go to a store?
This is a great product and great price, if you like spicy Korean Noodles you will Love this one. Great for snacks or even a meal. Enjoy and fast to fix

I should have read the other reviews before ordering. No where in the description (maybe I missed it) did it say it was SPICY. I ordered this for my son and he said even using 1/2 the seasoning packet it is too HOT! Rather than waste the noodles, he makes his own soup broth, from the other reviews prob. a healthier choice anyways.

I love the Shin Ramyun flavor of ramen, and bought these because, unlike the bowls, the description for these said "Boil or microwavable," and I assumed that meant you can either pour in boiling water, or pour water in and then microwave it.  This is NOT the case.I recommend getting the 4.2 ounce packages, as that is the more cost effective way to do it.  As always, keep an eye open for coupon codes or subscribe and save discounts.  Maybe check the googles.

Because I cannot trust Japan-made noodles (or ramens) due to recent nuclear radiation spread in Japan, I highly recommend everyone to stick with the best-selling Korea-made noodle among Koreans in Korea and the world.
Nothing special.  I found the taste of this tea to be a bit lacking.  I generally expect more flavor out of a loose tea.

column9: Fruit and spice; makes a good chai with milk
column10: This black tea can be a bit much on its own, but combined with milk and a little sweetener, it becomes a wonderful hot chai. I haven't been tempted to try it iced yet, but if I do, I'll still add the milk.

My wife and I made the switch to fair trade coffee recently and set about looking for a good coffee pod for our Senseo at a fair price.  My doctor recently advised me to cut down on the caffeine, so our search included decaf coffee pods.  We weren't optimistic.  However, we tried Baronet Coffee Fair Trade Organic (!) Decaf Small Village Blend and found it to be a really flavorful cup of coffee. It was a pleasant surprise to find a decaf pod that rivaled "real" coffee in taste. If I have a second cup of coffee in the morning, it is brewed with this pod.

column9: When it's good it's very good
column10: Sometimes the decaf coffee pods are very flavorful but sometimes the brew is all watered down, no darker than strong tea. In this last batch I've had three so far and two were bad so I am going to look for another brand for decaf.

These crackers seem to disappear from my house! They are lightly flavored and filling at the same time, I find if I have a package of one these and perhaps a piece of fuit, I stay full for a much longer time than when I do with other snacks. My husband and youngest son like them too!
Aleppo pepper is hot and spicey but doesn't linger on like jalapenos, for instance.  It's become a staple on my spice shelf.

column9: Hard to find items have a home on Amazon
column10: Not much to review except it's the usual Carnation in the delicious strawberry flavor that I drank as a kid. It seems all the strawberry available in the stores these days is in a mixed/variety package and only 2-3 packets of this flavor are put in the usual 10-packet variety box along with 4-5 packets of 2 different chocolate flavors. After searching a half dozen grocery stores for the strawberry only box, I gave up and turned to Amazon, which thankfully stocked it. I'll be ordering more soon. Cheers to Amazon. (note: this item requires 3 boxes--so minimum order appears to be 30 strawberry packets for the $12-13 price.)

I'm glad to see these on Amazon. I scour the grocery stores for the strawberry flavor, but it's hard to find. Most times, if they have it at all, it's part of a variety pack. I just want the strawberry. I've gone so far as to order them directly from the manufacturer.The flavor of these is great. I'm not a big breakfast person, and most breakfast foods are heavy and greasy. Eggs get boring after a while, but strawberry instant breakfast is always a treat. It's quick to make and easy to take along if you want - just put it in a travel mug. It has vitamins and minerals and great taste. I mix it with organic whole milk and I'm set until lunch time. I've used it for years when I'm on a diet - the taste is something to look forward to, it gives me a little boost, and it's so quick that it keeps me out of the kitchen.

column9: my husband lives on this product
column10: Excellent flavor -my husband had mouth cancer with radiation .He has lived on mainly this product for three years.

I was hesitant to purchase this at first because I thought it might turn out too thick and taste nasty. But I decided for a few dollars, it was worth giving it a shot. I'm so glad I did! It tastes exactly like strawberry milk and it's a great breakfast substitute for anyone who would normally rather skip that meal. I've also heard it's great for getting more nutrients and calories in children that don't like to drink milk or eat much.

If you're one of those people who doesn't like to do breakfast, but you don't want to suffer the lack of energy skipping breakfast brings - this product just might be the solution?  It's worth a shot.  Of the flavors, Strawberry is the best - my opinion - and I purchase the vanilla as an alternative so that I don't tire of just the one choice.  Your tastes may differ so you might want to start with the Variety package???
I havent been able to find the strawberry flavor in years, I had to resort to buying the variety pack to get strawberry.  I love that it is available on Amazon and delivered right to my door.

My 4 yr old daughter never eats breakfast and she is a picky eater.From where we come from,we are not used to cold milk out of the refridgerator,plain warm milk is not my daughter's favorite.After I found out abt this product,I didn't have to look bk.This replaced the nesquik I was giving her earlier.This is less sugary and for  vegetarians like us,this was a great source of proteins.I would like the product to be even less sugary(especially the strawberry flavored) so that even I can drink it and it will be a great meal substitute.Overall a great product for picky eaters.....!!

I love this product.  Strawberry is one of my favorite flavors. This product sort of  reminds me of nestle quick in strawberry but its for grown ups.  For some reason I could not find  this flavor at any of the local stores in town so thank you Amazon.  I am using it to help me get something quick, nutritious, and tasty.  It has a nice smooth strawberry flavor and I know its good for me.  Hopefully it will help me loose weight.

My grandson is autistic and doesn't eat very well, so we give him Carnation Instant breakfast with  his milk to give him the vitamins he needs.  The problem is he only drinks strawberry and we cannot find it in the stores. I am so happy that I was able to get this on Amazon. Thanks for carrying this product.
This is the only place I can find this product in the strawberry flavor.  Great buy!

My kid wouldn't drink anything except Strawberry flavored Carnation Instant Breakfast drink in the mornings. I couldnt find this flavor in any of our local groceries. Thanks for Amazon for the prompt delivery.I stocked up on this item, so that I do not need to worry for a while.
I love strawberry flavor instant breakfast and cant find it in any local grocery store. Glad to find it online.

These are great to use.  Mix a packet in a blender with milk, ice cream and it makes a great and healthy milk shake.  You can add malt powder and a banana or strawberries for even more nutrient value.We use these to help build up the body after chemo treatments for my wife.  Other flavors in the Carnation line work equally as well.  Taste great...recommend them.

My son is autistic and has a very limited diet, BUT he loves strawberry flavored milk. So I tried to find this in my local grocery stores but they never had strawberry! So I found this and he just loves it and I love it because I know he's getting more of the nutrition he needs!
My 3 year old son lives for this stuff.  He would drink it all day long if I let him.  It is really yummy and hard to find in the grocery stores.  The price on Amazon is great too!
We use Carnation instant breakfast to supplement our weight training and workouts.  It is cost effective, convenient and quite tasty!

I bought these for my special needs son so that he could have a variety of flavors.  We can only buy the vanilla and chocolate in stores, but no one carries the strawberry.  Unfortunately, he is not crazy about this flavor, but I have no problem drinking it myself.  I really like the taste and since I do not usually eat well as I should, this is a great idea to get in much needed vitamins and minerals once a day!  Highly recommended!

column9: Good for losing and gaining weight
column10: These are great as a substitute for a meal for an adult who is watching his/her weight and as a supplement to a meal for kids who are picky eaters and need to gain weight. At 42 cents per package the price is right too.
Tried it, it's good. Doesn't mix as easily as I'd like it to, but otherwise, makes a pretty good drink.

My 10 y.o. daughter is a very picky eater and could never hold down breakfast in the morning.  It makes her nauseous.  I tried this after a recommendation from her doctor and was pleased to find out she loves it.  It is really difficult to find in stores and Amazon's price is great.  I mix it with whole milk to boost the fat content, since my daughter has trouble putting on weight with her lack of appetite lately.  Breakfast is no longer a chore.  Everyone can enjoy this and its easy enough that she can make it herself.  I love the fact that it also has protein, vitamins and iron, since this is so important for growing kids.  Thank you to Carnation for making such a great product and Amazon for stocking it.

I purchased 3 3-box cartons of Instant Breakfast through Amazon in March 2008.  They were priced a third of what they are currently.  Too bad, it was convenient to order from Amazon for this, but apparently "buy locally" is the only option I can afford.

If you love thick, chewy, rich chocolate brownies, these are the ones for you.  The chocolate is rich, but not overwhelming and they are somewhat cake-like and thick, and are nicely chewy without being gooey.  Interspersed throughout the mix is a nice balance of semi-sweet, bittersweet and milk chocolate bits and the whole thing is so yummy, you aren't even aware of what flavor of chips you're eating, in case one of those is not your favorite chocolate.  It's that good. The box makes 6 batches, and that's 6 individual packs of mix, so it'll keep you supplied with brownies for a while.  If you're going to go with a mix, this is the one to get.

column9: Best brownies in a pack ever!
column10: I'm not a big fan of baking ready made brownies, because they never seem to live up to the home made ones..but Ghiradelli is one exception...The chocolate chips are what set this brand apart. Will definitely re-order...and soon! I've run through almost all of the six batches I received...

column9: The Best Brownies I've Ever Eaten
column10: Like many others, I found the big six pack of these wonderful brownies at Costco. I make two packs at a time and add two cups of diced walnuts. I feel as though I'm in heaven when I warm one of these brownies and add a big scoop of the finest vanilla ice cream! I'm totally addicted to these brownies! Unfortunately, I can no longer find them at Costco. I hope they didn't stop carrying them!

column9: Why waste the time on scratch made? Use these!
column10: I've thought about trying to make brownies from scratch some time, but why bother when these boxed ones are sooooooo good and sooooooo easy? I, too, get the big box from Costco, which is nice because once you make one package, you are going to want a second package sooner rather than later.They are moist and chewy and OH SO chocolaty. We have made these for a lot of people, and we always get raves about them. Just to spice things up a but, we will sometimes add nuts, M&Ms, coconut, or peanut butter for some variation...and those are just as tasty!

I can make a pretty good brownie from scratch, but after trying this brownie mix I've decided WHY BOTHER!  This mix is so easy to prepare, add milk, an egg and some oil and stir!!They have a texture that I can't duplicate, the brownies from this mix turns out chewy and crispy on the edges, with deep chocolate flavor.  Absolutely awesome.I've made some adjustments to customize it to my liking.  I use melted butter instead of oil and I use a spring release ice cream scoop and scoop the batter into lined (I've baked straight into oiled tins too) muffin tins so that I can get those even crispy chewy edges in every serving. They bake faster this way too, about half the time. Make sure not to over bake them. Then remove and  I just turn it over onto a cooling rack and wait 10 minutes for warm brownies.  Yummy!!

I buy this at Costco.  It's the only brownie mix I will buy - or I make them from scratch.It's fast, tastes great, and the Ghiradelli chocolate chips (3 kinds) makes it just a bit more outrageous.  I like to add toasted nuts (walnuts or pecans) to the batter before baking.I have even made one serving (still experimenting on actual measurements) in a bowl and microwaved it for a quick snack with a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream on top drizzled with caramel sauce.  Eye-balling the mix and ingredients, using a tablespoon egg in cartons, a spoon of oil...etc... you get the idea, to make your own single serving of chocolate delight.

These brownies are amazing and addictive... and so easy to make right out of the box!  I'll never make brownies from scratch ever again as long as these are around.  If you live by a Costco, you can get a box of six for about $10.

column9: Quick and easy mix -- with homemade goodness.
column10: Ghirardelli makes the best brownie mix ever!With real chocolate taste & richness like you made them from scrtach.We came across the Ghirardelli six pack at Costco.Since then it's been a staple of our food pantry.Our family agrees this is instant, ole' fashioned baking.When you make two packs at a time in a 9 x 13 panthe brownies are thick and yummy, sometimes a little gooey.For moist, but not gooey brownies, bake a little longeror only bake one batch in a pan.We add extra pecans, and think that makes them even better.This has been a big hit at family gatherings for the last several years.What more can you say about something that's easy and satisfying.Ghirardelli makes high quality chocolate, and this is a high quality brownie.

column9: Great Deal- if you're not a C*stco member
column10: First of all, this is the standard by which all box brownie mixes, (and most 'from scratch') recipes should be judged.  I've been buying them from my favorite BIG BOX store for years.  I enjoy making them even more decadent, sometimes adding cinamon for a Mexican flavor or adding a ganache for the "OMG" affect at parties.  (Sometimes both!!!!)The price is significantly better at C0stc0, but if you're not a member, then rock the Amazon deal.If you like these, I'd also recommend the Ghirardelli chocolate chip cookie mix.  It's not readily available in stores, and sometimes only found in PTA gift catalogs at xmas time at about $4.00/box.  On Amazon, they're available at about $3/box or less with free super saver shipping (case of 12).  I share the case with friends, neighbors and other foodies at work.

column9: Amazon is the only place to buy Triple Brownie Mix
column10: Great brownie mix...my grandchilden love the brownies.  Can't make  enough of them.  (equals 6 regular size brownie mixes).Ghirardelli Chocolate Triple Chocolate Semi-Sweet Milk, Bittersweet Brownie M

This dog food has done well for my Alaskan Malamute. We had difficulties with her ability to digest all other foods and are pleased with how this food makes her coat soft, as well as she is able to digest it easily. Recommend to anyone else who is struggling with a sensitive stomach in their dog. Did not give 5 stars due to the price.

My dog has some dry skin issues so I try this brand and formula because of it's higher fish oil content over other foods. It has helped and my dog seems to like it over her old brand. It does make her a little more gassy, but not intolerable.
Like all the bolner's products I've used, the brisket rub is an excellent choice. I use several of them, and I've never been disappointed.
Best Tic tacs out there, When i kiss my woman with one of these babys in my mouth its like the forth of july shes says.

I got excited when I saw Tic Tac's new blue "powermints" and ordered the carton of 12. Unfortunately these really don't taste like typical breath mints ... they taste like MENTHOL COUGH DROPS. This wouldn't be such an issue if I wasn't an ex-smoker, but menthol reminds me of cigarettes. I'll be switching back to my favorite "wintergreen" Tic Tacs.

I was tired of getting bags of assorted chocolate candy that always had a variety no one would eat.  I love that amazon was selling this product and it came in "bulk".  I won't run out of office candy again!  I went ahead and bought all of the favorite brands so I can keep everyone happy.  This one seems to be the favorite and the one that I ran out of most often.

Almond Joy - Coconut Joy! All bars are equally delicious;never fail to please! These are my very own treat. I would share if I could count on there being any left when I go to get one. So the little treasures have to be hidden. These are every bit as good as candy that comes in a box!
Almond Joy - I love them and with the little bars I don't feel guilty having one or two or ....

These were yucky! An old product that should have been thrown away and used as a write off for the manufacturer. The expiration (Best used by) date was only two weeks from the date I received them. I had not thought to check the date until we tried eating them and ultimately had to throw away. Totally wrong to sell old product. Be careful!

Who says you have to wait for Easter or Halloween? I purchased Almond Joy, Baby Ruth, Butterfinger, KitKat and one more...thinking...I ate it so can't remember. All came packaged as stated, perfect sized bars. Not huge, not mini, but perfect 2-bites sizes. Just like Goldie Locks and the 3 Bears. I ordered this for when company stops over - Everyone loves to choose from my candy dish. Only problem was, I ate more than I shared. Uh oh. Not melted, but I didn't order during a warm time of year. Maybe during the summer, a cold pack is included....We'll see because I intend to order again.Great buy. Great Price. And love the door to door service. I also got a $50 credit when ordering, can't beat that!

So for many of you, if you're here reading this, chances are high that you've had these candies before and know what to expect. If not, then I would tell you that if you've got any aversion to coconut at all, to steer clear of this particular treat. That said, if you do like coconut, then these candies are definitely for you. The coconut is flaked throughout the center surrounded by a nice dense layer of chocolate, which is all offset nicely by the texture of the almonds inside. It would probably be more accurate to call this candy [Coconut Joy] - but then I suppose [Almond Joy] has a better auditory ring to it.As for the product itself, the pack of 6 that I received through the mail were actually quite fresh. There was none of that chalky-white film that you often find with a lot of the older candies that have been sitting in storage boxes, no, these were pretty much perfect. I enjoy the bite-size as well, since as one reviewer put it, the candy is already portioned out for you, so you don't run the risk of accidentally nibbling that extra bite at the edge on the full size bars.Overall, shipping was hassle-free and product was in excellent condition. The candies last a long time, but my suggestion would be that if you do not intend to share these with anyone, you may want to order/purchase a smaller portion, otherwise you may find your candy getting stale. My family and I have already finished our first six bags (lasted about 2 months) - and will be ordering again.

column9: Almond Joy snack size are great
column10: What can I say.  These snack size almond joy bars are great and the size is just right for a quick bite.  They come in a 6 pack of large bags and saves the hassle and expense of trying to find them in the stores.  Plus they are delivered right to the front door!

Ok, so one bad thing about this candy is that it comes in a a pack of 6,yea 6 bags. But, I cant find these in my grocery store. I do love the fact that these are like a double bite size. Shipping was quicker than I had expected. I wonder if they would make a bag larger than 11.3 oz, then instead of six bags, there would be maybe four:)
I eat these regulary as desert after dinner - few calories but taste great - love them! They should have subscribe option on this

Part of my husband's job is to spoil his clients by bringing them cakes or candy or sometimes even lunch. I usually know what he is buying because he brings home the empty boxes (like Twinkie boxes) for recycling. I then of course have to look at the empty boxes wishing he would have saved me one treat. Well finally he did remember to bring me two Almond Joys. I must say they are one of my favorite chocolate candies. The crunch of the almond goes so well with the smooth chewy coconut all encased in a bliss of melting chocolate. One bite and you are hooked.~The Rebecca Review

column9: What is 6" long and has 2 nuts?
column10: These little things go fast.  When I open a bag, it does not seem to last very long.  This seems to be on everyones favorite list of candy.

column9: Fantastic what I found on Amazon.com
column10: Clearbrook Farmas makes the best preserves around.  Plus they know that service is paramount to maintaining good customer relations.  They expidite your order as soon as received. I have tried the Orange Marmalade, Black Cherry and Strawberry. All were exceptional. Because the container is so unusual I think this would make excellent Xmas gifts.  If you haven't tried preserves form Clearbrook Farms you are REALLY missing out.

column9: Great preserves and worth the price.
column10: My jar of Strawberry preserves is gone already.  For some reason our local stores are not selling preserves anymore.  I love fruit in my 'jelly'.  This is the second time I have bought this product and will continue to buy.  My kids love these too.

This is a very flavorful seasoned nori. It is shredded and not in sheets. Also it has MSG in it hence the four stars instead of 5. column9: Good popcorn, but not earth shattering
column10: I was hoping for popcorn that rocked my world.  Instead this popcorn is simply good.  It's about as good as any of the better grocery store brands, but for less money.  Would I buy this again?  Yes.  Did it change my life?  No.

Fresh popcorn seed, sea salt and no packaging to hurt the environment and a great price. Better quality than that plastic popcorn bottle company. Why buy somehting that once you get filled you fill the landfills.
Hardly any kernels left in the bottom of the pan, tastes great, and it comes in smaller packs to keep it dry and fresh. Will totally buy again, what a great value!

I have eaten a lot of popcorn over my years and I find this one to be very tough. My girlfriend and I both find this to be very hard to chew. Its not that its bad popcorn, its just very tough to chew. Maybe i have a bad bag. Anyone else have this problem? Also, this is A LOT of popcorn.

This product isn't bad but it doesn't hit the sweet sweet spot for me.I cannot remember where or what brand of popcorn it was so the search continues.If I find it again - I'll update and modify the review...

I was pleasantly surprised at the delicious, fluffy puffs of popped corn. The popcorn had very few un-popped seeds, and only a small amount of hulls. I originally purchased this popcorn due to the fairly low amount of packaging, positive reviews, and reasonable price. I would definitely buy Firecracker Popcorn from Dodo Brands again.

My poor opinion could be due to my popping method, but I just wasn't impressed. I have an air popper and found that 1/3 of the kernels won't pop and the ones that do are tough/stale tasting. It's a little disappointing that I now have SIX bags of sub-par popcorn to go through before I can try another brand.

I got these a while ago and they have been great! they pop well into tender, medium sized popcorn. our microwave isn't the greatest, so not all the kernels pop (~80% pop), but again, a better microwave would help. Also, this is kosher, blessed by a rabbi at the facility. I thought it was interesting, not that I cared about kosher popcorn, but they don't mention it in the description.
This has to be the best popcorn I ever ate!!  Pops up huge and is tender and delicious.  Lots of servings in the shipment, too.

I just recieved my first shipment of Dodo Firecracker Popcorn.  I popped 1/3 c. popcorn on my stovetop popper (Back to Basics) and it turned out really good.  It popped up big and fluffy. Only 10 unpopped kernels in the bottom of my bowl. It tastes light and airy and is not chewy like some popcorn seems to be. It tastes very fresh and I will definitely keep this on subscribe and save.

I love popcorn and this are the best I have tried until now!They taste delicious. It pops very quick and all at once, so when it's done there is no pop corn burned and/or corn seed remaining in the pan.I also like that it comes in many small packs. It is very practical.

I did a price comparison and picked one of the less expensive popcorns Amazon had available, so I'm really pleased to report that it is very satisfactory popcorn.  I pop mine in the microwave using one of those microwave poppers.  This corn pops up more quickly, makes larger kernels, and there's fewer unpopped kernels, so I had to experiment with how much unpopped corn to use and how long to go a bit at first (it didn't help that I got a new microwave around the same time).  But now that I've worked through those details, this corn pops up nicely, has a good flavor, and was a reasonable price.  What more could you ask?
Love this popcorn!  Pop it with a little olive oil and yum.  I have my whole family hooked on it.
after reading the reviews, i thought this was worth the try. it tastes good and is a great price for the quantity you get.

We originally got this for our Bengals, it was what the breeder recommended.  Then, we found two kittens only a day old on the street and adopted them.After they were weaned they took to this stuff like gangbusters.  Now, they are both 20 plus pound monster kitties.  Never sick a day in their lives, glossy coats, full of energy.Picky cats love Felidae, it is full of healthy ingredients.  Obviously, however, it's not the best food for cat weight control! Now the boys are on a "light" cat food, and they aren't quite as happy.So, I suggest this for Bengals or cats who need to put on a few pounds.

I took an abused mature cat from the shelter.  She was sick...throwing up almost everything.  My vet recommended Felidae and that was 3 years ago.  She now weighs 13# and is healthy & happy.  It may cost a little more, but it is worth every penny!

column9: Omaha Steaks 8 (12 oz.) Private Reserve Ribeyes
column10: Well, Grandpa made out like a king this Christmas.  Grandma bought him some Omaha Steaks (12 oz. ribeyes) and I must tell you that they are delicious!  Gramps shared his steaks with Grams and we had a delightful dinner.  There are six more for him to enjoy and there's not a piece of fat anywhere on them.  They cook even better on the George Foreman grill that went with them as a second gift (also purchased through Amazon.com -- thank you).  It's so easy to clean and he was like a little kid waiting for Santa to finally bring the gifts this year.  Of course, I made out like a bandit this year also, so now we're both flat broke.Who cares?  We have our health, our children and grandchildren, and we have each other for the past 44 years.  Who could ask for anything more?  Thanks to Amazon.com for making our Christmases so special!!

Blazing fast shipping, product as ordered, great price-this is the best of ordering online. I received this package at least a week and a half before I received a bag of different food that I ordered online from somewhere else.The food itself is great stuff. I mix it with Evo's chicken and turkey dry food to cut the carbs. My boy cat loves it and maintains his weight on the mixture. He is healthy and his fur is softer than silk. I use one cup of Evo and 1/2 a cup of this food when mixing together in a Tupperware cereal container. It goes in the bowl from that.I also give my little guy a feline multivitamin from PetSmart. GNC makes it. It has fish oil in it among other things and helps to keep him in the best shape.

I have had these crackers several times throughout the years.  I bought them from amazon.com because they offered them in bulk.  I didn't realize that the bags were full size bags.  It's not a terrible thing, it just means that I have more to eat.  I like the way the taste is subtle and not cheapened with strong artificial tastes.  I can see where some people may be coming from with saying they're bland, but I think that they definitely have a taste and it's a good taste at that.  It does take eating a few crackers before you really get the full effects of the taste.  I would probably say that people should order these if they really like them or often host parties or whatnot where people will consume them.  Otherwise, it's a lot for a single person.  That's not really a bad thing, but it is something to be aware of.

column9: Good companion with my term papers
column10: These tasty shrimp crackers remind me of hometown crackers--they taste exacly the same, yummy!That's why I always have them when fighting with my term papers.
This snack is long time Korean favorite.  Amazon has the best price ever for this.  It is better than buying at the Korean grocers.  The snack is fresh and yummy.

Not bland at all.  My family loves these.  These go fast.  The kids like them just as much as I do.Yes there is kind of a stink when you first open them but they don't taste that strong.The flavor is just good.  Really.  But if you've never had these before play it safe and don't buy bulk.

column9: THE BEST KOREAN FAVORITE  CRACKER!!! no fried
column10: I GIVE 5 STARS BECAUSE THE CRACKERS ARE THE BEST KOREAN TASTE COMPARED WITH AMERICAN CRACKERS ....this crackers i think isn't for every body my husband is Italian and he said that taste like already expired but for asian people is very good....if  want to buy just to try go to korean grocery or any asian grocery and buy 1 single package and you see if want try more!!I'm very upset with Amazon.com because recieved the  crackers expired.

No real shrimp flavor, more like a fishy after taste. I couldn't give these things away to family, or co-workers (which says a lot, because nurses will eat anything). This was money wasted. The whole box went to the trash.

Great product.  I found this item at my local market for $3.00 which is the usual price at most stores.
By far the best stevia.  I've tried others, but none compare to this brand.  I go through a lot of this particular product in smoothies and green drinks.

NuNaturals is the best stevia brand out there. It's not at all bitter or fakey like so many other brands I've tried. This is such a great product, as are others from this company (their regular alcohol-free stevia and pure stevia powder are excellent too).
It's the best Stevia Liquid on the market,with pleasant vanilla flavor, great in smoothies and oatmeal, also good in tea or coffee. I recommend!
I've been using this product for years now! always have a bottle handy for ice tea, coffee and even baking. Great product!

I love NuNaturals pure liquid Vanilla Stevia- great flavor, mixes easily, and works in a variety of applications!  I think this is the Stevia product for people who haven't loved Stevia in other applications or made by other companies-- none of the "aftertaste" many complain about.
This is my favorite stevia.  It has the least amount of bitterness of any I have tried.  I will purchase again
This is the best stevia product I've tried that erased a lot of the bitterness. Try it in baking and homemade chocolates, very good.

This won't work for everything I need to use a sugar-sub for, but I am absolutely happy with the flavor and I've been able to use it for most of my recipes or in combination with some other substitute. I definitely recommend it!
I love this stevia in my morning protein shake...so good with a banana smoothie too! Even though it seems expensive, a little goes a long way. Love it!

I give this to my 5.5 month old chihuahua puppy. He really loves this and eats all his food. He seems very happy with his food. In fact one of my cats also enjoy trying it. My dog seems to be thriving on it.

I won't comment on the price because that can change. We all do our best to find deals and bargains.This food is wonderful. I used to buy cheap, grocery store stuff and tried this on a whim. I'm so glad I did.My dog is a little older and is missing some teeth. Since he is a shih tzu he also throws up from time to time after eating. (Do all shih tzus do this, mine has since birth) Anyway, this food seems to cut down on the incidents. The pieces are very small and easy for him to chew.It's good for him, a great size for my little dog, and I will continue to buy it.

My dogs have been using this food for many years.  My 14-year-old and 7-year-old chihuahuas are very healthy and they like the food.  My 7-year-old dog has been on the mature adult diet since he was a puppy, since my older chihuahua needed a senior diet to keep her from having trouble  with her liver.  Science Diet is the best!

column9: A few tricks necessary to get my dog to eat it, but worth it!
column10: I cook chicken livers in the oven, use a thumb-sized morsel with hot water to coat the whole doggie dish and put a dollop of tuna fish on top of a big handfull of Science Diet.  Superb!  He loves it!  He's 11 and feisty as a pup.  Feed him small meals four times a day.

My puppy is a Boxador (Boxer/Lab) and she loves this food. In fact, the first time I brought it home she was jumping on the bag trying to get it open. I have read many reviews on Science Diet in general and they have not received the best reviews for some odd reason... but, my dog has not had any gastrointestinal complications and loves this brand of dog food. It's a keeper for me... not to mention it is reasonably priced.

column9: My Puppy Loves It and Thrives On It!
column10: My puppy has had much better success tolerating and thriving on Science Diet compared with pricier "all natural" brands...you know...ingredients that people would also be happy to eat.  But she is a dog, not a human and so if ground up chicken beaks are one of the fillers, but she is healthy and happy, I don't worry about it period.  At the shelter where I got her they sell Science diet for half the price of what it is available elsewhere...gotta go get some more.  Why, because my dog loves it and is healthy and happy and seeing is believing.  Cheers!
The product is fine - we buy this dog food anyway, but we found it's cheaper for us to buy it right in our home town.

I had been using this food mixed with the canned science diet for my lab puppy (because that is what the shelter had used), and didn't have any issues.  However, after reading the other review, I asked the manager at a local pet food store what he thought of this brand, and he said it was NOT good - all fillers (corn) and animal by-products.  He suggested I gradually shift the dog to Blue, which has a similar protein/carbohydrate mix, and then when the puppy is a bit older (around a year), move to a food with a higher protein content.  (To ease the puppy into a new diet, he suggested I start by mixing 1/4 cup new food with 3/4 old food for a few days, then half and half, etc).  He also recommended that I mix in a couple of tablespoons of canned food with some water, just to make the dry food moist.  (He said the nutritional content of the canned food isn't as important, since the dry food will provide most of the substance, and that I can vary the canned food.)  Finally, he also said that bully sticks are far better for dogs than rawhide (which are basically like eating leather).

Please do your research on pet foods and what is actually good for your dogs.  Hills science diet is a horrible food filled with horrible ingredients.  They charge an outrageous price because it's the #1 vet recommended food.  This is a joke and the only reason why it's rated #1 buy vets is because Hills gives money to soon to be vets to help them go through school.  Then they sell the dog food to them cheap so they can jack up the price and make a nice profit off of your marketing foolishness.  Read the back of the labels of Hills brand and you will see that most of the top ingredients are grains or cheap meat by products which are the feathers, bones, unwanted organs from animals, basically all of the stuff we wouldn't eat.  i would recommend going to [...] and compare brands and see what is right for you budget wise. try something like orijen or evo.

Since Tassimo, my  moods have been the best! I absolutely love cappuccino, and now prefer it to regular coffee thanks to Tassimo.  The TASSIMO SYSTEM is very affordable, and makes it so easy to do! My only problem is the price it sells for on Amazon.  In the market place, it basically costs $10 for an 8 cup package, not $25.  Do not let this high price discourage you. Definitely give it a try!

Absolutely delicious, savory pasta sauces...I tried all flavors in these handy, easy to store pouches.  If you want savory, this tomato basil is outstanding.  If spicy is your thing, try the spicy Fra Diavlo!  Too yummy and easy to dress up or down.  I ordered 3 cases of each!
144 Frosted Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop Tarts. Need I say more? I know have enough to last at least a couple of days.

Frosted Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop-Tarts are delicious but be really careful in buying 144 of them.  The Pop-Tarts arrived in near perfect condition with more than a year of shelf life left.Our plan was to have them one a day for breakfast, but after a week I never want to see another Pop-Tart again.  Too much of a great thing -- even Pop-Tarts -- can get to you.

This is fabulous!  My husband and I are both chocolate lovers.  We each put a square of this in our mouths, stopped and both said Wow, that's really good!!  It's incredibly rich and smooth and has real depth of flavor.  Love it!

When I start it is hard to stop. This candy is one that my children bought for their father every year.We would go and buy a box for few bucks and he would pretend to be surprised every time they gave him a box.  He is gone now but we still buy a box and put it under the tree.These are a nice cherry flavor and the chocolate, could be a bit smoother but it is fine just the way it is.

I thought this soup tasted pretty good.  Of course as others have stated, nothing beats homemade but this was pretty tasty.  I'm not sure if I got an updated package but the soup I purchased from a local store was microwavable.  The directions stated you had to first open the container and remove the metal lid then cover with plastic wrap. I just put the plastic lid back on top loosely and had no problems. Overall I think this was a great lunchtime alternative.  Will be trying the other flavors soon.

This stuff is terrible! To begin with, the packaging is completely misleading. The hefty plastic cup appears very similar to other microwaveable convenience soups, pasta dishes, etc. on the market, but they are NOT microwaveable. To microwave, you must first dump the soup into a separate dish. The instructions further state to "discard the container" after opening, so I was not sure it would even be safe to store my leftover portion in it. Turns out I didn't need to worry about it, because the soup itself was certainly nothing special! Same old salty-yet-bland canned soup garbage that ALWAYS disappoints. I ate about 1/3 out of the bowl hunger, then dumped the rest once I felt like I could make it through to dinnertime.I had bought several of these in preparation for returning to work after maternity leave because they seemed like a nice, convenient cold-weather lunch option. BIG mistake and BIGGER waste of money!!! I predict these will meet a swift end and you won't see them around much longer.PS - The Campbell's Healthy Harvest Tomato Basil Soup (NOT The Kettle Cooked version, just regular canned) is very good, and my husband and I always keep it in the house. It's the only canned soup we like. I should have known better not to waste my money elsewhere.
When you are watching your carbs and need some protein, this is the soup to get.The taste and texture is outstanding.  Wonderful to be able to receive this soupdelivered to my door by Amazon.

column9: Weird, I thought this soup was great!
column10: I thought this soup was delicious as far as canned soups go!  Tastes way better than a lot I've tried.  It had more depth of flavor that just salt and I loved the beans and greens in it.  I didn't care about the packaging not being microwavable because I've gotten into the habit of never microwaving things in plastic anyway.

column9: Campbell's Slow Kettle Chicken Bean soup
column10: I don't know where the other reviewers are coming from; they must never make homemade soup and think the prepared type should taste the same!  Especially comparing it with other prepared soups, Chunky ,etc.  I love this soup....of course, it doesn't taste like homemade-from-scratch soup but I think it's very tasty for a prepared soup. I like the chicken bean flavor the best followed by the portabella mushroom.  We have it for lunch and sometimes dinner with a salad.....bon appetite......

This soup is just your regular old canned soup with lots of very salty broth and rubbery chicken pieces.  First bite was a big piece of some sort of chicken fat, processed chicken by-product and it didn't improve much from there.  Some of the chicken was actual chicken meat, but the way they are promoting this product as a premium soup, I would have expected all of the chicken to be identifiable as such. The vegetables and beans were fine, but they were pretty much lost in the broth.

This is really gross. Salty beyond belief. One container contains 1520mg of sodium! They try to minimize the numbers by saying this is two servings but even then it is at 760mg of sodium (32% of your daily recommended consumption of sodium). In addition it has a really bad metal after taste even though it is packaged in a plastic container. One spoon full and it went in the garbage. Should have read the label first :-(

I just went to Publix to buy this for $3.69 and it sounds absolutely delicious, but it tastes just like regular canned beef stew, nothing special. I add to more spices and cheese to this to make it taste good. I'm thoroughly disappointed. Don't bother spending your hard earned money. If I could give this soup 0 stars I would.

I'm sitting here shocked and amazed by the two reviews before me. Maybe they got a bad batch because my family, my friends, and myself love this soup. It's absolutely delicious. So let me speak for me.I bought the soup on impulse and left it sitting in my kitchen cabinet until I the only things I left to eat for lunch were apples, peanut butter, and popcorn. I opened the soup and was disappointed when I saw the broth, thinking all broth soups were "blah." I decided to give it a sip before throwing it out and I was pleasantly surprised. The broth was good. So I put it straight into the microwave. A few pops later, I thought something was off and took it straight out of the microwave. Oh, there's metal around the top of the bowl. Do Not Microwave. Gotcha. Apparently I'm easy going because I just reached above me, got a bowl, and poured the soup into it. No biggie.Heated the soup for 1 to 2 minutes, took it out, stirred it up, and dug in. It was awesome. I was like what the heck? I already knew the broth was good but it's way better hot. =)  I think the amount of salt in it is perfect.  If you have to watch your sodium and the soup has too much for you, I would suggest not buying it. Cause buying it and then complaining about the sodium in it is weird. Anyway, I'm healthy, I stay well-hydrated, sodium is not a problem for me.Back to the soup. The chicken pieces are solid pieces - not those little "is that chicken?" pieces some companies give you just so they can legally put "chicken" on the label. Plus they make a very frequent appearance. The beans are Northern beans and they're good. I'm not overly fund of beans, which is why the soup sat in the kitchen cabinet, but I like these. They're soft but not mushy - but I prefer mushy over hard so take that into account - and they've soaked up all the other flavors in the broth. If the broth is good, the beans are good.I was also loving the carrots and spinach. I didn't taste them specifically but they added to the overall flavor. And there was enough spinach to easily add it to the label listing. I pasted the nutrition label below to give you an idea of the ingredients. As you can see, most of the soup consists of simple, easily identifiable ingredients and there are no preservatives.I am picky about my nutrition labels though. While I don't watch sodium, I do watch calories, fat, carbs, fiber and protein. I love this one. One bowl has 2 cups of soup so it's pretty feeling. Here are the totals for the entire container:  280 calories, 5g fat, 0g trans fat, 34g carbs, 8g fiber, and 24g protein. Those numbers are awesome. Especially since I was too full after eating the soup and drinking water to even eat the apple I had left.Maybe if you're a gourmet or you want to taste every single vegetable in a dish, this soup might not do it for you. But if you like canned soups, you're going to LOVE this soup. And if you're in a rush and you just want a healthy dish that's not fast food, I would recommend it in a heart beat. Heck, after I had it the first time, i texted my sister and my friends and told them they had to buy some. Yeah, I'm overly dramatic but for someone who prefers not to cook, this soup is a tasty, healthy, God-send.INGREDIENTS: Chicken Stock, Chicken Meat, Great Northern Beans, Carrots, Diced Tomatoes In Tomato Juice, Celery, Spinach, Tomato Puree (Water, Tomato Paste), Contains Less Than 2% Of: Modified Food Starch, Salt, Asiago Cheese (Milk, Cultures, Salt, Enzymes), Onions**, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Parmesan Cheese (Part-Skim Milk, Cultures, Salt, Enzymes), Broth**, Chicken Fat, Flavoring, Whey (Milk), Ascorbic Acid For Flavor, Eggs. Contains Traces Of Wheat.Good Source of FiberExcellent Source of ProteinExcellent Source of Vitamin AGood Source of PotassiumLow CholesterolLow FatLow Saturated Fat

This Simply Tomato soup is mildly spicy with Indian flavors and is not at all bland but for more of a bite, try the MTR Spicy Tomato Soup.It's very easy to make-- just boil 500ml (0.5 liter or about 2 cups) of water in a pot, add the paste, and stir a little with a wooden spoon. My two are now eleven and going strong.  I started both with Science Diet kitten dry and they have progressed through to the Mature Adult.  Their vet has always prasied their coats, teeth, and animaton.

My cat is about 8 years old, and up until the summer of last year, she ate Kit 'n Kaboodle exclusively. She has never had any serious health problems.
