column9: Great food for a long life!
column10: My cat has been eating Science Diet exclusively since I got her at 1 year old.  She just had her 16th birthday and still loves this food.  She has a large feeder she eats small meals from throughout the day & night.  I highly recommend it.

column9: Filler food is empty, leaves your cat always needing more
column10: This review will make me sound really stupid, but whatever. I don't really care as long as people find out what's real and can avoid my mistakes.I got my wonderful little sweet Bella Bean when she was a few days shy of three years old. She had been bounced around from house to house and eating whatever was cheap. I have had cats around me my entire life, for about twenty-five years now. My mother always just fed them whatever, the kinds of food you buy in the supermarket - Friskies, Nine Lives, Kit & Kaboodle, stuff like that. And our cats were always fine, at least in terms of their eating habits. They would eat in the morning, stop when they were done, come back, and eat some more when they got hungry.My housemate at the time was working for Hill's and assured me that this was the best food ever made, so great, so on and so forth. I now know that she is an utter buffoon, but I initially trusted her judgment, which is so unfortunate because she doesn't think. She also had plenty of coupons for free or deeply discounted bags, which made it a much more attractive choice.I first tried feeding the little Bean an unmeasured amount of Science Diet in a bowl, but that didn't work, as she would devour it in one sitting. So then I took to measuring it, and she did the same thing. Then I started parsing it out to twice a day. That didn't work either, because she would start going crazy in the middle of the day, running around, intentionally destroying things, deliberately spilling her water, crying, etc., until she got more food. So then I split it into three servings. Same thing. Then it got to be four servings. That was a little better, but it was too much maintenance and unrealistic to be around every day to feed her four times. So then it went back to three. All the while, I was trying to reduce the amount of food I was feeding her to less than 3/4 of a cup because she was a little chubby. Reducing was hell. She became even more hungry, but I figured she would get used to it. Not really.For over a year, she would wake me up every morning looking for food in a serious way, knocking things off my desk, ripping up any paper she could find, scratching at the door and committing general acts of mischief. As soon as she got food, she was back to her sweet self, but only for three or four hours.We thought she was bored, we thought she was a little nutty, and maybe even had a kitty eating disorder. She always wanted food. It was kind of funny but in the end it was just sad.A few weeks back, we took her to a new (good, non-money factory) vet for her second checkup since I've had her. I talked with him about her being always hungry. He asked what she ate, and I told him the adult indoor Science Diet. Without saying as much, he basically told me that this food is garbage and I should look for something else. He said cat food should have a protein followed by a carbohydrate as the first two ingredients. Science Diet does, in a very loose, by-product kind of way - ground up slaughterhouse leftovers and corn dust. Then they put a bunch of vitamins in it to make it "healthy," instead of just using good ingredients from the beginning. Not that I care about spending money on the Bean, but this food is way too expensive for what it is.So we began transitioning her onto Wellness indoor formula about two weeks ago. She is still eating 50 percent Science Diet with 50 percent Wellness (you really shouldn't just give a cat different food one day out of the blue) but SHE NEVER FREAKS OUT ANYMORE. It's amazing. And it's 100 percent because she is eating real food now, along with that sawdust and chicken hearts I still regrettable have to feed her. We have her down to eating twice a day, only 1/3 cup in TOTAL. She was eating three times a day, 5/8 of a cup in total. Now she eats some in the morning, walks away, eats some more a few hours later, and then looks for dinner about twelve hours after her initial feeding. No more knocking things over, no more trashing Dad's papers on the desk, no more howling, no more deliberately spilled water on the floor. It's incredible.I feel so bad that I was doing this to her for so long. We really thought she was just being dramatic or whatever. But no, she was genuinely hungry because she wasn't eating any real food.Do your cat a favor - buy her or him so food made with real ingredients, things you would eat - Wellness, Halo, Innova, Evo, whatever. Figure it out for yourself, but please don't feed your cat this. It's garbage.

column9: The freshness seal doesn't "lock", it's flawed
column10: I've been feeding my cats science diet for probably 3-4 years and the one thing they've had in common over time is that the reseal freshness "lock" seems to always be flawed in some way. I've used this sealing technology on lots of food and non-food containers for probably 20 years so I think the common denominator here is Science Diet. Someone at Science Diet probably needs to look at the QA results for their bags and figure out how to create a working "lock" that seals.I've resorted to just pouring the contents out into a large jug and feeding Sassy and Hoshi from there.

column9: Good product, but beware of prices on Amazon!!!
column10: This is a great cat food and my two cats have been on Science Diet since they were kittens.  Though this is a great product, beware of the prices from the seller "Monster Pets"!!! They are charging $25 for a 7-pound bag of cat food, when you can purchase a 15-pound bag from Petco for about $30 (you get about twice as much for $5 more).  I feel this company is being dishonest to their customers... Do not waste your money buying from this particular dealer.
Good reliable cat food that cats like!  Morsels are traditional size - not too huge which my cat and my friends cats do not like.  Food was delivered in good condition from the warehouse.

I ordered this in multiple colors. It's not that glittery, and it becomes gummy upon contact with moisture... I think this stuff only works if you sprinkle it on and then immediately serve the dish. I used it as a decoration on top of a cheesecake, and within 30 minutes it had "melted" into a gooey substance - and the cheesecake had just come out of the refrigerator. Cute idea, poor execution.Plus, for this silver color, the package came WITHOUT a safety seal of any kind - just unscrew the white top and the stuff comes pouring out. So I never even used the silver one - and it would have cost way more than the cost of the glitter to return it, so I just "ate" the cost.

Crunchy carrots contain - organic carrot, organic maltodextrin and lecithin.Hearty Sweet Potatoes contain - organic sweet potatoes, organic maltodextrin, organic corn starch, sunflower lecithin.Plump peas and crunchy apples contain - 100% peas and 100% apples.The peas and the apples were the first products I tried from this company.  The baby loved them and I loved the ingredients.  I thought I would try the other products so I ordered the carrots and sweet potatoes.  To my surprise and disappoinment, when they arrived, I saw that they contained ingredients that I was not pleased with.  I wrote Nurturme and asked why they put maltodextrin in their products unnecessarily and they responded, The organic maltodexrin in our products is derived form organic corn.  Maltodextrins are manufactured form starch and are extensively used as an emulsifier in foods.They are included in our foods because they are binding agents that are used when our foods are dried.  Like starch, most maltodextrins are easily digested and used for energy in the body." So, while the carrots and sweet potatoes are probably fine, they did not contain ingredients that I wanted to feed my baby.  The biggest issue being that this information was not included in the product description on amazon.

GeniSoy makes some of the best Soy Nuts around and these are especially good with a Deep Sea Salted flavor. You can eat them alone as a snack or use them in recipes calling for nuts and peanuts. Perfect to substitute if you have nut and peanut allergies.To make up your own health mixes, stir in pumpkin seeds, dried cranberries, cheese snack crackers (Annie's Baked Cheddar Bunnies are fun), sunflower seeds and anything else that gives you a nice mix of sweet, savory and salty.Ingredients: IP roasted soybeans, organic sea salt, organic expeller pressed canola oil.Never overly salted and perfectly delicious!~The Rebecca Review

column9: Full flavored and zesty-really good tea
column10: What a zesty change from my coffee routine. As I get older, coffee no longer agrees with my stomach. I started drinking pu-ehr tea last year when I traveled to China and it has helped my digestive system a lot. I then searched for it on Amazon because I needed an American supplier and came across this version of the tea. I live in Korea and have tasted their ginger tea which has a bite to it. This tea has the bits of ginger to give the pu-ehr tea a fuller flavor without the bite. It is smooth and mellow, and I love it with honey or sugar in the raw. Highly recommended for serious tea drinkers and those who would like a change from their coffee habits.

I love both ginger and pu-erh, so I had high hopes for this tea. It exceeded them. This is a fair-trade tea made by a minority community in China from very ancient tea trees, and it's simply delightful. The mellow earthiness of the pu-erh is complimented by the spicy ginger. A wee bit of citrus fills out the background. Simply gorgeous. An olfactory and gustatory delight.

column9: My favorite tea on the planet
column10: I think this is the best tea I've ever had--I like it brewed strong and very sweet.  The most ginger i've tasted in any commercial tea.  It's almost black, too, it's so dark.  Now that I've found it here in a three-pack, I no longer have to ration myself!!!

This tea is different from your typical brew. It has a smoky flavor with a hint of spicy ginger. Not something I could drink all the time but it is nice every now and then. You can re-steep the leaves a couple times which will make it last and last. I read that pu-erh helps with weight control so I thought I would give it a go. I am a big tea drinker and got excited b/c I had never heard of this tea before.

column9: Good tea with a ginger twist
column10: This tea lacks the aging one would pay much more for with pu-erh tea.  It brews up with a smooth feel of the tea on the palate and a delightful light ginger flavor.  It is soothing to the stomach and even invigorating with the citrus and ginger zing.  I even like it iced.  I drink it frequently at work. I do think it has helped when I have had some indigestion or some tummy upset or when I have been hungry the tea helps to curb my appetite when it hits before it's time for lunch.  The tea itslf seems a little lighter in body than some other pu-erhs I have had in the past.  I really like the fact that it is organic and taken from age old tea trees. It makes me feel like I am getting a picture of what tea tasted like centuries before our time.  I plan to order more when I have used up my current tins.
Great tea, goes a long way.  It has little bits of ginger in it.

Wow.  Just Wow.  This tea took me by surprise - when I first started to brew it, the ginger nose was a little sharp and pungent (did not like the initial smell), but the heat during steeping mellowed the ginger and the tea became a a dark velvety smooth warming exlir.  After a month of having this tea in my pantry, I was shocked to realize that I had powered through almost three tins while my other teas were virtually untouched.  Unlike other teas, leaving the tea in the pot "too long" doesn't make it too bitter, but actually improves the tea.  Drink w/o milk or sweetener.  My morning tea that I drink throughout the day!

This Rishi tea is a good stepping stone from strictly coffee to incorporating tea in to the mix. I like my caffeinated beverages strong and this tea does not disappoint. It has a full flavor profile and the ginger adds a touch of spice to that. It's also a very dark, rich brew as compared to other, more "watery" teas. I have read recently that this type of tea with ginger is also recommended for digestive health. I add just a touch of stevia and it's delicious. I've also added cashew cream and raw milk when I have it. All wonderful and a real treat.

This is probably the best tasting, most wonderfully ginger flavored Pu-erh tea I have found. Ginger is not a very common flavor to find in this tea and I was thrilled to find this at a reasonable price. Not to mention the very nice cans it comes in. If you are a tea fan, and have not discovered Pu-erh tea, you are really missing out.

column9: Not my cup of tea. You may love it though.
column10: I absolutely love Pu-erh loose tea by Rishi and thought it might be fun to give a try of the ginger blend during the harsh winter times where ginger can be a real treasure in providing support to blood circulation, especially to women.As much as I hoped I could love this blend, I did not. The ginger aroma is way too strong. It is so over-powering that the pu-erh flavor is pushed away. It is like mashed-potatoes with all the peper flavor but not potato-ish at all. Odd and unsmart way of blending the ginger and pu-erh. They could be a perfect match.But it could be just me as tastes of teas are so personally different. Think about all the health benefits you could get from a pot of tea and give it a wave if you love trying new things out. It could be next on your favorate list.

an excellent Pu-ehr. I really like the Rishi brand of teas. This particular tea is a fine example of a Pu-ehr. Some have said the ginger is too strong. I guess I like ginger and I drink a lot of different Pu-ehrs, so I do like this particular blend. I also love Rishi's Jasmine Pearl! These all come in tins that have an inner and an outer lid AND the tea is encased in a sealede foil pack. To me that speaks to their commitment to send you a quality tea.

It does not have the darkness that I'm use to with Puerh tea. I kind of miss that.The ginger is very strong, but I really like ginger so I'm not dissapointed with that at all.Each serving is good for multiple steepings.

Very tastily blend tea! All the flavours: Pu-erh, ginger and orange peel are very well blanced. I have a cough these days, drinking the tea makes me feel better. Highly recommend it in cold days, especially when you have a cold.

column9: Pu Erh Quality ok, and too much Ginger
column10: Rishi really markets their tea for political reasons, i. e. it's Kosher, it's picked by ethnic minorities, it's organic and fair trade.  In the case of tea, I don't think it's extremely important that it's Kosher, and I believe the marketing attempts to fill in for the mediocre quailty of the tea.  The Pu Erh Ginger has way too much ginger to taste the Pu Erh, and I also feel that is a way to mask the quality or lack thereof.

Rishi Pu-Erh Ginger is amazing.  I have had other pu-erh teas with ginger and they have been overly pungent and not at all enjoyable.  Rishi Pu-Erh is smooth and very refreshing. I look forward to taking my daily ginger now.
This is a full-bodied tea with ginger. It's substantial and satisfying--a great coffee substitute. I definitely will be re-ordering this tea. It's flavor is absolutely unique.

column9: WARNING: Major Side Effects- Death by Tea
column10: I purchased this tea from Whole Foods yesterday and I had my first cup this morning. I followed the directions on the package and drank it after I had breakfast. After half way drinking the tea I felt somewhat nauseated, sick and like I was going to throw up. That wasn't the end to my symptoms. The next 8 hours were extremely horrible. I felt more nauseated, my heart raced, head ached,some slight pain and my concentration was sharp but it made things appear so fast that I got dizzy. I also felt great anxiety. I prayed that I would be okay. I feel better now, but I really did think I was going to die. This tea just isn't for my body type. I really recommend seeing a herbalist before trying out "natural" products like these even if you do year about it on Dr. Oz. BOTTOM LINE: be careful what you consume even if it is natural.BEWARE!

We were visiting family for Christmas on Cape Cod and bought three varieties of Trois Petits Cochons pate at a local deli to bring home for appetizers. They were very reasonably priced and came in a reusable plastic tureen. Our choices were, the Pate au Poivre Noir, Mousse de Foie de Canard au Porto, and the Salmon Mousse...WOW!!! What a treat to share with our family.Now I am desperate to find a source in California and it looks like I can get it from Amazon...a happy smile is on my face! Just as good as what you would expect to be served at a fine French restaurant.[...]

I ordered this pâté because the type I wanted was out of stock, but I wasn't at all disappointed.  It's very good, very rich and arrived quickly.  I still want to try the other type but this was a welcome substitute.

column9: this is a spice mix, not actual harissa
column10: beware  - this is a spice mixture only, not actual harissaNot what I intended to order, but the ad wasn't clear.Harissa as I ate it in North Africa was a pulpy mash of peppers and spices, some oil. Fantastic stuff.I recommend Mustapha's Moroccan Harissa - it was terrific.
Tunisian Harissa is a Tunisian/Moroccan spice and herb blend, often used in tagine cooking.  I have not had an opportunity to use this particular one yet. Fritz

I have tried 5 of the Wind & Willow mixes and all are excellent. Guests who have enjoyed them rave about them...taste homemade and yummy. The unit price is much lower buying in quantity from Amazon, but you have to take 6 packs of the same 'flavor'. I bought two six-packs and my daughter bought two different ones and we mixed and matched to get variety.
I simply cannot get enough of this dip! Buy a bag of potato chips and go to town like a monkey on a cupcake.
This cheeseball is really easy to make and the hit of every party!  I've had several Wind & Willow Cheeseballs, but this one is by far the best.  It is spicy, but delicious.

I love oil cured olives, and these would be fine, except that their is about 5 to 10 times too much salt in them. I cut them up and add them to salads, etc, but as whole olives, again the salt is way too high (think of really salty potatoe chips and then make them 10 times more salty).

There is a way to "oil cure" olives, and once done, the result is a lightly salted, meaty olive that still has a lot of flesh. This isn't that olive. It is salt-cured. The result is a dried out, very salty, leathery skin. Once cured, they wash off the salt and put oil on the olives.There is a place for salt-cured olives, but not when the title is "oil-cured".

I bought these olives originally to make a Sicilian salad using fennel, blood oranges, oil cured olives and olive oil.  The result was ok the first time but very salty.  The results were much better after that because I soaked the olives in filtered water several times over the course of a day or two to remove a lot of the salt.  I then used them exclusively (no green olives) in tapenade and they were delicious.  Highly recommended product but you need to rinse salt off them.
This is my second delivery of these olives.  We use them in many recipes.  They keep well without refrigeration and 1 tub lasts me about 6 months.

This jam is amazing.  You would never know it is sugar free and the super bonus is that xylitol is so good for your teeth!  This jam, more than the other Nature's Hollow jams (which I also LOVE) seems to be packed with whole fruit.  The flavor is fantastic and worth every dime of the added expense!

column9: It is made with a healthy sweetener (xylitol) rather than the bad stuff.
column10: Healthy preserves without sugar and harmful artificial sweeteners. It's made with xylitol, which is actually good for you. Nice whole berries. Fresh-tasting. I wish it was carried in Des Moines, Iowa stores so I wouldn't have to order it online.

column9: Lovely sugarfree preserves, but the blueberry flavor comes across lightly
column10: I'm probably being TOO picky, cause the truth is, I've never gotten a burst of true, full blueberry flavor in any preserve/jam of that fruit I've tried. I don't know if the heating lessens the flavor or what.So, while this wasn't as "true fruity" flavored as the apricot, it was very pleasant and I enjoyed it. It has the same semi-puree consistency as the other Nature's Hollow preserve I've tried. For sugar-free, this is really nice. Only 2 grams of effective carbs per tablespoon, with 20 calories per tbsp. Ingredients: blueberries, xylitol, spring water, fruit pectin, citric acid. I like that simple list of ingredients. :)I am eager to try the strawberry one, now. :D

I bought these Nature's Hallow Sugar Free Bllueberry Jams last year and they were really delicious.  Plus they were sugar free with all natural and organic xylitol for sweetener.  BUT.....I just purchased a case of them and they were grossly spoiled.  One jar arrived opened and leaking all over the package so I threw it out.  The second and third jars I opened were thick with globs of fungus encrusted blueberry's and smelled awful.  Needless to say, I threw them out......that's thirty dollars wasted.  A fourth jar smelled ok and after tasting a little of it to make sure it wouldn't make me sick, it turned out to be ok....at least I am still hoping so.  I am actually afraid to open the remaining jars.  It's like the company had a few really old jars left and sent them to me to clean out their inventory.  Well, I can tell you that they have lost me as a customer.  I use to buy their cookies for my old uncle but NO MORE.  He is old and might not recognize if they are spoiled, loaded with fungus, or rancid.  I won't be responsible for his demise by buying from an unethical company.  I already told the company about the opened jar upon arrival but I hadn't opened any more at that time.  I don't expect to hear from them!  I definitely DO NOT recommend this company any more.  Beware!
Found this to be a very good, fresh tasting jam.  Doesn't have an artifical taste.  Whole berries.  A little pricey but very satisfied with the product.
I love all of Natures Hollow productsYou can't tell they are sugar free.The kind I would buy in the store (sugar free) would give me a funny after taste.  This brand doesn't.
Great taste, I liked it very much and will order it again.  I really don't need to buy sugared jams again!
This is good stuff. All the Nature Hallow products are great. You really can't tell the difference between them and products with sugar. You won't be disappointed.

column4: E. Hamilton "CLT Gal in God's Country"
column10: bought this on the recommendation of Jorge Cruise's book, Belly Fat Cure.  The flavor is great.  I wouldn't know it was sugar free if I hadn't read it.

I have moved in the maintenance phase of the Ideal Protein program. My chief complaint with their products has been the liberal use of Splenda. Walden Farms products are encouraged.Xylitol is an acceptable sugar replacement on IP. I had been using this jam prior starting IP. I actually found it in my gourmet grocer back in TX.I mainly use this as a topping for protein pancakes since I don't customarily eat bread. It is a great convenience item when I don't want to take the time to prepare my own from scratch.Perhaps not as fruity as a french jam but it is a fantastic alternative to sugar free products artificially sweetened.

This jam is delicious! I bought it because I'm on a low sugar diet (Belly Fat Cure) and it is difficult to find Sugar-Free jams that don't contain artificial sweeteners.This product is so much better than I anticipated. I didn't expect the whole blueberries inside. It's filled with them! Everyone in my household loves it and even non-dieters pick out this jam to use on their toast. I warm some up to use as a pancake topping and it's great.I will buy this again and I want to try other flavors of Nature's Hallow now.
Wow, you would never know this is sugar-free. It tastes so fresh, with lots of blueberries. No odd aftertaste at all. Love it!
I try all types of dark roast, Starbucks & others. There is no other way to say it. For me, this has the most intense deep flavor. This is my ULTIMATE COFFEE!

column9: Bella Gluten-Free Cinnamon Raisin Bread Mix
column10: I make this on Sunday morning when I feel the whole family needs a treat. The organic cinnamon and plump juicy raisin are the die for.  But it's the taste and texture I love.  Real bread again.  Hooray!!!

column9: Steep too Long and It's Bitter
column10: The mint in this tea is very good, but it's not the oily strong mint that I get with some flavored teas. The mint leaves are dried and they are a bit weak. When steeped for too long or if too much tea is used, the tea gets very bitter. However, I can put in a spoonful of the leaves in the hot water, and refill or top off the cup two more times without losing major flavor of the tea.This mint teas is wonderful for after dinner. I love the way it seems to settle my stomach. It's become a regular after-dinner tea. I received it as a gift, and while I have tasted some teas with a stronger, oilier mint flavor, this one is nice in that it doesn't have the essential oil floating in it that can sometimes irritate the lips or the stomach. This has the real mint leaves dried in the tea to steep. Adding a few sprigs/leaves of fresh mint to the tea and lightly mottling/crushing them in the cup right before adding the water makes a huge difference and really enhances this tea.But even without that, this is a great tea, high quality green tea, delicate flavor. Just don't use too much of the tea so it doesn't get bitter. As for steeping time, I just throw the spoonful in with the hot water loose, so I steep it the whole time I'm sipping it and it doesn't get bitter or lose flavor at all. I prefer that to using a strainer or bag for brewing. I love drinking tea and herbal mixes loose like that.I think most people, especially for the price, will like this tea if they like mint teas in general.

column9: Love this tea, but it needs more mint.
column10: This tea is great, but alas, it has a big flaw for me, there is a lack of strong mint flavoring in this mix. I definitely expected a strong mint taste mixing well with the green tea, but there's a lack of mint taste here. You can see the leaves in there, but the taste is lacking.Other than that, it's a great green tea. I suggest steeping it for longer than the directions say, but definitely not longer than 3 minutes. Maybe even adding a bit of spearmint herbal tea will help?

column9: Very good tea, but not quite great
column10: Just tried this tea with my wife last night, it was very good, but just not quite as good as I had hoped.The tea turns out to be a little bitter (even with 100% correct steeping time) and the mint isn't quite as strong as I would like.  Also, you do end up having to put in a little extra tea to make it strong enough.Think of a mint medley bagged tea with less mint and a better green tea and you'll have a general idea what it tastes like.
Both steaks in The Celebration are sufficiently large, and the filet is amazing. The strip is good but not great, but can feed two.
Great product, easy for the mornings when there isnt much time. Arrived promptly, and well packed nothing was out of place when I opened the box.
I ordered 3 jars of cinnamon sticks and they showed up in just a few days! They were exactly what I had been looking for.

Its possible I consume wayyy too many butter mints. That being said, I liked this mint the best of the several brands I've gotten from Amazon.  Probably the next favorite is the Penn. Dutch ones.  The Richardsons are a quality butter mint but dry.

I drink decaf coffee, and it's often hard to find decaf pods. I'm happy to have found the Baronet Mocha Java pods. They have a nice flavor, one of the best I've tried in this price range. I like it so much I'm going to increase my subscription.
I was delicious, and a price was economical, too, and a delivery was fast, too..I drink well, and there is it.
Baronet coffee pads are a great tasting coffee, that we can use for our coffee (pod) maker.  Excellent tasting.

This is my favorite flavored decaf by far. The mocha flavor is subtle, and the coffee tastes very bold and strong, which I like. Just perfect with a touch of cream.Note, these pods are a bit fuller than your typical Senseo pods - it helps if you wet them first before loading your coffee maker so they fit well.
I tryed one pod then two pods, weak! Not my cup of coffee. I was disappointed. Will not buy this company again.

My daughters love this decaf Mocha Java and will usually drink a cup on the weekends in the morning while I'm drinking my regular coffee.  It's strong enough, not bitter and makes a great dessert coffee w/o the guilt.

As a westerner with an adventurous palate, I like culturally different foods. These are interesting. You can taste the molasses. Much more complex taste than our refined white sugar or brown sugar. It almost tastes burned. Not bad, not great. I expect you would have to grow up eating black sugar. These are good, but not sure if I'd buy them again.

Tried these as an experiment.  It was a bit random that I found them, and they looked like something that would be fun to try out.  And I have to say, they were actually quite good.  I offered some to my Mother and Grandmother and my Mother hated it, but my Grandmother said it was different and ate it.I'm giving this 4 Stars because, even though I loved them, some in my family didn't.  So some shoppers may not enjoy it.The taste is a bit bitter at first, but once you get passed the unfamiliar taste you're good to go.  Enjoy!

didnt work for me, i thought the taste was a bit to strong. like another reviewer pointed out, it does taste burn. its definitely sticky so be careful. they are summer/hot weather proof since my room manages to get 70-85F degrees and it hasnt melt or anything. the taste is bearable but i think ill will just give them away.

column9: Excellent bubble gum (that happens to be sugar free)!
column10: Dubble Bubble is my favorite brand of bubble gum, but has so much sugar.  This new version is sugar free, and in my opinion, it tastes even better!  The flavor lasts longer, and it stays soft a lot longer than the sugared version.

column9: It's definitely the best sugar-free gum!
column10: I have a hard time believing this gum is really sugar-free. There is no after taste. It actually tastes better than ANY gum I've ever tried. It has kept me from smoking for a year now, but the store that sells it just stopped and I can't find it anywhere. I was buying it from Walmart for .88 a bag and it's $2.79 online. Anybody know where it might be sold??
I love this gum.  If you loved the original, then you'll love this.  It's even better, cause... SUGAR FREE.  Oh Yeah!!

This product was commonly available in stores but I have not seen it lately.  It's an excellent gum and since it is sugar free, it works to partially clean my teeth too.  It's a good product and I wish it was still marketed in grocery stores.  Sorry, Amazon.

column9: Reminds Me Of My Childhood...Only Now It's BETTER!
column10: I say it's about time we can find Sugar Free Bubble Gum!!! I'm a big gum freak! When I was a Teen, I'd munch on a bunch of the original, but FINALLY, we're able to find a SF Version. Just as great as before & I don't have to feel guilty!
If I could write word over I would.. It's just gum and what more can you say.. It's what I ordered so I'm happy with it.
dubble bubble has to be the worst buble gum ever invented. the moment you pop it in you mouth you can already taste the awful after-taste. and this crap is most rubbery than anything else.

Secondly, Coke has 'in stealth mode' kept pricing the same but for less quantity.  The packaging look did not change so consumers for the most part will not recognize this important difference.  Cases for instance just months ago contained 24 cans.  Now, so-called cases contain only 20 cans.  A pack of the recent past contained 12 cans - now you only get 8.  Coke is a very profitable company and therefore it is not logical to assume these decreases in quantity were to cover costs of the turn-key product.  Coke is more than likely passing along additional profit-taking to us.  Consider your options is my final opinion of this product.

I've tried a dozen crepe recipes over the years. Few taste better and none are easier than what comes in this box. It's the only store-bought mix I've seen that requires six eggs. Probably not the healthiest thing in the world, but it tastes fabulous. I make these every other weekend. The only trick is to add the dry ingredients slowly, using a whisk to blend them with the liquids. Then, let it stand for five minutes and give one final, vigorous stir before cooking. The resulting crepes are light and delicious. If you make too much you can only store them in the fridge for about a day, two at the outside. Even though they separate a bit, vigorous stirring will reblend them to the point that they will cook just fine even if they don't look as good as they did straight out the box.Suggested fillings:My favorite is a warm banana filling. Make 2 1/2 cups of simple syrup (water and sugar) in a non-stick pan. Add six thinly sliced bananas, a tablespoon of bourbon vanilla, and three teaspoons of pumpkin spice mix (blend of cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice). Cook over medium heat for around four or five minutes until the liquid reduces and the bananas barely begin to get mushy. Splash in a little crème de banana liquor to finish, stir once, and serve. The easiest way to fill the crepe is to place it on a plate, spoon the filling into the center, and fold in both sides. Dust with powdered sugar for an elegant touch.If you want something easier and sweeter, simply lather some Nutella chocolate/hazelnut spread onto the crepe after the first flip while it's still in the pan, layer in fresh bananas, fold and slide onto a plate to serve. It's quick, easy, and kids love it. Dust with powdered sugar for an elegant touch.Enjoy!

Tea tree oil is toxic to cats in all but the very smallest doses. A cat's liver is not capable of processing it. For an average cat weighing seven to 12 pounds, somewhere between 1 1/2 to 3 teaspoons of tea tree oil would be lethal. Because of this cats should never be treated with anything more than one to five drops of tea tree oil per teaspoon of carrier oil. The same thing applies to small, and some medium-sized dogs.Another reason to avoid using tea tree oil on small animals is that they tend to lick themselves and end up ingesting the oil.Most of the cat deaths from tea tree oil come from people using tea tree flea & tick treatments which are applied to the entire body of the cat. This product is applied only in the ear. Nonetheless, given the extreme toxicity of tea tree oil to cats, I would be very cautious. Is the ear wash so essential that it is worth risking your cat's life? Perhaps try another product first.

column9: What is all the fuss about?
column10: I do not consider myself any kind of professional but I did take up coffee as a hobby nearly two years ago. I have tasted nearly two dozen single bean varieties and a few blends. What I found was a coffee where most of the flavor comes from the roasting rather than from the bean.This is not the quality one expects from $1/oz beans but rather from an average grocery store offering at maybe $0.70/oz.=====Consider roasting coffee analogous to toasting bread. You can get flavor out of a bland white bread if you toast it enough. That is what was done here. There is little intrinsic flavor in these beans yet I know Sumatra produces some excellent coffees which the correct roast enhances their flavor rather than producing a generic roasted flavor on top of next to nothing at all.

I gave him 3 off the bat, and he just went NUTS trying to get to the package and get some more!! Finally I stashed them where he could not get them, and the little stinker then tried to get the empty shipping package they came in..LOL Safe to say, HE LOVES THEM!! I love the fact that they are made in USA and seem fairly healthy!! They are fairly small, but you have to remember, these are treats. We already ordered the jumbo-pack of them! :-D

I am trying to train my dog and he is not particularly food greedy. However, he LOVES cheese! But as you may know, cheese isn't that portable. So I needed a cheese treat that was pretty much 100% cheese with nothing else added. This is it! My dog is crazy about these because they are just cheese. I am using them as his training reward (along with freeze-dried chicken) and he is responding because these aren't your every day dog bone. I also feel better giving these to my dog as frequently as necessary in training because he is not getting alot of additional ingredients such as grains. I highly recommend these treats. The company also ships very rapidly!

I discovered this tangy thirst quencher this past Spring when the local soda machine vendor added this to our beverage selections at work. I have also purchased the product in this size from the supermarket.Chilled it offers a taste that makes the taste buds burst with excitement, the kind that relieves the dryness so common to those labring or playing under the hot summer sun. If you want a bracer, a shot of gin or vodka to this concoction would also add a gusatory splash.Drink the Snapple--not the Kool-Aid.

I have gotten to drinking iced tea made with freshly brewed organic green, white and red (South African Rooibos) teas every day. It's relatively easy to get green and white teas that don't cost a lot, but not that easy to get organic Rooibos at a good price. Well, this one is excellent, for sure, and at a great price on Amazon! Plus, you get an additional discount if you sign up for regular shipping every month or three months or six months, which makes sense if you are a regular tea drinker like me. (If you are not, Amazon will let you cancel at any time prior to the next shipment.)This tea has good body, excellent flavor and very good color. Rooibos is best brewed at 190F, allowing for steeping from 3 to 5 minutes tops. It has zero caffeine and reportedly has 50 times the antioxidants of green tea. It also has anti-inflammatory and calming properties and hence makes the perfect bedtime tea. Also makes great iced tea, either by itself or in combination with other teas (as I make).
If you like rooibos, this is it.  Basic, simple and tasty.  We say better than FreshPak, so have at it if you love the tea!

There is another brand of organic rooibos tea offered on Amazon (Choice brand) that I previously ordered.  I gave that tea 5 stars.  Numi also offers a good rooibos.I decided to give Davidson's a chance since it was so cheap.  Now I understand why it's so cheap.  It is extremely weak tea.  2 bags of Davidson's is still not equal to 1 bag of Choice.  Maybe 3 or 4 bags is more like it.I actually ended up throwing out my most recent cup of Davidson's because I had left 2 old bags in there, along with 2 new bags (so 4 bags in total) thinking that maybe I could suck more tea out of the old bags (something I did quite often with the other brands).  But the joke was on me because what the tea ended up tasting like was the bags themselves with just a hint of tea.I feel that drinking this brand of rooibos tea is more like drinking plain water with just the hint of tea flavor.  I doubt I will drink the remaining 96 bags I have left but will instead use them for my tired eyes when I go to bed at night.

the tea per bag is less than most (2g v. 2.5g).  teabags are loosely packed inside a thin paper box (no additional wrapping at all to keep its freshness.)  there is no packing date to indicate when it is made.  also no nutritional information.

I LOVE rooibos tea - i love it better than any other tea! It wakes me up, reduces my stress level and anxiety, relieves any aches I have and doesn't taste bitter like yerba mate nor awful herby (with rosehips and the like) like Celestial Seasoning's teas.  I still prefer Numi's or Republic of Tea's or Choice's more deeper-tasting red rooibos teas but Davidson's is still great value for the $$'s.  I still get the same great relieving, anxiety & stress-reducing effects as the other rooibos teas.  The flavor is fine also.  Make sure the water is very hot - i microwave mine to boiling - and let the teabag steep in the cup for 20 minutes.  The longer the rooibos steeps, the more rooibos steeps into the water which makes it more flavorful, giving you more healthful benefits.  Just like the other rooibos teas, instead of sugar, I add organic raw honey once the tea is warm or lukewarm (adding the honey in if the water is too hot will deactivate the enzymes and other healthful items inside the honey) to get the honey health benefits, also which also sweetens my tea.  I don't have access to Davidson teas in any of our stores in the city so Amazon providing it with this great Subscribe & Save deal is purrrfect!

column9: great tea, not the same as what you get in SA
column10: We drink this as our house tea. It tastes great we really enjoy it. It is definitely the best stateside rooibos i have had. It does not taste like what i had in South Africa. The store brand there is the real deal, almost has more of a menthol flavor to it. That is the main difference between the two. I would love to have the real stuff, but its kind of pricey to have it shipped over. I love that this tea doesnt get bitter like black tea, its also naturally caffeine free.

I have switched to Rooibos tea because it is low acid and caffein free.  This Organic Rooibos from Davidson's makes a decent cup of tea.  The flavor is a bit weak, but it can be improved by adding an extra tea bag "for the pot" and letting it steep longer.  The bagged organic rooibos from Davidson's has more flavor than their loose leaf, so I think it must be a little higher grade than the loose leaf.  It is okay with milk and sugar, but the milk tends to kill the delicate flavor, so it seems better plain or just with a little sugar.  I read other reviews complaining about the packaging, but Davidson's has corrected that, and now the bags are inside a zip-lock bag within the box.
I grew up with this tea.  Traditionally it is served with milk and sugar which is delicious.  It can also be enjoyed as is.  Very soothing in the evening after work.

This is a lovely rooibos.  I love rooibos, but it is so expensive compared to common black teas!This brand gives you a lot of bang for your buck, so I ordered it.  I wasn't disappointed.  It is a very fine tasting rooibos tea.  I read a review here that said it was weak.  I did not find that so.  What I always do with rooibos is steep it for a full 10 minutes, then squeeze out the tea bag with the back of a spoon pressed against the inside of the cup.  I did so with this brand, and it was just fine.I'll definitely be a repeat customer.  A very nice cup of tea indeed.

If you know what rooibos tastes like, this is an excellent version. But if not, beware, this is not black tea. Or a "substitute." If you are expecting that flavor; well this is not it. If you are trying to cut back on your caffeine, this is a smart choice. It has a pleasant flavor, once you get accustomed to it. But yikes folks, this is not black tea. As a vegetarian I eat various burger-shaped things that are not real meat. The caustic cynic says, "Well, not as good as a real burger." OK maybe not, but they aren't as bad as  a real burger either. They are two different things, and if you think one IS the other, as opposed to being something that serves a similar purpose, then you will be dissatisfied.But if you say, "I enjoy a hot beverage with some punch, but can't do the caffeine," then these are a good value. Trust me. I've been using rooibos for over 30 years; this is a great price on a good tea.And--the bags are not wrapped individually. I hate throwing away all that foil lined paper that will last forever; these teabags come in a ziploc bag that can be re-used.

column9: Great for iced or hot tea
column10: I like brewing loose tea and enjoy Davidson's loose rooibos tea but these tea bags are handy for when I don't have time to fuss or when I want to make some iced tea to keep in the refrigerator. Very nice flavor ~ not weak. I like to put a couple seeds from a cardamom pod in either iced or hot tea. It gives it a nice, chai-like flavor.

This was my first experience with Roobios tea and I LOVE IT.  It's shipped in a box with the tea bags loose in a zip-lock type bag so it stays fresh and there's no hassle and no dealing with paper wrappers.  Huge box, great value.  I use two bags in a 20 ounce cup, pour hot water in and let it steep.  It's got a sweet taste without sweeter added. I also use it with green tea to make iced tea.  Roobios isn't acidic so it is easy on your stomach and you can drink it all day.  I'm now subscribing to have it automatically delivered so I'll never run out.

We started drinking rooibos tea at night because of no caffeine.  We first tried the Choice brand, but it was a bit weak.  Davidson's is excellent value, it's organic and it also has a lot of flavor, especially for a tea bag.  We steep a teabag in a teapot of boiling water for about 15 minutes to get as much flavor out of it as we can.The "proper" way to make rooibos tea is to use loose tea, and boil it in a metal teapot on the stove.  Every day you add a teaspoon more of the leaves, more water, and boil it again.  After the first day, you get a very flavorful cup of tea.  After about five days, you start all over again.So no teabag is going to give you that flavor, but it still makes a decent cup of tea.
Bought this because I was looking for a great rooibos at a great price.  Turned out to be a good rooibus and about the same price as Twinings, which is also fine.

If you don't need to fancy packaging box and wrapping, it is perfect what you are looking for. One hundred tea bag were packed in a simple box. That is all. However, the quality of tea is not different with any other expensive rooibos tea.

This is excellent tea.I drink it every day because I like it, but also because since I have been drinking it I have no more symptoms of acne rosacea.  It is a cure for it.When I was in Europe I heard of a baby who had colic.  The mom didn't have enough formula, so she finished filling the bottle with rooibus.  The baby went to sleep for the first time and really slept.  It's good!

After I had Rooibos tea from Teavana, I was looking for cheaper version of Rooibos online, which I found here on Amazon. This tea to some extent is good, however it lacks the lemon taste, which is not intended for this packing. I add little lemon to the tea I make and it tastes great. Finished off 10 tea-bags, 90 more to go. Hope I will make it.Update: I brought it to my office and all colleagues like it when some lemon is added. I changed the rating from 3* to 4*.

The taste is excellent, and the best thing is that this is 100 percent caffeine-free rooibos tea. Studies indicate that it possesses antimutagenic and antioxidant potential. Apparently there is also an unfermented rooibos tea which has significant health value, too. Some research suggests that both the fermented (which Davidson's is) and the unfermented have antioxidant and other health properties. I discovered this tea in 2007 and have consistently bought this brand. It's good and also inexpensive. Five stars.

column9: A good tea for the money
column10: There is another brand of Rooibus that tastes slightly better, but each tea bag costs about ten times as that of the Davidson's brand.  For that reason, I would have to rate the Davidson tea a much better consumer value.  It is a good daily tea if you like the flavor of Rooibos, and you can always serve the high-cost tea for special occasions.

I received my order in just two days.  I was a little reluctant to order since the last time I purchased Rooibos tea (African Red Bush Tea) was in a health food store.  It was very expensive, but extremely tasty.  The taste of Davidson's is at least as good as the expensive tea.  What makes it so much better is the price.  It is a wonderful product. For all of you who are hesitant to purchase, I suggest you hurry and order.  I am so pleased that I found it.  Anyone who is curious about the bush tea referred to in The No. 1 Ladies Detective Agency series on HBO, this is it.  I know you will enjoy this tea's wonderful flavor along with its many health benefits.Unwrapped teabags, Organic South African Rooibos, Box 100

If you are trying to reduce caffeine in your diet, and you drink a lot of tea, this tea is for you! It has a robust flavor very similar to black teas and has no caffeine. We started out by using half rooibos and half black pekoe to test the taste. Now we only use the rooibos. It makes great iced tea.
This red tea is really great. Not fancy packaging, but the flavor and value is great.

We like to make homemade chai and this is a good decaf choice for that.  I will do 1/2 of this and 1/2 regular decaf black tea.  Tastes great ...  This will be a good decaf iced tea in the summer as well.

I love Rooibos  tea and have been purchasing it from Peet's Coffee in the past.  I was looking for a cheaper alternative when I found Davidson's on Amazon.  I was a little wary that the tea much be weaker or less fragrant as the Peet's tea, but it's just as good.  What a fantastic price on a great tea!Rooibos is a full bodied herbal tea that brews very dark.  If you steep Rooibos tea for too long, it doesn't get bitter like other teas.  It has a very aromatic flavor and it has great health benefits.  It's also caffeine free, which makes it a great after supper drink.  I also like it with milk and sugar, or served iced.My only complaint about the tea is that it places all 100 tea bags in a large zip close bag inside the box instead of being individually packaged.  This makes it hard to transport some of it to the office or on trips.  I understand that this helps cut down on costs and packaging, but it's a little inconvenient.  I just put them into smaller zip bags when I don't want to bring all 100 tea bags with me somewhere.

I don't have another brand to compare this too, I've red tea once before at Starbucks this taste the same to me. I like it a lot, I add ginger, lemon and honey it relaxes me. No caffeine so its ok to drink just before bed I will be purchasing this product again!

What I found ,after searching, was a Tea (or Herb) that would help lower my blood pressure. This works great for late night cravings. Drinking Rooibos before going to bed, sleeping 7 hours, helps me achieve good morning numbers. Diet without over kill of Sodium is also important.

column9: Great Tasting Tea - Davidson's Organic Tea South African Rooibos
column10: Hi,Tried many brands of African Rooibos this is by far the best tasting IMHO.Thanks, VicDavidson's Organic Tea South African Rooibos, 100-Count Tea Bags

column9: African Bush Tea hits the spot
column10: We have now ordered this product three times in the last 8 months and it continues to be a welcome  addition to any tea time.  Delicious and bracing.  I hardily recommend it.

This Roobois tea is packaged nicely and is more convenient than the loose leaf tea I had been ordering up until recently.  I drink this with a little bit of Coombs Family Farms 100% Organic Maple Sugar, 25-Ounce Container added. The flavor is appealing, the tea helps settle my sensitive stomach, and I'm told Roobois is full of antioxidants. It's also caffeine free which is appropriate since I have ADHD or ADD or both depending who you discuss the matter with. Try the tea, you won't regret it.

I am loving this tea.  It's rich tasting; we drink it every morning now, and I will try to dye some scarves with it too..it has a beautiful bronzy color.  Has a sweet/tart quality that I like, and all this is over and above the health benefits of the green tea and the rooibos.
I love this Red Rooibos tea, especially nowbecause I am avoiding all the caffeine for nursing my baby.I like this tea hot, of course, I also tried to make this cold,it was really good too!

There was a sticker placed on the package of tea that said it was Roobios Tea.  It wasn't printed on the box, just the sticker.  At first that made me think that it was just plain tea.  I will take ther word as to the sticker that it is what I ordered.  Sorry for the mishap. The tea is very good.
I'm pleased with the big box; a large supply of Rooibos tea which should last me a while. I was pleased with how quickly it arrived and the fact that it's organic at a reasonable price.
Tea has a great flavor besides a lot of health benefits. It is mild tasting not strong at all. (Here are a lot of bags in box so lasts a while.
Great product and value.  I have a cup of this tea every morning and the subscribe and save makes this an excellent value - i never have to worry about running out!
I drink tea because it is the best alternative to other drinks, but this one is just excellent in taste. I hope it's good for my health as well.

I wish everything that is healthful would actually taste as good as this tea does. I am very pleased with this purchase. The flavor is smooth and rich. I will be buying this product for my family continuously.

I bought this tea because Dr. Oz said 1 cup of Rooibos tea a day would help you lose weight.  I have been drinking one cup a day now for several weeks and have lost nothing.  Oh well, at least I tried.

I purchased this tea based on the reviews here and am glad I did. It's very yummy! I also like to drop a packet into a gourd and mix it up with my yerba mate. The box was sealed in plastic and the tea bags are contained in a large Ziploc bag.

I am so glad to have found Davidson's rooibos tea at Amazon.  It is great tea, and so much less expensive that any other rooibos tea bags that I have found.  I can no longer drink black tea, and rooibos gives me the same kind of depth, especially since I drink it with milk or cream.  Highly recommend.
Can't always find this tea in stores so glad I found it on Amazon and large amount. Zip lock bags keeps it fresh.

This tea was recommended by a very good friend. She and her husband had been to South Africa and she had this tea there. I had been to her home and had it. Feel in love with it and now order it from Amazon.

Sure these tea bags dont come with a string on them but that cuts cost and its more eco friendly. I use a spoon to dig them out and to mix with some milk and sugar, ice for a tasty drink. The taste reminds me of grass jelly which I love so its a no brainer that this is my favorite tea drink.

column9: Organic Rooibos Tea at a great price
column10: Finally I can get my favorite tea and not have to pay for expensive packaging and pretty boxes. I love the tea and I love that it is packaged in an earth friendly way and is priced much lower than similar teas.

This is perfect red rooibos tea!  I drink it all the time.  The individual tea bags come in a recloseable ziplock bag.  Nothing fancy, just great & affordable tea.  If you want to serve it when you have people over, just use another cute tea tin & put the packets in that.  Super fast shipping!  I'll order more as soon as I get low.

Superb tea at a fantastic price. My only complaint *used* to be that once you remove the cellophane wrapper, the box is not sealed. But now the tea comes packed in a ziplock bag to keep it fresh. And they didn't even change the price!In the morning and evening I drink it with milk and sugar, like a latte. At work I drink it with sugar, no milk.Has a rich red color and an excellent taste that does not become bitter if it steeps a long time.
Great tasting tea, I make a blend of ice tea, using red,white,green and oolong tea without any sugar at all, tastes great without sugar.
I was introduced to Rooibos Tea by a South African ex-pat.  I love it, but it can be hard to find where I live.  Davidson's brand smells and tastes like it should and is a good value.

column9: Very good quality for the price
column10: I use a very large mug for tea, and after reading some reviews I worried that using two bags would offset the low price. There is no need for two bags. Red tea doesn't contains the tannins that cause bitterness if left to brew too long, so it's fine to leave the bag in the cup. I feel it's perfectly full flavored.I really appreciate Davidsons commitment to organic farming methods, and that is another reason I will continue to buy this tea.
this is 1 of the worst tea ever it is so bland and King Harley tech. Please do not waste your money.
I have had red tea (herbal) before and it never tasted like this, Yuk!!!  I should have paid the few extra dollars for something better.  This tea had a strange underlying taste to it.

This is probably one of the most incompetent companies that I have ever ordered from. Not only did the first two orders not arrive (one somehow got lost in the mail, and the other was damaged during shipping, which they never notified me about; I found out by calling Amazon several weeks later), but for the third order, they sent me Earl Grey tea, instead of Rooibos tea. I didn't want to deal with the hassle of returning it, so I kept it, but the people who process these orders seriously need to get their act together.
This is not a favorite flavor of mine.  Other than that, there was nothing wrong with the tea.

column9: Needs some doctoring, but makes a good couple of meals
column10: For the price I paid (with Subscribe & Save and another discount), I'm pretty happy with my order of Tiger Tiger Black Bean Sauce with Cantonese Fried Brown Rice , 19.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6) (FAR happier than with the Tiger Tiger Sweet & Sour with Cantonese Fried Brown Rice, 19.4 Ounce Box (Pack of 6), which has a thin sauce that I've not yet been able to doctor to my taste, though it seems to get a bit better if the leftovers sit in the fridge for a couple of days, and the all-vegetable version was much better than my second attempt that included shrimp).In addition to the sauteed thinly sliced chicken breast, garlic, grated fresh ginger, onions, carrots, broccoli, sweet peppers, and cherry tomatoes which I prepared before adding the sauce, I found that I needed to add a pinch of brown sugar, a few shakes of toasted sesame oil, and some hot pepper (I used ground cayenne) in order to brighten up the flavor.With those additions (the fresh gingerroot, sesame oil, and cayenne, at least, seem particularly necessary to me -- I wouldn't want to try to make this dish without having those, or similar spices/condiments, available), I was very happy with the dinner and with the lunches I got from the leftovers.  In fact, my co-workers seemed quite envious of my leftovers when I heated them in the microwave.[update:  "BETTER WITH BULGOKI"I discovered by accident that this product tastes best when made with bulgoki (Korean barbecued beef).  I had some wafer-thin slices of round steak in a bulgoki marinade that had been in the fridge for two days and needed to be cooked, so -- lacking time for anything more elaborate -- I tossed the marinated beef in a sautee pan and added the usual fresh vegetables and extra garlic and gingerroot, followed by the black bean sauce.  Except for being a little on the salty side (I'd omit or greatly reduce the soy sauce in my bulgoki marinade next time, since there's more than a little salt in the black bean sauce already), it tasted great. Weird as it might seem, I think I'll use Korean marinades on any meat I use in cooking up the remaining boxes of this product.]
This product came all dried and broken up.  It's not worth the money and super expensive shipping!!

column9: In a word AWESOME!!! Would buy them again.
column10: The cakes were purchased for my daughter as a Christmas present. Her comment is simply one word AWESOME!! She is my Japenese expert so if she says they are good there is NO doubt. We would buy these again.

My husband and I discovered Slap Ya Mama seasoning during a recent trip to New Orleans. What a perfect blend of seasonings-you wouldn't believe how delicious it is! I even purchased some for my parents and in-laws. My family uses it on ribs, chicken, vegetables, everything! Oh so GOOD!!!!!

I have been using Slap Ya Mama for the better half of two years. There is nothing comprable. The review that claims this is nothing more than a salt and pepper mix. Must be snorting this stuff. If they wanted something hotter they should have gotten the red pepper blend. You can use this stuff on everything, and no kidding this stuff is better than Christmas.... Visit there websight for all other products and great cajun recipies...

My boss gave me a small can of this seasoning for Christmas, and I soon grew addicted to sprinkling it on popcorn, fish, vegetables, you name it!  It is spicy yet flavorful, and doesn't overpower the flavor of the food.  Before long I had used mine all up and craved more!  So glad to find the larger size on Amazon.  It is cost effective and should last me a long time.
This seasoning is the best, I put it on literally EVERYTHING! I first bought it on vacation in VA and when I ran out, I simply panicked. I couldn't find it anywhere in FL. Amazon to the rescue!
This product is very good. Just don't buy it from Aunt Sally's Praline Shop where I bought it. That was bad.

I have been a SLAP YA MAMA fan for over 10 years.  I use it for everything - even Veggies.  It adds some sodium but if youre drinking the recommended water a day that should not bother you. I get it on Amazon cause the prices are much less and most times I get my Prime Status so it comes fast. If you use it alot, get the 16oz can.  Open it only to show a few holes.  Going from the smaller can to this one, if you open too much you get a lot!!I mix it into my normal SHAKE/BAKE seasoning for an extra kick.  The perfect way to get breaded chicken with NO fat.

The best part of Slap Ya Mama is that although it gives the dishes spicy flavoring, it's entire claim to fame isn't the heat. It has a great taste without overpowering the food flavors with heat so bad that it will clear out your sinuses for weeks!I have been using it for 7 years ever since I found it in a tuck stop store in Lake Charles LA.Got for it!

This is a first-rate proprietary blend of spices with well-balanced flavors. In my opinion, it is by far the best and most versatile spice blend in my over-stocked pantry. Slap Ya Mama is spicy hot but not overwhelmingly so and you can adjust the heat by modulating the amount used.  I have been using this blend for awhile now but still keep finding more and more delicious applications for it.  It can be used (lightly) to enhance rice, vegetables, or some awesome scrambled eggs; (a bit heavier) for Cajun grilled catfish or to amp-up a soup or stew; and (liberally) on barbecued meats.  You can even sprinkle it in olive oil as a dipping spice for fresh bread. Go ahead and give it a try -- bet you'll be really glad you did.

I wish I had purchased a smaller size because once I tried it, I realized it's really nothing more than salt and pepper combined together for you, haha. It's not very spicy at all... pretty good on eggs, though.

column9: Unique (at least to me) and very tasty.
column10: I can no longer find the Malher brand where I live so it's nice to have an online source for these delicious beans that put traditional "Mexican restaurant" refried beans to shame.  Not only are they rich in flavor but apparently also very high in fiber.  As with Malher's refried black beans, the consistency is thick but I prefer them that way.

I have done my share of reading on this topic and like to think that I provide my pets with not only somewhat healthy, but also palatable food. There are pros and cons to be said about all the brands. With this in mind I feed my dog and cat the Wellness Core brand dry food, but tend to switch between the "better" quality canned ones (depending whats on sale). For the most part I've been happy with with the brands I've tried, i.e. Natural Balance,Solid Gold,  Wellness, Merrick, Innova, etc.Open a can of any of the afore mentioned brands, and they won't have that generic pet food smell, i.e. nonspecific and overprocessed. The food made by these companies actually looks like food, not processed mush.Hence the prices they charge.I thought that Science Diet fell into this same category...WRONG!!Opened the first can and immediately got hit with the smell of ....goodness knows what. The food itself was a solid gelatinous mass that I had difficulty mixing..since i add only a small amount of wet food each night, one can lasts a few days. After a day or 2 in the refrigerator, the gelatin type substance only congealed more. This food very obviously contains a great deal of fillers, and yes my pets ate it..but this could be applied to anything not nailed down, so this was no shock.These reviews are highly subjective, and i hesitate to bad mouth something this strongly, but first and foremost I want others to know what theyre getting. The worst part is that the price is not that different from what I'd consider quality brands..

So I agree with the first reviewer in the consistency of this product. Its not chunks of meat or veggies but rather a potted meat type goo. But I am able to cut it up in little chunks and my dogs LOVE it. Which surprised me as they turn their noses up to so much (I have 4 dogs.) Like Iams as an example; my dogs hate the stuff but others swear by it.The light formula is great as it helps maintain and even reduce weight which is very important if you have small dogs, of which I have 3. The other is a boxer and he loves this stuff too. I mix it with dry - well, not mix really, but rather put both wet and dry in the same bowl for each dog so I am able to measure how much they each get. When I took them off this and opted instead for a more affordable regular wet food, the weight came back which is not good, especially for my little chihuahua.Every review should be taken with a grain of salt. Is this the dog food for you? Maybe - just buy a couple cans and try it. How else will you know?
At only 100 calories each & tasting just like snickers bars, these are always in my pantry for a quick chocolate fix!!!

column9: Good Flavor, Not Long Lasting - Not Recommended
column10: "Mentos Watermelon Gum" is a fairly good tasting sugarfree gum, but the flavor dissipates very quickly. This gum has a hard outer shell and a soft inside, but it isn't the "squirt" type that you might expect by looking at the picture on the plastic package (it is way over packaged, in my opinion). Each package contains 15 pieces.Not recommended

column9: not a bad cup a joe!
column10: I purchased the Bellagio dried Espresso to make desserts....chocolate espresso cookies, etc. I decided to try it first as per the instructions, for a cup of espresso. It was pretty good! It reminds me of the Starbucks single cup instant. I've had two cups so far and enjoyed both. I think I might just use it when I want a strong, fairly good flavored cup of coffee in the afternoon, when making a full pot is too much trouble and drinking a regular instant is out of the question. This espresso powder does not have that instant flavor so common among the store brands. And even at the price I paid, its far less than the one dollar per cup of Starbucks instant.

Product arrived quickly and in good condition.  It has a pleasant, fresh aroma but not quite the "kick" I expected.  I have added it to cooked and uncooked dishes with success and was very pleased with the final flavor outcome.  Just wish it were more spicy.
Very yummy, I put it on pita chips!  ZOWWIE!!! It is a bit zingy, so if you don't like hot, not for you.
The tea is clean and earthy and just great tasting...I loved it from the first sip! I wish it was made in the US but hey, what can you do?

I was surprised that these were about 20 per cent rice flour, but happy to say rinsing under warm water after cooking washed away most of the starch.The noodles held up well, did not get too soft or mushy and fall apart. They held up well to my very meaty pasta sauce.Overall I am pleased with the product and intend to purchase it again.

I WAS LOOKING FOR BUCKWHEAT PASTA SPECIFICALLY, AND I WAS THRILLED THAT AMAZON ACTUALLY HAD SUCH A THING.  I WANTED THIS PRODUCT FOR THE TASTE AND NOT NECESSARILY FOR THE GLUTEN-FREE PROPERTIES.  I AM QUITE HAPPY WITH THIS PRODUCT.

This is a HUGE container of paprika.  I'll be lucky if I use it up within 5 years.  First time purchasing Spanish sweet paprika so I can't really compare the quality to any other, but it works for me.

column9: So pleased to find this on Amazon
column10: I've been driving 30 minutes and paying full retail to buy this mild, satisfying, low sodium soup.  Since it's not full of salt, the flavor is much more mild than regular miso so everyone might not appreciate the taste. It's perfect for my health concerns and I like the flavor.It's a great sprinkle on seasoning and nice warm snack for the afternoon.  Thank you very much for carrying it.
Love the lighter sodium. Overall flavor very good. Wish there were more tofu and vegetable bits, but still very worth purchasing.

I have a head cold & I've been craving something warm & comforting. I'm vegan, so I got this low-sodium miso soup. One word....YUM!Contrary to a few reviews, this little cup of comfort IS flavorful. Perhaps those reviewers were missing the extreme amount of sodium in restaurant miso soup.Next time I fix this, I'm going to put some zucchini & spinach in it for added nutrition.

column9: Very good for instant, and not too salty!
column10: Albeit it's not as good as homemade miso, I find this to be the best instant miso I've tried.  Personally, I don't like super-salty food, so I was thrilled to find the reduced-sodium kind.  This soup is flavorful, and, as another reviewer mentioned, it tastes even better with some dried seaweed added to it.  I use Annie Chun's dried seaweed snacks in the sesame flavor: I rip the snacks into 2 or 3 large pieces, throw it in the bowl with the seasoning, and add hot water - voila!  That also helps for those of you who might like a saltier soup because the seaweed snacks have sea salt sprinkled on them.  If I'm feeling adventurous and have more time, I'll take extra-firm tofu cubes, sear them in a pan with a little olive oil and a bit of the seasoning from the packet, add them to the soup after slightly browned and crispy, and let the soup sit for a bit so the tofu absorbs the flavor.  It's healthy and filling without the parched-tongue after-effect that happens with many super-salty instant miso soups.  I love this stuff!

column9: It just doesn't taste that good
column10: It doesn't especially taste like Miso soup. In fact, it doesn't taste like much anything at all. Slightly brown hot water. Miso soup is a wonderful thing, but these packets do not produce anything that I'd call Miso. Sure, opinions vary on taste, but don't get a 48 pack unless you're sure you like this stuff!
I know that Miso is good and sodium is not so good, I like this on a cold or damp day.

Recommended on a Dr Oz show to eat before your dinner. This soup takes away those hunger pains so you do not over eat. It is also lower in sodium than most Miso soups. It is vegetarian and tastes good.

Originally I had bought the "full-sodium" Miso-Cup soup packets that contained 690 mg of sodium and it tastes identical to what you would get at a restaurant.  When I saw the reduced sodium packets, I was excited because Im always looking for more healthy alternatives.  This Miso Cup reduced sodium is disgusting.  It not only has no flavor but the bits of soy and whatever else is in there, doesn't get soft and just floats at the top of the soup like rocks.  Now, I have a huge box of these soup packets and am not really sure what to do with them. I've tried preparing it different ways, but still haven't been able to finish a single cup of it.  My advise? Go for the full-sodium Miso-Cup.  Yeah, it has more sodium, but it tastes great and is high in protein, vitamins and minerals.

column9: Doesn't even taste like miso soup
column10: After following the rather simple instructions (add one packet to 8oz of hot water and stir), I was extremely disappointed. The soup produced tastes and looks nothing like miso soup. Now I'm stuck with 47 more packets I have no intention of eating.Trust me, just buy another brand. This one is horrible.

column9: Great cereal for people who don't want added sweetness!
column10: I love this high fiber cereal with no added sweeteners! The cinnamon adds a little kick that I like.If you want a healthy,grainy,high fiber cereal with no added stuff, Simply Fiber is your best bet!

I have purchased several different types of Nature Valley Granola barsespecially for my college aged kids. I was rather disappointed at this selection as there were only two varieties in the box  Oatmeal Raisin and Chocolate Chunk.The Oatmeal Raisin bars were fine but the Chocolate Chunk in several of the bars had only ONE chunk and at most two. I do not know if this was a manufacturing error on Nature Valley's part or if they had to cut back but the kids were not thrilled.The product description did not specify the varieties I would be receiving but I did not mind as we generally have enjoyed all of Nature Valley's varieties we were just disappointed in the nearly non-existent chocolate chunks.

This is a high quality product with an excellent price.  It has a wonderful, smoked flavor and tastes very fresh.  We liked it so much that we purchased another for a friend's birthday. It makes a wonderful gift.  The only thing I would suggest to improve upon, is to perhaps have 2 separately wrapped package, since the larger size requires the salmon to be eaten within a few days.  It's so delicious that you want to savor it for a while, yet 24 oz. is quite a bit.  I highly recommend this product and will be ordering it again.

I ordered three packages of granola and expected all three to be equally tasty. They weren't. Since I cannot remember which one was not particularly good, I'm reluctant to re-order granola from this terrific company.

The description for the item reads "... Large arrangement measures approximately 24"H x 16"L ..."  The item I received is nowhere near that size.  In fact it's smaller than what the product description describes as a "small" arrangement (20"H x 14"L).  At $94.99 it's a rip off.  More expensive than a dozen roses (it only contains 8).  Combine this with the fact that it arrived a day late and I had to call 1-800-Flowers and spend 20 minutes on the phone to find out where it was.  It's the last time I do business with them.
great tasting  kuchela. exactly what i was looking for to eat my dhal and rice. will definitely buy this again sometime

column9: A halvah junkie wallows in pleasure
column10: This halvah is from the old New York City days.The package dripped oil.  I didn't care.  It was a glut of halvah.  I didn't care.  My arteries crackled as I cackled.  I didn't care. (They are using some partially hydrogenated oils now unfortunately.  But death comes to all of us, so eat.)This stuff, if you like it, is so addictive, you can use it for a tranquilizer.  I used to buy this brand by the chunk in New York at the deli counter of the supermarket.  It still tastes the same.The price is definitely right.It was great.  Amazon, you little devil, what did you do with my waisteline, or shouldn't we mention that?Counting calories?  Lock the stuff away and only allow one really caring friend to feed it to you at decent intervals.  Otherwise, chomp on!  It really doesn't get much better than this.
This batch was not nearly as good as our previous order. Much drier and less tasty.

When I tasted it, I immediately knew that this wasn't the halva I remember from my youth. I checked the ingredients and guess what; no honey - just corn syrup and partially hydrogenated oil ! Why is corn syrup in everything nowadays !I do not recommend this brand.

My first purchase of black refried beans was AMY'S. Why did I deceide to try EDEN'S? I am now stuck with 10 cans of DRIED NOT SO GOOD BEANS. AMY'S refried black beans, (LOW SODIUM), are DELICIOUS! BUY AMY's. . .
This decal was very easy to remove from the packageing and apply to the cake. It looked like a professional did this job once I was done!
I received the package promptly and it's contents were exactly what I ordered. All is good!

My wife bought me some of this as a surprise gift a couple days ago.  I love cooking and paprika is one of my favorite ingredients.  This paprika is pretty hot, so it will be great in blackening seasoning and is really good on chicken.  I also used it in a butter garlic cream pasta last night with imitation crab meat and it was very good.  Also, this is not bad for the price.

picked one of these up at a local market because it looked interesting - what a discovery. The savory flavor if the thyme combined with the sweetness of chocolate and the crispiness of flax seeds has made this a new favorite. Now if they only made a sage and cumin bar...

My fiance knows how much I like chocolate and thyme.  This should be a slam dunk, right?  Well you might be thinking the problem is that two flavors that taste good individually do not taste good together.  That's not it at all.  The Thyme must get burnt in the process of making the bar because it is awful.  My fiance and I were shocked by how bad it tastes.  Like burnt plant, not chocolate.  Avoid.

column9: Really Surprisingly Good Baked P-Chips! MMmm!
column10: I'd pretty much given up on baked potato chips cause I hate that funky texture that, for instance, the Lays one has.Since I really love the organic Kettle Chips in chipotle flavor, I decided to give these a go. I got the lightly salted first, and the texture was great. They were very nearly like regular. (A very minimal difference). Crispy, potato-y. Nice.I then ordered these, and I love them. Much tastier than the somewhat bland "lightly salted" regular ones. They're sweet and smoky. A very nice barbecue flavor, I have to admit.I really hope they make the chipotle flavor in baked (and organic). I'd buy those in a heartbeat.So, for folks looking for a non-fried potato chip alternative (great for brown bagging lunch, four servings to a bag makes them more economical), I recommend the Kettle Bakes. Very good product.Mir
Great taste but very low fat and sodium. Ideal for those who like chips but don't want the fat, salt and calories in regular chips.
These are $3.79 a bag at my local grocery - 15 bags at $34 is a great price. These arrived fresh at the end of April with a best buy date of late August. Great chips!

column9: The BEST! Kettle Baked Cheddar Chips
column10: My husband and I went to Kauai  in Feb. of this year and we tried these chips for the first time.
