I like that it doesn't have that horrid cat food smell to it and I'm feeding them good stuff not a bunch of fillers and by products.  Their coats are looking great (soft, fluffy and shiny) since I've switched to this product and the Castor & Pollux indoor dry food.

It might be organic and with no grain, but my cats who are usually not picky won't eat it unless they are really hungry. Most of the time they left it there to dry...It's interesting because they didn't like Newman's Own Organic cat food which is also organic, so I wonder what manufacturers put in those organic pet food.At the same price point they enjoy much more the Wellness brand and love Weruva's chicken.

column9: Not a Favorite.  Only 2 out of 5 Cats will Eat this Food.
column10: All of my cats eat Castor & Pollux Indoor Dry Cat Food, but only 2 of my cats will consistently eat this wet food.  A third cat will nibble at it and then walk away.The non-eaters have not traditionally been finicky eaters.  I have fed them Friskies Special Diet wet food in the past, but one of my cats seemed to react to the Friskies (itchy skin).  They now have no other wet food choice anymore, so all I can determine is they simply do not like the taste of this Castor & Pollux food.I will not purchase again.
my cats like their other products but will not eat this flavor can! too many fat chunks in it too.

We had these beans in bloody mary's while in New Orleans. AMAZING. We now know where to get them, so we can have awesome Bloody mary's here in Chicago. We have to make our own. No one here knows how to prepare a good Bloody mary.

A friend of mine brought these over for our wine tasting.  Now, I like cookies and I like wine, but I never would have thought of this if I didn't hear it from her.  We sampled several cookies with different wines. It was amazing how each one brought out different flavors in the wine.  We had so much fun comparing and tasting with different wines.  The apricot sage cookie is outstanding.I would definitely recommend these for a wine tasting party or any party where wine is served.  I haven't tried them on their own yet, but I'm sure they would hold up to a glass of milk too.

I came across cookies and corks at a wine tasting event were they had a Cookie Pairing Bar set up.. I immediately loved the concept of pairing cookies with wine and hung around the cookie  bar for a while tasting each cookie they had on display.. I knew exactly what I would do the next time I hosted my bookclub, I would create my own cookie & wine tasting bar.. So I ordered the 3 pack and then went  to the cookies and corks web site,  and paired my cookies with wine using the expanded wine wheel (each box has a pairing guide but the wheel is as more)  and got tips on "how to create a bar" . I was set.. My girls friends loved it, we didn't get to review the book but we did have a fantastic time trying cookies and wine and I discovered I actully like red wine (Pinot Noir) :)Cookies and Cookies is a must try, for every hostess or even great for gifts.. That's exactly what going to gift my mother for mothers day this year, Cookies and Corks Red Wine Pairing Box and my new favorite Pinot Noir.

I'm so excited about these cookies! They taste incredible and the concept of pairing with wine is so fun. I love the individual packaging because they can be a real treat for my husband and me after dinner without entailing a huge dessert. Friends of ours in Wisconsin bake for company, so I know the quality of ingredients and baking process is nothing but the best. You will not be sorry you splurged on these!

This product is amazing. It's not very spicy, but is incredibly flavorful, with a bit of a smokey taste, and makes a great addition to noodle soups, ma-po tofu, stir-fries, or any sauteed vegetables or marinades.

I got a terrific price on these and I'm so glad I got them. Tiny little treats that are perfect for positive reinforcement training. He loves them and will do whatever he needs to get one :-) so I we give two thumbs up and will purchase again.

The EVO 95 has been the one thing that has stopped my cat from bleeding when he uses his litterbox...in other words, it stopped his colitis/internal allergies and he's been a healthy, active, loving cat since.  I couldn't get over the difference simply changing from a diet of hard/soft mix...which I was first on Royal Canin for him and then tried SD z/d...then went to this.  It worked...period.  To those bashing the company, quit the hysteria!  IT WORKS...and now both my cats are on it and doing well.  I lost two cats last year, and mine are doing well on this diet...and I'm thankful to have it!

column9: Absolutely the best all around seasoning!!
column10: I have purchased this repeatedly.  It is great in soups, casseroles, cottage cheese -- Anything!!  Definitely recommend.One bag I received had a slice in it, but Amazon was very quick to replace the order and make it right.No problems here!

column9: Does NOT work for large roaches.
column10: I caught two american roaches/waterbugs and put them in a box with one of these and it failed to kill them. Probably because the openings are much too small for the roaches to even be able to go inside.. The picture on the box is grossly misleading and the trap is shown twice as large as it actually is.

We aren't used to seeing roaches, but moving to NC has forced us to deal with them. We weren't seeing many, but one or two a day was enough to make us concerned. We set out the bait stations and after about 4 days we stopped seeing roaches. After about 3 months we started seeing small roaches every few days so we recently set out new bait stations. We have been very happy with the results we are getting. Fingers are crossed.

This is the second year that we are using these baits and they seem to be working well again.  The only roaches we have seen since putting these baits down about 1 month ago are dead/dying roaches.  We tried another type of bait (Combat 766694/519 Quick Kill Formula Large Roach Bait Stations rated 5 star) and they had done nothing to stop the roaches we were seeing so we went back to these and are happy to say that they are working well.  Would be nice to not see any roaches at all, but am okay with seeing them dead or almost dead.  The challenge has been getting to them before our 11 month old twins do.

column9: Maybe these worked for a while
column10: If these worked at all, it was for less than two months.  I have my doubts about even that, as I watched a couple of small roaches completely ignore the baits before I gave up and killed them.  In any case, it's been about two months, and I just killed the first large roach I've seen since I put these down.  (I've seen plenty of small ones, though.)I previously used Combat baits and was more convinced they actually did something for the three months mentioned on the box.

column9: Worked great in combo with Combat Roach Killing Gel
column10: Put all the traps out at once-- this is for the medium/small roaches, not the huge palmetto bugs --along with the Combat Platinum Roach Killing Gel (used the whole tube-- used both products exactly as described on their packaging) and NO MORE ROACHES. This is in a 1-story concrete slab home, about 1700 sq feet, including garage. Concentrated mainly on bathrooms, kitchen, laundry area, and a little in the garage, and it really worked. We did NOT have a severe infestation, but just seeing 2 roaches each week, on average,  was too much for us. Anyway, this really did the trick.If they ever come back (these things work for about 3 months, per directions), will get this combo and do it again. Very happy!
Within a couple of hours, the few critters I was seeing (thanks to incredibly filthy neighbors) were gone, and weeks later, I have not seen a single one.

Came here wondering what the description was of this product. Have had 5 or 6 spread around counters for more than a month but the dirty folks downstairs keep sending more roaches up along the pipes. If this is a wonder-worker it works its wonders out of sight.

I read labels all the time. I first bought these bars because they are relatively low in calories (140) while high in protein and fiber - 6 and 4 grams respectively. I buy them now because they taste good.
These are my favorite Kashi bar. They are very satisfying and I eat one every day as part of my lunch. Has fruit and nuts, what more could you want?

For a snack bar, this is a crunchy delight, more nuts than anything and quite tasty. It is not for the calorie counter, but for those who want a fairly low cal and healthy snack after a workout. It has about 150 calories but no added fat.

These are the lowest calorie bar with the highest fiber and protein ever. Plus they are so good that when Harps stopped caring them they sold out. Very tasty, not too sweet. Great for healthy snacking.

I originally tried these bars because they're fairly low calorie, and high protein. They also do not have a ton of sugar. I love them because they're crunchy because they have almonds in them, but chewy at the same time. They have fruit, and nuts in them, and they're the perfect late afternoon snack. You know, when you want something sweet, but a candy bar is a BAD idea? Try one of these, they really hit the spot :)
I have tried many of the TLC bars and have found the mix of nuts and raisins in this bar to be just right for my taste.
A very healthy organic snack bar containing only fruit & concentrates.  I find the taste though very bland, as most "healthy" products are. The bar size at 1.3 oz makes this a very poor value.

My cats eat every scrap of this food...not just this flavor but every Organix flavor.  It NEVER smells.One thing I am afraid of with cats is their bowels movements.  If the food sucks, so will the movements.  Hence, my plan is to improve the food they take in and the bowel movements will follow.  Also remember cats are very susceptible to stomach cancer.  The better the food, the longer your cat will last and the higher the quality of the purr....get it?I can tell you the stool has been clean, with nearly without any incident.  As long as the stool is simple, I think the food is doing what it should be, and thats Organix.Worth the cost, in my eyes.
My cats just love this brand of cat food. I love it because it does not have the same bad smell of most canned cat food.
My cat loves this product! I care about her health so we buy this canned cat food for our house. I can hardly keep my little chihuahua away from it too! lol

My two cats liked this food the first few times I gave it to them, but in less than a week they stopped eating it. I would try getting a few cans from the pet store before you invest in a whole case. I have a few I'd be happy to sell you!

I love Organix wet food but this particular formula seemed to upset my cat's GI. She had diarrhea and then stopped eating for a few days ANY food. I tried introducing the same formula again as a snack and now she won't touch it. She had no problems with the turkey rice chicken formula and continues to eat that formula.Wondering if it was the spinach that upset her. Still a great brand and great company.
Smells delicious to me though.  I give it to my dogs and chickens.  Wont be buying more.  The cats and dogs do like the dry kibble from castor and pollux.

I bought this because it was highly recommended on several 'nutritional review' cat food sites and because of the raving comments here. My cats are hard to get to eat 'any' food except dry. This includes raw, fresh cooked, or people-canned chicken, tuna, salmon, etc... Anyway, at first my cats gingerly ate a little bit (PROGRESS!!!), so I ordered another case, but this whole case has literally ended up in the garbage.  I'm not sure if the ingredients have changed (in quality or quantity) or if it's my cats. All I know is that it's being thrown away on a daily basis, can after can. So I'm on the hunt again for a quality canned food that they'll eat-with minimal waste. Bummer!
This is a fabulous organic cat food.  Love that it has spinach in it.  My cats really love it. So glad to have found it.  Thanks Amazon!

I have been very much impressed with the entire range of Organix catfoods for some time.  But the two stores I frequent in Northern New Jersey that have supplied the product no longer, for some reason, do; maybe it's too expensive in today's economy.  I ordered a case of one flavor through Amazon.  Nothing wrong there, but if I wanted to provide my cats with some variety, I'd have to order five or six cases, and I live in an apartment.  I'd be great if, since their catfoods are no longer available in a very population-dense and upscale section of the country, Castor & Pollux could offer a mixed case of catfoods.  That way, they'd never lose me as a customer.  As things now stand, I've gone back to Iams (not easy to find either, but still available in stores!).
I received my shipment fast and the bacon was lovely.  I would recommend ordering this item to anyone interested.

column9: Really Surprisingly Good Baked P-Chips! MMmm!
column10: I'd pretty much given up on baked potato chips cause I hate that funky texture that, for instance, the Lays one has.Since I really love the organic Kettle Chips in chipotle flavor, I decided to give these a go. I got the lightly salted first, and the texture was great. They were very nearly like regular. (A very minimal difference). Crispy, potato-y. Nice.I then ordered these, and I love them. Much tastier than the somewhat bland "lightly salted" regular ones. They're sweet and smoky. A very nice barbecue flavor, I have to admit.I really hope they make the chipotle flavor in baked (and organic). I'd buy those in a heartbeat.So, for folks looking for a non-fried potato chip alternative (great for brown bagging lunch, four servings to a bag makes them more economical), I recommend the Kettle Bakes. Very good product.Mir
Great taste but very low fat and sodium. Ideal for those who like chips but don't want the fat, salt and calories in regular chips.
These are $3.79 a bag at my local grocery - 15 bags at $34 is a great price. These arrived fresh at the end of April with a best buy date of late August. Great chips!

column9: The BEST! Kettle Baked Cheddar Chips
column10: My husband and I went to Kauai  in Feb. of this year and we tried these chips for the first time. And my husband started a saying then "an opened bag of these chips is and empty bag of these chips"  and once we came home we could not find them anywhere. No store around our town of Grand Junction Colorado carried the baked cheddar chips. So I looked to Amazon and there they were. So now we have them available and we will order more. Yesterday we had sandwiches for lunch and as my husband ate the last few chips and crumpled the bag up he said" an opened bag of chips is an empty bag and he laughed. They really are good tasting chips whether a person is watching their calorie intake or not. We will buy them again!

These chips are the best snack since the invention of chips themselves. They are actual baked potato chips, not potato powder or potato starch. And after you see the nutrition facts you wont feel guilty eating them!! Try them and you will be sold!

column9: Fantastic ! Best baked potato chip ever.
column10: These potato chips are absolutely the best baked potato chip I have ever tried.  They are so good that my husband and son will also eat them.  In fact, my college-aged son says he prefers these over the greasy regular potato chip.  With 65% less fat and baked, they are a healthy alternative to regular potato chips.  We got the lightly salted because husband is watching his blood pressure and these are perfect with just a touch of sea salt on them.  Sodium is lower than Lays baked and the taste is much better.  These look and taste like real potato chips, unlike Lays Baked which don't even look real.  Highly recommend these.
The best baked chips I've ever tried.  Yummy!  Also, crunchy enough to satisfy that urge to munch.  And low fat and not too bad on sodium content either.
These chips are the best I ever had.Very low in fat and taste great, I just wish they had less salt like amazon says they are.

These chips are the best chips ever. They are thick and crispy. No chip compares.These chips are gluten free. And should be considered a gluten free grocery. Ordering by the case really saves money compared to grocery store.
These chips are low fat 3 grams a serving very firm chip great for dips or just to eat all I can say Is I set up delivery 15 bags every 3 months. Yummy! Chuck from Baltimore

The chips that were delivered have little to no barbeque seasoning on them which makes them pretty bland.  I get seasoning on every third chip.  Keep in mind it is the seasoning that makes the chips worth buying.

They taste great while you're eating them...but wheeeeew...the aftertaste is awful.  Not only that, it's very hard to get rid of.  I like the sea salt, and the white cheddar, but the sea salt and vinegar is the my favorite (very, very, salty).

My son will only eat these hickory honey baked chips from Kettle Baked. He says their taste can't be beat. They are always sold out in our area so we buy them from AMAZON for the BEST deal! Stick with Amazon for the greatest bargains online.
I love these chips.  I no longer crave regular potato chips!!  They are so tasty and crunchy!! Alot of salt tho!!

I really love these potato chips.  It is great that they are made from real potatoes and do not contain any genetically modified ingredients or msgs like most other brands of chips.  This is a really great price for them as well.

column9: It's really hard to believe they could be this good!!
column10: I have been a fan of the Kettle Bakes for a long time now.  They truly are the best chips available anywhere.  In my opinion they are far better in every way than any brand of fried potato chips, not counting Fritos, which aren't potato chips anyway.  I don't see how they could really be improved.  The crunch is fantastic, the flavor is fantastic, and you sacrifice nothing but greasy fingers!  I have tried every flavor, and my favorite is definitely the Aged White Cheddar, but you won't see me turn my back from the BBQ, or the Lightly Salted.  The Salt and Pepper flavor is a bit peppery, so if you like that then you'll like them, and I even eat them sometimes.  The Salt and Vinegar doesn't work for me, but then I'm not a fan of vinegar potato chips anyway.Just buy these, please, any flavor that tickles your fancy.And then you can thank me later.=)

When I received this item it was labeled "Sea Salt." In  fact, the Sea Salt version of these chips is also described as "lightly salted," so you might think the two were one and the same. However, these are listed as having 115g of sodium per serving, while the Sea Salt version has 135g of sodium per serving. If this matters to you like it matters to me, stipulate that you receive the Lightly Salted version ONLY.

I wish I could be responding more favorably, but this is my honest experience.  I was excited to find lightly salted and low fat kettle chips on Amazon at a good price.  I was going to have them delivered every six months.  When I got my first order I got seasalted chips instead of lightly.  I called about it and they put through another order at no charge to me.  Second order again wrong chips.  So I called and cancelled automatic delivery.  The chips are good except they are a little too hard and hard on my gums.  Also too salty for me.  The above should have read (lightly salted)I have to admit though that I do like the chips because they are lower fat and may order again.  I just wish I could have gotten lightly salted ones.  "Thank you.  Irene Zalonski (zalonski @sbcglobal.net)
really, that's all i have to say! The chips can be a little....uh...crunchy at times, so watch the roof of your mouth, but the flavor is great.  I hope Amazon carries the salt and pepper ones soon!

This is the only company I know of that makes baked potato chips from sliced potatoes, rather than from reconstituted potatoes. It makes a real difference in flavor and texture. For those new to the product, expect something more like a baked potato than like a french fry.

column9: Excellent alternative to fat fried chips
column10: Full of flavour and crunch without the oily aftertaste,fantastic product. YummmmPackaging needs to better or UPS more careful when handling.
Being a chip lover from way back, these are among the best.  Where so many other baked chips taste like cardboard, these actually taste like a potato.  LOVE these chips.

column9: Like no other baked chip! Delicious but expensive
column10: I love these Kettle brand baked chips!  They are so close in texture and flavor to regular fried chips.  I just wish they were less expensive.  They really are greatly reduced in fat content as well.No other baked chip comes close.  I wonder how they do it?

Loved these chips.  They taste like real potatoes with less than one half the fat of regular chips.  I can eat these without feeling guilty and without sacrificing taste.  Eat them alone or with your favorite dips, and they are delicious.  When I found these I realized I don't have to give up one of my favorite snacks. If you are a potato chip fan but feel you have to eliminate chips from your diet, try these.  I did, and now I am a real fan.

Good alternative to the typical baked potatoe chips which are usually filled with other additives like corn and artificial ingredients. They're relatively low fat and taste like the real thing. My only complaint is that they are very salty even thought the manufacturer claims that they are "lightly salted".

I first tasted these on a trip to NYC and my wife and I were hooked.  Tough to find them around here and I was thrilled to find them on Amazon.  No other baked chip even comes close to these - you would swear they were kettle fried chips but with no greasy feel.  Our current favorite snack!

column9: Kettle Bakes are my #1 favorite potato chip.
column10: If you are craving Potato Chips and Dieting this is one to check out..They are better then traditional Potato Chips.  3grams fat per serving..it is remarkable..Try them and you will love them.

We are always searching for low fat, lower calorie snack foods to satisfy our strong snacking needs. These chips are one of the best we have ever found. They are delicious and satisfying and have only 120 calories per serving. They are terribly expensive at our local supermarkets, but  Amazon offers a great price!

Bought the pack of 15 and made the mistake of having them delivered to my office.  They were consumed in a week...couldn't keep anyone's hands off them, even those that are discriminating about eating healthily.  Great, crispy and super tasty. Yummy, yum yum!!! :-)

column9: not too salty and not greasy
column10: If you're a big potato chip fan, you might find these a little unusual because they are baked.  I personally am not big on the greasiness that most potato chips have, so I actually prefer a baked chip like this.  I also like that these chips have a little less salt than most chips, so the potato flavor really comes through.Let's face it:  a potato chip is never going to be a truly healthy snack.  Even without the extra fat that comes from frying and without the excess salt, a chip is still a bunch of simple carbohydrates.  If you can control yourself and not scarf down bags at a time, however, this is a reasonable indulgence to add to your diet on occasion.

These chips are great and so is the price! Other low calorie potato chips are made from a potato batter and usually have added sugar. These are real chips that taste great. Bet you can't eat just one.
These are great. Low fat, low calorie, low in sodium and taste good. A perfect snack. What more can we ask for?

I am so impressed with these chips, especially compared to the other brand of baked chips I've tried. The texture is very similar to the original kettle chips, plus there is a little fiber in each serving which is nice to see in a snack. I will certainly buy again!

My husband and I are on Weight Watchers and eat these chips frequently because they are much lower in fat than regular chips. One serving is equal to 2 Weight Watchers points (old point system). It seems that the local stores are always out of them so I ordered through Amazon, but was disappointed in the freshness date. All 15 bags had a freshness date of August 11, which was much too close to the date ordered. The ones I bought at the grocery store in June had a freshness date of October. Although we eat these almost daily, we won't be able to consume 15 bags by August 11, and did not want to be bothered with the hassle of returning them.

column9: Best Chips Ever - Non-greasy and Crispy
column10: These are the best chips on the market. They are very crispy and tasty. Because they are baked, they are not greasy. Also, they are not as salty as other chips. I love mine with beer.
These are my favorite chips now-bar none. They are crispy, delicious and are actually made with real potatoes...two thumbs way up!

These chips are amazing.  Though baked (i.e., much healthier than regular chips), they have a great and thick crunch to them.  The ingredients list is also pleasantly short:  potatoes, safflower/sunflower oil, and sea salt.  It's rare to find such a high-quality pre-packaged product these days.  Only real negative is price, but buying on Amazon helps in that regard.
These baked chips have a great crunch. Best baked chips I've had to date.  Not totally like fried, but a delicious way to cut fat and salt.
The chips taste good, are low in fat and easy to digest.  However, the company keeps sending me the sea salted instead of the low sodium version.

Kettle brand Baked Potato Chips are the best baked chips I have ever eaten.  They are real sliced potatoes (unlike some brands that are "compressed" chips).  They only have 3g of fat and 135mg of sea salt per 1 oz. serving but you can't tell that by their taste.  I have trouble finding them in my local stores, so this is a great way to buy them at an excellent price and keep extra bags on hand.

These chips have some of the best barbecue flavor of any chip without all the grease. The texture is a little hard, so sometimes if I get a thick chip it hurts my teeth. But the taste is worth it!  The irregularity of the size and shape of the chips tells you that they're real, not something created in a lab. Plus through Amazon I save almost 50% off the grocery store price!I just wish Amazon carried the baked salt and vinegar flavor. It exists, but is not easy to find. I manage to snag some every few months or so but at almost $4 a bag I can't really stock up the way I could if they were available through Amazon.

column9: Better healthy chips compared to most
column10: Great baked chips, but it taste most like sour-cream-and-onions than cheddar. It still a great product.

column9: I have died and gone to Heaven
column10: I love potato chips, but since I have an "efficient metabolism," I can't eat them. However, I can eat these! They are low in fat and calories but the are DELICIOUS and taste better than regular chips. Try them!!

column9: Much better than other baked chips
column10: These are my favorite chips.  Very crunchy and tasty.  Not processed and mealy like other baked chips.  You'd never know you were eating a reduced fat product.  The best!!!

These Kettles bake chips are the best!  They taste like fried chips, but they're not, so much healthier for you.  I have trouble finding them in stores, so I've started buying them on Amazon by the case...  we use them up!

Yum, yum, yum! These baked chips are so delicious I keep forgetting they're baked. They taste like thick fried kettle chips. My husband prefers lightly salted chips, and he was thrilled with these. We only have a couple bags left and will order more when they go on sale again. My only complaint is that they're a tad pricey.In case you're wondering how big a 4 oz bag of chips is, the bags are in-between the larger bags you usually find at the supermarket and the small individual serving bags you might get at a sub shop. The nutritional info says each bag contains four servings. Well, of course, that depends on your appetite and restraint, but I'd say it's more like a two-serving bag.  :)I received the chips on August 30, and the expiration date is December 14... So I wouldn't order these if you don't think you'll eat them within a few months. Not a problem in our house!

These potato chips rock.  I've been looking for a low-fat real potato baked chip for a long time and I finally found it.  What's even better, it tastes like a real potato chip.  Not those other baked chips that taste like a salted piece of dried plastic potato mush.  Love these chips.

Well, baked potato chips have finally gone mainstream after years of being some obscure brand in the store that you bring home and just try to eat while they crumble in your hand and taste bland while they're doing it.Now some of the big national snack companies have "baked" chips, but why are they shaped like hexagons?  Some of those baked chips from national manufacturers look like the result of some mad scientist experiment.Not these!  These look like somebody sliced up potato and baked it in such a way that they still hold their structural integrity when the process is complete.  They're crispy just like traditional potato chips and the seasoning is balanced just right.  Once I get through this box I'm looking forward to trying other flavors.

These are great chips, relatively low in fat and calories. A great snack when you have the craving for something slightly salty.Glad they have these on Amazon. Can't find this inexpensively anywhere else, when you can find them at all.

These Kettle Bakes potato chips are incredibly good.  They have a more intense potato taste, and they are not too salty like a lot of other baked chips.  If you open the bag, heaven help you because you are probably going to eat the whole thing.  Luckily, the bags only contain 4 oz.

These are great chips, low in fat, high in potassium. When I had difficulty finding them in Publix, I cheched out Amazon.com. Happy that I did. Not only is it more convenient, but less expensive, also!

Kettle's hickory honey BBQ chips are fantastic! There are a lot of snacks on the market that are supposedly healthier alternatives to their full-fat counterparts, but in my experience, reducing the "bad stuff" usually causes similar reductions in taste and quality. Moreover, in cutting out the fat, almost every snack adds artificial sweeteners, fillers, preservatives, or fat substitutes, nearly all of which can be health concerns for consumers. (For example, any product with sucralose/Splenda in it makes me extremely ill!)However, with Kettle's chips, consumers can easily identify all of the ingredients in the package, and in the baked chips, you can essentially eat an entire bag for about the same amount of fat you'll find in a single serving of most other brands of chips. Even better, the BBQ flavor is really great in these chips, ensuring that your snack is really satisfying and truly filling your cravings. I love the fact that more salty snack options are appearing on the market, and I hope that Kettle continues its trend of producing simple, healthy, and absolutely tasty products. I guarantee that chip lovers will not be disappointed by this yummy offering...

column9: Potato Chips are Back on the Menu :D !
column10: If you crave real potato chip taste without all the fat, this product is for you. If you've bought other 'low fat' chips and were disgusted, just try one more - this brand.  They look and taste like real potato chips, because they are.  A green company, and a great product.

It is unusual to find the perfect snack food that dazzles bag after bag.  They are almost addicting which is a good thing in this case.  I feel it is safe and not going to do too much damage to the health conscience system.  More to it than a baked potato but almost halfway healthy.  The flavor of course and the crunch texture make this chip a rare masterpiece of monstrous culinary excellence.  Good job there Northwest.  Wish I could find a life coach that was this good.
I love Kettle's baked lightly salted chips. They taste better than regular chips, are less greasy, and have a terrific crunch!!!!
Product was fabulous but I would like to be able to purchase 1 ounce bags

column9: good but definitely taste different from fried chips
column10: these are good, not like the baked lays that are made with processed potato flakes.
Great flavor, much lower fat than regular chip. Good to have healthy alternatives for children (and their parents!!)...
best low calorie chip yet.  hard to tell that they are baked.  very, very good!!
These chips took me about 5 minutes to get used too. It tastes and smells just like aged white cheddar chips should, very strong.
Just received this from amazon, great condition and fast shipping. Great buy, 15 bags for $20...crispy chips with just the right amount of seasoning.  Much cheaper, than buying one bag for $4...
These are nothing short of amazing. So good you hardly miss real chips. We keep re-ordering them and the whole family. They definately fit the good and (sort of) good for you (at least not too bad!).

I have fallen in love with these chips. They taste great and I can eat a handful for less than 100 calories. A great little treat to have in my desk at work and on the counter at home. Try them they're great!!!
These are the best chips EVER!  Fantastic potato flavor and crunch.  I don't even want regular chips again.  You will not be disappointed!

These are absolutely the best tasting baked chips out there.  You can't even tell they are baked except that they're not greasy.  Great flavor - though I  think they would be even better if they put even more seasoning on them.
These are a great snack for those who love potato chips and want to watch their fat intake.  The flavor is very delicious!
These are great baked potato chips for those who are watching their fat intake!  Love them!

column9: Weird after-taste for me (try one bag before you buy a box)
column10: I bought a box of these baked barbeque Kettle brand chips from Amazon in somewhat larger-sized bags, because they came so highly recommended by other reviewers, but I really don't care for them at all (though other people to whom I've offered them  munch through them quite happily, and are pleased to take the rest of the bag home with them when I make the offer).  I can only conclude that individual palates may respond very differently to these particular chips.So, if you've bought a bag of Kettle's baked chips in this particular flavor recently in your local grocery store and found them quite tasty, you'll probably be quite happy with buying these by the box-full from Amazon.However, if you haven't yet tried them, do NOT invest in a multi-bag shipment until you first discover whether or not these particular chips appeal to your particular palate.I'm busy giving away every bag I bought, because I developed a distaste for them after eating the first few chips from the first bag I opened (which I ended up throwing away half-full).  But my dislike for these baked barbecue-flavor chips from Kettle brand (whose other, 'full-fat' chips I've almost always relished) is definitely a minority opinion among my friends and neighbors, so far.

column9: Great chips, but a little too salty for my liking
column10: Considering these are baked, they are very tasty.  They are super crispy and taste like fried goodness, but without the oiliness.  The only bad thing I have to say is that these are supposed to be "lightly" salted but I still found them overly salty (that's why I only gave it 3 stars). I actually found the Baked Salt & Malt Vinegar ones less salty than these. So for those watching their sodium intake or don't like things too salty, then you may want to consider the other flavors.

column9: Not as good as I hoped
column10: I had high hopes for these chips, I love the Kettle Brand and I love cheddar. But they were TOO crisp,they were sharp and hard. And the taste was salty but it didn't remind me of good aged cheddar at all.

column4: R. W. Taylor "Wil O' The Wisp"
column10: I hope that one day this snack can reach the point where it is truly healthy and consistently good.A) Claiming to be healthy, at least - last bag I munched on had nutrition info that would in one serving give you the bare minimum healthy cholesterol score (<300) for an entire DAY. Many snacks do this. Like peanuts. Or popcorn. The idea is that since the products are from 'natural' sources, there is less control over the batch. But seriously - less than 300mg per serving? Give me a break. This gives no one trying to help themselves in this area any hope of control. It's almost like writing a blank check. To yourself. To state that your product's single serving falls less than the daily total max recommended is garbage. Read the label.B) The batches may be uneven in cholesterol, and they may avoid legal issues by setting it at the 'max'. But the uneven textures and flavors you may get (I consumed, along with family and friends, several cases of these over 2 years or so) don't add up, either. I had burnt tones, teeth-cracking textures at times.I used to love these chips, much as the majority of the reviews portray. I thought I was enjoying at the least a fair product, staying healthy, keeping the fat away. But - they are simply simple carbs with a little twist of fat that get you by in the place of their higher-fat brethren. In case you are not sure of where I stand, I am one of those people who think carb-laden chips are not a great food. You don't miss health until you lose it. These chips will not help your health. They might, at best, make it slightly less worse than everyday chips - at twice or more the price.A leading non-profit consumer org concluded this was 'junk health food'. They cited other causes, as well. I wholeheartedly concur that this is not a healthy food. It is a junk food that is masquerading as one.ADDENDUM:Just got around to adding this. My wife purchased a bag of the "Hickory Honey BBQ" at the beginning of July. They were real dental-rattlers, uneven but thick-cut and baked into seriously hard material. The spices were horribly uneven.Lot mark: 12JUL12 090227921:37

I've ordered this item three times.  Lightly salted, right?  Three times I've gotten my order, and three times it's been wrong.  Very disappointing.The chips themselves are very tasty, though...just WAY too salty for me.
The chips have dark rings from overcooking and have a burnt taste. I contacted manufacturer but no reply. Hugh disappointment.

So you want some tasty flavorful potato chips, seriously why bother with these. Please understand they are baked. Even so, they taste like seasoned cardboard. Ur better off with a rice cake. Or how about you walk around the block and then enjoy a handful of the standard kettle chips, well worth it!This product Skip!

column9: Makes GREAT Healthy cherry pie filling
column10: This is a great product.  It's not as finicky as arrowroot powder which if heated too long will not thicken. I made the recipe on the back with some additional changes and it was fabulous!! My kids loved it and it's a great substitute for the very unhealthy cans of cherry pie filling on the store shelfs.Here's what's on the back:QUICK APPLE CHERRY PUDDING (I call my new reciipe "Cherry Pie Filling"- used for cobbler)4 C EDEN organic apple cherry juice (I used Santacruz unpast. OG apple juice)(I also added 1 1/2 Tbl of Dynamic Health Black Cherry Juice Concentrate)4 Tbl EDEN Kuzu dissolved in 5 Tbl cold waterPlace all in a saucepan, bring to a boil, and stir constatnly until thick.Kuzu is also good for sothing the stomach and strengthening the intestines. this would be a great thing to give your child if he's suffering from a tummy ache.

Been desperate to find a product I could use in place of cornstarch and flour for thickening sauces and gravies. I am seriously allergic to both.Purchased this and substituted it baking non gluten bread also. I pressed it to a fine powder before I measured it for my receipes.It worked great.

This is an excellent thickener and makes great pudding. It is expensive but with this "bulk" 4-pak order is cheaper than elsewhere. It is also recommended for health benefits-- can't testify to this tho.
I use this product to make vegan almond anise biscotti that gets raves from everyone who tries it (and doesn't dislike anise!)  I wish I could find it cheaper, but other brands have been subpar.

column9: We use this for colds, flu
column10: I add it to warm apple cider to help fortify the constitution and ward off colds and flu.  It is necessary, I have found, to bring the cider to a low boil, then allow it to simmer.  When the cider is just cooling from a simmer, that is when the kuzu just stirs in beautifully.  Any warmer or cooler, and the kuzu powder clumps.  If anyone has any more precise directions on how to avoid clumping, I would really appreciate them.  Because, every so often, I miss.  But this is still great for what we use it for.

I use this to make my own homemade baking poweder.  This is a great product, but a bit expensive.  I haven't decided if it's worth the extra expense yet, and that is why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.

column4: E. Vinson "Not all who wander are lost..."
column10: I ordered these as a cart filler, they were around 3$ at the time. (price as I write this review is $35.20 for some reason)Wasn't expecting much, maybe a tiny packet of half soggy caramel flavored mess.What I got was a tray holding about 24 small, very crispy "crepes". They didn't taste like salted caramel, just a pure sweet caramel flavor. They were about 2 bites each, and were absolutely perfect with a cup of hot cocoa after a rough day.It's a shame they aren't available at the same price, they would be worth buying in bulk next time.

This is a great assortment, and to me a better choice than the standard assortment - which is often 40% chocolate and 30% grape. This would be perfect with a few Oranges thrown in as well (instead of the chocolate!), but the Strawberry is great, the Lemon-Lime is also very nice, and the Blue raspberry is great too. You can usually count on 5 or 6 of the raspberries (red and blue, each)in the regular assortment but you only get the blue ones here. The watermelon is nice, and kids seem to really enjoy it as well. The regular box is Chocolate, Grape, Cherry, Orange, Raspberry (red) and another flavor, which is often Raspberry (blue).If you go through Tootsie Pops regularly or semi-regularly, this box is a treat not only because you don't get stuck with such an abundance of chocolate and grape, but because the Lemon Line, Watermelon, Strawberry flavors are great new additions (and you no longer have to fight with the kids over the too few Blue Raspberries).

column9: Beware - you might get a "standard" assortment box
column10: In some ways this is false advertising - the box I received was the standard fun assortment which contains chocolate, grape, cherry, orange, and green apple.  The box I received does not match the picture, and I wanted to get this particular assortment because of the lemon-lime, strawberry, watermelon, and blue raspberry - none of which come in the standard assortment.  Even though I still do like every flavor of tootsie pop that's available, I don't mind this standard assortment, but I was definitely caught off guard when what I received did not match what I had ordered.  After sending in my complaint, they did issue me a refund so that was a nice gesture.
I returned 2 cartons of these that were the standard variety flavors sold as the fun flavor assortment. It seems this is a common problem.

i should have believed the reviews.even senior citizens can be enticed by new fun flavors, so ignoring the warnings i ordered this assortment. it arrived with the usual amazingly fast amazon delivery but upon opening the box the contents were, obviously, not as described; no lemon-lime, no blue raspberry, and no watermelon. what i did receive was more disappointing. of the 100 pops 49 were cherry,6 orange and the balance distributed amongst the same old flavors. i guess the tootsie folks had too much cherry in stock, next time i'll heed the warnings.

I ordered this because I wanted to try to the Fun Flavor Assortment (Chocolate, Strawberry, Lemon Lime, CherryBlue Raspberry and Watermelon) but instead I received the traditional assortment (no Lemon Lime or Watermelon). Disappointing. :-(

I found a box of these tootsie pops at Costco over a year ago in another city I was living in at the time. Once I returned home, I was unable to locate the fun flavor box of tootsie pops anywhere in town =( Not good. My heart is set on these flavors, they are far more superior to the "regular" flavors that I usually throw away (orange, grape). I love the strawberry and watermelon the most, they are both sweet and fruity. I also enjoy having chocolate and cherry, the "classic flavors" and blue raspberry a "fun flavor" in this box. Try it out and i'm sure you will love it too!
Just want to warn you that "fun flavor" are strange berry flavors and NOT the traditional ones I expectd, like lime, orrange, cherry and grape.  I was very disappointed.

The taste on this one is only "so-so", verging on downright bland.  Plus, it has a lot of additives and preservatives.  Since I like to feel a little burn on my tongue and don't want to glow in the dark, I'll stick with "Shark" brand sriracha sauce.

column9: This balsamic vinegar is absolutely fantastic!!
column10: Very happy with this product.  The vinegar has a smooth sweet taste that accents almost anything!!  I've used it in a fresh tomatoe salad and also to marinate meat and it was fabulous!!
Good texture. My discerning tot approves. my 4yo enjoys them too.I even eat one if we're out and I need a quick "sugar fix".

column9: on time, good quality, as described
column10: On time, as described, good quality.  And here are a few more words to meet the minimum. This was called padding a paper in college.

After the turtle sundae of Berres Brothers Coffee, I figured I would look for another flavor to sample.  I stumbled upon this one and thought I would give it a try as I really liked the other one.  I would have to say that this one to me is just OK.  The smell and the flavor of this one isn't the same as the turtle sundae.  I'll stick with the turtle sundae and will look for another flavor to sample.

I have been looking for this product because my grocery store no longer carried this brand.By goggling the name of the company and the flavor that I have come to love, I found it on Amazon and ordered it.I was delivered swiftly and billed according to the stated price.I give Amazon five stars as I am a completely satisfied customer.rld

Okay, I will admit I tasted this right off the bar and it was really, really good. I really think this is one of the best tasting chocolates for cooking I have come across. It melts easily and you can use it to create such wonderful chocolate dishes. A little goes a long way because the taste is so rich. It is satisfying and puts you on a whole new level if you are most familiar with run of the mill type chocolate brands (some of the more mass produced brands). I absolutely love the fact that the ingredients list is so simple: cacao beans; sugar; cocoa butter; non-GMO soy lecithin; whole vanilla beans. This really is an amazing artisan chocolate experience and I am glad I had it. Will definitely be purchasing these in the future as well - can't wait to test out some new recipes using it!

column9: SO DELICIOUS YOU WON'T GET TO BAKING WITH IT
column10: If you're a choco-holic you probably like everything that comes your way, like Hersheys, or even lesser brands.  As long as it's chocolate, it's good.But then we had the pleasure of having a German girl come to visit us, and she brought some of the "real" stuff from her country, and it just strikes you how much better the higher quality stuff is.  I'm not denigrating Hershey's or Nestles or whatever--all right, I am, though I still like those brands too.  But try this chocolate, and you'll know what I mean.It's a semi-sweet bar and therefore made for cooking, so it's not going to taste as sweet as normal chocolate you get in this country, but trust me: you'll probably never get to cooking with it.  We handed some out to friends to show them the difference, and ate the rest ourselves.It's pricey (we paid about $16) but you get six bars for it.  The pieces are a bit big, so the bar goes pretty fast.But taste it: it's sweet, but the most amazing quality is its RICHNESS.  It has a very full quality to it--there are three real sensations with most food: the first taste when you bite it, then the "mouthful" taste, then the lasting or after-taste as it disappears down your gullet--and all of these tastes are of CHOCOLATE.  Not sugar, not additives..nothing but full, rich CHOCOLATE.It's really wonderful.  There's nothing quite like it.

column9: Is there anyone who doesn't like this?
column10: It's just the best chocolate, ever. My only complaint is that because of the high quality, the cost is too high for me to buy it exclusively for baking and general use. I would if I could, though. Everything about it is perfect--complex flavor, smooth texture, melts well...it's great. For a real treat, try chopping some up and whisking it into about a cup of gently warmed milk, for a rich hot cocoa similar to the "drinking chocolate" you can get at some cafes. Great stuff.

This is a deep, rich, luscious chocolate.  I intend to use it for frosting, so I had to hide a few of my six bars because otherwise they would all be gone by now.  I made the mistake of offering samples to family and friends.Let it melt in your mouth.  Very smooth.It supposedly has a citrus undertone, but I did not detect it and no one else mentioned it.  It must be very subtle.My only "complaint" is that it is scored into relatively large pieces that are too big and awkwardly shaped for eating from the bar.  Of course, it could be broken into smaller pieces, but . . . . somehow that never happens and I always eat the large piece I broke off.  No will power.  And friends and family each got a bigger piece than my chocolate greed would normally have allowed.  Okay, so that's my fault and not the manufacturer's.I might also point out that this is semisweet chocolate.  So there is a light touch of sweetness, including a very slight honey undertone.  It is my favorite semisweet, but that makes this only my second most favorite eating chocolate, as I usually reach for bittersweet -- my favorite chocolate for munching is Ghiradelli Bittersweet 60% Cocoa Chips (Ghirardelli Chocolate 60% Cacao Bittersweet Baking Chips, 11.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)).  We usually associate cocoa percentages with sweetness (62% cocoa for the Scharffen Berger semisweet), but semisweet chocolate in general is just a bit sweeter than bittersweet.Here's another wonderful use for the Scharffen Berger semisweet:  try heating some of the milk and melting some of the chocolate in it.  Oh, my gosh!  You'll never use hot chocolate powder mix again.

column9: Beats my old favorite for eating out of hand
column10: I jumped at the opportunity to test Scharffen Berger chocolate, as I was interested in comparing it to my go-to chocolates, which are Ghirardelli 60% for eating and Callebaut Dark 60% for baking. My original plan was to try three bars as eating chocolate and three in baking.Ahem. Well, I didn't get around to the baking part. This is a fantastic chocolate for eating out of hand, though! It's very creamy and has a very faint undertone of cherry--not obtrusive, just enough to deepen the chocolate flavor.These bars are only 3 ounces (as compared to the 4-ounce bars that Ghirardelli makes). They are scored in half and then each half is scored diagonally into quarters, sorta like your mom used to cut up the grilled cheese sandwiches when she wanted you to eat slower.I shared quite a bit of this chocolate with other folks, and even the milk chocolate lovers agreed that it's a voluptuous taste treat. Highly recommended!

column4: Jessica R. Westberg "A Catholic with a sense ...
column10: I love dark chocolate...the darker, the better. I didn't think that I would particularly care for this chocolate since it's only 62%, but I thought it was about "goldilocks", just right. As just a stand-alone chocolate bar, it was delicious (in fact, my 2 1/2 year old snuck some behind my back, the little ninja). But, in recipes, it was even more delicious! I made two recipes with it (both from Scharffen Berger's website): regular chocolate chip cookies and oatmeal chocolate chunk bars. With the cookies, the chocolate melted just right; with the bars, the chocolate stood up to the heat and stayed in chunk form. The pack of 6 was plenty to do 2 recipes, eat 1 1/2 just by themselves, and have 1 1/2 left over.Yes, they are a little pricey - but you get what you pay for with the cheaper chocolate, in my opinion. A very good product, worth the price.

column9: A bit sweet for my taste, but nice and smooth
column10: I really like a semisweet chocolate that verges on bittersweet, so this was a bit sweet to me.  On the other hand, the chocolate taste is very prominent and the consistency is wonderful--lovely and silky smooth.  I can easily imagine these broken up into chunks and put into chocolate chunk cookies.

Our family usually has a few pieces of semi-sweet dark chocolate after dinner for our dessert. It's a great way to top off a good meal, leaves a nice sweet taste in our mouth without going crazy with calories like most desserts would.Our typical go-to brand is Trader Joes, with a few international brands thrown in for variety. I'd never heard of Scharffen Berger, so was interested to try it.Fortunately, we had a family get-together the weekend these arrived, so I was able to let 7 people try it. Everyone liked the consistency of the bar - it's got a good "snap" when you break off a chunk. The smell is very chocolately with no floral or weird after tones. Taste to me is a nice blend of chocolate with a rich hint of cream, and not too sweet - I agree with their description of honey rather than sugar. My brother said it was a great accompaniment to the red wine he was drinking. My mother said it was a bit hard for her and kind of difficult to bite (she has partial dentures), but enjoyed the flavor. My sister-in-law doesn't like extremely sweet desserts, and she really loved this chocolate, saying the flavor was near-perfect to her. My husband and nephews thought it wasn't sweet enough and had a bitter aftertaste, but my husband really liked the flavor when I shaved some into his cappuccino the next morning.If you really like the taste of cacao, and are more of a fan of dark than light chocolates, I think you'll enjoy this blend. As a garnish and for baking, this would be great, as it has a straightforward chocolate taste without any added flavorings.

Since there were six bars in this review package I gave half of them to the front office where I work and asked what they thought. A surprising number -- more than half -- said things like "Icky", "Too Bitter for Semi-Sweet", "Weird after taste".  Some thought it was OK, but not great. But the very few who liked it (including me) liked it a lot.  It has a strong chocolate taste, but is far more bitter than most 62% Cacao dark bars.  It has a waxy quality, but seems all natural when you read the ingredient list. It also appears to be lower calorie than other bars of the same Cacao content.  Bottom line is this - you can beat the price and taste at Trader Joes, so for most it's not worth going out of your way for, but the unique blend of flavors will make it something you are unlikely to be ambivilant about. You'll either love it or hate it, so try it and see where you fall. If you do not like true chocolate flavor (in other words, you prefer Cacao butter and cream, milk chocolate, over dark) don't bother with this. If you do, this bar is more bitter than sweet.
I like dark chocolate but I found the aftertaste to be a tad too smoky and bitter. Otherwise, it has smooth texture, is not overly sweet and is good for dipping in peanut butter.

I have used this chocolate to make brownies, chocolate cake and ganache. Discovered it while watching The American Test Kitchen on PBS. Tried it and have not looked back since then.  It is certainly dear in price but worth every cent. I highly recommend this product.As usual when I order through Amazon the product gets to my place within the time limit and even earlier most of the time.I would recommend this chocolate to anyone who wants to try baking with something new but is hesitating.Enjoy!

column9: What can you say about the world's best baking chocolate?
column10: Scharffen Berger Semisweet Chocolate bars are good enough to eat out of the wrapper, but added to baked goods they are superb.My chocolate expertise is strictly self-taught, but it's based on years of careful study.  Scharffen Berger has a deservedly good reputation as one of the world's premier chocolate houses.  This semisweet offering has a hint of citrus and honey that supports but does not overpower the chocolate flavor.Any good cook will tell you that her Coq au Vin is only as good as her red wine, and her chocolate pie only as good as her chocolate.Scharffen Berger chocolate is for cooks who spend time with their cuisine and deserve good ingredients.And it's for cooks like me who nibble.

column9: Delicious, smooth and lives up to the Scharffen Berger name
column10: This chocolate is phenomenal.  I have typically gone even darker with my chocolate (70% Valrhona or even the 85% Green & Black's) and enjoy pretty much anything chocolate from the darkest to a simple Hershey's Kiss.  This Semisweet offering really grabbed my attention with its smooth consistency and great flavor.  I would guess chocolate preference - like coffee, wine or many other things - is subjective, but to my mind there is nothing NOT to like about this bar.  I can't guarantee it will be, as my 10-year old daughter said, "The best chocolate I have ever tasted", but I'm pretty sure you will not be disappointed.

column9: This is Really Chocolate of the Best Type
column10: Disclaimer First:  I am a chocolate hog of the first order and just love the stuff regardless of its brand name.  Scharffen Berger (SB) is without a doubt the best chocolate I have ever eaten at anytime any where.  I especially love the semisweet variety and am eating some right now.  Some brands of semisweet are just bitter and without much chocolate taste but not SB's.  The bitterness did not rear its head on the bars I ate and I would say that the odds of bitterness are diminished significantly with their quality controls.  I opened one bar and peeled small curls onto French Vanilla ice cream and that was one fine sundae.  A baking pan full of SB Brownies were consumed in one half the time of a normal serving.  I guess I'm not the only hog around here.  There may be other brands available that are better but after many years of eating this tasters delight none is better than Scharffen Bergers.  Thanks for the taste!
With my first bite into this candy, I noticed a touch of bitterness.  The bitter flavor diminished after that.  Unfortunately, this chocolate also has a waxy taste to it.  Very unappetizing!

This is a lovely dark chocolate. It's very smooth. Even my 12-year-old daughter likes it and she usually doesn't like dark chocolate. My favorite part is that I can have just a little bit and completely satisfy my chocolate craving. It's that good.

I love dark chocolate and this was a wonderful treat. I think this 62% bar is a perfect balance of a rich chocolaty taste that retains just enough sweetness to be satisfying but not overwhelming. What puts this bar at five stars for me is the creaminess. I know dark chocolate will never have the smooth texture of milk chocolate, I've found many brands can be brittle, which ruins the sensual experience. I really enjoyed having a smooth, creamy dark chocolate. I will keep my eye out for this brand in the future, I think it's my new favorite.As an addition, currently amazon doesn't list ingredients, so I thought I would throw those out there just in case anyone needs that information. The only allergen statement is that this is "a gluten free confection."cacao beans, sugar, cocoa butter, non-GMO soy lecithin, whole vanilla beans

Scharffen Berger's Semi-Sweet 62% Cacao chocolates bars are, simply put, delicious. They are very rich, very flavorful, and are perfectly semi-sweet--not at all bitter, smooth rather than sharp, with a perfect, light amount of sweetness. I used mine for hot chocolate (absolutely incredible, by the way), crumbled over homemade parfaits, melted in rooibos, chai, and mint teas, melted and marbled into yellow cake, broken up in lieu of chocolate chips, and of course, eaten straight as a dessert. I was extremely pleased that it was good on its own, and as an ingredient. I know that they're a little pricier than your average bar, but they're worth it (on top of the quality, the bar is almost double the width of an average Hershey bar.) Whether you're looking for a baking ingredient, a garnish, something to drink, or just something to eat, Scharffen Berger's chocolate fills each purpose.

A nice semisweet bar of chocolate.  Texture is good--both out of the fridge and at room temperature.  I found the citrus/honey overtones a bit much to finish an entire bar by itself, but found this bar (especially when pulled from the fridge) to be the perfect accompaniment to a bowl of ice cream (especially soft chocolate or vanilla).  I suspect it would also do very nicely on top of cheesecake or similar desserts.
This is great chocolate! Very smooth, slightly bitter chocolate melts in your mouth. My wife likes it and it has 62% cacao in these large bars.

column9: AMERICAN MADE CHOCOLATE GOOD FOR EATING AND BAKING
column10: I love chocolate, and  cannot bring myself to eat  low-end chocolate anymore. A  Hershey bar tastes  like plastic and sugar to me, and I'd never  bake with most  bagged  so-called chocolate chips. I will eat a high- end milk chocolate, but usually prefer semi-sweet.Somehow, I had never gotten around to trying Scharffen Berger, and I'm pleased to say I really liked it.I ate the first bar by itself over the course  of a few days. The flavor is a nice balance of bitter and sweet, with a touch of fruity acidity. The texture is firm and crisp,  with a smooth and quick melt in your mouth.Next I tried it in chocolate chip cookies- again, nice flavor and texure when baked.Third test was brownies- this chocolate gave the brownies a nice well-rounded chocolate flavor.As nice as it was in the cookies , at this price I'd probably reserve this for more  fancy chocolate-centric desserts.As a stand alone treat, it's very nice.  In addition to the taste, darker chocolate can be healthy, and this even has a bit of fiber in it.
Yummy chocolate! I am a chocolate lover and it is hard to please me, but this product is just soo to my taste. Not too bitter, not too sweet and just rich enough. Very pleased.

This is wonderful semi-sweet chocolate.I usually favor dark chocolate, and this isn't as dark as I'd usually get, but I find this really a treat.Pros:1. It's not too sugary sweet, like US chocolates tend to be.2. The texture is good. Some chocolates seem a bit waxy to me, and this did, just a bit, on first taste, but that sense immediately went away.Cons:1. Maybe the slight waxiness, but it's so slight that it's not enough to even lower this to four stars.I'm delighted with this chocolate and will get it again.

column9: Seems ordinary to my simple taste
column10: Looks like this is marketed as a high-end chocolate.  For real chocolate fiends with educated palates.  Like expensive wine.  "soft notes of citrus and honey overtones" (from the package)Well, it seems I don't have such a palate as this tastes just like plain old semi-sweet dark chocolate like I might get from Hershey.  There's nothing WRONG with it.  But I wouldn't pay more for this than generic semi-sweet.

column9: Made in America and made to please the Continental palate
column10: Scharffen Berger's Made-In-America lightweight bar - 3 very flat ounces - delivers a highly edible payload with its 62% cacao. The wrapping alone accounts for a fair amount of the total weight. The flavor is as dense as an Arizona dust storm without being as harsh, although my Hershey-bred palate pleads for a smidgen more sugar.  The paraffin-free texture is not exactly creamy; while it does not readily melt on the tongue, neither is it gritty like some other bars.  It grates quite nicely with a microplane grater and also shaves fairly well, but doing so is made awkward by the bar's wispiness.  While I do find this is suitable for eating as is,  I think this bar would perform best as a special embellishment, such as a drizzle over warm banana bread or shaved as a topper for pots de creme.

column9: oh my, oh my, oh my...
column10: Oh bliss, mmm, oh, mmm, oh, excuse me!  Was I talking with my mouth full? I have received a package of Scharffen Berger Semisweet Chocolate in the mail to review, and it is both my favorite type of eating and baking chocolate (of most brands).The Scharffen Berger does not disappoint. It bakes beautifully when chopped into chunks and used in my go-to cookie and scone recipes. The chocolate has lovely gooey melty flops when you bite into the chunks (I'm eating a cookie right now), and the chocolate is a glorious, subtle, hits-you-slowly essence. It's the sophisticated version of Mom's cookies. In scones, the chocolate is perfect with raspberry jam.I'd happily make my Death By Chocolate Cake  - or any other pure chocolate recipe - with these stellar bars. They really have an after dinner quality to them.So why am I eating the other half of a leftover bar in the afternoon? Well, as I said, Semisweet is my favorite kind of chocolate and Scharffen Berger does not disappoint! A perfect treat with a cup of coffee.

column9: Good grief what's not to love about this?
column10: Dark chocolate is my favorite, and these chocolate bars did not disappoint!  I read in the description that I was to expect notes of citrus and honey, but I have to admit that must be beyond my palette.  Regardless, the chocolate was indeed rich and flavorful as promised.  I also found the 62% cacao to be just right - not too dark and bitter.  I'm sure this would be tasty with your favorite wine or maybe a stout beer.

column9: A an excellent gourmet cooking chocolate
column10: This chocolate is an intense semisweet. It is similar to Ghirardelli's but somewhat less sweet, and far superior to the Baker's chocolate you find in supermarkets.  It seems primarily intended for baking, but it comes in thin bars that can also be eaten. The bars weigh 3 ounces each. They are hatched in a design of large, differently sized triangles that's attractive and facilitates breaking off pieces. However, the triangles do not seem to represent any specific weight, therefore are not useful for measurement. That's absolutely the only flaw I can find in this chocolate.

I've never tried this brand of chocolate before. I prefer semi-sweet so this was a real treat to be able to try it out. Everyone's taste is a little different so let me describe the flavor as very close to Nestle's Semi-sweet morsels used in chocolate chip cookies. Scharffen Berger is just a little bit sweeter (not quite the sour bite I'm used to).I did not taste the honey but I did have an aftertaste of citrus. Its hard to describe. Its like if you eat a fresh ripe strawberry, after a few chews you get a little twang after you notice the sweetness.Good chocolate is expensive so I think the price is reasonable at around $3 per 3 ounce bar. Although there is a cross-cut design on the top, it does not help if you want to make specific sized pieces.
I bought 6 packages of Scharffen Berger Chocolate Bar, Semisweet Dark Chocolate (62% Cacao. It's so cheap, and my kids like it very much.

I really enjoyed this chocolate, which has a very strong chocolate flavor without any overbearing aftertaste.  The sugar is just right and the texture is perfect, with no sign of waxy residue.  It would be perfect for cookies, but also ideal for eating on its own.

column9: Try the 62% with chocolate nibs--much better!
column10: I decided to try two different Scharffen Berger chocolate bars for my Vine choices, and am so glad I did.  This one seemed a bit bitter for semi-sweet and I'll save the remaining bars for baking.  The bars are big and well-wrapped, and I think a decent price here at Amazon.  For my money I'll stick with the 62% cacao with chocolate nibs--truly yummy!

column9: A Fine Semisweet Bar, But Not Fair Trade
column10: This a fine premium chocolate. The bars break cleanly along the lines without a lot of slivers or crumbs. The flavor is some of the best I've tasted with no nasty tastes or aftertastes. It has an nice mouth feel. I haven't used it for cooking yet so I can't comment on that.So why not five stars? Unlike many premium chocolate companies like Green & Black and Divine, Scharffen Berger offers no products that are certified Fair Trade or organic. I prefer to support companies dedicated to providing the growers a better price through a certified Fair Trade or similar program, and I am willing to spend more for it. So for my chocolate cravings, I will choose G&B, Divine, or even Newman's Own.
Yummm! Love it! Great taste and consistency as well as ingredients. Will order again and over again! best candy i tried so far!
i think the title says it all i love these and would like to buy more! where can i buy them at? besides christmas and walgreens?

This is soooo delicious!  my husband even asked for this again - that means it made it into like the top 5% of things he likes enough to remember :)  - very good.  they do melt very easily and so often they will be stuck together.  i have bought them at different commissaries and i did have one box that was all melted together.  i don't know how amazon will do.  they need to be kept room temp or less - about 68F.  They are truly soooo good and very, very inexpensive.  I would rate this over godiva or lindt.  especially if you enjoy a soft melt-in-your-mouth texture.  while there is a risk of melting (4 stars), i've given it as gifts more than once - they are good.

Got this at a post-dept-store discount place.  It still tasted quite fresh, though.  The envelopes work well...not to be taken for granted in most teas.  I thought the teabags were defective, but they just have a pull-through thing you do...not bad once you figure it out.  While most black teas are either a toasted/mild, fresh-wood/brisk, or dull/old-leaf this actually has an aromatic, almost floral top-note on a mild woody base.  Very nice as is, without other flavors dumped into it.  The steeping goes well, especially for a bag.  Makes a good light tea, or a flavor to break up your routine.

This tea tastes old and has zero taste. I'm a pretty experienced tea drinker.  Been drinking tea all my life. Did not have any aroma. Very unhappy. Ended up throwing away half of the box. Tried to give it a fair chance.  I tried the pure Ceylon.

Excellent tea with silky smooth taste. Also, very potent. In one minute you get concentration similar to what other teas produce in three. Another thing I like about this teas is that you can clearly see on the box where it came from and who're the producers. This information is often missing from other teas. Teabags are a little unusual, not sure for what purpose. This may be the only slight minus of the product. It may not be the cheapest tea on Amazon, but I would definitely buy it again.

Outstanding Indian Ceylon Tea.  This is as good as the tea I had when I visited Russia. I tried a lot of tea's to find a Black Tea as good as this one.  I like the price and packing from Amazon as well.  Very economical.

My heritage is Hungarian so I had to try this product.  This is the best honey I have ever tasted.  It is delicious and pure.  The honey pump is amazing.  There is no sticky mess and so clean to use.  I highly recommend the seller Curlymom.  I placed my order and received it in three days.  Great service.
This treat combines three of my favorite flavors. It was an Amazon impulse purchase as an "add on" to an existing food order. I thought it was a great surprise and would buy them again!
the service was a good expeience they contacted me to follow up on the order, made good on their products.

column9: Great Product / not thrilled with assortment sent
column10: I love these Flavor & Fiber bars -- they are great to grab for breakfast or a quick bite when you don't have a lot of time. I follow Weight Watchers and these are only 4 points, and they're very tasty and satisfying. I appreciate that they deliver a lot of the dietary fiber I need each day, too. The reason I did not give this purchase 5 stars is that for some reason I was given an uneven assortment of bars that was not packaged in a sealed box. I got MOSTLY the expresso chip, which turns out to be my LEAST favorite flavor in the assortment. There were 2 each of the orange/cranberry, brownie, and cinnamon/raisin, and banana, and I did not get ANY of the Lemon/Ginger. There were 8 expresso chip bars!! NOT what I expected -- I should have gotten a more even assortment.

Haha.  I fell for it as well!  I am a fan of Gnu Bars and wanted to try new flavors.  I received 7 (!) Espresso Chip, 2 chocolate brownie, 2 Peanut Butter, 2 Orange Cranberry,2 Banana, and 1 Cinnamon Raisin.  The Espresso Chip flavor is nasty- might as well just chew the coffee grounds from your morning coffee. This is obviously a way to dump the unpopular flavors.

I expected a few of each of the kinds instead I got2 Orange Cranberry, 4 Peanut Butter, 2 Banana Walnut, 1 Cinnamon Raisin, 1 Chocolate Brownie, 6 Expressio Chip ZERO Lemon Ginger - not impressed - the espresso chip is the worst of all of what I did try and I really wanted to try and Lemon Ginger - aside from that I love a few of the bars...

I am a huge fan of Parmigiano Reggiano after wxpweiwncing this dairy wonder in England in its finest three-year-old state.  I was delighted to find this cheese offered by igourmet and ordered it for a friend for Christnma along with an Argentine "reggiano" and a collection of SPanish cheeses.  The latter are pictured in a black gift pack in their listing, but arrived in a foam cooler.  I had to find a suitable presentation package.  WHile the quality of the Spanush cheeses was excellent, The description of the Argentine product was really lacking.  It in no way resembled Italian PR or grana padano, but rather a nice Gruyere with a nutty and pleasant flavor very suitable for a fondue.  It was not a hard grating cheese as expected, eityher.  As for the much anticipated very old Parmigianno Reggiano, it was poorly cut with a large proportion of rind.  For $25.00 a pound, they could have done a LOT better!  It was otherwise the superb product I had so enjoyed in England.  I would add that theeir aged Gouda bears little resemblance in the photo to what I had in ENgland- that cheese was deep amber, waxy in consistency and very intensely aromatic and fruity/ketotic in flavor.  Overall, I was disappointed with my purchase, rating the experience a very mediocre one.
We drink stouts.  This is a great place for non-grain brewers to start or those who want good beer without spending all day making it.

I'm not vegan or vegetarian, but I don't have an issue eating vegan friendly foods. I picked up the Dr. McDougall's Miso Ramen because it's somewhat low in sodium. I don't know if it's the lack of sodium, or just the product in general, but this really isn't very tasty. Eatable, yes, but I'm not going to order/eat more.

I have been searching for substitutes or at least staples to make what I used to enjoy before I became both gluten and lactose along with multiple food allergies. This duck sauce is the  best and has a great taste too.  It cooks better than the Sun-Bird or the Dynasty brands which contain items I can no longer eat.  Amazon is the least expensive place to purchase this sauce.

Got a case of this for $9 with free shipping!! At the local pet store (petco) its at least $2 per can on sale! I am about to head back to college so stocking up for my pup now with good healthy dog food is GREAT at this price!

column9: Brand-new product gets thumbs up from family!
column10: This is a brand-new pasta variety from Tinkyada, and it's wonderful!  We have pasta, always Tinkyada, at least once a week, so I have the cooking method down, and it's dependably al dente.  This pasta is much whiter in color than their brown-rice pastas, a little too white to look like glutenous pastas (which may be good).  As for the taste and all-important texture...A+!  My hubby was very complimentary and he and the kids ate evey scrap of the spaghetti.  Tinkyada is very good with gluten-free pastas, and this one is their best yet.  One thing I will say is that you REALLY need to rinse this pasta before serving, because it does make the water it's cooked in very gluey and sticky.  I don't usually rinse the other Tinkyada pastas, but I know some people rinse all of them.

I have to say first off that I love Tinkyada products. But I accidentally bought the white rice spaghetti instead of the brown rice spaghetti and I found a product I don't like from Tinkyada. My son (7) and I have Celiac's sprue and so eat gluten free everything. My son isn't usually picky about his gluten free food, but he won't eat the white rice noodles at all. I will eat them, but I definitely prefer the brown rice ones over these.

THIS STUFF ROCKS! Meaning it is wonderful. Cook up just like regular wheat pasta. Its whiter - doesn't have the familiar mild yellow tinge of wheat pasta - but for some reason this is appealing / looks I don't know, "cleaner" somehow. The taste is similar to rice, but not that you'd notice (and that's not bad) it takes on the flavor of whatever you put on it / just like regular pasta. NOT mushy, sticky or goopy - unless you over cook it (just like wheat)...takes about 10-20 minute on a high boil to ready to eat. It is not enriched pasta (FYI) so the nutrition is that of plain white rice (but excellent also in the nothing is added) its all natural, just unenriched plain white rice and water. I've used this actually to make rice pudding and pasta salads. Just cook it up and put it in the food processor with either honey or sugar or on another occaision some tuna and celery - green peas/mayo - and one whirr - Bam you have deli style pasta salad! Use your imagination with this. I know, you're thinking - but 12 of them? Hey, once you start eating this you'll realize it goes fast (for a person who cannot have other grains). I only wish the company would make this white rice pasta in all the other shapes/types that they do in the brown pastas. [...] So please, if you like this kind please contact them as ask as I have for that to happen. They say they follow consumer demand - so lets DEMAND macaroni, linguini and all the rest too!
