The company that makes this is in Toronto, Canada. Im very very pleased with this product and grab a large fistfull of this several times a week - and I enjoy!

This is an excellent product if you have sworn off grains, I follow the Perfect Health Diet and rice is allowed as a starch, but only white rice so his product fits the bill perfectly. A few tips.. use lots of water when cooking double what they say, I use a huge pot and wash in cold water quickly after straining. Put your sauce in a saute pan and heat, add the spaghetti and toss being careful not to over cook. I have found leftovers don't reheat well, so I only cook what I need. It is hard to tell the difference of the finished product from a wheat pasta, you may detect a slight difference in texture.

We did not like these at all.  The water was so thick, and it was too hard to get the noodles to cook properly.  They wanted to stick together.  If you have already purchased these, plan to eat right after cooking and try to use a much larger pot than you would expect. I've used the brown rice pasta before, and would recommend those instead.

My husband and I eat this pasta because we follow (pretty much) the blood type diet which means we need gluten free foods.  This pasta is fabulous and a great deal for the amount you get.  One tip I learned from another review-rinse after cooking to get the gummy film off of the pasta-other than that-enjoy!
This pasta has a nice taste, but is so starchy that it makes a mess when youcook it.  I much prefer the brown rice pasta,  cause it cooks better andretains it's shape much better.

This is the worst gluten-free pasta I've ever cooked.  I have a pot of mushy "spaghetti."  The package actually claims it's "not mushy!"  That's funny...  I've been cooking pasta for 30 years, and this is a terrible product.  Where the glowing comments are coming from, I don't know.  I bought this at the grocery store. I'm going back to my faithful brand now, Jovial.  I can only buy it here on Amazon or sometimes at Whole Foods.http://www.amazon.com/Jovial-Organic-Spaghetti-12-Ounce-Packages/dp/B0049IT94M/ref=sr_1_1?s=grocery&ie=UTF8&qid=1342132011&sr=1-1&keywords=jovial+gluten+free+pasta

column9: For Gluten Free Spaghetti, This is the Best
column10: I have tried a lot of gluten free pastas, and hands down Tinkyada makes the best in my opinion. This spaghetti is made very much the same way as normal pastas, you just need to time the cooking as they say, pull a piece out of the boiling water and give it a quick chomp to see if it under cooked or not and don't just go by the timer. Over cooking any gluten free pasta will result in some pretty gummy eating, so if you have doubts or think it is close to being done, pull it off the burner and rinse it off. If you think it needs to be done a little more you can even pop it into the microwave for a minute to soften it more, but try very hard not to over cook it.  I think the taste is there as well, it has been a long time since I've had regular wheat flour based pasta, but I think this spaghetti tastes every bit as good. I did get a pack of 12 from Amazon and I just kept it down in my pantry until I needed it. Never went stale or anything, was a nice staple to have around. A very good product! The brown rice pasta is quite nice as well.

column9: The Very Best Gluten Free Spaghetti
column10: I love this pasta! I discovered it when I went with friends to a local restaurant (upscale Italian). We were surprised to find a gluten free option, so we ordered a rigatoni dish to see what they found good enough to put on the menu. It was so good we asked the waiter to find out what brand was being used.My sister and niece have celiac disease, and I usually cook separately for them. However at a recent family dinner I decided to serve everyone this pasta under spaghetti sauce, and they all raved. Not a one knew this was anything but regular wheat pasta.I followed the cooking time directions, and the pasta turned out to be close to al dente, so I would suggest that other users of this product do the same. This will avoid the gooey mess that one reviewer noted.

I rarely eat wheat based products and was looking for a rice noodle that would somewhat mimic traditional pasta.  When cooked properly these are very close to wheat based spaghetti noodles in taste and texture.  They are white, so the color is different but the difference disappears with any type of red or cream sauce.  Will definitely be ordering these again.
The white rice pasta is a blessing. My kid is allergic to corn, wheat, soy, milk and eggs. So many things have corn or wheat in them. It is great to have something he can eat.

After being dianosed with Ceiac disease... I thought I would never be able to have good pasta again. This brand did the trick. I wish that they would make more of their pastas with a white rice option instead of only giving us a brown rice choice.

Tinkyada is hands down the best gluten free pasta out there.  We have tried it all ... spaghetti, elbow, spiral, lasagna, shells, etc.  You would not know Tinkyada is gluten free unless you read the label.
This is an excellent alternative to a regular pasta product.  Just wish it came in more shape varieties. Even my non-gluten sensitive friends and family member love it.
My son is allergic to wheat and this makes great pasta dishes for him and the family at a reasonable price. If you have a wheat allergy or gluten intolerance, I would try this. We enjoy it.

This is my favorite brand of pudding, since it has no gelatin like most other brands.  It is very tasty indeed.  Thank you for offering this brand.  I have searched for years in local stores and could never find it until I saw Oetker on Amazon.  Awesome service, fats delivery!!!  Thank you!!!

These certainly aren't for everyone. They're pretty sweet and have almost no nutritional value. The little packages are really cute though, and to me they taste amazing. They were a pretty good deal for the price I paid and I can't really find them anywhere nearby.

Enjoyed the packaging as well as the product. Cookies taste similar to fortune cookies, with a nice strawberry flavored creme filling. I enjoyed eating one bite sized piece at a time - coaxing the strawberry creme out of its hiding place, which made it seem like there was more to the box then there really was. Makes a great midday snack. They are a bit pricey, but these are a product of Japan so I expected to pay a little more.

For the amount you get, this price is great. However, these aren't cookies, make sure you digest that. These are a little more bitter. They're more like crackers. The packaging is unique and cute, the product presents itself really well, I'm just not a huge fan of the taste.

column9: Authentic absinthe and the first available in the States
column10: Lucid was the first brand available in the US since the 1900.  French in origin and true to vintage recipes.This is a verte absinthe, which means that when you pour it on a glass, you will see it has a nice soft yellow-green color.  The louche (the result of adding water to it) is mostly white, with some green hints.  The main aroma is anise, but the taste is anise with a quite bitter after taste.  I drank it mixing it 1-5 with ice water and one sugar cube.  The sugar did not modify the bitterness, and the taste remained in my mouth for quite some time.I had read many good reviews on the Lucid.  Most people would agree that it was a good starter absinthe, and not too overwhelming for beginners, but I could not get past the bitterness.  Maybe it was just my batch and I had bad luck with it, but I can not say I enjoyed it very much.However, I would rated it 3 and a half stars.  Specially because after trying other brands this is still not one of my favorites.P.S. I refuse to discuss thujone content and other non-sense and myths in my reviews.  If you are interested in thujone, go eat sage and forget absinthe altogether.

First tried this tea from a specialty store in Buffalo, NY where it sold for close to $60/lb.  Love it, even though it was only 2 oz.  Search the net for this tea and found it Amazon.It's a light delicate flavorful tea that can be brewed 2 to 3 times by refreshing it with more hot water.  It is non-acidic like some other teas.  It need no addition of cream or sweetner.  I'm currently drinking 5 to 6 cups per day as it is so delicious and light.  It's not exactly a green tea when brewed but a light amber color, with the hint of a flora or fruity taste. The added plus at Amazon is the price and very quick shipping.I would strongly recommend getting this tea for any tea lover and I'm sure they would be pleased if they enjoy a good quality chinese tea.
very good tea. weak but nice aroma. mild good flavor. excellect for the price.

I got into various oolong teas from a great New York importer. They really know their teas!But this year, the Numi Ti Kuan Yin is available at quality and price that bests the experienced importer. I dunno, maybe they got lucky at an auction or somthing. But we've been enjoying this tea!You can spend 3 times as much and get better tea. But then it's too expensive to drink every day. Buy this!

column9: Sorry to Buck the Trend... But I Didn't Like This Tea
column10: I've drunk a lot of tea in my time - every day for years and years - so I guess that qualifies me as something of a lay expert, loosely defined :o) I was excited about this tea because it's organic and offered at a decent price (because good tea can be pricey indeed). Well... the first cup brews up kinda foul and with lots of tannin, really bitter (and not the good kind of bitter either). Thus it's an absolute necessity for me to do a first steeping, strain it out and steep again to get a passably drinkable cup. This is not uncommon for some teas, but the cup you get is still pretty foul, truth be told: still real tannic and just not a happy quaff. The leaves are relatively crude and large. This is not one of those tippy-leaved harvests where they grab just the tiny bud; this tea was picked for volume production. For an Oolong it seems to have been barely fermented. I find it just a crude tea. Crude and rude. Figured for the price it'd be a good everyday drinking teas and didn't expect a religious experience in every cup or anything, but it just doesn't even rise to that basic standard. I would have given it only 2 stars, but for the price and the fact that it's organically grown. Your mileage may vary I guess, but that's this tea-head's humble opinion for what it's worth.

I have been drinking Iron Goddess of Mercy for years. Perhaps I can't get over how cool a name this tea has :)! However, I only would try Rishi brand and in a bind, I ended up buying Numi, and I love it. There is a slight difference in aroma and after taste between the 2 brands, and while I really still love Rishi, I love this one almost just as much and with some raw honey, it is a delicious drink to keep you going all day !!!

I tried this after getting hooked on oolong from Teavana but not wanting to pay 5$ an ounce.  It was a lovely, mellow oolong, not very floral but good flavor. A cross between dragonwell and gunpowder but with a distinct oolong aroma and taste. I would get it again.

One tablespoon makes a total of 30 ounces of tea (three ten-ounce servings).  Directions are printed on the package.The tea itself is clean and fresh with nice leaves.  It's a mild tea with the true oolong light aroma, color, and mild taste.imo, a good buy.

Tieguanyin Tea translated into English as "Iron Goddess Tea" is one of the most famous types of Chinese Tea. It has many different translations and is often called Tieguanyin, Ti Kuan Yin, Tikuanyin, Iron Buddha, Iron Goddess Tea, and Iron Goddess of Mercy Tea. No matter what name you use, it is a wonderful tea. Originating in Anxi County in Fujian Province, some of the best Tieguanyin Tea is also now produced in Nantou, in Taiwan. This tea is a variety of Oolong (or Wulong) Tea and has been very popular for centuries. The tea's leaves are dark green and rolled into tight balls. The "Tie" in Tieguanyin is translated into English as "Iron" This is supposedly because as you drop the leaves into your teapot, they ring like iron when hitting the bottom. The tea has the aroma of orchids with no hint of grassiness and its flavor is long lasting. It is a wonderful tea and a great tea to begin with.A variety of this tea comes from Wuyi Mountain in Fujian Province. It is called "Monkey Picked Tieguanyin". According to legend, the tea leaves were very difficult to harvest because they grew on the cliff faces on Wuyi Mountain. Local Buddhist Monks trained monkeys to pick the leaves from the inaccessible tea trees. Today, Monkey Picked Tea denotes a high quality Tieguanyin, although it is no longer picked by monkeys (if it ever was). When buying tea make sure you buy it from a reputable dealer to ensure you are getting authentic tea.Numi's Iron Goddess of Mercy (TGY) tightly rolled leaves DO give a solid plink when you drop them into your pot. Use about a tablespoon full for every cup. The bright, dark green leaves unfurl to about 7x their size after several infusions. Put sure to do a short rinse and 1 minute rest to clean off and "wake up" the leaves. This batch of tea from this specific vendor brewed up a lovely pale yellow broth with a light floral aroma on only slightly vegetal flavor with wonderful mouth-feel. It remained very sweet through several infusions with no apparent bitterness. I started the brews at around 3 minutes and gradually lengthened my infusions. It is only moderately oxidized and not roasted, making a very pleasant and drinkable tea cup after cup.There are better teas if you are willing to pay for them, but at this price, Numi's TGY is an excellent daily drinker. 16 oz. is a lot of tea to drink before it begins to lose flavor, so start brewing as soon as you get the package. Enjoy!

column9: A great tea that lasts a long time
column10: This Ti Kwuan Yin by Numi is a great oolong. It is quite powerful and little bit goes a long way, but what makes this tea unique is that you don't have to stop brewing the tea. Just leave the leafs in the pot and it will reach its full flavor and stay there by itself. Ti Kwaun Yin is unique in that aspect and is popular in China because of it.  Another plus, and yet another reason for its popularity, is the fact that you can get multiple brewings off a small amount of the tea.  I personally find that seven pots is the norm (sometimes more, sometimes less) before the flavor is gone from the tea leaves.Multiple brewings, a little going a long way, a great price, and very tasty tea add up to one heck of a package. If you are sensitive to caffeine, be aware that oolong is right in between green and black teas in caffeine content and the first pot is usually very strong on flavor. It is so strong that some people even lighty coat the leaves in hot water until they expand and then pour off the water and add more to get rid of the powerful taste.  In doing this, they also remove much of the caffeine, so that might be a handy trick for those wanting to cut down on their caffeine intake.Highly reccomend this product. It will last you a very long time and prove to be your staple for tea.

I've had this variety of tea from other sources, so I have an idea what it should taste like.  When I opened the bag, my nose was assaulted by a strong smell of turpentine - I thought it was the packaging, so I moved it into a plastic storage tub.  The brewed tea tasted equally of turpentine.  I did find that if you leave the tea out in the air, the taste and smell dissipates, but keeping it for any length of time in a closed container causes the turpentine taste/smell to return.  Even aerated, the tea has a very grassy taste to it.Maybe I got a bad batch, but I will not buy a Numi tea again after this bad experience.

I was looking into starting drinking loose tea and decided to go with Numi Tea Iron Goddess of Mercy.For the first few times I made tea - I enjoyed it - good taste, no bitterness and big whole leafs.The problem is that every few spoons I found a hair attached to one of the leafs. First I thought it might be mine, even though it didn't look like it. The second time I was puzzled. After the 3rd time - I poured a lot of it out on a plate and found LOTS of hairs! They are simply attached to the dried leaves.I am a clean freak and keep all food in clean cabinets. Tea package was sealed all the time with a clip. This hair made it all the way from the factory - where it somehow got to it during the drying process - where the leaves shrink to little balls.This tea ended up in the garbage and I'm back to tea bags.

column9: Tastes good but WAY too much caffeine for me
column10: I've heard about how good Oolong tea is for you and I heard this was a good brand so I tried it.  It tastes fine -- not grassy like green tea and not bitter like some black teas -- but I was WAY to sensitive to the amount of caffeine in it.  It kept me awake and buzzing for hours.  If you are used to caffeine, it probably won't affect you too much, but if you're like me, you should get something decaffeinated.

I love the taste of a good Oolong tea and I began to search for an alternate supply since our local grocery store stopped carrying loose Ti Kuan Yin Oolong tea.  I decided to try this and it tasted nothing like the stuff that I was buying at Wegmans.  This looks, smells, and tastes like green tea.  The leaves used for making this tea are huge.  When steeping them you'll be suprised to see the size.  If I wanted a cheep green tea, I would have been happy with this.  Needless to say I was not.

I had high expectations upon purchasing this tea. I am sorely disappointed. The tea is practically raw green and not semi-fermented as oolong should be, tastes like grass (minus the gr), bitter, weak, pale yellow at best and not the promised copper color when prepared as per directions (or even stronger).Simply awful compared to other fine teas I have tried. Even Red Rose Decaf teabags taste spectacular compared to this stuff which tastes like straw at best.Total waste of money.

Packaging suggests 1T for 10oz tea, which is high compared to most loose leaf teas, but the tea is still pretty weak at that concentration.  It definitely doesn't have enough flavor for iced tea, which is my preference.  Otherwise, packaging is nice, very little fines in the tea, and good price.  Unfortunately not my cup of tea, so I will not buy it again.

This is a solid and delicious TQY. Hold flavor up to 3 steeps, a 4th weak steep is possible.The package I received was labeled as organic, although that is not reflected in the item details.The price is excellent, you can easily pay up to $60/lb for comparable quality TQY, especially if purchased in smaller quantity packages. It's not top of the line luxury oolong, but it is much better then many TQY offered at the same price range.

It is not the best tea I have ever tried before. However, this tea is smooth, with nice tea fragrance, no grassy taste, and an excellent deal for less than $40 a pound. Highly recommended for everyday enjoyment. Thanks to Amazon for offering this good product.
this is a mildly flavored ti kuan yin and makes a good evening cup of tea.

I was pleasantly surprised by both the quality and flavor of this tea.  At a very modest $31.15 for a pound I wasn't expecting much, but this tea just might become my favorite.  It has large leaves with almost no dust or stems.  It's flavor is delightful - not robust, but not weak either, and none of the bitterness often found in cheap teas.

.I love my coffee, and after an online friend shared with me his knowledge gained from his time in a coffee plant, I have been trying different coffees. My goal is to find really great coffee that is not super expensive. This if the fifth coffee I have selected.I selected Boyers French Roast because it advertised as a dark roast with great flavor. I enjoyed this coffee from the first cup. It is indeed rich, smooth and flavorful. It is strong but not bitter, rich but not overwhelming.After brewing several pots, I tried varying the amount I used. Boyers recommends one tablespoon per cup. When I tried one rounded teaspoon per cup with an extra teaspoon "for the pot" as my father taught me, the flavor seemed as rich and tasteful as before.  I settled for one tablespoon per cup.  Sometimes I just want to breathe this brew. This is quality coffee.I may try some other coffees, but I know I will come back to Boyers French Roast. This French roast is the best of the coffees I have tried. Boyers French Roast is superior coffee and I highly recommend it.

column9: Love Achiote and this is a convenient form
column10: Funny enough, I used this for dinner last night!  We love the Anchiote and coriander flavors.  I added some cumin along with two packets of Sazon to thawing chicken breasts.  The anchiote turns the chicken a lovely reddish orange color.  I dipped the breasts in flour and pan fried them in a dash of oil with green peppers and onions.  Hmmmm- good.  It reminded us of our favorite cuban/latin restaurant.  The packets are easy to use.  Just sprinkle it any where which is easier than the "chunks" of anchiote.  Thanks, Knorr.

My 10 month old is milk protein intolerant and I have Celiacs, so her pediatrician is having me hold off on introducing wheat.  I am SO happy to finally find a wheat-free, dairy-free, baby-friendly finger food!  My kiddo loves eating them, too!

column9: Nutritional value is "meh," but my kid loves these things
column10: Like the title of my review says, these little puffs aren't much different from run-of-the-mill Cheerios in terms of their healthiness--though they are somewhat better--but our little man (15 months old as of this date) absolutely loves them.  They are pretty unsubstantial, so he can snack away on them without fear of ruining his dinner appetite.  Other things that I like:  1) They're organic.  I don't know how many pesticide molecules are finding their way into a box of Cheerios, but my guess is not many!  Still, I like that these are organic.  Every little bit helps, right?  2) They dissolve very quickly so there's never any fear of choking no matter how many he stuffs in at once.  3) The container is more convenient that a box of cereal.  4) Like I said before, my son really enjoys these.In terms of health value, I find them to be similar to Cheerios.  If you adjust for the weight or volume differences, comparing the nutritional information shows that the Cheerios have more vitamins and fiber, but also more sugar and sodium.  Though none of these amounts are really significant concerns to me. For example, a half cup of Cheerios has .7g of Sugar while the HB Puffs have 0.Now for the one negative--the real kicker--and the reason why I am giving this very good product just 4 stars.  Purchasing these from Amazon (6-pack, as of July 20, 2011) will cost you about $1.47/ounce.  Purchasing a 14oz box of Cheerios from Amazon on the other hand is just 21 cents/oz.  The HB Organic puffs are 7X more expensive! (And of course, getting a 19lb box at Costco changes the equation further). But unless you're giving your kid a ton of these, or you're feeding multiple kids, the price difference probably isn't a deal breaker.In conclusion, I'd try them both and see which your little sprout goes for.  Can't really go wrong in either case.
My son is 15months and this is still one of his favorite gluten free snacks. I just wish they would make all their puffs gluten free. He dosen't seem to mind though.

Pretty sure these are the only puffs that happy baby makes that are gluten free. For a baby with an allergy, these have been perfect. My one year old still eats them because she has no teeth.They do go stale in the container if your baby doesn't finished them in a few days.

I want to say THANK YOU to happybaby for making the organic sweet potato puffs that are gluten free.  My son has severe milk, egg, and oat food allergies.  The irony is that these are labeled as a "gluten free" food, but it is also free of the other allergens. It is very hard to find a product that satisfies his allergy needs.  Everything is either milk free and has oats/wheat... or gluten free and has milk protein.We buy this product in bulk from Amazon and will continue to do so as long as they continue to be milk, egg, gluten, and oat free!I'd give this product ten stars if I could.THANKS again to happybaby and thanks to Amazon for making them available in bulk at an affordable price!!!(PS. If your child has food allergies, please read the label and don't take my word on it!  They could always change the ingredients.)

Happy Puffs are the prefect preschool snack. I brought them today to my son's school and the kids were begging for more! I also like the the sweet potato is gluten free. They are easy for the 1 year old that I tend to pick-up and eat as well. Definitely my go to snack for the kiddos.
We take these on trips as snacks for my grand daughter - they are easy to store - easy to dissolve - just happy I could find something she likes on a trip.
My daughter gobbles these puffs up like they're manna from heaven... "Puff" is one of the first words she attempted to say... She walks around with a canister of puffs like she owns the place...
These puffs are great. My little man loves them and they are gluten free which is the best part.plus they tastes really good.

My wife and I really wanted to get our baby some hard food for her to work on dexterity without introducing any gut irritants like gluten to her. Kids don't need the cereals, they add no needed nutrients they can't get from veggies/fruits and meat, but it is a good tool for teaching them coordination, plus it's fun. My little girl absolutely loves these. When she sees the bottle, or just hears us shake it, she smiles from ear to ear and starts kicking her little feet with delight. They dissolve quickly and taste just fine. She has never choked on them, so that's a big plus. They are a bit more than your standard puffs, but the low sugar, and no gluten is well worth the price. Buy these puffs!

My 11-mo old daughter has been munching on these puffs since she started solids. She still continues to love this type of puff an flavor--she is always will to eat these. She's tried this flavor and the green spinach one and likes them both a lot.

We didn't want to use GMO, sugary cheerios for our baby. So we tried these. He loves them. Just the right size and shape to pinch them and learn to feed. Maybe a little more expensive than cheerios but they are far superior ingredients, and they are not going to break the bank. Very pleased.

My daughter loved these. I committed to not giving her wheat in the first year, that was hard to do! At the time I was buying these there were no wheat products in the ingredients. (be aware that companies change their recipes all the time. If no wheat is your goal too be sure to double check the ingredients before purchase) These little puffs are great melt in baby mouth travel food. And the dog liked them, so I rarely ever found them on the floor. :D
My 7 month old baby has loved these and the sweet potato ones for about a month.  It took him about a week to learn not to gag but he's now a pro.  He loves to hear "do you want some puffs?".

My 13 Month old goes nuts for these! He started eating the regular ones at 6 months and loves them. He is egg and peanut allergic so I loved that they are allergy free. He has recently been diagnosed as gluten intolerant and I was disappointed he would have to give up puffs, since he loves them and they are so convienient. I came on amazon to cancel my subscribe and save and discovered not only one but two gluten free flavors! Ordered both immediately and went to the grocery store and bought a canister of sweet potato to hold us until our order comes in. My son loves them just as much as the others. It is so hard to find convienient gluten free snacks for fiddlers,  thanks HappyBaby!

Kids don't need the cereals, they add no needed nutrients they can't get from veggies/fruits and meat, but it is a good tool for teaching them coordination, plus it's fun.  My little girl absolutely loves these.  When she sees the bottle, or just hears us shake it, she smiles from ear to ear.  They dissolve quickly and taste just fine.  She has never choked on them, so that's a big plus.  They are a bit more than your standard puffs, but the low sugar, and no gluten is well worth the price.  Buy these puffs!

I went to a Gluten free expo with my 1 and 2 year old and they loved these! IMPORTANT NOTE: Happy baby only makes sweet potato and strawberry gluten free.  I do want others to know that if you have a buybuybaby, target or babies r us close by, they sell them for 3.19 each.  I stock up every time I see them (specially the strawberry one... it is harder to find).I read other reviews complaining about the taste.... and yes they are rather plain but if my kids love them ... they are good enough for me!

My son loves these puffs, and I love that they don't have sugar (I was surprised how many "organic" puff products had organic sugar cane listed as a primary ingredient). It is sweetened with organic apple juice (third ingredient listed). They were by far the healthiest puff-type product I could find.

Though my daughter can chew on solid food (for the most)she loves the way these puffs dissolve in her mouth. She gets so excited when she sees me take the canister out of the cabinet. My husband and I have tried them ourselves, along with our 3 year old son, and we even found them tasty. The best part is that they're organic with no added sugar or high fructose corn syrup, so I feel comfortable having her snack on them.

My little boy is 10month, and I got this puff for him, he likes it very much, I let him get it from the bottle himself as a finger movement trainning which is great for him. and the taste is not that strong just a slight strawberrish, and not very  sweet which is good for baby.

We love the HappyBaby line of puffs. My daughter loves the taste (very mild--other puffs were very strongly flavored), and I love that they're organic with less sugar. Last thing I need is a 7 month old on a sugar rush, so these puffs are perfect! Her favorite flavor is the Greens, but Strawberry is a close second.

column9: Little one always asking for more
column10: My little girl loves these. It's the first thing she signed "more" for. We bought the sweet potato ones because this was the only thing available at our grocery store, but have since tried the others and this is the one she prefers. I do wish the bottle would travel better though. Learned this the hard way, to pack in our carry on on the plan and not the checked bag. We checked it on our last flight and they were all over our suit case upon arrival. So I love that this is the snack my little one loves but I wish the lid would snap or close more tightly.
These sweet potato puffs are wonderful, my son loves them!! It's so great to be able to  be able to give my son a healthy snack, without Gluten, Milk, or Sugar!!

Ordered these for our 14 mth-old twin daughters. They eat a vege gluten-free diet, due to family food allergy history. We are expats living in Riyadh, it seems there are no gluten-free baby products available here. Puffs were well received and because they are small, they require good hand-eye coordination in order to pick up and eat. Which means Mummy and Daddy get time to plate/heat (and sometimes eat our own) food. Other reviewers stated the container was easy to open and consequently led to spillages etc. We haven't found this to be the case, containers pop shut easily and stay shut until we open. Babies go through one container of puffs a week roughly, and no problems with softness or spoilage of product. Will definitely be buying again.

I really love these puffs.. most importantly - i have picky eater and she loves them.  For my older five year old, I actually made my own trail mix. I added raisins and pretzels for a healthy snack!  I checked on the back and these are the only puffs that are low in sugar so that makes me feel better and they don't even notice!
these puffs are the only ones that i was able to find that are soy and dairy free. (my daughter has allergies). i even searches the health food stores!!!

column9: The Cheerios replacement for gluten-free babies & toddlers
column10: Just what the title says - for all you parents of gluten-free babies who see people feeding their kids Cheerios everywhere and anywhere, these puffs can be that "anytime, anywhere" snack that keeps your baby happy. The container is already a good size for carrying in a purse or diaper bag, so you don't even have to empty them into a baggie to bring with you.They dissolve fairly easily and our daughter has been eating them as finger food since she was about 8 months old. She loves them and so does our five year-old.One thing to watch out for if you are gluten-free: not all varieties of these puffs are gluten-free, though they are all clearly labeled if they do contain gluten, so it's not hard to identify which ones.

I got these puffs and they are wonderful!  My kids don't even want to eat the other brands of puffs anymore!  My kids love the Sweet Potato Puffs because they are crunchy, sweet and always taste fresh!  I love that you get more puffs in this container than any other brand.  I really love the HappyBaby products and think that they are the best!  Even my four and two year old sons love their products!

My daughter loves Puffs and when I read the review about the strawberries not being organic, I was conserned but then I looked on the back and sure enough, ORGANIC STRAWBERRIES IS LISTED! I am not sure what the other reviewer was looking at! My daughter gobbles these up as well as the other flavors. We can eat gluten but it is nice to know that there are yummy choices for those who cannot!
My granddaughter loves these sweet potato puffs - I hope to buy more of these organic puffs in the future.  I would buy again from this seller.
SO happy there are gluten free puffs out there, I thought my kiddo would miss out on finger food all together will all his allergies, he loves these.

I'm celiac, so we've kept our daughter gluten free for the 1st year.  The strawberry and sweet potato puffs are gluten free!If you need/want a gluten free snack, these are perfect.  We put them into the tiny ziplocs and pack them on the diaper bag-they are perfect on the go, and don't make her hands all sticky when you're out and about
My daughter gobbles these puffs up like they're manna from heaven... "Puff" is one of the first words she attempted to say... She walks around with a canister of puffs like she owns the place...

column9: Perfect for babies who want to be social!
column10: I started giving these to my 7 month old daughter because every time her 2 1/2 year old brother had something to eat she looked at his food longingly. She loves them and blazes through them pretty fast. She's been able to work on her dexterity while trying to pick them up and she chews them (she has 8 teeth already) though they dissolve well too. I picked this product since the ingredients are right in line with the foods I've been introducting to her. Wish there were other flavors that were gluten free, but we'll be there soon enough (and other brands don't seem to have a gluten free option). They are rather boring tasting to the rest of us, but for a new solid food eater, they allow them to eat socially with the rest of us.

My 13-month old twins love this! I started giving them this snack when they were 9 months even when they only have few teeth since it easily melts and I never had to worry about choking at all. I subscribed and have this delivered every 2 months.

My daughter loves these and will clap and giggle when I take them out.When  my older daughter was at the age of eating puffs, it didn't occur to me that there was sugar in baby food.  Sounds dumb, but it really hadn't occurred to me.  I am a big fan of Gerber formula but these puffs win over Gerber without a doubt.  With Subscribe and Save these are a fantastic value.  They are organic and don;t have the sugar like the other brand.  We have also tried the banana and she loved those just as much.

column9: The best of the HAPPYBABY puff flavors!
column10: This is my son's favorite puff flavor and they always arrive well packed and sealed.  They are more expensive than the regular puffs but the texture is actually a bit crispier.  Give them a try.

My daughter really loves puffs! The strawberry ones have more flavor than the sweet potato ones, but she likes both. We haven't yet tried other flavors. One thing, it says it has less sugar than other puffs, but the nutrition facts seem to have the same amount (1 gram per 1/2 cup serving). A must for when we're out & about and she needs a quick, non-messy snack.

I am so so so so happy this product exists.  My 12-month-old was recently diagnosed with celiac's disease (cannot eat gluten).  Finding baby friendly snacks has been a challenge, but she adores these Happy Baby Puffs.

My 15 month old loves these and so do I!  She has problems eating wheat, so this is a good alternatives snack for her!  We have been buying these for awhile, but it seems our local grocery store is always out of the gluten free puffs.  So now I just order them from Amazon!  A little more expensive, but always available.  We also get the Sweet Potato flavor as well!

I just want to say "Thank you HappyBaby!".  Hallelujah!  As a mom who has a gluten free baby who also only eats organic, I was delighted to find this product and what's more important?  My son really likes it!  The cereal melts in baby's mouth, so not much of a choking hazard and it is just crunchy enough that it's nice on those sore, teething gums.  There is only one store within a 30 mile radius that carries this flavor and no stores have the only other gluten free flavor, which is strawberry.  I was happy to find that Amazon carries both flavors and sells them for a wee bit less than the market I found it at.  Woo doggy.
My son loves these, they are not filling but great to entertain him while we're preparing his actual meal.  Highly recommend!

My 11 month old has been eating these since she was around 7 months.  She showed some sensitivity to all grains except for rice so we looked around for something for her to have as a snack - this product fit the bill.  She likes the puffs fine in this flavor - now that she has been able to tolerate other grains I have tried her on other flavors thinking she must be bored of the same flavor all the time - but so far she only likes this flavor.

column9: A puff my son can eat
column10: I have been trying not to give my son foods that are common allergens before the age of one. So in my search for a snack that did not have dairy or wheat or soy, I found these. These puffs contain rice, sweet potato and apple juice - all things that my 8-month old son has tried and is not allergic to. He loves these puffs! I love that they are made from organic ingredients. I highly recommend these.

My baby loves these and they help her practice her pincer grasp.  Diced fruits & veggies are a little too slippery right now, so this is perfect for her.  I also like that the Sweet Potato puffs don't contain wheat, which she will not have until she is older.

column9: lots of sugar and a bit too expensive.
column10: My daughter likes these puffs but cheerios are a much better option because they don't have as much sugar  and are much more affordable, these are terribly overpriced.

I love the fact that the puffs are organic but they have no taste whatsoever.I can't tell apart sweet potato from any other flavors available by happybaby (we have tried banana and green apple). My daughter never ate them, and now I tried giving them to her little brother and he just spits them out.I'd say that if your baby would not eat bland foods (like baby cereal without any fruit/veggie), then skip these and try other brands. Gerber puffs have a lot of flavor and my kids love them.

column9: Does not seem to have any flavor
column10: I had bought this for my 12 month old  as he loved eating plum organics puffs. Just wanted to try out this brand on my friends recommendation. My son absolutely refused to eat any of the flavours so I tasted them to reallise that they were so bland compared to plum. Will not buy again.

column9: love this brand of puffs, but strawberries aren't organic
column10: I first tried the green Happy Baby puffs, which my son loves. I bought the strawberry ones once, and while he liked the taste, the strawberry powder in it is not organic. (It's not even listed in the ingredients above...not sure why not??).  Since strawberries are one thing I prefer to buy organic only, this was a deal-breaker for us.

column9: So much better than Cheerios- the Best Puffs!
column10: First, I love that there is finally a gluten free version of Puffs for my kids.  When kids finally discover the fact they can feed themselves, they can get over excited and stuff 800 Cheerios in their mouth!  At least with Puffs, they dissolve better than Cheerios.  Plus they are cheaper ounce for ounce than the Plum kind and Gerber.  This is a great healthy, snack for little ones.

It's nice to have a healthier option for "on the go" snacks for my 15 month old.  Snacks are generally fresh fruits or vegetables but they are too messy for the car so these are a good alternative.  She LOVES sweet potatoes so I thought she'd really love these but they don't have much flavor (yes I tried one).  They are good size for her little fingers and easy to handle.

I ordered 1 dozen of these and was disappointed to find that one of the bottles was only 1/3 filled!!! it might be a random mistake on the packaging part but more stringent checks need to be done to ensure quality of products
My son is currently on a gluten free diet, so I was happy to find these puffs he can eat. He loves these.

column9: Weetabix is widely available in USA
column10: If you live near Trader Joes in the USA you can buy a box of Weetabix for $2.39! Other super markets sell them for as much as $3.99/$4.99. I'm from the UK and never have a problem finding this childhood favourite cereal.: )

column9: Famous British Cereal, Introduced in 1932, Tastes Great
column10: When I saw Weetabix in my local grocery a few months ago, I just had to try it!  How many breakfast foods do you know of, that get mentioned frequently in British novels and on BBC television programs?Not surprisingly, the whole grain "biscuits" are delicious.  They're nutritious, too:  two biscuits with skim milk (no sugar required) provide 170 calories (10 from fat), 130mg sodium, 150mg potassium, 0.5g fat, 29g carbohydrates (including 4g dietary fiber and 2g sugar), 4g protein, no cholesterol, and a few vitamins and minerals.  The biscuits themselves (24 to a package, or 12 servings) are light, crisp, and flaky.According to the package, "Weetabix is great on its own or with milk".  However the biscuits are very dry, so I can't imagine eating them plain.  When you add low-fat milk (1% or 2%), the biscuits soak the milk up very quickly.  If you don't eat your Weetabix right away, the biscuits will break apart and your morning cereal will be a little soggy.But I like Weetabix, even when it's soggy, because of the delicate flavor and pleasant texture.  Weetabix has now replaced my previous favorite adult fiber cereal, Post Shredded Wheat Original Cereal, Spoon Size, and has become an almost daily habit.  In fact, I like Weetabix so well, I ordered a 2-1/2 month supply (also 72 servings, but packaged in smaller, single-insert boxes, making it more expensive per ounce; see Barbara's Bakery Weetabix, 7-Ounce  Boxes (Pack of 12) from Amazon!
not only is it naturally healthy it does great in meatballs and meatloaf and crumbles really quickly making them so much healthier

column9: Strange flavor --- I didn't like it
column10: I normally import my Weetabix all the way from England (being from England myself, Weetabix was always a firm favorite of mine for breakfast), so was delighted when I saw Amazon were selling it at a much better price.I had hoped that Weetabix is Weetabix, and taste wouldn't differ too much even if the product was made by a different company.  This product is made by some company in America, and it did taste different to the brand I typically buy from England.Unfortunately, I didn't like it.  It had a strange flavor that just didn't appeal to me.  I'm sure it's a preference thing though, and there will be plenty of people who like this just as much (or maybe even better than) the British alternative.  I, however, will be going back to importing my Weetabix from England.

This is the only breakfast cereal I can get all three kids to eat.  In fact when it comes in I have to put their names on the boxes so the oldest does not plough through her two (allocated) boxes within four days.  The kids eat this for desert too.

You can't beat Weetabix for breakfast. I grew up eating Weetbix back home in New Zealand and struggled to find a cereal that I liked until I found Weetabix. These are basically the same thing I had back home and I love them. My preference is to crumble them up and mix either some fresh or tinned fruit in with and munch down. Weetabix are a great way to start the day.

One of the best, if not the best and most versatile breakfast cereal available anywhere in the world. The reason for its popularity worldwide, is the number of British ex-patriots, who have settled in many different countries and sought out from their local grocery store available supplies of this, the tastiest and most nutritious of all cereals in my estimation. Way to go Weetabix. John Williams
I personally love this cereal and i know it maybe too plain for some but you have the option of being creative with this.helps me keep calories in check.

Trying to save money on an otherwise premium cereal, they ruined the product.As was pointed out above, it's no longer organic. That's not my real concern though. The quality of wheat has clearly decreased. The cereal is somehow more bland, less sweet.It's a real shame. They took something that was loved by many and had hugely popular reviews and decided to skimp on quality, thinking no one would notice.Such a shame.

This product changed recently from Organic to NON-Organic. There are other changes in composition and nutritional value. The Organic Weetabix was nutritionally superior to most other cereals. That's no longer the case. Now it's simply a good cereal.

column9: Try it with butter and cheese!
column10: (This is Paul's wife).  I grew up in England eating Weetabix spread with butter.  When an aunt came to visit and gave some to her children in a bowl and started pouring milk over it my mother was horrified (and so were we kids!).  We had no idea people ate it that way.  I dont remember the design of the box and whether it was displayed that way, but the logo hasn't changed.  I had some this morning for breakfast, spread thickly with Land o' Lakes butter spread and accompanied by a slice of cheese.  My favorite breakfast (or should I say "favourite"?  Must have been here too long!)  Paul eats it with milk and sugar but I like my Weetabix crunchy, not soggy!

I fell in love with Weetabix on a recent vacation to Ireland. This North American version tastes and looks the same as what I was eating over there. My favorite aspect of Weetabix is that the cereal box is completely full of food, you are not buying a box half full of air. This is more earth friendly than most cereals. Also the large biscuits make portion control easy. I eat three every morning, usually with sliced up banana. You have to keep the milk carton close by to keep everything moist as you eat your breakfast. Weetabix... it's good stuff. Now I just need to find a place to buy one of those cool tins like they had in my bed and breakfast over in Ireland.
On time, but flexible options, have not had any issues with the Cereal, like biscuits being smashed. Good price over the supermarket costs.

There is only one store that carries Weetabix in my area and they charge $5/box so Amazon is the best source for me - search for the free shipping choice. I first tried it in South Africa and was so happy to see I can get in in the states. Simple, wholesome ingredients with great taste and a wonderful crisp texture. Wish I could replicate it at home, but haven't figured out the recipe yet.
I had them when i was young and now i am older and i still eat them.What more can i say

column9: What can I say- it's Weetabix!
column10: Happy to find Weetabix on Amazon for a good price (less than my local supermarket options).  Weetabix is such a tasty, and healthy, way to start the day- having grown up in England I'd be lost without it.

we love weetabix, and can't buy it where we live.  Everything about the purchasing experience went well.  When the box arrived it was in good condition, the product was fresh.  I can't think about any way to improve it - just keep selling it.
This is an excellent and versatile cereal. Low sugar, low sodium, and high fiber - what more can one ask for!  Not available in most supermarkets, so I buy it from Amazon in a six-pack at a time.
I thought this was a great buy. In my local store, Weetabix costs approximately $5 a box and I have to drive to the store to get it.
This is a healthy breakfast.  It hasn't changed in the over forty years I have been using it.  The taste is great and you can use them as crackers if you want.

Love Weetabix! It's simple but highly nutritious biscuit cereal that is also practical. You take 2 biscuits out of the bag, maybe mix with some dried fruits (I use dried cranberry), pour the milk of your choice, and there you have a perfect breakfast that gives you enough energy to make the morning. The sweetness is perfect to not interfere with anything that you add. In Winter, you can just warm it up for 1 minute in microwave, and you have a nice bowl of porridge. Only wish is that they start to use organic wheat instead...

I can't say the flavor is bad because it isn't. It isn't bad for just a little bit of flavor. What I can say is this:I thought the packaging of the product was sketchy. Mine came with a seal but it was not one that actually sealed the product.I don't think it tastes like cotton candy at all. I mean, not even a tiny bit.It took me three times the amount in my GO TO frosting recipe to get much of a flavor at all.The smell of the extract itself isn't really a pleasant smell. It smells like chemicals.I guess what I am saying is I'm not impressed and I wouldn't buy again.

I am very pleased with the cotton candy extract I purchased.  It is good quality and has a nice flavor, not too strong and not too weak.  I have used it to make cookies and cupcakes and have received many compliments!

OK, I admit, I buy these seeds for the squirrels in my back yard. It keeps them off my bird feeder and provides hours of entertainment for what I call "Cat TV." They don't stain my deck like the roasted seeds do. They come in a nice big plastic bag, which I store in a popcorn tin. The squirrels love them and will fight each other if there are not enough piles to go 'round.

column9: Distinct spicy  flavor -- ease of use
column10: Wasn't quite sure what to expect, but this is tasty. Has a decent chipotle spicy flavor for a boullion cube. I've been adding it mainly to rice dishes. I often use part of a cube as they easily crumble and can add extra flavor just for me. My husband doesn't like overly intense flavors, so I can make a skillet of food and add chipotle only to my plate OR make mine a stronger chipotle than his. Reminds me of the flavor coating on a good chipotle or mesquite potato chip!

The taste is pretty good, although ingredients listed are not exactly healthy: Salt, MSG, Sugar, Hydrogenated Palm Oil, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Silicon Dioxide, Hydrolyzed Corn Protein, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Caramel Color, Citric Acid, Disodium Inosinate, Spice, Yellow 6 Lake, Disodium Guanylate, Sulfur Dioxide.The lable states "Best if used by 10.25.08".
Let me say it again, WOW! These little cubes go a long way and the flavor is excellent. Use them to spice up any dish. These are a must for any cupboard.

HAVE PURCHASED THREE SO FAR. UNWRAPPED EACH CUBE PLACED ABOUT 15-20 IN FOOD PROCESSOR, GRANULATED ENTIRE CASE, YIELDED ALMOST 60oz, PROBABLY MORE THAN THAT AS SEASONING IS HEAVIER GRANULATED THAN MOST, GREAT VALUE IF YOU DON'T MIND A LITTLE TIME CONSUMING WORK AND HAVE THE EMPTY CONTAINERS. OUTSTANDING FLAVOR AND SPICINESS, HAVE ONLY USED IT SO FAR IN BAKING CHICKEN, CAN'T WAIT TO USE IT IN FRYING CHICKEN WINGS. WILL SET UP RECURRING ORDER AND DELIVERY SOON. OTHER REVIEWERS HAVE USED INDIVIDUAL CUBES FOR SAUSES,SALADS,MEAT ETC. EITHER WAY, YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED.

This is a very good spice. I found it at our local grocery store and liked it right away. My husband likes it VERY much. He tries it on everything. We use it for fajitas, fried potatos, hot sauce, spicy fried chicken, Fried mushrooms, shrimp, taco meat, beans, potato cheese soup.... We have tried it on alot of things. My favorite is on chicken though, If you put it on chicken and then grill it It is awsome. Great for chicken fajitas or just with rice. I was really glad to find it here on amazon they quit carrying it at our grocery store. They flavor is spicy with a hint of sweetness. If you use too much it can be very hot. Great for adding a spicy taste to almost anything.

This is a great product for cooking with, it adds something good to graveys and stews. i bought it in my local supermarket and i was blown away how good it was but after that no one had it and i mean no one i looked and looked finially i found it here on the net it is a good kick to what you may be cooking

Useful if you crumble this up and put it on any type of meat even seafood. I also sprinkle it on baked potatoes, chili, etc. It's spicy without ruining the flavors, does add a slight smokey flavor - tastes really good on all meats in my experience. A lot easier than dealing with whole chipotle pepper since it's easier to gauge how hot you're making it.

column9: Yuck!  Full of salt and MSG, very little chipotle flavor
column10: I like Knorr products and have used them for many years. I just wish they would reformulate them to cut out the MSG and reduce the salt. These little cubes, which are a great idea, have 800 mg of salt in each one. That's basically the entire cube! They don't even have a good chipotle flavor - I thought they had a fake smoke flavor.Instead of these little cubes, I suggest McCormick's range of MSG and salt free seasonings (found here on Amazon, some with free super-saver shipping). They come in large containers at a great price, and are a better choice for healthy cooking.

column9: More a recipe than a review
column10: These are great.I crush two of them in enough olive oil to coat pasta and then fry two or three eggs in the oil.Pour everything over the pasta, mix well and serve.Fast and delicious.

We had game birds for Thanksgiving. I had some Knorr chipotle cubes (samples from a Southwest Food Show) so tried 2 cubes when cooking mixed white and wild rice.  Knorr Mini Cubes, Chipotle, 20-Count Box  Nice spicy chipotle flavor. Glad to have a supplier online for friends and myself.

These cubes are absolutely delicious with any dish.  I have used them as a soup base, on fish, crumbled them in breadings, ribs and even roasts.  I have even used them in plain rice.  Depending on the level of spice, one to two cubes... it is a must try!  Add a little zip to your food.

column9: Lotta taste in a little cube
column10: I use these cubes in soups and a rice dish i make, and they were hard to find. Thnx. Amazon for carrying them, I won't run out anytime soon.
I use this as a dry rub on meats and toss a couple of cubes in soup. Good on fish, chicken, pork, beef, eggs, stews, any savory dish,
Knorr Mini Cubes, Chipotle, 20-Count Box (Pack of 24)Adds that something that is missing to soups,stew, marinde and almost anything :)No where as salty like other chipotle seasonings

I was very disappointed when this product arrived because the expiration date is in 5 months. I would not have purshased this product had I known. I must have helped them get rid of an old product that was not selling. I would have returned it but they do not accept returns on food products. Buyer Beware!

Thanks for the timely delivery! It is exactly what I ordered and I can't wait to start grillin.......mmmmmm good! Open pit is the bar-b-que sauce that I grew up with and I couldn't find it anywhere in the Dallas area.

Well people these are a real welcome treat and taste very good indeed. The tuufiddy ml glass bottle was a bit bigger than i thought :-) (16,5 cm tall) None of my four time glass bottle`s had that cool paper card on the neck of the bottle, just the gold foil. There is a soft seal & cap on the inside of every white plastic cap wich may be used to keep it well, sealed! This white "short skirt" plastic cap looks good on the bottle once the gold foil is removed. Most have a golden sticker on the top of the cap with the grade type. Mine came packed with a good amount of big bubble wrap around them. As you may have noticed all these style bottle`s hold the medium amber type (second out of of the 4 grades/blends) The taste is vey rich and sugary with a very nice presence of aroma from what i would suspect is the maple tree! Also, you may want to get a 36 oz. "refill" tin of your own choice. At room temperature this stuff has about the same viscosity as fish oil, maybe a tad thicker..and it can even be freezed without it becoming "solid" just thick. Shelf life is very good. Uses: to be taken  internally ;-) at presence i just drink the stuff as i have yet to incorporate it into my waffles/pancakes and what have you...Recommended!

column9: Best Tasting and No Partially Hydrogenated Oils
column10: The most delicious ice cream cones I've ever had (besides freshly made waffle cones). They actually have a real flavor to them which is opposed to most ice cream cup cones. I prefer ice cream cup style cones to sugar cones and these are my favorite. They also are the only brand I've seen that do not have any partially hydrogenated oils in the ingredients. Unfortunately, Amazon won't ship these to Alaska and they stopped selling these in the stores up here so I am thinking about buying a waffle cone maker.

column9: Ice cream has a great partner!
column10: This is a smoking deal for price compared to my local markets.  You must be sure you can eat them all though.  We had a few boxes go stale before we cold eat them.  These are safe for people with peanut allergies.  Most other cones are not.  Most all Let's Do Organic products are safe.  They ahve an amazing website that lists all allergens for all their products.  I am very impressed with the texture and flavor of these cones.  Just like the ones we grew up on that were not so healthy for us.  I may not buy them again just because we tossed a few boxes and that does away with the savings.  But great product!
I have had these before but found the best price on Amazon. I would have given 5 stars except for the fact that some cones are broken but most times I usually can use these anyway.

column9: My kids and family Loved it!!!
column10: It's organic, it's vegan, it's kosher, NO HFCS and they're super tasty. This are the only ice cream cones that my super picky eater son will eat. There were like 6 or 7 broken out of the whole case, but come'on they're after all cones, they're fragile. Super fast shipping.
Used these cones for a back to school ice cream social. Everyone thought they were great. I would buy them again.

I have bought this brand several times and it's one of the worst cones I have tasted. It's tasteless and always broken. I normally eat everything organic but on this occasion I have to say there are some natural verities that have no hydrogenated oils that I rather buy.

a. These cones are consistently broken upon purchase, regardless of whether it is online or in a B&M storeb. They are not tasty and stale quickly compared to other brandsc. You can use any force while putting ice cream into these cones.  They will break under the pressure.

I have been buying Let's Do Organic cones for a couple of years. I used to be able to get them at my local grocery store, but when they quit carrying them I went online to purchase them.  I love the cones, the taste and the fact that there is no partially hydrogenated oils, however...this last case I ordered was very disappointing!  The cones crack and basically just fall apart when you try to put even the softest ice cream in them.  I have already "wasted" probably two entire boxes out of the six I have opened. They don't hold up to any pressure. There were some cones already broken in the wrapper. I don't know if I just got a bad batch or where the problem originates, but these are a little expensive to not be completely happy with them. I really don't like throwing 2 to 3 cones away for every one that I able to delicately fill with ice cream. I guess I will have to look for another brand...I love ice cream cones too much to give up! I probably should have returned the remainder of my case, then maybe Let's Do Organics might have gotten wind of this issue so as to address my concern.  I rated it very low based on this last case I received and the amount of waste

I ordered these cones because my wife and I are tired of eating cones with hydrogenated oil which has been found (at last)to cause serious health problems.  We do not know why the FDA refuses to ban it altogether, but we have our suspicions.  When I ordered these cones , I wondered if they would taste good, for I knew my wife probably would let them sit if they did not. She is the one who pronounced them delicious, and I agree. We are really happy to have another food that won't result in ill health from eating it. We got them for $27.60 for 144.Let's Do Organic Ice Cream Cones, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)

This item was listed in the gleuten free section but it is not. I did get a complete refund from Amazon, but was disappointed that I could not eat them. I guess this is what happens when you try to do things in a hurry and don't read every single word about a product, and rely on the search to bring up accurate data.

column9: not as tasty as Joy brand and black stuff growing on them
column10: I have no idea what was growing on them but it was black.

when it comes to salsas, I'll try anything once. I've probably tried hundreds of different brands, but Ass Kickin' Original Salsa is without a doubt the best.  pleasantly hot, but not so hot that you can't taste it...  and this stuff tastes great.  makes me hungry just thinking about it.

I bought this strawberry extract hoping to spruce up a strawberry wine that ended up with less flavor than I'd original expected. (A common problem in some fruit wines.)This is, indeed, good strawberry flavor!  Just add to your sugary concoction (be it a baking good, a dessert or a drink) to either give strawberry flavor (or add to existing flavor), and presto, just about everyone will be licking their lips (and maybe fingers).For those interested, I found the right addition to a liquid volume to be 4 oz of extract per 1 gallon of liquid.

I wanted to disagree with another reviewer that claimed this hot chocolate is weak. It is not. As long as you make the default size (about 7 oz.) it is great. I used to make my hot chocolate using nothing but milk and Ghiradelli Double Chocolate Cocoa Mix. This is also a great product, but no where near as convenient as Tassimo/Suchard hot chocolate. The Ghiradelli hot chocolate does taste better, but Suchard is of high enough quality that I now choose it for the convenience. The chocolate "milk" that is frothed up with hot water from the Tassimo does a decent job.Note #1: If you press the button that makes a larger cup it does so by adding more hot water. This will dilute the chocolate "milk" and produce a weaker beverage. (I know, this should be obvious.) Maybe this is what the previous reviewer was doing?Note #2: Check the pricing for a 2 pack versus the 5 pack. The 2 pack is often significantly cheaper.
We tried both of the available hot chocolate t-discs and this one is the best.  We also often use a disc with coffee to make a mocha.

The Tassimo T-Disk hot chocolate is the best! We've tried instant, we've tried our daughters K-Kup makers hot chocolate, and it's weak with very little flavor. We are so glad we have a Tassimo so that we can enjoy the Suchard Hot Chocolate. It has a deep chocolate taste. Not the watered down variety so many of the other brand brewers have to offer.

Suchard Hot Chocolate, T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers, 8-Count Packages (Pack of 5)  I purchase these for my husband.  He enjoys one every morning while reading the newspaper.  We have been buying them ever since we got our Tassimo Coffeemaker.  As long as he enjoys them, I will keep getting them for him.
Backordered item. Arrived just as advertised (6-7 weeks). If you like the product enough (and we do) then you'll pay whatever they ask (and we do).
these discs are perfect for our two kids and their friends.It makes a perfect cup of hot chocolate and tastes great with a great price.

kids and I found it to be a stronger and better chocolate than the milka one. prob because no milk.they love to get to make their own choc. on the tassimo. prices are great on amazon with the subscribe and save.
Just received my Suchard Hot Chocolate from Amazon. What a bargain! And Amazon made it so easy to make this purchase. Thank you again!
We have found the Kcups to be watered down while Tossimo gets it just right. not just their hot chocolate but all their products. The chocolate is SO rich. love it

column9: This Hot Chocolate is a treat at any time of the day, Yumm!
column10: This Suchard Hot chocolate is the perfect treat at any time of day! Finally a Treat that I can have with our Tassimo machine! don't drink coffee but when I discovered this and tried it, Yumm it satisfies me and leaves me relaxed!  (don't forget to order the  Foaming Milk creamer to go with it!)

I love this hot chocolate. It has a great taste - something you would expect from a coffee shop. It's not the best cup I've ever had, but it's pretty good. For the reviewers that are saying it's too chocolatey, I agree... sort of. My guess is that the Suchard makes it this way so the customer can add as much extra water as they want. And this is the key, you have to add more water to get a great taste. No, you shouldn't have to do this, but it's still worth it for me. I've tried the milka brand and you have to do the same thing, and I don't think that tastes good at all. I will continue to order this hot chocolate. With "subscribe and save", it's also a little cheaper too.

I wouldn't say this is the best hot chocolate ever, it's not the cheapest either. But, for anyone purchasing a Tassimo you are probably going for the ability to make a variety of drinks easily and this hot chocolate works in that regard.It is good hot chocolate, but it makes an even better mocha. If you take a Suchard disc and an Espresso disc, it makes a pretty strong mocha like drink. If you take a Suchard disc, a milk disc and 2 espresso discs it makes a pretty credible mocha drink as well.

I love chocolate - all chocolate.  These discs make a small amount of quite weak chocolate; the chocolate itself is very good, and you just know if it were stronger it'd be a go-to everyday... but it's just too weak.  If you do decide to try it, shake the livin' heck outa the disc for a while before you put it in the machine, it does make it a little stronger that way.  I'm waiting for a stronger version that makes more.
This is a fine Irish Breakfast tea, especially for the price. (It helps if you like Irish Breakfast tea).

but I've never found an Irish Breakfast tea that I like. This one, like the others I've tried, tastes like boiled sticks and dirt to me. I drink it only when I'm too tired to appreciate a more flavorful cup. But perhaps if you're a fan of the style, you'll find it exquisite...
Costumer service is great. I had a little problem but it got fixed. I recommended them. Don't wait. buy it.
They were just the correct thing to thank a mother for all she had done for her daughter who is now living 1000's of miles away.A special treat.

This cereal is not only delicious, but it creates the most amazing gas! I walk around for hours literally farting with every step I take! At work, my chair really takes a pounding and the warm odor of high-fiber farts lingers most of the morning, making my irksome coworkers more reluctant to bother me.The only down side is that unless you let it soak a long time, it's like trying to eat a bowl of rocks. Warming it in the microwave improves the soaking time and is great for the cold winter months!

O.K., my husband and I bought a big box of this cereal and agreed in the morning that it really tasted great.  Our lunchtime call was a little bit different !  I work in a crowded office and was completely consumed with constant gas !  Big gas !  My husband was experiencing the same thing on the other side of town.  His Yoga class was excruciating !  I had to write a note to my boss apologizing for my frequent trips to the restroom !  We are just really happy to be home where we can fart away in the comfort of our home.  Don't know how the little dogs who sleep under the covers with us will fare tonight.  Be warned !!!

column9: Gas for some, not for others
column10: First off, I get lots of fiber in my diet through fresh fruits and vegetables as well as flax seed. But this cereal gives me the worst gas I've ever experienced in my life. Foulest-smelling ever and it lasts from morning till night! I thought the gas was because of all the fruits and veggies I was eating, but as soon as I eliminated the cereal from my diet, voila! Gas be GONE!However, it doesn't affect my husband. He absolutely loves it with chopped banana. So really, it depends on the person. I think I do have a sensitive stomach, so maybe that's why it only affected me.As for taste, it's pretty good. Kind of chewy, but like I said, really good with chopped banana.

column9: Healthy cereal but causes bad gas!
column10: The "Crunch!" with exclamation point is no exaggeration. This cereal is very crunchy, almost to the point of being too hard. Some people may describe it as eating rocks or cardboard, but I still have all of my teeth and don't mind the texture too much. This cereal will indeed give your jaws a good workout. For those who find it too hard, you can let it soak for a few minutes in milk to soften slightly.I was pleasantly surprised by the texture and size of the clusters. This is the one instance I can remember where the actual product looks better than the box art, which is usually enhanced to show texture. There are no blueberries in here, in case you are wondering. It's just an example serving suggestion.The taste is sweet, but not overly so. The taste of puffed rice is most dominant. But this cereal's biggest selling point is how healthy it is. Kashi espouses a philosophy and lifestyle of healthy eating, exercise, and relaxation (explained on the back of the box). It's low in sodium, all natural, and low in fat. Just 1 serving gives you 32% of your daily fiber (8g) and 14% of your protein (9g) with only 3g of fat (25 calories). The downside of all this, though, is that this cereal can give you a bad case of gas if you eat too much.As for the price, there's no point to buying this cereal from the current seller when you can just as easily run down to your local supermarket or drugstore and pick up a box for much less, unless you like wasting money. When it is on sale, I can get a 15 oz box from Rite-Aid for under $3. For those who want a healthy cereal alternative that isn't as hard, you can try Nature's Path Organic cereal.

Apparently this deal for people who are really bad at math.A regular box of Kashi GoLean Crunch is 15 ounces and costs about $3.50 (maybe up to $5 if you buy it at Walgreens or something).  This is about 25-30 cents per ounce.  With this item, you'll be paying an astronomical $0.45/oz.What a ripoff.

Thank you CIRCUIT TWEAKER! I really needed a laugh and your review brought me out of a funk. I found this item (43 oz NOT the 51 oz as stated in Product Features) for $6.00!!!! at a local Grocery Outlet store.

column9: Delicious and super crunchy, but really too sweet
column10: I find the crunch and texture of this is very satisfying when you want to get your teeth into a granola-like cereal. The flavor is a melange of grains and of sweetness. It's reminiscent of sugar smacks--but richer and more healthful. :)I do wish they'd dial down the sweetness. Kashi has some very nice granola medleys and cereal products, but on some cereals--like this one and the Cocoa Beach granola--its sooooooooooooooooo sweet. Too sweet. I'm assuming most of the consumers of Kashi cereals are grown-ups, not kids. Well, grown-ups just don't need cereal to have this much SUGAR...er...let's call it "evaporated cane juice". (same diff, really)I'll give it five stars the day they ease up on the sweet stuff.But I'll still buy it. I just dilute with a bit of unsweetened wheat puffs or more milk or Almond Breeze.How appropriate that it's being sold by a store with CANDY in its name. (The shipping cost looks insane though;what up with that?)Mir
^I am happy that I can order this item when I need it, without the hassle of going to the store

column9: GoLean? It should be renamed to GoFart!
column10: Nothing on Earth creates so much flatulence as GoFart.... Taste great... then after about 2 hours, be prepared for LARGE farts every 2 minutes for several hours!
The item was received very quickly and the service was excellent. I recommend this company without hesitation, and also this product.
This cereal is great for getting you day off to a good start. The complex carbs provide energy for whatever you day holds in store.

I have eaten this for years both for breakfast as well as for a snack. This is not super sugary like the junk cereals aimed at children, and for me the sweetness is just right. Contrary to other reviews, this is not like eating rocks; the clusters of cereal are no harder than say almonds, and if you let them soak a minute or two in milk they become very soft. The taste is absolutely delicious.I have read reviews complaining about gas. If your diet is lacking in fiber and you eat any high fiber product, you are likely to have gas. However if like me you already have lots of fiber in your diet from fruit and vegetables, then eating this cereal will not give you gas.I usually have this cereal with some fresh fruit, and unlike low fiber cereals it is very filling.Bottom line: This is a great way to start the day with breakfast, or just to have a healthy snack in between meals. It is also a good way to introduce fiber into your diet.Shop for price. I currently buy a 43 ounce size for about nine dollars at my local Costco.

You will not fart with every step you take if you eat this cereal. Circuit tweaker just needs some Activia. This cereal is amazing. It has a high amount of protein and keeps me full all day. I'll admit that it is pretty hard to chew sometimes, but delicious. I also wish they would cut back on the sugar. It can be too sweet for some.

What else is there to say other than this Knorr gravy mix is just like homemade.  We've always usesd McCormick because that's what we find in our local groceries, and it is good too.  But, the Knorr is better, and buying it in bulk like this makes it cost less than half of grocery store prices.Great item, highly recommended

I agree with the other review.  This is absolutely wonderful gravy and is very easy to prepare.  This renders a lot of gravy-which we love.  I froze some after preparation and found it was as good after a few weeks frozen and when first prepared.  This was a great find.  Will buy again.

column9: The main ingredient  for a perfect meal
column10: Ronzoni's Enriched Ziti Rigati pasta makes for an easy dish to cook when you want a hot meal without a lot of fuss. It can also be the main ingredient for a meal that has pasta with sauce as part of a main course dish. The pasta remains quite fresh until any expiration date that is printed on the box; and each box contains enough ziti rigati for eight servings.The pasta is so easy to cook: just boil a pot of water; pour in the amount of the ziti rigati that you need; and stir for about 10 minutes. If you like your pasta a bit firm then cook it for about 8 minutes--watch it and take a taste test of just one piece of pasta if you have any doubts. Some people add a little salt while the pasta cooks; I personally don't add salt. I never noticed any difference between salted and unsalted because the small amount of salt that you're supposed to add makes no big difference.The pasta is very low in fat; and it contains no trans-fats--thank goodness! This pasta contains no cholesterol and no sodium, either. That's very good health news. It does contain carbohydrates as you may have suspected; but a single serving still keeps those carbs low at only 14% of the daily allowance of carbs. Great!Ronzoni states on the front of the box that this macaroni pasta is enriched; I assume they are referring to the Iron, Niacin and Riboflavin in the pasta. The pasta has 7 grams of protein per serving as well. In addition, this product is kosher if that matters to you.There are some caveats, however: this product contains wheat and it is made in a facility that uses eggs. If this is a concern for you please consult your doctor or nutritional expert.Have further questions? No problem. Just call Ronzoni using their toll free number or visit their website. They also provide you with a street address in case you wish to write to them.Overall, this ziti rigati by Ronzoni is the best out there! It's affordable; easy to cook and serve; and it doesn't pose any major health risks to the vast majority of people. I highly recommend this fine pasta.
My order arrived quickly in great shape. Product was as advertised. I recommend this company.Jean Hickman

If it wasn't labels dog food I would have believed it to be a tasty human stew. It has the right consistency and is not watery unlike some other stewed dog foods. My two dogs a very discriminating great pyrenees mix and a lab mix devoured this food which I mixed with the organix Ultramix in record time.
