I have had these many times. I used to eat these grits with my maternal grandparents as a young man(okay, probably a teen). I thought they were great and so simple to fix. Now they bring back happy memories(especially since I'm a grandpa now). Beside, they're Quaker, what more could you want?Quaker Instant Grits Real Butter, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Quaker Instant Grits Country Bacon, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Quaker Instant Grits Real Cheddar Cheese, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Quaker Instant Grits Red Eye Gravy and Country Ham, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)

Good Product, good price, just be prepared to eat a lot of grits, lol.  I kind of got tired of grits and donated 6 boxes to a food pantry, however, it had nothing to do with the quality of the product.12 boxes is a lot of grits to eat.  Next time I think I will spring for the variety pack with the cheese flavors in them.

I remember getting hooked on grits many, many years ago when they had to be cooked from scratch.  A person would add a small amount of grits to quite a bit of water with lots of stirring to keep them from getting lumpy and voila almost a taste of heaven.  I am sure that variety is still available but nowadays with everyone in a big hurry to get nowhere, we do not take time to really enjoy cooking.  Everything has to be fast, fast, fast so we now have instant grits right along side of many other quick to prepare foods.  I hate to say it but instant grits taste just as good or better than the grits that seemed to be hours in making (at least in my memory).  I have purchased one case of 12 count boxes of grits and now am almost out.  Time to start thinking about replenishing my on hand stock.  To me the butter flavored is the best.
It is a good mold, but smaller than we expected, that is, not a large press. So, we will use it as a model for making a larger one.

This is the best Earl Grey tea in the world to me! And trust me, I have tried many different types but nothing beats Pickwick. Too bad it's extremely expensive to order for a Dutch person who lives in the USA but happy I can atleast :)

column9: My kids can't stop eating these!!!
column10: My kids LOVE these!!!!  If I let them, they would eat 5 a day.  We have ordered these from Amazon probably over 20 times and have never had a bad batch.

While more expensive than most fruit snacks, these are great because there is no sugar added and my kids really like them. I have been buying the Stretch Island brand for several years now, and the price I paid through amazon was decent.

column9: I thought that I would eat them, but I found another purpose for them!
column10: I was looking for tootsie pops to replenish my supply. I am diabetic so when I found these miniature pops, I thought it would be a good thing. I mean, there were 200 of them! Turned out that my friend wanted some to, so I ordered a bag for him. He wants to stop smoking and that it would be a good idea to have something to put in his mouth. After a few pops, I realized that I would never get through all of them. What would I do? Around holiday time, I came up with an idea what to do with then. I decided to make holiday bouquets with them. I bunched up 4 lollipops (different flavors) and taped them together and tied a ribbon around them and curled the ends. It looked like a bouquet of flowers except with lollipops! I made 52 of them and gave them as gifts to the nursing home staff where I am living. Everyone was so touched by the unique gifts? They were easy to make and so affordable! It all worked out in the end!
Much more fun than the large size- easy to throw a few in my handbag to carry with at all times!Good size to give the kids to snack on,Everyone loves a tootsie pop!

I work in an after-school program that involves young children. These children are always looking for a treat when they visit our office. The miniature tootsie pops are great because with 200 in a bag, they go a long way. After looking at several sites, I found them to be the best price as well. I even find myself enjoying one from time to time!
I like the size of the mini tootsie rolls. you don't feel guilty because it is only 10 cals each. i love the orange flavor the most.

column9: Tiny Tootsie Pops...One or two biter
column10: These are very tiny tootsie pops. I purchased them for those moments when I have a sweet tooth. They are 50 calories per pop. It is very hard to just suck on it without biting into it, just like a regular tootsie pop, so I personally end up biting it and then it's gone in one or two bites because it is so small.  Still, I keep them in my desk drawer but seeing as though there are 200 I am probably going to give some to my nephew and nieces or they will last forever!! All in all, it's a good way to satisfy a sweet tooth without consuming a lot of calories and it's nice to go old school every once in a while and grab a tootsie pop! How many licks does it take to get to the tootsie roll center of a MINI tootsie pop?...(CRUNCH!!)...The world may never know.

These are great for the office candy dish!  I've noticed that occasionally I'll want a tootsie pop but don't want to take the time necessary to eat it.  These little ones are the perfect solution.  You get what you want but can eat it (without biting it before you want to) in the time of an average break.

this cheese, made primarily from sunflower seeds and macadamia nuts, is absolutely delish! sprinkle it on your salad with a little lemon juice and a drizzle of your favorite oil and you're all set! you can also eat it straight out of the bag like I did when I first tasted it. when you do, forget about the calories! my only complaint again is the price--everything raw (and generally organic) is sooooooooooo expensive. anyway, if you're looking for a splurge, you won't be disappointed with this one. Bon apetit!

column9: Tastes just great.  Addicting! And good for you.
column10: I love cheese but it usually doesn't like me.  Gas.  I tasted this product first (spilled some on a plaste and ate it with a spoon.)  Love it!  Then I looked at the ingredients.  Bingo!  Just what I've looking for, a substitute for what I'd been eating that didn't agree with me that is truly healthful.  More and more manufacturers seem to be getting the word that folks are getting of tired of crap that is addictive but makes them sick.  That includes products for pets!

column9: No real (vegan) cheese, just a little tiny, very little tiny seasoning sprinkle
column10: With all due respect, friends, this product seemed to me greatly misleading.  This is no real (vegan) cheese for one to prepare a sandwich or a vegan pizza.  It is just a little--very tiny little--sprinkle that resembles "cheese".  The photograph is quite misleading.  It suggests that we are purchasing something like a cheese pack.  This is not the case.  We are talking about a very, very, tiny bottle (similar to a medication bottle) with not even a handful of "cheese" sprinkle.  It is strictly speaking just a seasoning, not actual, melting, substantial vegan cheese.  Since they sell this cheese-seasoning for over 24 dollars (with shipping) for 4 tiny little bottles, one actually pays 6 dollars a piece...!  How's that!?  I tried to give it a final chance and poured an entire of one of those little bottles over a bread slice in the toaster, just to see what would happen with a little heat.  The thing turned into black ashes.  Six dollars directly into the trash container!  I felt deceived, to say the least.  So, if you are looking for actual, substantial, eatable, melting vegan cheese, try elsewhere (for example, in the US, Daya vegan cheese is my first choice--but there are a few other options and more are being launched in the market).  Peace!  Go vegan!  One day, as we hope, there will be no such a thing as vegan cheese any longer, as all cheese will be vegan, and children will not even know, by then, that there was a time in human journey in which we had to struggle to leave our fellow animals in quiet and peace!  Best regards to all from Brazil!  Claudio

I discovered this product while living in the Philippines with my wife. I was so glad to be able to find it back home in the United States in local Asian grocery stores (first in California, then on the East Coast and online).I love the TASTY HEAT that this product puts into my curry dishes. It is versatile, as I have used it to make beef, chicken, and pork curry (haven't tried to make seafood yet, but soon). This is so much cheaper (per ounce) and tastier than the impotent crap that they put in small fancy glass jars that they overprice and try to pass off as a great product. These companies (can you say Thai Kitchen) that manufacture those imitations probably survive here because most people don't know that they can buy MAE PLOY which is 100 times better. Not only is Mae Ploy tastier, it is also so much cheaper to make sauce with. All you have to do is add coconut milk (less than $1 for 14 a oz can) and/or a little fish sauce(not for me) to match (actually overmatch) the mix that the imitators sell. I also love the fact that I can vary the potency of my sauce because it is not pre-mixed with coconut milk. I once purchased a unauthentic crappy product out of desperation when I first returned to the U.S. in 2007. I used the whole jar (11 1/2 oz) and payed about $5. It was so weak and flavorless. That will never happen again as I keep it well stocked. One jar of this lasts me about 4-5 large curry meals (I always make enough for leftovers as I use two or three cans of coconut cream). So if you make a smaller amount it could last you 8-10 meals. They even make a 35 oz size of Mae Ploy that you can find (google it). Just make sure that you seal up the plastic well before using again (I also refrigerate it after opening).Bottom line though is that this is the BEST and the ONE and ONLY Curry Paste that I will ever use. I never order curry when I eat out because I know it will not be as good as the one that I make at home. Thanks to MAE PLOY RED !! Thanks for reading. Read up on this product and then try it out, you won't be dissapointed.

column9: Best brand for Thai red curry
column10: This is my favorite brand of Thai red curry paste.  We use it to make thai curry at home, because it's soooo simple to make.  Chop 1 onion into chunks, heat up 2 tbsp. of canola oil in a wok or dutch oven, toss in the onions and stir for a minute or so until translucent.  Take 1 tbsp of Mae Ploy red curry paste for a mild curry (use 3 tbsp. if you enjoy spicy foods like jalapenos) and stir into the onions, stir and heat for a minute, then pour in half a can of coconut milk, stir again, and turn heat to medium, toss in 1 lb. of cubed meat (beef or chicken or pork or duck), 2 lime leaves, a few dashes of fish sauce, stir to mix well. Turn heat down to simmer for 15 minutes, add chopped bell pepper strips, bamboo shoots and 2 handfuls of fresh basil, simmer for another 10 minutes. Pour in the remaining half of coconut milk, stir to mix well, then turn off heat immediately. Remove the lime leaves. Serve with steamed rice.The other reason we love Mae Ploy brand so much is because it's the only brand available here locally that has NO MSG, NO PRESERVATIVES. Thank GOD for Mae Ploy !!!

column9: Thai Girl Gives it Thumbs Up
column10: I am Thai, and my family has been using this since they lived in Bangkok.This is authentic as it gets, as this is a pure product of Thailand.  All I can say is:  Aroi, mak mak kcc! (Thai for "very very delicious")

column9: The perfect brand of red curry
column10: This brand of red curry is authentic and perfect. I applaud other domestic companies for trying to replicate this, but they cannot touch this product. Mae Ploy red curry is excellent. Once you learn to make curry, you can't stop! Even making Panang Nur, this curry is wonderful.
I have used this brand in Europe when cooking Thai or Indian food and am pleased that I can find it here!

column9: Afraid to try it at first but it's THE BEST
column10: I've only ever used the curry pastes they sell in my local chain supermarket. It comes in a tiny jar, is $7, and has such little flavor I almost need to use an entire jar every time I make curry.After doing some Amazon searches for curry paste this one seemed to have the most, and best, ratings. And it has  A LOT of paste in the container! So I ordered it. I figured if Thai folks use this curry, it must be good.And it is! It's the best, and now my curry rivals that of the local restaurants. We don't go out for curry anymore, since it takes less than 30 minutes to make one that tastes just as good.The container is huge, and it will take months for me to work through it even if I make curry once per week.When I first smelled the curry I was a little afraid to use it. The spices are definitely in there, and I started to sneeze from the chili! But I tried it and all the scariness of the curry went away. It smelled amazing, the amount of kick was perfect, and it was not overwhelming.I highly recommend this and I will definitely stock up. This is cheap, free shipping with Prime, and it's the best curry paste I have ever used.

Finally, thanks to Mae Ploy and Amazon, even an ordinary, Hamburger Helper stir-in kind of cook like me can make mouth-watering exotic Thai fare.  The best part?  All those expensive, impossible-to-find ingredients are right in the paste!  No more shopping, peeling, pounding, mincing, or guessing about quantities.  An easy master recipe is right on the canister, you just decide what vegetables or meats to use, and I haven't tried any yet that did'nt taste great.  In the time it used to take to make a box of macaroni and cheese, I now have a fresh, healthy, and very economical meal.  Love Mae Ploy!!

I'm not Thai, but I love Thai food and I love to cook at home - with this red curry paste I'm able to make chicken red curry that just as good as what I get in restaurants.  I'll always keep a jar of this in my cabinet - highly recommended!
The instructions are so simple, and the amount to use so small.It will last a long time. Absolutely delicious.
Buy this locally if at all possible, the price is way out of line.I just bought the larger size, 1000g, for 3.99 at an Asian Market.

Now, I have made many times; shrimp with *long cellophane thin noodles, in a Thai red curry coconut sauce. It was simple to make, but I am certain I left out some ingredients. I never tried the yellow or green curry paste yet. It tasted good to me the way I was making it, so I make it that way as often as I can, which is a couple times a year or more, for about ten years now.All I did was;In a large bowl of fresh, cold water, I would place the cellophane noodles *(we called them 'corn starch noodles), in until they were soaked for a couple minutes giving them a bath, submerging them and then, whilst they were soaking I put in a large frying pan, or wok, 1 can of each: Coconut Milk & Coconut Cream, stirring in as much Red Curry paste as I would like. I learned not too much, because it gets hotter the more you put in. Stirring until blended well and on a medium heat I then added my noodles and cooked them only a few minutes, until tender. Then, since shrimp only take a couple minutes to really cook, no longer than 5 minutes, I would toss them in at the end and serve. That was all I did. Like I said, I saw recipes after I made this and they always add this and that extra, but the simple way I made it was fine for me. To each their own, but it was good. :o)I didn't even need salt or pepper!

Since I love Thai food and there are no Thai restaurants in my area - AND I've had to go gluten free, which spurs me to investigate all sorts of new-to-me cuisine - I ordered this paste which incorporates the ingredients that are both hard to find here, and difficult to process. (Just TRY to get some galangal around rural parts of New England!)So then I had to learn how to use it. I think... I got it. To jazz up some already-cooked chicken tenders and millet, I used a teaspoon of this Mae Ploy Red Curry Paste, maybe a quarter cup of coconut milk, fresh minced gingeroot (the kind available in US supermarkets) and a couple of teaspoons of ground cumin. Mixed all those together, added my chicken and millet, bopped it in the microwave, and wow, I thought I was transported to a good Thai restaurant in spite of the non-traditional millet in it. The red curry paste has the elusive ingredients like lemongrass, galangal, shrimp paste with Kaffir lime already mixed together so adding the other parts is simple. Wonderful taste, wonderful heat.BTW I carefully cut off one corner of the heavy plastic packaging so that I can squeeze out what I need easily. And it does say to refrigerate after opening, although I suspect the red chili would preserve most anything, including me.
A little goes a long way of this delicious curry paste.  I have had mine in the fridge for a few months and we make curry about once every two weeks.  Yummy!

I bought this curry paste for a recipe and followed the recipe instructions and failed to look at the recommended serving size on the container.  HUGE mistake!  My recipe called for 3TBSP, while the side of the container lists 2tsp as the recommended serving size.  Even after trying to dilute the sauce it is way too hot.  The taste is fabulous but it is HOT, next time I will know to start very, very slow.

My niece turned me onto Mae Ploy red curry paste and I was hooked. One of my signature dishes now is Thia Curry using what ever protein and veggies I have on hand. It is always delicious. I tried using another brand (Thai Kitchen) once my Mae Ploy was gone. It was not the same. Unfortunately I couldn't find Mae Ploy locally so I had to go on line. Ordering it through Amazon I was able to get it reasonably, though it did take a while for delivery. Thanks Amazon!

I love cooking Thai food at home, but all I can get at my local grocery store is an Americanized version of curry paste -- bland, no heat, barely recognizable as curry. Mae Ploy is the real deal -- intense flavor, VERY spicy and completely authentic. My friends can't tell the difference between my red curry chicken & takeout from a local Thai restaurant now that I've switched to this brand of curry paste. I'll never go back to buying it from the supermarket!

This is an item I just cant find at the local supermarket.  Decided to buy online and was pleasantly surprised. I think it is a little too expensive for the quantity (14oz does not go very far for the Thai dishes that I make), but the quality of the product was very good and I have now purchased this a couple of times through Amazon.

This is my favorite red curry paste currently on the market. I enjoy each of the Mae Ploy curry pastes in their own applications. I really like the red curry for making peanut sauces and soups. I've tried many a powder and paste, but this brand seems to have the best flavor. I also really like that there are no artificial ingredients.

column9: Best Red Curry Paste I've Ever Used
column10: I love red curry. In efforts to recreate my favorite restaurant dishes, I've tried red curry pastes from Thai Kitchen, Trader Joe's, Berkeley Bowl, and Mae Ploy. Mae Ploy blows the competition out of the water - I highly recommend it.The only caveat: the price on Amazon seems to be higher than the price in stores ($1-$5?). Do your own comparison.Happy eating!

column9: The Good Stuff, Minus the Packaging
column10: I can confirm that this is the exact curry paste used in many Thai restaurants - I've worked in one where this was the case.I don't particularly enjoy the smell of this product, but the taste is quite good and will produce a nice result. The minor problem is that the actual paste comes packed in a vacuum-sealed bag that itself is stuffed in the tub. This doesn't make much sense to me; why not just seal the tub itself? The paste can be easily popped out of the bag, however.This is a cost-efficient way to produce curry at home. Using three tablespoons of paste for each curry, you'll get about eight uses per 14oz tub. Try it.
Very good package. I recommend that you don't have to add other salty thing because the paste have it already.

I've purchased different curries in the grocery store and was never completely happy with the flavor. I read a recipe that recommended this brand and after using it I can see why they recommend this specific brand. Great flavor - I purchased all 3 - Green, Red, and Yellow curry paste and have enjoyed all 3 types.
My favorite is the Mae Ploy Panang style curry paste, but the red is an excellent choice. Not as hot as the Panang, but great classic red curry flavor.

You can buy fancy jars at your local grocery store that will also be named Thai red curry paste. Mae Ploy is authentic and rich tasting. And in its economy pack it is quite cheap by the ounce. Red curry paste can be made in different ways, but there is no need to own anything else but the Mae PLoy variety for your home made curries.

This paste is infinitely better than the Thai Kitchen brand that you can buy in the stores. Its a LOT less expensive, and a little goes a long way. The other brand is very weak and you need pretty much a whole $5 jar to make a big pot of curry.The only complaint that I have about this stuff is that in order to get that nice red color and the great flavor of the lemongrass and thai basil, you have to use a bit more of it, and that means your curry will be pretty spicy. But, that being said, I love spicy curry so this stuff is my favorite.
The directions weren't kidding with their paste to coconut milk ratio!! This stuff is delicious, stock up on coconut milk!

I make a pretty simple curry: chicken, veggies (red bell pepper and a yellow onion)m coconut milk, red curry paste, curry powder, and fish and soy sauce.When I first started making the curry, I used the Thai Kitchen coconut milk and red curry paste you can pick up at any grocery store. It was always pretty good, and the main thing that prompted me to start looking for other curry paste was the $$ of a jar that lasted only 3 servings.We found an asian market next to a vietnamese place we frequent. I went hunting for red curry paste and came across this. Even cheaper than Amazon at $4 a jar for about 3x as much as the little Thai Kitchen ones!I have to say this paste(plus a higher quality coconut milk) has taken my curry to a new level. Comparing the ingredients to the Thai Kitchen paste, the only difference seems to be the Mae Ploy has shrimp. The flavor is amazing, not to mention it has a spicy kick that the other one lacks. When I first used this after the small jar I almost choked at the spice, mostly because I just wasn't prepared for it! After 5 servings of curry the jar is only half gone.The only recommendation I would make is to look for this at your local asian market - seems to be twice as expensive here on Amazon!

This product lasts for a long time when it is refrigerated; I find that the 50g or 10 tsp. that this would be, according to the package directions, is extremely hot even when mixed with the coconut milk and water.  I use half coconut milk and half chicken broth for the sauce. If you can put in some wild lime leaves (kaffir lime leaves),cilantro and a dash of fish sauce, the curry will taste like your local Thai restaurant.

I have three different flavors of these curry and they are all exceptional. Since they are so convenient I find that I use them often for general seasoning. They are a wonderful staple to have on hand

column9: Good and Easy to Cook With
column10: I love curry, with a passion.  But we recently moved to a small community where it's next to impossible to get curry.  So I desperately decided to order this product.  It's very easy to use, I found a ton of on-line recipes and you can season to taste.  I am extremely pleased with this product and so happy that it is available online since I don't think there is really any other way we would have been able to get it; we don't often drive to the city to buy groceries and the small grocery store in town does not carry Thai food.  I would highly recommend it to people who like red curry.

This is THE best red curry, don't waste your time on the cheap imitators.  Mix with cocunut milk and real palm sugar + chicken and veggies and you will amaze your friend and families.  This is great red curry paste!

column9: when you can make your own!
column10: when you can't make your own or don't have the time this is perfect!There are minimal ingredients, no preservatives.I use it for this crock pot chicken [...]

Good stuff!  If you are planning on making a traditional red curry, I would recommend that you also use some Fish Sauce, we used just the red curry paste and coconut milk with chicken, zucchini, red peppers, and cilantro, and it was definitely missing something, but I imagine that the fish sauce would round it out nicely.

Not only is it bad while eating the curry, it even has a terrible aftertaste to prolong the fun. I have taken the suggestion of another reviewer to try Hand Brand, we'll see what comes of that.

its ok for curry paste, better then the average curry products available at most supermarkets, but i prefer hand brand curry paste, much better, a huge difference, much more flavorful, its all i use now, also as a side note these mae ploy containers are the small ones not the larger ones found in asian food markets. not a good value here.

*****This milk chocolate from Dagoba is not just organic, it is unbelievably scrumptious! Creamy, milky, and definitely adult. Although if I had children, this is the milk chocolate bar I would give them because I would want them to eat sweets with quality ingredients. I'm more of a dark chocolate person, but I absolutely love this. We cook this in a Zojirushi rice cooker.  It turns out perfectly.  It has wonderful health benefits -- GABA promotes all kinds of good things, including relaxation (many tranquilizers work on a principle of stimulating GABA reception.  It's tasty stuff, too.  Give it a whirl.

This is the most delicious rice I have ever eaten. Fluffy, nutty, sticky-yet-separate- and a breeze to cook in my rice cooker.  It is sooooo expensive that I cannot have it every day but I savored every bite.  I cooked it in my instant pot with no problems. Absolutley delicious...I wish this could be the only rice I have in my house.

I cook this in a Progressive International Microwaveable 6-Cup (Cooked) Rice Cooker Set.I put 1/2 cup of rice, 1 cup or water, 3 teaspoons of Sprout House Beans that I have sprouted in a Easy Sprout Sprouter - 1 set,(Easy Sprout) and seasoning in the cooker and let sit for an hour or more.Then I put cooker into an 800 watt microwave and cook for 15 minutes at 70 percent power.After cooking I let it sit in the microwave for at least a hour.
This rice has great texture and seems like it would make a great risotto as well.  Even my niece and nephew liked it.

I made some of this rice last night in my Zojirushi rice maker and it turned out fantastic! Tastes great with Chicken Marsala made with "Patak's Tikka Masala Curry Cooking Sauce" and has a higher level of nutrition than standard brown or white rice.

It's absolutely wonderful. It has a nutty taste and cooks in about 30 minutes. For those people that are not so crazy about eating brown rice, you can boil it together with some white rice and they cook nicely together at the same time.

This is my first time trying sprouted Rice. I enjoyed it. It cooked up fine in my rice cooker. Good flavor and texture. However, my rice cooker has a setting for sprouting rice. I liked it better and it is cheaper. I will use regular brown rice from now on.

I was pleased to find this large size jar of sesame seeds.  The seeds are of typical McCormick quality (very good) and it was sent out quickly.  I do a good amount of asian cooking as well as homemade breads that are enhanced with quality sesame seeds.  These fit the bill at a economical cost.

Two of my three guys would look forward to this product twice a day. They never complained and always ate the whole thing. But when I bought cans (13oz) this week, first I noticed they changed the label coloring. No big deal, just wanted to make sure it was the same stuff; however when I opened the can, the smell was different, the consistency was different - it just felt wrong. The chunky, thick mealy consistency changed to a standard pate. After using this product for a year, it suddenly was different. I didn't tell my cats about it, and just fed them the same as always. They tried, boy they really tried to like it, even switching to each others' dish several times, but they wouldn't do anything more than move it around. That was a dinner - I ended up just giving them dry food. So for breakfast, I tried again, same results, only this time, I heard about it! So, I give this product one star, way down from 4.5 before. My husband LOVES tea and Punjana Family Blend is one of his favorites. The flavor, aroma, and body are strong and robust, with no hint of bitterness. If we ever get to Ireland, we'll need an extra suitcase to bring home this tea!

I really enjoy this soup.  It is very filling and hearty.  It is 260 calories, not 160 calories as the previous reviewer states.  It is very low in fat and high in fiber. This will very easily become a lunch staple for my home.

I'm buying another 12 bags of this soup after ordering it for the first time just two weeks ago.  It's delicious and easy to prepare in the microwave.  More importantly, it really is only 160 calories for a huge bowl of tasty noodles.  I know, because I gain weight if I eat more than 1000 calories a day.  I don't gain any weight on this soup.  It's a great hot satisfying meal for a cold morning, or an evening late night snack to help me sleep.  Even better is the real reason I happened upon this soup on Amazon and decided to try ordering it -- the soup noodles are made of Moroheiya, a vegetable that is supposed to keep skin young and supple.  It's a staple in the diet of long lived Japanese.  I found that eating this soup on a regular basis does seem to help make my skin look young and healthy.

column9: Delicious! Best Blueberry coffee I've had!
column10: This coffee is just the right amount of blueberry taste. When brewing, the smell of freshly baked blueberry muffins spread through the house. It is absolutely wonderful. At first I was skeptical if the flavor would be tasty, but if you imagine the combination of flavors of a blueberry muffin and sipping on coffee, that is the taste of this coffee. I have even mixed it with cheaper, regular coffee--it still tastes delicious and lasts twice as long. In my opinion, this is the best blueberry coffee I've tried yet.

column9: Good Blueberry flavor, but lacks the depth of other brews.
column10: All in all, it's not a bad coffee and it's priced well. New England Blueberry coffee does have a good strong blueberry aroma and flavor. However this flavor leaves immediately as it hits the pallet, and it lacks that depth that other brews have. The flavor doesn't last, and the aftertaste isn't that pleasant. I will say that compared to other blueberry coffees I've had, it has a strong blueberry flavor and I do enjoy that. The other pro was that it had no bitterness, which was a pleasant aspect of the coffee. Though, if you are one that enjoys a strong, deep, cup of coffee I would try another brew.
I love this blueberry coffee so much!  It is very flavorful and goes great with heavy whipping cream.  I look forward to waking up in the mornings now just so I can brew myself a cup  : )

I ordered this to try it to see if I would like it so I only ordered a single bag.  Big mistake! I should have ordered at least the 3 pack!  It has such a great blueberry flavor and I can't find it anywhere locally.  I will be placing another order soon!

column9: Excellent flavored coffee; Seller "TheNewMall" is overpriced
column10: This is excellent coffee with a great rich blueberry flavor and taste.  The price on this is double by the seller TheNewMall.  This coffee should costs less than $6 and can be purchase by the case for $40 elsewhere on the internet.

This is a wonderful flavored coffee, but as another reviewer pointed out The New Mall is vastly over priced. I buy it at Super Walmart or Super Target for $4.20 a bag and it's only $6.99 at the grocery store! It's definitely one to try if you like blueberries! I even add a little cocoa powder to mine to have chocolate blueberry coffee :)

column9: Taste is fabulous, this price...  not so much
column10: I really enjoy flavored coffees, and blueberry in particular.  New England Blueberry Cobbler Coffee is one of my favorites.  It is smooth and the blueberry flavor is there but not over-powering.  It smells terrific while brewing and when you drink it.  If you like flavored coffees I would definitely recommend that you try it.However, shop around for prices.  Our local supermarket has this coffee for 1/4 of the price for this exact amount if you take in account the cost of the item and shipping.

Love the taste! Sweet mesquite. Works great as a marinade or a bbq sauce. Tried it as a quick marinade, 45 min, and over night, both worked great, prefer overnight of course. Even liked it cooking with my Forman grill. I may be biased, being a Pepper, but wouldn't you like to be a Pepper too?
This is the only marinade I use on my steak would recommend it to anyone. Amazon makes it easy to get when you subscribe to receive orders. I personally order 6 every 3 months and that is just right.

column9: The right taste for anything on the grill.
column10: I use this marinade on anything I grill. I used to eat my hamburgers and steaks plain, but not any more. This Dr. Pepper Marinade is fantastic. It as a great flavor to my grilled food. I have tried other marinades but some had a weak flavor to them and others drowned out the flavor of the meat. Not this one, it is great tasting.
This brand is hard to find, but I found it on here. My order arrived on time!I was pleased with how smooth the process went.

i wanted to try this marinade. when i got it and opened it and tried it it is a thick bbq sauce. i marinated some chicken and after being cooked the flavor barely got into the chicken.  i tastes great however the one star is because this is a bbq sauce and NOT a marinade.

If you are a mustard fan & have never tried this mustard before, do yourself a favor & order today. I've used this mustard for years and for some reason it became unavailable in my area. After looking all over within a 70 mile radius & not finding this product, I turned to mail order. If you have ever been to a fair or amusement park & thought to yourself..."What was that great tasting mustard?"....It was probably Plochman's.....My order got to me quicker than I thought & arrived undamged. Thank you Amazon.

This mustard has the best balance of spice and flavor. I had the same experience as a lot of folks, local stores stopped carrying it and I had to go online to get it. Thank God for amazon as my mustard journey is now complete!
This is the best mustard there is. Hard to find in a lot of areas but well worth the search.
THIS STUFF IS GREAT, THEY STOPPED CARRYING IN NEW ENGLAND AND WAS SO HAPPY TO FIND IT ON AMAZON. I GREW UP ON THIS STUFF AND WAS UPSET WHEN I COULD NOT FIND IT ANYWHERE.

column9: The best mustard you could shake a stick at
column10: I have been searching for the best mustard mainly for hot dogs. Well, I found it. Especially if you are looking for an authentic Chicago experience with your hot dog this is it. The packaging is great and once again the shipping with Amazon is near untouchable. You wont regret this purchase.

Wow! $26.37 for 36oz of nachos?  That comes to $8.79 per bag!  Or, to put it into even more ridiculous perspective, about $.06 per chip!  What moron would buy these at this price, better yet, what moron would think someone WOULD buy them at this price?

Doritos speak for themselves with flavor and satisfaction! Buying bulk saves on shipping cost for a good deal. Cure your munchies today with Doritos.*****

column9: So Much Better Than Those "ORANGE" Things
column10: All natural and so delicious. I prefer these over their nasty chemical-filled alternative we grew up with. These are crunchy and yummy. So fabulous! I've not found a Barbara's product I haven't loved.

column9: Delicious! My favorite crunchy cheese snack!
column10: If you are expecting soft greasy CHEETOS you've come to the wrong place.  The crunch makes you take notice and there are no stained orange fingers as tell-tale signs that you have been in the snack bag.  There is enough cheese flavor and the salt is not overdone, so it is perfectly to my liking.  One ounce in these bags is just enough to tease. Perfect as a addition to your lunch bag, or a before bed crunch while watching the news, but for a midday snack you may need to sneak a second bag.

column9: Barbara's Bakery Original Cheese Puffs, 1-Ounce Bags
column10: I love Barbara's foods! It was my first time trying the cheese puffs. They arrived fresh and crispy. In regarding to the flavor it's okay,very slight cheese flavor for my taste. I will stick to the Jalapeno Cheese puffs that are more my style. Still a great snack for work and WAY better than the other cheese puffs in the market!!

column9: These sounded great but they are really TASTELESS!
column10: I read the ingredients and thought these would be a delicious, healthy snack but they are just plain BLAND!  They are crispy and fresh but there is very little flavor to them.  I was sincerely disappointed.  I'm just glad I bought them on sale or I would be angry as well as saddened by the lack of cheese flavor.  If you are looking for an expensive 'crunch' without tongue tingling taste, these are for you!  I can NOT recommend them.  I will not be buying these again!

i have previously tried these from Whole Foods so i knew exactly what to expect.  however, when i opened the first bag, they were STALE, which made them taste bland and disgusting.  i have 23 more bags left... i'd be better off having real cardboard.
I prefer Jave Monster instead of coffee. I have one to start my day off. I was very pleased with the product.

Kudos to Monster for making this coffee flavored energy drink (with approximately the caffeine content of one-half a cup of coffee!) It's my favorite drink on the golf course.... BUT brickbats to them for the total lack of retail establishments carrying it in stock. Thank you to Amazon for offering it at an attractive price.... you're the best!

One thing that sets this product apart from others is that it contains vitamins and not just loaded down with caffeine and sugar like in citrus type drinks (which tend to give me a read skin rash). Without the wake-up-tiredness I've also cut down to about 1 cup of coffee in the morning maybe once or twice a week.

I ordered this strawberry syrup to make snow cones for my grandchildren.  They love it.  It has a perfect not too sweet taste.  I will be ordering another bottle soon.

column9: Not Christmas for my son without this candy
column10: Ever since my eldest son was a teenager - he'll be 50 this year! - he has loved Coffee Crisp.  He would buy these yummy bars when we camped in Canada and then ration them for a long long time.  Now I order them at Christmas time from Amazon.com because it just isn't Christmas for Rob without them!

My hubby is from Cananda and told me that his favorite candy is Coffee Crisp but it is not available in the US. I was happy to find it for sale here - it is crunchy similar to a large Kit Kat but with a hint of coffee flavor.

I normally buy these at the Duty-Free shop when I cross the border, but having them delivered to my house is even better! This chocolate and wafer candy just melts in your mouth. They are quite a bit thicker than your average chocolate bar and so decadent. Highly recommended!!!

I actually bought these a year ago and because the experience was so good I thought I should give it a review. They arrived fresh, arrived as sceduled and at a reasonable price. Wouldn't hesitate to order again.
If you're a chocolate lover, this is definitely one to try. It's a quality product, that is consistently delightful. Get some for yourself and some for a friend.
The product was supposedly in stock when I ordered it, but I was told the next day it was on back order.  When the candy arrived, the bars tasted stale.  I will not order from this company again.

column9: Best instant coffee I have tasted, including the Starbucks VIA
column10: You will not disappointed with the quality of this coffee. In the instant coffee scale, this coffee deserves a 9.5 out of 10. Not only does this coffee tastes great with potent caffeine rush similar to a Starbucks brewed coffeee, but it also is also reasonably priced. Its only downside in taste is a very slight acidic aftertaste.I use this coffee at work and at home. Instead of going to Starbucks everyday, I now spend approximately 25-50 cents (depending on how much coffee I drink) a day on a similar caliber instant coffee. This coffee will fit your needs very nicely.

column9: Awesome, hard to believe it is instant...
column10: I saw an article on MSNBC regarding a taste test on a large number of brewed and instant coffee's- ranging from standard brands to exotic restaurant blends.  This coffee came out on top, even beating brewed coffee's.  Thought I would give a try and found them on Amazon here- this 4 jar package.  I am on my 3rd order!  Not only do I love this coffee, I ended up giving several as gifts, and everyone so far loves the stuff.  Highly recommend!

First of all, this is not espresso. I'm picky about espresso and this ain't it. It also doesn't taste much like traditional drip coffees.That said, Cafe Bustelo Instant is an excellent drink. I was looking for an alternative to Starbucks Via that was convenient but not so expensive, and decided to try a few on Amazon. This is among the best, possibly *the* best. It's an interesting, distinct flavor. Very substantial, but not bitter. I need to put cream in most drip coffees to offset the bitterness, but I drank this black and enjoyed it thoroughly.At the price, you really can't go wrong. Tired of noxious office coffee? I know I am. I'm taking a bottle of this into the office. I'll still hit a local shop for quality espresso but I'll gladly replace drip coffees with Cafe Bustelo.

I am not an instant coffee person, but after seeing a taste testing results pole, that touted the great flavor of the Cafe Bustelo Coffee Instant espresso, I decided to try it.  The first two times I tried to order it, it was out of stock, but I did not give up.  I finally was able to order the product, and I was very surprised at how good it was. Since the minimum order was 4 jars, I shared with my family and friends.  They also agreed it was excellent.  It is nice to have on hand for that quick cup of coffee, or an iced latte.

column9: Sent to Son at College based on Reviews
column10: I sent 2 jars to my 21 year old son in college, and he loves, loves this coffee..the concept of instant coffee is novel to him, and the flavor is great...Saving, lots money his trips to Starbucks..

column9: Treat yourself to this instant heaven!
column10: Don't let the "instant coffee" thing bother you. This is not your grandma's instant coffee. I have been using this instant espresso for years to make both hot and cold coffee to my own taste. The beauty is you can make everything from a gallon to a demi tasse without wasting any. I can't live without it at this point and up here in New England it simply can't be found in stores. I am thankful I can buy it online.

I think people giving this stuff bad reviews are expecting a freshly ground bean espresso drinking experience.  This does not come close to that.  However, for instant coffee, I still think it tastes better than a freshly brewed cheap coffee like folgers.  Also the recommended use is 1 teaspoon per cup, I use a bit more than that because it is a bit bland unless you use a bit more, but to each his own.  If you are looking for an instant coffee solution look no further.  If you are looking for a freshly grounded and brewed coffee experience with that strong coffee aroma, quit cutting corners and just grind your own beans or go to a coffee shop instead of buying this stuff and complaining its not like a real espresso =PAlso, you can get this item for cheaper at javacabana's website if you plan on buying in bulk (cases of 12), if not here is good =)

For what it's worth, Cafe Bustelo is a very good instant coffee. There has been a lot of comparisons between Cafe Bustelo and Starbucks VIA. In my opinion, I wholeheartedly agree with comparison. The good thing about Cafe Bustelo is that it costs a whole lot less. I think it is ridiculous how much Starbucks charges for the VIA brand.To be totally honest though, nothing beats a fresh brewed cup of coffee. Being that this is a instant coffee product, it can't be completely fair to compare it to that. I will say that this is one of the best tasting quick coffee product I have tried so far. There are many times where you just don't feel like (or can't) brewing a fresh cup of coffee and will settle for the quickness of instant coffee. Cafe Bustelo is also not lacking in caffeine I can tell you that much. The instructions say to use a full teaspoon for every cup of water but being that I also add cream and sugar, I add a little bit more. You certainly don't want to add too much because it can get really bitter. You'll have to play around with the amount to use to get it just right for yourself.

column9: Best instant coffee you will ever taste
column10: Being a coffee lover but also being a bit lazy about brewing coffee and cleaning up after, I researched instant coffees and found them to all be pretty bad in the taste department until this coffee...well actually it's espresso...but it's really like a stronger then average coffee without the bitter fake taste of all the instants I have tasted previously. I suppose at the right strength it could be considered espresso, but at normal strength (rounded teaspoon in about 6-8 oz. of hot water) it is a superior instant coffee.  Even when reheated hours later it is as good as when fresh.  Highly recommended.

The coffee we have at work tastes horrible, something like burned rice with sour cherries and bad red wine.  Most of my coworkers think it is just fine so we are stuck with it. You would want to use 1 rounded tsp per 6oz of water for regular coffee and 2 rounded tsps per 6oz of water for strong coffee.  Change tsp to TBs if you are measuring for grounds for brewing.  That's the calculation I've always used.

Given that it was a Scotsman -- a 19th century Edinburgh tea master named Drysdale -- who first marketed his particular blend under the name "breakfast tea" (and given that Drysdale's creation would soon come to be (mis)appropriated by tea houses south of the border, who proceeded to add the word "English" to its name), it seems only fitting that the Scots should have their own version of breakfast tea, too, after all. Even stronger than the already potent English Breakfast blend, this particular one is made to match not only the traditionally heavy English but even the Scottish breakfast, which like the English variety includes pork, sausages and eggs, but is amplified by that so distinctly Caledonian culinary creation: haggis (to most of the rest of the world, a classic case of "acquired taste" at best). A blend of primarily Indian teas, Scottish Breakfast contains a particularly high percentage of Assam, which with its malty flavor ideally complements the soft Scottish mountain waters ... as well as Scotland's famous single malt whiskies, the "water of life" ("uisgue beatha") likewise coming from the areas where those same mountain waters are flowing.Due to its strength, Scottish Breakfast tea maintains its flavor very well with the addition of cream or milk. As an everyday "work horse" and early morning pick-me-up it is easily as good as (if not better than) its more famous sibling from south of the border, or any kind of coffee. Enjoy!

This is a lovely way to start the day. I first found Scottish Breakfast blend when in Scotland - the box said something like "specially blended for our soft low-land scottish waters."  As the water where I live is very soft as well, I thought it might work well at home. It has. I've been drinking it for years - a gentle cuppa to start the day.

I love this tea.  With milk and sugar it is just like my Scottish grandma (from Kirkcaldy) used to make (always bring the pot to the kettle ... can't have the water anything less than boiling ... BUT make sure you "hot the pot" first and then get that tea cozy on ... I pour it into a big Stanley Thermos but I don't think Grandma would have objected).  I have it every morning to start my day (drank this whole bag in three months ... I take it to work in aforementioned big thermos after my first cup or two at home).  I served it from my thermos at work to a colleague and she ordered it immediately (raves about it ... best tea she ever had).  My Dad, also born in Scotland like grandma, just had a good strong cuppa last night without milk or sugar and enjoyed it as well (Chinese takeout was the meal).  This tea makes me smile when I drink it.  The best.

I found this to be a very rich and satisfying blend. It is difficult to find loose-leaf Scottish Breakfast blend, and this is a very sturdy brew. The taste is clean, crisp, and robust. The price for the quantity is very favorable. I highly recommend it for those who are serious about their tea.

This product contains yellow prussiate of soda, an anti-caking agent that is a regulated chemical that seems to be a concern when taken in high amounts.  No surprise as it contains cyanide.  It also affects what you can do with it in terms of pickling and brining.  The USFDA CFR Title 21, v6 Sec 573.1020 regulates it in the following way -- notice that it doesn't say HUMAN consumption:  The exact wording in the Code of Fed Regs is "Yellow prussiate of soda...may be safely used as an anticaking agent in salt for animal consumption at a level not to exceed 13 parts per million.  The additive contains a minimum of 99.0 percent of weight of sodium ferrocyanide decahydrate."  I bought this at the grocery store and am throwing it away.  It may not be "much" in terms of contaminants from this single product (altho they COULD use food grade diatomaceous earth and have the same "anticaking" effect), but given we are being bombed with contaminants like this from all sides in our foods, every little bit of avoidance seems like the smarter option.  I recommend you do not buy this salt -- look for Kosher salt options that do not have additives.  If your salt cakes, you can easily crush it and add a spoon of diatomaceous earth (food grade) and mix it well -- this does a good job as well.  The "convenience" of free-flowing kosher salt is not worth the added chemical ingestion...
I would buy it online again only if I couldnt find it where I am.I didnt know the actual price of this product in the stores.Now i know it is over prized.

column9: now, how does anyone write a reviewfor salt?
column10: Here my findings. It tastes very salty, so be careful how much you use. Also be aware that it looks like sugar. So if you plan in not storing it in its original package, mark it carefully.Fun aside, Kosher salt is dried sea salt, it can be a bit deceitful, If you have a recipe that calls for spoon measured salts, look up how much ounces fit on a spoon and weigh it. column9: The preferred salt for kitchen and table
column10: Except for baking, Morton Coarse Kosher Salt is what I use in the kitchen and at the table. I prefer pure, plain salt to the somewhat muddled flavor of sea salt. Table salt is much finer so it is harder to pinch and distribute evenly on a finished dish.This coarse, flaked salt is also necessary for topping pretzels and margaritas and making pickles. It is also especially nice topping whole grain loaves and on meat, poultry or baked potatoes. If you have a French recipe calling for "gros sel" something of this nature is what is intended. A nice gift that is easy to make using this salt is pickled lemons, which are very useful in Mediterranean dishes.Note that this salt is less dense than regular table salt. The label indicates to add 1 tablespoon per quarter cup if the recipe calls for table salt.

column9: problems with morton kosher salt and amazon's listing:
column10: problem #1:the price.$11.75 is ridiculous when it's $4 in most grocery stores (look for it in the spice aisle, on the bottom shelf)... it's SALT for cryin' out loud.good thing it qualifies for free shipping with a $25 purchase!problem #2:the description is wrong.yes, it's a "pack" "of three pounds" but that's it.the next two items contradict themselves... and the first one is wrong.  it does NOT contain iodine.  kosher salt, by definition, cannot contain iodine.  the anti-caking agent is yellow prussiate of soda.so, the third statement is OBVIOUSLY wrong, because it DOES contain an additive.jeez."Pack contains of 3 poundsTable salt mixed with iodine to prevent goiter and anti-caking agentContains no additives"problem #3:it contains an additive.it's NOT pure salt.  so, it's no good for pickling (it can turn the pickles mushy) or making preserved lemons, which i love.i was looking for kosher salt and couldn't remember the name of the one i like so well (and which is hard to find in my area) so i just did a search for "kosher salt".  when this popped up, i was quite surprise to see the price, so i looked at the product and was amazed... and not in a good way.i have used this product and still have a box on the shelf in the pantry.  i won't be buying it again because of the additives.  apparently, morton does not make a salt without additives... even their sea salt has yellow prussiate of soda.  so... sorry, morton.i will buy the diamond crystal kosher salt from now on.  NO additives, just SALT.

column10: I wasn't very pleased with the Pienaroma. I was getting the Super Crema and thought I'd give a darker roast a try since the Super Crema is very light. TASTE/ENJOYMENTThis is a beautiful espresso bean, full and creamy with an easy after-taste. As can be expected with 100% arabica beans, there is an earthy taste with notes of cocoa. This is perfect as a desert coffee, and I would highly suggest pairing it with a chocolate cake or pastry for maximum enjoyment. It does not work well as a breakfast coffee if you are looking for a jolt - it has reduced caffeine levels when compared to other espresso beans, but on the positive side it will make a great evening cup!CREMAThe crema that results from this blend is one of the best I have seen, sitting around long enough for you to enjoy your espresso without it spoiling. If you don't understand why crema is important, I would strongly suggest doing a little research. If after doing some research you don't think it's important, then I would suggest picking up some Folgers.NOTE: To anyone who has never enjoyed European coffee:Espresso beans are not supposed to be burnt, oily and dark in color. This is a by-product of poor espresso roasting, and has become the norm in the U.S. (think Starbucks). Espresso beans in most of Europe are a medium brown, without any oil on the surface (it stays within the bean with superior roasting processes). Espresso is not supposed to be diluted with syrups and flavored creamers, but should be consumed either straight from the machine, or in a macchiato or cappucino. You WILL notice a difference between this and Americanized coffee, and if you are expected something akin to Starbucks extra bold dark (overly) roasted beans, you will be disappointed. Instead, try to allow yourself to experience something different, the way that espresso was meant to be enjoyed.

It has a very dense flavor on the tongue, and the first time you drink it you will want to savor every sip to just appreciate the complexity of the blends flavor.I am biased and prefer dark oily roasts. But I always keep a big bag of this in the freezer and have it every day or 2 when making a cappuccino. It also supposedly has less caffeine than the other Lavazza blends, and I can attest to that. Dark roasts sometimes miss the department in complexity with flavor, but sometimes you want a nice strong kick in the morning or in a straight shot. But for all the other times? Get this, very very impressive.

column9: Delicious Gummies That Won't Make You Croak...
column10: Gummy candies such as Gummy bears, frogs, cherries and worms are my second favorite sweet candy next to Jelly Beans; so stumbling across my favorite of the gummy candies on Amazon was a real treat.  What we have here are Mini-Rainbow Frogs, 5oz packages in a pack of 12.TASTEThere are 4 colors/flavors to the frogs, Red / Green / Yellow / Orange  which convert to the flavors of  Strawberry, Raspberry, Lemon and Orange.  The underbellies of the frogs are white and have an almost marshmallow/coconut taste to them.  It is hard to really place it but surprisingly the white underbelly flavor blends together exceptionally well with the fruit flavor making for a delicious gummy treat.  The mini-frogs are fairly sweet so I tend to pick at them one at a time and let then slowly soften as I chew on the candy.  Makes them last much longer and brings out the flavorSHIPPINGThe product arrived in a standard box with the packages inside them.  Like most candy, shipping during the summer months can be risky especially with chocolate or gelatin based candy.  On 2-3 day shipping the product arrived in great condition, warm but still soft and fresh.  If left on a truck too long however gelatin candy like this can end up melting and turning into a big clump.  As a receiver/manager in the food industry I've seen this happen plenty of times; so just be a little careful during the summer months.  Other than that these ship great during the other seasons.OVERALL these are a delicious gummy treat.  If you are a fan of Haribo Gummy Bears then do not be afraid to try the mini-frogs.  The added flavor of the white underbellies makes for a unique flavor in the end, that might just convert your love for Gummy Bears into a love for mini-frogs (just like it did to me).  This is a excellent quality product with a delicious taste, and very satisfying as a sweet snack.  5 stars!
