column9: High quality cat food that my cats love!
column10: I have three cats, one of which has IBS/digestive issues.  My vets recommended that I switch him to a food with the fewest ingredients as possible and that has an unusual protein (like lamb or venison).  I can get both of those with Ziwipeak!  And all three of my cats love it, which was a real surprise to me.  It took some getting used to since the jerky-style pellets are very different from feeding regular dry food.  But my cats adapted relatively quickly.  All three seem to be thriving on it.  I'm very happy to have found this food.

I have two very picky cats. One has serious food allergy issues, so I've been trying out new foods. My cat with allergies LOVES this food, and it fortunately does not make him sick. The other cat, unfortunately will barely touch this food. He seems to like the smell, but he's really a dry crunchy food addict. The texture of this food is a bit odd. It comes in small flat squares that are dry, but a bit more like jerky than normal dry cat food (not tough like jerky, that's just the closest thing I can compare it to. I suppose you could even compare it to a chopped fruit roll up, made with meat puree instead of fruit). This food wasn't a complete winner for us, but it works for one cat at least.

column9: See how it stacks up against the others
column10: This is good syrup and my 2nd favorite.  It has a medium sweetness when compared with the other 2 that I've tried.  I typically don't like things very sweet.  I used 3 syrups listed below for my Master Cleanse.  They are all good quality and I'd recommend any of them.  You probably will want 1 jug for every 5 days of a cleanse.  It is possible that you'll need more.  I'm not an expert to comment on darkness or many other factors.  Here's my brief breakdown:Coombs Family Farms 100% Pure Organic Maple Syrup Grade B, 32-Ounce Jug - The sweetest of the 3 for sure.  It is also probably the thickest but still runny.  200 calories per serving of 4 tbsp.  When I put this in my lemonade for the Master Cleanse, it makes the lemonade sweeter than how I like it.NOW Foods Maple Syrup Grade B Organic, 32 ounce - Is less sweet when compared to Coombs but a little sweeter than Family Heritage.  Runnier than Coombs but these syrups are all a little runnier than grocery syrups.  200 calories per serving of 4 tbsp.  It provided the right amount of sweetness for the Master Cleanse specifications for a drink.Family Heritage Organic Vermont Maple Syrup, Grade B, 32-Ounce Jug - Good quality and tastes sweet but definitely not as sweet as the other 2.  Didn't get the calorie info before throwing the bottle away but I'm figuring it's the same as the other 2.  I usually put an extra 1/2 a tbsp in my master cleanse lemonade to get it a little sweeter and curb the hunger.

column9: Adds a dash of magic to breakfast
column10: This is really good maple syrup, packed with flavor, dense, and dark. Naturally it takes homemade waffles and pancakes to the next level, but it can also add a dash of magic to other breakfast staples, such as oatmeal or muffins. column9: So much better than Grade A!
column10: I'm from Maine and I have to tell you that I would never buy grade A maple syrup. If I'm going to use maple syrup, I want that rich, distinctive taste, not something that's barely different than white sugar. That's actually a good comparison - grade A is to grade B as white is to brown sugar. I know we're all used to thinking of "grade A" as meaning of superior quality, but that's not how it works with this. It is referring to the level of filtering/processing the sap goes through. If you want generic sweetness, go grade A. For everything else, grade B. This is a trusted brand of organic syrup with a great flavor. By the way, for baking and real maple syrup afficionados, there is also a grade C (even darker)!
This is my favorite syrup. I was happy with the price, the shipping and the flavor of this syrup.  The 64 oz lasted a very long time.

column9: Definition of NON-GE for this product, from Now Foods. I have not used this item, am just giving definition.
column10: Non-GE - "GE" stands for genetic engineering and is also referred to as GMO (genetically modified organism). Genetic engineering of food products uses gene splicing to overcome natural boundaries that would otherwise prohibit the creation of a product. Genes from different species can be combined to create a hardier product resistant to certain exogenous factors. As an example, you might be able to add fish genes to corn to make it resistant to pesticides. Although there may be "instant gratification" from such benefits as better taste, longer shelf life, and greater yield, serious concerns exist about the long-term ramifications of using these types of products and ingredients. Until more research backing the safety of GE products is available, we'll continue to make every effort to use only non-GE ingredients and products

column9: Different! And not in a good way!
column10: If you are used to eating the pink colored (artificial) ginger sushi slices, you will be disappointed with this product, just like I was. The reason I tried it was the fact that they do not add artificial colorants to it. Nor do they add any sugar. But!!! They add tons of salt! It is so salty, I can't eat it at all. I put it into a big bucket of water, to let the salt leak out. So far, after 5 rinses, it is getting milder. But, the salt takes away from the natural gingery taste. Why oh why did they have to do that? If I have to choose between a vinegar-sugar mix or a vinegar-salt mix, I will pick the sugar anytime, when it comes to pickled ginger. By the way, the saltwater-vinegar blend makes up 10 % of the product weight indicated (I drained and measured it). I now replaced it with a sherry vinegar plus some sugar. I'll let it sit for some days in the fridge and see if it becomes edible. In conclusion, this was not a great buy, especially when adding the cost of the bottle of vinegar (5.90) and the sugar, and the time to work it up.Unless you like it extremely salty, in which case, you'll be really happy!One more thing: what do you do with all that ginger in a plastic pouch, once you open it? This is terrible packaging! How about a jar with a screwcap? That would definitely help with storage! (I had to find myself a glass jar to put it into.)

This pickled ginger as good as more expensive, smaller packages. A good example is Eden Ginger, Pickled with Shiso Leaves, 2.1-Ounce Container (Pack of 6), which sells on Amazon for $29.17. Buy this big bag instead and pay about $5 less for 3 times more product!Have one large or several smaller storage container(s) at hand and transferring the contents out of the bag as soon as it's opened. Keep it all in the fridge. The ginger tends to loose some of it's bright pink color when exposed to air. Keeps well, even if the fades color, is not spoiled.Makes a great, homemade salad dressing ingredient. Add a tablespoon or two of the pickled ginger, 1 or 2 peeled cloves of garlic, 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar and 2 tablespoons of a nice olive oil to a blender. Puree it until it's emulsified and pour over your fresh greens.

column9: Excellent choice for the lactose intolerant

I like the vanilla too, but I prefer the original for taste and for versatility (does not add a vanilla taste to recipes or scrambled eggs etc).  Calories are the same in both versions.

Silk is usually absolutely delicious. But it contains cane juice --- which translates to sugar. Besides for which, the plain flavor doesn't taste nearly as good as the others. Between the unrefined, organic, naturally milled, all that good stuff SUGAR and the not great taste, my take on this kind of Silk is especially "Thanks, but no thanks."

column9: Raw for dogs who won't eat frozen raw
column10: My German Sheperd will not eat the frozen raw patties no matter what brand I try, but he eats all the Stella and Chewy's freeze dried with no hesitation.  I buy in bulk to save money and give him 6-9 freeze dried patties per day.  It has really helped his ear problems since I've incorporated this into his diet.  He no longer needs ear meds or cleaners and he has been staying symptom free.  I have tried so many different frozen paties -- different brands different proteins.  He had no interest in the frozen stuff no matter what tricks I tried, but there has never been a problem with getting him to eat the Stella and Chewy's freeze dried. He especially likes the Duck Duck Goose.  My cats like it too.  (I emailed the company. All of their products are for both dogs and cats.)I like that the brand has the organic ingredients, the high meat content, that it's pathogen free (safe), the organs, and mostly that my dog can get a raw meal with those good enzymes each day now.  It's a complete and balanced food,not just a supplement, like some other freeze dried.  It's in his daily diet now that is part of a fresh meat home-cooked diet that I supplement with Wysong Call of the Wild (a powder that is added to fresh meat and that also gives him some raw food ingredredients).  I've found that with a combination of Stella and Chewy's freeze dried raw, fresh cooked meat with Wysong Call of the Wild, cooked wild salmon, a cooked egg most days, sardines, fresh organic fruits and vegetbles and blueberries that my dog, even though he was not receptive to a raw meaty bone diet or a frozen raw commercial diet, is getting nearly optimal nutrition.

All of the Stella & Chewy's freeze-dried products are excellent. I know exactly what my dogs are getting and they love it. It's expensive so I recommend it for small dogs. I am delighted that I can get it through Amazon because few pet stores carry it and usually not much of it. It's perfect for picky eaters. The treats are also great.Stella & Chewy's Freeze-Dried Duck Duck Goose Dinner for Dogs, 16ozStella & Chewy's Carnivore Crunch, Freeze-Dried Beef Treats for Dogs and Cats, 4oz

My dogs love Stella & Chewy. I've tried feeding raw before. It was a real pain having to remember to put it out to thaw the day before and one of my dogs would not eat it at all because it was cold. This is a perfect compromise. No need to defrost and using warm water to rehydrate it makes it more pallatable for my little picky one.

column9: Great for my picky little one
column10: Stella & Chewy's Freeze-Dried Raw Duck Duck Goose Dinner for Dogs, 16oz is a home-run!  My little Yorkie (aka Lil'Bit), who is a little on the picky side, LOVES it! I love it because it is raw, full of nutrition, and so easy to prepare.

I have a finicky 10-week old Shiba Inu puppy who was only eating a small amount of her meals. I was feeding her Orijen Puppy Formula Dry Dog Food, but she would only eat less than half, if that, of what I put in her plate.At her first vet checkup, my veterinarian told me about STELLA & CHEWY'S RAW FOOD and how she feeds it to her dog so I came on to Amazon to look for it. Of course I found it here and decided on the DUCK DUCK GOOSE FREEZE DRIED formula.The patties are actually quite big, and you can add water to reconstitute it or serve it "as is" to your pup, and they come in a zip-lock top bag for easy closure and storage.Anyway, I crumbled some of STELLA & CHEWY'S FREEZE DRIED and added it to the Orijen kibble, plus a little warm water. I then gave it to Monju and she sniffed it and began eating like there was no tomorrow! She ate everything in the dish and was licking the bowl after. I couldn't believe it and was so relieved to find that she didn't have an eating disorder or something.So I'm sold on STELLA & CHEWY'S and have been giving it to my puppy mixed with kibble for her evening meals. I'll probably switch her full time to just STELLA & CHEWY'S FREEZE DRIED RAW when she gets older, but right now I want her to have something crunchy in her plate.I recommend it if you have fussy and picky eaters at home. And the freeze dried formula is super easy to use, no need to freeze, refrigerate, thaw or any of that.UPDATE 03/08/11For some unknown reason my Shiba stopped liking the "Duck Duck Goose" formula as I got to the bottom of the bag. Maybe it's because she's tried the other flavors or because I've transitioned her to only raw, but she just wouldn't eat this flavor anymore. She loves the "Super Beef" though. Also, now that she just turned 7-months and grown quite a bit, I realized that the patties aren't that big, so keep that in mind if you have a medium to large size dog. My pooch can eat two patties in one sitting and she's not even full grown yet. LOL.

Stella and Chewys is the ONLY dog food my spoiled Lhasa Apso will eat... I feel much better that he is eating a more balanced meal than the boiled chicken only.. His 'business' proves his little body loves it too... I'm a believer...

Great dog food!! keeps well and my dog loves it! He likes some flavors better than others but then changes his mind and eats the one he didn't like before with gusto. And it is good for him.  Great to take when you travel
Sam that is my furry baby loves the Freeze-Dried raw Duck Dinner. He is a very picky eater. I'm so happy that I found something that he likes and is good for him.

Therefore, for animals that can eat duck and NOT turkey, this fails to meet that requirement.  I always give a very low product rating to products that label themselves incorrectly.  If this said "with duck" that would be more honest.  Ordering online,  there's no way to know it contains turkey unless the seller includes that information in the description.

My 7lb poodle has never been picky about what he is given but since I started this food he won't look at anything else. I can give it to him freeze dried if I am in a hurry, or mix it with water (which is what I do most of the time). He is begging for his food and mad if I take too long. He is eight years old and was starting to show his age but since I started this food 2 months ago his coat is thicker and he seems to have more pep. It is a little pricey but he doesn't eat as much as the traditional dog food. Plus, no more bowel issues (if you know what I mean)! Since all the scares with the overseas dog food problems it is worth the price to me. He did have some kidney issues and I am anxious to see if his blood work has improved with the switch in food.

One of my dogs is allergic to almost every type of dog food and treat on the market.  Stella & Chewy's Duck is perfect not only for meals but also broken up and used for training treats.  I add half a patty mixed with hot water to my dog's breakfast kibble to add extra flavor or feed it to them dry for training and treats.  Great product.

I Started feeding this food as a topper to my 6 month old imo-inu, trying to supplement more protein and fat safely into her diet.  She's almost 3 years now, and it has become 1/2 her daily intake mixed in with canidae kibble.  Canidae's a great kibble that doesn't cost a whole heck of a lot so thats how i justify paying so much for S & C.I recently (about half a year ago) rescued a catahoula puppy, who is fast becoming my ideal Hiking/Backpacking buddy.  I only fed him canidae until about a month ago. He's now old enough to carry his own food, water and gear, but he can only carry about 7 pounds.  S & C really saves weight in his pack, as I've cut his weight down from 5.5 pounds to under 4.  Two days worth of Stella & Chewy's (39% protein), weighs about 1/2 a pound.  Two days worth of kibble (canidae 24% protein) weighs about 1.75 pounds.  I heard somewhere that competition sled dogs use these because of how little they weigh.  As far as taste, I've never come across a dog who doesn't love this stuff.
Been using this item in baking the lAST 6 years.  Holds up nicely.  Great flavor.  Stores well.  Good texture.  Used in cookies

column9: Rat hair?  Broken glass?  The company doesn't care....
column10: I thought this product was great, even if maybe it did not seem as pure as more expensive brands.  Then I decided to reuse one of the glass jars after I emptied the salt into a salt shaker today.  After peeling off the label, I realized that the jar had scratches in the glass on the INSIDE of the jar, with the serious potential for having glass particles mixed in with the salt.  I went to the next jar.  It is still safety sealed and unopened.  I peeled off the paper label from the outside of the jar, and inside the sealed jar there is a hair!  It looks like it could be a rat hair, but I have not tested it obviously.  I do hope the FDA will test it--I am contacting them in the morning.  This second jar also has numerous scratches in the glass--approximately 20 scratches, many of them black (dirt in the scratched glass).  The company was not at all concerned--they just told me if I didn't purchase it directly from them, I should ask amazon for a refund.  I explained that the main point of my call was certainly not for a refund but to protect consumers from DANGER!  They called me back and said IF I returned their jars, they would replace the salt.  I refused the replacement and am hoping the FDA will examine the jars.  It is a little alarming that Amazon has no procedure for pulling the salt from its shelves and checking the remaining jars.  The customer service rep at Amazon said she was sorry but unfortunately Amazon waits for a second person to complain before pulling a product.
Bought this for my hubby (he likes "different" food products). He really likes the product. A little expensive, but he's happy.

column9: The best cup of coffee I have ever had!
column10: Still smarting from the Community Coffee deal that I indulged in, I got right back on the horse in my quest for finding great coffee on Amazon.I have had a few weeks and gone through a full bag of this coffee, subjecting my family and friends to pots of coffee brewed with Eight O'Clock 50% Decaf Whole Bean Coffee.  Quotes from my victims:My mother-in-law, "I don't like decaf, are you sure this is decaf?  This is too good to be decaf."My father-in-law:  Asked for a second cup.  Honey, you never have a second cup of MY coffee!My cousin, "Oh my God...this is better than Dunkin' Donuts!"My cousin the next day, "Would you mind making some more of that delicious coffee?"My wife, who only used to drink Dunkin' Donuts coffee,: "Are you making coffee this morning?"What do I think?  It's the best cup of home-brewed coffee that I have ever had.  I am a big Dunkin' coffee fan, so I won't say it's better than DD....but it's very close if it isn't better!Keys to success:  "Use fresh, filtered water.  Use half and half or cream.  Grind the beans fresh.  Use a ratio of 1 1/2 tablespoons for each 6oz cup of coffee."If you haven't had this yet, do yourself a favor and give it a shot.  I guarantee that you will not be disappointed.Enjoy!

It's certainly convenient to have an out-of-the bag 50% Decaf bean, and the price is certainly right, BUT... I actually find this coffee to be fairly bland in taste.  I've tried adjusting the amounts, but I was unable to coax a really rich taste from these beans.  I have gone back to mixing Caf and Decaf myself.  (I just pour the Caf beans into one side of the burr grinder, and Decaf into the other side.)  Currently I'm mixing Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Co, Whole Bean Coffee, Decaf Private Reserve, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3) and Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend, Ground, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3), and this makes a pretty rich cup. column4: Lynn Hoffman, author:The Short Course in Beer
column10: The Eight O'Clock line of coffees has always represented extraordinary value. I had occasion to prepare a coffee tasting for a small group of wine-lovers a few years back. The contenders were Eight O'Clock Bokar blend, Illy Cafe's Famiglia blend and two blends from a very famous coffee shop chain that probably has a store within three blocks of your house.I asked the tasters to use wine descriptors to judge the coffees and then to  make a judgment of overall satisfaction. Of the 22 in the group,21 picked either the Illy or the Eight O'Clock in first place and all 22 picked one of them for second.This blend is one that we use at home for the afternoon or early evening cup when we don't want to be over-caffeinated. The flavor is truly balanced, slightly fruity with a hint of toasty chocolate. It's a medium-bodied blend, but you can concentrate it by using less water without harming the flavor.I strongly recommend using a plunger type french press coffee maker like Bodum Chambord 3-Cup Coffee Press or the unbreakableBodum Columbia 8-Cup Stainless-Steel Thermal Press Pot.Lynn Hoffman, author of The New Short Course in Wine and the extremely well balanced bang BANG: A Novel

column9: A flavorful Half Caf-- see update

I used these sprinkles to decorate cake pops for my daughter's first birthday.  The pink really stood out and sparkled against the white frosting. These crackers are actully pretty tasty. The drawback is that the package is very small and very expensive. They aren't THAT yummy to pay such a high price!

column9: Can't decide if they're better than nothing.
column10: I was so dying for a low carb cracker so I could enjoy some Atkin's approved tuna fish or egg salad on it, that I ordered four boxes of these crackers in different flavors. this is the strongest, most pungent licorice i've ever tasted! because of that, i cannot eat more than 3 pieces at a time. granted, that's why i like them, but if you are not a fan of overpowering aniseed taste, then this product is not for you.also dislike that corn syrup is the first ingredient on the list. this is perhaps the reason why these dogs are doggone sticky.. like another reviewer mentioned, these puppies stick to your teeth!but i love the cute doggie shapes, and eating them side by side with panda licorice, these drown the pandas out.i do like that panda licorice only has 4 ingredients though.. having a hard time choosing a favorite!

My husband is very fond of licorice. Our food co-op used to sell this variety but has changed to a different brand that contains wheat and other gluten. I was very thrilled to be able to find this here on Amazon. The best licorice ever and a wonderful Christmas gift for my Gluten sensitive husband.

column9: Great Food For Dogs With Stomach Issues
column10: We adopted our two year old, female german Shepherd, Cheyenne, from a local shelter last year. We knew nothing about her background or what she ate. I started with a dry food which our previous dog did very well on. Immediately, Cheyenne began having soft stools and diarhea. After a few weeks I tried another premium dry food... same results, soft-serve ice cream stools and sometimes watery stools. Months went by and I tried several other dry and wet foods and dietary supplements with little improvement. It drove me crazy! I took her to the vet and they did tests and ruled out worms, etc... and told me that German Shepherds are known to have stomach issues. Finally, I picked up a bag of Blue Buffalo Freedom / Grain Free... and Cheyenne loved it and her stools immediately firmed up! Most of the time her stools are very normal and firm now... sometimes they are a little soft... but nothing compared to before. I am so happy I tried Blue Buffalo Freedom. I hope that it works as well for you!

We have been using Blue since our dog was a puppy.  We adopted him and wanted to make sure we fed him as healthy as possible because I know it can cut down on vet bills in the long run.  Over time we have tried the different formulas, and when Freedom came out I decided to give it a try.  I love the grain-free aspect.  My dog is not a fast eater. He takes his time and savors every bit.  We do mix in real chicken and a dollop of cottage cheese.  He is 3 1/2 now.  He has had no major helath issues, is in excellent shape, gets all kinds of compliments on his coat, and we have people stop us all the time to tell us what a good looking dog he is.  (He is an Australian shepherd/possible cattle dog mix.) I wouldn't feed my family a bunch of chemicals and low grade ingredients, and my pets are like family.  Try it.  You may be surprised how much it can help your pet.

Blue Buffalo Freedom is both grain free and slightly higher in fiber (7%) compared to other standard and grain free foods (typically 3-4%). We adopted a 4 month old mixed Aussie Cattle/McNab and a 3 month old Shepherd/Lab mix from our Bay Area rescue group. Both pups were very healthy and energetic. Our Vet checks were good, and they settled into our home quickly. The only issue was with their digestion/stools. At first, hoped it was just stress, but it persisted for a few weeks. The premium food we selected was an upgrade from the cereal filled budget food they had at the shelter, but evidently, the richer protein level (29-32%) of "Taste of Wild" and "Premium Edge" did not go down well for both pups. While they appeared to enjoy the food, eating it all, it just never set well with them. We did put the pups on Science Diet (digestion special) for a short term, but the pups did not seem to like the food and it only partially appeared to solve their issue. After reading several reviews and noting that some people experienced issues with wheat or grain based food/treats, we decided to try Blue Buffalo Freedom for both the grain free and higher fiber ingredients. Magic! Both pups love the food, and digestion has been resolved. Stress still disrupts their system a bit, such as after a rigorous day at the park running and wrestling with other dogs, but their digestion clears up quickly. Note: We also limit their treats to non-grain/no wheat as much as possible. Natural Balance has mostly potato and meat based treats. Our only wish, Amazon would carry the Large Dog (orange label) Freedom version. We use kibble balls to keep the Aussie/McNab mix working, and the standard size kibble (blue label) is too small and pours out of the kibble ball. Cheers to Blue Buffalo Freedom and scoopable poop! Walking our dogs is no longer traumatic for everyone!

column9: A handy and versatile spice mix for your kitchen!
column10: I used to buy this stuff in tiny expensive packages at the grocery store, so I was very happy to find I could get it in larger and vastly more economical quantities at Amazon. It makes a great peanut sauce; mix it up with some coconut milk and boom! Quick and easy. I have also used it on baked chicken, fish, and vegetables, particularly a mixture of cauliflower, carrots, and broccoli. You just take your cut up veggies, toss them in a little oil or butter, coat them with the spice mix, and bake them until you think they're done. It really adds life to vegetables.

The tub price is far cheaper than buying individual packets at the store. We love this on pork chops. We found the recipe for 'peanut sauce' to be very nasty though. As an ingredient in the recipes found at the Taste of Thai web site, it's very handy.

I don't like to take the time to make the sauce with the coconut milk so I have started taking some of the spice in a ziplock bag and dropping my chicken legs or thighs to coat the chicken.  If fry it just like it is. It makes a great coating. Very tasty!
makes chicken taste so good .  Just coat it and Bake Better than some resturant peanut sauces.

This stuff makes be BEST peanut sauce, and used as coating for chicken, guarantees a happy family at dinner time.
We love this peanut sauce mix and have it for dinner a few times each month.  It's easy to make and tastes awesome.  Order some cans of coconut milk to go with this while you're at it!

column9: One of the better rice pastas
column10: If you aren't familiar with rice pasta or gluten-free pasta, you may have some problems with this unless you follow the instructions correctly. Because this is RICE, you MUST rinse it after cooking to wash away all of the starch created from cooking. And you must not overcook it or you'll have a sticky mess.(That's what rice does!)  I've had my share of failed cooking experiences with GF pasta because I didn't rinse it well enough or I overcooked it.  So now I know.  This is great tasting pasta.  The linguine is best since it holds more sauce.  The angel hair version is a little too delicate for my cooking experiences.  No one can tell it's not the regular pasta when I cook it for guests.  I sure don't get that bloated feeling after eating this, which makes sense since it's not a combination of ingredients that makes up glue!!!

It has very small particles in it, only one of my tea strainers captures them all.  The other two leave several particles in the bottom which is sad. column9: The first Rooibos I have ever liked
column10: This is the first rooibos tea I have tried that I like.  I have always found the flavor too, I don't know what it is...  This tea I actually got for my mother and figured why not brew one cup, I LOVE it, I will be ordering some for me. I added about 1 tsp tea to a cup of 191 degree water and steeped it for about 5 min.  It was absolutely yummie.

At home right now I have the following rooibos teas:Salada Green Tea with Red Antioxidants (strawberry-orange)Equal Exchange Wild RooibosPort Trading Cape RooibosZhena's Gypsy Red LavenderThese are all bagged teas.  In addition, I have some loose rooibos from a local tea specialty store called Virtuous Teas.Of all of these rooibos (or rooibos-containing) teas, the Teavana Tropica is the worst by far.Firstly, it is difficult to even tell if it contains any actual rooibos; any such flavoring is completely overwhelmed by citris.  Given that the tea is actually *called* a rooibos tea, I find this completely unnacceptable.It would be another matter if rooibos was simply listed as one of the ingredients.  For example, the Salada green tea I mentioned doesn't pretend to be a rooibos tea.  "Rooibos" is listed as a constituent (along with lycopene, anthocyanins and vitamin C), but the tea is called "Green Tea Fortified with Red Antioxidants."  Although the Salada tea is not called a rooibos tea, it is much richer in rooibos flavor than Teavana's so-called "Rooibos Tropica."  Teavana's tea should simply be called "Tropica" with rooibos listed as an ingredient (if there is any actual rooibos present ... I'm not convinced).Secondly, the tea's "tropical" constituents manage to produce a cloying experience in a tea that is otherwise too weak.  I have not been able to brew a pot that had any satisfying tea impact whatsoever -- it has always felt too weak regardless of how much tea I've used -- yet making it stronger simply imparts more of the bad tropical mix.  And the tropical mix *is* bad, as if I steeped some orange peels and random flower petals in hot water.This tea dissapoints on multiple levels.  Also, the fact that it is marketed as a rooibos tea will make me wary of any other Teavana offerings.

My favorite milk beverage. The local supermarkets don't stock this any more. Not sure why -- maybe it's old fashioned or something. Thanks to Amazon, I now have my malted milk again. The large container is about 3 times the size of the typical jar at the grocery store.This product is slightly different than the product sold in the plastic jar at the grocery store. The grocery store product dissolves instantly in cold milk, while this product does not. The ingredients seem to be the same. The trick I use is to put the powder in the empty glass and add a *very* small amount of milk. Mix until it's a thick liquid, and then fill the glass with milk while stirring.

column9: not the SAME product as the 'Jar' version
column10: I LOVE the malted milk carnation product and go thru it Like crazy-well while purchasing other items foolishly I just checked the Bulk Can assuming and seeing same name and ingredients-wellThe one I received I have TRIED to like but it has 'Whole Dry Milk' listed on ingredients-(the jar did not) and its too milky-well for me-I just wanted my old favorite-and now I will order that while 3 Huge bins of the item with same name and supposed ingredients will go into the trash-

This was my first time purchasing malted milk powder, so I can't really say how this measures up to other brands. But what I wanted was straight-up malted milk, not chocolate malt, not a milk shake, just malted milk and this got me there! I just add a couple tablespoons of the powder and a little bit of milk to a mug, microwave it for 20 seconds, stir, then add the rest of my ice cold milk and stir again. Boom! Awesome cold malted milk. Delicious. I fill kind of silly for buying this 2.5lb container (especially since I finally found a reasonable size at a local store). But hey, I'm sure I'll use it :)

This is one of the very few products that has maintained its quality and appeal over many, many years.  As a youngster I drank a mix of this malted milk with warm milk, but mostly I SNACKED on it in its powder form.  I still do!  Try it, it is absolutely delicious.  Specially great if you cannot have chocolate for allergy or some other reason.

column9: Doesn't taste the same as the 13 oz. size, but still good
column10: As noted by other reviewers, this product does not taste the same as the 13 oz. size.  I use a blender to make my shakes, and I found this 40 oz. product yields a thicker shake with a less malty flavor than would have been present with same amount of the 13 oz. jar product.  This may be good, bad, or otherwise, depending on how you feel about the difference.  As I would need more of this product to get the same malt flavor intensity as the 13 oz. size product, the benefit of the lower cost of the 40 oz. size is reduced if not completely eliminated.  Shame on Carnation for giving two products the same name ("Malted Milk Original") with different recipes.  This product is satisfactory.

I love the taste of this.  I started drinking a glass of milk before bed which helps with my insomnia, and the malt powder makes it taste so much better.  It is true that it doesn't dissolve well, but using a spoon for the lumps at the bottom of the glass....it is like dessert.  Like malt balls without the chocolate.  If you put the powder in the glass first with just a tiny bit of milk and make a paste before you add the rest of the milk, it works better, but like I said, I don't mind the lumps.  I suppose a blender would be the ticket if you want a smooth drink.  I don't know why more stores don't carry it.

column9: Old fashion soda fountin flavor, every kid from 5 to 75 loves this!
column10: There's nothing like introducing one to their first malted shake, about a lifetime ago at Berger's Pharmacy (N.Clark St. Chicago) when Dad split a chocolate malt with me, the wonderful taste and watching the shimmeringGreen River sign behind Mr. Berger.Over the years I have noticed malted milk powders are just obscure in many areas of the south and desert southwest, in a major city it's usually on the shelf.Now I'm using soy milk and the carnation malted mix is a good way to supplement nutrition not to mention flavor enhancement.

As a kid in the 40's and 50's it was such a wonderful treat to go to a neighborhood drugstore soda fountain with my mother and sister and order a chocolate malted milk served with two Salerno cookies wraped in celophane. The malted milk was mixed in a metal container that held probably 12 or more ounces milk, a scoop or two of icecream, chocolaet syrup and malt powder and could refill my glass after finishing the first. I found it in Amazon's grocery and gourmet food selections and have signed up for subscribe and save to make sure I always have it on hand. Now I heat soy milk and pour it into a cup with the malt powder and have a delicious, sentimental, warm, cozy and comforting bedtime treat.I'd better stop before I start to weep.

column9: Same as the ice cream stand uses
column10: I saw the local ice cream stand use this brand in the same container to make my milkshakes and they were yummy. We like to make milk shakes at home so I thought I would get some of this. If you like malt this is yummy. It is hard to mix as it doesn't desolve very well at all. So I bought the KitchenAid KHB100ER Hand Blender and presto no more problems.P.S. I've ben wanting to get the hand blender so this gave me a good excuse to buy it. Excellent product with lots of uses.

I wanted to purchase a 2 lb 8-Oz Carnation Malted Milk as I drink it every day.  It is a pain to buy smaller (8-Oz) packages as I have to go to the super markets sometimes just to buy it.  Carnation malted Milk is delicious with milk or with tea and milk.  I cannot do without it and I drink it after every meal.

I always loved malted milk shakes, and this is the key ingredient! However, since I do not have a blender, I have been taking several scoops of ice cream in a bowl, melting it part way in my microwave, then adding a few tablespoons of this malt to the top. I then add a little milk and mix it in with the melted ice cream. The malt doesn't mix well, but it's still quite delicious! Some of the milk even freezes by the solid ice cream, which adds a little extra texture to the mix. Try it!

column9: Tastes Great and Good for You
column10: Barley malt is naturally sweet and good for you.  No added sugar.  What's not to like?  Great in milk or milkshakes.

column9: GREAT PRODUCT, GREAT PRICE, FAST DELIVERY!
column10: I love this malted milk; hot or cold. If you compare the price of the 13oz container to this 40oz, you know it is a good deal. I was amazed at the speed at which I received the product.  I will definitely shop here again, and again, and again. 100% and totally happy with this purchase.

column9: NEW PACKAGING FOR A GOOD PRODUCT
column10: I have reviewed this product when i got it in the 3 13oz jars of it for a similar price. now it is all in one can. i use it enough so it is a better container for me.  less plastic to toss out , too. the other container looked and is shaped just like all the other Carnation coffee/tea condiments and can easily be mistaken in a quick grab.  so, this has to minor plus attributes . I like the product so I am satisfied and 2.5lbs is the same avoir du pois no matter how it comes to me. (though this may be an oz shy of the 3 containers if they did have 13ozs per.  i actually forget and have none around and too lazy to go check to see if that option is still available.if you like a malted milk product this is a good one. Different from some but still a consistent brand at a favorable  price.

I was searching for a Horlicks  type powder which I can put in Milk for Toddlers. They don't  like Chocolate flavors. Here in US Horlicks is very expensive and not completely dissolve in the  milk. I got this product initially while I'm shopping from winco. I tried this and my kids love this. The taste and smell is amazing..Great product ..Thank you Nestle
More malt for my malted milkshakes. Came as promised; 2.5 pounds of deliciousness. Can was sealed, no dents or dings.  Not sure what else to say about a can of malt...

Hate to say this but this was a huge yuck factor for me. I used it to help thicken my protein shakes without adding an enormous amount of calories. SURE it thickened it but it has the oddest taste ever. It taste like it smells and it smells like some sort of vitamin. I had this on auto-ship and I took it off. This is gonna last forever, because I only use a teaspoon. yucky... and i love carnation products, but this is a fail!

There is a huge problem with these crackers.  I can't limit myself.  I can't describe the taste except to say it is addictive.  I am not a cracker lover.  These  are the first crackers I have bought a second time.  Now I get them on auto delivery.  They are light, crisp, and incredibly tasty.

I tried this after a co-worker of mine bought a bunch of these boxes (because she liked the low fatness of it) and they were delicious.I ended up buying 4 boxes and between my mom and me, all 4 were gone in less than two weeks. There's something about the seasoning/salt and crispness of it that makes it so addicting.

I've grown up with Nabisco products all my life.  Never had anything not good from them. This product was no different.  Just enough of a herb taste without being overpowering.  My main problem was that it wasn't shipped properly and I ended up with pieces instead of long flatbread.  I would buy the product again.

column9: if you like your crackers to taste like crispy cookies
column10: Saw a commercial about a new Flatbread product, thought I had to have it. I was so disappointed. First of all I'm not a wheat thins person, so maybe if you love wheat thins you'll like this. I'm Italian so I was thinking more along the lines of flatbread from Italy. Pretty gullible, right? Just because the product is called Tuscan flatbread, doesn't mean there is anything even remotely similar. My biggest gripe is the amount of sugar that is used. They are CRACKERS, not COOKIES! I couldn't get past the SWEET flavor. I spit it out. Why does everything have to have so much sugar?! We do have other taste buds in our mouth. Order them if you're just expecting elongated wheat thins and NOT if you really want flatbread.

The crackers looked tasty so I bought two different flavors.  They're great tasting but unfortunately about half of the long flatbreads in each box were broken.  Don't know if this is an ongoing problem or if I just picked up two boxes that somebody had dropped.  If I was entertaining and opened the box to see so many cracked, I would be sorely disappointed as they would be unusable.  Hope they fix the packing problem.

column9: Tastes the same as regular with less calories
column10: I have to admit to liking Alfredo Pasta Sauce. I don't have it often but have a jar in the fridge for emergencies when I have no time to cook. Jarred sauce is not as good as home made, but I find Classico taste acceptable and it is a time saver.I have had the traditional Classico Creamy Alfredo (with the red label) in the past, and when I saw a "lite" version of Classico Creamy Alfredo in a local supermarket I decided to give it a try.  I found that the lite version tasted the same to me as the regular Creamy Alfredo sauce when mixed with pasta. Regular Classico Creamy Alfredo has 100 calories and 9 grams of fat per serving (a serving is a quarter of a cup).  Classico Lite Creamy Alfredo has has 40 calories and 4 grams of fat for the same quarter cup serving.  Tastes the same with less calories - I will use it again!Ali Julia review

column9: One of the best things that Dave's makes
column10: I am a big fan of this mustard.  It has a balance not often seen in hot sauces and condiments.  It is a little sweet for my taste but that can be remedied.First let me say that, unlike some of Dave's other products, this one does not include "hot pepper extract".  Instead we get our heat from "Red Chili Peppers, Mustard Seed, Habanero Peppers and Paprika".  In my opinion this adds flavor instead of just raw fire.I have used this product (sometimes as an addition to other sauces) on swordfish, inside of hamburger meat, on assorted grilled sausages, on deep fried chicken drummies, on top of corned beef (with horseradish of course) and several other meats.  I sometimes "kick-it-up-a-notch" by adding one of Dave's hot sauces, that and a little vinegar will tame the sweetness.  All in all a very good mustard.  Four stars from me!

Put simply, many of my friends have tried it and everyone loves it! Great taste with a nice kick. ordering of the  2nd batch is underway.only problem with this honey mustard is they do not have it at any local supermarketsBest tasting honey mustard I have ever tried!

My new pretzel dip.  I've tried it on a burger and it was okay.  A sweet flavor and in my book fairly mild heat.  I grow some habenera peppers so I'm used to considerable heat... this mustard is not that hot to me.  It does have an excellent flavor and I bought pretzels just so I could snack on this mustard more often.

column9: I base entire meals around getting to use this honey mustard
column10: This sauce is mild on the scale of hotness when it comes to condiments, but it is extremely flavorful.  I like it best on fried chicken.  The first time I ever tried this sauce was actually at Ike's Crab Cakes on the Ocean City boardwalk in Ocean City, NJ--and I think I'd been craving it, since.  It adds so much to a meal that I would have no qualms about shoving it into my coat pocket and taking it with me to restaurants.It's sweet like honey mustard, but not so much that it overpowers the peppers.  It sounds almost exotic to people who've never tried it when you describe it to them, but the ones I've met have unanimously agreed that they find this sauce agreeable.  :)Seriously, try it--if only to satisfy your curiousity.  This makes a great gift for anyone who is a fan of Dave's.
This product is worth every penny. It tastes good on everything, and makes everything taste better. Its like bacon. (Not bacon flavored just making a comparison of excellence)

column9: Dave's Hurtin Habanero Mustard Is Awesome
column10: This stuff is so good its practicly addictive! Awesome on brautworsts! You have to try this!!!

column9: Perfect Blend of sweet and spicy
column10: Good balance of tangy mustard, slow heat from the pepper, and a mild sweetness that ties it all together
FOR MYSELF, THIS WAS TOO HOT. BUT MY HUSBAND JUST LOVES IT. HE PUTS IN ON ALMOST EVERYTHING HE EATS NOW. I'LL HAVE TO ORDER SOME MORE SOON. GREAT PURCHASE. IF MY HUBBY IS HAPPY, SO AM I. THANK YOU.
I found this tea very good, especially made into ice tea.  I used the sun tea method and it worked great.  Makes yummy hot tea too.

This gift helps everyone. I gave Women's Bean soups, dips, and salsas to my extended family for Christmas.  Everyone loved the gift- it simplified my shopping, and I felt like I was helping those who really need the help.

I've tried most of the baked potato chips made by Popchips, so I figured I'd give these a try. They're delicious! These tortilla chips are just as good if not better than their non-healthy counterparts. The ranch tortilla chips are my favorite so far, but the chili limon and nacho cheese are very good as well. I highly recommend trying these tortilla chips!

I am a HUGE fan of Pop Chips and buy them regularly so I was excited to see them add a new product to their line. I was so excited I went ahead and ordered bulk from Amazon. Unfortunately, it was wasted money. They taste very odd. I wish I had a better word to describe it. When I realized I didn't like them I put them in the community kitchen at work for anyone who was interested. Word has gotten around from those who tried them and also didn't like them and now they're just sitting in there. :-(  To be clear, I absolutely LOVE regular Pop Chips. It's just this tortilla version that needs to go back to the drawing board.

I stumbled across these new tortilla style chips by popchips and decided I have to try them.  I really like most of the traditional popchips flavors (potato version).  I would honestly say that all four flavors of these new tortilla style are exactly what I expected from popchips.  They are all excellent and go well with the style of chip too.  The texture of these will take some getting used to for me, but I would say it's pretty good (that's why I've given it 4 stars).  It's definitely worth a try and perfect for someone looking for a healthy alternative to regular tortilla chips (and if you get the 24 pack, preportioned into 1 oz 120 calorie bags).  I'll certainly be getting more, and it's nice to have a little variation of healthy chips!

Love popchips!  The new tortilla chips are delicious!  I take a bag with me to school as part of my afternoon snack. The nacho cheese flavor is my favorite. If you are already a fan of popchips, you'll love the tortilla chips.  :-)

I tried the variety pack and there wasn't one flavor that I really thought was outstanding.  While I love Pop Chips, these were just ok, and to be truthful if I'm going to order anything again, it'd be Pop Chips and not the Tortilla Chips.
This is a great substitute for Doritos and satisfies that chip craving!  Great healthy snack and would highly recommend it!
I liked the light "popped" texture of these chips, and the flavors were pretty good. There is usually one flavor in a variety pack that no one wants, but they were all decent flavors.

These chips are so good.  I am never going back to fried chips again.  There are so many flavors to choose from and each one is just as good as the others.  I am very very impressed and I hope these stay on the market a long time.

I'd been eating the BBQ Pop Chips for a couple years now and love them, so I decided to try these.  Not my favorite, but my husband thinks they are great, so all is not lost.  I'm giving them 4 stars because I don't think they really taste like tortilla chips, but they are lower in fat and calories and have lots of flavor.

column9: Loved them and nice change from the chips
column10: The whole family loved these and it was a nice change from the chips.  All the flavors were good.  I'd definitely buy again  The favorite is the Chile Lime and Salsa.  Don't hesitate to give the a try.

column9: More flavor & better texture than Potato PopChips
column10: I bought some of the Potato PopChips & some of the Tortilla chips in the flavor variety pack.  I felt the potato were good, but the texture was odd, the taste was onlt from the powder, and it absorbed the water from my mouth & stuck to my tongue.  Only the BBQ Popchip was really really good.I would buy both kinds again, but only one is better than chips available in the store.I really liked the TORTILLA POPCHIPS!  They have a corn flavor, it has the texture of a puffed up corn chip, and it's not sticky in the mouth.  I'm not a big fan of powdered flavors, but I didn't mind these so much.  I enjoyed the nacho, ranch, salsa, and chili lemon tortilla PopChips.
My whole family loves these chips.  They taste great, are not greasy, and come in convenient sized little bags.  I'll be back to buy more.

column9: Great new low fat, healthy snack option
column10: I have been taken with the Popchips that are a potato base since discovering them 1 year ago but then saw an ad for Tortilla chips made by Popchips in 4 flavors.  I immediately ordered them because I love chips and salsa and always feel so guilty eating "real" chips with it. These arrived and I have tried all flavors and love them all. They are 3 Weight Watchers Points Plus so fit well into a weight control plan. Highly recommend them.

I've been enjoying the regular Popchip varieties for some time now.  When these became available, I had to try them.  Even though there are only four flavors, they are varied enough to be satisfying.  I like the light and airy texture.  I think the taste is better than the baked tortilla chips that are available.  However, without flavoring, I don't think they could stand on their own as a plain tortilla chip.
Love that I have a healthier option for flavored tortilla chips that actually tastes good!  Can't wait to try them in a taco salad!  Will be buying again!

column9: I GIVE POPCHIPS A HANDS DOWN FOR THIS PRODUCT.
column10: I love the regular PopChips, especially the Salt and Vinegar.  Was happy when these became avilable on Amazon.  I decided to try the variety box so I could taste all the flavors.  What a mistake, these are the worst things ever.  They have a terrible after taste.  I took them to work for our break area, and I only received bad comments from people.  I believe PopChips messed up with these.  Will definitely not purchase again, nor will my friends.

I like the original pop chips, and I love tortilla chips, so when I saw this product I thought it would be a slam dunk.  But no.  These chips taste very....off.  They taste like no other tortilla chip I've ever tasted.  Nor do they taste like the original pop chips.  They have an odd cardboard texture with a weird aftertaste.  I would avoid this stuff.

column9: A great idea for a chip but no flavor
column10: I have eaten the other pop chips and thought that these tortilla chips would be an exact match to the doritos and other junk food that my kids eat. But to my surprise these tortilla chips have no flavor. In the first bag it was all in the bottom of the bag. So the second back I shook the bag well to coat the chips and to no avail there still was no flavor. So if flavor is what you are looking for you do not want these but if you just want a low cal chip for a snack or with a sandwich then these are it.
Liked all varieties. More flavor than expected. Would definitely recommend. Makes a great low cal snack. My husband also enjoyed them.
My family says these taste like regular tortilla chips.  Will definitely buy again.  Worth a try for those who have not yet done so.

I eat Popchips every day! So yeah I was a little excited when I saw they came out with Tortilla Popchips... IMO they nailed it! It is crunchy but indeed slightly puffy compared to a normal tortilla chip. I don't find the puffyness to make any difference in comparison to a regular tortilla chip though. I just read another reviewer saying these don't taste like corn tortilla chips and I couldn't disagree more. These have a great fresh corn tortilla chip taste. Basically these taste like a great tortilla chip but without any greasy feeling or taste. As far as the flavors go that's going to be subjective. Nacho cheese Doritos had always been a favorite of mine before Popchips and I think the nacho cheese Popchips are a great alternative. Sorry Doritos, too much fat. Ranch is good also and I'd rank it 2nd out of the 4. As far as the limon and salsa they don't stand out as favorites but I have no complaints and they're nice to have for variety.
I highly recommended pop chips for those salty cravings.  Low fat, baked not fried and very satisfying. The tortilla chips are a welcome addition to the pop chip line.

I can't rave enough about the original popchips.. but these taste like flavored cardboard. I was only able to stomach the cheese flavor. I don't recommend and not sure what you are getting over the original other than a triangle vs. a circle.

I am a bit torn on these Popchips Tortilla style. I really liked the original Popchips with the different flavors and textures but the tortilla do not seem a good replacement for real tortilla chips and the flavors seem a little too light and washed out. After all real tortilla chips with real salsa is great and better for you too... bean dip not as good and cheese might be the worst (health wise not taste).

I have been a fan of the potato Popchips for a while, and I think I like these even better.  Just the perfect amount of saltiness for me. I ordered the variety pack and actually liked all of the four flavors.  The ranch flavor chips remind me a bit of Bugles, which I haven't tasted in years.  Odd that memory came back to me!

column9: unfortunatly not nearly as good as Pop Chips Potato based chips
column10: I really like Pop Chips potato based chips so I thought I'd take a chance on the corn "masa" based chips. I ordered this 4 flavor combo pack. Now I admit I don't like all flavors of potato based pop chips; FWIW cheddar and salt & pepper are my favorite. These corn based chips are not very good which is unfortunate as I bought a case of 12. I knew it was a gamble, but hey, I live in Las Vegas...It is hard to pinpoint exactly where these chips fall short. Too me they seem very salty, although each serving is only 6% to 8% of sodium RDA. The nacho cheese flavor is the most tolerable of the four flavors, although it does not taste much like cheese. The ranch flavor tastes very artificial (although these are naturally flavored). The chili limon and salsa flavors are just okay. The chili limon flavor is rather bland and does not have much chili or lemon-lime flavor but it also does not seem as artificial or overly salty. In sum, I could eat a few of the nacho cheese, chili lime, and salsa but could not stand the ranch. Perhaps a plain, corn flavor would have been better that these heavily flavored, salty tasting chips.Of course personal tastes vary so much, but to me these are not very satisfying snacks especially compared to potato pop chips. I would not buy them again but I thought I should post a review since I already played the roll of guinea pig.

I purchased this item when all of Popchip's products were on sale. I chose this item specifically because I wanted to try the "Chili Limon" flavor. When I tried this flavor, I was extremely disappointed. This flavor, along with the other three flavors, has the texture of cardboard. The flavoring itself, is very light, hence "tastes like flavored cardboard."I understand that these are not tortilla chips; however, I LOVED all of the flavors in the Popchips 11-Flavor Variety Pack, 0.8-Ounce Single Serve Bags (Pack of 24) that I bought at the same time. BEWARE! The potato chips and tortilla chips have totally different texture and flavor. I will not buy these again.The only reason this got 2 stars instead of 1 is that the ranch flavor was "okay."

column9: Popchips potato chips are better than the tortilla chips
column10: Popchips potato chips are better than the popchips tortilla chips. The tortilla chips have a strange consistency. It is almost like you are biting into a dry sponge

I love the regular style Pop Chips so when these were a Deal of the Day I grabbed a case of them. That was a mistake because these are gross. We had a party that weekend and put several flavors of this style of Pop Chip out and no one liked them. I have no idea what I'm going to do with all of them. I guess I'll take them to work because those people will snack on anything when it's free!

these chips are a little too different for me - if what you are looking for is a tortilla - like chip, you should keep shopping.  I like popchips potato chips, because they taste like potato chips.  These don't really taste like corn tortilla chips - they are too airy - the texture just doesn't work for me.  I don't think they would work well for dips, either - they seem like they would break.

column9: Great service for hard to find product
column10: I purchased this along with Applemon and am VERY happy with how promptly it arrived and am THRILLED that I can now just order this right here on Amazon instead of driving myself crazy looking for it in stores that don't carry it anymore. The price is great, too. Funky Monkey has had me hooked for years. What makes it different from other freeze-dried fruits out there is that it is actually full of flavor.

It hardly matters what Grandma thinks, my granddaughter LOVES this product.  When I give it to her, she thinks it is tantamount to chocolate. She does not have to know it is good for her. In addition, I find dried fruit becomes soggy very shortly after opening here in damp Florida (even if resealable), so the small size is portable in my purse and she can eat the tiny bag in one sitting. This is a GREAT product.

I read some of the bad reviews for this product and was concerned, however, I ordered it anyway.....I am so glad I did.  This snack is delicious.  I'll agree with some viewers that it gets sticky in your mouth and gums up your teeth.....but it's temporary and your mouth clears out quickly so it's no big deal...at least not for me.  I bought this also because my grandson is highly allergic to most foods on the market unless they are fresh fruits and vegetables so this gives him a little variety.  They are easily packed away in his diaper bag for snacks during the day.  I do wish it wasn't as expensive as it is.....but....seems everything that is exceptional in life cost too much.

These are crunchy as they claim, but it's more of any "airy" texture. It's hard to explain. But I was expecting them to be like dried fruit but instead of chewy, they would be crunchy. They're not. The peices aren't even solid looking. They look like pork rinds. It's really strange to be eating fruit that looks fried instead.  The taste however is fine. It does taste like banana and cinnamon. And while I will finish the box I bought, I will definitely not be buying these again.

column9: Easy open for kids, portable and tasty
column10: Great product.  Kids love this flavor, we have tried almost all of them.  I have these to send in lunch boxes and to use when we are out on trips.  Great plus is they are processed in the USA, which some of the dried fruits are not.

column9: MY KIDS LOVE THIS AND SO DO I!!
column10: My kids love this snack and I love giving it to them because it's so nutritious.  It's great to replenish their nutrients after gymnastics or soccer. I even brought it as the team snack to my daughter's soccer game, and all the kids loved it, especially the ones with food allergies who normally can't join in on the snack selection.  Can't wait to try all the other flavors!!

I got a great deal on these when there was a coupon code out for them, but I regret my purchase.  No one in my family likes them, so they're still sitting in my pantry.  The flavor isn't great, and they stick in my teeth something awful. The Bananamon is the only flavor I've ever tried, but I'm not inclined to try any others.

i don't know about the previous posters, but i'm new to diet sodas and this one is the best i've tasted to date!  maybe years of them gulping down diet Coke's has fried their taste buds because i love the flavor... dare i say it tastes like a regular coke minus the diet?  this is a favorite for me so i suggest at least giving it a try!
Due to health I have not enjoyed a soda for years. I truly like this! It is a good sub for those with diet restrictions!

Diet coke is a can of chemicals, and I love it. Same with Diet Pepsi.  So as the last bad staple of my diet, I gave them up.  Then I tried Hansen's and the flavor of this cola continued to grow on me until I love the natural flavors much more than the artificial ones.  So I only drink Hansen's now with an occasional Coke or Pepsi when I'm out.  Hansen's is just better.

I just finished the last can in the package of twenty-four, so I think I've given it a fair try. I've also just finished reading the reviews, so I gave it two-stars instead of the one-star I came here to post, but that's as far as I can go.This product is completely unremarkable--"bland," someone else said. Precisely. Although I did manage to finish all twenty-four cans, there will never be a twenty-fifth. There are just too many other things I can drink--like water--to ever return to this. Sorry, but while it's not "spitting out" bad, as is another diet drink I know of, it's just not something worth any further consideration.  There's just no point in comparing it to Coke. Coke has character, this stuff is just a waste of time.

column9: Not bad! A little too sweet though.
column10: As far as diet soda goes, it's very good. A strong ginger taste with a perfect level of fizz. It's a little sweet for my liking (it has a lot of artificial sweetener). To explain, the sweetness level is closer to "Coke Zero" or "Pepsi Max" rather than "Diet Coke" or "Diet Pepsi", but overall Hansen brand is good and very different than the traditional store brands.

I've probably tried just about every diet cola out there. My favorite has always been Tab, but I do worry about the health effects of drinking too much.This is a good alternative. I was very pleased with the taste. It doesn't taste like Tab. However, I found it to be similar to Diet Pepsi but with more flavor. It seemed that I detected a cinnamon taste which added an interesting spicy taste. Very good.

So, I got Hansen's soda on a price error. I'm glad I tried it because I really enjoyed it. Make sure it's extremely ice cold when you drink it because if you don't, the flavors won't taste right. I'll admit that drinking a can that wasn't completely cold was a bit unpleasant. However, I'm glad I tried it and thought it was good. I think the HEB sells a 6 pack for 4-5 dollars so this may be a cheaper alternative for some.
This soda is as good as coke and potentially more healthfull. I would recomend that anyone interested in it should try it.

column9: For the price?  Can't beat it.
column10: I managed to get this when Amazon listed it at an obscenely low price, to the point where I could not justify NOT getting it.  I was intrigued by the no caffeine part.  We are name-brand soda drinkers by nature and design, so this was way off the beaten path for us.It tastes a bit flat.  Definitely not like pepsi or coke.  that said, it is a reasonable diet drink.  Would I purchase it again?  Probably not, but it was worth it to give it a try.

column9: Acceptable Altnerative to Other Diet Colas
column10: I enjoy a wide range of Hansen's diet sodas, and am usually quite pleased with the product quality and taste.  The cola is probably my least favorite of their diet sodas, possessing a sharp after taste similar to any other diet cola I have tried.  If taste is your primary concern, I would recommend the more common brands as they are typically cheaper, and store brands taste as good as this one.  If you are concerned about the choice of sweetner, which is what lead me to Hansen's products as they use sucralose, than you may wish to pay the extra price and live with the taste.Overall, this is not a bad product, but may not be worth the extra money if taste is your most important factor, and this is clearly not their best diet soda product.

I was hoping to approximate diet Coke.  Hansen's hasn't got the zip.  A little too much nutmeg flavor, and not enough carbonation.  Wish they'd reformulate, because I like the Splenda sweetener.  And, maybe add some caffeine too.
Arctic Zero definately satisfies your craving for ice cream but it does lack flavor.  Although you can taste what the flavor is supposed to be, i think it should be a little more intense.
This ice cream is super delicious and the best part is, LOW CALORIE!!!!!!!!!!! Ice cream without the guilt???? That is my dream come true!!!!

I thought this would be awesome.... product didn't taste bad initially.... but cleaned me out.... and NOT in a good way... went to throw out the rest... and it defrosted but didn't lose it's shape in the sink!  That made me even more sick!  What in the world was in that product?
Luckily I liked the product that was sent to me but it was not what I ordered. I wanted the chocolate and coffee  and received the strawberry and vanilla maple.

I suppose if you had a good imagination, you could convince yourself you're eating ice cream. However, my imagination is not that good. In a word, this product is tasteless.  I usually do not eat ice cream and I did not expect this to taste like ice cream. I was simply looking for a low calorie frozen dessert. But this is not a substitute for anything edible, low calorie or otherwise.

I found Heinz baked beans on Amazon by chance a year or so ago and since then, my British-born husband and I have been thrilled to see all the latest offerings that have turned up from over the pond. Item was very well-packed, arrived quickly, and was the original.  My husband broke into the jar within hours of its arrival.

column9: I can't live without Branston Pickle!
column10: Branston Pickle is basically the UK's version of our sweet relish. It's chunkier and brown, due to ground raisins and spices being in it. It is also called "Ploughman's Pickle" and is an integral part of a traditional "ploughman's lunch." That consisted of a thick slice of bread with a slab of cheddar and a thick slice of onion that farmers would wrap up to take with them in the field. When it was time to eat, they'd pull out a jar of Branston Pickle to top it with. There is nothing better IMHO than an open faced sandwich with Branston Pickle, aged cheddar and fresh tomato slices, broiled until bubbly. Yum!

I couldn't believe it when I saw these on Amazon. I hadn't seen them in 25 years, since my teens. They've got a great, creamy-honey filling and are still as good as I remembered them.
I love these things - whenever I'm in NYC, I make a point of going to the one store I know that sells them and buying 5-6 packs for $1 apiece - now I can just order them in!
Honees are great for throat irritation caused by allergies.  They are a life saver when you want to remove yourself from the discomfort of slight allergy symptoms.

I can carry them with me wherever I go.  So convenient.  I will continue to purchase this product.  I enjoy the ease of the direct shipment.  Thank you.

Really good flavor! Better than the ones without milk. [The milk gives it a sweet sugar sensation]. No high fructose corn syrup or hydrogenated oils. Expensive price but once you try one it won't matter anymore. Highly recommended! If you like honey you will absolutly LOVE these to death!

i have found my new best friend. super fast shipping was only the beginning. these taste just like a piece of caramel with honey melting on your tongue.the price is perfect. i got these on subscribe and save. i have to hide them from my mother. i gave her a pack and before you know it she is looking for more.

I've been ordering these for a few years now and find the flavor is always wonderful.  They can be chewed once warmed up or just enjoy for a few minutes.  Both the plain and milk varieties are great.  Yum.

Halves and generous-sized pieces are perfect additions to cereals, salads, or just plain healthy snacking.I bought them for a convent and the sisters (and guests) love them. I am not much of a baker but I made these to bring into the office. They were a great hit. For this mix, all you have to add is a little water and you end up with yummy, chewy, coconut macaroons. The flavor is good - not too sweet or fake coconut tasting. I followed the optional directions on the box to dip in melted chocolate and they turned out great. Highly recommend.

My family loves these cookies. They are quick to make, and they are really delicious -- especially to come from a mix. They are moist and brown just right. Some of the people in my family don't like chocolate, so I'm always looking for desserts that don't include chocolate as an ingredient. These fit the bill.
This is the best Coconut Macaroon Cookie Mix that I have ever tasted!  It is SCRUMPTIOUS!  & so EASY!!!!
These cookies tasted great initially however they had a very unusual and unpleasant aftertaste.  I would not advise buying this mix.

A while back, I ordered one of each of every tea-tree foot/body powder I could find, to try them all out. I was looking for a natural alternative to the various anti-fungal medicated powders I'd been using for athletes-foot and jock-itch.On first glance I was unimpressed by this product. It's rather plain looking, and the label is even kinda wrinkled up like it was badly glued onto the cardboard tube.HOWEVER, after evaluating all of the powders, this one is BY FAR my favorite one!The first thing you'll notice is that it doesn't poof clouds of powder everywhere. Secondly, it has a pleasant tea-tree oil scent - not too strong - just right. It does an excellent job of cooling, relieving itch, and healing and preventing chafing.It is labeled as foot powder, and it does that job well, but it's great for an allover body powder - not too strong even for the "sensitive" areas!

These are the best mints this side of fairyland! If you're looking for "anything BUT Tinkerbell" then this is a FAIRY special find for your birthday party. You get 150 tiny and tasty rose-flavored mints in a keepsake pocket tin. Kids love the rosy flavor (they are not really "minty"), so they make a great favor for kids too.Buy this novelty candy for the fairy lover in your life.NOTE: While pictured as pastel colored mints, the colors are really very vibrant blues and greens with hot pink and not many white candies.

column9: Very cute, but this is only for one tin of mints!
column10: I searched the item information trying to figure out how many tins I was going to get for $7, thinking it surely would be more than one. column9: Not bad, but you can do better
column10: Good, but you can make your own for a whole lot less. The mix is "just add water", but you can dispense with the artificial creamer by using milk instead: mix a tablespoon ea. of "Dutch processed" cocoa and sugar, 1/8'tsp ea. of salt & cinnamon, and a dash of cayenne pepper in a mug, add 1-2Tbs water and make a paste. Microwave for 1 min @ 70%, fill cup with milk, mix well and microwave for 2½ min on high. After the first heating, the paste should be thick; watch the second heating toward the end, cooking time may vary and you don't want it to boil over. Adjust spices to taste.

Overall, I like this spiced cocoa. It's good plain in hot water, or mixed with my coffee, no need for sugar(though i do use a lot). However, I do not feel there is a specific this-spice taste to it. There isn't a there's-the-cinnamon (which is why i bought it) or that's-real-vanilla-in-there moment, but it definitely isn't just chocolate. Since I have never had REAL mexican hot chocolate, I can't say this is like the real deal. I am still looking for a good cinnamon hot chocolate mix, but I would buy this again.Shipping is the reason there are 5 stars. It may have just been luck to arrive so quickly but this product showed up exactly 14 days after I bought it. I am located on a Navy ship, in the middle of the ocean, opposite the USA. If you have read any of my other product reviews you may think I only write negatively about the things I purchase at Amazon. With hundreds of purchases and limited time I figure the good products don't need my help but the mediocre or poor products waste unsuspecting folks hard earned money. That bothers me so I rate this brand of dog cookies only 2 stars.  I have purchase most of the major dog cookie brands as I am pretty particular about what I feed my dogs. This cookie is over priced for what is in it and how small they are. There is no steak or meat used for flavoring only beef broth and grains, which is fine but the price for a small bag compared to other brands that use ground meats for flavoring is out of line. The ingredient list was missing online so I took the chance they might live up to the Steak Frites name and price. They smell good and do have wholesome grains and no fillers but so do many other brands that give you more for your dollar. The cookies are quite hard and I would not recommend them for senior dogs who have dental problems or missing teeth.
Among all the flavors of this brand of dog treats, this is the best. The dogs love it!

I purchased these treats because it's our friends dogs that were on the bag. Amazon does mention that actual product packaging may be different than what is shown on their website, but we really wanted the exact bags that were shown. I am not into the energy drink fad with Red Bull and 5 Hour Energy, etc, but I recently ordered a Refresher from a local Starbucks and really liked it.  I think it was the Very Berry Hibiscus.  I then ordered a 12 pack from Amazon and like all three flavors with the Raspberry being my favorite of the 3.  I like the uplift I get from the drink and plan on ordering more in the future. They are expensive, but they have replaced my need to drink diet colas except I don't slug down a refresher as often.  4 out of 5 stars because of cost.

Arived as expected. Same great taste as you would get straight from Starbucks themselves...My favorite is the strawberry and lemonade. Only wish I could order only one taste at a time and not all three.

column9: Honey Is Sweet and So Are Honees
column10: If you like honey as much as I do, then you know that when you need a quick sweetness fix, you can just pop the top on the honey and have a taste. That's not so convenient when you're in the middle of Macy's, riding the subway, or suffering through a long, boring lecture. Honees to the rescue!What are Honees? I'm glad you asked. Honees are way at the top of my list of sweet rewards, the treats I have because I deserve them. They are little brick-shaped hard candies, golden in color, with a center of pure, liquid honey. The hard candy shell tastes like honey, but the payoff is when it melts, delivering that pleasing burst of sweetness. So delightful, they move me to poetry (I love Honees, yes I do; if you love honey, you'll love them, too. Okay, I get it, enough with the poetry).Honees are not available everywhere, but they are available to everyone in the forty-eight contiguous states through Amazon.com, my go-to source of hard-to-find groceries.  Manufactured in Italy by G. B. Ambrosoli, they are imported to the United States by Andre Prost, Inc.  Each luscious piece contains only twenty calories of unadulterated yumminess. There are nine individually wrapped pieces in each "bar," twenty-four bars per box. Besides the allure of their flavor, Honees are a lot more manageable than a pot of honey in your pocket.

column9: fantabulastical! Make sure to order 2 boxes

column9: always great to have on hand
column10: i always have a pack of the honey candies on hand. they taste great as a hard candy and are wonderful when i have a sore throat with the honey centers.
