column10: The sardines contained in the cans are large and the tomato sauce is thick. Have used them in many Asian dishes with excellent results.

These brought back fond childhood memories of my Mom's Sardine Spaghetti Sauce (Pasta con Sarde) served with whatever pasta struck her fancy :) Back in those days you HAD to eat fish every Friday AND a few other Holy Days throughout the year. When I look back I see my Mom's immigrant background intertwined BOTH nourishment of the body and spirit. Sardines in tomato sauce, olive oil or mustard found their way to our table and NO ONE was overweight inspite of the pasta at many meals. I joke with my son and tell him this was our go-to meal like Tuna Noodle Casseroles for others ;)These are pretty good. They are whole and are great on crackers too. For the uninitiated/squeamish, you may want to debone the sardines first, but you are removing one of the best natural sources of calcium when you do. Check out the web for recipes for Spaghetti with Sardines, a can or two with garlic, olive oil and a little more pasta/tomato sauce and a pound of pasta and you're ready to roll...healthy and cheap!These little fellows found their way into homemade salad dressings, although not nearly as good as the anchovies in a fantastic Ceaser's Salad but yummy too. I've deboned them, mashed and mixed them into Salsa for Salsa and Chips. This on Manager's Special was thirty three bucks comes out to 2.35 per pound of protein with NO unhealthy fat...but watch your sodium.

column9: Great for a convenient cup of coffee!
column10: I have a small single cup coffee maker for those times when I need a quick cup of coffee but don't want a whole pot.  All right, that doesn't happen very often - I can usually handle a whole pot.  But when I want a quick cup, I don't want to be grinding beans, getting out a filter and going through all the same steps as making a whole pot.  These filter packs are the perfect solution at a great price!  The coffee is almost as good as Starbucks for a fraction of the price.
Great tasting coffee a good deal for your money, many different blends to choose from. Goes great with my 4 cup coffee maker when I'm on the road

column9: Mountain Blend Coffee 4 Cup Filter Pack
column10: Coffee is very weak,I have to use 3 packs to make 4 cups of coffee.

Very satisfied.  It was delivered earlier than expected.  I bought this so my elderly mother wouldn't have to mess with loose coffee grounds.  She loves the convenience and the taste.  I will be ordering more.
I like just dropping the filter pack (or two or three)in my coffee pot, filling the water chamber... tasty coffee- no mess.

This coffee is ok, but nothing great, at least in my opinion..  I will not throw it away, but neither will I order any more.  It has that sharp aftertaste that I don't care for.  It isn't as strong as I expected it to be, which could be one reason for my disappointment.  If you like mild coffee and just drink coffee for effect this is a decent and well priced product.  I enjoy coffee and drink it for taste as much as effect.  The packets are easy to open, which I appreciate.

Bought this coffee to take on vacation to use in the little 4-cup pots that are always in hotel rooms.  My husband, the coffee drinker, said it was very weak (even using two packs at one time). I threw away the rest. Save your money...buy something else.
This is my 2nd Order of Island Blend.  I had used another brand for years so it took a few days to get used to a new taste, but its just fine. The envelopes are easy to tear open and very convenient.

I was disappointed in the quality of this coffee.  It has a weird whang to it - a bitter taste.  My husband tried it and said the same thing.  I don't know if I got a bad batch or what, but I won't be using this coffee except for emergency backup (when I'm out of good coffee).

column9: I had to stop giving this to my dogs
column10: My dogs love the Smokehouse Porky Pizzle.  When I took out the bag they were excited and they chewed it for a  long time. However, I have stopped giving this product to my dogs because it has become a chocking hazard . I have small dogs and found they have been chewing the pizzles and trying to swallow them in one long piece. I have had to stick my fingers down my dog's throat to get the pizzles out and clear their airway.  Perhaps the pizzles are better suited for larger dogs. My dogs won't be getting this product again. They do love other SmokeHouse products such as the Smokehouse 100-Percent Natural Chicken Breast Strips Dog Treats, 16-Ounce and the Smokehouse Chicken Skewers Dog Treats 4oz . They have been having these other products for over a year and there has been no chocking issue with them at all.

There should be a warning label on this product making people aware of potential allergic reactions. I tried this for the first ( and last ) time a few days ago. I had to go to the Emergency Room as my eyes were swelling shut, my sinuses & ears were rapidly closing up & my throat was feeling tight. I had hives & a red rash all over my body plus my hands were completely red .  I have never had anaphylactic shock before & have eaten celery without incident.
These muffins are just what the Doctor ordered. But you should add raisins and chopped pecans for a most perfect muffin.
Pacific almond milk is a staple in my kitchen, as I cannot tolerate dairy products or soy. I use it on cereal, in baking, and making frozen drinks.

I really like these bread crumbs.  Whole grain bread crumbs are hard to find where I live, so I was glad I tried these.  I took off one star because I think they are too expensive.  I am not cheap at all, especially when it comes to quality food items, but I think these are a little overpriced.

I use these breadcrumbs in so many recipes - in meatloaf, to top baked chicken, etc.  They have a great flavor, and are much healthier than white bread crumbs.  So glad to see them on Amazon - my local market stopped carrying them.

column9: it actually really and truly cleaned her teeth !
column10: The vet wanted us to use kitty toothpaste and some sort of odd finger brush and the cat HATED that (squirmed and BIT)!  After 2 weeks of putting of these little treats in with her dry cat food each day, her teeth are practically completely clean!  One note though:  She didn't like them at first and pushed them aside, but she now eats them right along with her dry food!  I will buy more!

column9: Dogs love them but sticky on bad teeth
column10: They smell like most dog treats do but with a little bit more of an earthy twist. They're colorful and most of them are about four inches long. My 10 month old West Highland White Terrier loves them but my nine year old Westie, who has bad and missing teeth, keeps getting them stuck in her jaw even when I break them in half for her. They seem to stick more to her teeth than actually in the jaw. I would definitely recommend it as a healthy treat for medium-sized pups.
Bought one of these cheeseman fruitcakes for christmas for myself and my mother-in-law and we both thought they were delicious. I will be ordering more in the futureas soon as I lose a few pounds.
Was like the packers in last years playoffs , a total loser.If you want to buy a good fruitcake, find it elsewhere. Wisconson need not be proud of this product.

This tea is amazing.  Right out of the bag you can smell the lemon and spearmint.  Awesome hot tea...cant wait to try it as an iced tea,  I highly recommend this one.  Love the Davidson teas. Price is excellent and quality is unbeatable.

We were delighted to find the Davidson's Teas in bulk.  They are the same quality as stores such as Teavana, which are 5-10x the price per oz.  This bag lasted us approximately 3 months drinking it several times per week.  It is an organic product, which we really liked, and the flavor is fantastic.

I liked this tea - added it to my subscription list so I get it regularly now.  I'm one of those people that keeps 3 or 4 different iced teas in my fridge (a recovering high-fructose corn syrup beverage addict) and am always looking for new tastes.  This one was more like a blast from the past, its just your plain old fresh minty tea.Some tips:  a little goes a long way, don't brew too long, and its really great iced (I live in Phoenix so, fresh cool tea is a survival necessity during the summer).  We have a few citrus teas out back and I've found the juice mixes really well with this tea when cooled, particularly lemons and tangerines.

I ordered this tea in part because it was so inexpensive, and I figured I had nothing to use. So far I've had it hot and in iced tea, and both are fantastic. It has a great smell and wonderful flavor. Not too strong, just delicate and lovely!

I love this lemon spearmint tea. The price was right and the delivery swift.I make a large batch and then place the majority of it in the fridge, for a later time. I prefer the looseleaf kind, (versus tea bags), because the quality of the tea is generally better.t

I'm not really into spearmint, so this was purchased for the wife.  It is easy to make too strong, so be careful.  But when properly made, with just a touch of honey, it tastes quite good (per the wife).  She likes this tea, and so, I'm happy I purchased it.  We shall try some other lemon blends later and get back to how this one stacks up.

I bought this stuff a while ago--- talking many many months here.  I still have 1/2 bag left.  I use it every so often for guests who are picky about coffee.  The stay fresh bag really works.  It's about 90% as strong as when I first got it.  Decent tea!  I add a bit to cheap bitter coffee to spin up the flavor a bit.  Friends "love" my "coffee."  He he he!

column9: Good, but be careful you don't use too much
column10: The instructions on the bag for the Lemon Spearmint tea says to use 2 heaping teaspoons and let it brew 5-7 minutes. For me and my SO, this was too much and way too long of a steeping time. Now, I use about a teaspoon or so of the tea, and let it steep for 2-4 minutes, and it's much better. I found it tasted bad when using the recommended times. However, like any tea, you have to steep to your tastes, and now that I've found my "sweet spot" with this tea, I'm much happier.
Have bought several different teas from Davidson's.  All have been good quality and exactly what I expected.  Good price, packaging and products.

This is simply spearmint with very little lemon peel, I have not seen any Rosehips, Hibiscus, and Lemon Myrtle. The color and aroma are fantastic - poor spearmint again. However the tea is too fine - there is so much dust and flying around when you are trying to scoop some tea out. And even if you are using a strainer or a tea ball, there are going to be some tea particles in your cup.
I fell so in love with this product at first try that I had to buy it in bulk !

the gum wasn't the right flavor I was looking for. Mentos makes a very strong minty flavored gum that has not been marketed in the US or at least in FL where I live.  I learned about it in the island of Barbados and thought it was the new flavor.  When I purchased it through Amazon, it looked exactly like the dark blue container I purchased in Barbados which was the stronger minty flavor.  This color container isn't anywhere here in FL and it was very misleading to me when I saw it online I thought for sure that it was the new flavor. Thank you.

You get more than enough cough drops for a very low price per cough drop.  However, I ended up throwing away many because the paper wrapping around the cough drop sticks to the slightly melted cough drop (perhaps during shipment) and you can't take off he wrapper completely.  So, unless you want to eat paper along with the cough drop, don't buy.

These are delicious crackers because they blend so well with whatever you eat with them.  Try the suggestions on the box as well as your own creations. In spite of how thin and delicate they are, they really hold up to dipping and handling.

Finally, a thin, crispy cracker that's not too filling, full of flavor, and just the right texture for serving with cheese.  The sesame flavor is great....the perfect amount of sesame seeds, but still versatile enough to serve with cheese, dips, spreads, etc.  I've finally discovered the perfect cracker.

Got my package quickly and was very happy to see the crackers were not broken. These crackers are so light yet sturdy enough to spread cheese on. They really let the flavor of the cheese or dip shine through.
These crispbreads are okay, but rather bland.  I don't know what you could put on them that would make a good accompaniement, as they are too thin to support dip or a slice of cheese.
My wife eats these and the last shipment tatsted a little stale according to her.

I really did not want to give any rating at all.These crackers were absolutely horrible.  They tasted moldy.  According to what I read in the returns policy, I can't get reimbursed.  I am stuck with 9 boxes of yucky crackers and am out $36. I tried three boxes only to find they all contained crackers that tasted moldy. I would not order a food item from Amazon again.

The jolly ole rancher made some sad candy.Tasted like it had been left in a hottruck/warehouse too long and the wax-paperleached into the candy itself.After about 5 doses, I gave the rest awaywith the caveat they could not return it to me.
Shame they are 2-3 times the price than in England, but then again maybe thats a good thing, stops me buying as often...

Excellent cookie.  Lots of raisens.  Perfect spices.  My husband put them in the microwave for a few seconds they were even better.  The 4 star instead of 5 was because one package was crushed and the cookies were crumbs. Very good cookie!

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: This Santa Cruz soft baked oatmeal raisin cookie is one of the best ever. They flavor it with wonderful spices that make me think i'm eating holiday pastry. When I put out a plate of cookies they are always the first to go. I call them the adult cookie that children love. The price is good and delivered to my door, what more could you ask for.the whole line of cookies are wonderful so try them and find out for youself. Happy Eating :)

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: A yummy brownie like cookie that ships well. Good price and got amazons super saver shipping. I have loved all the Pepperidge Farm cookies that amazon carries. One stop shopping these days. THANKS  :)

I purchased the pack of five for $23.59. what i got was one pack for 12.99.  when i went back to the site, i clicked on the pack of five and it took me to the page to order, but it didn't have the pack of five highlighted so i got the other.  i should have spotted that, but it was down lower than the screen.  it had the right type of cookie highlighted so i assumed(my favorite word)everything was correct.  this is the first time this has happened.  they need to fix this.  who would buy one package of cookies for almost half the cost of a pack of five.

column9: PEPPERIDGE FARM COOKIES-SOFT BAKED CAPTIVA(PACK OF 5)
column10: An astonishingly delicious soft baked chocolate brownie cookie by Pepperidge Farm, at a great price of only 13.00 for 5 packages that normally go for $3.49 each through Amazon.com seeing it rarely if never goes on sale at the supermarket unlike Pepperidge Farm's Milano Brand Line of cookies and their Goldfish Crackers all of the time. Great purchase at the right price when available! ENJOY!!!

These are great tasting, good quality cookies. But, they are packaged in cheap paper bags which offer no protection from damage. No matter where you buy them, you will most likely receive a bag full of broken cookies and crumbs.Campbell's Soup is the parent company of Pepperidge Farm and I have complained to them about their inadequate packaging many times and rather than improving the packaging, they just asked me to stop calling. Pepperidge Farm promised to send vouchers/coupons for replacement of the damaged cookies, but they never delivered on their promise. I was just told, "Don't call here anymore."

This is the only kind of Pepperidge Farm cookies that I have had in my lifetime that are just terrible. Very strange...the chips are great, but the cookie part of, well, these cookies, has a nondescript, bland, processed/white-sugar taste. No, you cannot compare the taste to a sugar cookie- it's like an alien's version of a chocolate-chip cookie hastily made in order to use to lure a human to its/his/her spacecraft. The brown sugar is just not kickin' here, so just kick these to the curb.

Started ordering these yummy, rich chocolate cookies a few months ago.As most chocolate lovers know,it's not worth it to eat poor quality chocolate. These are filled with dark chocolate bits and are soft and creamy in the mouth.Actually they are so good that eating "just one" is truly satisfying.

column9: PEPPERIDGE FARM SOFT BAKED SANTA CRUZ OATMEAL RAISIN COOKIE(PACK OF 4)
column10: Another delicious selection in the Pepperidge Farm family of Cookies called Santa Cruz Oatmeal Raisin. I picked up my order for a great bargain through Warehouse Deals fulfilled by Amazon.com for only $7.49!!! When you consider that these normally cost you listed on bag @ $3.49/per, and generally never go on sale at the supermarket/grocery store unlike the Milano Brand line of cookies by Pepperidge Farm the price was right to quote the famous game show still on T.V. today. Get yours today and ENJOY!!!

What can be said negative about Pepperidge Farm Cookies.....ABSOLUTELY NOTHING!!! These soft baked, milk chocolate variety from Pepperidge Farm comes with 8 deliciously decadent cookies per package with a total of 5 packages per order and is mouth watering for any cookie or chocolate lover period! To boot, since this type of variety of Pepperidge Farm Cookies NEVER goes on sale at the supermarket or grocery store(at least where I live) unlike Milano and their Goldfish Brands, it would cost you $3.49 per bag X5, for a total of $16.95. Except I pick these up all the time through Warehouse Deals fulfilled by Amazon.com for anywhere between my most recent purchase for 5 bags @ $11.04-$11.82 in the past, so you can't go wrong! If the Warehouse Deals(when available) or straight Amazon have a listing available at a higher price then mentioned in this review, then BE PATIENT and rest assure that the price will come down and you'll snag a great bargain like I do all the time on a regular basis. Having some now, Mmmmm!

These are great tasting, good quality cookies. But, they are packaged in cheap paper bags which offer no protection from damage. No matter where you buy them, you will most likely receive a bag full of broken cookies and crumbs.Campbell's Soup is the parent company of Pepperidge Farm and I have complained to them about their inadequate packaging many times and rather than improving the packaging, they just asked me to stop calling. Pepperidge Farm promised to send vouchers/coupons for replacement of the damaged cookies, but they never delivered on their promise. I was just told, "Don't call here anymore."

I love Pepperidge farm Soft Baked Oatmeal cookies. They make the perfect snack. While other cookies are hard and dry with the texture of sawdust these cookies taste great, and are soft like they've just come out of the oven.Downsides? Each cookie is 130 calories which is a lot for such a small cookie. Also these contain interesterified fats/oils which are chemically altered oils. Not really great for humans to consume.The result? I think I'll bake my own... Without the chemicals. It would probably be safer. 5 star taste. 2 star ingredients. Rating, Average.

I have been having extensive dental work done, and anything that says it is soft, I buy it.  However, these were very hard and dry.  I gave them away to a family with a lot of children.  They will get eaten there.

I ordered this tea after we sipped some in a great little restaurant, and I'm so glad I did. My husband and I both love it, and it's become an everyday beverage for us. Friends like it, too, and it's pretty to watch while steeping.

column9: Very disappointed - won't make the mistake again...
column10: I've been buying the Art of Appreciation gift baskets for years for my family members. The recipients were always grateful and seemed to have enjoyed the varieties. This year, I got curious and ordered myself a basket after sending several of the same out to my family and friends. Upon receipt, I was shocked at the content and the presentation of the basket especially for the price paid. I could probably come up with a much better mix with less than $30 - in fact I will do so from now on.  I feel embarrassed that this is the type of baskets I've been sending out year after year to my loved ones. Don't be fooled that you'd impress anyone with the included caviar - it tastes like salty but unsweet flying fish eggs. As a person used to the Caspian caviars and even some cheaper American Paddlefish alternatives, I find it insulting and again very embarrassed to have sent the product as gifts. I should've known better... I called my sister (yearly happy recipient) and asked her if this is how it had been for years, and she giggled sheepishly and that's all I needed to know.Received contents:4 pieces (1.2 oz) of Belgian Truffles3.5 oz Dill Salmon Spread (Alaska Smokehouse)3.75 oz Pasteurized Cheddar Cheese (Northwood Cheese Co)0.95 Oz Mochaccino mix - enough for ONE 6oz cup2 oz Smoked Almonds (Los Olivos)2 oz Wine & Cheese Biscuits (Los Olivos)1.8 oz Chocolate Dipped (Truffle?) cookies4 oz Tuscan Crackers (Focaccia Crisps)2 oz Water Crackers (Three Pepper Blend)4.4 oz Wafer rolls (Tiramisu flavor)5 oz Pretzels (typical salted dried)4.4 oz Angelina's Sweet Butter Cookies2 oz green olives, pimento stuffed (Mille Lacs Foods)2 oz Black Capelin caviar (Season brand)Missing Items:2 Pakages Cafe Comfrorts White Chocolate Cocoa MixSesame CrackersMerlot Wine Cheese - or is this for the pasteurized cheddar flavored dip?Stone Ground MustardMs. Pinables Caramel Confections
I was concerned ordering a gift basket on-line due to some less than favorable feedback on other baskets and vendors.  This one was very nicely done, and well worth the price.
Sent this as a thank you package and received rave reviews on presentation and products. The basket was as described and the integrity of the product was well maintained in the shipping process.

this is the first thing i have every bought at amazon that i was not only disappointed but embarrassed.  it was a gift for my childrens' anniversary.  the package was not at all like the photo. the items were flat down in the basket.  most boxes contained one or two items.  it was uninteresting.  the convenience of buying at amazon was a mistake this time.  i saw much more beautiful and less expensive baskets at other stores like costco.  anyway many other items i've purchased from amazon have been totally satisfactory.
This gift basket is perfect for someone you love, and they'll definitely love it too. I've sent this gift to my mom and she's very happy with all the goodies inside.  She said that she feels spoiled!

My brother and sister in law said the contents were fun and delicious. Great gift for the money, and with people dropping by for New Years, I am thinking of ordering one for myself. Good job. I would recommend
Recipient absolutely loved this gift basket. They commented on the quality of the caviar and general basket contents. The price is commensurate to the value.
I got this for my dad as a birthday/appreciation gift. He said it was the best present he received and he loved it. He's so excited to eat and everything. I felt so happy to make him happy :).

I'm placing my 3rd case order for Think Pink and it is delicious!  I'm really impressed with the company and their sustainable fishing.  The salmon does contain skin and bones - the health benefits are stronger because of it.  Once you mash it up with a fork you would never know they are there.  I've tried that recipes that come with the order and all are very good.  Highly recommend this product!!

I bought the THINK PINK Salmon for salad and sandwiches.  Opened a chilled can, drained it - and mixed the fish along with it's nutritious soft bones & skin with a little mayo and half a squeezed lemon.  It is the most incredible taste and because the Salmon is wild, has the health benefits one expects, but rarely finds, in our foods today.  I am thrilled to have at least one outstandingly healthy product!

I enjoyed your salmon!!! It's very  tasty. Really delicious. Yum!!!I also take the opportunity to say the work you do is very interesting . It is good and rare to see people comitted with healthy and natural life style.Thanks for the postcard and your touching message.

I absolutely love both the pink salmon and sockeye salmon from Wild Alaska! The taste and quality is fantastic. The people from the company are so nice and I highly recommend ordering any of their products!!

I like it much much better than tuna. I've had it in salads, hot dishes, straight out of the can and I love it (for canned salmon recipes see the company's website). I don't mind the skin and bones at all because you can't taste them, but when I'm preparing it for others I just mash the skin and bones with a fork, leaving the bigger chunks of meat intact, and nobody has ever noticed them. The delivery is always quick. I also appreciate the recipes and the postcards with the message from Pre Alaska Salmon Co included in the package. It feels good to always have a few cans of Think Pink tuna in my pantry.

I was hoping that it would be an alternative for canned tuna, but it isn't.  The can was full of skin and bones (and salmon meat).  It was like they threw the whole fish in a shredder and then canned it.  They didn't even remove the backbone.  After trying for a while to remove the bones and skin, I just gave up and threw it out.  Maybe I got a bad can?  If not, you guys need to open a can of tuna and compare product.

column9: Very good if you like the texture
column10: This sausage is covered in a sort of edible mold-like substance similar to brie cheese.  It's a part of the curing process and imparts a delicious flavor to the sausage.  In addition, this is a very well-dried sopressata--which I like.  However, the texture isn't all that good.  There are hard things in it which don't seem like meat--tough, almost like little pieces of leather.  If the texture was good, I'd give this delicious sausage five stars--but because the texture is a turn-off for me, it only rates a three in my book.  If you don't mind little touch hard chunks in your sausage, and love a rich, complex flavor, you'll probably love Molinari's sopressata.

column9: If you like hard, tasteless and expensive.................
column10: ..........then choose this product.  I know to expect a really dry, firm texture, but I could barely cut this product.  Once I did saw off a piece of it, it was like eating leather..........oily leather.  I wouldn't recommend........

column9: Fast delivery, but to me Sopressata tasted a little bitter.
column10: Fast delivery, but to me Sopressata tasted a little bitter. Actuall weight of Sopressata is under 1.5 LB (2 LB is parcel weight).

New to brown rice syrup. Used NOW brand in hot mint tea (with raw honey) and liked it very much. Decided to venture out & found this. Tastes very different than the NOW brand. It's richer and turns the tea cloudy, tastes and looks as if a splash of milk was added to the tea. NOW brand left the tea clear.I prefer the NOW brand in hot tea but prefer this for baking, cooking and as a topping (sweet potato, krispy treats, popcorn, greek yogurt, etc.)  It has a more complex and buttery background which is better suited to such applications.DELICIOUS.
Love this stuff!1 It is easy to work with, made some rice krisspi treats and they taste wonderful using this product.  Ships fast!

column9: Pretty ordinary as far as cakes go...
column10: It's hard to find birthday cakes to ship, especially when you live across the country from the recipient. I ordered this for my Mother for her birthday. The cake made it on time, but it was mostly frosting and very sweet.

This olive oil has a very nice taste with a bit of apicy kick.The only concern I have is that the item description says "Bio-Organic"but I could not find the term "organic" on the label, just "Bio".If the seller can point out to me where on the label it says organic,the I will gladly edit my review and up the rating to five stars!
This is the best kept secret. Incredible olive oil for this price. Perfect for any healthy meal! love the product. Dr. Charles Barr.

I sent this to my mother in law for Christmas.  She loved it, and I love that it's organic.  It's hard to find organic fruit gift baskets so I was thrilled to find it here on amazon!!! I will definitely be sending this out again in the future!

column9: The best damn chicken spice out there...
column10: As an avid cook and spice mix experimenter, my hat is off to Chef Tom and his 'Spice Girls' for creating a world-class chicken spice.  This is one tangy and flavorful mix that blows the doors off anything similar one could find at a supermarket.  Primary notes are paprika and brown sugar, but what my nose smells first is ancho chile and star anise.This mix creates a light crust on the food and colors it brilliantly red.  Surprisingly, it's also very good on the 'heavier', red-fleshed fish like salmon.  Highly recommended along with Chef Tom's other standout product, Chef Tom Douglas Rub With Love Salmon Rub.

This is VERY tasty!  Used it on baked chicken pieces, roasted chicken and for the Thanksgiving turkey too. For the turkey, I added some fresh thyme and it complimented the flavor well -- received many compliments and people commented on the subtle star anise flavor.  Already used up my first jar and am on my second one.  Will be my go-to dry rub for poultry since it's so delicious and easy.  Will have to try some of the other flavors too. . .

column9: Didn't strike a chord with my palate
column10: Background: Roasted chicken is something my wife and I often eat on Sundays and we like to try different things from time to time.  I tried this seasoning on a brined whole roasted chicken with a liberal application of the rub.First the objective facts.  Here is the ingredient list in order: Brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, ancho, black pepper, turmeric, coriander, garlic, cinnamon, star anise.Now my subjective opinion also shared by my wife.  I was completely underwhelmed by this seasoning.  It has a very different flavor profile from most rubs but it didn't impart much saltiness or spiciness. The cinnamon and star anise seem to take center stage here and it just came across as odd and unbalanced to me. Maybe I just really love a lot of saltiness in a piece of perfectly roasted chicken skin, but this didn't give it to me.  I would prefer a simple roasted chicken seasoned with salt and black pepper to this rub.  For that reason, I won't be using the rest of my rub but I'll put the container to good use storing extra nuts and bolts in my garage.  I hope the salmon rub I also bought is better.
This is the best  rub I have ever purchased. A little on the pricey side but well worth the money. I highly recommend it.

The smoked paprika does the trick I think, anyway for chicken I've never tried better. Expensive for sure but you couldn't make it as good(I couldn't) and you wouldn't save all that much.An easy "Recommend".

column9: Brilliant for the lazy gourmand / bachelor
column10: I originally picked up this product in a market on a whim, and it was my introduction to the world of dry rub.  It's still my favorite.  All you do is rub this stuff on raw chicken and cook it however you like (toaster oven works fine).  You're eating tasty food in 15 minutes and have very little in the way of dirty dishes... my credo in my bachelor days.

These are cheap when you buy them in bulk here.  The container is big enough and seed quality is great.  It's nice I don't have to keep running to the store because I used to buy the little containers of seeds.  These will last me a long time.
I like these because they are organic. They're a little expensive but considering how much I use when I cook it's not bad.
Very good quality and fresh! I use it when I bake bread, but it's excellent just sprinkled on salads.I like the fact that it's packaged in reusable glass jars.

This review is less about the cereal and more about the option of buying from Amazon for one of two reasons:1) If you've never had it, you're probably not going to buy a 4-pack. I was just two pounds shy of my Weight Watchers goal when I fell off the weight loss wagon and gained four additional pounds.  Life was busy, and I wanted a fuss-free way to lose those last pounds before swimsuit season.  Since I enjoy Special K products, I thought I'd put the Special K 2-Week Weight Loss Challenge to the test.  I ate Special K cereal for two meals, snacked on fruits and veggies (instead of the recommend Special K snack products) and made healthy dinner choices.  I didn't expect to lose 6 pounds as advertised, since my weight loss had slowed from months of dieting and I was near my goal weight.  To my surprise, I lost 6 pounds and have finally reached my goal weight!ABOUT THE DIET:It's convenient and doesn't require much planning.  However, it could get a little boring in the long run.  It could also be difficult to meet daily nutritional requirements.  Also, rapid weight loss could be difficult to maintain in the long run.  If you've been dieting and just can't lose those last few pounds, or if you need to lose a few pounds fast for a big event, give Special K a try.ABOUT THE CEREAL:One can usually find a box of Special K in my kitchen cabinet.  Most often, it is the Red Berries variety.  I enjoy the Fruit and Yogurt flavor, as well, but the serving size is 1/4 cup less.  The original flavor is also nice from time to time, but the Chocolatey Delight is just not a good idea, in my opinion.  But back to the Red Berries.  The cereal consists of the usual Special K flakes with dehydrated strawberries.  Once I pour on my Silk Light soy milk, the berries plump up to add lots of real strawberry flavor.  There are generous amounts of berries and the flakes stay crispy in milk.  All in all, this is an excellent cereal that I highly recommend.

Kellogg's Special K Cereal, Red Berries, 16.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4), is a delicious cereal.  Since Kellogg is number one  -- the number one producer of convenience food in the world --we know Kellogg will give us what we want while ignoring the things that do not matter to us.What do we want?(1) Flavor.  Those real freeze dried strawberries are so delicious that we are tempted to eat them dry out of the box and leave the cereal.  The cereal tastes good too.  It is sweet, and there is malt flavoring that we love.(2) Nutrition.  With 110 calories per cup, we can measure out a cup and use it for diet food.  It has vitamin A, vitamin C, iron, calcium, B vitamins, and minerals.(3) Grain.  There are crispy rice and wheat flakes.What does not matter to us? (Or does it?)(1) Sugar.  The cereal is loaded with it, but if we did not have it in the cereal, many of us would spoon in a generous application. The second ingredient is sugar.  Is that cane or corn?  Also listed in the ingredients is high fructose corn syrup.(2) Nutrition.  It is hard to stop with one cup full because we are used to feeling full.  A cup of light cereal takes us through the motion of eating slowly . . . that's a plus . . . but does not satisfy the way whole grain cereal does.  About the added nutrition:  some of us don't need all of what it gives us, or maybe we really do prefer to take them in pill form so we know we exactly what we are getting.  Many of us take in more iron than is considered healthy for our specific needs.  What your physician will tell you about this issue may be surprising.(3) Grain. If we are allergic to wheat, we need to pay attention to the label.  Also there is corn in the form of fructose.  What we are getting is highly refined grain products when whole grain would be better for our health by providing fiber.With the price out of the range of what we usually spend on breakfast foods, I don't find it a good value.

I love to eat breakfast and I'm a cereal lover from way back! My kids would rather have oatmeal or granola bars, but give me a good ol' bowl of cereal with milk and I'm good to go! I could eat cereal for every meal and not get tired of it, so I try a lot of different kinds. My latest love fest is with Kellogg's Special K Red Berries cereal.Kellogg's Special K promotes itself as being good for part of a weight loss program. The back of the box says that if you eat a serving of this cereal with skim milk, fruit and coffee that you'll have a meal that has less than 250 calories (although I don't know why you would want to add more fruit when you already have strawberries)! It's also fast free and cholesterol free. That's not why I bought it though. I bought it because it looked good on the box and I love strawberries.Kellogg's Special K Red Berries cereal is made with crunchy rice and wheat flakes and has dried strawberries in it. Yummy - I love strawberries! Never before have I had a cereal with freeze dried fruit in it where the fruit actually tastes real and fresh. When I first saw the shriveled strawberries in my bowl the first time I ate this cereal, I was not eager to put them in my mouth. But then I poured the milk in the bowl and the strawberries actually plumped up and almost looked like I had freshly sliced them! Then I took a big bite and wow, the strawberry taste was awesome! The cereal is just sweet enough to not be like a kid cereal but still enough to satisfy my sweet tooth. And there are a ton of strawberries in the box - enough to where I always get at least one strawberry with every bite of cereal.Now let's move on to the flakes. They are a good size but not so big that they are hard to eat. Some cereals make their flakes too big for my liking but this one is just right. Plus the flakes stay crunchy until the last bite is gone from the bowl, unlike some of the other flakes made by Kellogg's and other brands.So for now, Kellogg's Special K Red Berries is my top choice for cereal every morning ... until I burn myself out on it and then I'll switch to something else for a while!

column9: Our visitors who tried it ask us for more...
column10: I don't know exactly how we ended up with a 160-bag box of tea Taylors of Harrogate, Yorkshire Gold Tea, 160-Count Tea Bags, but I think my first reaction was "well THAT will last us approximately forever." Ferrara Pan Candy Company was founded in 1900, in Chicago, Illinois. In 1962, the company hit on a new great tasting candy - Lemonheads. Tart and sweet at the same time, it was a huge success, and a staple of the company. Later, the company spread out, making several other flavors of the candy, including Cherryheads (which were originally known as Cherry Chans and then Cherry Clans).Cherryheads are delicious, little red candies that are sweet and tart, and have that great cherry taste. Admittedly they are not as sour as the newer super-sour candies, but too many of those other candies just give you a wave of tasteless super-sour, and then you get to eat the super-sweet candy. With Cherryheads, you get a nice flavor of tart cherries, especially if you chew on them (which I recommend :-).When I was growing up in the Chicagoland area, Ferrara Pan candies were a staple of every kids diet. Now, eating Cherryheads takes me back to my childhood. Buy Cherryheads and enjoy a great candy. I highly recommend them!

Wow, am I ever intrigued. Schwan shipped my order from their Minnesota headquarters to Florida by ground UPS, and, among other perishables, was included chocolate almond ice cream and strawberry yoghurt. I haven't received the shipment, and I tried to cancel the entire order because I saw that Schwan wasn't taking any action on it, but they pre-empted me by ignoring the cancel request and shipping it UPS ground two day.Actually, what is even more mystifying is that Schwan's knew there are Schwan delivery trucks all over this region of Florida, and I am positive that there is a Schwan delivery route only 3/10 of a mile from where I live. So, they could have been less malicious about this by getting a refrigerated Schwan delivery truck to deliver the goods in the insulated bag with the ice cubes and gel packs that is standard for such deliveries.This is written after I got delivery of the above by UPS ground three days later. Schwan's replied to my requests to cancel two days after I sent them, in other words, on the day I received delivery.Truth to tell, Schwan's was playing a joke, because they use plastic insulated picnic chests full of dry ice to ship their products by UPS ground, and the products all arrive frozen solid, many with nearly quite acceptable wholesome ingredients. They don't mention the dry ice, so wondering how the product would survive shipping is the joke on the customer.So far, I've sampled the ice cream and the strawberry yoghurt, both of which are better quality from a wholesomeness standpoint than available at local markets. The wonton soup with the pork wonton has an ingredients list that is anything except wholesome, almost like a joke on people who eat pork. Undoubtedly, the next Time you read a Schwan's catalog on the Amazon web site, the wonton soup will have fake vegetarian pork in it.So, for the dairy goods sampled so far using my microwave to defrost, like my kids used to say, "Yummy, yummy in the tummy."Oh, and it's a good idea to dispose of the UPS packaging quickly, because the dry ice evaporates into carbon dioxide which is not safe to breathe in quantity in an enclosed area and could become a lawsuit issue of the kind we innocent consumers are so fond of these days.

Every wannabee cook knows that to make an above average culinary creation 3 things are necessary: Talent and creativity, a good recipe, and most important, great ingredients. If those 3 are in place then the results will be nothing short of outstanding every single time.I have been in love with seafood since a toddler when a mini wave took me up to sea and I was rescued by an aging mermaid. I love all things that come from the sea excepting in sushi form, perhaps some of the sea life in raw form does not agree with my palate. I love making seafood dishes, from soups to main entrees. Soups are my biggest weakness for I use to go to a pier where the seafood would arrive early in the morning hours and right then and there a hot pot with water will be waiting to be filled up with all manners of the daily catch. Mussels, fish heads, shell fish, pieces of fish, oysters, octopus, shrimp, etc etc. These selections would be the leftovers, the ones that did not command a sizable market price, they would end in their own version of the french bouillabaisse, with herbs and spices and the phosphorus of the fish heads, in no time the broth would be bursting with natural flavor right from the ocean. Add some lemon (lime here for the lemon in US is not as pungent), a little home made salsa with onions, chilies and tomatoes, and if you were courageous enough extra heat. By the time you would finish this powerful concoction all the phosphorus of the seafood would command to find the nearest hammock and snore for a couple of hours only to wake up feeling like a million dollars.Enter Knorr Fish Boullion Mix, 32 Ounce Canister: yes, somewhere in its contents there is some vague taste of fish, but it certainly does not taste natural. It seems to be a little on the smoky side, it definitely has its own particular taste but it is way off from an above average fish stock. I have been using Minor's Clam Base (because is the cheapest in price and imparts a delicious total flavor to dishes) and this time I was caught on the curiosity of purchasing this powder form bouillon.  I loved the quantity and the powder form mystified me, what if it works as good as what I had been using? Of course is much more affordable than the clam base I am talking about (that one must be refrigerated and it is semi solid but it does have a truly clam smell) so I bought it and immediately tried it on a seafood chowder cilantro based. A very simple soup that includes hulled barley, onions finely chopped, fresh corn, small diced potatoes and fresh chilies properly sauteed with fresh garlic and olive oil and then blended with the cilantro and a couple of cans of quality diced tomatoes, preferably the ones with a little herbs thrown in. Who am I kidding? The ones they sell at Costco! This soup replaces the hard task of making your own fish stock which requires good fish heads with very clear eyes and all the other ingredients. Too much work for a wannabee cook these days but if done right it is every bit as good as anything you can eat these days. Throw some scallops, different fish, clams (if you can find plump ones), two or three fillets of mahi mahi, large shrimp, etc. But in the end, really, if the broth is good that is all a person would need to enjoy a hot cup or two of fish broth.This one does not quite reach the levels of goodness I am referring to. It does the job but the final product lacks that essence of the sea, it is a little too processed?Please do not get me wrong. I use the Knorr Chicken Powder and it works for me, a great value, so perhaps some people are more than satisfied with this product as well. I give it 3 Stars but that is it and I realize I am deviating from all the other 5 Star ratings, but the thing is, when you had the chance to try a superior product this one just can not compete. My chowder ended tasting okey but not spectacularly good and that hurts for I threw in a whole lot of seafood. Happy to have Albertsons sell this little packages of $1 each that allows for variety even though it is not the best of the catch they do offer bay scallops, different fishes, even shrimp and calamari, so it is not a bad deal. 3 Stars.

column9: Delightful Full Flavor Strength - Perfect for the Afternoon!
column10: This tea is very unique as a blend of African/Kenyan, Assam, and Ceylon teas. This is definitely "Best enjoyed with milk." as the full-flavor strength balances well even with heaps of milk. Boxes (Pack of 6) (Keemun and Ceylon) which is entirely different and probably tastes different enough too.

column9: These treats made our dog violently ill; irradiated at too high a level?
column10: We were looking for a 100% meat treat for our dog, sourced and also made in the USA; this particular Smokehouse USA treat fit the bill (though others under the same label do not).  Initially, we were excited that our dog seemed to love the taste of these treats (she ate the two strips we gave her with gusto), especially since she's very picky about most "healthy" stuff for dogs.However, not long after ingesting these, she became violently ill with gastrointestinal symptoms continuing for days.  Non-stop diarrhea was the worst part of it.  Aside from these treats, nothing else in her diet was different than usual.  Her appetite is still not back to normal, and it's been a month now.  She's listless and just doesn't seem like herself yet, though the GI issues are OK now.I wanted to warn people that these treats are irradiated, since the listing here on Amazon doesn't indicate it.  There's a seal on the back of the package stating, "Treated with radiation for your safety".  Since a number of foods are irradiated for human and pet consumption and thought to be safe, I'm not sure if unsafe levels of radiation was the issue in our case, or if it was simple food poisoning.Either way, I wish I'd known the treats were irradiated before I bought them, especially since the irradiated Orijen cat food imported to Australia in 2008 ended up being the cause of death and illness for many cats.  It's getting harder and harder to stay healthy in this world, but being forewarned of potential issues is better than lack of awareness at all.  And I won't be buying more Smokehouse USA products, regardless of what the source of our issue was.(See article re: feline deaths/illnesses from Orijen cat food irradiated at entry into Australia (2008), here:[...]

column9: Almost as good as my memories
column10: I purchased the Cadbury Curly Wurly 1oz (which from a hair point of view has icky connotations) because the author of a candy nostalgia slideshow claimed they were like my much beloved, horribly missed Marathon bars.  Now, what they lack in texture, they almost make up for in quality.  This is nice Cadbury milk-chocolate and caramel, not the brittle, purposely soured milk of M&M/Mars (if you didn't know why you keep eating M&M's, it's because the slightly soured milk in the milk chocolate leaves an aftertaste that you try to cover with . . . more candy.  Genius!  Evil, but genius.).  However, the original Marathon bar was a much thinner braid with no lumpy parts, and it could really get some stretch on it if you wanted to.  If I had a real Marathon bar and a Curly Wurly side-by-side in the present and had to choose, it might go to Curly Wurly, but memory is a powerful thing and the Marathon bar is right up there with McDonald's deep fried cherry pies, FallsBrand hotdogs with warmed mustard relish, and Sunkist Natural soda--magic foods of the past that become even more powerful as legends.  I've been off soda for 1.5 years, but will gladly go back on if there is a Sunkist Natural substitute.

column9: very much like the Marathon bar
column10: Very good chocolate and caramel.  Loved the Marathon bar and love this one, very similar.
For those of us old enough to remember the Marathon bar, here it is. Thank you Cadbury and thank you Amazon!
I ordered this because I was a big fan of the marathon candy bar... this was almost like it just seemed a little smaller, but I'm much older now. Was good and came in great shape.  Thanks

Soy nuts are never going to be anyone's idea of comfort food.  No one's ever going to come home at the end of a hard day and say, "Man, I could go for a beer and some soy nuts!"  If you're eating these, it's probably because you're trying to find something to take the place of a much-less-healthy snack that you'd otherwise be eating.All that being said, these aren't half bad.  They are, as another reviewer noted, somewhat chalky.  You will want to have something to drink with these -- preferably water.  The flavor of these is pretty good, though.  Barbecue is the best of the various flavors these come in.  One problem with the soy nuts is that the manufacturer hasn't seemed to figure out how to get the flavoring powder to stick well to the soy nuts.  Because of this, a lot of the powder falls off, and the flavor has to be reasonably strong for you to taste it.  Barbecue makes it pretty well, whereas some of the other available flavors don't.Once again, these aren't bad.  I don't know if I'll buy them again, though.  I MUCH prefer Genisoy's soy crisps, which are genuinely awesome, and almost as healthy.

The best solution is to eat these nuts along with a good drink.The nuts are crunchy and taste similar to any other bbq'd flavor product(chips, etc). The macro-nutrient balance in this product is terrific(4 grams of fat, 9 grams of carbs(5 being fiber), and 12 grams of protein.I have added this product as a replacement for potato chips. I've founded that combining half soy nuts, half peanuts is a great way to balance nutrition and taste. Definately give that a try!

I don't write many reviews.  I'm not so good with words.  Every once in a while a product comes along that demands a great review.  The BackCountry Mud Coffee is one of those products.  I love coffee.  I am 56 years old.  I started brewing coffee in a percolator(with Chock Full O'Nuts coffee) when I was 12.  It was a Sunday morning gift to my parents.  If you think making a good cup of coffee is difficult theses days, try brewing Chock Full O'Nuts in a percolator.  Leave the pot on the stove for an extra 30 seconds and the coffee becomes undrinkable black tar. Put the flame up a little too high and the pot would overflow leaving on the stove a lake of coffee grounds.  I learned early that brewing coffee was an art.I left the Chock Full O'Nuts behind a long time ago, but I still like my coffee strong.  The key is the coffee must be strong and smooth, not strong and bitter.  Often I have found myself cutting a bitter french roast with a less acidic coffee like sumatra in order to make it palatable.  Not so with this brew.  The BackCountry boys have managed to create a blend that is strong, flavorful and smooth - Perfect -  and as we used to say back in the mid 1960s.....Good to the Last Drop.  Enjoy
This is great coffee at a very reasonable price...it's the anti-Starbucks! Plus, this coffee lacks the heavy acid that you get with SB, yet still has a hearty flavor and aroma.

column9: Great tasting healthy alternative to coconut oil
column10: This popcorn tastes great and is comparable to the Great American brand. Even better it uses healthier sunflower oil and not coconut oil. As to the other reviews that state it's too salty, you can find the same type of reviews with many of these pre-measured packets. The good thing about this brand (as well as several others) the ingredients are separated, so you can adjust to your own taste. I don't like very much salt on my popcorn so I use 1/4 to 1/2 of the salt packet. If others are over that like saltier popcorn I get mine, and then sprinkle some more on the rest. As for reviews saying the popcorn is "chewy" I belive that's more the timing of heating the oil & the quality of the machine. I've done multiple taste tests with guests (as we have tried several pre-packaged brands) and this wins more frequently than others. But for me the clincher is the sunflower oil. If you want a great visual effect, put some coconut oil based mixture and sunflower oil based mixture in two clear jars and store a little below room temperature -- around 60 degrees. You'll find a solid block of oil with the cococut mixture, while the sunflower oil mixture is still liquid & see through. Not exactly what I want stuck in my arteries.
