I definitely recommend this product for anyone that suffers with dry hair especially if it has been chemically treated.  It is a hair saver.  I do shed hairs as badly as I used to.  It is hair saving.

I have only been ingesting this oil and using as a moisturizer for my face, body and hair for a little over a month.  My face and body are hydrated and soft as a baby's butt.  Plus my hair is growing like a weed, soft and shiny.  My biggest thrill came last week when I walked past my entry hall mirror and noticed that the slight sagging on my jawline was firmer and I looked years younger.  When I started this Coconut Oil regimen my blood pressure was 188/92 with medication. Last week it registered 125/75 without medication.  Needless to say I am tickled at the results since deciding to take control of my health naturally and stop relying upon doctors and drugs.  My next natural health cure is switching to naturally alkaline water. I'm told that it also produces miraculous results. Does anyone know of a good brand that is at least a PH balance of 9?

I love this product, but its a little strange. When it arrived, it was completely liquid. Not exactly sure why, but it was liquid for days. I liked it better this way. As it got colder it became hard as a rock. Which makes measuring it for my hair a little more difficult, but I dont care I love it. If you are using this as a hair moisturizer this feel good hands down. My hair is Shinny for the first time ever and my scalp is moisturized without feeling like it has a pound of grease on it. its light and a little bit goes a long way. I have this on autoship, but i may skip the next order because this is gonna last! I have thick hair and a tablespoon to a tablespoon and a half goes a long long way. I do not feel this product on my head at all. Also works well on skin. I have dry patches on my face, this is a lovely light oil. My mom uses this product as well and she has think straight hair, and she loves it!Warning, do not add too much to your scalp and whatever you do do not leave clumps of this product in your hair. If it is hard, let it warm up in your hand. Reason: I add it in clumps and as i went out in the sun it began to drip down my face like water. I can only liken the experience to Jerry Curl Juice. BUT i love this product!

column9: Don't need my eczema medication anymore
column10: I've mostly used this coconut oil consistently on my skin for a month now. I have eczema and dry skin spots on my torso.So here's my review and my experience... a rant, and advice, I guess.You have to be pretty consistent with this stuff to see results -- if you're starting out with it, I think. I've been using this for a month at least 2 times a day, and it's in the middle of winter when my skin easily gets dry. I stopped using lotion after learning about its ineffectiveness and how it could be in fact harmful (carcinogenic from parabens and such) -- most of the conventional products anyway that we all find easily in our supermarkets.So I've learned that most health products they sell you don't really eliminate the problems at their roots -- mostly just symptoms, and in fact can contribute to cancer (make-up, shampoos, conditioners, lotions, laundry detergent...) This is a very clever business technique, because the customers will always be coming back for more toxic products that eliminate symptoms, but never completely eliminate the root of the customers' problems.I also learned that skin problems can not only be due to toxic chemicals from your conventional lotions, it can be from toxins that sit on the inside of your body from the junk food you've been ingesting -- this includes highly processed foods, toxic medications, the toxins your skin has absorbed over the years, and maybe even the polluted air you've been breathing.(I've been told by a nutritionist that many skin problems can be helped by colon cleansing and perhaps liver cleansing...).What I'm trying to say is that coconut oil can only do so much (at least, in my one month of experience) on the outside, it's helping just one factor out of many that would contribute to better skin health. But I'd say it's definitely better than using my prescribed topical medication which are basically steroids (betamethasone dipropionate I think). The doctor said not to use it for more than 10 days in a row (my medication), that it's bad that the skin absorbs it. *ahem* you know that doctors are not going to recommend anything other than drugs that are mostly toxic? my dermatologist was definitely giving me carcinogens, which I found out from my doctor -- so she started prescribing me steroids. that can't be good either now can it, especially when she told me that my skin shouldn't absorb too much of it?It's okay to absorb the coconut oil though, because it's non-toxic, nourishing for the skin, anti-fungal, anti-oxidant and can be used internally as well. So definitely, it's great for eczema. You have to be patient with it, though -- it's not harsh and strong like my steroid cream that works in minutes. The coconut oil on the first few applications within the first day or two will still leave your skin pretty dry (in my experience), but I think it's just a matter of your skin getting used to it or something. Or maybe it's a matter of getting it so that your skin is actually nourished, after all those years of using toxic malnourishing lotions.With acne, it's meh. I have acne on my forehead, and I learned that it's due to the oil from my hair... or, your forehead naturally produces more grease than other parts of the body. At least for me. I didn't see that big a difference with coconut oil in the past month, but I solved my acne on my forehead problem with a facial cleanse at a day spa, followed by applying organic jojoba oil on it day and night for almost a week now... and the acne's pretty much calmed down a lot.My face was really smooth when I consistently used the old lotions -- while I was switching to coconut oil for the first few weeks, my face was kind of dry. But now it's back to smooth, possibly even smoother.I bought another jar for my mom, just for general use. She used it on some sort of super itchy rash (possibly some sort of infection, I had no idea) that just wouldn't go away for months. In her experience, after applying coconut oil, her rash itched like crazy while it was greasy. But after a few days of application, it was getting better and itching less frequently. When she applied the coconut oil at night, it wouldn't wake her up anymore from the itchiness like it used to.I will continue to use organic extra virgin coconut oil, and stay away from toxic substances. I think I'm also going to start cooking with coconut oil as well.The only downside to coconut oil in my experience and/or from what I've read and researched, are:if you don't like the smellif you're allergicif you're too lazy/impatient to switch from conventional lotions to coconut oilCoconut oil is too good to be true. As a huge developed country we're so far removed that we had no idea that we don't really need drugs.  At least for good skin and hair and to slow the aging process, stick to organic extra virgin coconut oil. It's probably the only staple "cosmetic" product you'll ever need -- good health leads to beauty.

This is the brand I usually purchase at the local co-op, and I am super stoked to see it here for half of what I normally pay so I just purchased two pounds. I can go through a pound in a month because I use it to make deodorant, toothpaste, to oil pull with, as a supplement, to cook with, and as body and hair moisturizer for me and my toddler. We both have very curly hair and dry skin and this is my favorite oil to use. It does have a somewhat strong scent that smells similar to buttered popcorn, haha, but I like it. No one has ever remarked that we smell bad. A few times I've been told we smell like pastry or coconut or "something vaguely familiar" and whenever I mention popcorn usually people agree. Anyways, I love this for first aid (rashes, cuts, burns) and to fend of sickness (often I can take a TBS and oil pull and feel better within an hour). Word of caution: take it easy if you are taking this internally at first. I've thrown up from taking too much on an empty stomach before (felt better immediately after, though). The die-off from bacteria can cause you to have "detox sickness". Oh! And it helps make breastmilk richer too. I really hope it will stay at this price long enough for me to make my next order. Love, love, love!

I purchased this product because I am an African American woman with 4b hair and I was loosing a lot of hair. I saw a review on this product and I decided to get it. I would have to say that it is one of my staple products now. I love it.

column4: chrissy "save an egg.. crack a smiile =)"
column10: iuse this to deep condition my hair, and it makes it SUPER soft =) im starting to run low, so im going to go ahead and order more =)

I heard about coconut oil from someone on pinterest and decided to do some research on it which led me to amazon. I bought two jars of this stuff, one to keep in my kitchen for cooking,etc.  and one for personal care. About once a week I put a couple tablespoons full in a bath and wow it has done wonders for my skin. My skin is softer, I have gotten rid of most of these little bumps I had on the back of my thighs and arms. I have used it as a hair conditioner, leaving it in my hair overnight and then showering the next morning. It leaves my hair shiny and healthy. I also use it as a spread on my waffle, just a tablespoon on a whole grain waffle with some jelly, it tastes great and it good for your metabolism and health all around. it is high in saturated fat so you have to be careful but I think the good of this product out weights that. all in all I recommend it.

Great coconut oil! Purchased this to use when making my own popcorn & it is great.  My whole family loves the taste.  After buying this I read that virgin coconut oil is the most healthy for popcorn & was thrilled to get it & see that it is virgin coconut oil.  Love it!  Hope it comes in a larger container for next time!

Felt very energized, perhaps to energized; so half a tablespoon is enough for me.  Great alternative for COFFEE!  Run much more smoothly, better skin, better hair, better eye sight, better digestion, etc.

column9: Great taste and quality, and price too
column10: I started eating coconut oil for anti-fungus purpose. I found this great taste food. Later, I also apply it to my feet to prevent fungus growth. The result has been great. I am now regularly purchasing this product.

Have a complete obsession with this product. I use it every single day after the shower to moisturize my skin. Use it monthly as a conditioning treatment on my hair.  Just use caution if u go to a water park and slide down the water slides. I've never slid so fast in my life. ;)

I've been using either Nature's Way or Nutiva coconut oil for several years, and love how versatile it is.  Not only can you use it for cooking and baking (and even around the edges of bakeware or in a frying pan in place of olive oil), but you can also use it for personal care.To do so, I scoop some into a small container so I don't have to dip my fingers in the larger jar.  I keep the large jar in my kitchen for cooking purposes, and then small container in my bathroom, where I use it as an eye makeup remover when I have heavy makeup on, as a skin moisturizer, and as a hair treatment.  For the hair, a small amount rubbed/melted into your palms and smoothed on over hair helps with flyaways, and a larger amount rubbed in before bed or twenty minutes before washing serves as a deep treatment. (Oftentimes, I'll put it in my hair before I go workout so that the heat helps it penetrate.)  Since coconut oil is easily absorbed by the hair, it makes for a great conditioner.The Nature's Way brand has consistent quality and tastes very good. It's a staple item in our house.

column9: And to think this has always been around
column10: I love this product soooo much; I use it on my skin after a really hot bath and it just melts into your skin. It does not leave an oilly or greasy feel behind (my skin just drinks it up) and even if I don't put it on for a day or two, it still feels like I did.You can eat it cause ........ well it's food and you can cook with it bake with it. I tryed it on a spoon, it has a suttle tast of an amond joy or mounds bar. Just a hint of chocolate and toasted nuts. I also use it on my hair to keep it moist since I just discovered the trend of natrual hair and hair styles for natural hair. I stopped the relxars in 1998 but was still hardheaded about the box braids etc. My stylest finally got me to understand that less is more.so for over 10 years it's just been wash consi and flat iron. I did have color put in a year ago and it's almost grown out. But I wanted to try something diffrent that I would'nt regret later. and the blow out braid out works very well for me. The Coconut oil is organic and not something you go to a hair supplie place etc to buy. I like it cause I'm feeding my hair and body with something that is natural and good for you.With so many natural coconut oil products out there, how do you choose?. For me I read the reviews first and then looked at the prices and checked afew other places ( okeay one ) but I can't say where. In the end I chose this Coconut oil made by natures way. ( this is my second jar, still have not finished the first jar. Second jar is in the kitchen and the first jar is in the bathroom or bedroom. I am going to buy more and I just turned my aunti on to it. She said " My goodness, who knew and I,ve been passing by it at the food store for years".

column9: This is the best stuff ever....very pleased!!!!
column10: I ordered this product after reading the reviews keeping an optimistic state of mind because I am usally not a follower.  However...this product is more than what everyone say it is.  I am totally hooked.  I put this product in oatmeal, smoothies, whole wheat english muffins.  I even cook my rice in this product.  I am losing weight and enjoy the taste.  I purchase two because I also use this product on my skin in which my skin now look like a movie stars skin.  It is a bit oily however it soaks in the skin and you feel so soft all day.

I use this as a skin moisturizer and love the way it feels and smells!  Does a good job keeping my hands moisturized.  Need to reapply a couple times throughout the day, but it's worth the tradeoff that it's all natural without any weird chemicals, unlike the lotions you find the the personal care section.For those that care: this comes in a plastic jar, not glass.  Since I use it topically, I don't care that much.  But if I was eating it, there are other organic coconut oils out there that come in glass containers.

Being Indian, my mom used to always put coconut oil in my hair so it is my habit to put oil in my hair at least once a week or so. The oil sold at the stores isn't pure so I decided to buy this product on amazon. I have used 2 jars so far and I am in love with it! The oil comes in solid form and then turns into a liquid once you rub it between your palms. I warm the oil in a small container, then apply it to my hair, and leave it overnight to shampoo the next day. I also use this as a skin moisturizer in the winter. I don't use this on my face because my face is tends to be sensitive and flares up even with the most "organic" products. So if you are acne prone, then I would suggest testing it out before you apply it.

This product is awesome! If you know about real coconut oil (had it fresh in the tropics), you will love this product. My sister brought me some coconut oil from NY (Jamaica's Best I believe) at the same time I ordered this product. I was a little peeved because this product cost much more than the one my sister brought me. As soon as I opened the jar though, I understood why. This is the real McCoy!!

column9: Didn't buy it for the reason you'd think
column10: Did some research and decided to give this a try as a personal lubricant. I recommend looking it up and giving it a try!

I made a few orders, this one came fast and furiously first. I ordered two jars, just in case they are small. But when the package arrived, the jars are pretty big! I opened it up, and the oil smells beautifully !! The coconut oil tastes like the almond joy. I did not really buy this for cooking but for hair and skin care and it melts on the skin like butter !!! I already love it, it smells wonderful and I will continue to use it, so that way I am able to stay away from paraben- containing hair care and skin care products. If they had even larger jars, I would order them !!! Eventually I will order more even for cooking. I really would recommend this, if you have really curly hair to use it in place of hair grease. It will even last longer and it is much cheaper, cleaner and healthier in the longrun !!!I recommend this product to anyone who wants to use it what natuer already has to offer.

column9: Fresh taste and good consistency - absorbs quickly into skin!
column10: This coconut oil is an excellent multi-purpose product.  I have used it for cooking, broiling, eating by the spoonful and as a skin moisturizer and massage oil.Last night I put a few pats of this coconut oil on salmon with a salt and herb mix.  I broiled the salmon and it tasted amazing.  The coconut oil definitely enhanced the flavor.I have been using this oil for frying eggs as well.  It does not seem to burn as quickly as olive oil or butter and it also seems that less is needed for frying - probably since it's easier to use small amounts since it is in solid form.This coconut oil also worked well for sauteing tofu and broccoli with Bragg's liquid unfermented soy.It's also tasty on a baked potato and I find that I can skip the salt and still enjoy the flavor.  You can also add it to rice or rice and beans or french fries for a tropical splash of flavor.I combined this coconut oil with olive oil to saute vegetables for a pasta dish and it worked beautifully.It has mild, fresh flavor and a little seems to go a long way.April 19, 2012Still loving this coconut oil.  It tastes great so you could literally eat a spoonful or two if you were hungry and needed instant energy.I packed it for a trip to Florida.  It was solid when I arrived, but liquified once I hit the warmer weather.It also works great in a hot bath for instant moisturizing and it's the perfect after sun moisturizer.  It smells so good that you could use it as a very mild perfume and moisturizer just by rubbing it into your arms and legs until the oil is absorbed - seriously!

column9: Fantastic for hair.  OK for dry skin
column10: My hair LOVES coconut oil, apparently.  I have been using a small amount in my hair after I wash and towel-dry my hair for the past 3 weeks, and my normally fine, dry hair is noticeably healthier.  It's not as frizzy and dry.  The coconut oil is actually changing my hair condition instead of just sitting on the surface of my hair and making it look glossy.I have tried some pretty expensive products in my hair ($20-$30 conditioners, hot oil treatments, etc.), and all I can say is, I am never going back.  My advice is to be patient with it, it's not an overnight cure, but your hair will definitely feel great over time.I also have pretty dry skin, but the oil seems to provide only minimal moisture for my cracked skin.  I'm sure it's great for normal skin, though.

This coconut oil is fantastic.  I'll leave you to read the other reviews but leave you with one tip.  If you store your jar on top of the fridge, it will stay soft.  The slight warmth won't be enough to liquify it, but it will keep it manageable for scooping and such.  Enjoy!

The name "DelightExpressions" explains their service.True to their word the quality of the Teddy bear and Chocolate was very good, infact never believed it was the same item i ordered.The teddy bear is cute (not like the cheap ones imported from china)and my daughter loved it so much that from the time it arrived its been with her.100% value for money.
Oh how I love these truffles!  They were very fresh and the flavor is intense!  The only problem I had was that I could not eat just 1, I had to eat at least 3 to be satisfied, they were that good!
These chocolates are so smooth & creamy.  Received at a gift and then had to buy more.  Good price - less than sale prices in the store as long and you can get the free super-saver shipping.
WE ABSOLUTELY LOVE THEM. I HAVED HAVE SERVED THEM AS A DESERT AND EVERYONE SAYS HOW GOOD THEY ARE. THEY ALWAYS ASK ME WHERE I PURCHASED THEM

column9: Only have 3 packs in the package!
column10: The item says pack of 4, but the box only contained 3 packs! 3 packs of 5.1 ounce bags! What the hell?!

column9: La Florentine panettone is the BEST !!!!!!
column10: I've tried & had many different brands of panettone and don't regard myself as a gourmet BUT.......both my wife & I agree that La Florentine is by far the best-flavored and richest tasting panettone on the market today.  We've bought our panettones from italian dessert shops, big box stores, supermarkets, deli's etc but nothing compares to the La Florentine that we found at the local Shopper's food store (of all places) this past year.  Right now, they're clearing them out at $4.49 ea!  I bought one today to keep in the freezer to have during 2008.  You can bet that that next year, we will be buying La Florentine, no question about it !!!!!!!
The only detraction I found was dryness and not enough citron. The price we equal to the quality of the product. Yes i would by it again. I would use it for french toast.

column9: A taste of Iraq in America
column10: I first came across Alwazah Tea while on my second tour to Iraq.  Some of the local merchants sold packages to the US Troops in the bazaar, and I found the flavor to be very similar to the teas served by the sheiks in the area.  Later on, I became attached to a Joint Operations Center and continued using Alwazah to make connections and build up a repertoire with my Jundi counterparts in the Iraqi Army.  This is about as close as it gets to actual Middle Eastern chai available stateside.

I originally found this tea in a store in Nashville, TN, but have since moved.  Unfortunately, I have not been able to find it in any of my local stores.  This tea is worth the effort of ordering when unavailable locally.It has an excellent taste, particularly for those who enjoy the non-bagged variety.  You simply heat water in a kettle and once it begins to boil, take it off the heat.  Put a spoon full or two inside it to steep (depending on amount of water used).  A few minutes later and it is ready to go.  I recommend using a small stainer to pour the tea through and into your cup.For a comparison, I would say Al Wazah tastes similar to Earl Grey, but a bit richer in taste.

column9: The best tea I have ever had.
column10: Really nice tea. I have been using Alwazah Tea for years. It's not comparable with other brands.They also have the best green tea.
this the greatest tea you can find in the states and if you been to the middle east this is the same taste tea which is imported

column9: One of the Best Chocolates I've Found
column10: I am a big fan of dark chocolate - and until I tried the Hershey's dark choc. nuggets with almonds, I thought nothing could rival the Dove brand of dark chocolate (they've been mine & my husband's favorite treats for quite a while now)...However, when my local drug store was out of Dove, I decided to go ahead and give these a try - and now I'm hooked (as is my husband)!  They are melt-in-your-mouth good!!!  And, I love their nugget size - I can choose to eat just 1 or 2 nuggets to indulge my cravings, without increasing my pants size (or I can choose to eat a whole handful, and forget about my pants size - smile).Although I still love Dove dark chocolate, these Hershey's nuggets allow me to enjoy the combination of chocolate & almonds that I love - as I haven't found this combination in the Dove brand - and I've found them to be just as good.

column9: Where do they get these prices?
column10: Where do they get these prices?You can get this at your local grocery for 2 to 3 dollars.This is completely insane.

If you're looking for a great way to thicken gravies without making a fattening rue with butter, here's your answer -just mix 2 tbs. with 1/4 cup water, mix with 1 cup broth and you have instant gravy - no lumps, no problems - great stuff . . .

No They charged me 11.95 for 1 13 z cotaner.. Inn the store it is $2.45 That is too much money. I SENT IT BACK!It showed 3 cans in the picture. Thet wanted $20 some dollars for 3 cans. That is rediculous!

I love Barbecue and I never had it on popcorn. The name caught my eye and I deceided to try it out. Well, I had family over and we all just loved the flavor! I plan on buying more because it comes in handy for a in-between snack with a delicious taste.

column9: A gift basket with no basket???
column10: The product is obviously great quality but considering that I was purchasing a "GIFT BASKET", I find it odd that there was no basket once I received the items. So on top of paying the expensive amount on the "gift basket", I had to go out and purchase a basket! Change the title of the product please...it's extremely misleading.
Thanks Camano Island for the excellent products you have, my fiance love the coffee. Keep up your good and healthy products.

This was shipped to me on time, as described. Lavender is supposed to be difficult to grow, right? At least I got three plants so far. Two of them are thriving.. I'm still hoping to see more plants emerge.

I have never seen a beach housewarming gift before.  It came at the right time.  I wasn't looking to buy my boss a gift, but when I saw this it was perfect.  It was so unexpected by all as to the uniqueness of the theme of this gift that everyone kept saying.........."I have never seen anything like this before."  "Where did you get it."  The price was good and the look was good.  The delivery was pretty quick.  It was packaged well.  Thank you.
The "rocks" shipped out almost immediately. I was very happy with how realistic they looked. They taste just like a jelly bean! I used them to decorate a cake. So cute!!
Very real looking. I put them with a picture on a cake of a man pushing a wheeler barrow full of rocks. They were tasty too.

I am so excited to find these on Amazon, for a decent price and with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.  These are made in Austria.  They come in several flavors, but hazelnut is a traditional European, particularly German/Austrian flavor.  It is used in a lot of dishes.  These are yummy.  My Austrian mom used to buy these for my sister and I when we were kids.  When my kids and I were in Austria 6 years ago and in Germany 2 years ago we devoured these whenever we could find them.  Now we can get them any time on Amazon.  I think I will buy them around the holidays!  I recommend these.  They are traditional, authentic and delicious!

The 2.54 ounce package is too big to use as an individual serving, but contains 10 individual wafers that must be carefully broken apart.  The small individual wafers are perhaps a confection that you would serve with coffee.  They are multilayered wafers - I am reviewing the hazlenut cream filled - which form a light, flavorful treat.  I would not recommend them for an individual dessert, but perhaps they could be used as teatime treats for afternoon social functions.  They packages have a pull tab, somewhat like you find on packages of chewing gum, etc., for ease of opening.  The package indicates five of the small wafers as a serving size, but I think that would be too much.  They are quite filling.

I ordered the extract to make rose ice cream, because you can rarely find it.  The ice cream turned out really great with this flavoring.  I used 1 1/4 teaspoons to flavor about 3 cups of ice cream.  It was a very light and perfect flavor.  You can definetly use more for a stronger taste.  The seller was also very quick with the shipping.

I purchased a bottle of this rose extract from Kalustyan's, a specialty store in NYC. It is good, but not the best rose extract on the market. I suspect it is best for adding a mild, secondary flavor to delicate dishes, like another reviewer's rose ice cream.I used it to add to simple syrup for cocktails, and to add to seltzer. I find it has a soapy flavor when used in anything but the most minute amounts. This is common for many floral extracts, but it was more potent here than in others I've worked with. This should be fine if you're making lemon-rose or vanilla-rose or cardamom-rose cream dishes, but you may be disappointed with stand-alone flavor.I prefer the rose extract made by Silver Cloud Estates. It's about 3x more expensive, but worth it.

column9: Awesome Flavoring & So Glad I Finally Found It!
column10: I had looked for this extract for years and was unable to find it anywhere because its so rare. One day I got the idea to check Amazon.com and was elated to see that they had it. My mother used to use this in cakes when I was a little girl and they were absolutely delicious- like nothing I'd ever tasted then or since. I had tried to replicate her cakes for many years but could never do it until she finally told me her secret ingredient: rose extract. I bought 2 bottles to ensure that I have it for awhile (you only need to use a little bit at a time). This is now my family's favorite type of cake. Another plus is that the seller had it to me in 2 days!

We purchased this extract for flavoing a chocolate candy that we produce and it is perfect! It is very strong so we aren't having to pour an entire bottle of flavoring in to taste it. It also smells great! The Rose flavoring is very unique and adds a twist to anything that you add it to. We have customers who LOVE any of our products with this flavoring added.

I bought the Pure Rose Extract 4oz. bottle. It is absolutely WONDERFUL. My family LOVES my baking! We have made Baklava with it as well as a birthday cake that both turned out absolutely yummy! The package arrived very well packaged. I would buy from you again & again.

column9: I had no idea what to expect but wanted to try it
column10: I read how to make rose water and have plenty of rose petals in the spring but it sounded like too much hassle although I would like to make some candied rose petals because they are very expensive online.  Like others said, just a few drops or it tastes soapy.  I think you have to get accustomed to the new (for me) flavor.  The amount is generous and is not the same as rose water, more concentrated.  I made a Middle Eastern cake that was marbled pink and yellow, rose and almond flavors that complement each other if you don't get too much of one or the other.  I will try to find my photo.  After I got used to it, I liked the taste.  Some time later I used it I think I improvised a corn starch pudding and it was too strong.  I want to try a few drops in my Kittencal's Bakery frosting next time I get inspired.  Anyway, there's a generous amount in the bottle so it will last a long time unless you use it commercially.  Seller and delivery, no problem; I'm usually not in too much of a hurry.  Rose ice cream, divinity, all kinds of things I could try with it.  There is another Middle Eastern recipe I found for Raspberry and Turkish Delight Semifreddo that looks so yummy, will be hard to assemble all the ingredients and get it right.

column9: great value if you want a true rose flavor
column10: I am completely satisfied with this rose extract--it was as advertised, arrived promptly, and is even more concentrated in flavor than I expected. It worked perfectly for a rose sorbet. But, again, it is very concentrated: literally only a few drops are needed.
Misleading listing.  The bottle contains only 1 (one!!) percent of oil suspended in alcohol.  I expected pure rose extract.  Dishonest description.

column9: For green rooibos, a most excellent buy
column10: My wife and I love red rooibos, and without a doubt, Davidson's Tea provides the single best purchase in red rooibos one can find.We read some information that made green rooibos something we wanted to try.  It has somewhat different health benefits than does red rooibos, in ways that white or green tea have other benefits than does black tea.  Since we expect to go through a lot, we decided to give this a try.For those without experience with green rooibos, the taste is rather like a cross between chamomile, green tea, and a hint of red rooibos, but with a slight scent of recently-cut hay.  You will generally find green rooibos combined with other flavors in the store--one popular one is green rooibos with honeybush.  This will likely be our preferred blend, too.  Davidson's Tea also has a very nicely-priced honeybush, so do consider this.  Also, Davidson's Tea has bulk hibiscus, which helps make a nice blend of theirs called "Spring."We will be buying more of this in the future.

column9: My "go-to" remedy for a cold etc.
column10: I have a stressful job where I work around sick people and their often unprotected coughs and sneezes.  Davidson's green rooibos tea is what I reach for at the first sign I'm coming down with something, or those times when my own immune system just feels fragile and run-down.  I make the tea strong (2 heaping teaspoons to a cup), bring it to a boil then steep at least 6 cups on the stove (lowest setting on the burner so it's just gently steaming) for a half hour to an hour.  Sometimes that's enough to knock out the oncoming cold, sometimes I stay on the tea for a few days.  Bottom line:  my coworkers have been sick this winter, most several times; I haven't been sick once.I sometimes drink green rooibos straight but generally mix it with either Davidson's Spring Fruit and Flowers or Davidson's Spiced Rooibos Chai.  Good luck!

I really like this tea.  It is somewhat like green tea, with a grassy aroma.  If you like red rooibos (or if you like green tea), this is one you should try.  I only wish it was available in teabag form. Not quite as sweet as red rooibos, with a sharper edge to it.
Just what we wanted, loose rooibos tea.  Green is unusual, a lot lighter and crisper than regular, but delicious.  We'll run out of this quickly!
This is one of the best buys I have found on the Internet.  At the Vitamin Cottage this stuff is outrageous, but here a pound is much cheaper and a whole lot fresher!!

I don't know much about teas.  I didn't realize when I bought it that it was not a "green tea" but an herbal tea.  But I tried and I love it.  After doing some research on the tea I discovered it has some gastric medical benefits that really help me.  It is also naturally sweet, which means I can use less sweetener.

Residing in Canada, finding green rooibos is quite difficult except in pricey upscale tea shops. My local tea shop has it but the price is approximately 25$/oz.Here comes Amazon and Davidson's Tea where I could finally buy it in bulk for a reasonable price. The rooibos is great and it has that grassy aroma to it. Being rooibos, it is not the tastiest drink but it is good served hot during a cold winter or iced cold during a hot sunny summer day.Healthy, caffeine-free and cheap, what could I ask more ?

I love this mild flavored tea! For me, the most important thing about it is that it does not contain caffeine.  I like to drink it in the evening, English-style, with milk.  I just wish it came in teabags!

I'm a big fan of good, strong British tea like PG Tips but have been told that I can't have caffeine anymore. I tried this tea and am so happy to find a reasonable substitute ~ I don't really care for herb teas with lots of flavors added. The best way I can describe it is to say it has a sort of "earthy", full, yet mild (I know that sounds like a contradiction) flavor.  I like to brew it a bit strong but that doesn't turn it bitter. Some have said it's milder than red rooibos but I think it's more flavorful. It has a nice aroma too.

I usually order the normal organic South African Rooibos Tea and have jugs of this prepared in the fridge for iced tea, use it in my fruit smoothies and even prepare half and half lemon rooibos tea. My brother wanted to try something different and we order a bag of this green Rooibos.  It is a very mild tea leaning towards a pumpkin flavor, the tea in the bag is less aromatic than the normal Rooibos.  It  is a great tea hot or cold if you are looking for very mild color, taste and aroma.  Kind of like green tea with a smear of Rooibos.  If you tried the spiced Chai Rooibos and found it too strong cinnamon flavor, maybe this tea is for your because of this milder taste.  I love strong flavors, my favorite tea is still the original Rooibos, but having of a bag of this one around just to change it up once in a while will be great.

This is a fantastic price for green rooibos, and, though I haven't been quite satisfied with their other products, their green Rooibos is fantastic. Fresh, & delicious. I personally recommend mixing & brewing it alongside their Red Rooibos tea!

Because I really love red rooibos, I decided to try the green variant as well (after all, I do prefer green teas to black teas).  But I was disappointed with this infusion, which was somewhat pale and tasteless compared to the Davidson's red rooibos that I bought from Amazon in the same order as a test.  Even so, the green rooibos does make a nice base to try adding other, more pungent herbal teas, and the price was so reasonable that experimentation is easy to justify.  I suspect that the processing, not the underlying botanical product, is why this variant seemed bland to me, but everyone has his or her own tastes, of course, and you might conclude otherwise.  What's clear, though, is that if you know and like green rooibos, you just can't beat the Davidson's price on Amazon.

column9: Davidson's Teas are a Great Deal
column10: Our family enjoys many of Davidson's bulk herbal teas and they are all high quality and a great bargain compared to tea bags. The green rooibos is reminiscent of green or oolong tea without the caffeine.
This is very tasty tea, it has a little bit sweet, and it has more antioxidants than the red rooibos, you could have a very nice cup for relaxation.
This tea has an excellent flavor. Very comforting and after drinking it your hunger seems to go away.

Very Good product. Made an excellent cup of tea. Green Rooibos is quite different from Red but still a very tasty cup of tea with many health benefits. The picture doesn't do the bag Justice as it has a zip-lock feature. It will take some time to drink all of this one bag and I purchased 4 different varieties. The zip-lock bag would do well if I were were drinking from only one. I vacuum packed 3/4 of each and stored them in the freezer. The partial bags are in the fridge ready to use. I'm looking forward to drinking these fine organic teas for some time to come and save big $s as well.

column9: Like was said, smells and tastes like grass
column10: OK, so please do not consider this a negative review of Davidson's Tea in general.  I guess tea is like anything else, there are some who will like a particular tea and some who won't.  As you can see, there are other reviewers who like this tea a lot.  Another reviewer hit it right on the head, "smells like grass".  It does in fact smell like grass.  I don't want that.  I am ignorant of what a green tea should taste like and I am sure this is the proper smell and taste for this tea and that as green rooibos goes it will be better than other because Davidson's teas usually are, but like my dad told me about Gin-and-Tonics when I was a we one who snuck a sip while he pretended not to be looking, "it is an aquired taste son".I give it 1 star because I personnaly don't like it, not because it is wrong in how it tastes or smells.Hail Flavius!

It doesn't say ANYWHERE on the package that these bags are biodegradable--which is the whole reason I ordered them.  To avoid literally hundreds of plastic bags (nearly 1,000 per year, since we have 2 dogs) going into the environment annually from this household alone!  If they were biodegradable, then manufacturer would say so.  Don't be mislead.  I'm returning mine.

Well what a disappointment...the bags in two of the rolls were just tubes, not bags????  I didn't bother to check out all 120 bags, just tossed the bunch.  Good thing these were for cleaning the cat's litter box, it would have been bad news to have been outdoors "scooping" after a dog. Should have returned them but for $7 it was not worth my time.  I will stick to their blue bags.
Color is great, but see through is not! Buy the boring blue ones. You might feel a little less stupid walking your dog while holding an *opaque* bag of poo.

Colors make picking up "poop" more exciting however when you have to walk a little bit through a park filled with people with a brightly colored bag that clearly shows a lump of "poop" in it, its not as exciting as it is embarrassing. The times I put it in my pocket I can't count enough but then my pocket starts smelling like "poop" so I'm just gonna order the blue ones from now on :

They pick up poop well. I especially like the bright color, which draws attention to would be evil doers that you have a bag of poop ready in case they get out of line.  Cheaper at amazon than target, petsmart or other places online.

A new color every month keeps the poop scooping exciting!  I mean, what's not to love?Ok seriously, these bags fit nicely into the dispenser that's attached to my dog's leash so I'm never caught empty handed.Pros:  These are the correct fit and thus dispense properlyCons:  Um.. blue or red would be nice?I don't know, they're poop bags!  They do the job with a splash of color.

column9: It wasn't broke, but they fixed it anyway...
column10: These bags are just fine, though my first bags on board had the original black bags, and I think there were 20 per roll.  These bags are much larger, and consequently they only hold 15 per roll.  I have a 30-lb dog, so maybe if he were a great dane I'd need a bag that went up well beyond my wrist, but I think I'll skip these in the future for a smaller bag so I have to change the roll less often.  As far as function goes though, they're great.

I always purchase bags on board to pick up my puggles poop. I normally buy the blue bags but decided to purchase the colorful ones because they were a couple dollars cheaper at the time. I guess these bags are defective because I have had a few of the bags open on the wrong end and my hand went all the way through. This is not good when you are about to pick up poo. So I don't know if it was just a bad batch or what but I will definitely go back to buying the blue bags as I have never had a problem with those ones.

column9: These bags used to be good
column10: I open up my new bag of 360 today and take my 2 110lb dogs for a walk.  I open up the bag to pick up my dog's droppings to find out the damn bag has been shortened.  What a HUGE PIA.  Not only are they shorter, they are also thinner.  What a complete waste of money, now I have 358 bags that I have no need for.  Looks like it's time to find another bag for my dogs.

I have an 80 lbs Greyhound that poops like a horse.  He can easily fill a bag on a single walk.  The bags are the right size and have not torn.  Nothing is worse than using a bag to quickly realize you are literally picking up dog doo with a naked hand.  These have saved my hand from the cheap bags my wife keeps buying from the pet store.You could put a softball in these things.

Our family got two greyhounds last year, so we needed to have something that would pick up A LOT of poop.  These poop bags are great!  I have never once gotten poop on myself, which I am quite grateful for.  The bags have never broken, and I have used them for some pretty sharp, frozen poop!I do not use the dispenser along with these bags.  I just buy the bags and bring the roll with me on walks.  They are fairly inexpensive as well, which is great when you have at least 4 poops a day, 7 days a week.The last thing I would comment on is that a tightened bag does not hold the smell in completely.  I didn't expect that it would when I bought them, but I wanted to make sure that anyone buying them knows this.
I really like these bags because they are biodegradable and come in cute colors.  Plus, buying from Amazon was a bit cheaper than Petsmart.

Before I got my puppy, I was collecting plastic bags (instead of using my reusable cloth bags) from grocery stores to pick up my puppy's poop.  I refuse to be one of those people who think that dog poop will melt into the sidewalk after a certain period of time.  I also do not want to be blamed for starting the next Black Plague if dog poop could start a plague like that.In comes this `bags on board' bone thing stocked with bags for like $4.  I'm thinking, "Well, $4 is less than the price of a Bacardi and Diet...why not?!"  Man.  I am not looking back.  For some reason, my puppy pooped her way through all 30 bags in a little over a week.  Good for her... I guess?  So I had to re-up.  I almost went with stuffing plastic grocery bags in the bone and then decided that $7 was worth 120 convenient poop bags.  They fit perfectly into the bone.  The bone is not bothersome on the leash.  And, most important, I never forget a bag!  I don't really care about the colors and I don't see a quality difference between these and the `regular' blue bags.  The bags are not super thick, but my fingers have not broken through the plastic and poop has not come through the plastic.I am conscious of the destruction waste causes.  I do recycle.  I do wish that these were biodegradable.  But, instead of collecting the big grocery bag plastic bags, I am going to use these smaller bags for poop and my cloth bags for groceries.  Right now, the bags are a little big for my puppy, but I am sure she will grow into them...gross.

column9: great product, love the color assortment
column10: My first Bags-on board roll was given to me by my sister, and my B-O-B dispenser was given to me by a friend.  I quickly discovered that they are a MUST HAVE if you live in town and you LIKE YOUR NEIGHBORS!!My first refills were purchased at a local pet supply chain... I got these online to get a better price.  I love the color assortment of these refill bags, up until now I just had the basic original blue bags.What else can you say?  They are great poo-poo bags!  HAHAHA

I've been using the original blue Bags on Board refills off for over 10 years and have never had a problem. I ordered these for a change of pace; they are more transparent than the originals, which wouldn't bother me except they are also not as sturdy. I was using a bag from the 3rd roll in the package, and a hole tore while I was picking up. Ick! I will order the traditional blue rolls in the future!

These rainbow bags are much larger than my original Bags on Board brand. They are easily able to withstand payloads from my enourmous great dane. What else can you say about an item that is used for poop? It works.

Several of the rolls of bags were defective, so that individual bags split along the seams. This would obviously lead to some very messy clean ups, that were more like using a piece of ripped saran wrap (no surefire hand protection) than a bag. Sticking with the trusted blue ones, which I haven't had an issue with.Also, these are definitely normal, plastic bags. They are not biodegradable.

column9: Never had a doggie waste bag fall apart before
column10: I used most of the rolls in this pack without a problem, but recently I started a new purple roll and two bags I pulled off the roll tonight immediately tore open.  I took out a third and it started to tear from the top, but I managed to be delicate enough with it that I could use it to pick up after my dog without having a mess on my hands (literally). I've never had this happen before, but I won't buy these bags again!  I can't be caught outside without a way to pick up after my dog and I certainly don't want to risk using bags that will tear just trying to open them.

column9: Bags on Board Rainbow Bag Refill Pack
column10: Before Ordering,I read some reviews here that claimed that the bags weren't worth buying.But i decided to try them once and had no problems with them.They were reasonably priced,quite colorful and hold up well. Would definitely order again.

column9: Not just for doggie poo anymore!
column10: I am currently a contractor in Afghanistan, and we use porta-potties and toilet units that absolutely cannot handle anything but toilet paper.  These bags are a GREAT solution for what to do with one's feminine products.  Large enough to handle each change, but small enough to not be wasteful, inexpensive, and fun, friendly colors make these an excellent solution to one of life's little problems.I'd imagine they are also good for doggie poo ...

The bags are awesome for picking up the dirty stuff.  After I got the bags and the bag holder, I realized that it's probably going to take my whole dogs life to use 180 bags! Unless you dog poops every day on a walk you might want to consider a smaller package.
This bag is a good size and is thin but heavy duty. The only thing is it's a little difficult opening the bag but once you get it open it works great.

column9: Not quite as nice as the ones that came with the leash
column10: I have one of those retractable leashes that has a slot for the bags built into it. It came with a pack of bags similar to this that was light blue. (both were bags on board brand)These bags are very similar to those ones, but harder to open.It's not that big of a deal, when I need more bags I would buy these again, but if it is the same price as the light blue ones I would buy those instead (which I why I gave 4 stars instead of 5). But if these were cheaper I wouldn't hesitate to buy them again.
We have ordered these bags a couple of times and we do not have any complaints!  We like that they are biodegradable and the size is perfect.

column9: Great price & they do the job
column10: Poop bags are poop bags.  They do their job well and they are a good size.  Some bags get to feeling pretty small to use when your dog is 100 lbs. This one does not.
We have purchased these bags from the pet store and have not had a problem.  Half of the bags we have used are not properly sealed at the bottom and are unusable.

The first roll of bags was fine, but so far every bag on the second roll has been defective ... the bottoms tear open as soon as you put your hand into it, or (WORSE) tear open as soon as you put your doggy mess inside.  Gross!  I'm not real enthused about finding out if the rest of the rolls are defective or not ... I think I'll just cut my losses and pitch them into my recycle bin.

column9: visible at night so neighbors don't panic or glare
column10: I like these bags for night use (especially thecoveted yellow and bright green ones.  Orange isthird best and purple doesn't help.  When I haveyellow or green, they are easier to see at nightas I walk my dog and neighbors are more likely torelax and get in their house, rather than stick aroundto watch me pass by.I always pick up after my dog.  However, in my neighborhoodthere are people who open their door and let the dogs out togo where they please unsupervised.  Or there are stealth walkersthat let their dog go, then walk off, without picking up.I don't like finding others' surprises on my lawn either,so using bags is a must to be a good neighbor.PROS: Bags on Board are well made, I don't feel like themoisture is going through the bag onto my hand like I didwith another brand. As mentioned before, the bright yellowand green are great for night use.CONS:  Unlike the blue bags on board, these are a thinner materialand seem to stick closed.  The bags are all attached on a roll, soafter tearing free one bag, I usually rub the top bag edge  betweenmy hands very fast and try to get the bag to separate, then when itgives a little and I see that milimeter of separation at the top ofthe bag, I carefully pry it apart and open the bag fully.  This isBEFORE I go out with the dog at night, because in the dark, I'd neverbe able to see the milimeter separation and pry the bag open it timely.It takes awhile to rub the bag material and get it finally opened.Blue bags by contrast are easy to open without having to rub.I will continue to buy these bags and the blue ones, but because of thedifficulty getting the bags open, I have to rate this at 3 starsUPDATE - dampen one finger before you rub the edge of the bag and itsticks a little, making it easier to open the bag

These refills for the Bags on Board container take the boredom out of your walking routine!  Colorful, convenient, and cheaper in quantities; how can you go wrong?  At 5 am it is especially nice that these bags tear evenly, neatly, and easily along the perforations, and that the opening has dark bars making it easily distinquished.  With this kind of cheap convenience there is no excuse for not picking-up after your dog.

column9: Cheery bags for a dirty deed
column10: As the title says, these are cheery bags for a dirty deed.One bag usually suffices to take care of the business done by two 25 kilo dogs. I'd estimate the bag rupture/burst/break/tear rate at a little under 0.5%, which is acceptable considering the cost and how thin they are - usually it's just a small tear.Sometimes it's a little tough to open the bag, I suggest pinching the end with your fingers and rubbing back and forth to make it easier. Usually a bit of moisture helps that as well. We usually just use the pinch method before knotting the bag to the handle of the leash, then when it's business time it's simple to address things quickly without fumbling to open the bag.Good deal, worth the money. Love the colors.
This review is pretty straight forward. These bags are great just like their blue bags.  I love the Bags on Board holder in which their bags fit.

Its great that they come in different colors but I'm more impressed by the fact it has a black bar across the bag design.  I used to have a hard time telling which bag ended and when the next one began.  Its made it easier and its durable too.

column9: Good price, roomy, easy to open
column10: I like using these bright bags because I walk my dog at a popular park and I want people to know I pick up after him. I don't want someone stepping in a mess, much less glaring at me thinking it was my dog!I've never had a bag break and they are easy to open. They've got the Bags on Board logo printed on them. They're pretty sheer, so if you don't want to be obvious about what you're carrying, go with a black bag. I usually put an extra one under the roll, so that I don't unexpectedly run out.

I like these bags because they are big enough to do the job.  My dog is now 6 months old and weighs around 50 lbs.  Hopefully, they will still work when we are fully grown.  I'd been using the blue ones which are fine, but I liked the colors for a change.  The small rolls are good because they fit (I do use a soft cloth case) in my back pocket.

The description of this item on Amazon says these bags are biodegradable.  According to the manufacturer's website, nothing says this is true.  The packaging does not mention this, nor does any thing anywhere else.This is deceptive advertising.  I paid for an item I did not receive. I wanted biodegradable bags.

column9: Bags on Board waste pickup bags
column10: These are decent bags with an easy tear off strip. They hold the contents well and basically do the job they are intended for. I guess the bright colors makes them a bit more exciting.

The product was delivered prior to the promised time.  I expected a rainbow of colors to my bags.  However, the delivered product was all one color - blue.  Nice bags, however, I expected a color rainbow.

I go through alot of these bags and they are great! I love the colors and the size is perfect for me. I have a medium sized dog about 50lbs and these work great with her. The bags are great quality - I have never once had an issue with them breaking or not working. I highly recommend these.

Not only do these bags make picking up dog stuff more colorful, they also are a great way for people to see that YOU are picking up after your own dog, AND not leaving those little ubiquitous blue bags on the sidewalk... And they look great in his neon green bag dispenser.

So far I have only opened one of the rolls of bags. It seems good enough, but if my dog's poo was just a little bigger than I'd be having a hard time. For reference, my dog is an 8 month old female border collie/lab mix (about 35 pounds).

Overall, this was a decent price for the volume of biodegradable poop bags...the only problem was that each bag in 1 entire roll (orange)did not have an opening on 1 side (i.e. both ends were closed). Defective. Also, these bags are hard to open in the cold as we can't figure out where the opening is each time & it doesn't initially open easily when rubbed together to find the opening. Overall, ok for the cost (although, I think I found similar cost at Home Goods with cute colors too). One note for "big" dog owners; these bags are small. It's ok for us as we have mini dogs.

column9: My go to poop bags for my dogs
column10: I have been ordering these bags from amazon for a couple of years now, and they are my preferred choice. Compared to other bags I have used in the past the perforated edges make them easy to tear off and even more importantly they are easy to open. Also the side that opens is clearly marked. These points are important when walking two energetic dogs who can get excited so I like to be able to get the bags out and open and the poop scooped up as quickly as possible.
Love them! I've used other brands and they didn't tear well. These are sturdy and tear off well. Worth the money!

column9: These do the job, but don't hide the smell
column10: These do the job--carry dog poo--but they do not hide the smell. So if your dog poops early on in the walk, you get to smell poop the rest of the way until you find a trash can. I think it's worth it to pay a little extra for the deodorized bags.

Easy to tear off and does not jam up my little fire plug carrier.  When its cold out, its tough when the bags  wont tear off and I have to take my gloves off and struggle with the bags....these are easy and fit nicely
Along with the "bone" case, this is most convenient for doggie pickups.  Second time I've purchased it, and will continue to do so.
It is what it is. Our community now has erected a poop station The bags are actually bigger and stronger

excellent bags for picking up you dogs waste. strong and easy to pull apart.This pack has enough for our storage in the car for three months we own six small dogs. That's alot of poop but we feel it's a job that keeps the walking paths clean and safe for others.  Thanks

I've been using these bags for cleaning up after my lab since we adopted her last year.  They are super handy, and fit in standard dispensers.  These value packs on Amazon are a great deal - much better than store pricing.

I really like using these bags, as they are waterproof, so no leakage, it also reduces the amount of smell! They are not the strongest bags, but strong enough for the purpose. They will tear if you throw them against wall etc. Bright colors also make it easier to see, and also more fun.I have been using them for over a year now and very satisfied with them.
These bags do the job and in color.  It's nice to know that I have a plentiful supply of bags that don't have holes in them.  They're also very easy to use.
Used them before for years and would never be without them! Don't know how anyone can "walk the dog" and not have these bags on board.

column9: great product that does what it is supposed to do.
column10: The colorful bags are easy to carry while on walks with your pup and do exactly what they are intended to do.

These bags started off okay... but once we got to the 3rd refill we began to notice that many of the bags either a) didn't open at all or b) both ends were open! We figured maybe it was just one refill, but in four of these refills we have had the same problem. We had to throw away about 1/3 of the bags or try to use them even though they are defective. Will not be buying these in the future.

Great quality of bags.  colorful.  easy to insert into the dog-bag-holder.Remember, the bags must be thin enough to fit a large number of them in the roll, and thick enough so you dont feel like you're picking up poop with your bare hands!  as far as picking up poop, the thicker the better! We purchased another product from Amazon with a LARGE NUMBER OF BAGS for ~25, and while it was much cheaper than THIS product, the bags are so thin that its really nasty to pick up the poop.
Doggie poop bags are a must, might as well be pretty. I've ordered these before - never get caught short on bags . . . buy in bulk!
They're poop bags that do the job and look exactly like the colors pictured. I got exactly what I expected from this product. Would buy again.
these little bags are a lifesaver for those puppies who enjoy long walks! I wouldn't go anywhere without them! Unfortunately there are only 15 bags per roll, which seems like not that many...
These bags are large enough for my hands, & keep the stink in when tied. Thick enough that moisture won't come out & handles sticks, wood chips, & rocks well.

I bought the bone bag holder and it only comes with 60 bags so i figured id stock up now and bought the rainbow ones too, the colors are bright and so far none of the bags have any holes in them. the only thing that i dislike is that you can smell the dog droppings right through the bag. but what can you expect.
This is a good deal on doggie pick-up bags for a small dog.  I have a poodle and the bags work great.
great bags that do exactly what I need them to :) wish they made other color options (i.e....all green, all yellow, etc). but would recommend them for their functionality & price

column4: Leesa S. Chwan "L. Chwan, RN, BN."
column10: these bags are great and leak proof!  also, i love the rainbow of colours!  i would be lost without them :)
These bags were exactly what we expected.  Hold up well and do not rip or fall apart like other brands.  Fits in all holders too.

What can I say, they work.  I keep on buying work great and never guilty of leaving dog mess for someone else to have to deal with.  I wish everyone used doggie bags.  These work great in the plastic bone holder sold separately.
The bags are wonderful! They keep your hand dry and you have a nice barrier against yucky pool feeling. I just bought more!

Love these bags...just the right size for smaller dogs (I have a Crested and a Pomeranian), sturdy (that's important!)..and in color too.  They only have blue ones at the pet stores.  Good deal, better price than at the pet superstores.

If you walk your dog then you need to carry bags to pick up those doggie "diamonds" :) So I like carrying bags in a handy carrier and using colorful bags.  These are a good price and purchasing an eight pack helps me to stock up.  I put a few in my emergency kit too!

column9: Good bags, great price on Amazon!
column10: These bags are pretty handy to have.  They beat trying to use recycled grocery bags (which often have holes in them that you only notice once you're out on your walk).  The bags are thin but pretty sturdy.  Some reviews complain that they are too big, but I have a small dog and don't find that to be the case.  They are long enough that you can tie them in a knot, any shorter and this would be tough.  Overall a good buy and a much better price than you would find in the pet store!

Sure you can use those plastic bags you get from the grocery store..but I continue to buy these bags because I can store them in my glove compartment, my purse, my puppy training bag, and anything else small I might have. They also tear off well and open well. I've had some before that drove me nuts because when I tore one it tore the bag and it took me forever to open it. These work well for me.  As for the colors, the dogs could care less, but I like them!
I've purchased cheaper bags since buying these which work well.  These are thicker and cheaper here than at a pet store.
This are the cheapest bags I've found! They don't have any weird scent and are big enough for big-dog waste.
Very fast shipping.  Best price out there. For me the bags last about 4 months for 1 dog. They have never ripped on me!
The bags are sturdy and were received in a timely manner.  Love all the different colors too.
work fine.  I'm a dog walker so these are a very necessary item.  I've been using them for years.  love the different colors

column9: Bags on Board are the Greatest!
column10: Love the convenience of having a doggie bag when I'm out for a walk with my dog. Super convenient!

I've now ordered bags from "Bags on Board" several times and plan to continue doing so. I do have the leash clip to carry them that way, but the rolls are small enough to fit easily in jacket pocket. Not to be too graphic but I have large dogs and these work.

This is the best deal I can find over the web. The bags are pretty long compared with other brands I bought before. So they are good for big dogs, too. On the other hand, you get only 15 per roll, not 20 per roll. Try to get bags of darker colors. The yellow ones are too transparent.
Like these poop bags because they are pretty durable and they claim to be biodegradable. Will buy again.
Great bags ... they do not tear during use. I think that's the most important factor. :)
These were relatively cheaply priced and they definitely do the job.  I will probably buy them again.
Great to have along for the walk.  Good size, easy to use, biodegradable.  The number of bags in the pouch lasts a good while and the variety of colors are pleasing.

The bags are great- easy to use and biodegradable, which is awesome. They're long enough to easily tie when you've finished, and they're pretty! I just wish there were more bags in a roll. I feel like I am always running out.
Perfect size and colors.Just wish more folks would buy and use them.Bag fits like a glove over hand.Simply pick up and turn inside- out.Tie a knot and be done with it.Great product.

These bags are very sturdy and large enough to hold any size dogs poop. I find them to be very sturdy...never found a hole in any bag or had a finger poke through. These Bags on Board do a very good job at what they are intended for and that's all one needs to know.

column9: as functional as it is colorful
column10: these little rolls of bags are smaller than other brands you can get at baby supply stores. we originally received it as a baby shower gift. the powder scent and the durable plastic keeps odors within, which is especially helpful when on the road or in the midst of plenty of people.

The doggie bags are environmentally friendly (decomposable), and they were an excellent price. They work well, are big enough to pick up a couple different doo-doo droppings per bag, and are easy to use. Great product.

column9: I don't even have a dog :)
column10: I used these for party favor bags because I like the colors and they matched by ballons and ribbons.  They are bigger than regular favor bags and will rip if you put something really heavy or pointy in them, but easy enough for the kids to rip open and get to the prizes.  They are great for the diaper bag or holding wet clothes...  and cheaper than the versions sold for dirty diapers.

I'm a big fan of Bags on Board 100% biodegradable bags.  The construction of the bags are sturdy and dependable, which makes cleaning up after your pet easy.  The various colors are a nice touch to a good product!
Don't skimp on cheap bags... stick with "Bags on Board" for picking up waste.  They are the best!  I would purchase from this company (thru Amazon) again.
Not only are these bags colorful, they make cleaning up easy! I will certainly reorder when my supply gets low.
These bags work great, and it's nice to have the different colors to look at for a change. I also love that they are biodegradable.

This product is claimed to be biodegradeable, but it is not.  When the bags arrived, they were clearly different from the originals that we received as a gift, so my wife called the company and learned they had changed the chemistry of the plastic, and they are no longer biodegradeable.  They said that the EPA requires that anything in a biodegradeable package must be compostable, and they do not recommend that animal waste be composted.
I was amazed at how quick I received this order. I can't comment on the product itself as this was purchased for someone else.

I bought four of the "Best Sellers Collection" Gift Boxes as Christmas gifts for clients.  What a joke.  Subtract out the box, the "plentiful" cheese curds (probably a 1/3 of the product weight in the box) and you would have enough chesse to hold in one hand and at a ridiculous price per pound.  Go to a supermarket and spend the same money and get an amazingly better gift.  A total ripoff and I would never buy anything from these people again.  Wayne  -  Utah

The jerky itself is very good quality. The only problem is how much pepper they load onto these pieces. It's so much that it burns my mouth and I can't even taste the jerky, all I can taste is strong pepper. Then it gets into the back of my throat and burns sometimes, or might get stuck in my teeth, all making for a very unpleasant experience!

This double pack was delivered promptly.  I took advantage of the auto-ship subscription which discounts the order from $20.89 down to $17.76. I discovered after the fact that the same size package can be purchased at Wal-Mart at the same cost as this discounted price.

I read the reviews and took my chances and bought a bunch.  I am so disappointed by the sweet, lacquered Chinese bbq pork like beef jerky with an overwhelmingly raw garlic/chili favor.  Yes, the pieces are moist but in a preserved radish way with smallish, flattened pieces. It just doesn't have the premium beef jerky heft where you can separate the pieces along the grain. Don't expect premium beef taste and texture but rather a product processed more in the Chinese restaurant baking soda, tenderized fashion.  I truly regret my purchase which I probably couldn't give away.

The price was very good, but I guess I know why.  I gave it 1 star because it's low in carbs and another because it's edible.  There is a distinct foul odor when you open the bag for the first time.  After airing the bag out, the first piece I tasted was like chewing shoe leather, dry and chewy without much flavor.  After the 2nd piece, the meat began to leave a bad chemical aftertaste.  I understand everyone's taste buds will be different so do yourself a favor and buy a small bag of this at Walmart before getting the big bags here.

Unfortunately this is a very poor representation of Jack Link's Beef Jerky. The bags are small and the jerky is in very small pieces and crumbs. It looks like scraps or left overs. No piece is larger than 1/2 inch.

So I have been hanging with a top player at the world series of poker and I purchased 2 packages of Jacks Links beef jerky.  These 2 purchases were the worst possible way to spend my money.  The meat was so dry I was not sure if I was eating dried rat tail or beef jerkey.  The "meat" caused sickness and lock jaw.  Jacks links is as good as scraps off leather shoes.  It was pretty incredible of them to sponser the WSOP but provide poor quality food at a ridiculous price.

column9: Not a good value, but tasty
column10: The packs are really small. I thought I was saving by buying in bulk, but it was not a lot for the money.  As usually the beef jerkey tastes great.
If you're not into a healthy lifestyle, get these - they are DELICIOUS! "You can't eat just one!"It contains MSG and other "stuff." - You've been warned! It's very delicious, though...

I can't always get to the store on my bicycle, so it is quite handy to use Amazon & order something I hanker for.  The beef jerky, high in protein & low in calories, fat & carbs, absolutely hit the spot when it arrived nice & quickly!

28.99 dollars for one pack? Are people stupid, you can buy these at the neares supermarket for less than 28.99, aybe 7 or 8 dollars, but not 28 for one pack..  I know is easy to buy online, but buying this, is just playing lazy!

column9: Good, healthy and protein filled snack.
column10: I only have one major issue. Because of the texture of jerky in general it really gets stuck in your teeth and becomes a bit of a chore to eat.

Bought this thinking it cheap and more convenient, but i was wrong. The meat in the package seem dried and old. The price was also higher comparing to my  local samsclub.I like it when the meat is more tender and moist. And this doesn't deliver that. 1 star.
What a rip off.  We opened the bag and a day later there was wispy white mold on it.  The whole bag had to be thrown out.  It even smelled a little "off".  You're better off buying it at the store.

Jack Links is really good one of the bests and its actually real meat haha,I dont have to pay for it I get it for free because my dads company sells it and he gets free stuff from them all the time but if I didnt get it for free I would pay full price for it!

column9: lost one bag of my "jack link's" beef jerky
column10: I am a regular subscriber of this "Jack Link's" beef jerky terriyaki. This morning, I opened the new box from Amazon and found that there are only 9 bags in the box while it supposed to be 10. I used to trust Amazon and this is the first time that I check the quantity in the box. Since the inside box is open, so someone might have taken one during the packing process because s/he loves it so much but I hate to lose one bag of my Jack Links beef jerky!!

I'm a former Marine, got out after 8 years, did two tours in Iraq and one in Afghanistan. I was first introduced to beef jerky during MCT (Marine Combat Training)...which is where you learn warfighting techniques. For those LONG, sweaty, depressingly hot days in NC...this was an excellent snack. Beef Jerky is nutritious, low in fat content and tastes great! It also is a great chewy snack for those 'hurry-up-and-wait' days. Perhaps the biggest benefit for me was the salt....if you're out in the sun all day, you lose a lot of sweat....the Marine Corps motto should be 'drink water'...but as for electrolytes/ salt....this snack does an excellent job. I love the peppered taste...probably because I'm Jamaican. The 1.5-ounce snack size fits perfectly in your pocket and works out to be about half the price you'd pay at the gas station (thanks Amazon). I have a couple of buddies over in Afghanistan and I sent each two packs....for them and to pass around to their troops...they love it.For a healthy snack (especially if you're very active and sweat a lot)this is a great product.If there was one complaint....I wish the desiccant that is inside every bag was somehow shaped differently.....if you grab a handful in the bottom...you'll never know that you grabbed the desiccant too....luckily I've been able to catch it!

I'm normally a fan of jack links but this really disappointed me. Ordered 4 bags and had two of them. I spent more time picking through the meat taking out the nasty gizard and fat chunks all throughout the bag. Also the meat quality was terrible and quality control isn't. Good for this flavor. One piece would be moist and flavorful and the next would bard as a rock and uncomfortable to chew. Overall this was a terrible product. Jack links shouldn't put 10 different cuts of meat in the same bag. If you like quality controlled products this isn't for you.

Good stuff....but.  I'd gotten some at Walmart but didn't really pay attention to the price (for one bag).  I enjoyed it so much that I searched for it on Amazon (in bulk) and ordered three different flavors.  I happened to be in Walmart the next morning and discovered to my surprise that it was significantly cheaper there.  (Walmart $3.50 for a 3.5oz bag, Amazon about $23.00 for ten 1.5oz bags - almost 50 cents an ounce more from Amazon plus you have to purchase it in bulk).  I find that I tend to order blindly from Amazon when I'm actually purchasing from Amazon and not a third-party vendor because I'm so used to fantastic savings.  This was a bit of a wake-up call.  I will give kudos to Amazon for their customer service policies, though.  I was able to cancel my order relatively hassle free.

This is probably the best mass-produced beef jerky on the market.  It isn't too tough or dry like cheaper brands, isn't too sweet or spicy either.  Only problem is that as a snack I feel it isn't overly healthy.  (It has MSG, sodium nitrite and a lot of sodium).  However it is a low-fat, high-protein food, and very tasty.

I bought this flavor for the first time at the store, when they were out of my favorite (Sweet N Hot). My kids (ages 4 and 2) were begging me for some when we got back to the car. I told them they could try it, but that it would be spicy. They agreed, took the small bites I gave them and continued to ask for more until the entire package was gone! The flavor is exactly as the title describes. It's sweet and spicy, and reminds me of a dish I would order at a Thai restaurant. It's not as Spicy as the Sweet N Hot, but it still has quite a kick. It's not my favorite flavor, but I still give it 5 stars for the great texture and good flavor (and the fact that my kids devoured it). I bought this package with my kids in mind. bought this product in smaller packaging so as to take to work and enjoy. two of the 10 packages were moldy said best before mar 13 2013. can't trust won't buy.

I had meant to cancel this subscription but remembered after I was shipped another pack of two. Maybe they'll be better but I haven't been eager to to open them. Roll of the dice, I guess.

column9: Great value for a good quality jerky

column9: Good flavor but a bit tough
