be careful...even though this is listed under gluten free section it is NOT gluten free

After eating this product, I had a stomach ache followed by hours on the toilet. Those of you with a gluten intolerance and Celiac disease know exactly what those symptoms mean... somehow this product is contaminated with gluten! It is NOT gluten free! Please spare yourself the pain and suffering. These cookies are not worth it.For those of you who are tempted to continue eating this product even after you have been informed that it is not gluten free, please keep these facts in mind:1. If you eat gluten, it damages your intestinal lining.2. If you keep on eating gluten the damage to your intestines will get worse and so will your symptoms.3. If you further continue to eat gluten you will end up in malabsorption, increase your risk for intestinal cancer, and lead to all sorts of problems including infertility, autoimmune disorders, oteoporosis.In other words, cheating on your diet is not worth it!Don't eat Nana's products!Instead, I suggest you buy something like Pamela's chunky chocolate cookies. They are one of my favorites.
The most awesome cookies on the planet. We need a treat that is not full of sugar and Nanas fits the bill for us.
I was a bit disappointed in these.  They crumble very easily and have an unusual texture.  My son (6) does not like them.

column9: Ingredients are not up to date!
column10: In the past I have purchased these cookie bars through Amazon and have had good business. However, Amazon has not kept up with the ingredients changing in these cookie bars. It is very important to me what ingredients are in the foods I purchase. I am not happy with Amazon's business this time. Ingredients change often! Amazon needs to keep up to date with the ingredients if they are going to have them listed on their website.
I don't think I've ever eaten anything drier than these cookie bars, ever in my life. They taste okay, but I just can't choke them down, even with coffee.

This is only 3.5oz. box, so it is not a deal. Regular back is 7oz....now you are paying for packing.I fell for this not paying attention on the size. Finn Crisp's itself are 5 STARS, they are the best.
This is the real deal. I use them for trekking, hiking, camping and lately, as an alternative to bread. It is all rye, very crisp. Tasty!!!

column9: Love Finn Crisps, but this item is false advertising
column10: Don't be fooled by the picture!The picture is of the 7oz package, but what is actually shipped is the 3.5 oz package.Yes, the title says 3.5oz, but the picture is misleading.18 3.5 oz packages for ~$30 equates to 9 7 oz packages, or more than $3/7oz; that's not a very good deal at all. Very disappointing.Otherwise - shipped quickly, and Finn Crisps are definitely a good product.

These are ABSOLUTELY delicious. They are very crunchy and tasty. This is also my favorite flavor. I used to buy them from a store. They retail for $3 per box or so. These end up costing about $1.30 per pack. I was very excited about the deal. However, they turned out to be a smaller size packs than what they sell at store individually.I am not so sure if it is such a good deal after all. However, the product itself is ABSOLUTELY delicious. I use them as snacks. Buy them here or at your store. Highly recommended.

My sweet Golden Retriever is a cancer patient undergoing chemotherapy.  His appetite is pretty poor right now.  He's abandoned his premium dry food that he's eaten all of his life and was eating some canned varieties, but I wanted to find a dry food that he could also tolerate.  I found this food and figured that he might find it more appealing, considering the ingredients.  I am relieved to find that he likes the food a great deal.  After a week or so on this food, I offered him some of his former brand of dry food and he still wanted nothing to do with it, so I'm satisfied that he really is fond of this food and will continue with it as long as he's still around.I'm giving him small portions in the morning and evening and then some canned food at lunch and it's worked for him so far.  I am grateful I no longer have to beg him to eat!I do recommend researching this and other foods before deciding what is right for your dog.

My six month old pug will not eat any other dog food I've introduced--not even a different blend of Nature's Recipe(Farmstand Selects: Turkey with Real Fruit and Vegetables). I've given her Wellness, Canidae, Taste of the Wild--the latter two she tolerated, but she absolutely refused to eat the Wellness. However, she loves this particular Nature's Recipe formula so much so that I finally bought a huge bag of it at Petco because she was going through the smaller bags rather quickly. That's when I threw in a small bag of a different above mentioned Nature's Recipe Formula with the larger bag of her fave. She won't even touch the smaller bag. (The nice thing is I can return the smaller bag at Petco and get a full refund. That's Petco's policy for opened bags of pet food your pets don't like.) This formula that my puggy loves drastically reduces her smelly gas and that's great because for a tiny thing she can clear out an entire room! I still like to experiment with her food because I want to know that there's something else she likes should she get bored with this one, but so far this one has the winning formula!
My dog loves these. She has trouble chewing things because she had to have 2 back teeth removed but these she has no problems chewing.
I would not feed this to a dog.  Worst jerky I have ever had, and in the future I will have to think twice about ordering food on Amazon.

The small one-ounce packages are good for quick snacks, and my 5-year-old loves the flavor.  It's easy enough for him to eat, and seems pretty uniform.  We always have one or two packages ready to go for trips or hikes.
I love this brand of jerky, it's not too salty or sweet. I wish it was sold in more stores.Very hard to find and it sells out quickly.

The jerky is rather tough and very hard to chew, but the aftertaste is awesome and it is rather cheap.  I ate all 16 on a road trip, sharing with friends and they had the same feelings towards it. Don't get me wrong Jack's Links are great and superior to these, but if you are  on a budget try Trails Best.
This was a very good price, Would never buy it again. There was no jerk, only crunch. Flavor was ok.

I am not much of a jerky fan, and when I tasted this I nearly gagged, but my kids (ages 10, 13, & 17) just love it.  It is very sweet and tender (two attributes I think jerky should not have), but for kids it is a quick snack that satisfies them and is better for them than candy & cookies.  They are begging me to order more!

I'm baking bread with the "Artisan Breads in 5 Minutes a Day" book.  Just an observation:  I seem to get a stickier dough when I use Red Star as opposed to Fleischmann's.  Good rise and flavor with both brands, though.

column9: Sent an open package containing only 28 pieces
column10: The package arrived opened and only had 28 pieces in it. Completely unsatisfied. If my party was not right around the corner I would not have even second guessed sending it back.

I dont like this one it taste very salty and it seems to have a seedy the red on is ok but i;ve had better . i know they don't have seed but right now that the best way to explain it or like its grainy. salamon caviar is the way to go they sever it at my favorite resturant but wont sell me any. however they told me what it was. it smooth non-graniny
The powder is good but noisy,  The striker makes a hissing noise.  Overall it give an acceptable play.  Use it in small quantities before the start of each board.

column9: Only if you like garlic, a la pizzaz!
column10: We like all the McIlhenny Tabasco products, but this is our family's favorite.  We buy it by the gallon because it's hard to find in stores, and in the event of a national disaster, we plan to have a three to six month supply on hand!!  This is a serious Preparedness item for your pantry.

column9: What can I say, THE HOTTER THE BETTER! :-)
column10: There is not much to say about this wonderful item. You don't buy a gallon of TABASCO unless you really love the stuff. The Garlic Flavor Tabasco is ideal for foods like spaghetti or Hamburgers (If you haven't tried it on your burger go do it now).IF YOU BUY THE GALLON TABASCO YOU WILL NEED THE REFILL KIT ALSO, That's something they don't tell you prior to purchasing. So go out and spread the HOT & FIREY goodness to the entire world.

I've had many green tea combos and also have had Revolution teas.  When I read the review of this one I was intrigued and decided to try it.  I concur with the other reviewer.  This is the best green tea combo I've had.

I love this green tea and the added benefits of Acai berry!  I order this and the pomegranate tea 6 boxes at a time.  No additives no extra flowers etc.  Cannot find any other tea like this around.  Good price.
I shared this with my daughter and her family.  We enjoy the smooth mellow taste. Good hot or cold.  We enjoy high quality speciality loose teas and this is equal to Tevanas.

I really love this tea and take deliveries from Amazon every few months. Delivery is smooth and the time is adjustable, which is very convenient. With the subscriber discount, the cost of this product is as low as I have found anywhere else.I like the fact that this tea is caffeine free -- this allows me to drink it through my work day without feeling jittery. I also love the taste. As for the medicinal benefits -- there's no way to verify them personally.
one of my best last purchases,,green tea mixed with acai berry very soothing for the stomach and good for diet and health blood circulation

column9: If the price seems too good to be true...
column10: While this is certainly better than what I can buy in the grocery store, it really isn't a very good quality balsamic.  It does not have that thick, syrupy, sweet taste that allows balsamic to be drizzled over fruit.  It tastes too vinegary to be used for desserts and dipping bread and all the things good balsamic is used for.  For me, this turned out to be a cooking balsamic, albeit more expensive than what I buy at the grocery store.  I would not buy this again.  If the price seems too good to be true...

I first purchased this vinegar while on vacation and it was expensive, so i used it bery sparingly.  I finally ran out and went on line to try to find it, and of course, Amazon had the exact product, AND it was much cheaper.  So I ordered a couple of bottles and i can use it however i want as i have a way to reasonably replace it.  The vinegar is wonderful and i am afraid addictive.

Cat litter sure has improved over the years. The last time I had a cat was quite a number of years ago when all you could really get was Jonny Cat. So no matter what my apartment would always have a cat box smell. ick.Well this cat litter was amazing. I have 3 cats in a small apartment and nobody would know by the smell! This litter clumps exceptionally well, so it is really easy to keep the box clean. I am amazed at how well it controls the odor. I think this one clumps better than most of the other brands.

I have a cat that is prone to frequent UTIs / bladder infections. After numerous trips to the vet, I decided to treat her holistically. The first thing I did however was change the type of litter - and almost instantly - no more problems. I think that the perfumes / dyes that "mask" odors can also be irritants for the cat. I highly recommend this product!!!!

I used Fresh Step and Scoop Away cat litters for many years and was quick to tell any of my cat owner friends that they were the best "bang for the buck" litters. They clumped hard, making the chore of cleaning the cat box a relatively easy one. Sometime around 6 months ago, that all changed. Now, they form a sludge in the cat box that is nearly impossible to scrape out. The amount of effort necessary to clean the box could easily induce a muscle strain or hernia for those unfortunate enough to purchase one of these litters. Both products are made by the Clorox Pet products Co. Consider yourself warned!
I have one cat who is really picky and this is the only litter she will use. Glad I found it.
This stuff is the BOMB! I put it on a steak bomb as a condiment it was awesome! Also try it on a roast beef sandwich.  You will never eat either one again without some fatboy on them.

It's very hard to find sugar free products that don't contain Splenda.  This syrup is sweetened with xylitol which I tolerate very well.  Works great on a low carb diet using Julian Bakery low carb breads to make French toast, yum.
When I order these I have a terrible not eating all of them at once.  I fell in love with these at Disney World and can only find them here.

The fat-by-gram count might seem high, and the calorie servings .. by pack .. are 290. Kars uses M & M types of candy-coated chocolates, with many peanuts of diff. types, plus raisins, sunflower seeds in a FINE combo, though. The price, per-pack, is VERY-reasonable .. and the contents .. better than many other snacks of ANY kind. This is NOT "junk food"!
Awesome product, saves me 50 cents a day...the product is $1.00 in the vending machines and only 50 cents if purchased this way...

I never get to eat these while I am in Hawaii. But I always make it a point to buy them as I am stopping through. My family and I love the taste of these pancakes and always have. It always reminds us of the great times we have been able to go there on vacation. A great little treat for the family.

I brought some of these packets home to share. I wish I had kept them all they are so good. You only add water to the mix so would be great to take camping. The pancakes are quite sweet so taste before you add syrup, a little butter is enough. Slice half a banana on top and enjoy breakfast in Kona!

A great food for my little dog. He certainly likes it better than all other foods that I fed him before I discovered the Paul Newman Organics. It's healthy, nutritious, and certainly provides for good metabolism too. It's not cheap, but maybe in a long run it saves you some money on vet bills. Also, it's good to know that a good part of the price that you pay for it goes to animal shelters.

I can't get enough of the Gracious Gourmet brand! The Balsamic Four Onion is amazing when you mix in with hamburgers. I also made a dip by mixing this product with sour cream. My friends loved it. It was so good!

At first the price seemed high for such small jars, but you only need a little and the taste is immense! I have ordered twice already. My favorite way to use this is in an omelette with a little cheese, absolutely delicious! Well worth the price.

column9: A little goes a long way
column10: Each jar is petite, but the flavor is so intense that a little goes a long way.  The taste is pleasantly acidic and intensely rich.  I use it smeared on cheese sandwiches and as a condiment on meat or poultry dishes.  It is definitely worth the purchase price.

I have tried all of the Gracious Gourmet products and can't find a single one that isn't fantastic! The best part of these spreads is that you can use them so many different ways. I have cooked with them, used them as spreads on crackers and sandwiches and mixed them with sour cream to make a dip. So easy and so delicious!

The Balsamic Four Onion spread is delicious.  I got my first jar of it a few days ago and i never put it down.  definitely recommend for any food lover, i put it on a chicken wrap and even plain on crackers. great stuff

I began taking this to help with my joint pain and stiffness. It worked quite well. I found the strong taste a bit off putting but can't argue with the results. Initially I mixed it in water but did not like it at all. Next I mixed it in fruit juice ( orange or orange-pineapple-banana) and found it more palatable.  I purchased some tart cherry capsules and have been taking them instead. If I could not get the capsules I would certainly go back to the juice concentrate due to the results.

I had a recent flare up of gout which caused my big toe to swell up with a lot of pain. Taking the meds my doctor prescribed helped but didnt quite get rid of all the discomfort. I tried this drink for about a week (2 tablespoons in 8-10oz water twice a day). I was amazed at how this worked for me. I'm not saying it's a cure for gout, but it did help me get over that hump and now I'm pain free. I ordered a larger bottle recently (32oz) - now that I know that this helps. The taste is robust, smooth, and sweet. Not really a great tasting drink, but still not bad at all.

Bought this on a whim, thought to use in desserts however, added a spoonful to a Coke in a glass with ice, stirred & remembered what a real cherry coke tasted like. Have used most of it in Coke's, Dr. Pepper & citrus sodas. Makes lemonade special. Add to brownies or anything chocolate for a treat. Add to plain cheesecake with chocolate crust & top with cherry pie filling. Thought the price was high, but it goes a long way.

I ordered my first bottle of Tart Is Smart Tart Cherry Concentrate after reading several reviews.  I ordered several other items at the same time, and the cherry concentrate was shipped with the other items, not by itself in one box.  During shipping, the seal became broken.  There was foam at the top inside the bottle, and quite a lot of the concentrate had leaked into a bag with some important papers, before I was ready to use it.  I called the manufacturer immediately, and I was in close contact with them for a few days.  They were kind enough to ship a 32-ounce bottle to me in its own box, and I thoroughly enjoyed my first "dose" last night.  I am using only one tablespoon in 8 ounces of water, and I find the taste absolutely delicious.  Perhaps my body chemistry needs this juice to function optimally.  I understand that TART cherry juice is good for people with arthritis, although I haven't noticed any particular benefit for my joints.  It also contains melatonin, which my body needs at the present time. I have been taking tart cherry joice from various sources, particularly Trader Joe's, until their present crop source failed.  I have purchased this juice from Wholefoods, but I much prefer the consistency and flavor from Trader Joe's.  I have also tried Indian Summer juice that I purchased from Amazon.com, but the smallest order is 8 48-oz. bottles, which makes the package way too heavy, and it requires storage space.  I can't afford the juice from Wholefoods, as the cost is prohibitive for regular use.  I will be happy with Tart Is Smart as the brand of choice.  In communication with the manufacturer, I was assured that the product doesn't need to be refrigerated until it is opened.  The Best By date on the lid is coded for month and year.  07-13 is simply Best By July, 2013.  It has a shelf life of approximately one year.

This product is supposed to be refrigerated, according to the maker. Not refrigerated after opening, but refrigerated. They claim to ship it to retailers in refrigerated trucks. This is a concern, because it's bottled in #1 plastic bottles, unlike most health juices, which use glass bottles. A concern to me in Arizona, where even in winter the UPS trucks heat up. I received mine late today, and it was quite warm--luckily it was under 100 outside, but on an 80 degree day the insidees of vehicles reach above 102 degrees. So it was somewhere under boiling. Very bad packaging. They could at least use #2 plastic. The taste is fine but the anti-oxidant effect is bound to be either a wash or negatively affected by the heat. I will have to go back to purchasing another brane from a health food store where they keep it in a refrigerated case.I have an email in to the maker and will post an update.

column9: Good product, but the 16-oz. size leaked during shipping
column10: I have been ordering this brand of cherry juice for about 8 months.  I have always gotten the 32-oz. size, but due to the huge price increase, I ordered the 16-oz. size because it was a slightly better deal.  When the bottles arrived, they were sitting in a sticky, red puddle due to leakage.  The 32-oz. size has an airtight safety seal (I'm pretty sure) but the 16-oz. bottles definitely do not.  I decided to clean up the bottles and use them anyway (not wanting to cause a problem) but as they sat on the counter, the bottles started to bulge and the labels ripped open!  I do not think they are safe to drink, and Amazon stated that they will return my money, thankfully.  Tart is Smart Cherry Juice Concentrate has always been a good product that has helped decrease the inflammation and pain in my back.  I'm not sure why the company does not put a safety seal on the 16-oz. size.  I will pay the extra money for the bigger size with the safety seal so my juice will be SAFE to drink!

The antioxidant properties are great, and the melatonin helps me sleep.  It is not a diet drink but since I take this before bed I no longer crave desert because it is like drinking cherry pie.  I mix 2.5 table spoons with some sparkling water and it is a refreshing desert drink.

This product has such a great aroma and is super super thick. Lasts a long time. I add it to everything, but just a small bit as it is so concentrated. It seems to help with pain as I added cherry capsules to my diet.

I enjoy reading comments from buyers of Products. I read somewhere where Tart Cherry Juice was good for GOUT, helps your sleeping pattern improve & supplies the body with more Antioxidants than Blue Berries? I googled TART CHERRIES & found that Amazon was a seller. I read the comments there & decided to buy some. I joined their Buyer Delivery Program, got discounted prices & they remind me when I should need a new bottle or two.TART IS SMART is the brand. Many commenter's said they tried DARK RED, RED & other Cherry Juices without 3 way success.  My BIG TOE pain has vastly been controlled, I now sleep 6-7 hours in a row, not waking up many times & feel good about the fact I am supplying my body with elements to protect my health. I add it to low cal juice & use as directed. Some people advocate using more than directed, choose for yourself. I imagine I will be using this product for the rest of my life.Tart Is Smart Tart Cherry Concentrate, 32-Ounce Bottle

This stuff tastes fine. It is too early to tell if there is any difference in how it makes me feel. What really surprised me was that the bottle was out of date. I would have returned it but why the hassle? Someone had to know they were sending out something that was beyond the expiration date.

The price and product make this a good value.  Unfortunately, it took over a week from the date I ordered it for it to ship.  Once it finally arrived, I am happy with the product and the cost.  I will order again, but will allow plenty of time for delivery.  I am using this, along with tart cherry capsules, celery tablets, fish oil capsules, and lots of water to ward off gout which I recently had several episodes.  Since starting this plan, I have not had gout (about 5 weeks).  It is available and less expensive in 32 oz bottles.
This drink is great specially if you like cherry flavor,you can add as much water as you like and its good for you too.

I bought this because I thought the melatonin in the juice would help me sleep. Unfortunately, it has not.It is delicious, and if you don't mind the few calories, I would buy it for the taste and antioxidants it supposedly has.But don't count on it as a sleep aid.

This concentrate makes a very refeshing, slightly tart cherry drink.  Personally I added a little raw honey to mine and sometimes added club soda for a little fizz.  For the money I think I'd rather eat raw fruit.  If it's specically the benefits for tart cherrys then go for it.  If you're just trying to get more fruits and veggies in your diet, eat whole fruit.
excellent taste and tart cheery  juice worked better than taking advil every 2 hours and screw up my stomach problems

We are new to the gluten-free world but found this bread unexceptable.  Less than 1 star, but that was not an option.  Whether fresh, toasted or grilled it was dry, crumbly, had an odor and strange after taste.  After more checking we found "Sami" millet & flax seed bread. You have to toast or grill it, but it is FANTASTIC.  We are enjoying toast with breakfast and toasted or grilled sandwiches again.  So don't bother with the Ener-G look for Sami

This is a wonderful product. My grandaughter is almost 9 years old and up until a couple of months ago had never eaten a piece of bread. She has severe food allergies and is very limited as to what she can eat. Although she won't eat this bread unless it is toasted, I consider it a wonderful addition to her diet. I will continue to order this product.
As a Gluten Free Family of 4 THIS BREAD SUCK'S  2 Thumbs Down.WARNING if you have Allergies or Asthma "CHECK OUT THE INGREDIENT" (METHYLCELLULOSE). Even the birds won't eat it.

My children have been on a gluten free diet for 6 years now. They love this bread! It is great for lunches - we put it in a sandwhich holder so the bread doesn't crumble. Highly recommend it to anyone on a gluten free diet.

After trying many products, the Papa's Loaf is a product, that in my opinion, comes closest to regular bread.  I find though, that with any of the GF breads, toasting improves the product.  This bread is really quite good.

This is a sturdy wheat-free bread for sandwiches. The taste may be a slightly cardboard-ish, but I like it's fiber. And if you create a sandwich where the other ingreadients have nice flavor, the bread itself becomes a healthy companion. This is one wheat-free bread on which you can pile on the ingredients and not worry about it falling apart. Enjoy!

I am surprised to see such negative reviews for this product.  My daughter now 19, has been on a gluten free diet since she was 11.  We've tried many GF breads over the years and this one is her favorite.  She does toast it before eating, but it tastes good (I've eaten it, too) and stays together great.
Good option for a WF/GF diet, but texture is dry, so it crumbles easily.  My son prefers to eat it toasted, which helps make the texture more like regular bread containing wheat.
This is one of the worst gluten-free breads I have tried.  Fortunately it is also egg-free and dairy-free but I found the texture strange.

column9: Good choice if one is dairy, gluten, wheat and egg allergic.
column10: There are tastier bread options if one is not eating gluten alone, however if there are allergens such as egg and dairy this is a nice, convenient option to have.  Since wheat and gluten is not all we have to avoid, I'm glad that Papa's loaf is a bread my son enjoys.  The best ways to eat this bread are toasted and if one wants a softer bread, I put a spread (Mothers Margarine) on the bread and warm it up in the microwave.
hard to eat - texture is just not like having a piece of toast - will try it for breadcrumbs

column9: Buy to make croutons or bread crumbs....
column10: Being recently diagnoised with celiac and being a bread lover, I am constantly trying out the gluten free breads. This loaf bread was a major disappointment. Its very heavy and not suitable for sandwiches. It was just okay for toast. I ended up making croutons and bread crumbs out of the remaining loafs. I'm still looking for a great loaf of gluten free bread...

column9: If you love Rooibos - do try this blend
column10: This Provence Rooibos tea blend is quite delicious. 4oz is enough to make loads of tea. Lots of helpful info about tea making at the company's website, btw. The company gave a discount for the purchase of 3 teas, making this a good bargain. Pleasure doing business with them. Will order again.

Provence Rooibos is my top favorite tea.  Smooth, refreshing, aromatic -- recalls a walk in a flower garden after a rain (sorry to be poetic, but I don't know another way of describing it).  Culinary Teas deliver it promptly and freshly packed.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: Interesting - if only for the color
column10: I must not be enough of a salt afficionado to be able to tell the difference in taste between this and regular sea salt.  It looks marvelous in a salt grinder ball, but other than that, it tastes like salt.  I gave it as a gift to my husband along with a couple of other varieties and a grinder and he was pleased, mostly for the visual appeal.I would have given a 5 if I had been able to discern any difference in flavor with this on my food.

I like most of the Trident flavors, however this particular type of Trident provides a softer chew and lasting flavor.Their regular Trident is a more dense and stiff chew.These are packaged differently and are branded "Trident Layers" in large and bold lettering.  I highly recommend any of the flavors as long as they are the "Trident Layers" brand because of the improved chewing quality.Just search for "Trident Layers gum".
This gum has the perfect flavor and packs a lot of sweetness for a sugar-free product.  Great for the workplace when everyone asks for gum all of the time.

Extra Peppermint gum is great for my long shifts.  Night shift is hard, and snacking all night is hell for one's body.  I started substituting gum for snacks and lost weight.  Plus it's sugarless, so my teeth don't take a pounding either.Buy from Costco though, best price...

I found this as a good way of purchasing gum in bulk (I tend to chew a lot) rather then purchasing them in 3 packs from the grocery store.  The gum is fairly long lasting, better then other similar gums.  The price is still a little high compared to alternatives, I found that bj's had a 15 pack at a price significantly cheaper per stick so it might be worthwhile to price it out with any local bulk stores.  If those types of warehouse stores aren't an option, then this is a great alternative.
I should recieve pack of 20 and i should get what i have paid for i got 10 packs only!!! This is not right. You should check before sending the items.

I don't care for beer at all.  Most wines including champagne give me heartburn.  Hard liquor is too serious for me.  Montebello Long Island Iced Tea is just right. You can just serve it over ice or you can add a splash of Pepsi - it's strong enough to take it.  This is the best libation you can purchase from a grocery or convenience store and the taste is comparable to a nice bar or restaurant mixed drink.  It's better than any other Long Island Iced Tea mixed drink on the market.  Worth every penny!!!!!
It was nasty,tasted like rubbing alcohol. I'm going to see if I can find something to mix it with if not i'll give it away.

Not a really drinker, don't keep booze in the house.  That said - every once in a while I get in the mood for a libation... Always liked a Long Island Iced Tea but to make one requires buying 1/2 a liquor store's worth of clears.  Gave this a shot - for like, 12 bucks in a big 1.75 liter bottle totally on a whim when out to pick up a red wine for guests.  How awful could it be?  No worse than any of the other pre-made cocktails (which is to say "horrible") I've had.  Figured if it was terrible, I could mix it with real iced tea to kill the flavor. Gotta tellya, not too shabby!  Totally bested my low expectations - especially at its bottom shelf price and cheap-azz plastic bottle.  Have certainly had worse out at places that apparently don't know how to make a proper Long Island Iced Tea. Put this in a tall iced-filled glass with a lemon wedge?  Good to go. As always with recommendations, YMMV, but this will be purchased again.

We have been cookie fans of Gilbert's since we found them three years ago.  We are not gluten free, but have a healthy lifestyle.  Not only are these cookies made with all the "right" stuff, they are delicious.  My kids love making icecream sandwiches with them!
I've bought a number of the Gilberts Gourmet Goodies cookies... I just adore them.  A bag doesn't last a day in our household!I love the flavor and the texture!

I've eaten a lot of different gluten free cookies and these are by far one of the worst. The dough part has NO flavor.  The only flavor of the cookie is from the chocolate chips - and that's hard to mess up. The texture is decent - there's just no taste.

column9: Not that good. Buy WOW instead
column10: They are soft and don't crumble but do not taste like a real cookie. If you want a really good gluten free cookie or brownie then buy WOW gluten free. They are superb!

I am a grown A$$ woman, a grandmother, and I am writing a review about a Hostess cake.  A friend brought the into work and casually offered me one, I opened it, balking at the crumbs that scattered on my desk, and then took a bite carefully, not to make a mess on my clothes. Well, the topping that was dusted on top of the streusel fell off gently landing on my tougue and it felt like snow as I bit down the streusel which had a slight crunch.  It was sophisticatingly delicate allowing the warmth of my mouth to melt some of it.  Then the yellow cake itself streaked with cinnamon-sugar mixture that was not overwhelming - just added a bit of interest.  The cake was flavorful, light and had a wonderful texture juxtaposing the gentle crunch of the topping.Bar none, this is the gold standard.  I've been to restaurants since and their fancy bakery cakes have fallen short.

I like coffee cake (Streusel Cakes), usually making my own from Bisquick. This was perhaps better than I make! The cake was very soft (though I'd recommend keeping the individually bagged cakes in a air tight container), and the topping was light yet flavorful.

Despite its appealing list of ingredients (This green tea blend contains Japanese sencha green tea, dried ginger, orange peel and lemongrass), I found the tea disappointing.  After ample steeping, The blend remains devoid of flavor, color and aroma.  The tea teeters between having 'less taste' than expected and being 'tasteless'.  It may seem a bargain when purchased in bulk but if you're looking for a flavorful green tea blend tea, look elsewhere.

Cardini's Caesar Dressing is wonderful, not only on salads, but on baked potatos, instead of butter.  Excellent on steamed carrots also.  All the Cardini dressings are exceptional.  The Southwest Caesar dressing is great on rueben sandwiches, or with corndogs!  The Cardini Pesto Pasta is magical--all you need to make a pasta salad is  your pasta, some black olives, a few chopped tomatoes and Pesto Pasta dressing.  Sad thing is, for some reason, Pesto Pasta dressing has become very difficult to find.
This product is my top choice and not only for salads. It is a great on burgers, chicken and fish.
We eat this dressing more often than we probably should. I have yet to find a bottled caesar that even comes close to comparing. Hands down, the best.
This is the best Caesar dressing I have found.  Great flavor, real popular amongst my children.
Cardini Original Caesar Dressing, 20-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) This is my favorite dressing for any green salad and having a good supply is a must in my household.

column9: Great dressing, but expires too soon.
column10: I bought this dressing for my son and his girlfriend, who absolutely love it.  Unfortunately, the six bottles expire in six months, so they probably won't get to use it all in time.....  Wish the date had been further away...

We've tried all three flavors of Bright Bites and only one of our three dogs will take a star when we hand one to them.  Our food motivated dog will actually back up when he sees me with the Bright Bites in my hand and the other dog will sniff it and then walk away.  If I rub something that smells good all over the star, the two dogs will reluctantly take the star.Wonder why they don't make the Bright Bites in flavors dogs like instead of the mint or cinnamon?al.

I bought a whole ham because the good review by an Amazon reviewer on some other brand and because the Amazon's descrition that it is an award winning ham.The ham has excellent color, aroma and taste (on the salty side, as expected for dry cured southern ham).  My wife and I are very pleased with it.

I was a little leary of ordering a ham via mail but must say everything was excellent. Shipping was on time, quality was as good as advertised. A definite "splurge" (especially with the high shipping cost) but will get another one next Christmas.

I really recommend this ham for anyone looking for a quality American country ham.  Delicious, highly recommended.The price is very reasonable all things considered.  This is a home style product, not the mass produced wet things we can find in the supermarket.  A real flavor difference if you have only ever had "city ham".

Please be aware that these bars have ALFALFA that is a proven Toxin. When studied in monkeys (they will not dare study this in people, even though there have been many case reports), ALFALFA is a toxin that INDUCES LUPUS!!!  Beware! Why do these natural companies put bad ingredients in their products!?

Although Guava Leaf Tea is somewhat of an acquired taste, it doesn't take long to enjoy the refreshing & health benefits of this product.  As a T2DM, I have found an increase in energy, reduced tiredness and renewed desire to apply myself in tasks that needed to be done by using this product as least 3 times a day.

I was at an Italian restaurant and had a cup of espresso with a small biscotti at its side.  The espresso was good but the cookie was better.  I asked the server the name of the cookie.  I bought 10 boxes from Taylor market.  These are great with coffee.  They are slightly sweet with a generous amount of almonds.  I am down to two boxes  and will definitely be ordering more!

column9: only four bucks at local stores
column10: This is the best fish sauce I tried for fish noodles soup (SE Asian dish with rice noodles, "Khanom Jin"  in Thai, "Mohinga" in Burmese, "Nyonya Assam Laksa" in Malay). I pay a few cents less than four bucks at Latin/Asian/International stores in DC area. If you are in DC, you can find it in some stores including Latin groceries in DC Farmers Market. I am glad to find Amazon carries this brand but wish the same price as local stores.

column9: Not sure I need 2 ! Good product !
column10: This is a really big bottle. Two in fact! I really needed a smaller amount but it doesn't expire for 2 years so I suppose I will be making a lot of Thai food. Anyway, I bought this as my grocery store did not carry it and I was making Thai food. The recipe turned out really well. Now I am looking for more recipes to use this in.

column9: Great fish flavor, essential in many Asian foods
column10: I've used all kinds of fish sauce over the years but I think Three Crabs is my new favorite.  It has a nice fish flavor yet isn't overpoweringly salty like some brands.  That's a plus when you want to add soy sauce to your Asian food in addition to the fish sauce.  The ingredients are water, anchovies, hydrolyzed wheat protein (secret name for MSG) and sugar.  I wish it didn't contain MSG, so I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5.The price for two bottles is $16, but you get two 24 ounce bottles.  The average recipe calls for a couple of tablespoons so it will last a long time.If you cook lots of Asian food like I do, give this tasty fish sauce a try!

column9: When I reach for fish sauce, I reach for Three Crab fish sauce. All other brands just stink.
column10: Several chefs and cookbooks have pointed me to Three Crab fish sauce as the best available. I agree. If you cook a lot of Vietnamese, Thai, etc. it is worth special ordering.
i don't have much to complain about the sauce itself but with the price i paid, it absolutely comes short of my expectation. not recommend

column9: It's Limburger--how much more can I say?
column10: First, service was excellent, the product arriving sooner than I expected it.Second, it's Limburger Cheese.  If you love it, you'll probably love it.  If you hate it, well...  If you've never tried it, if you are able to ignore the smell (which is quite rank) you'll be better able to appreciate the flavor.

column9: Ceese was good but shipment was not.
column10: The cheese I bought was good, but I had an issue with shipment. They posted shipment notification a week before actual shipment, which made me eagerly waiting for the cheese that had not even left the shop. The company made a generous compensation for this unhappy incident, for which I am grateful.I suggest that in the future they post the shipment notification AFTER they ship the item as we all do in Amazon.com and also two business days after the transaction.
Don't buy so much until you find out if your cat will eat it.  Mine won't :( This is very expensive.  I'm sure it's very healthy, buy no good if they won't eat it.

I absolutely could not cook without McCormick Garlic Pepper.....I have tried lots of other brands of garlic pepper, but they just are nowhere near as good as the McCormick.  I use it on about everything from eggs and potatoes for breakfast to veggies and meats and burgers and salads for supper.  Wonderful for anything that you put on the grill, it is a perfectly balanced blend..just enough pepper, just enough garlic.....try it!
I love garlic pepper and none of the stores near me carry it.  I was thrilled to find a decent price for this product online so I can cook with one of my favorite seasonings.

Love this pepper. It has been my spice of choice for every meal for a long time. Problem was I checked every super market in our town but noone had it.  Thanks to your service I didn't wait long for my happiness.  Thanks.

Another item found on Amazon, that I can't find in local stores anymore!  My family (including parents, siblings, and my own adult kids) really like this seasoning, which we used to buy locally, but, the store no longer carries it.  "Montreal Steak seasoning" is slightly similar, but, it has too many flavors and larger particles of spices, including carraway seeds (not a flavor I enjoy).  The Garlic Pepper has a slightly finer grind and adds a more enjoyable (IMO) flavor to grilled steaks and in our hamburger mix.

When my local grocer stopped carrying this stuff, I had to take matters into my own hands. I use this in everything! Soups, potatoes, rice, eggs, anything savory can use a kick from this stuff. I've tried other mixes, but this is just the perfect blend! LOVE, LOVE, LOVE

Of all the garlic blends I've tried, this is the best! But I haven't found it in stores for forever, so I'm so glad Amazon has it. I wish they had the giant size. This is way better than McCormick's "Perfect Pinch" garlic blend.

column9: I'll Be Back To Shop Here!
column10: Great doing business with this company.  I recommend them to all.  Fast service, great price and I encountered no problems at all.

I am so happy I could find this product on Amazon.com!  I used to buy this product at a warehouse company for my husband...but, they quit selling this particular product.  He doesn't know it now, but he will soon find out he has a "stock" of the DaVinci Raspberry Gourmet syrup!  I bought this for his birthday!  I can't wait to see his face when he opens his gift! These small, thin, pretzels are delicious.  They remind me of the excellent pretzels that were made many years ago by Eagle Brands (Anheuser Busch's old snack-making subsidiary, I think).  The pretzel has a clean taste and it is perfectly salted.  The honey pretzels also are good, but I think the plain is excellent.  And the fact that they are organic is a bonus, I suppose, for folks concerned about such things.  I purchased these pretzels through Amazon, since the pricing was better than I could get at Whole Foods.

My family has recently switched to eating organic, and we've also given up white flour and white sugar. Since there are no health food stores around, this change pretty much meant going without some of our favorite snack items. When I saw these pretzels on Amazon, and read their simple list of ingredients, I was skeptical but decided to at least give them a try. HOLY MOLY THESE ARE GOOD! All of the salty crunch of regular pretzels, but with organic ingredients including whole wheat flour and NO sugar.We love them. In fact, I just subscribed to get more each month!
I love the caffeine. But honestly the flavor is a bit like vomit. Can't explain it. Sour, like a sour stomach were you belch degestive juices up into your mouth.

This product use to be available at the local drug store chain by me in Wisconsin. It was disco'd and I never saw it again till I did some searching and found it on Amazon for the best price. The taste can leave a little bit to be desired. It does work though. I have a augmented schedule for my job which borders around third/first shift so any kind of personal life late on the weekends can get too be late for me. That's where the Jolt gum comes into play. I usually will chew it while I'm out with friends, have a couple of adult cocktails to keep me awake or, I will chew it while getting prepared to play with my band at a gig. If you do the Math, It use to cost me $2.00 a pack at the store before vs only $.80 a pack via Amazon. Good stuff
This gum is great for places you are not allowed to take liquids. Great for sporting events where you can't bring your own coffee. Great for long drives / flights!

I have been using this gum as my late night, little pick-up for a long time now. It's useful for drives where I just need a tiny oomph to wake me up, and the flavor is nice(though not long lasting). There are very minor bitter hints of caffeine in this(like most caffeine products), but it's not noticeable unless I chew 8 or more pieces in one sitting. I can't drink coffee, and tea unfortunately means that I would need to hit the bathroom often on a long drive...so this is perfect. I highly recommend this product!

This gum rocks because it helps keep my energy level up at work where pop & other caffeine beverages are not allowed in the production area. The "jolt" of energy it gives me lasts a good amount of time.

Works as advertised. Nice, clean energy boost. I am fine with the taste, but I can see some regular gum chewers being a little put off by it. This has given me the energy I need throughout the day, and before gym/kick-boxing workouts. I cannot live without it!
tastes pretty good for having caffeine in it. slight bitterness which is not really that noticeable.
I don't drink coffee so I chew this gum on my way to work.  I also like it when driving long car trips.  It doesn't make me jittery but helps to keep me alert.
great product but wish it could be found a bit cheaper....searched around but not too  many places have for sale.

Gush alert - I love this gum! I think I have an entire box stashed intentionally and unintentionally in the house, office, and car.  I even found a left over pack with one long piece in my gym locker (that could have been gross.  Thank heavens for blister wrapping!) I kept forgetting the gum it and wanting it - now I keep finding it and loving it! I want it when I'm working out. I need it during snoozer meetings.  True story.  My 60-year old mom even takes some when she goes to the movies! That's actually kinda funny to me.If nirvana could be achieved by chewing a gum, I'd say this about as close as it gets. I tried another energy gum (sorry Jolt, I wont' be unfaithful again!) and it got disgusting after four or five minutes. Jolt tastes good and gives me energy. I don't normally get excited by trivial consumer products - in fact, this is my first review for a candy of any kind - but this gum is a life changer!!! Thank you!!Jolt Caffeine Energy Gum, Spearmint, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)Jolt Caffeine Energy Gum, Icy Mint, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)

Nice substitute when you need caffeine but can't get a cup of coffee. Not a huge fan of artificial sweeteners, but the taste isn't bad at all. A single box is enough for a month or two if you drink a single cup of coffee in the mornings.

I am extremely caffeine sensitive and this gum just doesn't do it for me.  I sometimes chew 3-4 pieces at a time (which is equal to two cups of coffee) and nothing.  I don't feel any sort of "jolt" at all.  I feel like I'm chewing regular old mint gum.  So much for help staying awake working the night shift!  Two stars for the flavor.

I recently began working a second job delivering pizza where my brother works.  I remembered this gum from about 4 years ago when I used to be able to purchase it by the pack at the gas station.  I went searching for it at gas stations, pharmacies, Walmart, and other places but could no longer find it.  I was so happy to see it available here on Amazon!  Also, it is much cheaper than it used to be when buying it by the pack ($2.50 per pack) so I took this offer.  I am very glad I did, as I am often scheduled for very long work shifts late into the night.Never in my life have I liked energy drinks besides coffee and Jolt cola, as they are just too sweet and often include tons of artificial chemical sweeteners, which carry a horrid aftertaste.  They also tend to take 30 minutes to an hour before they really work.  Jolt gum works in 5 minutes since it is absorbed under your tongue, and it is a low enough dose of caffeine that you can safely chew one piece every couple of hours while working and stay very alert. It is wonderful to have a piece or two of Jolt before going to the gym or running, as it will increase your stamina.Just one thing to watch for with this gum - whatever you do, never pull a World of Warcraft-player type of suicide by chewing 100 pieces quickly to try and stay up all night and play a videogame.  Caffeine can be harmful in massive doses, but one piece of this gum is about equal to a Coke can, it just works much faster and better.
This gum tastes great and gives a great boost before a workout!  I love it.  I will definitely order it again.  Great price.  Quick delivery.

So I'm away for college and sometimes I really miss the food back home. There are no ethnic super markets near campus so being able to order Asian products from Amazon is really awesome. It makes me less homesick!

We ordered these stroopwafels around Christmas last year and we were so excited when we received our box. I have lived in Holland for years and these taste exactly the same as I remember. You can tell they were super fresh. I really recommend these if you do not want factory-made, plastic-tasting, cheap waffles. These are the REAL DEAL!!
Great product works great used it with the bee trap and worked great would definitely recommend I used it with sugar water was pleasantly surprised!

I can't say anything more than this coffee was NOT anything special.Too bad because who does not want to support fair trade, organic coffee, etc.I'm blessed with a local merchant that roasts their own coffee and this product is not a match nor does it beat the local Starbucks.

We have been buying beans from Larry's for several years now. Living in Raliegh we found Larry's local coffee shop. Now that we live in Florida I still order all my beans from Larry!Coffee is like wine; Everyone has different tastes so don't let any negative reviews prevent you from trying the best coffee (EXCEPT FOR KONA while in Hawaii) we have found. It's all organic, fair trade coffee with lots of different roasts and blends... Our favorite stand by is Cowboy Blend and Frankie Blend (use to be Frank Sumatra). Recently we tried Mountain Sumatra and it was outstanding.If you want great roasted coffee from a great person that is pure organic fair trade than Larry is your man.(BTW- I don't not work for Larry) I was just prompted to write this review since we really love his coffee)
All Larrys Beans coffees are incredible.  our favorite is the Mtn Sumatra, but you can't go wrong on any of them!
This coffee is expensive but it pretty much lives up to its price. I'd like to (and will soon) compare it to the dark Peruvian I just purchased and am waiting to receive....

I bought this lavender honey to make a madeleine recipe that called for it and they turned out delicious! The lavender honey has a great flavor, and a little goes a long way. It's great in tea also, and would be a delicious addition to many cookies, cakes, etc. Very unique and yummy.

The honey also works well in my crème brule. (Not to mention a little butter mixed with the honey on toast)Jansal Valley has other honey varieties that must be tried!

These crackers are good with cheese, salads and/or dips.  They are very crispy and taste great. All natural ingredients,too. No trans fats. My grandkids love them.

column9: Great product for an even better price
column10: I was very impressed with this product. This is the best tasting and cheapest paprika that I have had. The product comes in a airtight foil bag and was surprising fresh. Highly recommended.
Nice, fresh and very flavorful, unlike the typical store paprika.  Be sure to put it in an air-tight container.

I use a lot of various spices in my cooking and wanted to find a source with a quality product at a reasonable price.  Frontier met that discription.

column9: Brings the West Coast to the East Coast Fall--Warms to the Bone
column10: I can't say enough about this tea. It's like drinking wine, mint up front with with the sage left behind. Don't let the thought of drinking chicken stop you from sipping on sage. This is like no other tea you've ever had. I like sipping it on cool, rainy days. It warms me up and the smell is heavenly. It soothes upset tummies, too!

The wild mint is gentler and the sage is also soothing, and I drink this one more that I would regular peppermint tea. I've also served this tea to avowed mint haters and they've liked it as well.

It has a VERY strong sage flavor, and I suppose that is good, but it is a little off-putting, so I either add a green tea bag when I brew, or, which is even better, add one bag to a pitcher full of ICED TEA, which I make all summer with at least six tea bags - green, ginger, fenugreek and different herbals (I especially like Davidson's Hibiscus with Tulsi teabags which are absolutely delicious even on their own). We order these thinking theyre black currants since that's what they're called. They are NOT black currants, they are zante currants which are raisins.
BEWARE!! these are NOT currants -- NOT EVEN CLOSE.... read the fine print they are raisins, plain and simple. fine print says they are made from GRAPES not CURRANTS.

column9: Fine IF You're Looking for Tiny Raisins
column10: I would not object if these had been labeled simply "currants" because Zante grapes are called currants in this country (the U.S.). However, Bob's Red Mill has unfortunately chosen to label these "black currants" which generally means Ribes nigrum. Luckily, I read the fine print at the last minute. Zante raisins (Vitis vinifera) are fine as raisins go, but they are not the antioxidant powerhouses that real currants are, and they do not have the complex flavor that the rest of the world associates with black currants. Bob's Red Mill "black currants" are probably better than most Zante raisins, but the label is misleading and it misrepresents the product. Bad call, Bob. I expect better from you.

column9: Health benefits are those of grapes, not black currants
column10: If you're looking, as I was, for the type of black currants that researchers have found are higher in antioxidants than grapes and may have powerful health benefits, look elsewhere.  It's not so much that the manufacturer is being dishonest as that "black currant" has come to mean "Zante currant" in the U.S.  What researchers studied was the Ribes nigrum species; the common name "black currant" here is just going to mislead you into buying small raisins.  Ribes nigrum is a berry that grows on bushes, while grapes are unrelated and grow on vines.After buying these and finding they tasted a lot like raisins (I should have read the earlier reviews), I did some research in Wikipedia and on the web and finally found a source of real black currants, which I've just ordered.  Amazon has some products that list Ribes nigrum as an ingredient, but doesn't seem to carry the berries, just seed oil, cosmetics, and powders.

column9: Good currants, though don't taste different than box in store
column10: I love black currants- the kind that are mostly in European products.  I decided to give these a try, and found them to be like the boxed Zante currants in the store... there's nothing wrong with those, but they are more like tiny raisins (as are these).  I'll use them, but am still looking for the true black currant taste that I love in the European black currant products.
These currents (Zante Black Curretns) are wonderful for topping cereal or musli, as well as for baking into scones of muffins.
Great flavor with the Bob's Red Mill quality! Who could ask for more?! Excellent in oatmeal or Irish Soda Bread!

column9: Lee Kum Kee Pemium Oyster Sauce
column10: This is an excellent product. I would say the best Oyster Sauce I have tried. Gave my Chicken wings a full rich flavor. I will definitely purchase again. Item shipped right away and packing was excellent. Definitely recommend this product. Great value for the money.

If you are looking for one of the best, then definitely purchase this one. Otherwise, you can get the non-premium Lee Kim Kee or Panda Brand.

column9: Best of the oyster sauces we have tried
column10: We initially found this product in a Costco store in Hawaii.  It is not available in amy of our local grocery stores -- we tried the other brands but they fall short in taste.

After trying different brands of oyster sauce, LKK makes the best, in my humble opinion. This Premium Oyster Sauce is definitely more expensive than their 'regular' oyster sauce, but the difference in taste is distinct. It also has a much smoother texture than cheaper brands of oyster sauce.Amazon sells this for a lot less than at Asian supermarkets and online stores. I will definitely order future bottles here.

Hello. I just purchased this product today. I won't be using it for about 4 months. I was wondering how long it will last unopened in a cool dried area. Should it be put in the fringe? I am confident that the product is going to be great help in the kitchen, just hope I make it in time.Sincerely,  E.A.C
When you want the best in oyster sauces, this is the premium!  It is expensive, but you pay for what you get and it makes your cooking taste like gourmet!!

LKK is a pretty good brand for most anything they sell. (As are "Healthy Boy" and "Asia Best.") However, you might want to try the LKK oyster sauce that has "No MSG" printed on the label. LKK sauces are assertive. And oysters are the third or fourth down the ingredients list--after water, sugar, and so on. You might also try an excellent Thai oyster sauce. It features oysters as the main ingredient, first on the list, and a full 30% of the total contents! Its English brand name is Maekrua and the label features a healthy looking woman against a blue background pouring the sauce into a giant wok. A more subtle sauce than most, but also more meaty (as opposed to sweet or salty). Maekrua's motto is "Diversity and Refinement" which, although certainly oxymoronic, is a noble ideal.

column9: BEST TASTING but CONTAINS MSG, and is expensive
column10: Lee Kum Kee Premium Oyster Sauce is considered to be the best tasting oyster sauce by far (by industry insiders and consumers). This is the original, truly. The Lee family literally invented oyster sauce. Grandpa Lee was making oyster soup and accidentally cooked it down to a thick liquid and that's how it was invented (its main ingredient is concentrated slow cooked oysters). Oyster sauce is a must-have condiment for cooking nearly every one of today's Chinese & Cantonese food dishes (that have sauce) and for a good reason. It imparts a unique flavor that can't be imitated by any other flavoring or condiment. Not sure what they used before this was invented more than 120 years ago, but we're sure glad they use it now.Be careful when purchasing, if you want this exact sauce. Lee Kum Kee makes at least 9 or 10 types of oyster sauce, but this is the best one they make, their "premium" oyster sauce. Still, I wonder why it's so expensive, since they have the power to buy oysters relatively cheaply by the millions and have already perfected the way it's made, getting it down to a science that for them is surely simple to do since they've been doing it for so long. Why so expensive. I imagine they charge so much because they can, since they have such a great rep for the best flavor.They make a darn good Hoisin sauce too, plus over 200 other types of sauces.The main headquarters of Lee Kum Kee is located in Hong Kong and has production bases in Xinhui, Huangpu, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Los Angeles. So those customers in America who don't like to buy imports, not to worry, chances are if you buy from a store in America you're getting the product that was made right here in California.Having said all that, it looses one star for having MSG in its ingredients. I'm also not happy that the price is so high (higher than other brands, no matter where you buy it). I always wonder, how would it taste without the MSG and caramel color. The color is naturally brown, so I don't see why coloring is needed. And salt is already a great flavor enhancer so I wonder why add MSG. I'm still searching for a great tasting oyster sauce with no MSG (and not so expensive) but haven't found one yet. When I do I'll be sure to post that info here for you all.INGREDIENTS: Oyster Extractives, Sugar, Water, Monosodium Glutamate As A Flavor Enhancer, Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Wheat Flour, Caramel Color.Learn about MSG and how many believe it is bad for your health:Excitotoxins: The Taste That KillsIn Bad Taste: The MSG Symptom ComplexThe Natural Diet: Simple Nutritional Advice For Optimal Health In The Modern World
This is the best brand of all Oyster Sauces -- make sure you always get the premium one as Lee Kum Kee also makes a non-premium brand, which is not as flavorful.
