I grew up with Brooks Tangy Ketchup in my home and anything else always seemed sub par. My preference for Brooks carried over into adulthood. When the local WalMart quit carrying Brooks Tangy Ketchup, I was able to get it at a local grocery. Although more expensive overall than WalMart, I would go to the local grocery explicitly to get Brooks Tangy Ketchup. Today I stopped in, and there was none on the shelf. I inquired and sadly, they no longer carry it. Upon returning home I immediately went to the internet and found it is still available. That's a good thing. But it is interesting to note that there is obviously a very loyal fan base for the product so why did it disappear from the grocery shelves?I hope it comes back to the grocery, but at least it is now available online.

Best catsup-ketchup product ever made. My maternal grandmother would buy it and I remember like it was yesterday(43 years ago) first trying a bologna sandwich with that catsup. The flavors were so much bolder it was quite a revelation for a kid who had never eaten food before that was remotely spicy.It's fun to have this again. Please never stop making it.I also love brooks' other products as well.

Brooks Tangy Catsup is so much better than Heinz, Hunt's or those other catsups on the market. Those taste like stewed tomatoes. Brooks does not. It is much more flavorful. Switch to Brooks and you won't want to go back to those others.

Brooks has not been on US shelves in years and too bad for us.  It is great tasting.Makes Heinz, Hunts and all the rest taste like what they are - tomato paste and sugar.Canada must know because it is now manufactured there.Check out the history - yes, Brooks has an interesting history and great following including a brooks bottle watertower in Collinsville Illinois.

column9: Not as tangy as I remember
column10: It had been many years since I last tasted one of my favorite ketchups, Brooks, so I was really looking forward to that spicy, tangy taste I remembered from at least several  decades ago.  I ordered some through Amazon, but alas, what I received had no unique flavor.  In a blind taste test with others we had trouble differentiating it from Heinz ketchup.It is a good quality ketchup but lacks the spice and zip to make it truly unique.

Brooks is the only brand of ketchup used in our families.  We have been using it for over 60 years, and never found another to compare with it.  Since we cannot find it locally anymore, I now buy it in bulk and give it out to relatives for Christmas, and they are very happy to receive it.

column9: The very best ketchup ever made! A++++++
column10: I have been searching local stores for months to find Brooks Rich Tangy Ketchup. When I finally heard that the it was no longer made, I went on the internet to see if I could find any bottles anywhere. That is when I discovered that it was being made in Canada. I also found that I could find it on your website so when I had the chance I bought a case and shared the bottles with family and friends who had been raised with this being the only ketchup ever put on our table. If you make your own barbecue sauce this just gives it that extra tang that you want. I am not a ketchup person but when I want it this is the only kind I want to eat.

Cannot get Brooks catsup where I live.  I lived on Brooks catsup and lettuce sandwiches in college in the '60's.  No other catsup has the great flavor of Brooks; just a tangy taste with other great ingredients. Brooks catsup is my secret ingredient in baked beans and is awesome wherever catsup should be used.  Hometown Favorites was prompt about filling my order and delivery arrived on schedule.

I learned about Brooks Hot Catsup in the early 1950's. I am 67 years old. My Grandmother had bad arthritis and cataracts. She could not drive nor walk very far so Grandpa did all the grocery shopping. I was about 5 when he was shopping at Worth Food Market on Henderson and Pennsylvania on a Saturday afternoon after he had gotten off work around noon. He liked to try new things so he bought a (glass) bottle of Brooks Hot Catsup. He loved it and he had it from then on. About 1979-80, Worth Food  Markets went out of business in Fort Worth and Arlington. I found Brooks again about 1999-2000. Same wonderful flavor. I am buying more now.

[Quote from The Wizard of OZ] "Never mind that transpizzle behind the curtain, he knows not what he's talking about"Quite literally Brooks is a thick natural tomato flavor with Earthly spices added to perk up the pallets of the best chefs on Earth.I grew up the main 3 catchup's, Hinze, Hunt's and Brooks. All 3 have their places in foods so this is not a knock on any, unlike transpizzle. He obviously has a ONE TRACK taste bud. Totally unworthy to make his review. Catchup on catchup? He also must like sugar on sugar.Once you try Brooks you'll appreciate it's down to Earth flavor you WILL be pleasantly surprised.

For those who say, "ketchup is ketchup", you are wrong!  The subtle, sweet and tangy taste of Brooks is like no other.  Grew up eating it. Now the only place to find it is the internet, but as long as it's available, it's the only one I'll buy.  Thanks for making these hard-to-find products available, Amazon.

column9: Why No Brooks Ketchup in stores?
column10: I have looked in almost every store in my area and am unable to find BOOKS TANGY KETCHUP. What store's sell it? I would never use a case of it in 5 year 's.

column9: The Best Catsup in the World
column10: Brooks catchup is really the best catchup in the world.  I haven't found any better.  I highly recommend this catchup.

I've also found Brooks catsup on the internet but it is $12.50 for one 24 ounce bottle (that's with shipping and handling). Where can I find it cheaper? Does anyone know? I love it -- it is the best catsup ever made and now I can't find it anywhere. Hey Brooks!! Do you here us -- We want some more!!!!!!!

column9: I had high hopes...and was let down big time.
column10: I found Brooks Rich & Tangy Ketchup and immediately bought it.  I love ketchup.  I put ketchup on my ketchup, but I wouldn't ever buy this again.  I'll stick to Heinz.

All joking aside this is a wonderful deal on a lot of dill seeds..... omg its a lot.... more than I will ever use.  Going to give away half pint jars to everyone and still have more than enough. But even if I dont use 95% of this jar its still cheaper than the crap they sell in the grocery store. Anyway its definitely a good fresh product.  I have no issues with it at all.

This cereal makes a yummy start to the day, and has a hearty, filling texture. It also has a subtle flavor, far less sweet than the kid-oriented products cluttering the cereal aisle. At less than five dollars a box, it's also less expensive than the mainstream brands, which practically require a second mortgage if you want to eat breakfast. And it's made without the synthetic ingredients that make other cereals kind of disgusting if you research them at all.But I looked at the nutritional information, and found there was almost no nutritive value. Almost no vitamins, minerals, fiber, or, well, anything. You get more nutrition from the milk you pour over the cereal than from the cereal itself. And I'm a bit squeamish about the repeated use of the word "natural" on the package. That word has no legal definition. Organic? Unprocessed? Who knows? They never bother to say what they mean by "natural."I need something I can rely on to start my day. Yummy is definitely a good trait. And this is probably better than most of the processed filth advertised to kids on TV. But you're better off with fruit, toast, and jam. I like this product okay, but it just doesn't go far enough.
Clearly this is where the government buys it soda.I doubt that anyone who actually earns their money would buy this.
These are the first Hi-Chews I've tried. Got them from a local store. The taste is terrible. Maybe others are better.

I was initially reluctant to purchase this, but I finally got tired of paying $6.00 for a 1-pound Rice Select container at the local grocery store.  I found that this Roland Italian rice made better risotto than it's expensive California cousin.  It was creamier, faster, and tasted better.Let's face it, it's a little arrogant to package and sell ELEVEN POUNDS of arborio rice.  I mean, who really eats that much arborio rice?  Well, after trying it, I do.  Order a bag, turn on the Food Network, cut up an onion, and be a culinary rock star.

I cannot believe the quality of this lovely ristto for the price.  It has a slightly firm, yet moist texture when cooked per the directions on the bag and the flavor can't be equaled.  I will purchase this over and over as it is one of my family's new favorite foods and I can make it in 7 minutes flat using my pressure cooker.  I just saute any vegetable on hand to stir in right before serving.  Top with a pat of butter and some parmesan cheese . . . yum.

I love using Arborio rice for risotto dishes a couple times a week. It's one of those dishes that you can dress up to be anything you want it to be; lemon and zucchini, basil and tomato, herb and cheese. This bag has lasted me about three months now and I'm about 3/4 of the way through it so far. I cannot really speak for the quality of the rice itself; it all seems to be uniform in size and color with no oddballs. The price is well worth it, however! This rice stores well and the price is unbeatable!

The Package arrived in good order and consisted of mostly whole, unbroken grains. After following one of the recipes on the packaging label, I found my first batch to be a bit more toothy than "al Dente". Be prepared to add additional broth as needed until the proper doneness.I prefer to use a mixture of equal parts real sweet cream butter and extra virgin olive oil when starting the dish with onions and then the rice followed by the addition of room temp (or warmer) brut Champagne before adding the heated broth a cup at a time. Additionally, sauteed mushrooms added into the dish at the end along with some crumbled crisp bacon and plenty of fresh grated parmesan cheese,then topped with dried parsley will make this a very satisfying meal with a fresh green salad and some crusty sourdough bread.
I couldn't be happier with this product. Great taste and great value. I will be buying more of this product

column9: I love the rice, makes great risotto
column10: I have tried a lot of different Arborio rices through the years.  Some are more fussy than others, I personally found this to work very well.  My family makes all their own food if it's possible to do so.  I used our homemade rabbit stock, some apple wine that's about ready to be bottled, some artichoke hearts and made some basic risotto.  Everyone loved it, my kids are spoiled when it comes to food, I didn't know what risotto was until I was 27.  This rice seemed to take a little less stock than the "fancier" rices I've used before.  It was very creamy while still holding a little bite.  Personally I will buy this rice again.

Great price, check.  Free Prime shipping for 11 lbs of rice, check.  But how does it taste?  Well, this rice made perfect risotto when combined with homemade stock, fresh ingredients, and proper technique.  We've been working our way through this large bag for several months, but we divided it down into smaller sealed packages to keep it fresh.  It has shown no sign of degradation so far.This Arborio rice cooks nicely and evenly when making risotto, resulting in the characteristic sauce around the grains from the slow release of starch.  It does not get mushy or too soft, but maintains a nice tooth while absorbing the flavors provided.I will be buying another 11 lb bag of this Arborio rice when I run out.  I highly recommend it.

I'm pleased with the quality of Roland arborio rice.  Since rice doesn't go bad unless it gets infested, it's more convient to buy this bag of AR than buying a bunch of expensive, small grocery store boxes/bags.

Excellent value, with fresh grains, yielding consistent, easy to repeat results. Will make you consider a risotto cookbook if you haven't bought one yet. You may find yourself having risotto in a menu instead of pasta or potato or other grains.
My wife was looking for a good arborio rice in order to make paella and risotto.  This is a great price for the quantity you get and the rice turns out plump, firm, and delicious.  Good stuff!

The size and texture were fine, and the price terrific.  The only problem is the huge size, which is about what we consume in a year.  If it has a shelf life of at least a year, we are home free with a good product at a great price (about $2.75/lb compared to about $4.50/lb).
the product shipped to me in great time, and the rice is so delicious, I have already made 3 pots of different types of risorto. I would absolutely purchase when I run out.

I love arborio rice but was having a really hard time getting it in the store. Plus, in the store it was super expensive, about $8 for a small little container of it! This was such a great deal, good bulk price and the quality is good. It came in the mail with no problems. Would recommend! I am not a big cook but my husband and I like to make a good meal for our family of four.

Given that Arborio rice costs a lot in small bags, I wasn't sure this huge bag could possible be as good.  But, it is!  We've made all kinds of risotto and have been quite pleased. No rocks yet, but with rice, that is always a possibility.

We tried this rice and were pleasantly surprised about and how well it works for risotto dishes.  The grains are uniform in size with little breakage.  When cooked by slowly incorporating the liquid it results in beautiful creamy but still al dente rice.  For the price, it beats by far other more expensive and glossy packed products.

I was tired of buying expensive arborio rice at the grocery store, so decided to give this rice a try.  We have recently received our second bag of this rice; the first lasted almost a year.  Excellent quality, no bugs or other materials, and it makes great risotto.  You can save even more money using Subscribe and Save.  I will definitely keep buying this rice.

we make rissoto at least once a week.  Since finding this product online we have saves 50% of what we normally spend on arborio rice.  Now, if we could only find a way to buy the wine we cook with at 50% off...

I love to make Italian risotto.  I usually find I can only get arborio rice in small quantities and at a high price.  This enormous bag cost me less than twenty dollars with subscribe and save.  That saves A LOT of mullah and a lot of bother trying to shop for it too (most markets round here don't carry arborio rice of any brand).

I ordered a bag of this risotto a couple of months ago after reading the great reviews.  We cook quite a bit of it, so I always like to have some on hand, and the price for this product seemed very good.My wife and I used it for the first time a few days ago.  As she was cooking it up she asked me what the black things were.  I looked down and said it was probably just some husks or something like that.  She pulled one out and it was very clearly an insect, legs and all.  Stirring the contents of the pan turned up at least half a dozen of the little beasts and this was in just a 1.5 cup serving.I next looked at the bag.  It had no holes in it other than the one we had made to start using it.  I poured out more of the rice and saw that not only were there many more insects in it, but other "debris" such as a couple of pieces of corn and other random things that looked like they were the result of poor processing.Now, I know that you can't harvest food without having insects and other things in the rough product, but normally insects and debris would be filtered out in the processing stage.  I don't know if we got a bad bag, or one that contained all of the "goodies" left over from a full day's sorting, but it was extremely disgusting and has put us off from ever buying this brand again!

I couldn't stand this coffee.  It smells like the old 'scratch and sniff' chocolate from the books in the 70's!  It leaves a horrible aftertaste that is very chemically.  I'm stuck with 4 bags, but don't know anybody I dislike enough to try to pawn this coffee off on them-yuck!!!

It's a quick snack that's healthy and delicious. All you need is a hot water dispenser which can likely be found in most offices - and you've got a warm, lightly sweet black sesame cereal. It is cheaper in an Asian supermarket as previously mentioned.

column9: Good stuff that combines 2 of the ingredients that I look for.
column10: I put this and other Greenmax powders into my protein shake daily.  Good tasting stuff with ingredients not easy to be found anywhere else.  But check your local Asian supermarket first, it's like 1/2 the price of here.  Since when is Amazon synonymous with high price?

column9: I bought this for both emergency and daily use and it works perfectly: the Details
column10: As a consumer, I've been alarmed at how quickly food prices have soared, including cheese and similar dairy products. Also, a power outage last winter convinced me that it would be good idea to have some items on hand which could be used to create cheese sauces, perhaps if we had to use alternate ways of cooking, such as the fireplace.This produce exceeded my expectations. We not only have extra for emergency use but I've found all sorts of ways to use it weekly. It is the ONLY cheese powder which my family truly loves on popcorn, neither too salty or bland. It adds just the right touch.When it comes to adding an accent to my homemade white sauces or giving some zest to buttered broccoli, the nice cheese flavor is perfect. Try adding it to melted butter and some garlic as a spread for toast. The possibilities are limited only by your cookbooks and imagination.Also, this is an item that can be used by both beginners and professional cooks. You really can't go wrong by having some of this in your pantry and the ingredients are far healthier than the typical Cheese product sold at a local grocery store. Unless you want to subsist only on peanut butter sandwiches for two weeks (we thought we might have to do that during the winter at one point, car stuck in garage, roads icy and temperatures below freezing), this is a nice, reassuring cheese powder to keep in your pantry and versatile enough to add to popcorn, liven up sauces and keep vegetables from being boring.

I ordered this by mistake, was looking at it online and decided i didn't need it & didn't intend to buy it.  Well i must have forgotten to delete it from my cart and when i placed my order i guess i didn't notice it there. I'm usually very careful about these things so i must have been running a fever that day.  So any-hoo i was a little bit surprised when it showed up on my doorstep one day.  I don't really cook much so i thought what the heck am i gonna do with all this powdered cheese???So far i have added it to a steamfresh package of cauliflower with cheese sauce that i was disappointed to find had virtually no cheese flavor at all. Thankfully this stuff cheesed it up up up and saved the day (i was quite happy to have my random powdered cheese package laying around that day.)  Another time i was having major cheese cravings, I added it to an Annie's microwave mac n cheese packet and i was in heaven.  Oh and i also slapped some on top of microwave popcorn, which was quite tasty as well.SOOOO.....I'm glad i bought this stuff by mistake.  I don't know much about cheese powders in general, but i can say that this particular cheese sauce powder has a great cheesy flavor and nice consistency when you mix it up.  I will order more when it runs out. :)

I make mac and cheese a lot for my hubby and I usually make it with real cheese. I wanted to save some money and try and use this. It is great! I received it a week early an just tried it. I make mac and cheese and use mostly this and a cup of real cheese to give it texture.

column9: I'd love a resealable bag for this to come in!
column10: I really enjoyed the flavor of this powder.  It was great on popcorn!  My only gripe is that it would be nice if it came in a recloseable bag so I didn't need to make sure I had large enough zip-close bags for it to be transferred to (which just caused a lot of wasted plastic).

column9: Know the ingredients before you order
column10: This product has two types of hydrogenated oil, artificial colors, and two types of MSG (MSG and hydrolyzed yeast extract). The company can be difficult to deal with- no notification if your shipment is delayed due to unavailable ingredients for example. It took several attempts via e-mail and phone calls to get anyone to answer why the order had not even shipped after the estimated delivery date. The shipping is outrageously high for the weight as well. Not what I have come to expect from an Amazon related company.

Not often do I come across such an awful food product that I throw the remainder away but this is such a product.  In fact, if I could have given it negative 5 stars, I would have!When using it, it filled the kitchen with an unusual aroma ... make that stench.  And, no, I did not burn it.  When we sat down to eat, it had a very unpleasant flavor that left the a lingering after taste of plastic.  Amazon should bundle all remaining stock and take it to the dump!

column9: Great for broccoli and cheese soup, or just broccoli and cheese!
column10: Disclaimer: if you're looking for the cheddar cheese powder that makes Kraft mac n' cheese, you'll find that here: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B000F9ZM7M?tag=a52-20&ie=UTF8This cheese sauce powder is intended for making the cheese sauce you'd normally find on broccoli, cauliflower or other veggies. But this is the GOOD cheese sauce, not the cheap knock off stuff found in off-brand veggie n' cheese mixes.I didn't think it was that great for use in making mac n' cheese, as foretold in the above disclaimer, but you might find it more to your liking for that sort of thing if you enjoy off-brand, cheap, cardboard-like mac n' cheese.Mixed with salt, this does make a great popcorn topping though. The cheddar cheese powder is just a touch better on popcorn than this, but we usually run out of the cheddar cheese powder pretty quickly, so this tends to make a great alternative.

Yep, it's yellow/orange cheddar cheese powder. Just like the stuff you get in kraft, etc., it's laden with tasty chemicals, hydrogenates, etc. If you want to avoid those, search for the organic stuff (which will be white and taste quite different).

I wanted to start making my own mac and cheese instead of buying it, and had hoped this would work well.  What I found was that it tastes terrible, I only managed two bites before I spit it out and threw it away.  I guess my first clue should of been the greenish tint to the sauce in the daylight.  I would not buy this again, and I would not recommend it to others.
This is so yummy! It's the exact same thing as the Kraft Mac & Cheese powdered sauce. I like to use this with healthier pasta, so you get the same box-taste (which kids like) but better nutrition.
I Liked the cheddar cheese topping better.But the kids loved this one, it is very cheesy and sauces up pretty good too.
Trying to deal with this company is just not worth the effort.They really need to change their attitude in Customer Service.
Says "cheese sauce powder."  I was expecting a cheese sauce mix.  Not so.  It is powdered cheese flavor to add to a sauce you make.
I had to throw this away when it arrived because it had trans-fat and MSG -- both well proven to severly damage our health.

column9: what did I do to deserve this?
column10: I got a box of 479 Popcorn sent to me as a birthday gift. the cool presentation made me think, "what did I do to deserve this?!?" I'm definitely going to regift this box.the gift box had four flavors in different sized bags (more on that in a second) -- and it was almost like a tasting menu. there was Black Truffle + White Cheddar, Fleur de Sel Caramel, Chipotle Caramel + Almonds, and Ginger Sesame Caramel.I liked all the flavors. each time you opened a bag, the flavor hit you fast. pretty cool. the Black Truffle + White Cheddar was really good, really rich, and not overly salty like you have w/other flavored popcorn ... and + my room still smells like white cheddar, which ain't a bad thing.and I'm a big fan of salted caramel ice cream -- so the Fleur de Sel Caramel was a treat. but my FAVORITE (think bold/underline/italic FAVORITE) was the Ginger Sesame Caramel, as the ginger went really well w/the caramel -- too bad this came in a small bag.and one last thing, there was not ONE single unpopped kernel of popcorn. loved it and big thanx to my friend for sending.

there are no details about the weight of the toblerone products offered on line........24 count means nothing what is the net weight per bar. it is suggested that both the single bar weight and total weight per box of 24 should be specified to make clear what one is buying also for the 60 count mini toblerone, it does not show the total weight of the 60 count mini toblerone box.  please clarify & display these details on your web site to facilitate a buying decision.thanks

column9: See the tooth fairy more often.
column10: Who wouldn't be tempted to sink their teeth deep into this classic chocolatey favorite? It's the unique combination of Swiss chocolate with honey and almond nougat that would keep you coming back for more. And who wouldn't recognize the unique shape of this mouth-watering bar? If you have not tried this brand, you are no choco fan.

column9: Thank you for supporting our troops in a time of need.
column10: Let me start by saying thank you to DeliDirect for shipping this basket out to our troops in Afghanistan. This basket arrived the same day riots happened over in Afghanistan and I received multiple thank you messages from our troops as this basket was actually taken into a bunker with our troops during a rocket attack. As I was told the cheeses and meats were shared by soldiers huddled together in a freezing bunker and helped immensely in the moral as they sheltered from incoming rocket fire. I also have to say I had ordered from Swiss Colony another basket alongside this one, but Swiss Colony notified me 5 days after I ordered that they canceled because they would not ship items to APO addresses, so again DeliDirect, Thank you so much for supporting our troops when another would not.  Soldiers mentioned they loved the Pepperoni/ Peppered Cheese/ Grained Mustard Combination. The Havarti Cheese and Merlot were also big hits. There was one comment that said soldiers joked, "Hey if this is my last meal I am glad it's Wisconsin cheese and not that MRE Peanut butter." You guys are Awesome!
I received this product 2 weeks expired.... the only thing edible was the cheese which was nasty quality. Go to your local stores x10 cheaper too..
Low end quality!  Do not buy it!  Go to your grocery store and for better quality foods.  It is an insult to the taste
Excelente, Muy buena presentación del producto,Estaba Delicioso!!! todo llego a tiempo, y el regalo fue muy bueno, muchas gracias por el envio.

By far, these are the MOST delicious brownies I've ever eaten!!  If you want to treat yourself or thank your friends, order these now.  They are so moist and rich with flavor.  We've had the double dark and the peanut butter - love them both.  They are all laced with caramel and dusted with powered sugar, which just give them that extra something special we've never experienced in another brownie. Anyone we've ever sent them to raves about them constantly.

Treat your self,treat your friends,treat your family to the best BROWNIE you have ever tasted.  One bite and you are hooked for life. So what are you waiting for place your order today before they are all gone. I now send BROWNIES instead of flowers or fruit baskets. They always make a big hit.I have tried all of them and can not decide which ones I like best. I love them all and you will too.

These brownies are absolutely the best brownies I have ever tasted.  I have had them on several occasions and would recommend them to anyone and everyone.  In my own wacky statement " They are better than S*X".  You will not be disappointed with these brownies.
These brownies are the best! You will not find a better treat for chocolate lovers! Love, love, love Devil Brownies!

You can now stop searching! - The best brownies on earth can be found on this website. If you enjoy lavish, ultra-rich brownies, an impressive selection, stellar customer service and high product quality this is the site for you!  Always delicious, never disappoints! A family favorite!

column9: Devil Brownies are To Die For!
column10: Can't say enough about how good these brownies are! Each one is a perfect little slice of heaven. Impeccable service and great packaging. Haven't tasted a better brownie yet! Love them!

Wow. I'm never baking my own brownies anymore. These walnut-caramel-chocolate brownies are dense and moist and incredibly satisfying. I ordered on a Monday and rec'd them 2 days later. Will definately be ordering more in the near future. Outstanding quality and taste. Thank you, Thank you

I was given these as a gift...they were so amazing I now order them for all occasions and sometimes just because I hadn't had them in a while.  A little warning; they are completely addictive.  I like the marshmellow ones;  my girlfriend likes the rocky road.  Highly recommended!Sure to be appreciated by everyone on your gift list.
I am not much of a brownie lover, however, I attended a function and these brownies were served. Because they were homemade I decided to have one and they were absolutely delicious!!!!!

We have had these brownies on numerous occasions and have not met anyone yet who did not love them! As a matter of fact, both grand daughters put them on their Christmas list every year now.You will not be disappointed with them at all.
Every occasion be it happy, sad, silly, or just for the hell of it, we send these brownies and they're the hit everytime.
I have had these Brownies on several occasions and they are the best!!I encourage you to try them and find out just how good they are!!I do not think you will be disappointed

column9: As advertised! Good for the price.
column10: The coffee is very good compared to Maxwell drip and reasonably good compared to other Tassimo brands. This is my standard morning coffee. No complaints for the cost!

I have purchased these T discs many times and there is something wrong with this last order.  Does anyone else have the problem of the discs only making 3/4 of a cup?  It's not my machine because any other brand turns out fine.  I bought another package from a retail store and the same thing is happening!  For the money that these discs cost, this is unacceptable.  I bought a whole case!!!

the coffee is good. but I've been trying to cancel the auto shipments but its impossible to find any way for customer service to help. therefore they continue sending it and I have to keep sending it back.

column4: coffee drinker in PA "coffee drinker in PA"
column10: This is still good coffee but they have DOUBLED the cost.  Half the price at BBB with a 20 percent coupon.  Also available half what Amazon is now charging @ Target & Walmart (at least it was available there a couple month ago)

column9: Exactly what it aims to be
column10: For anyone who simply wants a basic, American-style cup of coffee, this is perfectly fine. No, it's not as full-flavored or (arguably) as good as most of the higher priced Tassimo offerings, but it isn't intended to be. This is a simple, inexpensive cup for everyday use.That said, I knocked off a star due to Amazon's current pricing. The unit price for the "Friday Sale" is roughly the same as the individual retail price at many stores. That's not a deal -- and certainly doesn't represent the sort of discount one would expect to receive when buying a 5-pack.

The coffee is excellent the price great. After my K cup took a dive I gave the T-disc a try Wow. It was better than any of the K-cup brands I had. The only unfortunate draw back is you can't seem to get the T-disc in stores. Good thing Amazon has them at a good price.
I enjoy this coffee.  Biggest problem is that it overfills my mugs so that I have to watch it so as not to overflow. I don't understand why some brands overflow and some do not fill the cup.
I was surprised at the pleasant flavor of this coffee. Robust enough to satisfy, with a great smooth, full taste. One of my regular favorites for the Tassimo.
This coffee is just the right strength for me.  It has no bitter aftertaste.  I love it! Great price with the save & subscribe feature and it comes right to you.

When I come down the stairs in the morning, and the kids are "making coffee" I smell the great aroma of the original Maxwell House coffee that I grew up with. When I get to the kitchen, I have a great cup of coffee, with no mess and no waste. The coffee disc's are expensive, but there is no "day old" coffee left sitting in the pot. This coffee is nothing fancy, not too strong, and taste good every time I fix a cup.
These discs and the Tassimo coffee machine are incredibly easy to use and Amazon ships the discs in record time.

There is nothing really special about these t-discs coffee. It's not very strong, but it does radiate a fresh roasty flavor when brewed. This is definitely the most convenient way for me to brew coffee while in the office where I don't want to deal with the mess of coffee beans.
This is a great tasting product and it is much cheaper than others. You can't beat it in any way. I drank many other coffees including Starbucks and found this to be quite satisfactory.

column9: This Coffee is so smooth it's the choice at our house!
column10: This Tassimo Maxwell coffee  from the Maxwell Cafe collectionis the choice at our house no matter who is choosing! Finallya coffee that My husband, Kids & friends love! This price can't be Beat!
Great cafe and a good product.. The most you can get for what you pay for love it . thx

This is great-tasting coffee.  So convenient in the T-Disk format.  When you want just one cup of coffee, just pop one of the T-Disks in your Tassimo and out comes a very good cup.  Maxwell House should be proud.

As the title says, this is a good basic cup of coffee.  We feel a little frustrated by the 6 ounce default pour - does anyone still drink coffee in these lilliputian quantities? Still, with a little time spent pressing the "give me more" button, we can get a nice full cup of medium bodied coffee. We generally alternate cups between this and Gevalia Vanilla Hazelnut on the weekends.
The brand of coffee is a nice medium brew.  I don't like coffee that is too bold or strong and this fits the bill.

Do you remember what it smells like to add water to an ashtray full of cigarettes? That's how this coffee tastes. I added a caramel, some hazelnut flavoring, a packet of hot chocolate with miniature marshmellows, and Coffeemate vanilla chai creamer too it. It still tasted bitter, like wet cigarettes and metallic. I think the metallic flavor comes from the t-disc packaging. It doesn't make sense to buy a $100 coffee maker and drink trashy coffee. Especially when you can take that same amount of cash and buy some good coffee. I ignored the bad ratings of other reviewers because I believed the positive reviews. The only redeeming factors are that it is cheaper (less than $7 at Walmart), and that you can make a single cup of coffee. If it were allowed, I'd give it a -5 rating (or <-> -,  for infinitly horrible).

I cannot say enough about The Honest Kitchen. I have used all of their dog food products and a lot of their treat line and would, and do, highly recommend them to anyone who asks me what I'm feeding my dogs.I have a 7 year old Beagle and a 4 year old Plott Hound and I get a lot of compliments on how shiny their coats are, and how healthy they look. The Plott Hound has been on THK since she was a puppy, my Beagle since he was 3. My Beagle had severe food allergies and seasonal allergies, and I had a hard time getting him to eat until I switched over to THK. He use to get really bad hot spots in the spring and summer months as things were blooming, which were treated with a wide variety of antihistamines that can't be good for his little system. He had anal gland issues due to gastrointestinal irritation, (probably from all the pills). Thanks to THK's Preference, the anal gland issues are a thing of the past and he's happy to eat every time I put a bowl in front of him. (Salmon Oil has helped tremendously with the skin irritation).I feed THK Zeal, (white fish), Embark, (turkey) and Preference, (base diet that you add a protein source to). My dogs love them all.This is a great product for someone who is seriously thinking about feeding a raw diet, but like me, doesn't have the nerve to fully commit. THK is the only dog food on the market that is FDA Approved for human consumption -- and that's important in this day and age when commercial dog foods are full of who knows what and are prone to toxic contamination.This product saved my Beagle from miserable summers and a lot of visits to the vet, (and has actually saved me money in the long run by preventing the problems).If you care about what your dogs and/or cats eat, give it a try.

I have been feeding my dog home prepared raw with occasional meals of this stuff. Lately he started having trouble with some of the heavier boned stuff I was giving him (he is 10 1/2) so have shifted to feeding more of this. About the time I started that he started being more frisky and puppy like. He has never acted his age but it seems like something changed and the change in food seems like the only thing that happened around the same time. Aside from that I trust this company and like that they use human grade ingredients. The food does not smell bad either. I wish it was cheaper but guess you get what you pay for. My frisky senior is priceless though, for everything else there's MasterCard, right?Oh and he loves the taste but that is fairly meaningless as he will eat anything. He gets really excited about this stuff though!

column9: Good product but increased bowel movements
column10: This seems to be one of the better freeze dried raw food options because of it's high protein ingredients but my dogs had a lot more bowel movements than when using fresh raw food like Bravo or Primal. So take that in account when adding to your dog's diet.

I acquired several samples of THKs food when they were running a big sale for ~$1.00/ea. We found out that he loves Embark. I'm actually shopping for a control bowl because he chokes it down too quickly. It is also a nice comfort to know that the food is being dehydrated/packaged/shipped from a factory that produces cereal for humans.To the person complaining about the bowel movements. At least with my dog, you can compare the big(huge, yes) movement to the amount of reconstituted food in the bowl. It will likely be the same volume/mass. That sounds healthy and regular to me. Anyway, sorry for the rant. It's some good food and you should buy it.

We use this as a back-up for raw feeding, and our pup absolutely loves it. Although THK isn't technically raw, it doesn't cause much digestive upset when we use it between regular raw meals. The one gripe I have about this food is the poo factor; this stuff produces a HUGE amount of stool in comparison with real raw. When our Darwin's shipment was delayed last month, I had to use THK exclusively for a week. I was shocked when I cleaned up the yard that Saturday--the amount of poo had nearly tripled! Hence, we use this food only occasionally.

column9: Saved a dog's life with low red blood cells
column10: I'll keep this short, but this plus Vibrant Health Green food, salmon oil, and "Molleja" (chicken gizards) saved a dog's life! Thanks to friends who gave me some of theirs. One little puppy now lives and is adopted because of it.

Excellent food! Only dog food allowed to be labelled as containing "human grade ingredients!" Dogs LOVE it!!! One of my pups has a sensitive stomach sometimes and when that happens, this is the ONLY food she will eat and it settles her tummy immediately! Great product!!!

I was given a referral to try this dog food from someone else who owns a French Bulldog and it turns out mine hates it. I have to say, it does look really gross also. The green color when you add water is weird and I wouldn't want to eat that either. My Frenchie is picky so it might work well for other dogs, but i would try raw meat before this. I mean actual meat that humans would eat, stew meat, chicken, ground beef or turkey with veggies. My dog loves it!

I gave these a try with finicky, picky Emmy, only because everything else--Pounce, Friskies, the gourmet little cans--had pretty much failed. (I have no idea what she lives on, because she's determined to show me she's above eating anything I offer her.)  Much to my amazement, she's crazy about these Greenies' treats and would easily consume an entire package, even in my presence, if I let her.  She's making me feel a little bit like her "dealer," and now that we're momentarily out of her drug of choice, I'm feeling a bit guilty, as though it's my fault she's going through cold turkey withdrawal.  I guess I have no choice but to order another supply and, in the meantime,  endure the combination of her loud complaints and constant tapping of her forepaw on my shoulder to remind me of my duty and heartless dereliction.  I just hope I don't have to bring her to a specialist in feline addictive counseling.

I wanted to point out that these treats are different from the dog Greenies. Dog Greenies are chewy, cat Greenies are crunchy, like dry cat food. Because of this I don't know if they actually work (if they're the same texture what makes them different from cat food?) but I don't think they're dangerous, as a previous reviewer said. Canine Greenies have caused health problems, but from what I understand it is because the dog didn't chew it well (like most dogs) and because of the softer texture it swelled in the dogs stomach. My cats love the salmon flavor, the package recommends six pieces three times a day, not to exceed 18 pieces a day. I give my cats about six a day, all at once. They don't always chew them though, which is the only problem I've had with the product, swallowing them whole doesn't bother my cats at all though. I have one cat, Garfield, who is very picky, but he loves these treats. So I think its probably safe to say that these shouldn't cause health problems like the canine Greenies can and also that your cat will really like them!

I've opened 4 of the 8 packages of Greenies, one was rancid.  My cat started vomiting after eating the Salmon Greenies. I compared them with another package only to find that they had yellow-orange spots instead of being entirely green.  I smelled them and they smelled different too.  Normally Greenies are great treats for my cats but rancid products are not acceptable. EntirelyPets and other suppliers have to be aware of the age of the product they are selling according to when they buy it fromGreenies.  I could not find an expiration date on the packages.  Greenies is manufactured by S&M Nutec and they should be providing expiration dates.

We received a free sample of Feline Greenies in the mail today from PETCO. Our 13 indoor cats gobbled the entire 1-oz. package in less than 10 minutes. Even our finicky eaters loved them. We are very careful pet owners, double-checking every ingredient in anything that they eat (in the same way that we watch our own food). Unfortunately, I fed first and checked later (something that I have NEVER done before and will never do again)!Imagine my dismay when I found menadione sodium bisulfite in this product. This toxic, unapproved ingredient has no business in our pet food. Its use is prohibited in many European countries, and our own FDA won't approve it.We have requested that PETCO discontinue the sale of this product immediately, until the manufacturer removes this poison.If you love your cats, you will not feed this product to them. Just do a web search for "menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB)". You'll be a better cat owner, that's for sure . . .

column9: I thought they were great until I learned about menadione sodium bisulfite
column10: Thanks to another reviewer, I learned today that Greenies contain a synthetic, controversial ingredient, menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB), that is highly questionable and considered by many experts to be toxic. I will no longer take that chance with my pet just because the FDA hasn't gotten around to banning it. Based upon the information I have read about it, the only apparent reason to add MSB to pet food is to claim it as a nutritious ingredient, namely, the k-vitamins that come from green plants. In other words, the basis of "Greenies" is a cheap synthetic version of the real thing. That must be why the ingredient label describes the stuff as "source of vitamin k activity."Furthermore, although my 3 year-old cat has been eating between 6-12 Greenies every day, he is currently in need of advanced dental work. I see no evidence that these so-called dental treats are effective and they may very well be harmful.

From what I can tell the only reason that these treats have the Greenies name is because they are made by the same company.  They slightly resemble the shape the the Greenies for dogs, but lack the same chewy texture.  They seem just like any other dry dog / cat treat.  One of my cats likes them, and the other doesn't.  Neither of them like any one flavor more than the others.

my cat, Rosie, was having loose stools, diarreah, etc on and off. I finally found the best cat food for her and thought we were done with her intestinal bouts. I had not given her Greenies for a few months and never thought that 4 to 5 of those little treats could cause a problem.....I was wrong.She has only been back on Greenies for a week and once again, diarreah.....and she is a long haired Ragdoll, so imagine the mess!! I'm taking her to the vet today to rule out anything else, but I've got this gut feeling that Greenies and Rosie do not agree with each other.My male cat has no problem with them. So, I'm not saying Greenies are bad for every cat, but maybe some cats are too sensitive to their ingredients.....anyway, always, always look at your pet's food when their health declines in anyway......its the single most important thing we do for them everyday.oh....and as far as tartar and dry food/treats keeping their teeth healthy....that's bunk! that would be the equivalent of saying that if humans eat pretzels, their teeth will stay clean.....it does not work that way with US or our pets. You must brush their teeth, or take them to the vet for that.

I've been buying Greenies for a few years now and I have never once encountered anything close to what I have just read here on some of the other reviews. I'm certain this was an isolated incident and is not a common scenario. My cats would need therapy if I all of a sudden cut them off from greenies. I recommend this product highly. It's not only nutritious for them it's also orally hygienic.

My cats do not like it. But I know other cats that are eager for a piece. It is all a matter of taste. However, the vet told me they are the best for teeth tartar removal and I would recommend them to a cat that has teeth problems. Nevertheless, I heard it caused cat choaks in the past (probably because the cats did not chew the pieces), so be cautious when offering them to your animal.

Feline Greenies Variety Pack (two of each flavor - 18-oz (six 3-oz packs))MY CAT LOVES THESE TREATS!!  I love them because they are also good for your cat's teeth.  I first bought GREENIES for my dog so when we got a new kitty we got these for her -- she especially likes the variety of flavors.  This pack is best value.
He loves them so much he'll sit-up and rollover for them.  5 per day and the vet says he has beautiful teeth.

We received the salmon greenies from petmed and my cats loved them. These are treats not a meal. I don't feed my cat the whole bag at once but they get 2 every night. They will run from anywhere in the house once it is bedtime just to get their treat. The package arrived fresh and had a pleasant smell.

My three cats were all kind of finicky about treats.  I tried the Feline Greenies and they go crazy for them!  Even my aloof Black cats are begging for more!  Our morning routine is for "treat time" and all three cats line up.  Great variety, great price!

column9: Feline Greenies are the only treats that my cats like!
column10: I had never had cats that were picky when it came to treats until I got Syd.  Then Nermal came along and she had the same nose-turned up attitude towards the cat treats I usually use.  Then I found Feline Greenies and thought, "Yeah, let's give 'em a try."  They loved them!  So not only did I find cat treats that my picky cats love, but Feline Greenies help reduce tartar in my cats' teeth too!

My kitty is 13years old, and she loves these treats.  Make sure you feed it to your feline as directed, or it can upset their stomach.  It's really good for your kitty, but like all good things, it needs to be in moderation..  It's simple, just 6 pieces at a time, up to 3 times a day.  If your cat is like mine, she will remind you if you forget.

column9: One of my cats will eat no other treats
column10: I just about gave up trying to find a treat that Prowler, my orange tabby would eat.  She loves peanut butter licked off my finger, and small amounts of dairy products (she'll try to steal ice cream out of a bowl, if I'd let her).  I've tried almost every brand, then my new girlfriend mentioned Feline Greenies.  I thought, "Naaa...she won't eat those either."  Wrong!  She looks forward to her Greenies every morning.  If she doesn't get them, there's no peace in the house until she gets them.  We give her and my tuxedo cat, Obie, 6 each morning.  They disappear quickly.  And they're good for the teeth, too.  I'm totally sold on them and it looks like they're going to get their 6 each morning for the rest of their lives :-)

My cat LOVES Greenies.  She's at her bowl meowing for the treats morning, noon and night.  She gets them three times each day.  That's what she WANTS to eat, the other food is OK but Greenies are ice cream for her!!

column9: This May or May Not Be So...
column10: The review below says that the ingredients are not digestible.  It is not clear if they are talking about feline or canine greenies, AND in my esperience, both my dogs and cats have digested their respective greenies "just fine."  My elderly male cat loves the salmon flavor, and I've often used them to keep his appetite "perked up."  Decide for yourself.  Try samples of the Greenies products out and observe your animals.

My cats RUN after their Greenies.  I throw the Greenies across the wooden floor and the cats take off - sometimes not for a soft landing.  They usually put the breaks on and slide around.  They love it when I throw one into a box.  I look at treat time as exercise time, and treat guests to a showtime.

Got these for my for my cat. Was about to give it to him when I checked the ingredient list. Glad I looked first. I see from the label that menadione sodium bisulfite is in these things. That stuff is really bad.I threw the ones I got away.

column9: what's the difference between a "treat" and "dental treat"
column10: My cats swallow them without chewing. I guess if they make it a little bigger the cats might want to chew on it? So it defeats the dental cleaning purpose and I view it as a regular treat, although much more expensive.The good thing about it is it really smells good and my cats love it (hence the swallowing...)

Matt the cat turned 11 yesterday.  Matt is our tabby who resembles a miniature mountain lion at 19 inches from head to toe and pushing 20 pounds.  He really loves greenies as treats.  The package says they are low in calories and are good for dental care, supposedly preventing tartar.  That would be great if Matt actually chewed them first; he probably crunches less than half of them (yes, he does have all of his teeth).  We have a regular session on Saturdays when my brother visits, and we make Matt "work" for about 10 of them.  That is, my brother bounces greenies onto the coffee table, and it is Matt's job to jump up and get them or, if too lazy, just stand up on his back legs and snag them off the table with a front paw.  Matt has only been "off his feed" once in 11 years.  Something may have upset his stomach, and the only thing he would eat for about a day was greenies, so imagine my emotional attachment to this product.  With all of the different flavors there are, I wouldn't give Matt anything else for a treat.  What is truly amazing to me is that I can open a bag of potato chips, or an energy bar or any other cellophane container besides the greenies bag, and Matt takes no notice, but when I open the greenies bag, he always knows and comes out like a shot.  All of my packages came marked with expiration dates that are at least six months out; for me, a good price is around $3 for the 3-ounce package.

I bought this product hoping it would help keep my cats teeth clean and their breath fresh. I wish I had read the ingredients before I purchased it because it doesn't seem to have any enzymatic ingredients found in true, working dental treats. Also the only breath freshening ingredients- rosemary and chlorophyll, are at the very tail end of the ingredient list as dead last and third to last. I am glad that these ingredients are present, but they are in such small quantities, that they can't be helping much. From personal experience, I have not noticed and breath freshening results.  I think the only reason why they are "dental" treats is because of the small amount of rosemary and chlorophyll as well as the fact that they are crunchy and not moist treats, which is very good. Another issue I have with these treats is that my cats only like this product while its very fresh. They seem to go stale really easily, like within a week, and then after that my cats don't care for it. I always close them tightly and I've even tried putting them in a separate bag- in container, but still no luck. If your looking for a real dental treat I would recommend Crunch n' Clean with DentaShield. However, this is still a MUCH better treat than Pounce brand or Meow Mix or any soft treat that can stick to your cats teeth and smell bad and cause dental problems. This treat may not help teeth significantly, but they definitely won't hurt them. Also there are tuns of vitamin in these, which is pretty cool. They really are pretty decent treats, and I would probably give them 4 stars if they were just treats. However, to be marketing them as "dental," they really should have enzymes or more prevalent dental ingredient.

I always love to find a new treat to give to the cats. So I tried these "Greenies" on them and they loved them. The other great thing is they have a nice variety of flavors so I give them a different flavor everyday.
Emmy loves her Greenies! She even sits for them. They're great for her teeth, too.  And, the variety pack is a great idea! Afterall, variety is the spice of life!
Great product, was delivered faster sooner than expected, and the cat simply loves it, all the flavors that it contains.
my cats love these. i get the 6pk variety. don't have to spend time trying to find them in store. delivered very quick.

Our two cats are 4.5 and 7.5 years old (so their teeth are good) and they love the crunchy consistency and flavors.  They are fish- and chicken-oriented, not beef nor liver eaters; maybe those flavors (in all products) are too strong; so it helps to know your cat's preferences before you buy.  This is a great product we include in their feeding rotation (some wet food, some dry food, some treats).

Having several cats with REALLY major "cat breath", Greenies were the only things I found that helped, and I couldn't get them anyplace except at my vet's office. This was a MUCH better price, and the amount will keep the guys supplied for months.

I have 8 cats, they are between the ages of 3 years and 5 years.  I have bought them different treats from time to time and some will like them and some of my cats won't.  Then I bought "Greenies" and all my cats love them, even Freeway.  He got his name because he was found on the Freeway by Caltrans, he was just a kitten.  Needless to say he is very timid but "Greenies" has brought him out of his shell.  He even takes them from my fingers.  I keep the "Greenies" in a cupboard under the TV and all the cats come running from everywhere if they hear that cupboard door open.  I feel like the Pied Piper with "Greenies".  My best friend loves her cats too so I gave her some "Greenies" for them.  My cats. Toes, Ralf. Chip, Missy, Peanut, Thomas, Freeway and William all recommend "Greenies" for your cats.  Plus they keep your cat's teeth clean too!

I have 3 cats and one of them would give Greenies 5+++ stars if he could.  He will come running from anywhere when he hears the bag jiggle and he loves them so much he'll do tricks to get them.  My other two cats don't seem to care for them.  I'd say, buy a bag and see for yourself whether it's love or hate.

I got my kittie a free sample of Greenies and she loved them!  HOWEVER - I could not find them in any store so she did without.  I stumbled upon them at Amazon.com (I should have known!!!) and was able to get them for her.  I have one EXTREMELY happy kittie.  She just LOVES them!!  From now on I will just come here to order them again and again.....

column9: Cats love these and they provide potassium
column10: Greenies Cat Treats are the best cat snacks. All my cats think they are cat candy and always eat them up when offered - one even fetches them when tossed (the treat, that is). The package is recloseable and each variety is different and appealing. They are crunchy but not messy. They provide nutrients that cats don't always get enough of, especially for good muscle tone for indoors cats. The package I purchased was a much better value than one at a time purchase at the store - plus, it is often difficult to find them in stores. So I recommend them- and more importantly, my cats think they are divine.
My two cats just love Feline Greenies. They look forward to their treats every day. I will be buying all the time for my kitties.

column9: Greenies can pose a risk of intestinal blockage and death!!
column10: PLEASE, please do not feed these treats to your dogs/cats. The company has not publicized the risk of blockage and choking, and 13 dogs have died as a result of ingesting Greenies. Try googling "Greenies" and "blockage" or "death." This product is not safe for dogs.I was sent a free sample of the "reformulated" Greenie in the mail. The package claims the treat is "easier to digest", so I gave the treat to my dog, a 100 pound weimaraner. I watched my dog chew the treat, and he chewed it appropriately, taking his time to chew the pieces into small, digestible chunks.The next day, my dog refused to eat or drink anything and vomited at least three times. He acted listless and lethargic all day, so that evening we called our vet. We told the vet that the last thing our dog ate was a Greenie. The vet informed us that Greenies are known to cause intestinal blockage in some cases. He suggested that we take him to the emergency vet clinic for advanced treatment.We took him to the emergency clinic for x-rays and diagnosis. The vet treated him with an anti-vomiting medication and told us to return if he continued to vomit. The cost of this visit was approximately $400.The next day, we woke up to find our dog covered in bloody soft stool. He has had three bouts of diarreha in two hours, all of it soft and bloody. We called our vet and he told us that the dog was experiencing severe intestinal distress, which was causing the bloody stool. He suggested we give him water and return to the clinic in the early a.m.Thankfully, our dog passed the Greenie through his body. Had he not passed the Greenie, he would have required exploratory surgery, which my vet estimates will cost approximately $3,000, depending on the nature of the blockage.The representation that the new, reformulated Greenie is "easier to digest" is patently false. Our dog properly chewed the Greenie, but yet the treat was still insoluble and indigestible. His ingestion of the Greenie caused serious health issues. These things aren't safe -- please don't support this company or put your dog's health at risk.
I love this lemonade the kiwi gives it a refreshing  taste  Taste really good when it's iced down plus the fact that it has kiwi bits inside it it makes me wanna by the rest of the other flavors.
This is the best tasting low calorie drink I've ever tasted.  I don't have anything else in the house!

column9: Beat the Summer Heat with Raspberry Lemonade
column10: Since the temperature is rising and summer officially seems to have arrived I've been keeping bottles of water in the refrigerator. By mixing in a packet of this delicious drink mix you can make water a little more exciting. I love the tart flavor and don't think it is overly sweet like some of the other mixes I've tried. With other flavors I was using half the packet at a time in a 16.9-ounce bottle of water. With raspberry lemonade I'm using the entire packet. What I really love about this mix is the hint of floral flavors. It is difficult to describe but it makes the drink a little more exotic. To be honest this is one of the best drinks I've ever tasted. I'll be buying more!~The Rebecca Review

column9: Great Tasting with No Calories or Sodium
column10: Crystal Light Raspberry Lemonade On-The-Go, is an excellent and flavorful way to enjoy your daily water intake.  We all know that we are supposed to drink 6 - 8 8 oz glasses of water per day.  That can sometimes get kind of boring.  Crystal Light is a great way to really add some flavor to your water without unnecessary calories or sodium.  A great product.  Five stars.
This stuff is ok, just kind of tastes like sugar water with fake flavoring.  Other than my opinion on the flavor... 5 stars.

Nice tart lemonade flavor with just a hint of raspberry. I don't care for overly sweet drink mixes, and this one is just about perfect. I like it better than Crystal Light's lemonade or pink lemonade.My local store carries this, but at nearly double the cost here on Amazon (although Amazon's prices vary widely from seller to seller). I need to drink more water, and this helps.
I drink water when I am at work and these little packets help! I hate the taste of plain water for some reason. But using these packets I drink plenty of water for the whole shift!
Great price on my favorite drink. I take them everywhere. Just add to a bottle of water, shake and it's ready to drink.

I was looking forward to receiving the Raspberry Lemonade I ordered and very disappointed when it came.  Unfortunely I didn't look at the boxes before putting them in the cupboard or I would have returned them.  The boxes are all dated July 13, 2009.  I am extremely suprised that Amazon would fill an order with a product over 2 years out of date.

column9: I really love the lemonade flavors of crystal light...
column10: What I noticed about lemonade flavors in general is that it is a stronger flavor than other flavors. I actually don't like anything TOO sweet and I try not to consume too much artificial sweeteners, so I only use 1/2 of this for the water suggested... Actually I cut it down to 1/3 and it turned into more like a sweet tea ish flavor. I was hooked on diet sodas and then I started using this as a replacement and now I'm cutting down on this as well! :)Also nice thing to have in your pocket when you wanna mix it with cocktails without adding unnecessary calories.

I'm supposed to drink 64 ounces of water daily. I buy Crystal Light because I'd rather drown in plain water than drink a half gallon of it every day.Crystal Light On The Go Raspberry Lemonade is tart, sweet and absolutely refreshing. I use Crystal Light On the Go packets with a Nalgene Tritan OTG BPA-Free Water Bottle. The packets are easy to carry, so I keep a box at my office and several packets in the glove box of my truck.My other favorite flavors are Crystal Light On The Go Natural Lemonade and Crystal Light On The Go Peach Tea. Both are just sweet enough to suppress my appetite, especially in the afternoons.I've found that Crystal Light is best when it is slushy cold. The instructions say to add one packet to 16 ounces of water. What I try to do is add 12 ounces of water, then fill my Nalgene Tritan water bottle with ice cubes or, better yet, crushed ice. After 30 seconds of shaking, I have an inexpensive, low calorie alternative to the office soda machine.Rating: Five stars.
I wanted a few boxes of crystal light on the go and found it at Amazon.  Thanks.
I really enjoy drinking this flavor.  I carry a water bottle all day, so I need to change flavors and this is one of my faves.

column9: Two for the price of one
column10: Like some other reviewers, I found this a bit too tart. Then I remembered a co-worker using only part of a packet for her 16 oz. water bottle, so I thought I'd try it.Now it's my favorite flavor. I use half a packet in one 16 oz. bottle, mixing two bottles at the same time so I can guesstimate "half" better. Works for other flavors, too. Cuts back on the cost and the calories.I, too, wish they'd use less red food coloring in all the flavors they use it in. I don't like the "staining" that another reviewer mentioned either. Perhaps they should consider their target audience. And I agree, a variety pack would be nice. There are flavors I'd like to try without committing money to a ten-pack.

This is my favorite flavor next to the peach tea. The flavor is very subtle. Not to sweet and just a hint of raspberry and lemonade. They are really convenient. I drink a lot of soda and the doc said to drink more water. Water is a little boring so he suggested these. I have been drinking lots of more water now. I am also consuming way less calories compared to soda.

I have probably purchased 5 of these cases over the last few years.  I drink maybe 3-5 packets a week and it lasts me forever.  Before I bought it i tried a smaller box at my local grocery store to make sure I liked the flavor enough to buy a whole case.Reading some of the other reviews I want to clarify: these are NOT calorie free.  There are 10 calories per packet.  So if you are using 6-7 packets per day, that's 60-70 calories. However, I do love this stuff.  Like one of the other reviewers, I also drink a lot of water - usually 70-100 ounces per day.  So, as you can imagine, every once in a while it's nice to flavor it up.  The only down side is the amount of artificial sweetener I am ingesting.However, it tastes great, and the price is a much better deal than if I bought it at my local grocery store.  Everything in moderation.  I do recommend this product.  (Note on flavors: I like this flavor and the lemon iced tea.  The peach iced tea is just okay.  The fruit punch is YUMMY but is REALLY red! Although everyone's taste is different.  Try the smaller boxes at your grocery store before buying here.  Then you won't be disappointed.) =)

I like to mix a packet of this in a bottle of water and put it in the freezer before I mow the lawn. It is so refreshing when I am done and way better than soda. Also great during bike rides. I am a big fan of individual water-flavoring packets in general and Crystal Light raspberry lemonade is definitely in my top 3 favorite flavors.

If I had one wish, it would be that Crystal Light On the Go came in a variety pack so I can decide which flavors I like without buying an entire case. The Raspberry Lemonade flavor is OK and I'll drink it, but I think the flavor is too tart. Maybe I'll try the Fruit Punch next.

I switched from caffeinated soft drinks to Crystal Light about 2 years ago and always have a bottle at hand, consuming on average 6 - 7 packets per day.The On The Go packets are very convenient and are easily tucked into a pocket or purse. Just tear open the top, pour into a bottle of water (about 16 oz), shake to mix and enjoy something better than plain bottled water, and with much less calories than soda (10 calories per packet, which they consider 2 servings).With Crystal Light On The Go Lemonade (my favorite) being difficult to find I ordered the Raspberry Lemonade as a substitute. I find this flavor very disappointing. The Raspberry Lemonade is more of a pink color and does not leave stains on your mouth.

column9: 13 month old Chocolate Lab. (English) thriving on this food!
column10: I'm writing as the owner of two Chocolate Labrador Retrievers.  My dogs both eat Orijen food, although my 3 year old eats the adult formula (we alternate between 15 lb bags of the regular adult and the fish adult varieties.)  This brand of dog food is worth the high price and difficulty in finding it to buy!My 13 month old lab is a powerhouse of energy!  She looks like a wet otter when dry, her coat is so shiny and sleek!  We went through several varieties of food trying to combat her terrible gas after eating and thankfully found this food, which our puppy loves; so much so that we changed our older lab to the adult version about 3 months ago.  Both dogs are thriving, and LOVE meal time (although to be fair, they are labs and would likely chow down average grocery store dog food, too).  I can use the dry puppy food as treat rewards when working with my younger dog.  She never tires of it!I'm writing my review mainly because I read another reviewer who INCORRECTLY claimed this food is not appropriate for large breed pups.  Although the reviewer seem well-intentioned, they are not fully informed.  Read the summary below from Orijen regarding their large breed puppy food and the hip dysplasia issue the other reviewer is concerned with.  Of more concern is a high ASH CONTENT in puppy food, NOT simply a high protein content, which puppies actually need for optimal growth."Orijen Puppy Food: Grain Free Large Breed was formulated because in nature, puppies are facultative carnivores - they thrive on a varied diet of meats with smaller amounts of fruits, vegetables and grasses. Puppies are biologically adapted to process proteins as an energy source, and need animal protein for healthy growth and building strong organs, skin and coat.High in protein and low in carbohydrate, ORIJEN PUPPY FOOD is a grain-free formula that replicates the same rich and diverse balance of meats, fruits, vegetables and grasses that puppies and young dogs would encounter in a wilderness setting.By utilizing special low-ash chicken and fish ingredients, ORIJEN PUPPY LARGE avoids the high ash levels--and subsequently elevated calcium and phosphorus--that are a common concern for large breed puppy owners on high-protein diets. Low-ash ORIJEN features perfectly balanced natural-source minerals, fortified with ocean source glucosamine and chondroitin to nutritionally support healthy bones and joints. Orijen Dog Food is our top-of-the-line dry dog food!"

We have a 5 month German Shepherd female. This has been the third and best dry food for our dog. The first one Nature's Abundance recommended by the breeder. Although a good quality food, the dog would not eat it, hated the taste even if we added fresh chicken or canned food with gravy. I also think the breeder got some kickback from referring this product. We then tried Innova large breed puppy. The taste was better, but my pup had constant very soft non-formed BM's. After reading reviews about Orijen I thought we'd give it a try. From the very first bite my pup loved it. She will eat the dry food plain, a first for almost any dog I've owned. As recommended we gradually increased the portion of Orijen to the old dry food. When we were at about a 50/50 mix, my pup's BM's started to become formed and more normal. We are finally at 100% of Orijen, no problems noticed, feeding is a breeze, no more finicky eater and the BM's easy to pick up! I think this is a winner.

column9: Best in Class Dry Dog Food
column10: Pet food has an immense range of quality that you can very roughly categorize into three levels.  (1) super cheap food that's basically feeding your dog garbage (1-2 stars); (2) food that's a good compromise on price and quality, containing some ingredients that aren't ideal but overall a healthy product (3-4 stars); and (3) "price is no object" foods that make no compromises (5-6 stars).  Orijen doesn't just fall into category 3, it's the best of it.  It's expensive, but you will not find a better dog food anywhere.  Period.Orijen is a Canada-based company that raises its own chickens, employs its own fisherman to catch fish and deliver them fresh, uses whole eggs instead of dried egg products, and loads its products with the highest quality ingredients you'll ever find in dog food.  It's good for your dog's muscles, heart, coat, skin, and is the most biologically appropriate dry dog food there is.  Instead of grains for the carb content that it needs to form the kibble, Orijen uses highly digestible fruits and vegetables with nutritious antioxidants and vitamins.Check out the first 6 ingredients in this product:  Fresh deboned chicken, chicken meal, turkey meal, russet potato, fresh deboned pacific salmon (a natural source of DHA and EPA), herring meal.  Meat, meat, meat, good carbs, meat, meat.Compare that to the first 6 ingredients in Hill's Science Diet Adult Small Bites Dry Dog Food, which I just selected by picking the first large size that came up in a search for "hill's science diet dry dog food."  Chicken, ground whole grain corn, ground whole grain sorghum, ground whole grain wheat, chicken by-product meal, soybean meal.  Meat, grain, grain, grain, low-quality animal filler like beaks and feet, and more grain.  It's loaded with grains that are cheap and known to be difficult to digest, often the cause of allergic reactions in dogs, and not nutritious.If you want a good compromise product, go for something like Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul Dry Dog Food for Adult Dog, Chicken Flavor, 35 Pound Bag, a very good food that's a bit more affordable than Orijen.  If you want the best of the best for your fuzzy-faced friend(s), get Orijen.Final note:  this is extremely rich food.  Introduce it very slowly, even more slowly than you normally would a new food, and expect some loose stools during the process.  We started with 1/6 new food and upped it by 1/6 every week, so we took a month a half to transition completely to Orijen.  That helped a lot.

Made from great ingredients, it was an excellent dog food for my mutt. His breath wasn't as foul as it was when he was eating pedigree, his coat shinier, he pooped less often and in smaller quantities. It's definitely worth the price.

This dog food is the best dog food and I see no change in food in the future.  I do not have alot of money by any means, but I will always feed my 3 black labs the very best.  This is the best food out there, in my opinion, and obviously others agree.  This dog food is a 6 star dog food and it doesn't get any better, literally.  My pups are growing slowly and correctly.  I love my pups and the price is worth their happiness.  I eat well and so should they.  Their coats are absolutely amazing and they are happy.  That alone is worth the price.

I was more devastated by this news than a couple of other serious revelations I had also received.  I love cookies, brownies, cake, pasta, etc. and actually wept at the thought of having to give them up.  AS I'm a rather determined person, I decided that I was going to get healthy and find alternatives to the things I love.I've been enjoying the KIND brand of fruit and nut bars, and have recently found Caveman Cookies.  The packaging is cute, and I loved that a sample of the Original flavor was included.  I also loved the consistency of this cookie, as it was moist and chewy.  Having said that I think perhaps I'm not a big fan of carob.  About the Alpine flavor I would say its decent, but I much preferred the Original flavor included as a sample.  It does take care of the craving for cake and/or cookies though, so that's good :) On a side note, my 2yr old loved them and threw an ever loving fit when they were all gone. column9: This is it!  The missing ingredient to movie theater popcorn!

column9: S C R U M P T I O U S.......S T U F F....!
column10: HONEY BUNCHES OF OATS HONEY ROASTED CEREAL, (14.5-Ounce Boxes, Pack of 4), is a truely delicous cereal!  Honey Buches of Oats cereal itself was the FIRST "combination" cereal to be invented, (and, on the back of my current box, it tells HOW and by WHOM it was invented.)  Yes, it has some artificial ingredients -- but it also has vitamins and minerals -- and it tastes SO good!  Those little "bunches" add a nice taste, and here, you can get HONEY flavour without stickiness! All around yumminess, which has some nice nutrition in it, too!  The combination of flakes and sweetened "bunches" makes it a hit with me!  I've even begun to use it as a snack food, in place of potato chips!It's hard, sometimes, to believe advertisements on TV.  But believe me, this IS a great-tasting cereal!  If you like honey and/or sweetness, (but not the "cloying" kind), you will definitely love this cereal.  It's not just "Honey Bunches of Oats"...but the Honey-Roasted Flavour of Honey Bunches of Oats."A total delight to eat!

I love honey bunches of oats cereal! It never gets old and it tastes so good! It's much better than sugary cereal like frosted flakes or fruity loops and stuff like that. This cereal has whole grain in them, more so than the other cereals with lots of sugar. I recommend this one!!!
I love this cereal. Very filling, healthy and tastes great too. Got a great deal by buying on amazon also.

column9: BEST cereal ever but WAY overpriced
column10: This comes out over a dollar more than most grocery stores around the DC area! Not worth it! It's a great cereal but if you have a coupon or a sale, better to just stock up at target or grocery store.

column9: good cereal, good price, no trip to the store
column10: Solid cereal, good price, no trip to the store, free shipping.  What more could you ask for?  Kids always love it and I don't have to worry about running out.

column9: Great cereal, great price, kind of stale
column10: The price is great, and this is my favorite cereal, but two of the boxes in this pack of four were pretty stale. Not so stale I couldn't eat them, but noticeable more stale than cereal from the grocery store. I would only recommend getting this subscribe and save if you don't have access to this cereal at a local store.
No issues at all with this product...got the package on time..I thought the packs will be having early expiring date date to low price but they are not.

column9: Honey Bunches of Oats one of my Favs
column10: Ok maybe not my favorite but close I like it almost as much as Raisin Bran Crunch. Have to mix up cereal so I don't get bored with only one choice. The new problem is now my children have acquired a taste for the same cereals as I prefer.
