My daughter is away at bording shcool and loives on and loves this cereal compared to dorm food!  It is healthy so what can a dad say?

column9: good cereal but complaint about subscribe and save.  so 1 star for bad service.
column10: Ok.  So why the one star.  Well Amazon ca canceled my subscription order when I got a good deal on it after I canceled it right after that is.Seems they don't wanna honor it also they deleted the order from my history without notice so I wont have records to back it up.It was for 5.50 or so during the sale after sub and save.  I first bought them for 6.50 or so after s. s.,They deleted it right before the 2nd delivery and me canceling on them for charging me the 8 dollar deal. Why do I want that.  Yep always cancel order on them after getting the first shipment. They wont honor the lower price deals anymore if you get them. Well I did change my cc number so maybe they had a error and just wants an excuse to not honor their contract, who knows.  But dont I would not trust s. s.  There is always a catch in good deals.It's a bait and switch. Obviously like all the retailers. They hate careful consumers.  A knowledgeable consumer is retailers worse nightmare.:PWell same old corporation ways.Anyway Now for the cereal review. Pretty decently healthy and tasty for regular cereals . But like all processed foods the stuff they use is processed so the canola oil/veg oil they use is crap and then extra sugar etc.If you do care then try to buy the natural organic cereals, of course even though they take less work they charge more. lame yes less work more pay because there is less supply.  Well this is great and cheap as long as you just want processed food and is less than 11 cent per oz.Otherwise I'll just get it from my local supermarket since its about the same price when on sale.

This box of blast from the past is the most awesome thing that I have found yet. Enjoyed mine so much it is going to make a fantastic Christmas gift for so many of my friends. Has more candy then any other box I have found. Great product and great company to work with.

column9: Hometown Favorites 1940's Nostalgic Candy Gift Box, Retro 40's Candy
column10: Hometown Favorites 1940's Nostalgic Candy Gift Box, Retro 40's Candy. It was a Christmas present, we all enjoyed remembering and trying the candy. You best like black licorice, as you won't find many modern candy flavors.

This is a box of pleasant memories of my childhood days. I can recall counting my pennies as I rode my bike to the corner grocery or drug store to select one of these candy favorites! My personal favorite has always been licorice flavored candies.

Bought this for my mother for Christmas.  It was an add-on gift, but I am so glad I got it.  She lit up like one of my kids getting a iPod!!  She looked at each kind of candy and shared some memories. My father chimed in, too!  A great gift!
I bought this for my granddad for Christmas. (He was born in the 30s.) He absolutely loved it! It was a great trip down memory lane.  All the candy was fresh, full-sized, and the correct era.

We purchased this basket for my parents who are in their 80's.  They are really enjoying it.  Hill's Cough Drops were a hit right off since they both have colds.  Said it had been 75 years since they'd seen that product.  There's a lot of reminising going on as they browse all of the items.  The "Bun" candy bar, which used to be made in nearby Ft. Wayne, was fun to come across.  Mom found herself checking the label to see that it's now made and it's somewhere in the western US.  They have placed various calls to me to relate a story to us about special discoveries included in the gift!  Perfect!!

My Mother called and just recieved this assortment.  She LOVES it. She said it is a large box, filled with full sized candy and she remembered many of them.She was very suprised and said it was the best gift she has recived so far.  The product was true to the description and was well worth the money.

I'll give Amazon 5 stars for sending a replacement box out right away but the drop from a gold box deal of $27 to everyday of $14, 10 days later, reflects someone NOW has knowledge of bad boxes!  This is a grocery item and cannot be returned. Candy is not really that special either.  1960's box was the same.

I was born and grew up in Indianolia, Iowa, which during my youth was a small town just south of Des Moines (its a lot bigger now!).  I have always been a hometown boy!  I love my hometown.  I have VERY fond memories of my hometown.  I would do anything for my hometown.  Imagine my joy when I came across the listing for "Hometown Favorites" candy!  How fantastic, an entire box of candy made in my hometown of Indianolia, Iowa!  I figured this would be the greatest box of candy I ever bought, one that would combine my moderate love of sweets and my gigantic love of my hometown.I anticipated the arrival of my candy for several days; each day bring me closer and closer to the edge of expectation overload.  Finally, the candy arrived and I busted open the box furiously pouring over the wide selection of candies and scanning the wrappers for any hint of Indianolia, Iowa.  Imagine my incredible disappointment when my hometown was not mentioned on one single piece of candy or even the box for that matter.  Heatedly, I ran to my computer with my new box of candy.  I typed and typed, my original joy dissipating with each keystroke as i learned one piece of candy after another was manufactured somewhere other than Indianolia!This product description is false advertising!  This candy had NO connection to my hometown of Indianolia.  This product gets one star for suckering me into buying it by capitalizing on my hometown pride.The candy was delicious though.

column9: WOW - GREAT NUTS BUT THESE MUST BE GOLD PLATED.
column10: I like nuts in general and actually eat a lot of them; various kinds in various ways.  We use a lot of these pecan halves in cooking especially in deserts and salads.  I am the largest (in more ways than one) user of these Fisher brand pecan halves in our household because they are one of my in between meals snack foods.  I love eating a handful of these nuts with a chunk of mild Cheddar or a nice Colby cheese.  For me, these are a part of a relatively healthy snack food...much better than Ding-Dongs or stuff like that.Anyway, these nuts are great.  They are always fresh when we buy them and they store well in the refrigerator.  They taste good and they are truly "halves" and not semi-crushed pecans that you so often get with other brands.But alas, even though these nuts get a five star rating from me - hey, I am reviewing the nuts and not the seller here, I must take away at least one star.  I do this for two reasons.First, Please note that the price listed here upon this writing is 25.00.  Oh my!  I just bought a bag of these same nuts...same weight, etc. at the local store for a total of 8.98.  Now if you are not a Prime member, you must pay shipping in addition to the 25.00.  Folks, these are expensive nuts! It should be noted that you can purchase a bag od Diamond Brand nuts...same thing really, for about 10.22 on this same site, i.e. Amazon.Second, I am not overly happy with the "zip-lock" bag these come in.  It is difficult to get zipped and sometimes it works and other times it does not.Anyway, take note of this price before you hit the buy button.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

I consider myself a fan of wasabi peas, having tried several brands.  These peas were shipped with five bags broken in the box, with peas leaking from the box.  The remaining bags were sealed OK, but this was disappointing.  The appearance is green to brown, as others have noted.  They were plenty crunchy, although some were hard.  The wasabi is light, with barely any heat. There was a definite strong flour taste to them, too.  If you are a fan of wasabi, I suggest looking elsewhere.  I know I will not be ordering them again.

column9: Don't be fooled by the packaging
column10: I'm a Wasabi Peas lover and usually buy them at Target or Whole Foods. I love Wasabi and GREEN peas.However, THESE are NOT green (despite the photo on the bag). Subscribed to this product and the first box arrived (12 bags) with 6 of the bags open on the bottom (seems like pressure popped). In all of the bags the peas were almost brown colored and the wasabi taste was so mild I could have eaten a handful without even blinking. Some of the peas even tasted a bit stale.I called Amazon and had the order refunded, canceled my subscription.Going back to WholeFoods for the time being.

Roland Feng Shui Wasabi peas are good tasting, crunchy and fresh.  I only gave them 4 stars because they aren't the largest wasabi peas I've had, but the deal is pretty good when you consider the cost per bag, especially with prime shipping.  I'll buy again!

Amazon delivers what I NEED, when I need it. All local stores sold out of this item mos ago. Panic-strikened, I found them in Amazon, of course. You want kick, flavor AND don't get your daily dose of veggies - well, here ya go. Don't go V8 route, boys...the flavor is right here!
These wasabi peas are bad. I should have read the reviews before getting them. The peas are not fresh and they taste strange. I bought other ones from nuts bulk.

I purchased these on Auto-Ship. Unfortunately I didn't think the order went thru & pushed it again. I wound up receiving two boxes of what I'd like to call "Rocks". Actually, more like 24 bags of pebbles. I thought I was going to break my teeth! And the Wasabi coating immediately comes right off as soon as you put it in your mouth. Not very hot either! I had never purchased them on my own before, so I had some "seasoned eaters" try them. They all told me that the problem was that they were stale. I opened the 2nd box just to see if it was a batch issue & that box was just as bad, stale and, rock hard. I cancelled both subscriptions. I will never buy from this company again... Don't you!!! Now I am about to try another vendor. I am definitely reading ALL the reviews & comments first!!!

I recently purchased this product from a local Hyvee.  They are the absolute WORST wasabi peas I have ever had!.  Not only do they lack the nice green color of others I have had (they are a dull brownish color) they are so hard.  The majority of them were like chewing on rocks.  I had to throw over half the bag away.  I tried them twice thinking I just had a bad scoop.  I'm pretty sure I just cracked a tooth.  I am going to write this company about this horrible horrible product that will now cost me $$$$ in dental repairs.

My daughter has a strong preference for spicy, hot foods. She loves thse peas, and the portion control size is helpful while she is watching her calories. These peas pack a punch and are not suitable for people who don't tolerate hot spices well.
These taste like old canned peas with very little wasabi flavor at all!The peas are very hard to chew and taste terrible.

Horrible wasabi peas.  These peas will crack your teeth, they are so old!  Very little wasabi coating as well.  Product of China with no data on when they were packaged and no expiration date.  Do not order.
This makes an easy, delicious, nutritious snack, with no mess or clean up. I've eaten these for years, but it's even nicer to be able to buy them by the case so I don't run out.

column9: Great low fat and CRUNCHY SNACK
column10: This is a fabulous healthy snack. 120 cals, 1 fat, 3 fiber and 6 protein for 1/2 cup serving. 2 points per servicing on Weight Watchers. I like them because hot curbs my appetite and they are super crunchy. Some people dont like the crunch I eat them kinda like popcorn or potato chips as a healthy snack. Available in 4.4 oz bag or 5lb bag. Go with subscribe and save and save money!!! You will not find them cheaper any where other than Amazon.

I've purchased Royal Oak Redskins in the past and loved them,  But, this order (2x40 oz. cans) is too salty to eat.  Efforts to reduce the saltiness ruins the taste that makes redskins our favorite.  And, e-mails to Royal Oak asking for advice/help have been ignored.  So, I'm stuck with five pounds of redskins that I'll eventually throw out.  I'll never by anything from Royal Oak again!

Large, flavorful peanuts. They enhanced the taste by adding artificial butter flavor, which I could do without, but they are a great bargain if you purchase them at a discount. I would buy them again. I don't know why Redskin peanuts (not the little Spanish Peanuts) are so hard to find in my area.
Great item. My husband had been looking for these in the store and couldn't find them This is agreat value which arrived in a timely fashion.
This whole family of Royal Oak Peanut is high quality, and at a good price.  The cannisters are reusable or recycled.
Been looking for redskin peanuts for a long time that are more than just the spanish peanut size.  Found these and love them,keep coming back for more.

I have always loved redskin peanuts since I was a little girl and discovered them at Sears. Every week my aunt would take me and buy a 1/4 lb. of peanuts. I loved them. These are just as good as I remember. I do love the butter flavor they add. Even if they didn't, I'd still love them. I too, don't understand why they are so hard to find. Keep making them!

Love Stella and Chewy's. Great for use as training treats too if you are worried about the little guy getting fat from too many treats. The goose breaks down easily. The chicken and beef are a little crumbly but that means more treats for training!

Recently, I was gifted the Ice Cream of the Month Club by a very good friend. I was somewhat confused thinking "how the heck can their be an ice cream of the month club?" But, with having given and received numerous "of the month clubs" and having all great experiences in the past, I was curious to see what they had put together here. Needless to say, WHAT A FANTASTIC SURPRISE! The 4 boutique frozen deserts arrived packaged in dry ice and were completely frozen. My girlfriend and I were pretty enthusiastic to dive in and try them all, but took a step back to read the companies review on each of the vendors and brands. We decided that we would begin with the "Berto's Gelato - Roasted Banana True Italian Artisan Gelato." After a single bite, my girlfriend declared that it might be the best gelato she has ever had, and proceeded to eat most of it while we watched TV. The best description she give as she devoured the gelato was saying it was like having "velvet wrapping around your body." The additional flavors included in our shipment were Gilles Sherbet Swirl, Cedar Crest Elephant Tracks Ice Cream, and Oberweis Cookie Dough Classic. Each of the selections were very delicious and from companies I have never heard of. I highly recommend this club to any person looking to give or get an array of tasty desserts that you'll want to find more of once you're done!

column9: Be Wary of AmazingClubs Ice Cream of the Month Club
column10: I ordered the 6 month ice cream of the month club for my wife's birthday.  She received her first shipment today and none of the 4 ice creams that were sent matched the sheet they included explaining the ice creams (you could have bought several of the ice creams, such as butter pecan or mint chocolate chip, in your local grocery store).  When I called the 800 number I was told that occasionally they reserve the right to change the ice cream if it doesn't "meet their quality" guidelines.  When I told her none of the four ice creams that we received matched the overview sheet from amazingclubs, the customer service rep was rude and told me that I needed to call back and talk to someone in their "support group" (note: you must call before 6:00 PM EST to speak to someone in this group). I would seriously caution you to shell out more than $300 for this club.

Though I am knowledgeable with Lucy Country Licorice, the most seemingly elusive flavour has been the marionberry. To those unfamiliar with this fruit, it is a blackberry hybrid from Marion County, Oregon ( thus the name ), and, as presented in this licorice, is extremely delicious. As is the way with Lucky Country Licorice, this item is aromatic, soft, and solid, leaving the taster wanting more.As presented on Amazon, the only way to improve this product would be to offer it in dozen and halfdozen bags of a smaller size per order; beyound that - which is no actual probelm with the candy itself - this confection stands at the top of  its catagory in terms of desire, flavour, and ingredients. Though one could continue to rave on about this confection, suffice it to say it rates a '10', or a solid 5 stars!
My son had a bag and gave me a piece. Heaven! They're soft chews with an unbelievably authentic marionberry flavor (I'm from Oregon so I know what they taste like). Now my son has to hide the bag!
Best and most affordable soft licorice.It arrived really fast and is wonderfully tasty.I will be back!!!  Kathleen

column9: If you can find this cheaper, GET IT
column10: Probably the best "licorice" I've had...an amazingly pleasant surprise @ $5.69ish from BJs or Target, when they stock this flavor.

I recently purchased this item and the bag is about empty.  I almost don't want to share it. Now I'm on the hunt for some of their other flavors, Black Cherry, Black Currant, Pineapple, Strawberry and Green Apple. Fabulous flavor and texture. Pieces are solid, no "tunnel" through. This is an awsome product.

column9: I am an adult with GERD
column10: I recently ended up with GERD and a really bad bleeding ulcer, due to stress and grief.  I have problems keeping food down and went on a baby food diet for the sake of thriving.  Some types of baby food stay down,  where as other types cause me indigestion just as bad as adult food.  This specific sweet potato one seemed to ease my acid refluxing and indigestion and sooth my throat.  I'm not at the point where I can eat the whole container yet,  but this is a good start.  This also has a pleasant taste.  Some of the baby food is just bland and boring,  but this one is alright.  Not the best but still alright. Please be weary if you're having gastrointestinal problems.  Babyfood is such a great idea if you're having problems keeping things in,  and need to retrain your stomach and intestines.  Just be careful,  some are more acidic than others.By the way,  this doesn't have all the nutrients you would need to survive.  As a adult you'd need about 12-16 small jars a day and you'd need to make sure you get enough protein.  So be careful,  this is only a temporary fix for people with ulcers and GERD.

My little one liked this and would eat it up without any issues. It does have all the vegetables. I think I could do the same in a blender, but it was just convenient especially when we were travelling. She would not create any fuss and actually showed excitement when I would open up the packet.

column9: He loves sweet potatos, but this one is runny
column10: I don't know if its the corn, but this sweet potato is runny.  The other ones from Gerber with sweet potato's are not.  I prefer the solid food to be thicker.
Can't beat the price and convenience of buying online.  Don't have to waste gas and time going to the grocery store anymore for baby food.

I cant figure out why Gerber 2nd peas are so hard to find in the store...I see something green and its always green beans! We go through peas so much in my house with my child and this is the only way we are going to buy them from now on. The box is very compact and I just remove the top and leave stored them right in the box. It saves a ton of room in the kitchen, rather than having them tipping over in the cupboard.One surprising thing we also discovered is that our cat who has a low appetite loves this simple pea baby food too. It has been healthy for my baby and a real treat for my pet. Good stuff.

This is a great find for our family. First off, mixed vegetables is one of the best flavors of baby food. Its also sometimes hard to find in the stores near me that typically have a very meager selection. This eight pack takes care of our needs for a while, and everything comes neatly shipped in a compact little box that you can tear the top of and keep them all together. Every tub arrived and it had a really long expiration date. You cant go wrong!
I'm a nanny granny and it's very convenient to have my sweet grandbaby's food delivered to the door. Sometimes it can be a bit of a challenge to get to the store.
Convenient. Didn't have to go to the grocery store and haul them. My baby eats a LOT so this really was a good thing.

My son has autism. He is on a gluten-free, casein-free, and soy free diet, so there is not a lot of pre-packaged stuff out there that he can eat that he actually wants to eat. We have tried the Glutino pretzels, they are good but have soy. My typical son on an unrestricted diet likes them and asks for them. But my gf/cf/sf son can't have them.I brought home a few sample bags of these from a TACA meeting (Talk About Curing Autism) and my son ate them right up. I was glad to see them on this site so I could order them in bulk.I tried them and didn't think they tasted bad. Of course, they could use more salt for my taste, but my son gets enough sodium from other sources, so I'm glad that they aren't salted.

I have a son with autism who is allergic to gluten, soy, and milk products.  He loves these!  My typical daughter does as well.  I think they taste fine as well,like others they could use a little more salt, but my kids don't need the extra anyway.  I'm so happy I can now buy them by the case!

column9: Light, Crunchy and not too salty
column10: I really was impressed with the Wylde pretzels. I had purchased it on a couple of different occassions, but my latest purchase in August 2007 was the best. It seems that they improved their recipes. My children love it and I am planning on reordering some more.

I thought  they had a stale texture and they didn't have enough salt. Ener-G does make a type of sesame pretzel that is incredible but these aren't it. Hope this helps all the gluten-free people like me.

column9: The ONLY egg-free GF pretzels I've been able to find!
column10: I think they taste great as well. They aren't really salty enopugh, but I can live with that. My son and I are both allergic to eggs as well as having problems w/ gluten.

column9: Product has been on the shelf for a long time before sending to us
column10: The expiration date on the package is 09-30-2011, as compared to expiration date in 2012 for the same product we buy from a local store. So the product must have been sitting somewhere for a long time before it was sent to us. Plus it does not taste as good as the one without the sesame. I will be very reluctant to buy food product from Amazon!I was not told that I can not return this item when I ordered it. I would have made a different decision if I were told so.

I love these small, round 3/4" pretzels!  What sets them apart is that they have 3 gr of FIBER in every serving!  That equals my husband's Metamucil (registered trademark) dietary fiber!  Plus, they taste very good, it's hard to stop snacking...Don't look for alot of salt on the outside, but the overall flavor is salty enough for me. A serving has 230 mg, or 10% of your daily sodium intake.Nutrition Facts: each bag has 4 (30g) servings of 40 pretzels, each serving has 130 calories, 30 from fat, 3.5g total fat, 2g saturated fat (9%), No trans fat or cholesterol, 24g carbohydrate (8%), 3g dietary fiber, 1g sugar, .6g protein.I once bought a bag of the Ener-G GF 2.65 oz. pretzels,Ener-G Foods Crisp Pretzels, Wheat-Free, 2.65-Ounce Bags (Pack of 20) and they taste great - but each serving has twice the salt, almost twice as much fat (6g), and less than 1g fiber.  That is alot of salt for a snack.  (all the other values are about the same).  Put enough fat and salt in anything, and it will taste good...I choose the Wylde pretzels!PS:  Don't eat these unless you have sound teeth - I had a temporary, plastic crown break while eating them.

I've been buying this product for years at the HfS, but decided to start ordering cases on Amazon.  The product came not packed well and the pretzels were in a million pieces and clumps.  I emailed Amazon and they sent me a new case.  Well, the same thing.  I emailed them again and theyrefunded me and I was thrilled at the exceptional service !!!!!BTW, these pretzels are very good and also soy free !

My son loves these little pretels. They are also great in Gluten free Chex mix!  I like the fact that they have a unique round shape - it makes it easy to distinguish from "regular" pretzels.  I'm sure my allergic son is eating safe food and not his brother's wheat pretzels!  Highly reccommend!!

I have a daughter with Autistic Spectrum Disorder... DAN! (Defeat Autism Now!) had an article that implied some connection between gluten and dairy allergies to behavioral difficulties in children with this disorder. So, we decided to try a gluten-free, dairy-free diet to see what happened. I have to say I have seen a good deal of improvement in her general behavior as well as her focus and retention rate.From what I understand it is a good product for kidney patients as well because it is low protein. And it's Kosher Parve.I tried these pretzles because of this new diet and now my whole family is addicted! They are tasty, crunchy and not too salty, but still satisfy my desire for salty foods. We will be buying these from now on.

column9: My picky eater grandson loves these!
column10: My little grandson who has celiac eats these practically all day, he loves them. I like them too. We tried once getting the sesame ones when these weren't available but they taste awful to us. I guess it's a matter of taste. PLEASE get these back in stock!!
I suppose which type of gluten free pretzel you prefer is a matter of taste, but these are really hard, crispy, and fresh tasting, which I prefer to the regular Ener-G GF pretzels.
Taste like I am chewing on glass. Hard and I am afraid I am going to break a tooth. Don't waste your money on this product.

These pretzels are one of our favorite gluten free snacks. Some people in our home eat them because they can't have gluten, but the rest of us eat them because we like them. Also, buying them in bulk makes them much cheaper.

column9: Good option for food allergic child
column10: My child has many food allergies, gluten being one of them.  This pretzel not only tastes good to him, but to all of his friends that we share them with as well.  They are a little on the hard side, but he doesn't mind.  He even liked them as a young toddler.  I like that there is not too much salt on them.  Pretty good.
My daughter, two grandsons, and I (all celiacs) think these are the BEST GF PRETZELs!  Even the nonceliacs like them too.  Highly Recommend!
I think that they taste like sawdust, but my son loves them. So happy to find a GFCFSF pretzel option. Great for lunch snacks.

column9: Saltless and Hard as a Rock
column10: A the salt on the outside has broken off before packaging and the pretzels are hard enough to break a filling.  They do have a good taste though.

column9: My highly allergic son's favorite pretzels!
column10: These are harder/crunchier than other pretzels, & lower in salt.  That's why we like them so much.  My son - who has severe food allergies - can eat these without any problems.  They make a great addition to his school lunches.Enjoy!

I have endometriosis and was looking for snacks that would not aggravate my condition.  These pretzels are so delicious, I can eat them all day with no negative effects.  I will say that people either hate these or love these though.  The people who hate them seem to be males more than females and usually are people who do not have any alergies.  My best work friend (who is vegan) sneaks into my desk constantly for them.  The taste is like eating just the outside crunchy part of a regular pretzel.  They are very crunchy and well suited for travelling, stashing in your office desk, and snacking during surfing the web.  I reccomend these to people with food alergies that miss their wheat snack products and often get a craving for a salty snack.Additionally, I find them to be a great value and they last a long time.  They are less suceptable to getting stale than regular snacks.  I ordered two boxes eight months ago and still have a few bags left.  When I open the new bags, they are just as fresh and tasty as the ones I opened eight months ago.  If you get tired of snacks and want to rotate variety, these pretzels will wait until you are ready to fit them back into your lunch pack.

We have such a horribly restricted diet, and these are pleasantly & surprisingly good, I even like the way they taste, its definitely not a wheat pretzel but freakin AWESOME for what it doesnt have in the ingredient list. Its one of the rare things I can actually not have to make from scratch myself. I love this company for having created them, I just wish the local markets hadn't stopped carrying this line.

column9: Gluten free 4 yr old loves this and so does mom
column10: I love this product the pretzels are salty and crunchy. I'm not gluten free...and I like it. My son is gluten free and he loves it cause that was his favorite snack. I've bought the smaller bags in a store and they were stail and didn't have enough salt. The 8oz. bags are perfect it last a week for school snacks.

This is the second order recently received that contained a case of stale pretzels.  Every bag was stale.  No excuse with posted expiration date over 6 months out.Until recently I have had no complaints with the quality of these pretzels, and my family has really enjoyed them.  But now having paid over $60 for 2 stale cases, you will lose a good customer if this happens again.

Our guy is gluten, casein, soy free.  Very picky about his snacks.He love, love, loves these pretzels.  They are a great alternativeto other illegal snacks for him.  They taste almost exactly likegluten-filled pretzels.

We love these pretzels!! Great flavor and texture! You would never know they were gluten, casein and soy free! They have become a staple at our house!  Ener g is a wonderful company with delicious products for those who have food allergies.

Just like regular pretzels.  Even my "gluten free means flavor free" teenager prefers them to regular ones.  All those I have shared them with say they are the same as the gluten ones with slightly less salt.  I like that too.

column9: Best gluten-free pretzels I ever tasted.
column10: These are the best gluten-free pretzels I have ever tasted.  Even my grandchildren who do not have to eat gluten-free love them.  They prefer them to regular pretzels.

I just received these pretzels but have not tasted them yet because I noticed under the ingredients on the package that it says may contain traces of sesame or poppy seeds.  My son is allergic to sesame seeds and this was not stated on the website under ingredients.  I notified Amazon and they will look into this.
GREAT PRETZELS JUST WISH IT COULD BE A LITTLE CHEAPER FOR CIALICSEVERYTHING I HAVE PURCHAED ON AMAZON HAS BEEN GREAT
The flavor is very good. However, they are a little too hard for my 18 month old daughter; she does better if I break them up for her. For me, I could use a little more salt.

These pretzels are a great gluten free crunchy snack and not too salty.  I love to just grab them and go but my girls love too dip them in warm cream cheese!  I think they're better than regular wheat pretzels.

I ordered a case & was dismayed that all the bags contained 70% broken pieces.  I bought these for my gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free son & for small children, broken food is a big deal.  I will pursue a refund from Amazon.Once you can get past the broken pieces, they taste good.

I was very happy with this product.  Even my husband, who doesn't need to eat gluten free, liked them.  Nice and crunchy with a very good taste.  I tried a smaller bag at the local store for 2 bucks and liked it.  Then, I saw these and it was a much better buy.  Compare prices though, because right now this size isn't the best deal.  It was when I bought it.

Another great produce carried by Amazon for those suffering from Celiac Disease or anybody else who wants a great tasting crunchy pretzel.  My husband was diagnosed with Celiac Disease 4 years ago.  It has been my goal to make him feel less restricted in a world that is chock full of gluten.  I read every food label of anything I purchase so it is nice to know that there is a wonderful worry-free snack food out there that tastes even better than regular pretzels.  Good thing you can get this product in 4 oz bags or you would not be able to pace yourself. Thanks again Amazon for making such a wonderful produce as Wylde Pretzels available and accessible to all.
My son is on the GFCG diet and these are his favorite snack. Although one shipment the pretzels were all broken in pieces.  But usually they are great.Support Autism Awareness
They taste great, they don't taste gluten-free. Very crunchy. Keep fresh quite a while. My 11 year old loves them, and his teacher does as well.Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Soy-Free.

Both my kids love these. I think the Glutino GFCF ones are better, but if you are avoiding soy, these are good. They are pretty hard and crunchy. Not loaded with salt which is nice if you are giving them to kids.

These pretzels are good. Not too salty, not too hard. Best of all, they contain no soy flour! The trick at our house is keeping the non-celiac from eating them all before we can to them - he prefers them to conventional pretzels.

These pretzels are the best.  You will not be able to tell the difference between these and wheat pretzels.  They are very crunchy, so that could be a downside to some people, but I happen to like that.
as far as gluten free products go - these aren't bad.  seems like nothing is really "good" so the best you can hope for is not terribly unpalatable.

column9: Excellent Snack for Healthy Kids this summer
column10: My kids have no idea these are so good for you and they are well worth the price compared to the health benefits!
I like to dip a little edge in white almond bark for that sweet-salty taste.
I'm all for reduced-salt, but no-salt is just nasty. I love sesame seeds so I was really eager to try these, but blech. They are also too hard not crispy - Glutino's pretzels are much better.
MY SON AND DAUGHTER IN LAW BOTH CAN ONLY EAT GLUTEN-FREE FOODS SO I USE THE WYLDE PRETZELS TO MAKE  THEM MY HOT AND SPICY PRETZELS. THEY ARE QUITE HAPPY NOW THAT I FOUND A GLUTEN-FREE PRETZEL.

My son is allergic to milk, eggs, and peanuts. He is also unable to eat wheat. These pretzels are the best. My son loves them and has brought them to school for a snack..everyone ate them!  Even my husband and I enjoy them and we don't have allergies. Actually, I'm constantly telling my husband to stay of of these! This is a must have if you have someone with allergies :)

This is the only gluten-free, soy-free and casein-free packaged snack I can't live with out. My whole family loves them. Some bags give the impression of having less salt than others but the crunch is always right on. Even if I didn't have to eat gluten-free these would be my top choice for snack food. They are great in chili or soups as a substitute for crackers too. I am so glad to be able to buy an entire case!
My son loves these pretzels!  They are one of his favorite snacks.  They are very crisp and tasty.

My son is gluten/casein free and LOVES these pretzels.  I even know some friends who tried them and liked them so much- they want to buy some for themselves- and they aren't even on a G/C free diet.These bags are a great deal.  I compared all the sizes of the bags and prices on Amazon.If your child has food problems, buy a bag from the local health food store, try them out and then come back to Amazon and buy a case or two.  Definitely the best deal.

My daughter has recently had to avoid gluten due to an immunity issue and we tried these locally. She is picky, but I tried one and almost lost my stomach. Horrible. There are other items that she likes. When it comes to snacking we just stick to potato and corn products and avoid anything sesame .

These gluten-free casein-free pretzels are as good as the real thing.  These are a very satisfying snack replacement and much healthier than some of the other options.  My 2 and 4 yr olds love these.  The mulitple packs are a significant cost savings over buying single bags locally at the grocery store.

column9: So Good It's Hard to Keep Them in the House
column10: This is an awesome snack.  I haven't had regular pretezels in 4 years so I'm going by an old memory, but these taste similar to what I remember pretezels were like.  The shape is an "0" instead of a traditional pretzel shape.  I like that the serving size is 40 of them; I can eat a lot of them without feeling guilty about it.
I can't keep these away from my family who do not have to be gluten free. They are a little on the harder side, but taste is good.

Well, it is all about personal taste, and I love these!  If you have to begluten free these pretzels make a great snack.  I haven't actually tasted a regular pretzel in over 20 years, and I never really liked them anyway.  But these are perfect.  Small, not too salty, and fresh, I think they are a super snack food.  I buy them by the case and so does my father, sister-in-law, and brother.  All have a gluten intolerance and think that these are the best since sliced bread!

My favorite pretzels in the world are Ener-g sesame pretzel rings-light and crispy and with seeds on the pretzels. Thought I was buying those,only in a bigger package.These are hard and dry-not crispy-dry!and must be made with ground sesame seeds because I can't find a seed on any of them.Next time will read description and check picture better.

column9: There are other and BETTER gluten-free pretzels out there...
column10: We have been a gluten free family for many years and have been enjoying the new products that are now continully being introduced.  These pretzels are not nearly as good as the ones by Ener-G Foods (small size bags) or by Glutano (larger, family size bags).  These Wylde pretzels are, as one reviewer already commented, not salty enough - that is, not salty enough for me to feel they qualify as satisfying a pretzel yearning.  These pretzels are also much harder than the others, which I don't find appealing.  That being said, I would highly recommend the Glutano or the Ener-G Foods pretzels over these.  I rated it 2-stars simply for being another gluten free product.

These are pretty interesting... They aren't that good at all. We bought them on a road trip, and landed at a hotel one night. All the fast food places were closed, so we ate what was left of our food... two packages of these. My daughter (who is GFCF) had opened them and spit them out... my sister and I ate them, and gagged... but, we were hungry (ha)...They have the pretzel crunch, but the taste is off...  Maybe if there was more salt.. or flavor..I wouldn't but them again.

This product is a wonderful blend of yellow, red, and black popcorn kernels. All of the kernels have popped perfectly. Haven't had a failure yet. You can save so much by buying popcorn in bulk. Wabash Valley Farms offers reasonable prices for delicious bags of popcorn.

Not my favorite popping corn by far.Fickle to pop.Suggestion:  add coconut oil, add corn kernels, then turn heat on medium low with lid on pot, shake after a few minutes.  Be careful not to burn, and don't over pop. The remaining ones won't pop, you will only end up burning your batch.  You will have quite a few left un popped.Add melted butter and sea salt, not bad.Not better than cheap store brands found in plastic bags in your local grocery store, colors are fun though.
This is a very good mix of popcorn, and it will last a while. I like this brand, and I'll continue to buy from them.

each color has its own toasty subtle flavor...much better than the pop corn at the supermarket. though not sure i would buy 18 pounds at a time!best way to pop is in an old fashioned lunch bag (brown bag) - put 4 tablespoons pop corn to 4 teaspoons oil (i use high grade coconut oil) fold the top over twice and pop in microwave just like microwave popcorn (only 1000s of times better and no one has to get popcorn lung - which is actually from the fake butter/oil mixture) - thanks alton brown!

column9: Organic, Low Sugar & No Artificial Sugar - Finally!
column10: We eat healthy. That means my kids drink very little juice and zero soda. By very little I mean I never buy it, they might have some at a friend's house or a party or something. Generally they drink only milk or water. But that means they feel left out when the other kids have sugar-filled juice boxes or caprisuns. Enter Honest Kids! Yes, they have sugar in them, that's what I like. Go look at a box of 'Roaring waters' - that has artificial sweeteners (and sugar too, something I never could quite figure out). I would rather my children had a small amount of real sugar than artificial sweeteners. Since they are used to drinking only water otherwise, they like these, they don't complain they taste watered down. In fact if you compare these to a typical CapriSun, its kind of like the difference between a Vitamin Water and Gatorade. When you are used to Vitamin water, (original) Gatorade is going to taste sickly sweet, if you are used to Gatorade, Vitamin water is going to taste like water with slight flavor. Ask yourself which you want your children to be used to?I've seen other reviewers complain that they are hard to open or messy - my 6 and 8 year olds have no problems with them.  They put the straw in themselves and don't have a problem spilling them.Now they don't feel left out when everyone else has a juice box, and I feel good about the amount of sugar they are taking in. At only 40 calories and no artificial sweeteners, this is exactly what I've been looking for!

I typically by these juice boxes in the store for $3.49-$3.99 for a pack of 8.  I should have checked with the seller on tha actual count, but was shocked that they are selling the same box for $14 and change! Lesson learned, and I am very disappointed.On the other hand, my kiddos love the drinks and I love that they don't have as much sugar as the other drinks.

column9: Sweeter coconut water from Thailan Than others from Brazil
column10: I have tried all of the coconut waters available to the consumer and this one is the sweetest. I think it is because the coconut water is imported from Thailand or the coconuts are younger. I would have given it another star if shipping was not so expensive. Amazon should pick it up and sell it rather than a third party.
This is a great product with good taste.  This is the best priced and the cans are recyclable.  I highly recommend Amy & Brian's Coconut Juice.
I love coconut juice and this is my go to can i love that it's a bigger size and no pulp

column9: delivery too much and too long
column10: The delivery of the product was more than the cost of the item. Which, I might have been ok with if it had not taken over 10 days to reach me!
I brought this for my uncle and he loves it.  He can only eat sugar free candy and he told me that it doesn't even taste like it is sugar free i would buy this again for him.
I like the quality of the laxmi brand of products as compared to the other brands that sell indian food and lentils.
Caribou Decaf K-Cups are as good as Caribou coffee at the Caribou coffee shop.  I drink so much that I had to switch to decaf!

column9: Good tea, but not my favorite
column10: This tea is very flavorful, good for early pm.  Feels heavy, if you will, so I don't have it much at night.  Try it, just don't get a ton b/c you'll prob only go through it every once in a while.

The flavor of this tea is not as good as other Golden Monkey teas that I've had.  It is kind of weak.  Also where the other Golden Monkey teas have a very nice buttery, honey kind of flavor (reminds me of butterbeer in the Harry Potter books), this tea has a hint of that, but really to me more of a soapy taste.  It's not horrible, so I'm giving it two stars instead of one.  I've been much happier with The Tao of Tea, Golden Monkey Black Tea, Loose Leaf, 3.5-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2) and I think I'll go back to that.

We came across the name of this tea in a catalog and my tea drinking grandson just had to try some.  He kept asking me if I had bought some so he could try some.  I got him some for Christmas, he just loved it!  It was however the name that sold it for him.

I'm a daily iced tea maker and drinker. Bounced around between lots of different teas but settled on plain black tea as my favorite. Found Golden Monkey from a local purveyor which then discontinued it. I loved the clarity and total lack of bitter flavors in the Golden Monkey. The Faerie's golden monkey is just as delicious, and the 12oz package is by far the best deal for this tasty stuff.

column9: They claim it is in stock....
column10: ...and then tell me it is backorderd.In fact, as of this writing, it STILL says in stock, even though they told me it was backordered five days ago.This has been happening with all of my orders to Chinese companies lately. They claim it is in stock and then take six weeks to get it to you. My guess is that they haven't even picked it yet!AMAZON: Please crack down on this practice by Chinese companies! It's ruining your reputation!

I'm generally a big fan of Guittard products (try their chocolate chips!)  I've used this cocoa in a number of recipes that required dutch process cocoa and have enjoyed the results.  The "Cocoa Rouge" on the label is no lie, it is an unusual red color, closer to natural cocoa than the dark brown you get with a heavily processed cocoa.  They won't be making Oreos with this stuff.I wish Guittard also made a natural cocoa, but alas.  Guess I'll stick to Ghirardelli and Scharffen Berger for natural cocoa.
These are the best tasting canned pears I have come across. I have been buying them for years. I like getting them by the case for my pantry. It is just good to have them on hand. Yummy.

column9: What you'd expect, decent pears in a 'heavy sauce'
column10: There's nothing I didn't really expect in the pears. They're the quality I expect (similar to any other canned pears). Mostly halves, some smaller pieces. A forgettable sugary water.A few of the pieces had a little spot that seemed to be from the skin not quite being removed - nothing disgusting about it. The reason for ordering - and I re-ordered: a decent price for a case brought to my door.
These Libby's Pear Halves are the best.  They are so sweet and taste so good.  I will be buying these again.

I feed my cat a wide variety of food and have been figuring out his favorites- this is one of them! It looks like soup I could eat (but I won't) and he licks his bowl clean!  I'm not sure he loves any of the other flavors so much, but this one will probably make it in his regular rotation :-)

My kitty eats all the flavors of Natural Balance Platefulls on rotation, and loves all of them equally. He gets dry food in the morning, and a pouch for dinner every night. His coat is GORGEOUSLY soft and shiny, and these pouches don't give him nasty gas or rowdy bad breath like some other canned/pouch foods. When I first opened a pouch, I saw that it had peas and carrots in it, and I figured those would be left behind in the bowl. Cats just...don't eat vegetables. To my surprise, the bowl was licked clean! And after 3 months, he still licks the bowl clean every night!

column9: The Best Noodle Bowl I Can Remember.
column10: I bought a few of these Nongshim noodle soups because they're easy to store and very handy for making a quick lunch on busy days. The latest I tried today was the Savory Bowl Noodle Soup, Chicken Flavor (3.03 ounces). It was quite good, much better than many other brands I've had in the past. The broth was particularly good. Very tasty. My reservations for food dishes such as this is the high sodium content. The soup doesn't taste particularly salty, but the nutrition label says a lot. I counter this by not having such dishes very often. However, if you're going to have these bowls now and then, this is quite a good one, the best I can remember.Gary Peterson

column9: Great flavor, inexpensive, filling and low cal.  I'm addicted!
column10: We purchased 3  18 packs of these about 4 weeks ago and now we can't seem to get anymore! My entire family absolutely loves them.  They are nourishing, extremely tasty, filling, low calorie,& cheap!When will you be getting more of these?  I have tried other brands, but not even close.HELP

column9: This is the best olive oil I have ever tasted!
column10: This olive oil is so delicious.  I can't imagine cooking without it!  I am going to try the other varieties also, I'm sure they are just as yummy!
My dog loved them fast delivery and they were a nice big size way cheaper than petsmart or petco. I will definitely order again.

I was looking for a healthy lollipop for my kids and someone recommended these!Shipping was slow but worth the wait!! These are soooo good! VERY flavorful and natural tasting!GET THESE! You won't be disappointed!

The cinnamon has a very good flavor, I really like it.  It's milder and I don't seem to need as much sugar when I make a cinnamon, sugar mix to sprinkle on toast.  My only concern is the way it is packaged.  It does not come in a sealed jar.  Anyone could open it and contaminate it with something and you would never know.  If it had some kind of seal I would give it 5 stars!
I use Ajwa dates regularly these days, they always reach on time and are fresh. Yes I would recommend them to a friend..

I got some of this ketchup as a gift. It really is different than the other brands on the market. The flavor is great, like what ketchup should taste like. I have had it on hashbrowns and tater tots and loved it. I can't wait to try it on a burger!!
Very nice tomato taste. No sodium so it's excellent for those with blood pressure issues. I have tried it on hamburgers and hotdogs and it hits the spot!
A sneaky way to increase intake of dark chocolate. Add peanut butter. Helpful for those who just don't like dark chocolate.

I generally use one tablespoon of coffee per cup in my drip maker. To get a drinkable cup out of this hazelnut I had to use two tablespoons per cup, effectively doubling the cost of this coffee.I also did not enjoy the flavor of this hazelnut. It has a bitter edge similar to the bitterness you might taste in a pot of coffee that was brewed with a dollop of cocoa powder added to the grounds.

I had a little trouble with this product...but the seller was the most gracious that I have ever dealt with!  The product was wonderful...but the weather conditions for shipping it were just not favorable.  A soon as the weather improves...I will definately be back to make this purchase again!Great Dealer...NEVER hestitate to buy from this one!

We mix this with sparkling water for our granddaughters and they think they're really getting a treat! I've tried several other brands of grape juice but none of them are nearly as good as Welch's. It's a great way to get the resveratrol antioxidant. You might want to get some Fruit Fast pomegranate concentrate, put a couple of pumps of it in your glass, add the Welch's, then mix and it's heavenly!We don't drink soda so this is a way to feel pampered and decadent while sticking to our commitment to good health. Buying it on Amazon is much cheaper than any store in our town; believe me I've priced it everywhere as it indeed is a more pricey drink. Worth every penny, and the health benefits are huge!
These are a good value & so yummy.  If you like grape juice then these are for you.  Try them -- you'll be glad you did!

column9: 17 years and as wonderful as I remember
column10: The groomer in Mo used to used this on my rotty back in 1989 or a version of it. I searched and searched and found it. It is a wonderful scent and I use it on my Akita(know for having allergies) and she smells wonderful. You have a fan for life. I highly recommend this longlasting perfume for your animal.
I'm impressed because the cologne you buy at pet stores doesn't last long enough, this one is more than a week.  The price is cheaper for this than the ones at the pet store!!!!
I have used this product for years.  It makes my dogs smell very good but not sweet like perfume sometimes makes dogs smell.

I have always bought this brand of hairball prevention for my cats.  It works great and it is the only kind my cats will willingly eat, they love the flavor.  I also work for a veterinary hospital that chooses to carry this specific brand.
This is the best.  We have them once a year whether we need them or not!  Also make good Christmas Gifts for out of state friends and family.
The quality of the product was perfection. The service received from the merchant/shipper was the best.

Great coffee, I've been hooked ever since the worlds fair in New Orleans back in the 80's when I sat down at the French Quarter and had a cup of this wonderful brew with a serving of Benyeys ( a sweet dough that is fried ) truly heavenly! Be warned this is no Girlie-man coffee, it is strong, but the secret is to drink it the way they serve it in New Orleans, that is, half a cup of this freshly brewed coffee, and the other half fill with fresh cream ... take a walk on the wild side my friends, this is the real thing, you will not be dissapointed! Enjoy!

THIS COFFEE IS GREAT! THERE IS NO MATCH FOR THIS SPECIAL BLEND. HALF COFFEE AND HALF HAZELNUT CREAM IS THE ULTIMATE ORGASM FIRST THING IN THE MORNING!!IF YOU HAVEN'T TRIED IT BY NOW, I TOTALLY RECOMMEND IT! YOU WON'T BE SORRY, BUT YOU WILL BE "HOOKED". ENJOY!MONESHIA PERKINS

column9: Awesome coffee for acid reflux sufferer
column10: I'm planning to purchase some of this coffee for at-home use.  My sister introduced it to me, and I can drink it without heartburn!  I've had to give up coffee since I began having LPR (laryngopharyngeal reflux), but since this is blended with chicory, the acidity must be greatly reduced.  I can have a cup first thing in the morning with no problems.  The taste is amazing.....and this is coming from a Starbucks lover.  Cafe Du Monde is my favorite coffee in a long, long time.

column9: Love this so much I ordered it online!
column10: After the store I normally purchased this coffee from closed, I searched for it locally then in surrounding areas to no avail!this coffee is one of the few that I will drink black, flavor is amazing.
This is the best coffee I had in a while. I generally do not like coffee in black but this coffee is so good that I could drink in black.

When you can't be in the BIG EASY enjoy a cup of Cafe Du Monde and you'll almost hear the jazz as you enjoy cup after cup. Great way to start or end a day, you wont be disappointed only satisfied like a good cup of coffee can do. Did I mention the price is right?
I have been hooked on this serum for years now. If you are a coffee lover, I would highly recommend that you try this at least once. You won't be sorry!

Good stuff. I'm no connoisseur but I give it 5 stars.  I like it at least as well as the French Market kind, my old favorite.  I cold brew it in a toddy and usually mix it about half and half over an ice cube with soy milk. It's real strong, but not bitter.. just rich!  It tastes great. Conclusion: Buy.
Very rich but yet mello blend.  If I have to drink a pre-ground coffee, this is one of my top 3 choices, plus my mother-in-law doesn't care for it, which makes it all the sweeter to me.  :)

Born in New Orleans and growing up at Cafe Du Monde, my son now lives in Denver, but MUST have this coffee!It is a simple, meaningful "all-occasion" gift, to purchase and have shipped to him, as he cannot purchase in Denver.  AMAZON.com does a fantastic job hadling this for me and keeping my awesome son happy! HE ALSO THINKS THAT I GO TO A LOT OF TROUBLE FOR HIM (which does not hurt my image one bit)!!
Ever since I spent a year in New Orleans, I have loved Cafe du Monde coffee.  At home, I brew it 50/50 with regular coffee.  It adds a wonderful rich taste.

Everybody who misses New Orleans misses something special about New Orleans. But how is this possible? You can find every one of everybody's special memories in a cup of Cafe du Monde Coffee. With your first taste, you will find yours. And it's going to be there for you every time, always

Having never been but having a fascination with NOLA, I was dying to try the world famous coffee. I ordered one canfrom the CdM website itself, but when it came time to order again, I found these were a little bit cheaper and quicker to ship. I was not disappointed and this is already on my list to buy again.

Had this at my cousins in Va. came right home and knew Amazon would be the right place to find it..Found it & ordered it and boom it was here..now we're enjoying this treat when ever we desire..It has a different taste alittle hard to explain but hubby & I love it!

Wow! I finally found a source for this wonderful coffee. I used to buy it at a health food store in downtown Detroit, and when they went out of business, I had to switch brands. Love this always smooth brew.
and I can't always find it in my local stores.  You really can't beat this pricing, either.

My daughter and I took a trip to New Orleans.  Our first stop was at the Cafe du Monde.  It was the best coffee I have ever had.  Must try!  I took two cans home and was sad when I ran out.  I then searched the net and found them on Amazon at a reasonable price.
couldn't find this item in any of the local stores, order, recieved and enjoyed. Will order agian if not found in local stores

As the other reviewers have stated, it is very hard to find this flavor locally.  For some reason the stores have stopped selling it.  We were afraid that they had stopped producing the peaches cereal and were pleasantly surprised that it was offered thru Amazon.  This is my family's favorite so we go thru it quickly.  Thanks Amazon.
My little boy loves this cereal although he loves mainly peaches. Taste is very good and nutritious!We try different fruit but I think this is the best one among them.
Just the right combination of cereal, clusters, and dried peaches that come to life with milk.  My whole family really likes it.  Too expensive to have all the time though, and not available locally.
Am a huge fan of this cereal so got the jumbo 4 pack which lasted me a very, very long while. It was packed well and tasted fresh so no complaints

I am a big cereal eater.  I have tried most all cereals on the market and this one is the best by far!  The pecan clusters give a sweet flavor that satisfies your cravings.  The best way to eat this cereal is with vanilla flavored almond milk!

column9: If you love cinnamon, try this!
column10: This cereal is quite tasty and unlike anything else on the supermarket shelf. The bunches are sweet but not overly so. I add Almond Breeze Vanilla Almond milk and what a treat! The only negative I can add is that the flakes get soggy pretty fast. Like the other reviewer I discovered the local supermarket stopped carrying it.

This is a family favorite cereal, but our local grocery store quit carrying it for some unfathomable reason.  So, now a monthly shipment comes to the door! I was a fan of the Honey Bunches with Almonds, but the cinnamon has a wake-up flavor--and is good for you.

column9: Cinnamony, not as good as the peach or strawberry ones
column10: So I love the strawberry Honey Bunches of Oats. I'm not a big cereal eater but I love that one. I discovered the peach one last year and love that one too. So I thought I'd try this one because hey, I love pecans.Nope. This one has a cinnamon flavor to it and I don't like cinnamon. Most people seem to so you may, but just know that this one has a different flavor to the cereal.

Post seems to have discontinued this product much to my disappointment.  I really don't care for the other flavors of Honey Bunches of Oats so will no longer be a customer.  I simply do not understand why such a good product was shipcanned.

column9: Honey bunches addict likes this best
column10: I love Honey Bunches of Oats and have been a fan for years. Of all the varieties out there, I prefer this pecan version the best. It seems to be slightly less sugary tasting than the original, and more flavorful than the almond version. The pecans are delicious. Overall, this is a fantastic everyday cereal. Its light and flakey, yet satisfying so you don't feel hungry again in an hour. Easily my favorite cereal.
Cereal tastes good as always, but very hard to seen any peaches, which is sad because they taste so good.

column9: u can put anything on these
column10: these crackers are so perfect for putting almost anything on them and that makes me very happy  My father is so hard to please but these crackers are perfect for him.

These are tasty and I am enjoying one with my morning coffee break while I write this, but reading the nutrition facts and the ingredients list on the package, I have to think that this is more of a tasty and somewhat healthy cookie than a substitute for breakfast. According to the package, a serving is four biscuits which adds up to 230 calories. Though that includes 4 grams of protein and 3 grams of fiber, it also includes 13 grams of sugar and 8 grams of fat.They are good, tasting like a nice butter cookie with a blueberry smell and a hint of blueberry flavor. Still, I think I'll be more likely to have one from time to time as a little treat with my morning coffee or after dinner than to substitute a package for breakfast. I'd more likely chose a low-fat fruit yogurt which would have more than twice the protein, less sugar and fat, and less calories.

When they say smokey, they mean SMOKEY!  I'm used to meat sticks that are more like pepperoni These are not like that.  The smoke flavor is very strong. At first I wasn't sure I liked them but they are growing on me.

For me, a perfect day includes the beach, a good book, and Beef and Cheese Ole Smokies. The mild taste of the cheese mixed with the premium beef taste go together nicely and the wrapper keeps the sand off of the beef stick.

I am completely satisfied with these turkey sticks, as well as the beef sticks.Most sticks leave a greasy smudge in my mouth which is quite revolting but not these.Finally a great protein snack to keep in my desk

I could hardly tell these from the conventional fat loaded pepper sticks that I never eat because I like my heart the way it is, thank you.These were great.  I couldn't eat just one, and I had an excuse to eat several at a time because they're made with turkey!  It would be fun to serve some of these as an appetizer for Thanksgiving.

The product description of the Jalapeno and Cheese Ole Smokies is right. These really do taste like a jalapeno popper beef stick. If you are looking for something a little different, these Ole Smokies are the ones to try!

column9: So good they made me cry
column10: Buffalo Bills snacks ROCK in general, but after a friend ordered these Jalapeno/Cheddar Ole' Smokies and shared one with me, I realized I had to have some for my own.  Now I'm an addict, and why?  ...because these are just that good.  They have just enough smack of jalapeno-zip and a good squeal of cheese in them.  So good I had to write this review, finding it difficult because the tears of joy streaming down my face.  I think I'm suffering from my own kind of PTSD (Product Tested: Super Delicious!!!).  Truly a great, great flavor and consistency with these.

Do not waste your time...  The "beef sticks" are not good.  The flavor is fake and nothing like a real beef stick.  The texture will almost make you gag.  You do not even need to chew these beef sticks. There is a reason why you can get this amount of volume at the price.  Not worth it.
Nice variety of jerky.. a littly oily, but the taste is great. Wish it would be a little spicier on some, but the taste is great. Good product.

column9: Not what I expected -- sort of gross!
column10: These beef sticks taste very odd, and I'm not sure how to describe it. They're super-oily, which is gross, and the jalapeno/cheese ones have a lot of spice, which is okay. They just taste strange and have a weird texture. Try Ostrim beef sticks instead, they are far superior!

I'm always looking for new things to try and the Buffalo Bills Honey Ham sticks did not disappoint.  The good smoked taste of ham blended with the rich sweetness of the honey brings back fond memories of Sunday dinners at Grandma's house. Not too smokey, not too sweet... these ham sticks have a pleasant, satisfying taste. They are also a quick, tasty snack when friends drop in - I cut the sticks in bite sized pieces and served them with a dipping mustard. Everyone loved them! These yummy ham sticks are going to be regulars at our football parties.

It's rather tastey. It's cheese to pepper flavor content is well mixed with the smokey flavor. It's cheap and high quality so worth the shot, maybe you'll like it better than I did. Thinkin about it, I kinda want some more.
I got this as a sample. Absolutely delicious. They use real friggin soy sauce and you can taste it. It was a real pleasure to eat this.
The taste resembles a smokey cocktail wienie gently glazed in honey wrapped in a beef stick. It didn't taste bad, just not my thing. ChooChoo was awesome as usual with fast shipping.

column9: Maybe I got a bad one
column10: I personally did not care for it. It had a non-smothering smoked pepperoni flavor which was pleasant for me but it had too much beef heart for my taste. It wasn't bad, just not my thing. choochoo was awesome with same day shipping as usual.
These were pretty damn good, I actually really like the smokey flavor and the meat tastes familiar but satisfying. I'd buy these again.

I love the smooth taste of all of the honey stung  Buffalo Bill's jerkys but these 9" Ole Smokies are definitely my favorite! The wrapper means that I can keep these sticks handy any place. Gotta be prepared for those jerky attacks!

There are to things I really like to snack on and that's, Jerky and Spicy Stuff. Believe it or not, these beef stick's have a little spice to them(not a lingering spicy).The reason I gave these a 3 of 5 STARS, is because I make my own Beef and Deer Jerky and although these Jalapeno and Cheese are something different and tasty, they come nowhere close to my awsome homemade jerky made from steak, not ground beef part's such as (beefheart).

I didn't care for these. It tastes like old salty ham and that horrible clove oil used for tooth aches. It's disgusting. I couldnt even eat it past half way. I actually had to get up and brush my teeth.
these are one of my favorite cadbury chocolates (cadbury from the UK or Ireland)- fingers are only second to time out :)

The ones I got from Amazon didn't taste fresh.  The chocolate covering seemed stale and had that dullish coating that old chocolate gets.  I wish Walmart still had these at xmas time but last winter they didn't.  I wouldn't buy this here... not worth the gamble.

column9: Cookies tasted fine but chocolate had "bloomed".
column10: Although the cookies tasted great they didn't look the same.  The chocolate had "bloomed" and the cookies looked moldy.  I was unable to add them to my buffet as intended.

I didn't really have any questions about this product, as I've ordered It from other places as well! I felt It was a very fair price, that's why I ordered many boxes from you over a 2 week span! I recently found them In a 24 hr Giant, that Is hust around the corner from me, that's why I haven't ordered any lately! I was extremely happy that you carried this product, and I was able to find It! Thank you very much!  Sincerely,  Donna James

Can't find where to complain directly to the vendor yet; I feel as if I was cheated out of my sixteen bucks actually.  What I ordered was NOT what I received.  And only discovered the discrepancy after one box of the shipment of 6 has been opened!  Bummed and still craving a Finger.

I was introduced to this product in 2003 when I visited Croatia. I fell in love with it while there and purchased Fant seasoning to bring home with me. I loved it so much I just had to find a place selling it here in the States and voila...Amazon had it. In spite of the high shipping cost for these light weight packets, I ordered them. I am not sorry either. If you haven't tried them..buy it. Soak chopped garlic in 8 oz. of water for a few hours, add only the water to the chopped meat, add the seasoning mix and allow the mixture to meld for several hours, if time permits. Shape the meat into sticks or patties, fry and serve with pepper spread and chopped onions. I also serve a chibatta roll with the meal...yummy and this is the way the woman from Croatia taught me to do it. Yummy, yummy.

I used a vanilla bean from this package making a vanilla ice cream (from JENI'S SPLENDID ICE CREAMS, an excellent book by the way).  It was fresh and pliable and full of vanilla 'seeds.'  The price is very good (10 vanilla beans for $9!).  I would purchase again.
I like the quality and price of this produce and will buy it again when this order runs out.  I would recommend it to anyone looking for quantity AND quality.

Teekanne produces fine quality herbal teas in general and their "Sweet Kiss" tea is one of the best.  It is a fruity strawberry-cheery tea that has a very full, rich flavor, beautiful color and aroma.  This tea is herbal, but it is not weak and watery, nor does it have any of the grassy flavor that some herbal teas can have.  This is a 10/10 quality tea.  Note, however, the price tag on my package is $3.29.

I was torn between this Amoretti or 3 times the quantity for the same price with Torani.  I am so happy I went with Amoretti.  I love my Peppermint Mocha's but at $4 a pop they get expensive, fast.  I've had the Torani at local cafe shops and thought it tasted really sugary, not quite like peppermint.  The Amoretti is like having a candy cane in your drink.  It's similar to Starbucks, but in my opinion just a tad bit better.  I'd never heard of nor used Amoretti but now I'm a huge fan and plan to buy more!
As a repeat customer to the peppermint and  other Amoretti products. I am very impressed with the quality and customer service.

I found this product on a Google search and when it went to Amazon.com I was able to see all the different products that Amoretti carries. I had questions about some of their products and found their customer service to excellent, very helpful. I purchased the Peppermint.  It is not too sweet, just the right taste of peppermint.  I can now make my Peppermint Mocha coffee at home as this tastes much better than the famous brand and lots less calories!  I can't wait to taste additional products from this company.

column9: Good product, Great company, Awesome customer service
column10: After speaking with Paul from Amoretti Company, we need to understand how to use this product. This product isn't like any other syrup that is high in high fructose corn syrup. It's very concentrated with flavor with much less sweetness. If you like to have your drink more sweetness, add sugar to your drink, not syrup because the drink will be too much concentrated with the flavor.  Based on pumpkin spice syrup calorie, 1 serving amoretti is 30 calories compared any other brand syrup 1 serving is 100 calories.This product definitely is a healthier choice of syrup for your coffee or desert. I will definitely will try more of their products and recommend this to my friends
We use this in our hot chocolate and it is the perfect amount of mint and sweetness. Lovely, delicious, quality product.

This is one of my favorite tasting syrups from Amoretti. It is nice and minty and sweet. It's also stronger than some of the other mints, so you don't have to use a lot of syrup. Highly recommend this product! It tastes great with a latte, or just adding it to your favorite morning coffee.

I used to get this cereal for my dad at our neighborhood supermarket and although it was pricey, he really loved it so it was worth it.  I never thought to look on Amazon for cereal until our supermarket no longer carried it.  Much to my delight, I found it on Amazon, ordered it and the best part is that the price was unbelievable and it qualified for free shipping.This cereal is delicious!  It tastes great and is made with natural ingredients.  My dad loves it and since he has recently been placed on a restrictive diet, it's awesome to find a cereal that is good for him AND delicious!!  I eat it as well and sometimes find myself snacking on it even without any milk.Corn Crunch-Ems is highly recommended.

I discovered this cereal at a local market and was thrilled.  I have a mild allergy to wheat and try to avoid it when possible.  Corn Crunch-Ems make it possible for me to eat cereal -- plus I like the taste.  However, my local store stopped carrying it.  Thanks, Amazon, for having it in stock -- and at a great price.

Can't beat this cereal for texture and taste.  Amazon has made it possible to get this cereal that I purchased locally before for a higher price and had to wait quite a while to receive.  The expiration date for the cereal is well beyond what I used to get it for.  Shipping has always been very prompt and received in excellent condition.  Recommend highly!
I liked Corn Crunchems better before they re-formulated them.  They now are kind of like eating straw with corn flavoring.  I used to eat them every morning--not any more.

column9: Terribly bad, but oh so good
column10: Cheez Waffies have been my most favorite, processed cheese-food snack since I can remember. The cheez flavor is overwhelmingly bad for you, but satisfies the most persnickety of "bad for you" food cravings. They are only for the true lover of fake cheese and waffle crisps. Don't be fooled with the cheaper Cheese Waffles also offered on Amazon. They won't satisfy like these will.

These crackers were my very favorite childhood snack.  The lightness of the waffles and the tanginess of the "cheez" are a perfect marriage.  Every time I go home to Atlanta to visit, I scour the stores looking for them.  The last time I was in Atlanta I could not find any.  My sister suggested that I try online...voila!! Amazon came through for me.  I'm stocked up for the next few months, but I will certainly order them again.
looking for an old childhood treat,  found it quickly, and it was the same product.  what a joy to find.....

You cannot find Cheese Waffies anywhere. It used to be that mini-marts would carry them. Then only truck stops. Now the Internet was invented just to provide a portal to obtain a Cheese Waffie fix. I guess the PC food police have run Cheese Waffies off the shelves. The waffle shell is crunching and cheesy. You can pull them apart like an Oreo and eat them in parts. Or nibble them slowly. Lastly, you can be a glutton and eat them whole. Any way you eat a Cheese Waffie, you will get lots of salty cheese pleasure. Go ahead, splurge. Run that extra mile tomorrow. But when you are watching football or just home alone (they are not meant for sharing), lay back in that lounge chair and enjoy each incredible bite. Try them and see what a Cheese Waffie addiction really is all about.
THESE CHEESE SNACKS BY WISE ARE JUST LIKE THE OLD LONDON CHEESE SNACK, WHICH IS ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE TO FIND..MY HUSBAND HAS LOVED THESE SINCE CHILDHOOD.

I loved Old London Waffle Snacks, and apparently Old London has sold the product line to Wise. These Wise Cheez Waffies are deliciously identical to the Old London product, and as these were a childhood favorite, I was delighted to find them here on Amazon.They have a very intense cheddar cheese flavor, like a boxed Mac and Cheese product... Some may be revolted, but I like it a lot. And the waffie crackers are just wonderful; light, crunchy, mmmmm-um!My 8 unit pack came nicely packaged and fully intact. No problems with shipping or delivery; product tastes fresh and delicious.

It's been a while since I have had these cheez waffles- Wise does not have much market/shelf space here in the MS Delta. After eating a bag- they seem thinner-thus not as thick and cheezy. But, I did eat about 5 bags in two weeks. Try them before the weather gets too warm to deliver fresh.

column9: too  decadent, cant stop eating them
column10: These are impossible to find, and i havent had these since i was kid. They are just as good as i remember. The cheese just melts in your mouth
Cheese Waffies taste just like they did when they first came out. Cheese Waffies are so good. I,m glad that I could find them again.

column9: Great to get an old favorite again !
column10: The box arrived today- haphazardly taped together with a huge part of the box missing, and paper crumbled around a plastic grocery bag full of the 8 bags of Cheez Waffies (NOT a factory box).... The bag was tied shut, and the bags of the snacks were a bit rumpled, but amazingly, the first bag I've opened has intact Cheez Waffies.  The expiration date is for February 2013 (it's September 2012 now)- so more than acceptable.Many of the 'sandwiches' have fallen apart, and are missing their matching 'waffle', but they are whole halves- if that makes sense. Naturally there are some broken pieces, but not an abnormal amount.  I don't think they taste like Old London-but they're close enough to get by.  I can't find anything around here that comes close, so I'm glad to have them.

My sister, Betty, who just had double knee surgery, needed a boost to cheer her up after the surgery.  Well, this was the perfect gift.  Unfortunately, we cannot find Cheese Waffies anywhere in a store so I was pleased to be able to get them at Amazon.  It did the trick!!!!!

column9: Great but to expensive for  eating on a regular  basis
column10: Had something similiar almost 40 years ago. Loved Them But To Expensive to buy on a regular basis. No Local stores carry them in my area-Almost 4.00 per 5 0z.
The chips are mostly in pieces and some bags are stale. We kept them because to much trouble to send back. I don't think I will be ordering again.

I had been trying to find these for quite awhile, and I was so excited to find them here on Amazon.  What a mistake....I was so disappointed to find that they are horribly stale!!! A bag doesn't normally last too long when they are fresh, but I can't even eat these.  Save your money.
Excellent, this product arrived fast, I ordered an 8 pack to split with a friend who has been looking for them as long as I was.  We ate our share in two days, need I say more?
I was somewhat disappointed in this product.  It had a good taste, but most of the crackers had separated in the bags.
The Cheez Waffles are delicious.  The packaging was excellent, and the whole buying experience went very smoothly.  Recommend this Seller.
i love them and so does my aunt so i bought some and split them with her...i will be buying lots more

My grandma bought these for us in the 70's at the Acme in Lebanon, PA. We loved them. Thought they were gone for good, and then I saw them back on the shelves.
