column9: Much Love for Memphis Mocha Java
column10: I received the Memphis Mocha Java coffee as part of a gift from a friend of mine. Figuring the coffee was going to taste like cheap swill being a novelty item I tucked it away forgotten till the morning I found my self completely out of coffee. What a pleasant surprise it was when the nutty chocolate laced aroma hit my sences upon opening the bag. I was not disapointed in the least when the brewing was done. I have found a new favorite in Memphis Mocha Java. Easy on the stomach, it's good as a morning coffee, but a rich wonderful taste of chocolate with a hint of hazelnut also makes it perfect for a dessert blend.

column9: City Steam Cinnamon Roll Single Cup Coffee Pods
column10: I love City Steam coffees that I have tried before this Cinnamon Roll coffee.  I just can't drink this flavor.  The cinnamon has a chemical taste to it.  I will definitely go back to my tried and true flavors and avoid this one.  I have given the remainder of the package to a couple of friends and they didn't care for the flavor in this pod.  Sorry.
I really liked this coffee and must say it didn't last long in the office. Two bags of this coffee was gone within a week and a half. I plan to order more soon.

I got the Mystic Morning flavor, and if this is what a medium roast from this brand tastes like, I wonder how deep their dark roasts go. It's a bracing flavor profile in the morning, the kind of coffee that'll put hair on your chest. If you want your coffee strong enough to get up and walk away on its own, this is for you. Bear in mind though that an 8 oz pack will not go very far.
I am not a coffee snob but craved coffee when I am pregnant, so I ordered some decaf.  I have to say i never touched again and its not worth the trouble ( not much of course) of making it
Marley Coffee is, in my opinion, the BEST! Strong, Bold, Satisfying...tastes clean and free of non-organic contaminants...I LIKE it very much!

...one of my favorite pleasures in life and I decided to try this brand once it was on sale for under $6. A bit lighter coffee then I'm used to but it was smooth and well rounded with just the right amount of nutty after taste. I'll be watching for the whole bean since I'm sure it will heighten the flavor. Actually bought some interest in the company (JAMN) since i think Mr. Marley has a winning product. Sure would be fun to sit down with him and listen to stories about his father over a cup of this Joe!

column9: Organic Mystic Morning Ground Coffee, 8 Ounce
column10: Price first purchased was $4.95 then jumped to over $7.  I stopped buying it at that price - coffee good, but not that good.

Big fat beans roasted just right....easy to get out of bed for a mug of this coffee.Much preferred to the Lively Up, the only other Marley Coffee I tried.My friend who is a coffee snob even likes it.Ordered the whole beans and I use my Aero Press to make it.Have already reordered.
I was disappointed since i had been drinking another brand which had a bolder taste but this was good coffee.

column9: I love it!  It's now my favorite!
column10: My home brew beats Starbucks now with the "Organic One Love, Ethiopian YirgaCheffe Whole Bean Coffe, 8 Ounce!"  Definitely a recommend!  Marley Coffee One Love Organic Gourmet Coffee 2 Lb Bag Whole Bean
We really enjoy this coffee and have gotten hooked on it.  It is strong and has a clean taste, no bitter after taste like some coffees and it's a great way to start the morning.
Bought these as a wedding favor for my wedding, and they were great. Ordered a few boxes and they were fresh and came fast! Thanks Jelly Belly!

column9: More beans than I know what to do with.
column10: I bought this on impulse, the moment I came across it on Amazon-- I had been shopping for Jelly Bellies after not being satisfied with the pricing of bulk beans from brick and mortar/warehouse stores. 10 pounds of beans for $65?  One click and several months later and here I am.  I've had these for months and I've hardly put a dent into them.  I've had to resort to finding creative things to do with them-- like putting handfuls into individual baggies and hiding them throughout the house so I can have "surprise jelly beans" when I'm not expecting it.The only reason I knocked off a star in this review is because these beans literally come in just a cardboard box.  No plastic bag holding the beans, just a bunch of beans sitting in and against cardboard.  There were some small exposed seams and I did have some concern if the beans could be exposed to creepy crawlies. A one cent bag to protect the beans while they are in the box would be appreciated.

I made a white- fondant covered two layer birthday cake and cut a strip of the black and white damask pattern to go around the cake.  I cut a letter "J" from the same pattern and placed it on top. I adhered the pieces with thinned icing that I brushed on the fondant with a pastry brush. I finished with some cute black and white small paper flowers spaced  around the bottom. simple and pretty easy! Black and white is dramatic no matter how simple the design!

Wilton Patterned Sugar Sheets Edible Decorating Paper -Absolutely infuriated by this product. I was so excited to find the Damask pattern that exactly matched the decorations we chose for my daughter's Sweet 16 Masquerade Ball. Plus I knew I was going to have so much to do, that the sheets seemed the the perfect thing to make a beautiful cake with not much effort. I decided to simply wrap the outside of each tier and pipe a border, place a few fondant masques, and call it a day. Buying that many sheets was expensive, but I thought it would be worth it. The plan seemed to have worked perfectly UNTIL I opened the cake carriers at the banquet hall the next day to do the final stack and pipe the bottom borders. The sheets had evidently absorbed moisture from the buttercream and were all bubbled up and buckled over the entire cake. Any attempt to press them back into place resulted in the sheets sticking to my fingers and shredding away from the cake. Thankfully, the hall was dim and I had made extra fondant masques, so I was able to cover most of the damage. BUT, this was supposed to be the centerpiece of the banquet table! It ended up being relegated to a corner table, so that the worst damage was blocked from view by the wall. I don't make my living making cakes, but I have been doing it for over 30 years, so to have to present such disappointment at my own daughter's Sweet 16 party made me sick! Shame on you Wilton for producing such a shabby product!
Excellent Freshness, Flavor, and  Vendor!  Couldn't ask for more!  It's what I have come to expect from Amazon!
I just can't stop eating these things. Once you start munching on a bag there's little that can stop you from finishing it off in one sitting other than finding a place for the shells.

column9: The best way to buy seeds
column10: My son usually purchases his seeds at a local convenience store.  Lately, they have been out of ranch and BBQ.  It never occurred to me to check Amazon.com for my son's favorite sunflower seeds.  On a whim, I decided to do a search.  Low and behold, Amazon had his seeds, and at a better price!  It's great to order by the case and have them delivered directly to our front door.  Thank you Amazon.

I'm in Iraq right now, and since these aren't available at the local BX/PX, I have to order them online.  They arrived quickly, and every bag was perfectly flavorful!I have to warn you though-they are seriously addicting!  Once you start on them, you can't stop!  I have them at home all the time for road trips, and even while I'm watching a movie.  I'm constantly buying bags at convenience stores to pass the time while in traffic, and they really help if you want to quit smoking!Back home I work in a prison, so there is literally no tobacco allowed in there.  Since almost everyone that works there is prior service military-a TON of them smoke as well.  Anyway, we aren't allowed to take smoke breaks, or even smoke on the grounds.  So in order for most people not to have a "nic-fit" they use these as well.  I got to the point  I could go through two bags in one eight hour shift.  Okay, probably not the healthiest thing ever-but it definitely did pass the time.  On a few occasions I even had inmates steal them.  But then again-they sort of steal anything and everything they can.  Otherwise they wouldn't be there...and I wouldn't have had a job : ) lolSeeds are great-and I don't know what that other reviewer was talking about-they arrived in great condition-tasted perfect and lasted for quite awhile out here.  Everyone always wants to know where I get them because they aren't readily available out here.Bottom Line: Seriously addicting.  Great taste.  No drawbacks whatsoever!-Hannah
Yummy Yummy....Great product. I will always order them rather then buying them from the local store. Service is great!!
I purchased these because I was sick of running to the store to buy seed and in the long term this was by far cheaper. The seeds are great and they taste perfect. I will be ordering more
this was my second order and they tasted terrible.  Like they were over-seasoned and stale.  I thought it might just be one bag but i tried three and they were all the same

Package arrived promptly, as I've come to expect from Amazon. Seeds are fresh and the flavor is as delicious and strong, if not more so, than the seeds I buy in the store. I'll never waste my money buying them in the overpriced store ever again!

column9: Best Flavored Seeds from the David Brand
column10: So far I have tried regular, BBQ, Ranch and Chili Lime sunflower seeds made by the David brand, and the Ranch flavor is by far the best one. The taste is very addictive and it is hard to stop eating them. If you are curious about Chili Lime flavor then stay away from it because it is nasty. I bought all 4 flavors at K-Mart for $1.49 per 5.25-ounce bag in NYC, which was a good deal. I will probably buy the Nacho 12-pack here on Amazon soon because I like it so much.

My hubby drives a truck all day long and sunflower seeds are his favorite thing to snack on to help keep him awake and alert.  They're sometimes hard to find in the ranch flavor so ordering them makes my search easy.he keeps the box they came shipped in in his truck. Great deal for us.

I started eating seeds 30 years ago when i quit smoking and chewing,, soo good to have all the different flavors,, Dill/ cheese & ranch are the best.. I eat as many as 10 bags a week,, probably avarage 3 or 4..
I am so addicted to these. I don't eat the shell. These are low in salt. The flavor is amazing. I would keep on buying and buying.
If you like seeds that are small and boring, these are for you.  For strong taste and BIG seeds, try Bigs or Jim Beam.

column9: TRANS FAT!! Beware, nothing against Amazon though
column10: I used to LOVE David Ranch sunflower seeds and honestly could and would eat a bag a day. I have always been a fan of David over all the other brands well recently I was in my nutrition 1020 class and learned that the FDA doesn't require the manufacture to show trans fat if it is less than 0.50g PER SERVING. The only way to tell is in the ingredients list. If it has any partially hydrogenated oil than it has trans fat and you are supposed to avoid ALL trans fat if possible. So when eating a whole bag a day I was getting a lot of trans fat. So I have now switched over to Spitz which has none.

Bob's Red Mill Balsamic Brown Rice, is like all of their product really excellent.  The texture. taste and aroma are truly wonderful.  I use this in all my rice recipes to raise the quality up at least a couple of notches.

I am a GF Newbie.  There I said it. ;-)  In the beginning, I tried to buy all the flours and mix all the ingredients to get a general all purpose gluten free flour.  What a mess, what an expense!  I then started trying the GF Flour blends like Bob's Red Mill, Pamela's etc.  Eh.. didn't care for them.  I stumbled upon Better Batter and gave it a try.  This stuff was made for GF newbies!  Substitution is close to cup for cup for wheat with the addition of a little extra liquid.  I am now making breads, cakes, cookies once again and having them turn out instead of flop or turn into bricks.  Wish I had known about Better Batter when we first started on the gluten free diet.  That would have saved me time and money.

column9: Best Gluten Free Flour mix I've tried
column10: Since my daughter was diagnosed with celiac disease 8 months ago I have tried so many different flour blends - both the kind I purchase pre-made and many I have made myself following various recipe blends. There is NO COMPARISON.  This flour is by far the best I have used.  I have recreated my old gluten containing recipes using the flour as the substitute and recipes come out perfectly.  I thought I would never be able to do that again!  Importantly, I find the my recipes using this flour are moist whereas with everything else I've tried, the recipes didn't have the same moistness, they were often very dry.  I have had friends and family who eat gluten eat recipes I've made with this flour comment that they would have had no idea that the recipe was gluten free if I hadn't told them.  It is so nice to not have to try to mix flours to come up with the right combo.  I use this flour exclusively for any recipe that I'm converting from gluten containing to gluten free.

In my opinion, this is the best gluten-free flour in the market!  I've tried pretty much every type and I have never had a recipe fail using this flour cup per cup.  I take a regular recipe and use this flour, and the only change I make is to add more spices or more vanilla and baking soda or powder than a regular recipe calls for.  I've been buying this for a couple of years, and am so happy Amazon carries it now!!Donna Spencer

I made cookies with this and it was refreshing taste that I remember from when I was a child. When I bought this I bought due to reviews that I have read all over the net and only bought a small amount to see if I would like it as well. I used it cup for cup in my family recipes and so far everything has turned out great and taste. The only thing I fine is that the cook time is a bit longer than what it is with gluten flours, but this has been the trend with most gf products that I have cooked such as pasta. Besides using old family recipes I have also done the recipe that was on the box for Italian bread rolls and they were taste and not dry. My family uses them for buns, they work great

I have been using this for over 6 months now and it is THE BEST gluten free flour you will ever find!!! I use it cup for cup in typical recipes and it works great! They also have a biscuit recipe on their website and you can make biscuits that are mouth watering!!! I will never use anything else!!!

I've tried a few flours (Bob's Red Mill, Pamela's, etc) and been ok with most of the results but it was never a first time success like the cookies we just made with Better Batter. They taste identical even though we changed the fat (from butter to palm shortening), milk (dairy to soy) and chocolate chips (diary free and 1/3 the size) as well as the flour.What I love even more than this flour is the company...seriously promise I don't work for them.  I called last week to find out more about purchasing at a discount (they have bulk discounts and greatly discounted auto ship options) and when I hung up the phone I had an entire page of notes.  They didn't just share options and help compare prices but they helped me better understand what changed were needed to recipes, come up with substitutions for going diary free (even explaining the controversy about palm shortening when offering it as a possibility), and really just help me know what to do to make it work best for me.  Later I got on their website to look at their recipes and discovered they not only post recipes but actively post within the comments to help others and answer questions.It is a crazy pricy flour when you're buying it a small bag at a time but they recently dropped their prices at their site and when you buy in a 25 pound bag it is much more affordable.CALL Better Batter if you have questions and I'd bet they'll really help!

column9: Don't waste your money on the others!
column10: I wasted so much money when we discovered our son was allergic to wheat. I kept on buying the gluten free flour I managed to find in the store. Big waste of money. Then I posted on a board and a mother told me about Better Batter. The bad news is that this stuff is impossible to find in the store, the good news is that its worth a little extra hassle. I can't even tell the difference between regular flour and plan to give up on regular flour and use this for all my cooking and baking.

I had to play around a little with the amounts as I had read you can substitute cup for cup in regular recipes to make it gluten free.  But I found that with my favorite muffins I needed to decrease the amount of flour by 1/4 cup and increase sugar by 1/4 cup and they are delicious.  Very light and fluffy!  I have made cookies and they tasted great.  You just have to let them cool completely on the pan or they fall apart.  I think that is par for the course though with GF cookies.  I am new to GF cooking so I'm still working on it but as a whole I think this is a great product as you don't have to stock 3-4 different types of flour and xantham gum in your pantry because it's all in Better Batter Flour!
I just went gluten free and purchased this product to make some family favorites and it's FABULOUS.  No one can tell the difference.

I have been GF for over 5 years and I am a big baker - I have been trying all sorts of combos to get a flour type batter for pie crusts and breads and this is the ONLY one that tastes delicious!  Bobs Red Mill tastes bitter and leaves the aftertaste of the beans used in their mixture.  Pamelas brand for some strange reason always gives everyone horrible gas and bloating.  Just using finely ground white rice flour tastes the best, BUT is never the right texture and always falls apart - Better Batter is by far the Best Batter - HANDS DOWN!  Get it here and save - my local grocery stores carry it but for $3-$5 more for the 5lb box.

I really like this product. It makes baking Gluten Free foods from regular recipes so much easier. I have used it for corn bread, puff pastries, cakes, custard, and breads. The only thing I can suggest is don't be afaraid to spice up your doughs and batters more to increase flavor. They can have a bland flavor without extra spice. Visit the manufactures website for tested recipes as well. I will continue to order this product.

column9: Best Gluten Free Flour Mix out there!
column10: My son & husband have Celiac Disease and I have tried nearly every premade flour mix out there. This is by far the best and easiest to use! While it does not work for every flour recipe, it definitely has worked for every gluten free recipe I've tried.The biggest thing I've learned about gluten free baking is that what one person may rave about another will hate. I would assume it is because of people like me, who does not have to eat gluten free. I may not like the taste of something where as my husband who has to eat gluten free may love it.I would highly recommend that you buy this flour if you must eat or bake gluten free. My biggest suggestion is that you try it out using gluten free recipes (they are all over the internet) and use it in replace of the "flour mix" and xantham gum that the recipe calls for. Their website has a bunch of good recipes, but I for sure have found better options out there. (mainly because a lot of their recipes on the website are made for multiple allergies, or vegan)
I tried this flour a few months after going gluten-free and I am so glad I did. It works so well! We've used it in a variety of ways and food always tastes NORMAL and good!! LOVE this product!

I was really excited to try this flour after so many great reviews.  I've been baking gluten-free for over 2 years now and am at the point where I can make most things taste exactly like gluten items, but find that many recipes take quite a bit of adjustment and almost all get dry quickly.  I've gotten a bit tired of mixing flours and wanted to try a quick solution.  Anyway, as soon as my sample came in I made vegan cinnamon rolls from the recipe on the Better Batter website.  I immediately noticed a funky smell to the flour, which I think is from all the tapioca.  Now, the recipe came together beautifully, the consistency of the dough was perfect and I've never before gotten quite such perfect texture and rise in gluten-free breads.  That said, the tapioca taste is overwhelming!  Even my husband, who is not picky at all, had to force the first few bites.  After that the cinnamon does cover up the funky flour taste, but I could never feel confident serving something I made with this product to guests.  It has what I consider to be the distinctive "gluten-free taste" that you find in most processed gluten free foods.  This taste has always bothered me way more than texture issues.  I guess it's back to mixing my own mixes using Authentic Foods superfine flours.

I ordered this because of the positive reviews here, and the description touting it as an almost 100% substitute for wheat flour.  It is not.  It is great for breading chicken breasts before sauteing, but has utterly failed in other applications.  I tried making crepe batter, which with wheat flour is very liquidy.  With this, I got a goopy mix resembling bread dough.  Even after doubling the liquid in the recipe the batter remained thick and doughy.  I also tried using this to make the dough for samosas, and again ended up with a thick goop, even after adding more water.It's possible this is a good batter for baking, as I haven't used the oven with it, but it definitely not a 100% substitute.

I have tried many gluten free products, trying to mix flours to find the right combinaton and Better Batter Gluten Free All Purpose Flour has the right combination!  As soon as I felt the flour with my fingers (smooth and light), I knew it would be a good product.  I have made Carrot Cake Muffins, Molasses Cake, pancakes, peanut butter cookies, coffee cake.  Every recipe has turned out fantastic!

The first reason I tried this flour mix was because the cookbook Gluten Free On A Shoestring recommended it. The second reason was because it is very hard to find all the separate flours (like rice, potato, tapioca, etc) needed to make my own mix especially in the small town I live in. I also didn't want to spend $12 on a bag of xanthum gum. I have tried Bob's Red Mill mix which still requires the addition of xanthum gum and the results were ok. Everything I have made from Batter Batter is yummy and my family loved it! So far I've made french bread, pancakes, cookies, a cake, and noodles all with great texture and taste. I highly recommend this flour mix because of it's convenience and taste.

I've used it only once - made Pumpkin Muffins (recipe from BB website) and they were excellent. I'm looking forward to trying other GF recipes from their website. I compared it to other GF flours and tried BB because it doesn't include some of the ingredients that make other GF flours unpleasant.  Try it, you'll like it.
This is hands-down the best discovery I've made since my Celiac diagnosis. It's worth every penny! My daughter and I are now able to make all of our favorite foods from the "old days"!

I used this flour for a cobbler topping and it worked well with no alterations to the recipe (which was not gf).  So I was excited to try making pancakes with it this morning.  I used a recipe specific for gluten free pancakes and the mixture turned out like concrete.  I added more milk...and more milk...and then I ran out of regular milk and started adding almond milk...and more almond milk.  The recipe called for 1 cup of milk, I ended up using 3-4 cups and the consistency was still like a very thick pudding.That's the point at which I gave up.  I only narrowly avoided throwing the entire bowl of batter at the wall I was so frustrated (I'm so sick of the hit or miss nature of gf baking!!!!)I may buy the flour again but try figuring out weights instead of measurements.  I just wish it was possible to find a mix you could really use like wheat flour.

This is like a fine cake batter. I think you need to have the correct type of recipes to use this product. To just subsitute this flour for regular cake flour made my cookies pretty flat. THere must be something either I am missing, or I need the right recipes to go with this type of flour. It is a great idea to make something gluten free...just needs more directions or recipes to go with it.

Ordered these when our usual internet supplier was out of stock.  Had no idea how large or how good they'd be, but what a pleasant surprise to see they were huge!  Lion's Blue Sky (my BF service dog) loves them.  Definitely recommend this seller; quick order turnaround & awesome quality, not to mention a huge savings over the retail pet shoppes.  We paid nearly twice as much at the local pet shoppe for cow ears half the size. That was when I check Amazon & was surprised to find them on line.  This will be our new best supplier! Since Sky is a big German Shepherd, you know she prefers the large cow ears for her evening snack.
Trident Vitality Rejuve gum with White Tea is the most refreshing gum that has come out in a long time.  I love it at work, at home, and when traveling...it keeps me from eating so much junk food.
Great product at good price.  Hard to find in the stores locally.  Easy way to shop on line and you get great service from this company.

This blend was hard to find. My wife and friends were throwing me a retirement party for my 20 yrs in the USAF. I had a crazy thought ... I'll look on Amazon! What do you know it was on there. It came on time and I had an outstanding retirement party.
This spice is the best!! It makes everything taste so much better! We've used it forever and love it.  From potatoes to meats, you can't go wrong!

column9: a good deal on high quality flour
column10: I love this flour and use it for my son's GF diet recipes.  Buying Gluten Free products on Amazon saves me the long trip to the specialty store. Per box, this flour was priced slightly lower than Whole Foods. The shipping brought it up to Whole Foods price, but I saved on gas and time going there.

I love Quinoa, red, white, black Quinoa. We use it in soup, side dishes etc. Now on to this Quinoa flour, its gross, totally gross. We have tried it in various things and the flavor is so bitter and strong that even cutting it with other flours it still over powers everything else. It has the flavor of Quinoa when it hasn't been rinsed properly and has that bitter taste. The texture is odd. Mealy or gummy depending on how you use it. Also the boxes I recieved were going to expire in December! I threw the rest out. Even the bread I baked with it the birds and raccoons wouldn't touch and raccoons with eat about anything! F-

I've got to admit, this quinoa flour has a strong smell when you open the package.  Despite that though, I bake with quinoa flour because it is a complete protein and a highly nutritious ingredient.  To mask it's flavor, I find that it works well with other strong flavors, such as chocolate.I've made chocolate crackers [...] and a chocolate cake bake [...] with this flour and got delicious results!I know I'm going to continue using this flour in the future now that I know how successful it can be in baked goods.

I was buying quinoa from a different supplier and when their prices went up I switched to buying from amazon this ancient harvest brand. Bad mistake. My daughter started to get this rash around her mouth like she had eaten something with wheat in it. She had the rash for months and would complain about her stomache hurting. Everyone else in my family said it made their belly hurt, even the ones who arent gluten free and yes the bitter taste is bad. This quinoa hasnt been rinsed. the exp date is still good but I will be throwing out the rest of it and going back to my old brand!

column4: M. W. Powers ""the covin of lovin""
column9: So Happy I found this Flour
column10: Now, if I could only figure out HOW ON EARTH TO TELL YOU - AMAZON, TO GO AHEAD AND PLACE THE ORDER -  Even HAPPIER I WOULD BE --PLEASE HELP ME AND MANY THANKS  Margie in SC  :)

this is some great tasting tea i take it for medicinal purposes, because i have alot of infectionswith the kidney and kidney stones and the urinary tract, and it seems to be helping. i got it from my mom, because she was using it to.  try it you might like it, i put a little sugar in mine and really tastes good.  thanks for making this tea.  d.sloupNIEREN-BLASENTEE#23 BAGS15 TEA BAGS BYSALUS HAUS

I bought this mainly to burn myself and it does the job. It's not really hot at first, but then the pain builds to the back of the throat and thats where it really feels like your mouth is suffering 3rd degree burns. I tasted it with the tiny spoon included first to be safe, and it was extremely hot considering the tiny amount. Then I licked about a half teaspoon off my hand and it burned for a good 10 minutes. The one problem is the taste, its not bad, but it has a strong chili powder flavor that can mask other flavors in food. Bottom line: This is a extremely spicy sauce that will last a year or two and is well worth the money.Oh... and MAKE SURE YOU WASH YOUR HANDS AFTER USING! I made the mistake of rubbing my eye and I thought I wad gonna go blind for a couple minutes... Also make sure you wash BEFORE the bathroom, I went per and it burned that area for 15 minutes..

After seeing a few youtube clips of people consuming this sauce, and being a pepperhead myself, I decided I had to order this stuff.  I was so thrilled to buy it and get it rushed to my door.  I eagerly awaited for the package to arrive.  Then the day came when it was mine.  I tore open the package and there it was, the evil little bottle itself, complete with silver bullet keychain attached.  I quickly noticed that inside the bullet is a tiny taste testing spoon.  I kind of giggled and figured what the hell, I gotta give this sauce a go.  I put a nice big dab on my finger, enough to cover the tip of my index finger and I licked the sauce off my finger.  Within seconds, I felt the heat coming.  It was insane, it was like someone lit a fire inside my mouth and some maniac was holding a blowtorch on my tongue and on the back of my throat.  I was sweating like crazy, I was panting like a dog on a 100 degree day that was locked inside a car with the windows rolled up.  Never could I ever have imagined how hot this sauce was.  The hottest I had recently tried was Quaker Steak and Lube's Atomic Sauce, and let me tell you, that stuff is mere steak sauce compared to this!  My stomach was killing me, I was on the ground holding my stomach and groaning!  Its beyond hot, its PAINFUL to eat.  Will I do it again?  YES!  Have I since?  Oh yeah.  Many times, just not that same amount.  Any insane hardcore pepperhead will appreciate this stuff, no matter how high your tolerance is.  And it makes a great gift for your hardcore pepperhead friends!

This is the real deal folks.  I had half a teaspoon full of this sauce on an empty stomach (big mistake) and for about 10 minutes I thought I was going to die.  Now I now what chili heads mean when they talk about an endorphin rush.  I've tried other sauces such as the regular Mad Dog 357 and Blair's Mega Death and never got this effect.Also the the flavor is a really unique tangy flavor that somewhat reminiscent of steak sauce or BBQ sauce.  Some people don't like it so much, I think it's because they're looking for a traditional hot sauce taste, but I think it's great.In the future I'll work up to this sauce a bit more gradually and only try it on a full stomach, but it's the first sauce I've tried that really delivers on the pain and suffering.Good stuff.

I am addicted to the hot stuff in peppers and my addiction has raised my tolerance level to pain, significantly. I love tacos and used to use a cap full of Mad Dog 357 Collector's Edition (300,000 Scoville Units) and the tacos were almost too hot for me. Now I use this hot sauce and pour about 10 cap fulls of the Silver Edition into the sauce. OMG, incredible heat. I go through one of these bottles in a month or two. I keep one at home and one at work!

This hot sauce is very very hot. I put it on my butrritos, and love the taste. The sauce has a sweet taste to it, and an impressive hotness that lasts a good while. One of my favorites, but I suggest moderation, as in one or two drops per bite (And that is if you like stuff super hot).
This stuff is hot. A lingering heat that makes its home in the back of your throat. Also, it's a bbq type sauce so you could always add it to a regular bbq sauce for some surprise spice.

This little bottle of HOT sauce is not for the amateur Chilli Head. IT IS HOT! It is great for spicing up dips, marinades, soups, really anything you want to add a lot of heat to. Read the disclaimer, enjoy responsibly. I love the product, the price is great, shipping was as expected. Will buy again.

column9: Bought this as a gag gift and then kept it.
column10: I bought this as a gag gift for a relative who claims to like spicy sauces but kept it fearing she might actually try it.  This stuff is HOT.  So hot that it will burn your skin if you get a drop on you.  (Be sure to wash your hands!)  HOT as hell.  It has a good burning taste to it but please try it out first.As an indicator, I like my Bloody Mary's spicy...very spicy.  I'll put 10 or more shakes of Tabasco "hot" habanero in a glass. If a drop spills on my hand I don't think twice about licking it off.  Don't do that with Mad Dog 357.With 357, a tear-drop is enough for me. I'll put about four, maybe five, tear-drops in a pot of chili.It's good stuff but just be careful with it until you find your tolerance and preference.

This is a very hot hot-sauce with a nice allspice presence.  In my opinion, there is so much vinegar that it detracts from the chili taste and the background spices.  When initially opened, this sauce was incredibly hot.  A table spoon of this sauce in a bowl of chili when first opened was over powering.  However, it appeared to lose this level of heat in just a few weeks in the fridge.  Now I put a dollop on a cracker with a slice of cheese and can eat those non-stop.  The heat level dropped below El Yucatan and way below 100% Pain, Melinda's XXX, etc.  One star off for too much vinegar and one star off for losing heat over time.

There was a feeling of the unknown when venturing into tasting my first extreme hot sauce. The hottest chili I have yet to experience is known to be the Thai chili which has a 150k scoville rating. Bearable when eaten with food but the Thai chili still is pretty spicy on its own.  If you find hot sauces from Taco Bell (fire sauce) or Del Taco (del scorcho) hot, then don't even try this stuff.This hot sauce is 4x the spiciness of a thai chili. Upon my first taste, I was expecting a burning sensation without anything else. The sauce is somewhat thick, so I tried to apply a drop to my delicious Mexican themed meal, specifically the burrito(not native to Mexico) and mix it around. Surprisingly, it had a distinct taste which was pleasurable followed by some heat. The heat was indeed intense, but not an unpleasing experience. My mouth burned in almost a masochistic way, painful yet pleasurable. Perhaps it was my own personal test of manhood. Never to a point where I felt it was too much. Soon after, there was a almost euphoric feeling of accomplishment. Your mind will challenge you to take another bite and experience it all over again. Alas, the cycle will start all over. Great stuff.WARNING:While consuming Mad Dog 357 hot sauce, its not recommended to accompany it with beer unless you intend on getting drunk really fast. I found myself downing quite a lot of beer to cool my mouth.

CAUTION: THIS IS SERIOUSLY HOT!!! NOT FOR NOOBS!! NOT FOR PRANKS!!If you want a quick endorphin rush, all you need is a drop or two of this. If you're going to do a tablespoon of it like on some YouTube videos, you will be brough to your knees within the customary 5 minutes just like them. I was afraid of it when I first opened the bottle. I dipped the very tip of a regular wooden toothpick in the cap and put it on my tongue - WHEW!! It just seems unreal how much heat you get off of that small of an amount. The second time I tried it I shook the bottle up and the sauce got all over the inside of the cap, so I rinsed it out at the kitchen faucet and the splattered sauce was making me caugh, similar to how onions make your eyes tear up.This is potent stuff! I love the BBQ flavor. Great single-squirt for a big pot of HOT chili. I would never want to run out of this.

My friend I gave this to for a gift was always telling me how most hot sauce is just not as hot as they claimed. Not so with this one. It is so hot I picked up a towel he had used after our meal together and I put my hand to my face right after and burned my eyes (not directly thankfully).Use caution, extremly hot!! He tells me he likes this sauce, but just a tiny drop will do it.

I have been eating 10+ hot sauce for several years and decided I wanted to go hotter.  This is one hot sauce with a very distintive flavor.  It startes with a kind of sour citris flavor then slowly starts turning hot and it keeps getting hotter and hotter.  It's very thick so hard to get a small drop.  I can eat it but be careful the first time you try it just to make sure.  There are some hot sauces with a better flavor but this one isn't to bad compared to some others.  I am not looking for the next hotter sauce but my old 500,000 scovell unit sause isn't all that hot anymore but does taste a little better.

If all you're looking for is a sauce that will burn your mouth off, this is the one. If you're looking for something to pour on your food, look somewhere else. The flavor isn't really awful, although there is a bit of a faint metallic taste to it. The real problem with putting a sauce like this on food is that it's just too hot. It will absolutely overpower anything you put it on.The little bullet/spoon keychain that comes with it is cool, but the links are pretty weak. I used it for a little while before they got a bit bent out of shape.There is one really great thing about extremely hot sauces, though (other than watching a friend run around while his eyes well up with tears after you talk him into eating a tablespoon of it). It's the feeling of euphoria you get once the initial rush of pain begins to fade. There's really nothing quite like it, and it's one of the main reasons people eat it even if they're not trying to show off their machismo.

This sauce is the hottest I've had so far.  Be very careful when pouring this, especially if you are coming from a sauce that is half the heat.Also, be careful of gut-rot.  The mouth can handle the heat, but when eating something very hot with the sauce, or when drinking a hot drink, or even on an empty stomach can bring the pain for hours and hours!

I didnt purchase this on Amazon. However, i thought i would share my story as a survivor of the Mad Dog bite. Here is my account as posted on a blog site i use.So, a new store opened in the Gateway shopping district in downtown Salt Lake City recently called Hot Sauce & Things (at least, i think that's what it was called...my memory is a little shaky after....). Shelly and i wandered in there last Sunday out of curiosity and boredom. There were only three other people in the store....the employee, a nice Korean girl (comes into play later) and a young couple who had name tags from another store in the Gateway. Anyway, they were sitting at the bar which also functions as a checkout stand trying hot sauces. After a minute of browsing, i here the guy exclaim, "Ooh, that's HOT!". The employee was like "Yeah, I'm Korean, and i cant even eat more than a toothpick's (dipped in) worth. Ahhh....now my interest and curiosity were piqued.The couple left without buying anything. Shelly and i had already grabbed a few promising sauces to try out at home. I walked up and asked the girl if we could try the last one the dude before us had tried. She said it was the hottest one sold. However, before you can try it, you have to build up to it. Thus began my journey through five continents and twenty four different hot sauces, ranging from the jalapeno based sauces, through the habanero based ones, and past the ghost pepper based sauces, to be greeted by my twenty fifth and final opponent, the Mad Dog 357 (complete with bullet holes and a whole list of caveats printed on the bottle. Let me just say, prior to that one, my mouth was already on fire and my insides were feeling a bit shaky. Afterwards.....well, lets just say i abhor even the thought of consuming milk, but quickly drank deeply of the chocolate milk they also sold there. I felt buzzed out and disoriented, like i had just left a bar in the new light of the morning sun after having sat in the dark and dank establishment all night. My heart was racing and my body felt like a balsa wood building try to stand against hurricane winds.Needless to say, i bought a bottle, took it to work, and made every single person i work with try it (in many cases i tried it again with them). Word got out and for the next three days (including today), doctors, nurses and administrators all came down to try this now legendary hot sauce (i work in a hospital). Best dollars i ever spent!
This is it, it's the hit at every get together!And YES - Use the spoon that is attached...... you need it!A must have, if you love Hot Sauce!

I have been using the regular mad-dog 357 sauce for a while and decided to start building my way to the really extreme hot sauces, like the "Da Bomb" or "The Source" sauces. I was a little skeptical on how much hotter this silver edition would be, comparing to the regular mad-dog.I can tell you, it is really hotter. I used a single drop of this thing, as I usually did with the regular maddog on a bowl of chilly (about 2 cups of chilly) and I had to drink some milk aftwards to get the burning away. :-) hahahahaHolly cow, really good sauce, burns like hell. Be aware and go slow so you don't get hurt.I will have to dig on it and build my tolerance a bit before I even think on moving to the next level, "DA BOMB" hot sauce.

column9: They give you the bullet for a reason
column10: This sauce is hot. Tip of a needle is enough to do it for 10-20 minutes.I find its nice to spread it a bit on steak or any kind of meat or to mix it with A1, spicy chili sauce, or any sauce.Just a little, gives the food some life. It has some taste, but given how hot it is and how little you need, it doesn't matter.The product description is wrong though, it is not 600,000. It is 750,000, which I think is better.If you like extremely spicy, but not lethal food, this is good for you.

column4: Hot Sauce and Heavy Metal Injector "Steve"
column10: This silver collectors edition is really cool. You get a bullet which actually twists open to reveal a tiny little spoon to eat the sauce with. And good thing it's micro sized because anymore than that well your basically screwed. Being the chilli head I am I took one of those little egg spoons and filled that up. That would be a fairly good finger tip amount, way more than the spoon they give you. I ate it, licked the spoon clean and whoa great balls of fire! After a few min it got even hotter and I felt dizzy and my ears hurt a little. What a rush that was, my stomach killed me later so I will never do anything like that amount ever again, well maybe, lol.This sauce is worth the money. The taste ain't too bad either for a powerful extract sauce. But what's to really taste, it just one big burn.
This stuff does not mess around.  I just had some at Firehouse Subs and I'm pretty sure it's the hottest sauce I've ever had.  But, it was good.

column9: One of the hottest and best tasting
column10: One of the hottest extract sauces I have tried, not as hot as Da' Bomb Ground Zero, similar to Blair's Zakk Wylde (Berserker Shot to Hell).  Hotter than Dave's. A size of a pea is all you need on a chip.  A VERY sweet sauce, wish I could use more of it for more flavor.  A small drop in your food and you will be able to taste it, the flavor does not get drowned out easily.  1 bottle will probably last you your entire life.

I ordered this for a friend as a thank you for helping me with a major project. I had it delivered to myself before giving it to her, because I wanted to make sure it looked OK before giving it to her. Not only did it arrive quickly, but it looked great! Although she has not eaten all of the food, she tells me that what she has eaten is delicious. I would definitely order this again!

For a flavored coffee, GM's Souther Pecan is rather good.  The instant water hits this coffee, the strong aroma of pecans wafts up.  On a cool fall morning, this can be rather refreshing.  The pecan flavor is not too sweet but quite true to its name.  There is no mistaking that this is a flavored coffee.  Of all the flavored k-cups that I have tried so far, this one is definitely in the top 5.  Not overpowering, but not weak on flavor.  Overall, a rather pleasant change of pace from straight (unflavored) coffee.
This coffee is PERFECT for someone who just likes a "hint" of flavor in their coffee.  The flavor is VERY mild, but VERY pleasing.  I recommend this blend!
Rich nutty pecan flavor.  One of the favorites here at work.  A great cup of coffee.

I'm almost not sure if this should be a morning drink or a dessert. It definitely has a wonderful pecan aroma and flavor. My fiance and I also would put this in our top 5 (and I think we have pretty much tried them all...) We tend to lean toward nutty, vanilla and caramel flavors as our favorites, so if you like those you will probably like this.  I found it to be a nice mild coffee (strength can be adjusted by choosing smaller or larger brew size) and as far as sweetness, adjust sugar to taste! If you're unsure about buying so many, try finding it in a variety pack, that is how we discovered it.

I was in a doctor's office waiting room that had a Keurig Brewer and tried a coffee flavor that was called Southern Pecan Pie.  It was delicious so I ordered this coffee from Green Mountain.  They are NOT the same flavor.  This coffee is a medium roast nutty flavored coffee.  It tastes great with a little cream and I usually sweeten my coffee, but if you aren't big on flavored, sweet coffee, try this one black.  This will not taste like a pecan pie.  Imagine a tray of fresh roasted pecans with a cup of fine coffee... that's the flavor.After trying this one, my 17 year old son declared it to be better than the Nantucket and prefers it to the Vanilla.Also, I don't think you can beat Amazon's price.  I belong to a coffee club and get a large discount and free shipping.  Amazon's price beats the coffee club considerably.

I am very fond of Keurig coffee makers. I own two. One at home, one at the office. The one at home is a replacement for an older unit that died. It is convenient, fast and make the right amount (1 cup/mug). However, I am not such a big fan of a lot of the coffee that is available. Most of it seems bland, tasteless, and often a bit pricey, at least to me. However, while not a fan, in general, of Green Mountain coffees I found this flavor, Southern Pecan, to among the best that I have tried (Van Houtte & Timothy's primarily). The aroma is good, as is the taste. I always drink my coffee black, so I realize that I am probably missing out on some of the flavor by not doctoring it up with cream and sugar. Nevertheless, this flavor has become a stable of mine and I expect to continue purchasing it as needed.

column9: Green Mountain Coffee,Southern Pecan, K-Cups from Amazon.com
column10: This coffee, Southern Pecan is still my favorite flavor from Green Mountain K-Cups for Keurig Brewers. It's refreshing, and the taste is great. It's the best way to start my morning and evening after work.You folks at Amazon sure know how to package and quickly ship the important stuff in my life. THANKS!
I love this flavor.  I found it on Amazon, not my local store and I am so glad I ordered it!

column9: Good for a change of pace every now and again...
column10: I'm not crazy about flavored coffee but I must admit this one is good. I got a sample pack of 5 k-cups from Keurig. You can taste and smell the pecans. It has a pleasing flavor and aroma. But I don't think I would want it every day. For me, once a week is enough.
I bought this coffee for my wife office and they seem to love it.  Good coffee and great sale price.  You can not go wrong with this coffee.

SOUTHERN PECAN IS MY FAVORITE FLAVORED COFFEE. GREEN MOUNTAIN SOUTHERN PECAN K-CUPS ARE A GREAT VALUE AND A RICH BLEND. IF USING THE LARGE CUP SETTING ON YOUR  MACHINE SOME OF THE FLAVOR WILL BE LOST. STICK TO THE SMALLER CUP FOR A DELIGHTFUL CUP OF COFFEE!!

This is my favorite flavored coffee.  Most flavored coffees are very weak and watery, but this one has about a medium coffee flavor.  It does not leave you with an overwhelming pecan flavor, but it is nutty.
An excellent product with good southern pecan flavor. A good start for the morning. Highly recommend this product.

column9: One of the the best flavored coffees
column10: The smell of while brewing is amazing. So is the taste.My wife simply will not drink anything else after I bought these from Amazon!
I really couldn't identify the flavor, and this stuff is pretty weak.  Not outright BAD like Maxwell House, but not memorable, either.
Southern Pecan has become my favorite coffee.  It has a warm smooth taste and is good with or without cream or sugar. This is one of the favorites in our office and I will be sure to order it again.

This does have a nice pecan aroma, but not at all a sweetened pecan/pecan pie aroma or flavor. It's actually a lot stronger than any other flavored Green Mountain coffee K-cup I've tried--stronger coffee, less sweet, less obvious flavor than the others.
I loved this when it was ~$20 but it went out of stock and became "unavailable". Orders arbitrarily cancelled.  Now its back but , oops... its $60.  I guess Exxon bought the company!

Open the package expecting instructions or advice on use, nothing! Injected large amount in several spots should have injected small amount in a bunch of places!Had dry creole seasoning what do you do with it? mix it in the liquid to increase heat, sprinkle on bird before of after deep frying? If you don't inject it all through out the bird you get areas over seasoned while others need help. And I still have no idea what to do with the dry!

I fried my first turkey at thanksgiving 2011. I read a lot about the process looking for the best recipes and tips. I cam across this seasoning kit and it turned out amazing! Everyone declared my turkey the best they'd ever had. I felt bad, because mom had always cooked thanksgiving before and I didn't want her feelings hurt, but later she also said it was the best turkey. This came with everything needed for 1 turkey. Do your research buy this, use it, and you'll have the best turkey every! =)

Besides the quick delivery of this product, I used it this past weekend in a beer can chicken recipe I devised from watching experienced chefs. First I injected the bird with the Creole seasoning and rubbed with the Cajun spice that accompanied as a kit. Added fresh garlic to the beer and with the help of the Masterbuilt Butterball Buttery Creole Seanoning Kit created the most exceptionally moist and flavorful chicken I had ever tasted!!!!!!
this stuff is terrible...not much more to say....i always use the butterball kits for all my bigger meats but this one is just bad..i guess i'll stick to the cajun kit

I purchased the Butterball Turkey Fryer for my husband as a Christmas gift.  He was really excited about trying everything.  The fryer never worked out of the box. I returned it a few days later. We ended up baking the turkey in the oven. He had injected it already with this seasoning kit, according to directions on the package.  Now I don't know if it would have tasted differently fried rather than baked, but it was horrible.We ended up throwing the turkey out.  It was inedible. Fortunately I am the mother of an Eagle Scout and I am always prepared with a Plan B.  I purchased a glazed ham the same time I purchased the turkey.  Christmas dinner was saved.  So I don't know whether it was baking the bird that made the difference or what, but beware if you don't fry your turkey.
I haven't used this product yet, but I plan on using it in the near future. If it from Butterball, it's got to be good
This is by far the best deep fryer for turkeys ever! And on top of this it is safe and used indoors!

column9: I don't like Stevia...but I really liked THIS!
column10: I had just about given up on colas (diet) cause I figured it wasn't worth all the crap they put in it. But, hey, I LIKE cola. Have loved colas since I was a kid and now I'm creeping into pension territory.I had tried the grape and cherry Zevia earlier in the month, and really, really enjoyed them. I decided to try the cola (without much expectations as a former Coke lover).Well, I like it a lot. It's VERY fizzy and totally the sort of cola flavor I love. Without aspartame or weird stuff. Without caffeine...I prefer my caffeine in my morning fresh gourmet java, not my casual summer beverages.If you're a cola lover and want a nice--though granted, really expensive--alternative, here it is. Even if you're normally a stevia hater like me, you might just like this.Enjoy...
Tastes really good.. almost like Pepsi One but without the caffeine.. Pepsi only sells caffeine free diet soda with Aspertaine..finally a SAFE soda to drink without artifical chemicals.
I have been looking for a long time for a diet cola without the aspartame and I finally found one in Zevia.  The bonus is, this one is caffeine free!!  Tastes great too!

I have been purchasing Zevia products for a couple of years.  Ever since they were recommended for being caffeine free, sugar free (sweetened with all natural stevia).  I have kicked the soda pop habit, but every once in a while...  It's nice to have a Zevia Cola over ice.  Very satisfying.

column9: I got a bad batch, I think
column10: I received this as a mistake when I ordered the Zevia Ginger Ale. This is my first taste of a Zevia product and I am sure there i something wrong with this batch. It tastes like a mistake. Someone wrote ". It's just a little bit too much on the sweet side, and a bit flat" I can't see that this could possibly apply to the product I received. The can of Zeiva I tried isn't sweet at all (maybe 1/4 as sweet as soda) and is overly carbonated (almost like beer). The one can I tried tasted like carbonated water with a hint of citrus and cola flavor, so I think it's just from a bad batch. I"m afraid to try another can because I got a terrible headache after drinking just half of the first (all I could stomach). I still have the headache a day later. I can't blame the product as it could be a coincidence. I just wanted that to be known in case anyone else has the same experience. Also, as a warning to people who haven't already tried this product, apparently Amazon doesn't allow returns on this item. I have Amazon Prime so I'm pretty sure I'll get a refund, but not sure yet how that will work. To be on the safe side, you might want to try this in a store before committing to 24 cans being delivered to your home and having to sit in your living room until Amazon tells you what to do with it.

column9: Really good stuff.  A healthy diet soda finally!
column10: I really like this stuff!  It's been a long time coming.  It tastes great and you know you are not putting a bunch of unhealthy chemicals in your body when you drink it.  It makes "pizza night" a healthier meal.

This soda is amazing.  It is sugar free- made with stevia, all natural and safe!!- and caffeine free..I used to drink diet Pepsi all the time.. then diet caffeine-free Pepsi and diet Coke... and this soda tastes WAY better than diet Coke or Pepsi!!  My doctor recommended this soda, that is how I found it!!  It is my favorite drink!!

column9: We can't get enough of this stuff!
column10: I don't eat sugar so this soda was a godsend for me! I missed soda sooo much.  It's made with a mixture of erithyritol and stevia, and admittedly, I have been eating these sugar substitutes for awhile so I'm quite used to the taste, but honestly, even my husband loves this stuff.  We also have friends who have recently started to buy it for themselves because it's a healthier alternative to regular soda.  Now, yes, I know--any carbonated beverage should be consumed in moderation as it can prevent your body from absorbing calcium (or so I've read) so don't go crazy or anything! I will say though that having a soda with a gluten-free slice of pizza feels just like the good ol' days when all I ate was crap! :)  I also appreciate the caffeine free version of this soda as caffeine makes me a little goofy.  If you love it, do the subscribe and save like we do.  It ends up saving us a good amount of $.

This product rocks but is more money here on Amazon then the local stores so buy it at the store you can find your local store when you visit there website.The tast you have to get use to but its not bad and its better then getting cancer with Coke or Pepsi that use Equal and better than using Splenda that make you so hungry and give you allergies. So its worth the extra money.

The only place I could get Zevia soda was at Whole Foods Stores. I recently moved & there are no Whole Food stores within a 2 hour drive.  Thank goodness for Amazon. I can get it delivered right to my door for less than the store price & with the automatic shipping there are no shipping charges.It's great to know I don't have to drink soda with Aspartame or High Fructose Corn Syrup & dyes in it. You may have to get used to the taste but I love it.I buy the caffeine free diet cola. I recommend it to anyone who doesn't want to drink the garbage that's in other sodas!

column9: Okay, not bad - just not great.
column10: The taste of this reminds me of a cross between Diet Rite and Tab.  It's just a little bit too much on the sweet side, and a bit flat.  I wouldn't buy it again, but it's okay to drink.  It's unoffensive.

You will not be disapointed with this cola. It is a wonderful alternative to traditional soda, both sugar and diet.My son loves this as do his teenage friends...whom have no idea that it is an All natural item. I have introduced this to my boss who loves it too. The cola is our house hold favorite. The root beer is also good. We are not a fan of the orange.
This is just okay.  I added a little of the powdered lemonade with stevia to mine and it greatly improved the taste.  It is a good option for kids who what a cola beverage.

This is not zero calorie nor actually sweetened with stevia! This is sweetened with a sugar alcohol, with a little stevia added. Each can has 50 calories and for a diabetic this stuff raises your blood sugar almost as bad as any regular sweetened with sugar soda. And the sugar alcohol gives you horrible gas. A big thumbs down to their false advertising.

We lived in the Philippines for a few years and really enjoyed the fresh Mangoes - and even the dried Mangoes. When we left we were worried we would have to leave that taste treat behind - but not now! These dried Mangoes taste just like the ones we bought locally in Manila.
These tasty and chewy naturally tree ripened mangoes are definitely the best I've had. Somewhat expensive, but you get what you pay for.

i have tried a few brands of dried mango. one from costco and the other is some brand i forget. this mango is the best one out of the three since it is more soft and moist. the sweet flavor is all there which is really delicious.

I do not usually order food products on-line, however I could not find what I was looking for in the stores around here.  I am very happy with the timely delivery and it is exactly what I was looking for.

Mango fresh or dried is one of my most favorite fruits. Since fresh is not as available this product substitutes perfectly. The Philippine brand has become my choice because it is consistantly fresh and the pieces come apart easily. It is also less sugared than other brands.

Good quality product at a reasonable price. I really like that these are tasty and firm. I'm glad to have access to this Goya brand which usually is available on the East Coast. It allows more choices when purchasing Chick Peas via Amazon... a good thing!

I drink iced tea year 'round and in large quantities. I've tried the China Mist Passion Fruit iced tea, and regularly drink Superior's Paradise Iced Tea - and I like this tea even better. It's truly as advertised - a really good black tea with notes of mango that don't overwhelm.
I think this tea strikes the perfect balance.  It's a good tea with a hint of mango that complements rather than overwhelms the underlying black tea notes.  I will be ordering this one again!

I love this product. I can save a ton of money on kcups and quite frankly it brews a better cup. The best news is I got this product for FREE when I bought Cafejo's My French-Press Caféjo My French-Press with K-Cup, Pod & Ground Coffee Adaptors Plus Various Coffee Samples.. Thank you Cafejo.
Excellent value. Very good taste and they work perfectly in my gumball machine. Will purchase again when this supply runs out.

column9: Bought as a gift and the receipents loved it!
column10: I bought this gift for my brother and his wife, since my brother and I were big candy addicts in the 80's. He received it on time (which was during the last holiday season) and they absolutely loved it! He thought it was so great to see some of the old candy that you can't get in stores these days. I did not personally get to see the item, but it seemed to make a gift for them and they really enjoyed it.

column9: Fun gift for nostalgic candy lovers.
column10: This was a great gift for a 30th birthday.  Lots of good candy in the throw-back style.  Would recommend for those nostalgic types who love candy.  It seems expensive for a box of candy but the memories are worth it.
I got this for my friend - he turned 30 this year...and he loved it...he was so shocked as he open the box and saw all the different kinds of candies from way back "80s"Def a cute gift idea.
yum thats all i can say cool old fashon candy my mom was happy bout that so i reccomend this as a gift

I went through a few of these types of boxes and came across a lot of bad reviews but I stuck with this one and it did not disappoint.  I'm privileged to be in love with a die hard candy fanatic and he has been eating on this box for 4 days now, quite happily.  I would definitely purchase this box again.  It was memorable of my own child hood with the mass of candy and novelties in the box.  Great product!

I gave this as a gift to my husband's sister's boyfriend last year for Christmas. Understandably, he was difficult to shop for. But his eyes lit up with this gift. I heard a few months later how much they enjoyed trying all the different candies. I would buy this again for gifts for hard-to-shop for people.
I purchase another 1980's box and was very disappointed.  This Retro Candy box is awesome.  It was packaged well and it had a lot of merchandise.
It was exactly what I wanted for my husband who is a huge candy lover! All the candy was fresh and we had a blast enjoying all the "old school" candy.

I have just received notice of shipment of this item. I was purchased on the 1st of March. It took 11 days to ship!!!!!!!!!! This is the second time that I have ordered something on Amazon that did not ship for a long time after it had been ordered. This is awful, and I don't think I plan on ordering anything from Amazon in the future! They also never tell you when something is backordered till a few days after you order. This is unacceptable!!!Gloria Souyias
Just what I needed. Just wish I didn't have to buy in large bulk. But at least I will never run out!

column9: Yummy MILD Cheddar Nacho Dip with PORTION CONTROL built in!!!
column10: Chi-Chi's Snackers Nacho Cheese, 3-Ounce Single Serve Cups (Pack of 24)These serving size cups are perfect! This is the BEST way for me to keep from over snacking - when the dip is gone I put the chips away. I LOVE this dip.In response to the reviewer who said these are too salty, I disagree. This dip tastes LESS SALTY than the dip I buy at the store. The high amount of fish meal in this food probably contains ethoxyquine which is a carcinogenic preservative. It accumulates in the liver and causes damage down the road. Unless you can get written verification that this company buys fish meal that does not contain ethoxyquine, do not feed this food. I think it states on the bag that no artificial preservatives are "added". This just means that Solid Gold company did not add artificial preservatives in their formulation (dog food companies are not required to list ingredients which were already present in the meals that they purchased). Fish meal in dry dog food is the newest fad since it is now recognized that dogs need essential omega 3 fatty acids. Unfortunately, these fatty acids have a very short shelf life (a week maybe?)and so dry dog food is not a reliable supply for these fats. Adding large amounts of a very strong anti-oxidant (ethoxyquine, which was developed as a pesticide and later found to be excellent for preventing the oxidation of latex rubber)is the only way to keep fish dregs (i.e. "fish meal")from becoming overly putrid. If you don't have a good preservative, then your dog ends up eating rancid fats which are also toxic. Solution: feed a natural diet of real food. If you still want to feed kibble, buy one that does not contain ethoxyquine and fish meal, then supplement your dog with human grade fish oil capsules. Also, don't fall for the flaxseed gimmick either. The short chain omega 3 fatty acids in flaxseed are not converted to the essential long chain fatty acids that high food chain mammals need. Dogs do not have the enzyme to make the conversion (ruminants do and so do krill!)

column9: Coffee for people that don't like coffee  (Edited)
column10: I tried this coffee months ago and should have reviewed it sooner, but I've had a difficult time deciding how best to describe it. The title of my review probably sums it up best. This is coffee that is utterly inoffensive in every way. It's the opposite of bold. The roast is light. The flavor is extremely mellow, so mellow in fact that when this coffee is used as the base for a milk-based coffee drink like a latte, the flavor recedes into the background so much that it almost seems to disappear. Don't misunderstand, it's still readily identifiable as coffee, but...well...I'm still struggling with how to describe it.Think of it this way. This coffee can be brewed full strength with a very nice body and mouth feel to the resulting cup, and yet still have the kind of flavor profile that people who drink their coffee very weak (as in "Hey, shouldn't you put some coffee in your coffee?") might prefer. I don't mean that there is no coffee flavor, just that the coffee flavor is not bold, not robust and not the least bit assertive. Very mild. Almost meek. It's good coffee, but it's perplexing coffee.If you want a coffee that you can serve to people who don't like dark coffees, bold coffees or coffees that are just bursting with robust coffee flavor while preserving the ability to brew full strength for body and mouth feel (which in this coffee is downright silky), this is the stuff. The flavor is so submissive that it won't overwhelm anything.Most coffees I've ordered from Amazon have been good enough that I have ordered them again. I have yet to reorder this coffee, but at some point I am sure that I will, probably when I know I'll be needing to serve coffee for people who don't really like coffee. If that's the kind of stuff you're looking for, then I can recommend this without reservation.On edit (May 3, 2011)...I wish I could make this four and a half stars rather than just four. The last bag I ordered really grew on me as I learned more about the coffee's flavor profile and how to best make use of it.  I now use this coffee as a base for blending with other darker roasts and find that it provides a really creamy mouth feel and balance. When I want darker, I add more dark roasted beans. And when I have company I use a higher proportion of the Panama Boquete and sometimes nothing else at all.If you're a person that makes homemade ice cream and you're looking for a coffee to use as a flavoring base, this is the stuff. (I pull shots of espresso and add that to the ice cream mix. My lady friend stops by to help churn and it all gets devoured post-haste.)If you like red-eye gravy but don't want any bitterness, this is great coffee to use. (For those that don't know, red-eye gravy is made by pan frying slices of country ham and then adding a cup or so of coffee to the pan drippings. Serve with biscuits or grits or even sop it up with toast. Yum!)As I said in other reviews of coffees I have ordered, the highest compliment I can pay is to re-order. I re-ordered this coffee today. So there you go...

column9: Smooth coffee for a good price
column10: Having tried and purchased high elevation coffee from the heart of Panama itself while traveling abroad, I've been looking for a home alternative to relive this taste (only brought back enough for a few weeks when I was down there!). I found this coffee to be smooth and tasteful when prepared properly. As drip coffee I have enjoyed it more than most beans I have tried up to this point, but still is not on par with the high elevation coffee I purchased in Panama for almost half this cost (however, 10x this cost if bought in the states).If you are use to a dark roast, this bean won't satisfy your coffee desires. If you enjoy a true arabica experience, you may want to look elsewhere, but it could be worth a try. If you enjoy a more "blended" taste than local arabica, with a medium full bodied roast, I highly recommend this coffee. I have come from all the styles of Lavazza and Illy, have purchased many variations from Dick's Coffee, and Coffee AM, and have ordered many varieties from local roasters. For this to get 4 stars is worth checking out. But again, know the style of beans you're going into. This is not a pure arabica, this is a medium roast with full body. I use this for Drip Coffee / French Press Coffee / Espresso / Cappuccinos. Give it a shot, if you like it you'll love it, if you don't like it, you may just hate it! But if you enjoy Illy medium roast, I will say this is VERY comparable minus that unique arabica taste (and $31 per lb price point!).

I have paid over $50.00 per pound for Panama Boquete. In fact, La Esmeralda beans from this region can go for $200! I'd prefer a slightly darker roast, but this is a nice medium-light roast. Never bitter, even when I brew double strength for iced coffee. This is a great all-purpose coffee.
This is really an excellent coffee. Nice clean flavorful taste. As it is somewhat lite tasting, I find using a little more coffee and grinding it coarse heightens the flavor.
This coffee is everything you could possibly want: fair trade, organic, already ground and delicious. We use it at my office and everyone loves it.

column9: Far Too Acidic to Be Marketed
column10: I've tried several variations of this company's coffee and, every time, the product was far too acidic to have ever been considered acceptable for marketing.  There is no flavor really other than the acidity.  We did not finish any of them - we threw them away.I would like to add here that, when it comes to "gourmet" or "specialty" coffee, I hope that the companies attempting to profit in this sector wake up and realize that the customer base interested in purchasing such coffees actually knows coffee, and we aren't being fooled by this kind of sad attempt to sell us garbage.  Please, if you want to market good coffee, then find some, rather than just relying on terms like "organic" and "fair trade" and "grown someplace Third World but hip" or whatever.

column9: Excellent Choice For Organic Coffee - Fresh and Good
column10: After reading a couple of bad reviews, I was hesitant to try this coffee. I am so glad I decided to try it! Wow so fresh and good!! Don't believe the bad reviews, I think they are posted up by rival sellers!! This is simply good coffee at a good price! and besides, if you don't like it, you have 30 days to return it! Amazon is great for that!!! Give it a try!!

I wanted to like this coffee as I appreciate the fair trade and organic policies of the company. However, I had my doubts from the moment I broke the seal on the can and there was no coffee smell whatsoever! There is hardly even an aroma when it brews! Drinking this, the coffee tastes stale and bitter with not even a remote hint of what a good cup of coffee should taste like.Perhaps their whole bean might have been better, I don't know. I got this for those mornings when you wake up and just don't want to take out the grinder and go through that process. Okay, I learned my lesson - it was a mistake!
The coffee is foul tasting and cannot be returned. The coffee maker used seem to make no difference. Lesson learned Amazon.

I have been buying this coffee for the past year.  It has a good overall mild flavor, just short of full-bodied without hints of being too weak.  No bitterness. Having the empty cans is just an added bonus. However, if the price continues to rise, I will start to consider other brands.

If you don't like strong coffee, you probably won't like this. I thought it had a very good, rich flavor. I don't care much for Columbian or some dark roasts, but I thought this was good. Will buy again.

I am surprised at seeing so many mixed reviews for this coffee. I buy it weekly at my local grocery store and absolutely love it. It is by far my favorite. I don't know how other people could say it's too acidic since one of the reasons I enjoy this coffee so much is because it is so mild and easy on my stomach. I've never bought it through Amazon before but I don't see how the quality of the coffee would be any different than what I've experienced buying it in the store. Unfortunately, the 3 pack deal on Amazon isn't any better than what I would pay locally for three individual cans of this coffee so I won't be bothering to order it here.

We like this brand of coffee. I get the ground stuff for my shop because it's easier to deal with. I think this brand's whole bean is better but then what company's bean isn't better than it's on the shelf ground?

I  thought this would be like the coffee I used to buy at my local health food store, but it isn't even close. It is bitter, has an unpleasant odor, and is only a little better than the grocery store brand that you find on sale. Don't waste your money, I wish I hadn't. If you get it on sale as I did, the price is fair, but otherwise, pass.

column9: Weird taste..Good smell as it brews
column10: I was excited to get such a good buy on this coffee. It didn't taste good to me. I am accustomed to Costcos coffee and this was bitter and an off flavor.Would not recommend to others...Wasn't horrible but was not like other fair trade coffees I buy through my church.

Dear Twizzlers. Just stick to your original recipes and flavors please! You've already ruined my favorite chocolate, and these are even worse, leaving a nasty aftertaste in your mouth reguardless of which flavor you eat. The texture is NOT Twizzlers, I don't even know WHAT  it is anymore....

I love Yorkshire Red tea, so I thought I'd give their Earl Grey a try.  It's a pretty good Earl Grey, less bergamont and flowery flavors then some others.  I prefer Tazo or Twinings, but Yorkshire Earl Grey is not bad.

If you are looking to make an Alfredo dish, whether it be chicken, shrimp, or both; this is the sauce that will make your stomach crave for more. This sauce is perfect in taste, when prepared right. I've been making my Alfredo with this Four Cheese Knorr Sauce for about 5 yrs now. And my family and I absolutely love it. The key to making it to perfection is to whisk the milk and the Knorr sauce mix together really good. I actually use Almond milk instead of regular milk to give it a sweeter taste. But anyway, you will love it. Give it a try, you will not regret it.
It's a great project, my daughter has been using this for the past 3 years and even though it's expensive it works for us...

This sounds so yummy, but when I tasted it, I didn't like it at all. Has weird pungent taste and it lingers. Since my kid eats some things that I don't care for, I gave him these and He hates them too. We tried it on many occasions and mixed in with other fruit mixes. It makes good stuff taste bad unless you use very little. I got a 12 pack ..and we got done with 3 after a lot of cajoling. The rest is going in the trash
My 8 month old loves this. So happy to see the teachers at day care reports that he eats most of this whenever I pack this for him
I love these because they aren't as sweet as all the other ones. My son loves them too. He chugs them down in 30 seconds.  They are easy to cap and easy to carry. Can't ask for anything more!

Baby Gourmet is a really great product! My son loves it (and I do think it tastes good too)! I always find that those products are too sweet (same for fruit pouches from HappyBaby or Plum), so I mix it with plain yogurt.

My son loves these little fruit packs and I love that they are veggies and not just fruits. However, I am not always a fan of the price. so while they are delicious and healthy I only buy them when they are on sale.

You haven't eaten oatmeal until you've eaten Holly's Oatmeal.  It is so different from what you buy in the grocery stores.  It has WONDERFUL texture and flavor.  My daughter loves it, too.  In fact, I sent her a 5 pound bag of the assorted flavors as a thank you gift for having me over for meals so many times.  She was delighted.  It's almost like dessert!!

i would never buy these for my children. too expensive and too delicious to waste. the strawberry is the best and though this company makes fancier biscuits in a more adult flavors, I prefer the simplicity. it is the way an English biscuit is supposed to be.

Let me just say that this tea is about average. I feel like the tea wasn't made to high standards, but then you have the fact that they're whole leaves. I think this creates a weird situation where you have a bad product of high quality. I'm a supertaster, so I will describe the product as best as I can. It has your typical oolong bass notes, but the higher notes are very grassy (sometimes oolong is sweet, bitter...etc etc etc, this is grassy). It has a fair balance between bitterness and boldness. Incase you aren't gathering what I'm trying to say... it's a very neutral flavor and doesn't really 'wow' me at all.
