The grassy flavor taste exactly like wheaties cereal (no frosted).... and that sounds stupid but when you try it you'll instantly make the connection.So, in conclusion it's a plain tea that I won't really hold up high on my tea shrines, but it does have one last unique quality. It taste odd, but I can't stop drinking it. It's like raman noodles... you never say "man I can sure go for some raman", but when you are actually eating raman you make sure you eat every last noodle. It's like that.12/10/11 EDIT: After drinking a few of these, I can say that it's a great tea to drink without anything added. I normally add sugar to most of my teas in some way or another (honey, sugar, guava), but I find that this tea is actually really good without anything added. I'm not going to officially change my 3 star rating, but I am tempted to bump it up to 4 stars.

I really love these! Compared to the veggie mix, these are of more substance. The veggies are good too, but very small pieces to snack on.  The corn has a great taste and I love the crunchy texture. No hard kernels like you find in popcorn!  Yum! I need another deal to have a reason to buy more soon!

If you are looking for freeze-dried sweet corn, you won't find it here.  This item is basically half-popped corn, coated in oil.  It is not sweet.  It tastes pretty much like popcorn.  Though advertised as low in fat, it contains 7 grams of fat per 28 gram serving.  I'm not even sure that this product has been freeze-dried, like other Crunchies products.For freeze-dried sweet corn, I'd suggest Just Corn.  Admittedly, I haven't tried any other brands.  However, it is leagues better than these Crunchies,  which I am now stuck with 12 packs of.
Crunchies Freeze-Dried Corn Snack, 3.25-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)Delicious and crunchy!  Gluten free!
It is exactly what I was looking for and have been searching for since a local market quit handling something very similar. I wish that I could purchase it locally.

column9: Good, but not what I'd hoped.
column10: Was trying to find a suitable substitute for the Minesota kiln-dried corn or Pueblo Dried Corn which chef Dean Fearing uses on his Red Jalapeño Caesar Salad with Shrimp Diablo Tamale.  This product - while good quality that does not over promise - doesn't quite fit the bill to this foodie.

column9: Great taste and the probiotic part turns out to be true
column10: I first tried this tea at a friend's; she had a collection of herbal teas and this one sounded interesting (I didn't even notice that it had probiotics). The tea had a wonderful scent of lemon and ginger that I really, really enjoyed. And it was delicious!The same friend dropped by a couple of weeks ago with a box of this tea and I've been drinking it every night ever since. Now I'm down to the last two bags so I came here to see if Amazon carried it and I'm delighted to see that they have it on Subscribe and Save for less than the sale price at my local supermarket.Now, about the probiotics. I really thought it was just a marketing scheme, but no, it isn't. I did some research and learned that the probiotic Bigelow uses is "GanedenBC30" and, if you do a search on that (go to the Gardenlabs site, the company that patented this particular probiotic strain), you'll learn that this probiotic survives high heat, stomach acid and enzymes, the manufacturing process, and is shelf stable. Look it up, there are many sites with  good info on this.Here's an excerpt from GanedenLabs: "Ganeden's probiotic strains are pure, precise, patented strains of Bacillus coagulans that provide superior viability compared to other probiotic bacteria. Ganeden's premier strain, GanedenBC30 is patented, has been proven effective in dozens of human, animal and laboratory tests, is self-affirmed GRAS, Kosher and a non-GMO. Plus, with hundreds of millions of doses consumed, GanedenBC30 has a proven track record of safety."Then I went to the Bigelow site and watched the video they have about their herbal teas, where they talk about how they developed this product.Now, does it work? Well, I've only been taking it daily for a couple of weeks (and only once a day -they recommend two cups per day) and, though I can't say it has had a noticeable effect on my digestion, I do find it soothing and I agree with one of the reviewers here in that this tea promotes a more restful sleep.

This is the best tea for me ,you don't have to add nothing like sugar or honey because the flavor is fabulous with the ginger and lemon. Help me with de digestion and to sleep better, I almost drink it every day.

Took a trip to Florida recently -- my brother got sick and wanted a nice tea so his wife found this..........OK it won't cure brochitis (you need anti-biotics for that) BUT I got hooked on this tea --it tastes great and has been helpful for my gut issues. And it is a lovely hot cuppa for our cold New York days and nights. I'm sure it will make a good iced tea in the summer! Give it a try --
I love the flavor and health benefits of the tea.  The product seems to be affordable for the average consumer.

This tea has a pleasant balanced taste, not very "lemony". It is not sour, and ginger does not stand out either. Not sure if probiotics have any effect. Likely no, especially given the high temperature it gets subjected to. In any case, it makes for a pleasant drink. I think we can manage the 6 boxes with no problem.

My husband and I both love drinking this delicious tea every night. It is a fond ritual to brew a couple of cups, and sit together sipping this great tea. It is very soothing for the stomach and the mood.

This is my least favorite of the croccantini's; in fact, i dislike it period.  The taste is difficult to describe, but for a cracker I have found it compliments nothing.  I would never recommend this particular variety, but the other flavors are great.  I am too embarrassed to give as a gift with wine and cheese so I suppose I'll throw away.

This is a fantastic tea. Love the peach flavor. Smooth, tasty AND organic! I'd buy it for the scripture alone, but the fact that its such high quality tea from a company that cares makes it the best buy, and a great one to support.

column9: Scriptures are incredible! Makes a SUPER tasty gift
column10: Thank you Shepherds Garden for a great product! The scriptures are well chosen, thoughtful. It really makes a perfect gift and accompaniment to quiet time (or any time!) As for flavor, compared to celestial seasoning's (non-organic) country peach passion, Shepherds is has soft peach tones and a more earthy flavor. Unless you're not a peach person or avid tea lover you should love it. It's organic too, which is VERY important for tea, and being a white tea it also contains less fluoride if that's a consideration for you. I got 5 boxes directly from their site for my mom, grandmom, sister, and friends this Christmas (great to pair w/ homemade breads or coffeecake!). If you don't think you'll dig peach they have a chai that's truly superior to any chai I've tasted, cranberry is good & unique, and peppermint just rocks (free samples at their website too...). No, they're not flavored with crazy artificial chemicals, sweeteners, non-organic leaves, and colorants. But I LIKE THAT! And for goodness sake they're Bible verse teas! How cool is that?!
This was the worst peach tea I have ever had in my life. I threw the box in the garbage and could not even drink it.

I've been feeding my cats Tiki Cat's fish-based cat foods for a while, so when I saw that Tiki Cat also has chicken cat food I just had to try it out, and I am very glad I did. Although my cats would be happy to eat nothing but fish for every meal I try to feed them a balanced diet with protein from chicken, lamb and beef as well. This is a very nice chicken cat food: each of these tiny cans is jam packed with chicken shreds that look tastier than most canned chicken intended for people to eat (though as I am a vegetarian I haven't tried eating this food myself :-)This chicken is certified delicious by my two fussy felines, who ate up everything I gave them and then begged for more. And as an animal loving pet owner I am very glad that the label of each can makes it clear that no dolphins were harmed when they rounded up all the chickens. I only hope they managed to keep the whales out of the chicken farm as well.
THIS PRODUCT WAS DELIVERED FASTER THAN EXPECTED, SO I HAD TO WAIT TO PURCHASE THE ADDITIONAL INGREDIENTS. MY CHOCHOLATE TASTED GREAT WITH THE MIX I MADE.

My wife is a gourmet cook. She often needs spices and oils not easily found here in San Diego. Most retail outlets, even specialty shops cater mainly to southwestern and/or Latin American cooking. (we live only a few minutes from the Mexican border) She wanted to make something that had this spice as an ingredient. In the city of San Diego, this spice was hard to find. When we did find it was prohibitively expensive and it was only one ounce.We ended up purchasing that small amount and having that dinner party. However, we looked online and as always Amazon came through. We found cardamon of superior quality and in generous amounts for a price that was more than reasonable.  We got nearly 4 ouunces for less than the price we paid one 1 ounce.

I found this coffee at Costco online for 42.00 for 2 bags of 2lbs each.  I had to go to decaf and wanted to elimate the chemicals while I was at it.  Amazon needs to check why the big price difference.

column9: Is this price real?  Great, great coffee but -
column10: We have used Ruta Maya for years and love it!  However, it doesn't cost nearly as much as in this listing.  Google it!  I have seen this kind of outrageous price on other Amazon listings - and there will often be other listings with lower prices here, for the same item!

I purchased 2 bags from a compeditor for less than half the current listed price & it's well worth the extra money spent (over regular beans). The price has gone up a few bucks since I purchased back in October but it's still a bargain. The aroma you smell when filling your grinder becomes a great tasting brew that won't keep you up at night! It's also strong enough to drink in the AM if you happen to run out of your favorite regular beans!  Highly recommended!

column9: Fabulous flavor (doesn't taste decaf) but don't buy 1 bag here for $42!
column10: You can buy 2 bags online for $42 if you just search it.  But, I love this decaf coffee!  It is bold but not bitter and not smoky.  It really hits the spot if you have to switch to decaf and you are a bold coffee lover!

The first time I looked for a dark roast decaf I found the product supplied by Costco at a cost of approximately $40 for two kilogram bags. When I reordered he product showed as discontinued. I searched by brand and description and was shown the product as an Amazon product. I ordered and received one bag for the same price. That is ridiculous.

I purchased this as a surprise for my bacon loving chocoholic wife on her birthday. I was skeptical not being lover of bacon and chocolate that she is. Much to my surprise this was VERY good. I never knew 2 flavors seeming so different could work so well. It was not overbearing of either flavor. A fun treat to bring out when a lot of people are around to see the reactions as well.

I got a 6 month cheesecake order as a gift, and the first cheeesecake arrived packed in dry ice.  It was frozen and tasted great after a night in the fridge.The second cheesecake arrived spoiled.  They did not ensure rapid delivery of the cake and the dry ice melted while the cake was in transit.  When I called the company and asked for a replacement, they said that would be impossible, and that I would have to pick another product.  I asked to speak to a manager and the manager acted like it was my fault that the cake spoiled in transit, and said I was lucky that they were willing to give me anything.I've ordered other month clubs from other companies in the past, and never once had an item spoil prior to delivery.  And on the very rare occasion a product arrived damaged, other companies were very willing to make it up to me.  Amazing clubs made it very clear they had no interest in customer satisfaction.

I love these pinto beans. Prior to soaking them I always put them in a strainer but unlike most pinto beans bought in bulk, there's never any foreign objects that need to be discarded. I appreciate the package size. To prepare. I cover them with water (about 3 inches over the top) in a pot, cover it and let it soak overnight. In the morning, discard the water (it can be used for watering your plants) and, if making a whole box, add 6 cups (3 cups of liquid for every 8 ounces of beans) of water, or broth, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 90 minutes.They are delicious and highly nutritious (you probably already knew that). Of course, that they are organic, also makes them even more appealing, in my mind.I've purchased this product twice (total of 12 boxes). I've used ten of the twelve boxes and the quality is consistent.Buy and enjoy with confidence.

Outstanding product, but not enough of it. I appreciate the dedication of those organic product producers, I understand the obstacles placed before you, getting your products to market, and the competition of automation. Thank you and continue your approach, the world is slowly recognizing that something's you can do successfully, only one way.

column9: So much better than non organic
column10: I love these beans, they cook better and taste better than the non organic ones and this is a GREAT price.I also like the box that I can recycle with paper. And I like having the beans sit in the box rather than a nasty plastic chemical bag.

We ordered the Eden Organic Pinto Beans, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6) and Eden Organic Black Beans, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). The quality of the beans is great, in my opinion...and of course I love that they are organic...but as another reviewer said - I thought the beans were out of date. I THOUGHT they were out of date, but after contacting the company though edenfoods.com I found out that the dates are just confusing on the packaging. When I saw "Best Before: 12DE07" I figured they expired December 12, 2007. The customer service representative that contacted me said the first two digits represent the year...meaning my beans are good until December 07, 2012. Good to know!And the contact on edenfoods.com was responded to quickly...I had an answer within half of a day.I'll be buying these again!

These are Eden brand dried black beans.  They are very good quality.  I have used this brand of dried beans quite a lot over the years.  They are very clean for dried beans. If you buy dried beans in bulk from a natural foods grocery, you will find more dirt clods and rocks than are in these.  How many clods are in the dried product is not a problem for me, but one of the other reviewers appeared to be horrified that they were in the beans.  Please, this has always been true of dried beans, some have more than others.  These have VERY LITTLE. But you should ALWAYS pick over dried beans and then wash them in two changes of water.

I have been buying Organic when possible. I ordered these beans from Amazon . I found that I am tasting the bean instead of the chemicals that are in regular beans. They are excellent! . Will not buy anything but organic beans again. Very good!!
If you want a good pinto bean you can not go wrong here.  Made some great tasting chili and organic too!

My family likes beans.We also like organic beans.Avoiding GMO is important to us for reasons relating to evil giant seed companies and the potential for health issues that we're not yet aware of.YMMV (your mileage may vary = you may have another opinion)Additionally, these seem to be fresher and cook up better than most you might pick up at your local grocery.
These Pinto Beans are very Good.  The Pinto Beans are good for you and have a great taste.  Loads of vitamins.  You can mix with their navy beans and have them as a soap or for re-fried beans.
Much better the other brand I got (can't remember what it was called,but had a squirrel on it.)

column9: Agave Nectar Sticks - Two Thumbs up!
column10: These are great to carry in your purse or backpack.  I love Agave Nectar in hot and cold tea. It dissolves totally, and has a wonderful taste.  It's low glycemic to boot!Two Thumbs up!
Love,love,love these sticks.  So sweet, handy, and available on line at Amazon.  I used them in chocolate delites and I was delighted with the results.  Thanks.

Not the right dimension to make a decent egg roll.What you need is an 8" wrap, or 22cm. They aren't easy to find but most local Chinesemarkets have them. This size wrap makes what you would call a snack roll, you reallycant fill them properly.Dynasty is a good company and I've used their Hot Mustard for years. These wraps do workand they hold together pretty well with nothing but a little egg wash. If you've neverventured to make your own egg rolls its time you try, its very easy. And with Chineserestaurants cutting back on portions i.e. $1.50 for a Air Roll, making your own will bemuch more rewarding.

Michocko are a favorite French candy - dark chocolate with a hard, chewy carmel center. Everyone I know loves these candies, and it's nice to know they are available in the States. Highly recommended!
I originally got these candies from a relative who was in Paris. Subsequently, I bought them while in Paris. They are a delicious chocolate candy, perfect for a fast chocolate fix.

My daughters and I discovered these candies more than 15 years ago, and we have bought them each time we have been in France.  I am so happy to be able to order them here now - no matter the cost!  They are delicious and so uniquely different, and they arrived in just a few days! Shhh!  Let's keep these our own special secret!

I am French so I have known the Michoko candies for a very long time. I actually grew up eating some when having a treat.Do you like caramels?Do you like chocolate? Dark Chocolate?Then you should love these candies.Order these and get a taste of quality!On the other hand, Damn these French products and their outrageous prices! Eating them outside of France is like a luxury... Come on... In these days and ages? How expensive is it to ship it from France? Does it justify a markup of about 100% ?Anyway, enough with this rant... I distributed some around at the office when receiving my order and everyone loved them.

Wonderful product Michoko Caramel Candies From France, 100 gr 3.5 oz bag, Six.  When we lived in Paris many years ago, we became addicted to them but they have not been available in the U.S. until recently.  Ordering was easy, they came very quickly, they were packed securely, service was wonderful, and my wife and I shall certainly repeat order from this store, Touch of Europe.  As for the dark chocolate covered  caramels, my wife and I love them.

I recently bought a bag of Michoko Carmel Candies when I was in Paris as a gift for the girls I work with. I wish that I had opened the bag and tried one before bringing it back to the US. This candy is fantastic and had I known this I would have brought home a suitcase full.  My co-workers loved them and the bag was gone before noon. I must now order them and have them shipped. If you like dark chocolate and caramel try a bag of Michoko Caramel Candies.

Finally a food all 3 cats love, including the one allergic to chicken protein. Only problem is that she loves this dry food more than the wet food with extra water that she also needs to eat. [I did try soaking some of this dry food in water but she said eeyew.]

column9: Larger pieces.  Makes them chew it.
column10: Because they have to chew it up, less barfing.  Have also noticed less stinky poop.  The cats seem to love it also, and I have six.  A little spendy is the only fault I can find with this product.  It is the same price in the local feed store, but they don't keep the stock up.  With free shipping from Amazon, just as easy to get it here.

This food is so great, my cat's coat has never been softer. I've fed my cats all natural food for the last 10 years and this is one of my favorites. It also seems to be my cats favorite too. I rotation feed them so they get something different every time, and as soon as I put this in the bowl both my cats had their heads in there trying to get some. This stuff is great for any cat, sensitive tummy, allergies, etc. Try it, your kitty will thank you for it.

The regular coconut milk - I've had a bunch of cans of it and they're all the same - is roughly a third to half coconut fat or butter that is solid at room temperature but easily melted at low heat in microwave or pan. The rest of the can is a somewhat viscous milky fluid. This "lite" version has none of the solid fat. It is all the milky fluid. Presumably it has FAR less fat.Ingredients listed are "water, coconut milk, guar gum". I'd rather there were no guar gum but please note the manufacturer has refrained from adding sodium metabisulfite. Some other brands of coconut products add that in order to keep the product white. But Google it. Sources claim that sodium metabisulfite is actually poisonous. I'm not a chemist but prefer my coconut milk unadulterated and thank this company for giving us a relatively pure product.I recently made a dish, I think it is a pudding kind of thing, using this lite version. I cooked a cup of well-washed millet in 3 cups of lightly salted water for 40 minutes, removed from heat and immediately folded in a half cup of confectioners sugar, a third of a cup of almond meal, a whole can of this lite coconut milk and a half teaspoon of cinnamon. Stirred it well. It tastes good (to me) warm or cold and I can really taste the coconut flavor. I like a dish of it topped with dried sweetened cranberries and a dollop of whipped cream (sinful and so easy from the spray can).
I visited family in Germany last year and fell in love with Rahmschnizel.  This is just as I remember that yummy sauce.
Almost taste like black tea. Very nice tea, but what is better than other tea is that this Pu-erh tea doesn't upset your stomach like black or green tea does to me.  I am glad to have found this tea.

Don't waste you're money buying this case folks... it adds up to over 33 cents a package. You can buy them idividually at Amazon for only 25 cents, & many online & local stores are selling them for 11 cents each.

column9: Herr's Baby Back Ribs Potato Chips Keeps It REAL!!
column10: Like MANY Others, I've Grown WAY Too Accustomed To Eating Flavored Snacks That Don't REALLY Taste Like The Food They're Trying To Emulate, Like Pizza, Steak, Tacos, Nachos, Etc. So It's Such A JOY, When A Flavored Snack Nails It Right On The Head; And That's EXACTLY What Herr's Has Done, With Their Baby Back Ribs Flavored Potato Chips!!Herr's Baby Back Ribs Potato Chips 8 oz (Pack of 3)From The Very 1st Bite, They REALLY Taste Like Baby Back Ribs, Starting Out Sweet, Then Coming "Back At Ya" With A Spicy Kick.I Actually Grabbed A Bag Of These At My Local Military Commissary As A Lesser Evil Choice, When I Couldn't Find My Usual BBQ Chips In Stock.Well, I Just Finished That 1st Bag Tonight; But I Assure You, It WON'T Be My LAST!!

Just when I became hopelessly addicted to Herr's Heinz Ketchup-flavored potato chips, along comes this new flavor meant to emulate the the sweet, yet subtle smoky flavor of barbecued ribs. There's honestly no way to put into words how good these chips are. They're just the most delicious-tasting BBQ-style chips I have ever tasted, with Lay's Potato Chips, KC Masterpiece BarBQ, 1 oz, 50-Count (Pack of 2) coming in at a close second.What's particularly great about these chips is that unlike so many other popular  brands (*cough cough* Wise *cough cough* Pringles), Herr's doesn't short change its customers with a light dusting of seasoning. Its chips are always doused in powder, ensuring that you get a shot of flavor with each and every bite and plenty of it to lick off your fingers when you're done. So I can't recommend these highly enough-- unless, of course, you're on a diet, because you'll totally blow it if you even so much as take one nibble.
First time ever trying these chips and they honestly and truly do taste like baby back ribs. They were good and I would purchase them again.
Good stuff ! It really tastes like baby back ribs, and its not too salty like other barbecue chips. I would say that its just right.

Im telling you, these are THE best tasting bbq flavored potato chips ever made. Im very picky about my potato chips, but I tried a bag of these one day that I picked up at walmart, and they blew my mind! They taste JUST like bbq'd baby back ribs! They are delicious! Only problem is, I only got 1 bag, and now I cant find them anywhere!!

I didn't buy these from here, I bought them from a local store.  The chips I bought had a different style packaging but I imagine they are the same chips.  They are delicious.  I can taste a meaty type flavoring to these that really makes them Baby Back Rib flavor and not just a BBQ flavor.  I wish I could find these in more stores and in a bigger bag.

column9: The most flavorful easiest pasta to make
column10: This is the best pasta mix ever.  I make it according to the package instructions and then add parmesan cheese to the final dish.  Delicious!  My daughter insists I make extra so she can have the leftovers for breakfast.  If it doesn't have enough olives for your taste - just add extra when preparing it.  I've gotten the best results when I make it with regular spaghetti pasta.  There's also a Green Olive Pesto available - I can't tell the difference between the two - green olive or black olive - both are terrific!

Although this product was tasty, I had hoped the olives would have been visible. Found only a few olive crumbs in the mix. I needed to use two packets for 8 ounces of pasta as per instructions. Would not recommed for a large crowd. Don't get me wrong, we did like the product. I was fooled by the packaging as it shows round sliced black olives. I will add my own olives to the mix with the remaining packages.
When you follow the cooking directions it's excellent. If you don't cook it into the pasta the flavor is ruined

Wonderful product. I used to get it in the grocery stores, but now they don't sell it anymore. I was overjoyed to find it online.  This is better than any pesto sauce because you feel like you're making it yourself, and it's extraordinarily easy to make. You can make it with just a tad of water, and it goes with anything on which you like a pesto flavor. I used it as a base sauce when making my own flatbreads and pizzas. It goes great over a simple pasta. The recipe on the back works perfectly.  It isn't too salty. I'll bet there are many more possible uses for it (like roasting nuts or something like that). I highly recommend this item.
These crackers are great!! They are good as a snack and really good in soup! Not small like most oyster crackers! We had them in a restaurant and had to buy some for home!

I love oyster crackers for soup but could not find good crackers that were not too brown, until I got the Westminster crackers with my soup at our local Hilton Garden Inn.  I decided that I had to try to get these crackers so went online and found them on Amazon.com.  They are delicious and my friend loved them too so I had to share half my box with her.

I am a lover of fine goat cheeses.  While I like my cheeses strong and pungent, I like my crostini plain and boring.  I am spending the big bucks on the cheese, and I don't want the cracker to interfere with the taste.  I have sampled many crostini and I think Isola Olive Oil are the best.  They are plain and unflavored, except for a bit of olive oil, and they compliment my cheese perfectly.I recommend these highly.

column9: Wonderful Assortment for 1st time Keurig Owner!
column10: I love all kinds of coffee and am so pleased with the assortment this purchase has offered me!  I received 35 cups total, NO DUPLICATES!  15 different cups of what I consider "regular" coffee; 5 brands of decafs; 9 different samples of flavored coffee; 2 varieties of black tea; 1 milk and 1 dark hot chocolate; 2 types of apple cider.  I am very pleased with the variety and look forward to a different treat each morning!

Although I never heard of most of the brands included in the variety pack, I thought it would be fun and a good experience to taste such a wide variety of coffee. I probably will never buy most of them any any quantity there were some that stood out. I am pleased with the product and glad I ordered it.
I didn't expect so many flavored coffee cups. I would like to have a Krazy Kup package with no flavored ones.

column9: Lots of variety in flavors, but not in drink types
column10: Ordered direct from Amazon and got exactly what was promised - 35 different cups to try out and sample. My only complaint is that the product description lists several manufacturers and drink types (coffee, tea, iced tea, cocoa, cider, etc) yet the pack I got was heavily loaded with Green Mountain Coffee, more than half of the cups. Yes, different flavors or strengths, but same type of drink and same brand. Just wish it would of been a bit more even with the coffees/teas and not so loaded with Green Mountain (GM). 27 coffees (15 of which were from GM), and 8 "other" types of drinks.Good assortment to bring into work as there will be something for everyone to like, but like I said, just wish it was a little more even in the breakdown - or that Amazon offered a sampler of either "only coffee" or "no coffee and only teas, ciders, cocoas".Complete breakdown of what I got:5 decaf (1 Newmans Own, 4 GM) - perfect for my pregnant coworker1 half caff (GM)1 iced tea (Celestral Seasonings)1 regular tea (CS)2 apple cider (Grove Square)3 cappuccino (GS)1 hot cocoa (GS)4 extra dark/bold (GM)4 flavored Gloria Jeans (hazelnut, butter toffee, mudslide, french vanilla supreme)2 GM flavored coffees (southern pecan, caramel vanilla cream)1 Kahlua1 Donut Shop coffeeand 9 various other 'regular' types of coffees from GM and other brands.

column9: It was ok.. Not really that great.
column10: I thought this set would be a bargain. But sadly many of them wouldn't even brew, coffee was clumped most likely exposed to moisture. A few others were mostly empty. Only a few we're actually drinkable.

column9: A nice way to try many brands of coffee.
column10: This is a great way to try many different drinks available for the Keurig without buying a whole box of each type.  Nice way to figure out which ones are your favorites!

While the concept of an asortment is wonderful, we were not too happy with ours. It's a gamble to order this assortment. Many reviewers had similar complaints. I think a company should come up with a way for us to choose our own assortmant. It's awful to pay for something that you will most likely not use or worse yet, throw away! So while not a huge investment here, I'm not certain we will order this again.Our order came from Kitchenista. The assortment did arrive loose in a box, none damaged. Here's what we recieved:0 hot chocolate ( we were looking forward to these!)5 teas13 flavored coffees5 decaf coffees2 espresso7 dark coffees3 ligt coffeesSo for those who love just about anything, this may work for you. For those of us who look for specific flavors, this may not be such a great deal.
Good coffee,  will buy this again. K cups are expensive but this was a good deal. I have ordered several times on te Internet, this was the best yet

I didn't think to count to see if they were all there. Might have to check on that when I get home. About 70% I had never seen in stores or even heard of before which was cool. I liked some of them a lot and wished there were duplicates, but there weren't (as advertised). They didn't come in a box which I thought was weird. They were in a plastic bag. No worries cause we just put them in a large bowl. I like the variety. But it would be nice if they had a variety pack with like 3-4 of the same kind.

You shouldn't listen to the reviews complaining about repeats and selection.  I took the risk and ordered this and I got 35 different K-cups.  I got 2 teas, 2 ciders, and TONS of delicious coffee options. Bolds, flavors, a couple decaffs... and they are not expired.  Just order this.  I will be.

I read all the reviews and decided to take a chance on this. I only received 34 k-cups instead of 35(seems like this is a common complaint). Not that big of a deal I guess. I did get a good variety, and only had a few decaf (which is a good thing). However, there are four or five of them that when shaken, sound like most of the coffee grounds have leaked out or something. Not sure what is going on with those, but I'll try them and see what happens.Overall it was a decent deal.

I read the reviews but decided to take a chance and purchase this Sampler K-Cup Portion Pack. I was not disappointed! Great variety and no duplicates. Coffees, teas, hot chocolates, ciders and even a few limited editions.

column9: Good selection but more Decaf would've been nice...
column10: I liked most of the flavors and bought it so we would have a good selection for guests but I wish there were more decaf ones. We only had one in our whole box and decaf is great to have.

I purchased these coffee's which arrived in good time.  Nine of the coffee's I received were not usable as they were not full K-cups, some were almost empty.  This was highly disappointing.  I also should have paid more attention as many of the products received were not "coffee"  I would not purchase from this person again.  Receiving nine (9) unusable coffee's is not my idea of a good product and not a good use for my money.

column9: Wish there was a no-decaf sampler!
column10: This was a great sampler. It was exactly what was advertised-35 different K-cups, no duplicates. I loved it. Not too many teas, cocoas or cappuccinos, although I do wish I could order one of these with NO decaf cups. I have no use for those!

When I shook the coffees, 5 sounded like clumps as opposed to fresh coffee inside so I threw them out-They have probably sitting on a shelf for a long, long time to get that way.  Plus they did not come in a box but in a brown paper bag, like someone just thew whatever inside the bag.  Would never buy from this Vendor again

Not pleased with the selections.Brooklyn k-cups had no exp. dates. Several K-cups have less than 3months b/4 Exp. dates. The 2 apple cider K-cups when shaken sounded like stones inside, these I threw away. I will never order your samplers again.Carol Jordan

Received quickly, 35 different flavors, NO repeats.  (I would have liked to try a few more of the teas, but I can't complain, since MOST people order for the coffee).  No complaints, even if I don't like some of the coffees, that is why we order samplers, is it not?

Mostly decaf very disappointed in variety  was pretty awful. The price for 35 k cup variety is great but the variety is bad. Would not buy again ever. The package mostly cocoa decaf and cider. If your looking for mostly coffee find another variety pack. Have gotten packs a few other times on amazon and paid a little more, for sure will pay the extra because this felt like a waste and will throw must of the bag away.  Shipping was very fast with the prime account though but overall a very poor experience.

My friend recommended ordering this sample pack and after reading the reviews I was a bit hesitant, but I'd like to figure out what brands/flavors I am going to like so the assortment was the best choice. I did receive 35 cups, no duplicates at all. This is a great assortment! I even received 2 ciders, 2 hot chocolates and one iced brew tea. I will order this again!
What more is there to say? It arrived on time and was as described. It came with several different varities and all of it was really good.
I recieved this product within a reasonable amount of time. It had the amount of cups that was listed. Very good selection of variety of coffee and some tea. None of them were the same.
I just bought my Keurig and its a lot of fun to have a mix of all different products to try.

column9: Too much fluff, not enough bold from Amazon
column10: My fault...I should have just bought a box of bold coffee. I found not enough good strong, pure coffee, and a lot of teas, cappachinos, weak artificially flavored coffee, and hot chocolate in this mix.I guess, what I really wanted was a Bold Coffee Mix.
I would have preferred coffee without all the exotic flavors.  I enjoy plain coffee in different roasts, i.e bold, extra bold, medium roast, etc.  I probably won't purchase this item again.

Ordered this several months ago and was not happy with the 'variety'.  This time though I did not have a single duplicate.  24 coffees, 3 decafs, 3 caps, two cocos and the rest tea.  I haven't checked the expiration date on them yet.  Shipped very fast, ordered late Friday night, arrived Monday morning.  I would like to see them dump the Grove Square coffees though, I personally do not like the taste of them and the just feel cheap.

35 flavors, no duplicates.  Was an excellent price but I see now it is $4 higher which is still less expensive than many.  You will be disappointed if you think they are all coffee and are only the premium brands and if you expect fancy packaging.  You are getting a discount bin but they try to have no duplicates.  I loved it.

column9: Variety includes some second rate K-cups
column10: Ok, for the variety I knew this was the grab bag of K-cups. What I didn't know but get it now is that the Grove Square K-cups are really awful. They are like a rock of hard substance like a bouillon cube in K-cup packaging. Gross. Cheap. And my mix contains quite a few of them. I ordered coffee K-cups from two vendors and to compare, they came in the same package from Amazon but the ones I am reviewing were in a plain brown bag closed at the top while the other was in a nice sealed box inside a box for freshmess. If the Grove Square product was omitted from this mix I would rate it higher but not by much.

I went ahead and ordered this product despite the small cluster of negative reviews.  Overall I was happy with the selection that I received.  I got 35 different K-cups of a reasonable variety (some coffee- caf and decaf, some tea, some other).  I would recommend this as a general sampler pack both for the price and the variety.  HOWEVER, with that said, approximately 1/3 of the products I received were expired (by 4 months).  Until this particular issue is resolved, I can't recommend this product for purchase.
Excellent product! I recived 35 different cups with no doubles. Love the variety! The product came in a brown paper bag within the box. All cups were intact. I will reorder!!

I got this product damaged, amazon was great about replacing it. What was undamaged was mostly coffee, I wish there was more then just that. I am happy of the great selection just wish there was more tea/coco.
I expected an assortment of coffee, but there was much more that anticipated in that there was alot of tea. I enjoyed them all and just need to remember the ones I liked the most :-)

I ordered this sampler, it states 35 K cups, got 33.  The assortment is OK, a lot of plain off and decafe coffee K-cups.  Would have lke to see more flavors in the mix and would have like to have received all 35 cups as listed.

I also bought this giving the company the benefit of the doubt, but was disappointed.  While I had a decent variety of hot cocoa, cappucino, tea, and even cider, there were only 3 true flavored coffees.  And I received about 15 bold/intense blend coffees with no flavor, just different makers.  To me, that isn't real variety.  And I'm not going to drink them so it was a waste of money.  I do realize you always take a chance when ordering something that clearly tells you it's up to the distributor so I fall back to that, but I agree with the other reviewers.  If you are looking for flavored coffee variety, this isn't it.

Exactly as the description says, this is a MIX.  I got everything from coffee, hot chocolate, iced teas, hot teas, decaf, etc.  Great way to try 35 different cups. Sure there were a few I wouldnt want, but thats what friends w/Keurigs are for, right? :)
I sent this as a gift to my son.  He liked it.  A nice variety and chance to try out different brands and flavors. A few teas also.
I love the assorted K-Cups!!  It is a great way to try out different flavors without having to buy a box of one flavor not knowing if you will like it.

column9: Exactly what I expected and wanted
column10: I got this before I got my keurig because a few of us at the office pitch in for the machine at work. I got my box super fast. The exp date is in dec which isn't bad because 35 cups should be gone by then. I was expecting the brown bag but got a box marked coffee instead. I'm ok with that. I had all 35 cups and no duplicates. In all I had 4 teas, 2 hot chocolates, 6 flavored coffees, 2 cappuccinos, 1 iced coffee, and 1 decaf, the rest was a nice variety of roasts and brands. I really can't complain and will order again. I get easily bored with the same coffee so this really helps me a lot. Thank you.

I've ordered this selection of Kcups twice.  Very pleased with the selection.  A great way to try 35 different flavors.  I don't see a problem with the paper bag they are shipped in.  The cups go right into my carousel anyway.

This mix of drink mixes is a good starter kit to figure out what you like. I wasn't sure what I was looking for and it was a good mix for my wife and I. I prefer the darker stuff and she likes the lighter stuff. We both found what we like it here. Plus, it comes with some iced-t and hot chocolate.

Sampler was EXACTLY as described. I enjoy flavored coffees so this was just the ticket! I received 35 fresh cups of differing product: Coffees - flavored & regular, light roast, medium and dark.(all good brands as well) Even got a sweet cappucino which was excellent. Not too crazy about the teas but my daughters enjoyed them.(only received about 4 of these so not a big deal) I get tired of the "same old thing" so this is a great way to try something new without buying a whole box. It is also one of the cheapest for the amount. I did not mind the paper bag it came in. It was packaged well and I plan to purchase this again!
Items came in brown paper bags.  had a good mix of different brands of coffee and tea.  i wished there were more coffee and less tea.
Awesome variety of flavors, coffee, decaf, tea, hot chocolate. My work also orders this variety pack pretty frequently, we love it. Great product.

I bought this after the office bought a new coffee machine, figuring that I'd prefer to buy my own k-cups rather than pay $1/cup for whatever flavor they had that week. This was a nice way to try a bunch of flavors at once, at the price is good (equivalent to buying a box of any one flavor on Amazon). I didn't get any repeats and most of the k-cups were good quality. A lot of it was from Brooklyn Bean Roastery and Wolgang Puck. A few cups were slightly smushed which isn't too surprising considering they came in a brown paper bag. Overall, a happy customer.

This was my first purchase of this K-cup sampler. I Bought this sampler for our work Keurig. It came quickly thanks to Prime and Prestige Delivery Systems (who were awesome). It was just like description. 35 cups; no identical cups; most look "popular"; cups were in good condition and clean. The only minor negative (maybe half star off) was that a couple were expired or close to expired.Coffees:Donut House CoffeeDonut House Chocolate Glazed DonutFolgers Lively ColumbianKahlua OriginalGreen Mountain Caramel Vanilla CreamGreen Mountain Southern PecanGreen Mountain Dark MagicGloria Jean Butter ToffeeGloria Jean HazelnutTully's Kona BlendTully's Italian RoastGrove Square Caramel CappuccinoCoffee People Donut Shop CoffeeCoffee People Black TigerBarista Prima Italian RoastRevv PulseCaribou Caribou BlendTimothy's EspressoEmeril's Big Easy Bold Big Easy IntenseHot Teas:Celestial Lemon ZingerCelestial SleepytimeTwinings English BreakfastBigelow Green TeaCocoas:Swiss Miss Milk ChocolateCafe Escapes Dark ChocolateGrove Square Dark ChocolateIced Bevs:Green Mountain French VanillaGreen Mountain Nantucket BlendCelestial Sweet Lemon Black TeaCelestial Black TeaDecafs:Green Mountain Hazelnut DecafGreen Mountain Half-CaffTully's French Roast DecafNewman's Own Special DecafOther:Naturals Hot Apple Cider

Wanted to try a bunch of different types of coffee when I first got the Keurig coffee maker so I could see which one I liked and which one I didn't.. Can never tell until you try them all.. Can't take other people's word for it, you have to try it for yourself, especially something so special as that first cup of coffee you have in the morning!!!!
If this is your first time with a Kuerig coffee maker, I would recommend getting the variety coffees and teas to determine what you like. I chose my preferences from it and it was a great help.

column9: Great variety, could have been shipped in a box
column10: I ordered this for my new Keurig with the hopes to find a brand, flavor I liked. I received a brown paper sack with 35 k cups. I will say that there was a fantastic variety of coffee, decafs, teas, and even a few varieties of apple ciders. I know a few other people were irritated with the decafs and teas but I dont mind them. All in all, for the price (I paid .60 cent per k cup) its a cheaper way to find out what brands and flavors you like. My only complaint was that they came in a brown paper sack. I ordered other items that came in a larger box which I suppose made shipping easier. I had to find alternate storage.

column9: Fantastic!  This is what a variety pack should be like.
column10: Keurigs are stupidly expensive and even though I got my machine for free, I feel like I'm flushing money down the toilet with this coffee.  What's even worse is that I'm really curious about different flavors and brands, different kinds of dark roasts and other varieties.  This sampler set is fantastic because not only does it really have 35 different K-cups, it also offers a really unique selection.  You don't get the typical Green Mountain varieties, I got Island Coconut, Mocha Nut Fudge, Southern Pecan and a few other unique flavors.  You'll even get some brands that you may have not heard of, like Brooklyn Bean Roasters.  This makes a great gift for you or someone who has a Keurig and really wants to see what else the company offers.

In my order I ended up with about 2/3 coffee, 1/3 other (cider, hot cocoa, tea).  So far they've ranged from good to great, and I've found a few flavors to order more of in the future.  I've been enjoying having a wide variety of choices when I go for a drink.  We put out all the cups in two big bowls in the kitchen which are gradually emptying out.
For our very first K-cup purchase, these have been terrific!  A great assortment of coffees, teas, and hot chocolates for all tastes and moods.  Good price, too!
Not a lot to say except it was a great coffee and I am pleased with the price and product.

Okay, getting past the strange packaging (a stapled paper bag inside a plastic bag inside a box), I found the contents, undamaged, fresh, and the loose k-cup count correct.The variety was interesting - there was no duplication, mostly brands and varieties I have seen readily available (the interesting newcomer was Brooklyn Brewery) - a nice balance between flavored and 'traditional' blend coffees.  There were about 4-5 teas (I ordered 2 samplers), and one hot chocolate in each sampler. 4-5 decafs in each.  The overall variety in each sampler was similar but different as well.I am very pleased with what I received and at .60/cup, that's a good deal!  And now I can try some types I have wanted to without making the major investment (chocolate glazed donut house, green mountain island coconut, wolfgang puck sorrento).I would buy again.

These arrived in a brown bag and had a big assortment of coffee, decaf, tea, iced tea and iced coffee. Lots of different brands I'd never seen (Rev, Brooklyn) and lots of familiar ones (Donut House, Emeril, Gloria Jean). Nothing was past due and most expire at the end of 2012 or in 2013. A few were things I'm not sure I cared about-decaf Earl Grey tea for example-but I'm pretty sure SOMEONE at the office will drink it. Great price for them, nice variety, shipped fast and nothing stale. However, if you're looking for a more specific variety (like just coffee and no decaf or tea) you might be disappointed. This is the best price and most variety in a K-cup package I've ordered.

I was hoping for a gold mine, but I thought it was decent enough for the price.  The variety was better than I had gotten in previous sets. It could be much worse!  I was hoping for a bit more variety in the types, but what I got was good.

column9: Three were empty;several looked expired and old.
column10: I could not believe actually received samples that were empty and some that looked like there were 5 years old-BUMMER

I read many of the reviews of this product before purchasing.  I have to agree with many of the other reviews.  The product did come in a brown bag, which I felt was a little haphazard, but ultimately ended up being okay (none of the coffees were damaged or anything).  More importantly, there were only a few duplicates, but there were SEVERAL coffees from the same company/brand but with different roasts/flavors.  I would guess that out of the 30-something coffees sent, 15 were the same brand.  Although, it was nice to see how this one company/brand has many different roasts/flavors, I really would have preferred to get a much wider perspective on many different brands and roasts.  However, for the most part, I was fairly satisfied.  When I am wanting a variety of different coffees, I will try this product once more.

column9: Great collection of a variety of coffee flavors
column10: Bought this as a gift for someone who just got a Keurig coffee maker and it was the hit of the birthday party!!  Great selection of different types of coffees.

Disappointed with pack---heavy on Brooklyn brand coffee (I don't like-not good coffee) & multiple mediocre brands of the same bold or medium brew.  Very low on flavored (only 3 pods) -not even 1 hazelnut-and too many premade "coffee drinks" with the hydrogenated fat creamer (high trans fat -YUK-not real coffee), iced coffee (with corn syrup or trans fat"creamer" - another YUK) or presweetened tea (a corn-syrup laden YUK to me).  Very few good brands (WG Puck & 1 Newmans Own pod being exceptions)- I gave away about 1/3 of the pods after opening the pack.  I have had better luck with Timothy or Gloria Jean variety packs.  Not for true coffee lovers - will not order again.

column9: Great variety for new Krieg owners
column10: Wonderful variety for new Krieg coffeemaker.  Lots of variety to choose from.  Some fluffy coffees, standard coffees, teas, hot chocolate.  Great variety.  Lots of variety in the coffee companies as well.  Gives us an idea what to buy next.  Thank you.
I was very pleased with this product. Had a great assortment of coffees teas and hot chocolates. Would order again without hesitation.

Very pleased with my order. Yes it came in a brown paper bag, but everything was fine, nothin was punctured or ruined. I also did not get two of the same type of coffee, tea, apple cider, or hot cocoa. I love being able to try many different brands and flavors. Each morning is something new and its a little excitement to your hum drum morning cup o' joe.

column4: Sara Free-Bird "Try and you will know"
column10: alot of tas in here and  idont like tea, and i got an EMPTY CUP, 33 ot of the 35 where kosher for those of yuo wondering

Of the 35 k-cups, none of the dates that I saw were expired. All were at least 3 months out in the future. There were:- 28 caffeinated coffees- 1 decaf- 3 teas- 1 apple cider- 2 hot chocolatesThere was a good selection of brands. I was slightly bummed to get 5 that were Grove Square, as to me that's lower end quality. Overall there were only a couple exotic flavors, so most of them were just various roasts.- Don't buy it if it's a gift, at least not if you want nice packaging. If you want it for yourself, the brown bag didn't bother me and not a single cup was dented or open- Don't buy it if you have your heart set on certain brands or flavors. You won't necessarily get what's advertised here or in your ideal amount. But if you're flexible and just want to try some different flavors without buying boxes of each, this fits the bill!
This is a great assortment we love it!  Always a few new ones plus old favorites! Nice job! I have ordered this twice already and will again!

The sample pack is a good way of selling product.I have sample them all and like them all there not one that I don't like and have over $200.00 worth of K-Cup coffee that I have bought from Amazon and different stores. Love the K-Cup keep up the good work.

column9: too much tea/decaf and reg brew :(
column10: of the 35 K-Cups, there were 5-6 Tea and another 5 decaf.  There were very few flavored coffees, just various types of different brews.  This is the 3rd sample pack I have purchased and I am most displeased with this one.
The variety in this package is excellent, I do not like a lot of bold/extra bold blends - so I would notorder it again.

I got this today. it was very badly packed, and seemed like the coffee cups were just randomly thrown together.It was in a brown paper packet, stapled at the top (delivered to me in a cardboard box, though).I haven't been able to sort all the coffees cups, but hope I wont be as disappointed by the 'Variety' of the coffees' as I have been in the presentation of the same.

The good thing about this is there were no duplicates.  The bad part is, they were still all very similar and so far I haven't particularly enjoyed anything I've tasted.  Bitter and rather stale tasting frankly.  And my biggest issue is the fact that of 35 packs, only 5 were flavored.  We were hoping to discover something new by ordering 35 packs and it turns out that most of them are just bold coffees.  I already get that with my Sumatra k-cups from Starbucks.  I would definitely not purchase this again and would not recommend it.

I was a little apprehensive reading some of the other companies reviews on the random selections.  It seems that some come with multiple duplicates and bad variety.  Well these folks delivered a great product.  I ordered two 35 pack boxes (in case one might be better than the other) and there were zero duplicates in either box as well as only a few decaf.  That is exactly what I was looking for.  The selection was excellent, if I had any small complaint, it was the two boxes were almost identical.  But that is not to detract from the quick shipping and me being a very happy consumer.  I will definately continue to get these, I would recommend them highly if you are looking for a good variety of good coffee.

I read the poor reviews and was concerned about ordering this coffee mix.  Several reviews complained that it was not a "mix."  I was very pleased when I receive my order.  I did not get duplicate coffees.  The ones by the same maker were all different flavors and it was not full of decaf or tea.  I only had 3 teas and didn't see a decaf.  The seller may be reading reviews because I was very happy with my order.
Terrific selection of available makes and taste. Now I pick my favorites for future purchases. The price is lower than I could find at a store.

This package gives you a nice variety of coffees but not such a great variety of other products. I expected more hot chocolate, teas and ciders in this variety pack. (If I wanted so much coffee I would have ordered the coffee variety pack) You receive only 3 hot chocolates, all from Cafe Escapes. What about Swiss Miss or a white chocolate variety? The tea variety was OK but still based on the size of the pack I thought I would be getting more of a variety. Only received 1 cider, why not a regular and spiced? Overall I liked it, just not loved it.

As other reviewers have already mentioned, this 35-pack arrived packaged in a brown paper bag. The packaging must have been incredibly well-stapled (and protective of the K-cups!) because I had a heck of a time opening it with just my hands.I knew I was taking a bit of a risk by ordering a variety pack, so I was quite pleased with what came.Hot CocoaDark Chocolate Hot Cocoa (Café Escapes)Milk Chocolate Hot Cocoa (Grove Square)Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa (Grove Square)CappuccinoFrench Vanilla Cappuccino (Grove Square)Caramel Cappuccino (Grove Square)Hazelnut Cappuccino (Grove Square)Apple CiderCaramel Apple Cider (Grove Square)Spiced Apple Cider (Grove Square)TeaEnglish Breakfast Tea (Bigelow)Mint Medley (Bigelow)Green Tea (Twinings)Southwestern Sweet Black Tea - Iced (Celestial Seasonings)Iced CoffeeSweet & Creamy Regular Coffee - Iced (Donut Shop Coffee)Decaf CoffeeThe Original Donut Shop Coffee - DecafFlavored CoffeeIsland Coconut (Green Mountain Coffee)Chocolate Glazed Donut (Donut House)Kahlua Coffee (Timothy's)Butter Toffee (Gloria Jean' Coffees)Southern Pecan (Green Mountain Coffee)Coffee/Coffee BlendsColombia (Barista Prima Coffeehouse)Brooklyn Bridge Blend (Brooklyn)Fuhgeddaboutit (Brooklyn)Cyclone (Brooklyn)Colombia (Brooklyn)Sorrento Medium Roast/Extra Bold (Wolfgang Puck) x 2Chef's Reserve Colombian (Wolfgang Puck)Pike Place Roast Medium (Starbucks)Rodeo Drive Blend (Wolfgang Puck)The Original Donut Shop CoffeeFrench Roast (Green Mountain Coffee)Sumatra Kopi Raya (Wolfgang Puck)Newman's Special Blend/Extra Bold (Newman's Own Organics)House Blend/Extra Bold (Tully's)Daybreak Morning Blend (Caribou Coffee)In a perfect world, I would've gotten at least one more decaf coffee to offer my pregnant sister when she visits. However, I do say this gets 5 stars because I got exactly what I ordered: a nice variety pack for my new Keurig. Only one coffee -- the Wolfgang Puck Sorrento Medium Roast -- was doubled.I'm looking forward to trying all of these new drinks!

as the reviews were varied.  But so glad I did.  I got my stapled brown paper bag today and must say I am very happy with the selection I received.  A few flavored teas, Hot Chocolates (dark and milk), couple different apple ciders, even 1 Iced coffee. A couple cappuccinos, very good combination of coffees (mild, med. and bold), most of which I would of picked myself, nice assortment of flavored coffees and only 1 decaf.  Expiration dates were at least a couple of months away but most were into next year. All n' all, I am extremely satisfied with this assortment and can't wait to start trying them out.

Wanted to sample a variety of different coffees & teas before purchasing a big box.  Received 3 hot cocoa, 2 cider drink mixes, 3 cappuccino, 4 teas, & the rest are various types of coffee.  The brands include: Wolfgang Puck, Barista Prima, Brooklyn Bean Roastery, Donut House, Donut Shop, Starbucks, Kahlua, Caribou, Gloria Jean's, Green Mountain, REVV, Tully's, Newman's Own, Grove Square, Cafe Escapes, Celestial Seasonings, & Bigelow.  Received very quickly.  And the K-cups do come in a paper bag, but the bag is inside of an Amazon box.  If it was wrapped in plastic, the flavor of the coffee might be affected.  I am very happy with my purchase & will order from this seller again!
No duplicates, With great varieties! Now I know what to buy in a box, Highly recommended ! A must buy for coffee addicts like me that is looking for the best coffee flavor K Cups!

As new Keurig users, we wanted to try a lot of different types of drinks before we bought any full packs. This is a great way to do just that. We got 35 cups and one 1 repeat. About 25 of the cups were coffee types, then the rest were a mixture of coffee, cider, and tea. Very happy with our purchase!

I just got a Keurig about a week ago and was overwhelmed by all the choices I had for K-cups.  Luckily, I found this deal.  I, too, was concerned that I would get a lot of duplicates, but after reading the reviews, I thought, "What the heck...Nothing to lose.  Even if I get 35 of the same thing, I'm still getting a good price for K-cups."  Well, needless to say, I didn't get "35 of the same thing."  Here's what was shipped in my bag:1  Green Mountain Island Coconut1  Green Mountain Southern Pecan1  Donut House by Green Mountain: Chocolate Glazed Donut1  Revv1  Starbucks Pike Place Roast - Medium1  Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee1  Caribou Coffee Daybreak Morning Blend1  Timothy's Kahlua Original1 Coffee People Donut Shop1 Coffee People Donut Shop Decaf1 Coffee People Donut Shop Sweet & Creamy Regular Iced Coffee1  Celestial Seasonings Green TEA with white tea1  Celestial Seasonings Lemon Zinger Herbal Tea1  Celestial Seasonings Perfect Iced Tea Half & Half Black Tea and Lemonade1 Tully's Coffee House Blend1 Nermans's Own Special Blend1 Cafe Escapes Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa1 Bigelow Mint Medley Herb Tea2 Wolfgang Puck Sorrento Medium Roast Extra Bold1 Wolfgang Puck Chef's Reserve Colombian Dark Roast1 Wolfgang Puck Rodeo Dr Blend Medium Roast1 Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya Dark Roast1  Grove Square Hazelnut Cappuccino1  Grove Square Caramel Cappuccino1  Grove Square French Vanilla Cappuccino1  Grove Square Spiced Apple Cider1  Grove Square Caramel Apple Cider1  Grove Square Milk Chocolate Hot Cocoa1  Grove Square Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa2 Brooklyn Cyclone Extra Bold Dark Roast1 Brooklyn Boardwalk Blend Medium Roast1 Barista Prima Colombia1 Barista Prima French RoastI only received duplicates on 2 flavors.  I'll take that deal any day of the week.  Once I finish making my way through these, I may "spin the wheel" again and see what other flavors I end up with.  I would definitely recommend this product.  If you are a new Keurig owner, this is a fantastic way to hone in on what your new brew will be.  And even if you've had your Keurig a while now, this is a great way to spice up your morning coffee routine.  :)
This is a fun way to try a variety of flavors and brews.  The price makes it possible to try flavors I would not have purchased as boxes of single flavor.
Received and the shipment only contained two duplicates. Very please with this purchase. This is an excellent way to try various types of K-cups.

I'm sure the K cups are fine and a matter of taste like most flavored things. This selection came in an ordinary paper bag stapled across the top with ordinary office staples.  No identifying label - definitely no frills.  I only mention it because a box would have been nice and it immediately pointed out the reason they invented K cup drawers and carousels.
I liked this one better cause it had all the flavored coffees in it. Theres alot of them and there are alot of name brand ones also.

column9: It REALLY depends on who does the shipping on this
column10: I've ordered this sampler twice: 1 from the Coffee Mix - LOVED their selection, absolutely NO repeats and shipped in a white box.  2nd from the Sampler King, a few repeats and some off season stuff.Honestly, I didn't pay close attention to expiration dates on either since I personally find that many products (especially coffee)"expire" before there's really any effect on the taste.Overall though, I've been happy with both shippers as they both offered a good variety of mixed coffees which allow this K-cup newbie to narrow down what I like.Update:  I ordered yet again and it was Sampler King that sent my 3rd order.  I was much more disappointed with the selection (a LOT more repeats and off season stuff).  I wish Coffee Mix was a bit cheaper or offered Prime Shipping again.  They truly had no repeats and an amazing selection.I've also ordered from CTech and just like Sampler King, they have no repeats and include a great selection.

column9: Great variety at a great price!!
column10: I received my sampler pack today and I was very pleased with the assortment I received.  My husband and I have very different tastes in coffee so this sampler pack will serve us well.  I received:-9 flavored coffees (4 special editions)-14 regular coffees-1 hot cocoa-6 teas-6 decafsFlavor wise we only got two duplicates which is fine by me because I love french vanilla.Some people are really turned off by the brown paper bag packaging but it didn't bother me.  It reminded me of the grab bags I used to get at the 99 cent store when I was a kid.I'm already working on trades with my co-workers for the flavors I don't think I will like.  Goodbye Pumpkin Spice, hello Raspberry Truffle!

I bought this product because it offered a wide selection of cups. Upon arrival I was impressed with the selection. There was a nice range of coffee and coffee with flavors. There was also some tea, hot cocoa and iced drinks. I was able to try to the tea and iced drinks without having to purchase a lot of the same. I did not have any repeats and I felt the price was good when comparing to the others. Overall if you a looking for a large selection of cups I would recommend this as a good way to try different options with your keurig. I had no issue with the seller I used and it was shipped quickly and arrived without issue.

I was nervous about buying a sample package because we aren't big fans of the extra bold coffees but I didn't want to buy another pack of one kind and have the same 20 cups in a row.We received the package today and it was in a brown bag that was stapled at the top (that bag was in another box since we ordered something else too) but all the cups were in fine condition.  There were 35 different cups and surprisingly there were only a couple extra bolds.  None of the cups were expired and most had months before the did expire.  We got a lot of Grove Square (7-8) and Wolfgang Puck (4), Green Mountain (4) but the rest were pretty varied.  We got hot chocolates (we already had those and they were tasty), ciders, flavored coffees, teas, regular coffees, cappuccinos, and I think one is actually an energy booster or something (Revv?)and a couple of specialty/seasonal coffees.I would definitely order this pack again and recommend it if you aren't too particular about what you are looking for and just want to try a bunch of different cups.

Price wise it seems a pretty good value for a sampler.  Sampler packs usually cost more per cup than single flavor packs but I'd rather buy an initially more expensive sampler pack than waste alot of money on a single flavor pack and hate it  Actually it is a "unique" sampler.  Every k-cup was different and most were from a variety of brands. Use by dates are a good 5-6 months away. They were packaged loosely in a cardboard box and all the cups were intact.  I've found a few already that I'll be ordering later. Donut House Cinnamon Roll coffee and Barista Prima Italian Roast were quite good for their categories so far.

column9: Great variety at a good price!
column10: I just received my order today.  As noted in other reviews, the K cups came in a stapled brown bag.  However, unlike the previous review, all the K cups were clean and undamaged.  None of them were expired, and the earliest expiration was in mid-August .... plenty of time for my family.  I was so pleased with the selection in my bag!  Here are the details:12 regular coffees10 flavored coffees (including several limited edition flavors)3 hot teas3 cappuccinos2 iced coffees2 decafs1 iced tea1 ciderand 1 hot cocoaI love that I have the opportunity to try so many different brands and flavors.  If I am looking for a variety pack in the future, I will definitely order again!

"35 Different K-cup Flavors" - we received some duplicates, and were missing some we were looking forward to (Hot Chocolate & Apple Cider).  We were happy with most of the selection, and very disappointed in what we did not receive.  This helped us to determine which ones we will buy next/again. Some are strong coffee, others the way we like it :) . For a sampler, this is good, but packing is not consistent with advertisement (all different).

Wish I'd gotten this sampler pack when we first got a Keurig. It's a great way to sample different flavors of coffees and teas. And true to the seller's word, there are indeed 35 different varieties included. Will purchase again!
I had great luck with this one. No more than two of the same flavor and one two decaf. I was very happy with this selection!

After reading reviews for other variety packs, this one had the best reviews so I went for it. I am very pleased with the selection! I only received 2 decafs (and one half-caf), then also received about 4 teas, 2 iced coffees (which I was excited about), 2 cocoas, and the rest were regular/flavored coffees. I'll definitely purchase this pack again.

I was pleasantly surprised with the variety offered in this bundle. Many different manufacturers and K-Cup types were included. My main goal was to try a bunch of different types of available K-Cups to find some new ones I liked and I achieved this goal.The packaging was a brown paper bag stappled shut inside a shipping box and everything was in tact. My only real issue was that there was one duplicate in the "Guaranteed 35 Different K-cup Flavors". There were two of the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend. Overall though, I'd order again.

The Coffee Max Fabulous 35 K-cup Samples, was one of the best buys I have made in a long time. There were only two that neither I nor my husband would drink. But 35 flavors to try was great and undoubtedly prevented some purchases we would not have been happy with along with some, I never thought I would like that I enjoyed very much. There would be little reason to buy it again for myself, but would certainly consider it as a gift for anyone with a Keurig type coffee machine. I am 65 years old and would never, ever have considered making iced coffee until I got this selection then discovered several of the blends are good as iced coffee.

column9: I've give this more than 5 stars, if I could!
column10: This was awesome! I got 35 different flavors of kcups, with mixed flavors and brands.Here is a rough breakdown off the top of my head:I got 5 different Celestial teas1 hot chocolate5-ish decafs7-8 varieties of regular coffee (different strengths including "Jet Fuel")and the rest were flavored coffees. Some of the highlights were Butter toffee, cinnamon roll, blueberry, french toast, too many to list!Most of the kcups expire in December, which is plenty of time to drink them.There were a few seasonal ones (Pumpkin, Eggnog, Gingerbread) that expire in August, which is a little bit of a bummer, but I guess it's to be expected because those are seasonal ones. I'm still glad I got them, so I can try them to determine if I want to order whole cases of them this winter.I will definitely order again!! I'm really happy with it!

I am from Trinidad in the Caribbean and ordered this item thru my skybox. After reading all the negative reviews, I was a bit skeptical about ordering a variety pack.  I still decided to order this one in particular and (so far) it turned out pretty decent! I have 35 completely different flavours including the Apple Cider, Pumpkin Spice, Iced Coffees etc. I just received my shipment today in acceptable packaging , haven't tried any of them a yet so this review is positive up to this point. Let's hope when I actually start to use the k-cups, I will not regret this positive review.

column9: Which one do I try first???
column10: My order came today. I am delighted!  Very speedy shipping, not a duplicate in the mix of coffee, decaf coffee, tea, iced tea, cocoa.  I saw what one person said about the packaging being just a brown paper bag.. so what?  The product is wonderful, and I took them all out of the bag anyway!  I would (and probably will) purchase this item again!

I was happily surprised when the package arrived 2 days after I placed the order. The K-cups were in a brown paper bag inside of a box no cups were damaged, all were in date! The variety was good with NO duplicates and it's an inexpensive way to try different flavors. The only down side was my daughter was really wanting a cider as the description promised but there weren't any. We aren't hot tea drinkers and luckily there were only 5 teas. I would order again without any hesitation!

column9: Believe the other reviewers: NOT AS DESCRIBED
column10: I saw the negative reviews for this product, but decided the positive outweighed the negative and it was worth a chance. Think of it just like that - a bit of a gamble. Maybe you'll get a good mix, maybe you won't. Maybe you'll get 35 cups, maybe not. I got 31 cups and they were not all unique - some were duplicates. All that said, the cups that I did get included a nice variety and there are several flavors that I had wanted to try and I am now getting to do so. I wish my mix had included more coffee and a bit less cocoa, but I feel like I totally signed-on for that gamble. I did, however, expect to receive the number of cups advertised.I waited to do my review because I contacted the seller and was hoping the situation would be corrected, but it's been nearly two weeks and I've had no response.

Considering we have a new Keurig machine at our house we wanted to try a variety of coffee/tea products.  Instead of buying 4 boxes of flavors we opted to purchase this "variety" product.  After reading quite a few reviews on Amazon I was skeptical on purchasing a "variety" pack thinking I wouldn't truly get a "big variety."  However, this sampler says you are "guaranteed 35 different K-cups" and they are right-we recieved all different cups, hot chocolate, caramel apple cider, flavored coffee, non-flavored coffee, iced tea, chai tea and decaf.  Some were even "limited edition" flavors.  I will buy from this company again-wonderful supply!

Here's what I received:36 Total instead of 35... YAY!17 Green Mountain +4 Donut House by Green Mountain:Vermont Country Blend Lake & LodgeVermont Country Blend (x2, but the extra is a freebie)Mocha Nut FudgeCaramel Vanilla CreamFrench VanillaHazelnut NoisetteSouthern PecanHOT COCOADouble Black DiamondOur BlendVermont Country Blend DECAFBreakfast BlendNantucket BlendDark Magic Magie NoireColombian Fair Trade SelectWild Mountain BlueberryDH: Coffee/CafeDH: Cinnamon RollDH: Chocolate Glazed DonutDH: DECAF/DECA1 Revv2 Gloria Jean's:MudslideButter Toffee1 Caribou Coffee, Caribou DECAF Blend2 Timothy's:Cranberry Green TEAWhite TEA Orange Indulgence2 Emeril's:Big Easy Bold Big Easy IntenseJazzed Up DECAF (Best Used Before Date: 2/25/12)4 Coffee People:Jet FuelBlack TigerDonut ShopDonut Shop DECAF3 Celestial Seasonings:Mandarin Orange Spice Herbal TEA (Best Used Before Date: 1/21/12)Green TEA with white tea for smooth tasteSleepytime Herbal TEA (Best Used Before Date: 2/6/12)I would have preferred more of brands other than Green Mountain since those are the only Kcups I've used thus far, but I am happy with my assortment. Only 3 were past or very close to their Best Used Before Date. I plan on buying this deal again.The Kcups were packaged in a brown paper bag with the top rolled down and stapled and then that bag was placed inside a plastic bag which was so helpfully labeled that the plastic bag is not a toy. ;) My box was rained on before I could retrieve it from my doorstep, so I do appreciate the protection of the plastic and don't resent the waste.I haven't sampled any yet, so I can't comment on the flavors yet, but wanted to get this review out the same day I received my package so that customers can see what they will most likely receive. No old, holiday clearance bin Kcups in this assortment!  :)

I was leery about purchasing a variety pack because there had been a lot of negative reviews about duplicates and boring selections for the other variety packs available on Amazon. I took the chance, anyway, and this purchase was exactly what I was looking for.Inside there were 35 different flavors, as advertised, including about six teas, two hot cocoas and six flavors of decaf. Yes, there were a lot of flavors from Green Mountain and Tully's, but there were also some really cool flavors from Coffee People and other brands, as well.I was expecting the package arrive in a box, however, it came in a brown paper bag that was simply stapled and shipped. Everything arrived in good condition, though, so who am I to complain.If you're looking for a true selection of 35 different flavors, this one is the one for you.

Dislike this assorment of K-cups; came in brown paper bag more like someone purchased coffee and all that they disliked they resold.  This was more a mix of teas not coffee.  I will never buy from this seller again.  Mix did not include any Apple Ciders and few I would say approximately 5 k-cups of coffee the rest was teas and decafs.  Hate this assortment.Lydia,

My husband is overseas and wanted to surprise me with a variety of coffee to try as I recently purchased a Keurig coffee maker. This order arrived in a brown paper bag stapled together with an expiration date of 8-23-12 written on it (it's almost June so not much time to consume these!). I was hesitant to even open the bag it just seemed a little strange to pack K-Cups this way (another order he sent me through a different seller came in unopened BOXES). I opened the bag to find DIRTY K-cups inside! Gross. There were crumbs of some sort stuck around the rim of a few cups. A few more felt hard as rocks as though they had been exposed to moisture somehow. I was completely taken aback. It seemed as though someone picked through the flavors and threw all the ones they did not want in this bag. Lots of decaf coffee, teas, one hot chocolate and a few other random coffee's I have never heard of were included. Needless to say, I will not be consuming any of these due to the packaging as it did not seem sanitary.

I read the previous reviews for this K-cup variety pack and I was skeptical, but wanted a good selection of coffees for my new Keurig so I decided to just order it. I received it today (7/19/12) and I am NOT HAPPY. I mean the selection was good for the most part, but most of the cups were EXPIRED or very close to being expired (within a month or two).
