This is what I received:Timothy's: Parisian Nights - Best Before Date (BBD)3/21/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Morning Blend - BBD 3/29/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Italian Blend - BBD 4/12/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Decaf Rainforest Espresso - BBD 1/19/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Rainforest Espresso - BBD 4/3/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Breakfast Blend - BBD 3/26/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Peppermint Tea - BBD 4/24/12 EXPIREDTimothy's: Chinese Green Tea - BBD 6/23/12 EXPIREDEmeril's: Jazzed Up Decaf - BBD 7/11/12 EXPIREDWolfgang Puck: Sorrento - BBD 7/11/12 EXPIREDTully's: Italian Roast - BBD 7/3/12 EXPIREDTully's: House Blend - BBD 7/17/12 EXPIREDGreen Mountain: Hot Apple Cider - BBD 7/13/12 EXPIREDCoffee People: Organic - BBD 5/1/12 EXPIREDGrove Square: Caramel Apple and Spiced Apple (2 k-cups) both were rock hard solid when shook, Expiration date unknown, but UNUSABLEWolfgang Puck: Creme Caramel - BBD 9/7/12Wolfgang Puck: Hawaiian Hazelnut - BBD 8/18/12Wolfgang Puck: Vanilla - BBD 7/24/12Wolfgang Puck: Jamaica Me Crazy - BBD 7/26/12Newman's Own: Special Blend - BBD 8/29/12Timothy's: Kahlua - BBD 9/11/12Caribou: Colombia - BBD 9/11/12Green Mountain: Golden French Toast - BBD 10/22/12Green Mountain: Spicy Eggnog - BBD 8/28/12Green Mountain: Our Blend - BBD 8/29/12Green Mountain: French Roast - BBD 8/1/12Green Mountain: Donut House Chocolate Glazed - BBD 8/31/12Coffee People: Jet Fuel - BBD 10/9/12Coffee People: Black Tiger - BBD 9/7/12Bigelow: Chamomile - BBD 12/28/12Bigelow: Mint Medley - BBD 12/27/12Celestial: Decaf Green Tea - BBD 9/20/12Grove Square: Hazelnut Cappuccino - expiration date unknown, but seems fineGrove Square: Hot Cocoa Milk Chocolate - expiration date unknown, but seems fineso basically, I received 16 out of 35 UNUSABLE k-cups. I am requesting a refund or product exchange. It's up to you if you want to take a gamble on getting good k-cups, but I regret buying from this seller.Thanks!

placed 2 orders, came in with 2 seperated brown paper bags, I Purchased coffee, but mixed with tea cups, one of the bad has only 33 k-cups in it. missing 2.. I will never purchase from this seller again..

I ordered this from Liquid nation and what I received was not as described. First of all I didn't receive all different K-cup as promised. I had recieved multiple duplicates in my package as well as 9 that had expired last year. I also received one K-cup that was clearly punctured in multiple locations on the top. I tried to contact the company of the poor quality of the item, but have yet to hear anything. Do not order!!Correction: The company corrected the mistake, and replaced the faulty/expired K-cups.

Great assortment of K-cups. I thought there was going to be 2-3 of the same kind of coffee, nope! EVERY k-cup is different. This was my first order of k-cups and it gives me a good sample of what flavors are my favorite and what to order in the future. This assortment would also be ideal for parties because it has plenty of decafs, teas, and even hot chocolate! This coffee is great tasting and fresh. Other reviews mentioned that some K-cups were expired and broken upon delivery. All my K-cups were sealed, none were broken or smashed during shipping. K-cups did come in a brown plastic bag that was just stapled shut, but the bag was placed in a box and therefore package was not damaged. Overall, I'm very happy with this purchase!

column9: GREAT MIX OF COFFEES NOT VERY MUCH OTHER THINGS
column10: I FOUND THIS TO BE VERY DISAPPOINTING WHEN RECIEVED. WE ORDERE THIS FOR MY WORK THINKING THAT THERE WOULD BE VARIETIES OF ALL KINDS OF THINGS THERE WERE NO CIDERS, 1 HOT COCOA AND 5 TEAS. I WILL NOT BE PURCHASING THIS AGAIN.
the k-cups arrived on time, the coffee selection was varied as described.As a non coffee drinker this works well for our coffee drinking guests.
The package arrived in a timely manner and was in great condition. The contents were exactly as described. Everyone in my family was able to find something they liked. Wonderful assortment.
Overall, a pretty good mix, but only one iced cup!  Really bummed I didnt get any iced coffees or anything :(

i like the different flavors but half of them exploded in my kerig coffee maker, didnt know they can explode, daughter went online and they dont know why they explode!! but some brands do , but i wont be buying again!!

k-cups were loose in a paper bag and this item was intended and marked as a gift.  the package was also a few k-cups short.  THE PRICE DROPPED 40% AFTER I PURCHASED.  DID NOT RETURN BECAUSE I NEEDED A GIFT BUT NEEDED TO BUY SOMETHING MORE SO THAT I WAS NOT EMBARRASSED!VERY DISSAPOINTED!
Received damaged cups, cups that had nothing in them, and all of the cups were set to expire 1 month after I received them. DO NOT BUY!

I admit I might be a bit harsh, but I am really not that satisfied with what I paid for. First, it looks like somebody just swept their arm across a shelf and dumped a bunch of random stuff in a box. I shouldn't gripe that much about packaging, BUT, as I was unpacking them and putting them away, I noticed that both of the pods from Grove square seemed a bit lite. I shook them around and they sounded empty. I opened them up to see if they were empty, and, well, you can see from my pictures what was in them. One of them looked like it had already been run through a brew cycle and then left to mold in the sun. The second one, again as you can see in the picture, was pretty much empty except for what looked like a moldy piece of pocket lint. Keep in mind that both of these pods were sealed airtight when I got them. I guess I need to blame the maker of the pods, but this is just not acceptable.I think it is safe to say I WILL NOT EVER be buying anything like this again and would highly advise others to look elsewhere as well

I wasent really too happy with this product. It states coffee and I also got tea and cold ice tea and hot chocolate. I only wanted for this particular gift...coffee... when you state coffe sampler that is what it should be and it wasent. Not satisfied.
This is a great sampler pack of flavored coffee k-cups especially if your just starting out as a new keurig coffee user try this sampler pack
Excellent! Love all the assortment of Coffees and Teas in the box.I will most certainly order this in the future, thank you.Sincerely,Belinda Gonzalez
35 cups were promised and only 32 arrived.  Very good mix of different flavors, types, and kinds.  It will encourage me to try these different tastes, but will not buy these online again.

These are someone's rejects thrown in a brown paper bag. 25 of the 35 cups were not from the brands they show. The package contained 1 Gloria Jean Butter Toffee, 1 Timothy's Kahlua, 1 Emeril (wow real coffee), 1 Donut House Chocolate Glazed donut, and lots of off brand flavored stuff, teas, coco etc.. There are 8 Brooklyn K cups which get terrible reviews. We are afraid to even use them since the reviews state they tend to explode and make a mess of the coffee maker.  It's junk and there is a no return policy.

column9: Where is the apple cider and hot cocoa??
column10: I purchased this sampler mainly because it advertised apple cider and hot cocoa. My package did not contain either. Maybe there is a disclaimer in there? Oh well...

column9: You get what you pay for...
column10: I would not recommend this to anyone.  I didn't read the other reviews before I placed my order which I know was my fault.  The K-Cups arrived in a brown paper bag, stapled with a hot pink sticky-note on it.  And that in my opinion is pretty ghetto.  Some of them were dented so who knows where each of them has been and I am not even going to use them.  Wasted funds because you can't return them either.My friend ordered a sampler pack described just like this. His came in a box with each K-Cup individually seated and looked like an actual product.  Not something that someone is taking from their school or work and then reselling them on Amazon.

column9: This is definitely a big gamble.....
column10: I was so anxious to get my assortment of K-cups so I could try before I buy big packages.  Well, they arrived yesterday, and much to my dismay, many of the ones pictured are missing.  I saw the notation that they may be replaced, but my word, the variety I received is less than satisfactory.  I have an abundance of tea/cider that I refuse to drink.  Gross!  I have an abundance of plain coffee and decaf....decaf?  Are you serious?  That's like taking a bath with your clothes on, IMO.  If I wanted decaf, I wouldn't be ordering coffee at all.  That just defeats the purpose of coffee totally.  If I wanted plain coffee, I didn't need to try before I buy, either.  I have several hot chocolates....if I wanted that, I'd have ordered it.  I don't need to try cocoa before buying.  Besides, I'm diabetic, and I can't drink them....unless they are sugar free.  What I don't have is a big variety of flavored coffee that I wanted.  I did get three flavors I wanted to try, but the cinnamon roll and mocha nut fudge were not included, so I can't try those.  I think the mudslide is horrible...tastes like coconut.  I think the butter toffee is bitter and doesn't have a toffee flavor at all.  The chocolate glazed donut is doable but it's not the best thing ever.  There are 3 others that I will try, southern pecan, french vanilla supreme, and caramel cappuccino.  So, out of 35 cups, I got 6 to try.  It basically was a complete waste of money, IMO.  So now I'm stuck with a dilemma....do I buy a big box of flavors and hope that I like them enough to continue drinking them or do I put the Mr. Coffee single-cup maker I just bought in a cabinet and forget it?  That would be another big waste of money.  I already wasted $20 on a carousel that doesn't live up to its description...the K-cups do NOT fit in there properly and fall out.  It does NOT hold 35 cups at all.  You have to skip every other one for them to fit.  Piece of junk.  I had to order a different one that holds less cups and isn't a carousel :-(  This whole ordeal just stinks.....and just an FYI here:  I ordered all this because I missed my English Toffee cappuccino (that I can't have any longer as it's not sugar free) and was hoping I could find a decent replacement with K-cups.  I lost this battle :-(  Buyer beware unless you like regular and decaf coffees, cocoa, tea, and cider......

Not happy.To much iced tea, decaf, hot chocolate, iced coffee,etc.The coffee that was there was mostly so dark & extra bold it was almost not drinkable.Seems like this is the stuff nobody is buying in this variety pack.WOULD NOT RECCOMEND THIS ONE!!!!!
I thought in the pic it should have emerald coffee too but when I received it nope not there. It's nice to have diff stuff to try. Untill u find something u like its worth it
There was good variety--all 31 are different, but I DO NOT RECOMMEND a product that does not deliver the promised number of items.  I only received 31 of 35 pods promised.

column9: Not really a coffee and tea sampler
column10: I bought this item, and out of 35 different k-cups, one was crushed straight in half (which may have happened in transit), and only three were tea. Overall, I was rather disappointed.

Received our package today- I knew they'd come in a bag and not in a neat box- that's totally okay with me. But I wasn't expecting a third of my shipment to be flavors/brands that weren't listed (that I don't like.) I am very disappointed that there was only 1 Gloria Jean's, 1 Caribou, and 1 Timothy's, and only 1 flavored Donut Shop coffee.  I am also very disappointed that there were only 3 tea varieties, and NO iced tea flavors! I wonder had they not put 9 k-cups in my package that I didn't want to order, if I would have gotten more of the varieties I ordered this for. But I have company coming tomorrow, so I guess I'll run out to BBB and buy some different non-coffee flavors in person so the non-coffee drinkers have something to choose from. Big letdown, Amazon... :(Here is what I received: 35 cups:Brooklyn Bridge Blend: (these were not listed and have poor reviews, I'm unhappy to be stuck with 7 of them now.)corner donut houseboardwalk blendbreakfast blend decafbreakfast blendfrench roastbrooklyn bridge blendcolombianGrove Square: (not listed for anything but cider)Milk chocolate cocoaHazelnut cappucinoGMC:Southern PecanColombian fair trade selectmocha fudge nutisland coconut (limited edition)breakfast blendfrench vanilla iced coffeeWolfgang Puck:Creme Caramelsorrentojamaica me crazycolombian decafrodeo dr blendCoffee People:DS coffeeJet Fueldecafsweet & creamy regular iced coffeeDS chocolate glazed donutGloria Jeans butter toffeeEmeril Big easy boldNewman's own extra boldTully's house blend decafTimothy's Kahlua originalRevv PlulseCaribou Daybreak morning blendTea:Twinings Earl grey decafBigelow green tea with pomegranateCelestial seasonings english breakfast black tea

column9: K-Cups are not supposed to rattle!
column10: When I received the package, I was excited to see what was included.  I pulled out all of the K-cups out of the brown paper bag (what is up with that?) and as I was doing so, I noticed some of the cups rattling.  To see why these were rattling, I opened up one of the K-cups to discover a hard brown lump of coffee sitting on the bottom of the cup, yuck!  I took pictures of the cup to upload to the review; however, that option is not available on Amazon's site.  Believe me, it was not pretty!

We ordered this package of keurig coffees and found it contained many teas and chocolates in the assortment. My husband preferred getting more coffees in the assortment and won't order again, Also, one of the containers came torn open (hazelnut cappuccino)--these are too expensive to come ripped open.Disappointed in Maryland.

The Coffee Mix's Fabulous 35 K-cup Sampler Pack, You Are Guaranteed 35 Different K-cup Flavors, Flavored Coffees, Extra Bolds, Teas, Hot Cocoas, Apple Ciders, Iced Coffees, Iced Teas, Decafs Etc...I wanted to try different coffees before ordering a box of one type.  This sampler features flavored coffees rather than different brands.  I am not a fan of flavored coffees so I was disappointed.  I should have read the reviews before ordering.

Perfect for a newbie like me...we got the Mr. Coffee BVMC-KG2, and it's our first foray into the k-cup world, so this was a great way to get, quite literally, a taste of a small portion of the zillion cups available.  My wife and I have had a great time sampling the variety.  I'd definitely recommend this route for any k-cup rookie.
What a great way to sample many different types of coffee. Be aware that you also get about 10 teas in the mix as well as many decaf.
The shipment did arrive early. 15 out 35 were either tea, decaf or some flavored cappuccino type. I can't say that I will be ordering this again as I wont use any of the following listed above.

column9: Good assortment, but expected more decaf...
column10: I ordered this one because it showed up when I fed a sea h for decaf K cups. There were some decaf varieties, but I expected more.

I did not get any ciders tho....and I did get alot of decafs but overall this is a good selection and I would order it again. It would have been a 5 star if it would have had a least one cider....thanks

I have been ordering coffee from Amazon forever and never received them loose in a brown paper bag! many seem like they are about to explode--and I see an expiration date of October, 2012 on the bottom of the bag.No info on calories, carbs, etc--very Disappointing. I feel I have been had!!
When I order coffee, I want ALL coffee !!  Did not want a mix of decaf, tea, hot cider, cappuccino, hot cocoa, etc.  I will never order this again.
I purchased this coffee medley because it looked good in the advertisement. When I got it, the medley was TOO diverse and contained stuff I did not like.

It seems like a lot of the kinds they couldn't sell. This seems like it would great if you didn't drink cofee but wanted a mix for your office or to have for your fiends who drink coffee. 9 were not coffee- I knew there would be a few but 9? 5 of them were decafe.  There were only 5 flavors that were light (like mudslide). I guess I didn't look close enough at the description.  I wanted a yummy coffee mix- this was not it.  I would never buy this again!

I WAS SO EXCITED TO GET MY NEW PLATINUM B70 KEURIG WITH ALL THE VARIETIES OF K-CUPS AND I LOVE THE IDEA THAT MY FRIENDS CAN CHOOSE WHAT EVER THEY LIKE. THIS 35 K-CUP SAMPLER HAS A VERY NICE VARIETY, BUTTT I STILL THINK SENSEO HAS A BETTER FLAVOR ....

column9: Don't be fooled by item description
column10: I was very unhappy when I received my order today, I only had three different flavored coffees, I received 6 different favors of tea and all the rest were regular coffee, although there were different companies I received 5 house blend....I was hoping for some iced coffee and iced teas and received none. I will not purchase this variety pack again.

This product came to me in a brown paper bag!  That's right, 35 individual K-Cups just thrown in a bag and mailed! Oh, I almost forgot, it was a stapled bag tossed in a box with air pillows...What kind of business packages their product this way! Very professional.

I read the previous reviews and decided to take a chance, but I was one of the disappointed ones. A great variety of coffee, but only 4 teas and NO hot chocolate or cider. I don't like coffee or tea so I'm not happy with this selection. I understand the concept of how this vendor is creating an assortment so you don't have to buy a whole package of each flavor, but how hard would it be to just make sure there are at least some of everything promised in the assortment.

I ordered this shortly after getting my Keurig. It was the first bulk order of K-Cups I had placed, and I am very pleased with the results! True to their word, there were 35 completely different selections. I put them all on my K-Cup Carousel.When I wake up I generally am too dead to the world to peruse a wide selection, so I generally stick with the store bought boxes of one of my favorites for that, but this selection has been a conversation piece and source of much joy when I have company over. Lots of "ooohs" and "hmmms." The only downside is that I am going to have to start cutting off/charging my friends!! I just ordered the 50 pack Sampler and I'm almost giddy about it.

column9: Some of the sampler arrived open
column10: I have Keurig at works and I drank variety of brewers all the time.  Finally decide to buy a unit at home for myself.  Amazon sales it in a bundle and it looks like a good deal, so I bought the samplers.  It is unfortunately a wrong thing to do.  I don't know whether it is due to the pressure during the shipments, several cups lose their tight seal upon arrival.  We didn't notice until we put it in the unit and some of the coffee grounds leaked it into the cup.  I also notice some sampler tasted stale.  Perhaps it is from the shipper, but it is bad.  You will be better off just go to Publics, Target, or Beals to buy them fresh.About a third of the items on this 35 different sampler amount to either lose sealed or bad taste items.  I don't know if it is even possible to ask for a refund?  Does it worth my time and postage to mail them back??

13 caffeine coffees, all different roasts: 8 Green Mountain, 2 Coffee People, 1 Tully's, 1 Donut House, 1 Dietrich11 frou-frou caffeine coffees, all different flavors: 7 Green Mountain, 2 Gloria Jean, 2 Donut House7 decaf coffees, all different roasts, 1 frou-frou (hazelnut): 3 Green Mountain, 2 Donut House, 1 Caribou, 1 Emeril's3 teas, all different - 2 herbal and 1 black: Celestial Seasonings1 hot cocoaOf the 35, 3 were past buy-before dates; 1 at six  months, 1 at two months, and 1 at one month. This really doesn't bother me - I don't think of them as expired, they are "best before". Still, if it were more than three and worth the effort, I might ask for replacements.I'm perfectly happy. It was kind of like opening a Christmas stocking.

Well, I am very dissapointed in this package as I got ALOT of the "same" coffees that were of different Brands(and they were mostly regular coffees).  I got ALOT of the "Bold" coffees which I cannot stand.  Some of the coffees were outdated.  The oldest was outdated September of 2011 (so far).  NOT ONE cocoa, NOT ONE Apple Cider, NOT ONE Iced Coffee, NOT ONE Iced Tea.  I got very few of the flavored coffees which is what I was hoping for and I really wanted the Cocoa and Apple cider.  I have a 7yr old daughter who would have LOVED the cocoa!  And I couldn't wait for my husband to try the Apple Cider that he loves.  The only thing good about this package is that it came fast (of course, that was thanks to Amazon Prime shipping).  I will not order from these people again unless they make it RIGHT with me!!!  Had it been a good shipment I would have ordered over and over again, as I entertain alot.

Mostly decaf. I won't order this mix again. While I knew there would be a few in the mix I assumed it would be mostly caffeine. Lots of teas. At least 2 of the cups are past the "best before" date. One of the cups had been cut open & had leaked coffee grounds in the package. I'm not very satisfied.
My roommate and I got this to share, and it serves our needs well. We just wished there were more tea cups in it!
I chose this product to get a sampler of teas, ciders, hot cocoas as well as coffees.....NOT to receive a paper bag with one cocoa-one tea-NO ciders and leftover coffees no one wanted!!

If you are a new keurig owner, this is a great variety pack to see what is out there.  I got regular, decaf, coffee, tea, hot chocolate, cappuccino, and even "brew over ice" products.  Yes, the packaging is a little funny - once I got a brown paper bag and once a very generic looking box.  However, from what I can tell, all the sellers of this type of k-cup variety product are home based businesses, so that seems to be the standard.  And if you look around, cup for cup, this is a good price.  Will definitely buy again.

I was unhappy to open the package and see a brown paper bag full of random (but not a wide variety) of coffees, teas, and hot cocoas.  Three of them were so old that they rattled in their kups.I will NOT buy from this person again.

We order these for our office on a regular basis. While not every cup is absolutely unique, that has never bothered us. For the most part, there is always a good mix, even if a few are duplicates.However, in every recent batch that we have purchased, there have been a few cups that were nearly empty. You can tell by shaking them. We tried brewing a few of these to verify that we were not just assuming they should be full. And, I would not recommend this, as the coffee they produce is absolutely horrible.It is very apparent these are defective cups. I thought it was an anomaly at first, but I found 3 more in our most recent order. All of them that suffer from this problem tend to be from Grove Square, in our experience.1. Until this issue is resolved, I think customers should expect to throw away 2-5 cups upon arrival. So, consider the price as if you were purchasing around 30 cups.2. The seller of this product should seriously consider dropping the Grove Square cups until this is resolved.3. The seller should consider doing quick quality assurance by simply shaking the cup before packing it.That said, we will likely continue to purchase this product since it is a great deal, but if the issue gets worse, we will probably look elsewhere.See the customer image I posted of the near empty cups from our most recent order.UPDATE: After a few more empty cups, we have decided to go with other options. It was not worth it to throw out around 5 cups from every batch when other K-Cup options are getting cheaper and cheaper.

I knew I was rolling the dice with this mixed grab bag.  Based on some of the positive reviews, I took a chance.  Couldn't be more disappointed.  One third of the k cups are the cheap Grove Square  brand...some of which I immediately through away because they shook like a rattle with a dried up "chunk" of coffee in them.  The others sound like they have about a teaspoon of dried up indtant coffee grounds in them.  No comparison to any of the other k cup brands. Grove Square sells for approximately half the price of other k cup brands in retail stores. That is because it is instant coffee designed to look like a k cup.  Makes the purchase price of this mix really steep since one third of my k cups were these cheapies!  I tried them once before and to me they are absolutely undrinkable. Should note that the product picture and written description does not show or mention Grove Square as one of the possible brands in the mix.  I also got 4 teas, 4 decafs and about 10 flavored coffees.  Overall, a horrible mix that was not worth the price I paid.  Won't risk it again. Unless you like the taste of instant coffee or are willing to overpay per cup to get to try some other actual k cup brands in different flavors...don't buy this.

HORRIBLE PRODUCT. TWO OF THEM EXPLODED. 32 OUT OF 35 WERE EXPIRED. I WOULD NEVER ORDER AGAIN.Yes, there was an assortment of k cups but when 2 explode and 32 are expired, you are only able to enjoy 1. Not worth the money.

column9: Great variety, poor packaging & quality assurance
column10: There was a lot of variety in the pack, which I greatly appreciate and I'm excited to try all of these new flavors!  There are even several teas and cappuccino's, which are very nice.  However, the quality assurance could have been much better handled prior to shipping.  I had to throw out two of the k-cups as soon as they arrived because the contents of the coffee inside were literally hard (they were more than likely expired.)  Also, they were not carefully packaged and just all thrown into a box with some paper thrown in there.  If you're ordering this, expect to throw a couple of them out from the onset.

column9: Will order again! Product was as promised.
column10: I was not sure about this product. Placing my order was a gamble. However, I was pleasantly surprised when I opened the box. Shipping was fast, it was at my door several days before the deadline. Package was undamaged, I received 37 K-cups, instead of 35. All were in date and there were no doubles. Not all of the brands pictured were sent to me, but that was fine with me.The only thing I noticed about this product is that the price jumped significantly after I ordered it. I am very happy with my order and will order from this company again, once the price goes back down.Whitney
This was fun for a week but now all I have left is a bunch of decaf k cups 12-15) that I will never use.

I ordered three (ugh!) of these sampler packages intended as gifts to people to whom I had previously given Keurig's.  What a disppointment to see that they come in distasteful brown paper bag packaging with a 90 day expiration sticker right on the front!  Shame on me for not reading all the details closer and the reviews ahead of time, which I now see have the same complaints about shoddy packaging and what appears to be someone's leftover flavors.  Buyer beware!

And I loved it even more than the first!The first time I ordered, I would say 80% was coffee (regular, flavored, decaf) with a couple of teas and I believe 1 hot chocolate thrown in the bunch. Most of the coffee was Green Valley. While I couldn't complain about the GV coffee, I had hoped for a little more variety. Overall, I had been pretty happy with that shipment, at least enough to try it out again.Well, the second order was awesome. Along with some fabulous coffees that I'd been wanting to try and a new brand I hadn't even heard of -- Brookyln -- I also got several apple cider, hot chocolate, teas, and even a couple of iced teas and iced coffees. There simply isn't a better way to try out all the varieties that you can use with your Keurig. Maybe I just got lucky, but there is only 1 or 2 Kcups that are repeats from the prior shipment.I will definitely be ordering again!

There was an ok assortment (no iced at all though) however I did not get 35 cups---only 30.  Will not order this againUPDATE:  I was able to contact seller and they refunded me the dollar amount for the missing K-cups.  Very quickly.  Rating went form 2 stars to 4 :)

I have a new coffeemaker and wanted to try a variety pack of coffees to see which ones I liked the best.  The pods arrived in a brown paper bag that was stapled shut but the bag was inside a box with air pockets so the bag was intact.  All the pods were in good condition and none of them were beyond the expiration date.  There is a great variety...just what I wanted, of coffees, teas, and cocoas.  I received 35 different varieties and I can't wait to try every one of them.  This is a great way to try different varieties before you buy a whole box of something and then decide you don't like it. I will probably buy this again when these 35 are gone just so I can have a good variety for myself and guests.  Definitely a good buy!

I liked almost every one of the samples I received in this sampler box... It allowed me to try different types of coffee without having to buy full boxes of coffees I didn't like. I believe everyone should get a sampler box at some point to figure what different kinds are out there without wasting your money on coffees you don't like!

column4: Is it So who knows "Opinion Oky"
column10: Not trilled maybe sad. There were 28 coffees and 7 teas nothing else. I thought I'd get a selection. I wanted to try cocoa and apple cider but as many here have said there is no variety. There were 35 different products both dark coffee and medium. There were 6 flavored coffees and 4 decaf coffees. But not the wide variety I had expected. Also although I have not used the product yet, as I have not been delivered the coffee maker, I'm wondering how they will taste as the cups are old. Several of them are puffed up. I don't think they will be poison, but old coffee is not flavorful. Don't buy this product or maybe you're just into Russian roulette.Just went from 2 stars to 1. I ordered the Bed Bath and Beyond 60 samples for $39.00, and while their selection was just OK, a 3.5 star rating. Its .66c a k-cup while this is .75c, BB&B's selections where fresher and there was some variety. OK I ordered more so the price was better but let me tell you the whole presentation was better, the product was better, fresher and I think it has this beat by 2.5 stars.
The mix I received had about five teas and they rest was coffee.  No cider.  No hot chocolate.  Pretty disappointing.

column9: I suspect I know why there is variability here...
column10: So you order this thing and what you get is this weird paper bag stapled closed filled with K-Cups.I had always assumed this was some sort of "from the manufacturer" type of thing, but I suspect we have a vendor that buys large quantities of these things and hires people to mix them up and bag them and send them out.Obviously, that's going to result in some people getting what they asked for and some folks not.I got quite a few duplicates, and I also got quite a few of the same vendor... so lots of Green Mountain, for example.  I also got some teas, which I have zero interest in, and a spiced cider which is fine, but certainly not what I was looking for.In the end, I don't think this is a "bad idea", but I would say be prepared... random is random, and random as selected by an even more random employee (high school kid?), is even more so.

I don't mind receiving this in a paper bag. It has a 35 different kinds as shown. It has 2 hot coco k-cup and i am not a hot coco person but again i don't mind, at least i get to try it. It even arrived 4 days earlier from the estimated day of arrival. Over all 5/5. I am happy with the product.

column9: Correct number of K-Cups, all unique, good range
column10: This review is to address the concerns over reviewers encountered, which I did not:* I did get the correct amount of K-Cups (at the time of writing this review, the description states you'll get 35).* All 35 K-Cups were unique, as described.* There was a good variety of teas, coffees, and some interesting ones like apple cider/Kaluha/etc. that made this 35 pack a good purchase.The 35 K-Cups were packed in a brown paper Duro bag , exactly like I get from the Italian sandwich shop down the road when I pick up an order.  This makes this item an ugly gift for someone unless you were expecting to repack the K-Cups yourself prior to handing them over.The bag also provides no protection to the K-Cups, and one of them was crushed - although not sufficiently as to be unusable.All in all, I think this is a good purchase.
I got 36 K-cups and do not have one duplicate. Most of them are coffee though but I did get a good variety of flavored coffee.

I received my order quickly, but I had to throw away 4 of the K-cups right off the bat. When I pulled the cups out of the paper bag, some rattled. I opened 4 of them up and the contents were crystalized and hard. Hopefully, the rest will taste al right!

I got a huge variety of drinks...cider, cocoa, cappuccino, tons of tea (hot and iced) and flavored coffees. In fact, I hardly got any plain coffee, maybe 1/6. I didn't count them, but none of them are expired. I usually won't order something if it has negative reviews...I'm so glad I took the chance and ordered these!!

After reading the negative reviews associated with this order, I was apprehensive to purchase it. However, having just purchased a new Keurig machine, I figured I needed coffee, right? After receiving this variety pack today, I could not be happier. I do not think that I have any doubles. Not only that, but although I have mostly coffee, I also have a nice assortment of tea, hot chocolate, and even apple cider!  And I received 35 cups. I am glad I decided to take a chance.

We were promised 35 different coffee pods and that is what they delivered. It was a wonderful blend of coffees, decafs, tea, hot chocolate, flavored coffees...a wonderful mix.  I am back today to order more.  Order from this company and you will not regret it.Update...just received my second order. It came super fast.  There were 35 different pods...once again no repeats.  35 different pods...again some tea, hot chocolate, sweet teas, decafs, flavored coffee and many different types of roasted coffee.  It is a wonderful assortment.  You will not be disappointed.
Great variety to keep on hand!  Friends and family will enjoy sampling with you. Tea, hot chocolate, and many coffees.  Included 6 decalf, so you can enjoy at any time.

I was worried about ordering this based on all the bad reviews, but I am extremely happy with my purchase. I got 36 (instead of 35)assorted K-cups and absolutely NO duplicates. I bought this so I could try a bunch of different kinds and I was not dissapointed. I might even order another set.

This is my first pack of K-cups I have tried and I am pleased with the variety.  I have not tried the whole bag (yet).  So far not all "suit my taste" but I am glad to see the variety of what is being produced and anyway who in their right mind would honestly say no coffee is better than weak coffee (not anyone I've met in the military for dang sure).  Many are great!  The darker blends (is that the right word?) are my favorites so far, as well as the cappuccino mixes (I like a "fru-fru" cup every once in awhile).Great sampler pack!  Get's my new found love for these machines going strong.

column9: Shame on me for not reading the reviews
column10: Okay, the brown bag was a surprise; I should have read the reviews first. Because my mix is nowhere near as interesting as the other reviewer's, I have a vision of a bunch of people sitting in a room, smoking, watching t.v., and just tossing random K-Cups into brown bags. I still get to try a variety of coffees, teas, hot chocolate (2), and cider, but something about the brown bag just turns me off.

column9: Looks like this is hit or miss
column10: Four out of the 35 kcups were dried up to the point where I had to throw them out. Other people appear to have had similar experiences. There are also a number of sweetened items, so it's not a great choice for people who stick to low-calorie sweeteners. If you are willing to gamble with staleness, give it a try. Personally, I won't be purchasing again.
Was disappointed with all the non-coffee k-cups, were 8-10 cups that were tea, cider, and  cocoa. Also a lot of "Brooklyn" coffees-which were not listed in the add.
The variety is nice, but they only sent 32 cups, instead of 35.  Not the end of the world, but frustrating.

I did not read the reviews before ordering these K-Cups.  This was my first time ordering K-cups through Amazon (I normally do it from BBB).  I did not even think to read the reviews because how could they screw it up.  Boy was I wrong.  The packaging was my first clue that something was off.  It was in a brown paper bag, not a manufactures box.  Then when I opened it it was all of these strange flavors and very little straight up coffee.  I am so confused, I would think that the FDA would regulate coffee (I might be wrong here) and that this would not meet their standards.  I agree with someone else who said that it appears to be all the coffee and flavors that someone else did not want.  I may try to return but again not sure if that is possible because it is edible.  HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT!

It arrived on-time in a paper bag. There were 35 different K-cups. 2 hot chocolates, 1 cider, 2 teas, 2 decaff coffees, and the remainder different regular and bolds. Some were flavored. Many were "name" brands like Wolfgang Puck. No one company had more than 4 k-cups. None were expired (though they didn't all have an obvious date). None were bizarre flavors. It was exactly as described.

I finally purchased a Keurig brewer, just in time for a huge family affair at my house.  I had purchased some Newman's coffee but thought that this would have something for everyone and boy did it ever!  Half of the fun was looking at all of the samples!  Most of the these were chosen above regular K cups and were a huge hit especially with my niece and nephew.  In fact my niece just asked for the link to this pack as she wants to order it also.  I'll probably always keep these in the house so that people have a variety.  It includes some wonderful items, including hot chocolate!  DARK chocolate hot chocolate!  There is also decaf for those who prefer it.  LOVE it!
No two items where the same, and there was great items to choose from.  I would and will buy this item again.

I sometimes wonder about the people complaining about the choices... as if you can possible get a across the board perfect sampling with only 35 choices.  Should it be more balanced, sure I guess, but I am also guessing these is no pleasing EVERYBODY. Anyhow, this is NOT a bad sampling of flavors and a great way to try out some flavors.  Here is what I got:35ct Sampler:Specialty Coffees:------------------Gloria Jean: Mudslide/French Vanilla Supreme/Hazelnut/Butter ToffeeGrove Square: French Vanilla/Hazelnut/CarmelGreen Mountain: Southern Pecan/Moca Nut FudgeDonut House: Chocolate Glazed DonutTeas----Celestial: English Breakfast Blend/Perfect Iced Tea/Mandarin Orange Spice/Mint MedleyCocoa/Cider-----------Grove Square: Milk Choc./Dark Choc./Spiced Apple Cider/Candy Apple CiderCoffee (non flavored)---------------------Green Mountain: Extra Bold Sumatran/Extra Bold Double Black/Colombian/Dark Magic Extra Bold/Vermont Country/  Breakfast BlendTully's: Breakfast Blend/House BlendNewman's Own: Special BlendCaribou Coffee: Caribou BlendEmeril's: Big Easy BoldDonut House: Donut House BlendCoffee People: Jet FuelDecaf Coffee's--------------Green Mountain: Breakfast Blend/Hazelnut/Half-CaffNewman's Own: Special Blend** Also note: as stated in other reviews, this comes in a paper bag so if you are gifting this be aware it's NOT boxed up in a pretty case.

column9: A great way to sample the many varieties
column10: I consider this assortment to be very helpful and honestly described. None of my samples were duplicates. Someone mentioned some were "overfilled" and all I can think of on that comment is that coffee does outgas when it is freshly roasted so that makes the top of some of the cups puff up a bit. Not a problem at all. Some folks complained about the paper bag. I don't see the problem. Nice assortment and fun to experiment.

column9: Wonderful Sampler for the Common Coffee Lover!
column10: I received my order today after ordering it a little under a week ago. I was in need of an assortment of Kcups, as I just bought my first Keurig. So here I am, the incoming college freshman who is all too excited to journey off to school with this sampler, eager to go on a tastebud adventure with a sip from every cup brewed. Very very pleased with what I received (35 Kcups, all different). I tried one of the cups in my Keurig as soon as I opened the package, The Donut Shop's Chocolate Glazed Donut, and I am very very pleased. Awesome purchase for an awesome price! Worth every penny!The following is what I received:Green Mountain  -French Roast  -Extra Bold Double Black Diamond  -Limited edition Island Coconut  -Mocha Nut Fudge  -French Vanilla Iced coffee  -Southern Pecan  -Breakfast Blend  -Our BlendCelestial Seasonings  -Mandarin Orange Spice Herbal Tea  -Sweet Raspberry Black Tea (iced)  -English Breakfast black teaCaribou  -Daybreak morning blendWolfgang Puck  -Chef's Reserve Decaf Columbian  -Rodeo Drive Blend  -Creme Caramel  -SorrentoCoffee People  -Jet Fuel (very interesting)  -Donut Shop Decaf  -Donut Shop Chocolate Glazed DonutKahlua coffee cafeTwining's  -Earl Grey Tea DecafBrooklyn Bean Roastery  -French roast  -Breakfast blend decaf  -Fuhgeddaboutit dark roast extra bold  -Colombian medium roast  -Corner Donut Shop Medium roast Extra Bold  -brooklyn bridge blend  -Boardwalk blend  -breakfast blend light roastGrove Square  -Hazelnut cappuccino  -Milk chocolate hot cocoaEmeril's gourmet coffee  -Big Easy boldTully's coffee  -House Blend Extra BoldGloria Jean's  -Butter ToffeeRevv Coffee  -Pulse with Ginseng and Guarana (i dont know about this one)Definitely worth it!

I received these babies so fast that I'm wondering if my neighbor is the distributor. Seriously, 12 hours from 'one click' to doorstep-AMAZING. I was COMPLETELY out so the surprise was wonderful! It's been a while since I had to start my day without coffee. As for the packaging, as others had mentioned they arrive in a brown paper bag, which is inside of a padded box. This didn't bother me, but it's definitely not something you'd want to send as a gift. All the cups arrived in good condition. The variety was, well, a variety. It always makes me smile when I read someone claim that the k cups were "mostly bad ones" since what I would consider a bad flavor might be another's favorite. Example, my set arrived with a hazelnut coffee and a hazelnut cappuccino. I HATE hazelnut, but my mom loves it, so those are earmarked for her. All in all, I'm happy with my purchase. I could have been just as happy if they included less tea, but that's me. A quick breakdown:3 Flavored Cappuccino2 Hot Cocoa8 Flavored Coffee5 Mild Coffee5 Bold/Extra Bold Coffee2 Decaff Coffee1 Half Caff3 Flavored Tea6 Green/Black/Breakfast TeasFor the price I paid, twenty, I would order again. Also, I like the idea that next time, I might get something totally different. These are "fun cups" for us as we usually drink only Caribou or Donut Shop in the morning. BTW- I did not get either one of these in my set. Great for me, because I buy huge boxes of each, but too bad that a newcomer wouldn't have them to try because they are pretty popular brands. Bottom line- I'd recommend this set for the adventurous, but not for those who are trying to identify that perfect 'traditional' or mild morning coffee.

column9: Not sure what to get?  Get this.  Watch prices, though.
column10: I've had my Keurig machine for a couple of years now, wanted to try out some different brands, and came across this deal.The full list is mentioned in the reviews.  Thank you guys for that.Great mix in here, but you really have to like tea and flavored coffee to get your money's worth.  Luckily for me, my wife likes the teas and flavored coffee.  I got it for the various roasts/blends of the plain stuff.  It's about a 50/50 split between the regular and "fancy" coffee, I've gone through most of my half so far, and from that list, I added a couple new coffees to my cart here.  Nice and cheap way to try out some of the other brands.I won't give my personal opinions on the coffee included in this list, since my personal tastes wouldn't really mean much to others anyway.My bottom line on this is easy.  Buy it.  But I'd also recommend putting it in your cart and watch the price on it, it varied by a couple of $'s in the 2 weeks I had it in my cart.

I thought that I would receive mostly the brands listed in the title description, however the assortment arrived in a brown paper bag with a sticker on it that said "ready to ship".  There were almost none of the brands listed in the title and the mixture consisted of mostly various Wolfgang Puck coffees and Brooklyn Bean Roasters coffees. I got one Emeril's, 1 Gloria Jean's, 1 Donut House, and 3 Celestial Seasonings and a few other brands not listed in the description at all.  My ordering was to try to get those brands that I had already tried and liked; do not like receiving something that doesn't include many of the brands listed in the descriptive title.Very misleading and I'm extremely disappointed as it wasn't at all what I was expecting.

I was worried about getting this when I read reviews that said some cups were out of date, others came torn or punctured. But Its either this or try a sampler with only 4 flavors of 24 each. I didnt want to be stuck with 23 flavors I didnt like. So I figure what the heck, and gave this a shot. I couldnt be happier. 35 different flavors as promised. One limited edition flavor, Coconut coffee or something. Hot cocoa ect ect. Didnt bother checking all the exp dates. the ones I did look at were fine. This is great for someone like me. Who is new to one of these and has no idea what coffee to buy. However Im so happy with it I may just keep buying these.
We bought this so that we could try what's out there before paying retail for a whole box of (insert flavor here) the Teas were wonderful and the coffee selection was awesome.
Love this sampler. The cups arrived in perfect condition. Great variety. I purchased one for my daughter as well. She loved it. It's nice to try some before buying a whole box.
I love the k-cup variety pack received. It's a very nice selection of coffees. My husband is the coffee drinker in the family. He enjoys the variety packs too!

I'm really glad we got the big variety sampler because it gave us a chance to try many flavors. And they were delivered by Amazon, right to our house, so that made it really easy. Especially since you can't find that much interesting to choose from at the store. I wouldn't say I disliked any of them. Some I loved or liked better than others but they were all pretty good and it was fun to have the choice options. I would go with buying the sampler again, just because I have had so much fun sampling them so far. The blueberry...sounds weird, but it's not too bad. I love all the donought and cinnamon roll flavored ones. Mmmmm.

I saw mixed reviews on a variety of K-cup sampler packs.  I was attracted to this one because it guaranteed 35 different K-cups.  I got my order a day early and guess what - I did in fact receive 35 different K-cups - I even received a Apple Cider and a few Hot Chocolates.  I would order this again.

So I was hesitant to order this because of quite a few negative reviews, but I decided to anyway, and I'm glad I did!I searched through quite a few sampler packs before deciding on this one. Anybody who owns a Keurig knows that there are so many varieties of flavors out there, a sampler is really the only way to find one you know you will love.It came inside a brown paper bag inside the box, and inside the bag was 35 cups as promised. No duplicates at all which I was very happy about. 7 Decaf coffees, 3 Teas (Celestial Seasoning), 1 Hot Chocolate, and the rest were all flavors of coffee. Most were Green Mountain (which I have found makes damn good coffee) with a few Doughnut House, and a couple different brands (Gloria Jean, Black Tiger, and Jet Fuel) which I think will be interesting to try. Everything from Glazed Doughnut, to Extra Dark, to Mudslide in this assortment. Probably the best one I have seen yet, will def be getting it again since I love variety.

column9: Loving the selection that I have now!
column10: I originally purchased a Keurig because of the all the varieties of coffee made for them...what I didn't realize was how few real "variety packs" there are out there. I found the Sampler Pack from The Coffee Mix and purchased it so that I would have a variety for the machine, especially for when I had company over. I am already on my second purchase of the 35 cup sampler and have thoroughly enjoyed trying new flavors. You get exactly what they say too...out of each 35 cup purchase I had absolutely no duplicates. Out of the 70...I probably still only had about 5-8 duplicates between the 2 orders. I will certainly be ordering again! I may get a larger pack though :)

column9: Lots of Flavors To Choose From
column10: I received my 35 k-cup sampler today and was pretty happy with the variety, my only complaint is that I didn't get any Apple Cider, I really wanted to try that without having to buy a whole package of it.  But...I got a couple of extras and got a lot of different tea flavors, I love tea so I look forward to trying those, and I did get one iced tea as well.  I would order another sampler from them again!

very disappointed.  All the k-cups were just thrown in a box.  Some were crushed due to poor packaging.  There were too many decaffenated teas and coffee.  Some of the k cups tasted stale.  They could have been expired.  This purchase was not worth the money.  I will stick to my usual website to purchase my kcups.  Do not waste your money on this.

column9: you get what you pay for
column10: I just purchased my keurig and wanted to try a variety of kcups, which led me to here.  I did read the reviews but still I thought I might get "lucky" and be pleasantly surprised.  I did receive my kcups very quickly and the box did contain 35 different varieties of coffee and tea-but no hot cocoa or apple cider-which I wanted to try ONE before I purchase a whole box.  A little disapointed because I feel the information was very misleading.

Was quite disappointed at the selection of k cups I received. I ordered this variety specifically because I wanted to try the hot chocolates and ciders available in k cups. However the selection I relieved contained absolutely no cider or hot chocolate what so ever. I feel that the description is misleading and would never order this item again.
Completely unacceptable!  I wouldn't pay a dime for this product!  K-cups arrived in brown paper bag stuffed into a box.  Many of the k-cups were bent, torn, and unusable.  So disappointed!

First time Kurig user and did not know which brand to buy so I decided to buy this mixed flavor, but did not provide the variety that I expected. Too many Timothy's, only one Donut House, no Emeril's. Ended up using only half and the rest seatting on the shelf.

I wanted to try different K cups and didnt want to buy entire boxes of a coffe only to discover i dont like them.  I like to take chances and I like variety so I decided to give this a shot.  I only recieved 32 K cups, there were MANY duplicates and just under half were decaf.  But live and learn!

I ordered on the 23rd and it was deliverd 2 days later. It was in a brown paper bag, but placed in a box. I had 35 exactly and only 1 repeat. People complained of too much decaf or half-caff which I would like but only had 3 of those. Only two hot cocoa and two spiced cider. I loved the variety and looking forward to a whole new variety next time I order; and I will order again.

If I can learn anything from this I have learned~You get what you pay for!! Please, whatever you do, don't get this particular package, because you will be horribly disappointed, unless you want the K-cups no one else would want or drink!! Yes, they are all different, but out of the 35 there I will only be drinking maybe 10 of them, the rest I will try to give away although I doubt anyone will want them!! Alot are decaf, which I don't drink, or they are tea or hot chocolate. I was hoping for actual flavored coffee, now I know to only order my K-cups from Keurig or I will buy them at the store!! I am sadly disappointed in this assortment of K-cups, and the person that packed my bag really did a HORRIBLE job!! Oh, and 4 of them are either empty, or the coffee in them is hard and stale!!

It said 35 different but we got 34 different and a duplicate of the caramel cappuccino. Little disappointed in this. Otherwise it is what it said, a selection of coffee, flavored coffee, decaf, half caf, cider, hot cocoa and tea. I was hoping for the chocolate glazed donut and did not get one but I did get a cinnamon roll k cup.

column9: fun assortment, but did not get 35
column10: My assortment arrived via 2-day shipping on time and the k-cups were in a stapled bag with air packets inside a larger box.  Everything looked fine and I separated out into different types of cups.  I had:  5 decaf coffees  21 regular coffees  1 tea  2 cappuccino  2 hot chocolate  2 ciderI liked the assortment, but I only received 33 cups instead of the 35 the description claims (hence only 3 stars.)
bought this for a party so everyone would have a choice of hot tea/coffee both decaf and caff. Great selection and mix, gave me a chance to try different flavors also...
Great variety of coffee's, tea's and hot chocolate!!!  Loved the fact this item fit the needs of my large family!

One third of the products were Grove Square instants.Hot choc., apple cider, cappuccino or just plain instant coffee.Artificial instant garbage.Not mentioned in the product description.Do not waste your money.Buy an assortment that is real coffee.

Very disappointed in this item, promised Emeril's Uniquie Sampler and there were NONE.. Also some of the coffee appears it may be instant... I would not buy this product or recommend it to any of my friends.

This was a fun assortment of coffees. If you're looking for an assortment of all the different things you can have in a keurig you're going to be disappointed. There were two ciders, two hot cocoas and one tea. The rest were coffees, both flavored and not. I liked the ability to try all sorts of coffee and was suprised at what I ended up liking best. Now I can go out and spend money on one brand, knowing what I liked best. On the con side, there were only 34 k-cups and two of them were stale, so when you put them in barely anything came out and then it clogged the keuirg. But overall it was a good buy. It did come in a brown paper bag, but that didnt bother me either.
I enjoy the Donut House coffee very much! Sometimes I want something different so I get your  variety packs and mix it up a bit.  It gives me a chance to try new ones and different strengths too.

I was not happy with the selection of k-cups that were sent.I expected to receive regular coffee k-cups but wound up getting seasoned coffee mixes, tea, and cocoa. We are coffee drinkers and we gave away more that half of the order. Will not order this item again.

I decided to write this review after reading many of the negative reviews of the product. I read them mixed with the positive prior to ordering and decided that I would gamble and make the purchase. I couldn't be happier with what we received. We received 35 different K Cups-no duplicates. The variety was great including cider, cappuccino, tea, hot chocolate as well and decaf and regular coffee. This what just what we needed to decide what we would like to buy more of. I would definitely buy this again.
All varieties of coffee & tea was great. I will purchase it again. Great selections in the order.Tasty and fresh!

I received 34 sample k-cups (only 1 less than advertised), 3 of those received were solid lumps that would not brew (all of those were from Grove Square), none were duplicates (yippee! since I wanted a sampling).  That said, this accomplished what I was looking for which was an idea of what variety is available in K-cups, and what I want to order more of.  I will stick with my favorite which is Coffee People's "Jet Fuel" (of which I received 1 in this order) Coffee People Jet Fuel Dark Roast K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50). And I will never order anything from Grove Square which uses "instant coffee" and apparently inferior packaging.  I wouldn't order this again, but... I don't need to.  Not sure I'd recommend it to a friend either.

column9: Great for first-timers, loved my mix
column10: I just bought a K-cup brewer and wanted a variety of K-cups since my family doesn't just have coffee drinkers.  There were regular & decaf coffees, flavored coffees and plain, hot chocolate (milk & dark), teas and 2 ciders.I wouldn't have tried the teas otherwise because I'm a sort of tea snob but I really enjoyed the quickness and flavor of the teas.  I drank the "for iced tea" one hot and it was mild and delicious--I can't wait to buy a full box to brew iced tea.  The coffee drinkers enjoyed the variety too.

I am new to single-cup brewing, and wanted to try a variety of coffee and tea flavors. I received a mix that had a lot of variety in it, and only a couple of duplicates. With so many choices, I found the non-coffee drinkers of the family crowded around the little carousel I stacked them on, planning their next "cuppa". My son said the sweet ice tea flavor brewed over ice was very good, and I have been having fun trying out the different coffees. I was surprised to figure out I'm not a "bold" coffee person. I thought I would be, because I love coffee-chain-store espresso, but indeed the medium and light roasts are making me a happy girl. Having this variety pack allowed me to explore my preferences. I will definately buy this variety pack again.
I was expecting several duplicates, but was happily surprised by all the different choices and am enjoying trying them and determining my favorites.

This is a decent, but not great selection of coffees.  I purchased it for my small office group.  More flavored coffees than ideal, and only a few decaf.  Not something I would regularly purchase, since I now know what we won't drink (everything that's still left).

Our 10 year old cat had been having some skin problems by his tail.  We went online and decided to try some Vitamins for him.  After about two days the old boy had some real pep in his step.  He does a good cat run around for no reason thing, again.  As a kitten he did that often but this seems to have invigorated him.  In addition his skin has cleared by the tail so if your cat will eat it, and mine eats almost anything then it is a great product. We give it too him with his food or sometimes he will eat it alone in a dish.

My two cats, Ozzie and Eli, nearly climb up my legs when I'm about to give them their Blue Spa Select Turkey and Chicken entrée. Then Eli, who is part Siamese, begins his singing and meowing as if he were an operatic tenor. Needless to say they dive into their portions and whoever finishes first tries to help the other finish his portion. They love this flavor and it smells fine to humans too.

This is another food I have recently added to my kitties rotation of quality foods.  I bought a small can of it to see if they liked it and they went crazy for it!  They are on Wellness, Natural Value (sold here), Natural Balance, By Nature Organics and now this one.  All offer superb nutrition at very reasonable prices.  I love giving my babies the best!  They deserve it!
My cat was recently diagnosed with CRF so he needs to be on a special diet.  This has been the 3rd canned food I've tried and he has liked this one the best!

column9: my dog loves them, so do i
column10: i've been getting these  throughout my dog's life, which now is 7 years.  He loves them.  I have used them as a treat-reward for good behavior, such as  coming when he's called, or stopping barking.  I keep tins of them around the house for easy access. I like that they are small, i sometimes break them in  half when using them as a treat. What i like is that  they smell good, my dog loves them and they don't pose a weight gain problem. I can use them often without making my dog fat and unhealthy.  I used to get them at local pet stores like Centinela Pet and Feed. and PetCo.  When they stopped carrying them in the larger quantities, i was disappointed and happy to find them on Amazon. I don't like buying them in the large cellophane bags, it doesn't keep them fresh. i like the small tins and buy them like this, 12 at a time, it lasts a long time, a few months.  The seller i got it from this time, A World of Pups, was very fast with shipping and delivery, 3 days.

Yip Yap has always been a favorite treat of my pets.  I have finally come across a dog that hesitantly eats them.  I also noticed a very strong odor when you open the tin.  I am giving most of them away.  The formula is not as good as it once was, and if they are not eaten, the dogs do not see them as a reward.

I've been buying these for a few years.  They come in a convenient tin that you could put in your pocket or purse in case you need a training treat.  My dogs love them and it improves their breath.  You can even break them in half to make them go farther.
this company was very fast.  mollie loves her special treat each day.don't hesitate to order from this company.

My personal opinion: It is excellent. It tastes delicious to me. It is so convenient to have on hand. I subscribed to this one also. It is packaged nicely for the delivery. The price is well below any I have seen locally. It is delicious!

My first time for pomegranate juice. I thought it would be sour or bitter, but it tastes so good, I want to tip up the bottle and drink it all. I am drinking this for my cholestrol, however I am also losing weight.  Fast shipping.

i did ordered this juice before, it was very  very good  ,  we used to have farm of pomegranate ,and i know the the real fresh  test ,and this  juice is no different of the real thing, but i wish this company give us discount when  we order more?...
the best matza balls out there- super yummy with salt. too bad they guy stopped selling them since it was the best price out there.

column9: tastes better than Manischewitz brand to me
column10: This is the brand that I can get at my local grocery store certain times of year. It is pretty light and fluffy and tastes better than the Manischewitz matzo ball mix. Also, this mix only requires one egg, while Manischewitz requires two but this mix makes the same amount of matzo balls. Sometimes a girl just doesn't have an egg to spare. Elaine knows what I mean.
My sister brought me some of this tea after her trip to Seattle. I am in LOVE! My new favorite tea.  I enjoyed it hot or iced.
I can't speak for the seller, but I will say this is fantastic Lemonade. Really, really refreshing, not overly sweet, and very clean tasting. Absolutely crucial for a hot day.
This is similar to Orangina, only in very small bottles and more expensive. If you have orange juice and mineral water in your home, you can easily make your own, minus the sugar and preservatives.
Perfect thirst quencher which does not make you thirstier like most of the commerical soda drinks.

This product was charged to my credit card then delivered to someone else in another state; I confirmed this with the FEDEX tracking number.  I sent in an email indicating what had happened, and I was sent my product within the week.  Better late than never!
This drink is amazing! It is very different than a typical orange soda you might find anywhere in the U.S. This is a sparkling beverage that has a great orange flavor. It is very addictive!!

Like the Rosebud Powder found here: Rosebud - Powder - 1.3 OZ , I purchased this for incorporation into homemade Ras El Hanout.  Since the floral component of this Multi-Spice is quite small (floral powders easily overwhelming other flavours if overused), I ended up with quite a bit left over for use in my perfume-making hobby or in sachets, etc.I found this to be a high-grade powdered lavender, the floral 'nose' being greater than the (wholly expected and natural) bitterness of it.

if u compare to buying the 3 packs at walmart, its a great price. 4 of the 3 packs from walmart are $26+, this is $15the flavor is the best ive ever had. i like spearmint but then a friend gave me a piece of this and its way better

The BEST gluten free 4 inch sugar cookies on Earth but the $1.99 EACH cookie PLUS shipping is outrageous until the company lowers it for bulk orders.  I LOVE this brand/bakery food and this is the most delicious sugar cookie thats gluten free that our family has had in a LONG time as its so hard to find quality gluten free appetizing foods.  This is as soft as a slice of cake and so delicious it's impossible to bear that taste !Cookie is also very pretty with the pink frosting and rainbow sprinkles;  attractive 100 %.Nutritional facts are as follows :  Serving size 71 grams,  calories 300,  total fat 14 grams, saturated fat 14 grams, ZERO trans fats,  cholesterol 25 mg,  sodium 190 mg,  total carbs 43 grams, fiber 1 grams, sugars 23 grams and protein 3 grams.  ( There is 4 % calcium and 2 % iron per serving )  Serving is a huge 4 inch frosted sprinkled sugar cookie which is soft and tasty.  Carbs and sugars are so high its not for diabetics in the family but does help the gluten people here.  YUMMY.I love these and cannot wait for the price to decrease to buy this again.  5 stars on the product and 1 star on the unjustly cost currently for both individual cookies and the shipping.

column9: Great tasting, satisfying but loaded w/calories
column10: This is a amazing cookie. Eating Gluten Free has caused a evaluation of many favorite treats. Discovering this cookie has provided a great treat that is very satisfying and enjoyable. These cookies taste every bit as good as Grandmas or any of the other popular pink cookies. They are pretty large, very tasty and we love them. One cookie in the package weighs 5.7oz, they are pretty large.While they are Gluten Free, they are not fat and calorie free. Here are the notes from the info label:Servings per container: 2; Calories: 300; Calories from Fat: 120Total Fat: 14g; Saturated Fat 7g; Trans Fat 0gCholesterol: 25mgSodium: 190mgTotal Carbohydrate: 43g; Dietary Fiber 1g; Sugars 23gProtein 3gAt 600 calories per cookie you can see why they taste so good, so we eat them only as occasional treats in moderation. We buy a box full, or at least several at a time since they are so popular with the family. Everyone loves them, this is a treat both Gluten Free and non Gluten Free eaters will enjoy. Trust me, these will get eaten quickly!These are available locally along the Wasatch Front in Utah. If you live there you can try any of the New Grains products much easier. We've seen them in Maceys and Harmons too now. We look forward to occasional trips to Utah where we stock up on New Grains products.5 stars for a wonderful Gluten Free cookie treat

I was pretty amazed by the taste and quality of this cookie.  It stayed fresh for a long period, which only happened because it had fallen behind something.  My kids loved them and they are known for being very forthright with their opinions.  Thx for making a great product.

So pleased with these gluten free cookies! We didn't want the gluten free kids to feel 'different' or get 'less of' a treat. Man, everyone was fighing over these. I just wish I would have ordered the box of them!
The first time I tried this cookie I was happily surprised. These cookies are delicious and perfect for me when I get that craving for granny b cookies that I used to eat!

I was looking for syrups for my soda machine that use cane sugar instead of fructose corn syrup.  This cherry lime tastes so good, I think I'll just stick with it for my go-to flavor.  It also tastes good poured straight over crushed ice, like a snow cone.  It costs a little more than the other Torani syrups, but is well worth it.

Apparently Torani has already figured it out to achieving the full essence of Cherry Lime 1/3 more syrup is needed in comparison with Torani Peach Syrup 750mL.  Though not as much concentrated as the Peach, its high end taste still reflects throughout as being extremely flavorful while keeping up with the famous Torani label.

This syrup is awesome!  I have a Sodastream and I use this as flavoring instead of the Sodastream brand flavoring.  The cherry lime flavor is bright and delicious.  It has real sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup or artificial/diet sugar and it makes a huge difference.  I don't even have to use a whole lot of it each time either.  It is just really good and really high-quality.
We enjoy this syrup mixed with Seltzer water at our house, tastes fantastic! We enjoy the Torani brand and use other flavors for our coffee.

column9: Protein-packed, gluten-free, egg replacer--and a recipe for you
column10: Garbanzo flour is known as "Besan" in Indian cooking and it's simply the ground flour of chickpeas, so it's a bean flour, not a grain. it is slightly yellow in color and has a somewhat nutty and sweet taste. Due to the high protein, a batter of chickpea flour and water can behave rather like an egg batter when you use it to dip foods for frying. In addition, it's used in a number of Indian sweets that are somewhat like fudge or nougat.If you want a really great recipe for zucchini pakoras, or fritters, it's so simple, you'll want to make these frequently. You can also use large white mushroom slices, Vidalia onion rings, even thinly sliced potato or sweet potato. Slices of cauliflower, carrot and whole trimmed green beans work, too. Here's the recipe:1 cup Chickpea Flour1/2 cup water1 tsp Garam Masala (Indian spice mix)2 tsp each, grated gingerroot and mashed garlic1/2 tsp ground chili pepperMix this up until it's nice and smooth. This is your batter.Thinly slice (1/4 inch) zucchini, or mushrooms, onions (make into rings), potatoes or use a mix of these vegetables. Dip each piece into the batter and coat well. Fry in a cast iron skillet with a shallow layer of vegetable oil (you don't need more than a 1/4 to a 1/2 inch of oil.) When the fritters are caramel-brown on one side, flip and cook the other side. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle lightly with coarse sea salt, if you like. I use tongs to flip the vegetables. These are fantastic as appetizers or a quick snack.

The Chinese are supposedly cheaper because they lack the flavor and aroma of the French and Italian black truffles.This product is certainly not worth the price.  You basically get a tube full of what may well have been a paste made from black colored cardboard and oil.

"Tuber melanosporum Vittadini"This is the principal variety of Black Truffle in France.When people say "Black Truffle" this is the one they think of.Tuber melanosporum Vittadini is the only one used in their black truffle paste.The actual variety's scientific name is listed in the ingredient list of the package and on their website.This is helpful in avoiding confusion and bad reputation.They do offer Black Summer Truffles (Tuber aestivum) and Burgundy Truffles (Tuber unicinatum), as well.These are not to be confused with Chinese Black Summer Truffles.Chinese Black Summer Truffles (Tuber sinensis or Tuber indicum) are not inferior, just different.They produce at high volume, but can be distinguished from Tuber Melanosporum Vittadini using a microscope.None of the Chinese varieties are/have been offered by this company.The truffled products by this company last a long time and are great for finishing sauces and prepared foods.A little bit will go a long way making them an economical option. They also offer fresh truffles (in season), frozen truffles, numerous pastes, truffled oils, truffled vinegars, truffled pasta, truffled bonbons....You can't go wrong, if you're well-informed.
