I got these to use as part of my wedding favors. I had to make 100 favors. The package ended up containing only 82 bags of gummi bears. Luckily I ended up only needing 88 complete favors, but still, I ended up having to buy a few bags at the local candy store to make up the difference.  Just keep this in mind if you're doing something that needs an exact number.
These mini packet bears taste differently than the big ones, almost plastic tasting. I prefer the bigger bags that are not individually wrapped.
Haribo mini bears are adorable.They were a big hit on Halloween.The 100 count rather then 72 was an extra bonus and they were very fresh.I will definitely order more. Thank you!!

The order arrived quickly and it perfect condition. The individual bags are perfect for our wedding candy bar, and the gummies themselves are very yummy. I would definitely order from this company again!
Product was fresh and was delivered fast.  I will purchase these again and have recommended this product to friends.
I am gluten-intolerant and love Tinkyada's brand pasta!  My family is not restricted to this diet and also love this brand as well!

column9: The best brown rice pasta ever
column10: The problem with the rice pastas I've tried always comes down to taste and texture.  The taste misses the mark of true pastas and the texture is somewhere between slimy and mealy.  Not so with Tinkyada's Brown Rice Pastas.I first heard about Tinkyada from a friend whose wife is old-school Italian.  Joann swore that Tinkyada was almost as good as fresh homemade, a claim about which I was skeptical.  However, I've been using Tinkyada for almost 3 months now and can't imagine trying any other brand.  One other plus in its favor is that it is more forgiving to cook than other rice pastas I've tried, allowing overcooking with no unfortunate culinary consequences.If you're trying to get some (or all) of the gluten out of your life or if you just want to find a really good pasta, I can't recommend Tinkyada highly enough.

I only use pasta products made by Tinkyada. The pasta always comes out perfectly and non-celiac people can't tell the difference. I've used the spiral pastas for my veggie pasta salads and they turn out great. I eat Tinkyada pasta every week!

By far the best gluten free pasta I've tried.  Even my non-celiac family members like it.  You don't have to be too particular with cooking times - cook it to the firmness you like, just like "regular" pasta.

I bought this pasta when I was on a gluten free diet. They are actually much better than wholewheat pasta. If I made it into baked ziti then some of my kids were willing to eat it. You have to rinse it very well, otherwise its mushy.

column9: Used to use Barilla Whole Wheat pasta and my tastebuds have not noticed the switch to this pasta.
column10: Biggest worry about becoming a new gf mom, was the possibility of never having anything quick to fix for the kids again.  Problem solved.  Found this right away at the local grocery store.  I just had to adjust the time I boil.  I tend to stick the brown rice ones and not the white.  My family prefers the spirals and elbows.  No complaints from the teenagers.

column4: Penny Zeller, Christian Author and Speaker
column10: My husband and I both can't have wheat. We've tried several "rice" noodles and Tinkyada is by far superior. As a matter of fact, it tastes better than "regular" pasta noodles. I would highly recommend this product.
I've been so impressed with this line of pastas that it's has driven all others out of the house.  You would truly never know it's not white flour pasta.
My son and I are allergic to wheat. Tinkyada pasta is made of rice, but tastes as good as the best wheat pasta. You won't be able to tell the difference. Buy it!
like everyone says, not mushy.  really tasty.  i think the price is great, but then i saw them in wholefoods for a little less.  can that be possible!!!  check it out.
Want some good pasta and it has to be gluten free. Here it is.Well as a cold or hot pasta.

column9: Expect Chocolate and You'll likely be Disappointed
column10: I recently tried "Brewing Chocolate", which is ground cacao beans that you treat like ground coffee beans....and the result was interesting, even good.  So when I saw these, I thought "Why not?"These are different - and perhaps an acquired taste.  They are definitely NOT chocolate, and not particularly chocolate-y, either.  So, if you get them, try not to have any expectations...if you do, you're not likely to be pleased.There are 5 boxes, and I gave four of them away, to siblings and children.  Not a single one has contacted me with thanks or to say how wonderful they were.  That was kind of my reaction, too....

If you love dark chocolate, nutritionists now say it's good for you.  As a friend said, "Chocolate is a vegetable--it's a bean!"  About square or ounce of dark chocolate per day above 60% cacao is now recommended by health experts.  I love this affordable Ghiradelli chocolate.  I can eat less than an oz. and be fully satisfied.  It's a great after dinner treat and quite low in calories.  Less than 100 calories depending on size.  This 86% Cacao chocolate is not too bitter for me.  I now prefer it over milk chocolate.  Highly recommend this chocolate.  It's a non-guilty pleasure--one of the few out there.

column9: Mmmm, Ghiradelli dark chocolate!  My secret pleasure!
column10: All I need to see is the name Ghiradelli and I know it will be delicious.  I especially love these Intense Dark 86% cacao chocolate squares - they melt so nicely on your tongue, and satisfy that chocolate urge with just one square.  Ok, maybe two squares....This 4-pack works great because I can keep one bag in the kitchen for those moments when only dark, quality chocolate will do.  And I can keep the other three bags hidden safely away from my kids, who are satisfied with Snickers or Hershey bars.
If you love dark chocolate, then you'll fall in love with these!  Ghiradelli never makes a bad product and these didn't disappoint!

column9: Eat These for Health and Pleasure
column10: Ghirardelli makes the best affordable chocolate you can get and I love this very dark version.  However, I found it elsewhere at 6 bags for the same price (also with free delivery for $25 purchase).

I must have misread the description thinking it was 4 12 ounce bags.  Negative - it's four 4.12 ounce bags making each 4 ounce bag almost 7 bucks. I don't care how good the chocolate is I'm not spending $25 a pound for it again.

Love this chocolate! So satisfying - my husband says it's great with red wine, and he's not a big dessert lover. For me, 2 squares after dinner prevent cravings for sugary desserts. I was looking for a great 60%-plus cacao after reading Dr. Perricone's latest book, and this is it!
These are really good.  I have them when I need an extra energy jolt.  At about 20MG of caffeine per individually wrapped square, they are perfect for me.  I like the taste too.

My favorite standard dark chocolate. Dark chocolate is good for you, the darker the better. 72% is the darkest most people can stand. I like the 86% for a break from the 72% & for extra zing. I gave one of my friends an 86% square; and, he accused me of trying to poison him! Work up to the 86%.I love the squares which help me control my portions. 4 squares is the serving size SO if you just eat one a day it's about 70 calories! Ghirardelli is middle of the road for premium chocolates which means they're really good.
Wonderful Dark Chocolate and its my Fav...The Taste is really super and one need to have this for a healthy life
If you like true dark chocolate, this is for you. Ghiradelli Midnight Reverie is excellent and the individually wrapped pieces make portion control easy.
Goya, has high quality products. I like "Sazon Goya" because I enjoy preparing some traditional South American dishes and this product allows me to get just the right flavors.

This is the best instant tea I've had yet. Suddenly I'm not able to find it locally so I'm very happy that Amazon is offering the subscribe and save method of purchasing. I'll save a bundle on gas trying to find it near home.
Can't find these in stores anymore so was glad to find a place online.  Great product!  Only one I can find that is just tea with no lemon.

I've been using Adagio Teas for several years.  I love the 1812 Gunpowder Tea and have it sent repeatedly,  I've also bought tons of their Berry Teas for the college kids.  They love it and its a great pick-me-up.  Because of the stress at college many of them use the Chamomile or Peppermint tea for their tummies.The people with Adagio are very helpful.  And all their teas are excellent and reasonably priced.

But I'm still giving this tea five stars, even though I hated it.  Why?  If you love Gunpowder, you'll love this tea.  It is the smokiest tea I've ever had in my life and the taste stays with you for a long time.  In fact, I started to feel like I had just smoked a cigar, because the smokiness is that heavy.  I prefer Adagio's Hojicha over this and if you're not sure about the smokiness of this particular tea you might want to try that instead.

I absolutely love this gunpowder tea.  The utmost quality every time I refill, which is quite often.  A delicious smokey and smooth taste, I prefer this far more than any other green.If you enjoy darker teas and are looking to try something new, I highly recommend starting here.  Mix with peppermint for an amazing blend!

I purchased this soup mix just to try it out.  WOW!  You just add one can of diced tomatoes and you have a tremendous soup that one would never know is out of a package.  I served with shredded cheese and tortilla chips. This item will always be on my shelf. Absolutely delicious.

I initially tried Shore Lunch minestrone and it was pretty good.  I then tried this tortilla soup.  I added 1 pound of ground chicken with it.  What a wonderful blend of tastes!  I get three meals from each packet.  I couple my bowl of Shore Lunch soups with freshly baked rolls.  I really like their products.  The prices that Amazon charges are a bit higher than what I pay at one of our local grocers.

This is without a doubt the worst concoction that we have ever tried and I am amazed that anyone can stomach it. Nothing but a bland mix of goo with tons of pepper and spices added to cover it up. Same applies to the other Shore Lunch meals we tried! Do yourself a favor and leave them alone!

Having enjoyed other Shore Lunch products, their Chili mix and chicken and fish breadings are great, I was very disappointed with the Tortilla Soup Mix.  It is so salty that I wound up adding cut raw potatoes to the next 2 packs while they were simmering.  That absorbed the salt and made the soup edible.  Since I added only a can of salt-free diced tomatoes the mix is the culprit -- way too much sodium to be healthy.
This is a mollusk found in California, Mexico, and other places. If you are looking for real abalone, this is not what you want. In fact, the label on the can says ''abalone like''.
These brownies are delicious. They are about as good as you can get from a box. The semi-sweet chocolate chucks really add a special homemade feel. I would totally recommend these brownies.
These may be a bit pricey, but the flavor is terrific and lasts a reasonable amount of time also.5 stars!
This is the only place I know that sells this sugarless gum. No one else has it! It's always fresh.

I just had rectal surgery, so I obviously needed some good sources of fiber. After 4 weeks of recovery, I'm still eating this every morning. I make two pouches for breakfast so its pretty easy to get another 10g of fiber to meet my daily needs. It really helps that this stuff is so delicious. I highly recommend that you try this product.
Good honey, not as hard as what I am used to for whipped honey but still very good

column9: A good deal, don't order in warm weather.
column10: Addendum to the review I wrote previously:  Use caution when ordering.  I ordered when there was warm weather and the honey had seeped out of the containers and made a big mess.  I salvaged most of them, but it was a pain.I'm on a health kick so I'm buying the raw, local honey at the neighborhood food cooperative from now on.This honey does not seem to be whipped, but it is a little thicker than the stuff in a bottle.  But, still, it is an excellent deal-half the price as honey in the store and honey in the tub is less messy.  Kroger's has honey that is really whipped and it is even easier to use but costs more than $5 for a 16 oz. tub.  The best part, it's made in good ol' Kansas, U.S.A.

I bought these recently as a Friday special for a great price.  These came quickly and I have one bag open and the others hidden so I don't eat them all.  These are huge bags and the candy is nice and fresh.  Wish the peanut butter ones would come in bags like these and sold thru Amazon, not another seller who charges shipping.  Thanks for the good sale on these.

column9: Great Value for a LOT of M&Ms
column10: What can I say..Amazon does it again...A huge amount of M&M's for a very small price.What makes this a good deal as well is that they are all the individually wrapped M&M packages.These are a great size for snacks, desserts, etc. where you don't want to sit and eat 300 of them...

I loved this great purchase at less than ten bucks, and they're M&Ms!  What's to say about them?  If you haven't had them, go out and buy a pack, they're a fantastic candy!  I prefer the ones with almonds best, but considering how cheap the milk chocolate version was, I wasn't going to pass up a great deal like that!  Thanks Amazon, I will keep coming back!
I use these at work for treats, nice to get a larger sized bag at a decent price. No problems with the quality. They came packed in dry ice which was a pleasant surprise!
My favorite candy by far.  Just the right amount of chocolate and peanut.  I can eat a whole bag by myself.  And no, not the small package, the COSTCO sized ones!!  Yep I'm a huge fan :)

No need to review the product because I'm sure most people in the U.S. who are able to eat peanuts have had these.  These arrived fresh and in good condition.  I can't give even peanut M&Ms more than 4 stars since I think the chocolate used in these products keeps getting worse and worse over time; but they are still a fun, enjoyable snack.I ordered this along with a box of Snickers with Almonds, and Amazon included, as part of my Prime membership, a free "cold pack".This consisted of a very thick and sturdy Styrofoam lidded box, in which the candies were packed, along with four large cold-pack freezable units.The item was in shipping transit for approximately 3 days, and delivered to a hot, humid region.Upon opening the container, I found that the candies were still cold and in good condition, although the cold-packs were no longer frozen or really cold.Amazon did a great job on packing this.  Thought I would share that, in case others are concerned about ordering such products from this company.  I'm even keeping the Styrofoam chest and cold-packs for re-use, since they are of pretty nice quality.
Shipped quickly.  The candy was fresh and tasted great.  What more can I say?  I wish we bought more.  There

column9: they are a little bit too delicious for me!
column10: i had to order another 2 42 ounce bags today. the others i purchased at amazon did not last very long unfortunately. they are fresh. they are in a nice quality resealable bag to keep them fresh. they are delicious. watch for the lowest price. i am very happy with the freshness and quality of this product. it looks fresh and it smells fresh. i have ordered the 42 ounce size multiple times so far and i have no complaints.
This is a great products, kids love it.  Good for cooking!  If you buy them in the store they will cost you quite abit more for a single pack. 6 pack was a good deal.
Sent to my sister and she loved them!  Kind of costly but had free shipping which offset mailing cost to purchase and mail.

column9: What can you say about M&M's?
column10: Obviously if you're reading this you've probably already had M&M's - so don't let that stop you from buying this package!  I love the size of this bag because it fills a candy dish that I have out completely with a few left over for me to eat up right away.  They last for a while - though not as long as they should - in my house, but I'll keep ordering them as they are a delicious treat.

I was tired of getting bags of assorted chocolate candy that always had a variety no one would eat.  I love that amazon was selling this product and it came in "bulk".  I won't run out of the office candy again!  I went ahead and bought all of the favorite brands so I can keep everyone happy.

What can I say! I love peanuts M&M's. I love them more than the regular kinds. They're filling and tasty. I got one of those M&M gumball machines and filled it up with this. I just love them. Go M&M's!

column9: I received my M&Ms just fine.
column10: I ordered the 4 large bags. I received them in a timely manner and appreciated that they were shipped in a minimal amount of packaging. The four bags were simply shrink wrapped together and put in the box with my other items. I have only opened one bag so far but the M&M's were in great condition. Great price, delicious product, excellent service.Edit (10/01/10)- The price for these is now $35 more than when I bought them the first time. I can buy these for less than $10 a bag at the store. So the price is now closer to ridiculous then great.

A pair of these giant bags of your basic peanut M&M's sort of shrinkwrapped together, for the same price others are selling just one bag.  I took these as a gift for a friend in Italy who hadn't been able to find them there.  I had to pull one out of my suitcase to get it back under the weight requirements and put it in my carryon, no problems with either.  My friend was delighted when they arrived and began snacking happily away immediately.

A delicious candy in a hard, milk chocolate shell in different variety of colors at a very good price when available through Amazon including free shipping. Will be purchasing this again in any size as long as the price is right!

I received the package early, which was great. The candy packaging looked fine but I didn't discover the problem until I opened the bag. Half the bag of Peanut M&M's was cracked! I was really embarrassed to share them with anybody because the entire bagful was dusted with M&M debris. Not happy with this purchase at all.

First off, the initial arrival:  It came in a bigger box (since other things were ordered as well) when I opened it the 2 yellow bags set neatly and ready for me to eat!  Packaging, no other boxes or bags were used or necessary.  Review of the value: this is going to put it in perspective;1) The average size bags are about 1.69 ounces2) The larger size bags range from 9-11 ounces depending on which one as they make several.3) This bag was just over 42 ounces and they go up to 60 ounces in certain packaging.In theory you could go out and buy a bunch of the 1.69 ounce packages and to equal the total of about 84 ounces and at about $1 a bag you'd only buy about 48 bags at $.99 a bag it would be cheaper to go with these bags - however, the cost of this item was a little disappointing because I expected a little more in the bags.  Aside from a portion (probably 25% of the height) of the bag being air, I was just hoping for more M&M's.  Overall I give this purchase a C+ value as it was cheaper to buy this way.  But, as always beware of pricing for example another seller on Amazon charges $9.19 for the same bag (but you have to pay for shipping).  If you wanted to buy using Amazon Prime, like myself then you could get regular M&M's (no peanuts) for only $15.63 - about $10 less so that may be worth the savings.  An okay value - but at the end of the day it was cheaper than buying them individually. 73beats

I grew up on Sunmaid raisins and when they started to cover them with chocolate I thought I was in heaven.  I cannot get enough for these things it is dangerous, lol.I find the chocolate is smooth and creamy and a nice intensity, the raisins are always soft and chewy.  These are perfect.The large container is the best way to buy them. They are always fresh and I would recommended them.The large boxes were then bought when I had a business, my people loved the individual packs.

It really does not take me at least 20 words to tell you just how yummy this cany is.Listen Mahoney...The little "Mary-Jane" Girl on the bag is stoney enough for you to try this candy out as yourtoken a rip bro! ......5-STARS!

I have been eating this brand of squid since 2003 when I was in the Navy.. It is delicious and has a fantastic sweet taste to it. This stuff can be addicting, its  that good... A word of warning however.. Eat this only when you are alone or not going out with a group of people for awhile. Your breath WILL become funky after eating it. On the plus side, it goes well with beer.

column9: Great experience! I have never tried this before!
column10: So, I have never tried dried squid of any kind so this was a bit of an experience. I really wanted to and actually I am glad I did.The squid arrived quickly and I opened it up right away. It was fishy smelling (as expected) and tasted like a sweet fishy...jerky. (Trust me it was odd at first) But after a bit of getting used to I really ended up liking it and craving it! The only downside was the very fishy smell that sticks to everything. But I really liked the product and will end up buying again probably. The price was good as well.

column9: Did NOT receive item as pictured, mylar balls were ruined
column10: Instead of coming in a nice bagged package, as the picture shows, I received 4 mylar balls shoved loose into the mailing envelope. There was no sign of the original packaging. They were crushed flat and ripped in several places, and appear to be old and dusty (possibly used?) The balls were so badly flattened that I could not return the balls to a "round" shape even when I tried reshaping them. It may seem petty to complain about packaging for a cat's toy, but the items recieved were NOT as pictured, and were squished entirely flat and all 4 of them were torn. I was very disappointed that I did not even receive new-looking items from this seller for the price I was charged.

My cat loves these things. Just picking one up and crinkling it will bring her running from where ever she is to pounce on the ball when I throw it. Unfortunately she chases them so manically that they 'disappear' eventually (ie get stuck in out of the way places so I can't find them anymore) and I seem to always be buying her a new set of these to pounce on.

only 1 of my 2 cats have shown any interest at all in these mylar toys. Shes attracted to the crinkle sound right before i throw it but they dont go very far cause they're so light + they stop moving almost immediately when they hit the floor so she loses interest pretty quickly. As with most cat toys, you just never know until u get it home. 1 cats treasure is another cats yawn.

Bought three packages of these for my cat since she loves them so much.  She spends up to an hour batting them around and she's trained us to throw them for her.  I think it's the crinkling sound that makes it attractive to cats.

column9: Kitty Loves Them (but they are not cheap!)
column10: My kitties love these!! All I have to do is crinkle the toy a bit and they come running!  I wish they were cheaper, though.  And I do periodically have to check under furniture, stove, other appliances, wine fridge, etc. to "rescue" all of their toys...
What the hell, my two cats looked at it and then looked at me as if what have I given them!! They don't play with it at all. Moreover it was only 3$ in walmart.
you can tell, when they disappear under the couch within hours of being put on the floor - cats go crazy for these

These crinkle balls are pretty much my cat's favorite things on earth, other than food. I have two kittens and they just go crazy for these. It seems to be especially fun on a hard surface. The only problem is that they eventually end up under the furniture or some other inaccessible place. I plan to have a stock pile. If I ever need to distract my cats, this is my go-to.

My cats love these.I had to talk myself in getting these since a crumped piece of paper works for these. But I am glad I bought these. The cats are having so much fun with them and they last longer than the paper.

column9: Many cats love this toy, but the dye leaks into their water...
column10: At our animal shelter, this toy is a big favorite.  It is shiny, colorful, lightweight and makes a crinkling sound when crushed or batted.  I would give it five stars except for the fact that if the toy gets batted into the water dish, the dye from the toy will leak into the water, discoloring the water, and the cats will not drink the water anymore.  I am not sure if the dye is toxic or not, so I'm glad the cats don't drink it.I would not recommend this toy for cats confined in a small space with an open water dish, but otherwise, this is a great item!

These crinkly little balls have provided hours of play for our two cats.  The balls can be thrown for fetch, hidden in a old Amazon box for some hide-n-seek, or just batted around and fought over.  They are quiet enough that you don't notice the cats playing with them at night, until they lay stand on your chest in an attempt to get you to play fetch!The Mylar balls wear down over time, getting flatter and less round, but they don't lose much of their material and hold up to rough play very well. Your cats will enjoy these toys, and you'll be willing to fish them out from under the couch time and time again.

My cat hates the noise it makes as much as she is indifferent to the toy. I had such high hopes with the other rave reviews but found this to be another collosal waste. the only toys she's liked are the zany mice, real laser pointer, and the wand with the long pice of flannes.
Our cat is insanely lethargic, but he goes nuts when we open these things. We can be in the other side of the house and he will race in when he hears it crinkle.
My kitty absolutely loves these things...I leave them out for her at night and in the morning I have to really hunt to locate then since she bats them around the living room all night..LOL.
Arrived quickly. My cats love them. It is hard to find them in the pet stores. If only they sold something to retrieve them from under all of the furniture.

column9: Great addition to the cat toy box
column10: One of my two kittens absolutely adores this toy - It's sparkly, makes noise when attacked, and both rolls and throws very well. It also works well when tied to a "kitty fishing rod" (aka a dowel with a length of string and a toy on the end).

All my cats love these, especially my littlest girl.  None of my cats is a chewer, so this toy does not require supervision.  If your cats tend to chew these, they will need supervision as you don't want them ingesting mylar plastic - that being said, most cats are not chewers, so I think these are generally safe.  Also, these balls are large enough not to be accidentally swallowed, while still being small enough for good play.  Easy for cats to carry, light enough for great batting around and chasing and most cats love the crinkle noise - mine have terrific fun and will play by themselves with these even in the middle of the night (don't worry crinkle sound is not loud enough to disturb sleep, and I'm a light sleeper).  Bonus - not hazardous to MY health either - i.e. if your cat leaves them laying around (like mine) and you step on one by accident (as I often do), they just squash so you don't slip, fall or trip - plus they can be fluffed back up after squashing, good as new. Win win.

column9: Not what I was looking for
column10: I was looking for some jasmine extract to make some thai desserts with.  When I opened this bottle of jasmine extract, it sort of smelled like jasmine, but also had some other weird (not so great) smell to it. I tried using it once, and dumped the rest down the drain. It also came in a plastic bottle, which I found curious, as I was expecting glass.  I have since found much better jasmine extract elsewhere online.

Why would anyone spend $8.99 plus $5.50 minimum shipping for nuts without knowing the quantity to be supplied?  One wonders if it is 6 oz, 9 oz perhaps 15 oz (fast becoming the "supermarket pound") or even 16 oz.  But the scant information supplied does not tell the interested buyer this crucial fact.  I suppose we are expected not to care about such details.PS: They did not offer the option of "no stars."
I think this product had been in stock for years. They were not even squared because they had been manhandled; A whole lot of crumbs in the bag.

This barbecue sauce is really good. It definitely has that rich jerk flavor. I made jerk chicken tonight and topped it with this sauce and my husband couldn't stop eating it! We both felt like we were back in Negril.
I simply can't live without this. I love to bake chicken wings with it. They always come out so perfect.

This Lucuma tastes delightful. I use it on deserts (strawberries & cream for example), use it in fruit juices - carrot, oranges, apples and this. Powder is very fine and takes a bit to dissolve it into liquids but well worth it. Shipping was fast and hassle free.

We used to buy Nutiva in 29oz & 54oz from Whole Foods.  We're using more coconut oil; it is good stuff - you know that or you wouldn't be reading this :-)Anyway, we started with a single 1-gallon order to see how "bulk" would work.It worked very well - the order shipped promptly and was securely packed.Now that first gallon is about used up, so getting ready to put in another order (I'll be ordering 4 x 1 gallons this time).I wanted to write this & say thanks to Natures Approved; I like what they do.We're saving our old Nutiva jars to have an easy-access cupboard size.  This seems to have a bit lower melting point than Nutiva - I ordered in late summer, so it arrived all melted (no leaks - did I mention they were great about secure packing?).  I didn't think about this at the time, but being melted made it easy to pour into the smaller containers.*shrug* What's not to like :-  Highly recommended.

I made the unfortunate assumption that organic corn puffs would be wheat-free.  The online product info doesn't say either way, but the package, once you receive it, does warn that they're made in a facility that also processes wheat.  As someone who does fine with corn but is allergic to wheat, I had a violent reaction to them.  They taste good, but they're definitely not for anyone who needs to avoid wheat; that should be prominently stated in their description.

I read in a brochure from NonGMOShoppingGuide.com that the eight Genetically Modified food crops in the U.S. were CORN, Soybeans, Canola, Cottonseed, Sugar Beets, Hawaiian Papaya (most) and some Zucchini and Yellow Squash.  Therefore, Nature's Path Organic Corn Puffs was exactly what I was looking for.  It's light, crisp and tasty--and knowing that its essence was just as the Great Architect God had made it, made it all the more enjoyable.

The best Corny Puffy Puffiness out there. Fat? Sugar? Cholesterol? Sodium? No, no, no and no. Yummy, Yummy and Yummy? Yes, yes & yes. Organic and made by a company exhibiting care for the environment? Bonus.

column9: Cheaper than buying one bag at a time locally.
column10: My wife and I can go through these pretty fast. We eat them as snacks while watching TV. Amazon's bulk lot of 12 bags is cheaper per bag than buying at the local co-op. After eating 4 bags so far, we haven't had any issues with stale puffs. However, just like the locally bought ones, they do get stale pretty quick after opening (few days).

These corn puffs were pretty bland.  I could only get my kids to eat it by adding alot of sweetener (I use organic evaporated cane juice, or unrefined sugar as I call it) and a little sprinkle of cinnamon.  I probably will not purchase again.
I love love the puffed corn product,I wish they were sold at more places,its a whole lot healthier/cheaper then many other cereals
I purchase organic snacks often.  This cereal is a perfect snack.  It is very similiar to popcorn.  Nature's Path is one of my favorite brands.

I gave this product 5 stars because it delivers on what it is supposed to be. Nothing complicated, just puffed corn. I like to have this cereal for breakfast with blueberries, banana and whole milk. column9: Used to be a great drink... Now it tastes like flat 7-UP!
column10: What once came in a 12oz can, had 70% fruit juice and tasted uniquely refreshing has been unnecessarily transformed into an over-priced, 10.5oz can of flat 7-UP.  The only term I can think of that describes the new version of Knudsen's Mandarin Lime Spritzer is "Whooptie-Doo!"Just for archival purposes, since Knudsen's think they're doing us all a favor by ruining this drink, here's a list of differences between the old tasty drink and the new flat 7-UP version:OLD Mandarin Lime Spritzer Ingredients:* Sparkling Filtered Water* 70% White Grape Juice Concentrate* Natural Flavors* Tangerine Oil* 12oz CanNEW Mandarin Lime Spritzer Ingredients:* Sparkling Filtered Water* 60% White Grape, Lime and Mandarin Juice Concentrates* Natural Flavors* 10.5oz CanFor me, the biggest difference is the lack of Tangerine Oil that gave the original version a unique, fresh flavor.  The new version tastes like flat Sprite or Flat 7-UP and is absolutely boring.Additionally, what once came in a 6-pack now comes in an over-priced 4-pack.Less quality, less juice, less flavor and fewer cans for MORE money. What the heck is Knudsen doing?  Why change something like this that wasn't broken in the first place?Hopefully others will reward Knudsen for this kind of self-destructive behavior and stop buying their products.  After all, flat 7-UP is really cheap and easy to make - and still comes in 12oz can 6-packs.

Now, as an avid baker, I was familiar with paste colors and knew them to be superior to the regular liquid stuff you get at the grocer. I didn't realize, however, what a difference brandname made. These are truly superior in quality and you don't need near as much to get the desired color--which eliminates that bitter flavor you get when adding too much dark coloring to icing.I highly recommend these colors...you won't be disappointed.
Love this set but you can find it cheaper elsewhere.  Colors are vibrant & true. Only prob company sent me airbrush colors by mistake. They corrected it immediately. Great customer service!

column9: awesome colors, but note the Set#2 part!
column10: I'll go into more detail as I try the various shades.I lovelovelove gel food coloring!They don't get funky tasting and not being liquid, it doesn't changethe consistency of the food you are putting them in.That being said, just pay close attention to this listing.Truly, I was just looking for a 12-pc set and thought they were all the same.They aren't!  Notice what I didn't notice - SET#2.The colors listed are exactly what I received, so that part is great.But I was looking to get a base of more basic colors and build on that.I already had black, or I would have been very ticked that it wasn't in this set.(And it would have been my fault for not reading more carefully).So, just pay attention to what colors you are buying in any given listing.They are all good, and I certainly won't return them.However, I also wasn't truly looking for many of the colors in this set.
These are the best. The colors are vivid,simiple to use and no mess.I like that the bottles are spill proof.
these are great! I was very happy with how quickly they arrived. I'm always very happy with these gel colors

I purchased two sets of Americolor gels, and a set of Americolor Airbrush colors. Pleased with purchase.  Arrived quickly, no problems.  Gels colors look good, but can't comment on the aribrush colors yet.  Haven't used them, but arrived safely, no spills.  Everything intact.  Would pruchase from again. Thanks.

I was very excited that there were so many color options...that should have been my 1st clue. These are artificial food colorings so why are they showing up in an organic search??? When this cheese first arrived I found it creamy and very mild. So I put it away for 2 weeks in my refrigerator. Wow, after 2 weeks it had matured and is incredibly delicious. If you buy it and agree with me follow my example; you'll be rewarded by this excellent cheese.
Great product, would definitely order again. Great in salads too! The price was great too. Try it wou'll like it.
I am totally satisfied with this noodle. If you cook this noodle as written on the package, you won't be disappointed.

My cats have been eating this for several years and up to now-have loved it.  I have purchased this product from pet shops and amazon.  This last shipment from amazon is not the same product as the label claims.  When the can is opened, it initially looks and smells like salmon, but underneath the 1/8 inch of a top layer of the real looking stuff, is something else.  It looks like a wee bit of the real product was sprayed over an imposter product, because it is not the same underneath, nor does it look or smell the same.  My cat vomited with the first feeding.  My cats don't like it now.  they eat the salmon coating and leave the rest.  I want to know where amazon got this batch of cans, because it is not Dick Van Pattens Natural Balance. Someone is duping us and we are paying a high price for a fraud. Identifiers on the bottom of the can are: NBSCP, best by Jan 13 15, the numbers below the sku on the box are: 723633004152.

column9: good eating for a distressed cat tummy
column10: ANatural Balance Green Pea and Salmon Formula Cat Food (Pack of 24 6-Ounce Cans)After trying many foods for this beautiful cat. We found this is the one that causes decreased vomiting. Having tried Venison and Green Pea still caused freguent vomiting. The Salmon and Green Pea was the food he needed.

The beast loves this wet food. I was nervous about reordering after reading some of the quality issues in other reviews, so i switched to the Venison flavor. Big mistake. Its a different consistency, and he doesn't like it as much as the salmon. Since i put him on an all Natural Balance diet, his coat has been gorgeous, and he's a very happy boy. Worth the extra cost.

Have been using for years for multiple cats.  Great because it does not have any corn products.  Cats love the salmon flavor and the duck, chicken did not go over so well in house, and the venison was great at first and then they stopped eating it.  It is a staple in our house, we recommend over some Science Diet and other brands we have tried.

column9: Cat requiring limited diet loves this
column10: I bought this after my vet recommended my cat go on a limited ingredient diet due to some health problems.  We first bought Wellness food from a local pet store.  The Wellness food was really expensive (something like double the price of this Natural Balance food) and my cat didn't even seem to like it much.  My cat is a sea food lover and used to get Fancy Feast seafood in gravy.  She wouldn't eat the pate type soft food at all.  But she seems to love this NB food, we started off giving her a mix of the new and old food and within a couple days she was picking out just the new food and leaving the Fancy Feast behind.  This food is softer looking than typical pate style cat food.  This is more expensive than Fancy Feast, but for my kitty it is now a must and it's less expensive than some of the other options my cat is allowed.  Now I just have to find limited ingredient treat that my cat will actually eat to reward her for taking her medicine.

I rescued a small kitten - now strong, sleek, vital, wild beastie growing healthier every day. After trying a variety of brands and types we cottoned onto Dick Van Patten's formulas. Wellness? Nuh-huh, thanks. My little chausie loves this Natural Balance salmon variety the most. I can hardly put it in the bowl before its gone!

column9: reese pimento stuffed olives, 3-ounce jars (pack of 12)
column10: This was perfect for me as i can use 1 jar at a time for my cooking when i make chicken fricassee or beef stew as well as hispanic meals like rice with chicken.the slender jar takes very little space in my refrigerator. Also it assures the olives are always fresh. Olives also can be used in conjunction with various spreads on crackers as an appetizer.

This Marinade has the best flavor!!  This product is too good to use as a marinade, I use it on my sushi, tuna filets, shrimp and I would even dip french fries in it.  I hope it's available soon, my grocery store no longer carries it.

I've enjoyed this tea for years, and introduced it to many of my tea-drinking friends. The best Oolong tea available, in my honest opinion. And Amazon gave a better price to my door thanks to their super saver free shipping option for the bulk order over $25.00-better than the manufacturers' price and shipping cost.

I usually prefer loose leaf tea but my husband won't touch the stuff.  At the same time he wants bagged tea that somehow still tastes fresh.  This tea pack provides the taste he is looking for and for a great price.  Fantastic Value.

column9: Beware, contains sulfites - not that they make it easy to find out...
column10: I've been looking for an affordable source of sulfite-free lemon juice since Costco stopped carrying "Italian Volcano" brand locally.This looked like a possible alternative; the amazon price wasn't bad, and it was called "natural".  The ad above does NOT list the ingredients.  And I went to the Sadaf website which ALSO does not list the ingredients. So I wrote their website and asked nicely if it contained sulfites, and after a week I got back a terse reply that said "read the label".  They HAVE a label on their website, but it doesn't have ingredients on it.So I had to dig into googling for research, and I finally found a complaint against their firm (you can find it too, just google "Sadaf Lemon Sulfites") which accused them of falsely using the word "natural" despite the fact that their juice contains sulfites.So despite their being - seemingly - intentionally obscure about this, this product is full of sulfites, and should be avoided by those who are sulfite sensitive.The "Sadaf" people don't make it easy to find this out, and refused to answer me honestly.  My recommendation is to give this product a pass.

column9: Lemon juice is not all the same
column10: I got this on special for a great deal and figured lemon juice is lemon juice. I usually get a name brand but gave this a try. Its not terrible but not great.Next time I wont cheap out and just go for the name brand because in this case it made a difference in flavor in our drinks. I gave it three stars because it is what it says it is but the taste is not there.

Do not buy these rawhide bones. The outside of the bone is one large piece, but inside there are tiny little pieces that my dog was swallowing whole. I had to throw these out because I did not feel comfortable feeding them to my dog.

These are the best bones ever!  Real rawhide, but compressed so it takes them a long time to get through a bone.  So tough and compressed it doesnt get slimey and there is no choking.  I don't know what I would do without this type of bone!  I love them and my dogs love them!

I can confirm that these bones (by Cadet) have small pieces inside.The outside is fine, but the insides of the two our dog has had so far was composed of lots of narrow irregular strips about 1" wide and 3-6" long which the dog was able to pull out once she chewed through one end of the bone. This is exactly the size of chunk we hope to avoid by giving the dog hard pressed bones like this. Choking or bound intestines are a concern with these bones.On the plus side, the dog apparently LOVES the flavor of these bones. We will probably let her have all of the bones, but we won't leave one out while we're gone. We won't be buying this brand again.If your dog in a "serious chewer" that needs hard pressed bones instead of standard rawhide then these are a poor option.
I have a 100 pound lab that dines on these bones.  After paying $7 to $8 for bones at the pet store, it only makes sense to buy these.  No complaints for the happy dog....
My dog loves these and spends hours chewing these get them. If your dog is a chewer this product is for you and your dog.

column9: These bones were not as good as other bones on Amazon
column10: These pressed rawhide bones were not as good as some others that we have ordered on Amazon.  After the dogs removed the outer layer or two, the inside is comprised of a lot of smaller individual pieces that the dogs can then possibly swallow whole.

I recently ordered some 10" Pressed rawhide bones.  When the vendor received my order and realized they were out of stock, they quickly contacted me to let me know.  Once they were ready to ship, I received another notification.  Great service!

column9: lasts for days, no disgestive issues
column10: We have a compulsive chewer, even with lots of exercise and love.  Regular rawhides will disappear in 1-4 hours.  These last long enough and since they are large and last long enough we are easily able to throw away once it gets to that point where we worry about tummy issues.  These can run $4 each at Meijer; this is a very good price!

We bought these for our adopted one-year-old yellow lab who is an obsessive chewer.  He goes through most rawhides faster than these.  He and our older lab get to chew these bones for 15-20 minutes every morning.  Each bone last five days.  Our older lab (age 8) finds these too tough to chew so the young one "breaks hers in" for her on day one of the new bone cycle.  I have had no digestive issues with these bones.

My daughter and I bought the basil infused olive oil during a visit to France last year. It is amazing on caprese and I also love it on roasted veggies.  The citron and ginger is another great oil.  Wonderful on fish and pasta. These are by far the best I have tasted.  It is extremely hard to find in the USA and although Amazon shipping may be perceived by some as pricey, it is a whole lot cheaper than shipping directly from France!  I highly recommend the A l'Olivier products.  They have been perfecting them since 1822 and it shows!

Very hard to find in stores in USA. Used to be sold in Occitane stores all over, that is finished. Very few fancy food stores carry this oil (Citarella in NYC for expl). This olive oil is so good, all of them with herbs, lemon, basil etc etc.. No cholesterol so good for salad, pastas, fishes, etc.. Unfortunately on the web the distributors send this expensive product in several boxes, each time the price of shipping double price. In NYC you find the product at Citarella for about $14. If you use the web the price is more than 100% with shipping. The product is superb, but I think the exclusif distribution take advantage of their position, I advise you not to buy on the web. Too expensive!

I love the Plato line of products as they allow me to just mindlessly pick from the line and know that I am feeding something good to my dog(s). As for "Smart Dog Snacks" with Ginkgo Biloba and DHA...I'd better watch out, because my dogs love these treats so much that the treats just may make them smart enough to figure out how to open the "treat cabinet" take the container down and unscrew the lid to help themselves!While the treats themselves look like beef jerky, they are made with all natural, organic ingredients. The dogs don't care what's in these treats, they just know they love them. As I am typing this they are both sitting at attention, staring at me and whimpering while trying to do the Jedi Mind Trick of "you want to give us more Smart Dog Snacks, pick up your hand from that keyboard and reach in the container and hand us more. Do it. Do it now."There's so much junk out there and plenty of junk food that claims to be natural (just like people food) but this stuff is the real deal. Much like the food that I feed to the humans in the family, I know what each of the ingredients are and love that the first two ingredients are duck and brown rice. There aren't cost cutting fillers in these treats; it's a straight up high quality product. As an aside, I've bought from the seller, The Whole Healthy Pet many times, and I am always impressed with the products they carry. Just as I know that I can trust the Plato brand, I know that if a product is being carried by The Whole Healthy Pet, then it is a high quality product and I feel like a good parent getting it for my dogs.
I have ordered the Salmon Sticks before and thought I would give the Duck and Chicken flavor a try!  My dogs love them!  What a great healthy treat for my dogs!  Highly recommend!  Will order again!

I'm giving three stars because when I snapped off a piece my rat terrier/chihuahua loved it...but then, she loves everything!  My spaniel/chihuahua, well, he ate it but not with any enthusiasm.  Kinda played with it a bit.  He's a fickle eater with a sensitive stomach. That's why I am here.  PLATO DID NOT PROVIDE SERVING SIZE INFORMATION ON THE PACKAGE!  Yes, they pat you on the back for taking the time to read their label.  But did they read it before printing?  Clearly you would give a small dog less than a large dog but how much?  I don't know how rich these are and if they'll upset my little ones stomach if I give him a 1/4, 1/2 stick a couple bites?  I have no clue! So I attempt to contact the manufacturer (don't even try to do it from their label because it only has a mailing address!  ARGH!).  This means going online to find them.  After finding a phone number and email address I call.  Ring...ring...ring..ring...ring...ring...no voicemail..no human! ARGH again!  So I resorted to email to ask them what the serving size is. Then receive a return email that it can take up to 3 days for a reply while they make great dog treats.  I believe this since they don't answer even their phones!  The whole office must be chipping in! Unfortunately, I had no choice but to return them not knowing any info on serving sizes.  Thankfully, my pet store will take it back even though it's opened.  If you need servings, contact them first.  All in all, my one dog gives them 5 stars (she's the one who loves it all!) and the other a mere 2 stars.  I give it 0 for not providing the owners the information they need to treat their dog without making them sick :(

column9: Healty, Tasty, and Low in Calories
column10: I love Tandoor Chef's Chicken Tandori and Spinach entree. It's healthy, tasty, and only 280 calories for the whole box. The entree is heavy on the spinach and sauce. And the chicken gives it added flavor. So it's a great way to get your dark, leafy, green vegetables for the day.

column9: Great for low carb, healthy meal
column10: I love this brand.  Almost every dish I have tried has been delicious.  This one is great because you get a lot of spinach, no rice and the chicken is quite tasty.  Very reasonable on the calories and the sodium content isn't outrageous as it is on a lot of frozen entrees. On nights when I am tired and don't want to cook, this is my go to dinner.  I can't find this particular dish at my local stores so I order the pack of 12 from Amazon.  I was worried it wouild be too much in my freezer but it was fine.  Arrived in a styrafoam cooler and went into the freezer with no problems.  I also absolutely love their vegetable samosas.
love it ... eat it at least once a week , great product. Add with a cup of cooked rice ...very nice !
Tandoor Chef create authentic Indian dishes that are wholesome, delicious and low calorie. I usually eat this meal with Naan or parathas.

I started drinking this tea b/c I read so many great things about this herb. I don't know if its mental but I feel like I can handle stress better when I am drinking this tea. It has a little caffeine kick from the black tea added too which is nice in the morning. Calming and energetic! Can that be? I think so! The taste is acquired but I like it. This is a really good price too compared to going to a expensive health food store. Happy!!

column9: Tulsi tea is the best tea!
column10: Organic India Tulsi tea is, to me, the absolute best tea I've ever had...both in terms of taste and effects. I have tried several types and have found that I enjoy Chai Masala and India breakfast the most (I enjoy them separately, but also, 1 bag of India breakfast and 1 of bag of Chai Masala makes a perfect iced chai.)Black tea will give most anyone an energy boost, but Tulsi tea is unique to me in that it truly does (as the manufacturers claim) leave one feeling both energized and relaxed (perhaps "centered" or "focused" would be the best word). Tack onto that the purported health benefits of tulsi, and you've got yourself one fantastic tea!There are a number of non-tulsi teas I enjoy, but Organic India's Tulsi Tea is the only tea I purchase on a consistent basis and that I always have on hand. Also, it is the one type of tea I am frequently recommending to friends and family. Give it a try!

We love this cake for a holiday dessert or simply as a special treat.  It can be served plain or with a dollop of vanilla ice cream.  It's not a chocolate cake as thought by previous reviewers.  It's dense, rich, and loaded with rum...YUM.
The cake is very moist and if you love rum, you will love this!  The price is totally reasonable for an after dinner dessert.
Best rum cake I've ever eaten.  Moist, delicious and great flavor.  I've ordered this in quantity, and they've all been great.  Ordering more now . . .
When I ordered this cake I didn't realize that it was chocolate.  So I didn't try it for a while.  After I finally tried it, I liked it very much.  It is a great dessert cake.
This rum cake has little chocolate flaver and chocolate color I don't know why, it dosen't says on box, it is very moist, I wish it not so bitter.

Milka Noisette is the best chocolate ever - I am from Germany but living in Canada. I am so glad that Milka Noisette is available here as well. It melts in your mouth!Try it and you know what I am talking about!
I own a Senseo coffee maker and was delighted to find another brand of coffer that fits in this maker. Great cup of coffee from a terrific supplier.
I recieved a sample box of this with a BUNN "My Cafe'" and I love this coffee. It's perfect and rich, smells like fresh roasted in the kitchen when I make it.
For me, hands down the best coffee I ever had in my Senseo. A bit pricy but outstanding flavor. I am happy to have coffee in little filter pods and not plastic cups like other coffee makers.

column9: 0 stars actual rating-do not purchase for Keurig
column10: I thought I was purchasing a Community Coffee K-cup for my Keurig.  That was the search I did in the Amazon search line.  When I received it I found out it was filter bags of coffee.  Spent $60 on 6 boxes, big mistake on my part.  I did notice they called them pods, but I thought it was a different term for K-cup, another big mistake on my part.  It does not work at all in the Keurig.  The coffee comes out with the look of slightly dirty water and has no flavor whatsoever.  Tried many other ways of brewing it, like a used K-cup with a plastic lid made for it, wetting the bag before brewing, nothing worked, the water flowed through the "pod" like water instead of steeping like coffee.  Keurig owners save your money.

After single serve Senseo Dark Roast Coffee pods were discontinued, I purchased these pods on a trail basis.  If you like robust dark roast coffee, these are definitely not worth it.  Coffee is too weak tasting.  I wouldn't buy again.

I ordered this for my Senseo just for something new. I usually use the Senseo Sumatran pods. My normal serve is two pods with the double cup serve. I thought from reading this that I could use ONE pod for a double cup. Apparently that is incorrect. Okay, that's on me. I tried a pod on a single cup. Couldn't really discern any difference from the first. Very weak. I am not a "coffee afficiando" but I thought this coffee sucked.
I bought these and another brand and although the others are good, these are much better. The flavor is terrific, the cookies must contain real butter to taste this good. We will be buying more.

Just want to make a quick statement. If you like HOT foods.....this is what you've been looking for!! :) Is very habit forming (the broth is wonderful) It says DONT microwave....this is because it has an aluminum layer under paper lid to preserve freshness. I totally remove this paper lid, open spice package...pour over noodles. Add water to level inside of bowl (letting water dissolve the powder)...put either a paper plate or saucer over the bowl, then microwave for 3 minutes. Take out of microwave....reach in with fork and FLIP the noodles over (dont try to break up noodles yet) microwave again for 2 minutes.....now break (seperate) the noodles with the fork. Now microwave one last time for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes......now stir and let it rest with lid in place to steam for a few minutes (if you can wait) :) Now get ready for bliss :)
These noodles are by far the best I have tryed and i have tryed over 12 different kinds of noodles.

column9: Simply the purest cayenne out there!
column10: I really trust That spicely cayenne powder is the purest out there. I find no ther labels on other products that specify how pure these peppers they are using in their product! I went through a pound of this stuff within 3 months and my digetive issues are all cleared up thanks to the power of this stuff. I would recommend this product to anyone looking to heal themselves naturally!
It's hard to give a poor review, and maybe you would like these cookies. Our feelings are they have an after taste which is unpleasant. We ate a few and tossed the rest. Disappointing for us.
If your cat is finicky, this is the food to buy.  Cats love this flavor, and it does not smell as strong as some flavors.

Again, this is one of those varieties that you use as a "variety" from your cat's regular likes. I toss this one in whenver I can find it in the store and my cat just eats it like well, I have to eat this, don't I? It's not his favorite but he does choke it down somehow. He doesn't leave this one so he likes it somewhat. It's ground, so that isn't his favorite but you can actually see vegetables in this one. I like that part so that's why I buy it.

column9: A St. Louis Original -- Best Chocolate EVER
column10: My husband grew up in St. Louis (let me know if you want to know which High School ;-)  and the first Christmas he came to our house, he brought us a pound of the Milk Chocolate.  He certainly knew how to win over my family because our entire family practically had fist fights over this chocolate.It is incredibly creamy, rich, and full of flavor.  It makes Nestles taste like cardboard.  Their Bissinger's Dark Chocolate Peppermint Bark (10 Oz) is also like Nirvana.Service from Bissinger's is excellent and they often have free shipping. Every year, I send this all over the country to all of my family members and it is always the most popular part of the holidays for many.I've had a LOT of chocolate in my 40+ years... this is by far the best I have ever had.

As a St Louis native who now resides in Virginia, Karl Bissinger's Chocolate was at the top of the list of things I missed after moving.  Thank goodness for the internet.  Prior to purchasing these online, we routinely made trips back to St Louis to purchase Bissinger's Chocolate.  No we aren't really crazy, but this chocolate spoils you for any other chocolate). I have used this chocolate for years to make fresh chocolate covered strawberries for friends.

I prefer the Celestial Seasonings but it's very good when you're tired of paying CS prices. It's hard beat the price. I find that the  Bodum New Kenya 34-Ounce Tea Press sold by Amazon works really well for this.

Decaf is good, but the tea is very mild to taste. We have to use a little more for flavor. I think the apple chucks are too big, would be better if they were cut smaller. The stand-up zip-bag is great for storage.
This product is not the best tasting tea I tried.  It tends to have an overwhelming, strong flavor of cloves.

column9: Ground variety - not my cat's favorite
column10: If your cat loves poultry and ground food, this is a great one.  My previous cat loved this stuff, but my current cat just doesn't like the ground variety as well.  He prefers the food with chunks and gobbles it right up.  I've bought tons of this food over the years and many of my cats just loved it.  It just depends on your cat - if you have one that likes ground, give this one a try!

Im not a big fan of extra strong dark chocolate, but the health benefits are many so I figured I would try a few of them out. This is by far the best one. Actually has more of a sweet taste and any bitterness is hard to even notice. Packed with antioxidants. A few squares a day is a great addition to any healthy diet.

This is a very nice chocolate. It has been cured to a nice crisp hardness. The flavor has dimension to it with a sweet overtone and minimal back end bitterness. I've very impressed. This will definitely be on my "addiction" list for reordering.

I order a package of 12 Chocolove Premium Chocolate Bars, which by the way is an excellent chocolate, but when it arrived the bars were bent and melting due to he heat of the delivery truck. I contacted the seller and without questions or argument I was sent another order. I received the order well packed and cold in 2 days. Because I was stunned to see such customer service I contacted the seller once again to offer payment for the UPS cost, but the seller refused stating that their goal is total satisfaction and that I should not pay for the shipping. Just amazing service! I will recommend this seller to anyone and ask to support them. If there were more stars to give I would had given them the max.I hope this review helps.DF

this is my favourite chocolate ever.  creamy melt in your mouth texture..plus the little squares are domed and fit perfectly against the roof of your mouth (each one has a little heart on it too).  nice dark flavour without the bitterness that can happen in the REALLY dark ones.  i like the darker ones too, but this is my favourite percentage.  the flavoured ones are really yummy as well.  my boyfriend is also addicted to this brand.  maybe you don't think you need to buy twelve at a time, but i think it's a great idea!

column9: The best chocolate bar, hands down
column10: I love chocolate.  Good chocolate.  I've tried fancy bars, local bars, hand-poured bars, organic bars, and almost everything else, and THIS is my favorite.  The chocolate is perfectly dark without being bitter, the orange has an incredibly satisfying crunch and a slight (very slight) chewiness that makes the texture of the bar divine, and the flavor of orange and chocolate together are heavenly.If only they sold it in more places!

column9: mmmmmmfor chocolate lovers you gotta try this one
column10: I am not usually a lover of dark chocolate, but when a friend gave me this chocolove premium dark (55%) orange peel as a gift, I fell in love with it. So for Valentine's I decided to buy a box and give my special friends a bar for a happy. Now they are all addicted. The orange peel gives it a special little tang and crunch at the end and I would recommend it to any chocolate lover. It was funny that each person said they could not hold out to make it last a whole day like I had challenged them to. It is just too good.

Not only have i had just about everry brand of belgian chocolate this side of the atlantic, i have had this one several times.  But this seller sent bad chocolate. It has a powdery appearance and is very brittle to touch and taste.  Can't eat it at all.  And i guess i can't return it either.

I treat myself to Chocolove at my local health food store once a month.  I am very conservative on how much sugar I have, so I make one bar last me a whole month.  Yes, it has real sugar, but it is so delightful for the amount of sugar that it has.  A taste of heaven.  I buy the 70% cacao and I am hooked! Seductive bliss!  One more thing, if you are in to dark chocolate, the taste is quite smooth, not bitter as some darks go.

column9: Delicious and sells out quickly at grocery store
column10: This is the best chocolate bar I've ever tried.  The salty taste is in perfect balance with the chocolate.  I'm not the only one that thinks so, since our local grocery store sells out of this particular bar almost as soon as they arrive.  The other Chocolove bars are fine, but this one is tops.

My husband and I occasionally enjoy a few pieces of dark chocolate in the evening and this chocolate is a real treat. It is hard to find such good chocolate at less than $3 per bar. We order a couple cases each fall and keep them in the freezer till we need a new bar. This is not bitter chocolate and just 1/6 (3 small squares) of a bar is only 80 calories and satisfies our desires for dark chocolate.

column9: Favorite chocolate bar in the world
column10: I first tried this at a small coffee shop and the memory of the taste haunted me until I found it on Amazon.  It is a wonderfully decadent treat in which to indulge, whether to forget your bad day or to reward yourself for a job well done. You can taste the real orange peel shavings in this chocolate and it is that perfect blend of dark chocolate and orange, which is the most divine combination.

So, I do A/B tests.  You know, like buy bar A and then bar B and then eat 'em both.YEARS of doing this shamelessly has led me to become a regular purchaser of Chocolove's Pure Dark.  The 55% one.I don't care much for their other bars -- they're just so-so -- but DANG! the Pure Dark is crazy-good.Do yourself a favor.  Don't just buy this bar.  Buy this bar and then buy ten other chocolate bars.  It's in the name of science, it's okay.  Take all your bars, break them up, then try them all.Yeah, that chocolate that keeps evolving and coating your mouth with subtlety and wizardry?  That's this one.

Bought some of these in New Mexico at a co-op store and couldn't find them locally in Florida. Bought on line thru Amazon at a lower price and free shipping. The candy is wonderful and it's truly a sweet deal.

I am a fanatic about fabulous chocolate and even more so when it's combined with orange. AND, boy oh boy, Chocolove has hit the nail on the head with this delicious chocolate bar! Well worth  the price. I would definitely recommend this chocolate...so fantastic!

My husband a self-proclaimed chocoholic says this is the best chocolate he's ever eaten.  And because it's so high in cocoa content, it's good for him too!  That's all he needed - another reason to eat chocolate ha! ha!  We bought it in 12-bar packs and gave it out over xmas and everyone agreed...great chocolate!

column9: Best orange chocolate i have tried
column10: Someone gave me a bar as a gift.  I had no idea it would be this good.  Better than other orange/choc combos, it has a nice crunch to the peel bits. Yum.

Bought one of these at Whole Foods about a month ago.The secret: they freeze-dry the orange peel and this leadsto a really strong orange taste with each bite. You get a littlebit of peel this way.I've loved orange chocolate since i was a kid and my Dadbrought some home from trips. This is an excellentversion.

I absolutely love dark chocolate (77% seems to be the magic number) and have tried many different varieties.  This is one of my favorites due to the complex flavor and great dense and smooth texture. Also, this pack of 12 is a economical way to purchase.

Chocolove's Orange Peel in Dark Chocolate is one of the best dark chocolates I've ever eaten. If you're a dark chocolate fan, you owe it to yourself to try this. The orange flavor really shines through and the wrapping is colorful and stylish. The price was amazing too, much less than I pay at other stores.
Best candybars. I was skeptical buying food online, but I can't get these anywhere near me except the Chocolate Show once a year in NYC. They're great - no worries!
this chocolate is a true treat to eat, perfect texture, almond toffee mix goes together perfectly. the packaging is really cute too. very highly recommended!
I am a dark chocolate person and I love this bar.  It is low in sugar and high in cocoa flavor.

column9: Best Almonds and Sea Salt chocolate bar
column10: I have tried several and this one has just the right amount of sea salt added to not distract from the chocolate, but adds to the flavor.  It is my favorite.  I have many strong favorites for dark chocolate bars, but this one seems to be the only one to get this combination right.

column9: What's in this? Great food though
column10: I wish I knew what was really in this variety. It doesn't say much on the can.  I toss this one in for a little variety, but it's not his favorite.  He loves the carved versions the best, but he tolerates this one as one of those I use for a little change of pace for my cat.  He appreciates it some, I think, but seldom eats the entire can.  But I really would like to know what it consists of so I know what he's eating.  The gravy sure looks nice and the pieces are a nice size as well - not too big so he can get it into his small mouth.

column9: I can only go by my cat's "enthusiasm"
column10: My cat Crystal has to be the finickiest cat on the planet.  After trying several brands and varieties of feline food, I decided to give this variety pack a go.  Well, to my surprise Crystal lit into the flavor like it was "manna from heaven."  Thinking that this might be a fluke, I changed flavors for her next meal and she "attacked" this one with the same fervor.  I knew then that this was the brand for her.And based on her MEOW-valous reaction, I can recommend the variety pack.

Since these are not available in the store, this is a great buy for me.  My cats are very finicky about theirfood.  They like the meaty bits and gravy.  It does not take long at all from order to delivery.  This is a great way to feed your cats.
this box right here is really cool...it comes with 24 cans of food, not only 12 or 6, but a whole 24 cans...

I recently gave a poor review of this product because my elderly cat appeared to have a reaction of pain while eating it one day and refused to eat it thereafter. I considered that there was a possibility the food may have had a "sliver of bone" or some such contamination and stated this in my review, because my two cats previously liked this food. TURNS OUT that she has an allergy to who knows what (not this product I'm sure) which has made her mouth sore. The vet said it is common even in young cats and suggested it could have been caused by grass or plants she may have eaten during her short little trips out into the yard. So I am recinding my previous poor review and suggest that you buy this product if your cat likes it. Also this is a reminder that all "Reviews", although well intentioned, are not always correct.Happy shopping to all!

column9: who needs cheese when you have chocolate
column10: I purchased these at a "local" target for movie snacks. they are pretty good. any lover of teddy grams will enjoy these. the dry marshmallows are reminiscent of the kind in cereal. they have a tiny grove in them so you can "stack them".I strongly recommend them. what I don't recommend is putting them in a bowl and dumping milk on them.it is a horrible idea and creates and unpleasant gritty slurry.

column10: Amazing! I agree with the other reviewer, but I think cereal marshmallows are gross and never liked teddy grahams that much anyway.

column9: Great Product! But not from Amazon!
column10: I make a great syrup for our children during the winter months with these berries. I won't be buying this brand again however, I found another website for 1 lb, which will be cheaper on the long run.
This gets me about as close to authentic indian food as i can get at home. Maybe a little too much cinnamon in it, but makes a fantastic chicken tikka masala!

column9: Pleasant, mild spice with no garlic or onion
column10: I bought the garam masala to liven up my oatbran.  It worked beyond my expectation.  It's a little like Christmas spice cookies in flavor.  The mace gives it a pleasant nutmeg overtone.  The clove has just a little bite.  Highly recommend.

I recently purchased a variety of seasonings and herbs from Marshalls Creek on Amazon. Every container of seasoning were completely unusable save one their chives were very well packaged and the taste was terrific.  I don't endorse Marshalls Creek in any kind of way but from my experience the chives are a safe choice.
The season has a good flavor, good price, and I do plan to purchase it again.Update:May 16, 2010, I am about to place another order for this product so it has to be good! lol
I like the amount you get for such a low price. The Herbs is fresh.
