These Mikakuto Tokuno UHA 8.2 milk candies are the cream of the crop--the best of the best! You'll definitely want to purchase these in bulk.

column9: The most richest and delicious milk candy ever!
column10: If you like milk and sweets, you have to try this! 12 packs barely lasted me 1 month, it is so good! Hard candy, very concentrated milk flavor, and just the right amount of sweetness! To me, they taste pretty similar to sweetened condensed milk. They are individually wrapped, so I always keep a handful in the purse, in my pockets, never be without one when on break time!

I really an not a big candy consumer HOWEVER these little puppies are truly amazing! Dangerously so. Just about the best discovery I've made this year! The only problem is they are never in stock!!!! If you can manage getting a bag you'll wish you bought more. Condensed milk in the creamiest hard candy I've ever had!

I stumbled upon these candies at a local asian food market.  I wish I had bought more.  They taste like sweetened condensed milk, better than those werther's type caramels IMO.  really yummy.  If I had bought more than one bag maybe I would have shared with the kids.. maybe next trip :)
Can be eaten on its own, not salty at all with each single serving porch.
Just received and have incorporated this yellow seed into my latest batch of mustard sauce.  I can tell by the aroma that this will be a great batch!
This produce is delic.  Easy to brew.  For best results use with lots of ice.Good all year roundWill be purchasing again
Celestial tea is a solid brand and makes a good product. the tea has a wonderful taste and flavor. Sweetener is in the k cups, but the tea will be bland unless you add more sugar.
This is a great tea for those who like a full tasting tea without compromise. It is light in caffine, but taste great. I have been drinking this tea for years.

I keep on enjoying more blends from Raven's Brew, and this one does not disappoint. A very nice flavor, smooth as always and a lot of complexity go a long way.I made mine in a french press, 3:30 to 4 minutes brew time for best results.I tried my aero-press (sort of like expresso) and do not recommend this preparation. I don't think it had the right "depth" for expresso strength.

Have tried them all, the office has now sampled them with me and the overall winner hands down are the Dharma Beans. It just keeps making you come back for more, everyday its a tuff choice to which one I am going to grind and put out. The "first pot" now only last a couple of hours. So I believe that speaks for itself, in my opinion there isn't one blend I would give any negitive points, they are all good with individual flavors that keep you in coffee nirvana. Have fun sampleing....Ravens Brew what can I say I am hooked. Trust me there is something here for everyone who enjoys a good cup of joe.

Dharma Organic is a smooth high end coffee that is satisfying to the palate. It is hard to beat this brew and I continue to order it time and time again. The price is right, I hate to run out and other brands do not compare in quallity or taste. This has become my favorite brew.
I was really impressed with the resurrection roast from this company, but I was not a big fan of this one. I love coffee, but wouldn't consider myself to be a connoisseur.

When we were waiting for our Mini-dashund to be old enough to come home I did a lot of research on foods and things for him. The breeder had him on a food called Life Abundance- which though better than grocery, I wasnt impressed. That and the fact it's 20 bucks plus shipping for an 8 lb bag and it shipped. I call it the Avon of dog food. Good stuff but I can find it cheaper at the store. I went with Welnees small breed puppy, its ingredient list is really good. At first Fenways stools where soft but as we went through our first bag and transitioned completely into the new food, it was the breeder food casuing the diarhea. I will keep him on Wellness despite the price, though I am going to try the regular Just for Puppy. According to the bag's ingredience the only real different is the size of the kibble and I read reviews that someone was feeding it to a morkie so I imagine its not going to be an issue for my 4.2 lb pup.

My puppy is 10 months old.  Tried 3 times to ease her into this food, but she kept getting sick and throwing up.  This is only with a table spoon added into her Science Diet food. Got to where she would not eat her food at all when we had the Wellness mixed in.  We put her back on her Science Diet Puppy food and she is fine.  Unfortunately this one did not work for us.I will add we have a 9 year old dog that we did the same thing with.  She was fine, and loves the food!

My Shih Tzu is eating this brand and she loves. She puts her whole head in the bowl. This food is very healthy.  It's perfect for small breeds because the food is literally like small pebbles to fit in their mouths. Our other dog, which is a poodle/lab mix, he's much bigger and he also eats Wellness. He loves it and he's also very healthy.Don't give your dog cheap food, it's just not healthy at all.

column9: Great for small breeds with sensitive systems
column10: I have two small mixed breed dogs each under 10 pounds. This is to only food I have found that they can eat with out any problems.

I am raising three chihuahuas at the moment and as of week-7 they are finally on an all kibble diet of just this and their poops are perfect and their breath has improved and they love it!Buying this off Amazon is definitely the cheapest and easiest way! I did my research on the best food for chihuahuas and what exactly was in each brand and Wellness really is a great choice for you dog. I want mine to live as long as possible and I feel confident they will with a diet of Wellness!

column9: better than purchasing from the store
column10: I came to amazon because the pet stores in my area quit selling this size. It costs about the same, give or take a dollar. I don't have to carry it from the shelf to the check out, from the check out to my car,  then my car to the porch,  and porch to the kitchen. I now just carry it from the porch to the kitchen. I usually have a bunch of other groceries to carry and this is one less trip. Bottom line I love it for the convience.I have raised my chihuahuas on this and they are healthy and full of energy and like it. I have researched the product and know I'm feeding my dogs one of the highest quality foods.My pitbull eats the senior and he loves to scarf the puppy food when I'm not paying attention.They all love the wet food too. They all get a bite when my pit gets his meds at night.I recommend this food.

My dog was losing weight because she is so picky and I was resorting to feeding her people food. Got this today and she went straight for it and finished every bit. Mixed with Wellness wet and it's perfect.

I use this bullion for a myriad of things and my local supermarkets simply stopped carrying it. Taste-wise it is excellent, and because it is grainular, I can add exactly the right amount. My only slight negative is that the bottles themselves are very small, so I am opening them up more than I used to. But it's a minor complaint.

column9: Awesome Product to Prevent a Hangover
column10: Bought this product for my friends and I to have on vacation.  It worked great!  We woke up feeling like we never drank the night before.  Thanks Party Armor!!!

Cap doesn't fit the jar, so there is no way it can be used as shown. Hanging from the lid will cause jar to fall and break. So, I placed on a wide garden wall where it was knocked over (squirrels?) and broke. do not recommend.

I had a trap that worked and trapped a lot of wasps in the trap when the bait ran out. I replaced the bait with this bait, now the wasps just fly around it. I have not even trapped one wasp in over a month.

I am happy with this product.  My kids love spcicey food and chocolate.  The first taste with these is chocolate followed by spcicey ginger.  I think it is a great way to get them to eat ginger which has been linked to cancer prevention.  I just send a few pieces with their lunch each day.

While technically, the Product description is accurate, the Product picture is unfortunately very misleading.  As one reviewer noted, the pieces are tiny and the picture seems to imply pieces about the size of standard Bridge Mix.  This is NOT the case.  The pieces are barely large enough to contain any identifiable pieces of Ginger, but the chocolate coating is very tasty.  Unfortunately, I would have preferred to have real pieces of ginger inside the chocolate.  If you are familiar with the size of chocolate covered raisins, most of the pieces of this product are half that size or smaller.  You can taste the ginger in the larger pieces, but you might as well classify this product as Ginger flavored Dark Chocolate.  I can't fault the dark chocolate taste at all, but if you are expecting to bite into a piece of ginger inside, forget it.  In the future I will have to stick with the more expensive British Chocolate covered Ginger where you get about 24 pieces per box.

I was not happy with this purchase.  I had envisioned large chunks of ginger enrobed in chocolate which is what I have previously purchased from other sources.  This product is tiny jelly-bean sized with a very minute dot of ginger encased.  The ginger taste is all but negligible.  Resembling dark chocolate chips in taste, the quality of the chocolate, I would say, is very good, but it was not at all what I expected, and I shall not re-order.
This is one of my favorite snacks. I like hot snacks, and this does the trick. It does have calories so watch it and don't over do. It's yummy.

I have pruchased rice snacks before on Amazon, but I have never purchased one as bad as this. It was generally so tasteless, that even the kids didnt eat it and I ended up throwing it all in the garbage.

column9: Like A Cracker, But Much Better.
column10: I shop for groceries at a nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market and they have a good selection of gourmet items that I like to try from to time. One was La Panzanella Croccantini. The name sounds like something that would be an italian import, but they are made in Tukwila, WA. Well, in any case, they're a really good large cracker or hard-bread. I tried the rosemary variety first and just loved it. The items were so good, in fact, that the next time I went back I picked up a 5.5-ounce box of the Original Croccantini. Well, it's equally good. What can I say? These are the best crackers I can ever recall eating. They're lightly salted with sea-salt crystals. Does that do it? I have a slight preference for the Rosemary ones, but these are just excellent too. Use them with anything you might use a cracker with. The only difference is that these are much better.Gary Peterson

I have bad reflux and have been on PPI's for years.  It's to the point that I can't take even a sip of anything acidic, yet it was difficult for me to give up morning coffee.  I tried this totally on a whim, and didn't have high expectations for it, but now I'm totally hooked.  It is not TEA.  It makes a dark cup, identical to coffee.  It's delicious with a coffee creamer.  It's 18 calories per cup because there is carob in it (which also gives it some substance and a slight choco flavor).  It is truly non-acidic and non-caffeine (no problem lying down and sleeping after drinking).

column9: Love Teeccino... the perfect way to start your morning, have an afternoon delight, or end a meal.
column10: My husband and I have become huge fans of this during the past year. For my husband, it was love at first sip. For me, although I really enjoyed it and would drink it here and there years ago when I first stumbled upon it, it wasn't (at the time) the perfect coffee replacement to me. Then again, I was such a hard core coffee lover, I didn't think anything would ever compare to the real thing. That being said, here I am, loving Teeccino - big time! I can't imagine not having it. In fact, I don't know what I was thinking years ago by not thinking this was an awesome coffee replacement. Not only does it taste great, but it's not acidic and safe for pregnancy and breastfeeding. It's high in potassium, helps restore alkalinity, and the chicory root can help improve digestion. We enjoy all of the varieties and flavors, and lately I'm loving the chocolate one big time. The tee-bags rock, too! I can take them with me to Starbucks or restaurants when we're out and just order a cup of hot water.We love it plain (black), and we also enjoy it with Raw nut milk or other non-dairy milk for a nice creamy experience. Teeccino is much better for your health than regular (or decaf) coffee, and can help transition you away from coffee. I've even brewed coffee mixed with Teeccino for some of my coffee addict friends to reduce the caffeine and help them transition. They love it.

Many of my friends love this, which is lucky for me because I foolishly ordered the 6 pack. The price was so much better buying 6 and I was sure I'd love anything chocolate (I always have). The 3 star rating is because of the friends who like it--for me it would have been a 1 because I really don't enjoy the taste of carob and that's what I smell and taste in this drink. I didn't want to say anything negative about this, it's a fine product as long as you like carob, but thought it would be a good idea to warn people in case you're thinking of ordering 6 of them and you don't care for carob.

column9: Can't have caffeine, but love a good hot drink
column10: What's better than a good hot drink that tastes like a chocolate coffee but is not fattening like old-fashioned hot chocolate?  I like coffee, but get tired of decaf.  My body cannot tolerate caffeinated drinks.  I've tasted countless decaf blends of both teas and coffees.  Teeccino has several flavors that can purchased in the form of grounds for the coffee-maker or packaged in tea bags. Read the label (product specs) for the exact ingredients, because it is too redundant to go into here.  The unique ingredients are actually soothing to the tummy.  The tea bags are very convenient, but I would like them better if they were round instead of square.  Round bags "dip" better than square because the square ones tend to cause the liquid to run over the edge of the cup.  However, this is minor and the flavor of the chocolate Teeccino "coffee" is definitely worth the little dribble (just put the cup on a paper towel).  I put a tea bag in a mug of water and pop it into the microwave for about 1-1/2 minutes.  Remove the bag fairly quickly because it steeps really fast for a robust flavor, and you can reuse the bag at least two more times!  The local health food store cannot keep this product in stock, so that is why I buy it on-line (in bulk).  To sweeten the drink, stir in a single-serve packet of NuStevia (80mg Stevia Leaf) and add a spritz of whipped cream on top.

column9: These lemon drops pack a powerful punch
column10: probably the strongest lemon flavored candy I have ever come across.  The initial lemony flavor really makes your mouth pucker, but after a minute or so you reach the middle which has a complement sweetness making this can be one of the best I've ever had.  I tried lemon drops, but nothing compares to this one.  I am on my second box and I'm sure before the year is through I'll probably order several more.  I haven't been able to find this anywhere else except on Amazon which goes to show that you can pretty much find anything on this website.  You get 6 packs per box, and I just opened a new pack and counted (for the sake of accuracy). There are 22 individually wrapped candies in the pack, for $15.  I would consider this a pretty good deal considering the novelty of this candy, it is made and distributed from Japan so it would be pretty hard to find somewhere else for less, and the candy is the best lemon drop I've ever had.  So if you like lemon candy you might want to try this one out.  I would highly recommend.

I first ate this many years ago as a teen. It was the best sour candy I had ever had. By far better than the sour candy out there today. I bought some for my son for Xmas and he loves them. He has since passed them all out to his friends and now I'm on a new batch for him. You won't regret purchasing this candy.By the way, you don't want to eat the whole bag.It's not good for your tongue!LOL! And be prepared to watch people pucker and cry!

I have to say that The Super Lemon Candy is the best hard candy around. It brings back memories of elementary school when I first ate this candy. I love it where the candy is a little sour at first and after a few seconds of sucking and licking it becomes nice and sweet with a strong lemony flavor. You must try them, there will be no regrets.

A friend of mine from Japan first gave me one of these. It's so much fun giving them out and watching people's faces. I had one person spit it out on the floor.(didn't give another one to this person) They are the best sour lemon drops.Better even than Altoids!Buy some!Now i know where to buy them.
I am always amazed by wild rice, which is actually not real rice. the package arrived soon, but i haven't cooked it yet.

Loved this coffee. It was shipped quickly. Made a pot as soon as it arrived and loved the taste. It was as fresh as buying locally. We are having a hard time finding Ethiopian Yirgacheffe  - so we are thrilled to have this company as a source!

This is my first time ordering household supplies through Amazon.  A friends recommended that I do my bulk shopping online as she saves a ton on dog food that way.  So convenient and quite a bit less expensive!!

column9: Read carefully - picture doesn't match description!
column10: The picture for the "Hairball" type shows a green bag that is labeled, "Weight and Hairball Control".  This is what I normally get for my cats.  However, the bags that arrived were orange and just state, "Hairball Control."  I'm keeping them because my cats will eat it and it's easier than returning them.  However, I would like to actually get what I think I'm paying for.

column4: Heather L. Parisi "Robert and Heather Parisi"
column9: SOLID GOLD NUTRITION with MASS MARKET PRICE
column10: If you are looking for taste, nutrition and low carbs/calories, this beverage is for you. Add to that, low sodium in this particular variation, and you have a drink we should all be drinking. I was always a bit reluctant to indulge in this yummy veg-fest because of the huge amount of added sodium, but now the low-sodium product has become much more available and costs only 30% more than the original high-sodium version. Typically, this low-sodium, mixed 100% vegetable juice is the type of drink that sells for $2-4 at a juice bar per 8-ounce serving or about $8-$10 per quart from a health food store in bottles. WHY?There are more than 8 reasons WHY V8 is so special -- Tomatoes, Beets, Celery, Carrots, Lettuce, Parsley, Watercress and Spinach are the first eight. Low carbs/calories and no added sugar are the 9th and 10th reasons. Low sodium and the resulting favorable potassium/sodium ratio give this particular version an 11th reason to become a truly 5-star product. Also, the 17 mg. of naturally-occurring lycopene in an 8-ounce serving is more than the average amount that you would find in single nutrient lycopene supplements which cost an average of 16 cents per pill and which are less bio-available than the naturally-occurring lycopene in the V8 juice.In conclusion, if you are not allergic to the ingredients [e.g., tomato allergy], this is the most practical and convenient way to add a very healthy serving of mixed vegetables to your diet. Your body will thank you.

I am a huge fan of the V-8 100% vegetable juice flavor, and even the lemon-enhanced flavor, anti-oxidants and calcium-enriched ones but the low sodium?  Ptooey!  I didn't realize having 75% less sodium in the bottle would make such a huge impact on flavor but it sure does.  Both my husband and I bought a huge bottle and after two glasses cannot stand the flavor.  We're likely going to toss the rest down the drain, what a waste!

column9: Very good taste, low sodium, 2 servings of veggies in one 8oz cup
column10: This product is a dream come true for people like me who do not have the time or the inclination to prepare their own food to get adequate servings of veggies.You get two diverse servings of veggies in one cup. And you can gulp this down in 5 seconds :-) And the taste is very good.It is full of fiber and low in sodium.I looked and looked but cannot find anything bad to say about this product :-) It is not that costly either. So drink up!No refrigeration needed until you open it up. So it is ideally suited to a busy life style.

column9: save $$ and snort powdered ginger instead
column10: I guess if you like to eat ginger this would be a good choice, the flavor is so strong and the soda is not very sweet that the combo is overwhelming.  The first drink I took I had the weird sensation of burning up in my nose and I almost gagged. Basically it is disgusting.
I easily and quickly make my own dressing for about one fifth the cost. I even give it as gifts.

Amazingly smooth and pure honey! Never thought such honey existed untill read the reviews and tried!... Wow! The cap indeed, is very convenient, leaving the bottle clean and non-sticky at all times! Would highly recommend this product! I personally, like to dilute 1 tsp in a cup of room temp water and enjoy throughout the day.Happy and Healthy New Year, everyone!

I am an avid consumer of honey. I've had honey from all over the country and from various parts of Europe. This Organic Mountains sourwood is the best honey I've ever had for a light, subtle flavor, perfect for green teas, white teas, fruit teas, dessert with white cheeses.

This honey is exceptionally good!  I am a honey fan, with sourwood being my favorite, followed by mesquite and tupelo.  I wasn't quite sure what to expect from ordering this product online,  but I am thoroughly delighted with my purchase!  It stays high on the shelf out of reach and out of sight from the rest of the household, and only gets used as a treat!  It is truly, simply delicious!!

Some say it's raining men, but I say it's raining men covered in honey! By far the BEST honey I have ever had! I strongly encourage you and your little monsters to indulge in such a sweet and tantalizing experience. It is sure to knock your Spanx off. Mr. Wright is a connoisseur in the art of honey - absolutely no question he can't answer about it! I can't wait to run out so that I can buy again! Thank the heavens above for that handy dandy squeeze bottle and may every bear bottle in the world disintegrate into confetti. Cheers!
I like this honey, but the taste is a little faint.  The bottle is weak and will start to crease when you reuse it.  I had purchased this mainly for the bottle but it will fail soon.

column9: Our Son Loves Them, Very Convenient
column10: We love these baby food things in a little pouch. Sooooo much easier to feed to a baby or toddler on the go. Our son loves sucking the mish mash out and we are pleased that it is both organic and healthy with nothing added. He'll eat the sweet potato and other veggie pouches when he is more hungry, but probably because of the sweetness of fruit, he far prefers the fruit mish mashes to the veggie ones. For smaller children, not good to let them handle it themselves, because they love to squeeze it, which gets things everywhere. But older ones can feed to themselves. I like the 3 oz size rather than the bigger one like this (4 oz) because it assures that he will eat all or most of it in one sitting rather than having to save some for later. They only keep for 24 hours after opening and need to be refrigerated if not eaten, but then he doesn't like them cold, so they have to be warmed up a bit in warm water to reuse, so a bit of a hassle. You can also take the 3 oz size on airplanes without having to have it tested for explosives - not the case with the bigger 4 oz pouches. I also like that it is BPA free. If your little one likes them, ordering in bulk and with subscribe and save makes them much cheaper than at the store.

these pouches are the greatest invention. Its so much easier than jar baby food and my 2 yr old still loves them. They dont need to be refrigerated before opening so can be kept in a diaper bag and are an easy way to get vegetables into your children.

We eat a lot of Plum organics.  This is the thickest food that I have seen in any companies pouches.  It has a lot more calories (110 as apposed to 40 in some packets), so it is nice when baby is a little extra hungry.  It tastes good, and my daughter likes that is not all gone in a few sips.  This is great for the more experienced eater, but may be a little difficult for those just starting to eat right from the tube.

column9: Only Plum Organics with Vegetable as First Ingredient
column10: I wish we had never fed these pouches to my daughter.  She prefers these over anything I make because she loves to hold the pouch and suck it down.  She is drinking calories and in my mind this is tantamount to getting her hooked on juices.  Just a warning if you're a first time buyer. Like other reviewers for Plum Organics, I find it misleading that the product name always mentions the vegetables first, when fruit is almost always the first ingredient.  I do not consider most of these pouches a health food whatsoever. However, I will buy this particular flavor because sweet potatoes are the first ingredient.

Before buying a case of these through Amazon, I bought one pouch at my local Target. Thank goodness I did! This sweet potato, corn, and apple flavor is absolutely disgusting! The ingredients list states lemon juice as the last ingredient. When I tasted it, it seemed like it was the main ingredient. No wonder my son made the most disapproving look after one spoonful, which prompted me to try it for myself. I usually like most of the flavors in the Plum Organics line, but this one is extremely sour (as one reviewer noted on Feb 11, 2011). There is no trace of sweet potato, corn, and apple flavors. It should be called Plum Organics Lemon.

I used to love Plum Organics, and this one is actually really tasty.  My toddler loved it.  That is, until this last shipment batch, which was completely sour/spoiled.  I looked for the expiration date, and that is still within range.  It was however, really really bad.  I ended up throwing away the entire big box of it.  Very disappointed.

column9: Plum Organics Baby Food Sweet Potato Corn and Apple 4 Ounce Pouches
column10: Easiest way I have ever found of getting vegetables into my two sons. They still love it at ages three and four. A great organic product that is ideal for babies and kids alike.

column9: My kid goes crazy for these!
column10: You know that commercial, "What would you do for a Klondite bar"?  Well, my kid would do ANYTHING for a these things that we call "pouch."  I have him "earn" pouches by doing helpful things around the house, following directions, being safe in the car.  It just works like a dream!  I put it in front of him (he can't take off the cap on his own) and say, "When you finish your dinner, you can have this for dessert," and he gobbles everything up.  The funny this is, is that I usually give him the SPINACH pouch!  Ha ha!  So he eats his veggies and then gets a pouch of spinach!  Oh, boy, it's great!I wish I could reuse them though, even if I bought more product, because I feel a little guilty throwing them in the trash (I'm one of the people who compost and recycle).But these are great for the car and the plane because they don't need refrigeration.  Going through the security on the plane, you need your kid with you or they won't let you take them.  My husband met up with us at the airport and I packed a whole bunch of pouches in his bag.  When he went through security, they said, "Where's the baby?" and when he explained that our son was with me, waiting at the gate, they said it was a no-go and had him chuck the whole thing.  :(  But aside from that, this is a great product, a great invention.Imagine, getting your kid to eat his veggies so that he can eagerly have a spinach pouch!  :D

The only reason I gave this a 4 star was that the bulk pack was just too much of the same thing.  Geared toward infants/toddlers, my little ones LOVED this stuff until we had an abundance of it.  Variety is key, so order up one or two different flavors to rotate through.On the upside, they contain only organic fruits and vegetables so they're healthy (if you can get the kids to eat it).  I keep a few in the day packs and "bug out bags" for me or the kids.

While I prefer to make my own organic baby food that can't always be the case.  This is my 3rd child so these pouches are really a life saver.  Between preschool and activities we are constantly on the go, so my 8 month old can't always have a sit down meal at home.  These are great and the sweet potato, corn & apple is one of her favorite flavors.  We have tried all the different brands and flavors of organic pouches and these are a favorite.  By 7 months old she had figured out how to feed herself completely on her own with these pouches - makes life a lot easier!
This food is great!  It is thick and does not leave them hungry.  It stays on the spoon and does not run off.

I am giving these Plum pouches to my son since he was 8 month-old. I love them because they r natural/organic, super convenient n an easy way to always have fruits n veggies on the go. My son loves all the flavors n drink it directly from the pouch (no spoon needed). I use it a lot on our international flights n always carry one on my diaper bag. Love it!

We started feeding her the Sweet Potato, Corn & Apple at around 6 months.  She loved it!  She is now 8 months and loves to grab the pouch and just suck out the food on her own.  It is very convenient and portable.  Being organic and something she loves is a definite plus (it's hard to find foods that she both likes and are organic).

Plum Organics Baby Food, Sweet Potato, Corn & Apple, 4.22-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24)This baby food could not possibly be easier to throw in the diaper bag or car console and carry along!  Does not need refrigeration and is great to spoon feed your 7 month old or hand your hungry 2 year old to squeeze right into their own mouth for a healthy delicious on the go snack!  I order these and all the other flavors by the 24 pack thinking they'll last a while and they disappear before I can blink!  They're a crowd pleaser! :-)  Mommy even likes to sneak the last bite sometimes! ;-)  Order the Plum Organics food dispenser screw on spoons and life could not possibly be easier!

column9: So easy, healthy, organic - just pay for convenience
column10: These pouches are the best thing since jarred baby food - they are just a little pricey for everyday use in my opinion.  But, they are very easy and convenient to have on hand for traveling, restaurants, or picnics.  We just let our baby suck the food out of the opening, we didn't even use a spoon so then you don't have a dirty spoon to carry home from the restaurant either.  The product itself is super!

I LOVE Amazon subscribe and save and use it often.  I was going to purchase these but as a thrifty mom, but just realized this particular blend of plum organics are only $.68 at Target regular price.  The other veggies tend to be more so they are a good buy on Amazon but this mix (maybe because of the corn?) is much more affordable elsewhere.  If Amazon matched Target's price I would order in a heartbeat.  I still order Happy Tot and other on here...just not this one.

I honestly had to get a second opinion on whether or not this stuff was spoiled when I opened it up, gave it to my son, and he acted like I'd put a stinging wasp in his mouth! I have never seen him hate something like this.  He spewed everything in his mouth all over the room...it was horrific to watch.  I took a bite and just about did the same thing.  This stuff is GROSS.  Absolutely GROSS, which surprises me because I have bought every other flavor of Plum organics and I have never had a bad experience.  Too bad I ordered two cases of it.  I thought, how could sweet potato, corn and apple be bad?!  Well folks, I am here to tell you...it's BAD.  I am slowly getting rid of it by adding a dollop of it into something else...masking it with vanilla yogurt and cereal, applesauce, etc.  It makes everything taste very sour, so the yogurt kind of neutralizes that.

column9: Amazon comes through with the best price...againl
column10: It is hard to find organic canola oil at a regular store.  The specialty stores have it but the prices are really high and the bottles small.  LaTourangelle has a nice line of oils from Europe but they are generally quite expensive.  Amazon once again comes through with a fantastic price.  I usually buy three or four packs or however many Amazon has "in stock" so I don't run out.  The cans are pretty enough to leave on my counter (one at a time) and while at 16.9 ounces they aren't large, the size is consistent with other brands of organic oils and getting three, or nine or twelve cans at once is very convenient for me. I've been using LaTourangelle exclusively for almost two years.  I periodically check locally for less expensive organic oil but I've never found any store who can beat Amazon's price.

I love this oil so much, I now have it on my subscribe option. I go through about 1 can a month. It is canola, which is a superb cooking oil, the only problem is that most canola oil is GMO and chemical expressed. NOT THIS ONE! I highly recommend, everything a low flavor, high heat oil should be.

column9: Good oil but the price has skyrocketed
column10: This is a great oil for cooking and baking, and I even like the tins (I use a can opener to remove the top after they're empty and use them for cute storage).  That said, I get this through subscribe and save and the price DOUBLED since my last shipment one month ago.  It was around $9 per 3 pack (an excellent deal!) and now it's around $18. These are rather small containers so that puts them out of my price range.There seems to be a pattern on Amazon that as soon as something is well rated, the price goes up substantially. Ironically, I switched to this oil because my last regular subscribe and save organic oil (Zoe organic olive oil) jumped way up in price so I went looking for another good one.I guess I'm off to find yet another organic cooking oil that won't break the bank...
I love this canola oil. Organic canola is hard to find and this is pricey, but it's worth it to me. I'll be ordering again, soon.

so stoked on this product.... bought it about 2 months ago when it was $20 for a pack of 3 tins.... just went to reorder and was plesantly surprised to find out the price is now more like $12.highly reccomend

From pancakes to pies Bisquick makes baking easier as the hard work is pretty well done. Bisquick is a baking mix that has flour, shortening and leavening already mixed up and ready-to-go for making biscuits or pancakes. In fact, if you read the history of Betty Crocker, and General Mills, you will discover Bisquick was developed after a company employee enjoyed hot biscuits while traveling on the train. The employee wondered how the train's cook was able to bake up the biscuits so quickly. The cook showed the General Mills employee his pre-made biscuit mix. Bisquick was created after the General Mills employee returned from his trip.Today, you can use Bisquick to make pancakes, waffles, muffins, quick breads, cookies and Impossibly Easy Pies. It is a true workhorse in the kitchen.Books you can read about General Mills and Bisquick include Finding Betty Crocker: The Secret Life of America's First Lady of Food (Fesler-Lampert Minnesota Heritage); Betty Crocker Ultimate Bisquick Cookbook Exclusive Deluxe Edition 323 Delicious recipes for breakfast, dinner, dessert & more!, Bisquick to the Rescue: More than 100 Emergency Meals to save the day!, Betty Crocker Bisquick Impossibly Easy Pies: Pies that Magically Bake Their Own Crust.Highly recommend.

got this on a special for half the price.  love love love amazon. you can make hundreds of dishes with bisquick and they are all good. if you hate to cook or dont have alot of time this is the product for you.  look up the recipes on line

column9: One of the Best milk chocolate bars with almonds....
column10: Have no clue how old that bar of chocolate was the person who gave this bar 1 star got or what kind of radical temperature changes it went through to make it grainy because Green and Black's milk chocolate bar with almonds is one the best, creamiest, smoothest, richest chocolate bars I have ever eaten.  Not only is the flavor and texture of the bar outstanding but the amount of whole roasted almonds they pack into this bar make it a cut above the rest. It is a perfect balance of milk chocolate and nuts. I have in fact brought my mother over to the dark side.  She would normally prefer popcorn or an apple over a candy bar until she tried this. Pricey but in this instance  you get what you pay for and if you eat it slowly you will enjoy every bite.
I liked the flavor of this bar because it is not sickenly sweet like most milk chocolates including Cadbury. The guy that thought it taste like dirt must need a sugar fix. SB

column9: One of the better almond bars
column10: Most other almond bars disappoint me because there are barely any almonds in it.  Boy is this different!  Each bar is loaded with whole almonds so very nearly every bite is a nice combination of chocolate and almond.  As far as the chocolate part goes; yeah, I agree with most other reviewers, it sure beats Hershey's.

This Green&Black's Organic Milk Chocolate Bar with Almonds has to be the very best milk chocolate bar I've ever eaten. I had to quit eating the other "British" milk chocolate bar from the big box store because it was causing me indigestion - I don't know what ingredient caused the indigestion but after learning that this "British" product is made by a U.S. company I figured I could take my pick of substandard ingredients. This Green&Black's Organic Milk Chocolate Bar with Almonds, on the other hand, causes no indigestion and is in every other way simply sublime.Why is this bar a great value? Because I can eat one or two SQUARES of this bar and get more satisfaction than eating an entitre BAR from one of the cheaply made bars. This is the good stuff, my friends. Fair trade is just an added bonus.

I almost do not want to purchase Green and Black chocolate as I cannot stop at one piece but devour the entire bar.  ALL their chocolate has this effect on me but particularly this almond one as the almonds are whole, not pieces, and the chocolate is SO SMOOTH that it truly melts in your mouth.  I consider it health food as it has almonds, right.

column9: Yummy on a whole other level
column10: I first got a hold on this chocolate while living in England.  I can't stand the sickly sweet bars of other companies. This hit the nail on the head.  Such a lovely combination of chocolate and nuts, and now, I finally found it at Wal-Mart.  I could not be happier. I don't eat it because it is organic; I eat it because it is FANTASTIC!!

if you're a chocolate lover, and I am, you have to try this, it is sooooooooo good, warning though, you won't be able to stop with just one bite, before you've realize it you've consumed the whole bar.

Be forewarned:  These are the best chocolate bars I have ever tasted.  I don't say that lightly.  Amazing, creamy, totally, absolutely addicting.  I have had a good amount of experience with high end chocolate.  This is the best.  I am hooked.  Hopelessly hooked.  Sadly, i buy them in bulk and hide them from my children and husband.  Well, sadly for them.

Of all the organic chocolate bars I have tried this  is the best tasting ! Very creamy texture, wonderful whole almonds ! So glad I found these online as a local store stocked them & then discontinued them, so with Amazon prime I can order them & have at my door quickly !!

I'm very disappointed with this purchase. The item arrived one day late. The ice pack was melted and so were the chocolates. On top of this, they will expire in 60 days.Edited:Excellent customer support. I received a reply in less than an hour. They will either re-ship the item or credit my account.

This is the absolute best milk chocolate bar with almonds. It is not too sweet. Has a wonderful rich chocolate flavor and WHOLE ALMONDS and lots and lots of them. Almonds in every bite.  In 2011 this is almost unheard of.  I will never waste my time, money, calories, fat, sweets on any other chocolate candy ever !!!!! THE BEST !

I've always enjoyed Hershey's Chocolate Almond bars, but found this and tried it.  It was really delicious--smooth, creamy taste, and none of the "raw throat" effect I've had after eating a Hershey bar (whatever that is!).  This is my new, favorite chocolate bar.

This is my treat after dinner along with some red wine.  I wish it wasn't so spendy but I guess that's the price you pay for quality chocolate.  I can't eat the waxy Hershey's type after this.  Love the almonds, they don't skimp on them.  Hee, gotta laugh at the guy that uses his review as a slam to our President.  I'm thinking buying it at this 10 pack price with free shipping is a better deal than the health food section of my grocery store.  I will have to confirm.  I'm glad I checked out Amazon to see if they carry it.
Hands down the most perfect chocolate I and my husband have ever tasted.  Nothing else compares.

column9: Not so sweet that it makes your throat burn...
column10: I enjoy chocolate like wine, coffee, salt.  Many types, each with their own nuances and distinctions...this milk chocolate has a pleasant "tang" to it that prevents it from being too sickeningly sweet, like 99% of the milk chocolate out there.  Very balanced, fruity, and tasty.

Having grown up on chocolate in the 60's and 70's and not only the commerical stuff from the US, but imported stuff from south of the Border, I have a very picky chocolate taste bud (much like my Coffee taste bud).  Biting into a piece of Green & Blacks will bring back memories of how you remember chocolate used to taste, earthy, rich and yummy!Sadly, eating a piece of anything else, is much like a Chocolate FLAVORED gooy, additive laced, piece of fat.  From time to time i still try eating the others, and none can COMPARE!

I wandered into a Whole Foods (the favorite store of our snobby Socialist president!) to get some cash through a debit purchase, saw the Green & Black's chocolate and figured what the heck. I came at the situation with no preconceptions and actually expected it to be a good chocolate bar.But in reality, it tastes like dirt. Dirt with almonds in it.The best chocolate out there is still Ghirardelli. Failing that, go for Cadbury. But don't fall for the hippie message and pseudo-gourmet pricing & availability. Green & Black's is inedible.

column9: Does salt need to have flakes?
column10: I thought it would be better when seasoning meats and such but I would go with the grey salt instead. Reason for that is the grey salt melts better into the meats. I would still recommend this product but it's more for show than for use. It is good quality so no complaints there.I would still recommend.

Bought it initially because the bottle shape and then found the tequila to be outstanding.Sadly, I actually wish Kah would sell a plain bottle for me to refresh my skulls because I am starting to grow quite a collection of Black, White and Yellow heads.
I found the peppers to be a little on the small side, even for shriveled dehydrated ones. They do the job however.

I enjoy this coffee any time of day. It's very smooth, slightly sweet. Smells super yummy. Very very low acidity, which I really like in the morning. We tried it because what we used to get was temporarily out of stock, and this coffee is so good that this is now our usual. With the Subscribe & Save it's at a very reasonable price. (BTW I absolutely LOVE the Subscribe & Save! Now I'm never out of coffee. Yea!!!)
The flavor is bad and the smell of the ground beans is not even good.  Smells like it is very old and stale even though the date on the bag says it is still good.

I am used to Peets coffee, so I prefer a strong, clean flavor. This coffee tastes like cigarette ashes mixed with burnt wood. There is no discernable mocha flavor. It seemed old tasting, in fact. I would return it if I could.

For berry pie season, this did the job fantastically. I was tired of paying $5 for one measly box at the grocery store, and this was organic to boot. With 6 boxes in the pack, I have some left to start the season next year.

I looked up some recipes on the company's site and then invented my own. I add coconut at the beginning of cooking (the organic coconut is drier than then such products as angel flakes which has metabisulfite--very very bad for you). I also make it with coconut milk and keep thinking I want to get some coconut extract to finish it off although vanilla is ok. It can become any flavor you want it to. I add some extra tapioca starch (about 1 TB) to help it thicken.
It's so great that you can purchase good quality organic products online from Amazon.  This one is a winner!  Good quality, fast delivery, great price.

This is the ONLY thing my 12 year old Greyhound will eat for "lunch".  He has had 3 dental extractions over the years and had 13 teeth pulled including all of his molars.  So he needs something soft enough that he can chew.  These are sadly hard to find in pet stores.

I have ordered Flossies several times.  First few times they were great and well worth the money.  Lasted a long time.  I have an 11 pound Bichon who loves to chew. I order 20 at a time.  This last time, they were much different.  Very skinny and seemed to be stretched much more.  My dog finished it in about an hour. Usually she works on her flossie for days.Amazon Communication Center wrote: We do not sort flossies and because they are natural one box can bethiner then another. we sell over 100 box a week, so it is quite possible.I am very sorry you got a bad batch.I have ordered them from another source and hopefully, if I get a bad batch, they will stand behind their product.  It seems impossible that all 20 could be so thin.  They come loose and not pre-packaged.Good luck to anyone who orders Flossies from Amazon.

as the other reviewer says.  I have 3 dogs (2 large Bouviers and 1 Bichon). They loved these.  The small dog was able to spend some time chewing these (I have to lock her in her crate away from the big dogs, though). These weren't individually wrapped, but they weren't smelly or yucky to handle.  They were stretched out as in the picture and stiff.  I didn't worry about choking.  They came in a big box with other items in the order (and so I wish they would have been prepackaged in a large bag to separate them from the other items).  These are a US product and have nothing added to them that I know of so I felt safe in giving them to the dogs. I have ordered from Entirely Pets before and they are quick to ship, but when they miss something they will quickly send out the missing items.  I bought these at $2.29 each which is probably the sale price, but I wish I could find them for less sometime.  DHL delivered them to me.

column9: spirals of fun for the dogs
column10: My dogs love these flossies.  They are easy for them to hold, and they love them so much.  I would suggest using them for small dogs, under 30 lbs.  Bigger dogs eat them way too fast!

column9: great treats for your best friend
column10: I have yet to see a dog that doesn't love these treats. Need supervision when they have them as they break off really easy and not at all like say a bully stick. The dogs consume them rather quickly and should be supervised for choking.

I have bought these in other stores and my bull -terrier mix would play with them and then chew and eat - could last 15 minutes.  These however went in about 3 minutes because they were so thin!  I heard it crack just opening the the plastic wrap.  I like that they are individually wrapped and probably of good quality - just really realy thin/ skinny.

I was very pleased with this item,but not as much as my little dog Maggie.This is the only chewie item she will eat.They were shipped in record time and at a much lower price than my local pet products  store.

This is a great treat, although a bit pricy, for your dog!  The beef tendon is not only tasty for your pup, but good for their dental health as well.  The sprial shap means it will roll around, making it interactive for them as well.

My dog loved this treat. I wouldn't recommend it for a large dog. Mine is 30 lbs. and she finished it in about ½ an hour. I liked the fact that it didn't get slimy or smelly - maybe there wasn't enough time for that.

My dogs LOVE the flossie chews.  My dogs are dachshunds and are avid chewers.  I used to give them chew hooves, but the hooves were breaking my dogs teeth off.  My vet told me to get Flossies and I am very satisfied with them.  Great Product!!!

I am telling you I was lucky. I checked and found this to be the last two bottles in stock. With no fault of Amazon or the company my item was lost, for a while and then made there way to my address. It was well worth the wait. I do not spill any of it and it taste great to the last drop. With these, I will have to make do, until, I find another good deal, such as this one! I was skeptical at first, being the syrup was in a plastic bottle, but the flavor is unreal. I would not trade or give these up for any other at this time. Thanks Amazon and affiliates for making this happen.
This was the best stuff for my first trimester!  Even my husband enjoyed nibbling on it. Not too sweet and full of ginger flavor.

My concern before this was ordered was if it was made in the USA.  My e-mail was quickly answered with a yes.  If you are a crystallized ginger lover this is the place to get it.  GREAT price and GREAT taste.  We will order from this site again.  The only problem I have with it is keeping my husband from devouring it before I can use it in my baking.

We found this pearl sugar after looking at a recipe in a King Arthur Flour Catalog.  It seems to be quite a bit cheaper then what you would pay at most specialty shops.  My wife uses it with Swedish Braided Bread.  Good stuff.

This is a great product for your baking needs. It has higher melting point compare to regular table sugar so it's great for daily baking. Since this has larger granules than regular, you can use less sugar and still get the sweetness in your baking.

Whenever I make Aunt Martha's ginger cookies, I take a marble-size piece of dough, dip it in water and then in Lars' Pearl Sugar.  When it bakes, the sugar stays like snowflakes on top of the cookie and provides a wonderful crunch when you eat it.  I get all sorts of compliments when I use this sugar.  It can be put on any butter cookie you make.  Lovely addition for the holidays.

I love the product, however I returned it as the shipping was outrageous -  I just could not use "gold dust" I paid over $50 for a $5 item!  It was sent by the most expensive means, which was not necessary at all.  I have told others about my experience and they just could hardly believe that a little can of spice would be shipped in a big box at that price!!!  Oh well, buyer beware.

We used to buy this from a local, family run grocer.  Since they closed we can only get it online;  It is well worth it and we are hooked!  Fried foods of all types, especially chicken and shrimp are incredible with Aromat!  It is great on chicken and fish and even veggies.  Not for red meats though.  We keep a can on the table and a backup in the pantry.  Once you try it, you will too!

column9: Excellent Dates for Baking or Snacking!
column10: Bob's Red Mill dried Date Pieces or Date Crumbles are so tasty and a great find! I enjoy these in cereal, oatmeal, ice cream, muffins, cookies, salads, or as a snack! Soft and chewy and a great flavor. I like how they are 'nugget' style versus buying dried dates that are usually whole and large. I also love Bob's Fig Nuggets for the same uses. Yum!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Fruit at the ready for breakfast, smoothies, baking, hiking!
column10: Bob's Red Mill Date Crumbles (or Fig Nuggets) are the very highest quality! We keep them in the freezer and use frozen. They add natural sweetness and food value to all kinds of recipes, cold cereal, hot cereal, cookies, all baking, and great in trail mixes! For breads, soak first in hot liquid (whatever liquid the recipe calls for) then add to mixer bowl. For chunky or chewy taste, use right out of the bag. BTW, these are almost a dollar CHEAPER PER BAG from Amazon (on Subscribe & Save) than they are directly from Bobs! Plus, when we order from Bobs we have to allow a week to ten days to receive stuff. With Amazon, stuff arrives in a two or three days.
We put these dates in our steel-cut oatmeal each morning.  Don't need any other sweetner!  Very delicious.

Excellently packaged box of four 20 oz packages date crumbles.  I have used them in muffins, hot cereal, cold cereal, and straight out of the package.  These are the best date crumbles I have tried so far.  I have always found Bob's red mill products to be of the highest quality

I love dates.  I eat them when I want something sweet and I bake with them.  I have bought other brands of chopped dates countless times.I bought a 4 pack of these and I do not like them.  I like many of the products this manf makes.  With prechopped dates normally the first flavor is sweet, then the date taste kicks in.  With these the first flavor is oat, they are hardley sweet and have almost no date flavor.  The limited flavor they will add are not worth the extra calories (dates are high in sugar so 1/3 cup has 130 calories).These chopped dates are coated in oat flour so they do not stick.  Other manf use some sort of sugar.  The oat seemed like a great idea. I planned on baking cookies and muffins with these so the oat taste would have been okay if there also was a sweet date taste.The very small amount of oat flour did not change the consistancy.Maybe I just got a bad batch of no-flavor dates but I would expect the manf quality control to prevent something like this.Before wasting money on 4 of these I suggest you buy a single bag to see if you like them.The 4 bags are well packed in a nice color printed carton.

column9: Delicious and sooooo good for you!
column10: Soft and chewey, fresh as can be, and the price just cannot be beat. These are the best date pieces I have ever sunk my choppers into!Thank-you Bob's Red Mill for this product and thank-you Amazon for your excellent service!!

I love these sweet nuggets of goodness!  I mostly use them in oatmeal but I'm sure they'd be great in baked goods, too.  They're rolled in oat powder so they don't stick together.  Sometimes I eat them straight out of the package.

I mix these in my oatmeal since I really hate oatmeal and need to dilute it with something that tastes good.  This isn't bad, but it seems like the date crumbles when eaten plain taste a little more like the oatmeal powder that coats the pieces than sweet dates.  Maybe it's because the crumbles are very small.  Whatever.These are pretty good, though.  They're good in oatmeal.  They're not bad as a snack, but they're a little dry.

column9: Great as an ingredient or a snack
column10: These are very tasty dates.  There is only just enough oat flour to prevent clumping, not enough to interfere with the taste.  I use this in making cinnamon/raisin/date bread.  I also add it to cereal and trail mix.

column9: Not recommended, maybe I had a "bad" batch
column10: I am a fan of Bob's Red Mill's products and have been eating the date PIECES for years and love them. I decided to give the "Crumbles" a try since I use dates in baking and thought the smaller bits would be good for that as well as in my cereal.I received the item and the freshness date is good until at least a year- excellent. I always check that first.The packaging was intact- also important.I opened a bag and put a handful of the Crumbles on my cereal. Instead of little bits of the usual date sweetness I've had with the Pieces what I tasted was bitterness! I thought maybe I just had eaten a "bad" few so I ate some directly from the bag and they had the same bitter and unpleasant taste. Very disappointing and unexpected.

I really love these dates.  I keep them in my desk at the office and snack on them when I'm hungry.  They are healthy, and when I eat them I don't crave chocolate or other sweet snacks.  Great quality.

And I thought chopped dates were good, these date crumbles are great!! They come in so handy for just about anything.. salads, muffins, cooked cereals, cookie bars, or just to snack on! They took a good product and went one step farther to make it a great product! Love it! And buying it in a 4-pak is even better!
I love these - they are so easy to eat and not sticky like the whole dates. I love to mix them with raisins and I eat them daily.

column9: a great bob's red mill product as always
column10: great taste, ample expiration date for the 4pk case, recipe ideas, great nutrition - never been disappointed in any Red Mill product

Usually I agree with other's reviews on products, but not these Date Crumbles. They are not good- I was expecting a sweet snack that as one reviewer wrote I could "eat right out of the bag." Maybe if I was super hungry. They just didn't do it for me. Now I have 4 bags to figure out what to do with. Sorry Bob's. Love all your other stuff!
unlike other brands that pack condensed milk in a can, the Nestle packaging is very convenient. I use it to sweeten my coffee, Vietnamese style. It makes your coffee rich and thick.

column9: Don't know about the cakes, but the customer service sucks
column10: I ordered a cake-of-the-month for my dad and stepmom on the opposite coast on December 15. As of January 5, they still did not receive the card noticing them of the gift. When I called flying noodle, they gave me the brush off, saying that they could resend a notice to me (not doing me any good being 3000 miles away) or could resend them the card for a $5 fee. I told them that was unacceptable and had to actually ask for a manager to get anything straightened out. It almost doesn't matter how good the cakes or other products are if the company is unreliable.

I was given six months of cakes for Christmas this year.  I've gotten two of them and they were very good!  When I opened the first I was afraid I wasn't going to like it very much - pumpkin cake - but it was lovely, dense, moist and yummy.  The cakes travel well, keep nicely, and are not filled with artificial ingredients.  My first choice would have been six months of wedding cakes but, in light of the impracticality of that, these cakes have been surprisingly good.

Pretty much describes it all.  My wife loves it however made the comment that the two cakes received thus far were very similar in taste and design.  So 4 stars but it could have been 5 with a little more variety :D

I bought this as a gift for my brothers family and they absolutely love it! What a great gift to send to someone. It certainly beats giving flowers! This is something they look forward to getting every month and I can't tell you how much all of them brag about how delicious the cakes are and how happy they are to know they will be getting a fine desert for an entire 6 months. Don't be hesitant about ordering this for yourself or as a gift. Enjoy!

Gave this to my cousin and his wife the past two years.  They were very pleased with the cakes they received (and would send me pics of the cakes as they received them). Liked that we could send it quarterly, rather than monthly.  Just wish there was a little more variety in the cakes.  Nonetheless, great gift for that "difficult to buy" person on your list.

Great-tasting tea with way-upscale packaging that automatically makes the tea taste better.  At $2 a bag the price is steep (pun intended) but if you're marketing a business towards upscale consumers, this is the way to go.  We're a photography studio and when we serve this tea the response has been extremely favorable.

This is one of the more sucessful of Celestial Seasonings Zinger genre. In this case the flavor of rose hips and hibiscus does not overpower the other flavors (unless you brew longer than 4 minutes). The aroma of this ruby potion is deliciously citrus and full bodied. The flavor of the tea is sweet red grapefruit and orange. Very tasty! I imagine this would make an excellent ice tea. Also, it is caffeine free and has added vitamin C--45 mg.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box:"Be in readiness for favorable winds." Chinese Proverb.

This Zinger is blander than most of them, which was disappointing.  I have to use twice the bags to brew the same strength of cup that, say, the cranberry apple zinger gives me.  I like the taste very much, when I do double-bag, it's a lovely, tangy orange taste; but I expected better of a Celestial Seasonings zinger tea.

I got this for a good price on Amazon.  The noodles are sturdy and tasty.  I fear the organic movement always thinks people want other things, as opposed to just what they always had, but organic.  For example I do not want organic whole wheat spaghetti, I do not want organic rice spaghetti, I just want spaghetti that is organic.  That is what this is!
Bionaturae spaghetti cooks up well and very rarely clumps.  It has a fresh taste.  The packaging keeps the pasta tasting great even after opening.  My family and I truly enjoy this spaghetti.
My doctor advised me to avoid enriched pasta - Bionatura products are the perfect solution - delicious, healthy, and Amazon's price is right!

column9: You can make sugarless pudding with this and it's tasty.
column10: The only reason I haven't bought this on amazon is shipping. But it's on my wishlist and one day I'll indulge again.Sugarless pudding tastes great with fruits. I wish more pudding without sugar was sold.

column9: Crystal Light Decaf Iced Tea Mix
column10: I gave up the fizz of soda, even diet soda a while back. That was a good thing to do. Crystal Light Tea Mixes were recommended to me and they have turned out to be a perfect substitute. The decaf allows me to drink as much as I want without getting "all cafffed up." It tastes really good, mixes easily and you can carry a pack or two on a trip and make you own instead of drinking sodas.

My husband is diabetic and finding something he actually likes to drink that doesn't have sugar or that awful sweetner after taste has been a real challange. This tea, thank goodness, is a big hit not only with my husband but the entire family!

We ordered the mango flavor margherita mix - but they sent us a case of regular flavor. NOT MANGO. Amazon is great about exchanging so I don't anticipate a problem, but not happy I sent this as a gift and didn't realize until recently that they had sent the wrong kind.

The jerky itself is very good quality. The only problem is how much pepper they load onto these pieces. It's so much that it burns my mouth and I can't even taste the jerky, all I can taste is strong pepper. Then it gets into the back of my throat and burns sometimes, or might get stuck in my teeth, all making for a very unpleasant experience!

This double pack was delivered promptly.  I took advantage of the auto-ship subscription which discounts the order from $20.89 down to $17.76. I discovered after the fact that the same size package can be purchased at Wal-Mart at the same cost as this discounted price.

I read the reviews and took my chances and bought a bunch.  I am so disappointed by the sweet, lacquered Chinese bbq pork like beef jerky with an overwhelmingly raw garlic/chili favor.  Yes, the pieces are moist but in a preserved radish way with smallish, flattened pieces. It just doesn't have the premium beef jerky heft where you can separate the pieces along the grain. Don't expect premium beef taste and texture but rather a product processed more in the Chinese restaurant baking soda, tenderized fashion.  I truly regret my purchase which I probably couldn't give away.

The price was very good, but I guess I know why.  I gave it 1 star because it's low in carbs and another because it's edible.  There is a distinct foul odor when you open the bag for the first time.  After airing the bag out, the first piece I tasted was like chewing shoe leather, dry and chewy without much flavor.  After the 2nd piece, the meat began to leave a bad chemical aftertaste.  I understand everyone's taste buds will be different so do yourself a favor and buy a small bag of this at Walmart before getting the big bags here.

Unfortunately this is a very poor representation of Jack Link's Beef Jerky. The bags are small and the jerky is in very small pieces and crumbs. It looks like scraps or left overs. No piece is larger than 1/2 inch.

So I have been hanging with a top player at the world series of poker and I purchased 2 packages of Jacks Links beef jerky.  These 2 purchases were the worst possible way to spend my money.  The meat was so dry I was not sure if I was eating dried rat tail or beef jerkey.  The "meat" caused sickness and lock jaw.  Jacks links is as good as scraps off leather shoes.  It was pretty incredible of them to sponser the WSOP but provide poor quality food at a ridiculous price.

column9: Not a good value, but tasty
column10: The packs are really small. I thought I was saving by buying in bulk, but it was not a lot for the money.  As usually the beef jerkey tastes great.
If you're not into a healthy lifestyle, get these - they are DELICIOUS! "You can't eat just one!"It contains MSG and other "stuff." - You've been warned! It's very delicious, though...

I can't always get to the store on my bicycle, so it is quite handy to use Amazon & order something I hanker for.  The beef jerky, high in protein & low in calories, fat & carbs, absolutely hit the spot when it arrived nice & quickly!

28.99 dollars for one pack? Are people stupid, you can buy these at the neares supermarket for less than 28.99, aybe 7 or 8 dollars, but not 28 for one pack..  I know is easy to buy online, but buying this, is just playing lazy!

column9: Good, healthy and protein filled snack.
column10: I only have one major issue. Because of the texture of jerky in general it really gets stuck in your teeth and becomes a bit of a chore to eat.

Bought this thinking it cheap and more convenient, but i was wrong. The meat in the package seem dried and old. The price was also higher comparing to my  local samsclub.I like it when the meat is more tender and moist. And this doesn't deliver that. 1 star.
What a rip off.  We opened the bag and a day later there was wispy white mold on it.  The whole bag had to be thrown out.  It even smelled a little "off".  You're better off buying it at the store.

Jack Links is really good one of the bests and its actually real meat haha,I dont have to pay for it I get it for free because my dads company sells it and he gets free stuff from them all the time but if I didnt get it for free I would pay full price for it!

column9: lost one bag of my "jack link's" beef jerky
column10: I am a regular subscriber of this "Jack Link's" beef jerky terriyaki. This morning, I opened the new box from Amazon and found that there are only 9 bags in the box while it supposed to be 10. I used to trust Amazon and this is the first time that I check the quantity in the box. Since the inside box is open, so someone might have taken one during the packing process because s/he loves it so much but I hate to lose one bag of my Jack Links beef jerky!!

I'm a former Marine, got out after 8 years, did two tours in Iraq and one in Afghanistan. I was first introduced to beef jerky during MCT (Marine Combat Training)...which is where you learn warfighting techniques. For those LONG, sweaty, depressingly hot days in NC...this was an excellent snack. Beef Jerky is nutritious, low in fat content and tastes great! It also is a great chewy snack for those 'hurry-up-and-wait' days. Perhaps the biggest benefit for me was the salt....if you're out in the sun all day, you lose a lot of sweat....the Marine Corps motto should be 'drink water'...but as for electrolytes/ salt....this snack does an excellent job. I love the peppered taste...probably because I'm Jamaican. The 1.5-ounce snack size fits perfectly in your pocket and works out to be about half the price you'd pay at the gas station (thanks Amazon). I have a couple of buddies over in Afghanistan and I sent each two packs....for them and to pass around to their troops...they love it.For a healthy snack (especially if you're very active and sweat a lot)this is a great product.If there was one complaint....I wish the desiccant that is inside every bag was somehow shaped differently.....if you grab a handful in the bottom...you'll never know that you grabbed the desiccant too....luckily I've been able to catch it!

I'm normally a fan of jack links but this really disappointed me. Ordered 4 bags and had two of them. I spent more time picking through the meat taking out the nasty gizard and fat chunks all throughout the bag. Also the meat quality was terrible and quality control isn't. Good for this flavor. One piece would be moist and flavorful and the next would bard as a rock and uncomfortable to chew. Overall this was a terrible product. Jack links shouldn't put 10 different cuts of meat in the same bag. If you like quality controlled products this isn't for you.

Good stuff....but.  I'd gotten some at Walmart but didn't really pay attention to the price (for one bag).  I enjoyed it so much that I searched for it on Amazon (in bulk) and ordered three different flavors.  I happened to be in Walmart the next morning and discovered to my surprise that it was significantly cheaper there.  (Walmart $3.50 for a 3.5oz bag, Amazon about $23.00 for ten 1.5oz bags - almost 50 cents an ounce more from Amazon plus you have to purchase it in bulk).  I find that I tend to order blindly from Amazon when I'm actually purchasing from Amazon and not a third-party vendor because I'm so used to fantastic savings.  This was a bit of a wake-up call.  I will give kudos to Amazon for their customer service policies, though.  I was able to cancel my order relatively hassle free.

This is probably the best mass-produced beef jerky on the market.  It isn't too tough or dry like cheaper brands, isn't too sweet or spicy either.  Only problem is that as a snack I feel it isn't overly healthy.  (It has MSG, sodium nitrite and a lot of sodium).  However it is a low-fat, high-protein food, and very tasty.

I bought this flavor for the first time at the store, when they were out of my favorite (Sweet N Hot). My kids (ages 4 and 2) were begging me for some when we got back to the car. I told them they could try it, but that it would be spicy. They agreed, took the small bites I gave them and continued to ask for more until the entire package was gone! The flavor is exactly as the title describes. It's sweet and spicy, and reminds me of a dish I would order at a Thai restaurant. It's not as Spicy as the Sweet N Hot, but it still has quite a kick. It's not my favorite flavor, but I still give it 5 stars for the great texture and good flavor (and the fact that my kids devoured it). I bought this package with my kids in mind. I am all for natural products that they enjoy!
bought this product in smaller packaging so as to take to work and enjoy. two of the 10 packages were moldy said best before mar 13 2013. can't trust won't buy.

I have had this on order for about a total of 8 bags. I first had a good experience and what seemed like a quality jerky and continued to keep it ordered on my subscribe and save account. The next 2 bags were awful. There were tiny bits and they were extra hard and grisly. I thought maybe it was just a bad run and let the next order come through. They were terrible also. It was like there was one or two decent strips of meat, and the rest was inedible. I'm not sure how this keeps happening. I had meant to cancel this subscription but remembered after I was shipped another pack of two. Maybe they'll be better but I haven't been eager to to open them. Roll of the dice, I guess.

This is my second order of Jack Link's Beef Jerky, Peppered, Mega Pack from Amazon due to lower price than other stores and I hit the jackpot.  You can see the pictures I upload for this product.  It has mold all over, which even can be seen from outside the bag.  Unfortunately I did not see it and put one in my mouth.  Few seconds afterward, the taste was so strange and my friend, who was about to eat, stop me from swallowing.  Try for yourself, but please be careful.

I got Teryaki flavored of the mega packs and yuck! The jerky was so hard and crunchy and old.... It said that it expires in 2013 but still it tastes so nasty so i threw it away and got a refund for my purchace. Amazon is great but these people sell nasty jerky, just go to the store to buy jerky
I bought this and thought it was a good deal... WRONG!!!  The bags that I got were full of gristle and I ended up throwing it away because it was NOT enjoyable eating.

column9: Great product but the subscription ships old products.
column10: I love this beef jerky and so I looked everywhere for it, and had trouble finding it readily. So when I found this product on subscription on Amazon, I was more than thrilled to subscribe. That was two months ago. I've now cancelled my subscription. Why you ask? The unopened packages of the beef jerky were hard as a rock and were tasteless as a result. I don't know what Amazon does to receive the jerkys so cheap thereby giving the customers the 15% discount, but I'd rather pay more and get them off retail and enjoy every piece.. I am very disappointed at the result and won't re-subscribe again.
Jack Link's Beef Jerky, Original, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 2)Tough and chewiness, dry, not too salty, this is one of my favorites. Since the flavor isn't too strong, i tend to eat too much.

I bought eight packs. Seven of those, I hope, were in good condition. One of them looks darker and has mold on it. I didn't notice that after I ate two pieces... That was disgusting!! It says on the package the jerky will be good until 2013. I guess the company is wrong.I complained to Amazon CS. After 5 minute they decides to give me refund. This is probably all that Amazon can do, but I will not buy any kind of food/snacks on Amazon anymore. And I will not buy any Jack Links product on line or in store. Their quality control is really doubtable.MOLD ON JERKY!! Be aware!

column9: DO NOT ORDER THIS PRODUCT Eeeeew
column10: Jack Link's Beef Jerky, Peppered, Mega Pack, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 2)This order took five days to deliver and this is Florida with high humidity and high heat. Upon receipt I opened each package because I always place in my fridge in gallon zip locks. I ordered two of the mega two-packs and three of the four were fine. The fourth was FULL of mold which was visible through the packaging. I am seriously disappointed (and grossed-out). No returns/exchanges means I will NEVER purchase foods items from Amazon again.Update: After figuring out a way to contact Customer Service despite their policy of no returns on food items, they credited back 1/4 of total purchase price and offered free next day shipping for this item (which I will not use). Never again.

column9: Good, but had too many fatty pieces
column10: Mostly, this was good stuff. I haven't had this stuff in a long long time but decided to purchase some.Most of the jerky was good, but I ran into 1 too many pieces that was fatty or felt like a salty chunk of fat. I wish I would've gotten pieces or a bag without any of it considering this is pretty damn expensive stuff, but it is good.They definitely need to work on quality control if they want to keep the prices so high for this stuff, or I might have to go to a different brand.

Me and the missus went through this pretty quick... It's sweet, peppery, tasty.This was enough to satisfy my craving for jerky for awhile... I think the sugar, salt, and MSG are the main turn-offs for me although I do realize some of this may be required for jerky.It's almost like I want either a more wholesome jerky snack or a straight-up rod of faux-meat.Still, this is worth checking out to see if it's your thing.

This was an impulse buy. I purchased other food items and decided to try getting this from Amazon. I later found that the same product was much cheaper at my local Big Box Membership Warehouse store. The jerky was about the same freshness as I find in local stores. I was hoping for fresher, ie softer jerky.

column9: Great value for a good quality jerky
column10: Great item to do Sub & Save on so you can keep a healthy snack on hand for work, school or just at home. Teriyaki is my personal favorite.

I love jerky.When it comes to fresh organic jerky nothing beats Ed's Roadhouse.But for store bought variet?Jack Links is where it's at.The jalapeno version has just the right amount of heat and kick to make this one of the best store varieties out there.Not too tough, not too stringy.Just.......right.Too bad I mow through the whole bag in one sitting..  :)Highly recommended.

column9: Good flavor but a bit tough
column10: I really like the flavor of these but they are a bit tougher than I am used to.  I dont think I will be buying them again.
The spicy thai beef jerky makes for a quick high-protein snack between meals. I would give it five stars if there weren't some tough, unchewable pieces in every bag. The tender pieces are very good.
I have found this brand to be more fresh than others. The jerky is somewhat soft so it is easier to bite and chew. I like it and it is a good price.

I buy a lot of stuff online and only write a review if something was very good or very bad.I honestly have to say that Jack Link's Jerky is the best jerky I have ever eaten (I've even bought some from a meat market before).  I have tried several of their flavors and all have been good.  The Sweet & Hot could be a little hotter, IMO, but it is still awesome and my favorite of theirs.  Besides the different flavors being good, what really sets Jack Link's apart from every other jerky I've tried is the quality of the meat itself.  The meat has the perfect amount of moisture, making it able to actually bite a piece in half without having to gnaw on it for 20 minutes.  While other brands aren't very consistent, particularly Pemmican, which I used to think was the best available, Jack Link's is very consistent with the quality of each piece.
