column9: Claypso Lemonade Tastes fresh and refreshing
column10: I first tried this excellent lemonade in Sparks, Nevada and I have to admit it has to be one of the best bottled lemonades I have ever tried. It is very refreshing and has a fruity taste not normally found in bottled lemonades.

Definitely worth trying this one.  The Kiwi Lemonade is my favorite - just perfect.  Strawberry and black cherry lemonade varieties are both also excellent.  The Melon Lemonade is strangely appealing, though not as prized as the aforementioned.  The only one that disappointed me so far is the Ocean Blue, which really wasn't very good, IMO.
very great service. fast shipping. and i was pleased with how my product was wrapped...it came safe and secure :)

My wife really likes these cool bottles so I ordered two, despite the fact that I thought $43 was pretty expensive for a 24 pack of diet coke.  You can't find these easily in retail stores.Imagine my utter surprise when I received not two 24 packs, but in fact only two bottles for $59!My one star is simply because at least they honored the return. But, seriously guys?On the other hand, it's possible it was simply confusing labeling that caused this snafu. At the current time, it appears they may have changed how this appears on Amazon and their pricing.

I am a hot tea drinker; I love Earl Grey/English Breakfast teas. But it's summer. So I began a search for a lightly sweetened (no nasty faux sweeteners for me) and I found one: this Numi tea is very good. Just a touch of sugar to take the "nasty" edge off black tea, makes it great with food, too. Now if Amazon would just do a Prime eligible shipping deal, I wouldn't have to lug this from Gelsons. 40 calories in a 12 oz bottle; 9g Sugar; 10g Carbs.

column9: Not too bad before I saw the mold
column10: I was so excited to get these because I thought it would be a great healthy snack to keep at my desk.  I ordered these and other flavor (double chocolate chunk) and after eating a couple of each, noticed that one of the cookies had bluish green mold on it.  I assumed it was a bad one in the batch.  I saw on the manufacturer's website that these should be stored in the freezer since the shelf life is 90 days (due to natural ingredients and no preservatives).  I immediately put them in the freezer after getting them 3 weeks earlier.  The next 4 cookies I opened had that same mold on it and after I examine the rest, I found that they all were moldy.  Apparently Amazon had them stored in their warehouse for a while before I rec'd them.  Since there were no dates stamped on the cookies, I have no idea how long they sat in the warehouse before I got them.I will not be ordering these again and will be wary of ordering other food products from Amazon.com.  They were great about refunding my money and I will continue to purchase from amazon, just not short shelf life food items.

column9: should be renamed "Fruity, Not-so-many Chocolate Chunk" cookies
column10: I'm a veg who makes vegan baked goods and generally uses applesauce or banana as an egg substitute, so I'm no stranger to fruit in baking.  However, these cookies have an overwhelming fruity aroma, smell and taste, that I found hard to like and even swallow.  I'm guessing it might be the prune puree in the ingredients.  Oh and there were a disappointing number of chocolate chips in them - one cookie had two small chocolate chunks.  With no chocolate to compensate for the fruity aroma - 2 stars.However, I find these filling and better with a big cup of coffee.  So if you like fruitiness and want something filling for a breakfast on the go, this can be a good vegan breakfast item.

Vegan. Natural. Kosher. Big cookie. Mild delicious chocolate flavor. Very soft with some chewy oats mixed in. Kind of big for a snack, but is nice for quick breakfast or meal replacement. Substantial. Vegans will especially find these cookies useful, nourishing, and convenient. 310 calories per cookie. 6g of protein. This cookie was a Vegan Grocery *** TRIPLE+ *** in the 24 pack, which is no longer available. Hopefully the good word will again flourish for the benefit of everyone. Also really like Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookie Peanut Butter Chocolate Chunk, Vegan, 3-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) which has been popular with the Community. This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews and the vegancompassion Profile for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" & all the other helpful "Vegan Grocery" Listmania. Your input counts and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

I believe this is the first 'vegan' product I have ever knowingly tried - that is touted as vegan.  The title 'vegan' in anything rather tends to scare me (as in my ignorance I have nothing to compare vegan items to, coupled with a sincere love of dairy).However, Amazon dropped the price of these to a point where I could no longer deny my family trying them.Here is the best that I can do to describe the taste (and please, my vegan friends, do not have a stroke at the level of my simplicity - I mean no disrespect):They taste like cookie dough cookies not cooked.  If you like/enjoy cookie dough you should love these cookies.  My entire family does/did (past tense as the entire 12 cookies were WOLFED down by my cookie-dough loving crew).NOTE:  if taken from a FROZEN state (where we store all our Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies), they require only **20** seconds to totally heat up.  The non-vegan varieties we heat for 30 seconds and still have a cold-spot or two.  These TOTALLY heat through, for us, in 20 seconds and are unbelievably delicious.

I heard about these cookies many, many years ago from Weight Watchers meetings.  I used to eat them a lot, but had basically forgotten about them.  While running a search on Amazon, these popped up and, seeing they were vegan (I am now a vegetarian, attempting to eat vegan as much as possible), I had to try them.  They are every bit as magically delicious as their non-vegan counterparts that I ate many years ago.  I store them in the freezer, as recommended, and I pop them in the toaster oven on "toast" for about 5 minutes (microwaving them works, toasting is just better tasting if you have a few extra minutes - adds a bit of toasty crunch on the outer layer, while still leaving the cookie moist and chewy - exactly how I like them!).  At around 300 calories, they are very filling without going overboard, and full of healthy, natural ingredients.  If I am super hungry, I add a soy yogurt and an apple and I can go until dinner on this filling meal. I LOVE these cookies!

High sugar, low protein, just like many breakfast cereals out there. If you are looking for a direct replacement for a bowl of cereal, this could do it for you. If looking for a breakfast that is healthier then a bowl of cereal then go for something else.

Not all vegan snacks are that good but my daughter was recentley diagnosed with a dairy allergy.  She was coming home and we live in a small town with no access to better quality vegan snacks.  I ordered these from Amazon and she took the rest of them back to Seattle, Wa.  Great Success story.  Hope to find other varieties..  BK Richardson
Yummy. Very fulfilling snack or mini-meal. I keep a couple in the car & at work.

column9: Breakfast on the Go for oatmeal lovers.
column10: You won't notice that it's Vegan.  It tastes good, and it's reasonably good for you.  We find that just keeping these in the freezer, then cutting the top of an individual package open and zapping it in the microwave for 25 seconds is the best way to handle storage and preparation.  Wash it down with a hot drink such as coffee or chai tea, and it's a pretty satisfying breakfast on the go.  My wife packs a two-pack of frozen veggie sausage and a small paper plate along with my lunch.  After I arrive at work, I supplement the coffee and cookie I had along the way with the sausage. (Morning Star Farms soy sausage tastes pretty much like traditional sausage to me, but it's less greasy, and can be zapped for 1 minute, 25 seconds on a paper plate by way of prep.)  I usually have old-fashioned V-8 or one of the veggie/fruit fusion versions as well.  Sometimes we switch it up and go with some of the better tasting turkey sausages -- surprisingly, Jimmy Dean has them.  My wife sticks to the cookie (there are lots of different flavors) and chai tea, then has the veggie sausage as a mid-morning snack with brown mustard.  She doesn't have the V-8 until mid-afternoon, after soup for lunch.  (My lunch is usually a 6-in. Subway or something relatively substantial.)I've lost weight slowly, which in my case is a good thing. Remember, these are 300 calorie cookies, so plan accordingly. I used to have a home-made breakfast sandwich every morning, and now do the sandwich only on occasion. I'm getting older, and don't need quite as many calories as I used to. In case anyone is curious, the breakfast sandwich consisted of two slices of whole grain bread, a slice of thin, pre-sliced ham (prefer Dap), and an Eggbeater omelet my wife makes. You spray olive oil to coat the insides of a microwaveable 2 C. (you can use a 4 C if you want the eggs spread out more) measuring cup, add about 300 ml. of Eggbeaters (I like their Southwestern-style), a T. or 2 T. of chunky salsa (we like Pace), and a couple of large pinches of your favorite pre-grated cheese (we like Sargento's light 3 cheese or "Mexican" cheese.) Cover and zap for about 4 minutes, or until fluffy and done.  Slap it between the bread with the ham, and away you go. Hungry guys can add one or two whole eggs to the whole thing, as it just takes longer to zap, say 6 to 6.30 minutes.
not a lot of flavor in this item, but I like the idea of the natural ingredents

*First I want to point out that the actual product I purchase lists whole rolled oats on the package as the first ingredient, not the second as is listed on the Amazon website.  Check out [...] to read the actual ingredients fresh from the baker.*I work in a facility that stocks these in their employee cafe, where I pay $2 a pop for each - it is well-worth it!  As an on-the-go mom and employee, I often don't get to eat breakfast at all, let alone sit down to enjoy it.  What I love best about these cookies is that they are made with quality ingredients, yet there are flavor options.  That seems so rare these days!I'm a major chocoholic, so I reach for the only chocolate flavor my work stocks: this vegan chocolate chunk.  As another reviewer pointed out - these chocolate chunks aren't plentiful, but they are big.  I like the fruity flavor, so then its a treat when I bite into a bite of chocolate.  I detect a hint of banana when I eat mine, but definitely not overpowering or even obvious unless you are trying to pinpoint the flavor.  I think they are sufficiently moist, not crumbly, and filled with flavor.The sticker shock of 300 calories and 54g of carbs initially took me by surprise, despite how big these are and the whole oats as the first ingredient.  The cafe employee assured me these were a "whole meal in a cookie" but I was still skeptical until I ate one.  The first one I had... I ate less than half around 10am, and then finished it as a dessert after lunch (1pm).  I was beyond satisfied, and FULL!  Then I started eating them for breakfast and I am just amazed.  It usually takes me about an hour or more to get through one (and I'm normally a mindless eater - just shovel in the fuel) but not with these.  They fill me up after just a few bites, so I'm able to slow down my eating.  If I eat the cookie by 9am I am full until lunchtime (or beyond).  In fact, on my long 12-hour days, I am able to push my lunch hour back by 2 hours so I can enjoy dinner with my family instead of out of a take-out container.  I just couldn't ask for a better option - to keep me full, be good-for-me, and be convenient.  In fact, I'm ordering regular ones for myself and the minis for my 4-year old.  What a FANTASTIC treat to help our mornings!!!  (And since they are cookies, she'll think they are an incentive to move along faster LOL).

each cookie(one per package)is large and very tasty..but pop them in a microwave(600 watts or so)for 20 sec...WOW what a tasty delight!!!...be forwarned don't zap for more than 20 seconds or your cookie becomes totally unedible!!!....ENJOY!

Don't worry, even if you're not Vegan these are awesome! In fact, I couldnt even tell they were vegan just tasted like an Oatmeal cookie with Chocolate Chunks, perfect for early mornings. I eat one in the morning on my way to work and I'm not hungry until about 2pm. I also take these on my long bike rides.  Great carbs, great taste and they really stick with you.
I am a vegan and I eat these every morning for breakfast.  They are not only good for you they are delicious.  I highly recommend them to anyone, not just vegetarians.

column9: Substantial Yummy Breakfast- a little dry
column10: I am a new mom who needs breakfast every day without fail- these are great to grab and go.  I love that this is Vegan (unlike the other Erin Baker Breakfast Cookies) and the chocolate chunks are (few but) yummy.  The cookie really sticks with you throughout the day.  However, it is a little dry.  I highly recommend the Oatmeal Raisin.  I could eat those all day.

These are great. When I have one in the morning, I'm good until lunch time. The chocolate chunks are definitely the stars and make this cookie real a treat. I ordered these twice in the last couple of months and I have yet to find any mold =0). As a vegan snack and something to keep you going any time, I definitely recommend this cookie!

These do really taste great without having to toast them if you want a healthy snack any time of day. I got them because they were identified as vegan. Two disappointments regarding these:1. The packaging indicates that the product is made in a facility that processes milk, tree nuts, etc. So I'm not sure they should be classifying the product as vegan if there are possibly traces of milk in the product. But it won't stop me from finishing what I've bought.2. When you get the 12 pack, it does have a note suggesting that they be stored in the freezer to maintain freshness and then just pop them in a standard toaster when you want one. I will have to wait a week or so to do this with those I've not eaten as I had just gone shopping the day before getting the product and my freezer was full.Hope this information is helpful to others.

column9: great until they raised the price almost 10$ in 1 month
column10: The cookies themselves are "ok".  Not spectacular, but...ok.  They were also under 15$ when I purchased them LESS THAN A MONTH AGO!  Now they are almost 25$ for THE SAME AMOUNT! I would not suggest purchasing these price gouged products.  Make your own, better tasting and less expensive cookies.

My Boyfriend(who is a picky eater)and I love these! I was looking for a healthy quick breakfast option that wasn't really expensive. I have one almost every morning before work with some fresh fruit. You have to put them in the freezer when you receive them in the mail. They send you instructions telling you to do so. So all the people who keep posting about their cookies being moldy evidently can't read. We just stick them in the toaster on defrost and they come out delicious. The Chocolate Chunk is our favorite flavor so far, although I haven't had a bad one yet!
I ordered the Choc chunk and loved them so I ordered them again along with the peanut butter and they were out if date! I won't order again!

The taste is very good.  I enjoy the Vegan chocolate chip variety the best.  Fast energy and portable for a quick breakfast.  Very tasty when put in a toaster oven and heated.  The cookies are moist and crunchy when toasted.  You will like them.

I really like how these aren't factory made breakfast bars.  They actually expire which I think says a lot about the nutritional quality.  On the package itself it suggests to freeze the cookies to make them last longer.  I did this and was able to pull a couple down into the fridge whenever I needed to.  I even took a frozen one with me when I went out in the morning on errands and by the time I needed it, it was defrosted and ready to eat.  It has kind of a dense texture that goes better with a coffee or tea, but is fine by itself too.  I usually used them for an on-the-go thing, but especially delicious was warming it up in the toaster oven.  It really felt more like a desserty treat then.  I think the calorie count might be kind of high on this, but for me the ingredients and purpose outweighed that con.  The best thing about this item by far, was the fact that it FILLED ME UP.  I usually have to eat a big bagel to feel full in the morning...but I could grab this and an apple or banana and be good.  They have a lot of different varieties of flavors to explore.
All of this companies cookies are so delicious and healthy. They can also be frozen and then heated  super yummy!

These are one of the few breakfast bars that actually fill me up and get me ready for the day until lunch.  The flavors are outstanding, and the consistency is that of a home made cookie.  All in all, a great start to the day.

column9: First Time Buyer, Love it!I wa
column10: I was looking for a great vegan breakfast bar to grab in the morning on my way to work and these cookies could not have been more perfect. Filling, delicious, and easy to grab on-the-go, I will definitely be a repeat customer!

column9: Not Vegan! As other reviewers have said.....
column10: I think these taste good but am not sure why everyone is calling them vegan.  The ingredients list dry egg whites.  To me this is not a vegan option and I'm disappointed that I ordered based on everyone's review that they were vegan.  They taste good to me, but I will not reorder and am disappointed the reviews led me in the wrong direction.So, I give a low review because I hope it will cause others to read the review and know this item is not vegan, as suggested and as searched.  Otherwise, if you are not vegan they taste good and I would have been happy.

I found that Grandma's Peanut Butter cookies actually taste like peanut butter. I tried another brand and all I tasted was flour and shortening, no peanut flavor at all. My ideal cookie, though, would also contain bits of peanuts in the cookie.

Every time you buy a product in bulk, you will get a cheaper product. But another truth is that you will get tired of the product by the end. The quality of the food wasn't as good as I thought it was going to be, but it still tasted good, especially those days where I couldn't find anything else to eat (I'm a first-year college student). I wouldn't buy this product again, but I do not regret buying it.
Love these cookies!!!  Breakfast every day at work with my tea.  I have been hooked on these for a few years now.  Stores prices gone up so I order off Amazon and save alot of $$$$$!!

I ordered these cookies for my husband and they arrived in perfect condition.  He has enjoyed eating them every day.  Since then I have found them at some local drugstores for a good price.  The cookies that I ordered were a low price but the shipping was very expensive and therefore I will probably not order them again.
Great quality rawhide, it's good for right before bed. Their retriever rolls lasted about 2 months, this one is thinner, so maybe 2 weeks. lol.

After moving to the East Coast many years ago, I was thrilled (and shocked!) to find my favorite chocolates at Walmart, of all places! They carried them for almost a year, with me (and my family, once they snuck enough to get hooked on them as well!) dutifully purchasing a box here & there as I rewarded myself for a job well done.. Childbirth- one box. Purchasing a new home- one box... eventually it came down to 'Spring break's over and the kids will finally stop pestering you for a chocolate!'- one box.Walmart, alas, has finally taken them off the shelves, so when I get that craving again, I must order them from Amazon.com. Good to know I can still get them, once my stash of clearance truffles is gone (my kids saw the boxes and their eyes glazed over happily- I've gotta find a better hiding place!).

We bought these at Costco and love them!  Of course Costco no longer sells them and I was checking Amazon (the first place I check when Costco drops a product that we like).  Hopefully Amazon will start carrying them on Subscribe and save.  Anyway back to the product...  These little crackers have just the right amount of sweet and crunch to them to go with brie.
These crackers are wonderful with British Cranberry Cheese. Get them while they are in stock during the fall and order enough to last. Chocolate and Art Lover
I found these crackers about a year ago and LOVE them.  Wonderful in so many ways.  Now the problem is I can't find them anywhere.  HELP!

In all the years of trying so many wonderful crackers and related items around the world, we found these Cranberry Crisps a combination of great teat and usability... as they are perfect for dipping, or breaking up to put in salads, as a base for any topping and just lovely by themselves.  Enjoy, Lino

This tea is absolutely DELICIOUS.  Some green tea tastes like grass but this has a sweet flavor to it with the cherry blossoms.  The loose tea is always sold out in the coffee bean by me so I was so excited to find this online.  The resealable packs are great and they go a long way.

I ordered this tea based off the other two reviews which had made it seem like a pleasant green tea with cherry notes - this was not, however, the tea which I received. I'm not quite sure what ingredient used in this blend gave it such an overwhelming, almost chemical, cherry flavor but nothing about it was good. Aside from being able to see that there were other ingredients in this blend, I would've assumed it was exclusively synthetic cherry flavoring. I love green teas, I even love to steep my teas for extended periods of time and never worry about straining the loose leaf ingredients, maybe these were faults of mine that made this tea so horrible but I tried over and over to brew it and even mix it with other teas I have to make it tolerable. The best result I got was taking a small pinch of this tea and adding it to a full glass of another to achieve a flavor akin to a Lysol disinfectant spray.

I was pleasantly surprised by this tea. It has a delicate cherry and rose like after taste that is great with the green tea. I think it's great for a summer iced tea or I even just have it as a hot tea in the morning.

First of all if you are looking for a healthy snack these are no a go to product..Not even any prepacked cheese in crackers is real cheese.They taste good, creamy cheese and sweet crunchy breadsticks make it very nice to snack on.They are smaller than your handi-snack version..but you can get these on sale at a local marked for $1 a pack ..much cheaper than the other brands, and much better than the $1.50 Great Value brand.I say for a once and in while snack these hit the spot.

im a vegetarian and have been for 9 years or so. ive been through an exhausting list of different types of soymilk made by different companies, and i have to say, i like this one the best. ^_^but in all honesty, if you can buy it in a store, do so...it cost as much online as in store, without the extra shipping.

column9: Good wafers in the gluten free section
column10: I have recently shifted to a gluten free diet. Not being able to eat the common yummy items I was feeling frustrated. There are very few choices in the gluten free section. I have tried several other cookies/wafers. They are not the best things on earth. But this wafer is different. It is yummy. I loved the sour and sweet taste. one of the best snacks in the gluten free section.I did not buy the product from amazon. I got a single pack from Walmart. Now that I love the taste I might buy this in bulk.

column9: good for low carbers and diabetics
column10: compared to the usual white bread bun you might not choose this but if you are diabetic or a low carber it is a no brainer. these buns make it possible for us to have a real hamburger and not raise our blood sugar unduely. One thing though, it is better to refrigerate the buns and microwave a few seconds to warm it and not do the usual bbq or toast warming. I have found that microwaving makes reguar bread rubbery but not so the low carb buns (same for their hot dog buns) while the usual warming makes them dry. The ingredients are different and so the warming needed is different. Done this way they do not come out dry and cardboardy. and using more condiments helps also. So I give them a high rating even though the shipping makes them expensive and thus it is worth it for our health.
Carb Krunchers Low Carb Hamburger Buns is very good and I ate it with toast. I like the plain without hamburger.. I will eat hamburger very soon.. I like that very much.. Recommend to all..

I used to give my dogs chicken tenders from a major food chain.  They boasted high amounts of protein.  But this product is softer, no sharp edges and adds supplements of flaxseed and vitamins for the health of your dog.  I would much rather pay a little extra and diminish or delete any additives, dyes, fats and other unhealthy additives.  My dogs can't get enough and I feel better knowing they are receiving a healthy treat. I highly recommend them.

My dog has been enjoying these treats for over 13 years (and now the cat enjoys them too). From what I have heard, the company that produces the treats, is owned by a couple of American brothers.  One of the brothers, overseas production in China, and extra care is taken to produce a healthy product.
A great product.  Dogs love it and it's good for them.  They hear that bag open and are on me in a second.

FDA Continues to Caution Dog Owners About Chicken Jerky Products made in China.November 18, 2011The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is again cautioning consumers that chicken jerky products for dogs (also sold as chicken tenders, strips or treats) may be associated with illness in dogs. column9: Dog likes it, but source is suspect
column10: I've fed my dog several packages of the chicken jerky and she really liked them. My pet displayed no ill effects but as a precaution I will not buy this product again.
My dogs love these.  The only thing I don't like is sometimes they are hard and dry, but most times they are chewy, which is the way the dogs love them most!
Vitality dog chews are the best treat that a person can give to man's best friend!!!! Nutritious and healthy choice for your dog.

A friend of mine gives these to her dog and she is the type known to like finer things, even for her pets. I thought I would try them out for my dog too since I saw how much her dog liked them. They are my dog's favorite, he LOVES LOVES these treats! They are on the more expensive side but they are worth it. They are from cage free chickens, and have supplements like flax seed in them. I highly recommend!
My two dogs have been eating these chews for at least four years. They look forward  to them everyday.  I wish the price was lower.

column9: DO NOT BUY! Made in china!!!!!
column10: My dogs love these but I discovered they are made in China.  So disappointed because I thought they were healthy safe products.  Will never buy again.

column9: Do your research before you talk smack....
column10: [...]Dogswell is an amazing brand and you should read about why they choose to make these in China, and read all the other awesome facts about their company too.

Our dog seems to head for her food bowl at feeding time. She has been known to avoid it for hours. With 74-78% organic constituents (phone call with C&P) this food reduces my anxiety about dog cancers.

I wasn't sure if my dog would like this since it's the weight management formula. Simply put, he loves it....Criteria #1 met! My second requirement was that it be organic, have healthy ingredients, & no corn or wheat. I knew that requirement was met when I bought it, because that's a feature of the Castor Pollux Organix line. There are lots of fruits, vegees, whole grains, and chicken in this dog food. I wanted something that did not have a lot of fillers and by products. This brand does not have corn, wheat or soy in its mix. There are no pesticides, antibiotics,and no growth hormones.I have an older dog, 13 and he needs vitamins which is another reason I picked this brand. He really likes it and eats well. He is aging and he has some of the usual age related stiffness, eyesight changes and the vitamins help with that.A very good product, quality kibble and a reasonable price.
I love this brand!  There are so many foods out there for pets made with too much filler that isn't really good for them.
Both of my dogs love this food and from the research I've done this is one of the higher rated foods out there.

I'm a proud owner of a yellow lab, who has suffered from soft stool.  I have tried several name brands including holistic dog food and none have worked to help with his soft stool issue.  I am so glad I never gave up trying different brands and Organix was the perfect food for him.  He has consistently been having firm stools since he has been on it.  He also loves the flavor. column9: Dog food your pet will beg for more!
column10: First time using to new pets in family, 3 & 4 year olds, they took to it right away, even the neighbors dog couldn't get enough and she was a table people fed dog, now won't eat nothing but this pet food, my new pets really eat it up, I think this is the best food I could have found, love the no chemicals or preservatives.Were hooked for life!

This is great food for my Doberman. It was recommended by the vet. The only problem is how hard to find it is. Castor & Pollux doesn't seem to be very distributor/dealer friendly. So they make it difficult to support local pet stores.
Did they change bag cover as not same as prior ones but statesStill the adult foodPlease advise me onDan Johnson

I was happy to find this food at my co-op. My long-haired miniature dachund was given to me when he was just over 1 year old (he is still under two) because he was not well cared for. I immediated changed his cheap crap diet to this dry food. He loved it and seemed to do very well on it. After several 6-pound bags which were fine, I bought the last bag a couple of weeks ago. I have tried the Back to Basics Sugar-free syrups and they are pretty watered down tasting. I was pleasantly surprised how sweet and tasty the Jelly Belly Sugar-Free Apple was! I am in love and will be buying the 3 pack next time to save money.
Kids love the syrup but you can get it at Bed Bath & Beyond for $2.99.  We have also tried blue raspberry and green apple.  Nice thick syrup.

column9: Used These While On HCG Protocol
column10: I bought these to use as part of the Simeons (Trudeau) hCG weight loss protocol because they are so much cheaper by the case than by the box in the grocery store. Of course, the case is more than enough for several rounds of the hCG protocol.For those who are searching for grissini for the first time: these are probably the actual breadsticks that Simeons refers to in his book. I have visited Italy and this Alessi brand was in all the grocery stores that we shopped at in Rome and further north. Even the box is nearly identical to the ones in Italy, except the writing is in Italian there, of course.This particular flavor tastes great. The rosemary is noticeable, but very light and pleasant. They are not noticeably salty. The breadsticks are crispy and fun to eat.  My family loves them, too.

When you are on a strict diet like the hcg diet, you look for variety, and these are the perfect match! Alessi Rosemary Breadsticks give you just a little bit of flavor that makes it possible to endure the monontony of the diet. After the diet, these are a great accompaniment to any soup or salad meal.  I am going to purchase more when I am done with the stabilization portion of the diet, just to have around for snacks, soup and salad meals.

I have opened several boxes and have yet to come across even one whole breadstick let alone a box with the entire amount whole.I wanted to use these for gifts at Christmas presented with a decorated container to set them in and homemade spaghetti sauce and salad dressing. I would not purchase these unless you want to use them for breading.
Very fruity and tasty - my personal favorite acai tea. Expensive as all Teavana teas are, but well worth it.

God, I LOVE the Keen-Wah Decadence line of bars!!! They're HEAVEN-sent. This bar is awesomely good.  It has a bbq flavor, without the mess. The berries and bison is a great combination.  Perfect on the go snack.  My kids love them.  They finish a 12 pack box a day.  If offered a sweet treat or this bar, hands down, thus far, they have chosen this bar.

A little pricey but worth it for what it is.  Very meaty flavor with a bit of sweetness from the fruit.  Makes a very good emergency snack to carry around.  The ingredients are better and it contains less chemicals than some of the overly processed beef jerky and slim jim type snacks around.

The taste is good, but each bar I have opened have a real greasy, wet look & feel to them on the outside. Therefore, after I open a wrapper I roll the food bar in a napkin or paper towel before I begin to eat. The wet, greasy feel gets on everything if you don't wipe them off.

First, I want to confirm that these are tasty, appealing, and you feel good consuming them.Having said, that, I will say that I've never eaten anything quite like these before.  I've eaten plenty of bison (which just tastes like uber-awesome beef essentially); and of course I've had plenty of cranberries.  It's that this rendition of such a combo comes across as unexpected in both flavor and texture.The product is a slender, small candybar like shape and size.  Each is individually well packaged, so you can take one with you in your purse or etc. without leakage concerns.  The individual package opens by peeling back a loose bit of the upper part of the wrapper at one end (essentially splitting the wrapper along the seams).The bar inside is dark and looks pretty much like one solid piece of meat, although it glistens from the fruit content.  It doesn't look like a compressed bar of chunks, like a granola bar.When you bite into it, you discover that the bar consists of nicely sized chunky strips of bison which are compressed, heavily flavored with a juicy, saucy, fruity cranberry flavor.  It's rather like the meat bars were dunked into cranberry puree and absorbed it.  Here and there, in the little pockets that form between parts of the compressed meat chunks, you get tiny bursts of the fruit sauce and flavor.  The fruit taste is sincere, but not particularly tart.  The bar overall comes across as sweet rather than savory.If you have eaten meat with a fruit compote (turkey with cranberry sauce, for example or, as Katniss favors, lamb with prunes), then I think these bars will remind you of that more than anything else.So - not a savory, oily, tough, jerky or beef stick type of snack whatsoever.  But a goodly snack-sized amount of what seems like clean, healthy bison meat with a cranberry compote effect.I will definitely continue to purchase this product.  It's a great snack option to have on hand.

column9: Some of the best soft jerky I have ever had
column10: I've known about Tanka bars for quite a long time, but I never got around to ordering any until now. I thought the recipe sounded really interesting, but the bars are a bit expensive. I finally pulled the trigger, and I'm glad that I did. These are easily the best beef jerky bars that I've had. They are quite soft, and the cranberries provide a nice contrast to the buffalo meat. My only suggestion is to have a napkin handy, as they can be a little messy.

I was a little hesitant to order these, but having recently adopted a paleo diet I was looking for convenient, nutritious snacks.  The combination of buffalo and cranberry didn't seem too appealing.  I was pleasantly surprised to find that these are indeed tasty.  They are a little greasier than you would get with traditional beef jerky, but I'll get used to that.  The only downside is the price -- quite an expensive bar.
These are really good and addictive. The cranberry sounds weird but adds a great flavor. A bit pricey like all jerky but worth it.

Tanka bars are an amazing, super healthy, satisfying food. I believe vending machines should stock these healthy food bars in every college campus! I promote them in my Native American Culture courses, and I would love to see Tanka Bars become a national snack food! They are incredibly yummy!

I've used beef jerky before for a low carb snack, but it's not really my favorite thing.  I rather like this one because it has a barbecue taste to it.  It has a sweetness that is also tangy, and is not a "sweet treat" that leaves one craving more.  Also thumbs up for the non-chemical ingredients.  As for it being "wet and greasy" as noted by some,  I just open the top and peel it down halfway, using the bottom part as the holder; keeping the hands clean.

Product site says that it is "kid tested" & approved (probably because of the added sugar). I get more of a sweet flavor than a meat taste. Wont be ordering again. A nice meal/snack but I feel very overpriced. May be true to traditional Pemican recipe, maybe my expectations were wrong.

Perfect and convenient. They really add flavor to anything with just a small amount! Bacon without the hassle of cooking and grease, plus all the flavor without the guilt of eating strip after strip of bacon.

I subscribed and got a good price for them delivered right to my house. It is real bacon and it is good. Mine were shipped in a double box and arrived in good shape.

Message to Green Mountain: Give us a 50:50 mixture of the Dark Magic caff and Dark Magic decaff coffees, call it Dark Magic Half Caff so people will know what it is,  and deep six this product.

column9: Lots of flavor, very good soup.
column10: I'm a big fan of Amy's soups and this is one of my favorites.  I'll always be an omnivore but I try to eat vegetarian for lunch a lot of the time, and Amy's soups are a frequent part of my lunch.  Gourmet food is my biggest vice and I love all sorts of meat and seafood but I really don't feel deprived with this product.
Best tasting all vegetable  soup on the market. Vegetables are crisp and fresh tasting.
I'm very surprised how GOOD this soup is. I'm pretty picky with canned soups, no msg, etc. and that canned aftertaste you get sometimes.. This soup was really wonderful. I'm ordering more!

I just tried this product for the first time, it's delicious! I am VERY picky about soup and find just about every type to be bland, or not salty enough...thanks to growing up with Campbell's. I am not a big fan of tomato soup, but it's a light broth....it's not a heavy, thick soup, it's a tad bit sour..but it's tomato! I really enjoyed it. There was plenty of vegetables inside and it tasted very hearty and healthy. The sodium is high, but I don't care! I call it flavor! Very delicious and I easily ate a whole can by myself. Hands down the best canned soup I've tasted.I gave it 4 stars because it's a tad sour, I still love it though! And because it's really expensive, Over $2 a can at my local Whole Foods.

Amy's soup would be much better, and much healthier if they would reduce the salt by AT LEAST 50%. Even the soups that are labeled as "reduced salt" have very high salt content. It did not used to be that way years ago. Why do companies do this? Is it simply a case of the bottom line being the only criterion that matters to them?

I only buy organic, and decided to try a case based on the positive reviews. Here is my take on the soup:The pros:1. Good ingredients: organic vegies, no MSG, no hydrogenated oil or chemicals2. Good amount of vegetables (unlike many soups that are mostly broth)3. Low in salt, fat-free (you can add either, but can't take it away)The cons:1. Mushy overcooked veggies2. Not much seasoning3. No pop-top on the can (a minor gripe, but really I can't remember the last time I had to use a can opener for soup, making this soup less of an option to take to work)Here is what I did to take this basic soup up a notch: added a bit of organic olive oil, a little oregano, and a dash of cayenne. This makes the soup much tastier. Sometimes I add shredded cheddar or Parmesan cheese.Still, I can't fix the mushy veggies. It isn't enough of a convenience, with no pop-top and the doctoring required, so I'll stick to making my own with canned organic seasoned tomatoes, organic broth, and mixed veggies. Better soup, easy to make, more economical. Sorry Amy.

First of all, love this soup. However, I won't be ordering it (or any other canned item) from Amazon ever again. Over half the cans were dented and they don't accept returns. I'll pay the extra 50 cents at my grocery store next time.

I miss the old Walnut Acres soups, which were hearty with hand cut vegetables mixed with beans and meat.  I particularly miss the Scotch broth, which had barley and lamb with vegetables.I can use Amy's soups by adding cans of beans and using fat from meat to fill out the flavor.  For example, if I cook some Italian sausage, I remove some of the fat and then pour the soup in the pan with the scrappings of flavor from the sausage and some of the fat from the sausage.  I may then add a can of organic beans - garbanzos, pinto, kidney, white.  I may also add some frozen okra or spinach to give the soup some heartier vegetables instead of the small ones in the can of soup.I can recommend her soups as a kind of base, and that provides a saving of time and provides some organic nutrition.

column9: Disappointed - too much tomato based  liquid
column10: Very disappointed. Way too much liquid - 3/4 can - and not enough vegetables. The vegetable and lentil is much thicker.

I have tried a number of brands and varieties of nuts (including many of Planters), but I usually find that they are too salty or too oily for my tastes. After I tried one handful of these, I knew that I had found the perfect nut mixture. They aren't oily and they aren't very salty...to me they are just right.Heck, go nuts and buy them!
This is a nice blend of different nut flavors; not too salty.  Also a good buy compared to Wal-Mart and Target.
I like this mixture very much.  It could be less expensive but for taste and quality it is worth the price.

These are the best nuts I've found. I'm totally addicted. Perfect amount of salt and no oil at all. But $41.81 for 3 bags?? These are about $4.00 a bag at Target. $14 per bag is a TOTAL rip off. Hopefully they'll be back in stock in Amazon Grocery soon and not just available from this seller.

LOVE these wet bases from mccormick.  been using them for years.  BEEF and CHICKEN.  great price for quality product.  nice to be able to get on amazon as big box stores are now too far away for shopping.  THANKS amazon!!
This food is very healthy for my yorkie! Every store recommends it and she loves it. If I put a little bit of honey drizzle on it she eats it up sooo fast! I love fromms!

3 very picky eaters enjoyed this very much. Arrived extremely fast, and passed the 'taste test' by a dog notorious for starving himself rather than eating food he doesn't want. I can't praise FROMM brand highly enough for anyone who has to deal with a 'finicky' toy breed.

column9: Friskies Party Mix Shrimp,Crab and Tuna Flavor Beachside Crunch Cat Treats
column10: This is a very good treat for your cat. My cat loves it, I have tried different types and he likes them all.

column9: My Three Cats Love this Treat
column10: My three Siamese cats love the Party Mix - all varieties, but especially the ones in the blue packet and the green packet. The others are generally available in supermarkets but I order these because they are not. Treats are great for training. Our cats have us well-trained to give some every morning and every evening.

column9: Exactly what I wanted.  Tasty too!
column10: I love these things.  No artifical colors or preservatives, splenda instead of aspartame, and very tasty.  They're also incredibly easy to mix.  Definitely my first choice to flavor my water at work.

column9: Great Sugar-Free Lemonade (& made with Splenda!)
column10: This is a great sugar-free lemonade, and it's a great way to save money while still enjoying a flavored, calorie-free beverage.I looked everywhere, trying to find a product like this that is made with Splenda, and Arizona is the only one on the market that does not have Aspertame (that I know of).I actually use one packet for 32 ounces of water since I don't like a strong, overly-sweet beverage.  It works equally well at full-strength.I just wish Arizona would market more non-tea mixes.  I try to avoid caffeine in the afternoon and evenings and, as far as I know, all the other Arizona mixes contain caffeine (in the form of tea).

column9: I buy it by the "case"/drink it by the case
column10: Not a lot to say about it: just that it's my favorite addition to water.  I don't use factory-bottled water, just filtered-at-home water in a bpa-free bottle that I take to work or wherever.  Better than sodas, cheaper and environmentally better than daily flavored-water in plastic bottles.  **recycle the little foil packets and the cardboard box**Just good stuff that I found ONE time locally and now have to order it. v
I love this lemonade, but was unable to find it in my local grocery store. I signed up for automatic delivery and am very pleased.

Best Lemonade on the market. Not too sweet, Splenda instead of NutriSweet, dissolves easily. Everyone likes it. Even fits a 16.9 oz bottle, without having to sip some water out first, and mixes completely.

I absolutely love Arizona's Lemon Tea and 1/2 Tea, 1/2 Lemonade mix sticks. But their lemonade stix are a flop - they don't taste particularly tart, lemony, sweet, or refreshing. They have a bland, watered-down taste that does nothing to disguise the unpleasant taste of the sugar-free sweetener.
Very convenient for handicap that can't get items at grocery stores, also prices are lower than a chain supplies, plus free delivery, a real help.

Needed something that refreshed that was NOT a soda and that was low in calories that tastes good to get through the midwest heat wave this summer.This pretty much took care of the issue, and could easily be diluted by 1/2 the amount of mix to the std. amount of H2O and that was great as I got virtually 2 for the price of one deal here!Of course, NOTHING tastes like the real thing when it comes to good old fashioned lemonade....but this was the lesser of the brand evils.

I've been getting these regularly for a year because I liked the idea of using Splenda as the sweetener.  Just last month it was $15.40.  Now it's $17.81.  That is a price hike of over 15%.  I don't know if Arizona Iced Tea company raised their prices, or if Amazon decided to really increase their profit margins on this item.  However, it is absolutely dirty pool.  A decent product that just may have lost my loyalty--and my business.

mmmmthis is a nice lemonade and the fact it is sugar free is a bonus. I use a tornado cup to mix and it blends perfectly. It has a nice tart to sweet ratio, which I think is a huge requirement in lemonade.My only suggestion is you serve it as cold as possible, either mix with ice or ice cold water, once it gets warm, blaaaaaaaaah..m
I cannot recommend this product.  It tastes like lemon drop candies, not lemonade.  I guess it is an acquired taste...that I will not acquire.

column9: LOVE these!  I don't like tea, and I avoid aspartame when possible.  Arizona got this right!
column10: Arizona is the only brand I've found that makes lemonade sticks with Splenda instead of aspartame.  The flavor is great, and I can grab these on the go.  I keep the 16 oz Dasani bottled water in my fridge, so I can grab a cold bottle, pour in a lemonade "stix", shake and go.  Another reviewer complained about a chemical taste, I'm guessing the problem is the water they are mixing the lemonade with.  I'm very picky and haven't found a bad taste with this mix at all.

column9: If I could just get over the odd chemical taste
column10: I'm trying to drink more water and thought this would be be a great way to flavor up my water bottles.Pros:1.  Sugar free, calorie free2.  Nice acidic tartness.3.  Reasonably pricedCons:1.  Bitter with an odd chemical tasteI tried to use it in a smoothie I was making but that didn't help either.  Bottom line is I bought them and I'll drink them despite the taste.
My dog loves this puppy food! We select Orijen puppy food after reading reviews online and it didn't disappoint. So far, my dog has not had any problems with it. We have only used for a month.

column9: Not so good for my dog
column10: This has 40% protein which seems to be too much for my dog.  The ingredients are great which is why i wanted him to try it. He is 13 pounds, pretty active, don't know if size matters. The first day he had it, he liked it but then he started itching a lot and then refused to eat it.  I gave it to him for another week anyway mixed with his regular food which is taste of the wild, but the itching persisted. I guess his body can't handle it, and he's not allergic to the proteins because he is currently eating all the same proteins in his regular food and treats. He is back on his old brand and is now fine, no more crazy itching.

As far as dry dog food goes, this stuff is the nest that money can buy.  Dogs prefer the taste of nutritionless brands like Alpo and Iams - just like people want to eat hamburgers and ice cream all day - but we know that eating just what tastes "good" isn't necessarily healthy.  If you can't home cook for your dog, and if you can't be bothered with quality canned food like Spot's Stew, then this plus raw carrots and bananas from time to time is the next best thing.

column9: Puppy would not eat it.  Nasty smell
column10: This food had some good reviews on a site that rated the quality of various dog foods, however my yorkie puppy would not eat it.  He put a piece in his mouth and promptly spit it out.  He tried a couple of more pieces with the same result.  The kibble is larger in size than I had expected, about 3x larger than Royal Canin mini puppy 33,  and it smells nasty.  I did not like the smell at all and the puppy agreed.  Glad I only bought the trial size.

column9: Sliced Hard Chicken Hot Dogs for Cats!
column10: This product does not smell very well to me.  In fact, I have to use a fork to "tenderized" the pieces for my old kitty cat.
my cat loves this  first time I have found a cat food that he will eat and every time i go in the kitchen he thinksits time to eat

column9: Good Cat Food Without Smelly Cans
column10: What self-respecting cat isn't a picky eater?  I've never met any.  My cat likes Whiskas Choice Cut foods mainly for the gravy, and sometimes for the meat.  Omar the Magnificent and Wonderful likes both  the Beef in Gravy or Tuna.  Truth be told his dry crunchie is really his go-to choice, but he's that way with all prepared moist foods.  If you ask him his true five-star preference is meat caught fresh in  the garden.  Let's skip the details, you don't want to know.... Let's just say that Omar (M&W) is on the job!I personally prefer Whiskas foods in pouches because Omar is OK with allowing any remaining food to be left in pouch when stored in fridge, rather than having to transfer it from a can to a glass container.  (Come on you all have cats that expect you to do this!)  Pouches are easy to dispose of too.  Just rinse and trash.  You aren't messing with storing smelling cans and trips to the recycling center.

This Cat food is very delicious that my cat loves the product. Every time I open the pouch, my cat will come wanting to eat it. Please try this product with your cat if you have not done so yet. It is good for cats that are picky eaters.

My cat will only eat the Whiskas Choice cuts with beef.  My local stores quit carrying this product and I bought any cat food similar to it, regardles of price.  My cat ate only dry food for two months or more.  He lost weight that he can't afford to lose. I am so happy that I found this Whiskas item on Amazon.

It is hard to get just one falvor of this product. I was very happy to order 48 pouches. However, when they arrived the out side of the box label was turkey in gravy but they contained mixed grill instead. I could not return but Amazon gave me a total refund. If you are ordering this, wait about 10 days (after 9/1/12)so you don't receive Mixed Grill like I did. It was labeled wrong from the factory so it will take them a while to get new shippments.

column9: They run me over to get their Cod and Shrimp...
column10: Another popular seafood flavor that Sophie and Samson won't share.  When I bend down to place their bowls in front of them, they are on their back legs trying to get to it before I can put the bowl on the floor.  They act like they have not been fed in days. Nothing will disturb them - not even their favorite UPS man who brings them treats.  Can't beat Amazon prices !!!

Every day is Thanksgiving at Sophie and Sam's dinner mat when they receive their Whiskas Turkey and Giblets in gravy.  They are quick to devour it and clean each other right after eating (I know they hope to pick up a piece hidden in the fur!).  I only buy from Amazon because of their awesome prices!

Both my cats love Whiskas in any flavor.  My female cat, Sophie, is usually the one that takes little bits until it is gone.  When she hears me tearing the Whiskas Pouches, she flys into the kitchen and waits patiently for her food.  She never lifts her head up from the bowl until every piece is gone.  She will then sit by her brother, Samson, to get more food if he leaves.  After he gulps his food down and see's his Sissy waiting for some of his, he will tease her by taking one piece of his food out with his paw, look at her and when she trys to take it away he puts his paw on it and scoops it into his mouth. i can always count on empty bowls when I buy Whiskas.  The price at Amazon is more reasonable than the grocery store.

Cats love this stuff. One pouch doesn't go far so it is more of a treat than a meal (unless you feed according to recommendations on box).Pouches are easy to open and a little messy, always seems to get on my fingers.My cats come running if they see me reach for the pouch or they hear the sound of flicking it back and forth before opening.All the yucky stuff (think fast food for cats) must be addicting because they seem to listen for the very quiet sound of the rustling pouch.  We give pouches as a treat.

They LOVE it, I give my kitties (Silki and Tuffy) half a pouch each as a mid day snack to keep thier bird terrorizing energy level up.I gave it 4 stars only because it's a little messy to tear open sometimes, and I don't use scissors because you have to clean them afterwards. Oh Well, they DO love it.

column9: Tasty food for a picky cat
column10: Our beloved Bengal kitty, Isabel, is 13 years old and suffering from kidney stones, which are inoperable in felines. For years she lived on dry food but began to shun it as her health declined. Our vet ultimately advised feeding her whatever she'd eat: "She might as well be as happy as possible in her declining years."So, we offered her one soft food after another. She turned up her nose at the expensive, vet-sold brands and repeatedly rejected one national brand and flavor after another. Finally, to her gustatory delight (and our great relief), she made her choice: this particular Wiskas version is the ONLY kind she'll eat day in and day out. It MUST be Whiskas with the turkey AND GIBLETS in GRAVY. The gravy seems to add a certain flavor and texture she can't resist.We surmise that, like humans, our pets have food preferences linked to palate-pleasing aroma and taste. This Whiskas is the one that rings the bell for our Izzy. No, it's not the best choice for managing kidney stones, but she's got to eat. (So you won't worry that we're ignoring her renal problems, she's on daily medication and is doing quite well.)It's not an inexpensive cat food, but its packaging is very convenient and space-saving. The Amazon auto-ship program is a life saver. The cartons always arrive on time, and the per-package bulk rate is lower than the price of small quanities. Also, our local Target was the only place we could find this exact variety, and now the store no longer carries it. (Remember, our cat demands GIBLETS and GRAVY and accepts no substitutes).Give autoship a try. The price is better, and you can easily adjust the quantity and frequency of shipment or cancel altogether.
My finicky cats are difficult to please particularly when it comes to their food.Boy,....was I finally RELIEVED...when they chowed down on these!!!

column9: My cat loves Whiskas Beef in Gravy
column10: My cat will eat NOTHING but Whiskas Beef in Gravy cat food. Being able to order and receive it through the mail has been a blessing. I get it for my mom because she cannot drive to the store because of her health issues. Its great not to have the extra burden of getting cat food. Her cat is her companion through hard times.

I have two big cats that are over 15 lbs. each.  For breakfast, I give them each a packet of Whiskas Choice cuts.  They inhale the food in about 2-3 minutes.  This food doesn't have that catfood smell that most canned foods have.  There's a lot of gravy so the price is pretty high considering the amount of liquid.  Friskies Cat Food Favorites, 6-Flavor Variety Pack, 3-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24) are more expensive and very similar.I have these on Subscribe and Save so the price is pretty good.  Based upon my cats reaction, they really like this food.

column9: Poor quality ingredients, but my cat loves it.
column10: I bought this product because my older cat stopped eating the wellness dry and wet food I usually fed her.  She likes this food and she begs for it every morning and evening when it is time for her meal.  The ingredients are not quality ingredients but this food is keeping my kitty satisfied.

column9: Horrible stuff but it's all the cat will eat!!
column10: I adopted a 12 yo cat from a woman who had a premature baby with a lung condition.  She's skinny and will eat very little besides Wiskas.  I think it's Soilent Green for cats.  I would never feed this to her if she would eat anything else.  I don't think she's long for this world!!

There's a recipe for pancakes on the back of all the muffin mixes. Personally, I don't like real fruit in/on my pancakes, so this is perfect. It's also a small portion, 5-8 pancakes, depending on how big you make them. This is perfect for me during the week; I make one batch, refrigerate, and I have fresh, non-frozen pancakes for about 3 breakfasts.I did notice the recipe on the back can be a little runny if followed exactly, so a little flour may need to be added to the mix to thicken it up or a little less milk than recommended.
this drink mix is good but in civilian grocery stores is $3 per box.....here you get 6 boxes so should be ballpark of $20--NOT $40--SHAME ON YOU

These are spicy korean style instant noodles.  I usually buy Nong Shim, but decided to give these a try and they are as delicious.  The flavour is much cleaner, not as complex.  The ingredients are all natural except for the MSG, which is better than a lot of ready to eat foods out there. Although its far from healthy, in moderation its a nice quick treat.  To avoid the excess sodium and msg, i don't drink the soup. Whatever soup that clings to the noodles is satisfying enough for me.Ingredient List: Noodle -- wheat flour potato starch, palm oil, salt, onion paste, corn flour.  Soup -- Salt, MSG, Red Pepper, Soy sauce, garlic powder, bean paste powder, soy bean powder, onion powder, black pepper, cabbage, salted shrimp, onion, radish.
The noodles are yummy but took around 2 weeks to receive this order. Also, order came packaged in an adult diapers box. Not professional.
I love these noodles and will always order them. They are great to take for lunch and always taste great!

column9: Quick, easy, tasty, can't beat it
column10: Of course, they're not really kimchi.  But who cares?  If you like your reconstituted ramen on the spicy side, this hits the spot.  Bowl contains your usual dry noodles, spice packet and dehydrated vegetables.  Heat up your water, pour it in, add the spice and vegetables and you're good.  A simple epicurean delight.

column9: Packaged in Polystyrene - not good for eating
column10: Bottom of container is the recycling arrows in shape of triangle with a PS in the center.  From a website regarding food safety and plastics, it says this about PS...Styrene can leach from polystyrene plastic. Styrene is toxicto the brain and nervous system among workers with longer-term exposures,16,17 but also adversely affects red bloodcells, liver, kidneys and the stomach in animal studies.18[...]I have been eating these noodles and really enjoying it and did notice that the sauce was leaching into the bowl after it "cooked".  I will think twice before I eat these again.
This is one Monin's better mint syrups.  The mint flavor is sharp and bracing and the sweetness is not overwhelming.

For years our now 7 year old Manchester had eaten Science Diet bought from vet. She had dry skin, eye problems, hair loss and chronic skin sores with frequent vet trips and constant antibiotic spray with no results. Walking through Target looked up and saw dog food display. Brain flash said try new food. Bought Purina One. Within 2 weeks noticed marked improvement. Searched web and found site where owners rated food. Science Diet rated "F". Purina One better but rated "C". Natural Balance Ultra Premium rated A+. Bought first bag 3 years ago. Coat now thick and glossy, eyes clear, skin clear with no lesions after first few weeks, feels great and very energetic and playful where used to be in pain and acted like old dog. GREAT FOOD, Dog loves it, made from good stuff. Can't say too much good for this product.

I first learned of this food when I went to Petco to check out the Blue Buffalo brand.  One of our dogs has had some stomach issues and had been on a prescribed diet that was expensive.  We were recommended to try Natural Balance.  Our dogs love it.  We have four small breed dogs, and our chihuahua with the stomach problems has no problems eating it.  No messes, gas or anything.  We would highly recommend it for picky dogs also.  Also, the price on amazon is almost seven dollars cheaper than in store, with having free two day shipping...you can't beat that, especially with gas prices being so high.

My 1-1/2 year old basenji/jack russell mix loves this dog food. He's been noticeably healthier and more energetic since I switched him over from the standard dog foods earlier this year. Despite the higher cost of natural dog foods, I find that he eats significantly less of the Natural Balance dog foods and still stays happy and full. On the normal dog foods, he'd eat up to 3 cups of dog food a day (the recommended serving for his size), whereas he only eats about 1 cup to 1-1/2 cup of the Natural Balance dog food a day. When you take this into account, you're actually getting more "bang for your buck" with the natural dog foods since you don't have to buy as much to last just as long as the normal dog foods... and a healthier, happier dog, to boot! Add in the fact that you can get free, 2-day shipping with Amazon Prime... I'm sold!!

I first started using this food in April when I got my Boston Terrier puppy.  The breeder staunchly preached at me about following a natural feeding regiment that took longer to prepare and cost more than feeding my family did, so I went online to look for some alternatives.  I ran across this food and not only was it highly recommended, it is "nutritionally complete" and therefore appropriate for both puppies as well as older dogs.  The biggest selling point however was that I could also pick it up at my local PETCO, so it did not have to be purchased online.My Boston puppy loves it, and she does not ever have any of the stinky, stinky farts that are so common to Bostons and Bulldogs.  Its also a plus that my older Jack Russell Terrier loves it, and it has cleared up her skin issues and scratching.  This food is great for all dogs, and is a total steal on Amazon with cheap overnight shipping!

I recently switch my 2 shih-tzus to this food from eukanuba after both reading horrible things about the ingredients  in eukanuba and their continual price increases - plus recent recalls.  My dogs love this food!  And I am glad the ingredients are much better.  The cost is not any more than eukanuba if you have been purchasing it from a pet store.  I am so happy we switched.  Amazon delivered the food fast too.

column9: Natural Balance Ultra Premium Formula Small Bite Dry Dog Food
column10: My dog loves this food, more than any other I have ever bought for him. Thanks for an expeditious delivery.

I don't normally write reviews, but our mini schnauzer puppy loves this food. We have tried other natural brands like Natural Science Diet, IAMS, Blue Buffalo and she never runs to the bowl for those! This she will run to the bowl and chow down. Very happy with this product.

column9: Dog loves it, I love the price
column10: My 9 year old pug has been eating this food for a few years now and he loves it.I couldn't find it locally for less than $28 for a 12.5lb bag. After my local politicians applied their increased sales tax it was close to $32 a bag.Since I saved a few bucks, I bought the pooch a few extra treats.Amazon saved me a few bucks and it arrived at my door step within a week. I will definitely be buying it on Amazon again.
Great product that's good for your dog.  How can you go wrong?  Amazon gets it to me right away every time I place my order.  Couldn't be better or easier.

My dog loves this food and since I switched him to this product which has no wheat or corn he has not had one single ear infection.  He also is older so the small bites are easier for him to chew.  He was on canned dog food for years and switching him the Natural Balance was very easy.  What a great healthy product!!!

I love that this food is for adult dogs and puppies.  We have a almost 2 year old, 12 lbs chihuahua mix and we just got a 9 week old 2 lb tiny Chihuahua.  It's great that I don't have to buy two different kinds of food for the both of them!  They both seem to really like it... especially the puppy. He really chows down!

column9: Cured his itching and hair loss!
column10: My beagle/jack russell mix had terrible skin problems. He sleeps with me and was keeping us both up with his scratching all night. He started losing hair and actually causing bloody patches on his underarms and belly. I was giving him frequent baths and rubdowns with a baking soda paste which did give him some relief. After reading the reviews here though, I decided to try Natural Balance. Natural Balance Ultra Premium Small Bite Formula Food, 12.5-Pound Bag I ordered my first 12.5 lb. bag a few weeks ago. He is about 3/4 of the way through the bag and totally cured. No more itching, scatching or bleeding. We couldn't be happier! So worth the extra cost because I was spending a fortune on medicine, treatments and office visits. Plus, he had always been a picky eater. I gave away so much food because after a few meals, he would stop eating it. Not so with Natural Balance! He eats every bite. He loves it. Thanks Amazon.com, for your customer reviews or I never would have thought to try Natural Balance for Mac's itching problems.

I love that I can buy my dog food from Amazon. I have told so many people about the better cost and ease that I'm sure many of my friends and family have looked into buying their pet's food online as well. My dogs always finish this brand while other kinds my sit in the bowl and have to be refreshed or "touched up". I bought this brand base on the reviews and have been totally satisfied.

column9: Keep going back to this food!
column10: As a mom of a Min Pin and a Chihuahua we have tried other dog food brands but have always gone back to the Natural Balance Ultra Premium.  For the quality of the food, the price of Amazon cannot be beat.  Plus free shipping to your door and no sales tax!?!  This is a grain free, limited ingredient diet.  My Chihuahua is the picky one and my Min Pin has digestion issues.  When I have switched to more expensive, higher protein foods, my Min Pin ends up w/a runny stool.  While I do also give him a probiotic/enzyme supplement with his daily meal, this is one of the only foods that his stool has consistently been formed, solid and not runny or the opposite hard and caused constipation.  My Chihuahua has no issues w/this food and readily eats it plain.  While all dog foods seem to be at the mercy of recalls at one point or another, Natural Balance seems to not be the subject of very many.  My mother fed her lab Natural Balance Duck and Potato for 12 years and never once had an issue w/the food.The first ingredient in this food is Chicken, whole chicken, not "meal".  The other meats in this formula are Lamb meal and Duck meal, ingredient numbers 3 and 9 respectively.  Rice, oatmeal, barley and potatoes make up the carbohydrate portion so there are no grains.  I also appreciate the fact that for a while the Duck meal was eliminated from the formula because Natural Balance was no longer able to find a supplier of the duck that met their quality standards.  After 18 months, they found a new supplier and returned the duck to the formula.  Just the fact that they are forthright w/this fact and explain that they could not find a quality source (even if it was due to the fact that their previous supplier wanted more money for the same product, which I don't know I am just speculating that is why they dropped it initially) speaks to their ethics.  Then the fact that they searched and found a new, quality source of the duck without raising the price of the product also speaks volumes to their dedication to the customer.  Thank you Natural Balance!  We are happy customers here!

Wanting to be a responsible dog owner I wanted to give little Sasha the best I could afford. Being intimidated by the choices (like buying toothpaste in the supermarket) I relied on reviews by others who seemed to have researched this subject more than I. After a period of adjustment and no alternative Sasha finally started to munch out on it. Now she loves it. I think it is the best value, (cost vs quality), and with Sasha's approval I will continue to buy it through Amazon.

We have been quite pleased with this dog food.  Our dog has stopped itching and scratching, his coat is lustrous, and he eats less of it that other dog foods and seems to be maintaining his weight and being vigorous.

I rescued this tiny Pomeranian mix puppy and couldn't get her to eat until we tried these small breed bites.  I'm over the moon that she likes this, the healthiest food we tried!  The food she was given by her breeder seemed to make her pass a lot of gas, but on this Ultra dog food I haven't noticed it at all.  It's apparently for all life stages, so I'm happy I can keep her on this and not have to switch when she grows up.

I'm writing this Natural Balance dog food review for my Mom because she raves about Ultra small breed bites and wanted to share her opinion.  Her little Yorkie Patches wouldn't eat any other small bites natural food except this one.  The ingredients are great, chicken is the first on the list, and it is a very affordable and healthy dog food.  My whole family buys this brand and has for years, we love their dog and cat foods!

Due to extremely poor planning on my part, I did not have enough of their prior food on hand for a good transition feeding, i.e., mixing the 2 foods together for a few days.  However, both foods are a chicken rice formula, so I wasn't too worried.  The change was made as one of my 2 Miniature Poodles (Mr FUSSY) was completely tired of his old food after almost 2 years!!Today I put down a bowl for each of the 2 dogs, mixed with a bit of their canned (Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover).  Let me back up--"Mr Fussy" was actually dancing around while I was scooping!!  A FIRST!  Both dogs, the male and the female ate until their bowls were empty--and then licked them CLEAN---looked like I forgot to feed them!!!I just LOVE the small size kibble---it is absolutely perfect for them.  Even when I give them a cookie, I break them in half or they (neither one) will take it! They SNARFED this food.We are a happy family!!

Very happy with this brand.  I have a little yorkie that has skin problems and trying to find something that will not cause her to break out.  She can eat it fine and does not have any digestion problems with it.  Would buy again.

column9: Great for picky small dog breeds
column10: Went through probably 10 other dog food brands before trying this one feeding to two picky bostons.  Would barely touch if at all other dry dog foods even when mixing with canned food.  Bought this and they will eat it completely dry.  Much healthier than a lot of other brands and the small bite makes it a lot easier for them to eat and digest.

reviews from other buyers/puppy owners were right!my puppy loves this and just can't get enough of it.i'd like to see him bite but he just swallows it.  it's pretty normal for dogs/pups and found several ideas to put in a tennis ball to slow him down.he poops (smells pretty bad) in a finger sized form, solid, leaves no mark on carpet, or wood floor. =)

column9: High quality dog food for small dogs
column10: Both of our older dogs health problems improved once we started feeding them this high quality dog food!  The ingredients are superior to the popular, cheaper, store-bought brands that have been around for years, but our dog's health is so worth it!
My toy poodles have lost some teeth and need small bites for their food.  They like the taste, so this works  well for them.
My senior cocker has only a few teeth left and needs the tiny bites. This is a superior dog food and he loves it.

We have 2 dogs and 2 cats (hence the 16 paws), and everyone is on Natural Balance. When we adopted our cats a year and a half ago, they were pretty young and we wanted to start them off right. They've been on NB ever since and have done fantastically. When we rescued an overweight Pomeranian and a scrawny poodle/terrier mix earlier this year we tried several brands, but I figured since the cats loved NB, and the dogs seemed to have a thing for the cats' food, it was a logical next step to give the canine NB a shot. I went to my local pet store and picked up the $3 sample pack, and after one day I knew it was a hit. Mickey (the Pom) has started to slim down and I can actually feel her ribs again. Mollie (the mix) has filled out and gained more muscle. Mickey also has a very sensitive stomach, so this is perfect for her. Their coats have never been better and their energy level is amazing. They're both 3 1/2 years old and they act like puppies chasing each other around.If you're looking for a good-quality dog food at a reasonable price for what's in it, this is it.

column9: best small dog breed food ever
column10: My dog likes it eats it and poops well and doesn't get fat and it smells good too. Energy level is good and has reflected on dog's health as good food to give to my dog. Has high quality source meat. rice blend is better than oat for dog digestive i think.

Do some of your own research on sprouted flours and you'll find that your body treats it more like a vegetable than a grain.  The carb content is fairly high,  but the glycemic effect doesn't seem to be even close to regular wheat flour and it seems to be much easier to bake/cook with than regular wheat flour.  My wife makes all kinds of stuff with it now.  Pizza crust, cinnamon rolls (with whey low as a sweetener,  another miracle product), she even makes bread in a nice panasonic bread maker.  One of the keys for her is that she sifts it in every recipe.  Another miracle product we use is Extra Virgin coconut oil.  These are all more expensive but being unhealthy is way more costly in the long run.  Back to the flour,  man does this taste good.  She experiments with recipes,  but everything has been good and much healthier.  Some more things that are amazing with this flour are coffee cakes, did I mention the awesome pizza crust with permasan cheese in it?, she actually makes a chocolate cake that seems evil and is so good,  but is NOT fattening or unhealty! (substitute EVCO for some of the butter)  I am no nutritionist, but I know what the scale says and after we make stuff with this flour,  whey low sugar,(look it up online,  its AMAZING and does exactly what they say) and EVCO,  I feel better,  have better skin and have more energy and can eat freaking chocolate CAKE.  The scale and the way I feel are enough for me.  These three products are phenominal and can change the way you and your family eat.  We extensively researched it before using it and are here to say it does what its supposed to and with some work you can make some amazing healthy stuff as well.  And,  our cinnamon rolls have amazing icing made with why low powdered sugar with pecans in them!  I didn't even start about the ice cream with coconut milk,  heavy cream and whey low.  Amazing stuff and no weight gains!  (still have to have some moderation,  but wow!)

column9: No Other Sprouted Wheat Flour Can Compare In My Book
column10: I tried this a few years ago.  I loved it.  The price and shipping were high, but was willing to use this sparingly, just in order to have a healthier alternative.I did find some "sprouted" flour in my local health food stores, but the quality was not the same.This is high quality, made to order (as I recall).I now order the sprouted wheat berries and grind at home...I don't think I did this initially because I was afraid to burn the motor or something on my grinder...I attempted to sprout my own wheat berries, but they still had too much moisture in them and messed up my grinder.I am glad to say that the sprouted wheat berries are not a problem for my grinder.  Very pleased and it does bring the cost down for me to have it in this form...plus I can store it longer if I buy bulk.Thank you.UPDATE  7/2012I DON'T ADD ANY GLUTEN TO MY BREAD AND I USE 2 TSP OF YEAST INSTEAD OF 1 TBSP OF YEAST ON RAPID CYCLE OF MY BREAD MACHINE AND I GET BEAUTIFUL LOAVES.

Great product, a little pricey, but considering the price of Ezekial bread products, you still come out ahead purchasing the flour and making your own bread/rolls/biscuits.  Be careful when you open the box, though.  I used a knife and sliced right through the plastic bag that contained the ten pounds of wheat flour.

I purchased this flour because I was searching for a more digestible organic version of flour to use in cooking and baking at home for my family. Love it! Have used it a lot in my everyday cooking in such things as pancakes, waffles, breads, pizza crusts, soups and sauces. Also, it came with a packet full of recipes and ideas in how to use the flour which was really useful and much appreciated.
