Great high quality product, would purchase again, and would love to try some of their other products such as organic sprouted spelt, organic sprouted millet and organic sprouted long grain brown rice, etc.
The quality is outstanding. It smells great and tastes great. Plus it's much cheaper here in bulk than at the local health food store.
I was happy with the quality of the Frontier Organic Peppermint Leaf. We use it to brew tea and it has wonderful aroma and good flavor. I will order it again.

Just received my package; it's about 12"x12" bag full of mint leaves.  I got it to make my own mint extract, it's doing it's job! Smells & tastes great - thinking of flavoring sugar with it.  I'll have about 3 years worth in this bag :)

This tasted funny. I imediately checked the date on it & that was ok, but I ended up throwing it out. There isn't much food in there either. Just a dap of pasta & ONE meatball. So I guess I didn't loose much. Don't like the lid either.

I love BOLD EXTRA strong coffee and this had many different selections, which was awesome. Also, I was shocked that I actually enjoyed many of the medium/light coffees (chocolate glazed donut and wild blueberry come to mind).There was only 1 coffee I didn't like, and that was Wolfgang Pucks Sumatra was just horribly sour.All in all, I really enjoyed this sampler!

column9: Great starting poing for the addiction
column10: The sampler is awesome because it gives you a good idea about what's out there. You may not be a fan of many of the included flavors, but it does what it's supposed to: present you with a huge variety of flavors and from there you can go nuts on the ones you really really like.
Every cup was delicious! My personal favorite was 'vanilla cup cake', 'mocha java' and 'jet fuel'.  I also liked how my husband tried to guess which flavor I was making by the aromatic smells.

column9: Expired k - cups in the variety bag
column10: I was very surprised to get my variety sampler of k- cups in a brown paper lunch bag with a  Staple on top and a sticker that said 24 count k-cup sampler - New.  Clearly they are not new because the ones that are labeled with a expiration date are either expired already or about to in 2 weeks.  This is the first time Ordering from this vendor. These k cups are not in the actual sample variety boxes like in the store.I will be returning these as soon as I can figure out the contact .  Very disappointed!

I've gotten this sampler twice now and I love it. One of the reasons why I love my Keurig is the variety it brings me. I don't have to be tied down to one bag of one flavor of coffee. Maybe this morning I need an extra-bold, because I hate mornings. Or maybe I want to sip something light and flavorful all afternoon.I think this sampler does an excellent job of variety. There's regular coffees and flavored ones, light, medium and extra-bold. There are occasionally a few repeats, but that's bound to happen and I don't hold it against them. There is also a good representation of many of the brands as well. Van Houtte, Gloria Jean, Green Mountain, Wolfgang Puck and Donut House coffees are the ones that spring immediately to mind. It's also really good if you're new to owning a Keurig and want to know what kind of coffees are out there and finding which ones you like. (And don't like; in any variety pack, there's going to be some flavors you don't agree with.)Yes, this does come in a brown paper sack. It's maybe not the classiest-looking thing, but I'm not here for the aesthetics, I just want some coffee.
I just received my order for a 24 cup sampler pack. There were only 22 K cups in the package. Make sure you count when you receive!
I was not happy when I first opened the bag, it looked like all of the holiday leftovers thrown in.  But I ended up enjoying them all and I plan to order the assortment again.

These K-cups arrived and I found them to be exactly as described. They came in a great variety and we received 14 different types and flavors. No teas or decaf which was great because after reading other reviews I was afraid that it was going to be different from the product description.The packaging was as expected for a grab-bag type of item. They were secured inside of a large ziplock bag and arrived safely inside of a box.

This was advertised as a sampler of flavored coffees with a promise of 12 different varieties. What I received was 11 different varieties of coffee and only 4 of them were flavored.  Of the 4 flavored varieties, 3 of the 4 were different brands of French Vanilla.  Much of this was what I could buy in the grocery store (including Folgers).  Disappointed!
I bought this sampler along with the Mr Coffee Keurig for my daughters birthday. She and my son in law loved the mix and said they will purchase again.

I just ordered a k cup coffee maker and wanted to try out a wide variety of flavors before buying any one brand.  This is a good assortment of coffee flavors that help you find what you like best to drink. I only wish for the price that you received more than 24 k cups.
Wife received for Christmas. Came in a brown paper bag. Five cups were the same thing. One of the cups was broken. I'd suggest picking a different sampler pack than this one.

I ordered this item as a gift for someone who just got a Keurig machine and wanted to try a sample before investing in a 16 ct box of one flavor.  While the assortment was nice, the packaging was awful.  The cups came loose in a brown paper bag.  I do understand these were hand picked, but at least in a sealed plastic bag or some other form suitable for gift giving would have been helpful.

Ordered this as a gift to give for Christmas and very disappointed. None of the sample flavors mentioned were in our brown paper bag that we received today. They're all "regular" coffees from different growers, not flavored coffees as the description mentions.

column9: Not a lot of good in there
column10: Not a lot of good cups in there.  I guess that is what you sign up for with one of these grab bags, but we seriously drank like 35% of these, threw out the rest and went to costco for what we liked.-SM
Obviously I am not a soup connoisseur like the other reviewers, I must have a horrible horrible bland pallet, but I love this stuff.  Sorry fancy soup guys.

column9: Seasoned with Chili Powder and Not Much Else...
column10: As someone who eats soup almost every night during the fall and winter, I was pleased to see our local grocer carrying several of the new Progresso World Recipes Soup.  Unfortunately, the two varieties I have tried have been a real disappointment.  Like the Black Bean Jalapenos, the Tortilla y Pollo's seasoning is heavy on the chili powder and not much else.  Although a bit milder than the Black Bean Jalapenos, the Tortilla soup's broth is really little different in taste or consistency.There is little in the way of meat or vegetables in this particular soup which caused me to rate the product as deserving only two stars.  The can I opened had about six pieces of chicken, each measuring about 3/4" X 1/4" X 1/4"; a handful of black beans, a few corn kernals, and a piece or two of pepper.  I found this soup to be a significant departure from Progresso's usual quality ingredients and flavor combinations.In producing this soup, Progresso has committed a common error - assuming the flavors of Mexico and Tex-Mex foods are limited to chili powder; in the case of the Tortilla soup, there were not even pieces of jalapeno pepper thrown in to lend "authenticity" to the product.  I suggest Progresso review "Los Barrios Family Cookbook: Tex-Mex Recipes from the Heart of San Antonio" by Diana Barrios Trevino for the true flavors of Tex-Mex cooking. If attempting to produce a soup which reflects only Mexico's flavors, then Rick Bayless' "Authentic Mexican: 20th Anniversary Edition: Regional Cooking from the Heart of Mexico" would be an excellent resource for Progresso to use.If you are looking for a soup that combines interesting layers of flavor and multiple ingredients, you would do well to look elsewhere. This soup reflects neither the flavors of Tex-Mex cooking or Mexican cooking.  If Progresso's other World Recipes Soups are as disappointing as the two I have already sampled, I may be changing my brand loyalty when it comes to soup.

column9: Tortillas and Chicken without the tortillas
column10: This tortilla and chicken soup has no tortilla in it.  It's also mostly broth.  Disappointing.  The flavor is ok and the broth has some body, although it seems more like a tomato-vegetable soup with some spiciness added.  I enjoyed Campbell's version much more, which has more solid ingredients in it including tortillas.

This is probably the worst Progresso soup I have ever tried. It has an overwhelmingly very strong smell and taste of chili powder and bell peppers. There is really nothing to commend this soup, it has no tortillas, it's mostly broth with a little chicken.  I just sent feedback to the Progresso company website, not sure that it matters but wanted to let them know how badly this sucks

Whenever I get a product to review. One of the first things I look at is it's value in relation to what you get. The Freezy Pups Kit I believe is an excellent gift product for a good price.When you run out of treat mix you can make your own to freeze in the tray or purchase refill kits. I think I'll do both because my dogs love the flavors that come in the kit, but I'd also like to try making my own, I'm think watered down baby food would work well in the tray.As for the treats, the pups love them. It's over a 100 degrees right now in the summer where I live and neither puppy enjoys the heat inside. If they're running in the grass in the sun, that's one thing, if they're inside on the couch, they want to be cool!They love it when I break out a frozen treat for them. Fortunately my dogs are small, one treat is enough for several bites for my littlest one, my medium size munches it down in one to two bites. If you had a big dog, these would be a great size for training treats in the summer.

These are great organic treats and our dog loves them, especially on hot days! It's quick and easy to make. My only complaint would be that I expected the Freezy Pups Tray to work like an ice cube tray, meaning that you can sort of twist it to pop a treat out but that doesn't seem to work. You have to let them thaw for a few minutes in order to remove them. Not a huge deal since you can just dump them into a freezer bag but worth noting. As far as the flavors, our pup seems to enjoy the Juicy Apple the most. We've also used the tray for frozen yogurt and smashed bananas. It works well.

column9: For small size pets, these are better than ice cubes!
column10: Our pup loves ice cubes but they get lost under furniture or the refrigerator.  Because these treats are smaller, Callie can pick them up and chew them.  I have tried the apple juice flavor (which I ordered extra of) and she wags her tail when I get one out.  I freeze them into batches and pop them into a gallon-size plastic freezer storage bag so I have plenty on hand when our desert heat arrives.  If your pup likes ice cubes then it will probably love these frozen flavor treats!

This looks great and is very sturdy, but it is very difficult to get the ice out because it is so stiff (can't twist it at all).  I turn it over and hope it works eventually.  Switched to the flexible ones.
My dogs love the tasty cubes especially on a hot day.  The only downside to the trays is the cubes are little hard to get out of the tray.  But easy to make and a fun treat for the dogs.
I made these for my dog's 5th birthday party, along with 6 other dogs. They all loved them. The cheese flavor was the favorite!
Very cute trays.  I have 2 20lb dogs and they are the perfect treat size.  A great idea for a hot summer day and my dogs devour them....

I give my 30lb 4-legged friend 3 little freezy bones about 1x/week. He loves them! I'm happy because they're organic and I don't want to feed my little guy anything that I myself wouldn't consider feeding to my hubby ;) Our pup, Mr. Shimmy, absolutely goes crazy when I put these in his special treat bowl! I think it's over-priced for what it is - but what in the world of pets isn't??? If you're looking for a quality product this is the one to purchase.

column9: Perfect treat for my two pups
column10: I bought these after they were featured on a popular new product website. They interested me because my one dog loves ice as a treat for rewards. When I received the product I was very happy with the size of the bone treats, and the ease of making the treats make the product even better. They only take a few hours to freeze and my pups gulp them down. You do have to be a little cautious of where the pups lay the bones while enjoying, because some of the treats have a bit of a sticky texture (especially after drool). I will continue to purchase the refill kits, and hopefully will even buy the kit for friends.

column9: My three dogs loved their new treats!
column10: Pick your mix and add 7 oz of hot water (no need to boil) pour in the dog bone molds and in a couple of hours their treats are ready!  I had no problem popping them out after letting them sit for a couple of minutes (directions say sit for 4 minutes) turn it over and twist...they pop right out.  Sweet Potato Maple was something my dogs never had, it didn't look good or smell good when I mixed it up, but all three of mine seem to love having them as a treat outside.I was thinking I could try a jar of baby food mixed with water to see if they like that as a treat.Mold is very well made and should last forever.
This quick, inexpensive, unique and easy to make treat was a big hit with my grandchildren and their parents.

column9: Ya want a Mellow Mood? Try this!
column10: My son surprised me with a can of the berry Mellow Mood the other day.  I read through the ingredients list and liked what I saw.  It is a natural product.  Period.  Then understanding exactly what those ingredients do to a body, I waited until about an hour or so before bedtime before I tried it.  In a word the effect is *amazing.* I was definitely mellowed out!  Not drowsy or out of it; simply mellow.The taste was very enjoyable. The flavor of the berry reminded me of the sorrel drinks I'd had while visiting Jamaica. Although carbonated, it was only slightly so.  Nothing like soda pop, just a little gas to give it some zing.Words of caution: Do NOT drink this before operating a vehicle or heavy machinery.  I would not recommend drinking this if you need to focus on anything like your JOB.Have a drink, watch some tube, listen to some music, or simply just chill out. That said, expect to relax to the max and not feel sorry for it in the morning!Irie and one love!
Marley's Mellow Mood is fantastic, not only does it taste great but it really works, best thing since sliced bread, I highly recommend you try some.

I guess I'm really lucky that these drinks are sold on my college campus! They taste quite good and they really work. I had my doubts, but one will put you down in about 30min. Don't drink them at work or before you have anything important to do, trust me.

What a refreshing change from the countless 'energy' drinks and products.  Everyone can use a little 'layback' time and if a product like this can make people less hurried and stressed out, GREAT! I think Bob would be proud of this line of products and I applaud his family for their dedication to his message.

column9: Tastes great... Mellow Mood has got me!
column10: Wow.  Thats all i can say.  Hands down, best tasting relaxation drink.  I love Bob!  Who doesnt.  I drink one of these every day!  Try their teas also!!!!!!!!!!!New favorite

column9: It's delicious and it works for us!
column10: OK, We drink this a couple times a week, and after reading several of these reviews I would like to point out that this drink does not claim to put you to sleep, it says it releases stress & relieves tension. So giving it a low rating because you can't sleep is like giving Diet Coke a low rating because you can't lose weight. Like all things we imbibe, not everything will work for everybody. The drink is delicious, We like the berry flavor the best but we've had the citrus too and they both relax us just fine. There is a warning on the label not to drink more then 2 a day and not to drive or operate heavy machinery, I suggest you adhere to that advice. Other then that ENJOY it, It's delicious, it's not overly carbonated, and the berry flavor is the most beautiful dark pink color.

This drink is the best if you need to go to sleep early for a night or you just want to relax.  Taste like a mix of a Sprite with a light touch of ginger ale.  I could chug the thing if I had to...It is a must try... Local stores in the metro Detroit area are finally starting to carry it for about $1.89.

The Mellow Mood drinks are very tasty and a great way to end the night. The only draw back is that not only do they calm you down but they also put you to sleep. That is nice unless you're not ready for bed. But to be honest, I didn't crash out real quick every time I drank a Mellow Mood. If I was already a little tired, then yes, bed time came soon. Again, they are a very tasty drink. I'm pretty bummed that I'm out, actually.

I am extremely pleased with these drinks. I had used them as a method of calming down near the end of the day. I'd crack one open, put it in a class with some ice, pound it down, and chill out. It would put me out in about half an hours time, if I just relaxed and laid back. This drink is also delicious. I had my doubts about what it would taste like, but I was pleasantly surprised.
This drink tastes great!! And the relaxation really works! I would highly recommend this to anyone who wants to mellow out with a great tasting drink.

At a local gas station that I go to everyday, I seen a bottle and some cans with Bob Marley on it so I picked it up and my natural and first instinct was "Theres gotta be drugs in here" the clerk convinced me to buy the Half and Half and I was abouy yo ho yo work so I kept it in the fridge at work all day, 30 min before I had to leave, a couple of coworkers and I decided to give it a try I only drank about less than a cup but 20 min later I was calmer and I felt that it worked. Now when I get home from work I usually don't go to sleep till around 3, 4 in the morning, I was out by 12. And I didn't drink a whole bottle. Last night I tried the carbonated citrus one and I drank almost 65% of it and went straight to sleep. This stuff is absolutely amazing, not only does it help me go to sleep but it is something that tastes really good, without having a disgusting medicine taste. Its all natural, and I can't wait to get more, my coworkers have been hounding me for it also! Give it a try, but if your going to drink a whole one, don't drink it when you first get to work wait till your about to leave so that if your like me and breed help sleeping, you can do so at a decent time.

I didn't have this flavor specifically, but this drink is great. It really does relax your mind & body and any stress will melt away. If you're trying to get a marijuana "buzz" from it though, it's not like that so don't expect it. It's great because it's all natural too! I drank about 1/4 of the can and waited a little bit just to see how it would effect me the first time. It did relax me, and it also made me pretty sleepy. Not like "falling asleep while doing something" sleepy, but "as soon as my head hit the pillow, I'd be asleep" sleepy and that was just with a 1/4 of a can! I drank the rest the next night and the "sleepiness" wasn't nearly as prominent as the night before, but it definitely relaxed me. I don't know if this would be a great thing to drink just to relieve stress, like during the day, because of the melatonin in it. I found this in a local natural food store and only bought one can..now I'm wishing I bought the whole shelf! I will definitely drink this nightly once I get more. If you're looking to unwind at the end of a long day, without drugs, alcohol or harsh chemicals then this is definitely for you. I was skeptical at first because at $1.75 a can, (& I didn't even know if it would be worth it), to me, that's money I could be using toward gas, lol! Anyway, it was worth it and I can't wait to get more!

This drink is awesome! I use it often to get a great nights sleep and may i tell you it works wonders. Give it about an hour and youll feel it and drift off to a great night sleep. The bottle says dont drink it and drive and I go buy that also. I did that onece and I was on a one of those LONG DARK BLACK BACK SHORTCUT ROADS...and my eyes got really heavy.

I use this to help me sleep on occasion when I have a big day and have to get plenty of sleep. The reason I use it is not because it actually makes me sleepy, which it does. The reason I use it is because it calms my mind and I am not tossing and turning in bed thinking about the things that I have to do the next day. I go to bed with a clear head and am able to fall asleep easily and fast, and I feel good the next day. Keep a few bottles on hand because it starts to work in about ten minutes and you could drink it late without feeling bad the next day. Also try the black tea because it tastes incredibly delicious!

I love this stuff.  When I have troubles going to sleep it will put me to bed.  I haven't had it during the day, but if I drink a can in the evening, I seem to get naturally tired and sleep a nice, natural sleep.  That's much unlike artificial sleeping pills (ambien, etc...) which will knock me straight out but give me the weirdest dreams and don't really give me good, restful sleep.  Also, this drink actually tastes good- it's not some stupid collection of things with favoring added.  I could totally see myself drinking this regularly if it didn't knock me out. (FYI, the berry isn't all that good- for carbonated, citrus is the way to go)The price is a bit steep (if you can find it locally, go there and save a bit), but it's a good relaxation drink and worth every penny.  I swear it tastes better if you listen to "Mellow Mood" or "One Love" by Marley.  No idea why :)
Firstly I would like to tell you all not to under estimate this drink. Upon my first try of Marley's Mellow Mood Soda, I was asleep within an hour. This stuff really works and tastes great.

Yes, this drink will relax you...but can and often make you sleepy. I've tried this drink on two different occasions, definitely made me sleepy. In the future I won't drink one of these unless my mind is racing and I can't relax. I think drinking it while in a normal mood will just make you sleep. A cheaper alternative to this drink may just be melatonin supplement. It seemed to have a similar effect.

column9: great taste but 39 grams of sugar, really?
column10: Drink 1 can and you getting nearly the same amount of sugar you get by drinking mountain dew, therefore I imagine some of the "calming" effect one might get on this is counter acted by the amount of sugar in 1 can. The taste is great and the whole bob marley branding is great too, but the blend of herbs with valerian root and lemon balm extract etc.. is all 82grams only for everything in there. Of course they don't tell you exactly how much of each herb is in there though. The problem with this drink is you can achieve the same effect with Now Foods TRUE CALM AMINO RELAXER or Anxiety Control 24® Hour products which are oral pill based herbel supplements that essentially will do the same thing, without the sugar Not to mention you get much more valerian root and other neurotransmitters such as gaba. With those you get a much greater dose thus potentially being much more affective to people who actually do have anxiety or other issues that would need them to medicate with something.Despite the sugar content, the drink itself tastes great and I did experience a minor relaxation feeling. This is great for the occasional drink but if you are looking at buying this product for any medical related issues/need then I do not recommend this at all due to the level of sugar content, you would be much better off taking supplements separately. I imagine this is a great drink though if you want to chill out at a party, but after noting one reviewer who apparently uses this drink to help him fall asleep, drinking nearly 40grams of sugar before bedtime I assure you is not good for you. You'd be better off drinking diet coke with a pill based supplement. Still, cut out the sugar.
I love it an the charity movement is a plus really refreshing love it wish they would start selling in middle Georgia

column9: A great drink but cheaper in the store
column10: I love Marley Mellow Mood. I have full body pain and have to take lots of prescription pain medication. One day I tried a can of Citrus and to my surprise the pain went away. It tastes great but the online price is just too expensive. I buy it in the grocery store for $1.76 a can which equals $21.12 for 12 cans. Here the price is $29.99 for 12 cans. Much too expensive. Checkout Smith's Grocery they have it for $1.76 a can.

So I tried the Mellow Mood Citrus for the first time what can I say works great I felt relaxed but within 30min I felt asleep and had a very trippy dream don't know why but other then that I recommended the tea's better then the carbonated ones

column4: l.chong ""Go where there is no path, and ...
column10: I bought this after reading the reviews hoping it would help me get to sleep better.  It simply does not work for me.  I've tried drinking it slow maybe an hour before bed, I've tried guzzling it down.  I'm still lying in bed for hours.  I gave it two stars because regardless of its inability to work for me, it tastes pretty good (almost like a mello yello if you're from the south) so I'll still be able to drink it and it wont be a complete waste of money.  Buying them here, I'm paying about 2.60 a can which is definitely not worth it to me.

Since Neuro Bliss screwed up their formula, I tried this out as a replacement.  One man's meat is another man's poison, so I suppose you can never tell if something like this will work for you unless you try it.  In my case, though, I've been getting different results.  The first 3 or 4 times I tried it, I almost fell asleep (so, as it says on the can, don't drink before driving).  Other times, it would just relax me.  Once or twice, it even made me agitated, and a few times it barely seemed to have any effect at all.  All these attempts were usually a couple of days and sometimes a couple of weeks apart, so I don't think I'm building up a tolerance to it.  A 12 ounce can contains 43.5 grams of pure cane sugar, so you probably don't want to drink it before you go to bed.
Out of 12 cans, only one was dent free. All other 11 cans had 1 or more dents. Very poor condition. If you are purchasing for the can, check carefully.

I gave it 3 stars because it's a sleep aid not a relaxing drink. I drank this and within 20mins I was ready for bed and it was only 7pm. I was a zombie till I finally crawled upstairs. First time in a long time I went to bed before 8pm. If you want to take this to sleep its great but it you want to relax, smoke some p*t. Just a warning don't drink till your ready for bed.

I was not going to write a review but after getting 5 e-mails requesting that I do I figured what the heck.I was very excited to find this product online and couldnt wait to get mine in the mail..... Until it came.When I opened the box I find that 3 of the cans were CUT open. Not accross the top but across the side so I know that I didnt do it when I opened the box. I love the drink but I am really upset at the fact that I only got to enjoy 9 cans instead of the 12 that I had ordered. I dont believe I will be ordering anymore. I will just wait till a local store gets them so that I know what I am getting.Peace, Love And Joy!

Not much you can say about a spoon that is less than two inches long, but it arrived well packaged and undamaged. It has served me well when I use it with caviar. I keep it in the fridge with the caviar so the spoon stays cold and ready for use.
This spoon is a little large for caviar. I purchase hackleback caviar in 1oz jars and the spoon is too large to scoop out all of the eggs. I think a smaller more pointed/oval spoon would be better.

I live in a small town and you can't buy these in the stores. They are very nice leaves, some smaller, but most very nice sized, excellent for Thai food. I froze mine, so I should have enough to last at least a year!

column9: Importfoodcom- Thai Fresh kaffir lime leaves 1.5 oz.
column10: Product arrived promptly and was absolutely fresh. The quantity (60-70 leaves) was correct. Very pleased with the value.
haven't tried cooking with them yet. but they arrived quickly and are not damaged or bruised in any way. they are beautiful specimens. i immediately vacuum sealed and froze them.
Great aromatic leaves, hey infuse gin or vodka with them and you have a Thaitini, a good spin on a regular martini.
Don't skip on this item, if you are making a thai coconut soup, this flavor is not replaceable- makes a huge difference. arrived is great condition!

DELICIOUS! A RAAWY! AS I COOK THAI SEVERAL TIMES A WEEK I BUY THESE REGULARLY.  THEY ARE ALWAYS FRESH AND OF GOOD QUALITY.  EXPENSIVE BUT WORTH IT.  IMPORT FOOD.COM ALWAYS PROVIDE AN EXCELLENT SERVICE

The lime leaves were in great shape and have a wonderful flavor. This company is the best. They always have the hard to get supplies that I can't get locally, and they ship them fast, and inexpensively. A+++++++++++
The kaffir lime leaves arrived very promptly and had been kept cool.They appear to be quite fresh.Have cooked with them, it was wonderful.Thanks

this was my first time trying powdered kaffir lime leaf.  i used it in tom yum.  the tom yum was delicious.  i'm starting to feel like i like using powdered kaffir lime leaf better cuz that way we get to eat the leaves too, instead of just throw the whole leaf away and not eating it.  i do think that it's a bit pricey though.  but anyway, excellent selller, shipping was super fast, and leaf quality is good.  i would buy from this vendor again if i can't find something cheaper somewhere else.  thank you.

There is no comparison to the real thing.  I purchased a Kaiffir Lime Tree online.  Sorry, but I don't know the web address; however, you can Google it.  The tree cost me about $40.  When I got the tree in the mail, it was only about six inches tall.  I put it in a sunny corner about two years ago and it grew like crazy.  Now, it's almost four feet tall.  Get yourself a big container and plenty of potting soil, and tou'll will have Kaffir lime leaves for a lifetime.

I haven't actually tasted the product yet, but you should be aware that it comes in a teeny, tiny package equaling about one tablespoon.  I'll admit I should have looked at the amount closer before I ordered!  But now YOU know.

This is my second purchase of Thai Kaffir Lime Leaf Powder.  I live in a small town in central Eastern WA State.  Needless to say, exotic ingredients like this just aren't available in my area.  This powder is absolutely necissary in the making of many Thai dishes.  It's flavorful & easy to use, altho a bit on the expensive side when you add on the shipping cost.  It lasts quite a long time, tho, so it's worth it to me.  Any one who enjoys making Thai dishes would be happy with this product.Pam SchmidtSelah, WA

Seemed like it may have been a good product, but customer service was a nightmare. After multiple email requests to cancel my order to both their Amazon marketplace email and the customer service email on their website, I got no reply, except a notice three days later that my item had shipped. I refused the delivery and after a lot of phone calls finally got a refund.Hopefully not everyone's experience is like this, but as for me, I don't think I will be doing business with them again soon.
The sesame seeds are excellent. No hulls in the package. They are perfect for making Christmas "Simsim" balls: an African candy made by members of the Luo community in western Kenya.

This is hands down the best gluten free brownie mix!  I use this mix for both my kids birthday cakes and everyone always loves them! I add a little more water than what is on the mix and it bakes up fluffier.  Now that my son also has to go dairy and egg free, this mix is still perfect!  Thank you!

I've tried many GF brownie mixes, and this one is at the top of the list.  It's got more of a cakey texture, but tastes wonderful - none of the gritty feel that most GF mixes have.  And there's no eggs, which is great for anyone with egg sensitivity, like me.  Highly recommend!!

column9: needs to be dressed up - not as good as others
column10: I like The Cravings Place Ooey Gooey Chocolatey Chewy Brownie Mix, 20.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6) but it is not my favorite.  I much prefer Authentic Foods GF Brownie Mix which is so good it doesn't need to be dolled up.  This Cravings Place Brownie Mix isn't ooey gooey at all.  It is wonderful that you need to add only water and oil and that it is dairy free and egg free but it doesn't taste much like a treat.  To doll it up I add 3/4cup of Eden Organic Dried Montmorency Cherries, 4-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 3) and 3/4cup pecans chopped which tastes great but still not decadent like Authentic Foods Brownie Mix.  I am surprised I don't like this mix more as The Cravings Place Double Chocolate Chunk Cookie & Muffin Mix, 22-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6) makes my FAVORITE muffins.  The muffins are great! They freeze well and then you can pop them in the microwave for 22 seconds so the chocolate chunks turn ooey gooey!

column9: Ooey Gooey Chocalatey Chew Brownie Mix
column10: I bought this mix because my 6 year old son is allergic to eggs, dairy and nuts.  For convenience, give it 4 stars.  For taste and texture, 3 stars; it's more cakelike than brownie-like, and tastes okay, but my homemade cake blows it away.  The chocolate chunks in the OGCCB mix definitely helped, and my son enjoyed the brownies.  So if you don't have time to make your own "safe" cake/brownies, this'll do.

These are impressive brownies, but you have to nuke them slightly before eating. The chocolate chunks melt and create a lovely lava cake type of experience. Cold, they're a little weird. There's a slightly acrid aftertaste that's more noticeable when cold. And the big chocolate chunks aren't particularly palatable when crunchy.  All in all though I am quite pleased with the mix.  It's easy to prepare, hypo-allergenic, and I like that they aren't as sickeningly sweet as regular brownie mixes; perhaps that accounts for the accusation of 'blandness' in one review, but I consider it a positive.

I was thoroughly surprised how good these brownies are.  I added nuts which my family loves and melted chocolate chips on top.  They are moist and a little chewy (again which my family loves). I love the fact that they use brown rice flour, red beet sugar and non-aluminum baking powder. And if you compare these brownies to other brands, they are lower in sugar. They are a big hit with family and friends.
THESE TASTE GREAT! THEY ARE AMAZINGLY GOOD. YOU CAN'T EVEN TELL THAT THEY ARE DAIRY FREE AND WHEAT FREE. I COULD EAT THESE ALL DAY LONG, THEY TASTE THAT GOOD! WILL CONTINUE TO BUY THEM.

column9: what can i say but Yum!
column10: what can i say but yum! I made a double batch and served them to friends without telling them their gluten free, the response i received was A+ THEN i told them it was gluten free, and i had all non believers until i proved it by showing the package!

The way I bake them, these brownies come out tasting a lot like chocolate cake, and I absolutely love them!!  They are soft, moist and hit the spot when you need a chocolate fix.  I have tried all sorts of gluten free brownies, and I keep coming back to the Cravings Place.  I just love these brownies!

I tend to doctor the recipe a bit, either adding sunflower butter as part of the fat, or using almond milk and almond extract, adding pecans, or what have you, but we use this in lieu of cake for some birthdays. It makes great cupcakes (I just made some tonight.)I will say that this is a high price for the mix compared to what I pay in the grocery store.But taste-wise, these are excellent. Don't expect that batter to be identical to brownies made with eggs and butter, but the end result is very good, and it adapts well to additions.We've made it with coconut oil, coconut milk and shredded coconut in the past. Also, amaretto and cherry extract, with almond chunks. So many options, and everyone in the family can eat it, which with our dairy, soy, egg, peanut, and wheat allergies, is a small miracle.All the Cravings Place mixes whip up incredibly quickly, easier in a lot of cases than standard, conventional mixes.

What can I say?  This made the first brownies I have eaten in over a year and they did not make me sick whatsoever!!  My family, who is not gluten/dairy intolorant even enjoys this product, and their friend.  If you put my brownies and theirs in front of them, they will choose their own.  However, for me, they are what I remember brownies to taste like. I aslo save 3 dollars a bag over the ones I can buy at the only store who sells them near me, so they are at a good price as well.

I have dairy, egg, wheat, and nut allergies/intolerances.  Finding pre-mixed anything is a challenge.  Especially a mix with chocolate.  Before I was diagnosed with the allergies/intolerances, I was not a fan of brownies or any baked chocolate product.  These brownies I love!The chocolate chunks are good enough to eat straight out of the bag (I must confess I have done this on a few occasions).  The brownies are not dense like "normal" brownies, but I like the lighter texture.  They are not overly sweet; a dark chocolate lover would be more impressed with the taste.  However, there's nothing wrong with adding more sweetener to the mix or a frosting to the final product if you like it sweeter.My husband (who has no food restrictions) loves these brownies, too.Very easy to make.

Since I became a vegan about a year ago I (surprisingly enough) I haven't had too much trouble finding great tasting desserts. However, brownies seemed to be the one exception to this experience. I have made and tried brownies that were okay, but they were more like cake than anything. I couldn't seem to find that perfect chewy brownie I so loved before! Since I found these, problem solved! Another great thing about them is that they are quite light. You will not feel sick after eating one. The only thing I would change (and this is hardly an issue) about these is to make the chocolate chunks that come inside smaller. They are a bit large for my taste and I always chop them up to spread them around a bit. Also, while they are delicious without frosting, I often top them with the frosting recipe from Alicia Silverstone's "The Kind Diet". The final result is the most flawlessly chewy, fudgy brownie I've ever had, even before I became a vegan! My advice is: try them just to try them. Then, especially in my case, enjoy devouring one after you have regained consciousness from the wonderful, sweep you off your feet, greatness of the first bite!

column4: Penny Zeller, Christian Author and Speaker
column10: It's been difficult to find tasty desserts that are egg-free, wheat-free, and dairy-free for our family who has multiple allergies. This mix fits the bill - these brownies are absolutely delicious! An added bonus is that you only have to add water and oil. Too many times, we have purchased items that you have to add egg replacer or an alternative milk (rice, soy, almond, etc) to the recipe. These brownies taste ever bit as good as "traditional" brownies and I would highly recommend them!

Wheat and gluten is a new restriction for us...and in looking for products we have tried several...including the new General Mills brownie...which taste like card board.THESE WERE WONDERFUL....We served them at an adult soccer party and they were gone in a flash...and no one had any idea they were 'special'.  I'm really looking forward to using ALL of her other products.  With the holidays coming up we are really scrambling to find ways to make all of the holiday favorites without wheat, gluten AND dairy.

column9: Excellent - Can't tell it is Dairy -Free
column10: My son has a dairy allergy yet these Brownies are loved by everyone in our house.  Even the nieghborhood kids come over and grab them.  When our local health food stores stopped carrying them, we decided to buy them by the case from Amazon.  We saved some money as well.  I would definitely recommend them!

In my opinion, these are the BEST gluten free/dairy free brownies out there!  They are so delicious you don't even think about the fact that they are not 'normal' brownies....my husband who usually doesn't eat any of my gluten free baking LOVES these as well!  Definitely a good choice!
This is one of the best brownie mixes I have ever used - gluten free or not!  The chunks of chocolate are a nice addition in every bite.  Delicious.  They only lasted 1 day at my house!

column9: I couldn't believe it was vegan!
column10: DH is vegan, I'm not.  But we both fell in love with these wonderful brownies.  I'm only disappointed that they're not available direct from Amazon, as the other varieties are, which would make them less expensive and come with free shipping.  But, I found them at Fred Meyer.

Chalky and bland. I'm trying to be an ambassador for gluten-free foods, and this confirmed for a big group of people the myth that gluten-free means taste-free. Even the children at the party I took them to wouldn't eat them. I'll stick with Pamela's, Bob's, and scratch.

I found this stuff in our local market a few years ago. Recently they quit carrying it. SoI turned to the internet and found it on Amazon. This is a blend of the traditional Lawrysseasoning with a couple of twists. First, traditional Lawrys is very fine and easy to overapply to your food. This product is course and is an excellent compliement to steak, burgers,chops, chicken and even veggies! The second thing that I like about this product is it containscracked pepper. So I have an all purpose seasoning in one container.
We buy this by the case.  All of children use this in all of their dishes. It adds so much more than the Season Salt.  If you have a chance to use it, you will be sold.
I love this stuff, it's great.  I was able to get a case for a real decent price, this was the way to go!!!

I love, love, love Lawrys Black Pepper Seasoned Salt!!! It has less sodium than salt and tastes great in EVERYTHING!!!I had originally found it in Nashville, but then I couldn't find it anymore. Then in Tuscaloosa and Princeton with the same result...no more Lawrys Black Pepper Seasoned Salt. I decided to look on Amazon.com and there it was! I was tickled!!! I have given away quite a few bottles to introduce others to it. My favorite seasoning!!! Thank you Amazon!!! Lawrys Black Pepper Seasoned Salt, 5-Ounce Bottle (Pack of 12)

Couldn't find it at the grocery stores I frequent.Amazon -- $8 + shipping for 1 bottle or $30 with free shipping for 12.Now all my friends have a bottle as well!It is basically the Lawry's Seasoned Salt we all grew up on with added pepper.I have a few extras - stop by, I'll give you one!Great on meat!!
The taffy I remember was more elastic and this taffy is extremely soft.  That might be seen as a good thing but it doesn't work for me.  It is also way too sweet for my taste.

This arrived fast and on-time.  The taffy extremely soft and fresh.  The flavors are very pronounced.  With cheap taffy the flavors are all kinda the same.  With this taffy Chocolate is Chocolate and Orange is Orange. I would purchase and recommend this taffy.
I love all the flavors of this taffy. It has lots of variety and perfect texture. I will definitely order again.
Great product! I always send to my wife as a treat for her and her co-workers! Best Taffy ever...lots of comments from the office staff.
As a long type two diabetic I can strongly recommend this product to anyone who would like a healthy sugar free cookie.I prefer these to any of the Joeseph's or other cheaper product's.
It's so important to me that these cookies are sugar free and made with all natural ingredients. I love that they are made with spelt flour, too. They're delicious!!!

column9: Thank goodness, I found them again.
column10: So happy to have found this item on the internet.  They were a favorite of mine, available locally at a small candy shop.  That shop has gone out of business, and I have had withdrawals until now.  Thank you so much, you've made my day.

I purchased chocolate covered gummy bears from "Candy Zone" and they were not very good. They were stale, the chocolate was poor quality and the gummy bears were all the same type/color: clear. Overall I was pretty bummed out as I've had GOOD chocolate covered gummy bears before and these just didn't measure up. Finally they were really EXPENSIVE.
good quality chocolate, Good quality gummy bears. these are the best chocolate gummy bears I've ever had. nothing more needs to be said.
I have tried several Balsamic dressings and Newman's Own Cranberry Balsamic is the best. It mixes well and adds a nice tangy flavor to my salad.  It's very hard to find though!!!
Sorry for the negative review, but as soon as the hot water hit the tea bag, all I could smell was TOBACCO!  It smells like cherry pipe smoke.....Very un-appetizing.

I picked these up in a bulk grocery department while out-of-town.  I was looking for a pressed dextrose candy that was hard enough not to melt immediately but that would soften fairly shortly in the mouth.  These have fit the bill perfectly.  Similar in flavor to Runts (especially the yellow fish, which are banana-flavored) but easier to bite due to their shape.  The coating has a good texture and dissolves without becoming grainy, which can be rough on tender mouths.  Each candy remains smooth until completely dissolved, which is a sign of a fine, high-quality dextrose inside and a coating that is not glopped on in the production.Each color has its own flavor, with the green being the tartest and the yellow being the least.  As someone who is not a fan of tart candy, I did not find the green to be too tart.  If you're looking for sour candies, try one of the other lines from Oak Leaf for something with the same quality.  I look forward to trying some of their other pressed dextrose products, especially the Banana Heads, and would highly recommend these Aquarium Fish to anyone.  As a bonus for those of us with allergies, they are produced in a peanut- and tree nut-free facility and are OU Kosher certified.

I received a sample bag of Fromm Chicken A La Veg for Cats and when I gave it to my pets they acted like I had just opened a bag of kitty treats - they gobbled it down fast.  I would say they were very satisfied customers.

After chewing one piece of Spry peppermint gum you may notice your teeth and gums feeling more healthy. Since I'm always looking for natural alternatives to regular processed sugar as an ingredient, this item caught my attention.Not only does Xylitol not promote tooth decay, it has natural ingredients to decrease plaque formation and adhesion. Xylitol is a naturally occurring 5-carbon sugar alcohol found in many fruits including plums, strawberries and raspberries. Our bodies actual produce about 11g of Xylitol a day.It can be commercially manufactured from "xylan hemicellulose" sources such as Birch trees in Finland. Some Xylitol products are also made from corn.This product is made with a Xylitol, gum base, natural flavors, glycerin, gum Arabic, soy lecithin and beesewax.Xylitol actually has been proven to:Reduce Tooth DecayPrevent Cavities by inhibiting the growth of bacteriaInhibits the growth of a related species, Streptococcus pneumoniae, which is a cause of ear infectionsReduce the secretion of Plaque AcidsFacilitate the Remineralization of Tooth EnamelWhat more could we ask for from a gum? This gum is a natural defense system and you will start to notice the results. Unlike other sugary gums, this will reduce cavities and it is just as flavorful, if not more so than most gums.~The Rebecca Review

I won't repeat what the last reviewer wrote, I would simply like to say that this gum WORKS! It makes my teeth feel really clean for hours even without brushing! You know that feeling when you REALLY need to brush your teeth, because your teeth are kinda aching? Well, this gum eliminates this feeling altogether! One downside is that the sweetness/flavor of the gum runs out pretty quick, much faster than gum made with artificial sweeteners. But, it is fantastic for what it is, a dental gum! Highly recommended!!!!

column9: My favorite flavor of Spry gum
column10: I have tried all the flavors of Spry and this one is my favorite flavor. The flavor lasts really long! I love that Spry uses ONLY xylitol for their sweetener and it's why I only chew Spry gum. I also like the texture of their gum, as opposed to gums such as "Extra" brand gum. Spry doesn't make your jaw ache like those other gums do because it doesn't get stiffer or more rubbery as you're chewing it, such as other sugarless gums tend to do.

column9: good taste and good for your teeth
column10: Love this gum.  Just want to note that I have purchased it both in the 100 count jar and the 10 count packages and there is a difference.  The gum in the jar was stiffer and harder to chew - like it had dried out some.  The gum in the blisterpack type 10 count package is much softer and fresher.  I'd usually rather buy the product with less packaging but in this case I'm buying the smaller packs from now on.
good deal... it seems like 3 pieces are a regular stick of gum, but still a very good deal. If you like flavor, it doesn't last more than 2 mins
Just what I was looking for. Good for your gums, the flavor doesn't last as long as other gums but for a healthy gum it is excellent.

I love gum, it helps me stay awake during boring meetings or long hours at the computer and keeps me from snacking, problem is almost every type of gum made now has aspartame which tends to give me a headache. So I love this gum as it has none, plus the calories in each piece are even lower.  The peppermint and spearmint are my favorites and last the longest, the fruit is a little sweet for me and does not last as long.  None of them last as long as your standard commercial gum, but for me, it is definately worth it.

I love this gum! I'm not a gum person - normally I never chew gum. This, however, is a proxy for brushing at work or when I don't have time, and was recommended by my dentist. Though that's why I bought it originally, I really love the taste! It's a very natural mint taste. I really couldn't be happier.

column9: Love this gum, and its great for your teeth.
column10: I have tried all their flavors and not one has disappointed me.  While it may not last as long as "normal" gum, lasts for around 30-45 minutes, it is far more healthy for you and does not contain aspartame.
Very expensive for gum and the flavor only lasts for literally two minutes, but if you do not want to poison yourself with aspartame, then this is the only option.

So me and my husband are on this health food kick, and we're finding out how bad aspartame (among other things) is for you. Unfortunately, I love gum, just to have something help keep my mouth moist through the day.I've been chewing Eclipse gum, mostly because it lasts a long time and freshens my breath. The bad thing is that most, if not all, gums have aspartame in them, even the normal "sugar" ones!I thought switching to an all natural gum would be hard, but I've been very surprised and happy with the Spry gum. It's actually very close in taste, texture, and longevity to the Eclipse gum, except that it's natural and not bad for you. I couldn't be happier, and I'd highly recommend trying this if you are looking for a great alternative to the chemically-laced gum found at your local super market.

Spry Peppermint appears to be a healthy alternative to other chewing gums.  Peppermint oil is used in the manufacture of this product; raw materials come from China and the USA.  Each chiclet is small.  Two pieces might be considered one serving.I like the peppermint taste, which lasts for one minute -- yes, one minute as timed by my stopwatch.  After that minute most of the taste is gone.  It seems like much of any benefit the gum might provide will be lost if it is thrown away by minute two of chewing.  Recommended with noted reservations.

column9: Great at first, now below average
column10: Started buying this about two years ago if not earlier. Really liked it even though the flavor was gone fast. With the most recent batch that I bought the flavor is gone even faster than before, and I couldn't help but noticing that they are partially sourced from China now. Enough reason for me stop buying them. Switching to Orahealth Xylimelts Mints, 80-Count Boxes instead. No gum, but at least much better and higher Xylitol content. The Spry gum has very little Xylitol anyway. If I don't like the melts I'll have to search for something else, but the Spry gum from China isn't cutting it at this price and quality level.
I take a Spry mint every time I have eaten anything with sugar in it.  It keeps me from having cavities.I have to treat any xylitol product with a quartz crystal so that I will not have diareha.

column9: Just as good as any other sugared gum
column10: When I first tried this gum, I thought it tasted just as good as any other sugared gum. However, the flavor does go bland after a couple of minutes but it's much better for you and so much cheaper than the stuff you see at the stores. I wish I could find these at stores instead of having to buy them online!

I've tried five flavors of Spry gum: peppermint, spearmint, green tea, fresh fruit, and cinnamon. Of the five, peppermint is my least favorite. It loses its flavor within two minutes. That's not an exaggeration - you get literally two minutes of chewing pleasure. After that, the gum starts to turn strangely bitter.On the bright side, the gum is flavored with xylitol. Unlike some brands that advertise that they contain xylitol, Spry actually uses it as their only sweetener. Most sugarless gums make me sick, as I can't handle sorbitol and maltitol well. At least I can chew this without having intestinal problems, which makes it worth two stars despite the lack of flavor.
My very-conservative-about-new-products dentist recommends this - and gives out samples.  My kids like it.

column9: Okay, but flavor is gone fast
column10: If you're trying to avoid aspartame, this gum doesn't have any but like other chiclet-type gums, the flavor is gone in about two minutes and what you're left with is a sickening blob that you probably won't want in your mouth for very long.I chew gum to help with acid reflux, but I can't stand chicklet-type gums and would not have bought this had a I known that's what it was. I much prefer stick gum, so the search continues for something that more closely resembles stick without the aspartame.

column9: Do you really need titanium dioxide?
column10: Xylitol is good for you, but there are other xylitol products.  Titanium dioxide may make this product brighter white than others, but it won't do your teeth any good.  Even if it isn't in the form of nanoparticles that definitely should not be consumed, it won't help you and just might have deleterious long term effects.

This product was recommended by a doctor because it does not have the not-so-good-for-you ingredients of regular sugar-free gum.  Have only been able to find it at a couple of stores like Whole Foods and Wegman's.  Usually they are out of stock.  So much more convenient to purchase on Amazon and have it shipped to my door.  And at a better price!
Delicious peppermint xylitol gum that prevents cavities when you chew and bad breath. It comes in a convenient 100 ct. jar. I had a good experience with this company.

column9: Loses Taste in Less Than a Minute
column10: I usually chew Orbit Peppermint gum.  I needed something for Free Super Saver Shipping filler.  I thought this might be a good value and have heard about the dental benefits of Xylitol.I received the gum yesterday and I am very disappointed that the taste disappears within a minute.  I know Trident has a decent peppermint gum with Xylitol and the taste doesn't disappear fast.  If you want a peppermint gum with Xylitol, I suggest you try Trident's version.  Xylitol isn't something I require in a chewing gum and I prefer Orbit's peppermint taste.  I do chew Trident's version sometimes though and it is pretty good.
I've chewed regular gum for years.  But I have realized that I experience a reaction to aspartame (which is in most gum).  This gum doesn't have aspartame.  Its GREAT.

I purchased spry gum while pregnant as Ive always been a big gum chewer, but have always been leery of aspartame. Now that I'm pregnant, not only am I more aware of what goes in my body, but psychological or not, I was gagging on name brand gums. So I googled aspartame free gums and came across spry gum. I was hesitant as previous aspartame free/natural gums purchased at Whole Foods had dissolved in my mouth- not a pleasant experience, nor worth the extra money for such a short chew time. Somehow, the makers of Spry figured out how to make a gum aspartame free and have it hold together for hours at a time. The pieces are small- and I'm too stingy to chew 2 at a time given the extra cost- but they literally last at least 4-5 hours at a time- I've never tried for longer/don't know exactly how long they could last. They're not good for blowing bubbles though, if that's an issue =) Overall, I highly recommend this gum and will be buying more of it when the original batch runs out.

column9: Not Perfect - But Best On Market
column10: I have yet to find a true 'best' sugared or sugar-free chewing gum.  This is by far the closest I have come.  Highly recommended.  I buy both the buckets (this one) for my desk at the office, and the smaller retail sized packets to keep with me in my jackets, bags, etc.I have no idea how legitimate the xylitol claims are and simply assume this falls somewhere between a cigarette and and apple on the nutrition scale.

Having used this product through the years, I am pleased that it comes in a larger size with less cumbersome packaging.This is so much more convenient.  Having been a tobacco smoker in the past I may have never started with this peppermint refresher available in 'the day' of 60's advertisements for cigarettes in most stores, restaurants and professional offices.

Good tasting gum.Pieces are kinda small and gum doesn't last too long,but it seems to freshen my breath and without all the sugar of regular gum.Also no aspertame.Xlear - Spry Sugar Free Gum Peppermint, 20 boxes

I bought a 'jar' because its sweetened with xylitol. I was skeptical after my first piece. Yes the intense peppermint rush seems to go away fast, but two hours later when I was kissed by someone, they grinned and said, "ooo, peppermint!". I was still chewing the same piece (I'm absentminded that way). I thought it had no flavor left, but I guess I was wrong.One time I chewed a piece for over 6 hours (absentminded, remember) before I spit it out. Other gums would have disintegrated by then, but this was still intact and 'springy'.I'm looking forward to trying the other flavors. (I'm still working on that same 'jar')

It's the Xylitol stupid.  No brainer gum! - chew great tasting gum that naturally helps to reduce cavities without any synthetic sweetener.  This is the most economical way to purchase this gum.  You will find that it dissolves and reduces in size pretty fast (much more than other gum). Therefore, like me, you will probably chew 3-4 pieces at a time. The sweet taste of the Xylitol does fade away within about 10 minutes, so your not going to chew this for an hour.  If your looking for a hunk of gum to chomp on for hours, this is not it.  If your looking for an all natural non-toxic great tasting gum to chew after meals to reduce plaque and help reduce the chance of cavities, this gum is a no-brainer.

Spry gum is great for teeth.  It's xylitol sweetener (which is natural) inhibits bacterial in the mouth, thus making the mouth a more healthier place.Spry Peppermint freshens breath well, flavor lasts a long time, and it stays soft and easy to chew for hours.  It isn't sticky and doesn't stick to fillings in teeth.This nifty tub is great to keep at the desk, and you can throw a few pieces in your pocket when going somewhere.No artificial ingredients like evil aspartame, no sugar.  It's the perfect gum I'd recommend to everyone.

column9: And it's a wonderful gum for seniors, too!
column10: My wife and I, both seniors, love this gum. We are now on our third 100-piece container. When my wife's dental hygienist recommended she use a product containing Xylitol to remedy dry-mouth syndrome caused by some of her medications, my wife decided that a gum with Xylitol would serve her best. I researched products on the Web and found Spry at a good price on Amazon.My wife[s dental hygienist was right: it was a perfect solution for her dry-mouth problem. As a bonus benefit, my research revealed that Xylitol was also broadly supportive of good dental health.Although I had not chewed gum for many years after I lost some tooth fillings due to the adhesiveness of many gums when I was a much younger man, I gave Spry a try and liked it -- it did not stick to my fillings.Of course, with Xylitol being a sugar-substitute, we don't have to worry about the possibility of promoting dental decay. We both like the peppermint flavor and have bought that exclusively. We find that one piece of Spry is insufficient for a pleasant chewing experience, so I use three pieces at a time and my wife uses twoXlear - Spry Gum Peppermint, 100 gum. (By the way, we do not chew our Spry in public.)

column9: Good tasting yet good for you gum
column10: Love this product.  This gum is good for dental health and yet it tastes good.  The xylitol sugar is a type of sugar that fights stuff sticking to your teeth  And unlike other sugar alcohols (some fruit sweeteners) it tastes good.

My naturopath just suggested I try this, and while I was hesitant to buy gum in bulk like this (I'm not normally a gum chewer), it's worked out very well economically. It tastes good, just like a regular gum, and I'm sure it used to just be sold by the checkout stand in packs but I haven't seen it for a long time. It's supposed to actually be good for getting rid of bacteria in your mouth and believe it or not, your sinus' as well. I remain doubtful, but it's worth a try and a pleasant fix. Due to the recommendation I received from someone who really seems to know what they are talking about, I would in turn recommend this for anyone who chews gum, or for anyone with breath or sinus problems. it won't hurt, and it might even help.

Pros:  - 100% Xylitol sweetenedCons:  - pieces are small  - flavor doesn't last long  - gum is "stiffer" than mainstream gums  - more expensiveXylitol is the main thing this gum has going for it. Some studies indicate the Xylitol may have dental health benefits. Other gums with Xylitol, such as Trident, also contain other sweeteners such as aspartame. This is sweetened with only Xylitol and so has more Xylitol in it.However, the sweeteners don't last nearly as long as Trident and the gum is stiffer to chew. Also, the pieces are small so I usually end up chewing two pieces at once. When I chew Trident, I chew one piece or even half a piece. Also it is significantly more expensive per ounce than Trident.It has been a nice to try and it is not an unpleasant gum, but I will go back to Trident. For me, the additional Xyitol content doesn't justify the lower quality and higher cost.If you found this review helpful, let me know with your vote.

Spry gum tastes like someone already chewed all the flavor out of it. They need to add more peppermint oil or something. No wonder folks steer away from healthy things if they lose flavor in ten seconds!

Savor the taste because it only last 10 seconds. Too expensive and besides,it takes two pieces for a serving.Trident has a sugar free gum with xylitol ,much less expensive and the taste last much longer
The product may be sugar free but it is also hard as a rock and flavor free within the first minute...

I bought this gum to get to $25 and qualify for super saver shipping. I don't regret it a bit. The gum flavor is nice, it lasts a reasonable period of time, and the gum leaves your mouth feeling clean-ish. It's not going to change your life, but it's good gum.

column9: A list of ingredients would be very helpful!
column10: I have already been fooled once by making assumptions on ingredients.  I need more information.

Not for me.Gave me stomach problems and my hubby too. No more chewing gum for us. The act of chewing that promotes digestive juices that creates problems or this brand in particular I am not sure but we don't chew gum anymore after our problems with our digestion.
Individual packets make taking this salad dressing with you very easy. It is tasty and the packet size is good.
Soft, flavorful and fun; I feel a little goofy eating these 30 inch long Fruit Rolls - but they do taste great!

It's beef jerky.  There are really bad beef jerky, and, really good beef jerky.On a scale of bad jerky to good jerky - I'd rate this a good jerky.It's pretty tender and, compared to what's out there, good with the teriyaki flavor.On a scale of 1 to five - I've had 1 better jerky brand, and 3 worse jerky brands.  But, that's only five brands of jerky - So, try out a small pack - You may just enjoy it more than other brands.I'd like to thank cows for tasting so good - and question pigs:  Where's bacon jerky?  World would probably implode if there was a great tasting bacon jerky.  Now I want bacon jerky!

I found the product rather of inferior quality, the bag was huge and perhaps that was the problem because the Jerky just wasn't great and I'm a huge fan of Jack Link's and have been for years, with teriyaki being my favorite flavor. However from now on, I will keep my greed on a leash and get the smaller sizes only.

I have bought many 3.5 ounce packages of the Teriyaki Jerky from Jacks Links and have always found it to be fresh, tasty and a great treat. I had bought my kids jerky many years ago and decided to buy some larger bags to send them for Christmas. They were just as please as I was with the jerky.Jacks Links Premium Cuts Teriyaki Flavored Beef Jerky 14 Ounce Giant Pack

My daughter thought she was ordering Satellite Wafers with sour powder in the middle but she received the ones with "candy beads"in the middle and no one from the company with help us replace them.  Our order is unopen and we will pay shipping it back if we can get the correct ones.

column9: Delverde pasta is excellent! Buy with confidence.
column10: Really flavorful.  Have tried several varieties.  All are great. Tagliatelle is superb.  Wonderful texture.This one lends itself well to any recipe.  Ever tried a modified Fettucine Alfredo sauce? Use cream cheese or the lower fat alternative Neuchatel instead of all the heavy cream.Here's the classic recipe for Alfredo Sauce:For the Alfredo Sauce1/2 cup of butter1 cup heavy cream1 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese, groundedOptional: 1 clove of garlic, finely crushed1/4 tablespoon of saltPepperHerbs of your choice, chopped parsley is classic

This is my favorite and best pasta out there. period.  By a long shot.... Love it.  Cooked right Chitarra pasta is the best spaghetti type of pasta one can cook.  That's my humble opinion anyway and my $0.02 :-)

Excellent quality, I suggest to any one to put pasta in boiling water for two minutes, turn fire off,cover, steer occasionally and let stay in to the water until the suggest time of cooking direction. Follow same direction for other Gragnano Pasta Products.

I mean to give this product four stars, though the interface is giving me a little trouble. I'm very fond of it. I can't have bacon in my household, and this sausage, while not replicating the texture of bacon, does suggest that smoky savory flavor when sliced thin and fried or microwaved to crispness, far better than that nasty turkey bacon does. Also, it's tasty in its own right.

For the last 15+ years, Figis.com has provided our family with what I've always thought was the best summer sausage available today.This Christmas, I was given a 20 ounce package of Old Wisconsin Original Summer Garlic Sausage. Without even opening it, I already made up my mind that if it's not a Figis product, it won't measure up.Boy was I wrong! I can't believe the quality of this summer sausage. The taste is one that cannot be described, you'll just have to try it yourself.Off to order more...

This is my favorite sausage.  All other brands seem to fatty to me or poorly spiced.  Since its not available in stores in my region, I've bribed friends to send it to me from home.  I am thrilled to find it available on the web.

column9: Really wanted to like this, but sadly disappointed.
column10: I have a regular monthly subscription to another brand of summer sausage available on Amazon. It's very popular with friends and family for snacking, and when the regular brand wasn't available, I purchased this one for a temporary replacement. I read through the reviews and felt this would do the trick until the regular stuff was available again.Unfortunately, the only thing the two seem to have in common is general shape and color. While the flavor isn't unpleasant, the texture leaves a lot to be desired. It's both fibrous and greasy, with globs/pockets of fat and strings of what I can only imagine to be muscle or gristle of some kind. They're like white threads, and the mouthfeel of the sliced product is very unappetizing.In reading through the reviews again, I saw one where the reviewer mentioned this summer sausage had potential when heated/cooked, so I sliced it thinly and tried both panfrying and microwaving it. This does improve the texture and allows the extra fat to render out (if you're microwaving, be sure to sit the pieces on top of paper towels, and don't let it go too long without checking ... LOTS of fat drains out of the meat!). After it's been heated/cooked, the product can be enjoyed for its flavor without the unpleasant texture.If our regular choice becomes unavailable again at some point, we'll just do without or look for something in a local grocery store. We won't be purchasing this product again.

For summer sausage that doesn't have to be refridgerated, this is a good choice. The rolls tend to be a little on the fatty side and the salt content is hard to miss, but the overall flavor is good and in a sandwhich or paired with cheese or crackers, it makes a good snack or meal.

This summer sausage was not that great.  Had a very "tangy" taste, with very little other flavor.  If it were not for the price, this would have been returned.  My dog enjoys it.For real summer sausage I'll stick with the small, specialty companies.  Try Woody's Smokehouse or try the venison summer sausage from the Vermont Country Store.  Heck, even Hickory Farms is better.

I bought several of these as Christmas gifts.  They were outstanding in taste and leaness of the product.  Sometimes summer sausage can leave a very oily residue on your tongue as you eat it.  This product does not do that and is one of the best I have ever eaten.  They easily excel over Hickory Farms Beef stick which is a good product in my estimation.
I TAKE THIS ON KAYAKING TRIPS INTO THE FLORIDA KEYS BACK COUNTRY.KEEPS WITHOUT REFRIGERATION.EXCELLENT FOR BACKPACKING AND AS AN EMERGENCY STORE!VERY TASTY!
Very moist, not bad, but not worth the price. I was unsatisfied with my purchase. Worth maybe twelve dollars. I cancelled my subscription.

Tried various brands, and this is the best for flavor and seasoning and consistancy.  My three year old grandson loves it, causing me to buy a double order monthly.  Highly recommend.  Do the monthly plan for delivery savings.

I finally found the summer sausage that my 7 year old son loves.  He's a very picky eater, but he loves the Old Wisconsin Summer Sausage.  Very good price for a package of 3 with 20-ounce each. And it's something good to store for our emergency food supply box.

This sausage is way too soft and way oversalted. It feels and tastes like an extremely low-quality product, which is exactly what it is. I am definitely one-time customer for this concoction, good luck to all those who enjoy this junk. Back to Hillshire Farms for me, there is simply no contest between the two.

Easily one of the best summer sausages i have ever tasted.  I personally like the beef version of old wisconsin summer sausage because i think it taste better than the others when broiled.  The original flavor is also good, and i would say that one is the best if you're just going to slice and eat with no broiling.  I havent tried the Garlic one yet but im sure i would love it as well.  This summer sausage easily gets 5 stars from me.

OK, summer sausage is always salty but to me, this one is particularly salty.  Not excessive mind you, but salt taste is strong.  Pepper but not a strong kick if that means anything to you.  I am no summer sausage expert but this one is pretty good and definitely affordable.

column9: Great price if you love summer sausage
column10: If you love summer sausage and are looking for it other than during the holidays. This is a great price and tastes really good too.

column9: Great item to send to our Troops
column10: If you're one of the countless " Support our Troops" people who is sending food to service people in Iraq or Afghanistan - this is a great item.  It travels well and they don't see anything nearly this tasty in the MRE's.  Good protein,  they are trying to eat healthy.  I reorder this often
DELICOUS! It's exactly the taste I have been looking for in a summer sausage.  Price is reasonable too as compared to other branded summer sausages.

as others have mentioned, the texture is a bit mushy/moist at room temperature.  after letting it sit in the fridge (which i do before opening), i find the taste and texture more appealing. i mostly snack on products such as this rather than cookies, etc.

We thought this was the sausage cabellas sold during the holidays, but there was nothing merry about my purchase. It made my wife and oldest son sick to there stomachs and throw up. We had to throw out the rest.

This is the best summer sausage I've had. The fact that it's gluten-free is a huge plus otherwise I wouldn't be able to eat it. Just a small piece is good for a snack but it really stands out when cut up into little pieces and sauteed with some onions and boiled cauliflower. That way you get a very tasty, high protein, low carb meal which will sustain you for a long time. We ordered this for our camping trip but ate all of the 3 sausages already ha..ha...so good, now I need to place another order.

This is a reasonable price for mail order meat.  The taste is pretty mild (maybe a little too mild)and the texture is consistent with summer sausage which is a cooked product, not a dry cured product like salami.

I ordered my Beef Summer Sausage from Old Wisconsin because my previously favorite Hickory Farms website only sold their stuff in packages and charged $9.99 for shipping making my order of two small sausages come to $30!  I had previously ordered the pickled eggs from Old Wisconsin and I knew their products were of the highest quality; so I tried their sausage and now I like it even better than Hickory Farms version.  The most important thing to note was that it has the same flavor and taste as what I was used to at Hickory Farms but it tasted fresher and better.  I'm not into new flavors and changing the basics of this sausage and I was actually surprised that I liked it better. I've tried many other brands and just threw them away after the first bite.  To top is off, they sent me three 1 lb packages for $20 and on Amazon the shipping was free.  So I ended up with one extra beef sausage for $10 less and it tastes even better (although the same in many ways).

Nice texture, wonderful taste! My other half isn't a garlic lover and he wasn't offended by the amount of garlic in the product. Much cheaper and a better product than those big companies. Highly reommed this; I like it so much I have it on scheduled delivery.
I wholly recommend it.  I can eat one for a few days, with some crackers, Its really good stuff. Its spiced just right and the best value for the price.

column9: Get the non-plastic wrap version if possible - dries nice & hard like German salami
column10: Delicious salami/summer sausage, BUT this packaging version requires refrigeration after exposing to air/opening. They sell same sausage in delicatessens, giftshops and probably direct, with a NON-plastic wrap and STRING so you can HANG it and let it HARDEN as long as you like. I let it get very hard and crunchy, like the great sausages I buy when in Germany. Great price here as 3-pack though.

This summer sausage is awesome, fantastic flavor with perfect cutting consistency to go along with their cheese! What a value for three large sausages, plus fast shipping, would make a great gift for some lucky guy!

Old Wisconsin Beef Stick is a terrific product at a very reasonable price.  I used to buy Hickory Farms brand, but this is every bit as good and costs a great deal less.  I recently signed up for the subscription offer, which lowers the cost substantially.

I purchased three of these for my brother who loves these things. I chose this one after no longer being able to locate a similar traditional Hickory Farms beef stick. My brother said this was a great substitute.

I have done the recurring shipment on this product, and what a steal!  For my carb free diet, this item is a STAPLE in my DAILY food intake.  Items comes well packed, on time, and the quality, flavor, and value are outstanding.  THANK YOU for the recurring monthly shipment option.  Fabulous product!

The flavoring in this was just not very good but tolerable. I ordered the 3 pack from Amazon so we had three to get through. We were really put off that it seemed like each slice we had was half fat. We ended up cooking it off before we ate it. There just is no excuse for it to be so full of grease. Also we were very turned off in the fact that we would occasionally hit a bone chip and one got stuck between two of my teeth and I thought there was a dental trip in my future but I was able to work it out.We gave up on it and I would say they are careless in what they grind in the sausage. I really wanted to like this sausage but just couldn't get around all the issues with it. We will be going back to our old brand which is a little more expensive but I guess with sausage you get what you pay for.
After the holidays it is very hare do get summer sausage.  Got this and has been enjoyed by all...saving the last one to watch the Saints win the super bowl.
