Add to that, they are invididually wrapped and a substantial size, this is a very good buy. Especially if you like soft cookies like I do. There is a good amount of rasins in the cookies, but they do not overwhelm at all the chocolate but compliment it.I know Erin also sells just a chocolate cookie. If it is the same used here, I would highly recoomend that as well if you are not particularly fond of rasins or raisins or don't want them to get in the way of your chocolate.

I purchased two of these cookies when in Seattle and went looking online to buy them about 2 months later.  I have purchased 2 dozen on Amazon and had them shipped cross-country to me.  I followed the suggestion to freeze them to keep better.  They are very good and give a "hearty meal" feeling anytime of the day.  It says they are toaster friendly but I have only warmed one up in the microwave.  I will probably re-order although I have been searching the internet for a recipe that might bake up as good as the real thing.

These are a easy to grab breakfast when I am running late in the morning.  I store them in the freezer and they are defrosted by the time I get to my desk.  They are dense and cannot be confused with a dessert cookie.  One for breakfast along with a cup of coffee keeps me satisfied until lunch.  I also like the Fruit and Nut ones.
What a delicious snack!  Actually, I normally have one for breakfast, and my cravings are satisfied!  I love this cookie!  And I love the chocolate cookie, too.  YUMMMMMM!
tasty and filling on the go snack. Use for hiking & camping also keep some in the office
I really wouldn't recommend these to my friends. I was really looking for something that actually tasted like a chocolate chococolate chip cookie. Just didn't like them.....Sorry
My husband loves these cookies,he eats them most mornings and says they hold him over until lunch.  Easy to grab and go and not full of alot of junk.
I keep these on hand for the quick breakfast on the go or when my mornings are so hectic that I can't get breakfast made in time. We love this one, but the others flavors are good too.

column9: should have gone with another flavor
column10: DId not like the chocolate oatmeal raisin. wasnt very tasty. It is filling and wholesome but I would not buy again at this price.

column9: OK if you are already used to natural-style foods
column10: It's a dense cooky that has little moisture and does crumble a bit.  The chocolate is barely detectable.  To me is tastes kinda like fruit-cake, that dense Christmas fruitcake.  I liked it alright, but I'm into the organicky stuff.  A newbie probably wouldn't like it.

I have eaten Bakers Breakfast Cookies for quite some years now.  They are very yummy and tasty too. They also keep you satisfied for quite a few hours before lunch. They are kind of spendy but very worth it! I eat a Chocolate Chunk Raisin cookie every morning with a glass of milk...Enjoy
This is a great deal. Hard to find bulk quantities of this product. This was one of the last available. Hope they get more.
These are so good I can't believe they are instant. They taste like and have the texture of real mashed potatoes. I highly recommend (for a dollar twenty five per package, shipping included).

I love the Idahoan roasted garlic mashed potatoes (green package) and when I couldn't find them in my local grocery store -- because they're apparently quite popular -- I've tried these Baby Reds Roasted Garlic and Parmesan potatoes.  I have had roasted garlic mashed potatoes in fine dining establishments that haven't been as good as these.  I couldn't make them better from scratch.
I ordered the lemon flavor bear as a gift.  It was huge and had a good weight to it.  My girlfriend loved it, I tried some and it was pretty tasty.  No complaints at all.

The pork chops from Omaha Steaks were very tasty but at the same time exceptionally dry. Pork is usually dry meat but these were to the extreme. Possibly shipping them frozen and keeping them frozen was partly the problem.
I've been a tea-lover for 30 plus years. some teas are too bitter, or strong, but this tea is so smooth and silky, even without adding a sweetener. I would'nt want to ever live without it!

I bought this item because, unlike other options for dehydrated onions, I believed these were whole onions.  Hah same old minced onions.If I had known that I would have bought less and certainly not these.  I am finding that there is less and less actual information given about products for sale on the web.

What a deal. I just love dehydrated onions. They keep for a long time. This came in a large giant can. Great for storing. These have a wonderful flavor and I use them in everything that I would normally put raw onions in. I love the flavor.

column9: nice but got me at drug screen
column10: i really love this tea, it helped me a lot with my stomach pain and disconfort,has a nice flavor and helps even with my mood....I'm a trucker and i am screened for drugs regularly,no surprise they found cocaine in my test....If you take random tests be careful, don't lose your job over a tea....

the tea is very good--taste and quality are exactly the product i was hoping to find (initially discovered while traveling in Peru).  one slight inconvenience is the tea bags are "bulk packaged", rather than wrapped in individual paper envelopes.
this isn't really what i was expecting. drank 4 cups and didn't feel anything. was thinking it would have the effects of green tea but didnt really do much.
It is a good tea, but I have not felt any increase in energy whatsoever as promised. So I gave it 3 stars.

All NovoAndina Products ( Produced or distributed) do not have a paper wraps since they can harbor dirt and bacteria and the printing ink can change or contaminate the delicate flavor of the tea bags.NovoAndina products do not contain preservatives or additives; therefore they must be properly stored. All our Air Tight Bags are re-sealable with zip lock closures and once opened the bags must be kept closed at all time to avoid contamination in a dry, cool, dark place away from strong-flavored foods.  An extra airtight container is recommended when the tea is stored over one month.Do not store NovoAndina products inside a refrigerator if you have produce inside. Many fruits and vegetables, especially if they have been damaged, give off ethylene gas as they ripen. Our teas are very sensitive to the presence of even very low levels of ethylene gas. The refrigerator acts as a trap for the ethylene gas given off by the generating varieties, allowing it to build up to damaging levels. Although not hazardous to humans, the ethylene gas leads to the early aging and rotting of the tea.

column9: Cute Little Gift Set - Just Not For Fans of the REALLY Hot Stuff!
column10: I picked up one of these little "spicy 12-packs" last year from a hot sauce shop in Gatlinburg, Tennessee. I've long been a fan of the Dave's range of sauces and was very taken with the little miniature sampler bottles and the chance to try out so many of their sauces for a relatively good price. The bottles live on my desk at work and I've been merrily sampling my way through them for a while now.This is a great little set that will ensure you always have something slightly different to try depending on your mood, but for the serious lover of outrageously hot sauces like myself, there is nothing new to discover here. That's not a bad thing - these sauces are all as flavorful and complex as you'd expect from this company, and with such a wide range of flavors there's something to match just about any meal. If you're already familiar with some of the hotter sauces in the Dave's range, though, what you won't find here is anything new in the way of sauces that will give you that endorphin rush that comes from a sky-high Scoville rating. By far the hottest of the bunch here is Temporary Insanity (a "mere" Insane on the Dave's Insanity scale), and I already had a bottle of that lurking in the fridge.I'm not knocking this set at all, though - it's something that will be appreciated by anyone who likes things slightly on the hot side looking to sample a few and find a new favorite. If you're like me and find yourself going out to eat and wishing the place stocked some decent hot sauce, these little bottles are the perfect size to stash in your bag before you go. I polished off my mini-bottle of Rowdy Red Chile within a few days and refilled the bottle with Dave's Ghost Pepper sauce. That bottle now lives in my purse and comes with me everywhere I go, so never again will I have to endure a breakfast that fails to blow my head off in the expected fashion!I'd love to see a similar set featuring all the REALLY hot sauces in the range (as Dave's is, after all, famous for these!) - that would be something I'd pick up in a second.

OK, so I'm under Dr.'s orders to cut down on caffeine, so I've been looking for a good decaf that would match my favorite "high octane" coffee.I think I've found it.Although this stuff is a bit pricey, it delivers a LOT in terms of rich flavor and smoothness. Best of all, it doesn't have that burnt bitter aftertaste that too many popular coffees have.  It offers a hearty robust flavor, and that's exactly what I want from a coffee.Will keep this on hand for sure!

I found this box of chocolates for $3.99 at my local grocery store because apparently it was leftover from Christmas. I was planning on giving it to a relative as a present but my husband opened it up. That meant I could try some too. So we sampled the chocolates and found them quite good. My favorite two chocolates are the Almond Nougat and Maple Fudge. This box also contains: Coconut, chocolate covered peanuts, caramel, chocolate covered almonds, chocolate whip, pecan and English walnut cluster, molasses chew, messenger boy, cashew cluster, chocolate truffle, toffee, cherry cordial and toffee. The product description says this is sugar-free but I beg to differ. These are some of the sweetest chocolates I've ever eaten. Some of the ingredients include: Chocolate, sugar, cocoa butter, whole mik, milk fat, soy lecithin, almonds, cashews, peanuts, walnuts, pecans, sugar, brown sugar, condensed milk, butter, dairy cream, cherries, corn syrup, palm kernel oil, coconut, molasses, white chocolate tapioca flour, honey, natural and artificial flavors and preservatives. Some of the chocolates are dark chocolate and some are milk chocolate. Everything is delicious.~The Rebecca Review

column9: Very tasty black tea with peach
column10: The peach flavor is what I would characterize as 'a hint of peach'. Not a strong peach flavor. It is a nice balance with the tea, but perhaps could be a little stronger peach flavor.This is a good tea to make peach iced tea. I heat the water to 180°-190° and brew it for 3-4 minutes. I've had better results pouring the hot water over the tea leaves. I use 2 TBSP in 1 liter water. Stirring half way doesn't produce any noticeably different results. I then pour through the infuser into a pitcher of ice.Will definitely buy again.

I love this oatmeal because it has the most protein of any oatmeal out there. I love the cinnamon flavor best, tho the others are great if you like banana bread and maple sugar.  I just wanted to get the cinnamon individually and this company provided it. Has been discontinued, I hear, but it's coming back--yea, Quaker.

I enjoy this product but have found that it, as well as the banana nut weight control oatmeal is being discontinued.  I ventured to the Amazon website to see if I could find the item and was successful.  If you like it, buy it now.

Of ALL the various flavors, Weight Control CINNAMON is the very best!!!  Even my husband, who has hated oatmeal since he was a kid, tried it after much coercing by me and LOVES it.  We stir in some frozen blueberries after it's cooked and it's an easy, delicious & nutritious breakfast that the whole family will love.Don't mistake it for the apples & cinnamon though - we tried that one once and had to throw the rest of the box away.
I LOVE Quakers Weight Control Cinnamon, but I have not been able to find it on the shelves in months. Has Quaker discontinued this product.

column9: Not too sweet or bitter, & the mint isnt too strong or weak either. A GREAT candy!
column10: A friend brought some of these over & I LOVE them. Normally with mints I tend to be wary because most mints have no flavor & the mint it way too strong, but these arent like that at all. They are sweet but not overly so, & you can actually taste flavor because the mint isnt beyond strong. I really like these, would recommend these, & will buy these in the future :).
If you like mild mints then this mint is for you.  I've always loved these candies and have eaten them all my life as I am from a British Commonwealth.  Very nice
Sadly, these incredible candy gems are totally addicting!!! What else can I say? :-)  I have to stop myself from watching TV and knocking off the entire bag in one sitting!!

I absolutely love these squares from Ghirardelli...I went thru the first 80 squares alot sooner than I expected so I had to hurry up and purchase another 80 before they became unavailable until next season...I wish these were year around because they are just that good IMO anyway

column9: Tastes like bits of orange peel
column10: Didn't care for this too much because it has bits of orange peel in it (I guess I didn't read the ingredients very well before buying it).  If it weren't for that it would be ok but I wouldn't buy this again.  The orange peel takes away from the taste of the chicken.
Excellent!!!  I have used on pork as well as chicken. It's wonderful. Any Durkee spice is a treasure to me.

I and my family have used this product for a long time and find it to be the best we have ever put on our fried chicken and even in chicken noodle soup. Anytime you cook chicken you can't go wrong using this product for seasoning. I can't say enough about this product. I thought they had stopped making it. Sure glad I was able to find it again.
Another homerun WEAVER'S! Love your brew and won't drink anything else. Great starter for my mornings . . .Also best pricing. Thank you!

column9: Excellent choice for a breakfast blend
column10: I have to admit, before I had this coffee, I was drinking a Turkish coffee... thick black and strong.  It took a couple of days for me to be able to appreciate this coffee for what it is.For a gentle wake up (not for those days when I need the sledge-hammer version of caffeine to get me started)... this is a great coffee.

Why drink anything else? If you respect coffee, there's nothing like Weaver's. I recommend this stuff to EVERYONE. It's absolutely unbelievable, it's the coffee that all coffee's try to be. Drink this stuff or don't bother drinking coffee...
I have tried almost all Weaver's Blends and single-origin coffee, and the aroma and flavor are always HUGE!  I will drink nothing else, ever.  Weaver's is always fresh!

If you choose only one coffee day in, day out, this has to be the one.  The Weaver's Blend Whole Bean is a great value and delivers the goods each and every time.  It's consistently smooth and flavorful and such a great value!

My guess is that the other reviewer has only had sodas filled with chemicals, so when one that isn't comes around it tastes strange to them. Really though, I'm a big fan of natural brewed sodas like this. Filled with herbs and spices and microbrewed, they just taste fantasticly deep in flavour and are hard to beat.

I had read that Fentiman's flavors were very strange.  So I was prepared, but they weren't as I had hoped--not exotic or complex but just a little different and not quite what I wanted.  My main interest was the cola, and it tastes different from Coke and Pepsi, but it isn't good enough in its own right to make me buy it.  A good choice if you are looking to try different drinks, but if you are looking for a daily drinking soda, you can pass on this sampler pack.
Maybe it's just me but this soda is really terrible. It taste like chemicals. I have tried many sodas, but none of this taste.
Love the taste, relaxes me when I'm stressed and wound up.  Wish it came with a scoop though.  Any chance of making a 5 lb can?

I can't find sugar free caramels anywhere, and I just happened to come across these in one grocery store (not my regular store).  I am now on a mission to figure out how to get these on a regular basis because they're so good.  I might cave and buy the Amazon 12-pack soon.

My kids know I have a sweet-tooth and that my favorite flavors are caramel and vanilla, so what better gift than GoLightly Sugar Free Vanilla Caramels, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) for Mother's Day!They also know I'm not supposed to have too much sugar and that of all the sweeteners, I prefer Splenda (the one in the yellow packet).  I know Mindy considered those points when she sent me a basket containing this product, along with other goodies...including a thrilling James Patterson book. (She also knows my book fetish. Grin!)Now you all know what I'm going to be doing while James keeps me up all night: munching! Woo-hoo!For more information about this product read the description at top of the page, then get your own supply. I'm stashing these in my bedroom and no one gets any but me! (That includes Mindy and the grandkids. Just call me selfish... LOL)Reviewed by: Betty Dravis, May 2009Author of "1106  Grand Boulevard"

column9: An organically grown coffee of exceptional quality and value
column10: I have become a bit of a French Roast snob, tasting as many as I can in search of THE one which pleases my palate best.  So far The Bean Coffee Company Le Bean Coffee (Dark French Roast), Organic Whole Bean, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2) is that very best one.I prefer organically grown coffee and this is 100% organically grown Arabica beans.  The fresh flavor has great depth and is rich and smooth.  The beans are beautiful ~ dark and glistening!  The aroma is heavenly.  The beans are low acid and antioxidant rich.  This is truly a coffee of exceptional quality!The Bean Coffee Company Le Bean Coffee (Dark French Roast), Organic Whole Bean, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2) is also an exceptional value at Amazon.  The price per pound with Amazon's Subscribe and Save program is better than the price per pound of organic French Roast coffees I have purchased elsewhere and the quality of this coffee is much better.I'm very happy to have found this wonderful organic French Roast coffee!

I ordered organic decaf  and organic regular dark french roast.  The decaf was organic but the regular french roast was not.The sticker with the bar code said Org WB.  I guess it got put on the wrong bag.  Since you can not return food items,  I guess I will be using  what I did not order.

Description says:Ingredients100% Arabica CoffeeOn back of bag it says "We use only the highest quality Arabica and Robusta Beans!" They sell a premium product and fill it with cheaper beans. The taste is bitter aftertaste instead a a clean aftertaste like 100% Arabica Beans give. Do not buy this if your looking for 100% Arabica Coffee

Truvia is the only brand of stevia sweeteners I've found that doesn't leave an aftertaste. Yes, Truvia is stevia, but they use only one part of the plant so the sweetening effect is concentrated. Packets are convenient to take with you to meetings, conferences, or on the plane. I've tried everything else: agave is now a no-no due to it mimicking a high glycemic load, coconut nectar is messy and it doesn't taste very sweet. Truvia is a great product - and no artificial chemicals. Plus, the packets are portable - take anywhere. No, it's not sugar, but it's the best all-natural product I've tried and I've tried many.

This is the best of all the non-sugar products to add sweetness.And I've tried them ALL !!  I just feel it's a bit pricey forthe average person/on an average to fixed income to purchase.With more people using it; I hope the price can go down a bit.I especially like the fact; it's made from the Stevia plant; & notjust a host of chemicals.
Really do like the taste of TRUVIA; however, it is too expensivefor me personally.  So, don't buy a lot of it.

column9: Ok if you like acetone, methanol, ethanol, acetonitrile, and isopropanol.
column10: Bought this thinking it was natural.  Boy was I wrong, REALLY WRONG!  Came across this AFTER buying the product.  I haven't used any of it nor will I, EVER!  Since I can't return it, it's heading to the trash bin.  I'll stick with my all natural xylitol, thank you very much!!  [...]  "First things first, is Truvia made from a leaf?  Well the answer is kinda, sorta.  Truvia has three ingredients:  erythritol, rebiana, and natural flavors.  Rebiana is made from the stevia leaf by soaking it in water.  Although Cargill whitewashes the process as similar to making tea, the truth is revealed in Coca-Cola's patent where it outlines a 40+ step process that includes the use of acetone, methanol, ethanol, acetonitrile, and isopropanol.  I don't know about you, but when I make a cup of tea, I've never used any of those ingredients."

I don't generally care too much for the healthy alternatives, especially when it comes to coffee. However, after trying Truvia at a hotel, I am now hooked. I usually get it at the grocery store, but it is good to see that it is available on Amazon, and now that I have Prime, I might just be getting it online instead.This sweetener tastes really good, and in addition to coffee, I have had it with desserts and it tastes great. I think it even tastes better than sugar, and definitely tastes better than splenda.I cannot comment as to the health aspects related to artificial sweeteners, but I'm sure that there is plenty of information available on the Internet related to that.As a casual coffee drinker, I highly recommend Truvia! However, you may want to try one of the smaller box sizes before purchasing a larger quantity, just be sure that you like it.
I bought this product thinking is was pourable and not in seperate pouches.  Maybe that is good so that I can add to taste and not use too much.

My sons just loves these Plum Organics squeeze packs. I started giving them to him around 6 or 7 months and he's done great with them. He struggled with acid reflux for most of his first year and I found that having a grain included in the food seemed to help with that. He is now 1 and still eating these as a supplement to solid foods.

I wish I could buy these on subscription like other groceries on Amazon.  I start getting nervous when we get low on this stuff.  The moment I touch the bag, my two cats and two dogs line up in a row and wait in eager anticipation for treat time. When we are out of them they all just wander around the kitchen scowling at me.  By a long shot, this is everybody's favorite treat.  And I love the fact that there's nothing else in these except chicken.  I know this product is designed to be sprinkled on top of food and when we get down to the bottom of the bag we use them for that, but for small dogs and cats, these make a great treat.  A big dog would probably devour the whole bag in a matter of minutes so I wouldn't bother for big dogs unless you wanted to use them as a training treat.  The chunks are small, but for my chihuahuas and cats they are practically a meal.If they seem pricey for the amount you get, remember that dehydration removes the water and without the water meat weighs about 1/4 of what it weighed when fully hydrated.  These aren't cheap by any measure, but they aren't ridiculously expensive either when you consider that one 4oz bag is made from about a pound of meat and unlike most treats they aren't packed with fillers.

My cats go nuts for this but it's way to expensive.  Also, I have purchased 10-20 bags at one time and alot of the bags contained mostly crushed, powdery ingredients in the bags.  I don't know why this is but I'm not going to spend all that money for powder instead of pieces of the treats.  It's a shame because it's an excellent product but who can afford it!

column9: Two Reviews:  The Salmon and The Chicken Breast
column10: The salmon toppers are one of my cats favorite packaged treats or meals, wet or dry.  It's healthy, grain-free, and to a large extent, shelf stable.  I'd highly recommend it for finicky eaters.  It works as as a stand alone meal with water or, as it's advertised, a topper to add some good nutrition to other cat foods and improve its flavor while doing so.The Salmon has has always been fresh on my subscription here. I mention this because the chicken breast toppers were not and I notice another review has mentioned the same.  Not only was it thoroughly stale, but there was no expiration date on the package where it normally is. I find both those things happening concurrently suspicious. I'm familiar with this product in Salmon, Chicken, and liver varieties. I've ordered it from another pet supply company for years then noticed the two pack price at Amazon was lower.  It's worth if for the salmon which has always fresh with clear expiration marked for the four times I've received it on subscribe and save, but not for the chicken breast which I canceled after the first month.  It's not the product itself, as much as some company involved in missing or just pawning off -expired pet food- through Amazon.While I think Real Food Toppers make the best freeze-dried Salmon, Halo Liv-a-Littles Natural Treats for Dogs and Cats, Freeze-Dried Chicken Breast Protein, 2.2oz is the best brand for Chicken in any case. It's much less sinewy and comes in larger chunks.

column9: Get your pet to do anything you want for this nutritious treat!
column10: Real Food Toppers are a healthy and nutritious snack.  I can get my cats to do anything for a treat.  When they don't want to eat their food, I crumble some toppers on their food and "presto" all of their food is gone.  I have made the mistake of leaving the Toppers in a place that a smart and resourceful pair can get, only to wake up in the morning to a chewed up empty bag of Toppers!  This treat will bring them out of hiding when I can't find them.  All of that and it's pure and nutritious.  Toppers are freeze dried chicken (or beef, salmon). Nothing else.  No added ingredients.  Try them.  You and your pet won't be disappointed!!!!!!

column9: Awesome for both cats and dogs!
column10: My cat and dog both love this salmon treat!  My dog is part shar-pei and needs to eat a special kind of sensitive skin food which he never really liked until we were given a bag of the salmon treats for our cat.  Well, of course she loves it because it's freeze dried salmon but what surprised me was that my dog loved it too!  Being that it is high in fatty-acids like he needs for his skin, we began mixing crushed treats into his food bowl.  He now gets excited for dinner time and eats his entire bowl (before he used to only eat when he was so hungry that he had to).  I love that it's all natural and is only one healthy ingredient: salmon.  The only downside to this product is the smell.  But that comes with anything fish flavored.  But if it makes my dog and cat happy than I am happy!
I call this "Kitty Crack" and all of my cats can't get enough of this.  I have one addicted cat that if given the opportunity will carry the bag into the nearest closet and eat the entire contents.

column9: Unacceptable quality--Real Food Toppers Chix Breast Treats
column10: I have purchased these freeze-dried natural chicken breast treats in the past from a few different suppliers so I know what to expect in terms of product characteristics & quality. I have a dentally-challenged senior cat who is diabetic (in remission), has a hyperthyroid condition & mega colon. He has lost several teeth so it was important that I find a treat for him that he likes that not only is natural, without additives or sugars but also has a soft, tender consistency that is easy for him to chew. These Real Food Toppers freeze-dried chicken breast pieces were the perfect solution & my cat loved them. They even print "soft to chew" right on the packaging. I found this 2-pack listing on Amazon with an outstanding discounted price so I decided my next order would be from Amazon (I also decided to make it an autoship subscription as well so saving even more $). Unfortunately, when the 1st shipment arrived I was quite disappointed to find chicken pieces that were dried up & hard -- maybe 15% of the pieces were soft enough to give my cat. In fact, because when I offer treats to my cat I normally have to break the large chunks into smaller bite-sized pieces, I found the majority of the product in this order to be so hard I could not even break them apart with my hands. If I attempted to cut them up into much smaller pieces with a knife so he could maybe chew those, the product simply disintegrated into crumbs. All 4 pouches in my order were the same unacceptable quality. I also determined that not a single one had a "best by" date on the packaging. Since every other package I'd ever purchased regardless of who the supplier was always had dates on them I figured these pouches must have been very, very old. Because I opened all 4 pouches thinking I'd eventually have to find some acceptable pieces I was unable to return the order. When I receive the 2d shipment if there are no dates on any of the pouches then I'll be returning the order (unopened) otherwise I'll open a pouch & if I find the contents unacceptable I'll return the shipment & cancel the remainder of the autoship subscription.
I ordered this tea just to try out since my Lopchu supply had runout. I was impressed with the flavor of this tea. The tea is good but some what expensive.

column9: $36 for 21 lbs of bad dog food? You can do a lot better!!!
column10: Look at the first three ingredients of the following products (the first ingredients on the list are the highest in the makeup of the food):Product A: Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, corn gluten mealProduct B: Chicken,chicken meal,whole grain brown riceDoes a product primarily composed of corn and "by-products" sound as healthy for your dog as one whose first two ingredients are chicken and followed up by rice, a quality grain? Do dogs feed themselves on primarily corn in the wild? Of course not.And what if I told you that Product B is sold for $30 per 40lb bag at Costco, while Product A is being sold at $36 for 21lbs worth of inferior food? Which sounds like the better deal to you?Do yourself a favor and save yourself some cash while also providing a healthier meal for your loved one. I'm not here to push Costco's Kirkland brand dog food, which is Product B in this comparison and is clearly a better value then Beneful. Blue Buffalo, Taste of the Wild, Canidae,etc are other examples of much higher quality foods that can be had for a lot cheaper. For once you can eat healthy AND save money.

column9: Worse dog food on the market!!! Don't buy this stuff!
column10: My dog was on this food for a while because i like many other people thought the veggies on the bag meant it was healthy but what it really means is their is no substance just corn and wheat gluten and dyes to color the food to make it look like vegetables. Please take it from me, my dog was chewing holes in his skin because of this food,i spent $700 at the vet for anti-histimine shots and creams and visits only to find out from my groomer that it was the food i was giving her. She was allergic to the dyes in it. I started giving her California naturals and she looked like she gained 3 years of her life back. Shiny coat, healthy glassy eyes, good energy and happier than she had been in a while. She is 14 now and i will never buy her anything but wonderful food like Nutro, California naturals, Merritt.

We had given our dogs (two beagles) beneful for a while.  They had *constant* gas.  We wrote it off as just normal.Well, we had to switch dog food brands for health reasons, and the gas stopped IMMEDIATELY!!  Do not give your dogs this dry dog food unless you own and want to constantly wear a gas mask!

column9: Do not feed your dogs beneful
column10: For everyone on here that says your dogs love it, there is reason they do. It contains sugar and sorbitol (another sweetener). I like Kruspy Kreme donuts...but I wouldn't eat them everyday. If I did, I'd turn out like my dogs who ate beneful....riddled with diabetes and other health problems. Try to imagine the pain of seeing your dogs go blind and eventully have their lives shortened. After finding out (too late) what was in beneful, I have no doubt that it was behind their health problems. I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

column10: Jolly Time Buttery Seasoning for Popcorn.  Just call it THE Popcorn Salt.  It's fine grained, doesn't clot and has a taste that doesn't overwhelm you.  Most "buttery" popcorn salts are too much this or too much that.  There are even a few that you have to refrigerate!My local Fred Meyer stopped selling the Jolly Time Popcorn about a year ago.  I've tried to get them to reorder it but they'd rather sell their own store brand.  I've tried every other popcorn salt I can find in the local stores but they're no good.  I'm glad to finally find it here on Amazon. I've used Jolly Time for nearly 10 years, so you can imagine how I stick to products I enjoy.

I use this stuff to cook with - it's indispensible for me in the kitchen and at the table because I count calories, but love the taste of butter.  McCormick made a very similar product, but it was discontinued about five years ago so I switched to this.  I was horrified to discover this month that the Jolly Time product is now apparently discontinued, too.  If you love this product like I do, better get a case.  The great thing is, it's no more expensive here than it was in the grocery store and it doesn't spoil.  Load up, the other "buttery" products on the market are dreadful compared to this.
Could no longer find this brand of Buttery seasoning for popcorn in our grocery stores. It is my husband's favorite (Jolly Time). He was quite surprised and pleased when he received it in the mail.

column9: Wonderful and a little goes a long way!!!!
column10: I recently started eating popcorn as a healthy alternative to potato chips and other high calorie snacks. While grocery shopping, I found this seasoning with the popcorn and was hesitant to purchase it. I was on the fence because it is high in sodium. Being that it doesn't have any calories, I decided to try it. I was very surprised as well as pleased with the flavor of this seasoning. IMO it tastes just like the popcorn served at the theater sans the greasiness and made me reminisce about being younger and getting popcorn from the neighborhood ice cream truck. Being that 12 jars is too much for my household, I will  give a few jars to family and friends. I paid about $2.00(maybe more, can't remember)for one jar at my local supermarket.When using the seasoning I would suggest lightly sprinkling some on the popcorn BEFORE pouring into the serving container. After pouring the popcorn into the container, sprinkle a small amount on top again, and shake the popcorn around to distribute the seasoning. Due to the high sodium content I would recommend experimenting with the amount used because sprinkling too much will cause your popcorn to be very salty.I have tried it on a baked potato and it wasn't too bad(I like a lot of butter flavor on my potato). I would definitely recommend to anyone who enjoys eating popcorn that you pop yourself and not the microwave type(prepackaged).
I can't find this salt anywhere in my county.  It is the best butter salt to add to any kind of popcorn.

column9: Best popcorn salt on the market
column10: We've tried every butter-flavored popcorn salt out there, and this one is definitely the best.  Unfortunately, you can't seem to find it in stores any more, so we ended up ordering a case from Amazon.  That's okay - great price, and we'll use it up.  Here's a low-calorie tip for your popcorn.  Air pop it or pop it in the microwave, then spray it with butter-flavored cooking spray or I Can't Believe It's Not Butter Spray (both don't have any calories), then dust it with this salt.  Great buttery flavor, high fiber, and low calorie!

column9: Jolly Time Popcorn Salt excellent!!!  There is no replacement product that even comes close!
column10: We have used this popcorn seasoning for YEARS(20 +)!  I have not been able to find it in stores for at least 1.5 years.  This is the best popcorn seasoning!  We have tried every other product available in stores and ended up throwing the product away!  We love our popcorn and pop it the old-fashioned way on the stove.  Since we have not had our popcorn seasoning in a while, we rarely pop and eat popcorn any more!  I'm glad I found this product on-line!  I decided to purchase  2 cases!!!Too bad the grocery stores stopped selling it!!!
This is the best topper for homemade popcorn that I have found. Nice buttery taste love this brand...so glad you carry it...

Taste pretty much exactly like movie theater popcorn when used with coconut oil.  You only need to add a little otherwise you'll have it to salty.  Seems like it'll last a life time to because there's 12 of them and I have plenty left in my first one and I've been using it for months.

column9: By far the best popcorn seasoning around
column10: I couldn't find my Jolly Time Buttery Seasoning in the pantry so I picked up some Kernel Season's Popcorn Seasoning at the store thinking it would taste the same. I got home and tried it out and it had a bitter, nasty taste to it. Blahh yuck! I rummaged through my pantry and finally found my Jolly Time seasoning, thank goodness.The Jolly Time seasoning has a light, buttery flavor that's not too salty, but just enough to make it feel like a treat. It only takes a tiny amount to make the popcorn taste movie theater worthy. It's simply amazing. Making fresh popcorn at home is the best, but without anything on top it tastes bland. Melting butter and drizzling it on top adds a lot of fat and it only covers a small percentage of the popcorn. The best way to make fresh popcorn is with quality kernels, a little olive oil mixed in with the kernels and this sprinkled on top right after the popcorn is done popping. That'll make your house the most popular place to be on movie nights!

column9: Yummy - and can't find anywhere else!
column10: I'm never without this product and order it by the case.  I use it mostly on popcorn - but it's also great on corn on the cob and other vegetables.  I'm glad I can get it on-line, as my stores used to carry it - but no longer do.  It's a delicious product and you get the buttery flavor without having to use butter and fat which add calories.

i ordered popcorn salt. not satisfied with order. only got 3 6oz bottles.  add said case of 12 so i ordered it because it was a very good deal.  i only got 3 bottles.  i feel i was lied to about the number i was to receive.  false advertisement as far as i was concerned. here is whats advertised.Item being reviewed Jolly Time Buttery Seasoning for Popcorn, 6-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)  i feel i should have gotten 12 bottles not 3 and i would really like the rest of my order at no extra charge.  thank you

I've been using this stuff for years and it's disappeared from grocery shelves.  I was ecstatic to find it on Amazon since my hoarded supply was nearly depleted.  This is far and away my favorite popcorn seasoning.  It's fine enough that it dissolves in the cooking oil during popping and you get no grit on your popped corn.  The taste is comparable to the best movie theater popcorn.
Not as good as I remember.  Bland none I am stuck with 11 more bottles.  We are big popcorn eaters and I really was hoping this would work, but no one liked it.

column9: Fine Textured, More Salt Taste Than Butter
column10: Received this shipment promptly, and it should last a lifetime !! The taste is salty. I think I expected more of a buttery flavor. I think I'd have to use way too much of it in order to get a butter taste, and I don't need that much sodium! Thus, the 3 stars. It is very fine textured, and just right for sprinkling on popcorn, but I plan to try it on baked potatoes, vegetables etc. [after all, I have a case of it]This is the only buttery seasoning I've tried so far in my guest for movie theater tasting popcorn. I don't think I'd recommend buying a case of 12 to anyone, unless you go in with other people and split it a few ways. I did look for this in several grocery stores, and was unable to find it. That's the reason I ordered it as I did. It was only available as a case.Something I have found in "my movie theater popcorn quest"  is using buttery flavor spray from the dairy section. The one that says I Can't Believe It's Not on the label. It's good to take it out of the fridge a little while before using to let the chill leave it. It's not bad on popcorn and baked potatoes, Irish or sweet.

I had high hopes for this product.My kids consume popcorn by the bucketful and are always asking for the "butter kind."  I can rationalize feeding them popcorn as a snack because, after all, it's a vegetable of sorts, and I'll even salt it a little for them once in a while, but I can't bring myself to add lots of butter each time.  When I came across this Jolly Time Buttery Seasoning, I thought that all our prayers had been answered--buttery flavor for the kiddos without the added mess and fat of butter.  Excitedly, I tried the seasoning on a little late night snack for myself and simply couldn't gag it down.  It smelled wretched and tasted even worse.  Still, I remained hopeful.  My kids are the kind that eat all their broccoli and brussel sprouts, so I crossed my fingers that I'd eventually be able to use all 12 containers of the vile stuff.  I was wrong.  My little 4-year-old found my half-eaten bowl the next morning and proclaimed that it smelled "like throw up."  (Her words, not mine.) I tried to sneak a few shakes into their morning bowl of popcorn over the next few days, but they wouldn't take the bait.  Brussel sprouts, yes.  Jolly Time Buttery Seasoning, no way.  It's THAT bad.

The reviews for Jolly Time Buttery Seasoning were good, the price was considerably lower than other popcorn toppings, and I thought I'd give it a try.  Well . . . I've tried it, and, sorry to say, it's nothing but colored salt.  I guess the moral of the story is that one gets what one pays for; however, in this case, salt would have been much cheaper.

I purchased a different Finnska licorice and was about to re-order but it was out of stock, so I ordered this one. Just not as good as the other. A little harder to chew and doesn't have the same intense flavor. It must be the difference in shape, since it is the same brand.
Tastes exactly like coffee with no sugars! PERFECT! This is also a really good deal as these bottles can run up to $7 each in stores! Will definitely buy them again when I need to!

My wife was addicted to Dannon coffee yogurt, and constantly searching for it, since stores that do carry it never stock enough, and she would often find that the previous addict had cleaned out the stock.  With this extract, and home-cultured or store-bought plain yogurt, along with a little sweetener, she can make a perfectly acceptable substitute.  I have taken to eating it myself.  The bottles seem expensive, but a little goes a long way, and it has a rich, true coffee taste.  It would probably be excellent for coffee ice cream as well.

column9: best training treat for dogs----  ALL dogs love it
column10: Freeze dried liver has a hypnotic effect on dogs.  They LOVE it and will do just about anything for it, so it is a great treat to use for training.  (Powdered freeze dried liver is even added to many dog medicines nowadays-- heartworm and arthritis tablets, etc.-- because it causes the dog to scarf the medicine down like a treat.)Freeze dried liver has a dry, hard, yet powdery/easy to chew consistency.  It comes chopped/cubed.  It is extremely lightweight due to the fact there is so little moisture in the product (thus the low weights on product labels).Even though your dog will love liver treats, you shouldn't overfeed it.  The manufacturer recommends 1-2 cubes daily for small dogs, 2-3 cubes for medium dogs, and 3-4 cubes for large dogs.The largest package sizes of liver treats tend to be far more economical.  I recommend buying the larger tubs, as you will save lots of money, you'll have a handy treat supply around for a longer time, and your dog will never tire of this product.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~Here's the nutritional analysis:-100% freeze dried liver-NO additives or preservatives.-Crude protein..... not less than 50%-Crude fat.....  not less than 5%-Crude fiber.....  not more than 3%-Moisture.....  not more than 6%

My dog loves this product.  The company is great to do business with. I have ordered from them before. They contact you immediately after placing the order and it arrives within days.  I can't recommend them higher.
Duffy (The dog) begs for them.  He sits up begging in the corner by the canister for these treats.  We have to ration them out to him.
If you want/need something your dog will love, this stuff is like crack to our dogs. They will even come to get there hair cuts if we wave these treats at them. It's wonderful.
These capers go great on top of our fish. We just love how they taste along with the seafood and aioli sauce. We will re-order these, but the case of 12 have lasted a long time so far.
This make a really rich cup of chocolate!  It's smooth, creamy, and has a great rich flavor.
This is absolutely the best chocolate mix on the planet.  Rich, deep chocolate flavor.  Very hard to find, though.  Nestle, please, make more of this stuff.
Carlos V is the best! My housemate brought some with him when we moved in together, and it was unbelievably delicious. We promptly finished it off...thank goodness for Amazon. ;)

I have been eating this particular hot sauce for years now and I have to say, hands down, it is the best hot sauce for flavor plus heat. I am addicted and my cupboard always has an ample supply on hand.This particular product is El Yucateco's hottest and, in my opinion, the tastiest. Other hot sauces may indeed be hot, but this one packs a whole lot of flavor that the others just plain lack. If you are (still) sensitive to this much heat, I would recommend their green habenero hot sauce. It's a little less potent and still quite flavorful.

column9: A solid choice for hot sauce
column10: El Yucateco ("one from the Yucatán") is a powerful hot sauce. After traveling extensively in the south of México, I had a hankering for the heat and tastes of the foods typical of that area. I was pleasantly surprised when I tried this. There is a good deal of heat, not overpowering, and not to the detriment of the taste of the sauce.As far as characterizing the taste, I would describe it as very "earthy". You definitely can detect the habanero, but there is a complex multitude of other spices that come out after the initial heat subsides. Other sauces this hot I find sacrifice unique taste for heat. A good sign is that if this sauce was not spicy, I would still use it.I am not a very technical cook, so I cannot honestly tell you what dishes this sauce is most appropriate for. I can tell you however that it enhanced every dish I used it on, from adding heat to burritos, to making some plain rice more interesting.I would advise those sensitive to hot sauces to first test this on a toothpick. Also when cooking with it, make sure to pour the sauce into a spoon first, because a little bit of this sauce goes a long way, and the heat does take a minute or two to start to dissipate, you wouldn't want to ruin an entire dish by adding too much heat. I would most definitely buy this sauce again!
This has good flavor but be warned it is quite HOT as well. Enjoy:-)

This hot sauce manages to do what few truly hot sauces can--provide heat and flavor in equal amounts.  The sauce has a nice slow burn that can catch you off guard if you eat too much or aren't used to it, but the flavor is the real showstopper.  Unlike many hot sauces, the sauce has a rich flavor that adds a delicious taste to almost anything you add it to from pizza to fajitas.

Extra Hot, Extra Flavorfull.  Only drawback is that it's potancy gives it a tendancy to overwhelm any subtle flavors you may have been building in your dish.  Use sparingly if you want other, less bold flavors to come through.

Hot but not extremely so, this sauce has a great flavor. Ditto the other reviews. I love the red and green El Yucateco habanero sauces so when I saw this one, I thought I would give it a try. I have a new favorite sauce.
Normally an extremely hot sauce doesn't have a good flavor but this one does. it's just not made for daring friends to eat it.

This is a great product!  However the price here is ridiculous!  I regularly buy it here in Texas and my local grocer(NOT WALMART) for a $1.49.  I guess if you have to have it then cost is no option!  Because it is a great tasting and fiery condiment!

This hot sauce has a fantastic flavor. However, it was not as hot as I'd expected. I assumed habanero hot sauce would be enough to REALLY spice up a dish, since I can't eat a whole habanero without my eyes welling up with tears. This was not the case. This stuff is really mild compared to the pepper it's made from.That said, I have no regrets about buying this product. If you're looking for a really tasty, fairly thick sauce that's comparable to tabasco in heat, this sauce is for you. If you want something that will kick up a burrito all on it's own, look elsewhere.
This is way better than Tabasco and far cheaper too.  Buy it at Walmart, since that is where it's cheapest.

column9: Too hot for casual chili eaters
column10: This isn't lying when it says it's hot. For a niche fire sauce it's mild, I'm sure, but for a mainstream sauce it's a little too hot to start with. You have to get used to it after a few months. And once you get used to it I bet it won't suit your heat needs, so it ends up moot.  Also, this sauce has a good but specific flavor that in my opinion only goes well with certain foods such as the richer Mexican foods, perhaps others. That's why I prefer the milder red one of this brand. The red one with a less spiced habanero flavor is easier to use once in a while without the need to get used to the heat, and the flavor goes well with more variety of foods, in my opinion.

I have tasted several types of hot sauces and regularly use peppers in my cooking, even Habaneros.  It started out with Daves Insanity.  I do not use it much any longer because even though it many be HOT, it does not have the flavor and the slow burn that this sauce has.  I ordered 8 bottles and I am giving some to my relatives that love hot and flavor.  I know they will love it and use the amount that they are use to, but may gradually become addicted.  I will order more very soon because I, and my husband are really addicted to this very flavorful product, which by the way was difficult to find in specialty "hot sauce" stores.  I discovered it in a Mexican restaurant in Sausalito, CA.; I immediately copied down every word on the label until I found it on Amazon about 3-4 months later.  Thank you, "restaurant",  for making the food even better!

after having a friend bring me a bottle in Germany, the bag fell into the wheel of my bike and tore the neck off : (It was a bit embarrassing licking all the sauce off the spokes, but it was worth it.

I used this making mango habanero sauce for chicken and it was good but when I put a line in a veggie, mushroom and cheese omelet it was pure bliss.  It will definitely perk up your veggie dishes, just don't add too much.  Yum!!

I've been looking for a sauce that would take me to the next level beyond Jalapeno without getting too extreme. With some liberal doses I'll start to tear a little bit which was exactly what I was looking for. I've tried some other habanero sauces around this level and this one tastes the best by far. I'll make sure to keep this sauce around in the future.

I love this stuff. I'm on my second bottle. Not too hot that you can't pour it on your tacos (YMMV). Slightly garlicky but not overbearingly so. It's not vinegary like Tabasco and it's thick kinda like ketchup. The green color is quite bright and appealing.I give it four stars because it has preservatives and artificial colorings.
This sauce has just the right amount of heat. Its neither "oh my god my mouth is on fire" nor "is that all you got ?" kind of hot. I love it, can be used to spice up any kind of bland food.

This is a great habanero sauce, with really good flavor and a nice level of heat. It's not just hot for hot's sake. There are plenty of much more fiery sauces for true capsaicin fanatics and macho guys trying to impress party-goers. But don't underestimate the kick. If you think Tabasco Sauce (also a favorite for Cajun) is hot, be careful with El Yucateco. I love this stuff!

column9: Not very hot, not very flavorful.
column10: This "hot" sauce is not particularly hot and not especially flavorful. I find myself using more than a tablespoon of this sauce to flavor a 112 ounce bottle of unflavored salsa. With a truly hot sauce it requires 4 - 6 drops to get the same degree of heat in the same amount of salsa. I live in the South and can find better hot sauce at half the price in my local high end supermarket.J.R. Wilt
I needed these Juniper berries fora Sauerbraten recipe.  Couldn't find them in any store, so was pleased to find them here.  Very pleased with transaction.  Will be back!

The supplier emailed me to check whether I wanted green or black berries which I thought was an impressive followup. The berries arrived in a plastic bag when I was expecting a glass container as per the advertising pitcure. However, all in all I was happy with the service and the product.
These juniper berries were exactly what I needed to cook a few German and Danish dishes.  I was happy to find these online since the local grocery store doesn't carry them.
Good price on these and they seem to be of good quality.  I can only give it 4 stars since there is some debris in each bag that has to be filtered out before use.

This is one of the greatest things I have ever given my dog. He is a puppy, so it's taking him a long time to even show that he has been chewing on the antler. Antlers are much better than hoofs, rawhide, etc. because there is no mess or bad smell.

column9: Good deal, exactly what I was looking for
column10: I was a little wary purchasing these since they had no reviews and since their price was lower than many other antlers, but I was pleasantly surprised. The medium is a good size for my 35 pound mixed breed who is a VERY intense chewer (actually a bit bigger than I was expecting). No splintering and plenty of good marrow for her to work on. She's gnawed away about half the antler in three weeks, so comparable to other antlers she's had. She loves them, and when this one is done I'll be ordering more.

column9: Excatally what I was looking for, a perfect fit!
column10: My 60 LBS english shepherd used to be an intense chewer. After growing out of her puppy-hood, she's dialed back the urge to gnaw on anything and everything. That being said, she still enjoys the occasional rawhide roll or dental chew.Normally those don't last her long, and with the rawhide rolls, it leaves behind a stains that can be a huge pain to clean (if they can be cleaned at all). Enter the Antler chew!This is perfect, she loves chewing it and it leaves behind no mess whatsoever. She's had it for a bit over a week and it's still looks brand new, she's done very little damage to it. Once she's made her way through this one, we'll definitely be ordering more, a fantastic product and deal.

column9: GREAT Product - But DON'T order in hot weather!
column10: Awesome snack, healthy and despite previous negative reviews these ARE gluten free and contain NO msg.  The product itself gets a 5 star review from me and my family.  HOWEVER, I have ordered these many times from Amazon and will never order them again in summer months or warm weather.  Even though they don't require refrigeration until after you open the package, my July shipment was mostly ruined from the heat.  I watched for delivery and picked them up within 2 hours of delivery at my mailbox but they had a smooshy and gross texture, a texture that remained even after refrigeration.  Alot of dog treats in this shipment, but I'll know for next time. I still gave them five stars because the snacks are great when kept in normal temperatures.

My husband loves this stuff and it isn't always at the grocery store.  So I was thrilled to find it on amazon and for such a great price.  I usually pay around $7.00/bag for this so this was a considerable savings.  I will definately buy again.
The Old Wisconsin Turkey Snack Bites are healthy and delicious.  They can be part of a great dieter's lunch.  Good value for the price, also.
I love these bites & can not get them where I live in Wyoming. Great to know that once a month I'll get a new supply
These Turkey Snack Bites taste great, just enough spicy to give it a light kick.  My only warning is that it's hard to NOT eat the whole bag!

I started ordering the turkey snack bites when searching for a no carb snack with a high protein ratio and these fit the bill.Using subscribe and save I get a shipment once a month and pay under $3 a bag.  They are perfectly shelf stable, but I preferto have them refrigerated prior to eating.  The spice level is perfect for me and my six year old loves them as well.  For snacktime we often will have these along with some cheese.  This was also a go to snack for me while pregnant, a protein boostwith flavor, but not heavy on grease and spice that would cause indigestion.6 bites80 calories7 grams proteinno sugars/carbs

column9: I really enjoy these as a low carbohydrate snack or as a Hors d'oeuvre.
column10: Old Wisconsin Beef SausageI really enjoy these as a low carbohydrate snack or as a Hors d'oeuvre.  As an  Hors d'oeuvre you might want to cut each stick into 4 or 5 pieces.  I'll bet they would be good with a cheese dip.

First time I ordered these they were great.Second time around, not so much...Ordered on 10/14/10...Arrived on 10/18/10...Expiration date of 03/16/11...Unopened, air-tight package... gross, moldy, and rotting inside on 11/01/10.Won't be going back for thirds.

I love these because they are no carb, and lower in saturated fat than the beef snacks.  They are just spicy enough for me, and do not leave a greasy aftertaste.  By using "subscribe and save", these cost me the same as at Kroger's, but are more convenient.  Please ignore the negative review...it is not even for these TURKEY snacks.  This product makes being diabetic a little easier.

column9: Review by A Brown was not even for this product
column10: The "Turkey" snack sticks are very good.I do not normally like meat sticks.I was surprised to find that I liked these.Listed Ingredients does not list MSG and states the casing is gluten free.

I unpacked the box of Old Wisconsin turkey snack bite sausage pieces and put the separate packages on my pantry shelf and kept one out to open and my mouth was watering.  After the first package was consumed I took another package of them out of the pantry and started in on it.  Wasn't too much later in the following week I noticed a pretty unpleasant smell in the pantry.  I thought for sure a rodent had got trapped somehow and probably died and was slowly rotting somewhere I could not see nor could I find anything of the sort.  The smell lasted and I scratched my head and wondered if the dead thing would eventually just dry up. Pretty soon my whole place smelled like the county landfill on a busy day. Well, it wasn't too long I went to grab another bag of the turkey sausage and gosh I found out the hard way where the small was emanating from all this time.  The bag of sausage I had just picked up was all rotted inside and it was totally putrid.  It was totally disgusting and it made my stomach feel a tad queasy.  I took the bag out and placed it in my garbage can and now I just can't wait till the City of Oswego KS comes and empties that can at the landfill. I have had my fill of this stuff! I doubt I will ever buy sausages from this company again!
I added it sliced into sauteed veggies and onions.  Made a delcious appetizer - no real cooking and great lunch and dinner for myself.

My turkey sauage bites arrived before time and in great condition.But, because of the bad reviews, I opened all 6 packages to check them out--perfect.  Now, what to do with 6-8oz packes of sauage!  I put a covered dish by my computer and another by my viewing chair.  I made a variety of flavors out of the rest in 4oz wide mouth ball jars---one with bay leave and heated pickle juice; whole peppercorns and hot peppers; mixed with sundried tomatoes packed in grapeseed oil and capers; slice some to go on pizzas, salads, popcorn and made a great spicy dip with garlic and red onions.  Can't wait for my next shipment!!

Although the package says to refrigerate after opening, I didn't notice this, and my first package started to get moldy. My second, in the fridge, lasted a long while. Good for on the go, in soups, and even salads.

column9: Great price for a great product
column10: I have purchased this item locally for almost double the cost.  The quality of the product and the packaging was excellent

The perfect low carb snack with just the right amount of crunch and spice.  I really like these little meaty pieces.I keep mine in the freezer and just take a package out when needed, so have never had to worry about the mold that some pple talk about.  I find they keep for a long time once opened as long as I keep them in the fridge.They are just yummy

I started a high protien diet and started buying these as snacks whenever I got hungry... now I am addicted to them.  Very tasty and a pleasing texture when you bite into them.  These are helping, because I've lost 20 lbs since starting my protien diet.  Will continue to make these part of our normal snack regiment.

We got the Turkey and we really like it. There are only 1.5 grams of saturated fat in 6 bite size pieces and zero trans fat, less than 1 carb plus 7 grams of protein.Refrigerate after opening, makes a good low carb snack, I take with me on mountain bike rides for protein.The taste is mild with no strong aftertaste, I wish the expiration dates were further out however. We ordered in January and received the product in January with an expiration date of August. We order no more than we will use in about 6 or 7 months.Altogether the turkey is a good product and handy snack. I would give 5 stars if the shelf life expiration dates were a bit further out.

My first experience with this brand, and I cut my gum on a small bone that was inside of one of the snacks.  I have had many beef stick products, and never found a bone inside.  If you buy from this company, dont bite too hard the first few chews?

My family and I really like these snacks. Yes, they are processed food and not the healthiest thing to eat, but they are a good quick snack that tastes good and is a bit healthier than the beef and/or pork options out there. I like the fact that they are shelf stable, so we can grab a bag to take with us in case we don't have any other food options (travelling, etc.), and that is the main reason we buy them.We have noticed that these are packaged under a few different brand names, but I can't always find them locally. The price here on Amazon is competitive with our local retailers, so we buy these here when we run out and cannot find them elsewhere.

column9: Great at first, but HUGE mold problem.
column10: Sure, they tasted great at first, and I was happy to order my kids a healthy meat snack without all those artifical cancer causing ingredients.  Problem is, that after a short period of time (way before the expiration date), half the packages molded disgustingly inside.  We have a completely air conditioned house, they were stored in a cool pantry that is mostly kept dark.  Reading the other reviews, I know I am not the only one with this problem.  Something is wrong with the packaging process, or the cooking process, but these rot fast UNOPENED.  Don't bother with this, find another product and don't waste your money =/
I'm working out, so I bought it for extra lean protein intake. Like it so far. Tastes great. I would definitely recommend to others.
I am sorry, I found the taste of these unpalatable. They were too spicy for me.  I was also upset that I got turkey instead of the beef that I ordered.

These are a great meaty snack to keep at your desk.  They've got a great smoky flavor and a velvety texture, and the casing has just the right amount of pop.
