Will definitely buy from Yankee Traders again.

column9: Oh, this stuff is the BEST!!!!
column10: Oh, YES, PLEASE, do bring this onto Subscribe-and-Save!!!  This garlic-flavored Tabasco sauce is out of this world.  My husband would never let go of his passion for Frank's Red Hot (which actually won kudos from America's Test Kitchen), despite my preference for Tabasco.  Then he discovered this NEW Tabasco version with garlic (the magic ingredient in Frank's Red Hot).  He now, despite himself, admits to liking the snootier product even better than his own staple!!  And he brought it to a community dinner last week along with his famous chili, and people absolutely raved about the new condiment.We need this on subscribe-and-save.  We run out of it much too fast.  It's incredibly good!!!

This is a mild curry with surprisingly strong flavor. I have used it for years, but ran out a while back and had trouble finding it so was forced to used other curries. I tried several and none had the wide range of flavors that is characteristic of Ship Brand without absolutely eliminating all others. Curries can take over food so that the taste of vegetables and other ingredients are completely lost. Other curries are too mild and have an uniform taste. Not so with Ship Brand. The taste is mild enough to allow other flavors to shine without being tasteless or bland.I highly recommend this curry.

I'm new to home curry cooking and have been using those teeny little expensive containers from the spice section of the grocery store. I was a bit anxious that, if I didn't like the flavor of this, I'd have a big tin of curry powder sitting there forever. But this stuff is great! It's a nice, deep flavor, plenty spicy enough for my taste. I've used this in two dishes so far along with other spices like cumin and cinnamon and enjoyed every bite!
I WANT MORE! PLEASE RESTOCK!!!!!This is the best tasting Vitamin Water to DATE IMO.The NATURAL BLUE AGAVE SWEETNESS reminds me of capri-son citrus punch

We have been trying all sorts of flavors of Earth's Best and really, it's going to depend on what your baby likes and doesn't, so I hadn't planned on writing a review of them, except that this flavor got one star because some 65-year-old person complained it tastes like baby food!  Well, duh, it's not made or meant for older people with stomach issues, it's for babies.  Earth's Best is a good line of Organic baby foods and for what's it's worth, our baby likes the flavor.  It tastes kind of like spaghetti sauce.

Our baby loves fruit, as a lot of babies do.  It's the vegetables that we have a hard time getting her to eat.  So we figured a mixture of tomato & carrot might be a good starting point.  It's a bit watery, but we tend to thicken our daughter's food with organic baby oatmeal or brown rice anyways.  This food just requires a bit more thickening.  The first time eating this, she did not get the bitter face look (we all know that face--when a baby eats a new taste for the first time & just doesn't know how to deal!)  She ate the entire jar at one sitting for the first try!  Not too bad if you ask me, especially since we could not get her to eat any other veggies in the past.We always use bibs during feeding times, but food just somehow ends up getting on the baby's clothes no matter how careful you are.  This blend is diffuclt to remove from laundry if you don't spot treat it and wash it right away.  So, just keep this in mind when feeding the baby.Everything else about this food is great.  Will definitely buy again!
i have been giving my son earth's best jared food since he was 4 mo old, i have tried every flavor and this one is one of his favorites, great price on amazon.com thanks.

That's all we really want, right? Is for our kids to eat the food?? Well, my girl won't eat everything, but she will eat this. I plan on using it in the future with some whole wheat pasta (she's transitioning to chunkier foods). I think it will make a nice mini-spaghetti type dish for her.

column9: One of my baby's favorite flavors!
column10: You don't often find tomato in a baby food, and it really does smell and taste like tomato! My baby likes this flavor sooooo much that we are finally ordering an entire case (pack) of it, instead of just getting three of them in the Earth's Best 2nd Antioxidant Variety Pack, 4 Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)!! I do wish it was a little thicker, as it's one of the runnier/thinner Stage 2 foods, but I still highly recommend it!
This was my son's favorite of all his baby foods. We easily went through a few cases of this one alone. I do suggest getting the subscribe and save. As always, earth's best was the best!

Earth's Best makes the BEST organic baby food ever! I'm a first-time mom and this product was recommended to me by several friends. What I like most about them is they taste very fresh and high-quality. A lot of them even smell fresh too. My son doesn't like the fruit combinations very much, but the vegetable variety are his favorites. I will continue using this brand for as long as possible. While a little bit pricier than other brands, but I think it's worth it for your little precious one.  I was skeptical about this tomato and carrot blend being too tart, but so far my 7-month old loves it.

I started introducing Earth's Best Baby Jarred Food at 10 weeks to my daughter.  It was slow going at first, but at 6 months, she eats 8-12 ounces of baby food per day + her regular milk intake.  Carrot Tomato is her favorite.  If she isn't in the mood for something else, I always grab this as a backup and she snarfs it down.  But, my baby loves things like Apricots and Squash, so she may be a bit weird too.

Does organic baby food make a difference? I don't think anyone knows for sure. But we buy organic because it makes sense that for a smaller brain that is still developing amonuts of pesticides and other toxics that would have a neligble effect on an adult brain would have potentially a larger and more significant impact on an infant brain.So that is why we buy organic. This is one of the better tasting Earth's Best. Yes I do taste them. I would actually eat this one. Our 9 month old daughter likes it. It has organic carrots as the first ingrident (I will post the ingrident list directly from Earth's Best website below), good source of Vitamin A (150% RDA), and it is also one of the least expensive 12 packs of Earth's Best. Recommended.Organic Carrots, Water, Organic Tomato Paste, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Citric Acid.

I am impressed with the line of antioxidant blends. Like others mentioned it is not usual to find tomato in baby foods. I was curious to see if my son would like and he loves it. I do try to avoid giving it two days in a row though becauae it makes it a little constipated. I am happy with Amazon's "grocery" business. It is great to have the convenience to order these on-line and have home delivery. I think it is a great price and I have not had any shipping issues.
it's a great product , and good for my baby when she was between 4-6 month .

Again, I understand why my babies wouldn't eat babyfood. But as babyfood goes, the carrot tomato blend is almost edible provided salt is added. I should mention I have no babies. I am 65 and I have just had stomach surgery. Babyfood is one of the things that is not supposed to upset my stomach. Well, I'll admit I haven't had a barfing attack after eating babyfood, but on the other hand, I find it difficult to get down a whole jar. I'm used to food that tastes like food.

This is one of my favorite Indian sweets & this brand is as close to a homemade taste as you can get without making it yourself. For Americans unfamiliar with Indian sweets, the best analogy I can give you for soan papdi is that it tastes & feels similar to the inside of a very soft, very fresh Butterfinger... except the nuts used for flavoring are pistachio and almond instead of peanut. It also has about 1/10 the calories and melts in your mouth. Loooove it!
I was introduced to this by a co-worker and I couldn't get enough!! I never knew these sweets existed.  Delicious!

The company gets a 5 star for rapid fast shipping and great customer service! The product gets a 5 star for the flavor. I can get addicted to this brand of Soan Papdi! If you are "new" to Indian Sweets and like the inside of a Butterfinger Candy bar, than you will love this. Not too sweet, and yet crispity, crunchity, delicately sweet with complex flavors of heaven!I will for sure be ordering this regularly.Warmly,Jackie

If you like Earl Grey tea, then you will LOVE this tea.  A friend of mine used to own a tea shop, and got me started on this tea.  It is mellow, and absolutely perfect in every way.  The leaves are large, so you know  are getting a very good quality tea.  Since it is in bulk rather than in tea bags, you can make your beverage as light or potent as you would like.  Enjoy!

I purchased this product at a little shop in Venice last year. I had been looking everywhere for a "traditional" bottle. This is simply heaven over ice cream or cheese. I use this for very special occasions and it has never disappointed.The packaging includes some very nice recipes and other serving suggestions.

Beautiful item, wonderfully packaged so it arrived in great shape.The candy assortment was great fun, inspiring lots of reminiscing about where and when everyone had this type of candy before.  Great conversation piece, very tasty, overall great fun.
My dogs love this but it is made in China. Had I known I would not have purchased them. They need to reveal this in the product description

If your dog loves peanut butter, it will love SmartBones Peanut Butter Dog Chew. I purchased the 8-pack Mini and is my dog JJ's favorite treat. Product should be offered in larger quantities, maybe 12 to 24 in a package as they don't last long in our house!

column9: Much better and safer than rawhide
column10: My dogs love these and so much easier on them than rawhide bones.  I buy these all the time!  And they love peanut butter flavor!

column9: Smart Bones? What bones?  Gobbled em' down!
column10: Seller had the product out and to us very fast, TY.  The only thing wrong with the product was there wasn't enough to last!!  My Goldens ate them up in a couple of bites:0) Better buy a bunch!!!
The price is good, size is perfect...but my dog doesn't like them at all. Would not buy again sorry. Not the products fault

column9: smarrtBones, peanut vbutter dog chew, mini 16-pack
column10: What a great product for dogs. My mini doxie just loves these chew and to top it of, she loves the peanut butter favor. The day is  complete when she is given one. If she doen't eat it at once, she will hide it for later or carry it around with her. This flavor is the only one that she eats. I purchase the mini size because it is not too big for her and she can handle it for eating or carrying it around.
My dog loves the taste of these...they're a nice change from rawhides..I feel like I can give him treats more often

My dogs recognize the package & the sound of the tear-off top. As soon as they get a whiff of that peanut-butter flavor, they start dancing & prancing around me!  I''ve gotten these before - the only negative part is the dogs snarf these up too fast!
My dog loves the flavor and texture of these bones! Since they are dried, they allow that stiff resistance for bigger dogs mouths without the rawhide. Great product.
Great product! My pup is spoiled but these treats are his favorite.  He loves the peanut butter flavored ones the best.
SmartBones are a wonderful treat for your dogss.  My two Dachushunds love the peanut butter flavor.  Not only do they love them they are wonderful for them.

My dogs LOVE these Smartbones!  So much so that they sometimes turn their noses at other treats I try to give them.  These bones are a great alternative to rawhide, and Amazon & Co. have some of the lowest prices on them.  I have seen them sold for as high as $15.99 in some local stores.  The only downside is that they do not last very long, as they are so easy to chew through.  My dogs (Lab mix and Boxer mix) power through the medium and large sized bones in just a few minutes.  Still, all in all, worth the money!

These are the best bones for your dogs.  No rawhide and my labs love them.  Well work the money.  I have been ordering these for about 3months now and always a great transaction.  Delievery has arrived either on time or early. A++++++++++++++++++
My dogs love them.  They don't last very long with the larger dog. Will order more some time. Good price.
Our Cocker Spaniel Tinker Bell got this from Santa, and she picked it over all the other treats. It was gone in no time.

column9: My dog loves Peanut Butter Smart Bones!
column10: My dog loves Smart Bones Peanut Butter Dog Chew Minis...your dog will love them too! Good for digestion and affordable.

column4: Jeri Zerr "formerly a Road Rarrior of the Nth...
column10: Our family avoids chemicals as much as possible, so we use coconut oil for cooking, haircare, skincare and more!We use coconut oil as a moisturizer in place of skin lotion (add a couple drops of a good quality essential oil!) We use coconut oil to saute or steam saute foods; I use a spoonful of coconut oil in our stainless steel cookware so foods NEVER stick! We also use it in our microwave popcorn popper with sea salt for the healthiest, tastiest popcorn around!Coconut is a solid at cooler temperatures, it will turn to liquid when warmed "slightly" to the mid 70s.  Hence I store this bottle above our stove / microwave so it's usually a liquid. To make it MUCH easier to use, I have a wide mouth glass jar that I keep refilled.  When the jar turns solid I can still scoop the oil paste out with a spoon.
Hands down the best quality of coconut oill I have used and will continue to use from this company. It has a light nutty almond smell. I use it on my hair, skin and to cook with!

I purchased this product and was very unhappy. For starters, since you have to warm this oil up a little to get it into its liquid form, I found that the dispensing part was HORRIBLE. I could barely get any out.. even after warming it up a tad, Also I think the one that I got was rancid, it did not smell pleasant. I will not by this brand again. If I could give it no stars I would.
This oil is great, it smells like roasted coconut and you can actually eat it!

column9: BAD Smell, WORSE Packaging, not virgin
column10: I've been buying other brands of coconut oil from Amazon such as Nature's Way and Nutiva. Those are good brands. I ran out and I saw this brand at my grocery store so I bought it. First of all, the packaging... it comes in bottle that is just like a shampoo bottle, cheap plastic and not at all appetizing... and then the most ridiculous thing of all is the teeny tiny spout for dispensing the product--coconut oil is a SOLID at room temperature! How are you supposed to dispense a SOLID out of this teeny spout!?!I had to do as others did, I warmed the bottle until the oil melted and I poured it all into another more practical container, a jar. But immediately the oil smells BAD, it has a burnt smell. And unlike the pure white virgin coconut oils from the other suppliers I mentioned, this has a brown tint and some brown gunk that settles to the bottom of the jar. Yuck! This oil is NOT extra virgin, or even virgin coconut oil like the others. It seems very cheap and impure. For all I know they used solvents to extract it. It's very suspect.I used it for cooking until I could buy a better brand. It's OK for on your skin, but that's about it. I will never buy this again.

I bought this to use on my hair, because I had heard it does wonders and it was only about $7, so why not try it? My hair is curly, and naturally dry and delicate. I've dyed and flat ironed it too many times, so it was pretty damaged and breaking off. I'm getting married in 8 months and really wanted to get my hair healthy again!I have used this as a deep conditioner, by wetting my hair and applying a liberal amount of the oil all over my head, concentrating on the ends. I then put on a plastic shower cap and let it sit for at least 2 hours. When you shampoo, make sure you use a clarifying shampoo and wash it at least twice to get all the oil out. It leaves my hair so silky and hydrated! And it's not like some deep conditioners out there that only give you results the first day and after that your hair is dry again--this stuff really works!I also use it as a leave in conditioner in my hair, especially when I'm wearing my hair curly (I let it air dry). I have also used it as a styling product (for shine or pomade) and plus it conditions your hair all day. Works great! My hair is so infinitely healthier in only a month!The oil is kind of a solid, but as long as you keep it in a warm room you're fine. Rub it between your hands for about 2 seconds and it is liquid again. Not a problem at all. It smells great, kind of nutty, I love it. Best "hair" product I have ever found, and I've tried many.

This is excellent quality pure coconut oil at an incredibly good price! It works very well used in lieu of damaging, petroleum based anti-chapping agents. When cold it will harden but can easily be returned to its liquid state by inserting the bottle under hot water(it does work equally well in its hardened form.) We transfer a portion to a small container and carry it with us in lieu of petroleum "sticks" when we hike, climb or ski. It goes on smoothly without a greasy feel and more importantly, does not block healthy lip tissue regeneration. It also tastes and smells good.  We were very pleased with the manner in which the seller communicated with us to assure that our transaction went smoothly. This seller and his product rate an A+ in our book!
No expiration date on bottle.  Oil hard, had to be warmed up to get anything out of the bottle and when I did, it smelled really bad and rancid.  Awful experience.

I absolutely love this oil. Like many of the consumers who posted a review, I too use the oil as a body oil and as a hair oil. It smells great, it's light and for me, one large bottle lasts me at least 2 months (that's with daily use).I actually purchased my oil from one of the Indian grocers in my cities East Indian community. I love that I can enjoy this wonderful community, it's culture, cuisine and products!

I had previously bought various brands of certified organic and extra virgin coconut oil from the Philippines and was very pleased with them. I decided to try an Indian coconut oil. This seems to be the only brand that India makes. It's not organic or extra virgin but I wanted to try it anyways. It is tan in color not like organic coconut oil and it smells like used grease from a frying pan. It smells that way too. I will not purchase this again.

I have been looking at Coconut oil for my cat's fur, yet hesitated to purchase. I found this parachute coconut oil and have been quite pleased. It has helped my cats fur and dander 100%. They LOVE it. The youngest comes running when he see's the bottle. I have used it to cook with, to help a small fungal issue on my feet, dry skin, my own hair... My only concern is the bottle expires 15 months from the date of manufacturer date, so this bottle is good for another month.I'm glad it was  a small bottle. We love it and hope the next time we purchase we have longer to use the product.
1. Terrible packaging, no safety seal.2. Thee WORSE smell ever!! Smells like old cooking oil!3. Save your money!!!4. Will NEVER buy their products again!!

column9: Never made it out of the kitchen
column10: I bought this coconut oil to help tame my bangs, which are somewhat fried due to my hot iron.  I thought I would try it in the kitchen - and it is so tasty it never made it to the bathroom.  It pours right out of the bottle (I live in Texas - A/C is expensive so my house may be warmer than most) and it has a light scent and slightly sweet delicious taste.  I use it stirfrying, panfrying, and in recipes.  I will have to buy another bottle soon, and next time I'll buy two because I still want to try it on my hair.

column9: it smells so bad I could not use this + THIS OIL IS NOT EVEN A BARGAIN!
column10: I ignored the other reviews for this oil, and purchased because I thought the price was good.  There were two things wrong. First, you will notice it says to put in hot water to melt the oil so you can get it out of the bottle.  This packaging is appropriate for warm weather locations.  Seattle is not a location that works for this product.  2.  The smell gagged me.  You do not want to put this product in your mouth.  I might use this on my hair, before washing it, but that is about it.  It stinks!  I have purchased other brands, from this website and from vitamin websites and they were cheap and lovely to the nose, mouth, and body.  I honestly do not know why this smells so bad. I have edited my review.  The reason I purchased this oil over others was that I thought that it was a bargain.  When I got the container I found that it was no cheaper and in fact more money than some oils I have been purchasing.  If you are using coconut oil for eating or putting on your body,  I urge you not to buy this oil.  It stinks really really bad, is no bargain and you cannot get it out of the container.  I should have returned it to amazon immediately upon receiving this.

Coconut Oil, as I found out, remains a solid when it is not in its native tropical environment (70+ degrees or so). I also found out that this oil is rather less expensive at international foods section of the local supermarket. This means a) it must be melted to be used, and b) you could save a few bucks by shopping around. However, for the convenience factor, getting it sent to the house was a plus; I used it to make no bake cookies (it added a nutty flavor) and plan to also use it in making chocolate covered pretzels and raisins. No complaints about flavor.

I just received my order in the mail and was unhappy to find that the top to my coconut oil was missing. Thank god the coconut oil is at a solid, because the oil would be ever where. I will not be ordering this product in the future sadly.

I bought this to keep in the bathroom to use on my skin and scalp knowing I would have to warm it up before each use. What I was not prepared for was the smell. Worse than toasted coconut, it smells burnt. Totally unacceptable, no matter what the benefit! I have not been able to bring myself to even put it on my skin, so I'm hoping Amazon will take it back.
Bought it for my girlfriend and she loves it. The product was shipped very fast as well and it was well packaged.

Loving my Parachute Coconut oil! We use it for baby's diaper rashes and sore areas without altering the integrity of clothe diapers. We use it with cooking, in homemade baby wipe solution and hair care! Great product and great price!

This oil is incredible when it comes to conditioning and moisturizing. I use it on my 4b curly hair. I mix a little orange oil or lavender essential oil with it to kill the unpleasant smell. This keeps my hair from smelling funny and I am able to oil my scalp with it as well. Since I've been using it people tell me my hair looks thick and healthy.It's also a great at detangling my hair after a co-wash.
This product is great!  It does much more than the description says.  I really like it and will rebuy it for sure.

I was delighted with this product. Since I live in Georgia and it was the month of May, the product was in a liquid form when it arrived. I was also glad the container was not as pictured, but in a wide mouth plastic jar with a spout. The smell is wonderful and reminds me of the beach. I plan to use this for cosmetic purposes and will definitely order from this seller again.  I received the item very quickly. It came just a few days after I ordered it!
Love this product!!!  I read about it from another comment posted on another oil I was buying.  This is perfect for my hair!  LOVE LOVE LOVE it!!!

column9: Great natural product with Multi Beauty, health and wellness purposes!
column10: I only give it a 4 because at times there is difficulty extracting the product from the small opening at times, but its perfectly suitable when the bottle is warmed by the surrounding temperature.I actually brought this particular product back with me from when I traveled around India.  It was the natural home moisturizer and beauty treatment there.  Ask any Indian woman how she has such long, strong beautiful hair and she'll tell you its because she conditions her hair and massages her scalp with coconut oil.  I'm not Indian but I'm a girl who has been trying to maintain long hair and suffering from split ends, but reluctant to trim too much and I admired the healthy state of their hair.Its a great moisturizer and also its healthy for you if you want to cook with, its very good for digestion and provides healthy saturated fats.  I know it sounds counter intuitive, but certainly do your own research and don't go against doctors orders.Don't go overboard with consumption or cooking with it, but I was informed having a tablespoon with each meal is beneficial, just be careful not to consume after your meal if you want weight loss.I personally use coconut as a hair conditioner, moisturizer, in place of butter and cooking oil.I use Parachute for only beauty/moisturizing reasons because I find that the opening does not make it easy to extract the oil for cooking because half the year the temperature makes the oils solid and the opening is for the oil in a more liquid state.The coconut oil solidifies when the surrounding temperature is cooler.  This particular bottle makes it difficult to squeeze out if the temperature is too low.  I'd recommend placing the closed bottle it in a bowl of warm to hot water to help melt it a bit.This product is very inexpensive.  Avoid other products that are not 100% pure coconut oil.

I  have used this brand of coconut oil in the past and I was never disappointed by it.  It tastes good and smells heavenly.  I also add it to My homemade skin and hair care products.  I have tried other oils.  Even Nutiva organic oil and I didn't like that oil at all.  It lacked the deep coconut taste I like and also the rich coconut smell.  I had to go back to Parachute and I will not buy anything else but Parachute from now on.  To scared to try anything else out of fear I might get a product like that organic stuff I brought. If you truly have a love for coconut and know how to appreciate the true "taste" and "smell" of coconut then you will appreciate and "love" Parachute.  Parachute is better than Nutiva hands down!!Now I am going to use it for coconut popcorn also.
This oil is completely amazing. I use it all over! I use it in my hair ever so often to keep it soft and hydrated, my lips as a balm and my whole body as a deep moisturizer. I love this product.

When I ordered from Amazon- I thought I was getting the container pictured... but I got a short, squat version, which was okay... then I tried to use the oil as a "lotion" for my hyper (skin) sensitive newborn daughter- maybe I don't know how coconut oil is? If it's ALWAYS "frozen" and you have to warm it to apply... nonetheless, when I tried to use the spout with the container it came in, it was a MESS. It got ALL over the container, and all over my hands. Complete mess! I was very upset with the construction of the bottle- it simple doesn't work. I have to open the lid and just pour it without the "easy pour" lid. All in all, I do like the oil inside the container!
This stuff works wonders on head lice.  It works far better than any poison product we tried.  It killed the bugs and it dislodged the eggs.

Comes in a blue plastic bottle which at first seems ok.  However, if you leave it standing in a cold room the oil solidifies in the bottle and won't come out. So I had to put it under hot water to get it liquify.  The quality is good, it tastes great, and can be used as a lubricant or eaten.  I am moving the contents to a glass jar that has a wide opening so I don't have to deal with squeezing it out of this plastic bottle.  Good product.
The Parachute 100% Pure Coconut Oil 500ml is an excellent product & the price & free shipping on Amazon makes it an even better deal!

This coconut oil is a wonderful product.  For the price point, you get a fairly good quality of oil.  The scent is very natural and light.  The oil soaks into your skin, leaving it soft.  Delivery and fulfillment are prompt.  WONDERFUL PRODUCT AND SHOPPING EXPERIENCE.  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

The product was shipped to me quickly. And yes it did arrive in a solid form but after doing a little research, I knew this was normal and I am pretty used to heating it up in a bowl of warm water before using. My hair is in a transition from relaxed to natural state so I use this product to "seal" moisture in my hair every couple of days. Honestly because of the point I am at with my transition, I can't really say if the product is helping me but I know it hasn't definitely not done any harm to my hair!!! I didn't give the product 5 stars because while the product says 100% pure coconut oil there isn't an ingredient list for me to be sure. And I don't like the smell but it is not a bad smell, just not to my liking. I would say this is a good buy even if it does not work on your hair...it will probably be a nice moisturizer for your skin.

I love this, have been using and it is great.  I use it for my hair and for my daughter's hair as well.  It makes the hair sooo soft.  I could not ask for better.  Please know that it will be hard to get out if cold.  I usually hold the bottle between my thighs when I brush my daughter's hair then my body heat makes it softer and I can pour it into my hands and into her hair.  I will never use anything else for conditioning.  It is the best!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  Have not tried eating yet.  Just cant find it in me to try yet!  But will submit review when I do!

This bottle was my second purchase of coconut oil for my natural 4c hair. It (coconut oil, in general) doesn't do much in the way of moisture for my hair, but it's a great sealant. It also moisturizes better when combined with other oils. I loved this particular brand over the other one because it smells so delicious. I used it on my hair, skin, and lips when I ran out of chapstick.The only downside to my purchase was that the seam at the bottom of the bottle burst when the coconut oil hardened from the cold. That wasn't a huge issue, though. I just ran the bottle upside down under some warm water and moved the liquid coconut oil to another container.

column4: Cee Tee "If it's GREAT...I'll tell ya!"
column10: I promise that this oil smells like bacon. I just received my order today and opened it to use, I put a small drop in my palm and began to rub them together to apply it to my face and NO WAY....NO HOW....it smelled like bacon. I buy coconut oil all the time and it NEVER smells like this! I am soooo very disappointed in the quality of this product....I WANT A REFUND!!!!
I cannot get the oil out of bottle,iwill have to cut the top off the bottle.I have another brand that has a wide mouth jar now i know why.It is almost impossible to squeez out of container.

column9: Great for detangling and deep conditioning!
column10: I use Parachute Coconut Oil as a pre-shampoo detangler/deep conditioner for my kinky coily, Afro-textured hair. I purchased a 16 oz jar for $5 at a local Indian grocery store.Parachute Coconut Oil has a thick, creamy, lush, velvety texture when solid, It has more slip for finger-detangling than the brands of organic coconut oil I've tried (Nutiva, Vitamin Shoppe, Emerald Laboratories, Trader Joe's). It smells slightly of roasted coconut but that's fine because I top off the coconut oil with a layer of natural conditioner.From now on, I'll use Parachute Coconut Oil for hair and organic coconut oil for skin (via my DIY Body Butter).

I factually ordered this in to mix with neem oil for my son's acne. Didn't realize it was also edible. lol!  Works great with the neem to take out the stink.  I've been looking for natural handlings for his acne and these are working for him.Anyhow, I used it to whip up some scrambled eggs; delicious! I will use this for other cooking!!!I also somehow acquired a spider bite on my forehead and I heard coconut oil is good for that so I put a little on that and voila, the pain was gone and it shrunk down and disappeared faster than I have ever had a spider bite disappear.  Tried it on a mosquito bite too.  Took the itch away (I get quite the reaction from mosquito bites) and the swelling disappeared, as did the mosquito bite by the next day.Quite happy with the product.Seriously, if you are looking for cocnut oil to cook with, this is it. I like the General Foods International Sugar Free French Vanilla coffee mixed with the Sugar Free Mocha. Often, though, they run out of the French Vanilla and I'm stuck on a waiting list forever. So, keep this stuff in stock and I'll buy it!

French vanilla International Coffee has become a real favorite of mine.  I put it in the blender with soymilk, ice and whatever to make a different tasting smoothee. Being Gluten intolerant, eating in a restaurant is a challenge.  Recently I visited a restaurant that specializes in pasta dishes and was amazed to see that they offered a gf option.  I took a chance (gf pasta can be really pasty and gummy even if cooked properly) and ordered the shrimp scampi.  I was blown away by the firm, aldente texture and fabulous taste of the pasta and asked the waiter if the cook would share the brand of pasta he prepared. In short order the waiter appeared with a package of the Heartland pasta.  I can't say enough about this great product.  I have since purchased several packages of the spaghetti, fusuli, and penne pasta and can finally enjoy italian food again!  Even my very picky boyfriend who detects even the slightest off-taste that gf products can have likes this product.  If there was a higher score than "5", I would give it!!
This pasta has great texture and taste. It will not be available again until the fall according to the manufacturer , so stock up while you can.
FINALLY a gluten free pasta that does not taste like RICE!!!! this is the best I have tried yet...it does not get soggy, slimy or fall apart if you overcook it a little. superb!

Wow... I was so happy to try this pasta for the first time, it tasted just like regular pasta! I've tried quite a few gluten free pastas since going gluten free, and this is by far the best in texture, taste, overall similarity to the "real" thing. Thank you Heartland!!!

My husband and I used this to make macaroni and cheese last night. I have to say, it is sort of amazing. You cannot tell it's gluten free at all--great consistency, great taste, great product. And, it's a fantastic price on Amazon, especially with Subscribe and Save!

I was served this pasta at a local Italian eatery because the owner wanted my opinion, since I had asked him about gf products in the past. I was blown away! The best gf pastas I have had up until now were just "OK" and the worst were just downright nasty - slimy, sticky or rubbery - and tasted weird compared to regular pasta.The Heartland penne was fantastic in taste, texture and appearance and I do believe that with the way he fixed it, with marinara sauce and cheese baked on top, I would not have guessed it was gluten free if I had not known. He now plans to keep it on hand for customers who require a gf pasta.He showed me the brand, and I just had to rush to Amazon to order some to use at home. I honestly do not believe that you will be disappointed if you buy this pasta. I have also ordered some of their spaghetti and if it is as good as the penne, I will never need to buy those other (more expensive) gf pastas again!

Like many of you I struggle with my weight.And like many of you I've been looking for a shortcut.Ephedra.Caffeine.Hoodia.Acai Berry.African Mango.Ephedra worked but was too dangerous and was outlawed.Caffeine only has a mild thermogenic effect and keeps me up at night.Hoodia doesn't work.Acai Berry may have great antioxidant properties but is for the most part useless for weight loss.African Mango is the same as Acai.There are many others but all are the same, all hype and no results.Then I was reading a new diet book from France called "The Dukan Diet".The diet itself is ok but I have no intention of following it.I've already lost 20 lbs since January 1st of 2011 and I have about 20 more to go before I reach my goal weight just through some common sense approaches to everyday eating.Meaning, cutting out the junk food and soda.In "The Dukan Diet" the author suggest you eat one tablespoon of raw oat bran before every meal.This made me curious so I decided to try it.Now I realize that Quaker oats are rolled oats not oat bran.The only difference between the two are that bran has a slightly better nutritional profile.That's it.So for my experiment I just got the darn rolled oats.And.........take a tablespoon right before a meal with a huge glass of water and........baam........greatly reduced appetite.Why bother with expensive and ineffective hoodia when every grocery store has Quaker Oats?You want something that suppresses your appetite then this is really the Holy Grail you've been looking for.Try it; you'll be very happy with the results.Not only will it suppress your appetite but it has fiber and other goodies your body needs.It also keeps your blood sugar down which aids with preventing weight gain.Guess what?Mom was right, oatmeal IS good for you.So far I'm down another five pounds.Yayyyyyyyy.This is one "supplement" I can definitely stick with for the long haul.I know a lot of folks don't like the taste but I just let it dissolve in my mouth and it tastes like granola.Not gross, quite tasty actually.I can't believe I'm giving something I wouldn't go near as a child my highest recommendation but I am.Maybe we do get smarter as we get older.Too bad we get fat, bald, and wrinkly too.Oh well, I suppose everything has to have a trade off.Quaker Oats?Tasty.Nutritious.Good for weight loss.Recommended.
