column9: Started out okay, but became a lost cause.
column10: This is one of four or five varieties of Wellness canned food my dog has tried.  At first she seemed to like it, and she ate it well.  After a couple of packs(12 cans) she refused to eat it at all.  This was not the only flavor she was given during this time, but she knew when it was part of her meal.  I don't know what happened, but it is not on our menu any longer.

column9: Skinny, Picky Poodle has gained a pound on this stuff
column10: I was able to add a full pound to my skinny, 15yr old toy poodle with this.  He loves it and looks forward to dinner again.  I'd order it through Amazon, but it's only one cent cheaper on Amazon than it is in the pet store.
I'll be returning this product.  Half the cans were dented and the lables were falling off.  I tried one can that wasn't dented - my dogs were not impressed.
I have two dogs.  One dog ate all of it, but he even eats durian fruit. The other was very hesitant and didn't finish it. I won't buy this again.

While some of Larabars have a thick grainy-nut texture, this particular product is very smooth and almost tastes like chocolate candy. For those of us who can't eat real candy because of allergies, this one is a winner! It almost tastes like a soft Girl Scout thin mint cookie.
Wonderful healthy alternative to modern day candy.  Don't expect it to taste like a hershey bar, but it does taste very good and I feel better after eating it.

column9: Some of the other reviews are for a DIFFERENT flavor
column10: If you can get one at the store first, obviously try it before ordering a 16 pack.This is the plain Jocalat bar and I can say I am hooked.We gave up processed sugar and are going the organic route on everything. And this is perfect for a chocolate fix. It's great because there is no added sugar (or sugar substitute) unless you count figs.If you are addicted to the fat (butter) and sugar of the majority of candy bars, this is different.Tastes what I remember a brownie to be like except less sweet.When you get off sugar, your tastebuds change. It's worth it though. Some other people, if they are referring to this actual flavor, probably are thinking it isn't sweet enough.Did not care at all for the orange flavored one. Haven't tried the mint. Coffee/hot variety goes against what I'm doing health wise. I'm alright with pure chocolate though. I think this is as good as it gets.------UPDATE: Haven't eaten these in a long time. I am finding I do better with soaked nuts. I also prefer to eat as close to 100% organic as I can.

Read the ingredients, this is not a HFCS/processed chocolate bar!  However if you like "REAL" food and are looking to have a slightly sweet snack that is completely good for you then this is it!  I gave up sugar a few months ago, and these bars have been wonderful, a way to satisfy my sweet tooth will all natural fruit-sugar sweetness...the main ingredient in ALL of them (Larabar & Jocalat) is dates, this one also has almonds and cocoa powder, do note that just because it has cocoa powder it does not mean it's sweet, this is unsweetened cocoa powder, the sweetness comes from the dates.  It's a snack you can feel good about eating.  Just make sure you are not expecting a sugary chocolate taste, or you will be disappointed! If you want a real, raw, good for your body, mind and soul snack then I highly recommend.  I also love the Apple Pie Larabar!

Jocalat bars are made by the Larabar Company. The following applies to all Larabars and Jocalat bars:* All natural.* No added sugars.* No chemicals/preservatives.* No soy.* Nothing bad/only healthy ingredients.* Vegan-friendly.* Convenient. (No measuring, cutting, pouring, mixing, cooking, etc.)* Because they are healthy and convenient, they are good to have for when you are hungry and have no means to cook or buy something. They can curb your appetite and give you energy. They are also good for snacks.If I were to have an emergency food supply, Larabars and Jocalats would be in the box, (even though I don't know what the shelf life is for them.)Now about this particular flavor, Chocolate Mint Jocalat:I love this flavor. It is a rich spearmint flavor, and of course, chocolate.If you are used to eating candy bars, you might not like these bars at first. I do not eat candy bars (I can't remember the last time I've had one), and I am used to "healthy-tasting" foods; therefore, the taste of these bars are perfect for me. I love them.

Insanely delicious.  Texture and taste are phenomenal, they are incredibly satisfying (and don't leave you feeling mildly nauseous like actual junk food) and the ingredients are just marvelous.  Mmmm mmm.

One of the best I've had. It doesn't have any unnecessarily added fats. The ingredients are 100% natural, the sweetening is 100% natural, and the taste is 100% delicious. If you love your chocolate with a hint of bitter taste (dark or bittersweet), you'll probably find this bar delicious.

The LaraBar Chocolate snack is really quite tasty. The texture is good, and it has plenty of nuts. A filling treat, it is also thick and chewy, just like a brownie should be. It is a little shy on chocolate taste, though. If it had the chocolate zing of a PureBar Pure Bar Chocolate Brownie Bar, 1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12), then it would be the best of the best. I recommend this healthy snack for anyone who is looking for a healthy gluten-free alternative to a brownie. YUM.

I love most of the Larabar products because they only have a few basic ingredients in them and they are all natural without fillers.  They don't add sugar or sugar substitutes which I love.  I picked up one of the chocolate coffee flavors thinking "how good could it possibly be when using just a couple ingredients"...well, I'm hooked!  I can have a healthy fruit and nut bar WITH chocolate coffee flavor too.  You wouldn't know you were eating a fruit/nut bar..really!

Jocalat bars are made by the Larabar Company. The following applies to all Larabars and Jocalat bars:* All natural* No added sugars* No chemicals/preservatives* No soy* Nothing bad/only healthy ingredients* Vegan-friendly* Kosher* Convenient (No measuring, cutting, pouring, mixing, cooking, etc.)* Because they are healthy and convenient, they are good to have for when you are hungry and have no means to cook or buy something. They can curb your appetite and give you energy. They are also good for snacks.If I were to have an emergency food supply, Larabars and Jocalats would be in the box, (even though I don't know what the shelf life is for them.)If you are used to eating candy bars, you might not like these bars at first. I do not eat candy bars (I can't remember the last time I've had one), and I am used to "healthy-tasting" foods; therefore, the taste of these bars are perfect for me. I love them.These healthy bars have nothing unhealthy or gross or "things that you'd rather not know what you're eating" added to them, like so many "healthy" bars do. These bars have only healthy ingredients (nuts and fruits and naturals such as cocoa or coffee, depending on the variety). No ingredient has to be hidden or substituted with a word that you don't know what it means. All ingredients are proudly in plain English. These bars are healthy and truly amazing and come in lots of different varieties.

If you are a fan of Larabars like I am stick with the fruit bars. They are delicious. I ordered these without trying them and was very disappointed. They are dry and not the least bit sweet.  You do have to realize that you are not eating a candy bar, and that there is only 3-4 ingredients in most Larabars.  This works for the fruit flavors but not for this particular Larabar. I would not order them again.

These bars are decadent and good for you.  My husband and I are trying to eat "closer to the earth," so we really like the fact that there are very few ingredients and NO added sugar.  Sure, they are expensive, but certainly bakery cookies and specialty cupcakes would cost a lot more.  This (along with almonds) is my snacking/dessert go-to item, and it's certainly cheaper than that syrup-laden latte I used to purchase daily.

I was pleasantly surprised when I bit into this chocolate coffee jocalat bar! It is very tasty! To me, it is very much like having a brownie without all the sugar, wheat, dairy, etc. This is by far my new favorite flavor of Larabar! It doesn't really have a coffee taste to it. It just tastes like a dark chocolate treat. So, if you don't care for coffee, it is still worth a try.

I'm addicted to these! They're basically like a raw candy bar. I like them because the ingredients are healthy and they don't contain agave syrup. I used to make something similar, but these are so much easier and convenient to have on hand. I suggest you try the various flavors before buying a whole box on Amazon. I decided to try every flavor and discovered (oddly enough) that I only like the original chocolate. It seemed like most of the other flavors were too dry or something. If you buys these expecting them to taste like a "real" candy bar, then you'll be disappointed. If you're looking for a healthy treat though give them a try.

I have recently discovered LaraBars, and their whole-food sugar-free goodness. This was my first try of the Jocolat line... as has been suggested here, it's probably best to buy a single bar somewhere before buying a pack of 16 of them, and the chocolate coffee version was the only one I've found locally yet. So that was what I tried -- I love it and immediately came online to Amazon to order more.It's much more like a dessert than the regular LaraBars to me, almost like a brownie. I like the kick of coffee in it, and wonder if it helps with the flavor that some seem not to like. On the other hand, if you're expecting a decadent sugar-laden brownie, you will definitely be disappointed. This is a product you buy if you value whole foods and no sugar or artificial flavors. (Dates seem to be the main source of the sweet in LaraBars.) Also, if you don't like dark chocolate, this will not be for you.In general, I do find the texture of LaraBars takes a little getting used to. It's all those mushed up dates, which makes it very gummy, and then the contrast of the nuts. I'm past this now, but I know that some will just not like the texture.My only hesitation with this specific product is that I'm not entirely sure the niche this has in my diet. The regular LaraBars seem better as "food" (I eat them sometimes when I miss or am late for a meal). This seems more like "dessert".

I think that some of the comments that mention that it's not chocolate-y enough or just plain tastes bad might be used to a more milk-chocolate taste rather than a pure chocolate taste. Since, as far as I understand, the only sweetness in this bar comes from the dates, people might be missing the processed sugar and all the other stuff usually mixed in with chocolate.I also thought at first that the bar tasted strange, but I think it was like a city person getting to the countryside and thinking that the fresh air is unbreathable. I was intrigued enough to try a second bar, which I tasted so much better than I remembered. The third was a revelation. Now I crave this flavor all the time, and find that most other chocolate desserts that I used to love taste much too sweet.
I thought these were way too dry AND the nuts seemed to cut my mouth.  That combination turned me off to these bars completely.  And they had so much potential...

I like these bars but strangely, they don't really taste like chocolate or orange. They have a very strong orange-y smell (like concentrated orange oil, orange extract, or lots of orange zest) and a zest-like flavor but again, not quite orange or chocolate. But I like them. Weird I guess but they're moist and dense and you can't beat the unctuous quality of a snack that feels naughty, fills you up, and yet is healthy and natural and actually good for you. I'm starting to really like Larabars and hope to try more flavors.

I recently discovered LARABAR and am in full addiction mode.  I love most of the flavors.  Chocolate is one of my favorites.  I wish they had more mixed boxes as 16 of the same flavor will wear me down.  If you get a chance, try to Cashew flavor and the Chocolate Coconut Chew -- they're delicious.  So far the only flavor I'm not a fan of is the banana -- the consistency was weird.
If you like dark chocolate with nuts you should like this.It has a light sweet taste as there is no chemical sugar taste.

This is a pretty tasty bar with good texture.  Nice simple organic ingredients.  At the end of my case, I thought the taste wasn't as good they tasted like they spoiled even though the exp. date was very good.  These bars make a good snack or meal on the go.  I like to keep them in my bag for times when I'm out past my usual lunch/dinner ect.  They help keep the hunger at bay for a bit & keep you going.  They also make a nice quick meal as long as you have them with something, yogurt/kefir or the like.  The flavor is a mild chocolate nut.  I will buy again, but not by the case I think that was a bit much for me.

I tried a bunch of the fruity larabar flavors and thought that they were all sickeningly sweet.  Even with the coconut flavor that people seem to love, I could not finish the box.  I just got the chocolate mint jocolate bars and I love them.  I think the coco cuts the sweetness a lot.  I also like the dryer texture of these rather than the sticky texture of the fruit bars.  The same things I like about these bars the one star reviews seem to really dislike, so it seems like it is all about preference.  I don't like things that are super sweet.  I think milk chocolate is gross, and when I eat chocolate I prefer 85% coco or above.  So, maybe those things will be helpful to gauge if you will like these or not.
Goes beyond a "peppermint" taste.  It honestly tastes like hard liquor, although with none of the corresponding euphoric effects.  Would not recommend.

column9: VERY GOOD AND GOOD FOR YOU!!!
column10: This product is one of the healthiest things I eat all day and the taste is great.  Organic whole foods and no sodium.  I eat one shortly after I get to work and I am not hungry before lunch time.  I wish Amazon carried more varieties on a consistent basis. Amazon subscribe and save has the best price I have found. LÄRABAR Jocalat, Chocolate Hazelnut, 1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 16)
Mild, chocolate & mint flavor.  Not sweet tasting, but still delicious.  Enjoy with a glass of milk.  Very satisfying.

Jocalat Organic Chocolate Coffee was the first Larabar that I've ordered. Before the bars arrived at my doorstep, I was expecting a typical fruit-n-nut type of food bar that contains whole pieces of chunky nuts. So I was a little disappointed when I opened one and saw that the nuts were broken into tiny pieces instead. The bar was also shorter than I'd imagined.But the good thing is, the taste didn't disappoint. All the bars were not dry and hard, but instead they were moist and firm even when they were kept in the refrigerator. It would be a different texture if huge chunky nuts are used. Those who found them hard and dry probably got bars that were too close to their sell-by date. My bars had a good 10 months to go before expiring.What I like most is the fact that Jocalat Organic Chocolate Coffee (and later I found out it applies to other flavors of Larabar as well) these bars were not sickening sweet like other energy bars I've tasted. It's quite sad to taste a food bar prepared with good ingredients being drenched in excessive sweeteners, no matter how healthy the sweetener is touted to be. But this bar did not gross me out like other bars did, and in fact, satisfied my sweet tooth pretty well.Since I am a chocolate lover, especially dark ones, the smell and taste of the cocoa in the bar added to my satisfaction rating. There was also a subtle hint of coffee, but it was almost undetectable if you're not mindful enough.I wish the bars are bigger though. I'm in no way a large man, but I find one bar hardly makes me feel full, though it does stop my hunger pang.After trying this product, I've since moved on to other flavors. I found that Larabar Fruit & Nut Food Bar, Chocolate Coconut Chew, 1.8-Ounce Bars, 16-Count has almost the same taste as this. The coconut shreds in it have no taste but gives a distinctive coconut texture. But since this bar isn't made of organic ingredients, the price is lower than the Jocalat series. If budget is a concern to you, then you may want to consider that bar instead.One tip: As with any food bars, always eat Larabar with a full glass of water. Although not as hard and dry like other bars, it can get a bit dry on the throat when you're near the end.

column9: Good option for the overly health-conscious
column10: Sure, there are no added sugars, but the dates that overpower the flavor are the first ingredient, comprising 21g of sugars/bar, certainly no innocent snack, and with no real flavor in the original flavor. The hazelnuts are lost in that variety, too; had such high expectations and these just fell flat.

column9: Not one I would buy again
column10: Don't know if the box of Jocalat bars I got was just not fresh or what but they were awful. Loved the Cherry and Apple Pie, Pecan was ok but these were like a dry brick.

Just received 3 boxes of the Chocolate Cherry Larabars, and they expire in less than two months.  I have eaten a ton of Jocalat Larabars and this batch is definitely dry and stale tasting.Amazon or Amazing Deals needs to make the expiration date listing more obvious. Who wants to pay for stale Larabars?

I LOVE Larabars.  I am a very healthy eater and I try to limit sugary desserts as much as possible.  With that said, I occasionally get a sweet tooth.  These are a GREAT alternative to a brownie or other dessert when you feel like indulging without the guilt.  All of these bars have very few ingredients and are made of mostly  fruit and nuts. I also find that just 1 bar is satisfying.These are a good pick if you like dark chocolate.  If you are more of a milk chocolate person you will probably still like them, however they are less sweet and creamy than milk chocolate is, more bittersweet.If you haven't tried these you need to.  With around 200 calories per bar or less, these bars are like having a brownie with less than half the calories.

I got a batch of really bad tasting bars and the expiration date was November 2011.  I contacted Jocalate from the Larabar website and they sent a check to replace the bad bars.  So if they taste bad, contact them and they will refund your purchase if the bars have not expired.

I usually enjoy this product but the box I received from amazon was not fresh, so tasted more dry than usual.  The date on box expires soon, so I can tell this is an old box/batch of bars. Very disappointed.

column9: I normally Love Larabars but the jocalat was gross.
column10: I normally love Larabars. I have tried a few favors and have loved them all but there is something really off about the Jocalat bar. They were dried out and when you tried to take a bit out of the bar it crumbed. The box said they were good until Jan 2012 but they tasted old, dried out, just plan gross. I am not sure if this a bad box or if larabar company needs to redo their bar flavor.Bad product!!!

I love Larabars. These Jocalat are not my personal favorite but they are what you can get at a reasonable price through the subscription option. I just received a box dated November 2011 and checked them out since I had read that others found that batch to be stale. Mine are fine - or I am used to them stale as they taste the same as the last box. they are a bit drier than the regular Larabars.
These are amazing little bars. Filling, yummy and all natural. The chocolate mint flavor is nice though the mint is a little weak so it doesn't overpower you. The chocolate flavor is lovely too.
It is perfect for a healthy chocolate fix.I'd love to find a variety pack.Wonderful to find it in Amazon's subscription program.

I have always enjoyed this product, but unfortunately, the boxes that I received from Amazon in April,though the expiration date was November,2011,were dry, seemed stale and were inedible. Very disppointing.

column9: Love larabar, but this is not one of my favorite flavors.
column10: I have tried many of the different flavors of larabar and I love most of them.  Jocalat is not one of them.  It's o.k.  but not my taste. :)  I love the peanut butter cookie flavor and cinnamon roll.

column9: not outdated but not quite right
column10: I cannot get these Jocalat bars in my local store and I have ordered them from Amazon several times previously. In my last two orders the product, while not outdated, tasted stale.  It tasted as if the box had not been stored properly and perhaps had been inadvertently frozen.
It was a little drier than when I first tasted this.Maybe past its prime.Flavor was fine though, I like this minty dark chocolate-ness.Like a healthy Girl Scout Thin Mint>

These uber-healthy bars do the trick whenever I have a chocolate craving. I try my best to eat "whole food" and this becomes difficult when I am craving something sweet. I used to buy "Clif Bar Nectar" bars, which was essentially the same product. However, since those bars are no longer sold I am so happy that I've found these. Also, the savings are amazing...they cost almost $2 at my "Whole Foods" market. The Hazelnut flavor is my favorite so far but these are almost as amazing. If you care about the quality of the food you eat and love sweets buy them, you won't regret it!
Having been banned from dairy and refined sugar by my doctor, these have turned out to be an awesome alternative candy for me. They're delicious and not all that bad for you either.

I think no tastes go better together than chocolate and mint. If you agree, you'll love these wonderfully flavorful bars.The fact that two bars have all the protein you need for a meal (and much of the fruit) makes them a treat for air travel, hiking, and other quick meals on the go.They stay fresh and delicious for months without refrigeration.

column9: Cherry Pie ok, Choco Cherry not so much.
column10: I have food allergies, and while I am looking for a Chocolate fix, I think this will take a bit to get used to. The Cherry Pie is quite good, and tastes like the center of a fig newton. The Chocolate Cherry, however smells like vinegar, and while at first the flavor is fine, it soon turns into bitter cherry, a bit of a rum flavor and then you guessed it, a strong vinegar like after-taste. I can get used to it, as frankly I have no other options due to milk and soy allergies, but some sweeter cherries and maybe some organic molasses in the mix would not hurt, maybe a bit of almond oil for added sweet flavor. Next time I will try the plain chocolate as I hear they get good reviews.Over all, The Cherry pie gets an 8 out of 10, but the Choco-cherry gets a resounding 2.

column9: Delicious Jocalat bars, how I love you..
column10: I used to buy these bars regularly at Trader Joe's, but several months ago they stopped selling my favorite flavor, so I've resorted to ordering them online. I don't like to leave home without one in my backpack. Very healthy, raw ingredients, filling, flavorful...I really love this product.

column9: Delicious for a snack or treat
column10: I should start off by saying I was not instantly a convert to Larabars. I tried a few of the flavors in the regular line (Larabars) and did not prefer them over other snack/meal bars. The Jocalat bars, however, changed my mind. I love how they are the perfect balance of fruits, nuts, and cocoa. You can taste all of the flavors and they all work really well together. The chocolate mint is my favorite because the mint has a really clean natural favor and compliments the chocolate well. It easily takes away my cravings for a chocolate bar. I also really enjoy the chocolate orange and chocolate cherry flavors that are in this line. Now if they just come out with a chocolate banana version I will be in heaven.Despite all my raving it's still important to keep in mind that these DO NOT taste like a candy bar or a baked brownie. They definitely have more of a raw taste to them and you can still taste the dates so if you do not like the flavor of dates you may not like these. I also recommend that you try the flavors before committing to a whole case. I've found the Larabar flavors to be hit or miss with my personal tastes. There are some that I love and enthusiastically buy again and others that don't seem worth the calories.Overall these are great and I like them so much better than Larabar flavors and have recommended them to many friends.
I tried the Chocolate one, and it is perfect. Tastes very natural and not excessively sweet like some other brands. I will definitely be buying more.

The LaraBar Jocalat is becoming one of my favorite treats.  The rich chocolate flavor and the other nutrient-dense ingredients satisfies the sweet-tooth as well as hunger.  I am a teacher, and I keep these tasty bars in my desk for when I am hungry.  These bars are far healthier than donuts or candy, which are often found in my school office or teacher's lounge.  Furthermore, everyone who I've shared my secret stash with has enjoyed them as much as I do!  One day I took one to the principal, who is a health-conscious individual, and he now loves them, too!  So, this past Christmas I gave him a gift bag filled with LaraBar Jocolat's.  It never hurts to win your boss over!

I'm a big fan of dark chocolate..But this bars weren't what I expected..The ingredients are healthy but they still need a little bit of sweetness in my opinion..May be some organic maple syrup or honey..My husband and I ate the banana ones..I'm still working on these ones..I got a whole box..I bought some chocolate mint,chocolate orange, coconut cream pie, apple pie and some other ones..They were delicious!! I just got one of each first..I'll probably order a variety pack from amazon!!

I really like another chocolate flavored bar that's also gluten free, and have been a repeat customer of the other bar.  But I was very surprised at how much more I like the LaraBar Jocalat, Chocolate bar.  These area great!  I rated the other product 5 stars, because I simply couldn't find anything wrong with them and thought they were that good - these are even better.  And they're gluten free!One slight caution: I knew I wouldn't be able to eat a regular meal one day, so I took three of these along and made the mistake of enjoying all three at once in place of the meal.  I hadn't thought about what the "consequences" might be.  Two of these bars at a time are plenty for an active lower digestive system!  If you intend to spend an hour or more in a meeting a few hours after eating three of these, you may find it more than a little uncomfortable.  Have some Imodium handy in that instance.  ;~}GRITS
I love these bars! They are organic with no added sugar. Very filling and healthy. Made with real fruit.

These did not taste good to me.  They were almost chalky and did not have a good flavor.  The mint tasted strange.  I'm disappointed since I enjoy other flavors of Larabars.  I would pass on these and get the cashew cookie, or apple pie if you want something sweet and that tastes great.Edit : This review is for the chocolate mint flavor obviously

This is my very first review - I thought these were genuinely terrible. I like Larabars; I think the Cherry Pie variety tastes good. But these? Overwhelming orange oil/ zest flavor (it tasted just the way the orange essence smells) and zero chocolate flavor. If you haven't had these yet,  buy an individual bar before buying the box. I now have 15.9 of these bars and will *not* eat them.
These bars look and taste like they fell out of a monkey's butt.  Perhaps it's an acquired taste that I'm not sophisticated enough to appreciate.  OR....the monkey thing.
The item description and content sounded great.  Once we got it, the taste was terrible.  Tastes like acetone.
This stuff is terrible. I got one for free and couldn't take more than 2 bites before pitching it into the trash. Do not try this stuff if you like to eat.

I love Larabars and I bought a box of these when they were on sale and I didn't like these as much.  They are a little too minty for me.  The funny thing is that I bought a box of these because I had bought one from the health food store and I loved it.  It was very delicious to me then but six months later I guess my taste buds had changed.  The flavors I do really like are cherry, apple, lemon, and chocolate coconut.
This bar tastes like fermented oranges.  I like alcohol,but this just tastes bad.  It has a chocolate/orange alcohol taste to it. The chocolate coconut is a little better, but not great.

column9: The Chocolate Coffee is not so good
column10: I tried one of these since they were on sale and I am happy I only bought one (I've never tried the Larabars before).  It is pretty dry and gritty, reminded me of coffee grounds more than coffee.  They are organic which is cool, but they just don't do it for me.
Product arrived as promised. Also, I have had these bars before and I really like them. Thanks!

column9: Great idea...but I got tired of eating them
column10: Loved these both in taste and concept when I bought a few from EMS. Bought three cases (variety packs including, cashew, apple pie, this flavor, others) to leave at work and around to snack on, given lack of concentrated sugar, etc. Even though I never ate more than one a day, got a little sick of them and now can't eat them anymore. Kudos :-)= to the folks that make these, but hard to 'live on.' Larabar Bars Variety Pack Of Cherry Pie, Apple Pie, And Pecan Pie, 1.6-Ounce Bars (Pack of 18)Larabar Bars Variety Pack Of Cherry Pie, Apple Pie, And Chocolate Coconut Chew, 1.6-Ounce Bars (Pack of 18)

column9: If you like the smell of feet and the taste of chalk, this bar's for you
column10: I like to try all different health food bars and when I saw one that combined my two favorite things together (chocolate and hazelnuts) I said, "oooh I have to try".  I was sorely disappointed.  I bought two of these and I was excited to try one.  I opened it and was hit by the awful smell of... well a foot-like scent.  So that was a turnoff, but I said hey I have never been one to let looks or smell hinder me from trying something new.  So I went ahead and ate it.  I had to force myself to finish it.  It was like torture eating this.  It tasted awful.  I actually opened up the second and dared a coworker to try it because it was so bad.  He tried it and he felt the same way.  It has almost no flavor, but what flavor it does have lingers in your mouth and grosses you out.Who I'd recommend it to:  1.) People that like to give friends that lose bets something awful to eat. 2.) My enemies.
A perfect snack for those of us who have food intolerances and are concerned about the foods we eat. Yummy yummy and easy on the tummy.

column9: Looks good, feels like chewing a cardboard box
column10: It tastes neither like a chocolate nor coffee. I'm not sure about the health benefit but it's a torture to chew this thing. I enjoy many other healthy food but this one's a totally no no.It's as if they just mixed cacao and coffee bean then put tons of sugar to cover the bitterness of the two. Too sweet, but not tasty sweet.I won't buy this even if it's free.

column9: Ugh *Awful Face* Spitting out over the sink rinsing my mouth
column10: I love other Larabar products (and have them in my cabinet currently).  This one however shouldn't have ever made it through their testers.  It's so horrible that even 1 1/2 years after trying it, the thought of it causes my face to automatically squinsh up in digust.  I cannot express fully in words the utter awfulness of this product.  However, the telling of the story of both my mother and I leaning over separate sinks spitting it out and rinsing our mouths is sure to set both of us off in hysterics to the bemusement of anyone around us.  I wholeheartedly DO NOT recommend trying this product.  (Ugh.  I need to go rinse my mouth with mouthwash just from thinking about this product long enough to write this review.)

This was the first Larabar product that I tried, and it was awful!  The bar smelled and tasted like Vicks Vaporub, which is not exactly a pleasant thing when you're talking about food.  I will definitely not be purchasing any of their other products after this awful experience.

I tasted these for the first time today...  I am not a picky person, but this bar caused me to gag and I needed to rub the excess of this bar off with a nearby napkin. It really reminded my of acidy vomit.
was making an easter dish and was glad to find this ingredient. The price seemed like a lot, but it is hard to find. and made the dish taste just like my grandmothers
These are the very best brownies. I get wonderful compliments everytime I share a batch of these. Ghiradelli mixes are the best.

This item arrived well packaged, undamaged, and in a timely manner. The mixes were fresh. The mixes were easy to prepare. I like the idea that the caramel and nuts were included in the mix. The end results were very tasty and everone loved them. I have not seen this product in my local market so it was great to have something a little different. I will definitely purchase these again in the future. I highly recommend these to my fellow chocolate lovers.

I'm a huge fan of anything Ghirardelli! But I refuse to pay $4+ per box at the regular supermarket!! So glad I found these on Amazon. These are hands-down the best brownies I've ever had. It has walnuts in the brownie mix and a caramel pouch to spread on top before you bake. Worth every penny!

These are straightforward brownies if you follow the recipe.  I did not add the caramel fortunately because they are sweet enough sans caramel.  I don't know if the walnuts are adequate because I added more nuts.  I chose this mix because this mix does not have the chocolate chips in the mix.  It was two for five bucks at my local store which is decent.  I would definitely purchase again since I am too lazy to make the superior America's Test Kitchen recipe.

Even if you think you know Italian dry mushrooms -- order these and find out how wrong you were.  Unbelievably beautiful, deeply fragrant, terrific huge intact slices.  Flip all the cards over: these completely redefine the category.  Not just for sauces: soak a few to garnish your steak.  Make a knockout appetizer with these porcini, some stock and a shot of marsala.  To top it all: the price is reasonable.  Bravo!

I have purchased many porcini mushrooms in grocery and gourmet stores. These were the best quality (flavor and shape). The price was excellent as well. I added some to a fresh mushroom soup I made and got an incredible depth of flavor. Have also used them in braised beef dishes.

I have been buying mushrooms from JR Mushrooms for over a year now. I have ordered maybe 5 times. Service, delivery and quality are always number 1! I highly recommend this company and their products.Trevor

I've purchased 1# bags of dried porcini previously from a very expensive gourmet food purveyor in NYC.  I tried this product - the price was a bit lower, but the shipping was MUCH lower.  The dried porcini are as good, if not better than from the expensive place.  They arrived promptly and were packaged well.  I immediately put about a third of them into an airtight glass jar on my counter. Packaged the rest up in a doubled freezer bag and put them in the freezer.  They keep well for over a year.  The pieces are large, sliced well, clean and bright.  The aroma is beautiful.  Tossed some into a pot of braised lamb shanks the day they arrived - fabulous...

These mushrooms are wonderful!  They taste rich and woodsy, and add real complexity to soups, stews or anyplace you would use fresh mushrooms.Dried mushrooms don't weigh much, so you will find your order may be larger than you expect.  The supplier recommends that you store them in the refrigerator or freezer.Shipping was amazing.  I ordered them on Friday and received them on Monday, standard shipping -- the package started in Massachusetts and arrived in Seattle in four days!  Very happy with that!

When I bought these mushrooms before, they were clearly labled "from Italy". This time, the origin is not mentioned on the bag, and when I checked their website, I see they've written a bunch of malarky about how porcinis'taste the same wherever they're from, even from North America or China. That is just not true. Porcini from Europe taste better: the terroir changes the mushroom's flavor considerably, just as it changes the flavor of grapes made into wine. Since JR Mushrooms refuses to reveal their country of origin, I must assume they are selling cheaper, possibly contaminated mushrooms from China in order to make a bigger profit. Beware! Buy another brand.
Excellent rich flavor and the mushrooms were freshly dried.  Based on the spores under a microscope, were these 100 percent Boletus edulis?Rick

column9: Porcini Mushrooms - Grade Super Premium AA 4oz
column10: I was not able to find these mushrooms in any nearby stores, so I decided to order on-line through Amazon.  The product came very quickly and although 4 oz doesn't seem like much, my recipe called for only 1/2 oz, so this pack will go a long way.  Once reconstituted, and added to my pot roast they were delicious. They made the sauce really tasty and earthy.  My family loved them.  I will use them in stews and soups in the future.  Well worth ordering at Amazon.  Great service, great product.
These were fair.  I don't feel they are AA quality.  Would not repurchase.

I went for these, when I got a free 30 bucks to spend with a new Amazon Credit Card, and Im glad I didn't pay full price.I was in the process of creating an authentic Bolognese Meat Sauce, and I wanted some very hearty mushrooms to add a bit of OOMPH to the sauce, which is meat and onion heavy, and I figured from the reviews that these are a meaty tasting mushroom.  I also see the price asked for these at our local Giant Eagle grocery stores, so, yeah, I did get a bargain from their rip off pricing, but, these are basically taking up freezer space.I ordered two grades, a higher grade with bigger shroom pieces, less stems, etc, and in retrospect, should have just ordered the scraps, or even the dust, as I found the big pieces stayed a nasty tough chewy texture, even after hours of cooking, I also extracted just juice from the mushrooms, but the broth wasn't strong enough to bother, I basically just chop these in the food processor, and add a LOT of them to get a change in flavor in recipes, the one ounce bags, don't even bother with, because it takes a lot to get some flavor from them.In all honesty, I have not used another Poricini product, so I can't compare, but, I am disappointed with the results I got from these, it may be they do exactly what they are supposed to, for some one with a very tender palate, but, not for me, and in no case, are these ever going to be rehydrated and served on steak, they just stay too nasty of a product to serve by themselves, strictly good for grinding and using in a recipe.

Great product!  The sugar was not stuck together like some date sugars.  It worked great in all the baked goods I used it in and it stayed fresh and loose for the entire time I had it in my pantry.  I will continue to order Barry Farms products.
can't get enough of this sugar,I try to use it sparinglyjust love it so much

This date sugar is very tasty.  I have used it before in making date nut bars, date filled oat meal cookies, bread, and many other recipes as well.  It makes a good tasting alternative to regular or brown sugar in recipes that call for dates, or are date flavored.  Just remember that date sugar is a little sweeter than regular or brown sugar and should be used more sparingly.  Also, date sugar does not melt down and liquify like other sugar either.  When used in recipes it may appear as small brown flakes that give a more concentrated sweetness to cookies, bread, etc.  Date sugar is not cheap, but worth it for the few times you will use it for the special sweetness and flavor it adds. Also, it is near impossible to find in anything but gourmet shops so Amazon is a good bet if you are feeling favorable to it.  The only thing I would suggest is that you either order two or more pouches of this or something else that qualifies you for the free shipping. (If it's still be offered, it was at the time of this writing.) Then it becomes a solid deal and well worth the money.  Recommended...
Date sugar is great for baking,hot cereal and smoothies. I love getting my sweet with ntrients.
Palm oil and coconut oil, 2 of the least healthy oils, are used in the date sugar. I wish this was made clear in the description. I cant eat it!
Looking for a good priced quality product, I am very satisfied with Barry Farm's Date Sugar.Mailed efficiently. Dry and easy to measure. Great taste.

I bought this by looking at all the other reviews thinking this stuff will be the equivalent to sugar, but more healthy like Agave Nectar "Not". I made a glass of tea & I tried a tablespoon & I could not tell even that I put it in, then I put in 2nd tablespoon & again nothing, then 3rd & same then fourth & it was the same, the only difference was now my tea was ruined because it was nothing but undissolved date sugar floating in my tea cup & the water was very hot so this stuff should have dissolved, but no not at all. I think this stuff would be good for things like instead of using white powdered sugar, use date sugar because it is not that sweet. It's all good because I also use other healthy sugar alternatives like ( raw organic Agave Nectar, raw organic honey & organic sugar cane sugar. Packaging was not bad, but for the price I did not expect anything special. It is another healthy option, but not for me because I want something that dissolves & something you can actually use in place of sugar & this was not doing it for me. 4 tablespoons & no change just swimming date grounded powder floating in cup. If your a light sugar type person then this may be what your looking for, but if you are a normal sugar type person that likes to actually taste there tea, then this may not be for you.Update July 24,2012:I updated my 2 stars to 4 stars because I found a wonderful use for this date sugar & it is in smoothies it works perfectly & now I am going to purchase more for that reason & I will try to make other things like cookies, brownies & other sweet goodies. Now that I have found a use for it, it works into my healthier diet really well. I think it was because I actually grounded it into what ever I was blending which made the dried date sugar blend very well. Now I am thinking of taking my tea & putting date sugar in & then blending it in my magic bullet or main blender & seeing if that helps with the tea situation & I know that sounds silly & weird, but it worked for the smoothies & it just may work for everything else. Plus there is nothing better to sweeten something like dates or organic natural fruits, rather then using regular sugar. So worth a try in my book & if it does not work I will still continue to use it for other stuff & also use the date sugar for sure for my smoothies & hopefully future other things. Will see!
when I received this product I discovered that it contains calcium sterate, which is made from animals. This should have been made clear before I ordered the product.
Sylvia's Hush Puppy Mix is the best mix I have ever tried.  Just have to add a little onion and maybe jalepeno's and they are really good.

Great!!! Takes the guess work out of remembering a recipe to share with others.  You can doctor it up and add bell pepper,onion & 1/2 cup of extra flour for a delightful appetizer. All my shrimpers love it!

I believe Taster's Choice is one of the better off-the-shelf instant coffees. In the past, I tried many but I like the taste of this brand - comparatively speaking. In the stores, this brand often costs more than the others so this price for this quantity is a good deal. I purchased this product for a co-worker who has recently started drinking coffee. After seeing him drinking some really bad tasting and weak brands, I recommended Taster's Choice. He said he didn't know any difference in coffees. But after drinking Taster's Choice, he indeed declared that it was much better than the others. It's favorful and not too strong. Personally, I am a Starbucks, Seattle's Best and a new product line I've discovered, Joe (from Paramount Coffee Co.) coffee drinker. But, in a moment of desperation and lacking any possibility to acquire any of the above listed brands, I'd borrow some of the Taster's Choice I gifted to my co-worker.

Have usd this product for many many years when I lived in Hawaii.  Finding it through Amazon.com was a surprise - but a very pleasant one.  This product is manufactured in Hawaii and the factory does not sell directly to the public and does not have wide continental US distribution.  This was so easy and as usual, with amazon.com, a pleasant experience.  And SO glad to find one of my favorite cooking items.
Get rid of that salty nastiness you call soy sauce and step up to Aloha Shoyu.  Your tongue will thank you.  Order plenty though.  You are going to find all sorts of new uses for it.

column9: The Best Soy Sauce you can buy.
column10: I love Shoyu Soy Sauce.  It is the best soy sauce you can buy.  It is naturally lower sodium than the name branditems, and it takes better.  It is less salty and has a better soy flavor.  I had three bottles of this in my refridgerator when I moved to Florida.  I gave them all to my daughter, not knowing that I would NOT be able to find it own in Florida anywhere.  I am so happy to see it on Amazon.com and instead of buying an entire case of bottles I was able to buy just one or two bottles at a time.  I am going to be SO HAPPY to have shoyu in my house again.
Aloha Shoya Soy Sauce brings back so many memories of the Ohau and the local flavor. I loved it then as I love it still today. I makes all my plate lunches taste great, can't do without it.

column9: Best soy sauce in the world!
column10: This is a great soy sauce! No one should use any other soy sauce then this. But why pay this crazy price? Just go to the actual site for the comany and get a case of 12 bottles for nearly the same price!

Aloha Shoyu Soy Sauce is fabulous when making jerky.  It does not have the overpowering of sodium that other more familiar named soy sauces have.  There is a slightly sweet almost caramel taste like molasses.  Excellent substitution in Filapino recipes as well.  Mild -

column9: Too Sweet - doesnt compare to the Huy Fong
column10: I find it odd how different this Sriracha can be from the Huy Fong brand (red rooster).  The "other" sriracha is more chili-garlic inspired while this one just tastes like it has too much sugar added.  I tried to get through the bottle, but only got through two servings before buying Huy Fong.  I'm sure some out there prefer this brand, but I feel from a flavor standpoint it is lacking in complexity.

column9: The best hot chili sauce I have tried
column10: I got this chili sauce in a taco kit and I am in pure love. Its very hot, but a very tasty hot ( if that makes sense ) I would totally buy this on Amazon, but don't need 12 bottles- What a great price though for 12 bottles... I am totally craving this sauce, could put on everything.. Very tasty!

column9: It has a weird, peppery odor and flavor that is not good.
column10: I was very disappointed with this product. It has an unpleasant peppery taste and odor. I'm not sure how to rectify this and I should not have to.

column9: Tea made in March 2009 delivered in July 2011
column10: Compared to the Twinings gunpowder green tin my coworker has, this tea is not green in color (it's almost black) and has no scent.  Since it's over 2 years old and it's only wrapped in paper and stored in a cardboard box this is not surprising.  It still tastes like green tea when brewed but I consider it a waste of money.
This tea was produced in March 2009 and sold to me July 2011. It was totally tasteless. The worst gunpowder I purchased through amazon ever.

column9: Good, but Not Quite as Expected
column10: The tea wasn't light green as it was shown in the picture, but rather a dark green-brown. That might be attributed to the flash of the camera, but I'm not certain.  The tea itself definitely has a bit of a smoky flavor as desired by a gunpowder green tea, and is mostly in a pellet form, so I give it a 4/5 stars. Definitely worth the price.
As described. Tastes great. I make a large pot of it and keep it in the fridge for the week and it works out perfectly.

column9: This is the best, my mother use to use it.
column10: I love the flavor of this, it is also in glass not plastic. I always choose glass, I do my best to avoid plastic. This is the same as my grandmother use to buy, it's the BEST!!!!

column9: simply amazing - obviously not all gluten free pasta is created equally
column10: You will not be dissapointed if you buy this gluten free pasta. It is worth every penny spent. I have paid as much as $8 at local store (not many carry it) before they were unable to import it. I was thrilled when I found it offered on Amazon. I sold half of my shipment to my celiac sister. If you're part of a support group perhaps consider a group order to defray the cost. This pasta really puts the other top seller to shame. I am a self proclaimed pasta junkie and I have tried most of the gluten free varieties available. Try this and you will love it. Time to step down from my soapbox.

BiAglut Gluten-Free Spaghetti Pasta, 17.6 Ounce Packages (Pack of 10)BiAglut Gluten-Free Spaghetti Pasta, 17.6 Ounce Package is the best pasta I have tried. I have found with others like the Ancient Grain with Quinoa that sauce just kind of slides off and you dont get very much in a package. This one is the best tasting, sauce grabbing with the right pasta consistency and price per plate I have tried. Heinz makes a great product.

This is definitely the best GF pasta out there and we've tried them all (rice, corn, corn/rice, quinoa, etc.)  When the Bi Aglut pasta is  done cooking, you don't get a pot of thick, gooey water like with rice pasta.  It cooks up like normal pasta and also, it isn't as sweet as rice pasta. It's even good for leftovers the next day - most rice pasta falls apart into little tiny pieces when you try to reheat it and stir it.My wife and I find the we can get 2 meals out of each 17 oz package of spaghetti.  Most GF pasta comes in smaller packages, cost almost as much and you only get 1 meal.  So, in the long run, the Bi Aglut Pasta is actually less expensive for us.We've also eaten the elbow macaroni, penne and the fusili - all are great. We were able to get it from a local store in upstate NY, but had to move to CT for a new job and nobody carries it locally.  I guess we need to order it off the web now.

This pasta tastes, cooks and reheats like regular pasta. Wish it was available in stores but have to get it online for now. Worth every penny. My non-celiac family members say this the only GF pasta (of the bazillion we had tried) that tastes like regular pasta.

I really like these oats.  Every morning they are in my bag as I head out to work.  Add very hot water. (I heat the water in a hot pot) Stir, put the lid back on, and wait 3-4 minutes.  With a coffee, I have breakfast!  It lasts me well in to lunch time.  I just wish they weren't so expensive.  Oh well, I guess you get what you pay for, a delicious bowl of oats.  The other nice thing...the cardboard "bowl" is recyclable.

I had decided packaged oatmeal was a disappointing mush.  Umpqua Oats won me over!  Always warm and hearty, with just the right amounts of sweet, salty, and whole oats.  Mostly Sunny and Kick Start are my two favorites, but I ordered the 12 variety pack to change it up a bit, and was not disappointed.
My husband was missing pasta since diagnosed with type II diabetes. This lasagna did not raise his blood sugar.  I would recommend it.

column9: All it's cracked up to be!
column10: The pasta will certainly meet all of its nutritional and taste specs since i have had it once or twice in the past. Because i have not been able to find this particular dreamfield product at either the local publix or sweetbay supermarkets i ordered it online. the shipment arrived with many of the pasta strips broken. i imagine this was probably due to jostling in shipping and i really don't know how the problem could be remedied. bubble wrap each strip perhaps!!!

column9: Great tasting and a low carb pasta
column10: I have used Dreamfields Pasta for over a year and it tastes great and only has 5 carbs per serving. For a person who has to watch her blood sugar, this is a perfect product. It arrived on time and intact.  Thank you, Dreamfields!

This has to be one of the best low carb pasta's we have tried. We like the Lasagna best of all the Dreamfields prouducts. We can not find it in our local stores. So it is great to be able to order it on Amazon. We alway get our orders right away.

column9: Fantastic Low Carb Pasta! Highly Recommended
column10: This great tasting pasta is a diabetic's Godsend! Being a Type 2 Diabetic, I am always looking for ways to reduce my carb intake. Up till now that has meant avoiding pasta completely since a single serving of normal pasta has about 35 - 40 carbs. This has been one of the biggest impacts to my diet as we love Italian cooking. I was not sure about Dreamfields' claim to only have 5 carbs, but we gave it a try anyway.After having a full serving, my blood sugar levels only took a modest rise, about what I would have expected from 5 carbs (plus the 15 others from the rest of the meal)!We have tried almost all of the Dreamfields pastas, but have really enjoyed being able to have lasagna again!It does cost more than regular pasta, but it is worth it to me to be able to eat pasta again.Highly Recommended!

column4: Paul Hersh "serious cook and bottle washer"
column10: This is the most successful version of Dreamfield's pastas I've tried. All of them seem to benefit from slight undercooking, but of course lasagna is twice cooked. Would it work? Using low fat ground beef, low fat ground sausage, fresh spinach, sauce made with whole tomatoes and fresh veggies, and "just enough" cheese, it held up surprisingly well and made a satisfying holiday buffet dish with very few carbs, lower fat, and a minimum of calories.

column9: Dreamfield Pasta products-Excellent taste, low carb and healthier
column10: All of the pasta from Dreamfields is excellent.  I was diagnoised with pre-diabetes and I love pasta, this is a excellent product and it taste great.  It is the best product on the market that you don't have to worry about eating two many carbs.

column9: Good pasta and a help for diabetic diet
column10: Pasta is as good as any and relatively low carbs helps with my diabetic diet.

Dreamfields Pasta is an excellent product.  It enables me to have lasagne on a low carb diet.  I cannot detect a difference in taste between this and regular lasagne pasta.  Grocery Stores do not carry a full line of Dreamfields Pasta.  Amazon makes it easy to order it online!

While I love Dreamfield products, I would STRONGLY SUGGEST not ordering the Lasagna noodles for delivery.  Out of a 12 Box case, every box had at least 40% of the noodles damaged in shipping. When I opened the case, there were busted pieces of noodle that had already come out of the packaging of each individual box.  I only did this because none of my local supermarkets carry the Lasagna noodles. I will not make this mistake again, and I hope you don't either!

column4: The Frugal Diva "Loving My Amazon Deals!"
column10: Living a low carb lifestyle is tough for a pasta lover.  However this is wonderful.  Even my husband who is very picky when it comes to low carb substitutes can't tell the difference.  We even break these up and use them in our beef stew (for the larger noodles).  I have absolutely no complaints when it comes to the taste of this product!

Love Dreamfields Pasta.  Can't get the lasagna noodles where I live so I was so happy to find them at Amazon.Delivery was quick.  The only thing is the noodles got broken in shipment which was a dissappointment.
BEING A DIABETIC THIS PRODUCT IS WONDERFUL. FINALLY BEING ABLE, LIKE GARFIELD, HAVING LASAGNA AGAIN. GREAT TASTE AND TEXTURE.PETE

I am a type 1 diabetic and am extremely careful of what carbs I consume.  This has proven to have the best taste and doesn't raise my glucose level out of site.  I use all the Dream Field'sw pasta products.
I ordered several boxes of lasagna noodles.  Most of the noodle were cracked and fell apart, or were just broken.  Disappointing for a good product. For what I received it was pretty expensive.

column9: Tried Dreamfields spaghetti & it was awesome.. Trying lasanga tonight!
column10: I was just looking a reviews on here as well, and realized that if people order their pasta from here they are way over paying for it! You can order direct on their website for a 1/8th a price! Just do a google search for their actual website. I hate to see when people are getting ripped off for something they did not know about.

I purchased Deamfields Lasagne at Amazon.com.  Almost all the noodles were broken when they arrived.  The noodles themselves were very good when cooked.  My husband didn't notice the difference from the noodles bought in the store.  Because they are low carb, I can use them on my Atkins' diet.

While the noodles were tasty and cooked well, they were all broken by the time they arrived, there wasn't a single whole noodle in the box. I did still make a nice pan of lasagna, but I won't be purchasing them again unless they are at a store nearby.

column9: Lasagne is back on my Can Eat foods. You Made Good!
column10: I had complained that my noodles were broken but the second shipment came fine. I can now have lasagne! It didn't hurt my blood sugar and it was easy to work with. I will be buying more as I need. Thank you for being a Stand Up company. Most would not care. I'm very happy and will let my diabetic friends know about you. Thanks and many blessings!

column9: tastes fine but came in little broken bits
column10: I ordered this and it tasted fine, like normal pasta. It did give my family gas, but it did not raise my blood sugar. I ordered 2 boxes to try it and both boxes were shattered. I had 1 unbroken piece in 2 boxes which was disappointing. I paid over $[...] in shipping for 2 boxes and they took over a week to arrive and then came in bits. For that price I expect whole product.If my local grocery carried this, I would buy it regularly, but with the price of the product and the shipping so expensive, I most likely won't order this again.

The carton arrived with most of the boxes containing broken pieces of lasagna.  Its hard to make lasagna with jigsaw pieces of pasta.  It was very disappointing and even more disappointing when I didn't get a response from Amazon to my complaint.
This product is great.  It tastes exactly like the regular pasta and allows my diabetic husband to enjoy pasta dishes again.

My husband is diabetic and loves homemade lasagna.  Our local grocery store carries spaghetti,elbows and penne style pasta of Dreamfields.  So I decided to order online and am so glad I did.  On these cold winter nights we have enjoyed homemade lasagna which does not elevate my husbands blood glucose.  So enjoy!  I was worried about breakage of the noodles but it was well wrapped with bubble pack, there was no more breakage than from a grocery store shelf.
Product is good but 95% of the pasta arrived broken.  I will stick to the Dreamfields products available in stores from now on.

This is the only pasta I eat.  It doesn't raise my blood sugar and it's more filling than plain pasta. I am diabetic and it's great for me (I'm sure it works differently on everyone's blood sugar so you'll have to check individually).  I have the Dreamfields lasagna, angel hair, rotini and linguine.  I love them all!
Best tasting low carb pasta ever eaten. I only problem is the packaging for shipping, needs to improve. Order 6 boxes , half the boxes were broken up.

column9: Awesome taste for being high in fiber
column10: Most high fiber stuff is not so good, Dream fields is not the wheat type, so it is good as any "white" noodle that doesn't have any nutritional value.

column9: Reacted very badly to this pasta
column10: My wife and I ate the recommended serving (2 oz dried). It was delicious, and we felt full afterwards. Later that night, neither of us slept well because we were so hungry. I don't know if this is related, but we both had heart palpitations that night.We both woke up feeling starved. I usually don't even feel hungry in the morning! My wife checked her blood sugar levels (she has gestational diabetes) and found they had skyrocketed.This is not a low-carb product, it is a high-carb product where the carbs have been altered in a way that affects absorption - but not necessarily to truly lower its glycemic impact.If it works for you, great, but it REALLY did not work for us. We're throwing out all the boxes that I bought based on the 5 star ratings here. If you want to try it, start with a single box and see how it makes you feel.
I enjoy the Trident White Gum. It has a great lasting flavor, and it is pleasant to chew. It also helps my heartburn (reduces it) and freshens my breath. I will buy it again.

column9: fine sugarless gum with a peppermint burst
column10: Trident White makes a terrific peppermint flavored sugarless gum. The sugar free gum is healthier for your teeth; and the gum makes your breath fresh in an instant. The thin cardboard package is easy to carry because it is so small; and inside the thin cardboard package the pieces of gum are wrapped individually in tiny plastic pockets that are easy to open. The package states that the gum whitens teeth but I cannot comment on that. Always remember to brush your teeth--this gum isn't a substitute for that!A single piece of gum has nothing more than a measly five calories; and there's no fat, no sodium and no sugar. Trident White uses sorbitol and aspartame to sweeten the gum. Moreover, the gum stays fresh until the expiration date stamped on the reverse of the package. Good job!Unfortunately, there are a couple of caveats: The gum contains a milk derived ingredient and it contains phenylalanine. If either of these ingredients pose a concern for you please consult your doctor before chewing this gum.Have further questions? No problem--the manufacturers give you both a toll free number and a website. The website goes into detail about how this gum helps to whiten your teeth.Overall, this is a great gum that comes packaged in an easy to carry container. This gum makes your breath fresh; and it's a very tasty gum that you won't want to spit out after a mere five minutes.Highly recommended.

column9: why are met expectations not the norm
column10: just what I ordered and in the usual prompt manner

column9: Best glutenfree "vermicelli" I've come across yet...
column10: I confess, I bought the last subscription to this item.  And I sure hope it will be back in stock when my 6 boxes are gone.  It is the only rice spaghetti I've found that is actually "vermicelli" and I love vermicelli, not the fat stuff!  It holds up like real wheat vermicelli, doesn't stick together like corn/quinoa thin linguine, and tastes and feels like THE REAL THING.  Also, you can smell the spinach powder in this product when you open the box.  I cooked it up tonight and my only recommendation is:  Use the longer cooking time and maybe even add a minute.  Be sure to check by trying to cut the pasta before you remove it from the cooking water.  As with most rice pastas, it doesn't plump up as much as wheat pasta.  An 8 oz. box provides enough pasta for only 2 small plates of vermicelli.  But still, it was worth it!

column9: Takes A Little Practice to Get Right, But Yum!
column10: Like all rice pastas, it takes a few tries to get it to cook up right so it's not too tough or too over cooked. Once you get it right though, it's wonderful.The spinach flavoring was subtle, but delicious with pesto sauce. It certainly won't clash with any sauces, but it can add a nice oomph to their flavor.The Amazon price is a great deal too. I hate buying this stuff in stores, my local grocer wants $5 a package for all GF pastas. Yeah right!

I don't know why I can't find this is ANY store so I jumped on Amazon and found it.Being hypoglycemic, this is sometimes a must do for me post work out. It's easier for me and cheaper than buying the other drinks and carrying another bottle along w/my water bottle.

I was really disappointed in the quality of these bullseyes.  They were very hard not soft like the others I have gotten.  The ones I got a long time ago were nice and soft.  These were too hard to do anything with. I had to throw them away.
I love this candy and can't seem to find it in stores any longer so I was pleased to find them through Amazon.  The delivery didn't take any time at all either, very prompt service.
candy was very stale. i didnt send it back because i had to pay for it. i usually get great service from amazon but not this time. i just chalk it up as a loss.thanks bob delp

column9: Never thought I like Cahi tea
column10: I love tea, but never been a fan of Chai tea. Then my sister sent me this brand, and it is delicious! A wonderful rich flavor similar to hot chocolate, but not so sweet. No transfats, no gluten, no hydrogenated oils. 99% caffeine free, so you can enjoy it in the afternoon. I haven't tried the vanilla or chocolate yet, but am sure going to. Try it by buying the smaller packets, and if you like it, it's available at Sam's Club in a big can for a very cost-saving price.

column9: Good, but I was expecting more
column10: The saltiness of the caramels added a very interesting aspect that was rather nice and although they are good, it left me desiring something more.  To give you an idea, this is somewhat like a Tootsie Roll with a bit of salty crunch added.  I guess I was hoping for something richer.  I won't buy these again, but I'm not disappointed that I bought them.

Scharffen Berger Chocolate is one of the best premium chocolate bars out there. When they were based in Berkeley, I had taken a tour of the factory and was able to taste many of their bars. Of all the different Scharffen Berger bars there are, the Sea Salted Almond bar is definitely my favorite. This particular flavor  is so hard to find in stores that I'm excited that Amazon carries this flavor.The Sea Salted Almond bar is labeled as milk chocolate. However, it contains 41% Cocoa which makes it a "darker" chocolate than most milk chocolate bars out there. The higher cocoa content gives the chocolate the quality of a semi-sweet chocolate. Despite the higher cocoa content, the bar still has the smooth mouth feel of milk chocolate. The smooth texture of the chocolate contrasts nicely with the slight saltiness from the sea salt and crunchiness from the tiny almond pieces. This chocolate is everything you expect from a high quality chocolate bar: not too sweet, complex chocolate flavor, and a nice balance of flavor and texture from the added ingredients.

I believe in full disclosure so I will admit up front that I am a chocoholic. I am partial to milk chocolate such as is contained in these bars. I am not knowingly familiar with sea salted chocolate and I can't say that I can identify sea salt in this product. What I can identify is an excellent flavor. The almonds are chopped into tiny pieces which makes them easy to consume but still distinctive enough to provide the unique almond flavor. The milk chocolate has a superb taste and a perfect level of sweetness. One need not be a connoisseur of chocolate to appreciate the quality of this product.

I absolutely love these chocolate bars! They come nicely wrapped in thin (3oz) bars you'll have trouble setting down. There are thin grooves in the bar to pattern it and make it easy to break off in triangles, though I prefer cracking the bar before opening it and eating it in tiny pieces.The chocolate is sweet, as milk chocolate should be, but not overly sweet, probably thanks to the salt. The almonds are in tiny fractions, so you can chew the almond crunch or let it melt in your mouth.The package says it's 41% cacao milk chocolate. Ingredients include cocoa butter, nonfat milk, safflower oil, non-gmo soy lecithin, etc. and is gluten-free. One serving (half-bar) is 220 calories and contains 19g of carbs (so I should probably go easy, huh...).I received my package at the end of October and each bar says Best By '07/2012'. Well, let's see if I can make them last that long!

column9: Smooth nutty taste.  Your taste buds will say thank you.
column10: I love chocolate with almonds.  Buy those Hershey bars all the time.  This was a different taste.  I have to say it took a few bites/swallows to get used to a different taste sensation.  Of course, ah, I had to try a number of bites to be clear as to my opinion (smile).It is a great chocolate bar.  Smooth, light and crunchy.  The almonds are not huge, but they are noticeably there.Great quality bar with a nice smooth taste that will get your taste buds asking for more.  Enjoy!

I was surprised by my first taste of this chocolate. I checked the label to make sure that I had not misunderstood, but I'd made no error. It was milk chocolate. I guess I was expecting a high-class Hershey Bar, but that isn't at all what this product is about. The description for this chocolate says that the Scharffen Berger founders, "tested multiple combinations before perfecting a unique blend that highlighted the true flavor of cacao instead of masking it with sugar and other flavors." I think they succeeded.The chocolate is smooth and rich, but not overly sweet. If you have a real "sweet tooth," and like your chocolate with plenty of sugar, you might be disappointed.The almonds are ground up into very small pieces and distributed evenly through the bar. There is just a suggestion of salt, and I think this also counteracts some of the chocolate's sweetness that you might otherwise taste.I am currently dieting by counting calories. As a testimonial, I will tell you that any time I can get to the end of the day with 100 or so calories to spend, it means a bedtime snack of just a little of this delectable treat.

This is high quality chocolate, with a smooth, light taste.  I liked how the almonds were cut very fine.  The sea salt flavor was a bit strong for me, but if you like a good contrast of salt with chocolate, you might like it.  It would probably work well for baking, though I didn't try that.  I would definitely buy this brand again, but would probably select another flavor combination.

Who can resist a candy bar made of chocolate and almonds?  Not us!  Then when the almonds are sea salted it becomes a perfect combination of sweet and salty.We shared these with friends and they were all as enthusiastic about this "discovery" as we were.Further, the bars are a generous size - not at all skimpy.  Great to have on hand to take to the movies and avoid paying exorbitant price for sweets in the theater!

Salty almond chocolate bars are my very favorite combo, so I was very excited to try this Scharffen Berger bar. My past experience with Scharffen Berger was always excellent, and I expected the same here.While it was a tasty enough bar, it was nothing exceptional or that I'd recommend or buy again.The chocolate was fine, less creamy than I'd expect for milk chocolate, and a bit grainy, but with a full cocoa flavor. The almonds were just shreds and crumbs instead of the nice coarse chunks you typically find in a good salted almond bar.Overall, I wouldn't be embarrassed to share one, but no raves. It's about at or slightly below the quality of any of the 3oz bars you find at decent grocery stores, certainly not gourmet caliber, and not my first choice by a long stretch for a salty chocolate fix.

column9: Good, but nothing special considering the price
column10: I like Scharffen Berger's darker chocolates, so I thought I would give this milk chocolate with almonds a try.  While I cannot say that I don't like it (hence the four stars), I have to say that I don't think its quality matches the price.  Amazon's recent Lightning Deal price was reasonable (just shy of $3 per bar), but I've had other milk chocolate bars that are far better than these at full price.  If you like milk chocolate better than dark chocolate, however, you might like these very much:  the chocolate is very milky/smooth, not waxy in the least.  And the almond pieces are fairly small and well distributed throughout the chocolate, not just big chunks of almonds surrounded by chocolate like Hershey's.

column9: Velvety Smooth and Big on Yummy Factor
column10: I would definitely get this chocolate again!  The texture is velvety smooth and melts in your mouth.  And the almond bits are scrumptiously delish. This one's so good, it's dangerous.  I'll be keeping my eye out for this one.  It might be my new favorite bar.  Top notch!  Treat yourself or give it as a decadent gift, either way, someone's taste buds will be happy.

This chocolate is quite a treat.  I love milk chocolate, and prefer it over dark er chocolate, but what I really like about this chocolate bar is that it is not too sweet, like some chocolate bars are, for instance, like a Hershey bar.  Not that there isn't a place for that kind of chocolate, but this is for more mature tastes.  The mouth feel is very smooth and creamy, the flavor is rich, and the almonds are chopped, which I really like.  Maybe my palate is not very discerning, but I had a difficult time getting the "salty" flavor, but I might just be missing it.  Overall, this was a very wonderful chocolate bar!  Everyone in my family loved it.  Not your average chocolate bar, and worth the extra cost, a gourmet chocolate.

column9: Really good chocolate, almonds and sea salt - Magical!
column10: These Scharffen Berger Milk Chocolate bars with Sea Salted Almonds are excellent. The 4 ounce bars are made with 41% cacao milk chocolate. Sea salt and chocolate is currently a hugely popular flavor mix and that combined with chopped almonds is blissfully delicious. The salt is very subtle here and could stand to be a bit more assertive, but who's complaining. The chocolate is pretty soft with a very smooth mouth-feel. Be careful to keep the bars away from warmth - they soften quite easily. Milk chocolate doesn't get much better than this! Highly recommended.

Okay folks, this is some great kind of chocolate. The chocolate itself is labeled milk, but at 41% cacao, has a nice dark taste. Add this with the salted almonds and wow, this combo is great!!! Enjoy!

I once read that the reason there's a difference between American and European chocolate is that Americans view chocolate as candy while it's considered dessert in Europe.  This heavenly chocolate is definitely in the dessert category.  The almonds are perfectly tiny and dispersed throughout rather than the big chunks so often found in the candy bar purchased from the rack near the checkout.  The flavor is incredible.  I love chocolate and this one is definitely in my top five.

We had absolutely no idea what to expect when we ordered this bar, but since we're chocoholics we didn't see how we could  go too far wrong.  Not wrong at all!  We're loving this candy.  The label gives one the impression this is a milk chocolte - for us, it is closer to a dark  chocolate yet mellow and more mild.  The flavor stays with you, and the candy literally melts in your  mouth.  The bar is a generous 3 1/2" by 6" and scored in triangles rather than squares (2 bite triangles for us).  It is a thin bar yet each  bite is more than satisfying.  As we're huge fans of sea salt we might have liked a stronger sea salt taste - the almond bits add a nice small crunch.  We enjoyed it as dessert with the last of our glasses of red wine - bliss.  We'll be ordering  more!  - Gail Cooke

A subsidiary of Hersheys, Scharffen Berger is a small company in San Francisco that actually makes chocolate, from the beans. It deals directly with the growers to select and purchase high quality cacao beans of specific origins. Scharffen Berger does not advertise its chocolate as "Fair Trade" chocolate, but has a policy of not buying beans from the west coast of Africa, where the industry is know to practice slavery and use child labor. Note: this chocolate is not labeled "organic."This is a 41% cacao bar labeled as milk chocolate with sea salted almonds.  The bar has a nice, smooth, glossy appearance. The smell is of a French confiserie. Yes, just close your eyes and draw a deep breath. This scent reminds me of molded chocolate and chocolates wrapped in thin foil with fancy ribbon.The bar breaks with a nice snap, indicating that the chocolate has been well tempered. Small pieces of chopped, roasted and salted almonds are evenly scattered within the bar.The chocolate melts is creamy as it melts in your mouth. You taste caramel. It is sweet but not too sweet. The saltiness appears after the chocolate melts, leaving the almonds on your tongue. The combination is very tasty. The chocolate has a pleasant finish, not dark, not overly sweet, just right.The allure of this bar was so intense, it required finishing the entire bar. Need I say more?

column9: I love nuts in chocolate- this was OK.
column10: I do  not think I am a huge fan of chopped up really small nut pieces in chocolate.This brand of chocolate IMO it divine, I also tried the milk chocolate bar and LOVED it!I usually LOVE almonds in chocolate instead of plain chocolate, but this case it was not true.I think the nuts were chopped up too small to really give that satisfying nutty crunch and taste, in essence "watering" the sensation down.It is still a great chocolate bar brand!!!

column9: review for scharffen berger milk chocolate with sea salt almond
column10: These chocolate bars are delicious. I liked how they weren't too sweet like many milk chocolate bars can be. I also liked the hint of sea salt. I had been craving chocolate bars with sea salt in them after trying the Lindt kind. If you like those you will probably like these as well. These are similar but a little less sweet.

column9: Delicious chocolate, lightly salted almonds...used to sweeter flavor
column10: Great chocolate bars from both an ingredient and flavor standpoint.  If you're the type that enjoys the sweet and salty combination, these milk chocolate with salted almond bars should be at the top of your list.  They're quite good, and have a very smooth texture as well.My biggest complaint, which is just personal preference, is that other chocolate bars I enjoy are a bit sweeter.  The Newman's Own Organics Milk Chocolate Bar, while being only 34% cacao are great and have the additional sweetness I prefer.  (Hey, it's chocolate - may as well have a bunch of sugar to go along with it!)  More mainstream (but infinitely better than what "Hershey's" and other popular companies call "chocolate")...Ghirardelli.
