column10: Great price and healthy product.  Great for sports recovery and after being in the heat.  I live in GA where the heat index is often over 100 and this product works well.  One note is that to get good taste, I double the amount suggested.  Plus, it is cheaper and better for you than the gatorade like products.  Fruit Punch so far is my favorite flavor.

Over the past many years I have used several different electrolyte solutions and Vitalyte works the best for me. Using Vitalyte I find that I stay far better hydrated and energized than drinking water alone or when compared to many other electrolytes that I've tried. It isn't too sweet and only mildly sticky. The less sweet taste and electrolyte blend makes it easy on your stomach and that is important on long rides when water or other brands can cause stomach upset.In summary...I have found the product that works for me and no longer need to look for a better solution.

I was looking for a product to combat dehydration following my husbands surgery. Gatorade just wasn't good enough. This product came highly recommended so I thought I would try it. It has really helped keep my husband hydrated as well as tasting good without being too sweet. Very economical to use when compared to prepackaged similar products.

i have two rabbits, and they can't get enough of these "munch sticks", they totally devoure them every time i give them one. the local pet store can order them but they are too expencive, so even after shipping, i order mine on line.i have plenty left for now, but will be ordering more through here in the future.keep up the great work !V/r Richard Levangie.

We have gotten this on subscribe and save so many times; definitely one of our top three favorite cereals; I am glad I can get it so conveniently on Amazon. I love shredded wheat cereal, and find the pre-sweetened versions the best. While regular frosted is great, the strawberry has a more appealing flavor and has that delicious strawberry smell. I find this cereal travels well too, and does not settle after shipping.
I am surprised that they are so expensive at Amazon. I just bought a box of 16 Pikes place at Lowe's for $14.95, and Sumatra is even cheaper at $ 11.95.

I buy Pikes place a lot at the starbucks, I am a black coffee drinker, love the flavor of the coffee alone. I bought these hesitantly - honestly expecting to be disappointed. To my surprise these cups really taste like they came from the coffee shop! And at 0.67 per cup where I bought them, this is a large savings not only in $$$ but in time.

...this is no better than the competing brands (Tully's, Green Mountain, etc.) that have been out long before Starbucks decided they (finally) had to jump on the Keurig bandwagon. In fact, to me it tastes very close to Newman's Own Extra Bold blend. So while it's good, it doesn't have the intensity of flavor that you get at their stores, and therefore not worth the higher price. I'm still going to try their Sumatra and House Blend but Pike's Place k-cup is a little disappointing. My personal favorite is still Tully's House Blend.

This is pretty good "basic" coffee.  It has a decent flavor, and isn't overly strong, and has a pleasant scent.  I generally prefer a stronger blend, but I toss this one in every once in a while, even though it isn't as strong as Sumatra or Cafe Verona, because it is just a "pleasant" cup of coffee (to me).

column9: Solid Medium Blend with a Slight Kick, but also a Slight Burnt Coffee Aftertaste
column10: Starbucks Pike Place Roast provides the advertised Medium Roast blend.  The bonus is that it has a slight kick to it, so it makes for a nice morning cup of coffee.However, the downside is that there is a slight burnt coffee aftertaste to this blend, so that is the reason for my 3 star rating.  For nice medium blend, slight kick coffees with no burnt coffee aftertaste, try Wolfgang Puck Coffee, Vienna Coffee House (Medium Roast), 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2) or Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50).

I was happy to see starbucks for the k-cup. Some are good (dark sumatra) the Pike Place medium roast has a strange burnt taste that is unpleasant and lingers on the tongue. A bland burnt tasting coffee like in a restaurant when you're getting the remains of a pot that was made an hour ago and has been sitting on the heater to long. Drinkable, but not good.

As avid Keurig users - and Tassimo converts - we were thrilled to finally find Starbucks K-cups had arrived. I purchased 1 box of 16 K-cups for $21.90  - Pike's PlaceRoast - here on Amazon.  And the taste didn't disappoint. We were very satisfied with it and feel it rivals the taste of a cup purchased at a Starbucks store. Unfortunately, the price also rivals that of a cup purchased at a Starbucks store.Here's the math. We have been drinking Caribou Blend coffees to this point.Caribou Blend on average = $0.67/cupStarbucks =  $1.37/cupWe understand that Starbucks is a "premium" coffee and don't expect it to be cheap. Caribou is also premium coffee and we can afford to by either. But on principle, suspecting Starbucks Corporate folks set the price, we've decided to stay with Caribou. Based on our household coffee consumption, we would pay a whopping $1,660.00/year more to have Starbucks. So we're going to vote with our $$ and stick with Caribou.  (For those of you who are Kindle owners, this feels like the publisher price gouging we experienced when they set prices at 50% more than Amazon's.)

I wasn't sure if they would ever release k-cups, but at last they did! By far the best k-cup I have ever had. The taste is spot on to walking into Starbucks and grabbing a cup there.  Yes, they are a bit pricey, but they were just released, to give the product a 1 star review just because they cost a bit more then the average k-cup, is just ridiculous! Besides, it is way cheaper then going and getting a cup at Starbucks!

A nutritionist recommended Kashi products to me. If you're hankering for a Snickers candy bar, these might not satisfy you. However, I actually prefer the taste of these to a candy bar now. They're not heavy. And you feel good after you eat them. If you want a crunchy, nutty, dark chocolate treat that is actually healthy for you, you may want to try these. One bar is 4g of fiber or 15% of your daily requirement. 80% of adults don't get enough fiber, so these are an easy and tasty way to get some. They are low in sugar--only 6 gms--about the same as in a cup of Cheerios or Total.The nutritionist said to think of sugar as poison--your body wants to eliminate sugar before fat, so stay low in sugar. I keep one of these bars in my purse when I'm out doing errands in case I get hungry. I love the dark chocolate chips and nutty crunch of the almonds. Almonds are a great source of vitamin E and are recommended for nutrition. One bar at 130 calories is quite satisfying and is a great go-to treat when you want a little sweetness in your day. These are great for after dinner, too, when you want something semi-sweet and not heavy.One bar is only 3 points on Weight Watcher's point system. I took a box to my Weight Watcher's meeting to recommend them for a healthy snack. I've lost 30 pounds and reversed diabetes in the past 2 years eating healthy foods: low-sugar, low-fat natural vegetable/fruits/protein/dairy diet with little to no artificially flavored and processed foods. These bars are my treat when I'm desiring a little fun without the guilt. Now that nutritionists say a little bit of dark chocolate is good for you every day, these are a non-guilty pleasure.  I haven't found a chocolate dessert treat that's lower in calories/sugar and healthier. I always keep a box of these chewy dark mocha almond granola bars in the house.
The Kashi bars were good.  They arrived quickly and were fresh.  I was very satisfied with the process from start to finish.
My mom brought these yummy bars for me as a on the go breakfast they are super good I definitely reccomend and they fill u up.

I was suspicious [crunch] of another wholesome snack promising a "nourishing mix of goodness" [munch, munch]. What a tasty surprise...[crunch, crunch]...cocoa and a hint of cinnamon. Seriously. Where's the milk? [munch]Marketed for health & wellness customers, the package touts whole grain oats, sesame seeds and whole brown rice. One serving of Sweet Cinnamon Crispy Thins is 46 pieces (there's plenty of snacking) and only packs 120 calories.Health benefits aside, this snack can attract fans based on taste alone. The texture reminds me of breakfast cereal more than granola. The cocoa and cinnamon match adult tastes, i.e. the flavors are rich without becoming overwhelmingly sweet after you eat a couple pieces.The company also offers a Red Raspberry flavor and suggests pairing its "Savory Sea Salt" flavor with a glass or red wine. I agree. Either the Sweet Cinnamon or Red Raspberry flavors would taste great sprinkled atop yogurt.On another positive note, I didn't detect the artificial sweetener aftertaste so common with health & wellness snacks. Eat.Think.Smile uses dried cane syrup in their crispy thins.Eat.Think.Smile products are produced by Apure Foods Company, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Hershey Company. The snacks, manufactured in the United States, come in a re-sealable pouch. I read this eye-catching information from the company website:"We blend Cocoa Lavado with natural cocoa to create a premium blend of cocoa present in all Eat. Think.Smile(tm) products. Cocoa Lavado literally means "washed cocoa." The Cocoa Lavado beans are washed by hand on a small scale, possibly how the Mayans processed it traditionally. The cocoa powder produced from these beans delivers higher levels of flavanol antioxidants than the alkalized cocoa powder commonly used in food products. Our natural cocoa powder delivers higher levels of flavanol antioxidants than alkalized cocoa powder commonly used in food products. The natural cocoa in each serving delivers more antioxidant power than a cup of green tea."In summary, the Sweet Cinnamon Crispy Thins win on two counts: they are all natural with a lot of antioxidant power and, more importantly, they are delicious. In fact, [crunch] I'm still thinking about pouring milk over these for breakfast [munch]; or maybe I'll open a bag and pop the cork on a bottle of red wine.Rating: Five stars.

I love chocolate, and I love cinnamon.  I, of course, for sure thought these would be a huge win.  Sadly, they're kind of not.  Its not that they're bad.  They aren't.  Its just that they're not really good either.  They're forgettable.  You don't want to eat the whole bag - which could be a good thing if you have self control issues.  My problem - I feel like 6 bags of these will last forever.They have an impressive serving size (46 pieces per 120 calorie serving/appox 6 per bag) but then I doubt I'd even want to eat that many.  About the size of a goldfish cracker, in the shape of a triangle, you'll find a kind of chocolate tasting, kind of cinnamon tasting cracker cookie with sesame seeds on the top.  It tastes confused.  Not really like chocolate, not really like cinnamon.  Why are there sesame seeds?They're just okay.I ate them in desperation when I had nothing else that looked good to snack on, but haven't touched them since.  They're doomed to remain open but forgotten.I was honestly hoping for something that tasted like a marriage of the chocolate/cinnamon teddy grahams - but healthier with less sugar. Sadly, these are nowhere close.

column9: Make sure you really like cocoa before you buy this
column10: The all-natural ingredients make for very pleasant reading - with dried cane syrup; rice, wheat, corn flour; and sesame seeds combining to provide a delivery vehicle for the anti-oxidants contained in cocoa. Unfortunately for me, the taste of cocoa was so strong, that it overpowered everything else - I could barely detect traces of cinnamon or the other ingredients.While I was very pleased with the fact that there is practically no chemical aftertaste, I don't see myself becoming a fan of this product.Happy Snacking!~Damodar

I love chocolate and cinnamon. The combination of both with a wonderful crunch is surprisingly good. Eat, Think, Smile, Crispy Thins are a bit healthier than other chocolate treats out there. So, in essence, this is a product that I will probably purchase again -- especially when I have guests and need to have an assortment of goodies on the table.

I bought these on a good sale to try them out. They are very dry and taste like there is too much cocoa powder and not enough sugar. To be honest I didnt expect them to be great because they are 'natural' but they still didnt meet my low expectations

These are little triangles of cocoa and cinnamon, though the cinnamon taste is very mild. Made with whole oats, brown rice, sesame seeds, cococa and other ingredients, bettern for you vs. potato chips.I find that I can eat a lot of these at one time. Will certainly order more of them.

column9: Best low cal snack for my sweet tooth!
column10: These little bites of heaven are just amazing! You can have 46 pieces for only 120 calories! Let me tell you what they fill you up too! I am in love with this product. I crave it! The only down side, they don't sell them in my state so I order them online or have family in other parts of the country mail them to me, yes, they are that good! :)

Both my husband and my dad told me to take the bag away from them because they really did like the cinnamon/cocoa crisps. The amazing thing is its around 130 calories per serving and one serving is 46 pieces.My 7 year old son didn't really like them, but he is incredibly picky about everything.I would definitely recommend these to people who like cinnamon and cocoa and want a non-guilty snack.
Crispy and not too bad for you, but you get more of a chocolate than a cinnamon taste.  Good but doesn't quite satisfy a cinnamon nut.

column9: The Cocoa Taste Overpowers the Cinnamon
column10: Being on a health kick for the last couple years, I am always on the lookout for tasty snacking alternatives.  The Eat Think Smile brand boasts an all natural snack with the natural antioxidant of cocoa.  The product is small bit size and fun to eat except for a flavor that is listed as Sweet Cinnamon you can barely taste the cinnamon at all as the taste is vastly overpowered by the taste of cocoa from the first bite to long after you finish thanks to a strong aftertaste.  It is alright but the type of food I would only reach for if the rest of my cupboard is bare.  It is also nice that the bag is re-sealable to keep the food fresh.

Eat, Think, Smile, Crispy Thins, Sweet Cinnamon snacks are crisp and crunchy. These are a very nourishing snack. I woul have like somewhat more taste to them, but overall the are satisfactory. They are not bad, but for my taste I would have liked more chocolate and/or cinnamon taste.

Very flavorful snack and I love the cocoa flavor! Couldn't taste a lot of the cinnamon but enjoyed the flavor nonetheless. It's great as a snack alone or on top of yogurt or ice cream. The great thing about the product is I could identify & pronounce all the ingredients in the crispy thins. And if the claim is true about having antioxidants, then all the better! Even if it doesn't, it's still a great snack and very different from what is normally on grocer's shelves.

The combination of cocoa, cinnamon and sesame seemed like an odd one, but it works!  The packaging also indicates there are oats and brown rice included, although it's the cocoa and cinnamon which are most noticeable.While I'd say the 120 calorie serving size, with six servings in a bag, is optimistic, this snack is probably healthier than most, so the calories are well spent.

I tried both this flavor and the sea salt flavor, and have to say that this was the better of the two.  These snacks are basically puffed grains mixed with cocoa, and covered with cinnamon and sesame seeds.  I expected to like these.  I love chocolate.  I love chocolate mixed with cinnamon.  That said, these snacks simply weren't all that good, and I'm having a hard time on putting my finger on why I don't like them.  I think perhaps it's that there's too much chocolate.  The good thing about these snacks is that I have no desire to keep eating them- there's no addictive impulse here, so I'll quit eating them once my satisfied.  That's also the bad thing, though, as if I'm going to eat a processed snack food I'd like it to be tastier.As for the claims surrounding this product, I think claims of "antioxidant power" in processed food are always questionable.  I certainly think they're questionable here.  Without the cocoa (which is what supposedly provides the antioxidant power) this would be a pretty good snack.

I have to say, after eating the bars that I got through vine here:http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B005BPVE5Y/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_titleI really was afraid to try these.  The bars are AWFUL, but surprisingly, these are pretty good.  They taste a bit like a cinnamon cereal.  They have a nice crunch, and I like the sesame seeds on them.  You can't really taste any of the cocoa in them, all you taste is the cinnamon.  (Which is good, because I don't think chocolate and cinnamon flavors mesh very well.)My husband, who despises any of the stuff I get with natural ingredients, really liked these.  And also my 5-year-old did as well!  They're a good snack, and I would get them again.

These crisp and slightly sweet bites are totally awesome!  I munched them solo for a satisfying afternoon treat with coffee, I placed them in a community bowl for sharing with friends at a patio gathering, I scattered them over the top of a fruit salad and in each and every instance, they were a total knockout!  The slightly sweet, cinnamon and chocolate taste contained in these crispy little puffs are both satisfying and pleasing to eat.  I love them.

If you like the flavor of cocoa, you will probably like these. They are light and crunchy in a way similar to another snack product that has a cheetah for its mascot. They are all sort of triangular in shape and about a quarter of an inch thick.I didn't really notice much cinnamon flavor, but the cocoa comes through quite strong.They have sesame seeds on them, but still taste sweet through and through. The sesame seeds add texture than flavor.I'm a choco-holic, but not a big fan of cocoa.I thought they were ok. I didn't feel the need or desire to eat handfulls of them at a time, which is really a good thing.

column9: A surprisingly addictive, all-natural chocolate-intense snack.
column10: If you think healthy "natural" snacking has to be synonymous with bland or unpleasant, think again.Eat. Think. Smile. Sweet Cinnamon Crispy Thins are actually a fun, tasty, surprisingly addictive treat--that is, once you get beyond the first bite, which does admittedly have an initial "health food" vibe.But the lasting impressing on your taste buds is one that comes surprisingly close to the taste of the tops of brownies.  Despite the so-called Sweet Cinnamon flavor, what really comes through is a generous kick of cocoa, provided by the company's trademarked blend of two cocoas--one African and the other an anti-oxidant-packed Meso-American variety called Lavado.For those who aren't dark chocolate fans, it could seem overpowering, but I like it.  I also appreciate the fact that each six-ounce bag gives you approximately six 120-calorie servings of a generous 46 pieces each--although your chocolate craving should be satisfied long before popping that many.Personally, I could live without the sesame seeds on top, which sort of conflict with that brownie-like experience, but it's a minor quibble for a healthy snacking alternative.

I love cinnamon and when I popped a few of these in my mouth and I wasn't prepared for the overpowering taste of cocoa, which then had quite a bitter afternote to it. They are crunchy and overall a healthy snack alternative to high sugar items. Would I purchase them if given the choice? The answer is no.

column9: More sweet goodness from Eat. Think. Smile
column10: ETS's crispy thins are basically 1/2 inch triangular snacks that pretty tasty and good bang for the buck.The treats are very crunch and can be eaten as a cereal if desired.  They aren't too sweet and one serving (around 46 pieces) is pretty filling while only packing 120 calories.  (The snacks are so filling that I almost wonder if this accurate).  They have a very subtle cinnamon taste and like all ETS products, they also have a very subtle cocoa taste as well.The packaging easily opens and closes and keeps freshness.  Out of the three ETS products I have now experiences, this is by far my favorite.

Hands down, the best new snack I've tried in years!  Seriously, I will be ordering more of these immediately, as these did not last long around my house...These are crispy, with a great (but not bitter) punch of cocoa powder in every bite.  The sesame seeds add a great flavor to them as well -- these are just such a perfect snack when you want something sort of like a chip, but also have a sweet tooth.  Love them!  So did everyone who tried them.  I would give these 6 stars if I could!

Something about these puffy little cinnamon-chocolate snacks reminds me of eating breakfast cereal as a snack. They're not quite crackers, they're not quite cookies. They're also not very "thin" despite the name. They're more puffy than that. They're sweet, crunchy, and tasty, with a nice chocolate punch. A single serving serves me as a satisfying treat, without having a lot of fat or calories. Some vanilla soy milk or green tea is a nice accompaniment. I haven't tried red wine yet, but I bet that would be good too.My husband thought they seemed a bit too "health food". They're definitely not candy, like he was hoping for. But if you want something that is sweet, salty, crunchy, and chocolately, while still being relatively good for you, these are perfect.The chocolate is pretty intense. I do wonder if eating a lot of these would have a stimulant effect.

column9: A healthy snack with subtle sweetness
column10: I have to say that I wasn't a fan of these at first; they tasted a bit too much like cocoa powder, but over time they've really grown on me.  They tasted best when eaten right after a slightly spicy lunch, so maybe this made them a bit sweeter.  Overall, though they are not a very sweet snack, although they do have a hint of sweetness due to the dried cane syrup.  The most predominant flavor is the cocoa, followed by a strong hint of cinnamon, and the texture is very crunchy.This is probably not the snack for someone with a monster sweet tooth who likes a very sugary flavor to their snacks.  But for those preferring a more natural, slightly sweet flavor, this snack will be a good match.  What really sold me on it was the nutritional value.  A serving size is pretty decent for only 120 calories, and that comes along with 8% of your daily fiber, 10% of your daily calcium, and, according to the package, "more natural antioxidant power than a cup of green tea."  I also like that the ingredients are natural and that it's made with whole grains.  I'm glad I didn't give up on it after the first try, because I've been very pleasantly surprised by the taste which has grown on me, and best of all I can feel good about eating this snack.

column9: If you're not into "super sweet," these might be for you
column10: When I first tried this product, I did not really care for it. I decided to give it a few more chances over a week or so, and now I'd have to say that I like it more than I did at first (hence the 4 stars instead of 1!).First of all, I am a person who likes things that I consider super sweet. I am a health nut and my craze for sweet foods is a killer; I've tried so many times to rid my place of sugary stuff, only to have chocolate given to me as a gift or falling to temptation while grocery shopping. I decided to give these treats a try; while not exactly 100% healthy, they are a much better option than eating that candy bar or piece of pie.I was not happy with these at first because they really aren't *that* sweet, and like I said, I really like sweet things. I've only recently begun to like dark chocolate in the past few years; these remind me of the amount of sweetness you'd find in various types of dark chocolate. I wasn't sure how I felt about the hint of cinnamon, and the sesame seeds threw me for a loop.After giving myself various opportunities to try this product, I decided that once I knew what to expect (only a hint of sweetness instead of a slap in the face of sweetness!), they tasted better to me. I like the hint of cinnamon. I'm still not 100% crazy for the sesame seeds (that keeps me from awarding the 5th star), but it's not like they're so horrible that I refuse to finish the package.Overall, I say that you should know what to expect when eating these, and then you might not be as thrown for a loop when you try them. Don't expect them to be as sweet as, say, Cocoa Puffs cereal, but DO expect them to give you that slight hint of chocolate that might just satisfy your craving (without going crazy on calories).

column9: They are addictive little critters...just make sure you are eating an ounce
column10: I really love these crispy thins.  They remind me of really good dark chocolate bars with chili and cinnamon in them.  Yes, I even added some chili to get a true Mayan taste out of these.  I did however think that there weren't six servings in a bag.  I did measure it out and an ounce is about 39-40 thins not 46 like the packaging claims.  Which makes five servings, not six.  I measured this a few times with my scale and got 39-40 thins in an ounce.  I think one of the addictive properties of this blend is the cane sugar and it has a lot of it, so I tend to only have an ounce at a time, if I can drag myself away.  I could easily eat six ounces of this product without thinking...just eat without the think but I would be smiling! :)  It has a good sweet cinnamon taste, if they added a little chili or had a chili cinnamon flavor, it would probably be one of the best treats ever.  This also works as cereal or blended with oatmeal, I've tried eating them a lot of ways.  They do remind me of a luxury level Count Chocula, the cocoa used is very flavorful and the addition of rice and sesame seeds works with the cane sugar and cocoa.  I am not sure if this is health food, but I don't really care.  I love it anyway.  :)

column9: Tasty, but not exactly a health food bomb
column10: Everything about this product seems to scream health food.  From the product name to its packaging to its touting of the many healthy ingredients used, it looks like it's some sort of wonder health food.  Yet a quick look at the ingredient list reveals that the very first ingredient is...sugar.Now, I'm not saying that this is necessarily a problem in and of itself.  If you're looking for a sweet treat and you're debating between, say, this and a candy bar, I'd definitely urge you to go for this.  However, it's certainly worth noting that this product has a lot of added sugar so, for all its otherwise fairly healthy ingredients, you'd be better off eating some fruit or a slice of whole grain bread with whole fruit spread.However, as a treat, I think these little bites are nice.  I like the crunch and the contrasting textures of the oats and sesame seeds.  The serving size is generous--over 40 bites--but the pieces are small, so you may not be getting as much as you think you are.  Still, because these are so full of contrasting textures, I find that I only need a small amount to satisfy a serious chocolate craving.  They have a nice cocoa flavor without being overly sweet, and the cinnamon adds a nice, warm touch.It didn't really surprise me that I liked these crackers; the real challenge was my kids.  Both my eight-year-old and my two-year-old like them, though, so they serve as a decent alternative to graham crackers.

Chocolate crunch food with natural ingredients.  It is a lot like a chocolate version of Chex.  Pretty good stuff.  Can go with milk in a bowl lke cereal.  I keep a bag in my car for snacking on those long drives.  Great taste.  No aftertaste.  Chocolate.

The Sweet Cinnamon flavor Crispy Thins from Eat. Think. Smile. are an interesting snack idea.  The underlying concept of all of their products is that their cocoa is not alkalized the way that most is preserving more natural antioxidants.  That is all well and good, but it still comes down to taste, right?  I like chocolate and cinnamon, and I found these to be pretty good.  The texture is a little different, but I don't mind it.  The only thing I would change would be to make the pieces bigger.  If you wish to stick to a single serving, you would be stuck counting out 46 (that is not a typo!) pieces.  They should triple the size to make the serving come in around 15 or so, and it would be like most snack crackers.  Otherwise I think they are a hit.  If you are looking for a healthy sweet snack and like chocolate and cinnamon, give these a try.  The taste starts out chocolate with a cinnamon finish.

I am pregnant, so I am trying to eat as healthy as I can for the baby. When I saw this, I thought it would be a great snack for me to snack on at work when I get my chocolate cravings. They are very chocolatey, almost reminds me of the cereal coco pebbles but more bitter chocolate taste than sweet, an adult version. I get a touch of the cinnamon taste as well in each bite. I like them, easy to eat the bag in one sitting if you are not careful though.I was a little weary of sesame seeds and chocolate but it I like the combination. Although, on the front of the bag it shows a lot more sesame seeds on a crisp than it really is in the bag. Actually the front of the bag makes the crisps almost unappealing because at first glance it looks like meat instead of crispy thins, especially with the sesame seeds on it. But, you can't judge a book by its cover because once you open it up and get a whiff of the chocolate and start eating it, any thoughts of meat are gone.It is 46 pieces per serving and it has about 6 serving in it. 120 calories, 4g fat, 30 mg sodium, 9g sugar.

column9: Never one to shy away from trying something new... :)
column10: Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Sweet CinnamonNever one to shy away from trying something new, if a snack product boasts of being all natural and antioxidant -- on the front of the package --, it usually ends up in my shopping cart, especially of late, 'cuz that's the way I roll. :)Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Sweet Cinnamon was an especially nice surprise, as I found it to be crispy, crunchy, not messy, with an extraordinarily satisfying cocoa/sweet cinnamon taste -- that did not leave me feeling bloated/over stuffed, if ya know what I mean.  The extra thick zip-lock like re sealable bag really came in handy, as I was tempted to eat more than one of the 6 portions contained in the bag.  It is that good!  :)You might also like to try, as I did, Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Savory Sea Salt.  I can't make up my mind which variety I enjoy more...  Highly Recommended!  --Katharena Eiermann, 2012

I was skeptical after I read all the negative reviews, but these are delicious!  They're perfectly light, have a tasty whole grain body, and are topped with sesame seeds.  I felt like I could taste every ingredient.  Furthermore, the chocolate tasted very authentic (as it should) and definitely not artificially so.  One downside is that I consumed half a package within a few minutes...but the nutritional information is encouraging.Can't wait to try the other varieties!

This is the perfect snack when you're in the mood for something chocolatey and something crunchy.  The snack has a rich chocolate/cocoa taste with a hint of cinnamon; if you're looking for a strong cinnamon flavor, you may be disappointed. i found it to be a lighter flavoring which I though was just right. Though the first ingredient is sugar (dried cane syrup), these aren't very sweet and i think they would appeal more to adults than to children.A serving size is 46 (!) pieces, with about 6 servings in a bag. Each triangular piece is about 1/2 inch. A serving has 120 calories with 35 calories from fat. Total fat for a serving is 4g (of which 0.5g is saturated, none of which is trans fat); no cholesterol, and 30 mg sodium (1% of your daily value); total carbohydrate is 22g (7% of your daily value) of which dietary fiber is 2g (8%) and sugar is 9g.Though a serving size sounds large, these are really addicting - it's easy to just keep eating them. Yum!

all I can taste is the dry cocoa powder. Really disappointing. Are you familiar with the Hershey's Cocoa powder you buy in the can for baking? Well if you have some, open the can and smell it. That's what these taste like. There is the very slightest & I mean slightest taste of cinnamon but next to non existant. I don't know what you would use these for. I thought about maybe in a dry pie crust like the cookie crusts but the after taste is bitter so I wouldn't use it that way either. This item, to me anyway, is a bust...
I love this olive oil .  a nice aroma and full body taste .. Highly recommended ! I just ordered 3 more bottles
I really like useing "Saco" cultured buttermilk blend.I make lots of cornbread,biscuits etc., and it's very good.I  would prmote this product,it has a good shelf life.Norma Green

I am very disappointed in this product.  The first box was 75% hard, not a soft powder in each envelope.  When I called to complain, I got fast results in getting a new box.  The new box was 25% hard.  I do not blame Saco, but whoever stored it incorrectly or for too long.  The fresher envelopes did make great buttermilk biscuits.

I've used this product for recipes and it does a good job flavor-wise. However I purchased in the airtight can with resealable lid and if you are fortunate enough to get a loose powder when you first open the can, it doesn't stay that way long. It becomes rock hard and unable to work with. I believe it's just as simple to resort to the simple standby of milk with a bit of vinegar for recipes that require less than a cup of buttermilk. If a recipe requires more than that, just get the real thing. I still keep this product on hand as standby but I know to not anticipate getting more than 1 TB out by scratching it from the chunk. There comes a point when even that doesn't work tho. Flavor and convenience-wise, this product would be ok if they could conquer that issue.

I drink decaf only and only used whole beans.  I was pleasantly surprised at how great this coffee taste.  I have a four cup Mr Coffee maker and it made a wonderful pot of coffee.  Over the years I have tried many many different decaf whole bean coffee.  This is one of the best!!

If you are tired of all the fancy coffees and want a rich, mellow cup of joe that reminds you of those lazy mornings curled up on the sofa - 8:00 is IT!! I need the decaf and I prefer to grind my beans fresh - but you won't find a better cup using any of their products - full flavor without any bitterness - ENJOY!!

If you are used to an organic water processed french roast decaf, don't try this coffee!!  I tried the Eight OClock Decaf beans based on good reviews here (and elsewhere admittedly) and was completely disappointed.  I felt that it lacked taste, body, aroma and that it had what I can only describe as a slightly bitter, metallic taste.  I drink my coffee black with no milk or sugar.  I guess coffee really is an individual thing!

For years I have tried to eliminate caffine as advised by my doctor. I tried Eight O'clock Decaffinated whole bean and enjoyed the full flavor. The icing on the cake is that it is reasonable priced. Our coffee maker grinds and the brews the coffee. For us it is the perfect choice.

column9: Great decaf coffee for the money
column10: These are the best decaf coffee beans I've found for the money.  Very nice mild flavor with no bitter aftertaste.

The 8:00 coffee brand was originally imported by the Atlantic and Pacific Trading company back when ships were powered by sail. They opened up trade routs to Asia and Africa and were known for the finest imported goods and spices. They later became the A&P grocery stores which today have another name but their coffee continues to be some of the best around. It is also some of the least expensive bean coffee available in stores. Since they sell a lot it is always fresh which is very important. I have used it for many years.

column9: Good Coffee, but not the best
column10: I got this on the subscribe-and-save program and used it for a couple of shipments. It is a rather mild blend, and I really prefer a more robust flavor, hard to find in a decaf. It could not be made stronger by adding more, either, it just got more bitter. So, I shopped around and found I could get other brands of decaf that were a bit stronger-tasting for about the same price, so I cancelled my subscription.  I don't think this coffee is bad, just not my taste.

Purchased this because we switched to Decaf on doctor's recommendation..  Signed up for the bi-monthly automatic shipment plan.  The coffee is great, the plan ISN'T!!!  One shipment and then messages stating temporarily out of stock, we'll let you know when, etc. etc....Finally cancelled... Don't know why AMAZON offers something and then can't deliver... This is definitely not the norm...  Would have been only one or two stars, but the coffee is good.
Eight O'clock decaf coffee maintains the full flavor of it's caffeinated brother without the caffeine. So it become a guiltless pleasure that can be drunk anytime of the day or night.

Let's face it, there's no such thing as a really good decaf coffee.  I've tried EVERY brand that I've heard about and the Eight O'Clock 100% Decaf whole bean is the least disappointing decaf I've tried.  I give it four stars because it is at least tolerable (my doctor told me that I HAD to quit caffeinated coffee).
I was unable to obtain this product locally, but, as usual, Amazon.com carried it for a reasonable price.  The coffee was rated highest by the consumer report group.

I bought this because others have said that this was really good decaffeinated coffee.  When I opened my package,I was disappointed that there was no aroma.  None! I was also disappointed with the lack of flavor.  I checked the expiration date on the bottom of the package and the date was three months from expiration.  Perhaps I received a batch that had been mishandled somehow.  Basically it had little flavor and in my opinion it was also slightly more acidic than what I expected.

I ordered 4 bags of Eight Oclock coffee with the agreement that I would be shipped 4 bags each month.  I received the first order.  THen I got an email telling me there was a problem with my card and they would not ship the next shipment.  After some investigatory phone calls, I found there was nothing wrong with my card.  Amazon couldn't make good on their committment to me as a subscriber.  They told me it was their fault and would send it when they received the product.  Sounds to me like they made a deal and can't keep it.  Haven't received anything or a word from them.  Totally dissatisfied with this deal.

I was searching for a source of pure vanilla, without any fillers, but without the hassle of the vanilla bean.This ground vanilla is amazing. No fillers, easy to use, amazing taste and aroma.I will be purchasing this again!
This coffee started a morning stampede to the break room the day I took it to work.  We love it and I'll be getting more.
I use this spice frequently, it is soooo delicious! I recommend it to everyone. I bought such a huge quantity I was able to share with family and friends. Good stuff!

column9: Some trouble along the way, but great in the end.
column10: I originally ordered this product under a listing offering a pretty deep discount, which turned out to have been a pricing error.  My order was canceled, and there was some confusion getting things straightened out, but Godiva called me today to let me choose an equivalent product free of charge.The quality of Godiva chocolate was never in question for me personally, and I ended up being quite happy with their quality of service as well.

A friend told me that this was for all chocolate lovers and the best. It took forever getting here, the shipping and handling bump it to a unnecessary $20 and the candy wasnt spectacular. The box pretty and gold but the 8 pieces were small for $15. The milk chocolate was good but rest with that jelly filling esp white chocolate with raspberry was nasty so basically I just paid for the name and special packaging! Like paying for a cold big mac when you could of gotten a whooper or whataburger for the money worth! Ill stick to caramello, dove, gharardelli, or low budget reeses!!
Godiva chocolates are my favorite candy in the whole world!!!  They make great gifts and if I'm on vacation, I always pick up a small box for my freezer.

I suppose it depends on what your tastes are, but these were not my faveorite. The milk chocolate was very smooth which was a plus. I don't care much for dark chocolate. maybe these weren't the best selection. They were good, but I would rather buy Lindt.

I had no problem receiving these chocolates on time. They didn't cancel anything, so I don't know what all these reviewers are talking about. These are the best chocolates I ever ate. They are actually worth the 14 bucks and in a whole 'nother league than Hershy or Nestle.

I was looking for a grinder for sea salt and since this says it's a grinder, I bought it. There is no grinder with this!! Only ground sea salt with a sprinker on the top of the bottle. Still need to find a grinder.

column9: Great for cold, flu, or just congestion
column10: Yogi Tea Relieve, Organic Breathe Deep, Tea Bags, 16-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)  I've had the flu, or something worse, on and off since before Thanksgiving.  These teas have made it easier to breathe, and I feel immediately better after a cup.  Mom has COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease), and she really is helped by these!  Thanks for a greast product!

I advise to take a look at the ingredients in this tea. I believe there are licorice and fennel seeds, among other things. When I drank it the first time, it was just yucky. The second time, I tried mixing it with black tea and I just couldn't handle it.I have no idea if it helps breathing because I cant get through a cup of it.I will, however, mention that other Yogi teas are great (my favorite is the Vanilla Spice energy).

Would love to try these flavors, but the charge for shipping from all sellers is ridiculous.  I'm hoping another seller steps in and offers a better price on the coffee with free shipping.  Come on Amazon!!!!!

Bonnie's Tasty Herb Rub instantly turns chicken into a masterpiece.  I agree with the first reviewer:  My favorite way to use this rub is to put chicken breast or thighs in a gallon zip lock, with a couple of tablespoons of the rub, the juice from a lemon, I also throw in the peel, some salt and pepper and let it sit in the fridge overnight.  I pour all the contents of the bag into a pan and bake it and it comes out great.  Everyone in the family LOVES it and that is saying something.  Even if I'm just making some chicken on the stovetop for a quick meal, I just add some of this herb rub and it comes out great!  I gave some of my friends at work samples of the rub and got them hooked too.

I recently ordered some for myself and a friend.  I teach people how to eat in a health-promoting way, and I now recommend this to all of my students as a "no-brainer" way of preparing a great meal.  Open the can (ok, even the can is cool!) and your first sniff will tell you that you can use this rub for all kinds of things.  I love it on chicken (couldn't be easier to put some rub in with olive oil, garlic, lemon and let sit overnight before baking - yum!) but it is just as wonderful on roasted potatoes.  I have a lot of spices in my kitchen, but this is a quick, "go-to" combination that makes cooking up a great meal easy and fun.  An added benefit is how great the house smells when you are using it!
I have substituted this maple sugar in recipes (2/3 cup maple sugar = 1 cup cane sugar) with much success. Great product.

Looking for something else when I stumbled on this sugar.  Thought, "what the heck, give it a try".  I love the packaging that allows for spoon or sift. The sugar itself does not clump and dissolves well. I've tried it on hot cereal and pork & beans.  It is delicious and adds that something special for your palate to enjoy. Buy with confidence and prepare to be delighted.

I wasn't sure exactly what to do with Maple Sugar, so I just started adding it to my everyday baking items. It adds a nice warm flavor to cookies/pancakes/breads, etc. Blends well and tastes great on top of oatmeal.

column9: Good value if you know what to expect
column10: No, this is not sweeter than honey nor regular sugar nor even artificial sweetener.  However, it has the maple flavor that I need to add to certain winter cocktails (hot buttered rum, replacing some of the dark brown sugar with this) and to tea.  If you are expecting something super potent and super maple, like maple sugar candy, this ain't it.  It's what you'd expect from something that is pure and not artificially enhanced with other sugars or maple flavoring.  I'm satisfied and I think anyone would be IF they have proper expectations.

column9: Great Organic Maple Sugar for a Great Price!
column10: I love this maple sugar! It is great sprinkled on top of cookies, or other baked goods, before baking. I really like to mix it with some cinnamon to put on my buttered toast....Mmmmmmm good! You can use it for so many things. And the price here on Amazon makes it hard to pass up...especially if you do the subscription option!

Last fall I visited Quebec City and fell in love with maple syrup.  Now I'm back home and would like to do some baking, only problem is finding good and affordable maple sugar.  I found it with Coombs.  No wonder, I already use the syrup they produce.  This maple sugar is delicious and wonderful in baking.  Loved it.

This product is wonderful and a great buy.  I use the subscription service to get an even better price. I use this sugar for baking as well as for cereal etc.  When I bake with it, I turn it into a powder by putting it in my blender.  That way it disolves easier in cookies, muffins and other baked goods.
I really like this maple sugar.  I put it on oatmeal and the slight crunch  is really a nice contrast to the mushy oatmeal. The sugar is sweet, but not cloyingly so. I would definitely recommend it.

This stuff is fantastic.  I use it for nearly all of my baking and as the sweetener for a "regionally famous" mayan hot chocolate.  I have this on Amazon subscribe-and-save and get a 15% discount buying that way.  The crazy thing is, though, that this is less than 1/2 the price of my local retailer even WITHOUT the discount.
This is just yummy. I used in CC cookies instead of brown and white sugar. WOW they were good.
This product was ordered to be used in a Paula Deen recipe for a pound cake.  It turned out great.

Ordered this for my wife who needed it for a recipe. Turns out that the granular (small pellets) maple sugar is actually very versatile and can be used where regular and brown sugar is used as an add-on or finishing touch.
This was a good value and exactly what I expected.  I was a little surprised how sweet it was until I read an article about this phenomenon specifically about maple sugar.

column9: Maple sugar is wonderful in breads
column10: This is a great price for this.I love baking with maple sugar, and sometimes I'll have it in my coffee as well. My favorite use of this wonderful tasting sugar is in shortbread made with whole wheat flour. The flavor stands up well to the stronger flavor of whole wheat and makes just the best shortbread I've ever had. I've also used it in breads. It's more expensive than brown sugar, but the maple taste of pure maple sugar can't be simulated.It's also good in oatmeal, granola recipes, and most anywhere you would use regular sugar or brown sugar.

This is a great tasting product, and is definitely the cheapest around, anywhere, period.  Yes, it is very expensive compared to regular sugar, even organic sugar, but anywhere else you will find it in the $20-$30 per pound range.  No, it is not a strong maple flavor, which I personally am glad about.  I can't afford to use it in all my baking, etc. but it is a nice treat for occassional use.  It is also much healthier than cane sugar in ANY form, including Sucanat.  I will continue to purchase it, although unfortunately not as often as I would like!!
I am so glad I purchased this maple sugar. The taste is unique and it's very sweet. I will buy again, and I have it on my subscribe and save plan.

I have a lot of food sensitivities that include cane sugar and high fructose corn syrup. I was using Pure Maple Sugar, 1 lb. to sweeten the Roobois tea I drink, but the powder was a pain in the butt. It had a tendency to fly everywhere at the slightest movement because of how fine it is. I bought this 25-ounce container and I'm happy with everything but the high price (which is driven by market factors neither I nor the producer are in control of). Maple sugar is better tasting that cane sugar or HFCS, and it doesn't upset my stomach. The container is convenient compared to the bag the Barry Farms product shipped in. I also like the granules as opposed to the powder.

I tried this product for the first time at a friend's house.  I first tasted it in a yogurt parfait with fresh fruit.  It had a very nice flavor without being too sweet.  I have used it to sweeten many other things including tea.  It gives things a delightful flavor.  Very unique.
Excellent price for an excellent product, esp w/o shipping charges. I am very pleased w/purchases from Amazon. Plus, their selection is great- lots of ORGANICS, too!

This actually tastes like little maple sugar cystals, it is so yummy!! I bought this to put in tea gift sets that I am putting together for all the birthdays that are in Feb and March in my family (there are seven of them). I subscribed to the subscribe and save to save the 15% and I'm glad I did. Now I wont have to worry about running out which is a good thing because I have BIG plans for this maple sugar. I'm gonna add it to waffles, cookies, muffins and more!!
Yum...This stuff is Great!  It has a rich flavor and the price is much better than what I would pay at Whole Foods or some other specialty shop!  I will definitely buy it again!

I have used Coombs Family Farms 100% Maple Sugar for quite a while now an it is so great as a replacement for white sugar. I've used it in cookies and replaced it for the regular sugar in my sweet potato casserole at Thanksgiving. I like knowing that I've made better choices for the food that I'm feeding my family. You can not tell the difference except that it doesn't send you on a sugar high. The price was great and was delivered in a timely matter also!

My local healthfood store sells this for nearly double the subscribe and save cost.  I couldn't believe it.  This is very good quality organic maple sugar and the price is the best I can find anywhere.  I use this sparingly as it's still a very expensive sweetener, but it has all the vitamins and minerals so doesn't deplete your body to digest.

column9: Delicious maple sugar at the best available price
column10: This is exactly as described: delicious maple sugar, at the best price I could find anywhere.  While I abandoned my original plan for this as impractical (I wanted to attempt to make some maple rock candy), we've been enjoying this sweetener in our coffee, on our cereal, to make tasty maple kettle-corn, and with other treats.  And it's absolutely delicious as a sweetener for yerba mate (a South American herbal tea of which I'm especially fond).

Love this product. Have been purchasing this product  for the past 2 years from this buyer and it never dissapoints!I mix it up with brown sugar and use it for all my baking!! Not a  strong maple taste if that is what you are looking for but adds just enough maple taste to my baking that makes it  so distinct.  Not currently sold in the UK so i get friends from the US to buy in bulk from amazon and send it down! that's how much i love this product!!

I love Coombs Maple Sugar, and love its versatility.  Regular sugar is just sweet, maple sugar is maple-ey, so for me a clear winner when it comes to certain foods.  Broiling grapefruit halves?  Use maple sugar.  Baking (so much better than frying) bacon?  Sprinkle the bacon with a little hot pepper and maple syrup first.  You'll be hooked.  Oatmeal?  Of course.  I make an apple upside down pancake, swapping out the regular sugar with maple.  Amazing.  It's also great on yogurt.
it has the slightly smoky flavor of maple, and can be used to replace sugar in recipes. It adds a wonderful depth of flavor to chocolate, especially.
I love the flavor and quality of this product.  Rapid shipping as well.  Great value!  I mix the sugar with my cornmeal and it is delicious.  Well packaged and a good buy all around.

This ought to hold me over until I get back to Vermont. :-) This is a very good product at a very good price. I use it everywhere I can: cereal, yogurt, ice cream, oatmeal, anything... Use it on anything, maple makes everything better!

Just tried this for the first time, and I'm quite pleased. We're planning to get some to take over when we visit friends in the UK - "live" syrup would be too risky to travel with - baggage handlers, airports, customs????I did find out some info by contacting Coombs directly - this is made from Grade A Dark Amber syrup; I would have preferred that they'd made it from the more flavorful Grade B, but "A Dark" will do in a pinch, and second, the woman at Coombs said it would re-constitute into syrup pretty well by adding 2/3 c. maple sugar to 1/3 c. water. Haven't tried as yet; suspect that 1/3 c. water may be a bit too much so I'll start with 1/4 when I try it.If reconstituting works out, it'll be great for any type of travel where weight and possibility of spills preclude taking real syrup along.

column9: Pretty good and like that it's organic
column10: Love Coombs Family Farms syrup so when this went on sale I grabbed some.  Tried it sprinkled on muffins this morning and they were gobbled up.  Has so many uses I want to try it in and it tastes great.  Love that it's organic and this farm has a good rep.  Recommend.
This maple sugar is greeeeat!  Use less maple sugar that you would white or other sugars.  I put it on oatmeal with brown sugar, and i put some on roasted sweet potatoes! amazing!

I don't really care for maple syrup, but maple sugar is a different story for me!  It is so very good.  This has been out of stock and I'm glad it's finally back.  Strangely, I received an email from Amazon a couple of days ago saying my subscribe and save subscription of this was no longer offered, but here it is, and I've got a shipment on the way.

I like maple sugar for flavoring homemade oatmeal and other things, and Coombs is generally good quality maple products. If you haven't tried maple sugar, you're missing out. I've used Coombs for products for many years and have never been disappointed.
This Maple Sugar taste pretty much like the liquid Maple Syrup and dissolves easily in tea or oatmeal. I like it so much I will be ordering it henceforth via Amazon Subscribe & Save.
This organic Maple Sugar is wonderful! Turned out a Maple Sugar Pie that was a prize winner at Turkey Day!!

I have tried several maple sugar products in the past, and this is by far the best value.  Not only does it have wonderful flavor, but it is the least expensive I have found, especially when you subscribe and save!
I love the Coombs Family Farms Maple sugar.  Been wanting some for a long time so was glad to find it on Amazon.Thanks.
Could not find organic maple sugar locally where I am right now. Really good processed cane sugar. Nothing to complain... sugary goodness all along!

I found the quality of this to be very good.  the 25 ounce container goes a long way.  I like to use it in eggnog, french toast, and a variety of other deserts as well as sprinkling it on ice cream.  4 stars only because it is a little pricey.
I can't find maple sugar anywhere in stores where I live.  This product is great quality and the price was awesome!
This is delicious all by itself on french toast, waffles, pancakes, etc.Of course, can be used to make maple-walnut fudge or icing too.

I have recently given up refined white sugar and this product is a good replacement. It gives your baked goods a darker color, but I don't find that there is an overwhelming "maple" taste to everything. It is very sweet and a little goes a long way. I will continue to buy this product.

Really nothing special.  Description said twice as sweet as regular sugar & only need to use half as much.  We didn't find that to be so.  The tast of maple was hardly evident.  Really not worth the high price.

column9: Don't Really taste a difference from regular sugar
column10: I must be honest this is a decent price for this type of sugar.  I tried it once before at a coffee shop and enjoyed it in my coffee with milk. But now since trying this brand I don't really taste much of a difference from that of regular sugar.  Like I said this is a lower price than most other offering this type of sugar but don't think ill spend that much on sugar again...
Grew up in New England, had lots of Maple Sugar Candy, that being said, not very sweet and with a subtle maple flavor.

I had never tried maple sugar before, so I really can't compare it to another brand.  We thought that the taste was very good.  We like to sprinkle it on oatmeal.  It would certainly not be cost effective to use in baking.  At $16 or so a pound I cannot justify the cost. We really couldn't tell the difference between this and the $3/lb organic sucanat I found at the food coop.

My cats really enjoy this. Having grown spoiled and jaded on a diet of Fancy Feast, my cats did not know what to eat next. I was cruising through PetCo looking for an alternative when an employee came to my aide and suggested ProPlan. My kids like to have their meals in small bits, not in a thick lump like a Pate, and "Please Do Not Even Think About the dredded 'Shreds' ".I took this and some other ProPlan flavors home for sampling. I was overwhelmed by the positive response!Plates were licked clean very quickly. They continue to chow away on this flavor though it has been on their diet for a year! (It has just come to Amazon. I have been getting it from PetCo.)All are quite healthy with shiny coats and clean teeth.(Kibble is free fed, while wet food is only for supper.)I have been very pleased with this and the other Pro Plan flavors that come in bite sized chunks. I would suggest that you give Salmon and Rice to your kitties as a healthy meal and check out alternative taste treats under "Pro Plan Wet Food."My fondest hope is that Amazon will hurry up and put some of these flavors on "Subsribe and Save"! I have been hauling them home from PetCo for too long! This brand is great! Hope your kitties like it as well as mine do!
This is one of the very few flavors my cat will eat. She digests it well and seems to enjoy it.
Smooth, slightly nutty tasting medium dark roast mix at a very reasonable price. Great for every morning or as an early afternoon pick-me-up.

Can't comment on the quality of the product yet, but I can tell you that the packaging was terrible. The cap on the jar was not tight, and a small amount of the contents had spilled out into the bag it was in.  This makes me question the freshness of the product now. Anyone who uses this product knows what a sticky mess it will be to wipe the jar down now.  Can't return it due to the return policy on food.
This was shipped quickly from the vendor and these pistachios are delicious.  Fresh and no salt - just like I like nuts.

These unsalted pistachio nuts are the best I've ever tasted. I definitely will bepurchasing more in the future. Thank you for your prompt service and delicious wares. Continued success. Amazon is a great place to promote your business!!!
This is the 2nd time I ordered unsalted pistachios from Fiddyment Farms.  The package arrived in just a few days. The pistachios are delicious.  I will be ordering them again this week.

So very impressed with the nuts. Flavor and not one bad one so far.  Organic and unsalted is a huge importance to me.  The only down fall is the shipping cost, but then they came through Enterprise shipping.  I would guess the cost is for faster shipping, not sure.  Nevertheless, excellent quality!
if you like these nuts you will love this bag. lots and lots of them and the bag is heavy plastic and resealable zip top

We love nuts, but like unsalted as much as possible.  We found these after seeing unsalted pistachios at our local market for nearly $13.00 a pound.  We think these are great and have fewer unopened shells than the major brands. In 9 pounds we did not have a bad nut. The nuts come in a three pound heavy plastic resealable bag. Even with shipping they are a best buy.  We buy 9 pounds at a time

I love these Pistachios, however the shipping charges are somewhat discouraging.  If you love Pistachios as much as I do then you see how that becomes a bit prohibitive real quick.  I found this alternative to be just as tasty and CHEAPER! :Setton Farms Premium Pistachios Roasted Unsalted - 1 Pound
this was my second order. fast delivery with tracking number,pistachios as good as the ones you get in the storea but with the salt

My husband and I try to avoid a lot of salt in our diet,which makes finding tasty snacks VERY hard.I ordered these un salted pistachios as a gift for my husband and he was thrilled.They were packaged very well,which kept them fresh.will be buying more of these in the future.

I never ate one of these green things in my entire life until about 5 months ago.  I have been carrying an AARP card for 20 years.  Pistachios just were not part of my life.  But peanuts were.  I ate lots of them.  Then my doc said cut it out. And told me about the health benefits of this little green bean.I bought different versions, here at Amazon and else where.  All with salt.  I am supposed to cut down on salt.  So I finally ordered this package.Big surprise--they taste much BETTER without the salt.
These pistachios were large and fresh.  I would buy from this shipper again.  Unsalted pistachios are not available locally so I was glad to find such good ones available online.

The tea was just ok and in fact I was disappointed with its flavor.  I am a huge fan of Coffee Beans Green Tea with strawberry and this tea had too many competing flavors for my taste.  I'll still drink it, but it's not as enjoyable as other green teas with strawberry.

column9: Fruit adds a wonderful dimension to green tea
column10: I have to confess to being ambivalent about green tea. Normally, I drink herbal tea with no sweetener, or I occasionally drink a cup of black tea. But green tea, despite its health benefits, is not my favorite.However, add STRAWBERRY flavoring to green tea and you really have something. Strawberries add a light fruity acid to the tea and natural sweetness, so this takes away some of the tannic bitterness of green tea.Green tea has antioxidants, 1 cup of tea has the equivalent antioxidant properties of 2 apples. Strawberries have phenols --primarily anthocyanin, the colored components of fruits that also provide health benefits. But mainly, strawberries here add a great flavor.If you don't like green tea as a beverage, try fruit-scented tea like this one. It may change your mind. This tea is organic as well, so definitely it's worth your while.

column9: Diamond dog food for small breed has image for LARGE breed
column10: The Diamond Naturals Dog food for small breed adult (lamb and rice) shows an image of Diamond Naturals for LARGE Breed Dogs.Which is being offered????

The only dry food with more meat than corn meal I was buying locally changed their formula. I was extremely displeased and felt ripped off. However, now I believe they did me and my dogs a favor. I began researching dry dog food on-line and saw nothing but good reviews for Diamond Naturals. No doubt, better food is available. However Diamond Naturals is highly rated and within my budget. I'm also not the type that spends time cooking or preparing food. I wanted a nutritious, healthy dry food with small kibbles for my small dogs that fit my budget. I am very satisfied with Diamond Naturals and my dogs seem satisfied too. The product arrived on my doorstep 2 days after I placed the order. Surprise!

I couldn't have been more happy with this product. I had tried a deli type product before this, and was irritated with having to cut it up for my dog (more than I do for my own children's breakfast lol -_-). I needed a dry food that I felt was just as good, if not better, and I found it in Diamond Naturals.We have a pug, and everything we fed her seemed to yo-yo her weight. She was either to small or too fat. Since we've switched to Diamond Naturals her weight has been so consistent and healthy. Her own vet commented on how healthy she is (most pugs are not).

column9: DON'T MAKE YOUR PET SICK. MY DOG DIED FROM DIAMOND CONTAMINED FOOD
column10: My 8 year old Shit-tzu died from Salmonella contamination after I brought a bag of Diamond Food on amazon.com on February 2012. He suffered a lot and I was not able to save him.DO NOT BUY DIAMOND FOOD AS YOU CAN KILL YOUR DOG!!THIS IS A HORRIBLE COMPANY and TERRIBLE BRAND!
For some inexplicable reason, Frito Lay stopped making these a few years ago. They've just recently brought them back and I couldn't be happier. Salsa Verde is one of the best chips out there.

column9: Where have you been all these years?
column10: Salsa Verde is my favorite Doritos flavor, but I haven't been able to find them for years. I stumbled across some at Target last week, grabbed one bag, and came back the other day to find the rest of the stock depleted.If there was a plan years ago to introduce this awesome flavor, temporarily retire it, then bring it back to induce nostalgia... well, it worked, and I'm craving them again.But I don't go through them quickly enough to buy the bulk pack of 28 offered here. Here's to hoping they become readily available on store shelves or available in smaller packs online.

A good friend gave us this wonderful Whole Spice Chili Chipotle Powder for Christmas, 2009 and it's almost gone as I write this in early May, 2010.It's tantalizingly smoky and irresistable in the mysterious quality it lends to certain combinations. Yes, it's delighfully piquant and, if you have a heavy hand, just plain hot.  So, lighten up, use less and enjoy the deep flavor.Try a light sprinkle of this Chipotle and Garlic Garni on sunnyside-up eggs served on toast with a garnish of arugula or watercress.  Hmmmm...makes my mouth water just writing about it!
I like spicy, my son does not so my wife cooks bland. I keep a jar on the dining table and add it as a condement. This is a lot, but I go through it quickly.

The good thing about the Chipotle flavor is generally that the smoked jalapenos are a bit milder and more flavorful than regular (raw) jalapenos.  That is NOT the case with this powder.  This "Chili Chipotle Powder" is HOT HOT HOT, and seriously lacking in flavor.The other thing is that this is an extremely fine grind, so when I sprinkle it into a sauce, enough of it enters the air and I end up inhaling it, and it feels like I'm burning my nose.  YUCK!Stick with a plain old generic "chili powder" instead of this.

This is fantastic quality Allspice.  If you don't mind having a large quantity, this beats the pants out of buying it at a grocer for $7.00 per ounce.  I use Allspice primarily for making carribean types of dishes like jerk chicken or pull apart jerk pork.  It also can add a really unique flavor component to gravies.  Although I don't do too many desserts, it's also good for spice cookies and I can imagine a cheesecake with a graham cracker + allspice crust being really good.  Another great quality spice from Frontier.

I use Allspice in a lot of things.  Mostly in breakfast, as I have nuts and seeds.  I use cinnamon and Allspice for more flavor and it is good for me.  This is a great buy.  I also get cinnamon from Amazon.

I found this at our local TJ Maxx - there was this bar and a box of others that were individually wrapped for gift-giving.  I bought this bar to try it and see if I liked it.  I read the wrapper's description about marzipan and pistachio - and I was intrigued.  I have tried marzipan once before and wasn't all that impressed, but this combination is SPECTACULAR!! I was only going to have one, but one piece turned into two, two turned into three and I had to stop myself there before I devoured the entire package.  I wish they made this with dark chocolate, but the milk chocolate will suffice.  Will purchase again if given the chance - but these won't last long at TJ Maxx!

I was told years ago by many of the chefs at whose restaurants I dined in France and Italy that the quality of the spices in Europe is much higher because of the demand for the higher quality; as a result, we apparently do not receive the grade A spices in the US.  I was impressed by the quality of the spices at Hediard, Fauchon, etc...until recently.Many of those same chefs use either a large amount of, or exclusively, white pepper in their cooking, which was very surprising, as I had tried many sources, usually finding a fetid/fecal aroma in the background (sometimes the foreground!) of much of the product that I had purchased.  I commented on this to the previous head of Spice Hunter, who said that the problem is in production.  The least expensive method is the soak the peppercorns in ponds to remove the outer covering; the ponds become stagnant and the stagnant (read: fetid) aroma becomes part of the peppercorns.  The more expensive method is to soak the peppercorns in running water, which overcomes that problem.There is no comment about the production of this product, but I would be amazed if it were not the latter.  The aroma is so very exciting, with floral and spicy tones, and not a hint in the least of the off-putting aromas of other sources, even such well-known sources as Penzeys.  My wife and I are very delighted with this product.

These peppercorns were visibly of much better quality than we'd gotten other places before, and the aroma was tantalizing before we even opened the package!  They arrived fresher than I've ever tasted peppercorns in my life, and the seller is very professional and quick with shipment.  Highly recommended!

Living in a very isolated area gives me few options as to where I purchase items such as these peppercorns.  Of the several I have tried, the quality and freshness of these are by far the best.  I use white pepper in many of the dishes I make and having good quality peppercorns is a must.  I was extremely satisfied with these.  As to the cost, I have found that you pretty much get what you pay for.  Yes, the shipping is outrageous but it is outrageous for everything these days.  You can by a used .01 cent paper back book, and still end up paying almost four dollars.  The cost here is well worth the price.

column9: 1lbs bag. OMG there's so many peppercorns
column10: I was unfamiliar on how much peppercorns I would get with a 1lbs bag. Holy cow, I have enough to last the rest of my life.The white peppercorns I got were exactly what I was expecting. I bought a white salt grinder for the white peppercorns. Now I have three grinders, salt, black, and white peppercorns.White pepper isn't as spicy as black pepper. Also if you bite into a white pepper crackle it wont burn like black pepper does.I love it on eggs. Also white peppered shrimp is amazing.

I thought that the white pepercorn was such a deal. The only place in town that carried white peppercorn is Whole Food with costs 6.99 for 1.7 oz. For the price of 8.99 plus 3.99 postage you get 16 oz. It came to the house in about 3 days and works great in my peppermill. If you you a lot of white peppercorn or mix with black peppercorn it's a great deal!Pam

I received my white peppercorns today. I was very happy with them. They were sealed in an airtight plastic bag. And the shipping package was secure so as not to damage the products. When I opened the bag the smell of the peppercorns was amazing. They were all whole(none broken). I can't wait to cook with them. I use white pepper in potatoes,salads of any kind; just about anything you'd use regular pepper on. The white pepper adds a buttery taste to all foods.

I put the peppercorns by themselves in a grinder and use just like Black Pepper. The peppercorns are extremely flavorful.The product is packaged in a plastic bag. For the price it could have come in a reusable container.

The white peppercorns arrived as promised and are of better quality than I expected. I wish I would've ordered a larger bag because my husband and I use a lot of white pepper when we cook and serve meals. You bet I will be placing another order very soon, if not for white peppercorns, maybe other items as well! Thank you very much for a wonderful product and keeping your promise of high quality and service! :)

column9: PEPPERCORNS FROM JR MUSHROOMS & SPECIALTIES ARE GREAT!
column10: I ordered these white peppercorns from JR Mushrooms & Specialties via Amazon.com, and I have to say that these are the best white peppercorns I think I've ever had!  The amount you get (one pound) for the price completely blows local specialty shops and grocery markets right out of the water!  (Sorry local guys, but a rip-off is a rip-off, and frankly, JR's peppercorns are more fresh and flavorful!)  You won't regret shopping at JR's via Amazon.  The packaging is excellent, the delivery timeline is excellent, and the product is... well, I've already sung those praises above!  Oh, and a tip for you who order these, once the plastic bag is opened, just fill your pepper grinder(s), and put the remainder in a canning jar with a tight fitting lid, and store in a cool, dark place.  They stay fresh that way!!

white peppercorns are white peppercorns, so long as nothing is wrong with them.  i knew when i ordered from jr that my pepper would arive fast and be good.  buying a 1/2 pound of pepper will last me, and take up a little space in the spice cabnet,but it is mych cheaper than paying what the grocery charges for 1/8 pound

The pepper is fine but the bag it came in is one of those that seems to disintigrate when you try to open it. The result? Pepper corns all over the floor and counter. Be careful when you open it and have a second container handy.

The Bingo-Roo Kangaroo dog chew treats as stated are approximatly 10'-13'. I ordered two one for a distructive cattle dog (40lbs) and one for a shepard mix (75lbs)with severe allergies to beef. They both loved their kangaroo bones. Granted they were only allowed to have them for 15-30 minutes at a time they still made quite a bit of progress destroying the bones. In about 4 or 5 sessions (2-3hours)the bones are down to the center portion which is about 5'-6' in lenght.The shepard did get a slight up set stomach but it passed with in a day. The smell isnt too bad and the dogs love the taste but due to them being a little on the expensive side these will be added to the list of special order treats during the times I need the girls to be quiet for more than 20minutes.
