My dog loves it. It smells so good I get hungry every time I open a new can. Minimal preservatives. Very happy with it.

Diet Wild Cherry Pepsi is my favorite soda. Although I hate to admit this, I drink far more than I should--probably at least a twelve pack a week if not more. As my soda of choice, I find the diet Wild Cherry to taste less like a diet soda than any of the other sodas in the marketplace. There is a strong, but not too strong cherry taste. The flavors are much better than their closest competitor's brand! No comparison.

In my humble opinion, Haribo Peaches are dangerous. Don't eat them if you're celibate. Consuming these sweet-and-sour gummy peaches is almost an erotic experience. Being a sober-minded gentleman past my prime, I usually avoid them.Except as a guilty pleasure, of course!Eating them after devouring a Red Bull energy drink is especially sinful. Abstinence is a virtue, citizens of Alpha Prime. You have been warned.

column9: Finally a source for Haribo peaches!
column10: I literally spent about 3 hours today trying to find a single store in my county that carry the Haribo peaches! I went everywhere because I needed my fix. Trolli peach rings just don't cut it when you have a hankerin' for these candies! Whooopee!
I love these! I have looked everywhere for them and finally found them. I have a Haribo Peaches addiction.

These are by far the best gummis I've ever tasted. I just love the texture and the taste, yes these are my favorite I like them because:1) Texture: soft and chewy, not hard.2) Peachy taste.3) Coated in sugar.I know not everyone likes the above, but I do and it's very difficult to just stop at two. Just excellent!

column9: Highly Addictive, Strong Peach Flavor, Store Well
column10: I've had my love affairs with Haribo candies on and off for years now.The peach flavor is probably my favorite. I preferred to buy these in the 5 pound size so they'd last over a year and I could share them, but the last time I looked, they only had the 5 ounce bags. I had a lot of trouble finding these for sale in the US, impossible where I am now.Be aware if you've never tried Haribo sugar-coated gummis that these are not like gummi bears, they're a step or two up from fruit slices in their gummi-ness :DI find the flavor of these to be almost natural, there is no artificial taste like I find in most candies and I'm very, very picky about that. The taste is very refreshing and peach-y.They also store well, as long as you keep them sealed. Once opened, store them in a ziploc bag or they'll get hard. Should be obvious, but I'm just saying :DA single bag of these will provide ME with about 3 servings. It depends on how much sweet you can take. I try to avoid overeating sugar and generally give away most of what I order just so I won't eat too much of it. You'll probably want to keep them all to yourself! :D

column9: You'll never go back to Peach Rings once you've tried these
column10: As a fan of Peach Rings ... I remain amazed each time I buy a pack of these.  The taste is so incredible and almost intoxicating.Pro: Subscribe & Save is fast and great priceCON!!:  It arrives in 12 individual packages but there is nothing that come with the 12 bags to help you not just eat them all at once .....One bite ....  The bag will be gone in 2 minutes ... and with 11 more bags just sitting there ... I can't stop myself ..... lolbtw - I noticed amazon also sells these in a 5 pound bag ... That is a really SCARY! temptation I must avoid.
i love candy, and i love haribo, these gummi peaches give me a sense of nostalgia and are easily my favorite...i highly recommend these...
These Haribo candies are so good. If you like sweet and sour these are the ones. Great prices at Amazon.com. Thank you for carrying this product.
None better in my opinion. My daughter and niece agree with me. No rubbery texture. Very sweet.
I'm currently stationed to Iraq & it's nice to receive purchases so quickly like I received this one.  All packs were fresh and well sealed.  I will always order from here.
Hands down the best peach gummi candy out there!  It's difficult to find in my area, so I was tickled to find it on Amazon.

column9: Not as good as the original German ones
column10: While the price is good and service is good as usual with Amazon, the best quality real Haribo gummies are all German. I hope Amazon brings the real ones here even if they charge more for it.
This gummy is really sweet but the peach flavor balances it out. It is not a stiff gummy like other Haribo gummies so I give it my daughter every now and then.

column9: Smell like feet when you sniff on it?......
column10: I'm a big fan of haribo candies especially raspberries and gummy bears. I purchased these hoping I would enjoy the juicy+tangy taste of peach gummies. I mean, who can possibly hate the pleasant peach scent when they first open the bag? I couldn't resist but to toss one in my mouth. My first reaction: soft (not that chewy), fruity, doesn't taste artificial that much. As I was having few more, I started to smell something besides that aromatic peach scent. I questioned the origin of funky smell. I literally placed a peach gummy right on my palm and sniffed....... It smelled unpleasant, more like unwashed FEET. When you smell the bag as a whole, you can hardly notice it, but when you sniff on them individually, that's when it gets you. For people who commented here that they enjoyed these made in Germany, mine says it's from Spain. I'm not sure if that would make any difference though. I did try other peach ring kinds that are sold in local stores too, but they all seem to have the same issues.

column9: Not as good as gummi bears!
column10: I had never tried these before but decided to order some along with my gummi bear fix. They aren't to my taste, just a little too sweet. I like the tanginess of the bears. Rather than return them, I'll probably give them away. But the gummi bears? They have been my favorite for about 50 years!

I am so disappointed with these. First of all, they are coated in table sugar. I wasn't expecting that and it makes them taste drier than I'd like. Also they are really a firm chewy texture and require a lot of chewing, so they're not like other gummy candies I've eaten. Finally, although they smell like peach, they barely taste from peaches. It's mostly generic sugary flavor. The most positive thing I can say is that they are much better than Haribo Fruit Salad or Rainbow Frogs, which I also ordered. I'll be giving all of these bags of candy away and not buying Haribo again.

column9: Not a substitute for Peach Rings
column10: I love the gummi peach rings that you can find in most grocery stores, and thought that this was the same thing. It's not. They are very squishy, and really sugary.
We have become addicted to Udi's.  My husband and I look forward to our bowl of Udi's as much as we look forward to our cup of coffee in the morning.  It is a quality granola that tastes fabulous.

I started eating this granola during a stent where I was eating foods without additives. I pretty much though I didn't like granola, but needed a snack and decided to give it a try. I originally bought it because it was the only granola I could find without any additives. Needless to say, I was AMAZED when I ate it! As other people have said, it is very fresh and the consistency is super, not hard, like most granolas. This makes the best yogurt parfaits. It's also good enough to just eat it alone, and you can't say that for the vast majority of granola. What's best about it though, is that it is actually healthy because all of the calories and nutritional content are from whole grains, nuts, and honey, not from other additional stuff whose only purpose I've found is to make the granola hard and not taste fresh. You will not go wrong buying this, trust me! My Fresh Market stopped selling their brand and I came on Amazon to see if I could buy it online and decided to write a review because I love it that much. It's that good.

Best all around granola flavor. It has a great balance of taste without being heavy on sugar (only 5g per serving).  Would not eat my yogurt without it.  If you are a fan of vanilla this granola is just the thing for you.  I am definitely hooked on it.

Delicious!  I've purchased the sample selection three times now and they stuff seems to disappear as soon as i get it!  Yummy.  What I like most is the fact that it's not overly sweet yet doesn't taste like dry twig (kashi - ugh).  We use rice milk on it and it's a perfect combo.  Add some banana slices or fresh berries and it's a perfect breakfast or late night snack.
A great way to start your day.  I pour some on top of hot cereal and it brings it up a notch.

If you are into Granola, and you haven't tried this, you really should give it a go!  Out of many granolas that i have tried, this is definitely my favorite.  Oats, Honey, Canola Oil, Almonds, Vanilla.  That's pretty simple!  It turns out it's not only simple -- it's pretty great tasting too, especially as executed by Udi's.I often eat this granola in plain yogurt or milk.  It's sweet, but not too sweet.  The almonds are sliced thin, and add a nice contrast to the oats.  But my favorite part of this granola is the texture.  Hard, but not too crunchy.  The oats aren't 'chewy' like in some granolas.  perfect.I have nothing bad to say about this stuff.  I foresee more orders in my future!

We tried all the Udi's granolas.  And many other brands and types.  After our favorite local granola supplier changed its formula and no longer satisfied.  The oats are crisp.  The sliced almonds perfectly toasted with just a bit of honey.  And it's real vanilla!You cannot go wrong!  Being able to order this monthly - with the 15% discount - is just icing on he cake!

I'm very diligent about monitoring what goes into my body as nutrition and have been making my own granola for years.  Not anymore!  Udi's is wholesome, naturally minimally sweetened, and delicious.  Its a feel good food.

column9: Udi's Vanilla and Almonds Granola Is Superb!
column10: Udi's Vanilla and Almonds Granola is delicious!  It's not too sweet, and it has always been fresh.  Some commercial brands of granola are as hard as rocks, but not Udi's.  The texture is crisp and fresh.  I have given bags of this granola to family members and friends, and everyone loves it as much as me.  In fact, they have placed their own orders through Amazon as well.

In a time where pine nuts are selling for $145 for a 5 lb. bag we were able to get quality pine nuts for just $60 for that same 5 lb bag using Amazon. Our customers have noticed no difference in flavor or after taste from those we previously purchased through our food service provider. The vendor, Candy Express, delivered their product ahead of schedule and in very good packaging.

My nuts arrived well packed and promptly.  They were in great ship and are as delicious as pine nuts are.  However, since the only other place I know to get them is at Whole Foods ($32 per pound), I figured that buying them through Amazon was the deal!  You just buy bulk and freeze what you are not currently using.
These Pine Nuts taste delicious, and are about half the price you'll find them anywhere else. The company ships promptly. The nuts are fresh. Definately recommend.
I was a little afraid nuts in this quantity might be "old" tasting.  Not at all.  I'm happy to say the nuts were fresh and firm and great tasting.  Will buy again when I run out.

The 5# of pine nuts I ordered are wonderful.  Used them right away for homemade pesto.  I use pine nuts a lot in my cooking but they're so expensive in the grocery store.  The value on these 5# is amazing.  I figure I saved at least $60.  The quality is great.
five full pounds of tasty pine nuts at a very decent price... arrived promptly.  they make wonderful pesto and so much more.  we've frozen most of them for future use.

Don't bother with these if you're planning to eat them raw. They have a very strong aftertaste which can linger in your nose and mouth for over a week, altering the flavor of everything else you eat. Roasting them removes most of the aftertaste, and makes them usable -- even tasty.  Still, i wouldn't recommend these to anyone who has a truly sensitive palate.  Also, if size matters to you, these are small.

What a buy!!! With the price of these nuts in the store this is an unbelievable price.  I was happy to find the nuts were fresh, good color, great taste!!  Buy the bulk and keep in the freezer.  Will be ordering more!!  Don't pass this up, you won't be sorry!!

column9: Scumbags left Grandma lonely and with no flowers
column10: I ordered simple yellow roses for my grandmother who was sick in the hospital alone - becaue it was taking me a week to get to her from Europe.  These ingrates not only did not deliver these flowers, I did not get a notice that they were *not delivered* until over a week later!  DO NOT BUY THESE FLOWERS

I ordered these for my wife for Valentine's Day from Afghanistan. They were certainly roses...but i ordered yellow. There were Red, pink, and white but no yellow to be found. My wife still loved them but I ordered Yellow because that is her favorite color. Not sure if it was a micommunication between amazon and the dealer or just the dealer. Oh well
This is really good... I don't know how to describe the taste, but it's just great. I eat it by the spoon when I'm in "snacking mood"

This sponge cake was just what I was looking for,  I made an English trifle with it, and it turned out great.

I personally do not eat this cereal (not because I do not like it, but because I am not a big cereal lover), but my husband does.  He loves it!  And I want to thank Amazon for carrying this sometimes hard-to-find product and at a discounted price via subscribe-and-save.  It still is a bit pricey for cereal but Amazon's subscribe and save program has saved us some money, as well as lots of time trying to find this product (especially at a semi-reasonable price) in our local stores.  It must be a good cereal because it is often sold out!So this review is not only for the cereal, but for Amazon's great subscribe-and-save program as well!My husband adds: "Please keep offering this cereal!"  That speaks volumes.
Great taste, crunch, and quality! Never has caused a gluten reaction - all organic goodness. Not too sweet or salty. A healthy choice for those of you who love cereal but want to keep it healthy!

column9: Great snack for little onse & so much healthier than Cheerios!
column10: My 1.5yr olds love these! They were their first non-pureed food and continue to be a hit in our house. These are organic and very healthy. We had to start ordering them by the case! I highly recommend these as a great anytime snack.

We love Barbara's and this cereal is an excellent healthy alternative to cherrios.  It tastes great and my kids love it.  In their old packaging this cereal was called "Breakfast O's".  It's so much cheaper for us to buy it here on amazon as our local stores rarely carry it, and if they do, they charge around 6 bucks a box.

I know they don't claim to be "soy-free," however, it seems completely unnecessary for them to buy corn that has SOY in it...for the price of this cereal, and the healthy image Barbara's is trying to project (especially with their new packaging push), they should take the extra step to ensure that the product is SOY FREE.  Cater to your many, many food allergy customers instead of going the cheap route and buying contaminated corn.(From Barbara's website: INGREDIENTS: ORGANIC WHOLE OAT FLOUR, ORGANIC CORN FLOUR, ORGANIC OAT BRAN, ORGANIC FRUIT JUICE CONCENTRATE (APPLE, PINEAPPLE, PEAR, OR PEACH), SEA SALT, BAKING SODA. CONTAINS SOY (IN CORN).MANUFACTURED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES MILK, HAZELNUTS, ALMONDS, COCONUT, AND WHEAT. *AMOUNT IN CEREAL.)I am saddened that Barbara's supports and enables the disgusting farm subsidies that allow soy, a top 8 allergen in the US, to contaminate our food supply.
These Arcor Viena are very tasty candies, if you need a sweet fix just reach for one of these, but I worn you, you can't eat just one.The Arcor candies come in great favors too.

THIS IS THE BEST TEA I HAVE EVER HAD . BOUGHT SOME HERE IN TOWN BUT IT IS A MUCH BETTER BUY FROM AMAZON , ALWAYS QUAILTY BUY FROM AMAZON .. VERY GOOD FLAVOR AND YOU CAN GET MORE THAN ONE CUP PER BAG !!

I love this tea. Granted, I am a very unsophisticated and uncouth tea drinker, but I still get an opinion, right?Pom & Petals has a subtle, gentle, floral taste to it, with a tiny hint of berry. I first tried it in a sample stacker tin and then had to order the full size, because I absolutely love it. When I take a sip it makes me think of shades of pink and Victorian gardens. It's one of those rare teas that works for me nearly any time of day - it's optimistic enough for the morning and afternoon, and relaxing enough for the evening. I love that it's caffeine free, as well as organic. And it comes in a cute reusable tin.But really, I love it for its flavor. It's romantic and subtle and flowery and fragrant. I'll definitely order it again.

column9: The BEST Peach Gummy By Far...
column10: So much better than the traditional rings.  Nice and sweet, with a slightly chewy outside with a nice, soft inside.  Great intense peach flavor.  It doesn't get much better than Haribo.  Lasts forever in a ziploc bag or tupperware.

If you're a candy addict, like I am, these are dangerous! They arrived quickly and are fresh. I've kept them in a tupperware container so they don't get hard or stale and have been happily munching away for 3 months.

column9: Who needs 5 pounds of gummy peaches?
column10: I need 5 pounds of gummy peaches. And you just might, too. Truth be told, I bought these so that I could qualify for Super Saver Shipping. It seemed like a good idea at the time. Now it's a month later and I still have a ton of the greatest gummy peaches on earth, and I still think it was a good idea.

I wish I had ordered more of these!  They were definitely fresh when I received them and the taste was great.  The bad part is that my family and friends discovered my stash and the candy kept disappearing.  I guess that's a testimony to how yummy they were.

I've got a huge sweet tooth and the fillings to prove it. I bought these in hope they were similar to peach rings. They are not. They are very soft, and not chewy like peach rings. While they are covered in sugar like peach rings they seem to be far messier. Sugar just falls off as u eat these. That brings be to my last complaint. With all that sugar these aren't that sweet.I didn't hate them, but I far from love them. I and my friends usually go nuts for candy but it took a while to finish these. I would like to add that it could simply be a matter of preference as I do love Haribo Gummi Bears, and I think Haribo makes quality candy.

Peach rings used to be my favorite candy, that is, until I met the delicious Haribo gummy peaches!  They actually taste quite a bit different than the peachy-o rings.  These have a much finer grain of sugar on them, which I prefer.  They aren't sticky/don't stick together.  Sometimes in the ring version I would pull one out, only to discover 2 or 3 more stuck to it.  The gummy part is also different.  It's not as chewy as the ring version - and by chewy I mean kind of rubbery.  The flavor is also a lot better in the Haribo peach candy.  It's more sweet peach tasting and less sugary tasting.  I first fell in love with these at my local Target store.  For some reason they were kept on an end cap in the toy department, and only during winter time. I was lucky to stumble upon them!  And so I made my yearly peachy purchases and spent the rest of the year reminiscing about how good they were.Fast forward to one day when I was looking on Amazon for a gift for my nephew.  I knew he loved peaches, so that's what I did a search for.  A long shot, but I was kinda hoping Amazon sold a peach pie or something. LOL!  Holy smokes, was I happy when I saw that you can buy Haribo gummy peaches ONLINE!  And not only that, but in a 5 lb bag!  I sent him a bag, and do I even need to admit that I bought one for myself?My nephew loved the candy.  He took a sandwich baggie full every day to school to share with his friends at lunch time, until they were gone.My own personal stash - 5 lbs is a lot of candy!  These lasted for a few weeks, among a family of 5.  I also gave a hefty size bag to my Dad.  They never got stale, each piece tasting as good as the first one out of the bag.If you love gummy candies or peach, you will not be disappointed in these!

I bought several bags of these... filled them in a giant jar, and my roommates and friends went through 25 pounds in a month.  Yes, that's right, in one month.  That's testimony for how amazing and delicious Haribo can make gelatin taste....

column9: Delicious candy, but do not order it in the summer because it will melt!
column10: I ordered the Haribo Peaches because they are a delicious variety of candy.However, I ordered from Amazon in the middle of August. And it was 100° out. Big Mistake.They arrived all melted, as you can see from the picture I uploaded way up there at the top.DO NOT ORDER HARIBO PEACHES IN THE SUMMER! You can probably get away with ordering the Haribo Happy Cola in the summer though, because I ordered those too and they didn't arrive melted.I thought maybe that once they cooled down I could cut up the melted part and eat it. However, it was still way too sticky. If you have some Haribo Peaches and you tear one apart or bite into it, you can see that the candy part inside of the sugar coating is extremely sticky. Everything melted together and was really sticky like that. Not good.I'm rating 5 stars because I have eaten them before, unmelted and they are great even though mine were all melted.

column9: Best gummy peaches in huge supply
column10: Everybody that has tried these, myself included, agrees that these are the best gummy peaches they've ever had. Like those ring ones but even better. The insides are so soft it's almost like you're eating a real peach, and the outside has just the right amount of crisp sugar coating. And there are a buttload of them. But beware, it's nearly impossible to stop eating them, even when you begin to feel sick.

I've missed these since the bulk candy store went out of town a few years ago. I think these are actually cheaper and the order went through easy.  I really missed these -- just have to be disciplined to not eat too many at once.

I live on/off in Europe and eat Haribo all the time.  However, coming back to the States, I can't find it, locally.  Hallelujah for Amazon and their connections!  I LOVE the peaches and strawberries and was ecstatic to be able to order them online.  I've even turned on friends and family to their delights.  These peaches are super yummy and not too chewy (which can be a problem with gummies!).  If you like fruit and want to find a candied form, Haribo is the one to shop!
Bought these for the 2nd time and they were great once again.  Very fresh.  Everyone loved them, they are great to have in candy dishes for parties as something different :)

I've bought these before in the smaller bags at grocery stores and LOVE the flavor, the sugar coating. I have a major sweet tooth... The grocery store I went to, didn't always have them & also I moved. Since moving I have not seen any haribo gummies. I just ordered the peach & pink grapefruit & plan on using some for my daughters first birthday party for the other kiddies we're inviting, I know they will be a hit with the parents & kids. The flavor is very delicious. I would even say these are better than the Jelly Belly jelly beans. They are very addictive. very very addictive. Hopefully some will last for my babes birthday...

column9: Just what I was looking for!
column10: These were soft-yet-chewy and so flavourful! I'll never go back to the Brach's gummy peaches. These arrived quickly and were very, very fresh. I put the opened bag inside a large freezer bag to help maintain the freshness; it's worked for the 5lb of (still soft!) gummy bears we bought at Christmas.

I tried these Haribo Gummy Peaches in San Francisco and absolutely fell in love with them (they are so much better than peach rings!), but when I returned to my homestate of Oklahoma, I couldn't find these awesome Haribo Gummy Peaches anywhere. I even looked in north Texas- still couldn't find them.  But then a stroke of genius occurred, and I realized Amazon might just have those delectable treasures I discovered in SF, and what do you know- it did!  I really love these peaches! I separated mine into several ziplock baggies for convenience, and I have a couple of baggies at home and one at work and I gave one to my sister-in-law. They're delicious!

Besides the Peach flavoured penguin gummies (which I have yet to find), these peach gummies (that actually look like peaches) are the next best thing! They don't turn hard and stale immediately after you get them like other gummies which is fantastic and they have a luscious peachy flavour that will leave you craving more and more (they outta put a warning on these things!). What also makes them wonderful is the texture to these fabulous treats. They are sugary and firm-ish on the outside and incredibly velvety and juicy on the inside. It's absolutely divine. Ahhh . . . Now I really want some . . . .

I ordered these on a whim because Amazon had a GREAT deal on Haribo products. Being a fan of good quality gummi peaches, and of Haribo in general, I decided to order this massive 5 lbs. bag (and I live alone!).I am thrilled with the product I received. The product is fresh, delicious and fabulously PEACHY! I'll be putting these in a giant air-tight container and enjoying these for MONTHS to come! I definitely recommend these for Haribo and gummi fans alike.

I never purchase huge bags of candy like this but I love all things peach. Plus, there was an extra 25% off Haribo sale so I went for it and purchased this and the apple :). I like the peach a little better, but both are good.A good tip that I read on the reviews here, was to keep them fresh in a ziploc bag or tupperware. I plan on splitting the bag with friends because it is definitely as much candy as 5 lbs sounds like - A LOT!The gummy is chewy, fresh (as much as candy can be), not too sweet, and basically just a perfect bite or two of yummy goodness to satisfy your sweet tooth. I highly recommend this.

I am using these for favors at my wedding.  They are just awesome.  I strongly recommend them to anyone that is considering them or if you like peach!  They are without a doubt the best gummy candy I have ever had.

I've searched and searched, but have been unable to locate a store that carries these delicious gummy treats in the US.  I was so excited to see them at Amazon.com.  I would recommend these to anyone.

column9: Very Yummy and a good price
column10: I buy these at the store all the time and this is the cheapest way to buy them.  They are very yummy and you'll want to keep eating them.

These aren't my favorite, but they are good. They are soft (but chewy) and sweet. I love the sugar coating on these gummies. I am a fan of peach sodas, so I gave these a try. I was not disappointed. Give them a try, you won't be disappointed either.

These Haribo peaches are just like I remember them from my childhood in Germany.  I have on occasion purchased them at the local candy store for a lot more money, and sometimes I can tell that they've been around a while. These were fresh and delicious.
These are One of the most Delicious Gummies iv ever had! I recommend getting them. :)
These peach flavored gummi candies dissapeared quickly over the holidays. Both children and grandchildren enjoyed them. While the grapefruit grmmi candy is the favorite, the peaches are second.

I order these and split the bag with a friend or else I would be four axe handles wide. I have no self-control when it comes to candy, these are a perfect pick-me-up. They are not hard like fruit jels, really soft and the dusting of sugar is a nice touch. Haribo is slightly off the beaten path when it comes to candies, unique and tasty!

I've bought these from Amazon whenever they've had them in stock, love the 5lb bag, because it's more economical.  On a whim, I decided I'd weigh the last bag...4lbs 8oz, even with all the loose sugar in the bag.  Maybe 4oz isn't a lot to some people, but 4oz is a single bag purchased alone for $1.69... makes me wonder if all the past purchases I've made have been underweight as well.
Tender, peach-coloured, sugar-dusted morsels of summer-fresh peaches!  They will disappear from the candy bowl in no time.Excellent gummies!  Real peach flavour.

Now that I have developed a taste for peach gummies, and after experimentation, found the freshest, softest, most tasty example of this product apparently sold everywhere, I am disappointed with Amazon's version of the same product.  The gummies arrived safely on time.  No problem.  Everything was the same until I bit into the first one.  It looked the same, smelled the same, even tasted the same, but the texture was not soft, nor did it taste fresh.  It seemed like this product had been on the shelves for months.  I've had some that were harder, obviously old.  But these gummies were unsavory simply because they were not fresh.I hesitate to want any more by the subscription method.  I had chosen the seller that sent the best product, obviously Amazon did not choose MY choice.  Please cancel this subscription.  I want to receive my gummies from the vendor I know has a fresh product.  Thank  you.

column9: try them first before ordering 5 pounds
column10: Firstly, these are my favorite candy. I'm literally addicted.. Hence the buying of 5 pounds of them. But if you've never tried these, i highly recommend trying them in a store if you can find them. I can find them at my local Walmart or Reasors in little haribo bags of about 10. It's a candy you generally either love or hate, so buying 5 ibs of them when you don't know if you like them is not a very good idea...

My wife purchase several small bags of this  product each week.  I got on net and found the same productat less than half price but in larger quantity, 5Lb.  She ate the whole 5 # in a week so I did not save athing. But they were fresh.

this candy is delicious, it is not the gummies that you have to keep chewing and chewing to get the flavor...  i take this to work and everyone raves about how much better than the other gummies this is.  i have bought this several times from Amazon and it goes so fast but it is great and arrives in just a few days each time.
I was pleased with this purchase and found it to be a quality product.  The shipment came quickly as well, very reliable.

Absolutely the best Peach Gummies.  I am constantly buying the peach rings at the store for 50 cents apiece and thought they were awesome, I was wrong because these are.  If you close your eyes and smell inside the bag you would swear a freshly cut peach was under your nose.  Put them in a Ziploc bag and they will stay fresh for a long while too.  At a little over $3 a pound this is a steal, I recommend highly.

Haribo peach gummi candy is simply the best peach gummi in the world.  When I lived in Europe years ago they were readily available.  They are very hard to find in the US.  I am thrilled to have found them on Amazon, and in a large quantity, and inexpensive.

So I'm not in the best shape right now, but I don't drink...don't smoke...don't do drugs...try to get enough sleep...etc. With that being said, I'm embarrassed to admit that I think I do have an addiction...to these DAMN PEACHES!  I don't know what it is, but I think it's that these remind me of when my mom used to cut up fresh peaches and sprinkle some sugar on them when I was a kid. I've already gone through TWO bags of these things over the last couple of months...that's just shameful! Even more shameful is that I just signed up for the "subscribe and save" option lol. I cannot believe how good these are...

I Love these things!Got the 5lb bag of the stuff and we ate them all in like 2 weeks. We'll certainly be diabetic from the  sugary goodness. LOLBut really, they have a lovely peach flavor that fills your senses. Highly recommend these! They came fast and were not melted or gooey.

This candy sells for 8.99 lb in the mall.This was a great deal and the product was very fresh.  I love this stuff and you can't get it just everywhere, [ I live in a small town ] Better than any other Peach gummie candy.  Thanks
perfect candy; so pleased I could find them available; fresh, well packaged; quick shipping. I will order in the future.
Exactly as I expected it to be. Bought this item as a gift and the recipient was pleased with it.
TASTY, TASTY, TASTY.  If you know HARIBO then get more for your buck.  These are hard to find but here they are at a great price for a hefty size.

If you need it by the bulk and fresh, buy it here on Amazon. I saw these at my local staples and they were selling them $5 for pretty much what amounted to a handful. I get one bag every 6 months and they run out the first week. My whole family enjoys them, maybe a lil too much.

I ordered these Haribo peaches to go in my pink candy bar at my wedding reception.  While they are definitely peach in color, they are so yummy and were a big hit at my wedding.  Would definitely order from this seller again in the future.

Bought these for my boyfriend who is out on deployment. Was kind of leary about it because of the freshness, we are VERY picky about gummy candy quality. He said they were awesome and he wanted more soon lol! Soooo guess what I'm gonna be getting more of

Oh man, I love me some peach rings.  Haribo brand peach rings are quite good, in small doses.  I find their flavor to be stronger than most, which is good, but I also can't plow through pounds of them at a time like I can some other brands.  Still, the flavor is excellent, and the quantity here is even more fantastic.  Just be sure to seal them up nice and tight or they might go bad before you finish.

column9: YUM!!! BUT BECAREFUL - Very hard to stop eating them once you open the bag
column10: As I predicted, my inability to control myself when I eat these candies has caused my worst nightmare.  Massive candy overeating and need to go work it off at the gym.BUT THEY TASTE SOOOOO GOOD!  :)
This is a great value.  I love this candy and always have a difficult time finding it in any kind of larger quantity, so this fit my requirements perfectly.

i ordered these well to be honest i have no idea why i ordered them but im glad i did! they arrived within 2 days even though i did standard shipping and they were fresh and delicious.  they are so yummy!

Haribo gummis are the illest. The peach gummis are one of my favorites!!! Not to mention how I received them in a timely matter fresh!!! Thanks Amazon for your great commitment to delivering great products!!

column9: Not as fresh as I was hoping, but still good!
column10: I got this 5-pound bag because free shipping and it was semi-cheap.  Anyways, they are not as fresh as I thought they would be, but it isn't terrible that you can't eat them.  Still a great value!

Bought this for my hubby, because I'm such a good wife :)  He's obsessed with Haribo peaches, and the small bags weren't cutting it anymore.  He has a glass jar on his desk which he keeps filled and consumes mass quantities while he works.  They arrive quickly and extremely fresh.

These arrived fast and fresh.  These little gummi candies are great.  Almost better than eating the real thing,  tasted just like a peach and was very juicy.  Great price and is a great fix for a sweet tooth.
The title says it all. They are extremely delicious, but I had to keep pouring it into a smaller bag to prevent it from being consumed all in one night.

These things are amazing, addicting and extremely dangerous.  But highly reccomended~!  I have recruited more people I know from work and even my hubby and they are all lovers of this particular candy.  They are truly amazing.  And like one person said I've been happily munching for 3 months... I wish I could, my kids and hubby snag em so quick I have to buy a bag and hide it just for me... Try em, I wont let you down, or contact me and I'll buy em off you.  LOL They are great!

Nothing beats Haribo as far as flavor.  It tastes like peaches off the vine, just enough sugar without being overwhelming. These are nice soft gummi candies which are totally addictive!!! I always buy Haribo white grapefruit, but these come in as a close second choice !!!

These Haribo Peaches smell just like fresh-picked peacheswhen you open the bag and they taste good too.  They'recoated with fine granulated sugar which makes them a littlesweeter than the traditional gummies, but these, along withthe Haribo Pink Grapefruit candies, are some of my favorites.

I guess my taste-buds just aren't like those of most.  I don't find this confection worthy of the high ratings others give.It's an okay confection.  Not horrible, not sublime, average.These circles are about the size of a $0.25 piece, have a yellow/peach alternating color scheme, and are covered with granulated sugar.  There's so much sugar that there are piles of it at the bottom of the bag.The texture is much softer than a traditional "gummi" product, and much softer than Hairbo's other "gummi" products.  After you open the bag, the confection starts to lose its softness quickly, so be prepared to eat the entire bag upon opening.  As a last resort, some sort of container that can be closed to the outside air, like a zip-lock bag, could be employed.  After eating about 2 lbs I started to feel full, and in a hyper-glycemic episode, broke down and put the remaining 3 lbs in a zip-lock bag.This confection is also very sweet.  If you are one that likes their "sweets" only partially so, this will probably be too sweet.If you're looking for an inexpensive, peach-flavored, very sweet treat, these are a good choice.  Just don't expect a life-changing, 5-star confection.
these things are so good,you have a hard time putting them down,great peach flavor.i think anyone would love these things,five star .

column9: Additive but satisfying in small quantities
column10: I have to put some aside because  my kids and hubby snag em so quick I have to buy a bag and hide it just for me , give them a tryu., I wont let you down, or contact me and I'll buy em off you.
