I have recruited more people I know from work and even my hubby and they are all lovers of this particular candy. They are truly amazing. And like one person said I've been happily munching for 2 months.

I love the flavor of these peaches.  perhaps the small bags is not a lot to some people, but 4oz is a single bag purchased alone for almost 2 bucks makes me wonder if all the past purchases I've made have been underweight as well. I've bought these from this site  whenever they've had them in stock, love the 5lb bag, because it's more economical. On a whim, I decided I'd weigh the last bag and it was  a little short but still a good buy

This has got to be the best gummy candy by Haribo. I really recommend trying this favor first. It smells like peaches and the gummy were all so soft unlike some of the other flavors. I have tried pink grapefruit and raspberries which were not that great in my opinion. The pink grapefruit were a lot harder than the peaches, but they tasted like grapefruit. However, after eating one there would usually be a bitter after tasted, which was disgusting. Meanwhile, the raspberries by Haribo was in fact very distinctive, in that the outer coating were cover with hard sugar while the inside was soft and sweet. The raspberries came in two color, red and black. The red actually taste like raspberries and they were good, but the black ones were awful. I could not identify what flavors they were, but one thing for sure is that they really sucks.
I am a huge fan of Gummi Bears and Gummi Worms, but these gummi candies are more like plain gumdrops in a peach flavor.  Not a fan of these and probably won't purchase again.

column9: Not the worst thing I ever tasted....
column10: BUT they leave one heck of a nasty after  taste.In my own opinion these are very nasty taste wise.The gummi bears are very much better,though they are really chewy and make your jaws hurt after a few.
These candies are too sweet for me, and they aren't as soft as I thought they'd be.
why would someone make a huge bag of unnecessary candy.I love candy and all but sometimes too much is too much!
Love this sugar!  Tastes wonderful!  Shipping is too pricey though.  Yet, I'll likely order more.... yeah, it's that good.

Dizzy Pig makes a number of fine rubs. Their "Dizzy Dust" is full flavored, not too salty, and perfect for pork ribs, Boston butt, and pork tenderloin.  I love this stuff for port, but not for beef. It is not spicey, so if you want a kick, you could had some type of pepper.

column9: Best Rub in the World. Period.
column10: You will not find a better rub out there. I PROMISE. Dizzy Dust is extremely versatile, pleasantly spicy, and instantly addicting.
I like a crispy cookie and have had a hard time finding a good gluten free chocolate cookie. These are excellent! Great chocolate taste!! Try some with a glass of milk. Yummmmm!

My experiences with these seeds, having bought them on several occasions, have been nothing but good. These seeds got criticized from the other buyer for their smell / oily residue on them, but in my opinion, this is what makes the seeds have that natural flavor and appeal. These seeds do have a very strong odor and spicy-taste to them, which is what  makes them the best I've used with my business. For the true and total experience of poppy seeds, I would definitely recommend this brand / type.

smelled weird when i opened the container. a little earthy but kinda like they have been sprayed with something. after preparing it the water tasted strange too, not like the usual Pee eS Tee flavor. it kept me from wd's so that was good, but as far as catching a good buzz...eh 1-10 it was about a 3.5
These seeds are very blue, thouroughly washed, fine for baking if that's what you want to do. "Black" they are not.

I received my "variety" pack of teas today.  It contained:7 Bigelow Pomegranate Green Teas7 Celestial Seasonings Mandarin Spice Herbal Teas6 Celestial Seasonings Sleepy Time Herbal Teas2 Celestial Seasonings Decaf Green Teas2 Celestial Seasonings Lemon Zinger Teas1 Celestial Seasonings Green Tea1 Twinings Green Tea1 Twinings English Breakfast Tea1 Twinings Earl Grey Tea1 Celestial Seasonings India Spice Chai Tea1 Cranberry Green TeaI was highly disappointed that two favors comprised half of the order--not much of a variety if you ask me.

I read the reviews but didn't listen. The assortment I received was 99% celestial teas.  I chose this package because I wanted to try the celestial but also the bigelow and twinings brands.  My package contained one bigelow and no twinings.  If I had wanted only celestial I would have ordered the celestial assortment. This package is not recommended unless you primarily want the celestial teas.
Not enough coffe to much tea samples' other than that the order was okay and arrived on time. would not order a sampler again.

column9: add some sour cream and these are wonderful
column10: Add a little sour cream to these just before they are done and you will have something that you swear is home made. Great product.

I brown hamburger with a little onion in a skillet, then cook this according to directions in the same skillet with the hamburger(I use really lean hamburger, so I don't even drain it).  Add a little sour cream and frozen peas at the end of the cooking time and you have a great tasting all in one skillet meal.  This will feed two if you add bread and a jello salad (or one if it's a teenage boy).

Good taste and good price at a buck a pack, but you really need to brown some ground beef and onion to punch it up. I've only had Stroganoff with BEEF and/or mushrooms as a 1-dish meal. I think this is great for the base of a 1-dish meal but I don't care for it by itself. I commend Lipton/Knorr's for this "less sodium" version.
This product is very good for the price.  Very simple to make~milk, water, butter, and in about 10 minutes you have a great meal.  Enjoy~!

Mmmmmmmm ... Pasta Sides! Now this is what my mother called "stick-to-your-ribs" food. It's filling and delicious!I enjoy all the Sides, but this Stroganoff with "fettuccine in sour cream and mushroom sauce flecked with parsley" is my favorite, with Alfredo/Broccoli running a close second.Served with a fresh garden salad and a cup of green tea ... Ah-hhh a quick, healthy feast ... fit for a Queen ... or even a writer. ;-)The entire meal, including salad prep, takes less than fifteen minutes.  What could be easier? Now dig in, kids, and enjoy ... I wouldn't steer you wrong.Reviewed by: Betty Dravis, 2008author of 1106 Grand Boulevard

I love stroganoff, but don't always havs time to make it the long way. So I get these, a steak to grill & either sour cream or country fresh veggie dip (adds a unique, fantastic flavor). After the steak is cooked & has rested, I cut it up & add to the side dish  & sour cream or veggie dip. Wala! I have a nice, easy dinner.
product is good, but how do you justify a 50% increase in price?  you were competitive, now, NO WAY.  this happens a lot.  trying to trick people.  not ethical.
These crackers are delicious!  The salt and cracked pepper flavor are great.  Crunchy, tasty, thin little crackers that taste great right out of the box.

These crackers are so good that even my non-celiac partner and my son love them! We have them with all sorts of dips and cheeses- they have a great texture, a lot like pita crackers.We highly recommend them!!
I'm into tracking what I eat and this is a welcome addition to my diet.  I love crunchy food and these are great!  No need for a dip, they are delicious alone.

After switching to a gluten free diet I was discouraged by the taste of all the breads and crackers I tried. This was the first one I tasted that I was like, Wow, that doesn't taste gluten-free at all! The word "lentil" threw me, but it's really the best cracker out there, gluten free or no. The pepper and salt varieties are good, too, but this one is the best. Add a little whipped cream cheese and it's the perfect snack.
Great value for a gluten-free, healthy snack. Even if you're not gluten-free, you'll love them. Received the crackers in a very timely manner.
I've tried the other lentil crackersw in a quest to find other than wheat based ones and this is by far the best of them all, so far

column9: Rosemary ones are to die for!
column10: I love love love these crackers!  They do not taste like a low glycemic index, gluten-free snack, but they are.  Delicious with goat cheese.  I highly recommend them.  Haven't tried the other flavors, the rosemary is just so good.

These are the best gluten-free cracker I've ever had.  Since GF crackers are usually disgusting, that might not be saying much, but these can stand up against non-GF crackers.  Their crispness is similar to wheat-thins without the sweetness.  My only critique is that I wish they had a non-salted variety as I think they would be just fine with less or no salt.  But the salt is easy to pick off as it is.  The rosemary flavor could use a little more rosemary, but they are nice, neutral crackers to pair with a dip or cheese.  Even with these criticisms, I still gave 5 stars.  I'm so excited I found them.
Crackers are very good and a great alternative for people eating gluten free. Most flavors we have had are equally as good.

I did a wheat-free trial diet for 30 days, and one of the snacks I had on hand were these lentil crackers from the Mediterranean Baked brand.  Plain Sea Salt Lentil Crackers.PROS:- Crispy crackers don't leave you feeling heavy after snacking.- Different dips or toppings can be paired with it.- Great list of ingredients- Gluten-free- 5g protein in a serving.CONS:- Rather bland and tasteless.FLAVOR:I found the crackers to be pretty bland.  They're not overly salty, which is nice, but I guess lentils just don't carry enough flavor on their own.  These crackers are good if you have a dip or topping for them, as their bland flavor makes a great base for just about any dip flavor.These are an okay snack for those on a gluten-free diet.  If you don't need to live gluten-free, find another cracker, for your tastebuds' sake.

I just started eating gluten free and gave these a try.  I haven't tried many GF crackers, but the ones I have tried all tended to taste like crunchy rice crisps, blah!  These were not the case and taste like real crackers!  They are made from Lentil flour which gives these crackers a nice boost of protein. Unlike many other GF products, these aren't loaded with starches, so they are healthier for you.  The rosemary flavoring is great.  The expiration date on thees were 9-10 months out, so they arrived fresh with plenty of time to enjoy.
This is  a real great cracker, they are crisp and more like one you would make at home.  A little on the expensive side but all gluten free items are,  I only buy these as a special treat.

I just discovered these and am blown away how tasty these are for a gluten-free snack. Also, because of the lentil flour, they actually satisfy your hunger like a wheat snack would. Happy to have found Amazon carries them. Price is cheaper than TJ Max where I first found them.

I tried these crackers to bring some variety into my wife's gluten free life.  They turned out to be delicious and we've ordered more since then.  They don't have a "gluten free" product taste and remind me most of pita chips.I highly recommend them for someone who'd like a gluten free cracker to serve with cheese, spreads, etc.  The best we've found in gluten free crackers.
I was very impressed with the crackers... I have many gluten-free customers that frequent my tea house... these are a delicious addition to our gluten-free menu we can offer them.

By far, this is the tastiest porridge (Jook, or Jo) you can buy. It's got a great very strong black pepper and ginger taste to it, very refreshing. There's not even much instant Jook out there you can buy, and having so much ginger in this makes it perfect for colds!
I have never tasted anything like this. I'm so addicted. I can't find it anywhere unless my asian friend brings it to work.

I do my best to reduce both sugar and aspartame in my diet so I like this little dropper of vanilla-flavored stevia as a flavoring for hot items such as hot tea, hot cereal. etc. I do find if you use more than a few drops it can be bitter, but I find the same for stevia powder. Really, it is sweet enough that a tiny amount is all you need, especially with its vanilla content. I also sometimes use it to hide bad tastes in liquid medications and other unpleasant things - the combo of the vanilla & stevia can hide quite a bit. But mostly, I use it instead of butter & sugar in hot oatmeal & other cereals, which saves a lot of calories.

column9: Crazy Cups K-Cups Medium Roast Sampler Pack 35-Count
column10: Crazy Cups Keurig K-Cups Medium Roast Sampler Pack, 35-Count Gift Box...is a great deal. I just received a Keurig coffee maker on Mother's Day and it is my favorite appliance. The sampler pack gave me an opportunity to test many flavors and decide what I really liked and would re-order.

column9: Not super sweet but will do.
column10: I purchased these a while back when I was trying to find a healthier alternative to artificial sweeteners. They are OK. Not super sweet. However, I realized that my taste buds had become corrupted by all the fake stuff and that I had become accustomed to the super sweet taste of nutrasweet, sucralose, stevia (blends) etc... So much so, that even SUGAR didn't taste sweet enough anymore. Just LIke Sugar is an appropriate name for this product. It is about as sweet as sugar. Now that I've been using it for a while I find it perfect in my coffee, tea, yogurt, or any beverage that needs that little bit of sweetener. Try it, but don't expect it to be super sweet. You may find you need to use two packets to sweeten your beverage.

I have been looking for a good sweetner for a long, long time. Sugar is out, and after reading about all the research on the artificial substitutes, I was almost physically sick. Those little blue, pink and yellow packets we've been pouring into our drinks are highly toxic!!! It boils down to the fact that these products are made from wood alcohol. In other words, formaldehyde!It causes a myriad of health problems, and could be a pre-cursor to alzheimers, according to medical lab researchers. Many people experience loss of memory, slow, fuzzy thinking, or fogginess. There are so many other troubling symptoms that I cannot even list them all.This is why I tried "Just Like Sugar". I put one packet in my tea and couldn't tell any difference. I put 2 more in, and still couldn't tell it was sweet at all. I had the feeling I was going to stand there all day and pour it in and still nothing would change. I am stuck with 3 boxes now, but never fear I DID find something better called "TRUVIA". I found it at the grocery store and am very happy with it. It has the natural sweetner Stevia in it and is healthy for you. I have tried other sweetners with Stevia and was disappointed, but this one works! One packet is all you need. Forget Just Like Sugar. Try Truvia and stop searching! Don't wait another day!

column9: Organic, Low Sugar & No Artificial Sugar - Finally!
column10: We eat healthy. That means my kids drink very little juice and zero soda. By very little I mean I never buy it, they might have some at a friend's house or a party or something. Generally they drink only milk or water. But that means they feel left out when the other kids have sugar-filled juice boxes or caprisuns. Enter Honest Kids! Yes, they have sugar in them, that's what I like. Go look at a box of 'Roaring waters' - that has artificial sweeteners (and sugar too, something I never could quite figure out). I would rather my children had a small amount of real sugar than artificial sweeteners. Since they are used to drinking only water otherwise, they like these, they don't complain they taste watered down. In fact if you compare these to a typical CapriSun, its kind of like the difference between a Vitamin Water and Gatorade. When you are used to Vitamin water, (original) Gatorade is going to taste sickly sweet, if you are used to Gatorade, Vitamin water is going to taste like water with slight flavor. Ask yourself which you want your children to be used to?I've seen other reviewers complain that they are hard to open or messy - my 6 and 8 year olds have no problems with them.  They put the straw in themselves and don't have a problem spilling them.Now they don't feel left out when everyone else has a juice box, and I feel good about the amount of sugar they are taking in. At only 40 calories and no artificial sweeteners, this is exactly what I've been looking for!
I bought a 32 pack and it was gone within a week. My three kids loved it and I was happy it is only 40 calories as opposed to the tiny juice boxes for 100. I am reordering right now!!

column9: Taste like watered down kool aid
column10: I got these because they seemed great for travel and I loved that they're organic.  That said, the ONLY good thing about them is that they're organic and have no HFCS.  Besides that, they're gross.  They have added sugar.  To be perfectly honest, they taste exactly like very watered down Kool Aid.  My little ones hated them as well.  We couldn't even finish the boxes we bought and brought them to my work to give away instead.  TOTALLY not worth the money.  Totally.

If you're used to the kick of standard Insanity or Total Insanity, then this will be quite disappointing from a heat perspective.  Has a decent taste to it, kind of a garlic limey flavor, but not spicy in the least.  Goes well with soups and salads I've found.

This is the best mustard on the planet. Bar none. It packs a powerful, zesty punch. Despite its strength, it enhances the flavor of my melted cheese bagels. It is a given that when friends or relatives visit us from Germany, they bring along a couple jars of this superb condiment.
I have been using this mustard for over 32 years.  I haven't found anything better in all my years.  Why not give it a try, you will love it.

I had originally found this mustard at an Italian import store in Tucson and introduced it to family and friends. Almost everyone loved it. The exceptions were those people who don't like hot foods and even they liked it in moderation. The import store was having trouble stocking it, so I turned to the internet. I use it to coat homemade French bread dough when making calzones. I also use it as part of the marinade when cooking pork loin. For myself, I use it on sandwiches and hot dogs but I really like the horseradish taste.

column9: This mustard is not the same as authentic Lowensenf from Germany.
column10: This mustard is not nearly as spicy as the authentic product from Germany which I have tried.  This seems like an "Americanized" version which I would not purchase again in the future.
Product claims to be "Extra Hot".It's not.It's an ok mustard but isn't really interesting and is only mildly hot. Very mild.
I have used this product for years.  It is the best mustard I have ever had.  Great on or in anything you would use regular mustard with.

I'm so glad I found this mustard to purchase here in the US. I used to get this from a German restaurant in NC and since we moved we haven't had it. So, finding this to get it shipped to me was awesome. We bought 3 jars so we would have extras on hand. My favorite mustard ever:)

column9: The Mustard that Made Me Like Mustard
column10: I used to hate mustard.  That was before I had Lowensenf.  Their extra hot mustard is a German classic.Several months ago, during a colder winter afternoon, my girlfriend and I tried this mustard when a friend-of-a-friend brought it over when they were making sausages and sandwiches.  We were hooked.  I was told that this mustard might be a little hard to find, since we don't live in a city.  So, when we found this item through an independent seller, we jumped on the opportunity and ordered a jar.Since the mustard is from Germany, the expiration dates in America run a little more quickly -- about two/two & half months.  However, that shouldn't be a problem because the mustard is so incredibly delicious that most people will find themselves running out of the product before it expires.  It is great on everything...  Meats and cheeses, breads, pretzels and you-name-it.  It is hot, but my girlfriend loves it and she never loves hot/spicy food or condiments.  But, I can't say that "it's hot, but not too hot," because that's not doing the mustard its proper favor.  The flavor is piquantly zesty and has a good lasting combination with food.If you are having a party with kielbasa, bratwurst, sausage and such, do yourself a favor and be prepared with Lowensenf.  Your friends will love it.  That's how I got hooked.
This mustard is by far, the best mustard I have ever had!  I got hooked on it while in Germany.  Now, I won't buy any other brand of mustard.  Hot American mustard just does not compare!

I had been searching for a good German mustard to remind me of the sandwiches I used to buy there as a U.S. Airman, way back in another life.  I have finally found it; Lowensenf Extra Hot is the real deal.  I bought one jar, then bought four more.  It gives one that wonderful bite (well, wonderful if you like hot food) and makes your hair hurt a few seconds after it explodes in your mouth.  One note though - it seems to need to be refrigerated before achieving full ignition; don't use it right out of the pantry.

column9: enjoyable tea - this 100gram bag makes 80cups of tea
column10: I like the flavor of this tea BUT I must confess that I appreciate bitter unsweetened teas as I know that is supportive of digestion and the beginning of assimilation and elimination.  While in the photo on this site and at Sunfood's website, the tea looks like chunks of bark, the bag that I received is almost a powder - more like slivers of bark.  I followed the directions on their website and mixed 2 tablespoons of Chuchuhausi tea with 8 cups of hot water and stirred and stirred and stirred.  It formed a rich tea darker than typical tea but not all of the powder was absorbed - I do not know, maybe all of it is at the bottom of my glass pitcher.  It is my first time to try Chuchuhausi tea so I can not compare this brand to others.  It was recommended to me because of how much magnesium oil helps me so I thought I might give it a try.  The flavor is enjoyable enough for me so I will go through one bag which makes about 80 cups of tea and then judge about purchasing more or not.Here is some more information I found about this bark.Chuchuhuasi is a small shrubby evergreen tree with leaves and berries that resemble holly native to South America and Southern Brazil, grown in city landscapes for its attractive appearance and decoration. Clinical studies shown its effectiveness in treating ulcers, and cancer with research back to as early as the mid 60s-containing antibiotic compounds that showed potent antitumor and Antileukemic activities in very low dosages.In traditional medicine an application of the leaves of chuchuhuasi is stilled used for various types of cancer the most popular has been for the treatment of ulcers, indigestion, chronic gastritis and dyspepsia. Brazilian utilizes espinheira santa for acne, anemia, stomach ulcers, gastric ulcers, cancers, constipation, gastritis, dyspepsia, liver disorders and many stomach disorders. Slowly becoming more popular and known to health practitioners in the United States.Leaf extract is currently being used for ulcers for restoring intestinal flora and inhibiting pathogenic bacteria, as a laxative, as a colic remedy, to eliminate toxins through the kidneys and skin, to regulate hydrochloric acid production in the stomach, for nervous disorders, and to support kidney, adrenal gland, digestive, and immune infections. While research continues health practitioners around the world have an important and highly effective natural remedy for many types of stomach and intestinal disorders at their disposal.

Some friends recently returned from a safari in Tanzania & brought this coffee back with them.  Simply amazing!  As a hard-core coffee drinker, I don't tend to expect much from instant.  But this one blows away just about any coffee I've had, instant or otherwise.[...]Not easy to find here in the US, but thankfully it looks like Amazon comes through again!

While i liked the coffee immensely i will not be ordering this again because the can was half empty or half full whichever way you look at it. I was shocked to see it at first and thought it was defective packaging but have read another review by someone who had a similar experience. Shame on them.
Excellent customer service. Was very pleased and satisfied with the outcome of my order. This is my favorite instant coffee.

We started drinking this coffee on Tanzanian safari, and now our whole family is drinking it in the afternoon when we don't want to make a whole pot of brewed. I also keep it at work and use it with the hot water tap.  It is smooth without being bland. All of us really like it and I am glad we can get it in the bigger tin now.
Great product! I've been guiding Safaris to Tanzania for more than 20 years.This is the favorite coffee of my clients.

I can't get enough of this delicious coffee. My husband is from Tanzania where the coffee originates. He is the one who introduced it to me. We both enjoy a few cups a day. This coffee is smooth and flavorful. It is rich and delightful. I would highly recommend this coffee.

I tried this coffe on a Safari in Tanzania it is one of the best coffees I have had. I ordered and have been using since. It is very convienent and the mildness and organic quality make a all day drinker if you like.

I've been searching for an Organic Instant coffee that has a robust state. Starbucks has Via but it's not Organic. Africafe is marketed by this seller as organic.The tin arrived and all it says is: "100% Pure Instant Coffee from the best Robusta and Arabica coffee beans".If it's organic, free from chemical additives AND processing, it should state so. Don't you think?In addition, it doesn't dissolve readily into cold water or Soy milk. In the morning(especially during the warm season), I enjoy making a cold/ice coffee with a 50/50 mix of Silk brand Chocolate Soy milk (light) and water. Very refreshing. I've been using Nescafe or Folgers crystals and both dissolve quickly and completely. Both products cost about $4 - $6 a jar. Africafe costs $24 with shipping!Bottom line: Save your money, brew Starbucks or other local organic roasted and keep chilled.

I've been searching for a good-tasting protein drink since I had a gastric bypass 3 years ago. I saw this product on another weight loss surgery blog and decided to give it a try. You can drink it warm (unlike most other protein drinks) or cold and it mixes quite easily if you use a container with a blender ball. I thought it was a bit too thick when I mixed it according to the directions (2 scoops in 12-14 oz. of water) so the next time I used more water. Others might prefer the thicker version, though. I also added crushed ice after I mixed it which kept it cold longer and made it more like an iced coffee drink. When I travel, I take my empty blender ball container in my carryon bag, stuffed with ziploc bags filled with protein shake powders but on my next trip will be taking these packets instead.

column9: Metallic Taste is the Deal Breaker
column10: Purchased this to use for travel as it's difficult to find iced coffee in most hotels & using water to mix makes it the perfect travel drink. I so wanted to love this. You have to shake vigorously - preferably using a shaker with a stirring ball or filter - as it's VERY grainy & takes about 2 minutes of solid shaking. Grainy I can live with, but the taste is the deal breaker. It has an incredibly strong metallic taste. The only way to soften the taste is to add lots of milk, which defeats my purpose of bringing a water mixing drink to travel. It's expensive for the convenience and would have been worth it - if only I could drink it. Oh well, the search for a traveling, water mixing iced coffee continues.
Was supposed to be 50 k cups only 48 were put inside the cardboard box. Otherwise product looked the same and was not damaged.
Wow, this coffee is good!  It arrived in quickly and boy o boy, is this good stuff.  Thanks everybody!  I really like coffee and this is some good stuff.
A delightful morning hot beverage without the caffiene.  Mild, delicate flavor in an express cup of coffee.  Very pleasing!  I definitely will buy some more.

The coffee has good flavor, not too strong, but not weak either. Unfortunatly the k cups I've used so far have left a mess everytime. The top hole of the k cup opens up much too large which sends grounds & coffee spraying all over. I don't know why this particular packageGreen Mountain Coffee, Vermont Country Blend Decaf, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50)would be different than the 24 count, but I never had problems with the smaller box of the same coffee.

One of the better K cup varieties that are available.  Tastes like coffee, and that's a real plus.  K cups aren't the greatest for making a really good cup of coffee, but this is one that is more than acceptable.
The coffee was excellent for decaf.  Not a dark coffee if that is what you are looking for.  I would purchase again.
I am use to a stronger blend I guess. This was ok, but just too weak for our taste. I will use it when I want to mix chocolate in it for a quick mocha.

OUTSTANDING MEDIUM BLEND COFFEE. I BOUGHT THIS FOR MY WIFE WHO NEEDS A DECAF COFFEE. I NEVER WAS A FAN OF DECAF BUT THIS IS SO GOOD AND I COULDN'T TELL IT WAS DECAF. I FIND MYSELF DRINKING THIS IN THE EVENING USING THE DECAF AS A REASON BUT THE TRUTH IS I LOVE THE TASTE!!!!

column9: Best coffee but comes in a bag and not a box
column10: The Country Blend is easier on my stomach than coffees that are more bold. It has great taste. I was afraid it would have a weak flavor. It isn't one for someone who likes a real strong coffee though. It's not too strong,not too mild...just right.  The only thing I didn't like is that the "pack of 50" came in a plastic bag and not a box. Would have been nice if it was in a box so I could store it easier. So disription is misleading. Should have said "Bag of 50."

I have ordered this coffee twice now and I keep going back to it.  I like the coffee, flavor is good, and the price is good when bought on sale.  I would recommend at least trying it.  Everyone has a different level of wants in a coffee.

I like a strong, bold, flavorful cup of coffee - and this isn't quite it, but it's better than most.  After trying a dozen "promising" decaf K-cups, Vermont Country Blend Decaf is my current 'go-to' brew when a cup of decaf is in order.  I'd really like something stronger and bolder, but until I find it, Vermont Country Blend Decaf will do.
Just switched to Decaf only and gave this a whirl  It it very good, not to strong and not to weak. I love this coffee

Really good decaf coffee flavor - I'd say it's on the bold side of medium... perfect for an evening cup of joe that won't keep you awake.Value is great, and I've never had a defective cup. Highly recommended.
I tried to stay away of the coffee so I deceiced to have one cup a day of Decaf...well with this one I actually drink 2 a day ,taste real good.
I really enjoy this blend of coffee, perfect for my first morning cup. will definintly purchase again. you will love it too.
Very satisfied with this great coffee, the flavor is perfect,  both my husband snd myself enjoy it, snd the price was right.

Green Mountain Vermont Country Blend coffee, decaf K-Cups, turned out to be much better than I had expected.  This is the first decaf coffee I've brewed at home that had great flavor, without being either too weak or bitter. It's nice to be able to have coffee just before bedtime and not be kept awake all night!  Kudos!
I am a senior citizen who lives alone and enjoys a good cup of coffee in the morning and this product is great.

This coffee blend is full bodied but not overpowering and makes for a smooth tasty cup of coffee.  It is great anytime of day.  Green Mountain has done an excellent job with this blend.  You will not be disappointed.
This is my favorite coffee. Having come from the Green Mountain state and having tried all different coffees all over, this is the best I've found. Will order again very soon.
Nothing bad can be said about GMCR, great price for K-Cups, Great Quality, DELICIOUS COFFEE!Love this coffee, made in Waterbury, VT can't beat the locality for me!

This is a nice smooth tasting decaf coffee, not at all strong or bitter. My box actually had 51 K-Cups in it so I got a cup on the house. I will be buying this Green Mountain Vermont Country Blend again.
I have purchased Green Mountain Coffee from this companypreviously and have always been completely happy with theservice and will continue to order from them.

column9: Coffee is good but lacks body
column10: I ordered this coffee after having seen reviews.  Some reviews stated that the cups were not properly sealed and leaked product into the brewed coffee.  I did not find that to be the case at all.  The cups were all well sealed and I did not experience any leakage whatsoever.  However, the cups did not come in a box and were simply packed in a regular mailing envelope.  The coffee itself is good but lacking in body.  It is OK for drinking occasionally, but I doubt that I would want it all the time.  I have had a french roast decaf made for Keurig cups which I found to be much better.  I believe it is also made by Green Mountain.  However, I have not found it to be available in the 50-cup format.
Love the coffee, love that I won''t run out of it for a long time, love that it was delivered in less than a week after I ordered it!. Amazon rocks!

Ordered Green Mountain Coffee, Vermont Country Blend Decaf, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, (Pack of 50).Have no problem with the product or the timely shipping.  When I recieved the product, the package was mangeled quit badly and there were k-cups missing.
I thought this coffee was okay, certainly not great.  It seemed a bit weak to me.  I would not purchase again, but someone that is not looking for bold flavor might like this.
this was bought for a friend who only drinks decaf.  I would guess she is happy.  Arrived before expected date.

column9: GM Vermont Country Blend k-cups - bang for your buck
column10: I really like this coffee and the value over k-cups purchased elsewhere. The only reservation that I have is that, without fail, a number of coffee grounds land in my cup after the process is completed. However, I guess I will still want to buy this particular brand at Amazon.com as long as I can get it cheaper.($25 for 50 cups).

column9: Hubby is Happy!  Green Mountain Coffee K-Cups Decaf
column10: For years while living in New Hampshire my hubby enjoyed his morning Green Mountain Coffee.  After relocating to North Carolina it was difficult to find and now that I've order lots of K-Cups - he is smiling and enjoying his Green Mountain coffee!!

I received a great offer from Amazon to purchase 50 K-Cups at a reasonable cost.  I purchased the item and found it to be fabulous.  I have recently been laid off from work so I am at home looking for a job so I seem to be drinking my coffee.  This was a great deal for me and the cost savings was wonderful.  Thank You Amazon

I was recently told to cut down on my caffeine...so sad.I went on a quest to find decent decaf k-cups...first attempt, total failure.I'm mixing one decaf and one caffeinated k-cup - so I can't 100% tell you how great these are...BUT - with these decaf k-cups, I barely noticed 1 decaf was mixed in with my caffeinated k-cup!  Yay!  :)

column9: vermont country bleand decalf k cups
column10: I have bin bying this coffee for four years from amazon.I am very please with amazon and there coffee.

First off, it was late...box went all over the place before receiving it. Box was beatin up & torn on one end(anyone could have reached in there and pulled out product). Coffee was dinged up some was torn open...coffee was inside the box. Not happy how it came. Will not buy from again.

column9: DO NOT BUY THIS... IT'S DECAF! unless you like decaf.
column10: I absolutely HATE how that dreaded "decaf" word finds it's way into descriptions like fine print. Now I have FIFTY of these things that I wasted 35 dollars on, and Amazon makes CERTAIN to not allow returns or exchanges. No one would buy this stuff if they did.If this were the real deal, I may even complain about the fact that there's 49 in the box instead of 50. However, it's one less piece of trash taking up space in the can, so at least I know to never order this kind of stuff again.EDITTING***So I'm changing my review of this. Wrote that stuff up there the day I got it and was still heated by my own mistake. My wife ended up bringing it to work where folks apparently think it's fantastic. Gotta give credit where it's due... if you like decaf coffee, this is a great choice!
One of my 50 count boxes of K-Cups only had 41 cups in it.  The money has been refunded but I'm still not happy.

This was so disappointing. I was happy to get the Friday deal on the 50 CT. To try this variety kcup. To my amazement I opened the outer box to find the loose k cups inside with coffee grounds leaked, but worst of all no protection or sealed package/box from Green Mountain with the name of the coffee etc on it. This is not safe and I called to complain . Amazon did take are of it, but I really am shocked and somewhat concerned at This practice - did they just buy bulk, try to sell it to us as a special, and hope I was dumb enough to drink ? It made me wonder...as someone said, would you buy something like this at a grocery store,like an open unmarked carton of milk? I think not.....this is my fourth purchase that has had damage or poor packaging .....I think I'll stick to local for my coffee . I cant comment n the flavor, sorry, it's not usable. I would be very curious if anyone else got a box like this?

Theo chocolate bars are all organic, and this bar is no exception.  I've been to the Theo chocolate store in Washington, and this bar is by far the most popular out of all the people shuffling in and out of the store to sample the chocolate pieces.  It is milky, but has decently sized hazelnut chunks within it to retain some crunch and hazelnut flavor.  At the store itself, it costs $3.25/bar, or $3/bar if you buy at least 6 bars.  I would heavily advise against shipping for a long period of time in the summer for these chocolate bars because they do melt pretty easily.
Great product and from what I can see and have experienced this is a great company.  I'll be back for more! :)
This hazelnut crunch chocolate has big chunks of salt in it. The salt seems to be what makes it crunchy, not the hazelnuts. Ick. The package makes no reference to salt.

I used to buy these at my hometown movie theater when I was a child and I was delighted to see them again!When I received my box of Linda's Lollies in the mail I was overjoyed...they were just as delicious to me 15 years later!I highly recommend these!

column9: Some were really good, most were just OK.
column10: Given the price, these should have been really flavorful. A few were, but most were very average. They are better than what is available at a grocery store.
These little beauties are about as perfect as you can get in the lollipop community. The are exquisitely handcrafted. and able to be displayed in many facets

These pops were absolutely awful. My first try was the German Chocolate Cake, which barely tasted like chocolate and more like a mild root beer flavored candy. The second try was the Cherry Cheesecake, which tasted like cherry flavored cough syrup. The third attempt was the Coconut Creme Pie, which had a mild coconut flavor.I gave up after the third attempt and shared a few of the remaining pops with some coworkers; most of them hated the pops as well, stating they tasted very artificial.I was very disappointed considering other products of this nature appear to have higher ratings.
I only wish it was a larger size (so I could have it longer).  I love loose tea and am really glad I tried this.  It you're a tea drinker I would recommend giving it a try.

The tea leaves were bright and fresh looking tho the packaging wasn't air tight. The tea was in a tightly closed (but not sealed) brown bag.The apple flavor seemed to predominate a bit over the jasmine, but both flavors were apparent.  It brewed up to a deep golden color.  Very nice.
product had a few heart shaped pieces in the bag...They were very good but the squares were ok at best...won't buy again!

column9: Tasty gluten-free and grain free pizza crust option!
column10: I am gluten-free, but try to go grain-free as well since grains irritate my skin and stomach. The Chebe mix makes a yummy pizza crust that fits the bill, and is chewy under the toppings and crunchy at the edges, just the way I like it. No funky aftertaste in this mix like in some gluten-free mixes. I have bought this mix many times and made it with a variety of different toppings, all delicious.
My nine year old son is allergic to wheat, corn, rice and soy. And he loves this crust! Thank goodness!
My son loves this pizza crust, just made it again yesterday for him.  We have all eaten it and it is good!

column9: Pretty good item.  Will order again.
column10: These were pretty good turtle-like chocolates.  The chocolate itself was good, not great.  The caramel was pretty smooth and creamy.  Granted, I'm comparing these to others that I've had and the best I've had which came fresh off the line at the Lindt & Sprungli Chocolate facility in NH during a tour of their facility.  I didn't expect these to beat those, but these were pretty good.  They were also fairly inexpensive in comparison to those made by Lindt.  With that said, I will order these again as they were very much enjoyed.
I know it cost too much when I ordered - wow shipping fees were an unexpected additional cost.  The Cashews were plenty and the chocolate was delicioua but I won't be buying again due to extra fees.

column9: Peace Wild Berry Cereal - not what it used to be
column10: I used to like it a lot but now it is just corn flakes and some oat clusters. You will be lucky to find half a strawberry and 2 blueberries in the entire box. Not worth the money.

I love peace cereal, this flavor in particular is really delicious.  It's organic, vegan and 10% of profits go to community projects.  It has dried blueberries, raspberries and strawberries which are in their natural state and are very flavorful with granola chunks that also have a rich, nutty flavor.  Overall, just really good stuff!
these are the very best jordan almonds you will find. Tried the one they sell in mass markets and it can't compare at all. I highly recommend this traditionnal French product for any events.

column9: Delicious almonds but candy lacks flavor
column10: These almonds were fresh and had a crisp and thin sugar coating but the sugar coating did not have a nice flavor.  I'm Italian and love the little flavor.  The brand that is my favorite is Marich (from San Fran), but they are difficult to find - thin candy coating and wonderful flavor.
The price makes these a real treat for around Easter. They are delicious.  The shell is crunchy and sweet, the almond inside balances out the taste.The light blue color is beautiful.

Ingredient list: Rice Flour, Almonds, Potato Starch, Expeller Pressed Safflower, Sea Salt, Natural Almond Flavor, and Butter Flavor.I got hooked on Mr. Krispers toasted almond chips, but when they got discontinued, I had to find a new, wheat and gluten-free snack. Voila - Blue Diamond Almond Nut Thins! Blue Diamond has improved on an already great snack with a "Hint of Sea Salt" version that is still plenty salty for me. With only 80 mg. of salt per serving (less if you consider the amount left over at the bottom of the bag), it makes a very delicious treat that sometimes I find myself consuming the entire box instead of limiting myself to 17 crackers! I'm positively addicted. I've also tried the Hazelnut Thins, which are also quite delicious, but the Almond Nut Thins are my favorite.

I love these crackers, and rely on them now for my lunches on the go since havig to go gluten free - although I ate them before my diagnosis as well, so they are great for anyone. Super crispy and light, perfect with cheese, and at 17 crackers per serving you get a lot for not too many calories. Subscribe and save beats all grocery store prices so far.  Definitely recommend!
Hoping they start carrying these here!  Amazon has great prices on the other 7 flavors, but this one is my favorite!

These crackers are addictive!  I've bought these in specialty stores because in chain stores I cannot find them in sea salt.  The price per box on Amazon was about a dollar less than the store prices.  I was worried about buying them by the case, but the only problem is stopping myself from eating them all because they are that good.  Bonus is they are only 130 calories for 17 crackers and low sodium.  The crunch and taste is very satisfying.

column9: Oh man, these are so addicting - I ate the whole box!
column10: I bought these at the local grocery store and then I found them on Amazon.  I bought several cases and I love them! These are lower in salt which I like and have an Almond base.  They are less flavorful than the Hazelnut (in my opinion) but I still like them without anything on them.  If you add some warm Brie cheese and dried cranberries, you will be in heaven! I particularly like that they are gluten free. I am so happy that Blue Diamond invented these. Highly recommend!

column9: I love, love, love these crackers!
column10: My two crunchy snacks of choice for some time now have been Snyder's Butter Snaps Pretzels and popcorn popped in my Nordic Ware 60120 Microwave Popcorn Popper. Blue Diamond Nut-Thins have pushed those two treats from the top of my crunch list. You simply cannot beat this cracker for mouth feel if you like plenty of snap, and the almond flavor of these crackers is sublime. They are wonderful with dips, but they are so delicious, I actually prefer to eat them plain. Though there is salt on them, it is truly a "hint," because they qualify as low sodium with only 80 mg. per serving.At only 8 calories per cracker, Nut-Thins compare favorably to my mini pretzels, which are 5 calories each.Blue Diamond is known for nuts and products made with nuts, and they have several other nut flavors for these crackers: regular almond, pecan, and hazelnut. All of the Nut-Thins are delicious.Highly recommended.

column9: The best I have EVER found
column10: NOW this is a bone made for my little chihuahua Rock is so happy when he see's these obnes and if Rocky is happy Mom id tickled pink .They are in chicken and we hid 2 them when he's a good boy and goed out side,he come in and we say ''find it'' BOY does he know what to do and searches places high and low till he finds all treats and this is a special one and he sure knows it

We buy these at the Family Dollar store for just a few cents over 2 dollars a pack, as well as Dollar General. At the grocery store or Kmart etc, they are usually 5 dollars or more.Our dog loves these, as well as a few other treats made by this brand. These, he doesn't devour immediately, as he is able to chew/gnaw on them for a few minutes before they are gone. It is nice to find a treat that keeps him occupied for a few minutes, rather than one he just basically swallows after a chew or two - like a biscuit etc. These provide a nice mix of treat and chew toy.The ingredients are very simple and he has no issues with digestion. These and the Drumettes made by Waggin Train are his favorite treats. The Drumettes are also only a few cents over 2 dollars at the dollar stores, whereas at the grocery store or elsewhere are over 4 dollars.I and our dog would definitely recommend them!

My 2 dogs and the little dog upstairs (that I gave one of these treats to) became violently ill a few hours after eating these treats. I called the manufacture who was very nice, and assured me that these (and all their treats) are closely monitored, and nothing had been reported to date. I told her I was taking my dogs to the vet, and she ask me to call her back with my vet's name and his diagnosis so that she can contact one of their vets to compare notes.Since speaking with this company, I have talked with a couple of friends who have also given their dogs these same treats, and also had very sick dogs.I have given my dogs the Waggin Train chicken jerky treats, and have not had any issues what so ever.

The description may be a little unclear, so just to clarify, you are getting 12 boxes, each box has 3 packets, so a total of 36 packets.  Each packet makes 1Qt of milk.  Those of you that have purchased powdered milk before will see how convenient this this.  To get powdered for a reasonable price at the store, you need to buy the biggest box they have.  The problem there is that as soon as you open it, you need to find better containers to store it in, preferably air tight and not made of plastic.The smaller packets you get with this product remove the need to find secondary storage containers.  Because you don't have to open it all at once, you don't have to worry about the moisture making the milk go bad, or light reducing the vitamin quality.If you have never used powdered milk before, there are some nice benefits.  The main benefit to me is that it doesn't go bad.  I don't drink enough milk to justify buying it by the gallon, and even buying half gallon sizes it would go bad before I could use it.  With powdered milk I never have to worry about it going bad, nor do I need to wonder if I have milk on hand.Now, as for taste, I don't drink milk by itself, powdered or not.  I've read that if you do, it's best to mix it up and then let it sit in the fridge for a few hours.  I use it in protein shakes, where it tastes no different than regular milk.  I imagine it would be great for things like smoothies as well.Another great use for powdered milk is adding it to coffee.  Much healthier for you than powdered non-dairy creamer, and just as creamy and delicious.  And, unlike regular milk, the powdered milk will not cool down your coffee nearly as much.  I've gotten a few people hooked on using powdered milk in their coffee.

My wife is cursed with arthritic hands and the those large dehydrated milk  boxes are just too much for her to handle.  Since the quality of dry milk is about the same by every maker, Mix 'n Drink is an excellent product. It is a wonderful alternative packaging with its 3-gallon packets which are easy to open and pour from.  Price increases among like products or other cost differences are not as important as my wife's health and comfort.

This product is easy to mix and use. Convenient to keep on hand.stores well--longer than recommended if kept in cool, dry place (such as the basement). Though with drinking it does taste better  after a few hours of refrigeration, it can be used immediately with good flavor.  For cooking, it can't be detected as different from whole milk. I first began using it to help a limited budget, but several months later when I could afford whole milk again my kids decided they liked the Mix n Drink milk better.

This milk is OK. It is not really for drinking and more for cooking.  In my opinion it has more of the flat aftertaste that powdered milk can have. Wal-mart Great Value is slightly better with Provident Pantry having the best taste.

But four stars instead of five because there is no pour spout on the side of the box like there is on the boxes I  buy in supermarket. We use this for baking, not drinking. With a spout, you pick up the box, slide the spout, tip out enough to fill a measuring cup, close the spout. This product has pouches. You have to open the pouch, pour into measure, reclose up the pouch which sounds good but it takes about 3 times longer. On the other hand, there is an advantage where you make a quart at a time. Each pouch makes 1 quart, which is extremely handy, no measuring.

The price of 43 dollars makes this product over 4 dollars a gallon for this product. I can pick up regular whole milk for a lot less than this.The price was around 22 dollars around July-August 2011  , less than 2 months ago.Buy it at 43 dollars and this product will go up even higher. Or wait until price drops back to 22 dollars.

column9: 12 cents a Quart price increase over night
column10: This product was .78 cents a quart one day, which made it about .02 cents cheaper per quart than the local supermarket.  Now it's jumped to .90 cents per quart making it .10 cents more expensive per quart than the local supermarket.  I gave it 3 stars because of the massive jump in price but the quality of the product itself gets 4.5 stars.

column9: These were at local store for 1.99 a box!
column10: These were great and easy to measure and mix.  My only issue is with the price here as I found these at a local store for about 2.00 for the 3-pack box.  That was only a couple of months ago.  So what gives with the prices here?  Amazon definitely does not have the best prices on groceries even though you think you should be saving money buying cases...I found this has seldom been the "case" for me.  I gave the product 5 stars but wish Amazon was more price competitive on their groceries as they are on other items.

column9: It is ok, not as good as fresh milk though
column10: For someone who lives alone like me, finishing drinking a half gallon milk before expiration date is far reach of possibility.Well, the taste is not as good as fresh milk, but it's ok.

column9: Pretty good tasting for instant non-fat milk powder
column10: Non-fat instant tastes okay, it will never taste like fresh milk, but the SACO brand is probably the best tasting of the bunch. Mix it up and chill it well for the best flavor.What I do use this milk for is cooking and baking. I either make up a small pitcher of the milk for cooking or use about 1/3 cup dry milk powder with 1 cup water for the recipe.You can also use this milk to make homemade buttermilk, if you have some buttermilk as a starter. Search the web for a recipe.If you want milk to drink, using milk powder, I'd recommend the Nestle Nido Milk Powder, Imported, (400 gm), 14.1-Ounce Cans (Pack of 3) as it tastes is very good.Recommend for cooking and baking.

Great quality and taste if you like skim milk...I make it as I useit, and rarely have to waste milk that has gone sour and have todiscard.  I buy several boxes at a time, store at room temp,and rarely have to make a run to store to buy milk.  Have foundother brands, such as carried by local Wal Mart, have a funnydisagreeable taste....Also carried at local Save A Lot but onlyin larger package.
This product is helpful for homeless and hungry patrons.The envelopes allow us to give milk to  needy recipients.

column9: SEE WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU GIVE GOOD REVIEWS - NO LONGER
column10: I AM LOWERING THIS REVIEW SINCE THEIR HUGH 25% JACK UP IN PRICE. $1.25 A QUART IS WAY TO HIGH TO BUY ANYMORE.I am pretty much disabled and hate it when I run out of milk. I'm buying this so I have reserve on hand when it's to hard to go to the store when I run out of milk. The 12 3qt bags is a little more expensive but I figure it will stay fresher longer and I will probably only need one bag a month or so. I have heard Saco is a good brand. I will add to this review after I have tried it.--Update: IT WAS GOOD AT $36 A CASE BUT NOW IS A RIP-OFF AT $44. THE 40 QT BOX ALSO JUMPED TO $44 PLUS $13 STINKING SHIPPING. NOW YOU HAVE A HUGE HIGH PRICE. IT'S NOW WORTH BUYING THIS CRAP ANYMORE.

This candy has been around the block a number of times, yet still manages it's tangy, sweetness, punch.A great thing about this candy is you can carry it anywhere in a pocket, purse, or backpack, without having a sugary mess, to clean up, if spillage occurred. Heat won't affect them.They are somewhat hard, but break fairly easily once chewed!

I go through so much of this stuff,and being in rural Va,sometimes my stores ,carry it,lots of times I can't find it.Great experience with this seller.Will order from again,and the Reduced fat Peanut Butter by Jiff is the best ever in my humble opinion.

The title says it all, but it's worth repeating; this "stuff" is absolutely disgusting.I love peanut butter, but there's none to be found here. If you love or even like peanut butter, and like Jif peanut butter, avoid this artificial glop. I just threw out what remained of the jar because I couldn't choke any more down. Yes, it's that bad.Read the ingredients and you're in for an unpleasant surprise..Right after peanuts which probably isn't more than 30%-40% percent of the total, you'll find "corn syrup solids" (a form of sugar), followed by (here's a surprise), sugar (again) and soy protein, etc. Most peanut butter contains added sugar, but not like this.The texture is grainy or mealy, the taste is artificial and overly sweet, and the experience is like a lab experiment gone wrong.I've tried to wash it out of the jar before throwing the plastic in the recycling bin... It won't wash out.. it forms this mass of sticky stuff that even scalding water can't dislodge. I let it sit over night. No good; this stuff won't move from the jar. None of this stuff is water soluble and I doubt that it's even biodegradable, let alone digestible.This stuff is so bad I felt compelled to let unsuspecting people know. I shared it with two other people; they won't go near it again. Abominably bad.
What we received tasted moldy - maybe the blossoms were collected from the ground.  Linden tea from Bulgaria still had the aroma of blossoms on the trees!!!

While traveling in Eastern Turkey I was introduced to Linden Tea. It is harvested and processed there in an area along the Black Sea. Its delicate flavor pleased me. I have digestive problems and found this tea to be soothing both with meals and alone. The NutraTea from Slovenia is close to what I found in Turkey. Enjoy!

THIS IS MY FAVORITE CHRISTMAS CANDY. I LOOK FORWARD TO IT EVERY YEAR. THIS PRODUCT WAS PACKAGED NICELY AND TASTED WONDERFUL. THE ONLY BAD THING I CAN SAY ABOUT IT IS THAT I DON'T WANT TO SHARE. I GUESS I WILL HAVE TO BUY MORE OF IT NEXT YEAR TO HAVE ENOUGH FOR ME AND MY GUESTS.

I've been buying these since they appeared in my area, and they are delicious.  The portion size is acceptable, considering these are only 100 calories.  The cookies are nice and minty and have a chocolate coating on the bottom of each cookie.Unlike say, the Oreo 100 calorie packs, these actually taste like grasshoppers, only smaller.  Unlike regular grasshoppers though, the 100 calorie pack version is trans fat free.Overall, these are a great example of what a 100 calorie pack should be.
These are wonderful cookies.  They taste like the thin mint girl scout cookies.  With only 100 calories they are a perfect treat for those trying to eat healthier.

True these are "little" cookies but they are big on good taste. True they are not extremely shortbready....however for 100 calories they are just right! You get about 13 - 15 cookies in each bag, all perfectly bite-sized. My son (13 months old) & I share a bag for breakfast it's our little "ritual" & he loves them! Just the perfect thing when you need a little pick-me-up, enough to settle that rumble in your tummy but not too much to spoil your next meal!

These cookies are a perfect snack for when you wish to get a 'fix' of something cookie-like.  They do not have the richness of a real shortbread cookie but for a 100-calorie snack they are simply more than good enough.If you are someone like me who on occasion want to nibble on a little something during a coffee break then I believe you can't go wrong by purchasing this product.P.S.  These cookies arrived in perfect condition!!!
Yummy! So great! If you enjoy mint and chocolate these are for you! Tasty mint cookies dipped in chocolate and you can eat a whole bag with only 100 calories! Definitely worth the money

column9: Keebler Right Bites Grasshopper 100 Calorie Packs,... DELICIOUS
column10: These are the best of the 100 calorie cookie snacks that I have tried and I have tried most of them. They remind me of the GIRL SCOUTS THIN MINTS COOKIES. They have a light chocolate coating. If you like chocolate mint, you will love these. They are just the right size to take on the go.
These cookies help to deter sweet tooth with a reasonable amount of calorie.  I have to hide a box, because my kids will devour all that they see.
I can't keep enough of these in the house.  Everyone keeps taking them for lunch, afternoon pick me up or a late night snack.  Good thing that Amazon stocks them by the half dozen!!

column9: Cookies that taste like a Hershey's Cookies N Creme bar/Oreo cookie
column10: I'm not a huge fan of the Hershey's cookies and creme bars because there's always so much white chocolate.  This is a little more cookie-y so I like it a lot better.  The chocolate cookie itself tastes a lot like the cookie part of an Oreo, but a little less dense and a little less chocolatey.  The creme itself tastes kind of like the white chocolate in a Hershey's cookies n creme bar, but MORE like the icing on those pink and white iced animal crackers.  Overall, it doesn't taste a LOT like an Oreo, but it definitely tastes more like an Oreo than the actual Oreo 100 calorie packs.
my grandkids and my wife and i love love love these cookies.  they taste just like the fudge strip cookies so i buy whichever ones might be on sale.  they're really yummy!
I like buying these in bulk as it they are easier to store in the box. Good product. Usually beats the price at my local stores.
Great tasting Chocolate Mint Snack package  good size and wonderful taste
Not bad for being only 100 calories, crispy and crunchy.  Definitely better than melba toast!

While the overall quality of Keebler's line of regular cookies tends to be quite good, their version of 100-calorie shortbread cookies is a true miss.Pros:  You get a large quantity of mini cookies per pouch (in comparison to Pepperidge Farm 100 calorie varieties.)Cons: Any essence of a "shortbread" flavor was completely lost to these crisps' just-sweet flavor.I won't be purchasing these in that future.  For those seeking a very decent portion-controlled shortbread-type crisp, I highly recommend either Nabisco's Lorna Doone (sweeter), or Pepperidge Farm Chessmen (very buttery) both in 100 Calorie Pouches.

column9: Light tasting but falls short of the original ones
column10: These are fairly good but they are not as tasty as the original pecan sandies. They do make a healthy convenient little snack ,however.

column4: Jason P. Pumphrey "the movie & music man"
column10: I like Keebler's 100 Calorie Snacks,but this one far from my favorite,there kinda bland and not as good as their Pecan Sandies! There far from bad cookies,there just not that great either! I've had much better!
Don't waste your time or money with this product.  The cookies have very little shortbread flavor and are no bigger than the tip of your finger.
My dogs are highly food-driven and this is by far their favorite reward. It also improves their breath so it's a win-win!

Man, oh man, these bad boys are addictive. I found some at a Kroger Grocery store in Tennessee and bought a bag to enjoy on the road. I live about 250 miles away and the bag was GONE by the time I got home! I logged on to Amazon and bought a whole 12-bag CASE! They are buttery, crunchy-crispy, and sliced differently than other bagel chips. Instead of the doughnut-shaped cross-sections of all the others, these are sliced vertically, so they are the approximate size and shape of a quarter. Seriously, these are GOOD good!

I discovered these chips while on a trip in Stamford, CT.  I have loved Stacy's pita chips for a while - so when I saw the bagel chips I was thrilled.  They are even better than the pita chips!  My only complaint is that I had to order them because they are not available in my area.  Also, they are kind of pricey - but for special occasions they are totally the best!!
These the best pita chips and at least half price from supermarket prices, and to boot, delivered right to your door.

I actually ordered the wrong item when I ordered the bagel chips, but I am SO glad I did! These are amazing and are so good in place of chips. I recommend these as well as the Pita Chips (which is what I thought I was ordering)

If you use significant amount of Cardamon you will like this package. I used to buy it in smaller quantities but the shipping cost for smaller packages is high ship so I opted for this one. Nice size kernels and great flavor. I grind it with coffee and have a great taste and mood! It makes the house smells great.Enjoy it!
Ghirardelli chocolate is the best when compared to others on the market. I will always buy it as it does give a good taste of chocolate in cookies or cake.
I order this coffee for work all the time through Amazon and it's the cheapest and best around. I will continue ordering.

Crown Prince Natural Solid White Albacore Tuna In Spring WaterThis is an exceptionally good tuna.... good texture and taste. Up until buying this, I bought Walmart's store brand Solid White Albacore Tuna In Spring Water, which is also wild caught. The primary difference between the two brands is price.The Crown Prince Natural Solid White Albacore Tuna In Spring Water costs $0.42 per once without coupon or subscribe discount.... $0.35 per once with $10 per 24 can discount.Walmart's everyday price is $0.23 per once.Needless to say, when my stock of Crown Prince Natural Solid White Albacore Tuna In Spring Water runs out, I'll go back to the Walmart store brand.If the price difference wasn't so great, I would have given 5 stars instead of 3.

This purchased was well package, arrived undamaged and in a timely manner. The product was the best solid white albacore tuna I have ever had. It was much better than the name brands in my local markets. I have already placed a second order. I highly recommend this product.

column9: Not too sweet, right size for little ones
column10: Unlike some other brands (and some of Kinnikinnick's own cookies), these chocolate animal GF cookies are not overly sweet but tastes chocolate-y enough for my chocoholic son.  The animal shapes are easy to decipher.  Small enough for little hands to hold, and for mommies and daddies not to feel guilty for giving the kids 5 or 6 different shapes (or more!).  I have only bought them at retail stores, and invariably and perhaps inevitably some of the cookies are broken when I open the package, but that has happened with all animal cookies I have bought, GF or not.  The crumbs make a great cheese cake crust :-)

I havent bought these from this seller, but I have had these crackers before. I have also tried the garlic and rosemary flavors. To me- this is by far the best. It has a delicious flavor, with great texture, and very fresh crunch. I gave some to my 5-year old niece and she liked them a lot. Tastes better than the other major brand (I wont say their name).  :)
These are the best gluten-free crackers that you can buy. In fact, they are the best cracker on the market. Try them with cheese or eat them plain. They are delicious!
These crackers are gluten free but they are the best crackers...gluten or not.THEY ARE TO DIE FOR !!!  Will keep ordering !!!

Doc suggested reducing the gluten in my diet as another weapon against some mild psoriasis on my fingertips.I can't really speak to the efficacy of that but I was looking for an alternative to my normal cracker/crunch routine (Saltines, Ritz, Doritos). These Crunchmasters are great candidates!I've had them plain; with cheese/salami; with guacamole. But my favorite so far is as a crouton replacement! I crumble them up and once they get doused with some salad dressing, they work out perfectly for me.This all being said, I'm not really a salt guy (says the guy who eats Saltines) and they are a little salty for my tastes until I re-realized "duh, I ordered Sea Salt Flavor" so what did I expect. This 6-pack is a good amount of crackers for one crunch-lover but when I do get through them and onto ordering another batch, I'll try a different flavor.
These crackers have a wonderful almost buttery flavor.  I would recommend them to anyone, not just those that must eat gluten free!

After being diagnosed with celiac disease, I was doubtful that I could find a cracker that I would like as much as my usual whole grain crackers.  My mom suggested these, and I was skeptical (what would I do with 6 bags if I didn't like them?)  They are fantastic!  They are crunchy, slightly salty, and a great gluten free cracker for any use.  Many gluten free crackers, and GF products in general, use mostly rice flour and are very low in whole grains and fiber, as well as being higher in calories than their whole wheat counterparts.  These crackers have 3 grams of fiber and 120 kcal per 16 cracker serving, which is great.  I would highly reccomend these crackers to anyone even if you do not need to follow a gluten free diet.

This cracker is super awesome!  I have to eat gluten free and I always keep a bag of these crackers around the kitchen.  Whether you need to eat gluten free or just want a healthy option, this is the only cracker you need to keep in the house.  You can't even tell it is gluten free, it just seems like a normal cracker.

I love these crackers.  I only have the Crunchmaster crisps available in my area.  So was happy to try another variety. These are great because they are big enough to add a topping if you want. But both are so addicting I want to eat the whole box. Thanks Amazon.

column9: This are awesome crackers gluten free or not!
column10: We were looking for a decent tasting gluten free cracker for our family members that have to deal with gluten issues. These are so good that now the whole family enjoys them and other Crunchmaster crackers which are just as delicious. You won't be sorry if you try these.

column9: "All Natural"???...contains GMO corn, confirmed by a phone call to Crunchmaster
column10: Eating gluten-free or wheat-free is becoming far less challenging than it once was.  Unfortunately, eating GMO-free is still like navigating a labyrinth with a blindfold.We can thank food manufacturers like Crunchmaster for that difficulty.  With the following proudly printed across the front of the package: "Certified Gluten Free!", "All Natural", "0g Trans Fat", "Cholesterol Free", one might be tempted to think this is a fairly "clean" product.  Not so.  A call to the customer service number on the back of the bag (1-888-574-7737, in case you're interested) to ask whether this "all natural" product is also natural enough to be GMO-free, elicited the following comment from a customer service rep "it has corn in it, so it's not..."."Not GMO-free?" I queried to make sure I was understanding.  "Not GMO-free" came the reply.So there you have it.  With recent studies coming out even more strongly questioning the safety and long-term health effects of GMO foods, why would anyone want to eat this?  Do you?Pass on this product and support those gluten-free products that are also committed to providing GMO-free as well as gluten-free.  There are alternatives out there that do both.

Other Glutten free crackers are hard and tasteless.  However, these multi grain crackers were not.  They had a crisp crunch and were also very tasty.  I put PB&J on them and also ate them alone.I will be ordering again!
the flavor and texture are excellent .my grand children are wheat sensitive so these are a nice addition to their limited selection of snacks. Not only that but the snack is healthy.

column9: Crunchmaster gluten-free crackers are exceptionally delicious
column10: Crunchmaster has perfected the art and science of baking crackers that are gluten-free so that the crackers taste and feel at least as delectable as those that are non-gluten-free.  People who do not need to eliminate gluten from their diet enjoy these crackers as much as people who must eat gluten-free.  Their high quality is exceptional in the gluten-free products industry; so many of those products are very expensive and not worth consuming.  Crunchmaster crackers are deliciously worth every cent.  The pack of 6 bags of crackers gives us an opportunity to bring a bag to share when we're invited to where they're serving a cheese plate as an appetizer.  Everyone comments on how good they are and asks about them.
These are great. They are always gone before I think of order another batch and we get 6 packages at a time.  Great as a substitue for Chips - Gluten Free - easy on the digestive system.

column9: Great, even if you don't need Gluten-free
column10: As a dietitian, I am always trying new, healthy foods to recommend to clients.  But these are so good, that I will also buy for myself.

After trying many gluten-free products, with great disappointment, I was dubious about the glowing reviews for these crackers.  However, the gluten-free world is not a delicious place, so the reviews convinced me to try them.  I found only the white cheddar flavor at my local heath food store.  I must admit they are delicious. Without a doubt, the best gluten-free product I have had.  I agree with the other reviews, the crackers are crunchy and flavorful.  Since my local store only carries the one flavor, I look forward to ordering the others from Amazon.  I wish other gluten-free products could be this good.

I received my shipment of Crunchmaster Crackers with Sea Salt. I love the flavor and the ingredients are healthy, for the most part. The only objection I have to them is they are too crispy and a little too brown. Otherwise, they are very good and I eat some every day. Crunchmaster Cracker - Sea Salt Flavor Gluten Free, 4.5000-Ounce (Pack of 6)

column9: the texture is fabulous, finally, a gluten free cracker I can enjoy with my cheese!
column10: I ordered these due to good reviews and being gluten-free. While I've pretty much given up bread/bread products, sometimes, I totally crave crackers with cheese. So, got these to try.Very crispy. I loooooove the texture. A perfect KRUNCH.The flavor is reminiscent a bit of Cheetos sans cheese, or Corn and Rice Chex mixed and toasted. Salty, a bit of corn taste, enjoyable. Great with cheese, so hey, I got what I wanted. Would reorder in a heartbeat. :D

I just wanted to note that there is in fact NO MSG in this product. Maltodextrin is not MSG, nor does it have the (alleged) harmful effects of MSG. That being said, this is one of the most delicious fast, easy and cheap food products I've found.

I'm very gluten intolerant and am always looking for quick to fix foods that I can eat.  This is made with rice noodles. I love the flavor of the curry one.  I can't always find this in stores, haven't found them at all since I moved, so I'm glad Amazon carries them.
Good, quick soup.  Nice alternative to Ramen noodles.  Not much curry flavor, but still tasty.  And it's made with Rice noodles, for those of us who can't eat wheat.

column9: My favorite flavor of this brand is Bangkok Curry!
column10: Absolutely delicious, light, gluten-free, low calorie, inexpensive lunch! I am on a perpetual diet, and nothing has made me happier than this soup. I like ramen soup, but the problem with regular Maruchan ramen is that it has msg and wheat (gluten) and also twice the sodium per packet and its preserved with TBHQ. All of which is bad for me. Also ramen is fried, these rice noodles are steam cooked, not fried. And I like the fact that they put two flavor packets, one is the soup mix and the other is the spicy oil, so if your kids don't like hot spicy, they don't have to add the spicy oil packet. Great, right?The price works out best if you get the box of 72 from Amazon. This package of 12 actually works out to be a little more expensive than the supermarket, but still worth it if your supermarket doesn't carry it.

column9: Gluten free, egg free, NOT MSG free
column10: I think a lot of folks see the word Curry and think, " oh noes, that's gonna be spicey!" This is not the case with the Bangkok Curry Instant Rice Noodle Soup. We were enjoying this as a  standard convenience food. It's quick, easy, and gluten free. That being said, it's not the best for you. It has Maltodextrin listed at least twice in the ingredients. This may not seem like a big deal to you, but I try to keep MSG out of my diet. If I had had a clear list of the ingredients prior to ordering this item I would not have purchased it.

This is a product your dog will love.  You can give it to him as a training reward or just for a snack.  It is made of all beef with no fillers.  Best part is that it is made in the U S A.  An excellent product.

Your dog will listen.  These snacks are so good I've given them to my young children.  They now do all sorts of tricks and beg for these snacks....  come on folks, kidding.  But they are perfect for your dog!

This was highly recommended to me by a breeder so i tried it with my dog and he totally loves it!

We are coffee people, and I mean coffee people. I've tried many, many types and always go back to Italian (although German comes very close). This one however, is one of the best I've ever come across in organics.  It's extremely smooth. It's not overly nutty and has a sweet finish on the palate without hitting the back of the tongue with an overwhelming acidity=bitterness. My husband usually likes a more acidic coffee, but really enjoys this one.We also found that it's much easier on the stomach with a lower acid level, but not because of the chemical process. A naturally occurring lower acid level means it's a true dark roast. A good company that is truly organic should never use the chemical processes, and instead know how to actually roast the coffee properly. A slower roast allowing the oils (which contain the acid) to be roasted out of the coffee without over roasting, versus treating them chemically is the key in other words. You get the caffeine, just not the heart burn. And that is ideal for coffee drinkers like us.I think I've found the one. With all that said, it really does depend on your palate. I do believe however, that this has a nice overall compatibility with what most are wanting in a good coffee, especially first thing in the morning. A good deep flavor without knocking you back. Perfect for what we're wanting.It's also grown and roasted right here in the USA!!
This coffee is wonderful.  I love dark, Italian Roast coffee, but it is difficult to find brands that are organic, affordable, and taste nice.  This is my new favorite.
