I PURCHASED THIS FOR MY DAUGHTER WHO CAN'T GET ENOUGH GUACAMOLE. SHE HAS TRIED VARIETY OF MIXES AND LIKES THIS ALOT NEXT TO EMERIL'S.  STAY FRESH PACKAGING. EASY TO OPEN. JUST NEED TO FIND A PLACE THAT CHARGES LESS THAN 1.00 EACH FOR AVACODO'S  (BUDGET MINDED HERE) LOL.

column9: Horrible looking guac dip. Horrible tasting guac dip.
column10: Title says it all folks, this is the worst guacamole mix I have ever run across. Waste of otherwise fantastic ripe avocados. Basically, each dip tastes like a 1000 rancid tacos from Taco Bell.Does not deserve one star. I really wonder what the taste engineers at Casa Fiesta were smoking when they created this mix.

This has a lot of tomato powder in it I think because the paste you make with it is red, add that to your avocados and you get rusty colored dip = old looking guacamole, doesn't look very yummy.I used 3 large fruits as directed and it was very overwhelming, very salty and seasoned.  I would use a fraction of a packet per 3 fruits in the future.  Maybe put a few packets in a jar and add a half tsp to your quac and go from there.

I always remember my grandparents and mother, whom were born in Holland, having this cheese around the holidays and I had not had it in such a long time.  It still tastes as great as ever.  Thank you.

I've been eating organic raw almonds for several years, buying them instead of the non-organic ones because of their better flavor and texture.  I found minimal flavor in these Sunridge Farms raw almonds and the texture chewy rather than crisp. I'll go back to the ones from the local large upscale natural foods store, where they are about 3 dimes more.

We have purchased these almonds before and enjoyed them.  Unfortunately, we just purchased them again from Amazon and were very disappointed.  The nuts were old, limp, and tasteless.  We opened all the bags and sampled many nuts; we couldn't believe the whole six bags were inedible.  They were! We E-mailed the company to inquire as to expiration dates and batch numbers so we could avoid getting a bad old batch next time.  The company ignored us.  Amazon did not.  They refunded our money.  Thank you Amazon.  Apparently, the SunRidge company does not care if they ship old nuts to Amazon warehouses.  Don't waste your hard-earned money on expensive old nuts!

This has been a disappointing item the last few shipments. The quality of the almonds has been deteriorating so much so that I have cancelled the last three subscribe and save shipments. The almonds were full, crunchy and flavorfull but now are shriveled and unappealing. Has the nut crop been drastically affected by some environmental problem? The walnuts, almonds and pistachios seem to have been affected in the last three months. Previously I have been totally satisfied with the Sun Ridge products. Now I have gone back to buying them bulk in my health food store and schlepping them home. But at least I know they are firm and full.

These almonds are great. The individual bags are the perfect size for tossing in a purse on the way to work.The almonds are all delicious, good quality, and give me the energy I need to get through my very long days.I highly recommend purchase of these almonds. They always come in a very timely fashion, well packaged, and taste great.

Ok, so first of all -- the package in the picture says RAW, and received packaging DOES NOT! So obviously is a mislead. The almonds I buy from the grocery store are not organic, cost less than half, and they taste/look far better than these... Sun Ridge almonds are very small, wrinkly and dry... So disappointed, asking for refund, and never buying that brand again! If you think they're great -- you either have never tasted fresh, good quality almonds, or I just received a awful bad batch...

I would recommend this product to those of us who are interested in healthy snacks.  I use them as an added protein snack when I've also eaten a carb snack to balance it out.  The bags are great as I was able to leave some in my desk at work and also at my cottage.  This will be my second time purchasing these from Amazon.

My husband was told by our doctor to eat a 1 ounce serving of raw almonds every day as part of a natural cholesterol reducing nutrition plan. These are very fresh and taste great plus they are packaged in 7 ounce zip lock packages and easy to divide into 7 servings.

I purchased the gluten free Domata Variety flour Pack and really like it alot.  The seasoned flour is good for breading and frying and makes a great golden crust.  I used the all purpose flour several times and everything turned out great.  It seemed nice and light.  I will experiment with the Pizza Flour soon.  I am hoping the Domata website will be up and running again soon so I can get some more recipes.  I will re-order soon.

I have used this flour product for 5 years and it is so easy now to cook my husbands favorite meals again. We are enjoying many of the foods we had to give up over the years and now we can make tasty breading for chicken, fish and pork. I bake breads and other baked goods and the Pizza is great. It is very simple and easy to use. Just cup for cup and what is easier than that. We love it.

This is a Dark Roast. I wish they would put this information in the descriptions. I can't say much about the flavor since it is a dark roast and those all taste the same to me. I am not a fan of dark roasts.
After trying several different beans from a number of sources, we found this coffee strong & smooth and the subscription a good way of assuring us of a steady supplly

column9: A great food for our dogs
column10: I have been feeding Fromm Four Star Beef Frittata for the last month to my bichons and chihuahua.The ingredients are healthful, no byproducts, grains or artificial anything. It's a family run company with its own production mill and has never had a recall, which is reassuring in today's day and age with all the recalls and sick pets!The kibble size is quite small, which is great for my 4 pound Chihuahua.  The other dogs don't seem to mind the kibble size at all.Coats are looking beautiful. I have one super sensitive bichon whose skin has stayed in good shape on this food, thankfully.  She gets yeast infections on her skin (ears, toes, face/muzzle) that can make her quite miserable.  Fromm has kept her in great shape!Back yard clean-up is good.  Initially when I switched the girls to Fromm, they had a little gas but once acclimated have not been gassy at all.Great food!  Transitioning/rotating to the Game Bird recipe now and will report on that too!

column9: The best quality grain-free dog food available!
column10: I have been feeding my Puggle and Pug Fromm grain-free dog food for three months and it has really improved their coats.  Shedding has dramatically decreased to that of a 'normal' dog. (Pugs are notorious shedders.)  Their coats are now so shiny and soft!  I don't get a big cloud of dog hair from petting them anymore.  I haven't had to use the Furminator in . . . 6 weeks, and I may not need it anymore at all.  Their coats are beautifull and glossy and hardly shed now.  Before Fromm, there was always a ton of hair on my dark leather sofa and I just realized that there is hardly a hair on it now!  Wow!My dogs LOVE Fromm and gobble it down.  We only feed our dogs Fromm dry food and use it for training treats -- they love it that much. (Okay, we also give our dogs natural chews like Bully Sticks, Pizzle Sticks, and dried cow esophagus, but they are all natural, too.  No grains, no sugar, no coloring.)I like that it has a natural ingredient in it that reduces feces odor --- and it REALLY works!  If they get an 'outside' treat (all we feed them is Fromm, and use it for treats) I can always tell by the horrible (regular/bad) smell of their feces the next day.  When they don't get any unathorized treats, the smell is greatly reduced.Also, Fromm doesn't have any fillers, it's a 'rich' dog food, in that you probably won't need to feed your dog the same amount that you were feeding them if you were using a dog food filled with corn and other fillers.  The good thing about that is that you get LESS poop.  (And that's always a good thing!)  My dogs generally poop 2-3 times a day and it is well formed and not overly malodorous.Go slow in transitioning your dog over from regular (corny) dry food, because Fromm is a very rich diet.  Check the back of the bag for how much you should feed your dog and also calculate in treats or you will wind up with weight gain.Fromm has never had a dog food recall.  That's awesome!  They are very careful about their ingredients.I truly believe that spending my money wisely on such a high quality, grain-free dog food like Fromm Beef Frittata will provide my dogs with a long healthy life and that they will be less likely to have diseases or cancer.  I can already see a great difference in their coats.I don't feed my family 'Frankenfoods' like corn syrup, sugar, 'flavorings', by-products and grains, and I wouldn't feed my dogs any of that either.  I believe I'm making an investmentin my dog's health by feeding them Fromm brand. Four paws up for Fromm!

If you like the taste of cocoa powder you'll love these.  As much as I love chocolate I could only take one bite of these.  I guess I'll have to give up chocolate if all gluten free chocolate taste like these brownies.  They're also very dry.  My five year old grandson wouldn't take a second bite.

I buy these locally at Whole foods and they are very fresh, chew and chocolatey! I can't believe they re GF. My friends who are not GF love these too. I like them better than gluten brownies I ate before learning I needed to be GF. The choc. chip are soft and taste, too.  The ginger are not very strong in ginger but nice and soft with real ginger pieces in them.You can't eat just one- one box maybe!
I buy these for my sister  and she is thrilled at the treats that she can indulge in now and then. She has never found them anything  but  WOW.
These brownies must have been old as they had a moldy taste to them.  Threw the majority of them in the trash.

They should have provided more description for the product.I just had it yesterday while shopping at a local grocery and seeing Bob Marley's face I had to buy it.  After coming home I started looking more closely and here are 2 things that made me happy about my purchase:1) the shortness of ingredient list - it's really just Jamaican coffee, milk, sugar, natural flavor, and pectin (not sure what the last ones are for, and I'm typing this from memory so I could be off)2) a portion of the profit from the sale of this product is going to non-profitAs for the coffee itself, it's a little bit on the mellow side (that's what Jamaican Blue Mountains are, right?), not too sweet, but other than that, it tasted like real coffee (that's a big one for me).  It's not something I'll drink for pulling all-nighters, but it's something to enjoy on a hot summer afternoon.I can imagine the palm tree and the sea breeze brushing through my face.
Terrible!!! Save your money and get something palatable. This has to be the worst cornbread ever!! One star is being very generous!!!

I am sorry to say these cookies did not taste at all like sugar cookies. They were actually salty, and not nice and chewy. The only good thing is that they arrived in one piece, no crumbs. However it did not deliver on the taste. Iw ill no0t be ordering from Scott's items again.

These are the perfect size and excellent for passing out as a reward.  They're beautiful, unique and memorable.  They've arrived in good shape and I've used them for photo session rewards for little kids and they love them.  These things have saved many photo shoots for me!

Wow who would have thought of this! I bought this for our 10 year old grandson who was visiting and it was a hit! We perfer to use it in waffles. They are nice and crispy and taste like desert! I think they would be good for a desert if you added strawberries and whipped cream and a touch of cinnamon. We have served them to all our company and they are a big hit! Not a lot of chocolate chips just enough to taste the chocolate. Nice for a change of pace. I will order more for sure.

My boys love this mix for breakfast. I love it because all you do is mix with water, so you can mix as little or as much as you need. They cook up light and fluffy. This is an easy hot breakfast before school. Amazon is the only  place I can find this mix now (I used to be able to purchase it local).

column9: It's Krusteaz. Need I say more?
column10: The chocolate chip pancake mix was the first product I ever tried from Krusteaz. I fell in love! The kids love it because it has mini chocolate chips in it. I like using it in my waffle iron too. These are hard to find around here so Im ok with only being able to buy in a bundle of 4, but it would be nice to buy maybe.......1 at a time :)
Excellent tasting product.very hard to find in stores.great price as well.if you like chocolate then you will love this stuff.buy it while it lasts.

column9: The best Rosehip Tea in US
column10: Do not waste your money buying any other brands of the Rosehip Tea available in the US market. I've tried all of them, from Whole Foods, Fresh Market, GNC, Organic/Not organic from any possible grocery stores and had total disappointment. Once you've tried the real rosehip tea, your search for a good one will be endless, as it was for me.  I was wondering how is possible to sell a product under the name of "Rosehip Tea" with no even closest flavor of the rosehip, or even worth, no flavor at all, like having a sewer water boiled and served. Well, maybe these manufacturers hope that the majority don't know the true flavor of a good tea and will buy their misleading product. Don't trash your money! Stop your search and buy this one, the only "Rosehip Tea" that taste as rosehips. Enjoy!

Thanks to Olenka's review... I decided to purchase this tea for a nephew who recently returned to the US from Ukraine.  Upon his return, he tried finding rosehip tea... but it was difficult to find and what he found was not very good.  He loves this tea, however, and says that it is very flavorful.

Thank You EuroGrocer- You deliver Happiness!!!  Onno Behrends is ABSOLUTELY in their own League!!!  After buying my 1st box three years ago on a whim at Big Lots, I was hooked. Returning to find the tea discontinued, I started a daunting year-long replacement task.  I tried several other brands along the way, which became both expensive and disappointing (most are mixed tea blends).  Having found it at Amazon, my husband surprised me with a case of 10 boxes & I was in Tea Heaven!!!  Due to my bragging, friends & family became curious and soon I was handing out little gifts of Rose Hip Magic.  Now even the guys are on board: my nephews make it year round- daily iced tea & during flu season, hot tea added (these guys are athletic & military- not your usual herbal tea guys)!  This is a well-balanced tea, but the key is to steep it for the FULL 10 minutes.  Many people are worried about bitterness, so they drink it too soon.  This tea is not bitter, and only tastes watered-down if not steeped properly.  I add a tsp of honey & a splash of lemon to mine.  For iced tea, we like to mix it with Onno Behrend's Peppermint & sweeten it with Agave, as it mixes so well!  How will you drink yours?
It is hard to find rose hip tea as goo as Otto Behrends.  I know.  I've tried.

column9: No Expiration Date on the Package!
column10: We had been buying Onno Behrends teas for some time thenafter the last purchase we noticed that there was noexpiration date on the package. We contacted Amazonthey sent us new ones, but still no expiration date.We contacted them again, they contacted the importerand said that they won't be able to provide expirationdate for the teas.We consume a lot of tea and buy from all over the world.This was the first time we came across a packaged tea withno expiration date and these teas are produced in Germany.So, buyers be aware these teas might have been producedwho knows when? They may even be antique!

I love Rose Hips tea. It is my favorite herbal tea to drink. I was so excited to get this brand of Rose Hips tea because of all the glowing reviews. I opened up the package and looked at the box of tea and saw that it also contained Hibiscus Flowers!!! I love Traditional Medicinals Rose Hip tea because it is just Rose Hips and nothing else. I made a cup of this new tea and was not impressed. I steeped it for 10 minutes, then added lemon and Agave just like I do with my other teas. There was hardly any taste! With my other Rose Hips tea, the flavor is strong. I think it is the Hibiscus flowers that change the flavor. I am upset that I paid this much for tea that I doubt I will use. In the future I will stick with the brands that I know and love.
I was wondering why i like the tea so much and then i saw that it is coming from Germany ! I am europian I guess I still like the best old Europe stuff :)

This Rosehip Tea comes from Germany where it is a daily stable. The flavor is out of this world and being high in vitamin C it has a slight sourly taste but can be very well tolerated without added sugar. The four packages contain 50 each tea bags - this will last you a long time.

I'm thoroughly pleased with this tea. I purchased it based on the recommendation of another reviewer. It brought me back to times I would sit and sip a similar tea with my grandmother. It is a healthy brew and very flavorful. High recommended.

column9: Not too bad! I'm honestly surprised!
column10: These are fairly decent little cookies! A good crunch, a good flavor, not too much 'sugar-free' or 'protein' aftertaste. I dip them in peanut butter or crumble them up to use in baking or on yogurt. A solid low-carb snack.

When I open a box, I end up eating the entire contents in one sitting. Lots of cinnamon and not too sweet. None is "filled with a rich, almond butter" though. Maybe each was before the baking process, but the end result has a dab of almond butter in a mostly hollow middle.  Still, I keep these on hand for when I crave a cookie-like snack.
I really wasn't expecting much from a low sugar cookie, but I am pleasantly surprised. I plan to order these again and again.
Great quality at a great price! Me, the birds and the squirrels love them. Fresh and they arrived really fast.

This brand of ground coffee definitely lives up to its name! I used to think that Eight O'clock was the right time to wake up...but not anymore. When you pop the lid, you're immediately overcome with the rich aroma of dark roast. Seriously, you're tempted to eat it straight from the tin! Moreover, if you've grown weary of grinding beans just to get the magic brew, relax...just pop-a-top my friend and prepare to enjoy! I highly recommend the Melitta drip coffee method for the preparation, since this coffee will only be as good and pure as the water you start out with.

I am a colombian, born in Bogota. I used to go to a Colombian grocer in Silver Spring MD just to get my hands on 10% imported Colombian (cafe sello rojo). I tried this coffee today..and wow! I can't tell the difference. For once someone who claims it is 100% Colombian not only spelled Colombia right (they spell it with a U sometimes and it drives me crazy) but it really IS 100% Colombian. This is nice and strong, with a bit of bitterness that lets you know this was ground from some mean beans.

I ordered this coffee after reading reviews on Amazon, usually those reviews are really helpful, but not in this case. The coffee does not have a nice taste, it is not better than any grocery store brand. It's flavor is strong, but not in a good way, rather like badly roasted coffee. I know some people like fruity (acidic) flavor and some like nutty flavor (like me) in their coffee, but Melitta coffee has neither, it is more like coffee flavored mud. On top of all, I wasn't able to return the coffee because it turns out Amazon does not allow returns on some grocery items.If you doubt my review because of all other glorifying reviews, well, when I ordered this coffee there was not even a single negative review. That's the way I was fooled. However, if you don't care much about the quality of coffee but just need caffeine this coffee may be right choice for you. If you care about the taste of your coffee at all, avoid Melitta even for this price. Trust me it doesn't worth.

I am very happy with this brand which is new to me.  I previously subscribed to Gevalia, but found that this is very flavorful and since it is a fine grind a little goes a long way. I have since switched my subscription from Gevalia to Amazon.

hey, i enjoy exotic, batch roasted, regionals and estate grown too, BUT...when you want to default to convenience and quality, this can't be beat.  flavorful, good medium roast, and super priced for decent coffee.  gratuitous suggestions:  for great, whole bean columbia supremo, costco rules, either their own brand or jose's, whatever they're stocking that week.  and for wonderful, personal attention to estate and exotics, st. ives in georgia, ed thelenius master roaster, or "our coffee barn" in wisconsin (good web sites, too). enjoy.
I had been trying different coffees and was happy to find this product. I ordered the medium roast and found it full flavored and takes less coffee to brew so that makes the price even better.

I bought a pack of 4 and that should say something. I have tried so many different brands of coffee, both foreign and domestic. I don't know how many times I've bought coffee and either gave it away to someone at work or just threw it out. But this coffee was amazing to me from the first cup! It has never disappointed me from one can to the next. It's balanced, aromatic, and flavorful without being over roasted ala Starbucks--which started that trend. Well that's fine if you into quadruple late..Frappuccino, Caramel Macchiato...whatever. I just want a smooth, flavorful cup of coffee thank you. And that is what Melitta 100% Colombian Medium Roast delivers can after can!

column9: Good to the last drop...but not Maxwell House
column10: The Melitta Columbian coffee is all that I will drink.  I bought it for the first time at BigLot and with the first cup realized that I was going to continue to buy it in the future. Every pot I have made is excellent.

I have come to prefer Melita 100% Columbian Medium Roast Ground Coffee for home use and am especially pleased to have it delivered to my door by Amazon at a huge savings (over $2.00 per can) vs. the grocery store. By purchasing eight cans, it was eligible for free delivery.  Thanks Amazon!

My old cat has always loved this name brand of cat treats.  I recently adopted a new cat and he loves them just as much as my older cat.  If they hear the treats move inside the case at all, they will come running, even if you're just putting the treats up.  They beg for them and will become your new best friend if you have them in your hand.  My older (who isn't really a people person) will even befriend you long enough to get a few treats out of you.  She even finds them sitting on the counter or bedside table and will knock them in the floor and try to open the lid. (thank goodness its cat proof)  I love these treats because they make my babies happy!

column9: Not the best cat treat in my opinion, but they are cat approved at first
column10: The only good comment I can give on these treats is that my cat liked them when they were fresh, and they are really inexpensive! I can usually find these treats for under two dollars at the grocery or pet store, and even on occasion at the dollar store. As this treat proves, often with a low price, comes a cheap product.  It would be nice if these pounce treats had healthier ingredients, maybe some vitamins or a dental cleanser, but no, its just junk food and a long list of filler ingredients. They smell really gross to me but my cat seemed to enjoy them. My biggest reason for not liking this treat, aside from the terrible ingredients and smell, is the fact that it is soft and chewy and not crunchy texture. Soft treats reek havoc on pet teeth as the sticky particles just sit on their teeth and gums and just rot there. Crunchy treats at least crunch off and don't stick to their teeth- hopefully crunching off some tarter with it. For a really good dental product, I recommend Crunch N' Clean brand with DentaShield. Greenies brand doesn't have as many beneficial dental ingredients, but they are pretty good as well as they contain vitamins and a little bit of breath freshening ingredients in them, so they are much better than these. Any crunchy treat would be better than these. Even other Pounce varieties are MUCH better than these, such as the Tarter & Plaque control varieties. The Pounce Tarter & Plaque control are a bit more pricey, but still relatively inexpensive and they contain vitamins and are crunchy. Another strange thing about these treats is that the recommended daily allotment is 6-8 treats per day, which is just crazy to me. I only give my cats no more than 1-2 a day of these while I had them. I eventually threw them out as they got hard as rocks and my cats didn't like them anymore anyhow.Pros: cat approved taste while fresh; and very fair priceCons: bad smell, lack of nutrition, terrible texture for teeth
I always bought these at Food Lion and they stopped selling them.  My cat loves these treat and I get them in Tuna, Caribbean Catch and Seafood.

My cat loves these treats. If ever I can't find her in the house, I just pop the top and she bolts out of wherever she was hiding to come get a treat. She doesn't like crunchy treats much, so these are perfect for her. I've given her all three flavors and she seems to like them all equally. They do tend to dry out by the time I near the end of the bottle, however. The flip-top lid is very handy. Very nice, inexpensive kitty treats.
My cat loves these treats. I wish there was a hairball treat with salmon flav. cause my cat is alergic to chicken food/flav.

I'm not really sure what to think of these treats. Cats seems to only want to eat them sometimes. I have given them to three different cats, and each cat has loved them at first and then grown tired of them. I have a feeling that my cats prefer crunchy treats to these moist ones.These treats also have a sour, cheesy smell to them, unlike crunchy treats, which generally just smell like kibbles.

I bought this at Marty's in Newton, MA... and was looking to buy more now that I live in NC. This is the BEST lemon juice I have ever had. Literally when I first opened it to use I was amazed at how bright and heavenly it smelled. This is NOT your normal lemon juice. I found myself constantly flipping the cap to take another whiff whenever I went to the fridge. My lemon poppy seed cake isn't half as good with the organic lemon juice I bought at Whole Foods last week - in fact hardly anyone would touch it - whereas with Nellie & Joe's Famous Key Lemon Juice it literally disappears. I didn't realize everyone liked it as much as I did till they weren't in the mood for this last cake. Normally its breakfast and afternoon snack for everyone, sometimes even a nibble before bed. This one sat until I finally cut it up and put it in the compost after it started growing mold.

While one might think good ketchup is an oxymoron, this ketchup is indeed good stuff.  Nice consistency and not too much of any spice that takes it somewhere you don't want.  We use it as a base for our home made BBQ sauce.  It is perfect for our recipe.

I am sorry to say these cookies did not taste at all like sugar cookies. They were actually salty, and not nice and chewy. The only good thing is that they arrived in one piece, no crumbs. However it did not deliver on the taste. Iw ill no0t be ordering from Scott's items again.

I never thought I would ever eat black beans, the thought of even the name was ykkk. I tried Eden's Organic Carribean black beans & now I'm a convert. Forget everyday plain black beans, Eden's is above them all & they are organic. I use them as an add in for wraps, and just as a side dish, instead of Kidney beans in Chilli, I use Eden's Black beans. And I use Amazon for most of my online orders, love them!
TACO SHELLS CAME UNBROKEN AND ARE VERY GOOD. THEY SEEM THICKER THEN THE LARGE SHELLS.

I have been waiting almost a month for this item to ship I will not be ordering from this supplier again. You cannot cancel the order and since it is formula I was ordering for my granddaughter and she can't wait a month to get this I will order elsewhere. Good stuff, just pricey. It fluctuates week to week. I've seen it as high as $25.99 and as low as $19.99. when it's cheap, buy alot if you can. They last along time in storage
Not sure what happened to the other reviewer's product but mine arrived in two days.  Same formula I can buy at the store, %25 percent off and no need to clip coupons!

While searching for a gift to encourage a friend who was trying to give up using tobacco chew, I came across this cooler full of Buffalo Bills Beef Jerky Chew (shredded beef jerky). My friend was thrilled with his clever gift. When he was craving "a pinch", he could indulge in one of the three great flavors of jerky chew. He also loved the sturdy little cooler, perfect for keeping his cool beverages and favorite jerky chews handy. No more of that nasty other chew; his new habit is Buffalo Bills Beef Jerky Chew!

I've had people bringing me Red Rose Tea from California for about 10 years now and my friends coming and going there has dried up so I search on the internet and found my Decaf Red Rose Tea.  I ordered 12 boxes so I don't run out again.  All other tea taste bitter to me but Red Rose does not.  I am an avid fan and will continue to use this product as long as I can reasonalby order it.Jackie

column9: amazon- please make this tea amazon prime!
column10: i now buy lots of food from amazon and i love the automatic delivery program. however, this is my favorite tea on earth and the only one whose decaf version doesn't taste bleh, so i continue to schlep to the store to buy boxes of the tea. so, amazon, how about making this tea amazon prime and eligible for automatic delivery? please?

I have been drinking Red Rose for almost 50 years--grandma started me on it--my kids inherited the tradition. Really, there is no other black tea. And I discovered their decaf at a Wegman's. Hard to find elsewhere. Wish it were amazon prime...really great flavor for decaf ice tea and hot.

This product is listed at over $24.  It sells retail for $6 at Target, Wal Mart, Babies R Us.  I ordered it because I thought there were 4, which would make sense but ONLY ONE arrived.  In other words, it is listed at a 400% overcharge. Buyer Beware!
I can't believe Amazon allows this product to be advertised at such a sky-high price. We buy a case of 48 for $41.99 on diapers.com and I was wondering if WE were overpaying. I guess not.

column9: Great tasting coffee, awesome, unique k-cups
column10: I only order SF Bay Coffee (for my K-CUP machine at work), as the coffee is wonderfully fresh tasting and boasts a great filter base instead of the lame plastic cups used by all the other K-CUP companies. My favorites are the Fog Lifter and Rainforest Blend (organic). And what a tremendous, affordable price!

This was a very good cup of coffee! Bold taste and yet decaf. I love the fact that the KCup is 'replaced' by ''gauze' and is more recyclable. It was a surprise to find the cup that way and it worked just fine. Delicious!

Love this coffee!!  It is a great blend that I drink morning, noon or night.  Also have ordered the "Fogchaser" from San Francisco Bay Coffee and that is super too when I need a little get up and go drink!

column9: Great coffee at an inexpensive price
column10: This is a bargain compared to other K-cups.  This cup is a little different but still works and uses less plastic which is better for our environment.  The K-cups come in 3 plastic, sealed packs with 12 in each pack so they will stay fresh.  The coffee is very good tasting.  Put this on a subscribe 'n ship subscription and can change the shipping whenever I want.  Love that it is decaffeinated.

These k-cups are a little different that the Keurig ones that we are used to, but work fine in the brewer and the taste is decent.  They have a slightly bitter taste and I did not care for that as well as some of the other k-cups I have tried.

column9: Better alternative to Coffee People's Decaf Kcup!!!
column10: with coffee prices rising, I had to look around for better alternatives. So far this is the best.  Full bodied cup and not watered down taste.  I like the pods/modified K cup since it is a space saver but you just have to store them in an air tight container.  For the price, it cannot be beat.

column9: San Francisco Bay Decaf Coffee K Cups
column10: Loved the San Francisco Bay Decaf Coffee K Cups. I wish they had more flavors for DECAP K-CUPS. Hopefully Amazon is responsive to this.

This coffee has a good, strong flavor. It doesn't suffer from the weak, watery taste that so many k-cups have, especially the decafs. It might be a little too bitter for some tastes.And it's not the typical plastic k-cup. This is a much better design - there are no more surprise "exploding" k-cups. You can see the filter so you'll know before you brew if the filter is torn, plus you don't get the grinds squirting out the top when the plastic didn't get punctured properly (because there is no plastic cup).  A couple of reviewers have complained that no plastic cup means that the coffee will get stale, but this is no more of a concern than it would be for regular coffee (the kind not in a k-cup, where you open the 1 lb bag or can). You can always put them in a resealable container to keep them fresh - a ziplock bag, or even an old coffee can.

I like that San Francisco Bay Roasters has cut down on the plastic in their design. The coffee is certainly fine for everyday, though Starbucks is still my preferred French Roast--but it's not available in decaf (yet).
this coffee is way too strong for our taste.  we have tried to go back to Timothy's but is no longer available on super saver.

I was surprise that these had no "bottom". I noticed that they now changed the picture to show this.I switched from the Senseo to K-cups because I didn't like the coffee drip when the Senseo filter were removed and that they need to be stored in a bag to keep them fresh. I assumed that these would have the same problems. I was please that there is no drips with these when removed but I do have to store them in jars to keep them fresh.The taste is incredible! It's the best coffee I've ever had from a single cup brewer. The quality of the coffee and the cheaper price more than makes up for the slight hassle of storing them in jars. The regular coffee is great and the decaf is the best decaf I've ever drank.

This is a great cup of coffee at a fraction of the price of the more expensive k-cups. Don't get me wrong, i love Green Mountain, but when you#re on a budget and still wanting a fast cup of coffee (and pregnant so in need of decaf!) This is the one. They work great in my Keurig machine, and i reckon they must be more eco-friendly without the plastic cup!
This was a new brand for our Keurig, so I did not know what to expect. I was surprised with no "k-cup" - but this works very well and seems "greener." Tastes great.
This is the most robust, flavorful coffee I have ever tasted, and its decaf! Flavor is not something you have to sacrifice if you must cut down on caffein. I just love the taste.

I was seeking a more robust full flavored decafe coffee but without the bitterness and acidity that is often associated with a stronger coffee.  This coffee filled the bill and then some.  Will definitely purchase again!

I was not bothered by the packaging, I put them in a container and that works out great.I also reuse them with the k caps which you can get on Amazon. Work much better than theoriginal k cup. As far as less coffee, take your k-cup totally apart and you will find thefilter only goes down part way. My only complaint is, they don't carry any decafother than French Roast and some flavors would be nice.
cups look different, but taste as the normal Keurig cups without the extra plastic to recycle. I was alarmed after I opened the box but cups fit and work well with Keurig Brewer.

column9: Price is right- but for a reason!
column10: This coffee is bitter and fairly strong. It's about the most sour or bitter I've ever tasted. I have had to keep drinking it- just to trust my first opinion. I was surprised about this when I first got the stuff. I will go back to Timothy's decaf Columbian. But, I'm still on the make for a different decaf...Too bad...I still like the minimalist packaging.

This was our first time using this new style K Cup...it has the traditional top, but the bottom is a mesh style material, not the plastic base of the first generation cups. It tends to leave a bit more residual in the bottom of the cup, but the price difference was substantial enough that I ordered these on subscrition. The taste/flavor is fine, the residual I mentioned is the only real difference. I would not hesitate to buy them again, nor refer them to friends/fellow Keurig users, with the caveat on the slight residual.

This is a nice strong French Roast.  For me, it's excellent with a bit of creamer, cinnamon and a tad of sugar!  Had not been familiar with San Francisco Bay coffee--decided to try it and was very pleased

I would recomend this coffee for anyone wanting decafe for their Keruig brewer, great taste.Great price and it ships fast. arrived in excellent condition too.  gp/product/B006IOKA9S/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

column9: Please bring back!  Great stuff and less plastic!
column10: This is great stuff and works great in my Keurig.  I like that it has less plastic!  Please bring it back immediately!!!

This was my first purchase of any K-cup product.  I was very pleased with the quality of the coffee and ease of use.  Each coffee "K-cup" (actually a little pod) was easy to handle.  I keep them in a zipped plastic bag for freshness.  I ordered the FogChaser flavor yesterday and expect it to be just as good as the decaf French Roast.

column9: Pros and cons for unsealed package
column10: The coffee is enclosed in a breathable pouch, so you have to either use it quickly, store them in a sealed bag, or be willing to drink coffee made from stale grounds.  I appreciate creating less trash from the packaging, though.

column9: Great Idea, Not so great coffee.
column10: The idea of using less plastic in a k-cup is a great idea.  But... the flavor of the coffee is not very good.  The filter design fits in the k-cup processers well but alot of grind residue is released into the coffee.  You end up with a less than desirable cup of joe.  The idea might work...it just requires a little more improvement and product testing.
My wife and I both enjoy this product.  It has plenty of flavor and at a "decent" price.  The flavor is nice and bold and we may just start using it as our morning coffee even though it's decaf.

My wife and I ordered both the Decaf and regular SF Bay pods and truly liked them as a less expensive and environmentally alternative to traditional K-cups. BUT- when we ordered them just two weeks ago they cost $15.99 for 3 packs (and less if you put in a regular order). Today we got an e-mall from Amazon showing regular order price of $20.99 or $5 per 3pack than 2 weeks ago! What a rip off.

column9: Shape like a k cup but not a k cup...
column10: Coffee aroma is gone by the time you brew the second cup from the plastic bag they came in with. Coffee has a bitter after taste, like any coffee brewed non-Keurig way. The lower price is not enough to continue by subscription.

I'm not a decaf coffee person, but pregnancy requires that I cut back and this brew is tasty! It's not at all watered down, but has a bold taste and aroma. I like the "pod" style as opposed to the usual plastic k-cup and they work great in my Keurig. The box came in 3 vacuum sealed packages, so I just open one at a time and store in an airtight container...I haven't found that this affects the freshness at all. Once this baby arrives, I'll likely order some other roasts.

We love this coffee. It's decaf, bold, the k-cup has a lot less packaging (plastic), from a company with a strong "commitment to sustainable agriculture and trade." I wasn't sure how well this would work in the Keurig K-Cup--it is essentially a filter designed to fit into the Keurig machine--but we have no problems with it and we get full-flavored cup of decaf coffee. We love this coffee and have even subscribed to a monthly delivery.

These work fine in K-cup machines, but have less packaging waste than regular K-cups, and cost much less, possibly because of both reduced manufacturing costs and not paying K-cup license fees. A definite win for Keurig users.The San Francisco Decaf makes an tasty medium size cup, one of the best decafs I've had, though like most french roast, it's taste is almost (but not quite) burnt.
We are close to Roger,s Coffee Company and know how extensive their endeavors are to create an excellent product.  We will stay with them!!

We tried the San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf OneCup for Keurig in our office because of the price and it was a hit.  The decaf was nice and rich without any metallic or bitter taste.They don't look like regular k-cups but they work great.  Instead of the plastic "cup" it just looks like a coffee filter on the bottom.  That said, it is less plastic and more environmentally friendly.  So, it's a great cup of coffee for less than other k-cups and greener- who can beat that.

column9: Great improvement on K-Cups, coffee too harsh, though
column10: The top of these S. F. Bay coffee cups appear to be K-Cups, cause the foil top looks exactly like every other brand of K-cup for Keurig makers.  The rest of it is extremely unique, different than any other type of K-cup,  There's no plastic below the top ring (where the foil attaches), just filter.  I was really concerned that the puncture tip on the Keurig would penetrate the filter, and there's be coffee grounds everywhere.  Not the case, the SF Bay cup is 1 cm shorter than other K-cups - the filter doesn't reach the puncture tip.  The only issue I had with the coffee is the taste.  It's very strong, and too dark for a French Roast, even set with 10 oz of water.  I've never had "Non-Keurig" S F Bay French Roast, so I can't comment on whether it's similar or not.  IMO it's just stronger than any other type of decaf coffee I've tried in the U.S, also has a burned smell to it.  I really like the cup packaging, a great saver for our environment.

This product is shipped with units that are not airtight.  Basically, it comes in a baggie.  Once you open it, all the remaining items are in the open air.  You can reseal it, but for me, the beauty of the K-cup principle is the sealed in airtight single serve package.Will update this review as the "age" more

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee "Decaf" One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast
column10: I've had the Keurig Brewer for a couple of years and the concept is perfect for my coffee drinking needs, however most available decaf coffees for this brewer are very mild and watered down tasting.  I was pleasantly surprised with the taste of the San Francisco decaf, it was bold and rich tasting, definitly my favorite prepackaged decaf for the Keurig brewer.  Amazon's Subscribe & Save subscription makes the price of the coffee more reasonable than most other sources.

San Francisco Coffee Company, a local brew I've always loved in K-Cup form with a recyclable container. I have felt guilty about the fact that the containers were environmentally unfriendly...not any more. The coffee is wonderful too!

These work just fine in my Keurig and are much more reasonable than typical K-cups.  Because it is a French roast, the aroma is strong, and the coffee is quite flavorful--much more like "real" coffee than decaf.  I'm very pleased.

column9: Less waste and great coffee too!
column10: I'm very impressed with the packaging of these "K-Cups"!  They take up less room when storing (we keep ours in sealed glass jars) and much less room in the garbage can.  Because I compost, and coffee grounds are an excellent addition to the bin, I've been opening up the old style cups and scraping out the grounds.  With these, the lid peels easily off (once slit with scissors) and the grounds just pop out - easy!The taste of the coffee is also excellent.  I prefer deep, dark roasts and the French Roast is perfect.  Can't wait to try other blends and to see other manufacturers tackle this greener packaging style.

These are my favorite new "find"! No plastic, less space, less waste, they work in my type of carousel, and they taste above average and cost less. I was skeptical but now I am a subscriber, fantastic deal! The only negative at all is the company should describe what the consumer is to receive in more detail, these are not k-cups.

As the picture depicts these are not your traditional K-cups however like others have stated it is not a problem. They pop right in your machine. To be honest, they might even be better than K-cups because the whole bottom is a filter... I'm not sure, but the coffee is really delicious! I bought these because of the subscribe and save and because they were decaf... so glad I did. Very tasty!!They did come in three separate bags and the filter is exposed. I still have them in the bag they came in and just cut a small whole to grab them out with.  Doesn't bother me. I might store them in a ziplock baggie, but I've only had them for two days and have had two cups therefore don't taste a freshness difference. The bags also have a little coffee filter thingy, like other coffee bean bags have for freshness but without a way to reseal the bag I don't see a point. No big deal for me though. These are a good deal and a great tasting cup of joe! Highly recommend!

This is a great inexpensive option to the actual K cups. These kind of look like coffee pods. The only problem with them is keeping them fresh. They are packed 8-12 in cellophane. Once you open the package, I just keep them in plastic bags. They are very tasty! I would recommend since the pricing makes up for the inconvenience.

Overall, the product is fantastic and the coffee is great! I am giving a review of 4 stars only because Amazon's advertising is misleading, it does not come in the advertised box, as someone else indicated, it's an unmarked box with 3 smaller bags on the inside.It is not a "plastic K kup", the product that you receive is what is pictured, with a filter type bottom. It does fit in your Keurig and brews just fine.I love the aroma and the taste of this coffee, reminded my husband and I of espresso we had in Siily, Italy a few years ago.

column9: I love the fact that they do not use plastic!
column10: I love this coffee!  I love that they do not use plastic....good for the enivronment and, due to no BPA, good for my health!  The use of plastic cups was one of the reasons I did not like the Keurig.  Good job San Francisco Bay Coffee!

I read reviews on this product and was a little concerned that they were not K-Cups, but made for K-Cup machines.  No concern was ever needed. It looks like a little round coffee filter full of coffee and a lid!  Think about it.  It works in my Keurig just fine!  And it makes a "Big" cup of "Bold" coffee.  These pods can easily compete with K-Cups.San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast, 36-Count

Was afraid at first since, yes, they are not the traditional kcup - but less waste, more flavor.  I love a REAL coffee and this one has great aroma and flavor.  Will definitely purchase again (and again)

column9: Not a K-cup but works in a Keurig
column10: As the other reviewers have said, this is not a K-cup! I uploaded an image of one of these pods next to a K-cup for comparison. The difference is the filter is exposed in these pods as opposed to being fully sealed in a K-cup. Since the coffee is exposed to the air when you open the package, you will have to seal them with a clip or put them in an airtight bag or tupperware to prevent the rest of the pods from loosing freshness. Having said that, in my experience they are a great inexpensive alternative to use in your Keurig brewer. The 36 count boxes arrived as unmarked brown cardboard boxes, not the colorful retail packaging shown on amazon. Inside each cardboard box, there are three clear heavy duty plastic bags, each of which holds 12 of the pods. The bags are not resealable!

While the coffee itself tastes good, the cup type is lacking. It does not work well in a Keurig machine, you have to hold the arm down until the brewing is finished. The open weave paper used makes it neccesary to store the pods in an airtight container. This is not a product I would purchase again.

I am a coffee drinker...and I like a coffee with bold flavor.  This is the best coffee I have ever drank!  If Amazon stops selling it...I will seek it out somewhere else.  They have a life long customer!!!
The coffee is good, not fantastic. So why 5 stars?Brewing coffee in plastic makes me uncomfortable. The SF cups solve that.The company is ethically responsible and local for me.

This coffee does not come in the usual plastic kcup; rather the cup is more like a coffee filter.  It worked beautifully in my Keurig.  I am pleasantly surprised by the flavor considering that the price was the most reasonable of any kcup I have ever seen.  It's a little strong, but not as strong as some of the other brands I've tried.
Tried this coffee because of the price. Husband only drinks decaf. Turned out, he loved the coffee. I didn't tell him how much I saved with this brand :-)  Definetly a great price.

column9: Good coffee, even if it is decaf.
column10: Great tasting coffee and an interesting new K-Cup although you have to keep them in an airtight container until you use them.

column9: San Francisco Bay, Decaf French Roast for Keurig K-cup brewers
column10: This coffee compares very favorably with other French Roast decaf choices.  Since the K-cup itself is not sealed,the packaging could be improved by making the plastic bag resealable. Although, I could not discern any degredationin the flavor of this mornings 2 week old brew.

column9: I love the individualized cup and flavor!
column10: I use to use a one cup french press, but now that we have this fancy machine in the staff room I don't need to bother! I love how I can get one cup of coffee and it's pretty strong. The cups have a filter built in packaging which I think looks great and it's such an easy clean up. Thank you for all the delicious aromatic coffee and thank you for supporting your local school! Jefferson loves San Francisco Bay Coffee!!

column9: San Francisco Decaf OneCp for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
column10: I ordered this coffee and since it was tagged as for K-Cup brewers, I assumed it would be designed like a regular K-Cup packet, but it is not. It will fit in and work in a Keurig, but because of its design, it lets a small amount of sediment through while brewing, which is not pleasing when you get to the last few sips of coffee. Also, this coffee has a bitter taste, so I definitely will not buy this product again.

column9: I thought the reviewers were exaggerating!
column10: I thought people were so excited to find an alternative to the monopoly that they were going overboard,  but when I opened the seal and got a whiff of the dark,  rich coffee smell I was sold!To add to the current comments:  this product arrives sealed in a large bag.  Once you open it, the seal is broken so it needs to be stored however you store loose coffee.  Also,  this is an extremely dark coffee and pretty strong - much darker and more flavorful than any other k-cup I have tried.  If you prefer a milder coffee, maybe try another of their roasts.I am not an expert in coffee tasting.  I will just say that this is a very rich French Roast,  with the slightly bitter aftertaste that is typical of that style.  I am not sure whether the reviewers who hated it were just not lovers of a dark roast,  or got a bad batch (maybe a broken seal?).This is everything I love about my Keurig (an amazing cup of coffee any time I want one) and none of the things I hate about it (price gouging monopoly,  excessive waste).

column9: Great to come home to after a long day
column10: Up until now my favorite french k-cup was Deidrichs and my favorite decaf was Newman's own. Well move over and make room for San Francisco french decaf. Like fog lifter, the k-cup is unusual. Instead of the bottom holding the coffee being plastic it's a coffee filter, meaning once you open the sealed inner package of k-cups you do need to store them in a baggie or tupperware or something to keep them fresh. I have a b60 and the cup fit perfectly and brew beautifully.Once I get past the weird little cup I appreciate the aroma as I open the baggie. The french decaf is a really nice medium to light bold cup of coffee. The taste is rich and mellow. This is the perfect decaf to curl on the couch after dinner and enjoy a cup of coffee.

column4: W. Gilmore "a day in the life"
column9: NOT Dark, Rich, or very tastey
column10: Well, THIS was a one shot deal! I won't order these again because there are a couple of issues with freshness and flavor that will never allow this coffee to taste as rich and full bodied as say Tully's decaf French Roast.First.. they are not true K cups but instead a little filtered nugged with a foil top. The coffee comes through so much more quickly than in the K cup with a small pierced bottom so I feel there is no time for the water to sit and brew to develop any flavor.Second.. of course it smells great when you cut open the cellophane packaging inside the box but I'm sure that the cost of that burst of aroma will be lost flavor unless repackaged into a locking container or baggie.There is no cost break to make any of these concessions worthwhile, in my eyes. And that taste of the first cup did not wow me at all.. mediocre at best. As often is the case, the aroma was better than the flavor, which was watery and not syrupy or complex or rich at all. All in all, just a disappointment and one time mistake :(Certainly was NOT worthy of the anticipation of being on a waiting list.  Nice name, not so good tasting in the cup though.  Don't be tempted it's not worth it. Better to stay with any of the other, better, bold decafs offered here.

Finally a real cup of coffee for my Keurig machine.  I have not been able to find any "fresh coffee" in the regular plastic k-cups.  When I opened my bag of SFBay Decaf French Roast OneCups and it was like opening a fresh roasted bag of coffee, the real deal, with less packaing.  I have been keeping the remaining cups rolled down in the clear bag, seems to stay fresh for weeks.  Thanks SFBay for this great new product!
Enjoy the coffee as a decaf.  Don't like the tough to open packageing.  The cups don't come out of the coffee maker easily.

These coffee pods are very weird tasting almost as they were stored with something other than coffee. I wish that i could of purchased a smaller amount of these pods as i am NOT able to send them back. Now i am stuck with coffee pods that i will have to throw away. Maybee i got a bad batch i dont know but i cant afford to buy more to find out.To bad i so wanted to try them

This is OK Coffee.  Definitely not the worst coffee I have had, but not the best either.  I drink coffee black no sugar so I am picky about my coffee.  I don't go for the celestial male deer brand of coffee which so many coffee brands seem to want to replicate.  If you are looking for a slightly milder/less bitter/better tasting version of that, this might work for you.My wife liked the idea of these style of coffee pods as they appear to use less plastic than a traditional K cup pod.  However, after weighing both this style and a traditional k cup pod (without coffee in it) there is nearly the same weight of plastic.  Not really scientific, but don't let your green side buy these just because you worry about the amount of plastic in a k cup pod.One concert of mine is the coffee going stale in these kinds of packets as they are not sealed to the air.  I only drink decaf on the weekends so it takes me a while to go through a package.  So far they don't taste any different fresh from the sealed package as they do several weeks later.

I am recently pregnant and have just switched to decaf coffee.  These appealed to me because of the earth-friendly design and mostly positive reviews.  They brewed fine in my Keurig.  Might not be a "standard" k-cup, but they work just as well, with less trash.  Great.  But the taste.  oh my god.  The taste is horrendous.  It's bitter, gritty, strong, but not strong in a good way.  The smell is just as bad.  I drink my coffee black, so it's not like I could even mask the taste with cream and sugar.  I know Amazon doesn't accept returns on grocery items, for health reasons, but I requested a refund anyway and it was granted.  These went straight in the trash, where they belong.  I did try the Donut House Collection Donut House Decaf, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count and it is delicious!  That will be my go-to decaf for the next few months.

column9: Really good for a decaf ,will definitely buy again
column10: I love my caffein but have really had to cut back ,so I waspleasantly amazed at how good this decaf was ,I forgot I was drinking decaf .Thanks for providing this great product on Amazon .I purchase all k cups here.

I ordered this not realizing it was decaf. The coffee is not exactly robust.  I like the Barista and Starbucks French Roast,Italian Roast, etc.  This coffee was kind of blah.  I know it is decaf but still not much flavor.  I also did not realizethat you could not return this item.  So be careful when ordering because if you are not happy you will just have to throwit out.

I posted this review for San Francisco Bay Coffee Fog Chaser K-Cups, but it bears repeating here:I was enticed by the cool design - less trash is good. The price obviously was also very enticing.When the coffee arrived, I carefully transferred the pods to a plastic ziploc bag.So far, so good. I then proceeded to brew my first cup - all excited to have found something wonderful.Well, the excitement ceased when the cup produced was pure black liquid with a flavor that was not pleasing to my palate - at all. Maybe if you like bitterness in a coffee without the pleasantness of a well-rounded rich coffee, then this is for you.I found it not an experience to be repeated. I tried to like this coffee, but will go back to another brand. Sorry San Francisco Bay Coffee company - I really tried.The same holds true for decaf French Roast - except it was even less likable...

column9: if i could have give no stars, i would have
column10: really wanted to like this (for the environment), but this coffee is undrinkable. i thought i liked it at first sip. then i noticed the smell and the aftertaste. as some of the other reviewers mentioned, it really does smell and taste like gas or oil. i threw it all away, and, i am not THAT picky. don't waste your money. for real.

My husband and I both like a good strong tasting coffee, but need decaf, so we tried this for our new Keurig brewer. Unfortunately I found that while it was strong, the coffee flavor was overwhelmed by bitterness. We subsequently tried the extra-bold Green Mountain Coffee Decaf Dark Magic, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2) which is more to my liking, with strong flavor, but a flavor of coffee rather than just bitterness.

These are not K-Cups in the traditional sense, a filter vice the plastic cup bottom.  A big surprise when I opened the box that didn't make me happy.But they do take ya home to a night out camping under the stars and a morning sunrise to a cup of coffee over the fire.  A bit gritty, strong, and full of flavor.

Since my husband and I are big coffee drinkers we look for bargains, when this was offered at a good price we made a purchase, this was the worst coffee either of us have had..horrible smell and even worst taste..we tossed it in the trash, now that is bad coffee!!

I was trying to find an alternative to donut house decalf, but this is not it. My wife described it tasting like old rotten wood. After taking a sip I had to agree. Will never by again. It could be because of the cheap packaging that does not have a total seal. Reputable coffeemakers package their product in nitrogen to preserve the freshness and you cannot do this without a sealed cup. Advise everyone this product is no good!!!!

This has to be the worst coffee I have ever had the chance to drink.  My daughter summed it up in a simple statement , "It was like licking an ashtray."  I agree.  Bad coffee.  Bad purchase.  As another reviewer said, no savings is worth bad coffee.
This is the worst coffee that I have ever tasted. I tried to drink my first cup and after a few sips all of it went right in the garbage. Very weak and tastes like an ashtray.
Their packaging process leaves a great deal to be desired. A bunch of the cups had mold growing on them.

A DECENT COFFEE BUT IS WAY OVERPRICED. SAME PRODUCT AT COSTCO IS ONLY { NOT DECAF} HALF THE PRICE????? CAN SOMEONE EXPLAIN??? DECAF COST NO MORE TO PRODUCE. WHY DO CLUB STORES NOT HAVE DECAF IS UNKNOWN TO ME??

I had no problem with the unconventional packaging. It brews just as well as the regular k-cups. The problem I had was with the coffee itself. The first thing I noticed was the smell. It does not even smell like coffee, but I am stuck with it so I gave it a shot. The taste is sour and leaves a disgusting aftertaste in your mouth. I ordered it because it was the cheapest coffee I could find that I could use in my Keurig. Now I know why.

I bought 2 boxes of San Francisco Bay French Roast Decaf because it was on such a good sale.  I brewed a cup and it does not smell or taste like coffee.  I was very disapointed and unfortunatly I threw the packing slip away so I am not able to return it.
would not recommend this coffee, the coffee is very bitter even after putting milk and sugar in.  i have had much better decaf regular coffee from other brands.

I had read all the reviews that it wasn't a traditional K-Cup. This appealed to me. But the coffee is not good at all. My husband and I LOVE coffee. It is bitter and the smell is horrendous. I was very disappointed.
I guess this is a question of "You get what you pay for"!  These are not real k-cups, and shouldn't be permitted to masquerade as such!

I ordered this as a kcup and got something that may or may not work, but is definitely not an approved kcup. I am not sure what these are for, but am a little nervous about trying to use one in my new Keurig machine. One reviewer said they did try it and it worked.  I have not tried. But if you are expecting the usual plastic K-cup, this is not the product for you. I received 3 plastic pouches in a printed brown cardboard box and nowhere on the box does it mention k-cups. My guess is that these were not licensed for use in Keurig coffee makers.

column9: excellent more environmentally friendly design k cup
column10: People people people relax - they are real coffee, they do work in the keurig and the cuisinart one cup model BUT, and this is a great but, they just use less plastic in their design.  For anyone who uses the one cup brewers it should bother you a little bit that every time you do you are throwing away a little plastic cup - with the popularity of these models that is a lot of plastic well San Francisco Bay Coffee has eliminated the cup- YEAH!!  You get a delicious one cup brew, so no waste there AND you are not adding to our landfills.

column9: OK but suffers from lack of K-Cup form factor
column10: My wife and I used to live in the San Francisco Bay Area and we loved this coffee, the San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf French Roast blend.  When I spotted this coffee on Amazon for use in the Keurig brewer I immediately ordered it in some quantity based on our past experience.  I was surprised to discover that the coffee is not contained within a K-Cup container but rather it is contained in a coffee filter like material with a top which fits into the K-Cup receptacle of the brewer.  Our family results are mixed.  My wife likes this coffee and drinks it a few times each day.  My experience was that the coffee flavor is still good but the hot water passes through the coffee and filter paper too quickly which produces a watered-down coffee flavor.  I wish the San Francisco Bay Coffee company would get the necessary licenses to put their coffee into actual K-Cup pods.  If the price was competitive, my wife and I would be steady customers.  But for my tastes, I'll stick with the Green Mountain dark roast decaf coffees which have a richer coffee flavor.

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf OneCup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast, 12-Count (Pack of 3)
column10: San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf OneCup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast, 12-Count (Pack of 3)Excellent, great, wonderful, tasty and full of all that coffee goodness, at a reasonable price per cup.Bold, very dark, strong smoky aroma and taste expected from a good French Roast. This definitely is not your store bought French Roast in the blue plastic container. If you don't like STRONG coffee, don't buy this.Very unique K-Cup alternative filter dispensing system that gives a better cup of brew in my opinion. I found this filter very easy to clean and reuse with K-Saver snap-on tops that I bought here at Amazon too.Yep, this is on my Subscribe and Save list.

column9: Not a traditional "cup" for your Keurig
column10: I took a shot based on the great "subscribe and save" pricing for these.  Haven't tried them in my brewer yet, but a few initial impressions "as received":1. These are not k-cups in the traditional sense.  There's no "cup" to them, just the filter attached to a rim with a seal on it.  So I don't see how these could possibly "brew" in the cup like a k-cup is supposed to brew.  I'm betting these are another "instant" coffee designed to fit a Keurig brewer.2. The shipment of 3 packages of 12 each that I received was 3 clear plastic bags.  No box as shown on the listing picture.  Now I get it they say packing may differ from that depicted, but IMHO it's dishonest of Amazon to display these online with a box when they know they aren't going to ship them that way.3. Combining #1 and #2 together means once you open the plastic bag of 12, since the individual servings aren't sealed per se, in order to keep them fresh it seems to me you would need to put them in some sort of sealed container.  Not at all user friendly for the many "carousel" and "drawer" k-cup storage units offered.I do not plan to open and try them at all.UPDATE 1/10/2012: As you can see from above, I wasn't particularly happy with what I received.  But as I said, those were my "initial impressions" and I believe fairly stated for what they are.  That said, I did contact Amazon customer service about my displeasure, and they issued a full credit to my account.  I've been buying from Amazon since 1998, and this is probably only the 4th or 5th time I've requested a refund on a purchase.  Since this is a grocery item, Amazon said they could not accept a return even IF unopened, and the customer service rep encouraged me to keep the coffee and go ahead and try it.  So, I did.I'm happy to report that it is INDEED real coffee (not instant), the aroma is great and the taste is great.  I've upped my rating from 2 to 4 stars.  I do feel justified in knocking the score 1 star for the inadequate description as people need to understand these are NOT "K-cups", but they ARE real coffee packaged in a manner different than most would expect when buying coffee for their Keurig. And I still contend that displaying what looks like a nice retail box in the item photo is also misleading.My issue #3 of course remains unresolved, and also contributes to the lower of my rating.  You need to keep these stored in a decanter or some other sealed container if you want to keep the other 11 fresh after you open the plastic bag to brew up your first cup.

I ordered these because they're the only decaf K cups I could find for subscribe and save.  You can see from the picture that they're not "traditional" K cups, but it would be helpful to have a more zoomed in view.  As the previous reviewer mentioned, the coffee is shipped in three plastic bags rather than a box and the "cup" is more of a pouch with a foil lid.  I wasn't sure whether they would work in my brewer, but I'm glad I tried it because the coffee is honestly the best decaf K cup coffee I've had (and I've tried most of them).  This is NOT instant coffee, it is regular, brewed K cup coffee.  This is a great product, I'm giving it 4 stars rather than 5 because of the confusing picture of the packaging.

I can confirm that the Rogers "One Cup" pods work in the office-size Keurig B-3000 brewer as well as the smaller Keurig brewers.  Sometimes you will see the "No K-Cup Detected" warning, but you can ignore it.  The pods load and eject as well as authentic K-Cups.As for the coffee, it's as the other reviewers say.  Nice body, darker roasted, and more flavor than the decaf offerings from Green Mountain.  A very satisfactory decaf.Opening the bag yields a wonderful fresh-roasted aroma.  As mentioned elsewhere, the bag is not re-sealable, but if you store it in a tightly-closed container, it won't lose the aroma for days.The complaints you hear in some of the comments are actually features to many.  The filter does allow a little very fine sediment through, which is off-putting to a few but adds to the body.  As one would expect from a French Roast, it is decidedly dark.  If you want a mild cup of coffee, you'll want to stay with the Green Mountain, but for those of us who want a stronger and more flavorful cup without the work of using a Solofill or other filter for your own coffee, this is a very welcome product.
I love my evening coffee, so finally I have a decent decaf.  Smooth and rich with no bitterness. Love the packaging and the price!

column9: Good coffee.  Cheaper price.  Happy sipper.
column10: I was hesitant to try this coffee based on the one review available at the time, but decided to take the risk.  I don't regret that decision.I have no issue with the strength of the coffee, as others have opined.  Although the coffee is not housed in the same type of plastic cup as other brands of Keurig-compatible coffees, but rather in what appears to be a thick filter material, the coffee brews thoroughly.  I found the resulting cup of coffee to be well within the range of perfect strength, and actually leaning toward the darker/stronger end of what I enjoy.I am also pleased with the price, as we finally have a product that should consistently be priced beneath that pesky 60-cent floor, and nearer to 40 cents for those who buy the coffee by subscription.  That is a significant savings!If I could, I might subtract half a star, because I feel that this coffee is not quite as smooth to the palate as some of the higher-end coffees.  However, it is very good coffee and is worth 5 stars.  I will definitely purchase it again (probably by subscription).Happy sipping!  :)

I love french roast coffee, but this is probably the worst I've ever tried. There are distinct smokey overtones, unfortunately those smokey overtones seem to have been produced by a stack of burning tires. Never before have I tasted anything that was so distinctly like the smell over burning rubber. Seriously, I was super excited to find some cheap french roast but this is just awful. Splurge if you have to on something which is possible to drink more than a few sips of.

I buy lots of K-cups, mostly from Amazon.  When I opened these, I thought I had bought the wrong item.  I looked at the original listing and realized they were for the Keurig.  I thought I'd try one and then send them back if it didn't work.  It not only worked, but worked better than K-cups.  I bought the decaf for my husband to enjoy coffee in the evening.  There is more efficiency with this design.  The keurig doesn't poke a hole in the bottom of these and the filter works very well.  There's less mess when you take it out.I will buy these again, especially since the subscribe and save makes them cheaper than traditional k-cups.  The flavor was bold and delicious.

My wife and I love our Keurig machine.  Now that most of the kids are out of the house we almost never use the old coffee pot.  So, although we're not connoisseurs we look for flavorful coffee in K-cups at reasonable prices (I always consider the cost-per-Kcup).  If you like a rich tasting cup of decaf with a slight "edge" to it, the San Francisco Bay French Roast decaf is a very good choice.Let's face it -- many of the K-cup coffees available for sale are WAY overpriced, even on Amazon.  The San Francisco Bay comes out to about 49 cents a cup, which is tolerable.  The one and only negative about this coffee is that some of the finely ground coffee can push through the filter and leave a small bit of sludge at the bottom of the cup, so I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.  Also, keep the pods in an airtight container if possible -- the open filter design means that oxygen can more easily get to the coffee grounds and affect the taste if they sit around too long.

Love our Keurig, but I hate to pay a fortune for good coffee, and Amazon always seems to have great options for me.  So as I was shopping for regular coffee and ordered the FogChaser variety, I found the decaf French Roast as well. Surprisingly, the missing bottom to the cup is not an issue! Spouse and I love the coffee, it is strong enough for him, and tasty for me. If you want to recycle the grounds, they are much easier to get to since you only have to tear open the paper basket on the bottom. The cups come in sealed bags of 8 cups at a time to preserve freshness, so buying 36 is no problem.  Also the coffee company has begun adding a plastic sealed container to the box so when you open the bag, you can place them in the sealed container for freshness.  I really like the San Francisco Bay coffees!

I love a dark roast coffee, and this was just perfect for me.  I'm the only decaf drinker and I hadn't been able to find one bold enough for me.  This was a terrific price and, for my personal taste, the perfect blend.

I recently discovered (or rather, tried for the first time) this delicious coffee. I love the flavor- very bold yet smooth for a decaf. And even for a regular coffee, actually- it's every bit as tasty as a non-decaf. I have ordered it twice now and will do so again.
Bought this for my husband, he liked it but would have liked it to be a little bit stronger. But he said it had a good flavor.
This decaf is so good that you can't tell it's decaf. Am enjoying to the fullest decaf coffee for the first time! Yum.
I have done a complete review for all the San Francisco blends under the Rainforest blend....States all the reasons we love this new brand better than any of the others....

column9: Coffee the way you like it
column10: I have been drinking San Francisco Bay coffee for years.  Recent doctors recommendations were to switch to decaffeinated coffee.  I knew SF Bay came in decaf but it was hard to locate.  We purchased a single cup brewing system to accommodate now differing preferences.  I was overjoyed when I found, on Amazon, San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf One Cup for Keurig Brewers, French Roast, 36 count.  Additionally they have a regular delivery option which saves me from running out of the product and they offer an exceptional price.  This product also creates less impact on the environment with their packaging.
finally a great strong, excellent tasting decaf product. I also liked the new design of the K-cup. Seems like it would be less of a waste of materials.

I love my Keurig, but hate the non-environmentally-friendly K-cups, so I'm always looking for something better.  I tried the San Francisco Bay coffee pods after reading some good reviews here on Amazon.  They are awesome!  They work great in the Keurig, and even seem to make a better, bigger cup of java than the original K-cups!  They smell delicious and taste soooo good!  I have enjoyed the decaf, and will be ordering more of those as well as some of the regular ones! What a great design by San Francisco Bay!  I opted for the eco packaging as well and had no problem with it.  If you were giving as a gift you might want to get the boxed ones though, so they know what they're getting!!  No more K-cups for me! Just a note to SFB-more flavors please!!! :)

I drink a LOT of coffee. Mostly half caf, mixing Caffeinated with Decaffeinated. This is easy to do with the single serve coffee makers. I prefer to use the same brand and flavor of Caf and Decaf. There are not a lot of brands which offer both Caf and Decaf. Then it's hard to find a flavor I like even when it is available in both Caf and Decaf. I like the taste of San Francisco Bay French Roast and it comes in both Caf and Decaf. I like their Fog Chaser flavor a lot too but it doesn't come in Decaf.The coffee is held in a little mesh bag not a plastic cup. They claim this packaging is more eco-friendly. Don't know about that and I think the coffee might not stay fresh if the little pouches are stored exposed to the air. Becuase of this I keep them in a seald plastic tub and I use them up pretty quickly anyway.I buy them from Amazon because I can't get it locally and Amazon always has it for a great price and quick delivery.

I have had Keurig coffee maker for several years now and the normal k-cup from green mountian and the others has been getting weak and tasteless maybe they have less coffee in each k-cup I don't know.The San Francisco Bay coffee is great tasting, full bodied and I don't throw away as much plastic because of their design. Also you can see the ammount of coffee in the bag not like the k-cups. GREAT COFFEE !

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf for Keurig Brewers French Roast
column10: The coffee is one of the best I have tried. This is not for those who love weak standard American style coffee. This is the real deal!

The coffee tastes good, not outstanding but acceptable.  The cuplets work well in the Keurig.  My only negative is they come in sealed bags of 10 or so and once you open the bag, the coffee is exposed to the air as the bottom of the cuplet is filter paper.  Thus I found a large screwtop jar and keep them in that.  Not a big deal but not as convenient as picking up a sealed cuplet and popping it into the brewer.

column9: Good flavored decaf & works well in Keurig
column10: I bought these because I'm trying to wean myself off full-caffeine coffee a bit more.  The flavor from these little pods is great - it doesn't have a watered-down/weak flavor like a lot of decaf blends do IMHO, so I really like these because I don't feel like I'm getting cheated out of my "real" coffee in the morning because I made decaf.As for the filter packs/pods themselves, I was a bit worried at first because of other reviews, but I figured for the price, I would give them a shot.
