I think they work great.  Yes, you have to seal up the pods after you open the pouch, but that's not a big deal for me.  I will take having to seal up a bag or canister for less waste in the end.  And they work great in the Keurig.  I still feel like there's this sound of the filter getting punctured when I close the hatch, but it never does.I'm still debating if I want to go with the subscribe & save option, but what's holding me back is the lack of variety.  These could always be my go-to dark roast, and I think I would be good with that!

I have been very pleased with this coffee. The flavor is quite good for decaf and the pods work well in my Keurig brewer. The only slight negative is the packaging for twelve pods coming in non-resealable bags. It is not a huge deal. I just keep the open bag inside a larger ziploc.

The first thing I would like to say is that the bottom of the k cup is a mesh not plastic but it still goes in my keurig machine just like a regular plastic bottom k cup. I don't understand what the fuss is all about.  It does look a little different from what you may be used to seeing, but works just the same. Now as to the taste of the coffee, I think that it is a full body flavor. If I want a strong taste I brew regular size amd if I wish to have a milder flavor I will brew the largest cup size, I have the best of both worlds. I immediately went on subscribe and save.  I order 5 boxes at a time.  Love the flavor of this coffee.  Now to my complaint. I notice today that the price of each box has increased approximately $2.54 a box and that is within about three weeks time. Now I really love the convenience of my Keurig, however eventually the price of the k cups will reach a price that will cause me to say NO MORE. That time is approaching quickly. This brand started out to be more reasonable than most, but with this price jump in the last three weeks I am afraid they (the company) will soon be way overpriced as are the other brands.  Again I will say I do love the flavor of this coffee. Did I mention my husband likes it as well and he normally does not like decaf coffee.

I read the reviews and got nervous at first.I'm happy I tried it and now I have a monthly subscription, loving the coffee.This is one of the best decafs I've had to date.The lack of plastic is good too, as it seems such a waste.

I freaked out when I saw the strange design of this coffee pod - definitely not your wasteful, landfill-clogging- feeling- guilty- about-  drinking- it K-cup.  However it works just fine in the Keurig machine and produces a rather nice, bold, cup of decaf.  I would rate it beneath the Tully's French Roast and above any other decaf I have had.  I would recommend it and would like to try the regular blends.

We ordered this product after reading positive reviews about the coffees taste, as we've had trouble finding good tasting decaf k-cups. This product met our high hopes and is our favorite k-cup decaf coffee (surpassing the donut shop decaf).With that said, the only thing from keeping this from a five star rating is the packaging. As others have pointed out, the cups are sealed in 12 packs. So when you open one 12 pack, the others are exposed to air. We are storing the opened cups in a zip lock bag, but only time will tell how the coffee holds up when we get to cup number 11 and 12.Overall, a great product.

I was really surprised of how 'good' this coffee tasted. It is smooth, rich (not strong/bitter), full flavor great tasting coffee and reasonably priced. I've tried many/various coffees and this-San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast, 36-Count is my favorite. My husband likes it too. In fact, he rarely uses the other kinds/brands.  Oh, this may sound terrible, but some of the other brands/coffees when brewing smells like (I hate to say this and I am not being mean or vindictive)...but urine, cat urine. We have a cat thus I associate that smell-aroma to the cat. Although their coffee tastes alright.San Francisco Bay French Roast coffee is our favorite; it has a full rich even sweet flavor, no funky smell-aroma and the best part is the bottom of the "CUP" (K-cup) is paper mesh, NOT plastic...how's that for innovation, ecology and just plain cool? I am not into plastics if possible, I am world/ecology aware and happy that SFB (San Francisco Bay) has it available, Thanks! Try it, you'll love it!

column9: Delicious coffee at a great price
column10: As the k-cup monopoly continues to increase the price for Keurig owners, it is natural that we start looking for alternatives.  With retail prices exceeding $.60 a cup for the Keurig branded k-cups, I was definitely happy to see an alternative!These cups look quite different- more like mini filters than the self enclosed plastic cups that we are used to.  They also are not individually sealed.  However,  I believe the plastic kcup is a patented product, so we can't expect the same thing at a much lower price.I have been using this product for a couple of months and have only good things to say about it.  I keep them in a Ziploc bag after opening the initial package (which is vacuum sealed).  The french roast is a very dark, rich roast an one of the few that I have been happy to brew on the larger cup size.This is the best cup of coffee I have had from my Keurig!  If you prefer milder roasts ("house" or "breakfast" roasts) this french roast might not be for you.  If you need to keep your kcups out in the open, this brand might not be for you.  However, if you love a dark roast and are flexible with storage, this is a great economical product!

column9: Nice Flavor, Dark But Not Overwhelming
column10: Pleasantly surprised by the taste...very dark (reminds me of Green Mountain's Dark Magic), but not quite so overwhelming and has a very subtle aftertaste.  Packaging (most of the "cup" is a filter mesh) is great...other companies should follow suit.

Rich and tasty decaf strong enough to stand up to the 3rd button on the Keurig brewer. Yay! Not a greenie-fanatic, but as an interested steward of our planet's resources, I appreciate this company's reduction of plastic use with their innovative cup housing, which also shrinks the package size. Works perfectly in our brewer! Happy to subscribe-and-save to this coffee and we look forward to trying their other offerings.

Later in the day when watching my caffeine intake, this coffee hits the spot.  All the cups I have made have been delicious.  I also like that the pod is not made out of all that plastic like the K cup.  I prefer my coffee less all the chemicals heated up plastics cast off.  Perfect coffee for decaf drinkers.  I will definitely buy again.

column9: Wish i had tried a sample...
column10: Intrigued by the new less expensive packaging and other reviews I bought the 36 pk ... Bitter and not rich if you like a bold or dark roast.
The coffee is tasty, true and exactily like the San Francisco Bay coffee that you buy by the whole bean(and grind).  Rich flavor not acidic just TRUE

Since kcups are becoming more and more expensive, we've tried some alternative coffees for our Keurig.  These "soft bottom cups" allow easier brewing and I think they make a stronger coffee.  I like the decaf brew, and my husband loves the Fog Chaser.  The only down side is they are not sealed, they have a soft filter bottom and they need to be stored in an airtight container, but who cares if it's cheaper and tastes good?  We will continue to buy from San Francisco.

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee Decaf One Cup for Keurig Brewers, French roast, 36 count
column10: I received the order on time. I love the flavor of the French Roast blend. I use my Keurig everyday when I only want one cup of fresh coffee.

This product has become my coffee of choice after trying many other brands.  It is full bodied without being bitter.  This coffee is not in a plastic Kcuo, but in a filter.  Glad to put less plastic out there.
All around good product. Coffee is tasty at a good price. Also, the K cup containers have less plastic so they are supposed to be less harmful for the environment.

column9: San Francisco Bay decaf, French Roast
column10: Great cup of coffee. Best decaf I have ever enjoyed.  Convienient, reasonable cost. Recomend to anyone who loves a good cup of coffee.
Coffee is strong, has full body flavor, aromatic and delicious, and a very good buy. Since I drink my coffee black, no sugar, nothing hinders the taste.

I am stuck with 36 of these K cups.San Francisco French Roast Decaf.  This french roast is expecially frenchy, very bitter!!!So what do I do with the other 34 cups?  One I gave to my daughter who loves french roast.  Does NOT want them.  Help!

This coffee has a wonderful aroma and a strong taste (which I do like). Price is lower than "official Keurig" k-cups, because, I assume, SF Bay doesn't pay license fee to Keurig. 12 cups sealed in a special bag will keep cups fresher longer.

Taste is good but very mild.PROS: Economical and contain very little plastic, likely better for the environment for those who do not recycle. Taste is decent but quite weak.CONS: Lack of plastic cup around bottom means the Keurig cannot extract the coffee, so it drips. Coffee, to me, is weak.... but I prefer mine stout. I'm not a fan of the plastic bag you need to keep these in.

Many decaf coffees are flat and low on taste.  This San Francisco Bay is fantastic--tastes as good as the "high octane."  I also like their non-plastic k-cups--more coffee in each (or so it seems) and better than filtering through plastic like typical k-cups.  A real winner.  We just had guests who are coffee-fanciers--couldn't tell the difference between the regular and decaf (we have both).

It took me 20 years to find out French Roast was my coffee.Most coffees have no taste. If you add to much coffee it gets bitter like Starbucks. San Francisco coffee taste great in the Keurig 1 cup and it is priced right. I will buy more. I also use The French Roast regular from Costco.

column9: Super strong great decaf cuppa joe
column10: Great single cup decaf coffee for Keurig brewers. This decaf tastes just like a great cup of regular coffee and I love the pod design. I also buy regular San Francisco Fog Chaser coffee for my morning jet fuel.  Great coffee!

A friend of mine recommened San Francisco Bay Coffee after discussing the cost of the pods for the Keurig coffee maker. I love this coffee product and highly recommed it, the coffee is great the and price is really great. Don't think I'll be purchasing the other brands again.

From the second you cut open the packaging and smell the wonderful aroma of this coffee, you know you have a winner. You will need to keep these in a sealed container instead of hanging them in one of those countertop holders so the coffee stays fresh and fragrant! This is really good coffee;it compares with coffee brewed in a french press! I buy the French Roast. Have tried others but that French Roast just can't be beat! I drink mostly decaf and I think there is a big difference in decaf coffees. San Francisco Bay French Roast Decaf is as good as it gets!

This is a very rich and delicious decaffeinated coffee. It really is hard to tell that it's not the real thing! San Francisco Bay coffee has the same "bite" as real coffee that is missing in most decaf's. The eco frendly design and resonable price is a big plus too.

I hate to be harsh, but this coffee does taste like what you think an ash tray would taste like.  And, it's not because it's "dark roast".  I truly enjoy dark roasted coffee, but this is horrible.  I purchase it because it had more good reviews than bad, however, many of the bad reviews were spot on!  I am very disappointed with the purchase.

We use their regular coffee purchased at our local Costco, it is a delicious brew.  Robust coffee without bitterness.  The decaf here is just as excellent, tastes so good it is hard to believe it is decaf.  Don't let the low pricing fool you, this is high quality coffee.
Had high hopes but was disappointed.  Although this coffee had a good price it also has a bitter after taste and is very oily.

I discovered this coffee on a salmon fishing trip in Alaska, the flavor really stands up to steamy frothy milk that I make in my Keurig milk frother. I buy both the regular and the decaf versions, so I can control the amount of caffeine I get at any one time.
Found coffee had a bitter and old taste.  would not recommend.  purchased item on amazon.Sorry but cannot recommend this product.  Could have been an old batch.

I'm a one-a-day coffee drinker, so my one cup must "wow" in the morning...consistently. Of course the Green Mountain brand works, but I decided to try the San Francisco Bay brand because it was cheaper. I have a new love! I have the perfect cup of intense, sharp, hello-I'm-awake-now coffee every morning.One caveat: You must love dark roast coffees. French Roast is not for the faint of heart.

When I first received the product, it looked like I bought the wrong thing.  I was looking for K-cup which come in little plastic containers.  These looked almost the right size, but they had a rounded bottom and were made from some form of "filter" material versus the plastic that I had expected.I eventually decided to put one into the machine before tossing the whole thing as having bought the wrong stuff.  Really glad I did.  They are for K-cup.  The coffee has a nice strong, French roast flavor.  The packaging is minimalistic and doesn't look like what I'm used to for K-cups.  I don't know if the added flavor is based on the packaging or the coffee.  Either way, I'm happy with it.

I am amazed how good this coffee is.  Prior to using I was using Starbucks and tho I found it bitter it was strong the way I like it.  I tried both Fog chaser and french Roast, and found no bitterness at all but a good strong cup of coffee that is divine.  The best part of all tho is the price.  Perhaps with the less packaging they were able to bring the cost down.  I know everyone is different and I read the one star reviews and figured hey we all have different taste buds, for my taste it is fabulous.  I will only buy San Francisco Bay from now on.

column9: BEST COFFEE EVER AND BETTER PRICE!!!
column10: I adore this coffee! And you simply cannot beat the price!!! So tasty!!! I also LOVE their regular coffee!!! I drink decaf at night but buy the 80 count reg for the days!!! Will keep buying and buying!!!

I don't know if it is because these cups are packaged differently than the regular K-cups, or if the San Francisco Bay brand coffee is so much better than other brands, or both, but this coffee is really great.  I only drink decaf coffee and with other K-cups I've used, the coffee flavor is very weak.  With the San Francisco brand, it is full bodied and flavorful like getting a cup from a local coffee store.

The "frustration-free" packaging is a win.  The cupless cups come 12 to an airtight-sealed package, so it's just a matter of finding an airtight container for them as you go through them.  I appreciate that they're much less waste.This flavor is a good dark roast, which I drink black or with spiced rum.  Some people may prefer a lighter roast, but the coffee itself is quite good.

This is the best decaf I have tasted & the price is right.  Just the right combinations of flavors.  A bit strong so if you hate a strong coffee this would not be for you.  Pefect for me though as I love it.  Highly recommend it. Love the auto delivery feature. Great idea.

I originally discovered this brand when it was on sale at Stew Leonards. Turned out I loved it. Maybe it's because it comes as a mesh bag instead of a cup but the flavor is bold and strong. They also come in a sealed plastic bag which I would guess helps preserve flavor while on the shelf.

My sister recommended this coffee to me--and I'm so glad I listened to her.  The taste is mellow and perfect for that late night cup of coffee that you don't want to keep you awake!  Great price, too.

Real coffee flavor and a lovely taste.  Love getting up to a fresh 1st cup, 2nd cup or however many I want.  And.. I love knowing each cup is perfectly brewed and fresh.  Will keep ordering this product.  Deelish!
San Francisco Kcups have an interesting design. The price is very good and I like the sealed bags for decaf - it would be nice to treat the non-decaf coffee the same way.

Good tasting coffee. Initially confused by the modified K cup design - more like a K bag. Works just fine with less plastic. Three packages to help maintain freshness. Great value, especially with Prime two day delivery.

This is a great, mild coffee blend. Best part? Less plastic! I can drink this coffee all day (it's decaf) and I don't worry about all the plastic going to the landfill with the other type of Keurig cup. (The "cup" is made of fiber and only the top is plastic.) AND it's considerably cheaper!

column9: Product was fine, preference is for milder coffee
column10: The packaging was fine but the coffee was too strong for my preference.  I would buy this again if I could find a milder product.

The coffee is good, and it stays fresh. Great price. I kept it in the original bag with a clip. It has a one way 'valve' on the bag to push air out. No different than keeping ground coffee before the days of the keurig.
The San Francisco Bay Decaf coffee is good tasting and a great value for the 36 count purchase.  A price of $17.49 is hard to beat.
My husband really loves this decaf coffee and the flavor.  Cost is also appreciated as the pass some savings on to you with their packaging.  Great coffee

Good rich decaf. This is how all kcups should be packaged, space saving and stays fresh in a thick foil bag. Use a strong chip-clip to seal the bag, squeeze out the air and the scent is like a fresh bag of coffee beans.

column9: Very rich coffee flavor in a DeCaf.
column10: This coffee has a very rich flavor and excellent taste without the caffeine. For those that like their coffee but find it keeps them awake this could be your answer. I make a pot of coffee in the morning and in the afternoon change to DeCaf to prevent loss of sleep but still enjoy a rich full bodied coffee. One of the only DeCaf coffees I have liked. You have to try San Francisco French Roast DeCaf to truly understand.
From the moment you open the bag and smell this coffee, you know it's the real deal. And, you would never guess it's decaf.

I signed up for monthly shipments of this coffee.  I am so glad I did.  It has the full-bodied flavor that ALL other Keurig coffees do, and the new, non-plastic, filter is more environmentally freindly.  The 36-count is just the perfect amount for me each month, and the price cannot be beat - ANYWHERE !!  Thanks for making this coffee available.

column9: Great value - excellent, stronger cup of coffee than most Keurig pods!
column10: You can't beat the value for these pods - though, because they are packaged in filter-type pods rather than plastic pods, I recommend keeping them in an air-tight container or zip-lock bag once the individual bag is opened to keep them at their maximum freshness.We originally purchased these because of the price, but have recently purchased another (caffeinated) flavor because we loved the taste.  These make an excellent - STRONG - cup of coffee.  Usually we need to use two Keurig pods to brew a larger cup of coffee, but it is not necessary to do so with these.

A very bold coffee.  I make two cups at a time in a large container and it is perfect for my taste.  This makes it even less expensive.  I wish they would make it for the Vue but since they don't I'll keep the old coffee maker.

column9: Good coffee great packaging for K cup machines
column10: Enjoy the coffee and find unusual k cup packaging better and more functional than the plastic cup design.  As with other reviewers the coffee has an unusual smell.
If you like a more bitter and strong coffee, you will love this coffee. It was too bitter for me.............
I think the concept is good, however the cups sometime get stuck in the holder. I also think the coffee is somewhat bitter.
Excellent coffee - great value - outstanding customer service. Works just like the other K-cups but without the added plastic packaging. Store in a zip-close bag and you're good to go.

Once I switched to decaf, I struggled with finding a K-cup that was strong enough. I will admit to brewing at a smaller size (on the more advanced machine) or shutting it off early (on an older model), but I am so pleased with the flavor of this decaf. I love that it has less environmental impact, but my priority for K-cups was definitely the taste. I do recommend keeping them in a sealed container since the filter bottom doesn't protect them from getting stale or absorbing oils in your hands on or in the air.

This coffee is Outstanding, and has the added benefit that the packaging of the "cup" itself is wonderful. It is not like any other in that it is not all plastic, it is essentially a "filter" cup, so much more Eco-friendly.Because I drink a large cup of coffee, I often combine this with their Fogcutter regular blend.
It's okay...not my favorite for sure.......not as mellow as I like.  It is priced better than most but probably won't buy it again.

The best thing about these cups is that I can just peel off the lid and invert the "net" filter to recycle my grounds as plant fertilizer.  With traditional K-cups, I have to scrape the sides to get all the coffee ground out--what a pain.  The taste of the French roast is good too, or I wouldn't be wasting my money.  Costco doesn't have decaf K-cups so this SFB is perfect all the way around--taste, cost, decaf, ease of use.  I store each cello bag in an air-tight canister made for sugar/flour.  After I have about 6-8 used cups, I "flip" the coffee out into a carton and dump the grounds immediately in the garden.  So simple.

column9: Amazing taste in a funny package
column10: I'm very particular about the taste of my decaf coffee.  I want it bold and strong and without the decaf aftertaste.  I'm also looking for a great deal on K-cups.I'm sitting here with my very first cup of this coffee, and it is amazing.  The coffee is robust and bold and tastes wonderful.  I just popped the funny-looking container into my Keurig and everything worked just fine.I also love the Subscribe and Save benefits, which result in my coffee costing only .41 per cup.  But being the dollar-stretcher that I am, I also use each K-cup twice:  first brew a large cup, second brew a smaller cup.  This coffee tasted great in both rounds.  So that means I'm down to around .20/cup!  Love that.Great deal.  Great taste.  Highly recommend.

This coffee is actually quite good and indistinguishable from a high-end k Cup. Very important to place the cups in a zip-lock bag after opening the pack as unlike a K cup these will get stale quickly. Highly recommended.

column9: I wanted to like this so bad.
column10: I bought this because I trusted the brand name, but it's got a weird flavor, that isn't really coffee. I found it tasted better with almond milk, but overall, gross. If this was the last thing on earth next to instant, I'd probably go for the instant first.
Price was the best and the cashews were whole, just a few not, but very few.  Checked online and this was the best for the money.  This will be where I continue to purchase the raw cashews.  Thanks.

These cashews where larger than I expected and most of them are whole as advertised.  Just a few broken pieces as to be expected with transport.  The sent them priority mail and I got them quickly. Good flavor.  I plan to order some more this week. Definately better price than the grocery store.

This product arrived promptly.  Double bag was a nice touch.  My wife and 3 year old ate them and enjoyed it.  We make a great vegan cheese with this since we are vegetarian. The quality is excellent. We where pleasantly surprised by the great price seeing the skyrocketing markup on cashews and other various nuts in the retail stores.We will not be purchasing cashews in this form from the regular stores anymore and we have shared this find with friends and co-workers.I highly recommend this product.5 STARS!!

Fast shipping.  This time was the best packaging.  Double Bagged always, this time in a good postal shipping box in great shape.I have gotten these twice before.  I love to make a Chocolate shake that is to die for.1 cup Cashews3/4 C waterGrind/blend to thick milk-add 1/4 cup Agave3 TBS cocoa powder1/4 tsp salt if you want3 C iceblend to shake consistency  < I got this off the web somewhere, couple places.How can you lose?  Its great.

I got the order promptly.  The nuts were double packed in plastic for freshness and then packed in a priority mail box.  I would say 99.5% were intact.  They are large cashews and taste great.  I will absolutely be purchasing from Bayside again.  Thanks!

If you are in search of a light roast coffee that doesn't leave that bitter stank on the back of your tongue, this is definitely one I'd suggest.When I first got it, I hadn't noticed it was pre-ground.  I generally like to grind my own.  It turns out this ground coffee makes a decent cup.It heads a little toward a medium roast flavor, but still is light enough that it doesn't taste burnt like medium and dark roasts tend to.Plus, it leaves a tiny footprint which is nice.

Great cup of coffee!  Pre-ground which is what I prefer as I do not have a grinder at my house.  I love that this product has no after taste (bitterness) like some coffees.  This product is a good value and it available in the subscribe and save which is even better.  We have switched from Dunkin Donuts coffee to this and we have been very pleased with the quality of the coffee.

column9: Best sugar free raspberry iced tea out there!
column10: I've tried every brand of sugar free raspberry iced tea that I could find and Wyler's is the best, hands down.  The only problem is that I can't find it anywhere anymore!

column9: Amazing, tastes like the least healthy thing in your kitchen
column10: I just bought these at the grocery store, seriously one of the best things I have ever tasted. I bought them to dip in hummus, but they are too good not to eat plain. Legitimately one of the best tasting things I have ever eaten. Tastes like something deep-fried, but way healthier then potato chips/french fries, For real, I bought french fries in the same trip to the store, and now they taste like crap to me. This has ruined every other snack for me. I don't even normally review things on amazon, but the world HAS TO KNOW. !!!. !!!!.

I agree with the previous reviewer -  these are the best savory snack out there! Super light, super crispy, fantastic flavour, only 6 calories per square, and are actually filling - how do they do it?!??!!!!

column9: Would buy it over and over again for all our parties
column10: I love those little sweet pacifers, got them to fill my baby favor boxes.  Love the taste and the colors but didn't hear any compliments from our vistors yet since I'm still waiting for my baby :)would buy this again for sure and enjoy filling my favor boxes/bags with those mini sweetstaste and smells and looks just PERFECT
Great candies for a baby shower.  Tasty, fast shipping and went over well.  Thanks!

Having fallen in love with this roast while visiting the islands over the years, I'm always on a search for that same flavor at my local stores.  This is far superior to any of the 'Kona Blends' I have available locally.

OK - I understand there are other flavors of gum, but I like this one above all others and like to keep enough in stock.  I really like the smaller packs rather than the "economy size" so I can throw them in my purse etc.  This was a very good price and shipping was very fast.  Not much more to say than that!

column9: Great taste without the hassle of being out of jav.
column10: I found this is one of the easiest ways to shop for coffee. The Subsribe and Save program saves you money and you never wake up to an empty can of coffee. The Maxwell House Blend, Ground Coffee, 31.5-Ounce Container (Pack of 2) is priced well and I prefer the House Blend better than the fancy coffee house brands.Trip to grocery store, $10 , two canisters of coffee $16, plus tax and hassle. Have is delivered free without tax for $18. Without the hassle.

column9: Love this Coffee, but Subscription Keeps Canceling
column10: Maxwell house is my favorite coffee. I like it more than all other supermarket brands and even specialty brands (yes, I can taste the difference). I was so excited to find Maxwell House Blend, Ground Coffee, 31.5-Ounce Container (Pack of 2)for such a good price available for subscription on Amazon. After I signed up, I got my shipment within 2 days, thanks to my Prime membership. My coffee was fresh and delicious. When it came time for my 2nd shipment to go out, I got an email saying it was delayed, due to lack of inventory. Shortly after that, I received another email saying my subscription was canceled altogether. This has happened 3 times. It is annoying to have this happen, but the pricing is so good, I'm willing to continue to re-subscribe to get my favorite coffee at such a low price.

column9: Best Tea on Earth (No, I don't own company stock!)
column10: Everyone in my house is addicted to this tea. We drink it iced. Make one or two pitchers of it a day. It's not sweetened, but has a subtle, natural sweetness to it. Feels refreshing and clean. It was also one of the few things I tolerated well when I was pregnant and routinely nauseated. I've heard this from other mothers too. Love it.

I was introduced to this tea at a local restaurant and went absolutely crazy about it. Its unique flavor and healthifying blend of green and black teas and yerba mate, along with a light touch of ginger, is a wonderful thirst quencher.  As a tonic for health and energy, I now find myself drinking it daily instead of my usual afternoon coffee. It perks up the body and brain without the jittery effects of caffeine. I find I get a delightful pick-me-up later in the day--when I need it--without the negative affects of keeping me up at night.  While a tad expensive, I will continue to buy SPORtea and enjoy its delicious brew.  It is now a part of my every day routine.

JFG Instant has full flavor and is nice to keep around for one cup fixes. Decided to give it a try over the usuall expensive Euro brands of instant. Pleasantly surprized. The missing star is due to the higher bitterness but this may be desirable for some.

This product came old and stale. The candy bars where kind of melted then cooled back off. They where stuck to the packaging.I tried one and just put the rest in the garbage. Very disappointing. I gave it a one star only because zero stars was not an option.

column9: love and surprised by seeing these.
column10: I have always loved these, but haven't seen them since the 1970's. So I got a case, and they are a great hit, at room temperature or frozen, broken into pieces. I love finding nostalgic things like this.

I don't know how it happened but I have a son who isn't crazy about candy at all.  That is until he ran across the Charleston Chew Bars.  He loves the strawberry flavored ones.  I try and pick a few of these up for him when I am able to find them at the store.  Usually, the grocery stores only carry the vanilla flavored Charleston Chew Bars and then you can only get what they have on the shelf.  In my case it seems that there are only about two or three bars left.Finding the Strawberry Charleston Chew Bars here on Amazon.com made my day.  I was able to order my son a whole personal stash of his kind of candy.  Needless to say, Amazon.com and myself are heroes in my son's eyes.  Thanks so much Amazon.com.
Great, it was a long time before I was able to eat an arepa before. Thanks for the product I may order it more often!
Easy to use and cook with.  This is my second sack and I will be buying more as the need arises since I can't get it locally.

For anyone looking for a gluten free arepas flour: I bought this item because a lot of gluten free web sites recommend this as a gluten free product. The label on the product does say "may contain wheat". I called the company to make sure and they confirmed it is NOT gluten free.I rated this a two star not so much for the product as I am sure it is very good, but because there are a lot of gluten free web site claiming this is a safe product for those who cannot eat wheat.
It's a Venezuelan traditional product, it could be used to make arepas and empanadas... i dont know why it said is from Colombia..

column9: Natural Apricot Preserve Is Just Right
column10: My husband loves apricot preserves on his breakfast toast. But not just any apricot preserve. We used to buy apricot preserves from an Amish farming couple  in upstate New York, but they retired last year. A crisis, my husband tried 9 different jams. There was an lovely artisanal one from France but it was nearly twenty dollars a jar! Smuckers was a bargain and it is a decent honest product but a little too sweet for his taste.And then we found Harvest Song on Amazon! Although not cheap with a price halfway between the French jam and Smuckers. It is worth it, with its just right natural flavor, consistency and sunny color.
I love the Harvest Song Natural Preserves especially the Apricot and Fig Preserves.  It is a quality product and doesn't contain high fructose corn syrup.  I plan to buy the products again.

I think this is a good deal.  Delivery was quick.  The tea bags come with about 6 tablespoons of loose tea in each plastic bag, which I use to make two pitchers of tea. I just measure out half of the plastic bag and save the remaining 1/2 in a zip lock bag for the next pitcher.  I love the smooth tea taste.

I first tasted this tea at PF Chang's.  They showed me the box they used and I had ordered several times.  Unfortunately I haven't been able to locate the company since they closed their web site, was surprised and pleased to find it on Amazon.

column9: Fiesta Fria tastes great, packaging sucks!
column10: The product itself is tastes great, but I was extremely disappointed when a little box showed up and "brown stuff" was falling out of it! As I was opening the box lots of "dirt" like material kept falling out of the box and was getting everywhere.  Inside the box all of the plastic bags of loose tea where just crammed in there and where leaking the loose tea leaves all over the place. I can only imagine all of the tea that spilled out as it was shipped before it finally arrived at my house.
I was first introduced to this Ice Tea at P.F. Chang's. All I can say is FANTASTIC and REFRESHING.

column9: Want To Pay $31.51 Lb For Loose Tea That's Mediocre At Best?  Then Look No Further
column10: Holy cow, when I placed my order for 24 individual packets I assumed each packet would yield 1 gallon.  Wrong.  3 Quarts.  Apparently China Mist has taken a different course and screwed the customer out of that extra quart even though all the other brands that offer family size or filter pack tea bags the yield is always 1 gallon.And now for the math...1 box 24 ct China Mist shipped = $35.45.  18 gallon yield = $1.96 per gallon.  Price per pound loose tea = $31.51.  NEVER AGAIN.  First and last purchase I make with China Mist of Arizona.  Especially when their product is mediocre at best anyway.  Give WALTERS BAY & COMPANY a try people.  They make 4 flavors of iced tea and their price which includes shipping and is prime eligible is $30.75 and that buys you 96 1.o oz filter packs...NINETY SIX GALLONS OF TEA.Enough said.  China Mist good riddance.
Ordered Iced tea at a restaurant in Santa Rosa California (Equus) and fell in love with it.  Waiter brought me a sample packet and I ordered from Amazon.  Fantastic stuff.
If you enjoy tea, you'll love this product. If you have been to Panda or P.F. Chang's, this IS the tea. The aroma of the tea before brewing is very pleasing as well.

I made this purchase because my father and my husband love this tea when we go to PF Chang's. I thought it would make a nice father's day gift. The tea itself is ok, but it's packaged in plastic bags, not tea bags. After making it, you have to filter the whole thing. It's a bit of a hassle.

We love this tea, we drank so much that we burnt ourselves out on it and had to take a break. We are not back to loving this tea, but not drinking as much as often. I think it is the same tea they serve at Weber Grill.
First had this at the San Diego Zoo and it got my attention right away!  It's soooo good without being sweet!!  Hunted it down and bought a bunch, love this stuff!!

I use lots and lots of Italian seasoning in my general cooking.When I ran out of my last supply of dried Italian seasoning, I started looking around and found the prices to be totally ridiculous - that's even if I could find the stuff to begin with. After looking around various stores including the big-box stores and warehouse stores, I settled on buying this. There's a nice mix of the usual Italian flavored seasonings: oregano, marjoram, thyme, basil, rosemary and sage,  No MSG, no salt, no sugar and no stems/no seeds that we don't need.The product was fresh smelling, had a really nice aroma to it and has a pleasant taste that adds to the flavor of all types of foods.  It was exactly what I was looking for and at a reasonable price. It's on my amazon shopping list for next time I need it.

I always try to use fresh herbs, but I don't always have the foresight to have the right ones on hand so I keep an Italian herb blend around for just those occasions. The smell when you open the package is amazing and strong. These are very good quality herbs. I've tried them already in a few recipes to test them out and the flavor is excellent.

I use this very frequently in small quantities.  I add it to practically all my soups.  It isn't quite the gourmet quality some prefer, but I don't really care.  For me, the slight improvement is simply not worth the extra cost.  It has more oregano than some of it's competitors (e.g. McCormicks) which I really like.As they note, it really helps to crush the blend before using it (I use a small mortar and pestle) and it takes 15 - 20 minutes of cooking to get the full flavor.
I prefer to blend my own seasonings but where I live I no longer have the option. This was a good substitute for my spaghetti sauce. It's a larger jar than I expected, so this will last a long time.

Planters has been in the industry of peanuts and nuts for a long time that by now they got a very reliable product. These Peanuts do not disappoint. They are crunchy, flavorful and not oversalted (though probably they are?) but like I said they are nice to have around the house. I like to ground these peanuts to almost powder and mix them on some dishes and they never disappoint. Well deserved 4 Stars!

column9: Great peanuts with the perfect level of salt
column10: This is a six-pack of fairly tall cans of salted peanuts.  I find the level of salt on these perfect - not too much, but not too little either.  Planters also does a good job of keeping out the sins and shells.  Arrives in a shrink wrap six-pack and each can is vacum sealed.
These are great, fresh and tasty.  Very pleased with my order and shall continue to order.  I've ordered many items on subscribe and save and some were disappointing, but not these.

Peanuts are a great snack, wonderful in soups, salads, stir-fry, main dishes, with meat or just about anything one can imagine.  This is a great value and it isn't sweetened up with toffee, honey or any other product.  They're a great price and no meat products were used in their processing (including gelatin).  They are salted, but that's how I like them anyway.
I love these things.  Great for snacking.  Also great for cooking (chinese stir fry.)Highly recommended.

My husband loves Planters cocktail nuts.  He can tell the difference, and these are his afternoon snack most days.  Using a coupon savings from the Grocery section plus super saver shipping, Amazon recently ran these so that the net cost per can was $2.25.  This is very competitive with stores plus you have the convenience of having them delivered to your door.
I LOVE PEANUTS BUT THESE PEANUTS HAVE A WEIRD TASTE TO EM I DIDNT LIKE. LEFT A FUNNY OFF TASTE IN YOUR MOUTH AFTER U EAT A FEW. I WOULDN'T BUY THEM AGAIN..

Ok .. I live in the woods of Northern Minnesota.I have birds and squirrels and chipmunks that need feeding in the winter time.They really LOVE these nuts ....While yes I could buy cheaper nuts from the feed store, or other products, everyone else feeds corn and sunflowers.  So I think the animals need a break!And with Prime Time Shipping, I can easily replenish my stock when they eat me out of house and home!The nuts are a 'treat' that I use maybe once a week to supplement the bread and other commercial feeds during the winter of mega-snow!  I sometimes put them out during the summertime also.Call me crazy, but its kinda nice having animals on the deck enjoying themselves!

I have always enjoyed Planters nuts.Like John, I live in a wooded area,the hills of WV.I also feed animals: squirrels, birds,rabbits, foxes, coons, ground squirrels,stray cats & dogs, deer, occasionally, aneighbors horse gets loose, & only God knowswhat else is lurking in those woods.I teach my children to take care of animals.They have a purpose just as humans do.I also teach them that if a stray cat or dogcomes around, it is our responsibility to takecare of it.We are the only ones on this hill that will.Everyone else runs them off, throws things at them,shoots BB's or bullets at them. Besides, I live at the top.By the time they get here, they are in bad shape, sometimes wounded.I could never sit in my house & eat knowing astarving animal was right outside.I have given the squirrels nuts before.Deer bring their little ones around to showthem where the food is. They of course hidein the woods nearby. One time, a baby deer wasalone at the usual food spot, there wasn't any corn.He kept looking up at the house.I searched for something to give him. I found something.However, I came too close to him & he ran away. Later, Irealized that was stupid since I knew the mother was close.I was surprised she didn't come after me.A fox family was living here when I moved in.The fox was very brave, walking around my yardin daylight. I figured there was a pregnant fox.I was right. They left after the babies were bigenough to walk a distance. However, the babies cameback about a year later. I taught them thathumans could see them in the dark with a flashlight.I knew they were going up higher in the mountains &I knew hunters would be there. I also know that foxare not used for food, but as a trophy. I didn't thinkthey should give their life to hang on a wall.So, if John is crazy, so am I. Maybe even more so.
I had cancelled this ship and save order but it still came.not real happy.thanks anywayguess every order has to be triple checked when cancelled

column9: ideal product - tastes great & feels very beneficial + healthy ingredients
column10: I was scared to try this given many negative comments about various mangosteen juice options, but was pleasantly surprised to find it tastes great.  It's not too sweet which can be a drawback with some juices, and it has the added benefit of a slight tang to the taste (similar to  pineapple type fruits) which makes it more interesting than just plain sweet.Also, I liked that it has no added sweeteners & that it is a good blend of various health-supportive organic juices.  BEST OF ALL THOUGH, I've found over the years that when something is very beneficial, there's a way that my body responds immediately.  This is hard to describe but it's like my body can't wait to take it in & I can feel an immediate beneficial impact regardless of my personal thoughts or biases or taste preferences.  FYI I TRIED & DID NOT LIKE THE Dynamic Health Organic Certified Maqui Juice Blend with Pomegranate, Acai & Mangosteen, 33.8-Ounce - both the taste & the feel of it made me not want to drink it (like my body actually recoils from it) unlike this Now blend where I can't wait to drink more.  I'm not sure why the difference, but I did notice that the Dynamic Health juices were mostly from reconstituted powder so it could be something to do with the processing involved.As I take & have been trying out various products, it's hard to tell what specific improvements this juice resulted in, but overall I've been feeling great & with good energy & better able to handle some detoxification challenges & I think this has contributed to all that.  The other item I tried recently that I've found is making a big difference despite my having noticed no difference from many previously tried forms of B12 including methylcobalamin is Source Naturals Advanced B-12 Complex, 60 Tablets.  It is more expensive than basic B12 but this specially formulated combination truly seems to make a huge difference so it's another product I'm very glad I tried.  As a lacto-vegetarian (i.e. I eat dairy but no other animal products of any kind including no eggs), good B12 supplementation might be more important in my case but I did hear on the Dr. Oz show that a scarily large % of the population is being found to be deficient in B12.  As this is such a key nutrient, I'm extra glad the Dr. Oz information prompted me to try this B12 out as it clearly makes a huge difference whenever I take it despite thinking I'd already more than covered my bases by supplementing with good multi-vitamins & extra B complex for many years now & so should be getting more than enough B12.So, based on my experience, if budget is an issue, I'd first prioritize making sure your key nutrients are first well covered as that's likely to be more important.  However, if you can also try this juice, I hope you enjoy it as much as I do as it always feels like the ultimate treat thanks to bringing health benefits in a very enjoyable & easily accessible way.  But before I take it, I drink 1 teaspoon of psyllium seed husk in some water as a quick way of adding some fiber to slow down the blood sugar impact of the fruit juices, which is also why I at the time eat 3 teaspoons of sunflower seeds + some Greek yogurt (both also recommended by Dr. Oz), which I further supplement with some protein powder when I have time (again more important because of my vegetarian diet).  I find this combination works ideally as a quick & easy way to start my day with some good all-around nutrition so as to give me time to later put together a healthy meal without excessive hunger skewing my food preferences.  Note that until I found this juice, I rarely drank juices as I figured fresh fruit was usually healthier than juices that can't be immediately consumed upon juicing.  So it's only because this juice combination feels & tastes so good while making a powerful set of rarer fruits easily available to us in an organic & healthy form that I found it worth adding despite the relatively high cost.
More of a real "marshmallow" flavor than Jet Puffed. Great for making fudge (terrific recipe on package) as ice cream topping or Rice Krispy treats. Highly recommended!
Can't seem to find any of the original squirrel nuts lately.  But these are good anyways.  These seem to be a cross between the original squirrel nuts and mary janes.

I used this vanilla bean to make vanilla-infused coconut oil. My project turned out great! The vanilla-infused coconut oil was a lovely cream/off-white color with small brown speck and a wonderful vanilla aroma. It worked wonderfully as a body moisturizer. I'd definitely buy from this seller again.
I bought this for a trial run with my new meat grinder and it was excellent! It took a total of two days for shipping and the price was great, too!

I first tried these candies when my Japanese pen-pal sent them to me in grade school (because my name is Chelsea). I was so excited when I found them online. They tasted as good as I remember, and I received my package in 4 days! I will definitely order from this seller again.

Meiji Chelsea butter scotch is always my favorite. I finished the two little boxes of butter scotch I bought from Uwajimaya in two weeks. This is the first time I try the other two flavors and they both taste good. :)

column9: Tangerine are great; watermelon are better!
column10: These are DELICIOUS! They remind me a lot of Wonka Jaw Breakers as far as taste, but they are soft and powdery instead of hard. I prefer them over conventional candy and while they are obviously a bit more expensive they are worth every penny and you don't get that nasty sugar rush then crash that you get with conventional candies. Enjoy!! They're great!

column9: perfect for times when craving sweets!
column10: These are really yummy, and I have a major sweet tooth problem! These are snacks I can go to when a piece of fruit just won't cut it, but they totally satisfy that craving for a sweet or dessert. I am not sure why you would criticize them for being sweet, i mean the title is Cinnamon Danish after all? Of course its sweet, I think that is the point. If you just want a cereal bar Healthy valley has plain old fruit filled cereal bars too, I think of this as a healthy alternative to candy bars or reaching for cookies during my day. Highly recommend them for those trying to live a healthy life, but just need some sweets too!

column9: A perfect sweet snack with coffee or tea
column10: I consider these bars to be in the same category as store bought packaged cakes as they taste fresh baked, but without the typical trans fat and unappealing artificial ingredients.  They taste great with plenty of cinnamon flavor and a soft and creamy texture.  Much better than a crunchy granola bar or hard sandwich cookie.  I can't find this flavor of Health Valley bar in stores and it is definitely the best, though the vanilla creme-filled chocolate ones are tasty too.  So I ordered a case through Amazon and sent them to my office address so I can enjoy them in the morning with a cup of coffee or tea.  They are a light and healthy alternative to the tempting snacks at my local bakery or coffee shop (which I purchase from time to time) and keep for months so you can store a box at your desk and enjoy them when you have a sugar craving.  I hope Health Valley doesn't stop making them as I only can find them for sale here online.

column9: Not quite what I was hoping for...
column10: These are fine, but I didn't find them wonderful. They made a nice snack mid-day with coffee, but were way too sweet on their own. They also had a slight chemical aftertaste, though I did get used to that by the end (not sure if that's a good thing or not).I wound up giving away most of the boxes to friends who felt about the same--they're not *awful*, but they're not something that I'd repurchase. The texture's a bit grainy, and the bars themselves didn't have much flavor (it was the frosting middle that was so sweet).Instead of picking them up in quantity, I'd start buying just one box to see if you like them first--they're a great price here, but it's a lot of bars to have to eat if you decide they're not for you!Also, I did find they tasted much better if I popped them in the toaster oven for a bit--I wouldn't microwave them. I still wouldn't repurchase, but they were better warm.

Health Valley Cafe Creations - Cinnamon Danish are a tasty treat to keep on hand.  They make a great morning or afternoon snack while at your desk; and if you are following Weight Watchers, each bar is only 2 points!  If you like the taste of cinnamon, and you crave sweets, you will enjoy these bars.

I have one of these every morning on my way to work. They have a great flavor and are just enough to tide me over until my breakfast break. I was a little hesitant to buy so many after never trying them, but I'm glad that I did. I ordered these and their French Vanilla Yogurt bars and was very pleased with both. I also like that they're organic and don't have a lot of the added chemicals and preservatives that other cereal bars do. I would definitely order these again.

column9: Okay if you like this type of thing....
column10: I wanted to add a review since, while these aren't a bad product, I don't particularly care for them.  There may be others who are helped by my description of the product.These are neither pastry-like or cookie-like.  I would describe them as similar to a very thin, soft Fig Newton in consistency, and somewhat similar in flavor as well, except instead of "fig" these have quite a lot of cinnamon flavor (very good) and a nondescript "creme" filling (meh).While I appreciated the courageous use of lots of cinnamon in these, overall I find them far too sweet (and I like sweets) and lacking in appealing texture and flavor really otherwise.On the plus side, if you like these sorts of "bar" snacks, these are healthier versions than some.

This is my husband's favorite mid-morning snack.  It is very hard to find in the local stores ... but when we've found it, the price ranges from $3.79 per box and higher.  It wonderful to be able to buy this in bulk (we usually get 2 orders of the 6 packs of 6) and also get free shipping, so it is less expensive.  It was delivered in less than a week.

I really like these bars, mine looked just like the picture on the box.  Many reviews I read talked about a cream filling but mine only had the cinnamon filling.  They are very good and perfect in the morning.

The nutrition information is entirely inaccurate.  I ordered these based on the nutrition information; Amazon did refund my money and I gave the bars to my local food bank.  I hear they were very good in taste, but with a restricted diet, there was no way I could chance trying them.  They did arrive on time and were packaged well, however.

Wow, this stuff has a zing to it. You have to taste it yourself to see what I mean. If you care about some thoughtful balance of protein and calories, which is easily achievable in a product like this, you'll have to look elsewhere. There is something downright malicious in the recipe for this confection and its insistence on sources of empty calories and borderline objectionable food products. The best you can say for it is that it isn't immediately harmfull.Oh yes, the product package implores the shipper to keep it below 70 degrees F, "because it is natural". As you will find out, this is a signal for shippers to ignore any precautions, since refrigerated trucks don't occur on most shipping company routes.

column9: Why does Health Valley use such misleading photos?  See my pic up top
column10: This is not the only Health Valley product to show a photo on the box that differs considerably from the actual product.  They did this with Health Valley Cobbler Cereal Bars, Apple, 6-Count 7.9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6), too.  (I've also posted a photo and review of the apple bars.)  Their chocolate bars differ, too, although not to the same extent as these other two.The photo on the box of the Cinnamon Danish bar certainly LOOKS delicious, with a seemingly thick, juicy filling.  As you can see from my photo, the actual filling is a thin layer of a beige, sticky, and overly sweet substance.  Another reviewer described it as resembling school paste, and I can't think of a better way to describe it.  A better name for these bars might be "Sugar Danish" because the sweet taste is so much more pronounced than the cinnamon.I followed other reviewers' recommendation to heat these up prior to eating.  I would recommend a toaster oven, rather than a toaster, because it tends to become very "floppy" when it's warmed, and it breaks apart in the toaster.
These are great morning treats! The filling layer is very thin, I wish it had a bit more. I totally recommend these for your sweet tooth fix.

column9: Tasty, but a bit too sweet and very flimsy when warm.
column10: I decided to take a break from the organic chocolate tarts I've been enjoying and try the cinnamon danish.  While they do taste pretty good, they are a bit too sweet for me (and I actually like sweet things, so that says a lot), and when put in a toaster, become almost impossible to get out of the toaster, because they lose their rigidity and basically fold over and become a bit of a mess.  I'll try some other flavors, but that's it for me on the cinnamon.

Health Valley Cafe Creations, Cinnamon Danish Bar, 6-Count 8.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)I have become a member of Amazon's Subscribe and Save Plan and have ordered several different low cal foods through this plan. This item is one of the low cal snacks that I received and would re order again. These very tasty cinnamon danish bars are perfect when I am in the mood for something sweet without having to worry about weight gain. The hard part is not eating all of them at once, but since I am used to dieting I am able to savor one bar at a time a few times a week.  They taste very much like a cinnamon danish.  However, the consistency is not at all like that of a danish. They are somewhat chewy and yet soft and creamy.  I know this sounds contradictory but they do have an unusual and delicious slight amount of chewiness which does add a degree of eating something more substantial then your ordinary low cal thin pastry snack. Obviously cinnamon is the predominant flavor and if you are not a fan then these are not for you. I am very happy I found these on Amazon.  They are a welcome change from the low cal snack cakes I am used to. They are great by themselves or with a beverage. So if you are a fan of the flavor of cinnamon and are watching your calories, try them. Your taste buds will thank you.
Delicious way to get 50% of your selenium (not often added in quantity and very important nutrient for men).

It's a nice change-of-pace for a snack to go with your mid-day coffee break, and isn't overly caloric. But don't expect the filling to remind you of those wonderful Hostess products. It tastes okay, but has the consistency of school paste.
These taste very decadent even though they aren't. The only danger with getting the 6 boxes is that they are so good the temptation is to eat too many.
These bars are rather different from the run of the mill, fresh, tasty and enjoyable. Price is right.
These  Cinnamon Danish bars are AWESOME. All natural and delicious, could you ask for more??

My husband won a basket of dog treats at a raffle. Most were too big for our little 7lb Chihuahua mix, but she works on them anyway. :) The Merrick sticks weren't too stinky or greasy (pig ears are way worse) and our pup works on them forever. I didn't know they were so pricey, but reading the reviews of the other brands, you must be paying for quality. I'm going to bite the bullet and order some of these 6" sticks for her now. At least I know they last more than a few hours and will be worth the money!

I have a very small Papillon who's not quite 2 yet.  He loves chewing on bully sticks and he likes Merrick the best.  I have given him some non Merrick bully sticks that just lie around half chewed.  The Merrick sticks get chewed up to a little nubbin that I throw away when he's not looking.  They do stink like a dead animal or something.  It's really bad but it keeps him out of trouble.  I gave him these to chew on as soon as I got him at 4 mos. and he has never chewed on any furniture or other objects.  I also noticed that if he doesn't have one to chew on he starts licking his paws and I'm afraid he could lick a bare spot.  These keep him occupied so he doesn't do stuff like that.

column9: My yorkie loves Merrick Bully Sticks
column10: I gave my yorkie puppy his Merrick Bully Stick and he chewed on it for HOURS, which I love because it freed up some time for me to relax without having my puppy running around destroying everything in my house!Merrick bully sticks are great for puppies and adult dogs.  I have purchased other brand bully sticks and my dog prefers these far more than other brands.  The only thing is that Merrick stick tend to have a stronger odor in comparison to other brands, however, the smell reminds me of really strong smokey beef jerky (doesn't bother me).  I've heard others complain that Merrick bully sticks smell really stinky so they won't buy them for their dogs.  I guess it depends how sensitive you are to strong odors.  I love the bully sticks because they keep my puppy occupied and it helps him with his teething.  It's definitely worth purchasing if you're having chewing/biting issues with your puppy or need something to keep it entertained.
These were too hard for my old (16yr old) lab to enjoy.  Best for young dogs that like to chew.
I bought this for a trial run with my new meat grinder and it was excellent! It took a total of two days for shipping and the price was great, too!

column9: Gefen Sweet and Hot Relish  Yummy
column10: Delicious not too sweet and not too hot.  I have been putting in on everything.  Very Good.  This pack of 6 will take us a little bit time to use, but I would not hesitate on buying more.

column9: OK if you like sour almond syrup
column10: I bought this product, remembering the sweet almond taste of the Orzata beverage.  To my surprise, the sour taste of the added citric acid was strong enough to make the overall flavor tart instead of sweet.  Compare the ingredients in Ferrara Almond Orzatata Syrup to the ingredients of Monin Almond Syrup, and the difference is obvious.Ferrara:  sugar, water, almond extract, citric acid, artificial color, 1/10th of 1% sodium benzoate(as preservative)Monin: Pure cane sugar, water, natural almond flavorI rest my case.

column9: Great taste, a couple of drawbacks
column10: I recently tested three orgeats available on Amazon, including this one, Monin, and Teisseire. I tried each one in a variety of cocktails. Ferrara and Monin both beat Teisseire by a long shot, and were more or less equal in terms of taste. I have to deduct some points for Ferrara because it contains preservatives and comes in a plastic bottle, rather than glass. But it is a very close second. Recommended, especially given its lower price.
If you like almonds, you'll love this syrup.  I discover new food uses for it regularly and am frequently pleasantly surprised.
My cat loves weruva, this cat food was recommended to me by a vet. I like that my cat has so many different flavor choices- I think it is healthy for her.

My cat loves this food. Contains white meat shredded chicken in broth -no grains, no vegetables. Also, it is BPA free.A little pricey and contains a fair amount of broth- but the quality seems much better than other cat foods and the extra liquid has been good in the hot summer weather. He likes most food from Weruva- but this seems to be his favorite.  Worth the extra cost.
I have 5 picky eaters. They seldom agree on any one food but dove right in as soon as this was offered & scraped the bowls clean. Expensive, yes, but no waste. Not a morsel.

column9: Need magnifying glass to find liver.
column10: Finally, a canned cat food that the kitties are eating (at least for now, with a few vitamins & minerals. And this brand won't end up in the dog bowls! But I am hard pressed to find the chunks of liver - very skimpy - which is really O.K. because the cats leave what few itty bitty pieces that ARE in the can behind (3 Star for deceptive liver chunks/ 5 Star for chicken breast).  Looks almost as pictured, except for liver chunks.  I also bought the plain chicken from same company & will just go with that and rate a 5-STAR.  If your kitties LOVE cooked liver, you won't find enough in this recipe to satisfy their hunger - unless they eat all of the chicken too, which you probably wouldn't buy if cat didn't like chicken.  I am just so happy to transit the dry food & salty canned chicken addicted cat to a wet food to save on the kidneys. I do have one cat that loves raw liver & chicken, but I like to take a day off from adding vitamins and messing with raw meat (cutting, etc) so this is going to work out, it appears; hopefully for awhile - though one never knows with kitties.  Great today - terrible tomorrow!

column9: Cats love it, but I wish it was cheaper.
column10: My boys love this food. They split a can every morning and are always super excited to get it. They've tried most of the varieties, but the "Paw Lickin' Chicken" is their favorite.
Tried the steak frites and the 9 liver...both cats will eat the steak without hesitation, the nine liver chicken is a different story...thanks amazon for standing by your products...
It is a very nice, juicy cat food with chunks of mackerel, and it's grain free.  The new formular has pumpkin in it, and my cat really likes it.

My fussy cat licks the bowl dry with this product.  Weruva uses quality ingredients and no fillers which pleases me.  Amazon ships a case which is good because my stores can't seem to keep this on their shelves.

column9: Good food that the kids love!
column10: Grain free, human quality ingredients, no fillers and the kids love it.  Good healthy food doesn't mean much if it doesn't get eaten, so the fact that both of our kitties lick their bowls clean mean a lot.Weruva gets consistent top ratings for grain free, natural products.  We've experimented with all favors of Weruva.  This and Paw Lickin Chicken are their favorites.Our local pet store offers a "buy 3 get the 4th free" deal and a buy-by-the-case discount. The price here on Amazon beats both promos by several dollars.  It's not a huge dollar savings, but the fact that it's delivered right to my door adds time and gas savings too.Happy kitties, healthy kitties, time, gas and $ savings makes for happy humans too.

I'm pretty picky about what my cats are fed.  While I have never eaten it myself - my clan of 4 all approve this flavor of Weruva.  My only real problem with it is that the calorie count per can is very low compared to other brands.  This food is pretty pricey anyway and it takes a lot of it to fill them up.  I wish the water content wasn't so high or they calorie content was better so I felt I was getting more value for the money I am spending on this food.

This is the best canned food I have ever purchased!  My cats love it and race to their dishes with this food.  The food itself appears very fresh and healthy, it is appetizing and even smells good compared to most other canned foods.  I will admit that I thought the picture of the food didn't look too appetizing, but it is the complete opposite when you see the quality of this food.

We have two picky cats - Calie & Dylan - and have tried most of the grain-free foods available. Funky Chunky is the one that they will eat. Dylan chomps it down while Calie is still picky with it, but at least she will eat it where she and her brother won't touch the others.
Cats seem to love this.  Looks and smells like chicken people would eat.Thanks you for a great product.  Worth the price.

column9: Your cats will love it and it's good for them
column10: After some health problems with our cats we switched over to a more natural diet.  This was the transitional food.  It is made with quality products no fillers or junk you can get in most other cat foods.  The only reason I give it 4 stars is the price.  Our cast love it and can be picky eaters.  You can't find it in local stores and prime shipping is a great deal.

My cat loves this stuff, and it even looks appetizing to me (not surprising, since its made in a "human food facility"). No animal byproducts, grain-free, BPA-free packaging, made from Mackerel (a safe and sustainable seafood choice, unlike most Tuna), and reasonably priced (especially the larger 5.5 ounce cans)... What more could you want? Seriously, this is as good a choice for wet cat food as I've seen anywhere.BTW, for dry, I strongly recommend Acana Grasslands Grain-Free Dry Cat Food, .88lb (Trial Size). (Check out the samplers, and look for other flavors and sizes from Acana on Amazon and elsewhere.)
The cats love this flavor. Finding cat food they ALL (currently 5) agree is tasty, is quite an accomplishment in this house.

We adopted a 2 year old / 12 pound Russian Blue male from the shelter 3 months ago. We wanted to start him on the best healthy diet of a wet and dry food regimen we could. We tried many brands of canned food including Blue Wilderness, Tiki Cat and Instinct; all of which left unfavorable results. We then moved on to Weruva and my Blue Boy can't get enough! He especially loves the chicken flavors. He's now a happy active cat with the shiniest coat of fur east of the Mississippi.
I have finicky cats and they seem to like this stuff 80% of the time.  They actually like the chicken flavor the best.

i was a skeptic of this product when i first met the rep in my pet store a few years back because they'll tell you anything to push a sale. "human grade this", "super-luxe that", and so on. out of curiosity, i picked up a few cans at a different pet store in the area to test it out.my. cat. LOVED. them.every morsel, licked clean from the bowl. this price offered online is an exceptionally good bargain: 36.92 for a 24-can case gives you a deal of just over $1.50 per 5.5 oz can. i've never seen it for less than $1.99 in stores with the average being around $2.50/can. the quality of this product is simply unbeatable, period. the moisture content is great for weight management, urinary tract and dental health. the meat quality is absolutely unbeatable compared to any canned food i've ever seen. the best part is the SMELL - delicious! it smells just like canned soup for people to eat. it doesn't smell anything like cheap, canned cat food... because it isn't.do yourself and your cat a favor. buy this product and lots of it.
This is my cat's favorite food.  Also, if I were forced to eat cat food, I would choose Weruva, because it looks like REAL FOOD.  A bit pricey but once and awhile I like to treat my cat to the best!

The Weruva cat food, Mack and Jack from Amazon smells good enough for humans,  we envy our 2 cats their food! :D  The cats bury their little noses in the can and just love their food.  Thank you.  Cece in the U.P.

After trying Wellness, Innova and other grain free wet cat foods this one takes the prize! My cat would not eat the Wellness or Innova but LOVES this Paw Lickin Chicken and cleans the bowl! I highly recommend this nutritious food.

A nice surprise: it looks good, it attracted the cat the moment I opened the first can and it appears to taste soooo good, cause my Fatty licked the bowl clean and then decided to ask me to recommend it to all the cats. Only BFF with tuna made such a great impression on him!

just received my case of this food after reviewing many other types. I wanted something that was organic and healthy for my two cats,instead of taking them to the vet all the time..They absolutely LOVE this food,plenty of juice and meat. One 5.5 oz can feeds them both heartily and they lick the dish clean. I started them on an organic holistic dry food over a month ago and I see a big change in their coats,so shiny and soft. I believe that the added expense should keep them overall much healthier and happy...

Weruva is the best food around, and I feed it to all my cats (including the three ferals that live outside - they need good nutrition too)! In case of an emergency, I'd eat it myself (but probably add a little salt). Thank you for making a great food!

My cat likes Mideast Feast and Asian Fusion. He's not so crazy for the chicken or Marbella Paella, but I think it's more that he doesn't like non-fish and doesn't like shellfish.This stuff might be a bit expensive but I see it this way:With the wet food I used to buy, if I didn't take care and left some in my sink or garbage can for more than a few days, there will be small flies that emerged from it. With all the Weruva stuff, I've left some remnants out in my sink for a week and no flies. I really think the cheaper, more available wet cat food has something wrong with it to be spawning flies so quickly.
Product looks nutritious, but my two cats refused to eat it.  I purchased the chicken version and one cat flat out wouldn't go near it and the other would only lick the juice.

column9: Best wet food I've ever purchased!
column10: I have 2 super-picky older cats (13 & 9).  I've tried so many options, but this is the first one where the CLEAN the bowl.  I've tried every flavor of Weruva on them, and the plain chicken is by far their favorite.  They like the other chicken varieties but for some reason there are peas, carrots, and pumpkin in it, all of which they strategically eat around.  They both can't stand fish, so chicken it is!Being meat and gravy in it's almost purest form, it definitely has a positive impact on their health.  Their fur is shinier and softer.  And they seem more happy and playful.I never used to believe a food upgrade could make such a difference, but this certainly did!!

This food is a hit!The cat likes it because it's got chunks of shredded meat in gravy.  He won't eat ground or pate-style foods, so the shredded meat in this one is a winner.I like it because, for one thing, it's grain-free.  To my mind, if you could only pick one quality to shop for, grain-free would be it; carbohydrates - and particularly grains! - are not good for cats.  It's very high in protein, which *is* good for cats.  It contains pumpkin, and while that is a carbohydrate, it's supposed to be good for their tummies.  I'm also pleased that it contains duck meat, since I like to rotate my cat's protein sources to take advantage of their differing nutritional profiles.  And finally, it's got plenty of gravy to help my cat stay hydrated; cats are built to take in much of their fluid from their food sources, so feeding dry food exclusively can dehydrate them (and possibly lead to urinary crystals).True, it's expensive.  Even for higher-end cat foods, it's expensive.  But if you'd ever had a cat develop diabetes because of an improper diet (i.e. dry foods high in carbs and too low in animal-based proteins) - or any other condition brought on by a poor diet - you'd agree that a little expense up front is way cheaper in the long run than treating the health condition.  The fact that I'm still giving it five stars should tell you something.  Not that I don't recommend shopping around for deals!)Give this food a shot.  It's a very healthful choice.

Freddie loved it!  And the little bit that he left behind, Rufus (a dog) gobbled up.  I think the reason that cats love this, aside from the taste, is that it is nice and wet and mushy.  Will buy again!

My cats like this flavor of Weruva best, out of all the ones I have brought to them.  However, I can't seem to find any made in the USA, as it once was...which is a bit of a downer.  I can only find it made in Thailand.

Paw Lickin' Chicken is a big favorite with my cats. It's amazing stuff. Looks good enough to put on a crossiant!I use it in rotation with other Weruvas and other brands. When I first served this, my cats ate it like little crazies. Having seen the euphoria, I went out and bought more cans of PLC. I served it all the time and suddenly there was no interest. My epic fail. Too much, too often, equals wasted uneaten cans.I place Weruva's Paw Lickin Chicken on reserve, serving it 2X total (breakfast and dinner) per week, due to the high cost hence one less star in my review.

column9: How do I get cooking like this at home?
column10: Seriously, this stuff actually looks like something humans could eat.  When you open the can, it looks and smells like real (canned) food, not pressed and formed mystery meat or worse, meat paste.  Gluten-free, which has helped reduce the amount of cat barf left in random places or hidden behind couches, etc.  We buy two or three varieties at a time and rotate it through so the cats don't get bored with it.  Pricey, but definitely worth it!

column9: Only Food the Babies will Eat!
column10: I first discovered this product at a local pet food store. Bella and Dora, our adopted kittens, were suffering from a respitory cold that they had picked up from the shelter and were not eating any food.The girl at the shop was really cool and introduced us to the Weruva line of food as well as other brands. I was interested to find out that the owners of Weruva are somehow related to the company that produces all the tuna for Subway Sandwiches. I guess the husband/wife team had cats and were dissapointed to find low quality soft food in the market, and asked to find out what it would take to be able to use the same facilities. They found out that as long as they produced human grade food, they could use the facility. Anyways, we bought a whole bunch of flavors to see what they would like, and ultimately this is the only one that they always finish!I like that you can tell that it is fish, and not some mushed up by product. It smells very fishy, so if that makes you sick just be aware!Hope your kitties love it as much as ours do!!!

column9: Weruva is top quality and this flavor is *MY* cats' favorite
column10: I've tried many different vendors and varieties of canned cat food and this is the favorite for *my* cats' (two of them) by a long shot.  *Your* cats may not like it.  Cats are very finicky!My advice to any reader is to learn about quality pet food (take an hour or two on the web, there's plenty of material to read) and then shop for top quality pet food only (Weruva qualifies in my opinion) and try a small sample until you find a set that YOUR cat likes. Rotate here and there for variety... if your cat likes variety, that is.  Both of my cats hate fish, love poultry and pork, and will tolerate other meats such as beef and lamb, and they both like a little variety.I wish I had fed my cats canned or even raw food from early on but I made the mistake of listening to an indoctrinated vet and fed them "prescription grade" Hill's Science Diet kibble which is total crap as I have come to learn from my own research. Like most doctors with humans and the pharmaceutical companies, many vets become distributors for pet food vendors for financial reasons and won't recommend something that doesn't make them money.I now feed my cats this Weruva flavor and a couple of other quality canned cat foods (they don't care for any other Weruva flavor, by the way) plus a couple of quality kibble brands (high protein, grain-free - no corn, wheat, or soy).

column9: The only food my cats will eat
column10: This is the best cat food on the market, as far as I'm concerned.  All three of my cats gobble it up every day, week after week, month after month.  It's pure white meat chicken breast, shredded, in broth.  The vet recommended it for all of my cats, who have different medical issues.  They love it.  Unfortunately the price has gone up twice since I started buying it. It used to be $32/case, then it went to $35/case, now it's at $37/case.  That's a 15% increase over the past six months.  However, shipping is free, and I order 4 or 5 cases at a time.  They arrive promptly, and I never run out.

My cat is somewhat picky eater, so I was a bit nervous about ordering a 24 pack of this can food. The delivery came quickly, and I served the can. Boy my cat loved the food so much, he licked the bowl clean and asked for more.The food looks like it's made with chicken breast and broth only - no fillers.I've gone though about 16 cans now and my cat still loves this food best.BTW his second favorite is "Asian Fusion". Also from the same brand.
