My 15 year old daughter that doesn't have Celiac disease is always saying that she likes his pretzels more than the regular ones.
Gluten free food can be good or bad.  These are good.

column9: Just as good as regular pretzels
column10: I've been a pretzel fan for a long time, and these are definitely the equal of any pretzels one might find in any supermarket.  Given that they're made without gluten, that's quite an accomplishment. I'd have preferred a bit more salt, but most people with a healthy diet will probably appreciate them more as they are.

These are the best gluten free pretzels. I have tried them all and these are great. They taste like real pretzels and there isn't any after taste. I buy them from amazon by the case you can't beat it.

These taste very similar to the real thing to me. The only difference is the crunch.. you can't hear a thing while eating them except for the crunch, crunch, crunching going on in your mouth. LOL The price on Amazon seems high, but they were $3.99 a bag in our cheapest local store, just 8 bags at the $3.99 would equal amazons price for 20. Great deal!

I actually got these by mistake; I'd meant to order the sesame pretzels by Ener-G.  Was bummed when I opened the box...until I tried one. Now I'm just glad (sort of) that I'm near the end of the case, because the darned things are addictive! Nice crisp crunch to them, they actually have detectable salt flavor (unlike the sesame pretzels, which I have to add salt--pretzels gotta have a little salt). I  think they're better than plain old wheat pretzels, to the extent that I remember what those taste like.another tasty snack to add to the GF arsenal of munchies!
I've served these to folk who eat gluten and they love 'em too.  The only difference from wheat pretzels is that these have less salt--which is a good thing for some of us;)

These are terrific pretzels. We found them when my son was first diagnosed, and they have been a lifesaver. We can take them anywhere for a snack, and I love to eat them, too. He used to keep them at school for when they would give out snacks. My co-worker was just diagnosed, and now loves these, too. I would highly recommend these pretzels--they're yummy!

column9: As good as pretzes with gluten
column10: I got these today and was ready for them to taste funny like many other gluten free products, but they are great! The taste and the texture are both very good.

My daughter was diagnosed with Celiac disease recently.  These were a great substitute for the other pretzels she can no longer have.  My son really likes them too.  My biggest complaint is the price.  Better to buy in bulk on Amazon.com rather than in stores.
These are some of the best pretzels!  And, with the added sesame seeds, it makes them all that much better!  The sesame seeds really add a lot to the flavor.  Add a little dip, and WAHOO!!
These pretzels are absolutely delicious!  In fact, EVERYTHING from Ener-G foods is usually great.  They're a little pricey, but so worth it if you have to avoid wheat and gluten.

My daughter can't metabolize protein correctly and her special  nutritionist has provided these pretzels and other low protein foods.  These are BY FAR her favorite!  I shared them with a lady at church on a glutein free diet and she likes them too.  A warning about other Ener-g foods though, they are not typically her favorite brand.
Was not disappointed in this product. Taste good and not too salty and provide a good crunch. I would recommend to others.
These satisfy my salty craving. I like that they are in single serving packages. It makes them easy to throw in my purse or the diaper bag. They have a buttery flavor that my two year old and I love.

These are the best pretzels around. I have even crushed them up and used them in place of breadcrumbs. The sesame seeds give them a nice flavor. I dip them in pineapple yogurt for a nice crunchy treat  They are my husbands favorite and he's not gluten free.

These are so flavorful.... All ages love these pretzels.... We don't need to eat gluten free but buy these anyway because the family loves their flavor! Amazon does a great job stocking and shipping them too.

I really enjoyed these sesame pretzel rings. Ever since I was diagnosed with Celiac Disease and went gluten free I searched for pretzels that were easy to chew and tasted good. I tried many brands and most were not very good. These pretzels are tasty and easy to chew.After I am finished with the pretzels there is always some salt and sesame seeds left in the bottom of the bag. I use these to sprinkle on my salad and also other uses.

My kids who are on a GF diet loves these.  My daughter who isn't on a GF diet says they taste better than wheat pretzels.  I'm not a pretzel lover myself, but I do ocassionally like to eat these.  I divide them into 3 baggies to cut down on the calories.
I love these pretzels.  I don't like a lot of salt and I love sesame seeds.  It taste like the bread sticks they have at resturants.
Husband has celiac and loves these pretzels.  We keep them on hand at all times.  Love the size...nice for grabbing for on the go.

These are positively addictive.  If I ever cancel my ongoing re-order from Amazon, I will have to go into rehab.  There is absolutely no diffenence in taste or texture from wheat based pretzels.  If you miss a salty crunchy snack, this is Nervana.

column9: They taste just like wheat pretzels
column10: I love these pretzels. They taste crunchy, fresh, and are gluten-free! Keep making them, Israel. Thanks. :)
Great little pretzels, perfect snack size bags. I keep a bag beside my computer for munching, and my great-granddaughter takes them to school in her lunch!

I had high hopes for these, based on the other reviews. I wanted to like them but I really don't, nor do my husband or son. To us they taste nothing like "real" pretzels, and are definitely not worth the calories, fat, or price. I know that this is because they lack the gluten, but they aren't very crunchy, more like crisp, since they aren't dense at all. They also have a funky, sort of metallic aftertaste.
These are the pretzels I buy. They are a good, crisp, salty snack and the serving size is generous so you get to eat more!

My 4 years old daughter loves them. The package is really convenient to keep the product's freshness intact. I love to pack it in her lunch box and with peanut butter on the side, it becomes a very nutrient snack.

The cost on these has gone up since I first bought them some 12 years ago. Despite the cost, they are a good deal for anyone who can't eat wheat or gluten.  They taste delicious, and as several others have noted, are just as good, if not better than regular pretzels.  It's hard for me to find these even in the Twin Cities, so I will very happily be buying them through Amazon.  I have tried and used many Ener-G brand products over the years.  These are among the best.  I find their breads dry, tasteless, and unappealing in the extreme, but the pretzels  are awesome.  Other brands have an off taste, but not these.  They are wonderful and I will buy them frequently. Even my gluten eating family enjoys these, so I hide them!  They can eat their own.

column9: I like them better than regular pretzels

My husband thinks these taste EXACTLY like "normal" pretzels, and he is NOT on a wheat/gluten-free diet.They are great to have in a mixed house since everyone can enjoy them.  This size of bag is perfect for two people to share during a movie or car trip.  I find they are DIVINE when dipped into GF chocolate and set aside to cool -- better than Flips!  I think kids would love them too.These are one of the items I can have that really taste like one old wheat ones I was used to enjoying.  Highly recommend!

column9: You Don't  Have To Give Up Pretzels
column10: Delicious alternative pretzel for those who cannot eat wheat with just the right amount of crunch and salt.
These pretzels take just like "normal" wheat pretzels.  They are crisp and just the right amount of salt.  Would like them more if they were organic and less expensive.

column9: Taste is Equal to a wheat flour pretzel, but better!
column10: I really like these pretzels.  My husband has to eat gluten free because of a wheat allergy, but I do not.  However, I enjoy adding this to a chex mix.  Wonderful product!

These are great as a healthy snack. I find them quite tasty, but I do not like the ones without the sesame seeds! Easy to throw in a lunchbox and better than 99% (if not 100%) of what's in most vending machines when you want (need?) something a little salty and gluten free.

The only reason I'd rate these pretzels with four stars is due to the somewhat high fat content, most likely due the the second ingredient listed being palm oil. However, the low protein in these pretzels is a positive for those diagnosed with chronic kidney conditions.I will order again!
These taste as good as regular pretzels, and since they are hard to find in our local stores, it's nice to be able to stock up with Amazon.com.

I just love these pretzels. They are a great snack from the ordinary gluten-free diet. I was a counselor at camp this summer and one of the kids wanted to try what I was eating. I told her she may not like it; it was my special food. The next day she came back to me and said, "Where's your pretzels? I want more! Can you go buy me some? I will give you some of my allowance if I can have more of them!" So needless to say they are a big hit with all age groups. And don't forget you can dip them in peanut butter for a special treat. Enjoy!

I have to agree with the rest.  These pretzels are so good that people that don't have to be on a gluten free diet love them.  Both the taste and the texture are fabulous.  It's a bit difficult to describe why they are better.  You almost have to try them to see what people are speaking about.  Part of it, I think, is that they have a crunch just like regular pretzels, but not quite as hard.  And they seem to have almost a buttery taste to them.  But, I have to agree with a previous reviewer, this is probably one of Ener-G's better products as I have been disappointed in others.

My son has been enjoying these pretzels since his pre-wheat days.  They are delicious!  More flavorful than typical wheat pretzels and in a convenient size to bring along.  My only wish was that they also made a family size bag.

They are a wonderful addition to homemade Chex Mix though.  I make it without Wheat Chex.  Divine combo.  The gluten-free Chex Mix is a wonderful treat once in a while. I had a craving - it was like eating really, really, really HARD cardboard.  Tasteless and HARD.  I'd rather go 5 years more than eat another one of these pretzels!

Great peach tea....  Excellent price!  You will not go wrong ordering this tea if you enjoy a great peach tea.

This is genuine North Carolina type BBQ sauce. Vinegar based with spices. None of that thick tomato paste. If you like your sauce to overpower your meat so you only taste tomaoes this is not for you. I'm from NC and this is the kind of sauce I grew up on. It enhances the flavor of the meat and you can make it as hot and spicy as you like. I've been using this sauce for over 25 years.

A friend of ours is from North Carolina and brings this sauce back every time she goes home.  We use it for our pulled pork.  Until Scott's it was missing that "umph."  This was it.  Now that we can get it from Amazon means that we don't have to wait once a year every time our friend goes home.  It may not be thick, but it has a kick.  Besides sometimes you just don't want sauce dripping all over everything.

column9: For one thing and one thing only!
column10: In the Carolinas, people have all sorts of ideas about how to cook up and serve bar-b-que...mostly bad.If you like vinegar soaked cat food, come to North Carolina and we'll hook you up.However, this runny red mildly-hot vinegar-based concoction by Scott's makes about the best marinade forribs you'll find anywhere, that is if you don't have a bottle of Chiavetta's laying around somewhere. Justsoak your ribs in this juicy juice for about 3-4 hours before you throw them on the grill, baste with yourfavorite brand of bar-b-que sauce and voo-ah-lah! Makes a great marinade for chicken too. 5 Bones

column9: Adam Scott's Dream Sauce.  Carolina Style Barbecue.
column10: Compared to barbecue in the rest of the United States, Carolina-style barbecue is a whole different animal.  Literally.  While most people think of beef dripping a thick, sticky sauce, Carolina Barbecue is shredded, pulled or chopped pork in a spicy vinegar sauce.  You can make the delicious Southern staple at home with a bottle of Scott's Barbecue Sauce.Scott's Barbecue Sauce is based in Goldsboro, North Carolina.  The vinegar-based sauce packs a lot of punch for something that looks so thin.  The punch is in the secret blend of spices that add a bit of hit and lots of flavor to your slow-cooked pork. Don't be surprised if the herbs and spices have settled to the bottom inch of the bottle, just shake it up and you're ready to go.Baste your pig in this vinegary sauce while it cooks.  This can be done in the oven or on the grill with a shoulder or butt.  Basting will give you the maximum infusion of flavor.  You can also add the sauce to the mixture after it has cooked (which many people do in addition to the basting).  The result is a slightly tangy, mildly hot, delicious melt-in-your-mouth pork experience that you have to taste to fully appreciate.The standard bottle size for Scott's Barbecue Sauce is 16 ounces.  The sauce does not contain any sugar or fat.  The ingredients are secret, so the bottle gives the minimal required list of ingredients as vinegar, salt, pepper and spices.  My title alludes to the origins of the sauce, which founder Adam Scott claims was given to him in a dream.  With this recipe, he began making the sauce back in 1917.If you like good Carolina Barbecue (Eastern style), you are certain to enjoy Scott's Barbecue Sauce.  Five finger-licking stars.
As soon as I'm done BBQ-ing my meat with low carb, low-sugar BBQ sauce I will be getting more & more from this company.  The delivery was very quick and it tastes just like wonderful BBQ sauce!

If you want sauce that tastes like candy and tomatoes, and don't understand what real BBQ is, then this sauce is not for you. Another review said they bought this sauce for chicken nuggets!  LOL!  This type of sauce has been around a lot longer than any of that tomato stuff. Come to North Carolina and eat some real food! Have a nice day eating fake garbage.
This is anything but barbeque sauce, more like barbeque liquid. I could have saved my money and bought a bottle of vinegar, and seasoned it myself. This stuff tastes awful a waste of money!
its some of the best BBQ sauce I have ever used. to bad the shipping is so much. it cost as much as the sauce does.
If you like vinegar, then you will like this. It taste like all they did was add a bottle of vinegar with some hot spice. You can make your own as I did.

column9: What's a "Cream Seal" anyway?  Buyer Beware?
column10: The claim for this balsamic vinegar is that it's 50 years old, and the vinegar has a "Creme Seal".  Hmmm.The "Affinato" designation means it must be at least 12 years old, and a gold designation is reserved for balsamicos that are at least 25 years old.This "offering looks alot like this one also sold on Amazon for more money, but fewer claims. Acetaia-Leonardi "Tradizionale" Traditional Balsamic Vinegar of Modena. If you're looking for something older, then go for the silver or gold designations.  Here's a good article on balsamicos:[...]In full disclosure, I haven't bought this specific product from this specific vendor, so, while it COULD be 50 years old, I'm guessing that this is more like 12-year old balsamico than 50-year old....I'm just sayin'

Someone from back home mentioned it recently and I went on an internet hunt for it soon after.  I was DELIGHTED to find this seller on Amazon and beg them to keep it in stock!  It's almost exactly as I remember -- crispy and tangy and fantastic!  It does seem like the pizza sauce is thinner, more watery, then I remembered it being, but when it bakes, it's bubbly and rich.  There's never enough cheese, but I always have ground parmesian on hand, so with a few extra sprinkles of that, I think it's about perfect.  So excited to have it again. I added my own shredded mozeralla cheese, but it cooked too fast for the crust.  The crust needs more than 20 minutes too cook.  It's a good pizza, but you need to buy extra cheese and pepperoni.

column9: INSURANCE WILL PAY for hypoallergenic formula!!
column10: Hypoallergenic formula was necessary for our daughter's acid reflux.We found out from a friend that most insurance companies will completely cover the cost of hypoallergenic formula, either by reimbursing you what you've spent on it, or if you get it as a prescription through your pediatrician. Ours did!Many doctors don't know this, so they don't know to give a prescription for the formula. Call your insurance company today!

column9: Worked wonders for silent acid reflux baby
column10: Our son developed acid reflux when he was 2 months old.  We put him on Zantac.  No improvement.  Mylicon drops.  No improvement.  Tried other formulas - we've now gone through Good Start, Enfamil AR, Similac RS, Allimentum and finally now Nutramigen which was given to me by a mother of 4 who heard about my son's acid reflux problem and immediately sent over her last two cans to me.  At first he didn't like the taste, so we mixed 1/2 Similac RS with Nutramigen.  He started eating and no screaming or arching his back.  He reverted back to the happy, eating baby he used to be.  It's been almost 4 days now and hopefully this will last.  He went from eating 22 ozs a day to 34oz a day!

My baby had problems with other formulas until we started with this one.  He has done very well with this.  I think it's important to know that babies with allergies can do well on this formula.  Make sure you consult your doctor before you switch.  Yes this is expensive, but I've found that it's well worth the price in the comfort of my baby.

Definitely don't use reviews as your basis to switch your baby to a different formula. I have 4 children, 2 of which were on Nutramigen/Alimentum and One was on Neocate. All for severe allergies. It only helps with Colic if it comes from allergies to foods. If your child has trouble, definitely try different bottles and nipples and different consistancies of the formula you are on first and then talk to baby's doctor as well when you think you may want to switch to a different type of formula. They will eventually get older and it will get easier. This product helps settle their little bellies if they need it.

column9: Best formula for babies with alergies

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

You heard me right; this stuff is made to be eaten. We own a Siberian Husky and he can down a bowl of this in less time than it takes to slap a mongoose (That saying sounds prettier in Mandarin Chinese). But honestly I put the food in he eats it and within 24 hours I have a mound of puppy dung in the backyard. It's almost like clockwork, you could set your watch to it if you needed, like say if there was an electromagnetic pulse that took out all your digital clocks (heck I guess it would take out all your electronics as well), or the sun didn't come up. Both of which are worse case scenarios.Speaking of worse case scenarios, if you ever run out of food, and it has happened, I mean really Lucky Lady was supposed to win in the fourth my guy swore it up and down, last time I get advice on Horse racing from a guy living in a box but I digress, just take a cup of Beneful put some Ketchup or Catsup (either will work its a personal taste issue at this point) on it and go to town, I also found that you can boil it and fry it, and wow does it taste good, You can also cook it Paula Deen Style but it requires a pound of butter. However I think the best way it to just pop it in your mouth straight from the bag.If you are looking for good food for your dog, or just a snack in between meals, or heck even as a meal, Purina Beneful Puppy food may be just what you are looking for.

She even called the beneful "The Worst Dog food out there". So I took her advice and immediately saw results in my puppy, he was back to being his healthy, happy, and playful self. I have learned a lesson, not to cut corners on dog food. If buying more expensive food is going to mean a happy puppy, I will spend the money.Update: 1202011I read other review on similar beneful products, other people seemed to have similar problems. I found the Dark to be a bit too dark for my tastes, and the Arctic White a bit too sweet; I solved the problem by mixing the two powders together, half a packet of each per cup, and loved the result.Another nice thing about these Land O'Lakes Cocoa Packs is that the individual pouches are all tin, not just paper, so they stay fresh a long time. column9: UNSALTED and 240 mg. of sodium per serving?
column10: I'm only giving one star because I believe there's some funny business going on with their listed ingredients. As I am always on the lookout for a decent tasting vegetable stock or bouillion that isn't loaded with sodium or additives, I snatched a box of this "unsalted" veg. stock off the shelf in my local supermarket when I saw it. Then I noticed that the sodium content was 240 mg. per cup. I know that vegetables contain a certain amount of natural sodium--some more than others--but there's no way that THAT much sodium can be attributed to just the vegetables. A lot of companies lately have been sneaking salt into their products under the guise of "Natural Flavor" because technically, that's what salt is so they can get away with it. And since this product does contain "Natural Flavor" as one of it's ingredients, I'd bet the farm that's EXACTLY what they did.

column9: Does not dry overnight; thick gel hard to apply evenly
column10: Wilton's Black Sparkle Gel icing looks and tastes good, but the thick gel is difficult to apply evenly. After putting the cookies in the oven for 10 minutes at 200 deg. F, and cooling them, the icing was less wet, but still tacky and not ready for bagging.)  I have since read from reviewers elsewhere that this icing takes 2 to 3 days to dry.  It would've been helpful to see this noted on the packaging.  I would not recommend this for decorating cookies; after 2 to 3 days for drying, your baked goods will have lost much of their freshness.

I will not buy this product again and I cannot recommend it to others.

I HAVE BEEN ORDERING THIS PRODUCT FOR OVER 6 MONTHS NOW. WHEN I RECEIVED THIS PRODUCT FROM THE US POST OFFICE, THE CANS WERE ALL CRUSHED. I WAS VERY DISAPPOINTED. USUALLY MY SHIPMENT COMES VIA UPS AND THE CONDITION IS ALWAYS GOOD. WHEN I OPENED THE ONE OF THE CANS  I CUT THE SKIN INSIDE MY THUMBNAIL. I WAS BLEEDING FOR AT LEAST 30 MINUTES. I FEEL THAT AMAZON SHOULD COMPENSATE FOR THIS INJURY.

My purse always has ready to eat snacks in it, but I find most fruit hard to take with me. These things are fantastic! First off, I love pineapple. This package contains individual 90 calorie packs that are the perfect snack on the go. The only thing I have to complain about in regards to these is that they're hard to find locally, so I've been ordering them online. I can't wait to try the other fruits they have available, I definitely recommend these for those who want a snack that's not high in calories and sugar.

In every sense, this is a fine quality espresso. I was surprised that Nestle could prepackage espresso in a capsule yet retain all of the desirable characteristics of a good espresso. The espresso is strong yet smooth, sweet without bitterness, and had nice thick crema. I haven't enjoyed an espresso this good in a long time, but this was a pleasure to sip.I've been a fan of Green Mountain Coffee Extra Bold Espresso Blend, but I have to admit that the Dolce Gusto Espresso wins this battle.This would also make a nice base for homemade coffee beverages. At 44 cents per serving, this is not only inexpensive but makes a nice afternoon pick-me-up drink.

As with all the Dolce Gusto capsules, these are very fine quality. They brew up nicely with a wonderful crema layer. Even though it's espresso, it's actually the first non-bitter espresso I've ever tasted! It's very bold but not like drinking coffee grounds, as some can be. I'd highly recommend this product, especially for a nice after-dinner coffee. This will give your stove-top pressure brewer a run for it's money. Won't disappoint.

While I loved my Nescafe Dolce Gusto coffee maker, I really didn't care much for the milk capsules so I'd substitute real milk and added in a little flavored syrup. I ended up with a great cup of coffee but was annoyed that I had to pay for the milk capsule that I never used. I was so excited when I found these individual espresso capsules. The espresso is a little weak when made as directed, but a smaller cup of coffee tastes as good as from the coffee shop.

I realize this isn't "instant" but the convenience of the machine makes it seem as if it were. I like espresso. I like it strong, bold and dark. This really wasn't as bold or strong as I expected it to be. I liked the flavor of it, but almost want to call it strong coffee...not espresso.However, I never make espresso at home. I don't have a fancy machine and don't know how to make it anyway. This Nescafe machine makes a pretty nice cup for a home machine. Simple enough that you can overlook some slight flavor preferences in exchange for such ease.

Espresso seems to have a variety of flavors. Some are bitter. Some are burnt tasting. Some are smooth. The Nescafe Dolce Gusto Espresso falls in the "smooth" area in my opinion. It has a slight nutty flavor as well. It's a very nice drink.

Length:: 0:47 MinsMaybe living in Seattle has made me a bit of a coffee snob, but this espresso does not really impress!See video for demonstration.It extremely easy to pull the shots from the Dolce Gusto machine and it leaves a nice crema layer at the top. The shot is not very strong, but definitely not weak or watery (like most the other Dolce Gusto pods which I reviewed). I still prefer my Lello 1375 Ariete Cafe Prestige which gives me the flexibility of using whichever beans I prefer. One of my favorites (besides some local roasters) is Lavazza Super Crema which is a much bolder and full-bodied coffee.

I am not an 'espresso' expert by any means, but do like a good cup now and then.  This product fit the bill in that regards, and I was pleasantly surprised. It was rich and smooth, not overbearing or too strong.  The Nescafe maker that goes with this coffee is a gem, and if you love coffee and trying different things, I would recommend trying this flavor.  It is our household's favorite flavor overall of the five  we have tried.

Typically, I'm not a straight-up espresso drinker and prefer my espresso in mixed drinks. I tried using this capsule to "goose" some of the other flavors by adding an extra espresso shot but was not pleased with the results.On its own, though, the flavor of the espresso is rich and dark, like I would expect. One complaint from these capsules, though, is that I had some large granules drip through.Overall, an unremarkable flavor, though certainly not awful...3/5.
This is one of my favorite flavors for Nescafe Dolce Gusto, I love strong espresso, I wish there was something stronger but it tastes great!

column9: Not bitter at all and plenty delicious!
column10: I have been making Cappuccinos for about a year with my Dolce Gusto Piccolo, and decided to see if I could save money by ordering the "Espresso" capsules and frothing my own milk in my Capresso frothPro, which I already had from trying to make Cappuccinos in another espresso maker that didn't do foam well, so I bought this milk foamer to do the trick and it is wonderful. After brewing my Dolce Gusto Espresso, I finish it off with the milk I foamed and then I sprinkle a little cinnamon/sugar mixture that I keep in a shaker on top of the foam. Everyone thinks it looks very professional and the taste is fabulous! There is no bitterness with this espresso capsule, which I was surprised to find. The crema is lovely and the aroma is heavenly, so I was so happy to find that it tastes as good as it looks! I like a mug-sized cup of coffee, so I usually use two capsules, which is why I decided to try using the Espresso capsules instead of the Latte or Cappuccino ones, where I would need 4 capsules (2 coffee & 2 milk). What would cost me $4 at Starbucks is now costing me 88 cents for the double, and when I only want a single, it only costs me 44 cents!

I am a mom of two boys under two years old.  I rarely have time to sit and drink a whole cup of coffee, so I ordered the espresso.  At first it was just for the caffiene, but I was so surprised that it actually tasted smoother and less bitter than the Dolce Gusto Cafe Americano!  I love it, it is delicious, and sometimes I add it to the Caramel Macchiatto for an extra kick.My only complaint of using pods is that the used pods leak in my trash can.  I have to squeeze out the excess water from the pods so my trash bag doesn't leak all over my kitchen floor when taking it outside.
The coffee is good: in no time (like 3 min) one gets a decent cup of coffee. Would recommend for busy people like myself.
Finally, someone who carrys this product and doesn't take forever to receive.  The taste is great, and service outstanding.  Thanks

I have had my Dolce Gusto Machine for over a year now and use it alot every day. I buy all my Capsules from Amazon they have the best price and selection. I order both Mocha and expresso thru the auto order system monthly. You cannnot beat this machine or Amazons service and prices they are the best.

column9: great taste for a little too much money
column10: dolce Gusto is a great system and great tasting coffee!unfortunately the capsules are more expensive they could be.

I tried this at a tasting as I'm currently in the market for a machine that makes more variety than just drip coffee. However, I was a bit disappointed with this espresso. It was a decent cup of coffee, don't get me wrong, but it was just on par with a strong brew made via drip brewing. It did not really taste like a real espresso even though it looked authentic with the crema top. Also the taste certainly did not make it stand out from any other "premium" coffee brew. I guess I was expecting more from a  brewing system that only offers one choice of espresso.
The coffee is pretty good if you use a really small cup, nice and strong.  For a regular mug, I usually use 2 of these to get the right flavor.  Aroma is great when making the coffee.

Not my favorite, but a decent cup of espresso. It seemed rather strong to me, but I'm not a regular espresso drinker. That may be desirable. Without the milk product, these Dulce Gusto coffees definitely improved.

This is a nice espresso, especially considering it's brewed in a tiny plastic package.  With the Dolce Gusto, of course, there is no fussing or fiddling.  It's quick, tasty espresso done easily.I could not give 5 stars here because, for me at least, the color of the finished product is a bit lighter than I'm used to and the temperature is a slightly cooler than I prefer.  Still, the flavor and the crema are there, just as one would expect.Espresso is not my first choice for a coffee drink.  However, when it is as easy and tasty as the Dolce Gusto makes it, I will enjoy it from time to time.
Along with the flavor of this pod it literally means how fast it can be made. EXPRESS! Wondeful flavor! better than you will get from a machine 2-3 times more expensive or at the best coffee shop.

column9: Excellent convenience -- could be bolder and stronger
column10: Don't get me wrong -- this is pretty good stuff and extremely convenient to make.  It just doesn't have the knock-my-socks-off bold taste I'm used to with a ultra-bold espresso roast.Very nice, though, as it's slightly frothy.  Fairly good taste for instant:  am looking forward to trying the other flavors

The Nescafe Espresso was a bit weaker than the shots I've gotten from coffee shops, but that was alright by me since I do not particularly enjoy the bitter, strong taste. It was ready in a flash - mere seconds - with no mess, or measuring. I'm very impressed with the quality and convenience; it's not as cheap as your basic coffee, but definitely worth it for the product you get.
Unbelievably rich and smooth with that famous darkness of a specialty espresso.  Put this into a smaller cup and fill almost 3/4 for a perfect espresso treat.  Excellent flavor.

column9: Smooth shot of espresso; lacks some flavor.
column10: I have to say that Nescafe Dolce Gusto left me pleasantly surprised again, this time with their espresso. Your espresso is ready in seconds, with a nice crema layer. If you draw just a shot-sized amount, it is a good-flavor (a little weak) shot of espresso. If you fill a cup, it is an Americano. I was nervous that passing more volume would cause a bitter drink as this is what happens if I pull too big of a shot on my espresso maker, and surprisingly enough, no bitterness. Just a good-tasting Americano. The flavor of the espresso/americano however is just a bit lacking. They went safe on the blend and ended up with a drink that's a little boring. Nevertheless, it is so easy to use and so inexpensive (50 cents per drink) that I bet my espresso machine (and coffee pot) will be getting less and less use. Overall, I didn't expect much from pod-based espresso and was pleasantly surprised though not blown away.This has, nevertheless, grown to become my most-often-used dolce gusto pod.
Nestle addressed the complaint about the 16 capsules = 16 espresso vs 16 capsules = 8 cappuccino bu hiking the price on the espresso, thanks for that.

The flavor of this capsule was bitter, and strong, but not in a good way. It was dry and old tasting, not at all fresh.It's unfortunate because I've only enjoyed a couple of the capsules I've tried. Most just don't taste fresh. I am not sure if it's the coffee used, the capsule itself not being airtight, or a combination.This is just not good espresso but it will do in a pinch if you need to get a quick jolt of caffeine, it just isn't very enjoyable.

I own and use regularly an espresso machine. The Nescafe Dolce Gusto machine isn't that. It is a single-cup brewer. What it is, however, is a solution when time is in the way.My home is open, and friends know they are welcome to stop by without much notice. The beauty of this is I can enjoy the company of wonderful people. The challenge is that my time to prepare is minimal. Using a single cup system, I meet their needs, while focusing on hosting duties. Given time, I can grind beans, whip cream, and more. Without time, guests can still enjoy a better than average espresso.The term 'espresso' is used here loosely, but accurately. Unlike some single cup systems, high pressure is used to make the espresso. Is it the same as a standard espresso machine? No. It is not that sophisticated. Still, for what is asked of this machine, the espresso flavor is very good. There is a nice crema, and the roast is medium to slightly dark. Those looking for a stronger flavor ought look elsewhere, but, for the average chain coffee house customer, this will be more than adequate.A better solution for those looking for speed with a more authentic espresso should invest in a standard espresso machine and ESE pods. The pods are single-serve, ready-made. However, if you own the Nescafe Dolce Gusto machine, and love its convenience (great for other flavors), give these a shot. Keep them handy when friends honor your home with an unexpected visit.--Brockeim
I am very pleased that I can order this product from Amazon.  I love my Dolce Gusto Coffee Maker and the Espresso flavor is delicious.

I'm not one for the nuances of coffee flavors.  I drink coffee and I drink espresso, and unless it has some kind of "flavor" in it (like hazelnut coffee) then I don't notice a difference between, say, Starbucks espresso and Nespresso.  I don't notice a difference between all the various Nespresso varieties.So, in our ongoing Dolce Gusto tests, on Friday I had a 'hot drink' made with the coffee capsule for Latte Macchiato, but without the milk capsule for it.  I just wanted to see how it was as a standalone.  It was all right, no big deal, and I came to Amazon to write my review.Later in the day I decided to have my Espresso capsule and see how it was.  This was about 3 hours after the first drink.  I brewed it for my standard 23 seconds and drank it at a reasonable pace.  Wow.  It was not any different in FLAVOR than the others (Nespresso, the Latte Macchiato coffee capsule, or even the Caffe Lungo capsule) - at least not to me - but I got the jitters about half an hour later and they continued for about four hours!  I didn't change anything else in my daily routine so I'm guessing it was the Espresso.Now, on the first day the machine got here I had an Espresso and it was great, and I didn't get jittery.  So perhaps it was simply the combo of the two drinks.  Tomorrow I am going to test it again and see what happens.  But I think the Espresso capsules are off my list.

column9: Just like the gas stations serve
column10: My husband, who is not a coffee gourmet, was excited to try this.  His response after the first cup was "it tastes just like at the gas stations".  Not impressive, but fast and easy, so it gets 3 stars for convience without the convenience store.

I purchased this product after entering Nespresso in the search field.  Unfortunately this product has nothing to do with Nespresso except it is made by Nestle.  It does not work with Nespresso.  It might be a good product. But beware that it is not compatible with Nespresso.

column9: I have an espresso habit of about 7 shots a day.
column10: I bought the Circolo because I like the way it looks. The taste, however, is never quite up to snuff.  The flavors are just a bit offThey do pack quite a kick. So that's nice.

I found this flavor to be undrinkable.  I even tried brewing a green mountain coffee in my Keurig K-cup machine and adding a shot of espresso as you would get at a coffee shop.  This made my normally enjoyable Green Mountain coffee undrinkable as well.  I will continue to try to find a way to enjoy the remaining cups of espresso.

Let me start by saying I'm not an espresso guy.  I like cream and sugar in my coffee so espresso always seemed to strong to me.  That said, I'm obligated to review this product but it's not for me.  I wound up making coffee out of it by simply filling the cup with more than 2oz.  It's fair coffee, but making plain  coffee in a 150 machine is kind of a waste.
Wrong item purchaased.  Bought item to use for Keurig.  Descrpition of item didn't indicate it wasn't compatable with a Keurig.
It is the wrong size for my machine.  I want a refund.  I bought it with a new machine.

Amazon website automatically suggest these pods with Nesspresso machines.  These pods are huge and INCOMPATIBLE with Nesspresso machines.  Please beware of that.  The coffee maybe good, but it's advertized with the wrong products.  As far as I can see the Amazon is not selling Nesspresso pods at all.

I to, thought mistakenly that these pods would fit into the new nespresso machine I had just ordered through Amazon! I spent $75 on these pods and immediately I tried to return them, to buy the pods that do fit, Amazon wouldnt allow it because of their foodstuff laws. What really got me to thinking they were compatible, was the fact AMAZON advertised these coffee pods on the same page as the nespresso machine. I've now learned my lesson, Amazon will put whatever on a page, not necessarily what is conducive to the product you are purchasing. I also had an issue with lens kit, also on the page of the Canon camera I purchased. The lens' didn't fit the Canon Rebel t2i I had purchased. Word to the wise, check before your purchase. Also, I admit I have no way to telling if this is a good product or not. Love the nespresso machine we bought.
I bought this on the advice of a friend and I believe it is better than my family makes. It's also ready on the shelf for when I have the taste for Polenta- which is often, now!

column9: OK for a cheap mochi fix
column10: This mochi is just ok.  Price is very high.  It can be found in any Asian market for about $1.50.
The outside of the rice cake was thicker and a little harder than other rice cakes I have tried.
They tasted kinda off.  The filling was ok, would've appreciated it being a little less... lumpy.  I'm sure there are better products out there, IMHO.
I was kind of suprised, but for a canned cracker mix; these are excellent! They have a fresh and flavorable taste in almost every handful!

column9: i absolutely love this as a snack
column10: I found the small cans of this at the local Kroger, and they are like 3.65 for a small can.  This was a much better deal, and a very tasty snack.
we love this snack!! its very tasty and also the quality is really good. go get your can of this yummy snack.

Most Asian rice cracker mixes are basically the same.  This one is different: it has a greater variety of crackers.  They are also quite a bit larger than I am used to; one is about the size of a big gumball!  Perhaps this is the reason for the can, instead of packaging them in a bag?  These crackers are simply bursting with flavor.  I'm scared I will eat the whole can in a single sitting.

A friend had brought this treat into work and we loved it.  I couldn't find it anywhere and decided to look on the internet for them.  I was excited to find that Amazon had them with Super Saver Shipping on top of it.  If you enjoy asian snacks with seaweed wrapper, you will love this!

column9: Short on pesto, long on onion.
column10: I thought this would be an interesting take on pesto sauce which is a favorite in our house. There were some green bits in the sauce but so few that I'm not sure why it is called pesto sauce. It is hard to taste the basil for the overwhelming flavor of onion. Pesto should contain  basil, fresh garlic, olive oil, pine nuts or walnuts, and parmesan cheese. This list of ingredients appears on the label along with tomatoes and cream to make the sauce pink. And then the onions, lots of onions, big chunks of onions. They take over the sauce. The pesto should shine through but it hardly makes an appearance. The folks at Scarpetta need to go back to the kitchen with this sauce and try again.

column9: Not as good as the others
column10: Compared to Scarpetta's Puttanesca sauce, and even compared to ordinary supermarket brands, this Pink Pesto is sadly lacking in flavor.  Just because it contains cream is no reason to expect it to be bland.  There is absolutely no hint of the basil flavor which should be front-and-center in a product labeled "pesto".After voting it merely edible the first time, we were able to enjoy it a second time by adding in wine and additional chopped tomatoes.  That turned out delicious.  But hardly acceptable paying a premium price for this sauce, and then having to doctor it up - too bad.
Quite simply: delicious - difficult to resist eating it with a spoon straight out of the jar.
This sauce is incredible!!  I even had a question and the company returned my call within 24 hours. I am almost the most pickiest person that I know. Enjoy!!
This sauce is delicious. It is one of the best pasta sauces I have ever bought!!! My family agrees.

No idea why the other reviewer was expecting classic basil pesto with something called "pink pesto" and sauce that's clearly pink in the picture.Sauce was rich and yummy, good enough to eat as-is. It's creamy and kind of tangy, a little unusual but very tasty. With the half-off special, it's 3 bucks a jar, a ridiculously good deal. 3 bucks would normally buy you a gross, watery cheap sauce, so that's delightful. I would probably buy it at the regular price, but wouldn't be as excited. I love a bargain.I  had no packaging issues people have reported with the scarpetta, but I use Amazon prime, so the faster shipping probably eliminates the rough handling.

column9: Cat loves the food, but all of my Fancy Feast subscriptions have been unreliable.
column10: My cat loves Fancy Feast catfood.  However, all five of the Fancy Feast subscriptions I signed up for have been unreliable.  Im October, I signed up for delivery every two months and received shipments only in October and December (it's now March 18, but I canceled all of my subscriptions yesterday).  What was supposed to be 48-can cases Amazon turned into 24-can cases, with one flavor being canceled entirely.  I was notified by Amazon that shipments would be sent in mi-February, but they never arrived.

column4: S. Tristan "Lil country girl in the BIG city"
column9: My cat is 18yrs old and finicky as ever LOVES THIS !!!
column10: I have a 18yr old cat getting very picky bout what she will eat and losing weight(wouldn't eat friskies or nine live anymore)..I started to feed her fancy feast and she is eating pretty good again and not losing anymore weight and is more active. This seems to be one of her favorites. Lot better price than in stores and shipped to my door every month. Thanx AMAZON!!

column9: Tasty, low-carb food for diabetic cats
column10: We recently switched my daughter's diabetic cat to low carb, wet cat food and Fancy Feast Savory Salmon Feast is by far her favorite! We had no problems at all switching her from her dry, prescription cat food to Fancy Feast low-carb varieties.I am not a vet, but my daughter's cat had been on insulin for about 7 years and was beginning to have other problems associated with her diabetes. After doing a lot of research, I came upon information about home blood glucose testing and feeding only wet, low-carb cat food. After following careful directions, we made the switch and amazingly, the cat is now in remission! No insulin at all! And her vet, who wasn't a proponent of home testing before, is as surprised and delighted as we are. (Don't attempt this switch on an insulin dependent cat without a lot of research and information and guidance. diabeticcatcare dot com is a great place to start.)I now have switched all of my cats to the low-carb varieties of Fancy Feast after learning about the dry food/diabetes connection, and my cats all prefer this Savory Salmon Feast, too. They will eat the other varieties in a pinch, but they are always enthusiastic about the salmon. I use the Subscribe and Save option since I have a lot of cats and it is less expensive and I am never running out to the store late at night in search of cat food.

column9: Our cats line up for it!
column10: We have a male cat with a urinary problem and we've tried a lot of high quality pet food with little success in dealing with his urination in the house.  Our vet recently suggested that we cut down on dry food, even though we buy a very expensive, organic grain free dry food.  She said that Fancy Feast is palatable to most cats and reasonably priced, unlike some of the more expensive canned foods that cats may refuse to eat.  (We have tried them all!).  And, most importantly, canned cat food contains the moisture which might help address the male cat's problem.  I am pleased to say that it works for him and for our other two cats, all of whom have lived out most of their lives on dry kibble.  This is the first "wet" food that they have eaten with a bit of enthusiasm.  Salmon seems to be their favorite.  I'm sold on Fancy Feast, whatever it is made of, as a moist complement to top quality dry kibble.  Our cats are healthy and happy.  And, of course, subscribe and save helps cost-wise.

My very selective cat has eaten Facncy Feast Savory Salmon Feast Classic since she went off the nipple.  I live in West Marin in northern California and I have to drive 48 miles round trip to keep a stock for her.  I resented that, but now our cat and I are reconciled because I have establshed a standing order with Amazon.Com and both of us are as content as puppies.  Noos

I am pleased that we can get this by the pack at a good price.  Retail stores in my area only have mixed packs - this doesn't help us as this Savory Salmon Feast is the only one my Mom's cat will eat!  He approves of this purchase as well but he wishes that he could have more than a can-a-day.

Of all the gormet Fancy Feast varieties, this one seems to be the least favorite.  Not sure why - they won't eat salmon fresh from the market either.  Must not be on the regular cat's palate for some reason.  The smell is quite nice though - smells like people food really.  You can't really go wrong with these Fancy Feast varieties - they're the hit in this house!

Our Kitty just loves this stuff.  He goes wild for it; it must taste great!For me, I like it because Kitty eats the whole thing and it doesn't smell strongly of cat food.  I buy this again and again because he loves it so much.He also loves the Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food 3-Flavor Variety Pack.

Princess loved this, and she'd get it as a treat -- then later on in her life when she was dying and was very fussy about eating, she would eat this, or at least some of it, and would refuse any other kinds of cat food.I was able to mix Cee Cee's powdered cat antibiotics in Fancy Feast when she was recovering from a burst abscess, and she'd eat all the food, with the antibiotics.But I always wondered about the color of this food -- it seemed pretty bright for the combinations of meats and fish that were in it -- is there alot of food color in this food???

column9: How to make my cat happy
column10: If my cat could write, she would tell you how much she loves Fancy Feast Savory Salmon Flavor Cat Food.  This is a perfect size for one cat.  I tried many other flavors and brands and Fancy Feast Salmon is the only one that she will eat.  What a relief when I found this!  The "single serve" size (3 ounch can) ensures that each meal is fresh.

GREAT CAT FOOD IF I GET IT!!!!!  I LIVE IN A GATED LOCKED SECURITY COMMUNITY & DELIVERY OF THIS MONTHLY HEAVY ORDER HAS BEEN LEFT AT MY DOOR.  NOT LEAVING IT AT THE DOOR IS UNACCEPTABLE!!!!  WHEN WILL DELIVERY BE MADE TO MY HOME????  I HAVE REQUESTED THIS CORRECTION BEFORE....DO YOU WANT ME TO DROP THIS MONTHLY DELIVERY SERVICE?

column9: It's sooo good, I can drink it!
column10: This is one of the best hot sauces I have tasted. It's so good, I can't help but drink it (it's really not that hot compared to the conventional hot sauces that you find at Mexican restaurants etc). I'd have preferred it to be a bit hotter (in which case I would promptly stop drinking it and use it as intended :o)). I mean look at the ingredient list - all good stuff that's healthy for you! Not to mention it's all organic. I am a big fan of organic foods - did you know that Apple cider vinegar is one of the best remedies for acid reflux? I am Indian and from where I came from, we almost always use garlic and ginger, coriander and cumin in our cooking quite frequently....I think I am going to order a case or two of these! I originally found this stuff at Whole Foods. Kudo's to the company that makes this product!

column9: Better than Taco Bell hot sauce
column10: This is a good tasting mild sauce, if you don't want too much burn.  Slightly sweet from the apples and other sweet ingredients, but with a nice flavor that goes nicely with mexican foods.  We love making burritos & tacos at home, and this is a nice sauce to put on them for it's flavor, and a little kick.  If you want major burn factor, this sauce isn't for you, but if you want a nice flavor or that "Taco Bell" flavor then it's nice.

I've been a gummy fanatic since gummy's hit the specialty stores in the 80's & then branched out in drugstores, grocery stores, movie theaters, etc. and I can tell you about every gummy brand company, flavor, shape, style, etc. because they are my passion. It was love at first taste when they came out in the 80's and I was a young girl. That being said, I'm also a gummy snob. I like my gummy's to have that perfect gummy taste and texture. I don't want my gummy to have a Swedish fish consistency or an over chewy, overly additive tasted and artificially flavored that lasts on your tongue and leaves your hands sticky! (that being said Swedish fish are delicious but have their place in a different candy catogory) That's a big NO! If you're a gummy expert and you love gummy's like I do, then you will understand exactly what I'm talking about. I have bought many Chocolate covered Gummy Bears over the years, both white and milk chocolate which I like equally depending on my mood. I have bought chocolate gummy bears both from upscale candy stores and from the one that comes packaged in a box typically sold in drugstores. I have had every gummy both regular and chocolate over the years and I love them both and enjoy them equally. I eat the regular ones more often because they won't put a dent in my diet and I save the chocolate ones for special occasions. I also don't eat the chocolate ones as often because they are hard to purchase for me geographically. In fact, I have to resort to purchasing them off of the internet if I want my chocolate covered gummy fix! These gummy's both white and milk chocolate are the best I've ever tasted! The chocolate stays on even after being shipped to me, which chocolate often comes off if it's not a quality chocolate, but these chocolate gummy bears are pan flashed which means they are covered thoroughly and drenched in the chocolate and not made in mass quantities. The gummy's are put through the process in small amounts so that no gummy is missed and the panning effect is only used with the finest chocolate companies. These gummy's are the best gummy's I've ever tasted and I've tasted many gummy bears over the years. You will not be disappointed! I try to keep my ordering of these fabulous gummy's to only special occasions or holidays, but they're so good that I'm finding myself making excuses to celebrate so I can buy these sinful but so delicious little bears of chocolate goodness more often! The chocolate tastes fresh and you can tell that the recipe is of the finest chocolate quality. There is nothing I despise more in the chocolate world than cheap chocolate! These gummy's are on the opposite spectrum of cheap & generic tasting! These gummy's are the best! You will never need to buy chocolate covered gummy bears anywhere else! I'm sold and I will always be a loyal fan.

I ordered several products from Superior Nut Company including these Milk Chocolate Covered gummy bears. I was skeptical ordering something like chocolate over the mail but they arrived unscathed and very fresh. I do alot of baking and I will definitely be buying from this seller again. Fair prices, excellent product.

these are very very addicting , if you have never had them you will get addicted , these are probably my favorite treat that i order about twice a year from them , i have tried other chocolate covered bears and they would have a stale taste to them but i have never had a bad batch from these guys , just love them!!!!

I was so looking forward to finally having chocolate covered gummies in the house, as they stopped selling them at our local candy store. When they arrived they were slightly melted to one another but not badly.There was an ICE PAC in the packaging, but it had long lost its coolness. However the gummy bears still held their shape and came apart from each other easily. The sad part was when I ate some.  I found myself chewing endlessly on a gummy that had no desire to break down in my mouth. It was like chewing chocolate covered rubber bands. And the chocolate was not the best I've ever tasted either. So now I have Two lbs of gummy bears I have no interest in consuming. Really sad. :-(The ones I would buy at my local kosher bulk candy shop were amazing and had a wonderful soft texture. Oh well, I guess my search continues. If you like gummy bears that are rubbery to chew, then these are for you, if you like gummy bears that are tender and easy to chew, then look elsewhere!DTS

Bonjour mes amies! J'adore la chocolate. I am French and live in America. The chocolate is delicieux! But, I find the combination of la chocolate and gummy bears a little strange.  As Americans say, "To each his own!" I suppose. Personally I think the chocolate in Paris is beyond compare...Who is in agreement?

These are very yummy bears, the only complaint I have is that the chocolate is milk chocolaty enough for me, but the bears themselves have a lot of flavor, and they are different colors, so different flavors. The bears are well coated and its definitely a treat.
I Bought these & they came in Saturday, I put a small bowl out for a get together & everyone was asking where i got them, they're delicious! I'd definitely recommend people to buy these!

I received the pack of gummy bears through usps with an ice pack to keep it cool.  I was impressed by the ice pack since we have a little heat wave that week.  The bears were delicious, just how I remembered, and just as addictive.  Would definately order more from this company!
its the best gummy bears in the world,when you stick one of them in your mouth it feels like a million dollars

I had some chocolate covered gummy bears while on a road trip in southern California and had been craving more.  I couldn't find them locally, so I ordered a variety through Amazon and a few other online sites.  These were definitely the best of the bunch.  Great quality chocolate.  I don't know how to describe the gummies, really, but these were how I like them -- not too chewy but not too gelatinous either.  I will definitely order these again the next time a craving hits.

Not that it is an earth-shattering mistake, but instead of receiving what I ordered (chocolate gummy bears) I received a bag of chocolate coffee beans. Not really worth my time to go through the return process and mistakes do happen. lesson learned.

Canned chipotles are smoked, pickled jalapeno chiles.  Different brands taste slightly different because each company uses its own pickling mixture.Herdez chipotles taste distinctly better than the more commonly found Embasa or La Costena brands.  The Herdez brand is worth seeking out- their salsas are good too.The easiest way to use canned chipotles is to puree the entire can and transfer the puree to a jar.  You can then add smaller quantities of the puree to your recipes- soups, dips, sauces, spice rubs for grilling, etc.Drizzle a thin layer of oil on top of remaining puree, and keep the jar in your refridgerator.  It should keep for a few weeks.

column9: not as natural as I'd hoped
column10: I had ordered this product in search of a brand that didn't use wheat or corn syrup in the product.  Couldn't tell from the website but this product does contain one or both - can't remember now - but couldn't use unfortunately.  If you don't care about the processing I am sure this is a fine product.
I had trouble finding Chipotle peppers in my grocery store so I ordered these.  They are very good and I would recommend them.

column9: Alright Tea, but Only Relative to the Price
column10: Out of all black teas, Yunnan tea is my favorite. It has a very earthy flavor (sort of like what I'd imagine tree bark would be like) and a slight spice to it. I've had many Yunnans from many different tea sellers, and I must say that this Yunnan is a bit thin. A good Yunnan is pretty full flavored and has a good complexity to it; this Yunnan had the same earthy flavor I expect, but is missing the depth that more expensive Yunnans provide.So, my assessment is that this tea is passable for those who want to pay a bit less. IF you don't mind paying about $10 to $15 more, though, and really like a more rich and complex black tea, there are Yunnan teas that are better han this one.

You didn't post my review, I know it was negative, but the tea sucks and you will not allow me to return it.  This is leaving me as an unsatisfied customer, I will look elsewhere for my purchases before going through Amazon. Then you go and post this remark.  Amazon is ridiculous.  Looking to find an alternate palce to shop now.
What a wonderful tea. And to be able to find it available online. It's very hard to find a trust worthly buyer who offers this tea.

column9: Your Chocolate's in MY Peanut Butter!
column10: How HEAVENLY are these?  I can honestly say that Reese's Peanut Butter Cups are my VERY favorite candy!  I've loved them since I was a child and they always bring back fond memories.  I love them in their regular size so you can imagine that I just about FLIPPED LIKE A GYMNAST when I saw these! They're HUGE!  In my mind, candy wise, NOTHING could be better than your very favorite just bigger (and MORE of it)!They are HUGE, FRESH and ABSOLUTELY YUMMY!  They really do make a great snack.  Besides, who doesn't love a Reese's?  They make so many Delicious candies!These will remain at the top of my list for that "anytime snack". And for an extra special treat, I either freeze them or I break them up over vanilla or choclate ice cream! SO GOOD!This Seller is spectacular. They always send their items quickly.  They are pleasant and professional.  So, if you are thinking of ordering these, or any other candy from this company, do not hesitate.  I would uses them again and again.  I wish more sellers on Amazon were this reliable.Enjoy!

I absolutely love Reeses Peanut Butter Cups. Because I could not find the Big Cups locally, I searched Amazon and ended up ordering two boxes from the Online Candy Shop. Given that selling chocolate via mail-order is their business, I figured it was safe to do so, in spite of the gross shipping charge ($12.00).The only thing "good" I can say about the end result is that the candy arrived quickly - end of "good" remarks. The outer carton they arrived in was crushed at both ends. Even the inner carton showed signs of the crushing. And apparently the chocolate had gotten so hot it caused the chocolate to stick to its paper covering, making it impossible to remove the candy whole.  Well, I learned my lesson. Never again will I order ANYTHING from the Online Candy Shop. You have been warned!!!

I found this product at Epcot in Japan(duh) and bought b/c it looked funky. It looked and felt (through the packageing) like uncooked cookie dough.So i bought only one packqage. We didn't eat any till we left the park(stupid I know) Well i LOVED IT!!!! (so does my mum) I was soooo happy I was able to find them online. I have tried the melon and oragne flavors also. Orange not very orange taseting but i love the strawberry and melon.  I keep buying more when I run out.

These were really great, the first time you take a bite it may seem a bit strange, but you quickly get used to the texture. Its kind of like a marshmallow with a jelly filling. I liked the Melon better and I really like sweet anko, but sometimes the anko can be bitter. Strawberry or Ichigo as the Japanese call it, is a really good mild introduction to Daifuku and Japanese treats.
I used to spend a lot of time in Japan and was thrilled to find these daifuku on Amazon. Now my children are addicted so I guess I will be buying often.

It certainly has a unique texture, I love how squishy they are. I thought the dough would be firmer like bread dough but it's more gummy and soft. The taste is delicious, I prefer strawberry over melon. I haven't tried traditional anko yet but I definitely will and can't wait.
Fast delivery, and a great product. I will be ordering from this dealer again soon.

SO upset... and it is not the traditional semisweet mochi. It has gross filling!!!! You could just get some chocolate marshmallow santa and that tastes about the same as these. The ingr. listed above are not correct!!!
These contain insect extract. It is not listed on the sellers page, but it is listed on the package.

I usually don't care about organic etc...but these are priced competitively with non-organic baby foods, so I picked them up.  Compared to other brands, these bananas are ever so slightly pinkish, I think it's the fact that they're all natural.  Regardless, my 4 month old son loves them mixed with a little baby cereal.

We have been giving our daughter organic from the beginning and I can see how healthy and well she is growing.  We always get a great report from the doctor about how great she is growing and how she looks.  It makes me happy to know that we made a good choice in going organic.

column9: will not get this brand again - Beechnut is better for bananas
column10: Beechnut is better than Earth's Best due to the added ingredients E.B. has in it.  I like NATURAL AND NON-added ingredients.

What's not to love about this product?  From their website, the ingredients are :Organic bananas, water, citric acid, ascorbic acid (vitamin C).  The ease of purchasing on line, together with free shipping and a discounted price through Subscribe and Save, makes this a wonderful option.  No more spilling tiny jars of baby food all over the place from a grocery cart to home.  And I saved money over the single jar price.

Barcelona's Red Sauce (Universal Cooking Sauce) 16 Oz. JarAs a working mom, it is so often a struggle to prepare something healthy and delicious in a matter of minutes for a hungry family.  That's where Barcelona Sauces comes in.  Using this sauce and a few on-hand ingredients, I can have a home cooked meal in no time that I feel good about feeding my family.  Also, it helps me stretch my food dollars by turning a few leftovers into a brand new, tasty meal.  With somewhat picky eaters, I am thrilled to say that both my kids love the enchiladas and the chili that I have made with this sauce. The company also offers many simple and delicious recipes on their web site.
I like this nori. Nori from other brands are too salty, but this one, not very salty at all. I enjoy this nori as a snack or make a sushi with this nori.
Loved this Seaweed!! Tasty! not like some seaweed that you get that is very bland.Not too salty like some of the the seaweed you get from the Korean supermarkets.

column9: Good Candy at a Low Price
column10: Very fast shipping, well-packaged. I've had better allsorts, but these were okay for the price. They weren't very fresh and had less variety than I like (most were chocolate). Still, you can't beat the price.

column9: If you can't make it yourself!
column10: This tastes like old time home brewed root beer. It is the best and I have tested many brands. Drink it plain or OMF with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
This is the best root beer I have ever had.  I would recommend buying a 12-pack right now!  It has a good root beer taste with a hint of honey and real vanilla.  Good stuff!
This root beer is the BEST!!!  There is no "bite", it is smooth and rich and I can't say enough about this product.  It is worth every penny!!

column9: love them, except for the packaging
column10: When I was younger I loved sourpatch kids, and now I can get my fix naturally and vegan. These are really tasty! I only wish that they came with less packaging --I don't need 12 little bags inside another bag inside a box, but I can't find larger packages anywhere.

I really enjoy these covered pretzels. I use them to snack on occasionally or will break them up and put them on top of some vanilla ice cream with some additional peanut butter. They are really good.

These pretzels are much less sweet than Funky Chunky's caramel pretzels.  They are supposed to have lots of peanut butter flavor but it's mighty scarce in the cannisters I received.  Light on the chopped peanuts too.  For chocolate-covered pretzels they taste good and were fresh and crispy, but if you had your taste buds set on peanut butter you'll be disappointed.Update:  I e-mailed Funky-Chunky about these pretzels and promptly (same day!) got a call from them.  They sent out 2 replacement cannisters -- arrived via UPS in 3 days.  I must have gotten a bad batch the first time 'cause these are just great.  Plenty of caramel, peanut butter and chopped peanuts.  Very enjoyable product and Funky Chunky is certainly responsive to their customers' comments.
Out of all the sweet chili sauces out there, we like this one the best.  It has the right amount of "bite", yet is not too hot for those of us who prefer a milder sauce.  I highly recommend it.
Have used this product since I was a child - put it in gravy, vegetables, mashed potatoes,stew,spaghetti sauce. Boosts the flavor of everything.  ALso makes great broth. Very versatile.
this is a really good seasoning for anything you are cooking it gives plenty of flavor would recommend you to try it.

Ok, so this is mostly msg and some seasoning spices.  But, if you can eat msg and salt, this is the best seasoning ever!  I use it to make soup bases, in shepherd's pie, to make gravy, and even as a soup by itself.  It is the secret ingredient used by chefs to enhance food tastes.  It is totally an amazing seasoning that makes everything taste better.  I am allergic to milk, so I even use it mixed with water instead of milk and butter in mashed potatoes.  If you can eat msg and salt, try it.  You won't be disappointed.

This has been a family staple for generations!We use it mixed with sour cream for an amazing dip and always get compliments on how it pairs so well with chips and veggies.  Also sprinkle it on chicken or potatoes before roasting to deepen the flavor.

G. W. Broth has been a mainstay in my family for years. As a matter of fact, I made lemon chicken soup today which my Grandkids love. As usual, one of the ingredients used was G. W. Broth. My wife orders it by the case and we share boxes with the rest of the family. Good stuff!!

column9: George Washington Golden Seasoning and Broth
column10: I needed this item and couldn't get it locally.  It was a great price and came quite quickly.  Thanks.

This mix makes the perfect cones.  They're slightly sweet.  The batter is easy to work with and doesn't seem to have issues with changing humidity levels.  It's fairly forgiving of water and can be used for both small and larger batches.

I don't know what type beans are used in this vanilla. Frankly, I don't care.  This vanilla is KSA certified.  I have tried many brands of vanilla. Morton and Bassett is the most flavorful I have ever tried. The price is reasonable for such clean flavor. Pure vanilla is expensive but there are other brands that are pricier and doesn't taste as superb as M&B. I am convinced this is the best pure vanilla you can find in the US.  I do wish I knew what bean is used but maybe that's a trade secret.  It's Kosher certified and that's good enough for me. I have searched for the perfect taste in a vanilla for many years.  Thank you Morton and Bassett, my search is over!  Now I can enjoy a vanilla taste that is pure and smooth. I am very happy to have found this vanilla extract.

Three bottles are shrinkwrapped together so they may not arrive intact.  I ordered this most expensive option ($29.64) because it gave the clearest ingredient list.  Other brands included water and sugar.  However, there is no advisement regarding whether this is Madagascar, Tahitian or Mexican in origin.  Vanilla is more expensive than gasoline!$2.47/oz = $316.16/gallonAmazon's customer service continues to be accommodating when I complained but the replacement vanilla was even LEAKIER.  They offered a discount so I'm happy but what a waste of precious vanilla.A bottle cap in the second shipment was crushed.This compares favorably to my second experience with bad supermarket pricing of McCormick's brand spices.  Their vanilla is on sale for $7 for 2 ounces.
At least according to me the taste of this vanilla is much better than the imitation vanilla that you can get at your local grocer. I'll be ordering more once my 3 bottles run out.

Every time I ordered this, half of the quantities they shipped are outdated. Every time they intentionally wiped out the expiration date. Most of the time they tasted bad or not as good. The other half with long expiration date taste good.Amazon should stop doing this. If Amazon does not know this, it should make sure it won't happen again.
This is the best rice I've had. It is sticky, but not too sticky. And it is as plump and flavorful as rice can be.

It has a very pleasant non grainy taste, almost a bit of sweetness to it. If I rinse it enough and let it stand in really hot water for 10 minutes it turns out fluffy and less starchy- like the basmati rice. I put less water then suggested though. I did not compare taste or texture to the non organic... that is up to you.
We only have hawthorn pits in our bag. Can't taste anything with hot water. And it does not contain leaves or pulp.
We got hooked on this coffee when vacationing in New Orleans and have been buying it ever since. It is a strong, bold but smooth coffee so Starbucks and Pete's coffee fans will love it.

If you've never yet had coffee at the French Market in New Orleans you have been going without one of the world's supreme gourmet experiences. But a this French Roast--with its savor at once exquisite and robust-- ill do everything put history back  on your side.
I have used this coffee for many years and I can not find anothercoffee that has the body without being too bitter.  This isgreat.
Great coffee. Always good and not bitter. We have been drinking it ever since Katrina. It is easy to obtain at Amazon but strangely Brookshires doesn't carry it any longer.

This coffee is by far the best for our French press.  We have tried many other brands only to be disappointed so since we couldn't find it in any local stores, we use Amazon to order it!  Couldn't be easier!!!
our order also looked like it had been drop kicked all the way from italy but we had no ripped bags or exposed pasta.  would get it again.  great price for linguine.

Anna Linguini #7 is an excellent pasta product made and packaged in Italy. It is not carried by any of our supermarkets and as a result I placed an order for 20 one pound packages via Amazon to restock our pantry. The order arrived in a timely fashion but it looked like the original cardboard shipping container was drop kicked all the way from Italy. The box was ripped in a number of locations and the food product was exposed. Three of the the one pound bags were torn and had to be disposed of. Email to Amazon with a complaint must have been lost in transmission because I received no response. Next time I'll travel up to New York to buy my Anna Linguini. New Yorkers treat linguini with a lot more respect than Amazon does.

column9: Four Star Flavor, Five Star Value
column10: So I've been looking for a quality looseleaf green tea, but all the dragonwell teas are getting outrageously expensive, what with the ridiculous health craze about green tea.  I used to get top grade Rishi organic dragonwell teas for less than $30/lb, but those days are long past.Anyway, so I decided to take a chance with this green tea from Elmwood Inn.  As it turns out, this sencha is very good.  It's grassy and lightly sweet with very little bitterness.  It brews to a very sencha-like, distinctive green cup.  It's no lungjing, but it's very good.  I would say my only minor complaint is that the bag does contain a fair amount of stems with no leaves attached, but for this price, it's acceptable.This is a solid value, and the quality is very good.  I recommend this if anyone is in the market.  It certainly blows bagged sencha such as Kirkland Signature Ito En Matcha Blend (Green Tea) (which is really MOSTLY sencha with a little matcha powder thrown in) out of the water!

I used to be a specialityteas customer. It is not sencha I used to get from Specialityteas. The grade is dramatically lower. I would not recommend it if you are looking for sencha but it is ok green tea. If you don't know what kind of tea you want you likely to satisfied with it. If you have been drinking green tea for long time that is not the tea you will truly enjoy.

I didn't want this person's strange review to affect this product's good reputation. This is the most convenient form of chocolate there is! Very tasty too. If you ever find yourself in the Army and are lucky enough to get M&Ms in your MRE they are quite valuable for trade; and if you can bring yourself to part with them you're guaranteed have the upper hand while bartering. I can never part with them though. They're the best chocolate fix there is, hands down, especially if you don't like licking chocolate off of the inside of wrappers.

I'm in Afghanistan and using Amazon to find a good deal on M&Ms to share with my troops.  After finding the "good deal" at Eauction my bill arrived in a separate email indicating that the mailing costs were more than the two bags of M&Ms.This is totally ridiculous when the cost to ship to an APO address is minimal these days through USPS.  This has got to be nothing less than a company screwing it's potential customers.I would not recommend this seller to anyone purchasing from a military account.

When it comes to junk food, I usually stick with Ding Dongs, Ho Hos, and other Hostess products.  But recently my friend (Walter) recommended M&Ms.  I'd never tried M&Ms before, so I bought a bag to see if they are any good.  I didn't like them at all.  In fact, I flushed most of the bag down the toilet (hopefully this didn't harm any alligators).Maybe I've been spoiled by Hostess products, but when I buy a snack item, I expect a creamy filling.  M&Ms do not have a creamy filling, and they taste awful.  Avoid.
