I bought these for my two year old son who eats plain oatmeal every morning for breakfast and he loves it!  They are fast and convenient to serve him.  But I usually end up making two packets for him each morning because each packet doesn't contain much oatmeal.

Instant oatmeal is the ideal healthy fast fuel.  I choose original flavor so that I can add whatever I want with it (3-in-1 coffee mix, instant noodle soup base packet, honey packet, powder milk, hot chocolate packet, any savory spices/paste/solids, last night's left over food, etc.).  When eating it without additive, it tastes just as good!  It doesn't have the artificial taste that Trader Joe's and Quaker Oats' instant oatmeal packet has.  After cooking it in hot water, it thickens and becomes creamy.  If you only add boiling water and cover the bowl to let it sit, it softens but will not become creamy.My only gripe is that each packet doesn't have too much oatmeal in comparison to Quaker Oats and Trader Joe's.  There were times I had to use 2 packets to get enough calories to get through the first 2 hours of activity (240 cal + whatever else you put in it).

column9: McDougall's Instant Orig. Organic Oatmeal. Simple, Basic, Love it.
column10: Basic, organic, low sodium, plain old instant oatmeal.  There's NO sugar (which I like a lot) and all I have to do to make it satisfying is put a big spoonful of cinnamon on it and I'm a happy girl.  It's organic oatmeal. I highly recommend it. Enough said. Peace and all good things, L.

column9: I have this nearly every day for breakfast.
column10: This is a great quality oatmeal that has a great flavor and texture. It tastes just like when I make oatmeal in a pan, but ithout the extra mess of a pan. It never is soggy or slimy, and best of all it is organic. I highly recommend this oatmeal.
This is a really solid product.  My wife and kids have tried almost every flavor, and love them all.Don't know what else you could ask for from organic/all-natural oatmeal.
I was all kinds of excited to find sugarless, all-natural, INSTANT oatmeal cheap, in bulk.  Now I am stuck with 6+ boxes of oatmeal that tastes very much like loamy topsoil.Caveat emptor!

column9: reminds me of life before celiac disease
column10: Great oatmeal, easy to take with you to work or travel.  It tastes great and works well in baked recipes!

The EVO 95 has been the one thing that has stopped my cat from bleeding when he uses his litterbox...in other words, it stopped his colitis/internal allergies and he's been a healthy, active, loving cat since.  I couldn't get over the difference simply changing from a diet of hard/soft mix...which I was first on Royal Canin for him and then tried SD z/d...then went to this.  It worked...period.  To those bashing the company, quit the hysteria!  IT WORKS...and now both my cats are on it and doing well.  I lost two cats last year, and mine are doing well on this diet...and I'm thankful to have it!
These are absolutely the very best gluten free ginger snaps I have found. They are crunchy, not too sweet, and provide a great ginger burst

i usually buy these at my local ocean state job lot for a dollar a pack,or 6 bucks a case but they were all out so i thought i would buy them here! what a ripoff at 6 bucks a pack, and they are stale too! ocean states cookies tastes like fresh baked, these taste like they were in the tardis for 2 regenerations! i'm not very happy!
I love Jammie Dodgers :) I love the black currant ones but they usually are harder to find so i have to have my fiancees nana mail them from england :)  I love these with a good cup of tea :)

After listening to Eddie Izzard's Glorious (in which he makes a reference to Jammie Dodgers) I decided to give them a try. These are great cookies (or more correctly biscuits). They are round wheels of shortbread held together by sticky raspberry flavored plum jam. They are rather expensive in the United States because they must be imported, but perhaps that is a good thing--it would be very easy to polish off the entire package in short order!
Must have for any Doctor Who fan. Tasty treats to put in your Tardis cookie jar. Yummy plum jam flavor!

Wow, I never thought I'd love shortbread cookies and jam so much! These cookies are amazingly good, and even better - I'm usually satisfied after just one, so no worries about sitting and eating a whole package at once. Great to go with a hot beverage, or as a small dessert. MMMMmmm...
The cookies arrived fresh and well packed. Paid a lot for shipping as it's a product not readily available in our area. Given to a Doctor Who fanatic. Cookies were good but nothing special.
NOTHING WRONG WITH COOKIES AS THEY WERE MARVELOUS.BUT SO EXPENSIVE, FOR JUST A FEW COOKIES,YIKES I AM NOT DONALD TRUMP.
These cookies were crushed almost to dust when they arrived.  The filling was hard and stale. Overall this product was totally ruined upon arrival and had a stale sour smell when opened.

I ordered 3 boxes of Jammie Dodgers (over$24) as Christmas gifts on Dec. 2, 11. They were not opened until Xmas and a week or two later. They were spoiled. They smelled off and tasted awful. The best by dates were covered up. They seemed like they were over a year old. I will never order anything from them again!

We were looking forward to our Jammie Dodgers, but from the first bite it was a big disappointment. I couldn't believe that these were the same cookies I remembered so fondly from our trips to visit our daughter in England. When I looked at the box, I found that they were 2 years past their sell by date! Don't waste your money on these bisquits! I thought Amazon would have more quality control.

Incredibly tasty! A friend of a friend brought some along to a picnic and I was instantly hooked. I'm actually not a very big mustard fan, but this stuff is delicious! It's a sweet mustard with incredible flavor. For those who don't typically like mustard, the sharpness is dulled some what by the sweetness of the honey. Tastes great on beer brats!

I find this coffee to be very much to my liking and taste. The price is reasonable and the shipping time is good also. I have tried several other camerons coffees but like I stated I find this one to be the best to my taste and liking. I also liked the woods and water coffee beans and I find that grinding your own beans the coffee tastes fresher and also seems to go further as you dont use as much to brew a pot of coffee
This is my favorite flavor of pasta salad.  I have bought this for years until they stopped carrying it in my local grocery stores.  Thank you Amazon for continuing to stock this item.
Not sure what is going on here, but the Cesaer Salad flavor is seriously off.

column9: Add a can of Tuna and whalla
column10: Excellent product. Throw in a can of tuna and it is a meal!

One of the things I missed from my trip to India was the Tulsi tea I used to have there. Over there, fresh Tulsi leaves are plucked from a plant and boiled with the tea and milk (also called "chai"). I couldn't find a Tulsi plant in US and was desperately hoping to find something close enough. And Teatulia was more than close enough.The taste is very similar, and as Tulsi is, extremely calming and soothing for the throat, esp. when I have cold, sore throat, and runny nose.I picked up my box from Whole Foods. At 8 bucks per box, it seemed a little expensive. Although calculations based on the label make this come to approximately 50c per tea bag, or 25c per cup, it is actually much cheaper. I put one tea bag in the tea pot. I also mix in other "normal tea", to infuse the brown color and I end up getting about 5-6 cups of the Tusli chai with the single tea bag. So yes, I only use it to get the Tulsi flavor, and get the Tea/Chai flavor from my regular, loose Tea leaves.Your preference may be to use the tea bag directly in the cup. If yes, I think it is strong enough to give at least 3 full cups of tulsi tea.Summary: If you like Tulsi, you wont be disappointed with this. If you make tea in tea pot, even better. If you want tea bags to use directly in the cup, this works too, but might be a bit strong for a single cup.
Texas Pete makes great stuff and this is no diff. If you like honey mustard give this a try. Everyone in my house thinks its great.

Red residue everywhere? Well of course you're supposed to decorate on top of wax paper or newspaper! I love all these color mists. They're so easy to use and give off a very nice look. For darker colors spray close, for lighter colors spray farther way. Be smart and decorate on top of your kitchen table using newspapers underneath :]

I love the concept of the color mist.  I purchased 3 bottles of the red mist to decorate 75 cupcakes.  The mist went on very easy, but because I wanted a darker red I had to keep applying it.  To say the least, I am not a big fan right now ... since my kitchen now has a red residue all over the counter tops!  :-(

I love this tea pack. I bought these in Scotland and I wish I had bought more! I cannot find these in regular supermarkets in the UK, so I will have to order more from the company's website. I was surprised that I would be able to buy them from Amazon in the states (yay for Amazon!). Living in the UK has turned me into a tea addict, and these teas are very good if you add about a teaspoon of sugar and some milk to them. I'm not a fan of the regular English breakfast tea, but I love every one of these. I particularly like the whiskey one. They do NOT taste the same. All of them brew strong black teas with a distinctive overtone to them. The flavors are delicate, but they are brought out if you add sugar and milk to your tea. I tried them without adding anything and it doesn't taste good. Sugar and milk is the way to go if you want to enjoy these teas!

This tea is just ordinary without any distinctive flavors. The thistle tastes just like the whiskey flavor. The bags are small but brew a strong cup of tea quickly. For the price, I was hoping for more.
wow, I LOVE these teas, they are great so much so I ordered another box for a Christmas gift they are so good, I use them almost everyday and I am very pleased with them

Purchased these while in Scotland in 2009.  Been drinking them ever since. Originally had to order from Scotland and have them delivered to the US.  Thank you Amazon for providing them in the US! Have to agree with the other review - each one does have its own distinct flavor. While I use a little sugar, I do not use milk/cream. I add a bit of Whisky to the whisky flavored one for a bit more kick! Wonderful teas! Thank you!

column9: Wonderful way to start your day!
column10: I was originally searching for a Scottish Breakfast tea when I stumbled upon this 4-pack. I am a tea person and can't think of a better way to start my day each morning. These teas are delightful! Each tea has a subtle difference in taste, but it's made more evident when you add just a bit of milk. These are also very strong teas and I would recommend adding sugar to suit your taste. I hope you enjoy them as much as I have.

I'm in love!  My husband brought me a Caramel Cob from Utah while on a business trip - he thought it would be a fun little gag gift.  He was so wrong - one bite and I was in love with the soft, sweet, buttery caramel corn shaped like an ear of corn.  I was immediately hooked and went (a little) nuts looking for Caramel Cob in Las Vegas.  I even called Caramel Cob headquarters but they weren't able to find a distributor in town for me.  I went to the next best place - Amazon!  I found Caramel Cob on Amazon and it was a much better buy and it was also shipped for free.  When my box of 18 Caramel Cobs arrived it was difficult to pace myself and eat only one a day.  And as for sharing, well, let's just say, if you can find out where I've hidden them you deserve to have one!One of the best ways to eat Caramel Cob is to open the top of the wrapper and heat it in the microwave for about 15 seconds - the caramel softens a bit and the warm buttery taste will make you swoon.  Don't miss an opportunity to fall in love!

These caramel corn cobs are soft, chewy, and absolutely awesome!!  They literally melt in your mouth.  Best caramel corn I have ever had before.  You will NOT be disappointed!  And much cheaper if you buy the 18 pack.  I was paying $2.70 a piece at my local convenience store.  I culdn't find them anywhere else, so I ordered the 18-pack!  Enjoy...

I bought a couple of these from my local grocery store and was so sorry I had not bought more. These are so gooey,chewy and full of flavor. I never did try them warm just straight out of the bag! I have been looking for them for the last few months and have not had any luck in finding them in stock. So as always Amazon comes to the rescue and was able to order them. Like one of the other reviewers pointed out "If you like hard and crunchy these are not for you".

WOW, this caramel corn in shape of a cob is very addictive.  My whole family loves these and it's hard to stay away from them.  I no longer order a case and they disappear.  When you heat them they just melt in your mouth. I highly recommend these, you can't eat just one!

I moved from Texas to Ohio a few weeks ago and happened to run across these at a local farmer's market. I bought one solely because I thought the packaging was cute and I love popcorn balls and this is essentially a popcorn ball shaped like an ear of corn. I've searched far and wide for good store bought popcorn balls and usually couldn't find them until around Halloween and even then they were sub par. Same goes for up here, the only place I could find these was at a farmer's market where they were selling them for $3 a pop! So until now I was stuck making my own which is really a pain. As soon as I sunk my teeth into one of these I was in love. The popcorn is rich, buttery, and delicious, they are oozing with caramel which is exactly how I like it but surprisingly they aren't overly sweet. Everything about these is just right, the crunch, the sweetness, the softness, the butteriness, everything is just perfect. I raved to my husband about how awesome they were but how I couldn't find them anywhere besides that one place but they still were over priced and he surprised me by buying me this 18pk. I'm going to have to pace myself and not eat them all in one day which I could certainly see myself doing with how delicious they are. Now I must add that this stuff is soft and very caramely so if you are looking for the crunchy caramel corn that comes in the holiday tins, this is not what you want to buy.

I live in FLorida and there aren't many places to get good carmelcorn.  This is chewy with lots and lots of carmel.  If you like hard and crunchy this is NOT for you.  If you like to have the caramel dripping from the popcorn, try this, it is awesome. It is like getting it from the copper bowl all chewy and warm.

Super fast delivery! And amazing packaging! When i opened the box i saw 18 Cob's as promised and i took the first 1 out to try it, and it tasted GREAT! I love these things and i will definitely keep buying from here when i need more! =D REMEMBER TO HEAT THEM UP FOR 10 SECONDS!

My bride enjoys carmel corn. Except for one or two mom and pop shops scattered around the country, she has not found what she considers really good carmel corn. She went so far as to start making her own. So I bought her this product as a Christmas stocking stuffer. SHE LOVES IT! Great chewability and not overly sweet. She softenens it up by putting it in the micro for 10 to 15 seconds. Looks like I'll be buying this on a regular basis.

This yummy, chewy, sweet treat is the best thing I've had in a long time.  I had tried 2  purchased in a supermarket and once I tasted they lasted all of 20 minutes (long enough for me to get the second one open).  Went back for more and they had none left so went online to search and thankfully found them, and at a great price, thanks Amazon!!  If you want a chewy, carmelly treat this is what you've been looking for.  I've already ordered 4 cartons (we have a large family and everyone loves them,and especially my 94 yr. old mother, for whom they are soft and chewy enough).
We found this caramel cob corn while on vacation and loved it. Had to order more for us and the family. Very very good. You must try this wonderful product ! The price is right !
Warning, if you try it once, you will be addicted. My wife bought me one and I have been addicted ever since. Soft chewy caramel, like homemade caramel corn.

I bought this caramel corn in my local grocery store and that was it. They stop selling it and I freaked out. I searched online for the maker of this wonderfully addicting caramel cob and found that I could order it by the case, so i did. Mmmmm... warm it just a little in the microwave and walah you have a delicious desert. I am totally addicted and im never without. It is heavenly.

I have bought many times from Amazon but never written a review. But I am totally addicted to this caramel corn. I had bought one a time or two when I saw in stores. It was great and much softer than the bagged or boxed types I had tried before. Tried making Orville R's microwave version and it was messy and popcorn turned mushy. I recommend this heated, I break them in half and warm on a plate in the microwave (about 30 seconds in mine). The result is a plate full of warm, gooey caramel popcorn. Just ordered my 3rd case!

you will love Caramel Cob. Somehow they manage to keep their popcorn soft, even though most caramel popcorn gets brittle. And being able to microwave it in their plastic cover for 10 seconds to get warm caramel popcorn is even more awesome. I wish they sold it in six-packs, though.

The product Carmel Corn Cobs is wonderful.The service at Amazon STINKS!!!!!I pushed the one day service button just to see how muchit would cost before ordering any other ways, andbefore I knew it, Amazon had charged me $55.00 for a$20.00 box of Popcorn. They offered no way to correctmy order, they offered no way to delete it, they justtook my money and ran!!!!!

column9: This purchase was a definite MISS!
column10: I read multiple reviews prior to purchasing this product.  Most all of them RAVED about this product, so I was really anxious to receive the shipment so I could try for myself!  What a letdown!!  They aren't at all crunchy... You could kindly call them "soft and chewy" or describe them as they seemed to me, more "tough and spongy".  After eating part of one, I threw the rest of that one away.  Then I gave the other 17 in that box and another whole box of 18 away {As I said, I was impressed with the reviews I had read and kind of over-bought!!).  The general feedback I got was maybe 50-50.  Some liked them, but alot had the same opinion as I did. The actual taste was OK... it was the texture that killed them for me...  Just one opinion from Oregon.

A great mixture of sweet and sour.  These are not sour-balls, but rather a lemon-flavored hard candy that starts out sweet, and finishes slightly sour with a continuing hint of sweet.  I love the way the taste changes a bit from beginning to end, leaving you ready to try another!

When my husband quit smoking, he used these candies as his crutch. Over the years he has continued to use them , but ONLY the lemon. I have to move heaven and earth to find them sometimes, but fortunately, Amazon came to my rescue. Don't ever stop carrying them or I'm in trouble!

I think these candies are great; so nice and lemony. I'd give them 5 stars, but the sugar coating doesn't taste very nice and you have to get past that to the candy. OTOH, it keeps them from sticking together, and that's a plus. I just received another order. Not only do I purchase them for myself, I have them on hand to stick in as an extra with gifts. I recommend these. I haven't tried any of the other flavors, but I really love the lemon.

column9: Refreshing candy in a useful tin
column10: Here's an item for your Emergency Readiness Kit (or your everyday sweet tooth).Hard sugar candy lasts forever (although it may melt together). These candies give a sugar boost while also giving a refreshing lemon zest kick; good for staving off hunger and the dryness of thirst, and giving a quick energy boost..On top of all this, the tin itself is a useful item for reasonably dry storage or for the survivalist/recreationist to use as a tinder-box or for "cooking" char-cloth.

column9: La Vie de la Vosgienne Lemon Hard Bonbons
column10: This is my favorite candy - it really refreshes your pallet! I will be placing orders for these Bonbons many times in the future through Amazon - I give Amazon and La Vie five stars rating.
These are tasty hard candies. We love to take them to the theatre to suck on during performances. Only problem is in the metal container they can make a lot of noise unless you're careful.

These lemon and cherry drops are the best.  The favor last long and they are small.  The tin keeps them fresh.  I was unable to find them in the grocery stores where I use to get them, so I was glad to find them online.
I used to get these at specialty shops and then could't find them. They are great for when you need a little something, The tins are really great.

Looking for a replacement for Altoids sour candies which seem to discontinue, i bought these La Vie candies to see if they are as good. I bought Orange and Lemon flavors. Either of them are that good. They just don't have the kicks like Altoids sours; however, these don't give the irritation like the Altoids did. Not bad candies but nothing great either. I would never buy these again.
My husband and I love this milk it taste great you could eat it in cereal and it taste amazing compare to most non dairy milks. Give it a try you will love it
I have tried so many non dairy drinks for my son, soy? no,oat? no.....so when I found 7 grain I took a chance, and he liked it from the start. so why cant i buy it anymore?
The syrup tastes great but comes in a little tiny bottle. It is overpriced compared to what you can get at your local super-mart.  I'm giving it 5 stars for the taste and 1 for the price.

Well I was glad that the item arrived in time for the party. But I thought it was going to be bigger and in some kind of pop up display asthe picture seems to represent. It was a plain old cardboard box with a printed top that did not punch out and pop up. The card that I thought they were includingwith a sentiment was a yellow piece of paper with words handwritten on it. At the party people were taking notice of what candy was around in 1981 and what one'swere not. It was ok but I would never order it again-was not cheap especially when you ad in the shipping cost.

I sent this to my little sis for her 30th birthday. I wanted to send her something fun.  She loved it!  She was a candy freak when we were kids (and still is sometimes) so this was perfect. Lots of candy and the box it came in was really cute too.

The texture of the chocolate-covered raspberry jells is perfect, and the taste is so close to the original that I was totally satisfied. BUT: the sugar alcohols used to sweeten it are lethal to the digestive system. If you eat more than one of them in a single day, be warned. You're going to need a restroom nearby. However, if you can restrain yourself, these are a delicious treat. My only concern is the expense, so I'd recommend asking for the candies as gifts if anyone wants to know what you'd like for a special occasion.

I have bought this kind of candy before at a small candy shop in the mountains of North Carolina and these are just as good. Not as expensive as those were. Love the dark chocolate and raspberry together and to have them sugar free is even better.

These are really-really good! Take it from a person who tried all the best sugar free stuff there is. It's so good,you won't regret the pricey shipping even. The jelly inside is so fresh and yummy and the chocolate is not too thick, just right. Best experience if you eat them cold - right out of the fridge with a cup of tea or coffee. I'm getting myself more!

If you like Garlic and Olive Oil..... this is a MUST have for your kitchen.  Finally a product that tastes "Home Made & Fresh."The product has a great flavor and can be used in SO MANY wonderful dishes.  My favorite....add to chicken breast and fry in a pan...simple FAST and TASTY!PS  The health benefits of Garlic also keep me coming back for more.

i have been ordering solbites from my organic grocery delivery service.  i am addicted to them and must order them every week!  would love to see amazon sell them so i can get them at any time and in bigger quanities! the almond butter and honey are my favorite.

I am often out-of-doors on duty as a guide at the windy and sunny elephant seal rookery for a 3 hours. After my shift, I pull out SolBites for a great portable snack to pick up my energy. A real treat with lots of flavor. Thanks so much, SolBites!

I just ordered 5 boxes of Solbites to give to my customers at Fiat of Montgomeryville. Within a week the supply was depleted. Great packaging, great taste, great addition to the cluttered assortment of snacks. Solbites gets five stars from Fiat of Montgomeryville. Look for our next order!

First, I want pure coconut milk when I buy coconut milk. Please, read labels when buying this product, as there are many out there with fillers and chemicals which have no place in coconut milk. There will be a bit of thickener (Guar gum, as a rule), but nothing else should be there.Second, this product is very versatile. It can be used in soups, sauces, salad dressings and deserts. One of my favorite uses is to make a chocolate dipping sauce with cocoa and stevia - Diabetics and low carb eaters - this is WONDERFUL for fruit. It has great flavor, although very mild, and does not dominate other flavors when used in recipes. Yummy!You may find it has "separated" slightly when you open it. This is normal, just stir and use. I put mine in a glass storage container if I need to do this, as it is easier to stir in something other than the can.Enjoy!

column9: Use this stuff if you want to grow back your gums...
column10: This stuff is really potent. I originally bought it for my gums, but taking it also somehow gives you energy and vigor.  Read this article by Ray Peat [...]  ...Anyway, it basically explains how our diet lacks non-essential amino acids that are truly the hallmark of good health.  Somehow, eating this gelatin improved my mood, decreased my sugar cravings, and even increased my libido. I'm not making this stuff up.  Just try this stuff once and you'll feel the difference. I would recommend taking at least a 5-7 tablespoons  full if you want any noticeable effect on your first dose (think I've taken up to 15 at once). Anyway, I'd recommend buying the 2lb bag for the price break. I liked this stuff so much that you'll also see another review from me on the 2lb bag! Everyone should know about this stuff... Long story short, buy this stuff because at least in my case it helped heal my gums, gave me more energy, decreased my sugar cravings, and increased my sex drive. Try it once and review it, this product could truly change your health.  Oh yeah, I should also mentioned that the stupid shipping company lost my order the first time, but GoBio! was nice enough to send a replacement by Expressmail...

I recently bought some of this at a local market.  I decided to try it because for quite some time now I have purchased Morton's Light Salt to cut down on the some of the sodium I take in.  This Diamond Crystal blend is not only cheaper than the Morton's for a generous amount more, but it also taste better in my opinion.  Like the Morton's, it contains a full one third less sodium.  But where the Morton's uses the popular substitute Potassium Chloride that has a slight metallic taste to it, the main substitute ingredient in this Diamond Chrystal blend is Silicon Dioxide, which to me has a much more natural salt taste.  I prefer it over the potassium chloride, and as already mentioned, you get more for your money with this blend making it a sure deal. It took me no time at all to get used to it, and I use it in my cooking as well as in the shaker as well.  If you have trouble finding it locally, I suggest you pick it up by the case here on Amazon and you will be set for a year or more.  A real good salt substitute, (that does contain real salt as well) that I recommend...

column9: Product Rejected by Stores and Sold to You
column10: All cans dented.  That's how they manage a good price on this I guess

I've tried several different brands & this one is really good.  They had a great recipe on the back for dip & I got good feedback on that when I made it for parties.  I saw that another reviewer received dented cans, but mine managed to arrive in good condition.

column9: Everyone must taste this wine at least once.
column10: Everyone should try this wine at least once becasue it's unbelievable. I just wish it was easier to get in the States.

My dog just needs to see me shake the container of these treats, and she comes running to sit at my feet. She'll circle through all the tricks she knows in order to get one! They are a good small size, so I don't feel bad about giving them to her and ruining her appetite for her regular meals.
This is a terrific treat. My dog loves them. They are a bit pricey, yet worth it as a special snack.
Our puppy LOVES these.  As soon as she has one in her mouth, she runs to some comfy spot to chew on it.  We love these because they are just chicken and no chemicals.

At a couple bucks a bag indulge yourself!  Heavy with the caramel and the flavor, a bit light on the nuts-but they are in there.  The cranberries are a very nice touch if you like something chewy with your caramel corn.  Comparable to Poppycock but a bit more flavor and lighter on the nuts, a very good change of pace.

column9: Carmel Corn Clusters with Cranberries and Nuts!
column10: This was a really surprising delicious caramel corn. The kernels were very large and the caramel was really buttery and flavorful. There were not as many cranberries as advertised on the package but it was a tasty treat.  This is not for anyone with tender teeth as the nuts would easily cause some folks to seek dental work after consuming. The almonds in particular were very tough to chew and the caramel is a tougher type akin to hardball/crack stage of making homemade caramel.  This product is of a much denser consistency than the typical grocery store Fiddle Faddle or Cracker Jack brands.  Overall it was something completely different and would be enjoyed by most at the holidays.

I bought these for my husband, who spent a few years in Okinawa, Japan when he was younger. This is a great kit! Easy to understand directions, although I couldn't read it the directions had pictures that were step by step. My husband loves the fact that the seaweed is kept apart from the rice, so that the seaweed doesn't get soggy. These are great with smoked salmon in the middle!

After living in Japan for about 8 years, I got used to picking up different flavors of "rice triangles" at the convenience stores off base.  They made for the perfect breakfast, lunch, or snack.The REALLY neat thing about how they are packaged in Japan (and in this set), is that the seaweed sheet is wrapped inside its own little plastic section so it doesn't come in direct contact with the rice unitl you actually open it.  That way the seaweed doesn't get soft and mushy because of the moisture in the rice.  All you do is peel the tab at the top of the rice triangle to expose the seaweed (like unwrapping a pack of cigarettes), and then slip off the 2 halves of plastic, and you have your perfectly wrapped little treat - crunchy seaweed and all!When I rotated back to the U.S., I really missed them, and am very happy to have found these.The directions on how to make the rice triangle and wrap the seaweed around it correctly are fairly easy to follow (pictures, thank God).  I already have Japanese friends here asking where they can buy them.Also, I was the envy of those sitting around me on the plane when I whipped two of these out and everyone else was stuck eating either junk food or over-priced airline sandwiches!Good stuff!

If you love rice/onigiri, this is a must-have. You will get one rice mold (mine was pink instead of blue, as in the picture) and a package with 10 sheets of nori wrappers. The instructions for the wrappers are a little hard to follow, but after doing it twice it is relatively easy. I bought these so I could make an onigiri in the morning, toss it in my bag and have it for lunch at work. I'm not confident enough in my wrapping skills to throw the onigiri in my bag quite yet, but I will get there.These sheets of nori are packaged individually between one sheet of shiny plastic and one sheet of non-stick plastic. They are air-tight. This makes the nori unbelievably fresh. In addition, the nori itself is thinner than the nori I usually use, which allows the nori to stay stuck to the rice (thicker sheets tend to unpeel themselves), and makes it easier to bite into. In short, they are designed especially for onigiri.... but the really special thing about these wrappers is the layer of nonstick plastic between the rice and the nori. When you peel away the wrapper, the rice and nori meet for the first time. When I bit into the first onigiri I made from this set, I was absolutely blown away. Never have I had nori so fresh. Texturally, it's a totally different experience. Instead of chewy or soggy, the nori is dry and crunchy. It breaks apart easily. If you have had sushi before, you know that the seaweed wrapped around the outside is kind of chewy and impossible to bite in half. This seaweed is exactly the opposite because it doesn't absorb any moisture from the air or the rice until the moment you're ready to eat it.I know that these sheets are used all over Japan to package convenience store onigiri. Because they are made especially for onigiri, they are especially good. I will be repurchasing more wrappers in the future. They are really wonderful!

After spending a great amount of time in Korea as a wandering student on a budget, I discovered this snack and became hooked. If you're looking for a healthy snack that you can can have a say about the contents of it, then this what you need to make it.The product is solid. I received exactly what was shown on this product. The molder works like a wonder and helps me prepare snacks very quickly. It's does the job just fine. If you love this snack, then mold will help you greatly. I'm very happy with it.

Very strong seaweed taste, and they sent me a different mold than the one pictured.  It was 2 little molds connected together.  It still works--but I wanted the single mold that was pictured.  I didn't try to fix it--they probably would have--just didn't bother.

Not only is this excellent coffee when prepared in conventional coffee makers, but it's my preferred brand and flavor for my 16 ounce mocha cappuccino every morning.I like being able to order it in the three-pack, especially with no shipping charge thanks to my Amazon Prime account, because it assures I have plenty on hand.Also, this is a much better price than I pay for the same product at my local supermarket.+++++UPDATED ON AUG. 11, 2012At $40+, this is way too expensive. I can buy the same three packages at my local Kroger supermarket for $26.97 ($8.99/package).
Starbucks Italian Roast wakes me up, does not upset the stomach and is superbly fragrant and never ever bitter.Can't do without it!

saw the starbucks coffee at an excellent price and it was free shipping, my daughter and son-in-law in Phoenix love their coffee, so what a great treat they got and were thrilled with it, thanks for the sales up-dates..
Starbucks is my favorite coffee. Xbold wakes you up quickly in the morning. Sometime a good price from Amazon, othertimes cheaper in neighbourhood groceries on sale.
For anybody that like good rich coffee with breakfast every morning this is the product for you. Strong,rich and plenty of flavor with no harsh bitterness through the whole pot.

column9: Great Deal If You're Hooked On Starbucks Coffee!
column10: My local grocery store charges $9.95 per 12 oz bag of French Roast which is the only Extra Bold Starbucks which they sell. I prefer Starbucks Italian Roast and get it here on Amazon. For anyone, like myself, who drinks strictly Starbucks Coffee this is a great deal! Starbucks is more expensive than the everyday coffee brands so anyone shopping for those would find Starbucks expensive. I recommend to all my Starbucks loving friends, family and YOU to buy it here on Amazon where the price is great and shipping is fast! Italian Roast may not be your favorite but search for yours on Amazon and I'm just about sure you'll find it!

When you "subscribe" to one of the Starbucks products, you set a schedule for them to send you coffee at a discount, every month or whatever. The price is right, and you can hold off shipments if you overestimated, or invoke an immediate shipment if you're running low. The only complaint I have about this great deal is that you have to purchase 3 packages of the same type of coffee at once. This can get monotonous if you don't roar through coffee (at work, say). A good deal, it could be made better.

Is Starbucks Italian Roast disappearing?  'can't find it in VIA packs or ground coffee in stores - no VIA packs sold here.  Please don't stop making this coffee available.  It is what it says - Extra Bold - not bitter - and for my two cents "LOVELY"!!
Wonderful, good price timely delivery no problems...love starbucks coffee important to get it at a fair price otherwise will start drinking chicory not good...

column9: I like this even better than the Sumatra!
column10: This was really good. I got the Sumatra last time, and it was pretty good, but this was even better, and goes extremely well in my espresso maker. Tastes really fresh even though this is already ground and not beans.
If you like the darkest of roasts, the dirtiest of earthy, the boldest of bold, this coffee is for you!  I am very much enjoying this daily wake-up call.
Italian roast is very expensive on average $14.00 a pound. This coffee is bold and extremely flavorful. The price is right as well.

column9: very good coffee for those who like a bold flavor
column10: very good coffee with a bold not bitter tastereally enjoy this coffee  ships quickly and ispackaged well Will buy again

starbucks addict. bought five tassimos great coffee bought five keurigs when starbucks went withg them inferior product.still use other brand italian roast and sumatra asa starbucksa k cups suck in bold coffees
its terrible. bad batch maybe, i went of the three reviews before me and that was a mistake. dont spend your money!
If you like HOT sauce, this is the stuff for you.  I has a bit of a kick to it, so make sure you have a glass of milk near.

I have all kinds of hot sauces for all kinds of recipe and condiment purposes, but this is the most unique one in my collection.  A jalapeno/horseradish/wasabi hybrid, you'll want to use it on things where you can really appreciate the flavor and not just the (moderate) heat.  Try it on a veggie dog!

I received this as a gift and wasn't sure what to think.  It was clearly unique.  I was having trouble in my mind picturing the nasal blast of wasabi pairing with a jalapeno hot sauce.  The first taste told me it was not what I was expecting, and it was in fact real good!The flavor is a sweet and tangy base (almost mayonnaise in flavor, not texture) with jalapeno up front and wasabi and mustard at the end.  The whole thing works together beautifully in my opinion.This goes great with shrimp as a cocktail sauce, and that is where the rest of my bottle went.  I will be buying this again.

Be warned this is not the stuff you get at the grocery store, if you want to make a cocktail sauce that will literally make you cry this is it. Its a bit pricey because of the shipping but it is worth every penny. THEY HOTTEST ON THE MARKET

Growing up in Milwaukee, Gardetto's breadsticks and snack mix were always a favorite.  When I moved to Florida they were not readily available in stores (though I see them everywhere now).  I love that I can buy the snack mix products in small snack size bags.  A perfect size to take along on a car or plane trip or just for a snack in front of the TV (I fear what I might do with the big bag).  The seasoning is amazingly flavorful - Pretzels, Breadsticks and Rye Chips! What more could you want? And shipping with Amazon Prime ..... who coud ask for a better setup!
SO yummy - lots od fifferent sizrs shapes and textures. Seasoned perfectly with the baby rye rounds being the stand out !

This is one of the few times that Amazon has really let me down.  According to the company that sold this item -- Nutricity is the name of the company -- Amazon mispublished the price of the item.  I was supposed to get 60 of the Numi pots for the price they advertised, but I only got 10, because according to the company that these pots came from, Amazon made a mistake.  No one called me to correct the mistake, but it was corrected on Amazon when I back on-line to see what had happened.  I kept a copy of the advertised price that I bought the pots for.  I am terribly disappointed that I was not contacted by Amazon and told of the mistake.  So, instead of 60 pots for $265+, I got stuck with 10 pots.  I called the manufacturer and asked to return the pots with them paying the postage for the mistake.  The rep at Nutricity said she'd get back to me.  I never heard from here again.

We have a Nostalgia Cotton Candy Machine.  When we tried this floss with our little machine one scoop made a nice fluffy cotton candy cone that almost resembled the ones we get at the fair.  It gave us better results then the floss that came with the machine.  I think we will get a lot more use out of our machine with this!

We own the Nostalgia hard candy cotton candy machine. We tried using the hard candy and it worked great, but it wasn't giving us the true cotton candy flavor we love. My machine states I can use both cotton candy floss or hard candy, so I thought we'd give this floss a try. We purchased both the pink vanilla and blue raspberry flavors. They arrived today and I couldn't wait to try it. This stuff worked so much better than the hard candy.  We used the scoop that came with the machine, and I was surprised how big and fluffy it turned out. One scoop made a regular sized cotton candy just like at the carnival or fair. With the hard candies I was getting just a small amount at a time. The flavor is the flavor I remember from my youth. Absolutely YUMMY!!! Will definitely buy this again when needed. But the 4lb container is so big, it should last us a very long time.
This is the best cotton candy sugar I've had. It makes more cotton candy than other brands and tastes amazing!

column9: Make some of teh Best Cotton Candy
column10: We had an opportunity to use the Paragon Cotton Candy Floss sugar recently in a commercial Gold Medal Cotton Candy machine.  The end result is simply amazing.  We read all of the other reviews before purchasing the Pink Vanilla flavor for our event and we were not disappointed.  The cotton candy had a full and sweet flavor with a nice texture that everyone loved.  If you are in the market, this would be a great choice.
This cotton candy floss is a great product. I used on the Nostalgia Electrics Cotton Candy Maker (bought at Bed Bath & Beyond). It works perfect. I would recommend this product.

I prefer to eat the "PINK" cotton candy and this flavor pink  vanilla is better than great!  You get a lot for your money. My girls also love it!! This is the BEST! When you buy this, I promise you will not be disappointed with this purchase. I Almost forgot to add, my  family members, the girls at my job, and my mother in law really loves this cotton candy flavor too..buy with confidence-deb,kamri and endia.

So happy I placed my order with this company! Order shipped quickly, was delivered before promised and size is great for the price. Took my cotton candy maker to my classroom for a fun activity for my fourth graders at the end of the year and they had a blast spinning their own delicious treats! The pink vanilla is my favorite flavor and is usually what I order but this floss sugar has the best flavor of any others I've ever ordered so I'm confident I'll be a return customer and may even try some of their other delicious flavors! I recommend this product with complete confidence to anyone with a sweet tooth and a cotton candy maker!

It took a little long to get going in the machine, but once it did it tasted great. The kids loved it. It tasted just like the pink cotton candy at the fair. It's much better using this than trying to crush hard candy and put it in the machine. This cotton candy floss makes light and fluffy cotton candy.

I ordered this to go with my Nostalgia cotton candy machine (which didn't come with any sugar/floss).  This is just like the stuff you get at a county fair.  It was nummy and easy to do.  The smell is incredible.  I have even eaten some of the sugar without flossing it in the machine.  :) (naughty me).  If you want to do cotton candy at home--this is what you are looking for.  Be care - the 4lb bottle is enough for a hundred cones.
Bought this to use in my Nostalgia Cotton Candy Machine CCM-505. Works perfect in this machine. Easy to use and makes a great tasting cotton candy. Will buy again.
tastes and looks just like real cotton candy. and it lasts a while. ill buy some ina few months when i run out

It's a shame that Amazon doesn't offer more choices in the sizes of this product. I read the reviews and I thought this flavor would produce the original pink cotton candy flavored floss, but it's not quite the same. It's close, but the flavor is slightly different and the floss isn't quite as soft as I expected. I wasn't looking for any other flavor of floss, especially since the machine I bought works with any flavor of hard candy you want to try, so I'm a bit disappointed that I'm stuck with this huge container of sugar that isn't quite what I wanted. It would be nice if they offered smaller sizes, like pints, of original flavor floss sugar, and even nicer if they included one with the machine when you purchase it.

This cotton candy sugar tastes just like the old-fashioned fair cotton candy I remember from when I was a kid. YUM! I like that it is in a plastic container, it seems like it will be better protected from heat and humidity.

We recently purchased a home cotton candy maker along with this floss.  The floss worked very well in the machine!!!  Love, love, love cotton candy.  I would purchase this item again!  Might even try another flavor.

Bought this for a birthday party to make cotton candy and before I knew it all the cotton candy was gone. I kept getting asked to make more from both kids and adults. It tastes just like the cotton candy from a carnival or circus. It tastes and smells delicious.

Got the 5-pack of this because it came with free Prime shipping, so 1 bottle (without Prime) would've cost about the same as the 5. It's nice, I actually use it quite a bit, but it's sort of bland. I was hoping it would have a more distinctive vibrant flavor, but it's more of a "background" spice blend, to use when something needs a little more body. Works well for that.Out of the 5 bottles, I gave one away, 2 others were fine, 1 bottle has a horrible 45 degree "lean" like it was exposed to a lot of heat at some point but the contents seem OK, and 1 bottle was chock-full of live moth larvae. I've gotten a number of spices and grain products over the years that have been infested before opening, so I guess it means they didn't irradiate the spices here, which is a good thing!?!? One bug-egg can easily make it through processing, especially since herbs aren't usually heat-treated, but together with the leaning bottle I'd have to say their quality metric wasn't exceptional.

I own a doggie daycare and boarding facility. I keep these stocked in our lobby all the time because it is everyone's favorite. Dogs love them and the owner's like the size of them... not too big and not too small. They also have a nice texture... again, not to hard and not too soft and the dogs seem to like the peanut butter taste. Very reasonably priced for a good quality product.
Our dog has a liver condition and cannot eat meat. Our vet highly recommends these treats because they are all natural. Our dog loves them too!

My dog has loved these treats from the beginning. I have used them as a training reward for commands as well as an all round treat. She has not put on extra weight during training as she did with other treats. I have given her up to 20 treats a day during her training. I use them and include her twice daily meals.

column9: Best Creole Seasoning I've ever had!
column10: I've was introduced to this product by my dad when I was in my teens. 30+ years later, Konriko's Creole Seasoning is still my favorite. I use it all over the place, but one of the simplest ways is still my fave: just lightly sprinkle some of it on chicken or pork and grill it.

I adore this seasoning. Why on earth has it disppeared from the grocery stores? I was excited to see it on Amazon. Twelve cans was a bit much, but I HAD to have this stuff so I'll just store it .. somewhere. I use it on meat, chicken, fish, eggs, veggies, popcorn.. I use this instead of salt and pepper.

column9: Konriko Seasoning makes good jerky great..
column10: This product was discontinued in my shopping area.  I found it on the web and ordered a case. This is by far one of the best cajun seasonings I have ever found and I've done a lot of shopping for different flavors for my chili and beaf jerky.  Every time I make a new batch of jerky people say that the last batch was much better. Usually the only difference was that I left out my old standby Konriko. I have turned every meat I can get into jerky.  I know a little bit about what people like.  Spicy, not hot.

This seasoning has got to be the most awesome thing EVER!  good on everything from soups to potatoes, but best on steaks! I havent used salt and pepper for prolly 10 years. Thanks Konriko, PS hire a marketing team and get this in some stores again!

Like the others who wrote reviews, I also have used Konriko Creole Seasoning for years. I use it on meats, poultry, you name it. In the past, I would buy several cans at a time.  Unfortunately when I finished my last can, I scoured all the local supermarkets for more. None carried the seasoning. Thank goodness for Amazon. At least they cared about those of us who love this product and would do anything to get it.

Konriko is my favorite Creole Seasoning and  it's hard, no, impossible to find in local (Mesa/Phoenix AZ) grocery stores. Other brands of creole/cajun seasoning can't hold a candle to this one for overall great taste and just the right amount of heat. Found Konriko  online with best price/lowest shipping cost at Amazon. However, lowest per-unit cost  was achieved by buying the 12-pack.  More than I really needed at one time, but it's nonperishable, and extras should keep  OK stored in freezer.  Easy transaction and the 12-pack of seasoning arrived in a flash--- excellent order fulfillment!

My husband and I found this seasoning many years back. Only one local grocery store carried it at the time and now none of them do. But luckily, we can still get it online. It's the only seasoning we use for our carne asada tacos or just when we're having a grilled steak. It's fabulous and all of our friends now use it too.

I love this seasoning and I use it in just about everthing I cook.  From fried chicken, to spicey rice and beans and combos.  I couldn't find it in  my local grocery store; so I said to myself let me try my trusty Amazon site and there it was!!!  So love Amazon and this creole seasoning!!!  Try it you won't be sorry!!!!

Many coffee brands that advertise their beans as "Kona" are blends, containing only ten percent beans from the highly desirable region, but these Aloha Island Gold beans are pure Kona, all from plants grown on the Big Island in the designated microclimate that produces some of the smoothest coffee beans in the world. While the Aloha brand may not be Hawaii's best, it is certainly one of the more available brands on the mainland.  Store in the freezer to maintain optimal freshness, and grind the beans immediately before brewing.For coffee connoisseurs, two phrases light up their eyes, "Jamaican Blue Mountain" and "Kona."  If you want to give a gift sure to impress a sophisticated coffee drinker, you've found your beans.

column9: One of the best coffees out there
column10: Finally a coffee that is full of wonderful flavor without all of the bitterness and half of the acidity of regular coffee.  I can drink as many cups as I want without worrying about getting a stomach ache!  I will never go back to another coffee and will recommend this to everyone I know.

I absolutely love this coffee! It is extremely rich and smooth and without any of the bitterness that most other coffees have.Don't let the cost of this coffee scare you because you will actually use less of this coffee when you brew so it really ends up costing about the same as any other "regular" coffee. I highly recommend it.

Yes, it's expensive.  Most of the finer things in life are.  Buy it whole bean, get a good burr grinder and a french press.  You will not be dissapointed.  Anyone that has a cup of joe at my house is blown away, even me...every time.

It seems there is never a place where I can buy a good 100% Kona here in the States. At last I found it!  GOLD Estate Kona is the best Kona I have EVER had. I gave some to a co-worker down the hall and heard instant raves; this coming from a coffee gourmet. This brand is excellent.  The reviews were right.The directions in the package are just right.  Follow them and taste the best coffee you've ever had.

Sticker on invoice: "We care about your satisfaction with our products and service. If you have any concerns or questions about your shipment, please call us toll free at..."Who would think that getting coffee could be so difficult?! We had a problem and it had been arranged that the coffee would be exchanged. They sent a Fed Ex label and off it went. After 2 weeks, a call was placed to check status. Emma (Pres) relayed the shipment would go out immediately and apologized for the delay. Thought it was done...  A few moments later, Anna calls back and goes into some diatribe with my wife not knowing what coffee is.  If the president of the company resolved the issue, why is someone else from the company calling to stir it up?!Another call back to speak with Emma and she apologized for the actions of Anna. The coffee and a "for your trouble" gesture would be sent along that day. They are located cross town about 10 miles away and most shipment are next day...nothing came.A week passed and still nothing. Another call. Emma relays that it should have been taken care of and will call me back next day to confirm. Next day came, went...nothing. We are quite disappointed by this company. They got the $$ and we received empty words.
I gifted my brother and sister-in-law with this for Christmas and they enjoyed it very much. Their visitors smelled the coffee brewing and decided to stay longer. What a bunch of mooches.:-)
My husband loved the coffee and keeps it to brew for special occasions/guests.

We bought this coffee based on all the hype (Food & Wine Magazine, "handcrafted" , "Estate" , etc)  but as serious coffee drinkers, we didn't feel this was worth the high price (especially when shipping is added). It had a pleasant, full bodied taste, but so do a lot of other, more easily available and less expensive coffees.Starbucks for example,  has enough different varieties of coffee where you'll find one blend very similar if not as good (or better) tasting than the much lauded Kona........just our $0.02

Not really, but she gave me this stuff for Christmas and I'm totally hooked. I got a gift card from a co worker and I'm going to blow it all on this coffee.Oh well the kids don't really need private school do they? :)Try it you won't regret it......

When I got to enjoy a cup of Kona on our vacation to Hawaii, I thought I was in Heaven.  The smooth flavor was something to enjoy at any time of day or night.  This Kona brand seemed very strong to me - I even tried not using to much coffee and more water and it still seemed too stong.  I missed the smoothness and flavor of the Kona I remembered in Hawaii.  For that reason, I do not think it's the same Kona I loved so much and would rate this coffee at a 3.
Very good but too early to give final rating until we try other beans

column9: Great Product!  Fooled the cats again!!
column10: For those cats that think they are pigs, this mat works great.  No longer can they succeed with getting their food and water all over the floor within minutes of me getting their mess cleaned up.  I know it spoils their fun to no longer be able to watch the water run across the floor after the joy of seeing it bubble out of the container and then push food into it just to watch it swell up, but my time is more valuable than theirs...at least to me.  Also, the mat does not scoot easily so they cannot drag it...oops, spoiled another one of their games!

column9: Works well unless you have a messy lazy pet
column10: When I found this mat, I was looking for something to keep the cat food off the kitchen floor.  This works better than anything else that I have tried.  I still have cat food on the floor every morning, but nothing like before.  We have two cats, one who isn't messy with her food and the other makes up for it.  My two year old cat is very lazy and will lay on her side and pull the food out of the bowl with her paw, making it land on the floor by her head.  This way, she can eat laying down! Yes, I did say she was lazy!  :)  Great product and was shipped nicely as well.  No complaints. :)

The Van Ness food mat is a great product.  The edges are raised to prevent water leaks onto your floor/rug, and the material is very easy to clean. I also found that the size is perfect for an automatic feeder, and a decent size water bowl. FIVE STARS!

I have had two of these mats for a number of years.  I use them for my two cats food bowls.  Sometimes the cats manage to push little bits of wet food out of the bowls and it's nice to have it land on these mats rather than my floor.  They are also excellent for water bowls.  One of my cats liked to dip his paw in the water and lick the water off his paw rather than drinking directly from the bowl and the mat was great for catching little drips.  These mats are very easy to clean and they've held up wonderfully and still look great.
Product came all bent out of shape, probably due to shipping. Big enough to fit 2 dishes. If I place the water dish on the warped side it holds the mat down. It's OK

This is just too small for my messy black lab.  Water still gets on the floor when Bear is drinking.  It is easy to clean though and I can see where it would be perfect for a cat-so I guess it deserves 4 stars.

column9: Great mat at a great price
column10: Love this mat and it is the perfect size to put one water bowl and a food bowl. The lip is great as it keeps food and some of the water on the mat and not the floor.

Have used various place mats for our little dog in the past. They still let water either soak up in porous materials or run off onto the flooring if the material was non-porous. This Van Ness Dinner Mat solves the problem!!  Water is contained on the mat and the mat is easily cleaned. Great product !!

column9: You never know about the color!
column10: Great product, it does it's job in my house. Mine arrived and it was blue, but I suppose that's more of a seller thing than a product thing.  So I have no complaints!

This pet food mat is a heavier, thicker material than I expected, which is good!  It doesn't slip around and the edges are high enough to catch stray food/water.  Bowls do slip around on top of it, so if you want the top to be non-slip, pick something else or get bowls with a rubber bottom.  Otherwise, I love it!  I've only had it a few days, but I imagine it will be simple to clean as well when the time comes.  Highly recommended.

The mat works very well in keeping the cat's food and water contained. The lip is a good height and the mat doesn't slide.  No more messy floors because my cat thinks her water dish is a swimming pool.  The only fault, as another customer has mentioned, is that the mat I received is bright blue instead of the beige color that is shown.

The mat works well to contain food and water. The raised lip is great. The mat lays flat and doesn't slide all over the floor. It cleans easily. My only complaint is not with the product but the fact that I got a blue mat and the poicture ius white., which is what i wanted
This keeps the water off the floor.  We have a cat that likes to play with the water so the combination of a wide shallow popcorn bowl and this mat keeps the water from running out over the floor.

I didn't think this honey tasted as good as the hampton's honey. I bought clover honey both times and the mclures tasted more like pure sugar. It was OK, but the hampton's honey had a nicer, fuller, somewhat spicier flavor and it was ever so slightly thicker.Next up, Wedderspoons.

This product was disappointing, the honey tasted like any other brand of nondescript honey, no hints of blueberry whatsoever. I have had blueberry honey from a blueberry farm that did taste mildly of blueberry. I do not recommend McLure's Blueberry Honey product.
I use a lot of this Kraft cheese. Put it on almost anything. At the store you get half the cheese at almost the same price as Amazon. Great cheese and deal.

I used to run out of cheese pretty frequently, it's annoying to have to go to the store for just cheese when, as a bachelor, the majority of your diet is buttered noodles with cheese. With this product, I got's cheese for days son.

This container was delivered about an hour ago in a cardboard box with other food items. So far no problem, but after taking this 24 oz container out of the box I noticed it had no tight plastic wrapping around it that could protect it from tampering.After opening the cover i noticed there was a round paper right under the cover that is supposed to be glued completely around the top of the container. This paper was only glued half way around the container.... in other words, there is the possibility of tampering with this product. I cannot trust it, so even though the parmesan cheese smells good i would rather not take chances on that one.

Good deal on mass produced parmesan cheese. Add it to a lot of things and I do like the taste it produces a fair bit. Made an eggplant-onion-tomato stew the other day and sprinkling in some non-fat sourcream and a small amount of this cheese made it rather delectable.

I'm giving this 5 stars because I just love this product; however, it only has a four month expiration date, so I'm going to keep it in the fridge like I always do.  It's great on pasta, of course, but really shines if you put some in your homemade white bread recipe!
I was testing buying this cheese online and it was great.  I will get it again.  The cheese came in tasting great and I liked it on my ground beef.  Really enjoyed it and would recommend it.

I found this product sold as "No Filler"Lets take a look at the ingredients: 2% of Enzymes (stomach lining of slaughtered cows and pigs, 2% Cheese Culture (may contain itch causing cheese mites, with anal suckers, known to give the nutty flavor in hard cheeses), 2% Cellulose Powder (inert  filler) to Prevent Caking, 2% Potassium Sorbate (Elsevier says, "Based on our and other positive results, consumers should be made aware that Potassium Sorbate should be considered genotoxic and mutagenic compound). Rest is composed of fat free dry milk, most of the time aged and about to be expired for added flavor.

I received this 4 pack of graham crackers on June 26th.  It expires Sept. 12th.  It is ridiculous and inappropriate to send bulk food items with such a short expiration date.  I am living overseas, and returning this will involve significant time and money on my part, almost not worth the effort.  Not a happy customer, and will not be ordering from this vendor again.

My green cup arrived (They sent 2) and when I opened the box, I thought... what a joke.  It was two pieces, a green cup with a cover that snapped on top.  It came with a pod so I popped the pod into the cup, put on the cover and inserted in my Keurig. To my surprise the coffee was great. It has no moving parts and seems so simple but really works.  My only complaint is the pod they provided (Brioni's) I can't find on Amazon or anywhere else.

column9: The Green Cup Pod Adaptor for Keurig
column10: My new Green Cup Pod adaptor arrived today. I recieved two adaptors along with some sample pods. It worked as promised and made a delicious cup of coffee( I brewed their Firenze Blend). It is very easy to use and to discard, I am sold it is a great product.

Well, I was at the neighborhood grocery store with my little boy (3) and we were going past the candy isle. Any of you with kids knows what that means. The question is not whether you'll get some candy, but what kind of candy are you going to get? Well, I don't like to feed the guy sugar, so I found these Ice Breakers Frost (wintercool) mints which are sugar free. He could hardly wait until we got out of the store to have one and I had one with him. Mmmmmm. These things are really good. Brisk and refreshing. Nice tasting. Long lasting. He loves them. Now he's carrying his little box around as a prize and I give him another every once in a while. I might have another myself too.Gary Peterson

Got these to put in my automatic dispenser (instead of candy) at work. These satisfy sudden, pre-break hunger nicely, and I like that they're a significant source of protein which stabilizes blood sugar. The color mix is  visually enticing and decorative in the clear dispenser, and they taste great. In fact, they've been declared "wonderful" by everyone in my office. The Wasabi taste is addictive, and these are just lightly dusted/coated. Perfect.Also, the seller (American Spice Co) got them here incredibly quickly, long before the projected date.  I'm greatly impressed. The only way they could have gotten here quicker is to ship them BEFORE I ordered.  This is an item that I will order again and again.

column9: So far this is the ONLY product that satisfies my craving for bread
column10: FIRST -- Let me tell you that I am the type of person who -- while not fat, does need to be aware of weight issues and watch calories.  A woman reaches an age where even a former skinnywinny has to do that.  And I am a former skinnywinny who used to eat the entire bread basket and ask for more at a restaurant before the meal even arrived. I love bread. . . all kinds of bread.  And I hate having to limit how much I eat of it these days. So, three cheers (or 30) to Wegman's food for producing the only product I've ever found to satisfy my craving for bread -- and for ONLY 16 calories per slice . . .er, per "popcake."  I've tried Ak-Mok, flat bread, pita bread, Ry-Krisp, home-baked, wheat thins, salt-rising, oat bread, seven-grain, organic, beer bread, sour dough, high-fiber/low fat bread, Trader Joe's mini-muffins, the 45-calorie slices one of the bakeries puts out, hi-fiber low-cal white tortillas (which aren't horrible) . . . but this stuff ACTUALLY DOES quench my bread cravings with minimum calories and maximum satisfaction.  Forget those puffed rice cakes! Yeeccchhh! Like eating styrofoam.  Plus, they crumble all over the place.  But these are heaven.  I cannot get enough. Or, rather, I CAN get enough to satisfy me so that I do not have to stuff my face on actual bread. Maybe it's the shape. They're about the size of a tortilla, only puffy. Texture is similar to the rice cakes, except for the "mouthfeel," (I understand this is a technical term that professional food tasters use, ha ha!). These feel a little "slick" in your mouth, which is so much better than rice cakes and, somehow, they are not as dry. They're a little "glossy" on the tongue, not "matte" and flat.You can cut them in half and put sandwich spread on them, such as tuna fish, or diet mayo, cucumber, and thin slices of lunch meat or roast beef, or ham and mustard.  Then cover them with the other half and you have a sandwich! With only 16 calories of bread!  Or, you can even eat peanut butter and jelly.  IT's easy to spread them with tub/bin-style margarines or butter substitutes... Or, even whipped butter if you want to pig out.  Or, eat them with a thin trail of honey drizzled over them.However you use bread, you can use these (except for French toast -- I'm sure that would NOT work.)  I have not put them into the toaster yet, but I might try it on low at some point. (They might shrivel or burn fast . . .I don't know.  But my instincts tell me they'd be okay on the "low" setting, and just get brown and even tastier. I love to put soft boiled eggs on them with salt substitute and pepper, though I boil the eggs until the yolk has thickened a little and isn't really too runny anymore because if you put really wet things on these, the liquid WILL bleed through and drop on your blouse or something.  I would NOT put pickle relish on them (too wet), or tomatoes (unless I covered the "popcake" with a layer of mayo, butter, or a big, wide lettuce leaf).  I did eat them with a pretty runny egg once and the egg dripped out through a soaked crack in the popcake.I think the thing I love most about them is that, while they are mostly AIR, they actually TASTE like yeasty bread.  And they are really crisp.I can eat a whole one during the afternoon -- either along with shaved carrots and Laughing Cow lite cheese, or with a piece of low-fat, or no-fat cheese and cucumber and mustard or lite mayo.  It's flavor, plus texture...  I suppose if I sprayed them with butter spray, and sprinkled them with that yellow "popcorn salt" that you can buy in some grocery stores, I could sneak about 7 of them into the theater in my purse and be very happy guzzling them down and pigging out on them for about 112 calories.  That would get me through a movie... ha, ha.  I could have my "popcake" and eat it too!  Normally I do not go on and rave about products.  And I realize it's a matter of personal taste.  Some people might find them a bit styrofoamy due to their airy texture.  But I am so grateful to have found a substitute for bread that actually has that "bready" taste, something that I can use for sandwiches (which I love) and still feel satisfied, that I am celebrating the crispy texture rather than complaining about missing that yielding, semi-moist texture and fragrance of fresh-baked bread. I feel like I've just gone to Marshall's and bought a Ralph Lauren Black Label Evening Gown that fits great and looks like dynamite for only $10.99.  If you have to buy $30 worth of these, or 10 of them, to qualify to purchase them online, I believe you will not regret getting so many UNLESS THEY GET STALE DURING SHIPPING.  I would not know about that.  I got mine at Whole Foods in Massachusetts.  Not sure if they're available on the West Coast -- I've not ever seen them there.  And never at a standard grocery store like Ralph's, Von's, Safeway, Market Basket, Albertson's, or other chains.  Just Whole Foods, though some of the other artisan-style foodstores might -- just might -- carry them.  You might check the actual Coco foods site by doing a search engine search.  Anyway, I think this is one of the best diet aids EVER! Hope this helps.  And no, I do not work for the company or have any relatives working for them.  I usually am a bit critical of products.
I enjoy these with peanut butter or cheese spread on them. They are a great way to replace bread.  Even good by themselves.  Love them!

I LOVE this product.  My 12 month old and 3 year old can't get enough of them.  I used to buy the Baby Mum-Mums, because it was a choke-free snack that kept babies and toddlers busy and happy, but I always had serious qualms about the fact that they were made in china.  After passing these by in the store forever, I finally picked up the Coco pop cakes at Whole Foods one day and realized it was PERFECT.  It totally melts in baby's mouth, just like the mum-mums, so a great non-chokable snack for anywhere.  My baby loves crunching on it, it makes him so happy and keeps him occupied.  And since they are light and airy, I don't worry that I'm filling my kids up on too many crackers.  Its also very neat.  Don't know why these aren't marketed more towards kids/babies, they'd make a gold mine if they did.Note - I haven't actually purchased these from Amazon yet, only at Whole Foods.  But we go through them so fast at our house (not only do the kids love it, but the adults do too for all types of light snacks), but I plan to buy them from here so that I can get them in bulk.

Trident White makes a terrific "cool rush" flavored sugarless gum. The sugar free gum is healthier for your teeth; and the gum makes your breath fresh in an instant. The thin cardboard package is easy to carry because it is so small; and inside the thin cardboard package the pieces of gum are wrapped individually in tiny plastic pockets that are easy to open. The package states that the gum whitens teeth but I cannot comment on that. Always remember to brush your teeth--this gum isn't a substitute for that!A single piece of gum has absolutely no sugar; it has only a measly five calories--hooray! Trident White uses sorbitol and aspartame to sweeten the gum. There is no fat in this gum either.Unfortunately, some people won't be able to chew this gum because of certain ingredients that may disagree with them. This gum contains a milk derived ingredient; and it also contains phenylalanine. In addition, use this gum before any expiration date printed on the back of the thin cardboard container. Don't chew stale gum!Have further questions? No problem--the manufacturers give you both a toll free number and a website. The website goes into detail about how this gum helps to whiten your teeth.Overall, this is a great gum that comes packaged in an easy to carry container. This gum makes your breath fresh; and it's a very tasty gum that you won't want to spit out after a mere five minutes. The twelve-pack is economical, too.Highly recommended.
I love this product.  It is no longer sold in stores in my area which makes me sad as it is the only gum I really like to chew.... So glad someone still carries the product.
This is my favorite gum and I have to order via Amazon.Com because I can't find it on store shelves.

You're telling me that the original price of a 12-package carton of Trident Cool Rush gum is $949.00?  And you're selling it for less than $8.00? Get serious.  You can buy a good used car for $949.  This is about the falsest advertising I've ever seen.  Trident Cool Rush is excellent gum, but it is not worth $949.

column9: I did not get this item
column10: I did not receive this item. I don't know what happened, I did not get any explanation from the seller.

column9: Variable quality, but when you get a well-done pack, it's great!
column10: I've been buying these for hubby's lunch and our snacks since last year. I'm a cheese addict, and though I can't have as much as I did in my fatter days (yeah, I gotta watch the calories), I still love cheese for a snack.These have a nice crispness/crunch. Very flavorful with the "everything" spicing. (If you like Everything Bagels, this is like that, no bread, for us gluten free folks).My problem with these is consistency. Sometimes, I get a batch that's really overdone, burnt. And the taste of the toppings "burnt" is not good. Those batches I have to toss in the trash. BUT...when it's good, it's REALLY good.I hope they have their caloric stuff sorted out. I found that the info on servings did not match-up with what was in the container (ie, it said 6 servings per pack, with 3 crisps per serving). Well, when there are 11 or 12 (varies) crisps in a container, that's nowhere near 18, which would be 6 servings. So, I don't know if the caloric info is correct, but the servings on the packages I have are off.I do enjoy these, and I recommend them for folks who can tolerate cheese as a snack. A fun crisp and flavorful snack, if sometimes inconsistent in quality control and wacky in package info. :DI do prefer the plain ones, though. I haven't had a bad batch of those yet, and I've bought at least 2 dozen packs so far. (I haven't used amazon yet, but have used Netrition, with no problem.)Enjoy...
These "crackers" are INcredible with goat cheese and olives and a nice glass of wine!  Only 2 carbs for 3 crackers--SO delicious.

I recently tried these for the first time.  They are great when you want something crunchy and salty and are doing a low carb diet.  They are also wonderful crushed up on top of a salad.  I plan on ordering more and trying other varieties.

These are very crunchy. A nice snack if you are wanting to avoid wheat or carbs. there is a bit of a bitter taste - maybe a little brown sugar would help. You won't be tempted to eat the whole pkg but nice if you want something crunchy.

What can a person say about a dog treat. They are all the same, right? Wrong. I have tried so many treats on the market that I can't remember half of them any longer. I like the Old Mother Hubbard Meaties treats for dogs...chicken flavor. First of all the size is perfect to use in training your dog. So many of the training treats out there are just too small or too large. These treats are the perfect size. I usually get the chicken flavor but with the extra chicken added. It comes in Lamb and Liver flavor too. When I yell to my dogs that I have a 'special treat for you' they come running, which is what I want. They even know where I keep it and poke it with their noses while they wait impatiently for me to open the bag. I make them sit before I give it to them. They love the flavor of the extra chicken treats and never turn it down. I like it because of the size and my use in training with the dogs. I usually buy them 10 bags at a time because I go through them so fast. It's one of my favorite things to reach for with the dogs. The price has continued to go up on this product but so has it for other dog treats as well. I also like the fact that Old Mother Hubbard uses only a good quality of things in their products.
Besides being a dog owner, I have a pet care business and am a dog trainer. All the dogs love these Old Mother Hubbard bite size Meaties. I can't be without them.
I was disappointed with this produce; the nuggets are harder than I thought they would be. On the upside, however, I love the Old Mother Hubbard brand as a rule.

I can't say how good it is because I never tried them myself, but both of my dogs love it! It's one of the few ways I can get them to come on back home when they are out in the back yard. I just yell that I have their chicken treats and they come running. I go through them very quickly as I use them for treats all the time.
