They are just great for training, small, yet bite sized where they feel like they are eating something. The taste must be good to get my two dogs to do things they don't like to do. I buy them all the time. Old Mother Hubbard makes quality dog food and treats and I recommend this to all my friends that own dogs.
Pamper yourself and get the very best in tea.  This is a real treat and makes more then one cup.  Its worth the extra price you pay.

column9: Taco Bell Hot Sauce is Great
column10: This hot sauce is the equivalent of Medium in the restaurant (not Fire or Mild). It is excellent. I bought several and gave them as gifts. The packaging kept the bottles very well protected.

My husband loves this stuff and we can't find it anywhere in the Lake Norman region of North Carolina (only the mild and medium)!  Delivery was superb and everybody was individually wrapped.  Not one item was damaged!

Ordered these Kcups to take on vacation w/the family...PS ....they were all gone at the end of the vacation...so must have been great cofee...and yes my Keurig machine goes on vacation w/us every year...can't live w/out it...LOL>>>

column9: Fritos Corn Chips, Chili Cheese, 2-Ounce Large Single Serve Bags (Pack of 64)
column10: I received my order quickly and the exp date was far in advance!The only con: packaging...some bags crushed as there were no plastic air bags to prevent crushing..carton flimsy.Warning: these r addictive LOL!!!

Very easy to order.  This product is not offered in most retail stores but readily available online.  One thing that I would like to have seen on the product description is a reminder that this product is perishable and has an expiration date.  This should be known to the consumer but I wasn't thinking about that when I purchased it early in December for a Christmas present.  I would have waited a few more weeks.
This is A good product and it is good but can do with LESS SALT than it has, God bless.
I started eating chilicheese corn chips out of the vending machine when I was a young soldier in the Army. They were Delicious back then and they are Delicious today.

This is our favorite chip and the single serving bags help to keep the kids for wasting them.  They are good for those times when you have to grab something on the run.  I keep a couple of bags in my car for the kids.

column9: FRITOS have been great since I was a kid and nothing has changed!
column10: Nothing has changed over the years: They were great 35 years ago and still are!

column9: Feeling like a kid in a candy store ............
column10: Knowing these types of snacks are unhealthy has me in a state of guilt, to purchase.I hope they will soon have an organic variation. Cheetos, and Lays do!

I am certain that these Chili Cheese Fritos would have been perfect if not for the UPS treatment of the box.  They arrived in a box that had been smashed and had holes in it.  Only a fair amount of packing tape held it together.  There were actually smashed fritos on my front step from the 5 or so bags of chips that exploded in its trip.  The remainder of the un-opened bags taste fine, albeit the fritos are noticably smaller.  It just wasn't worth complaining but since you asked....

i ordered the product on 8/29/09 and received it on 9/3/09.  64 single serve bags.  I was very pleased until i noticed the freshness expiration date on the bags was 10/6/09... way too soon compared to snack items that i would have found in a grocery store on 9/3/09. i doubt that i will order food products from amazon again... what a disappointment.

column4: D. Mikels "It's always Happy Hour here"
column10: Big sporting events. . .I'm into them all.  Super Bowl.  BCS Championship.  March Madness.  NBA Finals.  The World Series.  Pay-Per-View Boxing.  Wimbledon. . . .not.  And when you're watching a bigtime sporting event, you need a bigtime snack with taste and crunch and texture to hold its own in all the excitement.  You need a bag (or more) of FRITOS CORN CHIPS.Just something about the original corn chip and sports.  They go together like bacon and eggs. . .salt and pepper. . .Ginger and Mary Ann.  Could be because FRITOS CORN CHIPS go great with brewskies--or pile them on top of a steaming bowl of chili.  Mmmm, now you're talkin' Super Meal.  And for dipping, nothing beats Fritos Scoopers (not available here, alas) into a bowl of Lay's Creamy Ranch Dip (also, alas, not available here).So bring on the playoffs; usher in the buzzer beaters; welcome the wild card.  As long as you have FRITOS CORN CHIPS, it's all good.  Your taste buds will score.--D. Mikels, Esq.

I got 100 bags at Sams Club for 16$......only hours after I placed this order for 62 bags at 42$ish. No way to cancel...next time I will pay closer attention to the fine print. Bottom line...these were. 56 per bag compared to Sams@ .18 per bag. Its hard to find multiple same chip bags do I just went for it. Haste makes waste.
Hey they are chips, you want me to say they taste like chicken?? They showed up on time in good condition!

This order came practically before I finished paying for it!  The coffee flavor is delicious, and the fact that it makes an 8 oz. cup rather than a 4 oz. is even better!  The pods are individually sealed in foil, which keeps them fresher.  Just a helpful hint, though...I wasted a couple of pods by putting it in the 'double pod' Senseo holder...it came out watery...thought there was something wrong with the coffee maker.  Then I put it in the 'single pod' holder, and it was perfect!

We own the Senseo coffee maker and were using the Senseo coffee pods.  I was so excited to find the Javapodz flavored coffee.  However, they tell you that you only need to use one pod for an 8oz cup, unlike the Senseo coffee where you use 2 pods for an 8 oz cup.  After drinking the Senseo, I found the Javapods to be a bit weaker coffee flavor, especially after I add half and half.My remedy to this was to use one Senseo mild pod and one flavored javapod and make a 12 oz cup, by using the 2 cup button and then directly after without changing pods I used the 1 cup button.  This works wonderfully for me as I get the stronger coffee taste with the wonderful flavor that Javapodz offers.  It makes a super iced coffee as well!The packaging is great.  Each pod is foil wrapped so they stay fresh for a long time.

column9: not quite enough coffee per pod for advertised 8oz brew
column10: the main issue with these pods would be that there's not quite enough coffe in one pod for the advertised 8oz brew of coffee.  they expect you to make an 8 oz brew with their single pod as opposed to 2 Senseo pods, which end up having significantly more coffee to brew from than their only slight larger single pod.  the result is very watery coffee--well, almost tasteless.  to remedy this, instead of placing their single pod into the 1pod holder, place 2 pods into the 2pod holder for an 8oz brew which makes a more tolerabe coffee in terms of strength.the next problem is taste.  this is all preference but i find the taste decent at best.  it's lacking in flavor and body.  perhaps a bit bitter too.lastly, the packaging is embarrasing (if not hugely questionable).  the inidividual pods came in very scratched, generic packaging.  meanwhile all 15 pods were packaged together in not some proper javapodz logo-ed box but...a ZIPLOC bag!  (which actually would be forgiveable if the inidividual pod wrappings didn't look so worn, cheap, and almost fake.)  I was hoping to try their other flavors but now I'm highly reluctant to.The pods by Gourmet Cafe, another coffee pod stocked at amazon, I tried previously were quite good.  Those are good to try if you're disappointed with these Javapodz.

column9: Want Chocolate Cappuccino?  Try CoolBeans pods instead
column10: I have tried them all.  The Cool Beans Pods are the best for taste and value overall.  They have 10+ grams per pod, the packaging in a delight, and they have a large variety of flavors.  They are less expensive than the other gourmet coffee pods, having 25 pods per box for $10!  Coolbeanspods.com.  And no, I am not an employee of Cool Beans.  Just a coffee lover!

"This one caught us by surprise! We don't know of any other pod maker that has this flavor and it's really good! We love the way it smells - the way it tastes - and the fact it is just plain different. Most pod people are ignoring the flavored sector to this extent - and it's nice to have a cup of really flavored coffee - meaning - a rich...flavored cup of coffee is hard to come by and this one is very good." - singleservecoffee.com

Please don't take this product away!  Excellent product!!! Have searched for years for a lactose free, corn free, gluten free, soy free nutritional rice milk.  All other brands have some form of corn that causes fatigue and concentration problems.  My first order was a week ago, me and my sons are finished with 8 cartoons already.  We race to the refrigerator like its a dessert.  I have fibromyalgia, there are so many foods and drinks I can not eat or drink.  This multi-grain rice milk is my work-out nutrition drink. I can't drink any other health drinks, sports drinks, protein drinks, pops or cool-aids. My plans are to use multi-grain rice milk to make ice-cream and use in cooking recipes because I can't eat any ice-cream or sherbet products either. Please give others a chance to try.  This product is a winner!

I first tried this brand at Whole Foods who is no longer carrying it anymore and I'm not quite sure why. I requested them to put it back on the shelves even though it makes more sense to buy in bulk. Still need to run out on an emergency basis every once in a while :)Anyway this ricemilk is by far hands down the best ever! I've tried numberous brands and this stuff rocks. There is no chalky taste to it and doesn't leave any funky after taste either. The chocolate ricemilk is to die for. Yum....and whole grains! Only downfall is once you've opened it, it's best to use with in a week otherwise it gets pretty thick and nasty.
This has one of the best taste out there on the market.  I wish it would go on subscribe and save.

What else is there to say? The Ritz crackers came in one roll per box boxes. So the packaging was great. There was a little bit more cracker breakage than normal, but I was expecting that too. The expiration date was more than 6 months away so I had plenty of time to eat them. Would buy again.

column9: REALLY REALLY SALTY. And many crumbles.
column10: For the price, its just barely ok...for some reason, these crackers are *REALLY SALTY*. And I don't mean "RITZ" crackers, I mean *THESE* crackers. I have purchased Ritz crackers for years from many places but for some reason the ones in these shipments seem to contain 3-5x more salt.It is so salty that my gf can not eat them at all and was about to throw them away; but I like salty so I don't mind them..Also, due to packaging, many of the ones especially in the boxes packed on the outside came quite crumbly/broken.All around, just barely okay in my book....straight to the trash in my girlfriend's book....so I gave it a 2star.

These are the best crackers available. Every time I start a new stack, I cannot stop myself from finishing it. These go great with tuna for a light snack. Definitely something every pantry should have.
Perfect for on the go to throw in my sons diaper bag and him to snack on. He loves them.

column9: Perfect size for the Diaper Bag
column10: In the past, we've tried taking these along as a snack, but they break easily, so it wasn't practical.  With these 4oz boxes, the crackers are protected in the diaper bag, and my son loves to snack on them on the go!

Ritz is one of the best crackers ever. It's buttery, flaky, salty, soft yet crisp - just delicious. They are great on its own or when paired with others foods such as cheese, meat, fruit. One of my favorites is pairing the Ritz with soft boiled eggs. I always have Ritz on hand in the house.

column9: Good crackers to have on hand
column10: This is a reliable cracker to have on hand for snacks- either by itself or with toppings on or with it.

no words for taste, it has its own taste. Some like it, some doesn't. Even I don't prefer too. I  saw a  awesome deal posted in some deal site and ordered it. I love Nips especially when you were selling them for a dollar. I will be purchasing your products in the future.

I am a intermediate school teacher.  Our class dissected grass frogs.  Afterwards, I 'treated' them to fried frog legs!  The order was delivered on time, packaged well, and the kids...after some hesitation...LOVED THEM!!!!

Greetings:I blew off your first request for a review....however, will respond to your second request & trust that you will never print it....am not interested in casting any bad light on the vendor nor do I want any retaliation from same....with that said, suffice it to merely say that I was most disappointed in what I received for what I paid....the actual weight of the frog legs was @ 3 1/2 #s & they were small (I went to Wal-Mart & bought a diet scale to weigh them)....my total cost was @ $65.00 & divided by the #'s was costing me @ $18.57 a pound....imagine my surprise when I discovered the next week that I could buy JUMBO frog legs for @ $3.99 a pound locally....in fact, just purchased 10 #s yesterday for @ $40.00....want to see the receipt?  I'll send it to you....Bottom line, it has opened my eyes to NOT think that ordering anything online is going to be cheaper than buying locally....from here on, will always exhaust all local vendors for anything I want before resorting to online....that's a reversal from the way I used to shop....suffice it to say, I will NEVER order frog legs from you folks again, & short of the great deal you offer on Colman's Mustard, will check locally on everything from here on....thanks for the lesson learned!  Have a Nice day....tfg
I have not had my own wild caught legs for years.These do not compare to those gems.I have purchased these a few times and will continue to,they are a good treat.

Can't we just say 48 frog legs instead of "24 pair"?  Do the left and right legs taste differently?  I was a connoisseur of frog legs for several years until one fateful day at an authentic Chinese restaurant.  I was delighted to see a placard for frogs' legs on the buffet sneeze shield until I discovered that the legs were prepared attached at the crotch.  Being a fan of the dish, I placed several on my plate and returned to my table.  I immediately used my knife to separate the legs and attempted to enjoy my entree.  The legs were prepared exquisitely; however, I could not enjoy them as I kept imagining going down on an amphibian.  Since that day in 1999, I have forsaken all exotic foods of the oriental variety.  This includes:1. frogs-legs attached at the crotch2. fish served with head and eyeballs displayed3. whole baby octopi4. anything with tentacles5. shrimp with heads6. deviled eggs7. jello
What is 'Salmon Trout' ? Salmon and trout are two different fish. Is this a mistake or a new species I'm unaware of.

I certainly respect another reviewer's opinion about the bones falling apart into "a million pieces."  However, I have ordered these bones about eight times and all-in-all, I am happy.  I gave it a four-star rating because I typically am very conservative when rating items.  My dog is a large Yellow Lab, about 100 pounds.  Ideally, these bones are a little too small for him, but they are a good deal.  I wish that they were a little bit bigger.  However, if you have a dog of approximately 35-70 pounds, then they might be fine.  My dog does eat them quickly (within ten minutes), but he seems to enjoy them.  There seems to be about 20 per bag, but I will have to check this more closely when I receive my next shipment.I am very aware of what I eat and what my dog eats.  So I was very careful when giving him the first bone.  I gave him one and waited a few days before giving him a second, just to see how he reacted.  Everything was fine, and continues to be fine.One thing that I don't like, but will probably not bother most people, is that they are packed in a very thick type of plastic bag; very durable, but it scares the heck out of me because I don't like plastic touching food, due to potential chemicals that can be released, especially during shipping when they might be subjected to very warm temperatures in planes or trucks.  So I take all of the bones out as soon as I receive them and put them in a big cardboard box that I am able to seal up.In summary, I am happy with these bones because my dog never reacted negatively or got sick and they seem to be of acceptable quality.  One final note, if you order the beef-flavored bones, which are dark brown in color, please note that when my dog starts getting them wet from his mouth, that they heavily stained my light tan carpet.  So I stick with these chicken-flavored, or the peanut-butter flavored.
Save your money, these are awful, they actually fall apart in a millionpieces like particleboard..... made in china.  surprise!

I got my Jack Russell puppy started on Glucosamine bones several months ago and she loves them!  I was buying them at the local pet store for the same price and they only had one knot while these have two and last longer for the same price!  Best of all, I don't have to leave the house to go to the pet store!  My puppy is now 8-months old and one of these bones will last her about 1.5 to 2 weeks and she chews on it constantly.  I highly recommend this product!

column9: not a bone for aggressive chewers
column10: I have a pitbull boxer mix who will chew on anything and everything. It's been a struggle to find anything that lasts more than  a day or two. This bone was no exception--Charlie had it finished in a day. Also, it was smaller than I expected. I would not recommend this bone for a dog that likes to chew. I gave it three stars, however, but he seemed to enjoy the taste of it. Otherwise, I'd like my money back. =(

column9: My Dogs Love them and they LAST!!!
column10: My dogs (4) all love these bones.  They will chew and chew and they last a long time unlike other bones.  It is definitely true that Chunky Chews last at least 3 times longer than regular rawhide!  I will definitely buy these again!

I have a MAJOR chewer. So far, this bone is lasting longer than bones of the same size I've purchased before. Also, she hasn't choked at all, which is amazing, because she always finds some way to try and shove a giant piece of rawhide down her throat. **panic time** I was suspicious of the "safety" knot claim, but so far, so good. She has only managed to get little, safe-sized pieces. I will be purchasing again.

I tried this one as well as the one with the knots on the end.  I had to take each one away after a few hours, wait several days and give it back to her to finish up in a few more hours.  It also gave her gas.  I do have an aggressive chewer which is why I tried these rather expensive rawhides.  I will not purchase again.

Most lamb is actually not graded by USDA.  But, a very select amount of domestic lamb does get graded USDA Prime.  It is rare, but it is absolutely valid.  I sell meat to white tablecloth restaurants and this is where the USDA Prime lamb products go (Not to retail).
I didn't know the USDA graded lamb...much less had a Prime grade for it.  I think this is miss leading advertising.I didn't buy this item because I don't believe this is a valid grading for Lamb.
The Kashi granola that I wanted was not available, so I went with this one- I am very happy with it!  Great taste, good price, great nutrition numbers...a winner!

My hubby loves this granola because it's one of the few out there that contains raisins, but doesn't have nuts! It's not overly sweet like a lot of granolas. Hard to find in the stores, so it's pretty much a convenience factor to buy from Amazon.

column9: Cascadian Farm Cinnamon Raison Granola Cereal
column10: This is an excellent product.  No preservatives are added which is difficult to find in common cereals on the shelves today.  The healthy and wholesome ingredients in this cereal allow me to provide my kids a quick and delicous breakfast (or snack)that will give them the energy and nutrients they need.
I found that this is great tasting and really healthy for me!  I went through my five boxes in a very short time.  Fantastic!

We first tried this cereal about a year ago and think it is the best cereal we have ever eaten.  It has a marvelous cinnamon flavor with oats and raisins.  No sugar is needed and I can heartily recommend it to everyone who likes a good crunchy cereal.

column9: + 1/2 star: tasty and healthy although a bit too much sugar
column10: I recently discovered this cereal and wow, do I love it! It tastes great; it fills me up; and this will be the cereal I now eat most frequently!PROS:* It is organic and there are no genetically engineered ingredients.* I like knowing that it is relatively healthy for me. It has a lot of whole grain in each serving.* As of this time the price here is less than what I pay at my neighborhood supermarket.CONS:* It also contains a fair amount of sugar--in fact, it has more sugar than a well-known brand of sugar coated corn flake cereal! That's a disappointment.* It is a bit expensive if you consider that you only get 17 ounces in each box.Overall, despite a drawback or two this remains an excellent, comparatively healthy and delicious cereal. I recommend it.

I really enjoyed the Cascadian Farm Cinnamon Raisin Granola Cereal.  I like the cinnamon taste mixed w/ the raisins, dates, and pecans.  The hint of brown sugar is also a nice compliment. It's a very hearty cereal you can have for breafast, or you can eat handfuls just of the box for a snack.  Getting 5 boxes for a good price is also nice.

When I was a kid, I remember school lunch ladies serving me granola on the grounds that it was good for me. I certainly liked the raisins, but remember thinking, if this stuff was good for me, why did I feel so heavy after eating it? That's why I like this variety. Beyond the health and environmental benefits of organic raising, this stuff tastes good and leaves me energized after eating. A breakfast of this stuff with orange juice, and I feel ready to take on the world.
Great product. Tastes amazing - I have been eating this for breakfast about 6 days a week for over 6 months and haven't gotten sick of it yet.
This was a great value for a great product.  It didn't last on our shelves for very long, as the kids at it all up.

My family loves this cereal!  It is the only kind I buy.  We have a few different allergies and this is the only one that everyone can eat.  I am constantly at the store buying this so I was happy to find it here on Amazon.

This ,along with several Kashi & Cascadian products are among the very best cold cereals. This one is tasty ,crunchy and not overly "raisined"(is that a word??). Being a consumer of cold breakfast cereals most every morning,good quality is greatly appreciated !

This is a wonderful tasty granola that is chewy and fun to eat.  It's extremely healthy for you, as long as you have it without sugar.  You don't need it.My only real criticism is that there isn't enough of it in each box.  There!  That's it, I've said it.
this is my new favorite standard for morning granola. will be tryin other cascadian offerings. hope you enjoy as well.
i have it every morning and really enjoy the taste. it might be a little sweet for some, but it is no match for my sweet tooth.

This cereal is a bit on the pricey side, but they usually have 'Buy 2, get $1 off' coupons directly on the box when I buy them in store.But even if they didnt, I would still buy this cereal because it is so good!!!As a matter of fact, this is the only cereal I usually buy!I also tried almost all other Cascadian Farms flavors. They are pretty tasty as well, but in my opinion, this is the best one of them all.I highly recommend.

If you like oatmeal raisin cookies, this cereal will be HEAVENLY to you. The raisins make the cereal not as dry, the cinnamon is the perfect amount, and the granola brings it all together for a perfect cereal. I also find it nice to look at the ingredients on the side and know what everything is without seeing chemical names and tons of preservatives. In my opinion, this is how cereal should be.

column9: Great taste, but lots of sugar
column10: One of the best cereals I've had. Great taste and not overly sweet (until you get a cluster of 5 raisins). However there's 16g of sugar per serving (mostly from the raisins I'm guessing), which is quite high. Even something like Fruity pebbles which is a pretty unhealthy kid's cereal only has 12g. Even though raisins have their benefits, sugar is sugar. I tend to pick out some of the raisins, there's a lot in there. My other go-to cereal is Honey bunches of oats, and that only has 8g of sugar.

I eat this cereal every day. I replaced my daily M&M's with this cereal, so it was definitely a healthy switch. You can't go wrong with this cereal. Nice simple ingredients and great taste. I can get it a little cheaper locally than on Amazon, but I am certain availability and price varies widely on this stuff but it is definitely worth it.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Very GOOD Granola with NO SOY!!
column10: Not easy to find SOY FREE cereals, especially organic ones, but this cereal is excellent!  Cascadian Farm Cinnamon Raisin Granola, 17-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5).  We use it as a snack, while working online or reading, and it makes an excellent bedtime treat because it really seems to promote sleep! And the price on Amazon, $3.38 per 17 oz box, can't be found anywhere else. At our market, Cascadian farms cereals are way over $5 per box! Recommended!
This is my favorite granola cereal.  Delicious, with just the right amount of raisins.

What can a person say about a dog treat. They are all the same, right? Wrong. I have tried so many treats on the market that I can't remember half of them any longer. I like the Old Mother Hubbard Meaties treats for dogs...chicken flavor. First of all the size is perfect to use in training your dog. So many of the training treats out there are just too small or too large. These treats are the perfect size. I usually get the chicken flavor but with the extra chicken added. It comes in Lamb and Liver flavor too. When I yell to my dogs that I have a 'special treat for you' they come running, which is what I want. They even know where I keep it and poke it with their noses while they wait impatiently for me to open the bag. I make them sit before I give it to them. They love the flavor of the extra chicken treats and never turn it down. I like it because of the size and my use in training with the dogs. I usually buy them 10 bags at a time because I go through them so fast. It's one of my favorite things to reach for with the dogs. The price has continued to go up on this product but so has it for other dog treats as well. I also like the fact that Old Mother Hubbard uses only a good quality of things in their products.
Besides being a dog owner, I have a pet care business and am a dog trainer. All the dogs love these Old Mother Hubbard bite size Meaties. I can't be without them.
I was disappointed with this produce; the nuggets are harder than I thought they would be. On the upside, however, I love the Old Mother Hubbard brand as a rule.

I can't say how good it is because I never tried them myself, but both of my dogs love it! It's one of the few ways I can get them to come on back home when they are out in the back yard. I just yell that I have their chicken treats and they come running. I go through them very quickly as I use them for treats all the time. They are just great for training, small, yet bite sized where they feel like they are eating something. The taste must be good to get my two dogs to do things they don't like to do. I buy them all the time. Old Mother Hubbard makes quality dog food and treats and I recommend this to all my friends that own dogs.
Our Aussie loves these bones.  We give him one or two a day.  Great product that always ships on time.  Just remember to order or $30 with this company so you can get free shipping.

Best gift set ever! I am a tea addict, love teavana, and all of their products. I was so very excited to receive this, all of the teas are delicious, and the tea tins they come in are really adorable! The tumblers are plain and I'd never have purchased them, but they are very functional so their blandness is forgiven.

I was introduced to rice seasoning by a Japanese friend and I've enjoyed every one of the eight or so seasonings I've tasted. I found Kimchi Furikae recently at a local Asian store thought I'd try it, so glad I did it's the best I've tasted so far! In fact everyone who's tried it loves it, especially the kids. Unlike the others, this one has a light crunch, it's a tiny bit spicy (chili & wasabi...but it doesn't seem to bother my 13 & 8 yr old's or our neighbors 6 yr old), it slightly sweet too..why the kids must like it. The entire thing was gone in a week! Love it & would order her if the shipping wasn't $5.95. Going today to pick up a few from the Asian store for $3.59. Just sprinkle over rice but best if you form balls out of sticky rice & sprinkle on top like my friend from Japan show me. Enjoy!

I've been drinking caffe d'vita coffees for about 20 years and the Hawaiian Mocha has a slight edge over the rest of the pack with it's distinctive COFFEE flavor instead of added flavors I've used like orange, amaretto, cinnamon, rasberry chocolate, english toffee, pumpkin spice and almond mocha which tends to give you a sweeter aftertaste.  The Cappuccino comes in a close seceond to the Hawaiian!

I add this to coffee and make iced lattees.  This is a real mocha flavor and is so cramy when using milk instead of water.  I use lowfat to watch the calorie intake.  An excellent product hot or cold.  I hunt this down and buy it whenever I find it.  Sometime Amazon is out of stock, but I keep a look-out for it.  Better than other mixes because it contains no hydrogenated oils.  Yummy!!!

This is my first experience with Caffe D'Vita; and I'm so glad I chose this as my first flavor!!  From the reviews, and the picture it sounded very appealing so I took the plunge and ordered!  The great thing about this is that it's not overly sweet (if you have a sweet-tooth and are used sugary coffee drinks, you may have to add some).  It's also 99% caffeine free, so if you want a jolt, simply add it to your normal caffeinated coffee.  I think it's just right the way it is, so I don't need to add extra sugar, or caffeine.  I've only tried it in hot water (adding more than 3 tsp.- since I had more than 6 oz. of water).  It has a slight hint of coconut flavor (hence the "Hawaiian" aspect of it), which added a nice richness to it!  And as a previous reviewer said, it does have a prominent coffee flavor- which is very pleasing!  If you're really desiring more of a specific "flavor" (like Irish Cream, etc.) then maybe some of the other mixes will be more pleasing to your palate.  ..I'm not sure if I'll order some of the other ones, being that this one hits the spot; but I'm sure when I run out- I'll order this again!!

column9: If you add sugar it taste excellent!
column10: It tastes very bitter once you mix it with hot water.  I think it has a lot of raw bitter dark chocolate in it. If you add bunch more sugar it tastes great.

If you love coconut, you will love this!  Plus it is 0 trans fats, no hydrogenated oils, no cholesterol, and gluten free.  While it may have some artificial stuff in it, at 60 calories, that is less than any fancy Starbucks drink...and costs a lot less.
I just love Caffe D'Vita products.  Hawaiian Mocha has  a hint of coconut and tastes great.  Very smooth.

I have been gluten free for 3+ years, and have tried many substitutions for regular wheat flour. None measure up to this mix. I have mixed my own using Bette Hagman's recipes, and I've used Bob's, Arrowhead Mills, and Pamela's multipurpose blends...this is the only one that produces the feel (aka, 'crumb') of 'normal' foods. I have found that I do not like the taste of bean flour, and this Authentic Foods blend is free of bean. I have a buttermilk pancake recipe that I use this in; they come out so delicious that even if I could eat wheat, I would keep making them with this flour. Love this stuff, and I love not having to keep 10 bags of individual flours in my fridge. I won't be without it!

I am not new to this product and I must say it's great!  I have celiac disease and it's super for anything you use regular flour for.  Toll House chocolate chip cookies (recipe on back of bag) are probably my favorite--they taste just like they were made with real flour.  Delivery was prompt and accurate. Anyone gluten free will agree using this flour beats mixing your own!
Purchased this and use it cup for cup when baking.  It has the xanathum gum in it, works great!

column9: Best Gluten free flour you'll ever find!!
column10: My daughter has been living with Celiac's disease for 3 years now, and we have wasted more money on all the different kinds of flour's available.  Some were so so in taste, but the Multi Blend Gluten Free flour by Authentic Foods, stands far and above ALL the others out there!  It looks, smells, and tastes just like regular flour! It might cost a little more, but for all those of you out with a gluten intolerance of some kind, you won't disappointed in this purchase.Multi Blend Gluten-Free Flour

I have spent an unbelievable amount of time and money experimenting with gluten free flours and mixes...this flour is by far the best!  I use it cup for cup replacement for chocolate chip cookies, pancakes, banana bread, etc.  Thank you for making my gluten free child's life better! I just wish Amazon would start offering it with the free super saver option, or in bulk.
This flour blend makes everything you bake seem like you're baking with wheat flour!!  I love it
After mixing flour blends from many different cookbooks, I keep coming back to this one as my favorite.  It works great for everything except bread.  Now I use Multi Blend for almost all my baking.

This is a very good basic flour that can be used in recipes to substitute for wheat flour. It is based on what is called the "Wendy Wark" recipe. For those who don't want to go mixing up a lot of different flours this is a good choice. I tried it and then went out and made the mix myself. However, doing this required going to three different stores for flours. As I was setting up a gluten-free pantry I didn't mind but for those who want less hassle buying the mix is a good way to go. I use it for scones and quick breads.

column9: Delicious! I will never miss wheat flour!
column10: I just made waffles with the multi-blend flour, and unlike other gluten-free flour blends, the waffles didn't have that telltale grainy texture. My family could not tell they were eating gluten-free! I actually think the waffles were even lighter and fluffier than had I made them with wheat flour. I have found my gluten-free baking solution. Thanks Authentic foods!
Ever since I found out I was gluten intolerant I have used this flour for my cooking and baking. I have tried many others and been very unhappy with the resulting taste.

If you are cringing at the cost, I recommend you bite the bullet and give it a try!  I was very skeptical and agonized about the decision to order the first time, thinking it was just too much to pay for flour.  But then, gluten free products are always more expensive.  Hopefully, they will come down over time, especially as more and more people go gluten free.  In the meantime, I will happily pay a little extra for a better product.  This is by far the best flour blend I have used for baking.  And like most other gluten free bakers, I have tried more flours than I care to remember.This is great in pancakes and waffles (Joy of Cooking recipes), and I made my mom's traditional coffee cake recipe this morning and it was delicious.  However, I don't necessarily use a one-to-one substitution.  I usually back off a quarter cup or so in a standard two cup recipe and like the texture better, but that may just be personal taste.  I would definitely recommend experimenting with the quantities, though, to get it just the way you like it.It's good in cookies, but to me it shines best in the more leavened baked goods - pancakes, waffles, breads and cakes.  Again, that might just be personal taste, but I've found certain blends work better for different types of foods (bread vs. frying vs. baked goods), so we have experimented a ton and keep around several different blends for different types of cooking.  This is definitely my go-to blend for baking.
I have been looking for a good gluten free flour for quite a while.  This beats King Arthur, Bob's, etc.  Just use it 1:1, not 3/4:1.

column9: Tastes just like the real thing!!!
column10: Having just gone gluten free on the recommendation of my physician, I was worried about not gettting to eat all of the things that I love (i.e. cookies, cakes, etc). I enjoy baking so I thought I would try making chocolate chip cookies with gluten free flour as a trial run. I'd heard all kinds of horrible things about gluten free baked goods, especially bread (try Kinnikinnick Gluten Free Bread (frozen) - it's fantastic!!). I stumbled across Authentic Foods Multi-Blend Gluten Free Flour while searching on Amazon and although the price was steep, I thought I'd give it a try.All I can say is WOW!!!! This is the real deal - - I could not taste the difference at all. The cookies were soft with just a hint of crispiness on the outside. I'm pretty picky about ingredients when I bake and I was completely and utterly won over. My family even commented on how yummy the cookies were (I didn't tell them they were gluten free until they were licking their fingers!). I will definitely buy this flour again and am going to try making cupcakes next. Can't wait to try them!!P.S. It does say on the package not to use this flour in yeast recipes UNLESS the recipe is specifically gluten free. Not sure why, but I guess just don't substitute this gluten free flour in a regular flour yeast recipe.

column9: Abslutely amazing - definitely the most underrated flour out there!
column10: This flour is incredible.. I trick all of my friends and family with this flour and they have no idea it's gluten-free. My husband prefers baked goods made with this flour over regular wheat flour! I've tried every gluten free flour out there and this one tops every other one hands down. It's never gritty or grainy.. it always has excellent texture and no funky gluten free flavor - like Better Batter! I will never buy any other flour again. I swear by this stuff, it's delicious! :)

column9: Amazing gluten free substitute for all purpose wheat flour
column10: Multi-Blend Gluten Free Flour - 3lbIf you miss baked-good recipes which were based on all purpose wheat flour then you must try this product. The manufacturer recommends that you replace each cup of all purpose wheat flour with 3/4 cup of the Multi-Blend Gluten Free Flour. I was quite skeptical because of earlier disappointments with gluten free products. To try the product I used my favorite corn bread recipe (old fashioned New England style with low fat/low sugar). When the corn bread came out of the oven it looked exactly like the corn bread I would make with wheat flour. The taste and consistency of the gluten free corn bread was equal to or better than the wheat based recipe. It was also as light as the wheat based recipe. On the down side this flour does not work with wheat based recipes for yeast breads. The manufacturer indicates that you should try gluten free recipes for yeast breads. I need to do some more research on gluten free recipes for yeast breads. If I find recipes that I like, I will note them here.

This flour blend is amazing.  There is no after taste as with other flour blends I've tried and you can use it cup for cup in your own family recipes.  I will say that it is best in cookies, nut breads and cakes (heavier items).  It does produce a heavier product than regular wheat flour but I can over look this as I thought there was no hope of making good baked goods until I found this.  My problem now is the store that I usually get it from isn't going to stock it anymore so I need to look elsewhere.  I can't believe that the shipping costs more than the product.  I guess that Authentic foods never heard of the post offices $7 if it fits, it ships!!:)  I refuse to pay that much shipping so I'm looking elswhere to  purchase this product.  If you don't mind the price buy it.  It is a great product.

This is an all-purpose gluten-free baking flour blend, used in many recipes found in gluten-free cookbooks or magazines.  Like other Authentic Foods' products, the flours are finely ground so the texture is just as it should be.  The blend is generally a bit more expensive than the flours purchased separately, but it saves time and reduces the mess that inevitably occurs with beating together several kinds of flour.

I followed Micki's lead on this one because we love Toll House Cookies and being gluten-intolerant has kept us from having them. We have tried alot of brands and they always have a weird lingering flavor or the texture is odd. This mix is exceptional. We are very happy with the results and will never have to feel deprived again. LOVE this flour mix and so thankful we can have satisfying chocolate chip cookies!!! I am also dairy intolerant: This worked amazingly well: Replaced the 1 cup of butter with 1/2 cup virgin coconut oil and 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce and we used Enjoy Life dairy-free chocolate chips. Pure heaven!!!! No funny aftertaste or texture problems.

I have a few gluten free bread cookbooks. My cook books gave recipies for various gluten free flour recipes. While shopping for the ingredients, I found this blend. Excited not to have to order several different flours, and mix, I ordered tihs. The description claims it is super easy, just use as you would wheat flour in any wheat flour recipe!! Great! I have several wheat flour bread cookbooks, and was planning on giving them away and replacing with gluten free ones. This way, i can keep them, and save money, I thought. But not so. When I received this flour, I was dismayed to read on the label that this flour does not work in yeast recipes. All the recipes in my regular bread cookbook have yeast in them, so no go there, pretty disappointing given the fact that the description on Amazon claims that this flour will work in place of wheat flour in any recipe. And, not only that, but it says it will work in any gluten free recipe. But, the ingredients are different that the gluten free recipe I have, and the label does not give preportions so I cannot tell if it will work in the other gluten free recipes I have which gives specific preportions. The label recommends a certain cookbook, that this mix is exact to the flour mix used in that book. So, now I am expected to spend money on another cook book? Just so I can use the flour i bought (to use as advertized) in wheat flour recipes? I greatly dislike scams of that sort, that adversited something easy only to require associated tools or books. I will not be buying yet another cook book. I will try to use this flour somehow, but I will not be buying again. Next time I will purchase all the seperate flours as indicated in my gluten free cookbook and mixing my own.
Wow.  Taken by surprise that the shipping costs more than the product.  Too late to cancel but never again....

I absolutely love these jelly beans!! They come perfectly packaged and are so soft and chewy. I would recommend this product to anyone, and will definitely be purchasing this product again in the future :)
I bought this cappuccino thinking it would be really good.  It's OK, but I'm not really a cappuccino drinker.  I think I will be using it to flavor my coffee.  I'll try vanilla next time.

Excellent service, and packaging is excellent. And excellent quality and sent on timeMy advice to deal with themExcellent service, and packaging is excellent. And excellent quality and sent on timeMy advice to deal with them

column9: Totally tastes like the real thing!
column10: This tastes just like what you'd get from the store directly.  You just add water to (and I love these directions) "3 heaping tablespoons". I keep a container at work and use their hot water, so I can have Tim Horton's every day.
I love this and it is very exciting to at last be able to purchase it in Tennessee!  Now my family in Canada does not need to send it to me.

column9: Nice fix for those between visits or lazy days
column10: Almost as good as the real thing from Timmy H's! Good change up from the run of mill 'French Vanilla' doldrums you get some times.Since there is no Tim Hortons within 1,000 miles of me this will have to do.Not overly sweet, not acidic like some others.
This is the first time i try English toffee, i always buy  Hot cappuccino but need change and it's good but i don't like it more i like others one.

column9: Healthy treats. Made in the USA with all organic chicken, and doggie loves them. Very happy repeat customer
column10: I am the proud mom of a 16-year-old rescued Border Collie/Lab mix who just happens to be one of the sweetest beings that has ever lived. :) Well, I want her to live a very long, healthy, and happy life, so I only feed her things that I believe will help achieve that end. These treats have all organic chicken, no meat bi-products, pro-biotics, and lots of other great ingredients.I purchased our first bag of Plato Farmers Market Chicken & Vegetables Treats for Dogs over a year ago, and she absolutely loved them. Many bags later, she still wags happily for them.I also give her the Plato Sweet Potato Treats. She loves to chew the sweet potatoes, and they are easier on her teeth than chewing bones. Plato, thank you for making such great products. You have two very grateful customers.INGREDIENTS: Chicken, carrot, celery, beet, parsley, lettuce, watercress, spinach, green pea, sweet potato, tomato, parsley, salt, zinc propionate, vitamin E supplement, coated ascorbic acid (source of vitamin C), bacillus subtilis.NUTRITIONAL BENEFITS:- Grain-free -no corn, wheat, soy, grain fractions or fillers- Natural ingredients, fortified with antioxidant vitamins, zinc propionate- Contains a source of live (viable) naturally occurring microorganisms- No artificial colors, flavors, synthetic preservatives, GMO's (genetically modified organisms), meat by-products or meals.- Naturally preserved.

Our two dogs love these treats.  They are great to train a puppy because you can hold the treat and the dogs can have a nibble instead of giving them the whole treat. Both of our dogs love the treat and we feel that this is the healthiest product for our dogs.  You can see some of the vegetables and blueberries that are in this treat.  When I reach for the bag of treats both dogs go crazy.

Farmers Chicken and Vegetable is a great healthy treat for your dogs.  Best of all, it is grain free.  We have two standard poodles, one that cannot eat grain, and a mini pincer this is their favorite treat. We have many visitors who bring their dogs and all of them love this treat.  We order the treats from Amazon.com as they have the best price.
All 3 of my dogs absolutely LOVE these treats!! I love that they are made in the USA. No weird bowel movements either, 2 of my pups have really sensitive stomachs.
It is difficult to find a grainfree treat for your dogs, but these treats we're a great find! My dogs love them , they are the right consistency not too hard or too soft.  My pups love them!

I buy treats for my dogs in bulk to have them on hand. I opened this package 2 months after purchase, which meant it is too late to return, and found the product to be moldy. This is even though the expiration date hasn't been reached yet. Also, the sweet potatoes are soft, as if they are not fully dehydrated. I've bought this product at local stores and haven't had a problem. This must be part of a bad batch. I won't be buying this product or other dog treats from Amazon again, as now I am out of the money I paid.

One of my dogs has inflammatory bowel disease. This is one of the few products I can give her for a treat that she can eat because it's low in protein and in fat. It doesn't upset her stomach. It's also grown here in the USA which makes me feel safer after the recent scare we pet owners had not too long ago. All my dogs LOVE them!

My dogs love these sweet potato treats.  I feed my dogs grain-free diets and other high-end supplements, so of course I wanted a treat that followed our feeding ethic. This is low in protein and fat, so it is gentle on the stomach of puppies and sick dogs alike. My dogs go crazy over these. They love the taste and since these are a little tough, it takes them a bit longer to finish them, which is great because dogs usually swallow treats whole. They are not extremely tough though. Puppies can eat them. Even though the bag does not have an indication to refrigerate after opening, please do so. They will last longer and remain fresher. Plus, you could prevent mold growth. Amazon sells these by far at the most affordable price. Specialty stores sell these treats up to twice as much as Amazon does, so I suggest you buy them from Amazon. If you want a healthy treat, this is the way to go. :)

My dog refuses all vegetables, but he likes these treats.  Because the vegetables have been cooked and are dehydrated he should be able to get some nutrients out of them.  Dogs lack the enzymes to break down plants cell walls normally.  At first he hesitated to eat one, but I broke off a bit,and he decided they were good.  I also crumble two into his food each meal.  His fussy, meat-loving poodle pal also enjoys them--and no stomach upset.  Nice product.

My dog is allergic to almost every edible food, including treats. I was looking for something that could be a treat that wasn't manufactured and it wouldn't affect him, so I bought them. These sweet potatoes treats are all natural, he loves them and the best thing is that he is not allergic to them.  This is a perfect solution for those owners who want a different kind of treat for their dogs or for those dogs that are allergic to manufactured treats. I will be buying more.

column9: My Dogs Love Sweet Potatoes, But.....
column10: they did not like these! I cut them in half thinking that they could smell that it was sweet potato but that did not help.

column9: Sweet Potato Treats had mold on them
column10: I have stocked our dogs' treat pantry with Plato's Farmers Market products for about a year. My dogs love their Salmon and Salmon with Vegetable treats. I recently purchased their Sweet Potato treats, which have a "Best by" date of 9-22-10. Shortly after opening the bag we saw that treats were covered in white & blue mold. Unacceptable & disgusting. The bag's sticker has "X00133D6P" on it. I have bought Plato products many times previously and have been pleased, however, these are supposed to be safe and quality treats. I absolve the seller, The Whole Healthy Pet, of responsibility of this issue as they have taken swift steps to rectify the issue. However, I do firmly assert that Plato should have done a much better job of notifying customers of a bad batches of Sweet Potato treats.

column9: Good product but a tad crumbly
column10: My two dogs love these.  I bought them along with the regular Plato chicken treats when I saw they were USA made.  The only reason I gave these four stars instead of five is that they are somewhat crumbly when you get them out of the bag. I assume it's due to the vegetable content so I'm not really complaining. It's great to find products that are not only good tasting, but good for them as well.

column9: why would you put EGGS in sweet potatoes???
column10: Just make plain Sweet potatoes. I can;t buy these because my dog is highly allergic to Chicken, eggs and everything dairy.
Nice treats. Not messy, great for inside feeding. All my dogs enjoy them. Perfect size too...not too big or small for large breeds.

My Boston Terrier Max loves the Plato Organic Chicken treats, his favorite actually. When I first gave him one of the Sweet Potato treats he wasn't sure what to think. He was thrown off by the texture I think and was having trouble chewing it. After he finally ate the first one he was sniffing around the garbage where we had put one he had left on the floor. He was trying to get the treat that was in there. Now everytime we break them out that's all he wants. Along with the Organic Chicken treats. He's hooked.

Our doggies love Plato's Salmon treats the most, but the chicken ones come a close second.  The treats are friable, so pretty easy to either split into 1/4s or crumble into their regular kibble.  The resealable bags are also nice to have.  The "and Vegetable" part does not seem to diminish their appetite for these treats!

column9: Our Dogs Chew On Them, But Don't Finish
column10: I have two Doodles, a brother and a sister, and the male eats just about everything you put in front of him and many things you don't!  He seemed very interested in these and even the female took them into her jaws and scurried off.  Alas, we found most of them later secreted in different parts of the living room.Other Plato treats have been enthusiastically recieved, so I have a good opinion of the company.  Worth a shot, but not to the beasties' tastes!

These treats are fantastic. Made in the USA, grain free, wonderful ingredients. My dogs absolutely adore these treats,  and all Plato treats I've bought for them. They are worth the extra money to ensure I'm feeding my dogs healthy, SAFE, nutritious treats.

They're different looking from the other's I've seen. They're smaller and darker in color then other Chicken Strips. They look more like beef Jerky.Nonetheless, our doggies like them, and that's what counts for us.
There was white, hairy mold on the treats in the middle of the bag.  Unfortunately, I'd already given my pups a couple of them before I found the mold, just an hour or so later. :(

My dog loves this salmon treats, he is allergic to wheat and some protein products but since this treat is Made from salmon and veggies there is no allergic reaction at all. Great for training or I give it every time I'll leave the house and my dog doesn't even look for me!

column9: Not for dogs with food allergies
column10: I have a dog with all kinds of allergies. She loves sweet potato treats and I love giving them to her because they're so healthy (the more I read about all the dangers of processed treats found in pet stores, the more resolute I am in my decision to never, ever feed her that garbage).The only problem I have with these treats is that they contain eggs and salt in addition to the natural sweet potato and probiotics. Eggs are a big no-no for any dog with food allergies, and salt is just something you shouldn't really be feeding your dog anyway. At least not in excessive quantities. These treats are a thousand times better than regular dog treats, but they didn't work for my dog.I've decided to stick to Snook's sweet potato treats. They're 100% dried sweet potato and nothing else - also made in the USA and my dog absolutely loves them.

column9: Dog Loves Them, We Love Them - Made in the USA
column10: My dog loves sweet potato treats, but after discovering a lot of additives in her previous treats, as well as the fact that they were made in China, we started searching for a new treat. She loves them, they are pricier, but that's basically what it comes down to if you want a low number of ingredients and products made in the USA.
Excellent quality dog treat for training.  Most dogs will view as a "high value" reward.This is the best salmon treat I have tried! My dog loves both the Salmon Strips andthe Farmer's Market Strips.

I have two dogs....one picky and the other not.  They both ate this and the picky one got tired of it after give it for the 4th / 5th time.  I really like it because of it being a healthy treat option.
My dog loves them, loves them, loves them. The probiotics are a great addition, my big boy has a sensitive system and he can be a bit gassy. A couple of these treats a day and he has been less gassy.
It is priced the best and my Gertie loves it, plus it is good for her!

column9: Natural Treats made in the USA
column10: I will no longer buy anything made in China for my dogs. I searched for a treat for them and even the ones in places like Petco were made in China. I finally found a link to Plato's Farmer's Market and then to them being sold on Amazon. They are made here in the USA and all natural. My vet told me to feed my dogs sweet potatoes or pumpkin and these treats fit the bill. So I ordered them through Amazon. My dogs beg for these. I have now ordered them three times and will continue to do so.
My 3 toy dogs like just about every treat put before them except these and the other Plato Organic Chicken treats.

UPDATED APRIL 2012: I'm returning 6 more pouches of PureBites Chicken today, after first calling the company for instructions. The same rep (female) who responded to my complaint in  Dec 2011 took my call today, but not knowing I had called before, she kept insisting there has never been a complaint about rancid bits before. I told her I called in Dec and she said "someone else likely helped you". Not wanting to argue, I moved on, but she clearly lied to me so I thought I should update about this. I was asked to include a note this time, to say where purchased but that has nothing to do with the fact that the company thinks it's "acceptable" that some fat is getting thru via processing. Fat cannot be freeze-dried so it will turn rancid even if freeze dried - read my original review and see how this was answered the 1st time I called last year...Very disappointing that the company doesn't care to hold the processing plant's feet to the fire about fat getting in, but then to lie to a customer is not good. But they will honor their satisfaction guarantee! So the only way to get this issue resolved is for all of us to get refunds. All you need to do is send the proof of purchase and your invoice to the address on the bag, along with your name & address. I find that about half of the bags are rancid. Dogs don't care, but cats won't eat rancid anything so very expensive if issue is ignored. Pls help make this company fix this issue by sending proofs in and forcing them to refund. Companies ignore issues until their wallets get hit. I hate to do this, but my cats beg for these and I'm going broke replacing rancid bags!ORIGINAL REVIEW: I bought two 6.2 oz bags of PureBites Chicken for dogs, first trying out a small cat size pouch found at PetSmart, and then moved up to the dog-sized bags/chunks, which I crumble with my fingers to get them smaller for my cats, who love this product BUT both of these bags purchased on Amazon had rancid chunks that smushed into slimy/greasy mush when I crumbled them.The company admits this happens, said it's part of the processing, nothing can be done, but it's not acceptable, and they will refund once I send proof of purchases & invoice to them.So it's hit or miss, and the company agrees...so just an FYI to warn others to check their bags!For those feeding this to dogs, and not breaking up the chunks like I do, please take note of this and check on the chunks before feeding. You can also detect a faint rancid odor if there are rancid bits in your bags.The reason for the rancid chunks, according to the company is that pieces of fatty chicken do get in, and fat doesn't freeze-dry, so without preservatives, it will go rancid. I knew that, but had hoped they could offer a promise to correct this; they can't and have no intention to do so. So I'll keep buying and hoping I get good bags, but will certainly take the time to get refunded whenever this occurs.The product is excellent when you get a good bag..just check each piece before feeding, or if you have a good nose for rancid odors, take a whiff and you'll smell the slight rancid odor, and can return the product.

I usually put some honey in it and it goes down great.As for the rest, I've only been using it (3 times a day) for the past 7 days and haven't gone a full cycle yet, so I don't know if it really does work for PMS yet or not.

column9: A great product, you must try!
column10: I study plants and I am into alternative healing.  I learned about Mullein a number of years ago and found that it's very useful for sinus, cold and flu issues.  Often times I have treated many of my friends with it to help them get back to feeling well.  This particular brand is high quality and good medicine.  I highly recommend buying this tea as we all need to get away from Western medicine as much as we can when other opportunities are out there.  The idea is to stay in balance and not get extremely sick by using products like this early on when symptoms first start developing.  I think you will find this product very useful and effective.*  Please note: Do not mix to many herbs and or prescriptions medicines as they can counteract and amplify the strength or effect of the meds or herbs.
I love this stuff. It has really helped me with a lot of things. I absolutely swear by it. I probably drink this tea at least once a week. Sometimes several times a day if I feel the need.
I purchased this item a month ago and i drink a cup morning and night. I love it! I drink it with clover honey...

My mother-in-law recommended this tea to me to help me naturally alleviate my menstrual cramps. I have to warn that the tea doesn't "kick in" for a couple of cycles, so don't drink this expecting a magic cure-all within the first cup. I used to be very dependent on Advil, Tylenol, etc. so this tea was a lifesaver.It's a very mild tea and you don't need a lot of sugar or honey in it. I recommend it.

Recommend it to all.  Lovely natural sweet delicate flavor and add some raw honey is a great cold kicker.  I loved it during a URI, upper respiratory infection and it was fabulous.  Soothed my sore throat and helped ease the coughing.  I now brew it for cold tea as well.  Very refresshing.

I trust Alvita's brand because all of the teas I have tried from them are pure and excellent quality. The Raspberry leaf is no exception. The taste is mild and it works like a charm to ease menstrual cramps. A must have during your moon cycle. Good value for the price.Also check out Yogi Woman's Moon Cycle, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)

I drank this tea after my first trimester of pregnancy for its numerous health benefits.  It is pure red raspberry leaves and great organic package.  They are  not individually packaged, they come in a foil lined paper lije package and there are no strings or tags, just steep add agave or honey to sweeten...it is a little bitter but not bad and drink!

column9: Good Things Come in Stinky Packages
column10: I have very bad insomnia and panic attacks, and this tea calms me down and helps me to sleep. Research suggests that Valerian works on the brains in similar ways to benzodiazepines, and was used in the past as a muscle relaxant and for DTs. This tea has an obvious effect, though it takes about half an hour to kick in. I smells like crap, but if you mix it with mint tea, it isn't as noticeable. I don't see any problem with the flavor, it does not taste like it smells.

I bought this product because I read on a couple other sites that it can help with head and chest congestion. I also read it is safe to use while breastfeeding. So I tried it. If I drink it on an empty stomache it does seem to help with my cronic nasal congestion due to allergies. I saw no difference with chest congestion. I only drank the recommended 2 to 3 cups a day. Maybe I would see longer or more results at higher doses. I have noticed that I do smell alot like maple syrup even 4 days after not drinking the tea. I do mix it with Honey, if not it tastes awful to me. I never noticed a maple syrup smell on my 3 year old breastfeeding son like another site mentioned might happen. He does only nurse a few times a day now tho. Overall I like the product and will continue to use it when I am feeling congested. I even recommended it to somebody I know.
I ordered this product because of the Dr Oz show for anti-aging, a nice by product is I swear my knee pain has improved since I started drinking a cup a day, oh yeah and it taste good.
This is a great product to help with insomnia.  Really great.  Some do not like the smell or taste, but I actually love it.  Maybe it is an acquired test.  A+++ for this product, it is excellent.

"They found that two of the licorice compounds, licoricidin and licorisoflavan A, were the most effective antibacterial substances. I bought this product and love the flavor.  A great and relaxing way for me to end or begin a day.

The first time I drank Fenagreek Seed tea I did not like the smell or the taste very much.  I added a very small amount of Stevia to sweeten it.  The more I drank it, the more the taste grew on me.  It is now my favorite tea by a long shot!

A friend suggested this as I have been taking pain medication which tends to bind the bowels. He told me that this would help keep me regular. He was so right. A cu p of Senna Tea with my dinner has been better then metamucel for regularity. It tastes good, and I recommend it to anyone who has constipation problems due to medications. If you eat out, you can take the tea bag with you and ask for a cup of hot water to steep your tea in, and you do not have to worry about missing a dose.
Not enough flavor, murky brown color, lacking in aroma. I enjoy other varieties from this line but prefer a different brand of rose hip tea. I'd drink it over regular black tea though.

After reading reviews from baby sites, I was ready to get my red raspberry leaf tea on and strengthen my uterus and I was so excited that I got the first one I saw, which was the Alvita brand. I love the flavor, just LOVE the flavor, but I read more reviews and a lot of women gave the Traditional Medicinals better reviews so I after I ran out of the Alvita I purchased the TM. I have to say, the Alvita has a stronger tea taste and I actually got contractions when I drank it. I'm only 37.7 weeks along, but I have to say that I think this tea will help move my labor along quite well. I'll update this review later with how it went.UPDATE 3/28/2012:I totally forgot to add my update! Well, as I'd previously believed, this tea helped me tremendously through my labor. I had my beautiful baby boy on December 12th. I had a 17 hour labor because my bag of waters prematurely ruptured and I wasn't dilating the way I was supposed to. I had to be put on pitocin (without meds for the first 14 hours) then I got the meds and then got the epidural about 45 minutes before I actually gave birth. Let me tell you, I only pushed for about 20 minutes and I was done. I attribute that 100% to the tea. I had friends who didn't drink the tea and were in labor for very short periods but pushed way longer. Also, my uterus went down very quickly and I stopped bleeding quickly as well, I forgot how soon but the doctors and nurses were amazed. I'd definitely drink it again next time around.

column9: People Either Love or Hate Valerian!
column10: I love Valerian and I love it's earthy smell! But just because a previous reviewer hated the smell and threw a tantrum, (which is ironic because Valerian is used for its relaxing properties) doesn't mean it doesn't work! Seems to help, I sleep well and if I do wake up I'm not long getting back to sleep.I ordered two boxes and I'm about to buy two more.

This tea was very good. I was Very happy I got it. A tea that is so good for you and will help many things in your body. My breathing felt better after the first cup. I will be buying more again soon. Doug in Calif...
I ordered this to serve at a "tea" where I was speaking about roses.  It was a hit with those who were brave enough to try it.

column9: Yes it does have an odor that some will find disagreeable, but it works for me and I will continue to purchase it
column10: I read some of the reviews on here and I almost didn't purchase.  But I reached a point where due to my erratic work schedule, trying to fit in my studying time and completing assignments, my sleep pattern was disrupted and it was affecting my mood and concentration.  So I bit the bullet and purchased this at a local B&M store.  When I got home after work, I boiled some water and opened the package.  I noticed that this tea was packaged in a plastic bag so I guess it did has a pungent smell.  I opened the plastic bag and took a big whiff.  I was kind of disappointed.  It doesn't smell as bad as some of the other reviewers made it out to me but then again my nose has been wonky for some time so it could be me.  Yes I will admit that it does has a funky odor but it is not that strong to me.  To me, smells like this health food store I used to frequent in the Hyde Park neighborhood.  Very musky but weirdly comforting.  I have tried it with peppermint, turmeric (for a different affliction) and I have tried it plain with stevia and it taste okay to me.  I wouldn't say I have an iron stomach because I can easily get sick if food is left out in the open not at the proper temperature.  For me, this product took about two days for it to kick in and I am now able to sleep for a full eight hours straight instead of sleeping in fits of four hours here, wake up for about two hours, sleep for three, wake up for a hour and sleep for another four hours.  For those with sensitive noses and sense of taste, you have been amply warned by other reviewers.  For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  For example, mints like peppermint or spearmint will help.  Some folks will use lavender to mask the smell.

Easy to store on the shelf and great 100% juice flavors, make cranberry and I would be thrilled:)

Be Careful - We bought the juicy juice apple juice for our kids and saw in light ink the words 'product of china'.  I will never buy apple juice from Nestle.I live in a Michigan where apples are exported and a top crop that support many people along with meeting all the FDA requirements.  By the way are fresh and taste great.  How does the economics support processing apples in China and sending them here to be cheaper then made down the road?  Obviously, there is something wrong - I am not anti-globalization but seriously WTF.

Look carefully at the packaging in the store. Nestles' Juicy Juice is now a product of China: China where pesticides and chemicals banned in the U.S.A. are still used. China is a country that has sent us poison toohpaste and dog food and makes use of prison labor. From undermining breastfeeding worldwide, to the implicit condoning of slavery in the production of raw ingredients such as cocoa to importing juice of questionable safety into America, a nation awash in apples; there is no bottom for Nestle. I'd rather buy juice from British Petroleum - at least they don't use slave labor.

As with our other reviews, we reserve 5-star ratings for the very best of the best, so this 4-star rating should not be seen as in any way a negative.The taste is excellent, but the concentration is not quite as strong as I've experienced in some other juices.  With most bottled 100% fruit juices, I'm able to dilute almost 50/50% with water and still enjoy the juice.  In this case, it's a bit too diluted at 50/50%.  Had it been a bit more concentrated like some other brands, it would have received five stars.Again - it's very good - a nice blend.  And the price was outstanding, particularly with free shipping.  Would we buy again?  Absolutely.  And if you like your juice without any dilution straight out of the bottle, this will be just fine - even with some ice melting in the same glass.  I dilute mine on top of already having ice in the glass, and it's still not too bad.

column9: food ok, but 9 of 24 cans crushed
column10: my cats love this cat food, but 9 of the 24 cans were crushed.. the amazon box was not crushed.. the carton the cans came in was not crushed.. the cans inside were crushed.. i think this was a manufacturing problem.. not an amazon problem.  i tossed the 9 cans.. did not want to take a chance with contamination.  inspect the entire carton when you receive it.. i waited til 10 days. i think it is too late to claim a problem.

I love the convenience---Amazon does a superb job of packing - the subscription price is wonderful..unfortunately I am discontinuing the subscription.The manner in which FRISKIES packs is unacceptable: the amount of DENTED cans seems to go up monthly...sorry--back to the store I go..where I can also mix up the flavors for fussy cats.

It's the same Friskies as you buy in the store, and the per-can cost is lower, but by the time I threw out all the cans that were leaking from being banged up (and some smelled really bad) the cost per can was more than what I buy locally.

Below is a letter I wrote to customer services at friskies.com I don't think this is an amazon.com issue, since the damage is not to the amazon.com shipping-box or to the Friskie's packaging-box that the cat food is contained in. My guess is that damaged-cans must happen during the canning part of the process?  (Besides this issue, the feline-companion here enjoys this seafood blend).Here's my note to Friskies.com:Hi,I order a box of Friskies Prime Filets Seafood Selections Variety Pack, Seafood, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)I buy a lot of cat products over the internet, mainly places like amazon.comThe box I received, from amazon.com, was in good condition, as was the packaging box that holds the cans of cat food. But, inside the box, 5 of the 24 cans were badly damaged.I'm not sure how this might have happen? My only guess is that the cans were placed into the packaging box "damaged", then sent to amazon.com, that unknowingly  placed them into shipping-box that was then shipped to me.

I just uploaded a picture of all the dented cans that I received in my latest shipment. This was the third month in a row that cans arrived dented. Amazon did refund half the shipment, which was great, but this just isn't worth it when some are so dented they are leaking.Too good to be true! Wish this worked because I hate buying cat food at the store and this was very convenient, but I have now cancelled my subscribe and save. Bummer.

However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first few ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are for one of the flavors: turkey, poultry by-products, water sufficient for processing, and meat by-products. Another flavor was: water sufficient for processing, chicken, and liver. At least there is turkey and/or chicken in it, but other than that its mostly nasty stuff. By-products aren't even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product. It is just not a good quality cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats, and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Some Friskies flavors are even worse than the ones I listed and contain no real meat. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure, meat, and there just isn't enough real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself- provided that you eat a typical (not vegetarian or other restricted) diet. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo, or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality foods.
