column9: " D E B U T A N T E "......C O F F E E
column10: "Jamacian Mountain Peak" Instant coffee has won a "Monde Selection" award, (Luxembourg, 1990), and has an impressivereputation.  I have seen "Jamacian Blue Mountain" ccffee featured in a "By Appointment To The King of _____", famous mail-order coffee company.  This would be the GROUND coffee version, (they don't, sadly, offer any instant coffee in this famous mail-order house....although I have, several times, asked them to do so), but the fact is that their "Jamacian Blue Mountain" coffee is not only a "by appointment to Royalty" coffee....but it is also on their "specialty" list, and can only be ordered at certain times of the year!  "Jamacian Blue Mountain" coffee is also listed in the book, "100 Things To Buy Before You Die", (by Maggie Davis).  It is NOT the first choice in coffees, (that belongs to 'kopi lewca' coffee....which is produced with the help of certain insects), but IS choice Number 2.So, when I saw what looks to be, (both from name and description), an INSTANT COFFEE version of Jamacian Blue Mountain coffee, instant-coffee-drinking me could NOT resist it!Looking at the coffee before opening it, I noticed that this is a TRUE instant coffee....quite powdery, with no hint of the larger granules one finds in freeze-dried instant coffee.  In the jar, it is a surprisingly light brown -- almost a hazelnut coolour, much lighter than most other instant coffees.  If you look closely, SOME of the granules seem to sparkle, just a bit, as the light hits them.  I remember hearing about "flavour crystals" in another brand of instant coffee, (forget which one at the moment), but also remember calling up the oompany, and discovering that "flavour crystals" were created by the way the coffee granules are cut....The suggested tags for this coffee include "organic coffee" -- and though I believe that a coffee with this much reputation MUST be organically grown, the words "Organic" or "CertIfied Organic", appear no-where on the bottle's label.  Strange.....Anyway, though I usually blend all my instant coffees together, (dry), in a cannister, to get my own unique blend, (and also to disguise the taste of instant coffees I have bought and do not like, (such as Cafe Bustelo, Instant Decaffeinated Espresso coffee, which I found too strong and bitter), I decided to honour JAMACIAN MOUNTAIN PEAK instant coffee, and its reputation, by using it, and it alone, io make at least the first few cups of this coffee....I found the taste to be very, very mild.  (It is no accident, that JACOB'S CRONAT GOLD instant cofee is sold by Amazon, as an option, with Jamacian Mountain Peak Instant Coffee...as it too, has a very mild flavour.)  If you like MILD coffee, Jamacian Montain Peak Coffee should definitely be your choice.  Jacob's Cronat Gold, (for which I have also written a review for Amazon), is excellent, mild coffee as well -- but this Jamacian Mountain Gold coffee, when imbibed, has surprising, fleeting moments of a darker, richer flavour on the tongue, amongst most of the moments, which impart a pleasing mildness....As someone who prefers a somewhat darker and richer blend, (my favourite -- though lazy me doesn't make it too often -- is regular, ground French Roast coffee), I found I had to add TWO rounded teaspoons of Jamacian Mountain Peak instant coffee to my 16 ounce coffee cup, to get even an approximation of coffee flavour...at least, coffee flavour as I like to drink it.  Doing this, the Jamacian Mountain Peak coffee did have a very pleasant taste -- but a very mild one.  It reminded me, somewhat, of a sweet and innoent girl making her society debut.  Nothing loud, strong or raucaus, just a pleasant, mild sweetness -- not unpleasant at all, but not that mature, either.....I intend to have a cup or two of Jamacian Mountain Peak instant coffee mixed with my favourite instant coffee -- Taster's Choice Original.  To my American taste, I suspect that the two will be perfect together.  Or, perhaps, mixed with an instant coffee I have also liked, but found a little too strong and bitter for my tastes -- Taster's Choice Gourmet Maragor Bold.  Tge rich, dark flavour of the Taster's Choice Instant Maragor Bold, and the delicate, warm flavour of the Jamacian Mountain Peak instant coffee should go very well together, I think!  A "marriage" of two great instant coffees! I think they'll have their "honeymoon" in Jamacia!  (When I buy the Taster's Choice Maragor Bold Instant coffee, and mix it with the item here being reviewed, I'll report on whether this will be a "long and happy marriage", or not.  But from what I know of drinking both instant coffees individually, I have no doubt it will be!  Stay tuned for the update! )

Buyer beware.  Notice how carefully worded the descriptions are to avoid stating the caffeine content.  Many other sites still quote Perky Jerky's original advertizing claim that Perky Jerky contains 150mg of caffeine (from guarana).  Before you buy you should know that, due to federal Food Safety and Inspection Service intervention, Perky Jerky no longer contains anything close to 150 mg of caffeine.  U.S.D.A. officials explained that the Food Safety and Inspection Service "would not allow producers of beef jerky to add sufficient quantities of guarana to produce a stimulant effect." You can read the original source published in the New York Times:  [...]Notice that the company now refuses to state how much caffeine their product contains.  The description says: "Perky Jerky, the caffeinated beef jerky is an all-natural, great tasting snack with a kick: an energy-drink's worth of invigorating caffeine in each serving."  But some "energy" drinks contain very little caffeine.  This new and intentional vagueness about their main claim does not bode well.  Buyer beware.

THEY'RE ARE MANY MANY NATURAL INGREDS THEY COULD PUT IN THE FOOD THAT NATURALLY HAS VIT K IN IT! THEY CHOSE TO USE THE TOXIC WAY. TISK TISK ON ADDICTION PET FOOD...I LOST ALL RESPECT FOR YOU!
I SPENT 6.94 ON A PACK OF GREENIES WHICH WAS SUPPOSED TO BE A PACK OF 10AND I GOT I LITTLE BONE FOR THAT MONEY WHAT A RIP OFF, THIS IS FALSE ADVERTISING.
There is no quantity listed, but let me tell you.  It is only ONE treat.  One treat.  Are you kidding me?  Original list price $75.00 for ONE treat?

I wish I had read the reviews before I ordered this product - there is something seriously wrong with their system.  The picture clearly shows a bag of 10 - but I received ONLY one Greenie.  I even paid extra to have 1 day delivery - only to receive ONE. I'm returning for credit but will probably be charged return shipping, with no way to find anyone at Amazon to listen. :-(

The picture shows a package of 10 Greenies but when you order it, you only receive one!  What a total absolute ripoff.  After going around with Amazon Customer Service though, I'm happy to say they are going to refund my money.  I only spent $5.93 but every penny counts and I'm tired of being ripped off by people.  Thank you Amazon and I hope they get rid of this seller completely.
I was worried my dog would chew on these and they would stain my bed, etc. They don't. She's happy, I'm happy. Good value.

column9: Proof positive that hot sauce really can make anything better.
column10: I've got no complaints against the macaroni in this product. The product is designed to produce one bowl at a time of mac and cheese and the mac part comes out perfectly. I am still iffy on the cheese. Oh, I get that it's real. However, it's white, and it mixes with the starch water in such a way that... well, it's not appealing to look at. Even after adding a little butter. It tastes alright, but I cannot get past that weird, glue-like appearance. But a liberal dose of hot sauce later, it's easier to look at and quite palatable. This product is pretty convenient if you want a single serving of mac and cheese without a lot of additives, but in future I think I'll just boil a little elbow macaroni and melt some Muenster over it.

Delicious chocolate with just a hint of sea salt.  Really an interesting and luscious combination.  Yum...The 5 pound bag is HUGE.  I wasn't going to share at first, but I could be eating this bag for years if I ate it all myself.  I will be making many friends with this chocolate!

They won't allow a review unless it has a certain number of words so I will just reiterate the 5 stars I gave it.  These are delicious and addictive and 5 pounds is a fine and dandy amount. MORE PLEASE
This is a great snack to throw in the kids backpacks for school.  They get to eat a cereal they love and it's a quick and easy pick from the pantry!
This product, cereal, arrived on time and was as as good as expected.  What more can I say about cereal?

Good cereal and at the price Amazon had it for with their 50% off special, it's good stuff. My kids like it too.  It's not too sweet either, it's sweet but not sickeningly so like some of the kids cereals.

I love being able to purchase "bulk" items at such a savings. These are my favorite cereal and I am able to keep a supply easily with the subscribe and save program here on Amazon. If you haven't at least checked it out, do so. You just might be surprised.
its delicious almond flavor, price and size, economy and gives us a good complement to every morning, is a favorite of children since combined with yogurt flavors

Post Honey Bunches of Oats is an all-time favorite cereal for everyone in the family. We all like it and that makes it a great cereal to have in the pantry. The giant size lasts much longer than the small boxes. The price could be more competitive to in-store sales, etc, but the cereal itself is fantastic.
I love this cereal and I buy it all the time but I have never paid more than $4.50 for a box of cereal, I'm not sure where these people shop but $6 for a box of cereal is nuts
The soup is a wonderful addition to my pantry. The flavor is good and there is plenty of  meat and veggies. Low cal too!

I purchased two packages of this product, but have only opened one of them. Not only did this package contain seeds, but the seeds have been sliced and broken up into small sharp pieces that may harm one's esophagus and/or intestinal tract if swallowed. The only way to eat the tamarind is to hold a small amount in your mouth without swallowing, and allow your saliva to loosen the tamarind while your tongue locates the pieces of seeds so you can remove them with your fingers. Only when you're sure all pieces of seed have been removed should you begin chewing the tamarind. I gave this product a "1" rating but only because I wasn't allowed to give it a "0".

column9: Xanadu of Dragonsweyr Got It Wrong
column10: This product is not supposed to be popped in your mouth and chewed without cooking.  You're supposed to use it to prepare tamarind water for use in a sauce -- think of it as sort of a sweet-and-sour replacement for sugar + vinegar (but fruitier).  It works just fine when you break off a chunk, put it into a saucepan with a cup or two of water, boil it for a few minutes, and STRAIN it through a sieve into whatever sauce you're preparing. Thicken it with cornstarch and it makes a wonderful sauce for pork. I use it frequently and it's just fine. A good product if you take it for what it is. It's not candy.- Bill Warriner, Tucson, AZ (I moved)

I was hesitant to order this tea because there were only a few reviews at the time.  One reviewer said the tea was "tasteless" and another cited poor packaging affecting the freshness.I'm glad I took the chance because I disagree on both counts.  The taste is excellent which is, of course, the most important factor.  I love strong, aromatic, flavorful tea and this does not disappoint.  I had to add just a teeny bit more (a more rounded teaspoon for one cup) than with the tea I normally drink, Twinings Irish Breakfast, but that is insignificant since this Davidson's tea is half the price.  I love that it is organic since I drink a lot of tea.I also thought the packaging was adequate.  It is similar to the packaging used for the organic Ruta Maya coffee that I buy and I have never had a problem with freshness.  Of course it is best to make sure you press out all of the air before resealing the top...I usually tap it on the counter to settle the contents then bend the top over on itself while leaning over on it, then seal it. As it reduces in size putting a rubber band around it helps just in case you didn't get the seal completely closed. I keep a small quantity of the tea in an old Twinings tin so that I don't have to open the original package so often.I am very happy to have found this tea.  I still love the Twinings but it is just too expensive with three people in my family always drinking tea.

I drink a lot of tea, always loose, always as high a quality as I can get.This stuff is quite flavorful, I'd actually say that it is the most robust English Breakfast I've ever had.The package is sealed, maybe they updated their packaging lately, but it arrived an an air-tight one pound bag.It is strong and tasty. Which is what I want in a breakfast tea.

This is an excellent tea, I've bought tea in bulk for years and you just have to go by trial and error to adjust a new tea to your taste. The fact that this is organic along with a great price is absolutley wonderful.

Unlike another review, I see no problem with the packaging. The tea is in a foil lined bag with a zip lock closure on the top. The tea should stay nice and fresh. The tea is full bodied, much like a bay watch vixen. Very pleasant aftertaste, nothing like a bay watch vixen. Smooth and rich.

This is the best tea I have had so far. If you open a bag of the so called upscale teas and compare it to this one,the difference is obvious. This tea smells like tea should and does not have broken stems and powder.
Really like this product....fresh, don't have to use as much as I did with the Twinings.  Really pleased with this and the extra bonus is that it is organic.  I'm getting ready to buy some more.

This is a lot of tea at a very good price; however, I would put the quality very much in the mediocre category.  I drink loose leaf tea every morning and like a strong English Breakfast to start the day, and with this tea I have to use a bit more than more expensive teas.Don't expect a wonderful experience with this tea, but its a decent tea at a great price.
better than the tea dust you get in teabags. The taste is very good and the price also so the small inconvenience of trashing the tealeaves,is worthwhile.

I have been using Amazon for years and have rarely had a problem. After reading the reviews for this tea I purchased it only to find that the tea received was tasteless as another reviewer described. Now I have a pound of tea but I will not drink and have found that I cannot return it(I definitely do not agree with this policy). Regrettably the bag was not dated selected not tell if I had gotten an out of date bag.

column9: Not English Breakfast, and not the same as before.
column10: I was delighted with my first trial pound of this tea, which I ordered a few months ago. It was full bodied and rich, with large leaves and flavor that wouldn't quit.Confident I had found 'my tea', I ordered 2 pounds and imagine my surprise when I got a completely different tea. The leaves are only a bit smaller, but the taste is more astringent, without that pleasant 'dark' taste that is characteristic of a good English Breakfast blend.I am in the process of contacting Davidson's about this, as I have no idea what has happened.

column9: Tastes like Dargeeling not English breakfast.
column10: This is not really English breakfast tea.  It is closer to a Darjeeling tea, and seems to be all one tea not a blend.  The Yorkshire  tea is closer to English breakfast than this one.  In order to make this tea more useful, it is better to blend it with another tea such as ceylon tea, or one of the Indian teas.

This is excellent tea, for a very good price. Its better than the supermarket "british" or "english" alternatives in the red can or the purple box. I will likely buy this again.UPDATE: After getting better aquainted with this tea im upping my rating to 5 stars. I find that i have to use a bit more tea than other teas im used to, but the reward is a very satisfying cup with good body and nice flowery top notes.

We drink a lot of tea at our house, in fact we drink almost exclusively  tea.  I had been toying with the idea of trying one of the Davidson bargain teas so I finally took the chance and ordered their English Breakfast 16 oz. bag.  We love English Breakfast tea from PG tips,  Twinings, Taylors of Hargate and Dilmah Ceylon supreme tea. all of which have flavor and aroma in high degree.  My personal favorite is Taylor's Assam tea.  Since Davidson's English Breakfast is a combination of ceylon, assam and Kenyon teas I anticipated a rich and aromatic tea.  Unfortunately the experience was a little disappointing.  The initial taste was somewhat woody to my palate but I wanted to be fair so I waited a day and tried it again in the morning free from the taste of any other tea; same result!  I guess I'll use up the remainder as iced tea.4/20 addendum:  This tea makes excellent iced tea.

column9: Inexpensive yet not a good flavor for me
column10: I thought I would try it out-- good price and pretty good reviews, but it's not for me. I crave a nice strong cup of English Breakfast in the morning but this one wasn't to my liking. If brewed too long it had a really bad flavor, but if I brewed it less, not enough or an off-putting flavor. I'm going to try something different.

Inexpensive and it's clear why: it's bitter and tasteless,  whether brewed for a minute or four. To be immediately relegated to "emergentea" at the back of the cupboard. Get this instead: Taylors of Harrogate, Yorkshire Gold Tea, Loose Leaf, 8.8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 3)

column9: It has a funny taste to it
column10: Maybe it was just the blend that I got but this english tea had an off taste and aroma.  No matter how dilute I prepared it, it was stagnant every time and I've english tea in the past.  In order to not  waste it, I mix it with herbs (hibiscus and/or mint) at a very small ratio haha.
The English Breakfast tea is okay but to my taste buds not out standing. I prefer the Irish Breakfast tea and brew that more often.

This is my first purchase of bulk teas from Amazon and I am very pleased with the product. The flavor is bold and it doesn't take much tea to develop a strong brew. I overestimated the tea required for my first pot and reduced the quantity used to suit my tastes. The quality is good, only leaves with no debris. The tea arrived in packaging slightly different than shown in the product photo. The brown bag is foil lined with a ziplock closure that keeps the tea fresh. I will definitely buy this tea again.

I am very impressed with this black tea. I used to work in a specialty coffee and tea shop and I know for a fact that they spent much more for tea of this same caliber. The bag does seal tight and I just do my best to get all the air out and it stays fresh. I was a bit skeptical given the price, but I will be singing the praises of Davidson's Tea to anyone who will listen!
A great tea for any price. well packaged fresh. makes a very very good cup of tea. have had other breakfast teas at much higher price points that did not come close to this.

column9: Pretty good tea at a great price
column10: I am a big fan of strong English & Irish teas and have had numerous brands of English Breakfast for decades. The Davidson's is quite good except that it could be packaged to stay somewhat fresher and more aromatic. As it is, I gave it 4 of 5 stars. The price is great and the tea is good. If had been packaged more airtight I think it would go from good to excellent. I would happily pay an extra dollar for better packaging. As it is, it is still a very good value on a good tea. It is a nice rich brown flavorful tea with plenty of morning "kick".

I guess it had to happen sooner or later but this is my first disappointment buying from Amazon. No aroma when the bag was opened and totally tasteless. I bought in spite of the negative reviews and now will man up and regret it. Too bad because it was to be my first subscribe and save experience. After contacting customer service full credit was issued, subscribe and save cancelled and I was asked to dispose of the item. Five Stars for Amazon!
This supplier seems to have problems in quality control.  My own bag was very dry, with almost no aroma and a taste of little but tannin.

column9: Doesn't Taste Like English Breakfast Tea
column10: I ordered this tea because it had pretty good reviews.  I got it a couple of days ago and have been trying to convince myself that I like it since you have to buy so much.  It tastes fine, but doesn't taste like English Breakfast tea.  I love having English Breakfast in the morning and am somewhat disappointed that I spent over $10 dollars on tea that I don't enjoy that much.

column9: Not bad but a little weak
column10: I really enjoy a strong cup of tea in the morning, which is why I like English Breakfast tea and Irish breakfast tea.  This tea, while not bad in flavor, is a bit on the weak side.  I find that I have to brew for over 5 minutes to get the strength I like.
I had great hopes for this product, but it was virtually tasteless, no matter how much tea I added. It's going in the garbage, and I'm going back to Yorkshire Gold.

column9: Great value, but only Good taste
column10: I read many of the negative reviews here, but decided to give it a try since the price is right.  I don't have any complaints about the packaging, but I also found the taste mediocre.  Despite trying more tea and/or additional steeping time I can't get a cup brewed that is both strong, but not bitter.With that said, it isn't bad tea and it superior to supermarket teabags.  But when I use this up I'm trying something else.

I give this 5 stars for price, 3 stars for flavor.  I need to use more tea than the directions call for to get the expected English Breakfast flavor.  I put 2 rounded tablespoons in a 4 cup pyrex dish and microwave for 6 minutes. At that time it is ready to drink without tasting 'stewed'.  For me steeping it per the directions made a thin brew with a 'stewed' aftertaste. When this is gone I will not automatically re-purchase but it will be my baseline for comparing others.
Davidson's English Breakfast loose tea makes excellent iced tea.  I am from the South and enjoy iced tea.  I use Stevita powdered stevia to sweeten my iced tea and the result is delicious.
I buy this tea to brew for kombucha, not to drink. I'm happy with the product though and would buy it again.

I normally buy from mountain rose herbs, but this is a really good price for organic tea so I had to try it.  In my opinion it tastes a little bitter no matter how long it steeps.  There is a powdery texture to it as you drink it.  With enough honey and milk it is ok.  The taste was unbearable as sun tea.

This is great tea for a great price.  Have made several pots don't end up with a lot of powder unlikde some of the brand names. In fact, for Englich Breakfast this is as good or better than just about anything else out there.
THis is the third of fourth pound of this tea that I have purchased over the last couple of years. Very good!

First time buying loose leaf tea, so I am by no means an experienced reviewer when it comes to these things. Take that into consideration.Tea smelled fine, nothing to strong. Tasted fine, didn't seem to bitter as some reviewers have said.Average to slightly above average tea, great price, 4 stars.10oz cup just over 1 tspn of tea+ some milk and sugar.

column9: A Very Good English Breakfast Tea
column10: I have ordered the Davidson's English Breakfast tea a couple of times now.  I have really enjoyed the flavor.  I had only been using it on weekends because I didn't have time to brew it and get to work.  Now that I have retired, I have it every morning (2 - 14 oz cups) to get me going in the morning.  The lined brown paper packing looks simple but really protects the tea and keeps it fresh.  The delivery of the product is prompt and the price is very good.  I'll be ordering this one again.
Pretty good, not great tea. It's on the weak side. I wish there was an exceptional organic tea on the market.
I have been drinking this tea everyday for 2 weeks and I really like it!  Give it a try.  I also bought the Earl Gray with Lavendar.

I was hoping to find an English Breakfast that is not too heavy and has the Kemun flavors.Tea was good qualtiy but seemed to lack something. I cannot tell if it was the Kemun.I wish tea makers would tell you what the dang mixture is so we do not have to guess so much.

We love this tea. Because my husband drinks a lot of tea that we make in the tea pot from loose tea, we decided to switch to organic tea. We tried other brands too and settled on this one. It is great! You can make a 8 cup tea with a teaspoon of davidson's tea. We also tried Assam and other types of black tea. This one is the best because you can make iced tea as well as opposed to assam tea that gets muddy after boiling it and letting it stay for 1 hour or two. Now, we are subscribed to this tea and get a pack every month. You can't beat the price when you subscribe and save. Highly recommended!

Recently my store changed prices on loose tea (in some cases 100% increase). Looking for alternatives I came across Davidson's tea. I was pleasantly surprised by quality of the tea. The convenience of automatic shipping and the price of the tea is a plus. I subscribed to total of four different teas. No regrets.

Tea arrived quickly and the packaging was first rate. The quality of the tea itself was, in my opinion, only average. As others have said it is somewhat weak and lacking flavor. However the price one pays for this quantity of tea makes it a good deal just the same and I would buy it again just for that reason.
This English Breakfast has an excellent body and is enhanced by a little milk - in the English style. You'll like the sturdy flavor of this black tea. Davidson's choice to be organic is important.

This might just be my new favorite tea! I'm used to Twinings and Bigelow English Breakfast, and was worried that I might be stuck with a substandard "value" bag of stems and grit for the low price that I paid. But after the first cup my concerns were laid to rest - this is the most flavorful, hearty english breakfast tea that I've had. English Breakfast is my go-to morning cup, I drink it daily in lieu of coffee these days. This tea holds up perfectly to milk and sugar, and I love that it's loose so I can control the strength of my morning brew. I'm a recent loose leaf-convert, and I can't wait to see what other gems Davidson's has to offer!
This is absolutely the best tea Ive ever drank. Our Son turned me on to it, and told me where I could get it. I love this tea. I drink hot tea everyday. It really is the best!
This has got to be one of the all-time greatest buys on good tea. A nice, dark, malty brew with great character to get you going in the morning.

column9: Pretty good taste; pretty good price!
column10: I originally purchased this tea to re-use in my k-cups and use in a separate filter for the Keurig.  It's not so good for that.  It really needs to be steeped the old-fashioned way.I love a strong, aromatic black tea, and this is very good.If you're not using enough tea, it'll taste terrible.  If you're not steeping the tea for the proper amount of time, it'll taste terrible.  I have a feeling the negative reviews have come from people not using enough tea or brewing it the wrong way.I even used it in a french coffee press.I was impressed with the tea, and you can't beat the price.

I must drink more tea than anyone else on the planet.  I am an Freelance Artist and always have a cup in my hand.  This is a really good loose leaf tea.  Nice blend.  Can't wait for Scottish Breakfast loose leaf tea to come back.  Love that one too.

This is an excellent morning tea, as clean tasting and robust as a good English breakfast blend should be.  I have enjoyed tea all over the world for years, and this is a blend I look forward to each morning.
I am a regular tea drinker although maybe not considered a connoisseur. I thoroughly enjoyed this tea.  Will definitely be buying more.  The price was excellent too!
I'm on my second order.  I like the taste, the aroma, seems very fresh, clean, and smooth for a full flavored tea.The whole family is drinking it so we go through a lot of it.I prefer it to Twinings.
Bought this tea to brew with a The Breville One-Touch Tea Maker. It's very rich, flavorful, and taste great!

The first time I tried this tea, I was a little disappointed. The flavor was very similar to an oolong that I had purchased at a Chinese supermarket. I don't believe I steeped it long enough that first time.I gradually discovered that the longer I steeped the tea the better the flavor became. I even started stirring the pot (Horrors! I know, not quite proper, eh, wot?) to mix the heavier concentration of flavor at the bottom into the rest of the tea. Now I had a good strong English Breakfast tea. Then I started using it in my French coffee press (which has never had coffee in it). The results were outstanding.I recently decided to try brewing the Davidson's English Breakfast right inside my new 40 oz. Thermos Work Series thermos bottle (double horrors!). I keep a small sieve by my desk to filter out the tea leaves, but the shape of the stopper (with notches in the threads so you don't have to remove it to pour) filters 90% of the leaves so I don't even need the sieve. Now, that is excellent, to my considerable surprise.

We used to purchase a very similar-tasting English Breakfast organic bulk tea at a local market for nearly twice the price.  Glad we stumbled upon this find. Richly flavored and nicely smooth, Davidson's English Breakfast is quite delicious AND a real money-saver. Liked it so much we signed up for the monthly subscription to save even more.
I usually use Twinings English breakfast loose tea.  This was a poor substitute for that.  This tea has a strong, earthy taste, almost like dirt rather than tea.

Somehow tea tastes better to me when it doesn't come in a teabag and is coarse leaf. This tea has a very pleasant taste and I look forward to it in the morning. I use sugar and milk and the bulk English Breakfast combines for a great taste.

column9: Excellent tea at an affordable price!
column10: This tea is first class quality. Excellent flavor and aroma and absolutely delicious to drink. The price is affordable too!

I have purchased various black teas over the years and I was really surprised by the excellent quality of this tea, I was expecting much less of it due to its low price. WRONG!! I like it so much I find I brew it more often than the other varieties that I have on hand.  It is a steal at this price.  I have become a Davidson's tea convert!

I'm normally a coffee (espresso) drinker.  This is a great alternative, made warm, it's filling and flavorful on a cool/cold day.  Cold, it's better (less 'muddy') than Lipton for iced-tea.  It's that classic English Breakfast taste.  Not too much caffeine, I drink this all day long (mostly as hot tea in the winter).

Yields a very respectable cup of tea if mastering the right amount and the value is surprisingly good. For that it gets a 4 Stars. Nice deal and for tea drinkers should be a very good bargain. I thank the many reviewers who ended being right on the money. Tea is such a wonderful alternative to coffee and I think that if I really had to choose one or the other I would go with tea. Knowing how many types are out there does not make it very easy to choose but slowly but surely one can find all kinds of great tea. This one, for the value and taste, is a very convincing argument that one does not have to pay exorbitant prices to be able to drink a good cup of tea!

column9: Best Tea at the Best Price Anywhere
column10: Love this Tea.This is the Greatest English Breakfast Tea.I don't think you can find a better price either.Shipped directly to your home, how can you beatthat. Fast shipping too.Great Service, Great Tea and a Great Company !I don't how else to say that this is the BestTea Company around.It's very difficult to find loose tea these daysespecially if you live in a rural area. Can't findthis Quality Tea at a local grocery store, that'sfor sure.Thanks Guys!Keep up the great work.DV
This tea is excellent! And I love the eco-friendly packaging! I used to drink Fortnum and Mason, but can no longer get it. This is a great alternative!
We have been buying this tea for several months. It is consistently excellent. The flavor is very full and deep. One of the best English Breakfast teas we have had.

I received this tea the day after Amazon's email announced that it had shipped. The dry tea leaves have a good aroma and the brewed tea has excellent color. Flavor of the brewed tea is very light and not pleasant.
The only adjective that I can think of to describe the taste of this tea is dirt.  I drink loose English Breakfast tea every day, and this is the worst that I have ever had.

I love tea. I wish I could have enjoyed this one. It is organic and reasonably priced. Two big factors going for it.Unfortunately, I thought it was awful. It wasn't bad English Breakfast Tea. It was just bad tea.I don't enjoy leaving this bad review. However, I don't want other people to waste their time and money on this tea. It was a frustrating experience.The search begins again.

Great tea for a AWESOME price.  I got this tea when it was over 70% off @ amazon.  It tastes really nice and has a perfect british breakfast taste.  The tea is shredded in large long pieces compared to some other loose tea I have had.

I usually buy PG Tips or Typhoon english breakfast tea in bags.  I wanted to try loose-leaf tea for a stronger flavor.  Unfortunately, I fill the tea infuser and it is just not as strong as the previously mentioned brands.  As for the packaging, it arrived just as pictured here but you should know the paper bag is plastic lined and has a ziploc to seal it. It's good packaging.  I hate to give it this review and I've only made 4 pots of tea so if my opinion changes later, I'll surely note it here.UPDATE: I figured out I was making a rookie mistake: in my desire to brew a strong tea, I was overfilling the infuser thereby preventing the flow of water.  This tea is not weak after all.  I upgraded from 3 to 4 stars.  Why not 5? I still think the PG Tips has a better flavor.  I am going to keep my subscription to this tea because it's organic.

column9: If this is tea ... then my dog lays eggs
column10: This is the worst tasting tea I have EVER had ..... it was very dry and flaked into powder when you but it in between your fingers.  Had a taste of come chemical that had to have been used in it's drying or production.  I have drank teas for many many years and after one cup through this way ... I also tried their earl gray style.... again way too dry and chemical taste in the tea ... DO NOT BUY THIS TEA .... thank goodness for Amazon's customer service department ... they sent me two new bags which were also bad and then refunded my moneis.....Again, Do Not Buy this product.  I wish there was a zero starts because this item earned it....

I bought the Davidson's loose tea to go along with the Eco-cup for Keurig appliances.It is really good! I fill the eco-cup half full, choose the larger Keurig setting,and I get a great cup of tea really fast--no waiting for it to steep.

The worst tea we have ever had the misfortune of drinking. Tasted like dishwater. The first time we purchased this tea it was acceptable. The second time it had all the taste and character of floor sweepings. We will never never purchase tea from you again. It was certainly not up to the standard we have come to expect from Amazon.

I usually choose english breakfast tea because it has a rich flavor.  This tea was practically tasteless. I could go out in my back yard and randomly pick weeds and it would taste better than this stuff.  I recommend Taylors of Harrogate if you're looking for english-style tea.

I used to dislike tea of all kinds (hot or cold) however with age and an evergrowing desire for variety, I've changed into a totally different person.  I highly recommend this stuff.  It's delicious tea that your entire family can enjoy.
Very good tea and beautiful tins (the tins're not too full though). I really liked it. Contains ginger, clover, cinnamon as well as milk powder. Very tasty, Great!
I bought this for my wife and she loves it, so I'll give it a 4/5.This isn't just tea, there is powdered milk involved too.  I was surprised, so if that isn't your thing...

I'm no longer eating fast food or junk food but despite eating steel cut oatmeal, steamed lentils and quinoa without complaint, nothing makes me as happy as leftover BEEF slices between two thin slices of rice/flour toast thickly smeared with the only mayonnaise worth eating:  Hellman's Original.And it's not the animal flesh that makes a sandwich but the Hellman's.  Try a sliced tomato lightly salted with a fistful of lettuce leaves between two thin slices of crisply toasted rice/flour bread thickly smeared with Hellman's.  You won't even miss the bacon.  Mmm, juicy heaven.
Simply the BEST mayo around! Hellmann's / Best Foods is awesome! Taste better than any mayo out there!!!

It feels great being able to create a wonderful sandwich anytime I want it. I no longer have to save a little mayonnaise for later because now I always have plenty on hand and can have yummy sandwiches any time I want.

column4: My 2 Cents "A penny for your thoughts"
column9: Perfect for adding flavor to dry food. Our little dog loves this stuff
column10: I don't know a lot about dogs but I thought they ate anything. The dachshund we had growing up would eat banana peels if you left them out. We rescued a Maltese (5 years ago now) and while he is healthy, he eats when he's hungry and leaves the rest. column9: We're both happy at long last!
column10: I have two dogs, but only one of them eats Cesar chicken "in meaty juices" (it HAS to be the "in meaty juices kind!) and she GOBBLES IT. after years of searching for a food she'll eat to enjoy, not just eat to survive, we've finally found a winner! Gigi is a 9-year-old Papillon mix who is both dainty, firecely independent, and plain fierce when she's disturbed, while 1-year-old Mini-Dachshund Sophie is a happy, bouncy, and utterly addicted to attention. Gigi spends her time under the bed, Sophie is wherever I am. What Sophie eats is actually still TBD. This is Gigi's review.Both of them have been picky eaters. Gigi went years on starving herself until she couldn't hold out any longer, then deigning to eat the dry food we supply between wet food dinners, even as we tried all kinds of different foods to tempt her. Beneful Dog Food Prepared Meals Beef Stew Dog Food, 10-Ounce Plastic Containers (Pack of 8) used to work now and then, and though it was expensive, we could get 3 servings from it. However, even though it had a lid, it would often grow moldy even before the next meal. So even though she liked it, it was wasted and really too expensive anyway.When Sohpie arrived, we'd been serving Mighty Dog Hearty Pulled-Style Chicken Dinner In Gravy, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) with the longest sustained success yet, about a year. Only chicken, mind you, and it had to be the chunky in sauce kind, NOT the pate kind. Well, along came the puppy, and Gigi expressed her distaste by wasting food again.Finally, I've found Cesar. And oddly, now it has to be the pâté kind, I.e. "in meaty juices" NOT the chunky kind! But AT LAST we've found a dog food that The Mrs. will absolutely SNARF ON. She doesn't come up for air when I put any chicken-based "in meaty juices" Cesar dinner in front of her, which I cube into bite sizes.The added bonus is that I can hide pills in the cubes. Gigi's been diagnosed with congenital heart failure, and she's on 3 different pills, 3 times a day. Dinner is the easier dose, because I just push the little pills into the soft pâté, and she's none the wiser because she swallows the cubes almost whole! Sadly, we won't probably have Gigi with us for the fourteen or fifteen years I've been blessed to have spent with my previous dogs. But I'm determined to make sure she's as healthy and happy as possible in the time we have. She may be feisty, prickly, and a loner, but when I *can* catch her, she does love to snuggle with her mama.Cesar "in nearby juices" dog food might just give me a few month's more snuggled than we'd otherwise have.

column9: Not a fan of granola bars, but the taste of these wowed me
column10: I don't typically buy or snack on granola bars. They are often more chewy than like a crisp cookie and taste of honey and artificial ingredients. In fact, I would never have tried these were there not a sample bowl of them at a local grocery store.I was more than shocked...it almost tasted like a homemade oatmeal cookie.  In fact it was so good I returned for seconds and bought 2 boxes of these and 3 other flavors as well. Although the chocolate chip is a close second, these are hands down the best in my opinion.Surprisingly the calorie count on the box is for TWO bars. While many manufacturers try to sneak in calories by doing things like saying there are 2 servings in soda can or 2 servings in a single frozen dinner so the calorie count looks smaller, they were more than generous. TWO bars of most of their flavors have only 160 calories and for a mega sweet fix that satisfies me plenty with just one bar, that wowed me.This is an organic bar and they are actually vegan. Not that they advertise this anywhere, I just read labels and was surprised to see no dairy or eggs listed. One servings gives you 40% of your daily recommended serving of whole grains yet it tastes like a cookie or dessert...and that also means a nice doce of fiber.While I wouldn't fool myself into thinking that I'm eating HEALTHY just because of the whole grains and organic ingredients...it is, afterall, sweet and has 11g of sugar (but that's for two bars, remember, and one is plenty filling for me so that's not so bad for a sweet snack.) I do feel I am eating healthier than most alternatives when I'm craving a sweet snack that I can tote in a purse or keep in my desk drawer. Most bow far deeper into the less healthy alternatives of preservatives to keep them shelf-stable, or far more sugar.Not to be confused with a protein bar or one packed with vitamins, of which it's not, it's still a healthy alternative to the afternoon candy bar or morning donut in the break room and in my opinion it tastes way better than either.

Each packet has 2 bars, sure -- but the weight of each packet is 1.5 oz, which is less than two-thirds the weight of ONE regular Clif bar. These bars are maybe 1 1/2" wide, 4" long, and 1/4" thick. You'll be tempted to use them to file your nails. Why would Clif suddenly decide that humans can't take a granola bar that weighs more than .75 oz -- and package two of them together? Gosh, let's all think.Anyway, now you know. On the plus side, if you don't like these -- I'd give them a 5 out of 10 on taste -- just hold the box in your open palm, and a hefty breeze will take them away.

column9: Great taste, but not very filling
column10: I am a huge fan of Clif products, and consume them almost daily. My breakfast every single work day consists of a standard Clif Bar, and I also occasionally eat a Clif Builder's Bar after a strenuous workout. Happy with all previous Clif products, I purchased a couple boxes of these Clif Crunch Bars, in the Chocolate Chip flavor. Like other Clif products, the whole ingredients list consists of real, natural items; nothing on the list that you can't pronounce or identify.If this review were based on taste and taste alone, there is no doubt in my mind that these bars would deserve a full 5 stars. Given that the bars are relatively healthy, with a solid ingredients list, they taste wonderful; I wouldn't have them change a single thing. Unfortunately, the big downside to this product is the fact that they just aren't nearly as filling as other Clif products. Each pack contains two separate bars, and as far as satisfying hunger goes, I need to eat two complete packs of these Crunch Bars to get the same amount of satisfaction as a single normal Clif bar. Granted, these are lower in calories than the normal bar, but they just don't seem to cut it if I want a quick snack that will fill me up.Another product I have used that is about the same nutritional content as the Crunch Bar, but seems to satisfy my hunger better, are the standard Nature Valley Granola bars. I will keep buying Clif products, but these Clif Crunch Bars will likely not make it back onto my shopping list anytime soon.

column9: Overpriced! Not what you are expecting.
column10: My main beef with this product is with the labeling.The box is labeled very deceptively. This goes double when inspecting the packaging from the Web (as you are doing now). "10 bars" is prominently displayed on the box. Lo and behold, once you open the box, only five bars are present. Upon further inspection, you see that printed in mice-type on the box is "5 two count packages". The net weight of the entire box is 7.4 ounces. That's less than one cup of granola. That's when you realize you've been had.You can buy a mega-size box of Nature Valley granola bars from a warehouse club for less money than the "Pack of 2" you'll find here. I mention Nature Valley because in a blind taste test you won't be able to distinguish that brand from these Clif bars.Seriously, if they are selling them for this much on Amazon, I'd be shocked and chagrined to see what they go for at the camping stores which is their retailer of origin.I consider myself embarrassed to have been duped so badly on this one. Clif has seriously damaged their brand credibility. Live and learn.

My grandson, who is in special forces training in the Air Force requested these.  Needs a lot of protein for his training.  Asked me not to send cookies or junk food.  Wanted these instead.  Lots easier than cooking, packaging, and trips to the post office.He said his favorite is the Blueberry bars.

I love these things! Usually they go on sale on Amazon and I only buy them when they are about $6 - 7 for the pack of two. My favorite kind is the white chocolate macadamia nut. However, when I bought them I wasn't expecting them to be quite so messy. They are definitely crunchy, and you will get crumbs everywhere - so keep that in mind. Otherwise I love the things! I'm a college student so this is a good breakfast or snack on my walk to class.

I purchased 5 boxes of these. I really enjoy the taste and nutritional value of the bars. Great starter, mid day pick me up or evening snack (dip into milk). These are crunchy. Great price & excellent Amazon service!

The "healthiness" is great, as are most CLIF products.The price, even with subscribe and save is way too high.There is not much difference from just buying regular granola barsThere are only 5 packages in each box (with 2 smaller bars in each)I always wonder why they make such big boxes and only put a few items in the box....who only eats 5 granola bars?

column9: Taste just like Chocolate Chip Cookies!
column10: First off let me say that I've been a fan of Clif bars for a while now. So I saw these at my local grocery store and decided to give them a whirl.WOW! Just wow! These take exactly like crunchy chocolate chip cookies. They are absolutely delicious. I find myself craving these now instead of brownies or a candy bar. I was actually eating them in class one day and a few people tried them and now are also obsessed. Great product and completely yummy!

Great for on the go, I work in a job that I don't always got to eat lunch on time so grabbing a bar is a great way to eat. These are great, the only thing is that it comes in a 5 pack because 2 bars are in each pack. But it is still a great deal
Just as good as the other Clif bars, but dry and crunchy. Tasty, portable, and cheaper than the others. Perfect snack.
We love these granola bars. I didn't realize that they were crunchy when i ordered them and it was such a nice surprise. They have great flavor and I feel good about my family eating them.
This cliff bar is much more expensive than the nature valley products. But, it is not worth to be pricey.

This new product packs the perfect crunch into sweet bar. I love the bits of white chocolate. The only downside is that it crumbles incredibly easy so it's pretty messy to eat. But overall, it is a very satisfying bar!

column9: Decent granola bar, but the packaging is a bit misleading
column10: When I first opened the box I was surprised to find 5 packages of granola bars, each with 2 bars each, so a "10-pack" has 5 packages with 2 granola bars in each package (I never noticed it was normal to do that with granola bars), hence the serving size is 2 bars. The price for each packet is about the same as that of a normal clif bar, so I don't know if it's really worth it to me. You get about 60% more mass with a clif bar than with this for the same price.That being said, they taste decent and taste good broken into pieces with peanut butter and nutella.

These are so awesome. They have great crunch, without being really hard (like nature valley) and the little bits of chocolate throughout the bar are delightful. I would eat these for dessert instead of cake or brownies. Peanut butter is good too.
Figured I'd try these when Amazon lowered the price and glad I did!  My wife and I both enjoy these very tasty bars and it is a much healthier choice than a bag of chips!

These things are awesome!  I only ordered them because they were on a good sale on amazon, but now I'll gladly pay full price.They taste soo good!  No high fructose corn syrup, a big plus.  They do have "evaporated cane juice" as the sweetener.  I'm not familiar with it, but a quick google search shows it to be a healthier and better alternative to regular cane sugar.Great texture and crunch, and great flavor.  A perfect snack that is much much healthier than a lot of alternatives.I could not imagine a better granola bar.  Try these, you won't be disappointed!
My parents sent me some of these in care package while I was deployed and they are amazing.  So much better than nature vally bars.

column9: Pretty good break from other brand granola bars
column10: I got the white chocolate macadamia flavor of these.  They really aren't any different from any other granola bars.  The white chocolate flavor isn't as strong as it is in the regular Clif bars.  Overall, they're tasty and reasonably priced on Amazon.
Great crunch and taste.  Love the auto ship program with discount!  I can't find these in any stores in my area, was so happy to get them on Amazon.

I love these granola bars!  I can honestly say they are the best granola bars I've ever eaten.  They also have protein, and I love eating them just as a snack as well as if I'm on the go or post workout.  My only problem is they are hard to find in grocery stores...and I usually don't like to wait around to fill out a "please stock this item" form.

Love Cliff bars, but have only liked the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip Peanut Crunch flavors (maybe an occasional Blueberry).  The others are too sweet for my taste.  These are my new favorite.  Great taste combination.  Go Cliff Bars!
These are the best crunchy granola bars I've tasted. They are excellent alone or with a nice cup of coffee. Highly recommended!

Got these with a one-day shipping delay, but still very quickly with Amazon Prime.  The taste is quite good, perhaps a little on the sweet side - especially when you hit a pocket of white chocolate.  The big problem is the condition of the product when it arrives.  I opened my first 2-pack and the granola bars were crushed into nuggets and powder.  Strangely, the box wasn't in bad shape, just the bars.  A few days later, I opened the other box of granola bars, which was in better shape than the first one, and the first pack I tried again contained smashed fragments of granola bars.  These are no fun to eat, as you can't really open the pack and pour it into your mouth (I tried), and if you pick out the big chunks you get fragments and powder sticking to your fingers, and on your clothes (and in your beard).  I'll eat the rest, maybe out of a bowl with a spoon or something (with some fava beans and a nice chianti...), but I won't be ordering any more crunched Clif Crunch bars.
What looks like a great deal is actually a terrible one. This is ONE box of 5 packs of granola bars (packed like Nature Valley). So, instead of receiving 20 snacks, you get 5.

column9: Identical taste to Nature Valleys Granola bars
column10: I was hoping that the taste of these granola bars would different from Nature Valleys but it turns out they taste pretty much the same if not identical... maybe a little bit less sugary.Oh well, moving on... I just hate when companies deliberately trick consumers, the freaking box got 5 packs, just put that on the box.

These bars are tasty and delicious.  You get 20 bars for a decent price (depending if you do subscribe and save).  These bars are great for my little ones, they love them, and they are a good healthy alternative to candy or cookies.
The listing of the box describes as twice as many bars as there are servings.  Each foil pouch contains two very small bars, which together make one serving.  The 10 count is really a 5 count.
These granola bars are very similar to the Nature's Valley brand bars.  The Clif Crunch Bars are very messy.  They crumble.  The flavor is not as good as the flavors offered by Nature's Valley.
Item tasted plain and was crumbly. Did not taste at all like it is described. We were disappointed with product.

Just when you think you're eating healthier - you research to find out "Your NOT" with Clif Products. Theirs so much sugar, carbs & fats in these products that you might as well eat cookies or candy bars. They definitely taste better and you get the same sugar & calories.

I was surprised to have found this item.  I had been looking for it for quite some time as we spend alot of time travelling and want to bring our own creamers (hazelnut flavor) But when i received the order - I was a little disappointed for a few reasons:  (1)some of them had leaked into the carton and (2) the expiration date of item was September 09 (just two months away).  I guess that is why they only had three left to sell (expiration date was coming up).  I believe when advertising an item like this - the expiration of the item should be listed so that we can make a decision on whether to order it or not

column9: Nice to get six boxes at once
column10: I use these individual creamers at work since the office only supplies the dry powder with its coffee set up.  Some folks buy the bottles of flavored cream that require refrigeration but that has its own complexities (expiration, unauthorized "sharing" by others, etc.)  Since these little cups need no refrigeration, I keep a box in my desk drawer and use on demand.  It was always a challenge to remember to buy another box at the grocery story when I ran low at the office, and now I don't have to remember.  Instead, I have several months worth and with the subscribe and save option, it came right to my door.
I've never been much of a fan hazelnut, but I do enjoy drinking the International Hazelnut Non-Dairy creamier mixed into my morning cup of coffee.

I was so excited to see it available @Amazon, since they were not sold in any grocery store, at least not in my area. I subscribed it on 10/8 midnight, and it arrived at my front door on 10/10. Fastest "standard" delivery ever! These creamers do not need to be refrigerated, so I can just leave them at my desk, or just carry few in my purse - so convenient! Hazelnut and French Vanilla are the only two flavors taste normal to me. Hazelnut has stronger flavor comparing to French Vanilla.

column9: Not as good as they used to be ...
column10: This used to be a wonderfully flavored, handy product. Something has gone awry in the last 6 months. The creamer is virtually flavorless when I pour it in my coffee, although it tastes fine if I sip it while in the original product container. Wonder if there was a product ingredient change or an ingredient source change that could account for the loss of flavor when it is added to a hot liquid?
expiration date is 4/19/2012.  i received package on 5/23/2012. I CANT RETURN IT.  NOW WHAT????????????????  I SHOULD KNOW BETTER I GUESS.  FIRST TIME THIS HAS HAPPENED TO ME WITH AMAZON.
If you use cream on your coffee and love hazelnut flavored coffee, this is a good and money saving alternative to buying expensive hazelnut flavored coffee.

column9: 4 Stars for the Product - 2 for the Price
column10: This creamer tastes superb and is my favorite of all creamers.  And I prefer the pods like this because I can keep them in my desk drawer and one pod is perfect for one mug of coffee.  I'd give it a five it didn't use saturated fat.But compare the price to what you'd pay locally (and factor in taxes). I can get it cheaper at Walmart and Big Lots.

column9: The Expiration Has Not Come, But ...
column10: I love this flavor of International Delight and my grocery store has discontinued it in this single use product.  I was so happy to find it at Amazon, but althought the expiration date is February 2009, most of the containers are sour and not fit to use.  I will not be purchasing more.
has a great flavor. I use it everyday in may coffee. But some of the boxes got crunched a little and the containers leaked and got sticky. not a big deal.

Double check the ingredients.  There are animal products in this, so if you're opposed to that you should choose another product.  Also, a friend of mine that has a dairy allergy gets allergy simptoms when she has this product.
Ordered 3 packages. Stored in cool dry basement.  Flour keeps very well. Have made a ton of breads from it already.

I dont really like potato chips but I bought a can of these by accident when I picked up some for my grandkids when they were going to visit and I tried them and now I keep at least 5 tubes of them in the house all the time

column9: I just tried these for the first time, and they fall somewhere in the middle of the pack of Pringles flavors
column10: I like Pringles, and I bought this flavor on purpose, since I like to know what my snacking optins are.  You see, I am a major salty-crispy snack kind of guy.I love chips, cheetos (crunchy), and just about anything that crunches and has salt involved.  I am able to tell how well I like a snack by the degree of vigor with which I attack the snack, and how hard I have to try to stop before I eat the whole thing.  For example, for Regular Pringles Original, Super Stack, Pringles Potato Crisps Super Stack, Barbeque, 6.38-Ounce Tubes (Pack of 14), or Pringles Cheddar Cheese Grab AND Go!, 2.61-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) flavored chips I look at the side of the can and it says that it contains about 6 servings, and all I can do is laugh.  I know myself well enough to know that left to my own devices that for those flavors of chips that the serving size is one entire can!  But, when I come across a snack that just doesn't do it for me, I find it easy to stop.  It was no problem stopping eating these Honey Mustard Pringles by the time I had eaten about 1/3 or so of a can.I am a BIG fan of honey mustard, but that flavor combined with Pringles worked only adequately for me.  If, however, you like the new onion-flavored Pringles, you are sure to love these.  If not, then these will probably be a bit better for you, but not up to snuff with sour cream and onion, BBQ, or regular flavored Pringles.  The taste of the Honey Mustard variety is a bit flat, but fortunately lacks the rather repelling aftertaste that the Onion flavored Princles have...which is called umami flavor...and that's L-glutamate, the stuff that makes bacon taste so good.Anyway, I have to say that Honey Mustard Pringles are good, but certainly not great, so that falls into the 3-star category for me.  I liked them, "liked", but that's all.  So I'll be giving these a miss as long as there are 5-star snacks around.3 stars.
We love this hot salsa mix much better than purchased salsa. It's flavorful, so easy to make and a treat to the tastebuds.

I first found this tea in a specialty store and paid over $15 for one container of it, so you get a good deal on here (since you get 2 containers). I enjoy this tea with a hint of sugar, but you could also add milk if you like. This is a black tea that has a hint of vanilla in it. It's my favorite tea by far (and I drink a lot of tea).

Octavia French Breakfast tea is an organic and fair trade, loose leaf black tea which is simply marvelous!  It is a rich and full-bodied breakfast tea laced with organic rose petals and subtle hints of vanilla and caramel. It has a lovely natural sweetness and I prefer it black so I can enjoy each of the delicate layers of flavor.I recently acquired a The Breville One-Touch Tea Maker which is a brilliant way to prepare loose tea.  This Octavia French Breakfast tea when brewed in the Breville is extraordinary and I don't think I'll ever be able to drink black tea from a tea bag again!  I've been so spoiled!The tea comes in very practical but attractive 4.2-ounce tins which ensure freshness.  The label indicates that one tin provides 50 servings but I have discovered that each brew can be infused several times so a tin of this tea should last well.  The pack of 2 tins at Amazon is a very good value and I'm very happy that it is available here.

column9: French Breakfast Tea by Octavia Tea Company
column10: I was given this tea as a gift. I have enjoyed it ever since. I like to make a cup on Sunday mornings to enjoy while I read the paper or on special occasions (such as my birthday). Friends and family who visit and are treated to this product praise its light taste, too. I think anyone who would like something lighter than Earl Gray or "regular Lipton" would find this most enjoyable.

Some of the best candy/treat that I've ever eaten.  It's all at once crispy, sweet (but not too much so), and satisfying.  The 2oz portions are great (to restrict your intake of this addictive product).  The ingredients seem odd, but I am definitely one impressed fan, now.

column9: Important component of a nice dinner
column10: I'm not sure I'd call this "extra hot" - it's more mild or barely medium... but extremely flavorful! Lots of citrus/lime flavors.  I add this with a little habanero sauce to my Mex food, and it's heavenly.

Adds great flavor to meats and stews...ground very fine so breaks down easy.  Just got to clean out a spice jar for it otherwise will be messy sitting in the bag.  Will be purchasing more from the company.  Not always easy to find gluten free products with a reasonable price.

column10: Green Tea Helps You Lose WeightGreen tea is believed to be a potential agent, which can help you to lose weight. Weight loss has become a serious matter in the present world. The possible reasons for weight loss can be many such as lifestyle factors, the diet and stress and strain the modern life. Irrespective of the possible reasons, there is a need for an ultimate solution since the weight gain or obesity can lead to many serious health hazards such as diabetes, and the heart diseases. Green tea is projected as an effective weight loss remedy since many of the reports show positive effects.Nature green tea is better than artificial greens tea productGreen tea is primarily appreciated for the weight loss since it is a natural substance. Now, many artificial products are available in the market, claiming that are effective for weight loss. Since most of them manifested side effects, people have started searching for reliable natural products. It is postulated that the green tea have medicinal properties and the traditional medicinal systems support the argument with evidences. It can be used to protect the heart, liver, skin, pancreas, oral systems and most importantly as a curative for cancer. It regulates the insulin level in the body and inhibits the sudden rise of insulin in the body after the food, which may initiate the fat conversion. The lowering of the insulin level prevents the sugar level rise and the fat storage, which ultimately prevent the weight gain. And, the influence in blood sugar level has proven some effect in the appetite level, also. The continuous intake of green tea is suspected to decrease the appetite, which naturally contribute to the weight loss.To add on, if you do not even count any of the above attributes of herbal green tea too, a simple factor will certainly add a cutting edge to green tea. If you are lenient enough to just substitute the usual morning drink, which is rich with calories, with a cup of green tea itself can definitely help you lose weight.How to use green tea for your dietThe easiest way to include green tea in your diet is to drink it. However, you could also use greentea extract pill and green tea patch.Drink green tea - This is the best way and the most effect way to get the full benefit from green tea. Since it is still unknown which anti-oxide in green tea encourage fat loss, it is the best to take it with its original form. The easiest way is to put green tea bag in hot water and let it rest for 3 to 4 minutes. I sprinkle a pack of this over my greek yogurt in the morning for breakfast! It makes a satisfying, filling and nutritious meal. (and fast)

I picked these up at the local grocery store after spotting a coworker with some. They are delicious. I cannot wait to try the other flavors! Amazon's pricing isn't too competitive on this variety, be warned, at Kroger's I got a box of five for four dollars. So in order to get this quantity, I would only spend sixteen dollars! But if you cannot find them in your local grocery, you should definitely give them a try!

I used the Bubblegum Pink Gourmet Salt water Taffy as part of a candy bar that I put together at my daughter's Christening.  The Taffy looked amazing in the glass candy jar.  I received a ton of compliments.  Not to mention that they were very yummy.
Great treat for training and rewarding your pet. My dog loves these treats. The size works so well for my dogs too.

column9: Truly Zingy, Yes! Great Taste Too!
column10: I am so glad that Amazon has this tea! As, I never even heard of this Green Beans Coffee company prior to this order. Green Beans Coffee got it's start supporting the US Military and continues to do that.  AND, this Extreme Tea that they have is great!  As soon as I opened it- I could smell a pleasant fruity flavor (like orange/kiwi maybe? Definitely/evidently, pleasantly, fruity!) and couldn't wait to taste it:  Also, in addition to tasting good:  I was surprised that this Extreme Tea actually does, quickly, give that zing stated. Within about 25-30mins of drinking a cup- I really felt an energetic lift!  I'm an avid tea drinker- and, from any other tea, I've NEVER experienced the very noticeable boost that this tea gives. Actually, very noticeably zingy!  If you prefer tea instead of coffee:  This Extreme Tea tastes great and, like coffee, gives the needed boost or zing as well.  And, with all of tea's well-known antioxidant benefits this is most welcome.  If you need a healthy antioxidant energy drink- it's even cool to make iced tea from this like I have done and be on the go!  The only thing I feel buyers would desire to know is the actual amount of caffeine within this Tea, and I couldn't find the caffeine content about any of their products on the Green Beans Coffee company's website.  But, this tea is a 5star! I'm ordering more.  AND, I'll do so knowing that I'm ordering from a company that supports our US Troops. Win-win. After drinking this, I'm thinking:  Starbucks who???

This cereal has everything. Great flavor, tons of fruit and nuts, it's absolutely great tasting. My kids ate all six boxes within days. The only complaint is the boxes are small. They're about half the size of a box of Chex, if you have one standing next to it in the pantry (which I currently do). But for all natural cereal without any of the garbage in it that my kids actually eat and want more of, you can't beat this stuff!

I love this cereal. It's very tasty, and has a great texture. I've ordered it from Amazon for several years and it always arrives fresh. It's also surprisingly healthy and, for gluten intolerent folks, it contains no wheat!
The berries are very tasty, but I was disappointed that it's not a "true" granola.  There are corn flakes in it.  I would have to rate it a very good "cereal".

I bought this cereal because I needed a wheat free cereal and this had so may good reviews.While  the taste is  good with lots of berries there were no clusters at all. - only crumbs !! I am disappointed and would not consider it a granola.

I liked the taste of the cereal just fine but I felt like I was eating crumbs, you know the type of cereal you get at the bottom of a box or bag of cereal. It does makes good muffins and since I bought the six boxes here on amazon I think we will be having muffins at least once a week until I use it up. We just won't be eating it in our cereal bowls in the morning.

I was surprised with the unanimous good rating of this product. Guests at our inn thought this is strictly a cereal for very young children. We were surprised that the cereal mix had a large percentage of corn flakes!!

I have been buying the single berry (strawberry, raspberry, blueberry) cereals from the same company for years. This one has a mix of all and even has flakes mixed in the granola grains. Also great as has no wheat for those of us who need that. The 6 pack automatic delivery saves time and money. Do wish I could get the raspberry only on this plan, but don't see it offered.

I bought this because it was very cheap, it was on sale and also used subscribe and save, and oh my was it worth it.  The perfect amount of fruit and the perfect amount of crunch, so yummy.  I've been trying different granolas and this one is a contender even though there are flakes in it as well.

I found this item while searching for Granola and Berries and looked forward to it's arrival. However, I was very disappointed with the abundance of corn flakes. Like other reviewers the amount of granola crumbs is disheartening too. The Triple Berries are yummy and I would have enjoyed this WITHOUT the cornflakes. There's too many cornflakes to pick out...yes the thought crossed my mind!

This cereal is an excellent way to gain healthy weight.  Each box has 1470 calories, and one big bowl of it would be about half the box.  With milk this makes for an extremely healthy and well-balanced 800 calorie meal!

This is one of the very few cereals that I don't mind eating right out of the box. I even followed their suggestion to add it to ice cream. If you like berries & healthy cereal, you won't regret trying this product out. My wife & I went through one box the first day it arrived. We'll be reordering it soon...
This cereal is filled with tasty ingridients, but there are better tasting cereals at the same price.  I used it with rice milk.  Note that this is a medium size box.

See's candy is always good!  The candy we recieved through Amazon was good but not fresh.  Most pieces were starting to change to a chalk color and were dry. We were disappointed in the quality of our shipment.

column9: A SWEET TOOTH CANNOT BE IGNORED
column10: To our taste these chocolates are on a par with far more expensive ones in glittery gift boxes.  We often take them as hostess gifts (hoping, of course, that said hostess will immediately open them and pass them around.)  See's Candies hasn't disappointed us yet.
Chocolates are great. Shipping costs are high. They took close to a week to actually ship the chocolates.

See's Candies is a well-known San Francisco chocolate company, now with stores throughout the United States.  In California, the lines to buy chocolate can snake out the door.  I've had See's Candies many times, most recently this assortment, and while See's makes an excellent product, the chocolate coating could be richer in flavor.  Still, these confections are above average; they easily outclass ordinary brands such as Russell Stover and Whitman's with fresher and more flavorful fillings.Anyone receiving a box of See's Candies for a gift knows that an extra effort has been made.  Although they aren't the best I've had, they certainly rank up there with the finest chocolate assortments available in a box.
The problem is not with the candy. Amazon pictures a christmas box but instead you get the regular white box.

$13.95 in shipping (5-7 days) for a $26.00 order!?!?!?  Do the math, that's OVER 50% extra on shipping alone.  Are you crazy?  We're not talking about Scharffen Berger chocolates here and they only charge $9 for 3 to 5 days (for a $30 order).  I don't care what chocolate you buy, but don't get taken on the shipping for a cheap product!!!
I really enjoy sending things online. This purchase was a gift so I really think that there should have been available a gift card to send with it. I had to mail a card separate from this purchase.

Although I have never ordered the candies from a website, I have heard from other reviews that the shipping is outrageous. I find that very disapointing since the chocolates themselves are so outstanding. However, these are available at other locations like airports around the country. That is, now a days you need to actually be flying in order to enter the shopping area, but that are often there if you do!
Nothing particulary outstanding about this chocolate, it's good but the extremely high shipping/handling costs not worth it.

they were really great and they came in excellent condition and i was a little worried with the heat that we have been having back here but it was in a cool chest and the candy did not melt and they had all the great taste of the candies that you get in the store. and the shipping was great too.

I've tried the rest, but this is the BEST!I've been eating See's candies since I was just a kid!  Easter was one of my favorite holidays, because my mom would order See's large easter eggs, we would get to pick our favorite filling, Chocolate or Chocolate Walnut, then we'd get a medium chocolate egg, I would always choose the Bordeaux (by far the best flavored candy See's sells), you could get the divinity if you liked that.  The buttercream is always a huge favorite at our house.  You have your choice of Dark or Milk chocolate. Choose your own liking!  I prefer Milk chocolate.  Another of my favorites is California Brittle.  Also, the Vanilla Nut Carmel (no chocolate on this one), but very tasty!Just remember the Assorted premade box doesn't always have the best picks in it.  If you like nuts and chews, that's one of the better choices.  I prefer to go down to See's and select my own mix!  Pecan turtles--just melt in your mouth.  Try the truffles if you like!Never did like Godiva or Fanny Farmer, once in awhile I could take a piece of Helen Grace or Lindt, but they never live up to my standards.See's is the perfect candy and it makes the perfect gift for family, friends, co-workers, neighbors, service company's and the postal person.  Don't cross anyone off your list until you surprise them with a gift of See's candy for the Holidays.
I always send See's as a gift to relatives!  They are worth the extra shipping cost and have always arrived in perfect condition.
The quality, presentation and taste of See's is top notch. We highly recommend the two pound box as a gift. The assortment is a nice mix and there's something for everyone's taste.

We ordered the box of candy for an anniversary gift along with a separate order of flowers.  The flowers arrived in a timely fashion but the candy arrived 6 days later.  When they arrived they were completely melted and had reformed in the box.  The recipient called to say what had happened.  A replacement box was sent a week later.  We don't know who to blame for the delay in shipping or for the manner in which it was shipped.  If you would like to discuss this matter further, please call me at 888.671.6402.Sincerely,Janet Mack Zaloga

Unlike the chocolate chip version, you will need to add 1 1/2 cups of peanut butter to the mix - which adds a lot of fat and calories. If you can afford the calories, the cookies are quite good!

column9: if i had am illion stars it would not be enough
