These normally go for $3.49/per bag in the supermarket/grocery store and usually are not 1 of the type of Pepperidge Farm Cookie that goes on sale at all, unlike their Milano Cookie Brand counterpart which do on a semi-regular basis. A great deal, highly recommended, buy them if the price is right!
Delicious as usual for this cookie. Love them. Glad Amazon had them on their website, esp. on sale when I ordered them. Can't beat that.

I purchased these Pepperidge Farm cookies for a family member that is sick in the hospital. The cookies had an expiration date of 5/2/2012 but they were STALE. This was very embarrassing and disappointing to say the least. This tells me that food products are not a good buy from Amazon.
You don't lose any flavor with this. It is DELICIOUS and with how much better it is for you than regular sauce it's a no brainer.

I wasn't sure what to expect from this low calorie barbeque sauce but i can honestly say i am pleasantly surprised. It is NOT sweet but it is extremely smokey and powerfully tasty. For 20 calories per 33 grams of sauce it is very easy to enjoy with any meat you'd like without feeling guilty. I definitely recommend it!

column9: GOOD BBQ SAUCE BUT NOT THE BEST
column10: this light BBQ sauce doesn't taste to bad in fact it tastes better then I thought it would. its somewhat sour & sweet and it is not very thick in fact its a little too runny for what I like. would I buy this again maybe ? if the rest of my family likes it.

This does not taste like it is a diet product. I am always searching for food that is low in calories, but does not taste like it. My friends that do not diet, love this as well. It has an amazing flavor without the guilt. LOVE IT!

I add 1/2 cup of the original Fiber One cereal to the 1 cup serving of the Fiber One Honey Clusters. I also add some dried cranberries (Craisins).  The taste is excellent and packs a full day of fiber.  Fiber One Honey Clusters has 13 grams of fiber and 160 calories. Fiber One Original contains 14 grams of fiber and just 60 calories. So for 220 calories in cereal, plus 110 calories in 1 cup skim milk and 25 calories for the 1 T. craisins you get 355 total calories and 28 grams fiber in one bowl!  Sure beats donuts and coffee and you're not hungry till lunch!

column4: A. Novel Idea "A Novel Idea Bookstore"
column10: I'm on Weight Watchers and this cereal is great at only 3 points per serving, tasty and it packs a fiber whallop.But it's cheaper at my local grocery store at $3.99 a box.
I have a 9,10, and 12 year old as well as a picky husband.  This is the only "healthy" cereal that my whole family enjoys.  I cannot keep it stocked.  Try it and you will like it.

My college-aged son decided to start eating healthy foods and wanted a fiber cereal.  He was never a cereal eater and tried several kinds of fiber cereal before trying this one.  Now he eats it for breakfast every day and says it's the best tasting fiber cereal and has an awesome amount of fiber compared to other fiber cereals. It keeps him going until lunch time and buying it on Amazon sure beats the grocery store price!

column9: A Great Healthy Cereal or Snack!
column10: One of my daughters introduced this product to me and I simply love it!  I put it in my Yogurt, eat it with milk or just in a bowl as a sweet, healthy snack with fiber and crunch.
Great flavor, and a good start to my morning.Fiber One Honey Clusters, 14.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

Finally a High Fiber cereal that tastes great!! I like mixing the Honey Cluster with either the Carmel or the Raison Cluster for an even Higher Fiber load. And the lowest price I've found these cereals in on Amazon.com (we all love saving money while being healthy, right?). Try it for 3 days and I'm sure you'll love it like I do. Thanks and have a healthy day!!!
I was looking for a basic natural fiber product that tastes good. This works. I will continue using the product.
This product is excellent.  Great sweet taste, great crunch and stays crunchy in milk.  Never had a better high fibre cereal, for that matter, probably my favorite cereal ever!
An wonderful healthy cereal that doesn't taste like paper or look like rabbit poop! Great tasting cereal with lots of benefits.

Thankfully I was able to wash these off and eat them.  I'm not sure what happened, but they were really salty and sour, like they forgot to put sugar in there somewhere.  I've had a lot of Sour Skittles, but this batch was very different.  I would have sent them back, but I didn't know they were going to taste bad so I threw the box away.

A nice sticky rice with a high starch content.  Reminds me a lot of Diamond G calrose rice I grew up on in Hawaii.  Very sticky after a light rinse, starch can be controlled some with multiple rinses prior to cooking.  Good stuff!
Love this rice it is the best sushi rice or asian type of Sticky rice around. The taste is superb and always cooks to perfection. will but this rice my whole life

column9: Nishiki Premium Rice, Medium Grain, 15-Pound Bag
column10: Great product excellent price and just as advertised.  I always order this product because of the great taste every time.

column9: Always love this type of rice
column10: The Nishiki Premium Rice is short and round, more like the sweet rice. This type of rice is more sticky compare to the regular rice. My favored!
Free delivery on a 15 pound bag of rice... why go to the grocery store?  It is so easy and convenient to buy from Amazon.

This Nishiki rice is pretty much the standard American medium grain rice that's not so bad when it's first cooked.  It's until you eat premium quality rice like tamanishiki and koshihikari that you'll know Nishki is a sub-par rice sold anywhere else.If you want QUALITY sushi it starts with the rice.  Nishiki is not something I would personally use.  You'll know the difference right away with the texture.But of course, preparation can make a huge difference.  Wash your rice and let the rice sit in the bowl for 20 minutes to soak.  Re-rinse and measure the water again and turn on the rice cooker (or the pot if you're cooking manually).  If you don't have a rice cooker though I would get one.  It's worth it and very cheap for a simple rice cooker.  Feel free to read my review on tamanishiki rice.

This is really  a very good product. I wouldn't hesitate to rate it more if I could. The porridge came out really delicious and the rice is just like the rice you get from a Japanese Bento set. I just love it.

column9: The only white rice my family eats
column10: Rice is something you simply cannot skimp on quality with. Nishki brand is THE BEST. I used to have to drive across town to an Asian market where the price was far too high and the employees were far too rude. Then I had to haul 15 pounds up to my apartment along with my two year old and whatever other groceries I had. Now I can just order from Amazon, save money, free shipping, and hey, someone else is paid to haul it up the stairs for me! It's great! I only wish Amazon would add a subscribe and save deal to this item.

I been buying this at the store for a month each week and wanted a bigger package and here I found it.  I cook this in my rice cooker and  it turns out great every time.  Has a good taste and is a little sticky which we like.

I've ordered other rice online that arrived rancid (Village Harvest brand Brown Jasmine). The Nishiki was fresh and excellent quality. It arrived fast and well packed. We love Tsuru Mai brand from the asian market but we live 3 hours away and ran out. This brand was the same quality and type of rice from CA., a nice medium grain brown rice with a good chewy, nutty flavor. I highly recommend this one and will purchase it again. A+

Same rice we bought in Japan when we lived there.  Packaging of the rice much better than the plastic fiber bags with other brands. High quality rice. I like this much better than long grain.U.S. Product!!

First time to order online than going to the store but when I cook the rice come out different. I use the same rice cooker but have to put a lot more water to cook. I will never order from amazon again.

If you want non-sticky rice, buy Californian rice. This was supposed to be STICKY rice and fails in that department. It was the first time I bought this brand, but I've bought sticky rice at Korean stores my whole life. I won't buy this brand again.

column9: This is my favorite cinnamon because it tastes so good!
column10: Other cinnamon brands may be rated higher because they are "organic", but this is the best-tasting cinnamon by far!  I bought this 8-pack and shared it with family.  Now I need another 8-pack.  My favorite use is in my coffee.  Cinnamon off-sets the bitter taste that is associated with some of the stronger blends of coffee.

column9: Dont order this item if its warmer than 75 DEGREES OUT
column10: I ordered these in the winter and they were ok.  But the last two orders which were in Spring and now in June came and were completely in a mangled mess of melted chocolate and broken pretzels.  Not at all appetizing, in fact disgusting.  After contacting the company and letting them know the problem they simply gave us a credit of $13 for our trouble.  That's laughable since the whole box is ruined and these pretzels are not cheap.  I order chocolate through the mail all the time from See's in California and have never had a problem with the chocolate melting to this degree.  Its a problem that you need to fix before I will ever be back.

These are the best...love love love them....I did just fins them at walmart last week.3-2012....I got these shipped to me and they came when I was home in 90* weather...They did not sit out side for 1 min and they were ALL mealted together...Make sure you order them in the winter....I called company and they refunded the money in a minuet. I thought they would come in a cooler...but no..so be careful!!!!! Cool weather ONLY!~!!

I absolutely LOVE these!!!!  I always loved chocolate covered pretzels and when I had to go gluten free I had to give them up.............until I found these!!!! They are really tasty! Can't even tell they are gluten free!
I love these things.  The only problem is they are so expensive!  Yes, buying them on here is cheaper than in the store, but still!  But these are definitely delicious.
They seem to take care of all my chocolate candy need. I used to love twix's. These are now even better!  Enjoy!

The non-chocolate-covered glutino pretzels didn't do much for me, but these are SO good. They're pricey, but meet a craving--and I thought I'd never get good chocolate covered pretzels again. These taste exactly the way I remember their glutinous cousins tasting, but admittedly it has been a few years. The texture is also what I remember.The price listed on amazon today matches what I can get locally, give or take 20%, but I don't have to buy I bulk locally.  They keep well when the bag has been opened-at least half a week without going stale. After that, there are simply none left to try.

Love these.  They taste exactly like regular chocolate-covered pretzels.  Great sweet snack for gluten-free diets! Wish I could buy them one box at a time because the case is big in my small apartment, but they're worth it!

These pretzels are a great combination of the Glutino gluten free pretzels (which are great) along with yummy chocolate.  I just wish they were available locally!  Don't like the white chocolate ones, but these are wonderful.  A great treat for the gluten free people in your life!!

column9: Best peanut butter substitute there is.
column10: I used to get this same soy butter under the Great Value label at Walmart. However, Walmart seems to think that it is a regional product or something (since when are peanut allergies regional?), and doesn't carry it in any of their stores within a 100 miles of me. At first I had my local Walmart order it for me, but the last time I did so it was such a long, drawn out, frustrating experience I gave up on them. Guess they don't really want my business. Hurray for Amazon for making it available!! This same product is also carried under another label by Amazon as well: "Tastes Just like Peanut Butter" SchoolSafe Omega 3 SoyButter(NOT SoyNUT Butter) Kids Love It--6 jars/case Economy Size 17.6 oz. $4.49 ea.--100% Nut Free , Peanut Free --2 year shelf life

I love this stuff!  It is not as sweet as the I'm Healthy brand.  I love that one too.  This has a more peanut butter like flavor.  Since peanut butter is not sweet it seems better in a sandwich.  I also have the single serving packs.  Kids love eating those just with a spoon.

As others have mentioned, this soy butter tastes really good, and has a flavor that is similar to peanut butter. While I like the I. M. Healthy chunky soy butter and chocolate soy butter a little more, this is my favorite creamy soy butter, and the one I usually buy, because it makes a very believable almost-PB&J sandwich.I'm now very sure that CGB Soybutter is relabeled by Wally World and sold under their Great Value name. I bought them both and compared them side by side. Same size and shape packages, same ingredients and nutrition information, both made in Canada, and most importantly, identical taste and texture. The only differences are that the GGB butter has a blue lid and Wally's has an orange lid, plus the labels are of course different.At the Walbert near me, the Great Value version sells for $2.97 a jar, an astonishing $2 cheaper than the I. M. Healthy goes for at the local discount grocery store. It is also lower cost per jar than this CGB 6 pack (@ $3.69 per jar), even with free shipping. However, I'd guess that for some people, not supporting Wally World is well worth the 72 cents. Plus this version comes right to your door.
The product got to me relatively quickly and I absolutely love it! I have a hard time finding soynut butter for a reasonable price these days, so this is great!

column9: short expiration date makes me upset
column10: I bought my product, which was 6 jars of soy butter in May.  When it arrived I discovered that it expired in January, giving me 7-8 months to eat 6 jars of it.  I loved the flavor of the product, it is quite better than any of the peanut butter alternatives that we can purchase at the grocery store. Next time I need this product I think I will find another mom with a peanut allergic kid and split the case so I don't have to eat so much in such a short time.I'd give the flavor 5 stars.

column9: Clown Gysin Soy Butter Smooth, Nut Free
column10: Excellent!  Price is good, low cost delivery.  I don't eat peanut butter any more (get cold sores from eating nuts).  Try it and you'll like it!

I have been purchasing soynut butter from the grocery store for many years.  Someone told me about this brand on Amazon so I thought I would give it a try.  I'm very happy I did.The taste is great.  My children love it.  The value is excellent also.  These come in slightly larger containers than the store bought variety and are less expensive.  We are a nut free household and finding a good value for special products is important.They always ship fast.  I will continue to order this brand for my family.

column9: OMG GOOD! Tastes as good as the old Wally World Brand.
column10: Actually, I do not like this, BUT my wife thinks it is the best ever.  I got it as a present for her since the Wally World Brand is no longer available.  We have looked everywhere, but not found one that tastes as good (her words) as this one.  Thanks to A. Arickx and her review I was able to order this great product.  Consistency is that of peanut butter, but no allergic reactions. If you are looking for a good tasting substitute for peanut butter, try this one.Even though I do not like any of the peanut butter substitutes, I will admit I could eat this one if I had to do so.

We have a peanut-allergy son, but I love almost everything peanut butter. We went a number of years with no peanut butter, but as our kids got older we decided to start trying peanut butter substitutes. Nothing was even close, until we found this product, which I believe is the same they used to sell in Walmart under a different label. This is excellent and almost exactly the same as peanut butter. It is not cheap (it was a lot cheaper at Walmart), but it is well worth the price. All my kids love it, as do I. Purchase and delivery was easy also.

We have tried the IM HEALTHY soynut butter and this brand as well. This brand has more of a "peanut" taste if that is what you are after. It is creamy and they do not offer chunky. We do like the chunky IM HEALTHY brand as well. This is a tad cheaper on amazon than the IM HEALTHY. Overall pretty good! Very thankful for substitutes like this for our peanut allergic daughter~ would recommend.
great product. I'm glad I found this one since the local Wal-mart stopped stocking it.

column9: Most excellent Soy butter great Peanut Butter replacement. Nut Free
column10: Tastes  great like some of the store brand peanut butters. Great for replacement for peanut butter. Texture is similar and spreads the same.
Received product timely.  Upon opening product found weevil infestation. Put product in freezer to kill weevils.  Returning product would have been a nuisance.

column9: Bow wow review of Dog Biscuts
column10: I have 2 sixty pound American Staffordshire Terriers, aka Pitt Bulls. Mugsy and Spookey seem to realy enjoy the Biscuts. I ordered 2 boxes of Biscuts, which in the future, I'll only order one box at a time. As I did not relize how much twenty pounds of dog biscuts are.Wells SPORTMiX Golden Dog Biscuit Treats, Extra Large - 20 lb. Bag A lot to say the least.

I ordered two boxes of these bones for my commercial kennel.  I chose the Sportmix products because I was assured by their customer service rep (who responded to my inquiry within the hour) that the ingredients and manufacturing are US-based.  I do not purchase foreign pet food ingredients - particularly China-made pet products.  I am thoroughly happy with the apparent palatability of the bones.  The dogs fall over each other to get one.  I am a little dissatisfied with the condition of many of the bones - about 20% of them are broken due to packaging.  They are not stacked - just loosely placed in the box to be knocked around during delivery.  This is the only thing I can fault, though.  Otherwise, a fair priced, quality, USA MADE product.

Generally the dog biscuits are great if not such a high percentage would be broken. The point in buying extra large biscuits is the "extra large", small pieces miss the reason for buying theme in the first place. There has to be a better way to pack the biscuits better than this.

I couldn't find Plantation Blackstrap Molasses in any of my local super markets. I like it for health reasons; it's high in iron. It also tastes really delicious. I purchased several bottles to give to family and friends. If you need a good source of iron, this is a good choice and this brand is really good tasting.
Although it is a little sharp in flavor I do feel more energy and the Black Strap Molasses cures my morning craving for caffiene. I 5 star it.

This black strap molasses I use to get plenty of nutrients into my body...I take a tablespoon or two a day, to help with my moods and help to alleviate pain...this stuff works in the body like no bodies business ♥

column9: Delicious taste and texture, fast cooking, organic staple!
column10: This is excellent pasta! We eat this at least once per week. It cooks perfectly every time, never becomes mushy even if you forget and cook it too long. The Angel Hair cooks fast! The taste is fresh and delicious even with just a bit of olive oil and salt. Our favorite is to toss it with alfredo sauce and top it with salmon. Also excellent with some sauteed vegies and melted cheese. Tastes just as good the next day reheated. We love this organic pasta, it is a pantry staple for our family!

column9: Great pasta but NOT wheat or gluten free
column10: Delicious, yes -- but Amazon has mistakenly listed that this product is wheat and gluten free.  It's NOT.
I'm not a big tea drinker whatsoever but after trying this, I'm hooked on it! Just the right amount of lemon/tea flavoring and it's a very refreshing drink.

column9: Tastless, weak, not sweet, do not buy
column10: I was excited to purchase this tea and found out thats its not good.  I brewed it on small setting and big, very weak, not of quality.  I have one of the Raspberry and one lemon I have to figure out how to get rid of.

This is an easy review.  It obviously is going to taste the same as from a store, but at a much cheaper price since you get to buy a larger quantity.  I love Snapple and stores hardly carry this flavor anymore.  So it was an easy decision to buy it here and have it waiting for me when I get home.

ordered this product and I am very satisfied with my purchase.  The price was outstanding.  In my area getting non tea snapple products is very hard.  I am going to continue to check on additional snapple products here, and in particular at the best price available.  Will for sure be looking at ordering again since spring and summer are around the corner.

column9: Great Basil Taste - Organic- Gluten Free
column10: About time, this is the best organic gluten free basil pasta sauce I have ever had.  My wife is Italian and said she has never had better.

The best spice tea for general use as well as with your Keurig.  It was hard to find a bulk spice tea that was "real" as everything else was "herbal".  This tea gives you all the flavor and zip you would expect from tea and at a reasonable price.

It's overpriced for something that must be used up within 2-3 weeks after opening. column9: Cadbury ought to fire their U.S. Marketers
column10: Crunchies are the absolute best candy bars.  Why they are not sold in the US is very puzzling to me.  With all the crap candy bars here in the states, it seems like Crunchie Bars would 'clean up'.  I'd never buy any other candy, except maybe Jaffas, another Cadbury product not sold in the US (I buy them in New Zealand).  Hey Cadbury, wake up, hellllooooooooooo  Are you there?  Anybody home???????????????  Please sell us your good candy here in the US, OK??

I had the pleasure of trying this bar for the first time in Halifax, Nova Scotia in 1999.  Now, whenever I am outside of the United States, I specifically look for these candy bars (I have eaten it in Europe in a couple of places).  I found a Asian Food Store locally that surprisingly carries it (2 weeks ago).  I am surprised that this is not sold widely on the US Market.This is a chocolate covered honeycombed bar with toffee undertones.  The bar lives up to its name, Crunchy!  The taste is so good it's worth traveling outside of the country for!Cadbury, are your executives reading this?  You need to market this in the United States.  What are you guys waiting for?This is a great candy bar.  You have to try it!Highly recommend!

column9: Crunchies are the best thing ever! Try one!
column10: My Australian exchange student introduced these magnificant chocolate bars to me in January, and have loved them ever since!!! I don't know why they aren't sold in the USA, I've looked everywhere and have yet to find them! I bought some recently in Canada, and before that, relied on my Aussie exchange student to send them over. Crunchies are the BEST thing that has ever happened to the chocolate industry!!! The taste is undescribable, they melt in your mouth and are just SUPER SUPER GOOD! TRY ONE!<3

column4: Susan G. Alexander "Author of Balloons to Pawpaw"
column9: My favorite candy bar of all time!!!!!!!
column10: I first tried these in South Africa. Now my best friend will ship some to me with packages that she sends on my birthday or other special occasions. I LOVE them! I want to have them here in the States!!!!

I gave it 4 stars because it is covered with Arabic words. I don't know if they are old, if they were sent there and sat on a shelf for months, I have no clue.As much as I love them, I will not buy from this seller again. I want to read my products in my own language.

I love everything Cadbury, and these are no exception. I've found that they sell them (and everything else Cadbury) in the US in a store called World Market and I will never buy any other American candy again!

column9: pretty good, just not my thing.
column10: Don't get me wrong, the right person would love these. Me i don't really like the texture of the "honey come" middle. I had never had these before this or heard of them for that matter, and i wanted to try it, something new. I did enjoy checking out this candy, but i will not buy it again.
These are the best candy bars EVER!  Why don't they have something similar here in the U.S.??  They are light and low in calories compared to other candy bars in the U.S.!  Yumm!!

If you like sponge candy- and have never tried this before- you are really missing out. I am not able to obtain this product and usually have friends that bring them back to me after holiday in the U.K.So please that I can these online-

I like the crunchy-ness of the middle, but it doesn't have a great flavor, basically just a very sweet taste without much substance. The chocolate around it is pretty sweet too. If you like really sweet candy and crunchy-ness then go ahead and get them, but there are much better chocolates out there.
Although they are a bit expensive, every now and then these candies are worth considering. I wish they sold them in the states because they are so unique in both taste and texture.

column9: One of the Best Bars I've Had in Years!
column10: One rule I always try to follow is to never go to the grocery store when I'm hungry. Well, I missed on this one tonight. All was well as I visited my nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market until I passed the baking chocolates. There sat a tray of Cadbury Crunchie bars. I couldn't help myself. The label said it was made in St. Bournville, Birmingham UK. It was 190 calories, but I'd been good all day. Into the cart a bar went, and I opened it first thing when I got home. Man, was this thing good! The outer chocolate cover was excellent but the best part was a crunchy caramel-like interior. I can't describe it. It tasted a bit like the inside of a Heath Bar, but it was better. It was part solid and part like a really stiff and crunchy foam. Did I mention that it was delicious? Mmmmm! One of the best bars I've had in years. To be honest, I don't consume many candy bars, but this one was certainly excellent!Gary Peterson

When I was a kid I used to love Violet Crumble candy bars.  They are difficult to find and very expensive.  I found these in my suggested items and gave them a try.  This is a great replacement.  The chocolate is lovely.  The honeycomb center is perfectly crunchy without being hard.  What a treat.

I got this candy bar because it seemed to be similar to the violet crumble which my family used to get and were obsessed with. I just wasn't willing to pay $6 a bar!I'd say this bar is great and inexpensive, a good alternative to the crumble.But what really stood out was the customer service! I can't say enough good things about this company, I've never been so impressed. There was an issue with the post office, and it seemed the post office was sending it back to NY! Jof not only gave me his cell phone number to try and see what we could do but sent a new package the next day (2-day air so it could be here by Christmas). Jof saved the day and went well above and beyond!
Was shorted by one bar.  It was supposed to be a six pack of bars but only five were in the ziplock bag they came in.  Hopeing they correct this problem.

First can I say that the seller of these candy bars is very thoughtful and they included and ice pack so the chocolates didn't melt in shipping. I grew up eating these candy bars in Africa so was delighted when I found them here at amazon. The honeycomb center is crunchy and melts in your mouth along with the milk chocolate coating. The only problem with these candy bars is they don't last long. They are that good and once others in your family find out about them they will disappear even more quickly. Maybe order 12!~The Rebecca Review

Order came on time, was fresh and crunchie. This is the best bar ever, healthy and delightful. Wish we could buy them in the states, In Australia they are called Velvet crunchie's; come in a package and are bite sized. They just are the best.

Someone bought these for me by mistake. The first time I tried a bar, I thought it was a little too sweet. But by the second bar, I was hooked. There's only a little bit of chocolate on the outside, so you can hardly call this a chocolate bar. The magic is all in the honeycomb candy middle. It goes crunch, then it melts in your mouth like honey-butter. You really have to try it for yourself to understand how delicious it is.

These are my second favorite candy bars.  I like Violet Crumble a little better, as they are a little smoother.  However, being that both are hard to find, I'm happy to take either of them.  If you're having problems finding them in the states, check your mall candy store.  Some of the chains carry them, and others can order them for you.  It would be nice if you could pick them up anywhere, but this way it makes for an extra special treat.  They are more expensive than regular candy bars.  The prices here are a little cheaper than I've paid in the past, but you also have to figure in s&h.
Tried these for the first time through this Amazon order. Not sure if this is normal but to me it kind of had a stale after taste. Not something I would get again.
i love these they are so good. they arrived very fast, and was in great shape, and was delish!!

This is a delightful English candybar. It's not like anything we have in the states. I lived in England for a short time and was able to try quite a bit of different sweets. I am not a fan of British Cadbury chocolate, however, this is the one and only exception for me! It is worth a try for someone wanting to try something new.

I grew up on these  so I know what I am talking about. Crunchie are to crave for with that golden honeycomb covered in cadbury chocolate.You can find them in the English stores over here, you might also find them in Albertsons

column9: tastes bad, tastes stale, obsolete inventory?
column10: 1) these candy bars were apparently made for overseas distribution but never got there.  I ordered from a company in Mass. figuring that all the reviews talking about candy with asian/indian language on the wrapper might be avoided but it was not.  Seems you will get these "overseas" bars wherever you get them from.2) I wanted the VIOLET CRUMBLE but it is not available in the US anymore.  Some reviewed these and said these bars were close to if not better than the VC.  I disagree greatly.  Although they are both a form of "sponge" candy with a chocolate covering, this bar does not come close to the VIOLET CRUBMLE.  The "sponge" center only makes me think the word STALE, and the chocolate has something wrong with it.  Not even close to the quality of the chocolate used on the VC.  Indeed after just a small sampling from the first bar, I was so disappointed I tossed them all in the garbage.Too bad.  Guess I'll keep on looking for the VC.  Hail Flavius!

Imagine ordering chocolate that is supposed to be from England and receiving chocolate wrapped in paper with Pakistani language(Urdu)all over it. Yes, it contained English translation but I didn't order candy from Pakistan. I ordered candy from England thru Trade Concepts. The candy is rather stale and old and tasted like cheap milk chocolate. If this indeed comes from England, why do the wrappers indicate they are from Pakistan?I also ordered the "Flake" These too are from Pakistan. The center is not flaky or crunchy or crumbly but rather stale and old. Because of the Urdo language all over the wrappers, I can only assume that perhaps Trade Concepts imports from England, removes the wrapper and then rewraps them in their own wrappers? I'm sure the FDA would be interested in this practice.This review refers to the seller Trade Concepts

column9: Does not taste like the Lipton Yellow Label Tea I've had + no expiration date on package
column10: I was initially excited to find Lipton Yellow Label Tea on Amazon, as I just got back from Italy and fell in love with it there.  The Lipton Yellow Label Tea in Italy doesn't taste anything like the weak, poor-quality Lipton we get in the U.S., but the tea I ordered on Amazon (sold by Simply Beautiful) is actually manufactured for India and tastes bitter and/or stale.  You can't see from the photo, but the writing on the packages I received is not in English and says it was manufactured in Canada for India.  It is hard to tell whether the variety sold in India just tastes different than the kind in Italy, or if the tea was in fact stale, because there is NO sell-by or expiration date on the package (very disturbing), and the bags are NOT "foil-wrapped for freshness" as described on Amazon.  I was extremely disappointed in the taste of this tea from India, having looked forward to the lovely, full-bodied Lipton Yellow Label tea bags that I brought home from Italy.  Not to mention the fact that I would never want to buy imported groceries that don't have an expiration date, so there is no way to know how long they've been sitting in the warehouse, if they are stale, or when they will go stale after opening (especially since they are not individually wrapped).  I returned both boxes of tea and hope to get an Amazon refund soon.  There is another listing for Lipton Yellow Label Tea on Amazon at an even higher cost, but it is also sold by the Indian grocery, so I don't know why they have 2 listings at different prices if the tea is exactly the same.  I am very bummed.

I normally purchase this tea in Toronto Canada and I love it.  I was glad to find it on amazon.  For some reason it does taste a little different to me but I'll know for sure when I get my next Toronto purchase.  Unfortunately it was a long break before I found and purchased this one from Amazon.  Overall a great and totally under-rated tea.
You don't have to wait long to get a nice cup of tea. After a couple minutes Tea was ready to drink.You could probably get a small pot out of one bag.
I really enjoy this tea.I often have it in China town and Flushing, where it is refereed to as Nai Cha (milk tea).Its very good with cream and sugar, and is one of my favorite treats.
These bags are not foil wrapped Not even paper envelope wrapped as thecheaper Lipton bags are more like crammed in the box of 100 naked. Tastes OK though.
This is an excellent saffron-seasoned rice with no MSG or other harmful ingredients.

column4: Ms Simone "Natural sharp shooter and occasion...
column10: I bought this for some Indian food I was making, and thought I'd give some quick Saffron rice a try. This product ruined the taste of my meal. It had an almost dairy-meets-mildew taste to it. NOTHING like the spice of Saffron.
Bought this for a friend who is crazy about this rice and can never find it in her grocery stores.

Tangerine Orange Tea is wonderful.  The rich flavor allows more life to the tea bags.  It makes perfect icy tea.  (I do not drink hot tea.)  It doesn't take long to make.  I love it because I don't even have to "brew" it; I simply put it in my water bottle with water, stick it in the freezer, and I have icy tea in no time.  Ths tea would be perfect with an orange muffin - or any flavor muffin.I recommend this tea to any tea lover.

This is one of the more sucessful of Celestial Seasonings Zinger genre. In this case the flavor of rose hips and hibiscus does not overpower the other flavors (unless you brew longer than 4 minutes). The aroma of this ruby potion is deliciously citrus and full bodied. The flavor of the tea is sweet red grapefruit and orange. Very tasty! I imagine this would make an excellent ice tea. Also, it is caffeine free and has added vitamin C--45 mg.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box:"Be in readiness for favorable winds." Chinese Proverb.
I'm sure taste is still great but $9.25 for shipping is outrageous. If your local grocery store carries it, buy it there, last I saw they were $1/package.

column9: Put it on top of ice cream!
column10: I love spooning this on top of ice cream. I always loved the inside of the Whopper candy specifically because of the sweet and grainy malt bit, which you can in essence recreate by topping ice cream with this stuff and mixing it in. It works with just about any flavor ice cream you would want as well. As your ice cream melts, you get yourself an ice cream shake (you can add some milk to thin it out). I probably put way more than I really need to on top of my own servings, but with 4 packs to use up, I can afford to indulge a bit.
This product is very hard to find in stores. The price is right, and is always fresh when we recieve it.

Nostalgia moment:  Perched on the counters of my mother's kitchen, my friends and I would eagerly await her magic mix of Carnation malt (generously added), Mayfield chocolate ice cream and enough milk to smooth it all together.  She mixed it in a big bowl with a spoon and served the thick malts in cups with a spoon. Awesome chocolate malts! Those malts were perfect snacks for late night original series Star Trek.  I am so glad to find it available here.

I have occasionally joked that this is drinkable heroin. When a really good "malted" is served to me, my eyes tend to cross as my lips embrace the straw and I will sometimes not stop sucking on the straw until that awful slurp at  the bottom sounds off indicating my fix is ended. I have used Horlicks in the past and it's quite good, but I still consider Carnation as the real thing. I've had some "no-name" syrups and I believe another brand used to be available in the US, but they were useless.I do think there's something genetic about my love of malt (just as I despise okra or green peppers). With this apparent withdrawal of Carnations from the supermarket shelves, it's obvious that the malted thing needs to be revitalized. Young versions of "ME" who have this genetic preference are waiting for this ultimate "comfort food" be a popular item once again.

column9: Carnation Malted Milk in original 13-ounce jars
column10: I love malted milk drinks, but have not found other than chocolate flavored malted milk powder in a Knoxville store.  However, I found plain malted milk on Amazon and have, on more than one occasion, satisfactorily ordered a supply so that I will not again run out.

I love it. It's great with milk or soy milk, it's great in cereal, it's great by itself! In fact, I love it by itself as a snack, though I know I'm probably not supposed to do that.Just the right sweetness with a great aroma!

This is so hard to find in grocery stores - so glad to find it here, and it's a better buy too!  We've been sprinkling it on our breakfast cereals for four generations now (thanks grandma!).  My children request it every morning. It's a great product!
Great deal on a deelicious product I couldn't find in a store.Amazon you're right on!

I'd been looking for malted milk powder and bought some Ovaltine, which is good but has a lot of other flavors with the malt, and then I tried Horlicks from England, which is very malty and nice but contains "vegetable oil," though the site says it's no longer hydrogenated, and then I found the Carnation Malted Milk here. Well, let me tell you, that opening the first jar sent me back to about age six. Of all my childhood memories of sweets, a malted is one of my favorites, and this stuff is exactly what the doctor ordered. I mean it's perfect. How many things can you say that about? And the ingredient list is short. No polysyllabic NASA chemicals, AND NO HYDROGENATED FATS OR TRANSFATS! I feel like writing a letter to Nestles and begging them to keep making this exactly as it is. I can't say enough about how much I love it.
Bought this product specifically for making milk shakes.  Tastes very good in chocolate milk shakes!!
I do not know why this product is so hard to find in grocery stores or even online. This order was also back-ordered. The product is fine. No issues. Good quality. Name brand.

Mix Carnation Chocolate Malted Milk with a good quality vanilla (not French vanilla)ice cream and whole milk, blend thoroughly and you will be rewarded with the best chocolate malt ever !I will be buying by the case in the future due to the difficulty in finding it on grocery store shelves. Reminds me of the loss of Tang Instant Grapefruit Drink Mix, Birdseye Hawaiian and Japanese International Vegetables and Stouffers Swiss Cheese Crepes. Gone but not forgotten !

column9: You Can't Find It In Stores
column10: I'd combed every supermarket in reasonable distance from home and could not find the malt I remembered from Carnation to make real malted milks.  Then I saw it on Amazon at a reasonable price.  It's just as I remembered -- my malted milks are smooth and delicious.  Thanks, Amazon!

column9: Amazon best place to buy this
column10: I discovered this favorite product recently during an Amazon sale promotion.  The price here is a good bargain since our local grocery charges about $5.25 each.  This makes super malts!
This is a great buy! This stuff runs $5 + in stores! Saved myself alot of $$$$$! ;)

I assume those readers who enjoyed malted milks in their formative years would jump at the chance to re-create the taste of the drink (any flavor-- you choose) and the feeling of profound nostalgia when you taste that first sip of an ice cream malted milk shake. This drink had magical properties. Individually, there's milk (low-fat or regular), flavored syrup and, of course, the magic Malted Milk that transforms a glass of milk with favoring into a unique concoction that so permeates your youth, it comes back with that first sip. When I ordered a malt from the "malt" shop, I made sure that (1) the soda jerk used real malted milk---not just milk, syrup and ice cream (a mllk shake)==and not the liquid malt which is no doubt cheaper to use but in no way matched the flavor of the real thing. I worked my way through college at a "malt shop" which was the generic term for an ice cream parlor. If my boss didn't use malted milk--Carnation Malted Milk--I heckled him until he did.Thanks to the magic the internet this drink can be reproduced just as I made it back in Frosty Bossy in San Francisco.
Love this stuff.  I used to get it as a kid about 40 years ago, and the Kroger's where I live doesn't carry it!  (hmmph.)  Makes great smoothies with bananas, peanut butter, and/or chocolate.
I just love the carnation malted milk powder. It makes delicious malts. I no longer have to go the the ice cream shop for delicious malts. And the price is great.

This product is exactly as I remember it from when my father made malted milks for my kids. They are all grown now, but have repeatedly asked if we couldn't please find the powder he used. I looked everywhere, including the company website, without any luck. Only breakfast powder was available, and that definitely wasn't it. When I found this on Amazon I was delighted, and we were all taken back a few decades when we tried it out. The taste is exactly the same(I know this is very subjective but it worked for us, and we added stuff like ice cream and vanilla), it dissolves easily even in cold milk, and makes a very smooth milkshake. A hit in our house.

yummy!  it made my cupcakes taste nice!  that malted flavor really hits the spot!The malked milk shake is better with ice cream than just plain ol milk!  bleh!  make it fancy!This thing is great.  Add it to any sweets you would wanted a malted taste!  great of baking, and "drink making".  Your life getting boring?  then buy this and add it to your everyday life to make it sweeter!Warning, do not eat the powder with a spoon, as tempting as this sound, it is not so good.  bleh!

Great in pancake batter. Better than ihop now. I'm looking forward to using it in other receipts. These words are enough.

Why stores do not carry Carnation when it is available I have no idea. the origional is like I had when I was a kid and Im now 73 and still enjoy it once in a while in my glass of milk. This was supposed to be pretzel bread that you can make in your bread machine.  Instead it is pretzel mix, that you can use your bread machine to combine, but then you have to shape the pretzels by hand and finish in your oven.  Very misleading!!!!

This pretzel mix and its mixing/baking instructions leave a lot to be desired.  The mixing/baking instructions are printed so small that even with good eyesight, I needed a magnifying glass to read them.  Instructions were confusing to say the least in that it talks about pouring the yeast packet into a small bowl and adding a cup of warm water, mix well before adding to dry mix.  There was no yeast package in the box I was working with nor any of the other three boxes that I opened.  Just to confirm that the yeast had not already been added to the dry mix and the instructions had not been updated accordingly, I called the company and asked.  They informed that there should have been a seperate yeast package in each box.  They then offered to send me four packages of yeast to replace what I was obviously going to have to buy before I could make up the mixes.  To date, I've not received anything from this company albeit it has been nearly three weeks since I called them.  Thankfully, I had one package of yeast on hand so that I could continue with my immediate baking project.  There is also no salt in the mix which renders a very bland tasting pretzel notwithstanding the coarse salt sprinkled on the tops.  For those on a low to no sodium diet, this pretzel mix might be ideal for you.  As for brushing the formed pretzel with warm baking soda water after placing on the baking pan, I am convinced this procedure contributed to the burned bottoms.  Yes, the oven temp was exactly as per the baking instructions as was the bake time.  The instructions do not recommend brushing the pretzels with a small amount of lightly beaten egg white which allows the sprinkled on top coarse salt to adhere much better than just brushing with the baking soda water.  I have three more boxes of this mix to use and I intend to modify the mixing/baking instructions to match a much better made from scratch "old world" receipe for pretzels that calls for both a bit of salt and dunking the formed pretzels in near boiling baking soda water for 20 seconds.  Once you lift the pretzels from the water with a slotted spatula or similar utensil, the baking soda water drips from the pretzel.  I've never had burned pretzel bottoms using this method.  The oven temp and bake time will also be adjusted.  Was just trying to find a mix that could reduce the number of ingredients needed to be kept on hand for the "old world" receipe as well as to alleviate some of the mixing since my hands are becoming very arthritic.  Bummer.
I made the dough by hand according to the package directions quite easily. I then rounded pretzel roll shapes and they were delicious although give their shape they did take more time to bake.
This product is very good.It makes a very tasty bread. It smells very good as its baking. I would recommend this product to everyone. I used my bread maker and it was very easy.

It makes great fresh bread sticks... plus "baked surprises"... we roll it out, cut it with a large circle cookie cutter and then fill it with ... well... anything and everything.  and each ball of goodness (we have used a chicken alfredo filling, a mixture of shredded cheeses, as well as an egg salad) comes out fabulous.I tend to crimp the edges to make them more like half moons.. but the grand children bring the sides to the top,  making it a ball with a small ball on top (of the edges that are twisted to seal)... then after baking they (the balls)  end up looking like mini snow men, or ducks (depending on which child created the pop-over)Whenever these are in stock we stock up.

column9: Excellent base for an amazing (healthy!) meal!
column10: I love this organic cous cous. We try to only eat organic. This is so quick and easy to prepare - just heat water to boiling (I do it in the microwave in a pyrex measuring cup), stir in the cous cous, cover and let sit for a few minutes. Fluff, done! Our daughter likes it plain with salt and a bit of olive oil blended in. I like adding a nice sauce with vegetables over the cous cous (such as the delicious 5-minute Indian dish, Tasty Bite Jaipur Vegetables, that I also buy on Amazon). My only complaint -- and this is not the fault of the product -- is that the case we recently received had an expiration date only 2 months out. Most products are still good past the posted dates, and we like it so I'm sure we will manage to eat it before it goes stale, but Amazon should be more careful with their stock control.

great deal on this cous cous - has gotten hard to find locally, so this is a great way to order - my only "complaint" is that the expiration date is only a few months - so don't buy if you plan to eat, say, only one box a month, it won't last the whole year

This product was the worst - it was so stale, even the dog didn't eat it (and she eats everything). It had such a stale taste to it I thought for sure the product was years old but there was no expiration date on it. None the less - it went in the garbage.

Nacheez is the best! The Spicy version has the perfect amount of spiciness. I heat it quickly in the microwave and it's great for dipping tortilla chips as a snack. It's also delicious and easy to use in recipes. Great flavor and wholesome ingredients - I loved Nacheez even before I decided to be vegan. Yum!

column9: You get what you pay for
column10: There are no intact leaves in this tea- I suspect it is some kind of "fining" grade. It brews up very tannic, which hints at a kind of oxidation similar to green tea and completely lacking in the subtlety customary for white tea. If this is your first exposure to white tea, rest assured this is not your normal white tea, and a world apart from my standard, Drum Mountain White Cloud (not apparently available here but very reasonably priced at Silk Road Teas).

I've had better White Peony, and it cost about three times as much.  For the price this is a very good tea.  Brew it around 170 degrees for 5 minutes and it has a very smooth, slightly sweet taste with no sweetener added.  My personal favorite is to add 2 parts White Peony to 1 part rooibos.  Give it a try!

Very sub par for white peony.  The leaves are in tiny pieces and taste more like lipton tea than white peony I have had elsewhere.I won't buy this again.  Unfortunate because I like davidsons silver needle (which is significantly cheaper at soap . com ever since amazon upped the price a few months back)

I find this goes quite well with a bit of lemon juice. The price is surprisingly low and quality seems fine. I'm used to $4 to $15 per ounce for various white teas, never purchasing more than a few ounces at a time. I find myself drinking much more now and will likely be ordering another pound in the next couple weeks. I may order Davidson's silver needles variant at some point to see how it compares to the $200 per pound silver needles I'd grown used to from other sources, but for now I'm quite content with this.March 4, 2011 edit: I just logged on after getting my second shipment to leave a positive review, and noticed that I already had three months ago. I continue to enjoy it on a daily basis, steeping at 160 degrees F for 2 minutes and adding nothing more than perhaps a bit of lemon. I've yet to feel a need to try their more expensive white tea.

This is a very nice quality white peony.  For the price I am blown away, there is no greater value period.  Very nice flavor and lasts for a solid 3 large cups of brewing.  The tea is organic too which if you do some research is very important when you buy tea.  You wont be disappointed.  Too many positives here to ignore.

It's not heavy on the caffeine, but chug three big cups and you get a nice lift.  :)I suggest giving it a try, especially at this price.

It has a concentration of natural sugars in it (most Norwegian dairy products are organic even if they are not labeled so).My fiance has to go to her Norwegian church in New York to get this delicacy as you usually cannot find it anywhere in the U.S.. There, on weekend mornings, the ladies prepare fresh waffles with this cheese melted over them. TO DIE FOR!It doesn't get any better.

I purchased this tea because it is recommended for helping women's PMS symptoms and menopause symptoms.  I've only had one cup of it, so I can't say if it has helped my symptoms or not.  I have purchased other teas of this brand.  I would recommend their teas.  I wasn't crazy about the taste of the red clover, but that is just my personal opinion.  It's a little bitter but bearable.  Add some sugar and you're good to go.
I didn't realize it but my tea wasn't arriving as promptly as suggested. The company also noticed and sent a box out immediately! WOW! I was very impressed!

The tea has a mild, pleasant flavor and is easy to combine with others, without overpowering the mix. I've just moved to a new town, and I don't know where to look for the teas I need. Buying online saved me a lot of headaches. The boxes I ordered arrived promptly.

I read about the benefits of Pau D'Arco tea and decided to give it a try. It's hard to find this tea in the market. The Whole Foods near my house doesn't have it either.The taste of this herbal tea is interesting: it's got a hint of sweetness with a very slight medicinal bitterness. Feels quite dry and alkaline to me. Color is light brown. Not particularly delightful or tasty, neither does it have a strong, captivating aroma like the Japanese roasted green tea - it's just weird beyond description. Reminds me of dried summer leaves. Not unpleasant though; I am still glad that I tried it!

column9: Saw this on Dr. OZ for eliminating crows feet
column10: I watched Dr. OZ on television and he was explaining how to minimize and/or avoid crows feet. His advice? Drinking Fenugreek tea, taking L-Arginine supplements and getting a good nights' sleep (6 hour min.). Well, I am going to give it a shot. This tea has an interesting taste-not your typical tea but not bad. It tastes pretty good with a bit of honey added actually. I wasn't able to find this tea in any local supermarkets but here it is on Amazon. Seems they have everything!

Tea comes in bags inside a large foil lined pouch.  There are 2 bags 'attached', and you peel them apart to use one.  They are not individually wrapped, and they do not have strings.  Strong flavor, great price.

column9: Sage Tea helps with night sweats
column10: I have one cup a day and it really decreases my night sweats. I'm in amazement at how much it helps!The taste isn't great, but I don't think it's as bad as some other reviews have said. If you're concerned about the taste, you can use some sage from your spice cabinet and make a cup. It tastes pretty much the same, but it didn't seem cost effective to use the sage you buy in the spice aisle.

column9: Yes it does have an odor that some will find disagreeable, but it works for me and I will continue to purchase it
column10: I read some of the reviews on here and I almost didn't purchase.  But I reached a point where due to my erratic work schedule, trying to fit in my studying time and completing assignments, my sleep pattern was disrupted and it was affecting my mood and concentration.  So I bit the bullet and purchased this at a local B&M store.  When I got home after work, I boiled some water and opened the package.  I noticed that this tea was packaged in a plastic bag so I guess it did has a pungent smell.  I opened the plastic bag and took a big whiff.  I was kind of disappointed.  It doesn't smell as bad as some of the other reviewers made it out to me but then again my nose has been wonky for some time so it could be me.  Yes I will admit that it does has a funky odor but it is not that strong to me.  To me, smells like this health food store I used to frequent in the Hyde Park neighborhood.  Very musky but weirdly comforting.  I have tried it with peppermint, turmeric (for a different affliction) and I have tried it plain with stevia and it taste okay to me.  I wouldn't say I have an iron stomach because I can easily get sick if food is left out in the open not at the proper temperature.  For me, this product took about two days for it to kick in and I am now able to sleep for a full eight hours straight instead of sleeping in fits of four hours here, wake up for about two hours, sleep for three, wake up for a hour and sleep for another four hours.  For those with sensitive noses and sense of taste, you have been amply warned by other reviewers.  For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  For example, mints like peppermint or spearmint will help.  Some folks will use lavender to mask the smell.

this is a great product,it helps to relieve my bloating.I will order it again.Thank you.its better then anything else i have tryed
This is an outstanding product and value!  The cherries are great, in light syrup, no high fructose, and plentiful for the price

I never heard of this seasoning until I moved in with my roommate.  She puts it on everything!!!  The hot is really hot!  So if you don't like really spicy stuff, then you should go for the mild.  It has a good cajun taste and you can literally put it on anything!  YUMMY!!

Do not buy this!!! I love boba tea drinks. I've spent a small fortune buying them. To save money I realized it would be cheaper to find the ingredients and make it myself so I bought this powder. This is not yogurt powder! This is yogurt creamer, BIG DIFFERENCE! Tastes nothing like the drink I'm use to. The powder itself barely tastes sweet. Imagine buying creamer and adding it to black tea that is what you will get, gross. This creamer is not sweet nor does it taste like yogurt or at least the fake boba yogurt flavor that most Asians are familiar with. If you want to make real yogurt black tea or green tea boba drink then buy the syrup and not the powder. Trust me you will thank me!I think this powder is used for making yogurt milk tea or the yogurt ice blended drink but you have to add the yogurt syrup, sold separately.

The pomegranate flavor in this tea makes it a winner. It has that little bit of extra "something" that you just need sometimes when you drink a lot of tea. Something different. A different flavor. If you like to eat pomegranates, you'll like this. If you're not a fan of the fruit, you probably won't be a fan of this tea. It has that little bit of zing that the fruit has, and it's just perfect to drink while watching the sunrise.

We have been enjoying this tea at various Panera Restaurants.  I googled online to see if we could purchase some and Amazon came up with carrying this fine product.  The tea arrived as promised and was exactly what we had expected.  Thank you.

My SIL gave me a tin of this as a gift years ago, and I've been hooked ever since. It has a lightly sweet but tangy flavor and lingers pleasantly on the tongue, not to mention a positively ambrosial fragrance. I always huff the tin when I open it to get a bag, it smells that good. Good both as hot and iced tea, I only wish it came in bulk.
I absolutely love this tea. This tea is very flavorful and has a very fruity taste. It almost tastes like juice without all of the sugars or thick syrupy texture. Very delicious!

Hated Tea my whole life, UNTIL I FOUND (REPUBLIC OF TEA) I have about 15 flavors and I love them all, still trying new ones to see if I can find one I don't like. Got my kids, wife, dad, friends, loving it too!!!All 5 Stars, good price, good packaging, good product and got here FAST!!
This tea is very tasty without being sweet.  It is great either hot or cold.  Just don't over steep as it tends to get bitter.
2nd time I purchased.  They are good, they stay fresh and they have always arrived in a timely manner.  I would purchase them again when my supply runs low.
