column10: My Polish husband loves herring and loves aspic.  He was truly surprised by the quality of this product and I've already ordered it time and time again.
It is important to refrigerate this product first, otherwise it is like a soup. Once I did that it is very good tasting with a vinegar tartness. I enjoy it for lunch.

Unfortunately, I was hoping to get Jumbo Tiger Pops which are absolutely delicious.  I have since found out that they may no longer be available in the USA.  Jumbo TP come in four flavors--cherry, watermelon,grape, and orange--and are round. If anyone knows where they can be found, please post the answer.  They are wonderful.

column9: My favorite brand of canned soup - chickarina is my favorite kind!!
column10: I love this kind of soup!  Had it this afternoon for lunch.  Progresso is an excellent brand and their soups are very good.  The broth has alot of body and the flavor is very good, not mainly salty like so many canned soups.This flavor has little chicken meatballs with little round  macaroni shapes.  The combo is delicious and its nice an chunky!Try this!  Its very filling and a great warming, lunch!

This soup contains MSG.  The only canned soups made by Progresso that are free of MSG: Green Split Pea, Pasta E. Fagioli, Minestrone, Vegetable Italiano, Tomato Basil, Creamy Tomato, Tomato Rotini, Hearty Tomato, Black Bean, and Lentil.

column9: Over $3.00 / can - you've got to be kidding, Progresso!
column10: I LOVED this soup as a child.  However, now my wife makes me "Italian Wedding Soup" which is better and MUCH cheaper!Try making that for a *fraction* of the cost with the ingredients you choose.  Easy to make - find a recipe on the Internet.Progresso, be realistic about your prices and I might buy a few cans...
This product is amazing! If you need a pick u upper with all natural ingredients this product is for you! It will give you stamina and guard you from colds and flu simptoms!

I discovered this Popcorn oil at a local store, but when I couldn't find it anymore, I ordered it through Amazon.  This is absolutely the best popcorn oil ever.  I use it with a microwave popcorn bowl and it is healthier than using prepackaged microwave popcorn.  Try it and you will be hooked too.

Wow,I didn't know what to expect with an organic marshmallow,but this product is great. It had flavor, a differentbut great texture and last a long time in your mouth.I did a taste test, organic verses regular with a few peopleand after tasting the organic they thought the reqularmarshmallow taste absolutely horrible.I am very pleased with this product and will continue topurchase it, as long as the  ingredients are/stay wholesome,and the price doesn't get any steepier. (I think I made thatword up).ThanksP.S. For your information they melt really well for  rice cripy treats

We received a 2oz bag as a gift from someone from our church who when to Jamaica.  I try the coffee with milk (because the is the way we drink it) and right away I said to myself this is really great tasting.  I am not a big coffee drinker, but this coffee is full of favor and even my husband agreed that this is the best coffee ever.  It is a bit pricey but well worth it!!!

It is the most difficult thing to find good melon seeds in US.. I gave this a chance because of the option of returning to Amazon. the seeds are packed well, taste freshly roasted, little salted, so fantastic taste on the outside, but the inside is almost empty, nothing, very thin and no taste.since the price is not cheap I am returning them...

Since I was introduced to finishing salts, I've never been able to go back to plain old table salt. I highly recommend trying a sampler set of salts to see which one(s) you like before buying larger quantities, and it's also nice to have a variety of salts for different tastes and food/uses. Finishing and Gourmet salts are not just for Foodies, but for the average cook as well.  It is fun to try them on different combinations of food. You don't need to worry about getting too much salt in your diet if you omit salt during cooking and add a pinch on fresh, pure, non-processed foods at the table or upon serving.  Not only do finishing salts improve the flavor of so many foods, but they can add to the presentation.A salt sampler makes a great gift, but if gifting, buy the bottles instead of the tins - they would make a much more attractive gift. I got the tins because I needed small and light containers, but you wouldn't want to set them out on the table or keep them anywhere visible.As for this particular sampler and the seller:  It was shipped very quickly, and the quality of salts is fine, however -- it would have been helpful had they indicated the quantity (weight) of salt for the taster tins in the description.  It is indicated for every container, except the tins. (It varies: .6 oz., .9 oz., and 1 oz. depending on the density of each salt).  It would also be helpful if each label was on the top of the tin instead of the bottom so you don't have to turn each one upside down to identify the one you are looking for - unless you are able to see through tin.  The informational brochure that came with them would have been great - IF the type was large enough to read!  I had to use a magnifier and still couldn't read some of it because of the poor quality printing in addition to the tiny size, and I have 20/20 vision.

column9: Sea Salts starter set - very nice
column10: Finishing Salt Starter Set - 6 Different Sea Salts From Around the World, Small Taster TinsThis starter set is very nice. I am really enjoying these salts as each one is quite different. The set came with pamphlet that describes each different salt and what it is good to use it for.

I've been curious about finishing salts but wasn't sure which salt would be the best to use.  This starter set is allowing us to really explore the differences in flavor, color, and grain size.  You just need a tiny sprinkle on top of your food -- a little goes a long way (but that's the point).  My only complaint is that these tins are very difficult to open, and sometimes cause a bit of a spill when they give that final pop.  It would have been nice to have jars instead.

This set arrived quickly and is nicely packaged for gift giving.  It includes a good sample selection of sea salts and has been fun to try.  Great for those starting out to explore the world of sea and finishing salts.  The company has many more interesting salts where these came from.

column9: Great gift for a great cook
column10: I got these as a gift for my husband and he loves them, as does everyone who has joined us for a meal lately. The salts are potent. You need very little to get an amazing tasting meal together. The starter set includes enough diversity of salts that you have enough to use on many different foods (fish, meats, rice, etc) before you invest in a larger set or more tins.

Everything about this was as I was hoping except that, like another reviewer, one of the glass jars arrived broken and there were shards and salt in the package.  I'm not returning it because it was for a last-minute gift - but if you're buying it I'd recommend getting the metal tins.  Less expensive and less breakable, too.Aside from the breakage, everything seems great.  I tasted one of the salts from the broken bottle (risky, I know, given the broken glass), and I have to say it was delicious.

Received these tins as a gift.  Absolutely wonderful and so much fun to do a blind taste test before you cook/bake with them. Decided to send them as a gift myself to send on the happiness! WONDERFUL!
I was very pleased with these finishing salts. They add depth and one up the presentation factor. Thanks for the quickness of shipping and I highly recommend this product.

The salt selection is lovely but the jars are fragile. When opening the black salts the jar crushed in my hand. Needless to say I had to throw out the whole jar. Contacted the vendor for replacement and have never heard back so customer service is lacking also.

I purchased this as a gift for someone who loves to cook. The item was nicely packaged, priced well and I was pleased to give it. I can't speak to the quality of the item, however. Looked good though!
This product looked wonderful and priced well.  In actuality, it was poorly boxed, bottles were broken, and it was a mess inside the box.  I would not order this item again.
WEll it is very good mix of nuts of the highest quality but if you could only buy one selection of nuts this isthe one one  hold back is price but I am glad I went for it..
This item smelled really good when I opened it. But the good smell only lasted for about a week at most. I will not buy again! The label says it lasts up to 30 days. NO it last about 7 days!

column9: Vet recommended this for my dogs
column10: Our Vet recommended this for my two dogs, a rat terrier and a pound-puppy-mix.  She gave me sample and the dogs loved it.  I purchased it from the vet, but now that I see it on Amazon, I will get it here from now on.

I use California Natural Lamb & Rice for my 10 year old shepherd Terrier mix. She has a very sensitive stomach and after years of trying numerous different brands this one finally made a difference. It's all natural and only has three ingredients: lamb meal, rice, and sunflower oil so how could you go wrong. With other foods my dog used to have soft stools and vomit frequently but that rarely happens anymore. When it does, I give her California Natural canned food (any variety) and that seems to help even better than the dry. However, I stick with the dry because it's cheaper and better for her teeth. I have a lot of faith in this food and highly recommend it for any dog.

column9: My small dogs gobble this up.
column10: I had to switch food from Merricks to California Natural because after two years of feeding my dogs Merricks food, it seems like they are having problems with their pancreas. The food may be a little too oily. After feeding them California Natural for the first time, they loved it. They finish all their food every meal. Too bad they dont make the small bites in chicken and rice formula. I have three 15 to 20lb dogs, so the small bites makes it easy for them to chew.

column9: Parent company Natura sold to P&G in June 2010.
column10: My dog has been on this food for 6 years now and is doing very well on it.  There has been no vomiting, and she produces very solid and small poops once a day.  She has a very sensitive stomach and seems to not be tolerant of overly rich foods including the canned version of this kibble.  Other brands we've tried are Solid Gold, Wellness and Wellness Core.  Solid Gold (the pink bag with the Westie on it) was okay for about a few months, then she started having soft poops again.  Wellness and Wellness Core turned her into a doggie fountain.The only downside to this is that she isn't very excited about it.  This is probably the simplest diet there is consisting of 1 protein (lamb) and one starch (rice) plus some oils.I found that the addition of salmon oil or Vet prescribed Probiotics (mixed with warm water to form a gravy) helps keep her interested in her food.An important note is that as of June 2010, California natural's parent company Natura was purchased by P&G who has a track record of turning good brands into bad brands in the name of profit.  I am hoping that Natura's brands (Evo, California Naturals, Innova, etc) do not follow in the foot steps of Eukanuba.  Just a note to watch out for anything unusual since this is meant to be the simplest food on the market today.

column9: My yorkies will not eat this.
column10: I bought this food for my two yorkshire terriers because of the limited ingredients and because I know it's high quality. However, they will NOT eat this food and I've tried all the tricks (hiding it, mixing with yogurt or wet food, mixing it with their other dry food, etc.)  They eat around it and spit it out. I guess they just really don't like the lamb taste. Also, it smells pretty bad. I will have to try a chicken based food next time.

I was expecting this to be very chewing, borderline rubbery.  I was completely wrong!  The octopus was tender and flavorful.  The olive oil used was pretty good, it adds an extra level of flavor.  Again the package is for 2 but it's just right for me.

I have a hard time finding good Kimchi. Taking time out of my busy day to find Asian Groceries that carry it and find out if their product is decent is a hassle. I discovered Mama Eun's kimchi on Amazon. com and love it. It's not cheap but it's excellent Kimchi. They ship it FEDEX next day on cold packs so it gets to your door safe and sound and refrigerated. Someone from the company called right after I received the delivery to make sure it had arrived safe and was still cold! I'm going to try their Bulgogi next! If you don't mind paying for it, their product is excellent.

This kimchi is tasty but is very expensive for what it is. ~15$ for packing and ~8$ for the kimchi itself makes this kimchi which is enough for 5 servings 23$ total.However the packing is excellent(which consists of many boxes and icce packings) and the taste is excellent. But price is not compromised.

You are getting the best Kimchi you can get if you live in a rural areaas I do.It's expensive because it's made fresh, delivered to your door in 24 hoursyou even (i did) get a call from a very nice gentleman confirming that you gotyour kimchi !5 STAR SERVICE IS hard to come by anymore.If you are having a dinner with more than 2 you should double your order unlessyou  are going to combine you kimchi with some soups or other dishes/ side dishes.I suggest learning how to make your own.. which is the quest I'm on.maja

column9: Very good kimchi, satisfies my craving
column10: I've been looking everywhere for decent kimchi, but the only products I can find in the stores nearby are so terrible I seldom feel inclined to buy any. This kimchi tastes good and satisfies my craving. I was completely satisfied with my purchase.My order arrived very quickly, in just a couple days, even though it was the week before Christmas. Regarding the shipping costs, which some reviews had mentioned, they can be minimized by ordering multiple units together; you can have 4 shipped for the same shipping cost as 1. I have also read in other reviews that this kimchi is not very spicy but, to me, it seems about what I would expect. It has the normal amount of chili and the amounts of other spices vary. Regarding the packaging, the plastic bags used are a convenient size for shippment and storage but are not resealable; you will need to repackage whatever you don't use immediately from each bag you open.I just hope this product remains available; I would like to keep some around for snacking or adding to meals.

This is the best kimchi I have ever purchased on-line. Of course, it is not as good as my mom's kimchi but it is very close. Being half Korean, a former military kid and a kimchi eater since I was 2 years old (I have pictures!), I have to say that this kimchi is very, very good. The only downside is the portions. The bag is small. Only enough for, maybe, three servings but if you don't have ready access to kimchi (my mom is 75 years old with arthritis in both hands) then try this kimchi. The package arrived quickly and was packed well. Also, please remember that food, like beauty, is in the eye/palate of the beholder/taster. What tastes good to you may not to someone else. I have to go, I am ordering two more bags of kimchi right now.

I love the smell, texture, and taste of this product. I have tried many kinds of kimchi sold in Florida oriental markets, and they are not the quality of Korean traditional kimchi. This kimchi adds a great taste to rice, meat, and any other dishes and I have also used it to cook Kimch soup with pork and Dubu(Kimchi ZZigae). I love it. I'd thank for the direct kind phonecall from Mama Eun.

Since good Kimchi for me too, is hard to find, I decided to give this product a try.  The kimchi was excellent (as were the other meat products I purchased). It is expensive but at this point worth it.  I am hoping they will offer some sales/specials in the future

I read the reviews before purchasing this product and I have to say I was disappointed.  I acquired a taste for kimchi while I was living outside of DC and have not found any suitable since I left.  I live in a rural area and most people do not know what the word is let alone have a place to buy it.  I was really looking forward to this shipments arrival.  Well it arrived yesterday and of course I had some for dinner.  I will say it was well packed and arrived in a timely fashion but other than that I was truly disappointed not at all what I was looking for.  We all have our own tastes so others seem to like this; it is worth a try if you are jonesing like I have been for a good kimchi fix - I hope you have better luck than I did.  I a giving the item 2 stars because it was well packaged and arrived in a time manner.
Cabbage always tastes great, and is a healthy diet food for lunch or dinner.Cabbage may also be added to any other foods to help add texture.

The Kimchi was fresh and of the highest quality. The packing was superlative with frozen ice packs and foamed insulation. True, the shipping is costly but the product arrives fresh and well refrigerated. I will order again. HDW
This is not a very spicy Kimchi, it is very complex in it's flavor and goes very well with any Korean dish. I would highly recommend it to anyone.

It was super soggy. Not crisp like good Kimchi should be. I am a big fan of Kimchi and have eaten it regularly for nearly fifteen years. THIS IS THE WORST I have ever had. DO NOT WASTE your time and money buying this slop.

It's not easy to find bomba rice in the stores, though Sur La Table typically has it for a reasonable price.  Williams-Sonoma also has some, but it's a bit more expensive.  We make paella a fair amount, and using real bomba rice really makes a difference.  I've started ordering it from Amazon to avoid having to drive around to several stores to find it.  You use less than you would think because it's so absorbent, so it's a better bargain than it appears.  If you want to make authentic paella, go with bomba rice.

I had been drinking Cameron's coffee sold on Amazon and, well.....it was watery and bland. Oh, it smelled great but that's about as far as it went. So, I tried this brand instead. It is rich, creamy, smooth and soooooooooooo much better than Cameron's. Let me reiterate that again: It is SO (I'd put "SO" in bold if I could) much better than Cameron's!! I'm convinced that whatever your favorite flavor of coffee may be, this company will deliver the flavor, richness, creaminess, and robustness of the coffee that you desire. In my humble opinion, any coffee from this company is WELL-WORTH THE MONEY.  It is now my absolute favorite.
The product is great and i like the specific brand. I would like to know if they sell it in larger quantities?

column9: Coffee Master's Flavored Coffee - Caramel Kiss
column10: The best flavored coffee I have every bought.  It has the best and most consistent flavor of any coffee ever....It will not disappoint you.  It is the best of the best....Thanks,Conrad Bird....

This is the best mojito mix I've found. I tried one that was like toothpaste ( Stirrings) then I found this one. It is a nice minty-lime. I always add fresh mint and lime with the soda, and I prefer vodka to rum in mine. Wish the shipping was not so much. My local store stopped carrying it so I might just have to order it now.
This is the best taste ever I had. They melt in your mouth, leaving a sweet and salty. Good Packing and perfect bag.

This is by far my favorite olive.  You can sometimes find them in grocery stores, but they are really not that common.  The flavor is mild and buttery...even olive haters should not mind eating these.  This particular olive is imported from Italy and is a bit saltier than the ones you find in the grocery store.  They are really good...if you've never tried them you should.
Recipient loved the product.  The olives were totally consumed in less than 24 hours.  Excellent quality and freshness, packaging for shipment worked well.
These are the best olives ever - buttery and sweet but not too salty.  They arrived in quickly and in perfect condition.  Fabulous and delicious.

Amazon doesn't currently show me as a purchaser of this product for some reason; I don't know why.  I will re-order them, however; they came well-protected and taste FANTASTIC.  Much better than the long-suffering, pimento-filled olives most Americans are familiar with.

column9: Toast of jarred applesauces, and healthy too!
column10: The woman that makes this stuff knows her food chemistry! This tasty, healthy, eco-friendly snack is everything an applesauce should be. It's thicker than the usual jarred stuff, making it more of an apple compote. If you can afford it you should definitely try it! Yum!

column9: Not the best cookies, but AMAZING cake.
column10: The title says it all. For a gluten free mix, the cookies are a bit lacking but the cake that this package makes (with sour cream) is absolutely amazing. I routinely make it for pot lucks and such so I know I can eat desert... and everyone asks if I'm sure I can eat it- no one realized it's gluten free!

column4: Silvia Bridger "Publisher of The Truth About ...
column10: These gluten-free chocolate chip cookies come out of the oven tasting very similar to Pillsbury's refrigerated cookie dough.

With two children, ages 11 and 9, who cannot eat wheat products, we have tried a variety of gluten free brands and cookie mixes- but this is by far our favorite!  I can make these for a party and no one seems to notice they are gluten free- everyone can enjoy this mix.

Get the Betty Crocker mix; seriously. It is so much better -- and less expenisve -- than this horrible mix. Like another reviewer said, this mix is grainy. It makes horrible, play-doh-like, tasteless cookies. Oh, and the cookies don't rise, and they burn on the bottom. In addition, the "flour" is a strange clay color.I was really disappointed, and could barely eat the cookies. No one else would even touch them.The Betty Crocker mix, on the other hand, is delicious, and I can't make cookies fast enough for everyone.One other thing -- don't be fooled like I was -- the Gluten-Free Pantry mix does *not* come with chocolate chips. The Betty Crocker Mix does.
We thought this cookie mix was a little bit grainy tasting. I added some coconut and nuts to it and it tasted a little better but still a little grainy.
This is the best tasting gluten free chocolate chip cookie mix. I tastes a lot like the pillsbury refrigerated cookie dough. It is very easy to make and comes out great every time!

I bought these because we had great luck with another brand of gluten-free cookies and thought these were worth a try also.  They were TERRIBLE, so bad in fact that nobody would eat them.  I contacted Amazon and they graciously refunded me.  I will stick with the original brand from now on, even if these are less expensive.

I managed to find a box at the Frys Grocer for only $1.29. They are usually $5.99. I wanted to try them to see how they compared to my regular choco chip cookies. These were easy to make. I over did it on the butter and didnt realize it till just now. But they are good anyway. Kinda crispy, and I like that. Much better then the under cooker doughie ones at the mall. I would buy them again, if on sale. but I dont think i would pay $5.99 for the mix. But I did nt make the cake. So who knows.
These are as close to tasting like wheat-based chocolate-chip cookies as I've found. They pass the "delicious warm" and "delicious cold" tests with flying colors.

My family has a history of celiac disease and right now my condition is very mild, although I prefer to stay clear of all wheat and glutton that I can.  When I bought this mix I wasn't sure what to expect, but I was thrilled with how they turned out.The first tray came out about three minutes after it should have, but the cookies were still soft, golden, and crumbly.If you feed these to people who don't know that they're made with rice and potato flour, then they'd never know the difference.  The only mark that these are not wheat cookies is a slight tang in the taste.  It's minute and goes away after a while, but it's definitely there.  Most would probably just take it as something to do with the vanilla extract, probably.Seriously, these are totally worth trying out.

column9: Not a big fan of this chocolate chip cake mix
column10: We thought this cake mix was just okay.  I've made it twice and nobody really loved it.  Their chocolate cake mix is excellent, but this one just doesn't cut it.

Put it everywhere you would use Rooster Sauce for extra garlic.  Really adds a nice zing to Pot-stickers.  Skillet Breakfast is my favorite with really crunchy hash browns. Anything that needs a kick will work.

I really love these chips and have a tendency to buy in bulk.  Best for time, effort and the cost is typically better.  So, I purchased 12 bags!  Well, I open the box just recently and grabbed one bad only to realize that the seem on the back side of the bag was not sealed.  I took out another bag and realized that the 2nd bags seal was not sealed properly.  We have a quality issue that I have not addressed with the retailer or manufacturer.  I will do so this week!  So bummed!

I have to say, my corgis LOVED this popcorn! They used to bark like mad whenever we popped corn, now they sit like little angels in front of the microwave hoping it is for them.  I wish that you could purchase this in a box, instead of just a single package.  My only complaint is that the shipping was more than double the cost of the product.

I don't have a coffee maker at home, so I rely on instant coffee to get my weekend coffee fix.  The trouble I had with instant in a jar was that the coffee seemed to get stale and oxidize over time.  These single packs are very good quality coffee and are individually sealed so they stay fresh.  I also bring a few packs with me when I travel so I don't have to use the suspicious in-room coffee makers in my hotel room.  Rich flavor, good strength, and always fresh.  Good purchase.
Lemonaise! Mmm Mmm mmmm....This is the stuff! I will never go back to Mayonnaise! Natural ingredients too! What more could you ask for? I am anxious to try the other flavors too!
The flavor of this mayonaise with either chicken or potato salad is escellent.  It is a touch too strong to be used with egg salad.

This is an excellent way to add flavor to anything you would usually use regular mayo for.  This is gluten free, sugar free, and no fillers or thickeners.  Adds just a touch of lemon tartness to tuna salad, deviled eggs, and even grilled salmon. Not a replacement for mayo; more of an enhancer.Was so excited to find this on Amazon.  It is always out at our local market.Pros:o gluten, sugar, filler, and thickener freeo wonderful flavoro smooth and creamy - just like regular mayoo excellent for anyone on the SCD (Specific Carbohydrate Diet)Cons:o it is always sold out!Overall - my family loves Lemonaise.  We buy in bulk and give to all the family.
This stuff is simply scrumptious!  It blows the doors off regular mayonnaise.  That it's healthier is icing on an incredibly delicious cake.  Buy it, try it, your taste buds will thank you.

column9: Waaaay Cheaper at Whole Foods (Crazy, Right?)
column10: First off, this is a STELLAR product. Just opening the box and taking a whiff of the tea makes your eyes roll to the back of your head. And the taste of it is...pretty amazing. I get mad sugar cravings after meals and this usually does the trick to suppress them.But the price here really throws me off. One box for $5.99 PLUS shipping is an extraordinary ripoff. I got a box at Whole Foods last night for $2.49. At WHOLE FOODS. If some vendor is marking this up more than double than at the Markup Emporium that is Whole Foods, something is wrong.So, please shop around! This is a product that is definitely worth the little extra effort of finding a better deal.

I admit, I was a little reluctant to try a tea flavored like sugar cookies. Would it just taste like sweetened water? But everyone was raving about it, so I figured I had to try. And it ended up being SO delicious! I'm having a hard time describing it except to say it tastes just like sugar cookies. And you know how you get those sweet cravings after dinner? This tea could seriously stop those.You need to try this! The price may seem a little crazy with shipping, but it's definitely worth it. This stuff is really hard to find in stores (trust me, I've been trying for 2 years!) and the Internet may be your only option.It will put you in the holiday spirit :)

column9: So Delicious that you'll want more than one mugful of this tea!
column10: This tea is very tasty and has a wonderful, velvety texture in your mouth.  I am not sure how Celestial Seasonings accomplished this, but they have created buttery softness and wonderful sweetness in this enticing and aromatic caffeine free holiday tea.  Pair this with turbinado sugar and you have a delicious and soothing hot beverage.  I found this for $2.49 after the holidays at my local health food store.  Now I will have to stock up on more.  There are three other teas in the holiday selections - Nutcracker Sweet (with caffeine), Sugar Plum and Gingerbread Sweet (both caffeine-free herbal teas) and Candy Cane Lane - caffeine free green tea with other flavors.Nutcracker Sweet is a flavorful mix of black tea, vanilla and other spices.  It has a little bite as compared with this flavor - most likely from the addition of black tea.  I have yet to try to the three other flavors.

I try not to eat desserts with refined sugar, but I know the joy of them, and especially of sugar cookies. I wonder how Celesital Seasonings does it. Maybe I'm just desperate for a cookie, but this tea tastes like the "real thing." It's delicious (buttery with a hint of vanilla and lemon, not tart) and there's something very relaxing and cozy about it. It's hard to find it in the grocery store. I bought up the last 4 boxes in my local store and am searching to find more boxes to get me through the year (until next holiday season).
I love this tea. It has a wonderful aroma. The item arrived as scheduled and shipped on time. Would order again.

I bought this tea based on others' high reviews for it, but I threw it out after one cup.  it is totally flavorless.  It doesn't smell quite right either, it has a chemical smell.  I knew sugar cookie tea was too good to be true.

I really wanted to like this tea. I was hoping it was going to be my new favorite especially after reading the reviews on here. I did not like it all and ended up taking it back to the store where I bought it. Luckily Wegmans let me return it. I also only paid $1.99 for a box. If you are used to drinking vanilla tea then this will not compare. It has a wierd flavor to me and even smell. I tried one bag with just water and another with cream and sugar and still hated it. Regarding the price I can not believe it costs this much on Amazon. I suggest checking your local stores at Christmas time and stocking up if you like it. Wegmans in upstate NY has it and it is only October.

column9: TEA good PRICE not so great
column10: This tea does indeed taste very much like a sugar cookie and allows me to have some sweets with out the calories.  I don't have a sweet tooth at all but from time to time this is exactly what hits the spot.I hunted around all over where I live and found not 1 single place that has it on the shelf.  I was dying to try it and sucked it up and paid like 9 bucks for 20 tea bags.Hope this helps.
I look forward to Celestial Tea's holiday tea every winter. This tea tastes like a sweet vanilla yet light. I recommend stocking up to enjoy all year long!

I wish I could buy this tea at a local store. I would drink a ton of it! Unfortunately, this was a splurge. The price of the tea and shipping, which I think was even higher than the cost of the product, will keep me from coming back for more.

I actually didn't purchase this on Amazon, I purchased it locally at my grocery store.  I wasn't quite sure about this tea in the store, it sounded weird to have tea that tastes like cookies.  As soon as I opened the box the scent was amazing, just like sugar cookies.  After having my first cup with a touch of cream and a teaspoon of sugar, I was hooked, this is the best most unusual tea I had ever had.  In the first couple days I craved it all day long and had like 3 cups a day.  I highly recommend this tea, if you can't find it locally then it's worth the splurge to buy it online.
Read other reviews, was really surprised and disappointed. Dont bother buying, it tastes like warm water w. a splash of almond extract.  Nothing like a sugar cookie! Wasted my money.

But overpriced for just one box.  I made the mistake of ordering this and assuming I was buying a pack of six boxes, as with other Celestial Seasonings flavors.  My own fault for not reading the description more carefully.  Lesson learned - read the description carefully so you know exactly what you're supposed to be getting.
I love these things, especially the Light Bites version. I have a packet nearly every day for my afternoon snack. The protein keeps me full until dinner, and I feel like I'm cheating when I'm not!
Awesome taste, chewy cookies, and they have a ton of protein! If you need a healthy snack but don't have time to make something every day for work, get these!
The service was great.  They sent the item right away and even gave a little sample.  The chocolate marshmeelows were great as well.

I received a birthday gift of these chocolates and was eager to dive in. Unfortunately they were a gloppy mess having melted during the shipping process by US MAIL. I don't know if they are good or not. What a disappointment. Shouldn't perishables be shipped another way? I won't order these chocolates again till maybe November.

column9: Did wonders for my cat with multiple medical issues.
column10: Switched to this food when my kitty was newly diagnosed as a Diabetic earlier this year; as I wanted a high-protein, no-carb diet for him without all the fillers & junk in most foods...especially since he already suffers from Inflammatory Bowel Disease & reacts poorly to most foods.  To my & the Vet's great surprise, at his first follow-up appointment, his blood sugar had normalized to the point that they took him off his insulin!  AND, within a couple of weeks on this diet exclusively, the frequent bouts of bloody diarrhea he'd been suffering stopped as well.  I'm keeping all my fingers & toes crossed, but so far, this food has been amazing.  I only wish I'd found it sooner!

We have two old orange male cats. They both developed urinary tract issues over the past year. The Hills Prescription diet they were placed on cost a fortune and of course, neither one of them would eat it.Researching brand after brand, we found that Merrick has a low ash content, is not crammed with fillers and both cats love it. Taking them off a life-time of dry food (little did we know how bad it was for their health) was not easy at first, but with Merrick, they both love the turkey and the chicken. The obese one has lost weight and looks great. He went from 24lbs and is now down to 18.4lbs. The skinny one has maintained his weight. Both no longer are experiencing repeat urinary track infections.

column9: The ONLY non-nonsense commercial cat food on the market !
column10: I've been doing some research on best cat food, and apparently cats as obligate carnivores fair much better on eating exclusively meat. And, since they don't usually have a strong drive to drink, even though they need plenty of water, they also fair much better on eating exclusively canned food.So, going through a variety of food, I've noticed that even the so called "grain-free" food, contains BS ingredients like "cranberry" or "carrots". So, really, whom do they try to appeal, the cat or their gullible owner who thinks that if eating veggies is good for people, they must be also good for cats. Plus, even "grain-free" diet contain broth and liver. The cats may like it better than just plain meat, but it's not best for them. The best meat for cats is pure, bland meat.So while may be inferior to raw diet (though much more convenient), Merick Before Grain, is the best canned food I could find for my cats. Since it (1) has no grains (2) has no BS marketing ingredients (i.e. fruits & veggies) (3) Contains just meat, not meat by-product, liver or broth.So, do my cats love it? Nope. Did they it initially ate it? Nope. But with some patience, and some creativity (like mixing with other food) they start eating it. Reluctantly. Do they love it now? Nope. Do they eat it. Yes: slowly and reluctantly. So here's another benefit of this food (4) Cats (at least mine) don't choke themselves until vomit eating it. They eat it slowly over a period of stretched time. Like overnight. And that's good for them: to eat slowly over a stretched period of time (since that's how they eat in nature).Most people are running back and forth, worrying if their cats hasn't finished their canned food within an hour. But people need not worry leaving cooked canned meat for many hours, since cats often eat decomposing carcasses in nature and are ok, they will be certainly ok eating canned meat that was left there for a while. Healthy cats have strong stomachs with an acidity so high that it destroys most food-poisoning bacteria.I do give my cats some variety, like Wellness Grain-Free canned food which they love(even though it has some BS ingredients, liver & broth). But this food remains their  staple diet.Now, a note of caution: even though there are 6 varieties of this food, I recommend only three of them to be fed on regular basis: 1 Chicken, 4 Turkey & 5 Quail. On occasional basis 2 Salmon & 3 Tuna are ok, but fish may trigger allergies in cats, and fish was not in regular diet of cats' ancestors. For that matter I would be cautious with 6 Beef as well, since cats haven't evolved to pray on Cows, and I don't think the red meat is very healthy for them.

My cats have totally enjoyed all of the Before Grain flavors, but the #1 is their number 1 - I think next favorite for them is #5, then so on. They like it and I like the ingredients list - although I do wish there were no carageenan, it's thumbs up (or paws)There is no excess water, this is meat for the cats - no fluff - I add a bit of water and they like that.  This food always results in a clean dish and happy cats.
I recently switched to this brand from Weruva. I have a fourteen year old cat who gets constipated sometimes. Since I switched to Before Grain this problem has largely cleared up.

Ghirardelli semi sweet chocolate chips are worth the extra expense.  They taste like chocolate and are not as sweet as their counterparts.  Now, if only I could get my husband to stop eating them out of the bag.

Recently found recipe(blueberry scone recipe from America's Test Kitchen) that tastes very much like the mini chocolate chips scones from wildflower bread company in Sedona, AZ.  So had to get GOOD mini chocolate chips and these fit the bill.

I've been buying this juice concentrate for months now (at the supermarket) and I love it. The price here is a little more than what I would pay at the grocery store, so I've decided to keep buying it this way. I just had to say something about the poorly-researched negative comments here.Pasteurization is not "nuking". It has nothing to do with radiation; it's just a heating process. The juice is heated before being sealed in the can to kill any microbes that may be present. Many food items that can be stored at room temperature before opening have been pasteurized.Since you add your own water to this concentrate, the quality of your water determines the quality of the juice. If you have heavy water or a detectable amount of chlorination (like in city water), it's probably not a great idea to make juice mix with it. It isn't going to taste right.Additionally, since you mix it yourself, you determine the concentration (sweetness) of the juice. I typically dilute the juice to 64oz of water instead of the recommended 48oz. For one of the other two flavors, there's a one-star review that complains about the sweetness level of this concentrate. I cannot begin to describe how wrong this is. Maybe the reviewer drank the concentrate directly out of the can.

I bought some juicy juice from Target recently.  It had "Product of China" on the package.  I won't take the risk of giving Juicy Juice to my children let alone given all the recent problems coming out of China involving poisened pet food, toothpaste, etc.  Why take the risk?  People from China living in the U.S. would rather not eat or drink anything from China.  Take it from me - I am Chinese and all of my Chinese friends say the same thing.

column4: Heather L. Parisi "Robert and Heather Parisi"
column9: CONVENIENCE IS A NICE FEATURE IN A NATURAL FOOD!
column10: A NEW PRODUCT FROM JUICY JUICE IS ANOTHER WINNER FROM JUICY JUICESimply stated, this is concentrate that need NOT be refrigerated until after you open it. You can make 48 oz. from each can, just like evaporated milk. According to 'Juicy Juice's' Website, this new concentrated form is available in Apple, Berry, Cherry, Grape, Kiwi Strawberry, Punch, and White Grape.TASTES LIKE THIS CAN'T POSSIBLY BE 100% JUICE!,JUICY JUICE'S MISSION: STOP BUYING SODA FOR YOUR KIDS: BUY JUICY JUICE, is a simultaneously self-serving and altruistic mission."Juicy Juice Berry"- A MOST PALATABLE VARIETY OF JUICY JUICY:This is one of my favorite varieties of Juicy Juicy. Why is it? It is very palatable and obviously very sweet. However, there is none of the high fructose syrup in it that is added to other punches. Afterall, this is 100% juice.So what's in this stuff?: NO ARTIFICIAL COLORS - FLAVORS OR SUGAR ADDED!Apple Juice, Grape Juice, Raspberry Juice (Water, Juice Concentrates) Natural Flavors, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Citric Acid. It is the combination of juices in this blend that makes this taste like a treat. For children and adults too, who like the sweet taste of soda pop or sweetened punches, this product represents a much healthier and palatable alternative.For providing this excellent, anti-oxidant rich alternative, as a compromise between healthy beverages and sugar sweetened drinks, I feel that "Juicy Juice Fruit Berry" has easily earned a five star rating.Now if only there were a way to decrease the amounts of natural sugars without affecting the taste?!WHAT IS THE "JUICY JUICE" BRAND?:Libby's "Juicy Juice Fruit Berry, 46 fl oz" is part of a larger family of 100% juice products that has taken aim at the huge market share that Coke and Pepsi have carved out for themselves. Their target market is the youth of America. That, more than anything else, makes this and other Libby's products important. I first became aware of this targeting when I was watching the PBS program "Arthur" with my youngest child (who is named Arthur). At the end of the show there was a message from Libby's that said, "Juicy Juice Is Proud To Support Arthur". Since then I have regularly supported their 100% juice products, although I drink more of them than our Arthur does. Surprisingly, most "Juicy Juice" products are significantly less expensive than "Ocean Spray" and "Northland" juices, though I still buy some of those varieties as well.THE INEVITABLE COMPROMISE:Though many critics and health advocates have pointed out that fruit juices are naturally high in sugar and after processing, including pasteurization, lose many of their healthful properties, they still represent a healthful alternative to soda for children. Surprisingly this seems to be a controversial statement, but 100% juice [with a little Vitamin C added] does help to engender healthful eating habits which begin with the choice of beverage. It is also a good source of potassium and is an excellent thirst quencher.It doesn't hurt that all of these juices taste very palatable to kids, probably because they are blended to taste sweet without any added sugar. Of course, it would be better to make your own juice, avoid pasteurization [made in a very clean environment], and include the natural vitamins, minerals and pulp, but who really has time. What's more, do you really think a child would drink such a homemade healthy brew? In the meantime, there is "Juicy Juice" and our children will most probably drink that thereby avoiding soda.LOOKING FOR MORE INFO?:To find out more about this product, see their website at "juicyjuice" on the world wide web. They have several useful links to pediatric nutrition sites and "Frequently Asked Questions" about their products.[I AM NOT AFFILIATED WITH THIS OR ANY OTHER PRODUCT]

Look at Juicy Juice GRAPE Juice.  It has a nice PURPLE label.  It says GRAPE JUICE.  READ the ingredients.The #1 ingredient is NOT grape juice.  It's APPLE JUICE.  The same with their "orange" juice.  It's NOT orange juice at all with its pretty orange label.  It's APPLE JUICE.  Watch your ingredients.

.....SUBTITLE:  READ THE E N T I R E....DESCRIPTION CAREFULLY OF ANYTHING  YOU BUY!JUICY JUICE has a reputation for being 100% juice.  Always!  No additives, preservatives....and even no extra sweeteners!  It isalso often regarded as a children's beverage -- and to me, thatmeans the manufacturers have taken EXTRA care that the product isas good as can be.  After all, no manufacturer wants to be accusedof giving health problems, (now or in the future), or even out-right poisoning, children!  To me, a product specifically made forchildren, (and/or usually associated with children's eating ordrinking it), is often, (but not always), an inexpensive way to getgourmet -- or almost gourmet -- quality food at a good price.I've had Juicey Juice before...and enjoyed it immensely.  But -- theJuicy Juice I have heretofore imbibed was the "real McCoy", (no, no-- NOT the Chief Medical Officer of the original Star Ship 'Enter-prise' -- but 'real McCoy" as in the "genuine article".  THAT JuiceyJuice, (forget which flavour), came in a large BOTTLE, and had to beREFRIGERATED.  But wow....did it taste good!  : ),Yet, any bottled juice contains a LOT of water.  So -- why not buy theconcentrate, and add your OWN water?  It should cost less this way --why spend money on water you can get out of a tap for, (almost) free?(Excluding the ubiquitous water tax, in most instances.)  As Itrust only my own, home-made distilled water, buying the concentratedJuicey Juice seemed to make sense two ways -- if not three.  (1. Iused my own home-distilled water, 2.) Ounce for ounce, re-constitutedconcentrate HAS to cost less than juice in big bottles and 3.)  It leftmore room in my refrigerator....AND on my shelf.For this is not the usual FROZEN concentrate, you see.  It is "un-frozenconcentrate."  That doesn't need to take up valuable space in thefreezer -- or even the refrigerator, at least till it is opened. On topof all this, it is all-natural Juicey Juice.  How could I resist THISbargain?  How could I miss with it?Well -- as soon as I opened up a can, (admittedly fitted with a veryconvenient flip-top), diluted it as per instructions, and tasted it --I KNEW I had "missed".  And missed Big-Time.  The flavour was absolutelyAWFUL!  It tasted as if MEDICINE, on top of the WORST-tasting of CHEMICALS, including a LARGE dollop of MACHINE OIL!  I definitely believe it could send many crewmen TO Dr. McCoy's sickbay on Star Trek.  It surely made ME feel sick!  I was also shocked and saddened.  In oomplete disbelief, I looked at the ingredient label again.  It said:  Apple Juice Concentrate  Water  Grape Juice Concentrate  Natural Flavors  Raspberry Juice Concentrate  Ascorbic Acid, (Vitamin C)  Citric AcidNope -- nothing wrong with the ingredients.  No motor oil, either. Theingredients -- they were all natural, as always advertised.  And this is a juice usually served to CHILDREN!  Cofusionmixed with great disappointment filled my mind.  I began to wonderabout the poisons I have heard that occur naturally.  Poisoned mush-rooms, perhaps?  But no mushroom of any sort was listed amongst theingredients.....Were my taste-buds going into pre-mature old age, perhaps?  SOMETHINGhas to go first, according to the popular view.  NOBODY reaches 90without SOME loss of faculties -- or almost nobody, anyway, so most people suppose. I guess I've been lucky in meeting mostly youthfully-minded and spirited 90+ year-olds in my life. But not everyone is that way, even I must admit.  But YIKES....I'm nowhere NEAR 90. (yet, anyway.)I sighed.  Better my taste-buds go first, than my eyes, or my legs...I tried drinking it straight.  Then, more diluted than was called for.  Ulgh, and double ulgh.  Then with the proper 3 cans of water to one can of Juicy Juice dilution.  Ulgh!  No matter how I tried to make it, the flavor didn't improve.  At all.... ):Still disbelieving, I looked again, this time VERY CAREFULLY at the label.  And I noticed something written there I hadn't noticed before.T H I S....P R O D U C T....I S....P A S T E U R I Z E D..( ! )  Not even written in small lettering -- but this notice WAS below all the other information on the label....Pasteurized!  In common slang, "nuked". I suppose, being a NON-FROZENooncentrate, SOMETHING had to be done to the Juicey Juice to keep it fresh.  I've heard that Vitamin E makes a dandy preservative -- but it probably is MUCH more expensive than nuking -- excuse me, pasteurizing! -- the Juicey Juice.  I mean, pasteurization really doesn't harm the juice, as far as health considerations go.  But -- it DOES make the juice taste like motor oil -- and USED motor oil at that!So, I guess I'll go back to either regular bottled juice, (including bottled Juicey Juice), or FROZEN concenrate.  (As much as admire the tv series ALIEN NATION, with Tenctonese aliens who drink sour milk, eat newspapers, and adore cooking all kinds of bugs -- this unfrozen Juicy Juice concentrate is NOT to my (Human) taste.  Sorry.  Then again -- I wonder if even a fictional Tenctonese, (and former slave), could stomache this stuff either.  Motor oil is NOT something evem the Tenctonese imbibed on the show.......I wish the taste of Juicy Juice Non-Frozen concentrate could be changed.But I doubt whether even a pound of sugar in each 11.5 ounce can could help.  (Before buying this, I was disappointed to see an extra .5 ounce had been eliminated from the usual 12 ounce can.  But after drinking the stuff, I was immeasurably grateful it had been taken off!I knew I could not throw it out.  I had paid money for it, and I was not brought up to be wasteful.Yes, I knew I had bought this....this ....stuff...and the taste was....well, on a score of1-10, it was about a 3...so I knew I could, and would, finish all 12bottles of concentrate, for I was not brought up to waste things.However......no one was telling me I had to drink them quickly.  Painis sometimes better when it's spread out.  Maybe....I could stretchthis stuff out, drinking a few ounces a week, to lessen the pain ofdrinking it all at once?  Maybe drinking it while watching my favourite cable channel -- the SyFy channel -- would lessen the blow....?  No, I suddenly thought -- drinking this horrible-tasting liquid whilst watching the SyFy channel, of all things, was definitely NOT a good idea.  Maybe....I could take it better watching a comedy?  A musical?  Or better yet, a musical comedy?  Then, THE perfect time to drink this this...juice...came to me.  The time when I felt not worse, not scared -- but at my best.  The day AFTER I file my income taxes!  And maybe on my birthday, and the 4th of July....when my happiness could, perahps, overwhelm the complete awfulness of the taste of this...this...stuff. Maybe I could pass it off on some friends, during a Halloween party?  No -- I like and value my friends to pass THIS stuff onto them.  Hmmm....maybe as a "gift", should I ever need to give one, to my ex-brother-in-law?  (This guy once told me: "You are 6 years younger than I am, and I'll never forgive you for it", amongst other choice morsels.  He has always had a chip on his shoulder as big as the Grand Canyon.)  Hmmm...maybe not. If I give him THIS, that chip on his shoulder may get as big as a crater on the moon!...It's amazing how GOOD regular, bottled Juicy Juice can taste -- and how totally awful this unfrozen concentrate is.  But at least I know the reason WHY now.  The old poem has it WRONG: "Their's was not to reason why, their's was just to drink....er, do....or die."  I looked at the can, and I now KNOW why it tastes so BAD.  (The information about this concentrate being pasteurized is also on the Amazon description of it,but it is NOT highlighted, so it's easy to pass by.)Well, live and learn.  Hey.............I've got it!  Instead of executing criminals, they should have to drink this stuff, at every meal, for a year.  I don't think every criminal will beg for the death penalty after this....but many surely will!

column9: Hands down best popcorn you can get outside of a theater
column10: I often wonder if I am the only person in the world who cannot stand microwave popcorn.  Give me real corn and a little oil and I am pretty happy.  Then I discovered this popcorn at a kitchen store in my local outlet.  Then they went out of business and I lost my awesome popcorn connection... until now.Wabash Valley Farms is the best popcorn you can get outside of your local multi-plex (though I really like target popcorn too).  You don't need the whirly popper as indicated on the package instructions - I always cook it on the stovetop in a large covered pot; my sister cooks it in one of those fancy carnival poppers.Each pack contains 5 pouches of product. Each pouch contains popping oil, popcorn, and a buttery salt topping (which I only use about half of - it is very fine and very salty). For those that like additional butter, you can add it after popping.  While I cannot attest to the exact amount of popcorn yielded, it does do a good job of filling up my 32-cup Tupperware Thatsa bowl.  Thatsalotta popcorn.The unit cost is $1.66 per pouch, which may seem high when comparing it to microwave popping corn, but you just cannot compare the quality and taste (and when compared to theater popcorn, it is a fraction of the cost). Orville Redenbacher has nothing on Wabash!
Taste just like the movies. Just add your own butter. No extra salt needed. Absolutely delicious. Unfortunately it went from five packs to three packs. I am not sure it's really worth it now.
Delicious popcorn!  Doesn't take any longer to make than a standard microwave popcorn, but much more flavorful!  If you love fresh popcorn, this is the way to go!

It is nice to have it all in one place. The corn is nice. The grease tastes good. It comes with seasoning (orange salt). It is all together and easy.The only problem is that it is a little on the expensive side and takes up a little more room.

column9: Nothing comes closer to movie theater popcorn
column10: We ate microwave popcorn for years.  Then I decided to try this.  Wow!  It is really like eating popcorn from the movie theater.  We will still use microwave popcorn for convenience every so often.
Have bought this brand before and now it is better than ever.  Better than the popcorn at most shows.  You will not be disappointed.

Yum, Yum, Yum, Yum...  (Munch, munch).  Yum!  Love it and it tastes wonderful.  Works perfect in a whirly-popcorn maker.  They best compliment is when the kids ask, can we make another batch, and they like it better than the movie.  Our friends have tried it and have asked for what we use as our popcorn recipe.  How cool is that!?

Great popcorn!  I'm a repeat buyer too.  One pack makes just a teeny bit more than my Whirly Pop can hold with the lid closed.  The kernels pop big and have a great flavor.  The hulls are farely tame for big kernels. My only suggestion for Wabash Valley Farms would be to boost the butter flavor just a smidge.  Maybe I'm old fashioned but popcorn popped on the stove top is so much better than microwaved.

column9: This is as close to movie theater (or disneyland) popcorn as you can make at home!
column10: I have ordered this product twice.  The box contains 5 packets inside, and each packet contains the liquid oil, the flavored salt, and the popcorn kernels.  Easy to make and surprisingly good, far better than any microwave popcorn and I have tried many brands.  You can make this in a large cooking pot with a lid.  They suggest you use something called a "Whirly Pop Popper" but its not necessary to buy that.  I have a gas stove, so so I set the heat to medium, pour in just the the oil first, let it heat a few minutes, then I drop in the salt and kernels.  Cover and gently shake a few times during popping and enjoy.  My family agrees this is the real deal.

First off, I must say I love my Whirley Pop popcorn popper.  Secondly, this popcorn is the best popcorn I have ever tried with it.  It tastes so much like movie theater popcorn.  I will continue ordering it!

I own a whirly pop and bought another brand of popcorn (similar to this) to compare to and this is hands down the winner. It truly taste like theater popcorn. It is light, crunchy and well delicious! I tested the brands with family and friends and we are all in agreement. I would like to note that some bags appear to be more salty than others, but I know I can always leave out some of the powder that is part of the kit. This will be only popcorn I purchase in the future.
i have a hand cranked whirley popper and this popcorn tastes great!  I also have three kids so when we have a movie night at home one bag will do the trick.
Best popcorn we ever had at home, and better than most fresh popped elsewhere!Thanks for such a good product.
I love this product. The taste is as good or better than real movie theatre pop corn and it is fast and easy to prepare.
Bought the Whirley Pop previously and it came with a sample pack of this popcorn and it turned out great...I was not dissapointed with this - absolutely the best.
The only thing wrong with this product is that you'll want to eat the whole batch when you pop it.  It will make your taste buds come alive!
TASTE JUST LIKE THEATRE POPCORN AS ADVERTISED.  IT'S REALLY GOOD OT HAVE FOR A NIGHT AT THE MOVIES AT HOME.

column9: A cereal for a sophisticated taste
column10: I have tried all the FAMILIA cereals- I think there are 6- muesli and granolas - by trial and error this one - Familia Low-Fat- is for me perfect because  I don't like the granolas that are sweetened with honey-  The Original Style Familias are really mostly just oatmeal and a few raisons - not a great value. This one has lots of fruits and nuts without being too sweet.Drei

column4: David De Sousa "The Automation and Control Guy"
column9: An Excellent and Healthy Choice for Anyone's Diet

You can't go wrong and the best of all: excellent taste and quality, and for a pack of six this comes at a good value. The fact that this cereal is low-fat makes a good product even better if you are trying to lose some weight or wanting to keep in shape.Sometimes your diet will require you eat frequently and consciously, and in those cases you need to have a snack at hand when you get hungry, in order to keep your metabolism high all day long. In such cases finding a good and balance option could be hard. I love this 6-pack and I always have one at home an another pack at the office. I try to eat five or more times a day, so in my case having a healthy snack at hand wherever I am when I get hungry is a priority.Since you are checking this product I have to guess that you are probably a person that cares about what you eat, either because you are interested in losing weight, getting in better shape or just be healthier and keep in good shape, so I will share my own experience in the weight loss game and staying in shape gameMy own successful personal experience in weight loss is based on strategies to boost metabolism. If you exercise, or want to start doing it right, the last threee are for you. If you do both, all the recommended options can improve your results.I am 39 years old, With the help of the tools I just mentioned not only I went fro size 44 to size 32 pants, but also obtained substantial benefits that included weight control, cardiovascular improvements, lowered blood pressure, and improved muscular-skeletal strength and flexibility, but also the myriad of mental and psychological benefits derived from being in the best shape of my life.Get this 6-pack of Low-fat Muesli to help your 6-pack ABS.

Like another reviewer, I've sampled a number of the other Familia mueslis, and other granolas and mueslis at stores.This is the superior muesli.  (I'm eating some now to make sure I get this right...)  I wouldn't think of myself as a muesli commentator, but this stuff is surprisingly good so I had to chime in.It has a good selection of dried fruit and nuts, plus a bit of dried rice and corn flakes for texture.  I wasn't particularly looking for low-fat but that's a bonus.Very tasty to eat!  I eat it with breakfast, and often as dessert after dinner.Enjoy...

column9: Convenient home delivery of Familia Low-Fat Muesli
column10: I've found purchasing this cereal via Amazon to be the most convenient and economical way to obtain the product on a regular basis.  And, if I'm not consuming as much and don't need a delivery, I can skip one.  The cartons arrive six per pack and are delivered to my door.  What could be better?  Plus, it's a product that's sometimes hard to find, and at most grocery stores, its price is at a premium.

This cereal tastes great, isn't high in calories, is low sugar, and has plenty of fiber. It has dried bananas and dates which add to the taste. I usually have one cup cereal, one cup light or nonfat milk, and sliced fruit. It makes a terrific breakfast or lunch. I've ordered the six-pack many times and still enjoy the flavor of this cereal. Highly recommended.

I love the fruit and nuts!  Honestly, they taste like they are freshly roasted.  And they are generously provided in each serving.I subscribe to this cereal and receive an added 15% discount.  Love that!Most cereal in this category delivers 5 grams of fiber, and I prefer 6-8 grams.  That's why I rate it 4-stars.  I increase my daily Metamusel intake by a couple of grams to compensate!I sprinkle some ground flax seed to top it off, this adds a touch more fiber too.Very chewy and a serving is rated at 2/3 cup, so this is a verry dense cereal. Have been eating this breakfast cereal for several years and think it's excellent.  It's not particularly sweet and has great crunch that holds up to the milk down to the last mouthful and it doesn't feel twiggy.  I also think it's good value per ounce compared to the usual grocery aisle cereals which are horribly overpriced.
Familia Low-Fat Muesli, 21-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)TERRIFIC CEREAL...WILL DEFINATELY PURCHASE AGAIN...

column9: Love these - SO easy to use in soups and stews!
column10: Lentils have one of THE lowest Glycemic Indexes of any food and are SO good for you.  I was happy to find this product and have set it up on automatic delivery for once a month.  We eat a lot of soups and stews and it is easy to add a bag of these lentils that don't have to cook nearly as long as regular lentils and they add so much to the dish.  I have been telling my friends about them as I haven't seen them at the grocery stores.  Fine product.

These are NOT anything other than plain, uncooked lentils.  The SAME ones you get for a few dollars at the supermarket.Having, purchased, cooked and eaten, many types of lentils, I think I'd know the difference between a precooked, freeze dried lentil and a pain, uncooked, off the shelf type.There's laws regarding false advertising.  I'm going to look into this.  This company is making a fortune, selling you something for over $30...... that you could get for a fraction of that sum, locally.....  wherever you live...
Just got these in the mail, and they are not precooked, nor are they freeze-dried. They are just regular dried lentils.  Amazon refunded my purchase price.
The lemon has something in it that burns the tongue.  I'm not sure which ingredient but I was very disappointed when I found out I could not eat them.

column9: Not generic cornflakes- healthy gluten free crunch-
column10: Please note: These are not your generic store brand cornflakes. They are high in fiber (from psyllium) and low in salt for those who care. With only a "hint of golden syrup" from cane sugar, the flavor may seem bland to many people, but I find it to be a nice departure from the overly sweet and/or high sodium cereals on the market. Nutritional breakdown for 1 cup (50 grams!- note most servings are 30g) calories: 190, 2g of fat; sodium: 3%! dietary fiber 20% (5g) protein 3g; iron 15%. These are sturdy little flakes, like tiny little clam shells and hold up well in liquid. I would definitely recommend and for those who want to spice it up- add some bananas/dried fruits and yogurt or other dairy/non-dairy beverage- great start to the day!

column9: ended up not being a bargain after all
column10: I ended up comparing the value of this item, a little too late, after I had paid for it.  The size was wrong, the cost was ridiculous in comparison to any otherplaces selling the correct items.  You live and learn, I suppose.

I am going to start taking it more regularly in hopes that it will help with my allergies as well.Don't dismiss this particular brand because of the one negative review. column9: One of the best Apple Cider Vinegar tabs you can buy!
column10: This is a very strong tab, that you will definitely taste. I however find that the overall benefits of consuming apple cider vinegar are felt with this tab. Everything from the carbohydrate control, to the diuretic effects on the body.I read the other reviewer stating the product never came, that is no reason to rate it 1 star, seriously, this is a great product.

The item was ordered and I waited a long time for it's arrival and was finally told it was on back order,but it still didn't arrive.I contacted Amazon about it and they made sure my money was refunded.

Hard to break, they don't leak, they stand upright on their own... MUCH better than plastic versions of the same thing.

I use these to store my own spices and home-made salad dressings to take to work.  They are excellent storage, haven't leaked on me yet, can be boiled to sterilize and have no BPA.  I have no complaints at all.

I wanted containers to store Holy Water and give as gifts.  Most containers I found were either cheap-looking, way overpriced, leaky, and/or the wrong size.  These were perfect.  They are a nice size, seal without leaks, and I was able to decorate them with "glass-friendly" markers.  They were also packaged well with a lot of bubble wrap.  The package arrived in a timely manner and all were in tact.  Great buy!
the perfect size for my purse!  i am extremely pleased :) they are much prettier than the picture shows. I will be ordering more in the future

good product. works as described, only thing that got me worried was it was sent in a small tight box by the vials themselves. Could have been broken or damaged, but carrier handled product well.Good use, will try it for cooking condiments on the go!
I loved this Chai tea.  It was better than I expected, and I felt it was a great price.

I have been drinking Davidson Rooibos tea and enjoying it. I ordered this Rooibus Spiced Davidson's Tea Rooibos Spiced Chai, 100-Count Tea BagsChai tea to give me a more flavorful tea for the holidays and it is wonderful. I would highly recommend it. They ship quickly and the packaging is nice.

column9: Nothing helps my IBS faster or more effectively!
column10: It is unfortunate that the previous reviewer seems to have misunderstood that this tea is for medicinal purposes. If you suffer from IBS, this is the fastest and best way to get relief from bloating or painful gas. It is true that it is not the tastiest of teas, but I am personally not a fan of fennel anyway.  However, when I am in pain from my IBS, I will gladly (even gratefully) drink this tea.  It has been a serious blessing to me and an absolute staple in my kitchen/medicine cabinet. Thank you Heather VanVorous!!!
About the only tea I can drink anymore, due to GI issues. (Hope that isn't TMI). Stuff tastes good, soothes the gut, and is a good value.

I started buying this salsa about 2 years ago on a whim. It was a little more expensive then I would normally buy, but after the first bite I knew why. This salsa has a heavier texture than most and pairs well with a thicker chip. It's not spicy, but it does have a full flavor. Occasionally I noticed an extra kick of vinegar, but this varied bottle to bottle. My only problem is that I am now hooked, but many of the supermarkets around me stopped carrying it. column9: Value for price is not good, just go to the grocery store
column10: I thought that "85 pieces" seemed like a lot, enough to justify the price. I was wrong. Went to the grocery store the day after this smaller than anticipated bag of candy arrived and saw comparable options for less than 1/5 of the price I paid here. Not worth it.

I have always been pleased with the products I've ordered from AmAzon, but not this time! I wanted this candy for Halloween but it is awful. The chocolate looks like it has melted on some of the bars and all that we have tried tastste funny. The chocolate ihas turned white on much of hit. I am very disappointed!!!

At the recommendation of my sister, I ordered this product through Amazon and got it within two days on the Prime program.  I Got two bags for less than one I had previous purchased at Wal-Mart.  I am loving it.  This is a great product to mix with smoothies for colon health.  It really does work for me especially the price.

I bought this item based on health reasons, reviews of the product here and all the great information on the internet about the benefits of adding flax seeds to my daily diet.  I also bought a mini coffee grinder just for this product.  At first I tried to chew it, ugh... it takes a lot of hard work, I felt like a cow chewing cud and the flavor is extremely, uh... earthy. I add it to everything and it makes a great addition to my healthy diet.  The seeds look fresh, clean and healthy.  They almost looked too perfect with a nice shiny shell. I would recommend this specific product to anyone who wants to add a bit of health to their daily diet.  I'll more likely than not be ordering more of this stuff in the near future at the rate that I've been chowing down on it.

column9: Awesome once you get the mixture right!
column10: I disagree totally with the above posters but knew what I was looking for from the start. I discovered a circle k with this drink in a granita machine and loved it so much I was there everyday. Their machine broke down about 3 weeks later and 2 months later it's still not fixed. Of course in the days of Internet, ask and ye shall receive! You do have to mess around with the amount since a gallon at a time is obviously not often needed but once you have your 'recipe' down it tastes great and the energy boost is better then any canned energy drink I have tried. I am assuming it must be my own body's need for b vitamins though. Different energy drinks seem to affect each person variously.

column9: Tang Energy FROZEN Beverage Drink Mix
column10: The item description is incorrect. The actual package says "Tang Energy FROZEN Beverage Drink Mix". Directions are for a GRANITA STYLE MACHINE that makes slushies TWO gallons at a time. All I wanted was a Tang Energy Drink Mix. I've been experimenting to discover the right portions for a water bottle, no luck. So I really can't speak to the Energy Boost, B Vitamins OR Caffeine, BUT I can speak to the weak lemonade flavor described by the other reviewer...he's right!I was expecting Tang with an energy kick. What I got was some pretty expensive flavored water you have STILL doctor up with inconsistent results ... 1 STAR and a SNAP!

I discovered Tang Energy on a road trip to Charlotte, North Carolina to see Flogging Molly.  Me and my fellow travelers stopped at a convenience store to both use the restroom and ask for directions and stumbled upon a Granita Machine with the Tang logo on it.  What drew us to the beverage was the B vitamins and the Caffeine content.  Little did I know that I was going to be starting what could arguably become an addiction.Every one of us filled a 32 oz cup of this wonderful product and went on our way.Let me just say this, yes, this is the energy drink mix for making frozen slushy drinks, but it is perfectly acceptable as a straight up energy drink.  Unlike people who bought this and made their own own mixtures, I went to the local discount store, bought a 2.5 gallon dispenser to put in the fridge and I mix it two gallons at a time.  You don't need a granita machine and you don't need to drink it frozen.The mix is easy.  1 gallon + 1 pouch = ecstasy.True to the advertisement, each 8oz of Tang Energy Drink mix has 60gm of Caffeine as well as a dose of B Vitamins that really do a great job of packing a megaton of energy content into a great tasting brew of pure heaven.  A single 8oz serving DOUBLES the caffeine content of a can of soda, a cup of coffee and many energy drinks on the market that taste like medicine.  This is tang, but it's better than Tang.  I drink regular tang on a regular basis and this is sweeter, has more of an orange creme-cicle taste to it and it has the added benefit of supercharging your system.  The drink has NONE of the normal medicinal taste that energy drinks have.  They don't have the sweet-followed-by-bitter aftertaste.  I take a gulp of this and there is NO CLUE that what you are drinking is loaded with caffeine or B Vitamins.  I cannot stress this enough...  You have no idea what you are drinking is an 'energy drink' until you've had too much and your heart is racing.The closest I've come to finding a product this good is the fellow Crystal Light Energy line made by Kraft (the same company that makes this masterpiece).  They have they same energy giving caffeine and vitamin content, but lack the sugar and sweeteners.DO NOT buy this unless you intend to make a gallon (it actually ends up being almost 1.25 gallons after mixing) and drink it religiously.  THIS has replaces $3 a pop energy drinks and about 6 cans of soda a day in my life and for that alone it gets 5 stars.

column9: Not the Tang I remember as a child
column10: Was trying to order Tang orange drink but costs, with shipping, were higher than previous order.  So, I ordered this product thinking it was just packaged differently.  My error! No picture or description was available.  Not the same Tang powdered drink I was familiar with.  More like a weak lemonade if you use only a scoop or two.  Need to use at least three teaspoons of powder to get any kind of taste.  Product okay, especially if heated up in the microwave.  Product would probably be okay if you need to make a large volume of beverage -- but you have to use a lot of product to get any taste.  Will not order this particular product again.
Tastes more like a bland, unsweetened lemonade than anything orange. I've been blending it in -- 50/50 -- with regular orange tang powder for a little caffeine zing. Tastes good that way.

column9: They came as expected and a great deal!
column10: We ordered these for the office and were quite pleased with the cost and quality of the saf-t-pops.They arrived on time and I am pleased to say that none were broken!

*****Stash's Organic Premium Lemon Ginger Green Tea has the pure, true flavor of ginger and lemongrass---not flavorings.
