Honest Ade's Orange Mango with Mangosteen is currently my favorite bottled drink. It has 100 calories per bottle and is caffeine-free. This drink combines three organic flavors from three of my favorite fruits - orange, mango, and mangosteen. The taste is just right - not too bland and not too sweet. This is what the co-founders of Honest Tea and Honest Ade, wrote on the sleeve of this bottled drink - "Patience may be a virtue, but not when you're thirsty. We got tired of waiting for a great-tasting organic citrus drink with a lot less sugar than OJ but still a full day's vitamin C. So we made one ourselves and - for an extra boost - added some mangosteen, a delicious antioxidant-rich fruit from Thailand. Our Orange Mango thirst quencher is a taste worth waiting for, but now you don't have to." What the co-founders, Seth and Barry, wrote perfectly captures why this bottled drink is great. There are not that many bottled drinks with mangosteen in it, so that's why I love this drink. This drink is USDA organic, and I love how they have quotes from famous people printed behind the sleeves of their plastic bottled drinks. For example, the two bottled Honest Ades I drank today, have these following quotes: "I would rather regret the things I have done than the things I have not." - Lucille Ball; "He who plants a tree plants hope." - Lucy Larcom. (Yeah, it's ironic how the two bottles of Honest Ade I drank today had quotes from women starting with the first three letters, "Luc".) Anyways, I highly recommend this drink. I also highly recommend Whole Foods Market's 365 Everyday Value - Orange and Mangosteen + B Vitamins Nutrient Enhanced Water. I bought the 365 Orange and Mangosteen bottled drink when my sister and I stopped at Greenlife Grocery in Chattanooga, Tennessee (we always go to Greenlife Grocery when we stop in Chattanooga, TN). This drink has 540 mg of mangosteen extract per bottle and has no gluten ingredients and is a vegan product. Since I'm a big mangosteen fan, I was so excited to stumble upon this drink at Greenlife Grocery. When I went to the checkout line, the Greenlife checkout cashier, stared at the drink, and instantly commented that this drink looked awesome, and that she was going to try it. I was very surprised that some of the Greenlife employees didn't try this drink yet. Anyways, the 365 Orange and Mangosteen bottled drink has 130 calories per bottle, and has 130% Vitamin C - 30 percent more Vitamin C than the 100% listed on Honest Ade's Orange Mango drink. Honest Ade also has 5% Vitamin A while 365 bottled drink from Whole Foods has 25% Vitamin A - 20 percent more than Honest Ade. According to the 365 Orange and Mangosteen bottled drink from Whole Foods Market/Greenlife stores - they basically have more vitamin content than Honest Ade - Vitamins A, C, E, B6, B12, B5, Niacin, and Folic Acid. So, Honest Ade has less calories, and 365 has more vitamin content. So, you can weigh your options. But both bottled drinks are great, and offer more healthier and delightful-tasting drinking options. I give both of these bottled drink brands a big thumbs up. Like I said, mangosteen is a great fruit and is good for you, and if you can find any bottled drink that has some mangosteen in it, I strongly recommend buying that drink.

This product contains Maltodextrin and so is NOT diabetic friendly. Maltodextrin reacts on blood glucose the same way as if you ingested table sugar. As per my physician: If you are diabetic, pre-diabetic or have a family history of diabetes you should AVOID maltodextrin.When I was first diagnosed with type 2 diabetes in January 2012, though I cut back my carb/sugar intake to no more than 20 grams per day, my blood sugar readings would frequently shoot up from within normal levels to either close to 200 or even over 200. I thought it was because my blood glucose meter was no good or something.The metformin I was taking caused gastric distress so I was on a clear liquid diet for a few days to clear that up. The diet consisted of water, low sodium, msg free chicken broth and sugar free jello. After I had been on the diet for almost 2 days, I had to go in for an additional lab. Since I thought my blood glucose meter was malfunctioning, I asked the lab to test my blood glucose and with the same blood sample, I used my meter to test. The lab test was 186 and my meter was 183. The head of the lab said that is very accurate for a home meter so why was my blood glucose so high????It turns out, it was from the sugar free jello that contains maltodextrin. It couldn't have been from the chicken broth or water and those were the only two other things I was ingesting. Later, my new physician confirmed that maltodextrin was definitely to be avoided.Once I cut out all products with maltodextrin in them from my diet, my blood glucose readings quickly normalized and have been normal ever since.Note that this product says it contains maltodextrin from CORN. Most people know that corn is a carbohydrate and is NOT a free food for diabetics. Because of how the law reads, manufacturers who include maltodextrin in their products do not have to count it as a carbohydrate or sugar in the nutritional information on the label they only have to list it in the ingredients.This page mentions that the American Diabetes Association and the American Dietetic Association says sugar free Jello is a "free" food and I don't know if those entities say that or not but it is NOT safe for diabetics and you can check with your diabetes educator or your endocrinologist to make sure but I'm absolutely POSITIVE that it spiked my own blood glucose REPEATEDLY. If you still doubt it, fast for a few hours, take your blood glucose reading, eat some of this Jello then wait 15-30 minutes and test again. I'm betting if you are like me - a non-insulin dependant diabetic - you'll see a spike in your blood glucose. How many spikes does it take before it affects your eyesight? Your kidneys? Your heart? Or before you get diabetic neuropathy? I don't mean to be an alarmist but if you have diabetes then you NEED to know what to avoid and those companies who tout their products as being diabetic friendly should have to tell the truth and be accountable. This is a DIET food but that does not make it suitable for diabetics.

If all the other brands were out of stock, I might buy these again, but they'd be my last choice.

I have tasted all of teh the True products and they are all awesome.  But, I especially like the grapefruit.  It tastes very much like a grapefruit was squeezed in my drink.  I wish they would make this in the bottle too.

column9: Sounds nice, but not a good product.
column10: Its no secret dogs like peanut butter.I can open a jar and my dog will sit there and lick it like a deer, but she wont eat this product.

I bought this product with a little apprehension.  Not because of the brand name or the price (both were completely acceptable), but for the fact that it said "Healthy".  I have two cats, and they are VERY finicky eaters, entirely too choosey for felines that get free food!  But, they loved it!  They both run out and eat it before I've filled up their bowls.  Big fan of this stuff and hopefully it'll help them shed a few pounds!

Every time I make this curry I get rave reviews. Any combination of meat and veggies, a large can of coconut milk, one can of curry paste, and 3Tbs each of fish sauce and brown sugar. It's a staple at our house!

column9: Maesri Red Curry Paste is teh Awesomes!
column10: While looking for Best Spoon Red Curry I found Maesri Red Curry at the local Asian foods store and gave it a try.  A very smooth flavour with good heat, not gritty like another I tried.  Makes a delicious Red Curry Soup when adding coconut milk (half coconut milk to half water, otherwise a bit cloying), diced bean curd (firm), asparagus, broccoli, sliced carrot, sliced bell pepper, green peas and pineapple chunks (add a little pineapple juice, for sweet and spicy!)  I am The Curry Weasel and I positively writhe at the prospect of good curry.  Maesri makes it great curry!

column9: Now a mainstay at our house
column10: I have to concur with another reviewer; this curry has become a favorite at our home. I have to admit I don't have the motivation to make my own Thai red curry, but I cannot imagine homemade being any better than this. This little can works magic when simply combined with a can of coconut milk, palm (or brown) sugar and a bit of nam pla (Thai fish sauce - We prefer Three Crabs or Golden Boy brands). Oh, don't forget fresh lime on the side or not. Or fresh cilantro or not. You get the picture? You can tweak the taste to match your own, but it's absolutely delicious standing alone with the coconut milk.But I must caution the 1:1 ratio is quite hot and spicy so 2 cans of coconut milk might be more suitable for a milder taste. Served with a side of jasmine rice, it's almost a cheaters way to make a exotic dinner.

The picture displayed for this product is DECEIVING. I'm still looking for all those almonds and juicy looking raisins among other things in the picture. I found waaaay toooo many sunflower seeds for the price of this product. The sunflower seeds were good and fresh. I CANNOT cost justify buying this item. I won't purchase this again.BUT...My son rated this 3-Star because of all the seeds and their freshness, HE wants it again! I rated it 1-Star because of all the seeds. We split the difference and rated it 2-Star...to each their own.UPDATE:I ordered AGAIN! The second order has the pictured blend of sunflower & pumpkin seeds, juicy raisins, almonds, cashew pieces all fresh. I'd give this batch 5 Stars. The inconsistent mixture in each order and price point makes it difficult to give the product more than 3-Stars.I'm addicted...I ordered TWO MORE TIMES and the mixture is more consistent with a great blend of ingredients.

column9: Really is bird seed. Don't buy it!
column10: We would return it if we could. It's mostly sunflower seeds and the smattering of other nuts are not even all that fresh. A real disappointment.

Was wondering how they got this so cheap, now i understand. Sad to say other than the large raisins it's pretty bad. Cashews are not wholes, but more like halves and pieces.I give it a two star since I still would prefer sunflower over peanuts.

column9: Bird Feeder Refills --- not people food
column10: cheap nuts, cheap bag, not for preferred human consumption ---try JR Mushrooms & Specialties "Survivor Mix" instead Survivor Mix 2 lbs.

I love these and have ordered them multiple times.  I put them in a pan with my whole oats and soak them for the night, cook it in the morning for breakfast, makes my day.  Love the stuff.  Always fresh and crispy.

column9: not consistent, but a good value
column10: i have 4 lbs of this stuff, almost all sunflower seeds.  doesnt look at all like the picture.  you would be hard pressed to find the cashew nuts. UPDATE:  the first bag i opened was almost all sunflower seeds, and the others 'looked' the same.  but i just opened the second bag and found more of the raisins and other stuff inside.  maybe the sunflower seeds just settle to the outside of the package.  there are more sunflower seeds than whats in their marketing picture, but i think its a good value for the price.  i changed from 2 stars to 4.  i'll probably buy it again.

I need to stock up because i can eat just this for dinner!each bite eating a handful of seeds and one raisin, this, with some experimentation, turned out to be the best tasting, raisins are naturally sweet, juicy, and big and round, really good (i just never like raisins by themselves)sunflower seeds crunchy and delightfully tastyCashews- good texture and good mild taste, compared to salted ones much better because does not leave horrible salty aftertaste, and guiltiness of eating itAlmonds- delightful as welldefinitely suggest it, whatever the price even
I keep these nuts in my desk at work so I have something tastey and nutritious to munch on.  The raisons are the fattest, juciest I've ever eaten!!

column9: Lighter Taste. Less Sweet. Suits My Needs Well.
column10: A nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market sells a variety of prepared foods and a selection of somewhat exotic drinks that might go along with their meals. I enjoy trying them. last week I tried Honest Ade (Made by Honest Tea) Orange Mango drink and enjoyed it very much. Tonight I tried another flavor, Pomegranate Blue. It's certified USDA Organic. It comes in 16.9-ounce plastic bottles. It's low in calories, at about 100 per bottle, and they say it's sweetened "just a tad." I'd say both the flavor is light and the drink is only lightly sweet. I prefer the lighter taste and the less sweet drinks so this suits my needs well. It has very low sodium. It went real well with my meal. Excellent.Gary Peterson

I stumbled across this while in the juice aisle and since it was on sale, I bought a few bottles hoping that it would help in my quest to cut out the soda.  I was pleasantly surprised that I like this.  It doesn't have as many calories or sugar as soda and it's just sweet enough without being syrupy.  Now I buy a couple of bottles pretty much every shopping trip.

I've drank the Honest brand products with mixed success.  Their lemonade left much to be desired, but this drink proved to be a little better.  And since I have a love hate relationship with pomegranate flavored things, I could be a little biased as well.  Sometimes they're fantastic, some times they're fairly lackluster.Pomegranate Blue is a flavored juice made from Pomegranates and Blueberries.  And it tastes most strongly of Pomegranates rather than the blueberries.  In fact, I didn't really taste the blueberries at all.  The pomegranate too was kind of muted, and this drink tasted like a watered down version of fruit juice.  It wasn't very sweet, which actually was ok because the bottle advertised that it was "just a tad sweet" so it lived up to that expectation.  Someone looking for a sugary kool-aid type product is probably not going to be fond of the taste of this product.The ingredients are healthy, which is good because that is what the Honest brand is known for.  It was a little disappointing that the juice is from concentrate, but at least its a healthier concentrate.  And a good portion of the ingredients were organic as well, which is always a plus.  The sweetener is organic cane sugar, so no nasty artificial sweeteners here.  Although I am a bit surprised that they didn't go for stevia in this drink.  And for those watching their diets, there's only a 100 calories in a 16.9 fl oz bottle.  For the juices, I was surprised to see that grape juice had a higher content than the pomegranate and blueberry juices, which was kind of disappointing since the name of the drink is Pomegranate Blue.Not a bad drink, but not one I'd seek out again either.  I'll keep giving the Honest brand a try, and hope that I run into a flavor I like.  They have good ingredients, but not so great taste most of the time.Review by M. Reynard 2012

column9: Didn't like the taste and didn't quench thirst
column10: I like the fruit punch Honest Aid flavor much better than this one. This one didn't seem to quench my thirst at all and after drinking it I in fact felt more thirsty than I do when I just drink water. I don't know what it is but this seems like it actually makes you thirsty.

Great flavor, low sugar and  low calories (only 100 per bottle, not per serving).  I drink an Honest Ade nearly every day and I used to be hooked on much sweeter drinks like Dr. Pepper and Redbull. These are much healthier and more refreshing.It should be noted that while the flavor is great, it is pretty light. It is not a strong sugary flavor at all like many juices. I enjoy this, others may not.
I love this stuff! Low calorie, low sugar, high satisfaction. Diabetic friendly.  It's very delicious & gives Inko's, which I also love, competition.  Good stuff.

Not a whole lot of honest-to-goodness fruit in Honest Ade.  I tried them for the first time yesterday, and was disappointed by just about everything I saw and tasted.  It basically tastes like what you get when you finish drinking a glass of fruit juice, then drink water from the glass without rinsing it first.Although the bottle is labeled 16.9 ounces, I was disappointed to find, when I looked at the bottom of the bottle, that it is acutely concave and pushed in more almost two inches from the bottle's base; that is, it's one of those "secretly shrinking" packages that looks like it contains a larger quantity than it actually does.  A more honest 16.9-ounce bottle could have been about two inches shorter.Speaking of honesty, the top ingredients in this drink are water and sugar.  There is just enough pom and blueberry juice to color the water a light purple, and no more.  There's virtually no nutritional value to the drink, so the pom and blueberry are not in high enough quantities to provide any antioxidants.If you are looking for the benefits of pomegranate and blueberries, buy 100% real juice, and drink that.  Then, when you're done drinking it, you can fill up the glass with water and a little sugar, and pretty much get Honest Ade for free.

I review BBQ Sauces at [...]... here is my review for this sauce.[...]Clearly marketed towards big loud chopper owners, the references aren't too strong enough to turn off those of us who aren't bikers.How many references to Harley's can you find on this bottle? I found 5The manufacturer describes this as "an aggressive, crimson-red, tomato-based sauce riddled with spices you can see, smell and taste," and I'd agree.This sauce was easily the best of a recent batch of three random varieties I just got in. The consistency was thin yet stable and clung to the meat well. There was just enough heat (provided by cayenne peppers) to really add life to really tasty set of wings. This one really is unique in that it provides the three major BBQ flavors: sweet, spicy, and sour (tangy). If you are looking for something that tastes slightly different, has no preservatives, and supports really loud forms of transportation - this one is for you!Smell: Nice with a very natural scent.Taste: Sweet, sour, and a dab of spicy. Unique, yet not overpowering.Consistency: One tiny nit is that it pours a little thin, but you can really see the spices as they flow out of the bottle and into intermediate basting container... and it clings well to ________ (insert favorite meat here).Packaging: Fun "Harley-marketing", but cheap plastic bottle. Guess it's good if you're like me with a kid or kids running around grabbing everything they can!One of my highest reviews and faves so far.Ingredients: Tomato sauce, prepared mustard, brown sugar, cayenne peppers, vinegar, natural smoke flavor, salt, spices, xanthan gum.Nutrition Info: 25 calories per 28g serving, 0g fat, 5g carbs, 240mg sodium

column9: Best darn BBQ in the world... and I live in the South!
column10: Simply the best!  The Syracuse Dinosaur BBQ location is funky and I strongly recommend it if you're in Upstate NY!

This is one of the best barbecue sauces on the market. It is not as thick as many of the other sauces but that is because it does not contain high fructose corn syrup. Dinosaur sauce is sweetened with brown sugar, honey, and molasses.

I love this sauce, it is, as another reviewer noted more runny than most other sauces, but that is a good thing.  It doesn't get the gluey, sticky feel of many others and it has no high-fructose corn syrup (the first ingredient in a lot of others). This brand has extra-hot versions, but I like the original one the best.
Not too spicy, not too hot, this sauce is just right and hits the spot. Does not overwhelm or hide the flavor your chicken or your ribs. I must confess, I do add just a kick of hot sauce for myself!
I only added a review of this product in order to make sure that the number of stars it has is increased.  This text is useless to you in your deliberations.

I would like to think of myself as BBQ Sauce connoisseur. I have enjoyed many varieties of flavors and styles of BBQ sauces, but this is by far one of my least favorite sauces. The sauce had a very runny constancy, which did not thicken up even during caramelization. Dinosaur's Original flavor was rather bland in taste. I have experienced more flavor and originality in a store brand BBQ Sauce.
I expected more from Libby's .  The fruit pieces looked like they took the scraps and trimmed them up.  I definitely will not buy this again.

column9: Take the plunge and buy this!!!!
column10: I just started to eat these chocolate covered coffee beans. So I thought to myself, "Hey I like White Chocolate, let's see if there is any on Amazon that I could try."So I took the chance ordered them and just love them. I live and work overseas and had a bag sent to me at an APO address. The order arrived quickly with no damage.Back to these beans....... If you have been trying the Dark and Milk Chocolate covered ones like I have been, then this will be a great change to a great snack. These taste great and give me and added caffeine boost. Hope this helps your decision... NOW BUY A BAG OR TWO.... I know I will! :)

column9: WAAAAAY Too much $ for too little coffee beans
column10: I could not believe the tiny, tiny bag of chocolate covered coffee beans in a large parcel post box.  Find someplace else to buy these!!!! JP

My husband and I are big fans of cheddar cheese popcorn.  If you are, too -- please be aware that this one is the best you will ever eat. This popcorn has just the right amount of cheese. You start chewing the kernels and they are so luscious, they melt in your mouth.

Its awesome ketchup what more needs to be said i use it on practically everything i eat steak, sausage,pork chops, rib roast, chicken, turkey, plus buying it in packs of two from amazon saves you time and money i will certainly order this ketchup again in the future its the best point blank period end of story!

My mother inlaw got ahold of this somewhere a year or so ago. I love this seasoning. i use on lots of stuff not just fajita. its good on hambergers,steak, shrimp etc. when grilling its a must have. be careful though it does have a lot of pepper but i love spicy.
This is the best seasoning for fajitas, tacos, and much much more!  Not too salty and just enough kick! Won't use anything else.
I just love this stuff. Put it on everything. Best meat tenderizer on the planet. You can put it on fried potatoes,  veggies, homefries, chicken, steake, ribs. Thanks so much. Made my day
This candy was ok but,was a little old.  Or it had gotten hot because some of the chocolate had that white film on it.  The seller was fast and efficient.  Would not purchase this again.

Although I didn't actually get to enjoy these chocolates, they got rave reviews from those who ate them.  They were fresh and very rich and came in an excellent assortment of dark and milk chocolates.

Great product from an independent (and responsive) company.  The cans are dated (package day; ddd/yy) and were very convenient, because they are cans.  The malt extract was great for use as malt extract on brew day.  It's also good mixed in oatmeal, if you like the intensely sweet bready flavor, though 3.3 pounds might be excessive for most people's oatmeal consumption.

I used this in a nice pale ale recipe and the results were great.  The Coopers on Amazon is a good value if you don't want to buy in bulk, or are willing to pay a premium for super save shipping.  Getting it shipped within 2 days is certainly very handy.

column9: Dented cans, but insides were good.
column10: Cans arrived on time, but really dented up.  It didn't seem to affect the product contained within.  Made a great ingredient in my brew.

My yeast do not like this ME compared to the ME I get from a large, Midwestern homebrew supply company that ships it in 6lb milk-jug style containers.. Even at 50% mixed with the other ME, there is a HUGE lag for fermentation to start. Using the Midwestern ME by itself, the same yeast strain (US-05) and culture (same aeration protocol, too) started vigorous fermentation within a few hours. Doing another batch with 50% Cooper's ME, it took just over over 3 days(!) for fermentation to start, and then it took about 12 hours for it to really get going. I'm not sure why this is so, but I would be inclined to guess that the Cooper's product used barley that was fairly heavily sprayed with chemicals which inhibited the yeast. Since they claim not to add anything to the finished product, and since it still shows the effect even when mixed with other ME, this is my best guess..

I had never bought from this company before. I still havent gotten any of my extract to include my dark malt. Not to mention, because I have spent all this time waiting for a package to arrive, the brew I was planning on making is starting to go out of season. Un impressed

column9: Product not a problem. Shipping improper
column10: Coopers light malt extract is a good product. The problem was  that Amazon shipped it to me and every one of the six cans I purchased were severely dented. If they want to sell a product damaged they should advertise it as such.

column9: Misleading, Lacking Info in Description Field
column10: I need pure light malt extract...  In powder form.  No where in the description does it state this is liquid!...  Now I will be set back yet another couple weeks AND a few wasted dollars short...  I take full responsibility for my ignorance; but in this case, I can only go by the information provided...Thomas Coopers needs to be much more thorough with their product descriptions.

This is a quick and easy way to make fresh bread. But, even though the four bags came in a sealed Bob's Red Mill box (inside an Amazon packaging box), one of the four bags was opened and spilling when it arrived. I'm hoping this was just a fluke.This bread mix produces a nice-looking loaf in the bread machine. Although it's 10-grain, I don't think it's 100% whole wheat (the first ingredient is something like "enriched flour" rather than whole wheat flour). It definitely has the lighter, chewier texture of a less-than fully whole wheat bread.This was ok to have on hand when I don't have time to make my own whole wheat/grain bread, but I'm going to try the whole wheat mix next time to see if it's better, as I prefer a denser whole wheat/grain bread.
My wife uses this mix for our everyday bread.  Great taste and texture...not to mention the good nutrition.  You'll never go back to supermarket bread!

Very good bread mix that holds up well no matter what I throw in with it.  The one downside is all this delicious bread is killing my diet.The company is employee owned and I can't help but like that as well.  All oars row In the same direction.:-)

I have used this for years to bake conventional bread. Recently I tried using this mix to make Roti, by cutting the mix with butter like a pie crust, and adding water to consistancy. I rolled out the dough, and cooked as with a regular roti recipe.....OMG!!! this is the best. My husband actually asks for this one now :-)

column9: Tasty Halva, Brittleness makes it a Messy Snack
column10: This is a great tasting Halva. Lately, I have been purchasing foods imported from Greece to help bolster the flagging Greek economy. Fortunately, I was quite satisfied with this Halva as it is as good as any purchased in gourmet grocery stores in Chicago or NYC. Unfortunately, it is loaded with fat and fat calories so purchasing it in a one pound block can be hazardous to your diet. Additionally, it is brittle so it requires a plate or napkin to catch the crumbs. Ideally, the Halva should come in individually wrapped snack-sized portions so that mess would be minimized while fostering portion control. Limitations aside, this is a delicious snack for those with the appropriate will power.

column9: Great for vegan dogs and owners alike!
column10: We have two dogs.  And they both LOVE this stuff.  (But one doesn't count because she'll eat anything.)  Our vet said that the other dog needed a special diet due to a severe wheat/corn/soy allergy--she was constantly itching, biting and digging at her skin.  As a vegan myself, the thought of feeding her sweet potato/duck/salmon food was SO wrong, but of course, I conceded because I wanted my doggie to be happy and comfortable.Long story short, I went out of town and the dog sitter accidentally mixed up the foods and gave v-dog to my allergy-ridden pup.  When I returned from my trip and discovered the error, I expected a big itchy mess, but she was completely fine!  No more itching, no pink irritated skin, nothing.  Even our vet agrees she's not special needs anymore-- apparently, v-dog helped her build up an immunity to all that ailed her.And all of us have been vegan ever after.  :)
My dog loves V-Dog Food!  He has more energy now than ever and his coat is silky smooth.Thank you for finally providing a dog food we can all feel good about!

Great transaction---great product!I've been feeding my Alaskan Malamute V-Dogfood for several years now. I am so glad it's finally available here at Amazon! My dog is almost 9 but people typically think she's much younger. We live in the mountains and are out running every day. She loves her V-Dogfood along with her nightly bowl of carrots and broccoli! Hope she lives to be as old as the other vegan dogs in Ripley's Believe It or Not and the Guiness Book of World Records!

Since my dogs transitioned to a mostly Vegan/Vegetarian diet, their health has really improved. They used to eat Wellness Lamb & Rice (dry and canned) - I was told the meat that Wellness used was "human grade" -- as opposed to the usual slaughterhouse slop/floor waste and euthanized shelter animals rendered for dog food. I never quite believed it ... and, being a long-time Vegetarian and now Vegan, it didn't sit well with me to feed this to my dogs.Anyway, I decided to change their diet, as well. I initially mixed in their old food (Wellness) with the V-Dog and the Natural Balance Vegetarian dog food.  This took about 2 weeks.  Since then (about 6 months ago), I would say they are definitely reaping the health benefits.  They no longer have runny stool or diarrhea, nor do they have gas. Also, some skin issues have cleared up. In addition to the health improvements, my dogs really LOVE the taste of this stuff. The kibbles are a good size, too.I understand that V-Dog is coming up w/a new formula at the end of January 2012.  According to their website, the "new formula is wheat, corn, soy and gluten-free, and slightly higher in protein at 24%."  I can't imagine how they can improve upon what they have right now, but I'm looking forward to (my dogs) trying it.  I would recommend ordering directly from the V-Dog website (www.v-dogfood.com) - the shipping is free and it arrives w/in a couple of days (as opposed to "business days" or a week or two like some "free shipping" deals).Try this dog V-Dog Food - your dogs will love it and you will feel good knowing that you are not feeding unhealthy and unethical slaughterhouse waste to your best friends.

Vegan dog food is okay, but it is the quality of the ingredients of V-dog that impressed me and my dog, Izzy.  Izzy would often have loose stools, often very loose. When she went with V-dog the problem was corrected. Izzy loves it and so do the poop bags.

I have a 12 year old lab/retriever mix and he absolutely loves v-dog. His weight is very good for his age and he is still able to run like a younger dog. I would recommend v-dog to other dog owners with no reservations. The dog food is high quality and the service is great.He just had an A+ evaluation from my vet.Thanks for the opportunity to praise v-dog and the retailer who sold me my v-dog .King Smith

Not only does our dogs seem healthier and have more energy, but they don't burn the grass when they go potty anymore and they no longer smell like dogs. They have no odor at all. More of a dusty smell actually.

column9: Best dog food - vegan or not
column10: After my dog lost interest in her food (Wellness chicken and rice), I looked around for an alternative that had really great ingredients with a comparable price. As a vegan, I thought I would try V-Dog, even though my dog is very picky, so I wasn't sure if she'd like it. The ingredients (the base is pea protein, with other delicious, healthy things like blueberries!) are top quality - there's nothing in the ingredient list I wouldn't eat - and the price is comparable to Wellness. I was surprised that my dog LOVES this food - she eats it right after I put it in her bowl, something I've never seen her do before. Her chronic skin problems have gotten significantly better, her coat is really silky, and she has lots of energy. For me, I love that it doesn't have a greasy, meaty smell or texture. I'd definitely recommend this to any dog owner - vegan or not.

I have bought from this company before. There is a major change in the SIZE of their containers. The description states "packed in large" containers.  FOR INSTANCE...Garlic powder (granulated). The last container was also "large" and rightfully so as it was 18 OZ. Today, I ordered the same product...and the picture caused it to LOOK like a large container but it ONLY had 10 oz of the item. You would NOT know the difference just by looking at the PICS.  This is all true for many of the product I purchased...Not a good thing to mislead consumers like this.
Comes in a large jar at a very reasonable price and the product is fresh. If you cook with a lot of garlic this is the way to go.

These spices are the freshest spices ever....they have no msg and are a GREAT value. You get miniscule jars at the supermarket with ingredients you can't pronounce. I am a life time customer of Marshalls Creek Spices!
wonderful for storage, and fresh on the table. I was perfectly happy with this item.

Everything about this item is great, packaging is secure and strong, the seasoning, is fresh and very good in recipes and for any cooking or seasoning purpose.Garlic Granulate is a new product to me, but it turned out to be just what I needed.  Here at our house, we love spices and seasonings from Marshalls Creek.
Two and a half times the price for comparable product at warehouse store and no perceivable difference in quality. Also, no shaker top for a product that needs one.
This is not as fine as the garlic powder you get at the local grocery, but it works well in cooking, tastes fine and I have no complaints.

I have a Keurig and I am tired of spending a ton on K-cups. I bought this coffee and Cafejo's Pod Adaptor for Keurig Brewers Cafejo Colombian Coffee Pods, Two (18-Count) Boxes with one Single Cup Pod Adaptor and not only it the coffee way better, but it's half the price. Thank you Cafejo.
These pods make a very fresh and delicious cup of coffee!  I tried them when staying at a hotel, and bought some right away when I got home.

We bought these to replace the Senseo pods that have been discontinued. The pods claim that you can use one single pod to replace the two that we used to use from Senseo. However, these pods have absolutely no taste at all - in fact when the machine kicks on, much of the liquid coming out is not even coffee colored. They are totally not worth it - I'm going to keep trying other products until I can find a good coffee. We miss our Senseo pods.

I have been buying special green coffee, roasting and grinding my own for years. This is excellent coffee and I will probably purchase more, even though I like to experiment with new coffees from time to time.

I have been grinding my own coffee for years. This is my first time to buy Jamaican Blue Mountain Style Whole Green Coffee Bean. Roasting my own coffee was new & exciting.  This is an excellent coffee and I will purchase again. Smooth an Well balanced.

Excellent coffee bean for roasting. Our family just purchased another 5 pounds for more roasting. Plenty of flavor and mild on acidity when roasted to a dark brown bean and before any oil appears on the bean itself (455F @ 17 minutes).

I recently started roasting my own coffee beans using a popcorn popper (West Bend 82416 Air Crazy 4 Quart Corn Popper from target ($10 cheaper than amazon). This is the first coffee i have roasted, so I can't compare it to other coffee beans (yet). Many friends and family members have sampled this coffee and everyone like it; some have said this is the best coffee they have tasted (way better than starbucks). The flavor is well balanced, not too acidic/bitter.Since I haven't tried the real Jamaican Blue Mountain coffee, I can't comment on how similar this is to the real thing.Will buy again once I have tried few other coffee beans.Update: 9/30/2012After trying various other coffees: Green Unroasted Panama Boquete, Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bag, Magnum Jamaican Blue Mountain Blend Coffee, Ground, 1 Lb Bag, and some others from Whole Foods, this is still my favorite coffee bean.
Considering what this is, it's not bad. I would compare it to the hot apple cider version of instant coffee. It is not the real thing, but it is ok. use the large cup setting or it is too sweet.

I discovered Taylor's Rich Italian blend coffee about four years ago and have yet to find any other brand that is both strong and as super-smooth.  A must try coffee, even if the price is a bit steep!

I saw this on sale at a local store for less than what its being advertised for here, so I figured I would try it. I bought two 18 count boxes. its not bad.. much better than the regular Green Mountain decaf, and better than Paul Newmans decaf, but its not my favorite... Coffee People Donut Shop decaf is MUCH better.. richer, smoother, etc. but, in a pinch, if I cant get Coffee People and I see this on sale, I would buy it. for now, I am going to stock up on the Coffee People brand and keep this Donut House decaf in the cupboard as a back-up.

This is an excellent hot sause, more like a pepper relish actually.  It has wonderful flavor is very hot (so a little goes a long way) and not alot of extra flavors like vineger, mustard etc that you find in some sauses.

I use it as one in the ingredients in my world famous shrimp cocktail sauce. A little goes a long way.Makes a great sauce for fish and  hors d'oeuvres as well.I would normally drive several miles to buy this in a store but in these days of $4 gasoline, this seemed to be the best choice. To reduce the shipping cost per container, I ordered two 18 oz. containers.Huey Fong Sambal Oelek Chili Paste 18 ozProduct arrived quickly and was very well packaged.
Very yummy. Mix with a tad bit of mayo and a yummy dip for shrimp or to put on a sandwich. It is hot, so take that into consideration. We will buy again!

I purchased this tea at a mall after sampling several flavors I instantly was hooked. Although they are a little pricey a little goes a long way. I now buy them on Amazon at a fraction of the cost. And after several weeks of drinking these teas my skin has taken on a glow. I have had people tell me that I look so healthy and I am sure it has to do with the antioxidants and the other ingredients. I purchased soothing nighttime teas and they work great. I highly recommend Teavana and all their  products. One very happy customer!

I compared so many different dog food brands before I settled on Blue Buffalo.  I used to feed my swiss mountain dogs Holistic anchovy until they changed the recipe to include pork and chicken meal (presumably to save $$).  Blue buffalo has none of that in it and it gets delivered to my front door in two days with Amazon prime.  Call me a nut but I always taste the food I feed my dogs so I can get a real idea of what I am feeding them, because lets be honest most of our dogs would eat anything that you put in front of them.  Lets just say that Blue Buffalo had a lot more of an authentic fish and oatmeal taste and texture than Holistic or Eagle Pack did.  I also add a little pro-biotic to their food to help with digestion.  I will be buying Blue Buffalo in the future for my boys.

I have 2 Labs and they are eating machines,  this was the only dog food I found that didn't contain chicken meal or anything chicken.  My dogs have a beautiful shiney coat now.  One of the best benifits of this food is what I like to call less mess factor.  The piles I have to scoop from my yard are much smaller.

column9: Tried many foods before settling on this one
column10: In a household with two dogs, we have several requirements for our dog food.  We have a Great Dane and a Samoyed.  The protein levels and calcium levels are both important with a giant breed and this food falls into the right range.  With the glucosamine and Omega 3 in the food this one fit all of the nutrient requirements.  There are a few foods out there that hit all of those points.  Our Samoyed has a sensitive stomach as well - so something he both likes to eat and doesn't upset his stomach is important also.  As a side benefit - talking to other great dane owners, they are feeding much larger quantities of food than we are.  Less food to maintain an optimal weight provides two benefits - a lower food cost and they digest it well - which means less comes out the other end.

My dog is an 80 pound lab with epilepsy. A few month ago, he started having seizures again despite his medication. I decided to quit using cheap grocery store dog food and switch to "premium" dog food. Since I have switched to blue buffalo, he has not had a single seizure. I have actually started giving him less of his medication. His overall energy level has improved as well. I think this food has made a significant improvement in his overall health.The fish smell is strong with this food. Plan on putting it in an air tight container or your house will begin to smell like fish.

column9: Great product for dogs with joint problems
column10: Our dog has hip dysplasia which is a fancy way of saying her bones in her hip joints rub on one another. This food has glucosamine and chondroiton in it which helps lubricate joints and helps to relieve arthritis type issues. This way, we don't have to provide her with additional supplements. Along with Adequan (an injection we give once month), her hip dysplasia is kept under control and she's able to be her normal puppy self.In terms of food quality, Blue Buffalo is high on the list and my dog seems to enjoy it well enough to eat it regularly, but not overeat.Packaging does seem to be an issue from the seller, since my shipment arrived with the box partially damaged and partially opened, but the bag inside was still ok.

column9: Blue Buffalo is So Yummy for my Puppy
column10: Love Blue Buffalo food for my dog. Makes her coat much healthier looking and has made some of her stinkier smells go away. Ordering this food through Amazon also helps me to save a bit of money since we have Prime. The food always comes very quickly after I put my order in.

column9: Finally something our 8 dogs agree on!
column10: For complex reasons I am in charge of purchasing food for eight dogs of wildly varying ages, breeds, health and degrees of finicky eating habits. Blue Buffalo is the first and only food that ALL of them will happily eat while remaining healthy.Every other brand we have tried, from the boutique specialty brands to the purportedly "near perfect" brands our vet recommends has never seemed to agree with all eight dogs. We dealt constantly with at least one dog and often several of them getting sick, vomiting, being stricken with diarrhea or (in the case of the elderly dogs) flatly refusing to eat more than a mouthful of one brand of dog food after another.At one point I had actually resigned myself to cooking all of their food, which might seem reasonable if all eight dogs were living in one household, but as they are living in 3 homes several miles apart it became a huge problem for someone with a 60 hour work week.Blue Buffalo has been a real find and a huge relief as all eight dogs have been thriving on it for over 2 years and are in better health than they have ever been.I noted several reviews discussing issues that their dogs had with loose bowels after consuming the chicken and rice flavor. I would venture to suggest that these dogs might be sensitive to the amount of chicken in the food, as consuming large amounts of poultry is a very common cause of intestinal distress and loose bowels in some dogs.The fish and oatmeal, sweet potato and fish and lamb and rice varieties have posed no problems at all (even for our 3 year old Lab who has some congenital bowel issues that make him sensitive to even the smallest treat containing corn, wheat and several other ingredients) so if you are considering giving Blue Buffalo a try, we have had great success with all three of them.

we have two companions.  both about 7 years old, one a chow-golden mix, the other a st. bernard-boxer mix.  about six months ago, the chow-golden started regurgitating his food (different brands: beneful, nutro, etc.) minutes after eating it.  after getting advice and doing my own research, we sussed that he had a cereal sensitivity.  i switched them to blue buffalo and he's not had an issue since.and other benefits are very apparent: they both love their food and are happy to eat it, their stools are a good size and firm, their coats feel better and their skin is healthier (less scratching and chewing).  we're actually not spending that much more on food, either.  we found that as we follow the feeding guide, they are getting a bit less in volume but the food is much more nutritionally dense.very pleased, and i wouldn't go to anything else for my pups! (they also enjoy the large breed chicken, but the fish and oatmeal is their favorite ... word of advice: you can absolutely smell the fish so likely best to get a nicely sealed dog food bin.)

My dogs have wicked bad gas on some of the other Blue flavors. While they aren't perfect on this flavor, the problem is greatly improved. About Blue in general, great dog food. My dogs coats practically glow in the dark they're so shiny.

We used to feed our dogs "regular" dog food, until we realized it had all kinds of by-products and things that not even us humans would want to eat. So we switched to Blue Buffalo. I usually buy whatever flavor is on sale that week, and they do really well with switching from one flavor to another...as long as we stick to Blue Buffalo brand. I have noticed with the Fish flavor, their coats are shinier. We wouldn't go back to any other dog food, BB is well worth the money.

Have ordered this in lots of 4-6 bags several times in the past. The dogs really like this food. However, yesterday UPS dumped four practically destroyed cardboard boxes on my front porch. One box was so damaged the dog food bag inside had the end torn completely open. Spent awhile sweeping up all of the spilled kibbles. So much for the convenience of ordering dog food online. From now on I will make a bulk purchase locally instead. That way I might be able to get a larger bag, and if not, at least it will be intact when I get it to the house.
My 7 1/2 year old mini peke loves these treats!  They are her favorite!  I could not locate them in the local pet stores.  Thank goodness I found them on Amazon!

column9: A nice step up from plain rice cereal
column10: Our nine-month-old daughter is ready for a more substantial breakfast than plain cereals.  We want her to get the nutrients and vitamins she needs (especially iron), so plain fruit or vegetables aren't enough.  This blend of fruit and grains (and, in some cases, yogurt) provides everything she needs for a good breakfast and keeps her full for several hours.  Plus, the flavors are not overly sweet.  One note:  at least two of these flavors include yogurt.  Some babies younger than 1-year may have a reaction to yogurt and other dairy foods, so just watch out for that.

column9: Buyer Beware - Jars break in transit!
column10: My daughter loves Earth's Best food items but after two broken shipments from Amazon, I decided to buy from the grocery store.  I sent an email to Amazon but my issue was never resolved.
My son loves all the food by earths best but would like to mention that it's way cheaper buying in store than amazon. Amazon charges 2 - 3$ more than stores.

We feed our baby this Wholesome Breakfast at any time of the day, not just for breakfast.  We're happy she's getting a good balance of vitamins and minerals.  Most jarred baby food is pretty light on the calories and nutrition, but the plain cereals that are fortified with essential vitamins/minerals are so boring and don't train a baby to enjoy different flavors.  We've been mixing cereal into our baby's food to enhance the nutrition, but that's inconvenient and messy.  This Wholesome Breakfast provides the best of both worlds:  the vitamins/minerals of a fortified cereal but with the stronger flavors of a real food.  We particularly like that this food contains yogurt.  When she was young (~6 months old), our baby loved yogurt but couldn't eat it plain because it would cause a rash around her mouth.  She was never bothered by the yogurt in this food, though, perhaps because it was mixed with other things.  Now that she's older (10 months), our baby can eat all the yogurt she wants without a skin reaction, but for awhile, this variety of Wholesome Breakfast was the only source of her favorite food.

We're not sure why, but this this flavor of Earth's Best Wholesome Breakfast (Peach, Pear, and Barley) is our baby's favorite flavor.  She'll eat this any time of the day, and we're happy she's getting a good balance of vitamins and minerals.  Most jarred baby food is pretty light on the calories and nutrition, but the plain cereals that are fortified with essential vitamins/minerals are so boring and don't train a baby to enjoy different flavors.  We've been mixing cereal into our baby's food to enhance the nutrition, but that's inconvenient and messy.  This Wholesome Breakfast provides the best of both worlds:  the vitamins/minerals of a fortified cereal but with the stronger flavors of a real food. column9: Fruit, dairy & grains...what more could you ask for!
column10: My little guy just loves this jar. I love the line of breakfast blends.  I am happy with Amazon's "grocery" business. column10: I tried all kinds of oatmeal to give my LO but this is her favorite one. I also love the fact that it comes on time.

If I had only figured out to order baby food online before.  The price is right on the money and the convenience of the shipping to the house is great.  No need to go to the store and have baby jars flying all over the cart.  This flavor is my baby's favorite.  It's a go to when she is not in the mood for anything else.

column9: Great Tasting, Fairly Spicy, But Watch Serving Size - Recommended
column10: These Nong Shim "Bowl Noodle, Hot and Spicy" bowls are very good tasting and a little over the medium range of the spicy hot range. The spiciness is about right right for me, but no one else in my house can handle these.While they can not be directly microwaved, these are easy enough to prepare by following the directions. All you have to do is pull the cover halfway up, open and add the contents of the flavor packet, add hot water, and let it sit for three minutes.My only concern about these is that the nutritional information lists the serving size is listed as 1/2 the bowl (didn't notice that before we ordered them), which means you have to double the values if you eat the whole thing. The noodle is hot if one puts all of the spices in the bowl, so the hotness can be controlled depending on how many spices are dropped in.  Some vegetables that are dried moisten when water is added, and this helps add texture in the noodle.  I think there is some dried seafood or something in it as well.

column9: Not as good as it used to be
column10: Nong Shim noodles were always my favorite noodles. Spicy, tasty, and relatively economical.However, Nong Shim has changed the packaging AND the taste of the noodles (probably for the American market).What you see in the Amazon photo were the OLD Nong Shim noodles. They were very spicy, had large veggie chunks, and were hearty and filling. The noodles came in a foam bowl with the blue, green, and red packaging.The NEW noodles (and likely what you will get if you order) are in a white plastic bowl (not foam). The packaging is dominated by white and the noodles are called "Hot and Spicy BEEF FLAVOR" rather than simply "Hot and Spicy."The taste is FAR less spicy than what it used to be. The veggie chunks are smaller, and the weird little (tofu?) red and white veggies are gone. Another reviewer said that the noodles are orange instead of the original red, and this is correct. The noodles are less flavorful and tend to get mushy after awhile. Even adding an egg or other spices doesn't really pump it up enough.So, while these are still good, they are not above and beyond the regular $.10 Ramen noodles like they used to be. All the raves about this product were likely about the original product imported from Korea. The new "Made in USA" version is not quite as satisfying.

As always with Nong Shim, the noodles themselves are great.  Not as hot as the Gourmet Spicy flavor, but a good spicy noodle.  They do contain some beef products, but the flavor seems purely spicy to me.

Yes, it's processed food, but it's so yummy! Makes a quick snack with lots of spicy flavor.My daughter is off at college and she couldn't find these in the grocery store, so I sent her 2 dozen. The price was great on Amazon, free delivery. Very convenient. Can't ask for anything better.

column9: Super-tasty noodles, but I can also taste the bowl
column10: I want to love these because I love Nong Shim spicy noodles, and I'm lazy, so I'd rather heat up a bowl than wash a pan.  I make these the usual way: add very hot water, recover, let stand.  But with about every third bite, I can taste the styrofoam-type flavor of the bowl.  It's an unappetizing flavor.  I seem to be the only one who has commented on this, so maybe I have gotten odd bowls or am smelling it rather than tasting it, but I thought I should mention it in case it helped anyone else.  It's back to the cook-in-a-pot noodles for me--which are great.

Cook the noodles normally, but don't add the spices.  When the noodles are done, remove and strain out the water.  Heat a pan and add butter/margerine.  Add the noodles on moderate heat and allow the butter to coat.  Do not burn or overheat.  Open the flavor packet and add to the frying noodles, but not all of it the powder should absorb into the butter and moisture, and glaze the noodles.  Add your own beef, chicken or pork, green onions, and other vegetables to taste and allow the spice packet to coat the meat as well as the stir-fry noodle.  Cook until the meat is finished and remove.  Serve hot.  This works with Ramen also, but the spicy hot noodles seem to add that extra kick.  Yes, it has MORE fat, carbs, but the meat and vegetables also add some real nutrition and you can easily divide it up.

Son loves these. The auto ship and discount with Amazon prime makes it easy to keep him in the Gourmet Ramen. I was cleaning out the shelf each time I went shopping. Now he gets two cases a month. I have not tasted this but if you are a fan of hot wings and red peppers you are sure to like this.

This is my favorite bowl noodle. It's flavorful and spicy, just like what I had when I was in Korea. The price is great, it's cheaper than most store price. I love it!

column4: G. Chen "what is in a nickname"
column9: Same price as in many grocery stores
column10: I went to a couple grocery stores for price comparison.  A lot of stores carry this brand now that Asian noodles are getting popular. This brand is very good. I would like to just point out that this particular flavor has won the Chef Award for good taste. The award is shown on the lid. It is a well deserved.  Basically, the chef award is given to the best in class for any particular year. An independent panel reviews the taste of several products. The one with the best taste gets the emblem in the front. I've found the Chef Award seal to be pretty reliable so far.These noodles were very flavorful. Also, if spiciness is a concern to you, because Korean ramen tends to be hotter than a lot of American brands, you can easily cut down the spice by diluting the noodles in more water than recommended or by cutting down the amount of the spice packet you add. The flavor is still pretty good even if you dilute the mix by 1/3. It's just not as hot.I definitely plan on ordering some more in the future.

As always Amazon saids their free shipping takes 5-7 days.  It always come at 2 or 3 days.  When ordering food the expiration date is important.  I have over a year to eat the noodles which I thought are plenty of time.  I'll finish these 3 box in couple of months.
This stuff is awesome. I normally pick out the swirly things because I'm not sure what they are, but that doesn't make this soup any less awesome. Pretty decent price too.

I used to eat these all the time when I was an undergrad. I'm so glad Amazon is selling them so I don't have to go looking for them in Asian supermarkets anymore (living w/ no car means trying to carry as little groceries as possible). It's a little pricier on Amazon even with the subscription price, which equals to about 90 cents per bowl, where as when I used to buy them at the Asian supermarket, I could easily find them on sale for about 70 cents per bowl. But anyway, you're paying for the convenience of staying at home.I love this flavor, despite the sodium and msg, which is typical of almost all instant noodles. Do not buy this product.  It is NOT the product advertised!I used to be a regular buyer of the Nong Shim Hot and Spicy Picante Bowl Noodles.  It appears that Nong Shim has made a change to their product offering and I have not been able to buy this product anywhere.A while ago, I made my normal order for the product and received a case of Hot and Spicy *beef* noodles. The new product has a flavor that is bland as compared to the original and in particular is much less spicy.In thinking that it was my error in the order, I went back and made sure to order from this link...and I still received the beef flavor.  At that point, I contacted Amazon about the error.  They refunded the second order and said that they would correct the page so that it has the correct info.Now, a few weeks later, it appears that they still have not corrected the product information.Please do not order this product from this link.  If you want to try the new beef flavor, search for Nong Shim spicy beef and you will get a page for that product.  But if you order from here expecting to get what it shows, you will be disappointed.Finally, unrelated to my purchase here, I have started to see the new product on store shelves with the word "beef" removed from the cardboard outer wrapper.  I purchased one from my local store hoping that it was new packaging for the old product.  Much to my dismay, the inner packaging (ie. the lid on the bowl, which you cannot see before purchasing) still said that it is the beef flavor.It's too bad that Nong Shim has made this change.  I really enjoyed the old product, but I do not like the new one at all.

It has a light, smooth, eathy-woody taste.The price is perfect, a big savings over single boxes. If you like Numi herbal teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you just want a tasty, high-quality rooibos tea, this one does not disappoint.Highly recommended.*****

Since I hadn't tried Green Rooibos before ordering this tea, it was a bit of a risk to purchase 3 packs to start with. However, it turned out to be one of the best decisions (regarding tea) I've made. It's delicate, sweet, and overall delicious, especially since it's blended with Honeybush. Definitely good enough to drink on its own, without sweeteners of any kind! As an unexpected but not surprising bonus, my skin looked 10 times better when I had a cup every day. Green rooibos is full of antioxidants, and since my skin is VERY sensitive to foods, irritation, and inflammation, it was a relief to find something that improved it so much. I would recommend drinking this every day or applying it topically with a cotton ball if you have any kind of skin problems, and seeing if it improves your condition. It certainly couldn't hurt!Bottom line: I highly doubt anyone can dislike this tea!

I tried many kinds of rooibos.  This is by far the best one.  It has a taste that is as close as you can get to real tea without the caffeine.

Bottom line - if you're a fan of rooibos and you don't mind paying the price, this tea will not disappoint.

I have worked for a major retailer for the past 20 years, we sell Soda Stream and all its accessories.  I even performed ALL the product samplings this past 4th quarter.  I bought one for myself.  I like it okay but slowly came to realize that every time I drank the diet cola my face would erupt with cysts that were huge and raw.  I thought it was stress or something else.  I went to an allergist and tested with very strong reaction to "sulfites".  everyone, I mean EVERYONE look at your bottles of syrup and despite all the "healthy" mumbo jumbo find the small print "contains sulfites".  My Dr. told me to stop drinking the soda stream diet cola (I believe all the flavors have sulfites, but I could be wrong) for several weeks.  I complied and stuck with good old Diet Coke.  My face cleared up within a few days and was cyst free.  Them my Dr. instructed me to make a batch of the diet cola in the 1 liter bottle and drink it throughout 1 day.  The next day the cysts were forming again and then progresively got worse.  Stopped using soda stream products completely and have had NO flair ups since.  I would be very careful as sulfites have many bad side effects.  I truly loved the product, its simplicity and sold tons of it because I thought it was great.  Little did I know I was selling something tainted with sulfites.  If you have noticed any strange blisters, cysts or acne do as I did with my Dr.s instructions and see for yourself.  I am male so don't insinuate it was a "monthly menstrual cycle".  BEWARE.

column9: What Every Consumer Should Know - NOT Economical
column10: The taste of SodaStream diet cola does not match that of mainstream brands.  This becomes especially noticeable for frequent drinkers of Diet Coke or Diet Pepsi.  Yet that isn't the main problem with the SodaStream offering.  The truth is simply that consumers are paying way too much for C02 refills -- sixteen times (16x) too much.While the general idea of at-home carbonation is solid, consumers should understand that they are grossly overpaying for SodaStream carbon dioxide refills. In fact, the prices charged are sixteen times (16x) wholesale costs or many, many times more expensive than the prices a restaurant would pay. In Europe, frugal consumers are aware of such markups and actually purchase their own restaurant-sized CO2 refills. In the US, we aren't so frugal.Other than the outrageous costs for the CO2 refills, there are other issues with the SodaStream Fountain Jet. One is the construction quality is quite low with very thin molded plastic and little weight. Additionally, the taste of generic soda flavors do not match that of the brand name products.Below is the calculated cost per two liter for the output of SodaStream soda. This includes the cost of the consumables AND the equipment costs. I have used very generous assumptions, including a low discount rate (i.e. cost of money).Transportation costs were not factored because 1) purchases of typical groceries should more or less overlap with soft drink purchases 2) grocery delivery has long been available in many areas 3) most people live closer to a grocery store than to a home furnishings store (I walk 100 ft. for groceries and drive one mile for BB&B) 4) the reverse logistics for the CO2 refills is an extra expense for the retailer that has to be factored into its profit margin and will ultimately be borne by the consumer.One of the reasons Bed Bath & Beyond, Macy's and Crate and Barrel choose to carry SodaStream is that they want the consumer to make MORE FREQUENT trips to their establishments for consumables. Instead of going to such establishments once every 3 to 6 months, customers will now visit once every 1 to 2 months. That makes an enormous difference for generating impulse purchases at such retailers. The regular cola flavor has a terrible diet taste.  I hate artificial sweeteners, just can't get used to the chemical taste. I just plain don't like it at all, and poured the rest of the syrup down the drain after using only enough for 1 bottle of soda.  Yep, it's that bad.
Nom Nom Nom....yum! I love this stuff.  I didn't buy the real Energy drink because the price was repugnant.  This stuff tastes better than that canned stuff! Nom Nom Nom.....  ;-)

This stuff would be pretty good if it wasn't for the artificial sweetener.  I'm not sure why they insist on putting sucralose into a product labeled as non-diet, especially after touting that it contains real cane sugar.  It does, in fact, contain real sugar.  But the advantage is negated by the unmistakable aftertaste caused by the sucralose.I think they're trying to keep the calorie count down by creating a "half diet" drink.  But I don't like diet drinks.  I've never had one that didn't have some sort of weird taste or aftertaste.  I don't drink a lot of colas either, but I like to treat myself to one every now and then.  So, when I do drink one, I want one with real sugar, no HFCS, and no artificial sweeteners.  I used to seek out Mexican Coke for this, and I was hoping to get a similar product with the Sodastream.I think a lot of people are attracted to the Sodastream by the prospect of getting a purer product.  They're going to be disappointed by the presence of artificial sweeteners in these syrups.  It's not a big deal to me because I mostly use the Sodastream to make plain seltzer, but I'm sure their syrups would sell better if they would get rid of the sucralose.

After years of dealing with increasing price of soda, finding place to store it and returning  empty bottles decided to give this a try. We bought ours at Costco which came with 1-130L Co2 Carbonator, 2 1-Liter Stainless Steel Bottles and trial flavors pack for $99. First let me say I'm very pleased, the flavors are not bad at all and i can use my own filtered water from either the fridge or Pure faucet attachment and no longer need to pay or bring back bottles for the deposit. They also have much less sodium than store bought soda with the exception of Diet Rite. I have tried many diet flavors and the ones i like the best are Orange, Caffeine free cola, dr pete, Fountain Mist, Cream Soda and Root Beer. As for the cost it has changed everything, no longer have to pay deposit, return empties or search for sale price on soda which means lot less trips to the store saving me from impulse buying and gasoline usage. I can now make fresh bottles of soda whenever I need it (unlike store bought soda which can lose carbonation)  and any flavor I feel like at the time. Already used up  1- 130L Co2  carbonator bottle so ordered 1 full bottle + 1 exchange for empty bottle from SodaStream web site this way I'll always have one full bottle when one is done. You should always search the web for coupons for any online store before ordering and SodaStream is no exception, saved $15 which is the price of the license on a new bottle.  So it cost me the same as if ordering to exchange 130L Co2 Carbonators, pretty sweet. If you order 10 bottles of syrup at a time you get one free  and with on line coupons and cashing in points your earn from them with every purchase can save you more than just the shipping cost, the cost of a trip to the store. For me the SodaStream is well worth the cost.

column9: Great flavor, and even better price.
column10: I drink energy drinks maybe once or twice per week.  I usually stick to red bull or rock star as those cans don't overdo the caffeine and have a decent flavor.  The soda stream mix tastes very similar to rock star and costs a lot less money.  Just watch your serving size when you use the soda stream.  All canned energy drinks have a limit whereas you could drink the whole bottle of soda stream if you don't watch your serving size.

column9: Some are good, some are not so much.
column10: Some of the flavors we have tried:Diet ColaI do not like diet cola. I don't like diet Coke, diet Pepsi or diet other drinks. We bought this flavor so we could make diet drinks for someone who might like a diet cola when we were making our own soda. However, this is really one of the better diet drinks that I have tried. If you make your own soda, this is a good one to try.OrangeThis is the best one by far of all of the flavors we have tried. This flavor tastes just like the fanta orange soda. We love this one.ColaThis cola flavoring is ok. It's not great. You can easily make simple syrups that will not be a cola flavor but will taste much better than this flavor. This is the equivalent of RC Cola. Ok but it's not near as good as other name brand colas.

The Soda Club machine is great.  We enjoy all the flavors (excluding the mango one).  I read the other reviews, my family doesn't understand what after taste they are refering too.  I have been drinking Pepsi all my life.  It is finally great to have soda without aspartame and corn syrup!  Plus, I am saving lugging 2-liter jugs from the grocery store and have cut down on the amount of garbage I throw out.  There are a lot of flavors at [...].  Yeah for Soda Club!!

This is the worst tasting cola I've ever tried. It has a horrible after-taste that is completly unacceptable. I'm now stuck with a very exspensive machine, that I can make carbonated water with, and replacing the carbonator is around $80.00. Bad purchase.

I love the Soda Stream unit, but the syrups need some tweaks.  It is too sweet, so I use half the amount required; this is good if you want the product to last longer; this is bad because they use Splenda added to all their recipes, not just the diet.  If they would just use plain old sugar, I'd be much happier with this product.

Wanted the Sodastream for my birthday.  Got it, made up the first cola.  It was horrid.  Got to reading about the products.  Sodastream seems to be so proud that they did not include aspartame in their diet products, and used only sugar in their non-diet products (Instead of high fructose corn syrup).  However, they also put Splenda (another artificial sweetner like aspertame) in every flavor they make...diet or not.  It leaves a horrible aftertaste in the non-diet drinks.  The whole point of not drinking diet pop is because people don't like the taste of diet pop.  My Sodastream is going back to the company with a message stating that if I wanted diet pop I would buy it myself, and they should only put sugar in regular soda.  They brag about real sugar, and then hide artifical sweetner in every product hoping no one will notice.  It shows in the bad taste of their regular sodas, and, in my opinion, does not make them a very reputable company.  Buyer beware.

You have to sample them all to find the ones you like.  You'll miss out if you judge them all after tasting one or two.  My favorites are Diet Orange, Diet Raspberry/Cranberry, and Diet Energy. Diet Dr. Pete and Diet Root Beer aren't bad either.  They mix well with alcoholic beverages as well.HOWEVERI encourage everyone to visit the SodaStream webstore BEFORE purchasing any of products here. There are many flavors at the SodaStream webstore not offered here like DIET Energy and DIET Orange.  Also, as of 2/15/2012, they charge 40-50% less at the SodaStream webstore but you may have to pay for shipping.  However, if you buy 10 bottles at Sodastream, you'll get 1 bottle free.  I'm not slamming the Amazon merchants but I think consumers should be aware of the significant price mark-up.(With this exception, I've found Amazon prices to be competitive with other stores so I continue to be an Amazon Prime Member.)If you only want one bottle, it may make sense to pay twice as much with free Amazon Prime shipping.

column9: What a hit with the kids
column10: Couldn't find a variety of flavors here in town, but I got everything they wanted at one location.  Great transaction.
This stuff is wonderful.  I like carbonated drinks, but not the sweetness or all the strange ingredients.  I use this with a very small amount of syrup or lemon juice and it's great!

column9: It's ok, but it's no "Diet Coke"
column10: As other reviews have mentioned, this pice is ridiculous.  However the product itself is decent.  I purchased this elsewhere because I love the taste of Diet Coke and read some reviews that  tastes just lke Diet Coke.  (My parents have had a soda fountain in their house since I was 2, I'm 31 now) ... I'm going to siphon some syrup from my parents and try that (if it works, you can get 5 gallon "bags" of Diet Coke from SAMs club, makes 35 gallons of soda)

column9: Are they kidding with the price?
column10: Either I'm missing something and this is a double pack, which the description does not seem to support, or these people are insane.  There are loads of places to get this same product for $3.99, $4.99, even as high as $5.99.  What are they thinking?

Over 70 years ago my Grampa took me to the beach almost every day., To me, highlight of the outing was when he bought us "Orange Crush" in the heavy dark brown bottle, from the vendor boy.  Back then the juice was unfiltered and there was even small bit of orange in it.  For many years I hve tried to find something to drink like the ORIGINAL OC.(to no avail)  I use my seltzer siphon and if I tinker with the amount of syrup I can get really close to perfect.  I am so glad I bought this, just great.,

column9: Pretty good taste; goes a long way
column10: Contains both sugar and sucralose (Splenda), which leaves me a bit of an aftertaste. (Your mileage may vary.) Everyone else in the family likes it -- pretty good root beer taste. We don't have a "SodaStream" carbonator, but just use plain old carbonated or sparkling water to mix it. A little goes a long way, making it cheaper than most alternatives.

I love this product.  I've heard alot about the Sodastream and finally decided to purchase one, and as I drink a lot of Red Bull (mainly as a cocktail mixer), I gave this mix a try.  Quite impressed on just how I can't really tell the difference between this Energy Drink Sodamix and Red Bull, other than the price.  On average I spend about $2.25 per can of Red Bull, and this Sodamix will yield 50 8oz servings, so easy math says $112 for 50 cans of Red Bull or $6.99 for the Sodastream Energy Drink Sodamix 16.9 Fl oz bottle and 50 8oz servings.  And as not to be biased, I have a few friends who also drink Red Bull who all agreed that it was a toss up on tasting the difference between the two products, and how much money could be saved.

I will never understand why they put Splenda into non-diet drinks but I can tell you that it was a horrible idea. So diet is undrinkable and so is regular. It tastes sooo awful. Maybe they'll get with the program and fire the fool that thought people would want to buy crap in a bottle.
