column10: I purchased this product from Follow Your Heart natural food store in So. Cal.  I noticed big chunks of black particles in it.  I then went online to Amazon and found some people complaining about maybe chipping a tooth from hard substances.  Pre-preemptively, I pulverized this product in my mortar and pestle.  Have you ever been at the beach and you get sand in your food, and it is grinding in your teeth?  This has been my experience with this product, and I am returning it today and will never purchase any salt from this manufacturer.  Going back to Himalayan salt, and might try Celtic Salt for the first time, but not just now, I need a rest.

Found this salt in a Utah cafe on a road trip in 2003-ish. At that time I could only get replacements from the company on line, but I'd bother ordering a bunch it every couple of years because I can tell my body really responds well to this salt. The taste is delicious, and I don't bloat or feel puffy from it. I have since tasted many other sea salts since they are now so trendy... This is still my favorite! Now they sell it in nearby grocery stores, but not the course grind that I love in the salt grinder. So I'm on line to buy again!  Introduced it to a lot of friends over the years....

This coffee is absolutely delicious. While other chocolate coffee brands have an artificial taste, this smells and tastes like real chocolate. Fantastic aroma in the kitchen while it is brewing, too!Yum Yum Yum Yum Yum!

Nice thick and chewy udon with a wonderful spicy seafood broth with lots veggies.  Can't be compared to the ramen noodles you buy in the grocery store.  Eat plain or throw in a poached or fried egg or two on top if you are starving.  Tastes wonderful.

column4: J. Rueschhoff "I am a retired software develo...
column10: This is not your normal supermarket instant noodle pack.  It is full of flavor and a generous portion size.  Suitable for an entire meal.

I say that they're "instant" noodles because, to the uninitiated, it might come as a shock that you actually have to boil the noodles rather than simply soak them in boiling hot water.  The preparation time is still very quick, and it's definitely worth it.These noodles are far thicker and chewier than your standard supermarket Top Ramen noodles.  They also come with a spice package and a dry ingredients packet that contains bits of seaweed, mushrooms, and carrots.I usually only put in about 3/4 of the spice package and add extra ingredients like nappa cabbage, shrimp, scallops, green onions, mung bean sprouts, and/or an egg.  Kimchi also goes really well with these noodles.The bulk price that Amazon offers is an excellent deal, especially for people who don't have access to Asian supermarkets.  It's the perfect food to have for when you want a quick and flavorful meal.

In my book, these noodles are even more delicious than the flagship shin ramyun "spicy picante". The noodles are coarser than even the shin variety, perhaps the coarsest noodles you'd find in a pack of instant ramen, and are billed as "udon type".  They certainly are chewier, and have a slight potato starch flavor, which is delicious.However, the ride-along packets may not be for everyone.  From what I understand, the company came up with these noodles after extensive taste-testing to make up for their relatively late start in the instant ramen industry.  However, bear in mind that these taste tests were done in Korea.  So if you don't like korean cuisine, you will not like these.  The soup base is fiery hot with a touch of squid flavor (tip: don't add the whole packet).  The vegetable packet is filled with seaweed (mainly kombu kelp), and tastes very fishy.Delicious I find these, but not everyone will.
its hard to find good asian food in rural america. I'm glad I can get the good stuff through amazon. Beats the 12/$1 el cheapo stuff at your  local walmarts!

Incredibly tasty, incredibly spicy, just the way I like it! It does have the flavor of seafood but it's fairly mild. If you absolutely do not like the flavor of fish, this may be something to avoid. Try the kimchi flavor instead.Incredibly salty, one pack is supposed to provide 2 servings but let's be serious - maybe for kids, but I garnish mine with vegetables and it's a full meal. 480 cal per pack at just over TWO grams of salt (that's 2080 mg). For me that's over twice the amount of salt I normally intake daily. But it really works with this soup. I wouldn't eat it everyday unless I was going to sweat it off/out. Noodles are very good in consistency, hearty and slightly chewy without being tough. Don't overcook the noodles, they get soggy/mushy in the worst way and are absolutely (IMHO) unpalatable.

As others have mentioned, these are really good.  I like the noodles and the add on packets of flavoring are nice.  This is really spicy too.  Not a strong flavor of seafood, but better than ramon type packets !

column9: I've had just about every Korean ramen and this is by far the BEST!
column10: I've had this ramen for over a decade and it's my favorite by far. Love the hot seafood flavoring and the udon style noodles. The seafood (squid, seaweed, etc) portions are generous. I usually cook two bags as one isn't enough. Add couple of eggs and it makes a great meal.

Yummy! these noodles are so good!!! Its also really spicy so I only use half of the flavor packet- still taste just as good. It deosn't compare at all to those ramen noodles. In fact, I will never eat ramen noodles again after finding out about this product. These noodles are way better-thick and chewy. I like the little bits of seaweed in the soup. One bag of noodles is so satisfying. These are the best instant noodles ive every had!! I highly recommend this product!

I like hot & spicy cuisines. This is one of my favorite ramen. It is very hot & spicy. It provide seafood taste, too. In addition it it very convenient to cook. Boiling is all skill to cook this ramen. It takes more time to cook than any other ramen such as Shin ramen, because its noodle is thicker.

column9: I love these Korean instant noodle
column10: These Korean instant noodle is one of the best tasting instant noodle out there. They have good texture and great taste.

Out of Korea, China and Japan.  I think Korea makes the best instant ramens.  This one is a long favorite of Koran folks. Noodle is thicker and chewier then  typical ramen.  By the way, Neoguri means raccoon in Korean.

column9: very happy to eat this but too late to get this
column10: as you know this noodle is one of korean traditional ramens.very spicy but very yammy.you can get this by using usps not ups.so you can get this over 1weeks.
I often eat three NEOGURI per day.Break fast, lunch, and dinner.You can cook them using bowl and microwave even if there is no pan.Enjoy!!

This is my favorite asian instant noodle.  It cooks up pretty fast (I put condiments into water, heat to a boil, add noodles for no more than 2 minutes, done!).  I will often add 4 or 5 Viet beef balls as well.  The list price given is questionable.  Your local asian foodstore might have these for 20 pack box for $16.  Definitely recommended.

column9: Awesome, but adding items is a must
column10: Dump a .70c can of tuna in this and you've got a meal that beats many gourmet meals I've had over the years for pocket change. Also you can add frozen vegetables and green onions if you wish. I like adding frozen peas. I dont find an egg works that well in these noodles, I add egg to the Shin Ramyun spicy noodles however. I find most people who dont like these dont add ingredients to the noodles. Trust me dump that tuna in and it's a whole new ballgame. Also adjust the amount of water you boil down slightly if you put the tuna water in there also.

column9: Best noodles that come in packets!
column10: I have been eating these noodles since I was a kid and love them. Since I have been aware of nutritional values though, I had to give it 4 stars b/c of the sodium content. I mean, I still always crave this, but limit it to once a months or so.I always undercook the noodles a bit for more chewiness, and add a touch of lemon juice and an egg. If i'm not too hungry, I'll actually break the noodle in half and use half the sauces and save the rest for later... It makes me feel better not to intake all that sodium at once!

These noodles are the best.  Extra salt, msg, and spices that will make you feel the burn out of the other end.  With the economic recession looming, I cannot afford to feed gourmet food to my family.  Stocked up on these noodles when Amazon had the $10 promotion and shipped free to my door.  I didn't even waste gas money.  What a deal, thank you Amazon!
It's hot and taste very shrimpy.Be Aware! They are very high in fat and MSG. If I knew this, I was not gonna buy it.Not Recommended!

column9: Don't buy these from Amazon because the cookies will be stale/soft.
column10: I also got two packs of 24 using the buy one get one free deal.  Despite the fact that the cookies are sealed in each individual box, the cookies are soft.  I've had Barnum's Animal Crackers countless times in my life, and I have never had soft cookies.Now I'm stuck with over 40 small boxes of soft animal crackers.  Amazon says that this item isn't eligible for return.  I'm not giving the animal crackers a poor rating; I'm giving Amazon's animal crackers a poor rating.Don't buy these from Amazon!!

column9: At Least the Box is Still Nice
column10: Barnum Animal Crackers are no longer the crisp, delicious cookies with beautiful animal forms that they once were. The new cookies are soft and pasty and feature cheap, vague animal forms. The only positive note is that at least the box is still attractive.
Terrible, terrible. bought two boxes with 24 in each box. One of the 24 packs was stale.

For $30.00 shipped for 48 boxes it was a good deal.  They are good snacks for the little ones. when they visit.  Also gave a case to my sister in law for her little one.First time I bought any type of food from amazon, wasn't to sure if the product would be fresh, but it was.

I purchased these cookies because my boyfriend and I both like them, but grew tired of buying the little circus boxes at almost twice the price. So we refill our boxes from these larger packs. The only problem is these Snack Pak cookies are NOT the same as the circus box cookies. They are a different size and they taste different. This should be clearly stated by the manufacturer or the seller[...]
Don't buy these at $37 for 24 boxes! You can get them cheaper at the supermarket! How can they call this a sale price- it's misleading.

column9: Love the crackers, but they don't ship well
column10: I really love Barnum's Animal Crackers and was tired of spending $2/box for some when I was traveling so I thought to buy a case.  These are the real thing and taste great.  Price is good.  packaging is good.  The only problem I have with it is that they were shipped in their original carton by Amazon and UPS wasn't all that nice to the box, so a good portion of the crackers were cracked (though still edible, just messy).I'll stick to buying them in a local store where I can feel for crackedness before I buy.
I got them buy one, get one free and it was a great deal. Love them.

column9: Great snack for young and old alike!
column10: We bought these animal crackers for my 2 year old to have around as a snack. He loves them and the size of the packs is great, both at home and to take with you. The animal crackers themselves are very good also, my wife and I find ourselves snacking on them along with our son!

column9: So much yummier than the original!
column10: I remember that the old animal crackers used to be a lot thicker, pastier, and dryer. These ones are different from those ones that often come in the big plastic containers. These have a yummy ingredient that I can't quite put my hand on...almost like cinnamon and they are sooo yummy. I can just keep eating and eating it. I didn't get them off Amazon so I can't comment on the freshness of those or anything but the actual food is very tasty. I just HAD to write a review! I'd definitely recommend them! :P
Made this purchase for a friend who had a love for them.  He was so happy to get them.

column9: Yummy and a decent price too!
column10: I've been spending $4+ per week putting these cookies in my kids lunches.  A lot of times the stores are out, so with Subscribe & Save, I don't have to worry if the stores have it in stock AND I'm paying less!  I'm always looking for a good deal, and this one qualifies!
i was disappointed in this one, it seemed very bland even though i used fresh broth to make it in and doctored it up a little.  not one that i'll buy again.

I'm so sorry to say that this was not good at all.  I really had high hopes, since I am a huge fan of tortilla soup.It was watery and had a strange flavor.  I made it according to the directions, too.  I'm just sad I have three boxes left over.  I also purchased the potato soup, but haven't tried it yet.

column9: Excellent starting point for making tortilla soup
column10: All by itself, this isn't much, but you can turn it into an excellent tortilla soup with a little work.  After adding the soup mix to the water, we add peeled and chopped carrots, peeled and chopped potatoes, and chopped scallions.  If you like it hotter, add a drop of Dave's insanity sauce.  Cook for 20 minutes per the instructions. About five minutes before it is finished, we add frozen corn.  While the soup is heating up, we grill some skinned chicken breasts or thighs, cut them up and add them to the soup when it is done cooking.  Serve with tortilla chips and fresh cilantro. Sometimes we add a dollop of sour cream or plain yogurt.  You can also add black or other beans to the soup.  The advantage of using this package is that it has a nice selection of spices, it is relatively low in sodium for a soup (190 mg per serving), and it is fast to make.
Leonard Mountain 4 Amigos Tortilla Soup, 6-Ounce. Boxes (Pack of 4) I gave it 3 stars because my son likes it.  It has a taste only for certain taste buds.  No, I would not order this again.

I read reviews on this product and if I hadn't tried it from my Mom first, would never have purchased it.  I'm so glad I did though.  I never tried the black tea version many other reviewers talked about.  THIS version I really like.  It's not sweetened so I feel I can drink it all day with no empty calories.  I add a bag to my s/s water bottle (28 or 32 oz) and leave it in.  I drink a couple of these a day.  It's a light flavor that I can drink all day long and really enjoy the taste (yes, it is a LIGHT flavor.  No matter how long I leave the bag in, it's still a light flavor - the tea doesn't get super strong but I like that about it).  I don't like plain water at all, so this is an excellent alternative plus I'm getting the added benies of antioxidants in the green tea.  My daughter is now a convert and asks to have a bag whenever she drinks her water.  My husband loves it as well.I've tried the other flavors of the Cool Brew Iced Tea and this one is by far my favorite.

As a big fan of the old Cool Brew Blueberry Ice, I bought this because the other had been discontinued.  I thought this may have just be a "repackaging" (40 instead of 48 tea bags) and would taste the same.  I was very disappointed because this pale green tea had very little blueberry taste.  In fact, there was very little taste at all.  Since I have six boxes, I am experimenting with ways to make it palatable.  I'm adding a couple of bags of other teas (Blueberry Breeze) when I make it, to add a hint of flavor. I wouldn't recommend as a blueberry tea.  Guess it is a good alternative to water.  Hope Celestial Seasonings brings back the old version.

column9: The previous Blueberry Ice (non-green) was MUCH better
column10: I purchase a case of this at a time as I drink iced tea in the summer and winter.  Previously Celestial Seasonings had a Blueberry Iced Tea and this new version is a Blueberry Ice GREEN tea.  I loved the old version and really do not like the new version.  The previous iced tea was really "blueberry" in taste, color and odor.  It was much smoother.  The new tea is simply not good - definitey not very blueberry-like.  I am exploring just purchasing their regular blueberry tea (not iced) from here on in.

The Blueberry Cool Brew Black Tea that Celestial Seasonings discontinued was much better.  This one was bland to my taste.  I wish they still had the Blueberry Cool Brew in Black Tea instead of Green Tea because it was the best iced tea I had ever tasted!

Like other reviewers have noted, this new formulation made with Green tea is simply not good.  The old version made with Black tea was a good (not great), convenient tea to have on hand in the summer.This one is very weak flavored as well (as are all of the other CS cool brew teas).

My only recommendation is to let it "brew" for at least 10 minutes, probably even 20 to get a full bodied flavorful green tea with a hint of blueberry taste. It is not over-powering and perhaps that is the main complaint. Green tea alone is not very inviting to me, but this adds a nice fruity taste that is just right.It is unfortunate they do not sell this in stores, but I buy it 6 boxes at a time so I always have it on hand.
We have a Mr. Coffee iced tea brewer, but it has been put into the deep freeze. This tea brews in the fridge and is very tasty.

I was so disappointed when Amazon stopped carrying the black tea version of this Blueberry iced tea. When I found the green tea version, I quickly ordered another case. Boy am I unhappy. The green tea version has no flavor - no matter how many bags I use to make a pitcher. If you are looking for blueberry flavor - skip this one. Now I have a cupboard of tinted water bags!

This is the best tea I have ever tasted.  This is a crisp,clean beverage with no bitter after taste.  There is no sugar or anything added so it is great to drink any time.  I have this with me at all times whether I'm in the gardens,doing housework or at work.

Didn't try the original blueberry Cool Brew tea from Celestial Seasonings, so we are not comparing this version to the previous version.  All we can say is this is a delicious, crisp green tea with just the right amount of blueberry flavor.  Have tried & enjoyed some other flavors of the brand and like the idea of drinking a healthier version with green tea. These Cool Brew teas are a warm weather staple in our house.

column4: D. L. Brown "A Knower Of Good Things"
column10: Personally, I love this cool brew tea flavor, it is much, much better than regular iced teas.  It is cleaner, fresher, caffeine free and in my opinion very good. I know everyones taste buds are different, the taste of the tea is light, subtle,it is not overpowering, if this is what you like in an herbal tea than this is for you. I really like it and keep pitchers of it made year round as I am not a soda drinker, my choice, try it , it just may become yours too. I also recommend the Tropical Fruit cool brew also by Celestial Seansonings,another fav of mine.

I love this stuff! It takes the edge off green tea for me (which I find bitter).  Its also very convenient, I keep these bags in my purse for a quick iced tea with has so many great health benefits.  The blueberry gives a nice sweetness to it & its also very thirst quenching to me!

column9: Not as good as the other flavors
column10: I am a HUGE fan of the celestial seasonings cool brew iced teas. This is my least favorite flavor. It is very weak in flavor compared to the other. However, I still order it just to have a variety.
sorry not a big fan.  even after doubling the number of tea bags, it still tasted very weak & watered down.  i would advise you to try the cool brew PEACH which has a great refreshing taste.
I ordered this on a Friday and it was there Saturday.  The order was exactly what I ordered and arrived in great condition.  Will order again.

I love this meal for an easy and healthy lunch. In addition, it is halal, vegetarian, low-sodium, gluten-free and diet-friendly, which means that I have been able to share with my co-workers and friends who have dietary restrictions, much to their amazement and delight. It is manufactured in a facility that processes milk, nuts, sesame, mustard and soya products if you need to know that info.I tend to eat half one day, refrigerate the leftovers, and eat the other half the next day since each package contains 2 servings.  Here are the nutrition facts:Serving size: half pack (175g)Servings per pack: 2Calories: 262Calories from fat:54Fat: 6gSaturated Fat: 1gTrans Fat: 0gCholesterol: 0gSodium: 165mgTotal Carbohydrates: 44gDietary Fiber: 8gSugar: 0.5gProtein: 8g(Also, no preservatives, no artificial colors, and no MSG)I am looking forward to trying their other meals, but I haven't found them at a reasonable enough price just yet.  This flavor was available at Costco just long enough to get me hooked, so I thought I should let everyone know how fantastic these really are.
Fifty dollars?  You've got to be kidding me.  I could eat at a 5 star restaurant for that.

column9: Not the same as buying them in France
column10: After trying these out on an Air France flight, I HAD to have them stateside.These, while in a very nice tin, these didn't have quite the same freshness or flavor.In general, they are still very good, and would be a nice gift, considering the tin can be re-used.However, if you want that CRISP flavor, that is so delicious, you might find a reasonable replacement or import at your local supermarket at about a quarter of the price.

I'm pretty pick about what I feed my beloved Golden Retriever.  (I adore my furr-baby.)  I stick to Blue Wilderness or Natural Balance for her dry kibble.  Of those options, this flovor of NB Alpha seems to be her current preference.Higher grade kibble has substantially reduced our vet bills (Golden's are prone to ear infections---switching her to a higher quality protein diet a few years ago has totally eliminated hers!)I trust this brand (and Blue Buffalo) and my dog approves.

My Shiba Inu started off eating Wellness Core and decided she really wasn't "that" into her food.  I switched her gradually into Natural balance starting off with the roll food mixed in with the Wellness and sometimes just as a treat. This year we went all Natural Balance Alpha dog and we started off gradually increasing the amount daily, as suggested on the bag.When switching out dog food it is very important that you introduce the new food gradually to your dog or else he/she will have stomach issues which could lead to diarrhea and the constant bowel movements.  My dog is a very picky eater and she absolutely loves this food.  Her poop is very firm and easy to handle after each movement, she has never had loose stools from eating this food and she only poops twice a day.Natural Balance Alpha Dog is ranked as one of the top 10 dog foods on the market; there are other flavors to choose from and I tend to go back and forth with all flavors.  Even my Norwegian Elkhound puppy eats his Wellness puppy food with some of this mixed in and once he gets older will be switching over to Natural Balance Alpha dog.I would recommend Natural Balance Alpha dog to anyone with picky eaters; however, I would also suggest that whenever switching out dog food it is very important that you don't do it cold turkey, that you follow the instructions listed on the bag.

column9: Good if your dog is constipated
column10: I switched my two yorkies to Natural Balance (ultra premium) over a year ago and liked it.  However, I saw that this was a new product and one of my yorkies has allergies so I decided to give it a try.  Bad idea!  This food made my dogs poop uncontrollably.  Both of my dogs are house trained and have been for years, but this food made them poop inside and poop multiple times a day!  Unfortunately, I bought two bags of it (this flavor and another) and wanted to use it all.  I'm almost at the end of the second bag and can't wait to transition them to another food.  I don't know why it made them poop so much, but I would not recommend it to others.  Try Natural Balance ultra premium or another top rated dog food.

Kudos to the makers for coming up with VERY clever packaging - doesn't hurt that the cake mix is pretty tasty as well. I did jazz up the basic mix a bit by adding some spices and touches of my own (2nd time around) but the first time I just made it as directed and it was still delicious enough to be snapped up by friends and family.This is a lovely item to have on hand for a quick gift because once the cake is gone, the recipient will have a sturdy, attractive towel, adding a nice spot of color to the kitchen. You couldn't save this forever because the cake mix probably has a limited shelf life but if you regularly give gifts and want something to have on hand for those occasions, this would be perfect for someone just setting up house, newlyweds or people who don't have time to make something from scratch but still like to cook something that tastes pretty close to homemade, far better than what you'll find in the "cake mix" aisle.

column9: Effect wears off after a week or so of use
column10: My friend had recommended this product to help loose weight but also clear out your system.  It worked well the first week or so but then lost its effect.  Dont think that I would buy it again!

I purchased this for a few kids, ages 3 - 5 and it was a huge hit!!  It was the 3 year old's most favorite gift.  She laughed histerically when she pushed the raindeer down and out popped the brown jelly beans.  She laughed and laughed and provided hours of entertainment!

I got this for my husband, brother, and father for Christmas. They ALL loved it and couldn't stop talking about it. My Dad couldn't wait to bring it into work to show his coworkers, my brother couldn't wait for poker night to show his friends, and my husband just kept laughing.

This is a fun and hilarious stocking stuffer. But the person receiving this needs to have a really good sense of humor. The instructions included made this easy to fill and prepare for Christmas morning.

These pooping Reideers are just to funny. Can't wait till I take them over to my Boss's office for her and her daughter to open them up. Both of these ladie's have a great sense of humor. Well they better like them or else I'm fired. Nah, they will love them
This was one Cute Gift..I will always remember the look on my suninlaws face when he opend it.Thanks so much!

These are so cute! They are perfect for elementary kids! I can't wait to see there faces Christmas morning. I can hear the giggles now. Amazon shipped it fast! I got it 2 days after ordering! Thanks great as always!

We were recommended by a friend that the malt beverage can enhance the milk for breast feeding. My wife started drinking this after our kid was born, and it worked very well. She drinks 1 bottle a day or every 2 days. The hop is the ingredient stimulating the milk, and the malt can boost her energy level. Perfect drink.

This is a great product and it is the exact same brand I grew up drinking in Germany. The only reason I give this otherwise amazing drink 3 stars is due to its price. This is more of a treat for me when I'm really home sick, and when I order them I tend to make them last and savor the flavor. German Deli has another brand that is pretty good, doesn't touch Karamalz though, and you can get 14 for roughly the same price if you're willing to settle for a lesser quality. I really wish it was easier to get in the States, because whenever I go home to germany I easily drink a crate of 20 in two weeks.

I grew up drinking Karamalz. It has a distinct taste that might take a couple of bottles to get used to. It does give a boost of energy that lasts. Karamalz will stimulate milk production if you are nursing a baby. We like Karamalz because it is non-alcoholic and everybody in the family can have some.

The American version of Karamalz (which is the one on Amazon) is not the same as the German version.  In Germany, Karamalz is very sweet and high in calories.  Here it's marketed as a low-calorie health beverage.The taste is fine, and everything arrives as promised, so I have no complaints.  But I will not buy again because it's not the original product from Germany.

I've enjoyed these anise pastilles for many years.  Just 3 ingredients, none of them artificial.  If you like anise flavor or like licorice you'll probably love these.  Everyone I've ever given them to loves them too.  Intense but not harsh, refreshing flavor.  Size and shape of tic tacs, but so much better!  I order them by the case to keep on hand.  The tin is lovely too.  Too good to be called breath mints, they are really a wonderful convection.
"Very pleased". I received the item in a timely manner and in perfect condition. I am very pleased. Thumbs up. Thank you very much.

I FOUND THESE MINTS WHILE BROWSING FOR FRENCH MERCHANDISE.WHAT APPEALED TO ME WAS THAT THEY WERE MADE BY THE SAME CO. FOR ALL THESE YEARS.I DECIDED TO CHECK THEM OUT,FOUND THEY WERE INCREDIBLE.I ALWAYS KEEP A SUPPLY AT HAND AND GIVE THEM AS LITTLE GIFTS.QUALITY IS FIRST RATE.

I bought these for my sons Mickey Candyland Party. They are the perfect size for Grab bags and the colors are really bright. They all came in one piece, nothing broken. I'm excited to see the kids faces. I would highly recommend this product. Fast shipping and adorable.

Not very happy with these. They came from oriental trading I could have just ordered from them :( They break apart into pieces when trying to open and they just don't look all that appealing. Of course a child wouldn't care though but as a parent I didn't like them.

I ordered these lollipops because they appeared to be exactly what I was looking for and was so excited to receive them.  Unfortunately, when they came I was totally disappointed!!!!  The lollipops that came did NOT look like the picture at all.  They were tiny circle lollipops.
Cute little twisty pops. The sticks were short like I read on the reviews, but perfect for our party. We were happy!
I guess it is my fault because I didn't read the dimensions but these lollipops are TINY! I thought they were much larger when I ordered them.  OH well...

Given the earlier reviews, I was a little nervous that these would arrive broken, but I needed them quickly and didn't have another option.  They arrived on time and of the three dozen I ordered, not a single one was broken.  They are packaged as a Oriental Trading Company product, so I could have ordered them directly, I suppose, but they would not have arrived as quickly and with shipping I probably would have paid more.  I also really like these because they have clear wrappers with no writing or graphics on them.
I got this for my sons 3rd birthday centerpieces. I got the idea from the Internet & I loved it. So I went & got these. Also I got them within like 5 days. Loved them!!!

I needed this candy for a dessert table decoration, All of the lollipops were broken. They come inside a clear plastic wrap and the candy was all broken inside the bag. It might just be my order got smashed or something, but not one was ok. All of them were broken. (maybe the candy is too soft I dont know). I wouldnt buy it again.
Ordered these as part of my child's birthday party favors pack.  They were really cute, packed well, and tasted great!  Would purchase again!

column9: Campbells Tomato Juice is absolutley the best!
column10: As another review notes, the sodium content on this product could be an issue for folks on sodium restricted diets, but for people who do not feel that is an issue (it isn't for me), this tomato juice is far and away the best- and so much less expensive that some other brands- especially those sold at "whole paycheck".  If you are on a sodium restricted diet, try Campbells Low Sodium Tomato Juice.
The title says it all. It's too salty. Whole Food's organic tomato juice tastes better. I still have the taste of this one on my tongue. Argh.

These tasted great! And they lasted  quite a while too, they ship in a sealed plastic bag, 2lbs for $11 (at the time of this review) is not bad at all. There's not much else to say, order them for a taste test.

They are so convenient, give a refreshing citrus flavor to my water, and the fact that there is nothing artificial....just crystalized fruit!  People see me using them and want to try them all the time!

I have tried other raspberry teas and didn't care for them. This has a delicious, natural-tasting raspberry flavor. I first bought this from my local supermarket but it may be a discontinued product there. I'm glad I can purchase it here. Would certainly recommend it.

This coffee -- my title pulls no punches -- is very mild. If, like me, you prefer coffee that does not pull its punches, and is more like a kick in the head from a friendly mule, this is not the one for you. Much better, for example, is the delicious and strong Café Altura Organic Coffee, Sumatran Dark Roast.

column9: Coffee is a little too sour for my taste
column10: If you're the type of person that puts white stuff in your coffee; sugar/milk, then this coffee might be ok for you.  I've trained myself to drink coffee black so that I get the antioxidant benefits without the fat/calories and because of this I need coffee that's not sour or bitter. This coffee was just a little to sour-tasting for me.I bought Copper Moon Kona coffee and it tastes much better!
The quality of these beans are fantasic!! smooth not bitter.medium to bold taste.(depending on quanity of beans used). very good! i would recomend this brand and flavor of beans,i will buy again.

We have been useing this seasoning for years, and they pulled from our local stores, so I was happy to find it on here because I don't like to make a roast with out it. If you try this with your pork roast you will make the best roast ever =) even the kids will love it, its that yummy

I am really a huge advocate of cooking from scratch, with all fresh ingredients, but I really love these seasoning packets especially the one for pork.This has not only nice flavors, but a bit of thickening.  I use it whenever I make split pea soup (one packet of this per 1lb bag of peas and only use half the amount of water they say to use on the bag of peas...beautiful, thick split pea soup every time!) or a pot of beans with ham shanks and it always comes out beautifully flavored.  I don't add salt when I use this but other herbs can be used, of course, with fantastic results.This comes in several other flavors now, but this is the one that I use the most.  Just store the packets in airtight containers, such as Lock & Lock, and they keep practically forever.

column9: can't miss with this slow cooker seasoning
column10: This is a hit with the whole family.  Most seasoning mixes are too salty but this is just right.  Comes in beef, pork and chicken.  We use all three.  I read there was a spaghetti seasoning mix as well but have not been able to find it.

Great shortcut for throwing something together, unfortunatly 75 GRAMS of high sodium salt at 31 percent! In order for the beef packet to work and the saltyness to dissapate one must use a lot of potato's in the ingedients.

My husband cannot eat red meat, so we eat a lot of pork and chicken.  We love pork in the slow cooker with potatoes, carrots, and onions, but it is nearly impossible to find any slow cooker mixes for pork that don't include some kind of beef ingredient (often beef fat).  This is the only mix I've found that has no ingredients that hubby can't have, and it's absolutely delicious!  It offers just the right mix of flavors, without taking away from the flavor of the pork.  Unfortunately, it seems that all of our local grocery stores have taken this product off the shelves, so I am thrilled to find it here on Amazon!!  :)

This Crockery Gourmet for Pork is outstanding!  I love the fact that all I have to do is go to the store, pick up a pork roast or tenderloin, chop up some carrots and potatoes and add them to my crockpot with a packet of Crockery Gourmet for pork mixed with water and in about 8 hrs I have a delicious dinner waiting for me.  It is great for busy Moms like myself who love taking my kids to playdates and running errands all day but still enjoy a delicious healthy meal. My picky kids love this too! I joke with all of my stay-at-home Mom friends that my crockpot is like my personal chef and lets me play while it works all day!  I highly recommend this great product!

column9: Actually a "Balsamic Must", but superb nevertheless
column10: The label doesn't even call this Balsamic Vinegar, let alone the Traditional variety, but for the price this is a very decent value.  Syrupy, complex notes from the various woods used for aging, clearly made from the finest grapes, I don't need to go Traditional and spend $100 as long as I can get this "must" instead.

column9: Unique, original, complex and a treat NOT to be missed!
column10: I buy my tcho chocolates at Whole Foods and absolutely LOVE their "nutty" chocolates.  I've always heard raves about these pricey tcho chocolates but its price is more than justified. I thought when I bought the "nutty" flavor that it would have nuts in it. I was wrong - it had NO NUTS! BUT IT TASTED NUTTY just like the package stated!! It tasted rich and nutty with just a little piece. I ate the whole pkg in only a few swallows fast. It's delicious and addicting and you'll never want to go back to common mainstream chocolates or even other luxury/premium chocolates when you taste just 1 piece of it! Unlike other organic chocolates, tcho chocolates are NOT incredibly bitter.Their chocolate is organic and fair trade. According to their package it states "Origin doesn't necessarily tell you about flavor, either. Within a single country, different regions grow different genetic varieties of cacao, in different climates and soils - each can greatly affect flavor. An Ecuador chocolate from one region can have nutty flavor notes, and from another, floral flavor notes." Tcho grades their chcolate based on a "flavor wheel" with tastes of "fruity," "citrus,", "nutty," etc with no added flavorings.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: It's actually some of the best chocolate I've tried. I have Virgin America airlines to thank for this little addiction; they tuck one of these squares in the package with my turkey cranberry sandwich that I always order when flying back east to visit my kids.One of the best things about TCHO chocolate is the texture. It has a good "snap" when you bite it, but softens on the tongue quickly, melting away releasing intense chocolate flavor. How cool is it that the "Nutty" flavor has no nuts??? I like that the variety of flavors are so uniquely complex - Chocolatey, Fruity, and Citrus, very satisfying - so much so that you really only need one piece to get a good chocolate *fix*.This is definitely the kind of "vitamin" I remember to take once a day with packaging that seems like it's really an essential part of my balanced diet.Pleased to recommend.

The most interesting thing about this chocolate is that the cacao chosen really does lend a citrusy, nutty, or fruity taste to the chocolate without containing any of those ingredients or flavorings.  I was very impressed with that when I first opened the container and halfway through, I still am.Each little bar is two bites and 44 calories.Makes a nice treat or a cute gift.
TCHO is an awesome company... great culture, packaging is wonderful, and the chocolate tastes great too.
Savor small and distinct taste differences in chocolates with TCHO, in portions of two or three bites ---

column9: LOVE this packet of scrumptious spicy noodles!! oh, it's also vegetarian if it matters to you.
column10: yes, it's full of salt, msg and other lovely stuff, but it can't be any worse than what you eat at many typical restaurants. i can handle a LOT of spice. seriously. in fact, sometimes i add a squirt of sriracha sauce on each bite when feeling indulgent. but this noodle would be spicy for some - if you can't handle the heat, get the sapporo ichiban's ramen. (or add less soup base, but more on that later.)if you don't count the high-priced specialty brand that i can't remember the name of (eh, it wasn't that good), this product also seems to have the distinction of being the only vegetarian instant ramen, thanks to the more accurate labeling of international food products. in case you're a vegetarian searching for the ingredients, here it is as printed on the package, complete with spelling errors:noodles: wheat flour, modified starch, palm oil, salt, gluten.soup base: salt, monosodium l-glutmate, sugar, capsicum, ginger powder, red pepper, bean protein.dried vegetables: green onion, mushroom, carrot, red pepper cabbage.since one package contains almost 100% recommended intake of sodium for a petite person, this is what i do. besides adding my own fresh veggies, i pour the water out directly from the pot after cooking (thus leaving some in there), then i only add the half of the soup base. i have no desire to drink the liquid part, and i think some of the palm oil also gets release from the noodles. i skip the dried vegetable packet since they just look gross.you could probably find this at a better price at your local korean grocery market if you have one nearby, but you can't beat the convenience of amazon. for about $1 each subscribe-and-save, it's worth it for me.

if you love hot and spicy and a bit of a noodle fan then this is a highly recommended brand to try.  The noodles and flavoring sachet are a lot higher quality than the 'ramen' you find in the local non-asian grocery stores.  Compared to prices in asian stores - this is a bargain and no lugging it all the way home.  Fabulous value.

I am a vegetarian so I always look for those food items.  These Paldo Hwa Raymyn noodles are just delicision, very spicy, with 2 packets for seasoning.  I would highly recommend these noodles to everyone.
Of all the Paldo Ramen I've tried these are my favorite. Not too spicy but a nice bite and such a great price!
These are super yummy, but they aren't quite as spicy as you'd expect them to be.They are however, vegetarian; the best of Korean noodles, but without the beef stock.

column10: These are super fabulous. I actually crave them! These are not your average "broke food" ramen. The flavor and spice are terrific. They are not too spicy so that you can actually enjoy the flavor too. The dried veggies are great too. If you want to be authentic crack an egg into it while it is still cooking. Mayonnaise is no exception... every single mayo that I looked at, at the store had soybean oil EXCEPT for this one... Hellman's Canola Cholesterol Free Mayonnaise. I love not wasting coffee by brewing one cup at a time, however, I do wish that the K-cups were a little more environmentally friendly.  I hope that they can start making the pods from something that is more biodegradable in the future.

Incredibly smooth, Sumatran Reserve has become the coffee of choice in my house.Big and rich coffee flavor without bitterness and an ever so gentle natural sweetness makes every cup something you really enjoy and want to savor.The 12 count package is small and opens easy, perfect to have sitting near the Keurig on the counter.

I love bold coffee and was a die-hard Timothy's Midnight Magic and Rainforest Espresso fan until I tried this GM Sumatran.  It's smoother with a cleaner finish and overall just a better flavor than the Timothy's (which is still a great k-cup btw).  And the fact that it is organic and fair trade makes it all the better!

A good everyday coffee with no bitterness.  BTW, folks, K-cups marked "Extra Bold" simply have more than the usual amount of coffee in the K-cup, allowing one to make the larger cup of coffee without it's being weak -- doesn't mean it's extra dark.

I originally bought this coffee because the one I usually drink, GM Nantucket, was out of stock, and was concerned that "extra bold" would mean a coffee that was overly strong and bitter.  Instead, it is very full-bodied and smooth, and is now my coffee of choice.  I recently compared Nantucket and Organic Sumatran Extra Bold back-to-back, and found the former almost tasteless in comparison.

This is, by far, the tastiest K-Cup variety I've tried. I've had about 10 different types, and this one is a hands-down favorite. Everyone who's tried it at my house has loved it and been very impressed that this came from a Keurig. I think the body and richness is comparable to coffee made in a drip or (don't shoot me, coffee purists) a press!The flavor just barely edges toward bitter, but in a very pleasant way. It's rich and dark and very full-bodied. A great coffee for those of us who prefer it dark (but not burnt in the Starbucks fashion).Highly recommend this product!

The ends between the trunk and the branches looked very fake as they are a green plastic color. I took a brown sharpie and did a little color work on them and it looked much better. Some of the plastic leaves also looked very fake, but I used some sharpies on those too to add a little color and it looked much more real and turned out to be a nice looking bonsai for the money. The moss at the bottom of the trunk is nice looking and a very good touch which adds to the overall appearance. The trunk of the tree is fairly nice looking, but I also did some touch-up work on it with the sharpies, which made it look better too.So the bottom line on this product is that it is fairly inexpensive, but for the money, and with a little effort on your part, this can be a decent looking artificial bonsai, and it is definitely easier to keep alive than a real tree! If you are on a budget or looking for something which is easy to care for, this is a decent option for you. Not the best, but good for the money. 4 Stars.Bohdi Sanders, author of Wisdom of the Elders

Although my cats rejected Merrick's Quail & Chicken, I'm giving it five stars [but not anymore - see UPDATE below] because I think it smells great and the ingredients list is excellent. After supplementing their regular canned food with small amounts of the Quail & Chicken over a period of about two weeks (six cans divided between two cats) in order to introduce it gradually, the cats began refusing to eat it all together. It smells like roasted poultry and they ate it readily at first. I feel it must not have agreed with their tummies, or they would have continued to eat it. But who knows why these things happen with fussy cats. I tried to reintroduce it several times over the next few weeks, but they'd have none of it.I haven't tried lots of different natural canned foods for my cats, but I have found two that they consistently like. Those are Natural Life Lamaderm Lamb & Rice Platter and Natural Balance Indoor Cat Formula. But who knows why they prefer those, or how long that preference will last.UPDATE (July 17, 2011): I've recently learned about an ingredient in Merrick's canned cat foods that may have caused my cats to reject it, after having eaten it readily at first. That ingredient is "yeast extract." It seems that this is just an innocent-sounding name for glutamates (the same as in monosodium glutamate or MSG). It's an appetite stimulant (flavor enhancer) with the same side effects as MSG. For the many who are sensitive to it, the side effects of glutamate include headaches, dizziness, abdominal cramps, heartburn, etc.If a cat eats something that tastes good, but then the cat feels sick, it will eventually reject that food. I'm glad they have that survival instinct or they'd be sick all the time thanks to these dumb pet food companies that will feed them anything. It would be a real coup to get pets addicted to your brand of pet food by adding a flavor enhancer that other brands didn't have, now wouldn't it? Of course, it if makes them sick and they reject it, then the scheme has backfired.And, by the way, my cats still enjoy the Natural Life and Natural Balance foods that I've been feeding them. So it seems it wasn't just a passing preference.Because of the deceptive ingredient "yeast extract" and its potential for making pets sick, I now give this food a "1 star" rating.

column10: After messing with cleaning the Keurig coffee brewing single cup server, I wanted my own brand of coffee at greatly reduced prices.  When using the lil grey pod replacement and screen filter I had lots of trouble washing the screen filter so I could make a new cup of coffee. column9: Warning: these can be habit forming!
column10: Cashews are the tastiest (and one of the costliest) of the what we call nuts. Although a nut in the culinary sense, in the botanical sense the fruit of the cashew is actually a seed that grows from the cashew tree. Their caloric numbers may be a bit high, but they provide surprising amounts of potassium, protein, and dietary fiber.That being said, these are some of the tastiest cashews that you'll find, and they have no trans fat, either. Must also note that Emerald's "On the Go" canister" is an excellent variation from the standard packaging, featuring a handy lid that seems about right to measure a single portion.Pros: good sized halves and pieces, lightly salted with an excellent natural buttery cashew taste. No trans fat.Cons: oil and sodium... but it's the salt that makes them great.Serving size: 1 ounce (about 1/4 cup)Servings per container: 10Calories per serving: 160Calories from fat: 120Bottom Line: If you want some really flavorsome cashews, Emerald does a tremendous job with these. For those who prefer whole cashews, you might try Emerald Nuts Whole Cashews, 10-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 4), and for an interesting (and highly-recommended) five-star taste treat, you might want to try Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashew, 10oz Canister (Pack of 4). All of these have outstanding natural buttery cashew taste, and are packaged in the same handy canister.Warning: any of these can be habit-forming!

Campbells soup has aways been a family staple for years. Coming in this size turns out to be great. There is less space for storage, less time spent handling the smaller cans, and a better value. I plan two different recipies, such as crookpot, meat loaf, or store half a can amount in the ice box fr use in a few days.

A brief tutorial for those who are unfamiliar with SweeTarts.  Tiny, sugary, multi-colored candies.  They are sweet.  They are tart.  Hence the name.  If you are confused as to what to do with them, instructions appear on each one.  BITE 'EM, it says.  If you do, there is a burst of flavor.  Very tasty!One thing, though.  I have been eating these since forever, and they have been re-branded as Willy Wonka SweeTarts.  Should I be nervous?  If you remember that story, Willy Wonka is known for some dangerous candies.  I keep thinking that one day I will bite into one of these thingies and the next sound will be all like "Oompa Loompa Loompity Doo" and I'll be all like "Uh oh!"  Just saying.

column9: Once  you go black you won't go back!
column10: If you are a black licorice lover these are for you! Not too salty, not to sweet. Just perfect high quality European licorice flavor. Yummmmmm to the max!
These delicious lentils keep their firmness and flavor, enhancing each recipe I use them in. They cost a little more, but are worth it, if you are looking for a really good taste and texture.
This is the only form of coffee that I like.  Once I started to eat expresso beans, I became addicted to them.  I didn't share them.  I ate the whole bag.

Wow...I am like another reviewer here...I am absolutely addicted to these things!  I hide mine from my friends and I do not share.  I am sure if Miss Clark, my first grad e teacher saw me now she would write my mom informing her that "Wren does not share with the other children."  The humility!Anyway, these might appear to be a bit high as to the coinage but I can assure you that they are worth every penny.  I keep a stash of these at my home, office and apartment.  They are a wonderful pick-me-up at any time during the day and the flavor...oh my...the flavor!

column9: Coffe shop quality capuccino at home
column10: I love coffee. Usually I would not recommend Maxwell House as I consider it a "supermarket brand". I was very surprised with the quality of this cappuccino. My wife loves it too!Contrary to instructions, we brew milk first then the espresso, this makes it look very nice, especially on a transparent cup. The taste is smooth and velvety, with low acidity and aftertaste. You can buy extra espresso T-Discs separately and brew an extra shot if you really like your coffee bold (like I do).In about a minute, you have a cappuccino that is as good as that of many coffee shops. Yes, it is not nearly close to making my personal list of best coffees I have tested, but you can't beat the convenience and cost. We also use it a lot to entertain guests at our house. Works great with any dessert.Instead of buying them one box for 6 coffees at a time, this 5-pack from Amazon really saves us money. Each set comes with 16 T-Discs: 8 espresso and 8 milk. So this 5-pack will be good for 40 cappuccinos.

This cappuccino is very good and tastes almost as good as Starbucks Latte Primo, T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers, 8 Count Packages (Pack of 2). The cream foams up well in the Tassimo machine. The only difference in taste between this Cappuccino drink and the Starbucks Latte Primo is that the coffee flavor is slightly stronger in the Starbucks product. Also, with the Cappuccino you brew the coffee first and then use the milk disc. With the Starbucks Latte Primo you brew the milk first then the coffee.Overall, I think this is a bargain buy. As long as you are not looking for a slightly stronger coffee flavor, I'd suggest purchasing this instead of the Starbucks brand as both products use expresso coffee and milk discs.

Some product work needs to be done on the discs. I have wasted several of the milk creamers that would not "read" properly resulting in milk leaking all over the tassimo machine. It did not happen with Starbucks packages.

If, like me, you crave a little popcorn with your cheese, then welcome aboard! This sharp white cheddar popcorn by Deep River Snacks, really fits the bill. The cheese is real and intense. The corn is light and flavorful, with a great texture. It comes in a two ounce bag -- two servings -- but, trust me, this is a one serving experience. For this indulgence, you get 300 calories, three grams of saturated fat, zero trans fat, four of fiber, six of protein, and six of sugar. Overall, a superb and pretty healthy snack...one that's already on my 'critical' list.

This is among the best tasting bagged popcorn I have tried.  I would give 5 stars if it were a bit cheaper.  Even so, I am placing my second order.  The first went fast.  The quality was good.  A fair size serving in each bag.Perfect for a late night movie.

This popcorn is amazing. I cannot say in enough words. The flavor is so strong and the consistency is just perfect. One of the reasons I bought this product is because I was looking for a satisfying snack for the children that I work with, at a local grade school. We are always trying to find that "perfect" snack. Yes, I know some kids are lactose intolerant. Nevertheless, this still is a great option.
My brother was raving about this stuff so this is what he got for Christmas.  A case for him to enjoy.  I must say that it is quite tasty.

I've tried many brands of cheddar popcorn and this is one of the best. I like the 2-ounce bags-they are supposed to be two servings, but I find them just right for a snack while watching a movie or at work in the afternoons. I'll be buying more.

column9: Deep River does it again, good, messy cheese popcorn bliss
column10: This is my third Deep River product and all of them have been superb. I had tried 2 potato chip flavors before and based on the great quality decided to give these a try. They are a large, satisfying, tasty snack. The cheese is very generous and there is enough that it will get all over your fingers. It definitely falls in the 'gourmet popcorn' category but I wish there had been just a tad bit more bite to the cheese.Also as a previous reviewers mentioned it is 300 calories in the bag and a good amount of unsaturated fat. But you do get all natural ingredients, no trans fats, not much saturated fat, and a good tasting product. When comparing calories versus how satisfying it is, it is a pretty good tradeoff overall. To me, it is obvious Deep River takes care with their products. They are well on their way to becoming a big player on the quality snack scene.

column9: Best baby white cheddar popcorn on the market!
column10: I've been buying this product for years.  It is definitely the best baby white cheddar cheese popcorn I have tried.  For those who love strong cheese flavour, this is the strongest you will find (at least that I know of).  I wish they made it in extra sharp, but they probably wanted a "middle of the road" cheese for the majority of consumers who might find extra sharp too strong for them.In any event, there really aren't that many companies that make baby white popcorn with cheddar cheese in the first place.  The larger-sized corn and yellow corn just are not the same quality as baby white, cheese or no cheese.That crap made by Smartfood that is sold in the markets is horrendous (not to mention lots of partially popped kernels).  The popcorn made by Deep River has less hulls because it is baby-sized, which is better for the digestive track (especially for those of us that are older).  Also less partially popped kernels than the other brands I have tried.There is great popcorn out of Colorado (Cornzapoppin) made fresh just before shipping, but it is full-sized.  The flavours are great, but there's just nothing like baby white corn (did I say that already?).  It's also rather expensive, but does make a great gift for those you want to spend money on.So until someone else makes a high quality baby white sharp cheddar popcorn, I am loyal to this Deep River Snacks product!

Overall, it's a very good white cheddar popcorn.  The AGED white cheddar flavor is great!  There is a reasonable amount of white cheddar on the popcorn, but I really wish there was 25-50% more cheese on it.  But at a dollar per bag, it's a great price.  The 2oz. bags are the perfect snack size.  When I get the bigger bags, I tend to eat it all until it's gone, which is often too much, so I'm a big fan of this size.My only complaint is that the popcorn (under the cheese) tends to have a bit of a burnt-flavor.  The kernels don't look burned at all, and they are very crisp and crunchy, but an odd burned-corn essence tends to compete with the cheese.  (I'm not sure how else to describe it).  I have tried every brand of white cheddar popcorn that I can find, and this is in my top 3.  It would be my #1 favorite if they added more cheese, and cooked their corn differently, or somehow tamed the "burnt" taste I'm describing.I still highly recommend, and I will be buying again =)
Great cheesey popcorn.  Wish it wasn't two servings and that they had had the calories - 300/bag but worth every calorie.
Our small dogs (She's 10#) loves these rawhide donut treats.  These are the only ones that she can really hang on to and chew by herself.  Others tend to be too large, too thick for her.

I'm on a low-carb diet, so I needed a different snack from the potato chips or power bars I usually eat between meals.  I ordered this turkey jerky, looking for a low-carb yet filling afternoon snack.  I'm not normally a fan of jerky, but this turned out to be pretty delicious.  It's like eating honey-glazed strips of heaven that melt in my mouth.The only downside is that eating jerky is fairly expensive, but I think this product was worth every penny.  And I feel better eating this, compared to when I eat potato chips.

I was introduced to Dean Jacob's creme brulee mix by a very clever friend who entertains exclusively at his home with great style and little cost.  Of course, I thought he had made the creme brulee from scratch but he kindly shared his super secret with me.  His secret is safe but I am willing to share this great idea with a few select friends.  It is delicious and easy.  Who could ask for more?

column9: Great Product - beats making from scratch!
column10: I have used this product for some time. No one knows its not from scratch. Easy to make and delicious. Always gets rave reviews!
This product is fantastic.  I have had Creme Brulee many times in France and this is just the same!I would recommend it to anyone and my guests have just loved it.

If you have ever looked at a recipe for Creme Brulee made from scratch, you may have started to shake uncontrollably.  With my cooking skills and patience, I found the mere reading of the ingredients and instructions daunting.  So, in my characteristic way, I began to look for the contemporary substitute or recreation (let's not use such a vile term as 'knockoff').  I have now tried several that are on the market and find this one quite lovely and very easy to make.  The most difficult task is pouring the hot liquid into a rammekin (that is a new word for me as well).  But, my best work is reserved for the carmelizing of the pure cane sugar with my butane fired blow torch.  Pure ecstasy!  [I have also used the dark sugar that comes with the kit but prefer the white stuff.] Actually, this stuff is great but I have reserved the five star rating for the real thing ...

column9: Creme Brulee just like the restaurants!!!!
column10: It's so easy to make and so delicious. They have the caramelizing sugar. Took about 10 minutes!!! Love it so much!

This is the only packaged Creme Brulee I have ever bought.  I follow the stove top directions and it always comes out perfect. I use my husbands blow torch for carmelzing the sugar. My guest believe that I make it from scratch... it is my secret that I don't.
I was very pleased with this product. Very TastyI got 2 and shared with friends, who enjoyed itPrice was reasonable and delivery was prompt as usual

Just finished the last of four boxes of Dean Jacob's Creme Brulee ordered from Amazon and it was wonderful.  It equals any creme brulee we have had at our best Albuquerque restaurants.  I sometimes add some Gran Marnier or Kahlua to the recipe for variety.  I am in the process of reordering more of this product.  My husband tells me it is the best "I have made" LOL.Additionally, I must say that Amazon is the best!!  I ordered this on a Monday and had by Thursday.  Amazing!!Elizabeth

column9: Best home Creme Brulee kit ever
column10: This recipe is better than 95 percent of restaurant creme brulee, even some of the upscale places. I actually used the microwave directions, took about 10 min prep, then an hour in the fridge. Turned out perfect.

column9: This helps me to make a restaurant quality sauce for duck
column10: Several times a year I treat my guests (and myself) to a meal starring boneless duck breasts.  I love the sweet, dark and rich flavor of the meat.  Sometimes I make a fruit based sauce (orange, raspberry or fig) and sometimes a cream and wine based one.  Regardless of which type I choose, I ALWAYS include this product to bring extra taste to the sauce.Glace de Canard is a 20 times reduction of duck and chicken stock, although the duck flavor dominates.  Following the classic French recipe for duck stock it includes carrot, celery and onion stock, tomato paste and wine.  This type of heavily concentrated stock is a staple in professional kitchens but usually out of the reach of the home chef.  First one must have the duck bones and the hours and hours needed to not only make stock but to reduce it to 1/20 of it's volume.  This (and More Than Gourmet's other products) allows me to make the type of sauce that one finds in a great restaurant.A good recipe is included with the glace and additional ones can be found on-line at their website.  I usually use recipes from a great sauce reference book "Sauces, Classic and Contemporary Sauce Making" by James Peterson (in his most recent edition of the book he mentions More Than Gourmet by name and recommends the use of their products).  For some of the demi-glaces that I use often (the vegetable, chicken and brown sauce) I buy the larger 16 oz. tubs.  Because I don't treat myself to duck breast that often I prefer these 1.5 oz. containers.  If you are into cooking and love duck, as I do, I think that you will enjoy this.Sauces: Classical and Contemporary Sauce Making

My Dogs love these! They have quality ingredients and I can feel confident that they're safe, as they're made in the U.S.  Note:  The price on Amazon is cheaper than ordering off the White Dog Bone Company website directly.

column9: Plato Organic Chicken Strips Dog treats
column10: My friend who shares her life with a Newfoundland gave my Belgian Sheep Dog one of these treats.  My dog loved the treats.  The Newfie has allergies so she is limited to what she can have.  My dog does not have that problem, but I am careful what I feed him.You can break up the strips into smaller pieces to make them go further or for a quick treat.  They don't crumble in your pocket.  However, do keep the treats in a baggie in your pocket as the treats had a smell to them.  They are not greasy or messy to handle.

column9: Item pictured is no longer made
column10: Be aware that the item you will receive is not chicken strips as pictured.  Plato no longer makes chicken strips, but rather formed pieces which are called Plato Organic chicken and sold for less on Amazon.  The seller would take no responsibility for the wrong picture, nor would they refund to me the difference between what I thought I bought, and the other product, which they also sell, for less.

column9: are these made in the usa?
column10: are these made in the usa?  do not see it in the product description and am skeptical when I do not see country of origin or manufacture,
It's great to find organic dog treats, and at a reasonable price.  Both of my English Setters think these are delicious.  I learned about them when Lola brought them with her from her foster home.

Plato Chicken treats are perfect for our dog.  She has gastrointestinal problems and needs to have a treat that is primarily composed of chicken or turkey.  Also, Plato products are made in the USA and not China and are subject to our more rigorous standards.  I highly recommend these treats.
I was so happy to find this gum at Amazon. My father,who is 90,wants very few things. He has been looking for this gum for two years. We really thought it was no longer available.
Love this gum - doesn't stick to dental work.  Can't buy it in the stores anymore, so my source is Amazon!

the Freedent is a good price and a good product, I don't chew gum, but my I buy freedent for my wife. cause it is getting harder to find the freedent in the local stores, so I buy a few months supply,  in exchange, she buys me peanuts. good product
It is hard for me to find this item in mt area. What I purchased said NEW and it was stale and 9 months old. I purchased the pack before this one and it was the same.
I chew a lot of gum.  This is a cheaper way to buy it.
I was pleased with this product but wish the delivery could have been a bit swifter.

is what my husband said this coffee reminds him of.  He likes a mid (not strong) taste.  I don't drink coffee hot. My idea of coffee is a wonderful smell in the morning that I will make and add to a latte or I guess I mean a chocolate/coffee smoothie that I make at home.  This one suits that bill.  It is a full flavor to me or strong.  I believe it would even make a second cup if I so desired.Would I pay a huge amount for it?  No, I think this coffee is relatively expensive. There are only 15 pods in the box and it happens to have Marley on the box.  Is that the reason for the cost or is pod coffee just expensive?Since I don't have a pod machine I boiled a cup of water and added it to the pod in a cup with a spoon holding it down.  Worked well for me.Good coffee but not worth what they want for it.

column9: convenient, low-acid, but a bit weak
column10: The first thing that hit me is that these appear to be a low-acid gype of coffee....I didn't get that icky feeling some coffees give you after you drink them.  That is a definite plus.  But the coffee itself isn't that strong either.  I'm not into Kona or really deep flavors, I like just a medium blend.  But this still seemed weak.  It almost came across as coffee-tea than a strong cup of joe.I don't think I'd order this particular blend again.

I had never used these coffee pods before and used them in my coffee maker without a filter.  I was really expecting the coffee to smell great when it was brewing, but maybe it is to mild.  If you like milder breakfast type coffee or chai tea you will love this coffee.  I added a little light cream and it was very good, be careful with the cream it needs very little.  My first cup I put to much light cream and it overpowered the drink.  I would buy this again, it is something nice to give as a gift or serve to company.

. . .A little fussy about my coffee, and this coffee did not disappoint me.  It has a rich flavor, I can control the strength by adding or substracting the amount of water I use (which you can do wih all coffees, I know).  The flavor - although I cannot pinpoint the difference, is very nice.  I'll definitely be buying more of this brand and I think that's probably the best review I can give it - I want more.

I made my coffee the usual way but it was not strong enough. I don't like my coffee overly strong, but I do like it to taste like coffee. I made another cup, but used 2 packets, perfect! It tastes exactly like coffee, nothing over the top, just coffee. I gave it 4 stars though because it is organic, and I prefer everything organic!

I'm still not a food reviewer. The problem is that I can't turn down free coffee. That said, this is good stuff, mellow with none of the bitter edge common with a lot of the cheaper stuff sold at the local grocery store. I subtracted one star from the review because of the ridiculously pretentious ad copy on the box. Drinking this coffee won't fix the world or make your life more fulfilling, I'm fairly sure.

column9: Roast is too dark for  a Yirgacheffe
column10: While the roast is  described  as medium it is actually a nice but slightly bitter dark roast which is completely without the promised floral notes that are expected in a good Yirgacheffe Ethiopian coffee. A true medium roast would have preserved the floral and fruity notes that are present in a good Yirgacheffe.  Otherwise, this is an OK feel good coffee for Senseo and Senseo compatible pod cofee makers.  It is both Fair Trade and Organic certified and promotes or sponsors the coffee kicks charity while trading on the Marley name.  However, there is a lot of necessarily sturdy packaging which blunts the organic and sustainable claims for me.  As is standard for Senseo pods, each pod has only enough coffee for 5-6 ounces of strong  coffee. Use two for a mug if you prefer strong coffee.

We saw that some of the coffee reviews said that the coffee was weak when "teabagged."  We put a few pods of Marley Coffee One Love, One Heart into our old-fashioned stovetop percolator and let the steam do its magic.Yum. Great flavor, and strong enough. Even though I prefer my coffee whitened and sweetened, I was surprised that I enjoyed the Marley Coffee black. This coffee was great alone, and would probably do well as a mixer for cooking or alcohol recipes.Next time, we may experimentally open the pods and try the in the Keurig; however, we *were* satisfied with the percolator.

First of, I didn't really know what to expect when I ordered this coffee.  Come to find out the "single serve pods" are flat, round cushions that require a special coffee maker.  I own a Keurig and Eco-Brew refillable cups that I really like, so I decided to open the pod and dump the grounds into the Eco-Brew cup instead.  It worked like a charm, and on the 6cc setting I got to enjoy a very bold brew with no aidic aftertaste.

One Love is a good, robust coffee - if you like a strong coffee in the morning, you should like the flavor. Honestly, I didn't really catch the hints of exotic floral and berry they advertise which is just as well as I enjoy a basic coffee. The single serving pods are handy but you can also use a couple in a regular machine and it works just fine as well. If you're environmentally concious, it is free trade certified and organic.  Partial proceeds are also donated to the charity kicksforcause.org.  Overall an enjoyable cup of coffee with decent flavor.

Well, I wasn't bright when I ordered this coffee and for some reason I thought it came in both single servings and pods. I had to tear the pods open and use just the coffee and that way, it is EXCELLENT coffee. Rich and dark, I really like the flavor. My only complaint is, no, they're not easy to open packets, I have to use scissors and really, does it need all that wasteful packaging? But the coffee itself is very good, though I don't know all the fancy words for describing coffee, I like strong flavor with caffeine, usually choosing medium roasts and this fits the bill.

This package of Marley coffee contains a bunch of "pods" designed for pod coffee makers. Look them up and boggle at the prices. I do not have one so my first try was with my French press - the purest way of making coffee. I put one pod into it and poured in a large cupful of almost boiling water. After poking it around for a while and leaving it to sit, I got a blackish coffee which tasted a bit weak.For my second attempt I cut open two pods and emptied the ground coffee into the press. The resulting coffee was quite strong, but as a quasi-European (English) that's the way I like it.What to say about the flavor? It was mild (no harshness) and fairly pleasant. The coffee in Denny's restaurants is better though.

Brewing Machine: Philips SenseoFirst thing I noticed was that the packet contained noticeably more coffee than my Senseo pods.  I thought great, I can use just one to brew my double serving cup.  Wrong, very weak when brewed that way.Second, tried to brew two servings at once, but two pods were much too large to fit in the two serving Senseo pod holder.  So, I used the single pod holder and brewed one cup at a time.  What a hassle.Taste wise, the coffee is okay, it tases sort of weak for my tastes and doesn't have a lot of flavor, and the price per pod you might as well buy Star Bucks (or favorite coffee house coffee).  I will keep using my Senseo dark roast pods which I think have better flavor and are much cheaper.

column9: not for french roast coffee drinkers
column10: i drink my coffee strong and black so this is too weak for me.  i do have the one pot coffee maker and i either have to decrease the water or use two of these.  this is not economical.  it is much easier to just wrap some french roast coffee into a paper towel and use that instead.  if you like very mild coffee pods, this i s fine, but not for those of us who can't get it strong enough.

While I am no fan of coffee, other members in my household love it.  This got rave reviews.This looks like it comes in a tea bag.  It's easy to make; you just brew it for a few minutes and wring it out.  You can make it the way you make tea by applying the bag concept.  This was a big hit with the coffee hounds..

column9: Needs more instruction but we figured it out
column10: Marley Coffee is an interesting product which comes in a tasteful display box/dispenser, and proves that one can have fresh rich coffee just about anywhere without dedicated coffeemakers or pod machines.Maybe the "One Love" variety is meant for two cups per "single serve" bag, or perhaps one is supposed to do something more than to "Stir It Up" little darlin', as recommended on the box (in homage to the song.)There wasn't instruction on the packaging on how to get the brew right with these large "tea bags" of coffee. The only thing clearly marked was which side of the bag should be faced down in the cup.The coffee has a good taste, but the first bag I tried brewed up so strong it gave me the jitters. Good thing there are 15 individual plastic-sealed bags in the dispenser. My husband fiddled around with them because he likes an occasional cup of joe in the afternoon but doesn't want to brew up a whole pot.I credit him with coming up with the "spoon test" to figure out when the coffee was at the perfect strength. We use a 16 oz. cup because the circumference of the bag is rather wide for our 12 oz, and we pour boiling water over the bag which rises to the top as the cup fills. Then we wait for it to steep. After a couple of minutes, he takes a spoon and starts lowering it into the cup just until the bowl of the spoon is completely immersed. When the brew gets dark enough, the bowl of the spoon disappears except for the edges, and then it's done.It's a quality product, convenient, and can save on electricity, as well as not wasting coffee and good water, or adding pods to the landfill. And it's a really nice way to remember Bob Marley, a man of nature from Jamaica.

column9: Strong and bold flavor, fits in Philips Senseo machines, and it is organic!
column10: We are still on our first box of this, but so far we love this coffee at home. We have a Senseo coffee machine, and we were unsure if it would work for us, but it fits perfectly. The coffee is organic, no artificial ingredients like some of the other ones have (including the ones recommended by Philips!) Size wise, each coffee pod is quite thick, I would equate it to 1.5 times the Senseo ones. Smells and tastes great. I am not the biggest coffee drinker, but the ladies in the house love it.Highly recommended.

column9: Good earth-friendly coffee but too much packaging
column10: I am a coffee lover and usually enjoy a strong cappuccino in the morning.  I tried this coffee and was impressed by the aroma and flavor.  It is not too strong but has a good not-too bitter flavor.  I really like the pods - so much less mess but these are all individually wrapped!  I know a lot of coffee pods/packets are to keep in the freshness but maybe organic and fair-trade coffee manufacturers could care a little more about the waste produced from individually wrapped items.  Needless to say, I did enjoy my cup of coffee and would buy this product again.

column9: Not the best Ethiopian coffee I've had, but pretty darn good for a coffee pod
column10: Executive summary: not as good as a traditional cup of Ethiopian coffee, but definitely the best coffee pod coffee I've ever had.Several years ago I walked into an Ethiopian restaurant for the first time.  The food was good, but the coffee was the best coffee I had ever tasted.  It was rich and dark and so incredibly flavorful.  It didn't pack a killer caffeine punch, which is good, because I drank a whole pot by myself.  I love coffee and drink it daily, and I've never found another coffee that came close, except at another Ethiopian restaurant.  It's my understanding that coffee originated in that region, which may have something to do with it.
