A great idea and I would recommend it.  However, it would be nice if the cigars were a little bigger and more cigar shaped.  Overall though good idea and good product.

Our office recently (and possibly misguidedly) voted a Starbucks machine off the island and replaced it with a couple of Bunn airpot makers. They're great for commercial coffee but that is also the problem: it tastes like mediocre diner coffee even when good beans are used. So I've taken matters into my own hands and picked up an Espressione Cafe Novecento espresso maker and have put it in the kitchen "on loan" to the company.My first few attempts at pulling a decent shot with fresh ground coffee convinced me that I simply don't have the patience to learn the proper technique so, as the machine came with a pod portafilter, I decided to give that a shot (so to speak). Illy had the highest number of positive recomendations so I settled on them for my initial foray.Simply put, I am impressed. The flavor is excellent, the output takes in the ballpark of 20-30 seconds a shot and has very good crema on about three out of every four shots. It can be tricky to properly seat the pod in the portafilter but moistening the pod first does help and that's a more a reflection on the filter design than the pod's.The primary reason I can't give five stars (although I'd do four and a half if I could) is that even the Amazon price works out to almost a dollar a shot so my double Americano in the morning is only slightly less than I'd pay my favorite barista. And she has a really cute smile.All in all, though, a very positive experience and I recommend the Illy pods.

Illy Dark Roast Pods provide a great-tasting cup of espresso with crema and without the mess of cleaning up all those grounds. The tin packaging is compact for easy storage, but I recommend keeping the opened pods in a vacuum container to maintain freshness. If you're willing to invest in two 18-pod tins, you can't beat the price on Amazon!For a slightly different great taste and individual packaging to maintain freshness, try Espressione as an alternative, though the individual packaging requires additional storage space in your cupboard.
These ese pods work, not mess.  Flavor is quite good.  Not as good as fresh ground, etc.  For what it is, a good product, with a nice flavor.

First time I tried illy espresso  6 yrs ago  while  on business trip  in Europe. Hard  to forget taste , illy Caffe Dark Roast PODs will satisfy any espresso lover , especially when Cleaning reduced to Zero. Highly Recommended.

column9: Easy to use, cheap, and actually makes pretty good espresso.
column10: So, I'll start by saying I'm sort of an espresso snob. I got an espresso machine after spending 3 days on the internet checking out the best ones and ending up with a great deal on a Francis Francis X3 FrancisFrancis! X3 Espresso Machine, Black Matte.I was wary of the pod idea and couldn't imagine getting real espresso from an air packed pod of really old espresso. Francis Francis had a canister to try in the package, so I broke down one day and just tried it. I must say, it was actually really good. The canister was a little old so the espresso was a little bitter but it had better crème and consistency of most any of my pulls.The Francis Francis machines are made for pods so I just put the little guy in and turned on the machine. Clean-up was easy, just pull the side paper and throw it away. I didn't have to wipe-up espresso dust off everywhere, clean espresso off the machine...nothing really. Not to mention the price of these little things is much better than having to pay for ok/horrible espresso close to home or pay outrageous amounts for shipping. Also, Lilly makes many different varieties of espresso like medium (I left this same review for that variety), dark, decaf, etc. (not sure about other brands, I've just stuck with Lilly)So, in conclusion, I've converted... I'm a closet pod user and the ease of use and the fact that I can get 36 pods for less than a dollar a piece is great for me.

I thought i was saving a bit of $ per pod by purchasing the Illy brand for my new Delonghi machine.  Espresso was weak compared to Starbucks.  I use 2 per large Latte with the Illy and one from Starbucks to make the same size.  Not much of a savings this way.  Would not purchase again.

column9: Not Up to illy's High Standard
column10: I am disappointed. They work as advertised: quick, clean, and easy. However, more important to me is taste.While individually wrapped, the freshness of beans ground just for that moment is missing. The pod itself uses less coffee than I would in a single shot. Since I more often will make lungos, the sheer lack of coffee volume produces a weaker drink. Instead of pulling twice as long, I pull it 80% as long for a short shot, but it takes longer to get it all into the cup.The crema is impressive, equal to any regular Illy.The cost-per-drink is poor. I already knew this, but hoped I would be impressed enough by the quality so as to tolerate the price.I regular buy cans of illy's dark roast whole beans for grinding into espresso. These ESEs are not as good as the real thing. Because of the high standard illy otherwise supports for its products, I cannot give my full support to the illy Caffe Scura Coffee, Espresso, (Dark Roast, Black Band), 18-Count E.S.E. Pods.--Brockeim

I'm pretty particular about my expresso and I much prefer fresh ground to the pods. But fresh ground is messy and takes more time. I have tried a bunch of different pods on the market. These are by far the best I've had. They give a rich bold flavor that's still smooth and enjoyable. Compared to the Starbucks pods these are one star above at least. They are a bit more expensive, but after going back and forth between these, the starbucks ones, and a few other brands the price difference per pod is usually no more the $0.20. In my opinion it is well worth the extra $0.20 for a delicious cup of expresso. Often better even then what I get at various coffee shops. If your an every day espresso/latte/cappuccino drinker then you will appreciate the subtle yet noticeable higher quality of these pods.

People used to the usual american burnt espresso (AKA starbucks) need to taste illy's coffee.  Also, the POD system works well to deliver consistency for those less inclined to fuss over their own grind-and-tamp.  The consistent quality of the espresso is high and together with the convenience, it's a winner for all but the snootiest (for whom, nothing but their own "recipe" will have been satisfactory anyway).
makes a great latte, quick and easy to use....  if you visit illy's website you will find that it is cheaper to buy illy coffee on amazon...
These pods make the preparing of deliciouse espresso, capuccino and late much easier, faster and cleaner.
For pod espresso, these are the best.  They make a great cup when I dont want to heat up my Ms. Silvia and grind.

I spend a lot of time making lattes and I've used Starbucks, illy, and Lavazza pods all ordered on Amazon. Right now illy is $.88 a pod, Lavazza is $.525 a pod, and Starbucks is $.4125 a pod. Which actually suprised me. illy pods take about half the time Starbucks pods take, I think this is because the grounds are not as tightly packed. With illy and Lavazza I have had a couple pods break, or water leak out of my machine, found out it was due to the extra little grip lip on the pod itself so after I cut those off no more leaking. I actually enjoy the taste of illy over Starbucks but in these times where money is tight. I'll stick with the Star-"bucks" to save a few.

I look forward to this coffee every morning.  It is much like the coffee they serve in Europe - rich and strong.  If you like the typical American weak and watery coffee you would not like it but if you long for the coffee you experience in Europe you would be thrilled.

On average my wife an I drink 1-2 expressos daily and a few months ago bought a delonghi bar32 expresso maker. I purchased this product just to see what all the hype was. It seemed from people I talked with and some reviews that some people really think this is a great tasting product. After going through the 2 boxes I can say it does taste good, but I still prefer fresh ground. It is hard to explain, but these pods had a distinct taste, not like the fresh ground I make or what you would expect at Starbucks. The taste isn't bad, just distinctly different, which may be what people that rate it high like. For me I enjoyed the convenience of the pods, but wouldn't regurally pay extra for the taste.

column9: Excellent pods and good for free shipping
column10: My wife loves these pods for her quick and easy twice a day espresso hit.  And I love them because, unlike how we used to buy them in units of ten boxes, here I can get two boxes at a time, which means that whenever I want to buy something for less than $25 I just toss this into the order and can get free shipping anytime.  Since she uses about a box a week, and I don't order more than once weekly, it works out perfectly.  And the coffee is excellent coffee if you like a dark roast pod.

column9: A Shot a day keeps me working away
column10: Great shot in a dirty chai, use in handpresso, handy, portable, consistent shot of joe!
This has to be the worse Espresso coffee I ever tried.  If you think it's good, you've never been to a Starbiucks to try their Express.

Because of time constraints in the morning, I've been trying different ESE pods. These blew me away! Maybe I got a fresh batch, but I am having a tough time distinguishing these from my fresh ground beans. Rich, flavorful and lots of crema. Very robusto. Makes a superb latte!  Stands up well in the the steamed milk. Price-wise, I save a bit vs. stopping for a grande Starbucks latte and get a much better flavor.One tip: I read this in another review, and I'll confirm that dampening the pod before use works well for me for the best seal and pull.Regarding some of the comparisons to Starbucks in other reviews, I've tried both @ home, and to me the Starbucks doesn't come close.
We order this product all the time for the office.  We put a splash of Hazelnut creamer and it is AMAZING!

I'm not a gourmet, just someone who looks forward to her morning latte. I typically make a 12-oz latte with a single shot.  I like saving money by making my own lattes, but don't want to take the time or deal with the mess of grinding beans, so I prefer pods. I recently bought a De'Longhi EC155 15 BAR Pump Espresso and Cappuccino Maker, and was inspired to expand my horizons beyond Starbucks espresso pods, so I tried a few different brands. Package came in as dated. The coffee is excellent. I actually prefer illy's medium roast and thought i'd try something new. If you love dark roast, this is a perfect choice.
They make it easy on you with this bags but it is a bit pricey compared to the same coffe from the can!Good coffe taste though!
illy makes a great product, possibly the best. Can't go wrong with these pods. Thank you illy, don't ever change!
Illy pods produce excellent coffee without the mess of ground coffee. The Dark Roast is highly fragrant, and strong but not bitter. I tried the Starbucks and Lavazza pods, but these are better.

Been trying various pods to make espresso, but this stuff can't be beat.  Just about perfect.  I like the dark roast best, but the medium is great too.  Slightly more expensive than most, but absolutely worth it.

column9: Excellent coffee, super easy to use!
column10: We have the Francis Francis X6 and it, and this coffee, are really awesome. Couldn't be easier and better tasting!

column9: Convenient, nice crema, and distinct taste

We use it for an awful lot of stuff, when we can get it: Hamburgers, Meat Fondue, pork, chicken, sauces, etc.  This spring I planted tarragon and was going to make it myself with a Dijon, because our local gourmet food store stopped carrying it.Amazon to the rescue. Once you've tried this blend, it makes it impossible to enjoy normal tea bags sold at grocery stores such as twinings and even the teas that are sold at Starbucks.

Many vocal critics of illy coffee have never actually tasted it. As Dr. House says, everybody lies and illy is apparently a very popular thing to lie about. I've caught several vocal critics lying about illy (by serving it to them, getting the typical "This is fabulous!" reaction, then telling them what they're drinking. You know, the Folger's Coffee Crystals technique).Why is this?Well, on the surface illy does appear to be frivolous and therefore an easy target.- It's very expensive, especially for coffee that comes in a can- It's got a very fussy, very European marketing envelope around it- It tends to be sold in fussy, trendy stores- Because it's roasted and packaged in Italy, it is always several months old when you buy it- Did I mention that it's very expensive?As a result, it's easy to dismiss illy as an elitist, "image" product that can't possibly be worth what it costs. And it's easy to convince others of the same thing, whether you've actually tried illy or not.The truth is illy is really superb coffee, just about the best I've ever tried. Since I've started drinking it at home, I've found I'm actually drinking much less coffee overall, because I only know a couple of places that serve illy locally and I just don't feel like bothering with anything else, at least most of the time. The ironic net effect of this is that illy may actually be saving me some money!I don't know if illy will be worth what it costs to you. There are some very good coffee beans sold by Costco for roughly 1/5 the price, much better than anything you can get at Starbucks or Peets. (In fact, if Starbucks or Peets is your idea of really good coffee, stop reading this now. Not because I think you're some tasteless boob, but because those brands are in the very modern, very successful mode of bitter, over-roasted, burned-tasting American coffee and I don't personally care for that. So if you like those brands, you're probably not going to like illy or any coffee that I like. Personally, I like the bottomless cup of Peerless my favorite diner serves much better than Starbucks.)What I do know is that if you like coffee enough to own a decent grinder and other caffeine paraphernalia, you really ought to try illy. In particular, if you like light-medium roasts but find most are just too wimpy, you may just love this stuff.If not, you'll at least have a cute, fussy  little can you can sub-divide some of your Costco walnuts into. And that is something.

Illy espresso beans are my favorite of all the widely available commercially produced roasted espresso beans. This is the standard medium roast that Illy produces and it is a bit less aggressive and milder tasting than the dark roasts of Lavazza (the other major Italian brand that some people favor).When properly ground, tamped, and brewed Illy espresso has a delightful aroma and flavor, unmatched by any of the other brands.Granted, Illy is quite pricey, and I do not use it all the time for this reason. However, you get what you pay for. Usually, I buy my espresso from a small roasting house in the Midwest that produces a decent medium roast substitute that I do not mind using most of the time. But Illy definitely produces a higher quality bean.One way to judge the quality of roasted espresso beans even before you taste the coffee that they will produce is to look at the evenness of color and size of the beans. The reason is that beans of a uniform size tend to roast more evenly than beans of varying sizes. Moreover, even when the beans are of a uniform size, it is important that they be roasted in small batches and churned during the the entire roasting process to ensure that they all get roasted to the same point. This is why most high quality coffee is roasted in small batches in a rotating drum that roasts all the beans to the exact same point. Moreover, since the moisture content of the beans varies a bit from batch to batch, quality control in the roasting process is extremely important. And it is here that Illy is unmatched. Just do a simple visual comparison of the color and consisteny of Illy beans when compared to any of the other widely available brands and you can easily see why Illy is the best.

column9: illy Caffe Normale Whole Bean (Red Top) Coffee, 8.8 Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
column10: Fancy coffee packaging. The quality of beans is very good. The reason for 3 stars is the price. I find Lavazza Tierra which %100 Arabica like Illy has the same quality or better for a fraction of the price of Illy beans.

column9: Best vacuum-sealed beans if you can't get fresher
column10: My adventure with coffee started years ago; I've been through a Jura-Capresso S9 (Super-automatic) and eventually found my way to a Rancillio Silvia V3 espresso machine.My hunt for good beans (Tucson, AZ) has been as variable, eventually being able to find decent fresh-ish beans at the local Whole Foods-type-place (Sunflower). Of all the mail-order, vacuum-sealed, "older" beans I've tried (including any main-stream beans like Milestone) from a super market, these Illy are much better, but compared to real, fresh beans, they don't quite stand up.Taste-wise these beans are much smoother than I expected; because they are vacuum-sealed and typically 2-4months old by the time you get them, I expected the dry/sharp/bitter taste that I get from every other bean I've tried (you ever tried Starbucks beans? Good lord, bitter) and was surprised when they actually ended up being quite a bit smoother.The smell during grinding is a typical "dry/old" bean smell, it doesn't have that lustrous smell that a fresh bean does and when pulling the shot it doesn't have that carmel-colored, never-ending crema that a fresh bean gives, but surprisingly enough, it tastes pretty nice.At my Whole Foods-esque store, I can get fresh-ish beans for $7.99/lb, at roughly $36/lb it is *impossible* for me to justify these Illy beans.If you are in a location where fresh-beans are an impossibility and you have been relegated to super-market, main-stream garbage beans, and you don't mind paying the premium, these beans are quite nice and should keep you pretty happy.If you are a bean-snob and demand perfect behavior of your beans through the grind/shot sequence, then you probably need to keep looking and need to move somewhere where fresh coffee is more readily found :)

I've been drinking espresso since 1983 when I was introduced to it by Signor Forza in Rome. I found out that Italians have a saying "Only women and babies drink cappucino after 9:00". What that means is that all the men take a coffee (espresso) break at 9:00. Well since I returned to the states in 1985 I have tried all kinds of expresso beans, using mostly Starbucks. I happened across a can of Illy beans at a Tucson store. I vaguely remembered the Illy brand from my 8 months in Italy and decided to try it. It is inarguably the best espresso I have had since returning from Italy.

This is my favorite coffee!  I don't drink it every day because it is a bit pricey, but whenever I have guests, I serve them illy...it is nice to let them feel special that I am sharing this treat with them.  It is very smooth without leaving an acidy taste in your mouth...like drinking a desert.  I would recommend it to anyone who wants a nice smooth cup of coffee.  They don't burn their beans!

I have had esspresso from here to china in many different shops.  I know my coffee and espresso.  As coffee is a very personal prefrence take this for what it may.  There is no bitterness (though some skill is needed in making it) the flavor is rich, smooth, and consistent.  that is where illy is a step ahead of others.  Notice the consistent bean size in an Illy can.  this leads to constent roasting of the beans.  This leads to constent flavor.  Weather you prefer a dark roast or a medium the bean size uniformity is key to the roasting and processing steps of the process.  a good analogy is does angel hair pasta need to boil for as long as a thick ziti.  No if you did the angel hair would be mush by the time the ziti was done.  Well cofee beans can be over or under done for the same reason thickness and size drive rates.One thing I would say to some one concered about the price.  For 16 dollars I get a week of espresso's.  I used to spend this in D&D or starbuck in 2 days, and it was not as good!If you really enjoy your coffee you should give it a try, if you still really like starbucks after that I would be shocked!!!  It would be a challange for me to go to starbucks again unless I am in an airport and no where serves Illy!For me it is well worth it

Illy brand has always been one of my favorite beans.  The price is comparable to grocery stores.  It didn't matter much to me but the tin was smashed/dented a bit on every can. The beans were unharmed.
Having drunk a bit of coffee and done some experimentation at home with our own grinder and espresso machine, we always come back to Illy.Can't go past it, perfect every time.

I make espresso with a Delonghi Magnifica Super Auto Espresso machine and I have found Illy Medium Roast to produce the best results possible.  It's a little more expensive than buying beans locally but the difference is astounding.

I bought a can of Illy whole bean coffee, hearing so many wonderful things about it. The beans are good, flavor decent, rarely bitter but didn't find anything truly special about the coffee. Bought a can of Kicking Horse 454 to compare. The beans are very oily and aroma far more overpowering than the Illy. It may be too strong but it was clear that these beans were very fresh and full bodied. While 454 is a dark roast, even the medium roasts seem to have the same experience. One of my friends called Illy "airport coffee" and while I think it's a cut above the cheap, I'm not sure I disagree with him. I certainly think Peet's is better than Illy. Perhaps it's meant for espresso machines, I don't know. But at this price, I don't think it's worth it. Everything is a matter of taste, of course, but if you get a chance to look at the beans from other brands, you might be surprised. I certainly was.
I use this coffee in my fully automatic coffee machine. The result is just as tasty as what I can buy at a commercial coffee house.

I found this coffee bean, freshly coarse-ground in a burr grinder and carefully prepared in a French press, to be devoid of aroma and very bitter, even with sugar (which I ordinarily do not add) added. Wish it could be returned for a refund of its unreasonable cost, but it cannot be.

Great product with a very smooth taste! One reminder.. the instructions on the can are for 5oz cups, you may have to adjust the amount of coffee used depending on your taste and the size cup measure on your coffee maker.
The beans are consistently roasted just right to produce the same high-quality cup of coffee from can to can.  My only complaint is the price, but I guess you get what you pay for.
This coffee is delish - I dump this into my Jura Capresso coffee maker and it makes the most smooth, mellow, almost chocolaty tasting coffee (never bitter or harsh).  Yumm!

This is a nice mild blend that I use for my daily morning coffee. It works well in a fully automatic Capresso machine, the beans are not oily at all. I use subscribe and save feature to get this coffee at a great price.

We purchased this with our super-automatic espresso machine. Very good brew, it is a bit expensive, but has great flavor. The cans are good for storing any coffee (we often get 3lb bags and use the cans for storing for daily use).

column9: very good flavor but at such a price
column10: Ok, I'd heard people rave and I had to try it. I grind my beans in a burr grinder, and I brew the coffee in a drip machine with a cone style filter. First, I followed the instructions on the can, and I found the coffee too weak.  At 25% stronger, the flavor was fine, but surely no better than some at half the price.  Nice can, though!
I bought these to go into gift baskets and the cans are ALL dented. Not very nice presentation. I will stick with local supplier where I can inspect the product.

column9: Great Tasting Sugar-Free Pudding! Highly Recommended
column10: Jell-O "Sugar-Free Instant Pudding" is a great snack! Since becoming a Type 2 diabetic last year, I am always looking for good tasting, low carb snacks.The Jell-O instant puddings are easy to make and taste so good that it is hard to tell it is a "diet" snack.Highly recommended!

The product is great.  I use it as my snack food because it is sugar free and a good way for me to "drink" more milk.  HOWEVER:  I ordered a 24-pack of 1.5 ounce boxes.  I received 1.0 ounce boxes.  Amazon replaced the order with another carton of 1.0 ounce boxes.  I would have preferred to have received what I ordered.  Still love the product.

column9: Great Product, but Amazon's warehouse is messed up
column10: The product, as listed, is a CASE of 24, 1.5 ounce boxes of pudding mix.  Imagine my surprise when I opened the box to find ONE box (1.5 ounce, 6 servings) instead of the expected 24.  This leads to a call to Amazon with a customer service representative who unfortunately didn't know what Jell-O pudding was and was having a hard time understanding that there had been an error in the number of items shipped.  Ummmm...who would pay $30 for six 1/2 cup servings of pudding???  This was finally understood and another order was placed (kindly, they did not require me to return the single box of pudding).  Low and behold, several days later the package arrives... AGAIN another single box of pudding instead of a case of 24 boxes.  Another phone call to Amazon, another rep who doesn't quite understand but finally decides to just credit me for the order and not require that I return the single package.  It was decided that we would not try to place the order again, as it would appear the warehouse has a problem filling orders for this item.  I orderd the chocolate flavor case of 24 and it arrived without problem... a carton of 24 boxes of pudding mix, as expected.

column9: Picky turkey junky cat turned it down.
column10: I was surprised when my turkey junky turned this one down.  He's loved most of the other varieties in this series and well, this one just didn't make the grade.  Had to flush it down the garbage disposal so the rest went back to the store for the egg souffles'.  Gotta love that finicky part, huh?  Anyway, I do recommend it anyway because of their high nutritional value.  My rescue Persian cannot eat these shredded varieties because her previous owner kicked out her teeth on one side of her mouth.  She doesn't care much for turkey anyway but I was disappointed that she couldn't chew these because of their high nutritional value.  Gets tiring cutting up all that cat food! Recommend but with the above experience.

My cat loves this product. I only give her half a can at a time considering how pricey it is but I found that the stuff is pretty rich so she doesn't really finish a whole can at a time. She's really picky about what she eats but every flavor of this has proven to be really great for her. I suggest this to anyone who has picky cats. :)
A quick, easy and delicious option for dinner. Slice it up, cover in sauce and sliced mozzarella, put into a 350 degree oven until bubbly... wonderful.

column9: The best Tandoori mix on the market
column10: I have tried many other Tandoori mixes, this by far exceeds all the rest. I use it with buttermilk marinated for 24 hours.
Does a great job, just add to yogurt.  I accidentally used French Vanilla yogurt and it was still good.  I think plain yogurt is best.

My husband is in love with Tandoori chicken and I bought this to make it at home.  It is a homerun every night I use it, and I experimented with it on beef in the crockpot, CULINARY MASTERPIECE.Super easy to use, open packet, add yogurt, mix, and cook.  Perfection everytime.

column9: Tasty, easy to use and good value
column10: I am a huge fan of tandoori chicken and wanted to try my hand at making some at home.  I looked online and found this product with good reviews.  I am glad that I bought it because it is certainly tasty.  It was easy to use, and I made it for some friends and they loved it, too.  I think for the money this product is a good value. If you like tandoori and want to make it at home, I strongly recommend this spice. I would definitely buy this again.

I used alot more yogurt than called for, and it is a tart Bulgarian yogurt. I use boneless/skinless chicken thighs whole in a 13X9 baking dish in a 325 oven for one hour. Makes a great sauce with which to top rice. This is my favorite of all the India spices from Curry Tree.

We go through this dressing very quickly.  It is delicious and easy to fix.  Got the 24 pack at a good price, cheaper than the grocery store (which only sells 4 packs), and enough to last for a while.

Product was received in good shape. The problem is that there was little packaging of the individual packets, and no date of manufacture nor "best used by" date--which leaves one wondering if this is a way of dumping outdated stock. DISAPPOINTED!!!

column9: My sister in law's favorite salad addition
column10: My sister in law loves Good Seasons dry Italian salad dressing.  Whenever I visit her in Israel it is the first thing I pack for her.  She makes the most delicious dressing with it and has given her daughter in laws the recipe so now they want me to bring packets as well!

We love this salad dressing at our house.  I make it with olive oil and balsamic vinegar with a splash of apple cider vinegar.  I've turned scores of people onto this dressing.  One friend said her husband liked it so much, he practically drinks it.  The Amazon price (24 packs) is about a third the price compared to the grocery store. Highly recommended.

Illy is the perfect espresso blend for people who haven't invested in a $600 burr grinder. Instead of trying to describe its qualities, let me relate a story:This summer we went on a houseboat vacation where I was subjected to God-awful drip coffee for a week.  As soon as we got off the boat I hit up a  Starbucks, which was of course disappointing.  Then, when I got home, we were out of Illy.On Monday morning I tried to make my espresso with some of Trader Joe's Espresso Blend, and while I love the Trader's, their espresso is horrible.  Finally at lunchtime I was able to find some Illy.  I was so thrilled that on the way home from work I had to pop the top, just to smell its deliciousness.  When I finally got home and pulled myself a shot, I was in heaven.It's like an addiction, a craving.  And in 6 months of searching since I got my espresso machine, I haven't found better nationally available coffee.
We love the taste of Illy coffees when brewed in our espresso machine-- smooth, never bitter. And the vacuum-packed canister has a unique, reusable design.

I've been brewing espresso at home for over 25 years, and have tried just about everything (including lugging suitcases full of coffee from Italy).  This coffee is indeed superior to everything else.  What's interesting is that the coffee is ground perfectly for espresso machines, so I'm saved the chore and mess of grinding my own. For some reason, the chief competitor, Lavazza, although selling decent coffee, for less than half the price, does not grind it optimally, forcing me to buy their beans and grind them myself.  Illy is expensive, at least double the runner-up. But then you could argue, that 45 cents a cup, instead of 20 cents, amounts to less than a dollar per day difference (assuming 4 cups per day), an amount you could afford spoiling yourself. Unfortunately, Amazon's price is even higher than our local supermarkets (Safeway, Giant, etc) where it's sold for $12.99 a can.  You could save 15% by subscribing, but then you could stock up locally when it's on sale.

Illy makes the best espresso roast coffee.  I don't usually buy ground coffee, but this is great for my rushed mornings.  Works perfect with a Bialetti stove top espresso/cappuccino maker.  Bialetti Mukka Express Cappuccino Maker, Polished Aluminum

column9: The perfect cup of espresso to jump start your day ...
column10: After purchasing a Gaggia 16103 Evolution Espresso Machine, Silver several years ago, I started hunting for the perfect Italian espresso roast. One of my first (and favorite) blends was the Illy Fine Grind Dark Roast. Imported from Italy, Illy is available in whole beans, drip grind (for regular coffeemakers), espresso grind, and pods.When I took the Illy for a test drive, it produced an espresso with an assertive crema, something that cheaper brands such as Alessi and Lavazza did not. The beans themselves are roasted to perfection, with a caramel-like odor and nuance of flavor that I've yet to match in cheaper blends. I don't consume espresso straight, but instead whip up divine lattes using Illy Fine Grind Dark Roast as the base, although the Illy has so many rich notes, it would probably be great solo. I live in a large metro area, so there are numerous stores that carry Illy, but if you live in a small town, you may have to mail order yours.Another plus is the fact that it comes in an airtight tin perfect for storing in the freezer (as ground coffee tends to go stale quickly). Yes, this is expensive, but still cheaper than purchasing a burr grinder to grind my own espresso beans (when I pondered buying whole Illy beans and priced a burr grinder, my estimates were between $150-400). Illy also makes a fabulous decaf blend in dark roast (ILLY Ground Decaf Coffee 00493) that runs several dollars more, but is perfect for those late-night espresso indulgences. If you're thinking that it's too expensive, consider that a venti latte at Starbucks will set you back about $5 for ONE coffee, versus at least a dozen from a can of really great Italian coffee.

column9: Probably the best between commercial ones
column10: I want to review this product because I think there are some misunderstanding on what you should expect from it. First thing: Illy is one of the most appreciated brands in Italy, between those you find in supermarket shelves. Definitely not THE BEST, since in my country you can easily have imported beans roasted and ground at the moment.Second: It is NOT for use in auto dripping machines. The type of grinding is too thin. American coffee is made with coarse grind. This is to be used with espresso machines, or "caffettiera", amongst which Bialetti is the best brand, or pressure steam machines, those you find at the coffe shops.Third: to all of you who say "it's bitter": just put sugar in it, in Italy we put sugar in espresso. If you don't use sugar it is SUPPOSED to be bitter. To all of you who say it doesn't give you the "caffeine shot": that's not what espresso is for. If you need caffeine and need to wake up drink one of those energy drinks you can find at every store across the USA. Or just take some day off, sleep more and work less, like we do in Italy. Espresso is something small and enjoyable that makes your life a little better. Therefore it has to be good. It's part of our culture to enjoy the small things and try to live happier.

column9: Try your local grocer for a better price
column10: Marvelous coffee with a smooth, rich flavor and no bitter taste when made with an Alessi Richard Sapper stovetop machine. BUT, the price here is *way* too high. I can find this at my local grocery store for five dollars less *per can* than the price listed here, with even more savings when it's on sale.

After a wonderful trip to Italy last summer, my husband and I wanted to continue having a cup of cappuccino in the afternoon. After a few experiments with some awful tasting coffees, we finally found Illy fine grind dark roast and it is perfect.It's delicious. It's an afternoon in Rome. I think I could eat the grounds by themselves! We have gotten a few friends hooked on it also and now give it as gifts. It's more expensive than what you'll find in a grocery store, but definitely worth the price, and definitely less expensive than returning to Rome every afternoon for a great cup of cappuccino.

I have tried EVERYTHING for our francis francis espresso machine, and had an extremely difficult time to make it taste wonderful.I found this espresso, and the first time I tried it, I was absolutely HOOKED.  Try it; you'll love it!

We love Illy coffee but it is difficult and expensive to find in our area.  When I found it on the Amazon web site - WOW!  About half the price and delivered right to my door - and quickly!  I surprised my husband on Christmas morning when he found the can sitting next to the coffee pot.  Excellent!

This is one espresso grind that I actually enjoy over and over again.  There is no strange after-taste with some other "premium" brands.  This is a coffee lover's coffee.  It is rich and deep with a slightly nutty undertone.  Try it.  You won't regret it.The canister is nice, too.

I bought this at my local grocery store to use in my new Mr. Coffee espresso machine.I'm a big coffee nut, I even roast my own coffee. I have a grinder, but at the moment it's about 400 miles away from me :P So I had to settle with this. And to be honest, it's pretty tasty! MUCH better than starsucks' best freshly ground stuff! (tells you how bad SB really is, worst coffee in the universe) But compared to my own stuff, illy coffee is downright nasty! Yes, freshly roasted, freshly ground coffee is that good!But if you have nothing else available, or you don't want to buy a grinder, this is the best pre-ground, canned coffee money can buy!I can find it in my local grocery store for a lot cheaper than here. Under 12 bucks at the San Antonio based Texas grocery chain.

Perfect Coffee that suits my taste. Goes well with your espresso machines.At times, I mix this Dark Roast and the medium Roast (Illy coffee), and the combination makes perfect coffee for my friends, who doesn't like very dark flavors..

I can get this at my local grocery store, but it's hit or miss whether they'll have the dark roast, fine grind available. The two-pack and auto-delivery ensures I won't run out even if I don't make it to the store. The coffee is a rich, dark roast (for some reason, harder to find than medium roast--seems strange for espresso) and has the best flavor of the Italian imports I've tried.
Great coffee at a great price.  I live in a very small town and I appreciate that I can order "gourmet" items from Amazon.com.  Illy is the best for home espresso machines.
This coffee is really yummy. I haven't had ground coffee that has tasted this good in a long time. I also like the self sealing can. I put it in the fridge so it will stay fresh longer

I admit to being old fashioned. My espresso maker is a Krups Il Caffe Duomo. It's a great little machine and it makes great espresso. I have tried at least 6 different kinds of espresso from the national brand where the baristas wear green aprons to most of the others. I settled on Illy because it was the first espresso made, back in the day, and it comes from Italy. The grind is very fine so you will need a basket that can hold fine espresso. If you are familiar with a burr coffee grinder, I will bet that this coffee is ground on a setting of 1.Don't talk to me about pods. Illy makes them but I like this espresso in the can. When you pop the lid, close your eyes and the aroma will take you to a bar in Italy. When you drink the resulting brew, it will have the same effect. It is the real deal and I buy it all the time.
Illy rules. My favorite espresso roast.  Great price.  Excellent.

And it brews perfectly in my automatic drip kitchen coffee maker. A customer introduced me to Illy in her office. I'd had it in restaurants and always enjoyed it, but never thought about purchasing it for my home use. I often mix it with another favorite roast and end up with the best of both worlds. It's a little more expensive than the coffee I regularly buy . The $$ spent for 2 8.8 oz. tins of Illy will buy about 2 LBS. of the other coffee I use. Illy is a luxury I won't give up soon.

Illy makes a great cup of coffee that rivals any designer-label coffee you can buy.  I first had it in Neiman Marcus at their in store restaurant and then purchased it for home.  Pricey..yes!  But rich and smooth.

column9: Best espresso you can bring home
column10: If you are someone who finds yourself going to Starbucks or Caribou much more often than you should, save yourself a lot of money and make it at home yourself!  I've tried them all, and can honestly tell you that this espresso is the best that you can get for the home barista.  It may seem expensive compared to the other brands that you can get, but nothing matches the rich dark espresso that you can make with illy.  I actually prefer home-made lattes with this coffee to anything I can buy in town.
It is, illy, Ground Espresso Coffe, so nice and great !!!This taste is very deep and flavor !!I strongly recommend this such a nice coffee !!

column9: Illy is my Madeleine de Proust
column10: illy, Ground Espresso Coffe, Fine Grind (Dark Roast, Black Band), 8.8-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)When I miss home, I make an illy espresso. I feel immediately better, it is my madeleine de Proust. Illy makes me feel as I were back home.There are wonderful, rare and precious coffees on this planet; but for exactly the same reasons, these beans are also very expensive. Let's think for instance of the Kopi Luwak alias Kafe laku alias Kape alamid (depending on the country that produces it), the Bourbon, or the Blue Mountain etc. Ok, sure they are great coffees if you can afford them.Even if we cannot compare what cannot be compared, Illy is a coffee company which makes fantastic AND affordable coffees. I like the dark ground espresso one because in Europe and especially in Italy we love strong coffee. Plus, I have no grinder. I like the foam on the top and the trace it leaves in my cup once I emptied it. And what to say about its fantastic color and smell? Illy coffee is a very good investment, above all if you love coffee and do not want to spend that much. Next time I am going to try the new espresso collection from Brazil...Illy MonoArabica Whole Bean Coffee Brazil full-bodied Coffee 8.8oz Tinand you?

This coffee has a rich flavor and nice body without any bitterness, no matter what kind of machine you use. I enjoy it at all  ties of day but especially in the afternoon or after a good meal. Exceptional depth. I love my Illy coffee.
It's more expensive than most other coffees.  Once you try it you won't be able to go back.  It's that good.

I was a bit disappointed with Illy.  It has a great aroma, but when brewed it doesn't have a strong coffee taste or boldness.  I drink coffee to wake up in the morning and break the fog, but this coffee just doesn't pack the punch to get me going.  I really wonder what they put in this Espresso Coffee to make it so aromatic? It almost smells like Pipe tobacco mixed with rum.  All caffeine effects me differently, this espresso made my hair go limp and I just couldn't get myself in gear to do anything.  I drink espresso to help me take on the day, but Illy failed.

column9: Great coffee, but don't buy it online.
column10: I have always loved Illy, and bought two cans at Christmas for delivery with a bunch of other Amazon orders.  I did it purely for the convenience of not having to pick up coffee to take to my holiday destination.However, I was disappointed:  one of the cans had a broken vacuum seal (all Illy cans are vacuum sealed).  Ergo, the coffee was not fresh; and since I couldn't be sure how non-fresh, I tossed it.  The other can was fine.I imagine Amazon would have honored a return, but it's not worth the time on a simple can of coffee.So I must reluctantly recommend you do not buy this product online, since there seem to be quality-control issues and returning to the vendor in that context is a net loss.The coffee itself, though, is very excellent, and I've been a loyal Illy customer for over 10 years.  This is the first vacuum-seal issue I've ever encountered.

Well , I learned again to stay away from  ground coffee , for this price ?  it is not bad or bitter but thank you, that was my last time , it is not a coffee for this price believe me ... I will use it for making cappuccino , because I do not like the taste of that coffee as espresso ... not even the smell , maybe is not my personal taste.. but believe me i am coffee freak and I am still in love with my gourme coffee

column9: Not worth the price, not even close
column10: Personally I don't find the flavor of this coffee in any way special. Purely on volume, this is 17.6 ounces of coffee for more money than 36 ounces of a competing product. It was nice enough, but it wasn't great. It wasn't special. It's just coffee.It does come in a nice tin though, so I took the empties and refilled them with fare trade shade grown coffee. It tastes just as good, to me, and I don't have to worry about the cost of having a few cups of coffee any more.I'm sure there are some people out there who are convinced that this stuff is worth the price. But not for me.If the tins hadn't been reusable I'd have given the coffee a 2 for being overpriced and no better than other competing quality coffees.

It is possible to have indulgent stuff without refined sugars.  Classic Fudge is the least sweet of the fudge flavors (according to Wax Orchards) and has a rich, creamy chocolate taste.  The consistency is very much like conventional hot fudge and it takes just 15 seconds to heat a tablespoon in the microwave for pouring or drizzling.I can taste the pineapple juice in this but I like it.  If you want something that doesn't taste like it was sweetened with fruit then this may not be the best match.  I usually warm a tablespoon and toss with a sliced banana and unsweetened coconut.  Delicious!I buy Wax Orchards Classic Fudge at the local natural foods store for about half of the Amazon price.  If you are interested, it's worth shopping around.

These are like their other Cheese flavored pretzel pieces, but better! These are actually full nibblers (no not the character from "FUTURAMA", although cute just the wrong nibbler anywhoo...). The flavor is much more smokey than the bright orange counterpart. I also like how most of the cheese is concentrated at the crack of where the pretzel separated so you can experience the flavor at your own pace.To sum it up, for me these are an adult version of the ever popular chip that is bright orange and has a cheetah for a mascot, and they don't leave cheetle behind, although a good licking session may have to be re-visited, but I digress...Buy a pack try 'em out.

Quite possibly the best flavor Snyder's has to offer. Once you've had a bag you will need 5 more and will understand why Amazon sells these as a 6 pack. The only downside is that these are only available here and direct from Snyder's site.

These are a great snack. It's powered cheese and not as good as Cheez-it's but it definitely packs a bigger crunch and satisfies the craving in less pieces than cheez-it's or other products have. One bag will take me a week or two to finish when a similar sized box of Cheez-it's is gone in half the time. They are similar in nutritional value I'd say. If you're a Cheez-it, cheese nips or other cheese cracker fan give these a try if you're looking for something different. You will not be disappointed!

I love these raisins.I like to have this for when I'm craving sugar and don't want candy.They're so sweet, I prefer these golden ones, depends on what grape you want.This is a nice snack for children too.I like dried mangos but I can't find them here.Dried cranberries are nice too.

I've eaten one full box of these and didn't experience a single bit of stem. Maybe because these golden raisins are moister and tenderer than the dark ones, the stems separate more readily in processing. These are a little sweeter than raisins I'm used to eating, but with a slightly less distinct flavor. I hope my first box was typical . . . they are delightful to eat by the fistful.

Sun Maid California Golden Raisins, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6) These precious little raisins are some of the best food being sold today.  The price on Amazon is less than the ones in the supermarkets, too.We love these raisins straight out of the box, on our cereals, or in our recipes.  We have used them in some of our recipes in The Collard Patch. We buy these often and keep them handy. As grocery prices continue to grow, we are careful to give ourselves little treats like these raisins, which we consider a gourmet product -- actually fit for royalty -- to keep us content with our frugal way of life.Nutritionally they are an excellent source of dietary fiber, energy, and potassium.In 2007, we bought a box of Sun Maid California Golden Raisins that did not measure up to our standards.  Although the raisins were tasty, the box had about 20% dark raisins.  We wrote the Sun Maid Company and expressed our disappointment.  Evidently this occurrence was something they did not expect or accept.  They told us that there is no way to avoid having a few dark raisins in the box but that this box was not representative of their fine product.  And here is the wonderful part of the story:  They sent us coupons for three free boxes of raisins to make things right!  Where could you find a better deal than that?  The Sun Maid people stand behind their product.

I ordered this product from Amazon with hesitancy, which I normally buy from Indian grocery stores.  When I placed the order the shipping date showed as 30 to 45 days, but it arrived in 7 days.  The product was fresher and cheaper than any grocery stores.  I use it as a snack and to and to desserts. I was thrilled with the experience of ordering a food item from a website, from where I only bought electronic items and books.  This is one of the best purchases I made at Amazon. I ordered the "Frontier Cardamom Pods" along with this order to avoid paying shipping charges and plus I use it in Indian tea and desserts.  I give this product 5 stars as it arrived on time, and when I opened the packet it was fresh, and full of flavor and would highly recommend buying this product from Amazon.
Very fresh, great tasting golden raisins and cheaper than what I can find locally.A great buy.

I really enjoyed eating these raisins and they were absolutely delicious. I will be ordering alot more of these in the near future. They were also fun to eat and i enjoyed snacking on them. Highly recommended.

Sun Maid yellow golden raisins are the best brand of yellow raisins on your grocer's shelf--period. These raisins are rather healthy for you. There is no fat, no cholesterol and almost zero sodium to boot! They offer fiber and potassium and that's good, too.However, this food is not an invariable substitute for a vitamin or other fruits with fiber, minerals and vitamins. They are relatively high in sugar (29 grams per 1/4 cup) and they lack vitamins. I'll have to take off one star for that.However, if you want a healthy snack or something to add to your breakfast cereal or oatmeal, these raisins are excellent. They taste great and they are far better than any candy to sweeten your food. Moreover, the raisins do not require refrigeration nor do they bruise or spoil easily.These golden raisins are better than regular raisins if you wish to use a recipe that calls for cooking with raisins. These can come in handy!Note: There should be an expiration date printed on the bottom of the container. Eat or use these raisins before the expiration date so you get them while they're nice and fresh!These raisins are great for persons everywhere who prefer to feed their children fruits as a substitute for candy. They are perfect for people who want to sweeten their food with something 100% natural, too. Raisins provide us all with a healthy snack; and that's a huge plus.Highly recommended--to life!

These raisins are very fresh and mild tasting. Besides mixing them in with my cottage cheese, I'm going to try the gin and raisin recipe for arthritis. Of course, they will be good in baked goods, too. All in all, I'm very pleased and the price is terrific.

These golden raisins (Sultanas) taste great. There are a few dark raisins, but not many. These are the perfect golden raisins to use for the Gin and Golden Raisin arthritis "cure" that some books mention. That's one of the main reasons I bought these--they soak up the expensive gin just right.

Truly fresher raisins that the ones I was purchase in my local store. I was ordering raisins from another vendor but switched to Sun Maid brand because I could get scheduled delivery. I'm concerned that over night Sun Maid's price increased almost $2.00 per order. At that price increase I might return to my other vendor and forget about the inconvenience of placing a order every 3 or 4 months.

Sun Maid California Golden Raisins, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)  WOW, they are GOOD.  Sweeter than the dark ones, but not 2 sweet.  I can easily get used to them.  Love them in my instant oatmeal every morning.

I use these raisins in baking. I find it difficult to find them at the supermarket.They aren't popular so even our best supermarket doesn't stock them.However, for delicate coffeecakes, breads, salads, slaws or even oatmeal whenyou want the sweetness of raisinsbut not the dark color, golden raisins are a good choice.I soak them to plump them either in warm water or in rum or brandy depending on what i'm making.I had them recently with pine nuts and sauteed kale at a local restaurant.This was very good.The golden raisins compliment the slight bitterness of the kale.The subscribe and save price is very good.I have them delivered every three months.
I purchased these raisins under suscribe/save.  They arrived fresh, plump and moist.  This is a great buy for baking and for snacking (can be eaten right out of the box).

Good tasting, great snack. All the stuff that everyone else says, but this isn't like overly good. Just like any other brand of sun-maid. It is a little wet to my liking. This wetness is just because the raisins aren't fully dried but still have some moisture inside of them. If you eaten great raisins grown and dried by hand, you'll realize this isn't the best. However, you ain't going to find those anywhere without personally going out to search so until then, this is a good substitute.

column9: golden raisins so much better than normal raisins!
column10: I've been eating golden (bleached) raisins with my daily bowl of oatmeal for breakfast (along with a tablespoon of wheat germ and wheat bran) for 30 years. Have never tried another brand than Sunmaid- very rarely seen another brand. The taste of golden raisins is quite different than unbleached raisins- lighter and fruitier. They're more expensive, but not much. Amazon has them quite a bit cheaper than the grocery stores, and I believe the 15ox boxes are an ounce or 2 more than the grocers.Never had a single complaint with Sunmaid's raisins in all these years.Great as a take-along snack too.

column9: Sun Maid California Golden Raisins, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
column10: This product and its delivery met all my expectations. I fully expect to reorder when my present supply is gone.
I received raisins that had a best if sold by date of only a couple of months out.  The raisins were hard and dry.  I usually get the golden because they are soft and moist.  But these were not.
These are my favorite type of raisins, for baking and just snacking.They are fresh and worth the price.

I KAYAK AND CYCLE AND THESE ARE GREAT FOR LONGER TREKS.MUCH TANGIER THAN DARK RAISINS.I CURRENTLY DO NOT BUY THEM FROM AMAZON BECAUSE THE ONLINE QUANTITY PRICE NOW EXCEEDS WHAT I CAN PURCHASE THEM FOR LOCALLY AS SINGLES.

column9: golden raisins are the good ones
column10: It used to be, when I was growing up, that the raisins that came in little boxes always had stems.  And curiously, when you'd get a box of Raisin Bran, those raisins were stem-free.  (And sugar coated.)  I don't know if there are different standards in raisin processing.  But at any rate, the golden raisins never seem to have stems and they are less dry and crunchy, than purple raisins can occasionally be.  I like them on cereal mixed with blueberries and cranberries and it looks very pretty with the three primary colors together.

column9: 3 Amigos soup mix not so bad

column9: Great Nuts, Excellent presentation....Good choice for Gifts
column10: We will order again, the nuts were large, tasty, and not stale.The presentation is nice for a gift idea.

Whoever came up with this is a genius and a lifesaver. I too only use formula when I'm on the go or need to supplement if I don't have enough breast milk, so the can is a waste since I won't finish it in a month. The packets are so convenient. I carry a bottle or two of 4oz water and a couple of packets in my purse at all times for emergencies. Paid $10.69 for a box of 16 at Target.Only 4 out of 5 stars because you can only make 4 oz or 8 oz.  So if your baby is currently eating more than 4oz but less than 8oz you either hope he is satisfied with 4oz or make 8oz and waste some.

Like others have written I only use formula when my milk production is low or I am mixing it with cereal.  I won't go through a whole regular can in a month (when the packages say to discard after opening).  These are perfect!  No waste!  Easy for travel too!

These single-serve packets are great for travelling. We also keep a few in our diaper bag just in case we need to feed our little one away from home.  It's a very convenient way to make formula away from home, and the cost is only slightly higher than the regular big containers of powder formula.
Great to use on the go.  There is less chance that water will get in and contaminate the batch.  I never left the house without these and the baby loved them.

I bought a Munchkin container with the easy-pour lid, but the lid snapped off and I lost three feedings worth of formula. I've since decided this is the best way to go. They're compact and fit easily into my diaper bag. 4 stars instead of 5 because I wish they came in 6 oz packets, but they are still an absolute necessity for my bag.

column9: Great for travel and at the bottom of your purse
column10: I love having these on hand.  It is a necessity when you are out and about and run out of formula or weren't expecting to need some and have a back up packet in your purse.  I also really like having them for airplane rides, easier when you have less space.  Very much worth the cost of having them packaged like this.
Love these for on-the-go feeding. Use them at home too since they are not as messy as the formula tubs.

Throw a few in your diaper bag in case of emergency and you don't have to worry about space issues or worry about trying to measure out formula in preparation for a long outing.  Like others, I use this to supplement so this is also fabulous for those onesie/twosie feedings that come up when I can't nurse - without having to buy a can of powder.  I got hooked on these when they sent me samples in the mail.
I love this for travel and times we're out of the house for most of the day. I was, however, very disappointed when the last time I ordered this, 4 packs in one of the boxes were open.
quick and easy if i dont have a formula dispenser on hand! love them! i think you get like 16 to 20 in a pack (not sure) but they are awesome and very helpful!

I love that I don't have to tote a large can of formula around with me when out shopping, at church, at family functions, etc. I keep a bunch of these in the inside pocket of the diaper bag, grab one out when needed, rip the top off (which is very easy to open), dump formula in bottle that has already had 4 ounces of water put in it (I fill mine at home before leaving), shake, and feed. So easy it's ridiculous! Best on the go product ever!

column9: as expected, yet cheaper than in the store
column10: Has been using this single-served powder packs whenever we are on the road.  I got 3 boxes for our 1-week trip.  Just bring bottled water. Very convenient.

column9: Great! Wish they were more affordable!
column10: These are an absolute must for momma's that are formula feeding and ever need to make a bottle while out. These easy tear packages packed in the diaper bag alongside a bottled water and empty bottle are great. I've tried packaging formula myself, to save money and it is just MESSY and ends up wasting formula that gets spilled (during packaging AND use).The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is the price. It's just so expensive and coupons are hard to come by for this type of enfamil product!

column9: Packaging is perfect for our situation
column10: My baby is breast fed but goes to daycare.  I'm no longer pumping as much as she sometimes demands.  This packaging of formula is perfect for that situation.  Any other type would go to waste since she only has maybe 4oz of formula once a week.  This is perfect for a baby that doesn't drink formula everyday and also perfect for travel, no waste and small packaging.

This is a practical product when you goes out and you are not sure if baby will requires his milk, then you need to fill the bottle with 4 oz warm water and carry the 4oz blister that is ready to use. Price agains big can portion is almost the same.The only problem is when baby eats more than 4oz.

column9: I always take this when I go out with my baby
column10: This is very convenient and whenever I go out with my baby, I always take 3-4 packets with a bottle of water.I am planning to travel 2 months later and I will buy enough of these to take with me.

We bought this because our little one wasn't a regular formula drinker so it didn't make sense to open large tubs of it, only to throw it away.  It's a great idea but obviously you are paying for the convenience.  I've been thinking of buying a vacuum packer but wasn't sure it was going to work with powder and worth the time and effort.  Also, this stuff is great for long road trips or travel.
These are great for the diaper bag and air travel.  There is a limit to how much ready made formula you can bring through security these solved that problem (mix after security check).

My wife loves these because it's convenient when we're out shopping or running other errands. No carrying a big container of formula, and trying to get the measurement right in the car ... we received samples like this in the mail, but couldn't find them easily except on-line.
We are very happy with the purchase. This item is very convenient when we are walking with the baby on the street. Easy to open, great taste (I can see it in my baby eyes).
Absolutely genius concept. 0 footprint, not like those bulky formula holders! The only thing is they are really over priced here. They're much cheaper purchased at your local store.

I would caution anyone who wants to buy this jerky. The jerky is very over seasoned. You will need a glass of water handy when you eat these. Only good when you heat them for like 15 seconds. Next time I will order the original flavor.

column9: Wonderful for making gluten free food.
column10: Since this was first time using the flakes I was so surprised of the taste when I ate gluten free breakfast bars. The texture was really good and my son ate them I was afraid that he wouldn't like them I wasn't even sure I did the recipe right but he loved them. I will buy these flakes again.

column4: Marcia C. Brandt Author Step Away from the Ch...
column10: I am looking to become gluten free and quinoa is a great way to get protein and avoid the gluten.  I fix a bowl for my breakfast and the flakes taste great!  Plus the price is better than in my local grocery store.  I add cinnamon and raisins and dried cherries.  Very delicious.  Really a quick, nutritious breakfast. column9: Easy way to add protein to carb meals
column10: I love adding this to oatmeal (measure out water/grains to equal 2 servings of each product and cook following oatmeal directions), muffins (add in some to replace a portion of flour) and even meatloaf as the thickener/stretcher instead of oatmeal. Love the price here vs. in stores.

This dog food was recommended by our standard poodle's breeder.  She feeds it to both her breeding dogs and her show dogs.  Our dog loves it, and eats every bit of his breakfast, lunch and dinner right down.The breeder said for us to mix the food with a little warm water and a tablespoon of plain, unflavored, nonfat yogurt.  My vet agreed, and said that the yogurt was an excellent addition.  He also has standard poodles as his personal pets.As poodle owners know, the breed can be susceptible to a horrible stomach condition called "bloat."  Feeding your poodle a top grade dog food on a regular schedule is very important for these lovely animals.  This dog food fits the bill perfectly.It is interesting that this is an adult dog food, but the kibble is smallish, and if mixed with the warm water while the dog is a puppy, it can be used throughout the dog's life, once he/she is weaned.  You do not need a puppy chow when the dog is young.This seller provides this food at a fair price, and ships promptly.Recommended.
This product has been excellent for our dogs for the past four years.Keeps their energy up and their health is great.

column4: J. Price "Working mom in a hurry"
column10: This is the first and only iced tea I have purchase since owning my brewer for the past year.  I put off buying iced tea due to the expense and thought how much different could it be from those cheep container mixes you find at the grocery store.  Boy was I wrong.  For starters my favorite ice tea is the half and half lemonade, and I find that these deliver the right amount of flavor, sweetness and that freshely brewed flavor I would expect from a Keurig brewer.  I find myself hiding my k cups from the rest of my family and complaining when the ice tray hasn't been refilled.  Keep in mind everyone's tastes are different and I tend to like my drinks sweet, I find the smaller tea cup setting on my brewer to work the best for this, without having to add additional sweetner or sugar.

column9: Close enough to my favorite coffee shop drink to make me happy
column10: I love going by Starbucks during the hot summer days here in Texas and ordering a shaken black tea lemonade sweetened with light ice. When I got my Keurig brewer and was checking out the drink selections for iced tea I came across this one and had to try it. I was pleasantly surprised that the taste is accurate for the ratio of tea/lemonade and the sugar was sweetened just enough. My son and I love them and he is the one that discovered that the 6 oz. water setting is best for the maximum flavor. These are a staple in my household and I love my Keurig brewer and will be saving money by drinking these at home instead of going to my local Starbucks! They are on 70 calories per serving and you get 25% of your Vitamin C intake for the day too.

Love this, great hot or cold.  I use lemon in my tea.  Here is a hint, slice lemons in 1/4 inch slices.  Place on a cookie sheet and freeze, allow them time to freeze solid. Then place in a plastic bag and place them back in freezer, just grab what you need.  Maintain their color and look so good in the tea.

column9: Pretty good but beware if you don't like artificial sweeteners
column10: This isn't bad but I can really taste the REBIANA (SWEETENER FROM STEVIA).  I dislike the taste of artificial sweeteners and didn't realize this product was artificially sweetened (though the first ingredient in the list is evaporated cane juice, so I don't know why they needed to add the Rebiana).

column9: Celestial Half and Half lemonade tea for Keurig brewers.
column10: I purchased a box of 16 of these half-and-half (black tea and lemonade) k-cups at Bed, Bath & Beyond.  They had a $9.99/box sale, and it was too good to pass up--especially since my better half loves lemonade iced tea.  Sadly, it was a bit of a disappointment.  It was barely different from the "Perfect Iced Tea -- Sweet Lemon Tea," and didn't have the bite of lemonade.  I wasn't expecting perfection--I realize that lemonade in any form is asking a lot from a hot beverage machine, but it was still a bit of a let down.  Also, I prefer to sweeten my drinks with Splenda.  (I don't need 13 grams of carbs from a glass of iced tea.)That said, my Keurig Limited Edition remains the best coffee machine I have owned to date, and the Coffee People "Donut Shop" variety is my favorite every-morning k-cup.

I first tried this k-cup as a sample.  I was hesitant at first because most teas for the Keurig brewer are either bland, weak, or both.  The sample I tried came in a pack of 4 different iced tea flavors from Celestial Seasonings.  They were are suprisingly very good brewed over ice.  But, this one was by far my favorite.  It has a nice blend of "teaness" and lemon-y sweetness.  A pack of equal or splenda really brightens up the flavors.  I was instantly hooked and ordered a big box of this stuff on Amazon right after trying this drink.As others have mentioned, there is one big caveat to this drink.  It is a caloric drink.  So, if you are looking to restrict your caloric intake in terms of sugary beverages, becareful with this k-cup.  There isn't a whole lot of calories (about 1/2 a can of soda's worth), but it's still there and considering how good this drink is, it's hard to just drink 1.  Other than that, I think this is the best non-coffee beverage available on the Keurig brewer.

Had this at the Marshfield fair in Marshfield, MA.  They were giving it out.  I fell in love with it.  Now that I have my keurig I am sitting waiting for it to arrive.  Nicely sweetened.  NOT WICKED ICKY SWEET.  Brew over is and Mmmmm enjoy...
Have used this product for a long time and still enjoy its taste very much. Really refreshing and sometimes I add just a slice of lemon.

Arrived on time and was as expected.  Appears to be the least expensive per serving that is available, even on line.  The larger version (54-count) was less expensive per cup, but was out of stock at the time.

column9: Pretty good for quick iced tea but the Southern Sweet Tea is better.

I also stumbled across a sample pack of the Southern Sweet Tea flavor since ordering this product and I've enjoyed it much more. This flavor is a good try by Celestial Seasonings but it still needs a little work.
I like my tea with lemon and I also regularly mix iced tea and lemonade so this just made sense for me to buy. It's very good and has a good balance of tea and lemon.

This is the best drink to have over ice on a hot day..Really any of the Ice Tea's have a great taste to them. You make them as sweet as you want or add no sugar at all. My husband seems to be drinking more than me in the Ice Tea world which I find hard to belive.. Time to play catch-up :)Its also a great drink to offer company instead of coffee, beer, wine, ect...

column9: This is a first for me

You get neither a good tea taste nor a lemonade taste.  You do seem to get a bit of a bitter after-taste though. This may be due to  how much the ice cubes melt during production. It's not overly flavored with lemon--just the right amount. Out of all the teas and coffees I have, this one always runs out first.

After reading the reviews, I was a little skeptical about this iced tea.  Being an "Arnold Palmer" fan, I used to make my own at home.  A pot of brewed tea and store bought lemonade.  It was great, but it took some too time to make, and the store lemonade had a lot of sugar.  So, needless to say, when I got this, I immediately made a cup. I like the fact that it's real tea, and that the lemonade side isn't too overpowering.I drink this probably at least twice a day now, and will keep it stocked in my Keurig pod holder!
I love this stuff . Everyone one who comes to my house and i make it for them is hooked .
This K-cup variety pack is great for trying to find which iced tea you like best.  I enjoyed the raspberry the most. Great value and variety.

column9: from the view point of a keurig ADDICT
column10: Abosolutly LOVE it. COULD NOT WAIT to try it. This is the second cold tea i have made with my keurig . This is worth EVERY SINGLE penny

I love this iced tea, it is my new favorite.  I think it tastes better than the Celestial regular iced tea, which is also good.  I especially like the fact that it has only half the caffeine, something I'm trying to cut back on.

I've tried all the iced tea flavors, and buy far like this one best. It could be a touch stronger, but i load it up with alot of ice so I'm sure that doesn't help either, 6 cup setting is my pick also. But all in all way better than a scoop mix brand iced tea mix

column9: Half n Half Iced Tea K-Sups
column10: We keep trying different BREW OVER ICE tea products, but we ALWAYS try to keep this one onhand as it is becoming our FAVORITE!

I intended to buy the Southern Sweet Tea flavor, but clicked on the wrong product (I was shopping by image, saw the little ice symbol, and didn't even notice I ordered the wrong thing until it arrived). If you like Snapple or Arizona tea with lemon flavor, you will like the Celestial Seasonings Half & Half K-Cup.

I was hesitant about ordering this the first time, but was surprised at how good it tastes. It has a true black tea flavor with just the right amount of lemon. I used it up quickly and have reordered it. Occasionally, I add a little sweetener but most people probably wouldn't feel the need to do so.
The ease at which you can make a cup of fresh iced tea is nothing short of amazing. Cost effective.

I use two pods on the "iced" setting and it is SOOOO good. Even when diluted with ice it remains sweet and has a wonderful flavor. This is NOT lemonaid so if you're expecting the crisp taste of lemonade, you will be disappointed. What it IS is the BEST lemon-twinged TEA I've ever had. And I live in the South, so I've HAD some good sweet teas!
Nothing spectacular.  It wasn't as sweet as I'd expected nor as flavorful.  It seems like I would need to use two just to get one glassful.  I probably wouldn't order them again.
A very good blend of iced tea and lemonade.  For those of you who enjoy an "Arnold Palmer" in the warmer months, this is pertfect for you!  Add lots of ice and brew in the 8 oz. or 10 os. settings.
I was pleasantly surprised with the taste of this tea. Great lemon flavor that is not in any way overpowering. I highly recommend this product. Great taste!!!

column9: My favorite ice tea - so far
column10: This is my favorite ice tea so far. Just the right mix of lemon and regular tea. I add the pink sweetener and it's great.It's fun to experiment so I'll keep trying new ones but I am very satisfied with Half and Half.

column9: Zero stars - this stuff is not good at ALL!!
column10: No tea flavor at all.  Tastes like watered down lemonade.  I drink a lot of tea and this stuff is so bad that I am returning the opened box for a refund.
Thought it tastes funny.  Not like iced tea, not like lemonade and no where in between.  There are much better flavors out there
