wish I would of tasted one before i bought this half & half.just to sum it up, it tasted like chemicals. The southern Ice Tea on the other hand is very good.

column9: High Fiber in a Tasty, Healthy Snack
column10: South Beach Diet Fiber Bars/Chewy Granola Bars are tastier than your average granola bar but not quite as tasty as your average chocolate bar--they definitely occupy the middle ground between these two extremes. The rich dark chocolate flavor is quite noticeable in these dense snack bars, which also contain 6 grams of protein and a whopping 9 grams of fiber (that's 36% of the RDA) per serving. These nutritional benefits somewhat offset the fact that saturated fat accounts for more than half of the fat content per serving (2 of the 3.5 fat grams per serving). Each bar contains 120 calories, so overall, this is a pretty good choice if you're trying to balance taste and nutrition.

column9: South Beach energy bars dark choc
column10: Want a party in your mouth and a healthy bar at the same time??  My South Beach dark chocolate bars came from Amazon just as my husband was working to increase his fiber for health sake.  This dark chocolate, chewy taste is fantabulous!!  It would be great as breakfast bar with coffee or tea in the morning or a delicious snack with extra fiber any time of day.  This individually packaged bar is convenient to carry and a delictable chew.  South Beach Diet Bar Fiber Granola Bar, Dark Chocolate, 5-Count(Pack of 8)

Whoa...in doing my research I noticed that one box of South Beach Diet Bar Fiber Granola Bar (that's a mouthful isn't it) costs $23.92 if you order it on Amazon. I have prime but I realize that not everyone does so if you factor in another couple bucks for shipping...ridiculous price. I'm not sure how much a box of this costs in stores (considerably less I would hope) but I daresay that it is unlikely that the price is worth the product. If anyone could use a good diet bar it's me but the problem with diet bars is in the name. They are DIET bars. They aren't supposed to taste great (otherwise you'd be in danger of eating the whole box and what kind of diet is that) so instead they usually taste like a mix of cardboard and...well more cardboard. Now the South Beach Diet Bar Granola Bar isn't THAT awful. Don't take that delicious looking beast on the package for truth. The real product is much flatter...And the taste? Well it tastes exactly what you would think a chocolate diet bar would taste like. It's unfair for me to bash a diet bar based on taste after admitting that diet bars aren't SUPPOSED to taste good but that image on the package really got my hopes up.But how effective is the bar? Effective enough. I ate one this morning and I didn't eat again till later this evening. That's not really praise for the diet bar, I have a pretty hectic schedule. But maybe I didn't notice the hunger as much. I'm guessing I could eat a granola bar (get better taste at a cheaper price) and be the same level as hungry. So if you take diets/diet bars seriously then this might be the bar for you. It doesn't really have anything to separate it from the other snack bars out there other than the South Beach name but hey, what do I know?

The South Beach Diet Bar (Dark Chocolate) offer a tasty but relatively healthy treat.  It has a rich though not overly sweet taste and is fiber rich while low on calories.  Don't expect it to taste like candy - this is a granola bar, after all - but it does offer a rare treat for those trying to lose weight.  While the heavier fiber intake may make it a little bit of an acquired taste, the chocolate makes it a lot easier to acquire.  If the rest of losing weight could only be this easy!

These diet bars have a rich dark chocolate taste but they're a little gritty (too much sugar)? I think the most important aspect of any diet product, if it's palatable and these are, is whether or not they're filling. These do fill the void, but with so much fiber you can expect a gassy side effect. They're kind of like drinking Slim Fast which many people refer to as gas in a can, but that's the sacrifice we dieters have to make to lose weight. They're great if you get up late and cannot wait to cook a plate!

This is the first time I have tried a South Beach product and I am sure glad I did. The have a wonderful taste and are very filling. I will check out more of their granola bars and try them also.120 calories will fit into my snack plan for the day. Also a good dessert. Very pleased with these bars. Thank you South Beach and Vine for allowing me to try these.

These diet bars are very tasty with a nice flavor of dark chocolate and a pleasant, non-sticky crunch. With 6 grams of protein and 9 grams of fiber to 6 grams of sugar and only 120 calories, they offer a much healthier snack option than the typical vending machine choices or even a lot of so-called diet products.I have successfully used the South Beach Diet over the past few years both to loose weight and to improve my cholesterol and I have incorporated its principles into the way that I eat all year long.Like some other programs, the first phase of the South Beach Diet encourages morning and afternoon snacks and allows a dessert in the evening. These diet bars are a good choice for anyone on such a program, or really for anyone who just feels like having a healthy and tasty snack or light dessert from time to time. I liked them, and my wife liked them, too.

column9: Healthier than Whole Wheat alone and taste even better
column10: I love the tastes of this pasta. It tastes even better than just 100% whole wheat. Kamut is a wheat type of grain but for what I have read has more micro nutrients (more healthy) and most of person that are gluten intolerant can eat Kamut with no problem. And Buckwheat is pretty nutritious (Whole grain buckwheat is an amazingly nutritious food. Even though it's protein is relatively low at approximately 11%, the protein buckwheat does have contains the eight essential amino acids and is one of the few "grains" (remember that buckwheat isn't a grain at all is more like a fruit) high in lysine. If you use half buckwheat flour with your wheat flour, the buckwheat's amino acids will round out the limiting amino acids in your wheat nicely, giving you a nearly perfect balance of the 8 essential amino acids. This particular balance between half wheat and half buckwheat flour is much more closely aligned to your dietary needs even than lean beef!!! It's also rich in many of the B vitamins as well as the minerals; phosphorus, magnesium, iron, zinc, copper and manganese. In addition to this, it's a good oil source of Linoleic acid, one of the two essential fatty acids we must have to be healthy. Nutritionally speaking, buckwheat is a truly impressive food. Taken from [...]. Even though, it said that is organic, it doesn't contain any known certification like (USDA) to prove it, so if you looking for an organic strictly food, you would have to take a leap of faith here.So in conclusion, if you are looking for getting a better (in healthy and tastes) to whole wheat this is a pretty good product.

column9: Delicious sugar free chocolate with no stomach upset
column10: I have tried other sugar free treats sweetened with malitol and other sugar alcohols. Tasted okay, but caused prohibitive gastric distress. Like the kind of pain you would not wish on your worst enemy, accompanied by a multi-sensory symphony of humiliating bodily expressions. I read that the sweetener erythritol had low glycemic impact, but none of the accompanying health problems, but still felt a bit nervous. All of the current dietary suggestions include a bit of dark chocolate for its antioxident benefits, so I decided to give these bars a try. I am very pleased with the taste of the chocolate. It is very rich and satisfying. No problems with digestion, even when I went a bit overboard with quantity! The erythritol does have a mild "cooling" effect as it melts in your mouth, but I rather liked the effect. Like powdered sugar melting in your mouth, or the coolness of mint without the mint flavor. The almonds (also on many 10 ten food lists of dieticians) are a wonderful addition. I wish it was not so expensive, but I am going to try to limit myself to a piece or two a day for good health and happiness and hope that more competitors enter the erythritol sweetened chocolate market and help drive down the price a bit. In the meantime, I will definitely buy again!

If you bake for someone who is gluten intolerant and get a little discouraged with the "gritty" consistency of your baking, you must try this flour! I received mine today and mixed up a batch of Wendy Wark's GF flour blend, using the superfine brown rice flour for both the brown and white rice flour called for in the recipe. I then made a batch of chocolate chip cookies. Let me first say, I am a gluten eater, my husband is the one that needs to eat GF. So I have had wheat based homemade cookies very recently. I have been trying new GF recipes for him during the 2 years since his diagnosis, trying to get as close to what he was used to as possible. This is the first time that even the raw cookie dough tasted like wheat based CC cookie dough!The cookies baked up beautifully and looked like regular. The taste and "mouth feel" was nothing short of miraculous. These did not elicit a response of "they're fine" but rather, "These are great!" When my kids came home from school, they saw cookies and had a couple. When I told them they were GF and I had made them for Daddy, they didn't believe me. I think I will have to make some more very soon as the ones I made today are almost all gone, thanks to my husband and the kids!I now have a flour that has given me that "perfect" GF CC cookie recipe to file alongside the "perfect" GF brownie recipe and the "perfect" GF pizza recipe. Maybe I will have to tackle bagels next? I only hope a store near me starts to carry this or I will go broke on S&H! But I will gladly pay the S&H to have this product available to me! I can't wait to try it in other recipes.

You don't need this flour if you make the breads from GFBC, only the sweets, but who wants to go through life without the sweets? There is little difference between buying it from Amazon and buying it directly from Authentic Foods - I think Authentic Foods direct was a few pennies cheaper.  Suck it up, count the shipping as part of the cost of the flour, swallow hard, and never look back...

The extra fine grind of this flour and their white rice flour allows cooks to create wonderfully textured baked goods.  When combined with other starch flours to make a flour blend, items bake up with a lovely crumb.  Guests don't even realize you're serving GF foods!

I think these are the best chips/crisps I've ever had.  They are thick cut and they come in all different sizes and shapes.  No pringle uniformity here.  Most of the chips are huge and they have potato skin on the outside! These are amazing! I'm eating the Salt & Vinegar right now and trying to stop since I should be in bed. OMG so good..

I love these almond oat goji cookies.  I have actually lost 5 pounds eating them as my snack instead of some other processed cookie.  They satisfy my craving and make me feel good. I love that they are made with organic and natural ingredients.  Mid-morning, I look forward to a couple of these goji cookies.

column9: Not Quite As "Tasty" As This Brands Other Flavors..
column10: I ended up buying this 12 pack of "Smoothie" flavor because I really enjoyed the "Mixed" & "Superfruit" flavors from this brand.  Out of the 3 I would say this is my least favorite though.The flavor I most dislike is the almost clear colored one (which I believe is mango.  All the rest are pretty good, although I think peach tastes a little different than the "Mixed", perhaps because of the "smoothie" (or cream) flavor added.I look forward to trying the other two kinds-- "wild berry", and "sport".If you're new to this brand, I recommend you try some of their other flavors before this one.EDIT:  I just received the "wild berry" today, and I must say, it's my favorite flavor pack to date!  If you can find them for a good deal, don't hesitate to scoop it up!

column9: DO NOT BUY! - READ THIS FIRST
column10: As a previous reviewer has stated, (I wish I had seen this before I purchased) the item description states, "LUNDBERG FARMS 12x 2 LB ECO-FR BASMATI BROWN RICE." This is NOT the case. You will receive only 1 2lb package of rice. Deception in advertising and an absolute LIE.
The product description says that you will receive 12 packets of 2lbs each. But you will receive ONLY ONE PACKET of 2lbs! So you end up getting 2lbs of rice for $11. Very deceptive.

column9: I love this rice - creamy and soft
column10: I use 1.5 times the recommended amount of water for my rice cooker with this and it comes out creamy like white rice. My husband was having a hard time switching to brown, but now loves it. This rice is delicious!
Best price,available in small quanity for individuals, quick delivery, good quality.
These pumpkin seeds were exactly the same as the ones they sell at markets for nearly $4 for half the price.

This is indeed the best salt/spice combo I've ever found. Our family uses it in just about every dish. The combination of sea salt and garlic compliments just about every food we prepare. As the label says, it is "Great on chicken, steak, burgers, fish, pasta, soups, eggs and vegetables." It also rocks in soups, dips, some salads and sauces too. The convenience of having these two indispensable spices in one package saves time in the long run as well. The plastic mill is easy to use; just give it a few shakes, remove the cap and grind away. Ours lasts us up to six months. If you live in a humid climate like I do, the contents can start to stick a little, but I find a few sharp taps on the counter and some vigorous shaking loosens things right up.Salt and garlic lovers, look no further!

Every since Costco had the Garlic Sea Salt Grinders a few years ago we have been looking for something similar.  We wanted to buy a large grinder and most of what are offered on the market are small containers.  We were very glad to find the large Olde Thompson Garlic Sea Salt Grinder,  and even more happy that they were sold in two-packs and were very reasonably priced.  The flavor is very good.  We are very pleased with the product.
Arrived on time and in good condition.  Love this item but can't seem to find it in any of my local grocery stores.

These were just what I expected, only bigger! LOL Just like what you would get at the movies. I used them to make move-themed gift baskets for Christmas. I used the container to hold a DVD, a package of popcorn, and 2 packs of hot chocolate. I wrapped it all up with cellophane and a bow. It was beautiful! And they can use the container for their popcorn. I was very happy with the product for the price.
Just like the real deal at the theater!!!  A little pricey but great for impressing friends!! There nothing like having your movie theater popcorn in a PAPER tub.
Thank you for sending the popcorn butter tubs right away so that I could get my Christmas order out on time.

I've fed these to quite a few wheat-eaters, and they see no difference between these and other cookies.  I have tossed in various combinations of nuts, dried blueberries, chocolate chips, and coconut and cooked them as bar cookies.  Everyone loves them.  They disappear within 24 hours of baking.Namaste makes the BEST GLUTEN FREE FOOD on the market that I've found.  If I had to suggest some food products to someone who was starting the transition from a diet including wheat to a wheat-free diet, I'd recommend Namaste's products.  I've never had a bad product from them.  Try also their pizza crust, spice cake mix, and chocolate cake.  It's all fantastic.

My 23 month old son was put on a no egg, casein, gluten...everything else diet so we can get a clear idea of what he is allergic too.  For those with young ones who are on a similar diet either by necessity or choice know that they can be extremely picky eaters.  I purchased this mix from a health food store just to try it out.  It saved my son's first attended birthday party!  He was perfectly content and didn't pay attention to the fact that others were eating birthday cake.  He loves it!  I put a powdered sugar, vanilla and rice milk glaze on it and cut it into small bites and he calls it candy!  I sincerely applaud the efforts of this company to allow all those who are free to enjoy special treats...especially the little guys!  Thank you so much!  (I will be ordering a case of everything eventually :-) )

Not just "best gluten free" Blondies ever- best Blondies period. I've been gluten free for 30 years, and I have NEVER had a better Blondie. Namaste Blondies have become my favorite treat. In fact, all the Namaste products I have tried taste far superior to anything else on the market that's gluten free.

I don't have to eat gluten-free but my daughter does and this mix makes the best tasting blondie brownies...second only to a Betty Crocker recipe I used to make when I was a teenager back in the 1960s!

I am not a blondie expert by any means, but I sure love them, there is just something about that yummy butterscotch flavor. I have a gluten sensitivity so I avoid it, it really made my day when I discovered these blondies, they taste wonderful and the texture is great too. I like to add chopped walnuts and small chocolate chips. Thanks to Namaste, those who cannot have gluten or other allergens can still enjoy delicious desserts!!

column9: Even if you are not celiac or gluten intolerant
column10: Even if you are not celiac or gluten intolerant, this is very nearly almost eactly like blonde brownies from scratch. Prominent rich butterscotch flavor. In a 13 X 9 pan makes 16 good sized brownies. And they freeze well. I have tried every Namaste product, including the chocolate icing, and they are all excellent products.

When I found out I had to go gluten free, the first thing that came to my mind was, "What about Blondies???"My grandmother taught me how to make them 25 years ago. I couldn't imagine never eating them again and I didn't think it would be possible to reproduce them. On a whim, I bought a pack of Namaste Gluten-Free Blondie Mix at my local natural food store. I was delighted to see that one package makes either one 9x13 pan or 2 8x8 pans and that I didn't have to make both 8x8 pans at the same time. The minute I got home, I measured out the ingredients and in 30 minutes (plus cooling time) I had perfect blondies almost exactly like my Grandmother's. My husband loved them even more than Grandma's because they are a bit softer and more cake-like (due to using oil, not butter, I presume.)Two days later, he was asking for more blondies, so I poured the rest of the mix into a bowl and mixed them up. Total disaster. They were wet and under-cooked. I was pretty disappointed. I checked the package to make sure I added the right amount of egg, oil and water. Check. I also had originally scooped out the first batch's dry mix very loosely as the package indicated I should. But it was obvious that the ratio was off.Back to the natural food store- bought two more packages! Today, I got out the digital food scale and weighed the mix. (Make sure you understand how to use the scale- you have to be sure that you are taking into account the weight of the container you are using.) I divided it exactly in half by weight, then measured them out again and was pretty confident I had an exact split. The batch just came out of the oven and is even more perfect than the original one. I am confident the next batch from the same bag will be perfect.***I added a scant 1/3 cup of very loose dark brown sugar to the mix both times (after weighing) because I knew it wouldn't be sweet enough for my husband. I also added a little extra bit of salt. The first batch I made, I added a splash of good vanilla extract to, but I forgot it this time. I also added 1/3 or so of a package of Ghiradelli 60% Cacao Bittersweet Chocolate baking chips. Ghirardelli 60% Cacao Bittersweet Chocolate Baking Chips, 11.5 oz.Once I test out the second half of this mix successfully, I'll be ordering a case. I am confident I can maintain a gluten-free diet if I can have my favorite snack and these blondies fit the bill.

I first bought this product as a close-out in a health food store, & have not seen it since.  I was delighted to find it on Amazon, & got a 6 pk.  The day it came I made a batch.  They are VERY good, & for the gluten sensitive, & maybe can't have chocolate, these are just heavenly, & very easy to prepare.  They freeze well (& for the desperate, can be eaten that way too!).  They also cost less buying them this way, as the store price for similar products is over $2 more each.
These blondies are way way to good.  They are quick and easy to make.  bakes in 30 minutes.  They don't last long in our house.
Really loved these!! I have 4 small kids and they were so happy to eat these and they taste great for them!! We put craisins in them,,, yummy!!

This coffee is an excellent buy.  I only use it for making lattes with my Rancilio Silvia, so I cannot comment on whether the bean makes good drip coffee.As a point of comparison, the beans are way better than Starbucks decaf espresso, and somewhat better than the well-advertised Lavazza beans.  The Coffee Bean Direct beans are not quite as good as Caffe Umbria Mezzanotte Decaf Blend.  Nevertheless, considering the incredible price difference between Coffee Bean Direct and Caffe Umbria, Coffee Bean Direct is a great choice.To be clear, I am not saying that you have to settle on flavor - the coffee is fantastic. Most people who have tried the lattes I make with the Coffee Bean Direct beans with the Silvia and the Rocky grinder cannot believe how great the coffee is or that it is decaf.  Like the other reviewers said, the grind is very important in order to get the great flavor and crema.  So if you are initially disappointed, experiment with your grind, dose, tamp, etc. until you get a great shot.I freeze the beans in air-tight plastic bags, and only take out small amounts of beans at a time.  I remove any air in the bag before returning the bag to the freezer.  If I don't, then the coffee becomes bitter/sour.  I average a couple of lattes a day, and a single bag lasts about 3 months.

column9: Coffee Bean Direct Decaf Espresso Beans
column10: We've started buying this product from Amazon about a year ago and the quality and value is so good that we started a subscription program (bit tricky to determine your needs for the first few months - but you can easily modify this as you learn).Love this bean - great taste and always fresh - we mix it with a regular espresso bean to cut back on the "jolt" a bit.Highly Recommended!!

I normally go for medium roasts for espresso since I drink it straight, and the dark roasts tend to have a burnt undertone that can range from unpleasant to downright nasty. This roast from Coffee Bean Direct is the exception, however. The flavor is rich with smokey tones, but no (or very little) burned flavor. Excellent crema as well.While I can't say for sure since I don't like milk in my coffee, I imagine the flavor would stand up very well in a milk-based drink. I did try it as an Americano, and it was quite good. The flavors were toned down a bit as you would expect, but still came through nicely.I did have to fiddle with the grind level a bit to get a decent shot. The setting I use for medium roast beans nearly choked my espresso machine - took nearly 50 seconds for a double shot and, as you can imagine, was quite horrible. I had to go two full notches coarser on my Vario grinder to get a good shot. I expect this is due to the fact that the darker roast is much more oily than the medium roasts, and needs a coarser grind.I do wish it came in a smaller package so it would be easier to store and keep fresh. But, the five pound bag comes at an excellent per-pound price.Good beans at a good price. Highly recommend.

It's almost as good as caffeinated espresso. Good job on the CO2 process with more flavor than water process. Smokey, slightly sweet, medium/heavy body, low acid. Very oily beans out of the bag with a rich strong smokey aroma. A good espresso bean. It had great crema, so I'm really glad I bought this. Too bad 5 pounds is going to take forever to finish by myself.
Excellent coffee beans! The beans were fresh and not dried out. Beans have a lot of oil. Taste is smooth. Use it for brewed coffee.  Very nice coffee. Signed up for automatic shipments it is so good.

This is no doubt the best tasting decaf coffee that I've had.  I stopped drinking caffeinated coffee last year and have found it difficult finding good tasting decaf.  (I also try to avoid chemically decaffeinated coffee.)  The selection of decaf coffees is somewhat limited, but more significantly, I find that most decafs just don't taste too good compared to full bodied caffeinated coffees.  This is my first taste of CO2 decaf - I'm not sure what role the process plays, but Coffee Bean Direct got it right.  This coffee is full bodied, rich and great tasting.  I would definitely buy it again.  I only wish it came in a smaller sized bag.

I really like this decaf espresso! It's tasty, smooth and rich. Since I make it in a regular drip coffee pot (sorry!)and drink it black, these qualities are especially important to me. Plus, it's a great buy. I do wish it were organic. My second five pounds is already on its way!

I like to blend decaf with regular coffee, but I much prefer to grind the beans prior to brewing.  This decaf is very rich tasting, has a deep roasted flavor without the burned/sour aftertaste (like Starbucks coffee does).  I mix it with Coffee Bean Direct Italian Roast beans.  Good buy!

I really tried with this coffee.  I tried it in a coffee maker, then I tried packing it in my espresso machine. Then I tried it in my foolproof french press, all to no avail.  No matter what I did I could not deny that every method yielded the dreaded grainy taste.  The price seemed right and so did the reviews. So Im back to taste testing again, searching for that perfect sip.
Another good hearty decaf from Coffee Bean Direct.  Exactly what my wife and I like.  The CO2 process seems to work well without removing all the favor.

column9: A good brew for a fair price
column10: Coffee bean direct CO2 coffee provides a good strong cup of decaf coffee, most decaf coffee's are weak or the ones that are espresso roast are expensive. This coffee is reasonably priced and has very good and rich flavor.
It came all busted up and leaking but I did have it shipped out to Afghanistan to use in my sweet tea maker. It did sweeten the tea though so it did it's job.
domino sugar is the best i've had in america so far as sugar goes. You dont have to use much sugar for your drink to taste sweet.

Sugar arrived on time and had no damage or defects. Bag was still fully sealed and there was no moisture inside. This is just a plain, refined white sugar so there's not too much I can say about it but it does deliver on fulfilling basic sugar needs.

Needed Sugar for cookies I was baking for my family. My Safeway delivery did not include the needed sugar. I was in a bind Thanks to you. I received sugar delivered the next day. Wow what a miracle. On the other hand I need Confectioners.

The bag of Domino sugar I ordered came open, and with a small hole in the bottom. The sugar was salvageable, but because the sugar was not properly wrapped or insulated from the rest of my items, the serration from the sugar granules poked holes in the gifts I bought that came in the same box. I would not recommend ordering easily breakable items like this through Amazon- or if you do, keep in mind what you order it with.

Amazon price is currently $11.89, this is much cheaper just about everywhere else by at least 50%. Unfortunately I purchased without researching much, just wanted to warn anyone else considering buying.
I cancel this order. Too expensive, opened bag spilled all over-what a mess. Amazon.com said they would send me another one and I'm still waiting.

column9: Great soup base but average noodle
column10: The soup is very good, taste closer to actual thing, the noodle however is pretty average, so I gave 4 star

I'm a big fan of Japanese culture, especially the food. I found this flavor of instant ramen quite some time ago, but it's still one of my favorites. Back when I discovered it, I only bought one bowl to try and I was instantly hooked! But when I went back to the store to buy it again, they were out of stock, and when I tried looking for it online, it was no where to be found. I'm so excited that it's available online now! It has a great garlic and onion flavor with a delicious sesame aftertaste. It's not spicy at all, which is a great alternative to all those super hot ramen soups. Some people might be put off by some of the ingredients, (look up tonkotsu soup) but it has such an amazing flavor, that it doesn't matter. If you're into trying new things, like Japanese food and love great flavor, definitely try this one.

These noodles are not spicy at all, but certainly flavorful!They have a buttery, garlic and onion flavor with a slight undertone of ginger.My husband even liked it. (He's not a fan of spicy hot dishes nor veggies.)They're easy to make.Pull the label open half way, and add the flavor packets found inside.I add hot water from my coffee maker to the line inside.Close the label, and let it sit a while to soften the noodles. Done.I found them at our local Asian grocery store.

I'll preface this review with the clarification that my five star rating is based on my opinions given the nature of the product- as a pre-packaged ramen. It's certainly no substitute for a "real" bowl of tonkotsu ramen. I'm a hardcore Sapporo-style ramen fan but the closest noodle shop with tonkotsu ramen is a bit out of my way and eating there requires some planning. Preparing the soup for homemade tonkotsu ramen is a long process that can take days, depending on the recipe, and I've never been motivated enough to finally try it myself from scratch because the time and effort is just too daunting for me. I dislike prepackaged ramen as a general rule, especially ramen of the "instant" variety that only needs the addition of boiling water and rehydration. I decided to give this product a shot since I've never had a prepackaged ramen that promised the flavor of a tonkotsu broth, which is rich and unctuous, and most instant ramen broths just resemble a clear bouillon. For a prepackaged instant ramen, I have to say that I'm really impressed with how well the flavors and texture of "real" tonkotsu broth are represented. No, I'd never mistake it for the real thing and if it were the real thing then I'd consider it below mediocre but for what it is, I consider it outstanding and I'll be re-ordering. Note: This is very salty (1680 mg sodium), heavy (21 g fat) and more caloric (410 calories) than most prepackaged ramen, which is already considered to be bad for you, but that's true of many "real" tonkotsu broths and as an occasional lunch while I'm at at work and stuck at my desk, I'm okay with that and adjust the rest of my foods that day accordingly. I wouldn't be willing to waste my sodium, fat or calorie budgets on any other instant ramen I've ever had.

**BEGIN UPDATE 9/08** Just received my 2nd case of 12 in a little over 3-wks, but then again I've been sharing, 1/3 for sharing w/my taste-buddies while the remaining 2/3's have been for my own taste-buds.  I added little steamed won-tons today but it was more than this soup needed, maybe tomorrow a sliced hard-boiled egg; keeping it simple is the best way to enjoy this bowl of ramen wherein the broth is superior. I will let you know if I ever get on to trying the other flavors as I'd originally hoped.  Thanks for reading. **END UPDATE**If you ever enjoyed add-hot water and wait bowl-type instant ramen, this has, in my humble opinion, the best tasting broth, no-contest of this type that I've ever had since "Cup Jorick" came along early 70's. Fast-forward, for the last year or so I've enjoyed the "Nong Shim Big Bowl Noodle Udon" (still do!) since it isn't SPICY at all, allowing me to add spice if I choose to change it up, add steamed won-tons, char siu - you get the idea.  "Menraku Tonkotsu Ramen" while the noodles are on par w/instant ramen of the bowl variety, here it's the RICH BROTH, that immediately upon tasting, is set apart from the usual within the category.  Other reviewers here who have also enjoyed have picked up the same flavorful aspects:  buttery, a bit of garlic, a rich-tasting broth like you could only get home-made or in the best kept secret asian restaurants.  I look forward to trying the other Menraku varieties:  Shio Ramen, Miso Ramen, and Shoyu Ramen, all very basic flavors that can be lost causes in the wrong hands but I am convinced on this experience alone, though "Tonkotsu" ramen may be my new, all-time favorite, that I will enjoy the others as well.  Wondered about "Tonkotsu"(pork-bone), not to be confused w/"tonkatsu"(breaded pork cutlet), as the broth didn't convey much pork taste though it could be usual Japanese subtlety at play here.  I got this on WED and I've had one each day since.  I should get another case soon as I know I'll be sharing.  Currently living in a dorm?  Buy the case. Stash it however you're best  able or split the case w/others. It's quick, easy and great value.  Amazon Prime got it here in two-days!!!  The only thing left to say is "Itadakimasu!"

column9: Did not get my thing at all
column10: I did NOT get my paid thing, and I can NOT track my package at all. I don't care who is in charge of missing package. Really freaks me out for cannot get the food that I had already paid for.

These are excellent Bully Springs but one of them was too big for my small yorkie to chew so I gave it to the neighbors larger dog.  He was able to chew the skinnier one and he seemed to enjoy it.  I do wish that these came in skinnier, easy to chew for smaller dogs.  I never know when I place an order what I'm going to get.  I'm going to keep looking but I highly recommend for larger dogs.

column9: Good tea, but better in the satchel
column10: I first had this tea in the satchel.  It is fantastic that way.  When I finished my firs tin I saw that it came in bags and a box as an option as well.  I ordered the fifty pack.  The bags are good and very convenient when I travel, but no match for the satchels in flavor.  If you like a touch of cinnamon, the bags are fine.  If you want a more robust taste, I recommend the satchel.
This is an excellent spiced tea blend for anyone with a passion for cinnamon.  Works well both with and without cream.
I have tried other cinnamon teas and they either taste like alfalfa or extremely weak. Harney's cinnamon tea is just great.

column9: Delicious! must have an allergy to something though
column10: This tea is absolutely delicious and I love that it is sweet without any additional sugar! It is very spicy as well. The tea is great as-is or with a bit of milk. Unfortunately twice when I've had this tea, part of my face has become bright red, tight, and itchy. It goes down after 20 minutes or so. I must be allergic to something in the tea. Take a good look at the ingredients before buying!
If you love cinnimon, this is your tea.  The flavor is is out of this world.

I first had this tea at a Starbucks & then ordered it for use at home.  I love the strong flavors and have made it my routine hot drink. I will continue to order online as I have had prompt delivery without any problems with the product.  I would recommend this tea to anyone who likes a strong, cinnamon/spice tea that is just perfect as it is... no cream or sugar needed.Harney & Sons Fine Teas Hot Cinnamon Spice - 50 Tea bags
Hands down the best tea I've ever had. The aroma is enticing; full flavor delivers. Delicious. I will order again.

Now how can you add anything to the excellent reviews the excellent people here wrote?  (I feel for the one here that had the allergic response to it). So, if you really like cinnamon, (that be me), you can't do better than this for flavor, unless you chew it off the tree.  Good luck with that one.  I'm not much of a hot tea drinker except in winter.  So this summer, I made a gallon of sun tea with this and I-am-now-addicted! I use 8 or 9 bags per gallon.  If the sachets, then 6 or 7.  I like my tea strong so I leave the bottle out for as long as it takes me to remember I put it out there.  No bitterness at all.  I can always dilute the mixture if I have to.  But that's what ice cubes give up their lives for.  I'll never go back to orange pekoe again.  Take THAT, Lipton!
Awesome tea, arrived VERY fast.  Although it is "hot" cinnamon, it is not like fireballs or redhots; it is actually a much milder cinnamon taste than I expected, but very very good.

If you liked Cinnamon Tic Tacs (no longer made), you will love this tea!  This is a flavorable tea that has a robust (but not too bold) taste.  I like drinking this tea after meals, like a soothing dessert.  I already ordered more as this has become a daily drink!!

This is AMAZING tea.  It is very cinnamon-y and spicy, but it is also sweet, not bitter at all.  Really outstanding tea.  I work at a school and have shared tea bags with lots of other teachers, and they all love it too - rave reviews from everyone who's tried it.  This is my all-time favorite tea.  Good any time of day.  Good hot or cold.  Good brewed weak or strong.  Worth every penny.  And the delivery was outstanding too.  I 've ordered it twice and it arrived really fast both times.  Super happy customer (and that's sayin' something, because I can be darn cranky about things).  :)

Just as all the reviews said, this tea is delicious. I am hooked on the strong, sweet cinnamon. I drink it everyday; I don't ever want to run out of it. I'm ordering my third box and am recommending it to my friends.

It's hard to get excited about tea, but this blend is amazing.  This tea has a smooth, rich, powerful flavor. When you open the package and the aroma hits your olfactory, you know you're in for a treat.  You won't be disappointed with this unless you dislike cinnamon.

I absolutely LOVE this tea. The first time I had it was when I had a wonderful meal at Ruth Chris Steak House and they served it to me there. I was so entranced by it,I asked the waitress where they bought it. Not only did she tell me, she also gave me four tea bags to take home!Needless to say, I've been hooked since then. This tea is just sweet and spicy enough to be absolutely satisfying. It tastes remarkably like the red hot cinnamon candy - which if you had asked me beforehand if I would like, I would have said no. But it's just the right blend to make it perfect.Another reason I love it is because it satisfies my sweets craving without actually  having to have sweets. Who wouldn't love a nice zero-calorie tea that tastes just as good as the candy?Try it for yourself - you will love it!

column9: I feel so fancy drinking this
column10: I am addicted to caffeine. If there were street pushers in shady parts of town selling it, I would be there looking for my fix. Thankfully, it is a legal stimulant and Amazon is my dealer.Hot Cinnamon Spice is not so much a radical break from my normal coffee and tea habits, it is more of a revelation that I can get a heck of a flavor along with that sweet caffeine hit.It has a fairly strong cinnamon smell, but the flavor is neither overpowering nor "hot" as the name may say. I would recommend drinking without adding any sugar, milk or cream to it, as it is sweet in it's natural state and this is a flavor that should not be drowned out. That, and milk is disgusting.After I made a cup at work, the vultures started circling wondering what the wonderful aroma was. 50 bags seemed silly to purchase, but with by freeloader coworkers they will be gone in no time.I give it two snaps up.

Hands down most delicious tea I have ever had. In fact it tastes so decadent it doesn't even taste like tea. With a little stevia and almond milk I feel like I'm drinking a delicious dessert! (Although I only drink it in the morning/ before 3pm since it does back quite a caffeinated kick!
I love this tea - to me it tastes like drinking a red hot cinnamon hard candy I used to love when i was a kid.  if you like sweet cinnamon you will love this tea!

Wow this is really spicy and cinnamony (if that is a word). A bargain really considering that you get 50 large bags in a box. I would advise that this tea tastes quite sweet to me without any added ingredients out of the box. So go careful on sugar. May I suggest pairing this with the wonderful organic agave cinnamon sweetner available through Amazon as a compliment. (ASIN: B0048INV38). This makes it a cinnabomb.

I've tried two different brands of cinnamon spice tea, and even though this is most likely derivative of the first brand, Harney & Sons' version is so much better. It isn't quite as bitter and the cinnamon gives you a more rounded taste, instead of being overpowering.The scent is intoxicating, and the tea tastes naturally sweet - its great for a cold day!
The first time I tasted this tea I thought...WOW! That feeling has not faded. If you like tea, cinnamon, spice something to put a little honey and milk into you'll love this tea. It's a homerun.

column9: good hot drink with any meal or in between
column10: My husband and I like this with cinnamon tea with our evening meal and usually about 8:30 or 9:00 we each drink another cup.  It is really tasty and has a sweet taste to it, so you don't have to use a lot of sugar  or splenda with it. This is something we really enjoy. Keep up the good work.Our daughter introduced us to this product and several other teas that you sell, but this is our favorite and hers also. I am a product reader so know what is in almost everything we eat.
I discovered this wonderful cinnamon tea at Au Bon Pain.  I am now going to buy it to have at home.  I love it.

I first tasted this tea at a local eatery. I had to order it so I could enjoy it at home. If you like cinnamon you'll love this tea. It's the perfect blend of spices and it curbs my sweet tooth. I look forward to getting it in decaffeinated.

column9: Okay... but nothing compared to the loose version available in tins!
column10: I have been a long time fan of the Hot Cinnamon Spice Tea, though I had only purchased it in the tin of loose tea bags. I am sad to report that the flavor is vastly LESS flavorful than the loose version and certainly not as tasty.While still better flavor than many teas, I was disappointed with this in comparison with the slightly more expensive tin version.
This is the best tea I have drank in a long time.  It is naturally sweet.  The aroma reminds me of Fall.

Tried this Harney & Songs Hot Cinnamon Spice black tea. The cinnamon is very fragrant & flavorful. This tea is very similar toGOOD EARTH Original Sweet & Spicy tea. I prefer GOOD EARTH, I think the Good Earth tea has more flavor! You can also get Good Earth products on salesometimes on Amazon, making them a better value for the money.

column9: Care for a spot ot tea...
column10: This product arrived today and I gotta tell ya its better than I expected! You ever walked into a store and smelled those cinnamon pine cones?Thats my best description of it...if I drank tea w sugar I'm pretty sure this tea would taste like a version of those cinnamon red hots candies. Anyway, its pretty dang good!!! :)

This tea is absolutely delish! I tried the wrapped tea bag version and I liked it so I ordered it in the sachet and it is soo much more flavorful. I liked it so much that I made up a batch of cinnamon cookies to go with it. This tea, a cookie and a good book equals heaven!!

Some teas smell great but when you taste them they are a disappointment.  This tea tastes terrific too. It's sweet without any added sugar - I guess that's from the sweet cloves. Whatever it is I love it.
This strongly spiced tea is heaven as a pick me up at 3 pm at work. My coworkers always comment on the delicious smell. You don't need any sweetener as the cinnamon itself is sufficient.
I really love this Tea!! It's my "comfort food" of sorts. It's very tasty with a little sugar-spicy and yummy. This was a really great price for 50 tea bags.

column9: Great High Quality Tea With A Strong Cinnamon Taste
column10: I've enjoyed an Orange Pekoe and Black Tea blend for years.  About eight years ago, I was introduced to an Indonesian brand that was a blend of Orange Pekoe, Black Tea, and Cinnamon.  It was incredible!  However, it was bought at a discount store and I was never able to purchase it retail - despite my dogged attempts.  Ever since, I have been forced to go from one imitator to another looking for a replacement.Enter Harney & Sons Hot Cinnamon Spice which I first purchased at a specialty store that carried somewhat exotic products and have since purchased on Amazon.com.  What can I say other than WOW!!!!  This tea has such an INCREDIBLE taste.  It is almost indescribable how beautifully the black tea mixes with the cinnamon and orange in your tea cup.  I love the cinnamon taste so much, I actually OVER steep my tea bag in order to infuse as much of the powerful cinnamon taste as possible.  I'm sure many tea enthusiasts in the UK and here in the US would be aghast at the thought of over-steeping tea as normally you would be left with a strongly bitter cup as the black tea would infuse too much of its taste into the water.  However, this does not happen with Harney & Sons.  Instead, the only thing you get is a stronger and stronger cinnamon & orange taste.  I steep my tea so long that I often have to reheat my cup, but it is so utterly delicious (that would be the basking in fields of flowers with rainbows and unicorns kind of delicious) that I'm willing to wait another minute or two.  Add a little sweetener and a touch of cream and its TO DIE FOR!!!As you can see, I can't say enough good things about either Harney & Sons teas in general or the Hot Cinnamon Spice blend in particular.  I was so happy to find this tea - it truly blows away any brand that I've found - one of the many instances where you win when you pay for quality!

My Mom bought this Tea and gave me a few bags to take home and try.....OMG, without a doubt one of the best Tea's I have ever tasted! Most tea's just taste like hot water. This one is soooo flavorfull..such a wonderful cinnamon flavor.  Tastes like you are eating a bag of red hots, and just a little bit of sugar and its so sweet! This is def my new obsession!

This cinnamon tea tastes slightly sweet even without honey or sugar.  When I ran out of the tea bags, I reached into my tea storage cannister and found some 2 year old tea sachet bags.  I tried them and they were still full of flavor after sitting unused for 2 years.  Makes a great gift too.

I purchased this tea after sampling some from a co-worker.  It is a strong tea with a very powerful cinnamon taste, but its sweet with only a little burn.  Very good.  No need for cream or sugar in the tea.  Will purchase again.

I have never had a tea that got better as it steeped over 5 minutes, but this tea gets more flavorful instead of bitter.  I do not have to add sugar or sweetener. As a diabetic this is very important. The cinnamon and orange peel is just heavenly.  If you like cinnamon and flavored tea, you are going to be in love with this one.

column9: go for the satchels in the tin, I guess . . .
column10: If you LOVE cinnamon, this is apparently the tea to buy, especially in satchels in the more expensive tin. Based on the rave reviews, I bought the economical box - and, for a gift to have on hand, the nice-looking tin . . . before realizing that the satchels in the tin are touted to taste better than the 50 bags in the box. Glad the gift tea should be better! I LIKE cinnamon - but to love these tea bags, it would help if you love cinnamon (especially if you enjoy Red Hots or hot spicy food). I usually enjoy my tea strong and with milk, but I suspect I'll be diluting this one with lots of milk. So far, I've found Harney & Sons tea to be high-quality tea - and cinnamon is healthy, so I'm okay with this purchase. But I don't plan to restock this zinger in my pantry :)

column9: Not the same as Hot Cinnamon Sunset, but still good
column10: This is a great tea, and if you have never had their Hot Cinnamon Sunset you will be none the wiser that it could be even better.  I fell for the price difference and decided to give it a try.  Truth be told I will buy it again because it is just so much less then the other.  But sometime I am guessing I will splurge and get the real thing.  Enjoy both, you will be glad you did.

I found this tea in a most unorthodox setting - a pizza shop when I was sick and wanted something warm and soothing to drink in December.  Not only does this tea smell heavenly, but everyone around me asks what smells so wonderful.  When I tell them it is this tea, they can't believe it and want to try it.  I ordered the 50 packet box and need to reorder already as I keep giving these packets away and everyone who has tried it loves it!  The tea smells fabulous, is bold and tasty.  I tend to like honey in my tea, and find this is truly the best cup of tea around!  I love it and think if you are considering, you should give it a try!  You may want to check Harney and Sons website directly as they actually sell it for a bit cheaper, but be sure to check whether Amazon winds up being a better deal due to shipping costs.  Plus, if you prefer loose tea, the company's website offers that option as well.  Enjoy!

My mother-in-law gave me some Hot Cinnamon Spice tea from Caribou Coffee and I loved it so I tried to find it online.  I was surprised to find that this tea seemed to be the exact same tea at a much lower price.  I decided to give it a shot and it is delicious!  I would definitely recommend this to tea drinkers and non-tea drinkers alike.  My husband, who is not much of a tea drinker was pleased to find that it had a rich, full taste, unlike a lot of other teas that he has tried.

If you are a tea drinker and like cinnamon flavored things you will love this.  Ikeep it on hand at all times.  You know how sometimes you really want a cinnamon...something? Usually something bad for you, try this instead. The flavor is perfect and most of the time it does the trick for me. And research has shown that cinnamonimproves the way our bodies handle sugar. That makes it even better. Love this tea!And if you are a tea lover, Harney and Sons has really good tea. You should givethem a try.
This tea is very popular in our house -- my husband panics if we're nearing the end of the tin!  I highly recommend it.
Recipients of tea found it to be excellent- I gave it as a gift and it was greatly appreciated and noted to be exceptionally good tea.

Love it!  I am an avid tea drinker (instead of coffee), and I love this flavor.  I bought one in a metal tin for myself and savor each tea bag.  The smell of cinnamon, allspice (and maybe cardamom?) are so cozy and flavorful.I decided to send this as a gift to warm up someone else's spirits.  It's particularly great for autumn/winter, but I enjoy it year-round.

My husband and I both love teas of all kinds, but this one is the best for true cinnamon taste. Nothing from the grocery store will compare. It not only smells wonderful, but it has a rich, spicy taste that is so perfect for a cold winter afternoon, all snuggled up by the fireplace. I love having a cup of this with a fresh scone or a piece of pie. Honestly, it reminds me of Christmas now since I have bought this for my husband as a stocking stuffer for the last few years since he loves it so much.

I drink three or more cups of tea a day.  This is tea is absolutely delicious.  It has a strong cinnamon flavor.  It is best to brew the tea for at least five minutes in boiling water.  I first had it in a restaurant.  I tried to find it at  the local supermarkets, but was unsuccessful.  Fortunately, it can be ordered.

I prefer loose-leaf teas, but at work the convenience of bags is hard to beat, and Harney has been reliable in the past.This "Hot Cinnamon Spice" is an excellent cold-weather tea: a pervasive cinnamon aroma with just a hint of orange, and a nice balance between the subtle spice and the tea flavors (assuming for a moment you want to taste the tea, not just the spices, that is.) I'm not fond of herbs and spices that totally overwhelm the underlying tea -- this preparation was actually better than I expected.Good packaging, even though the bags are not the top-tier sachets that Harney uses for their fanciest offerings; a great value.

column9: Excellency certified by the chai wallah.
column10: The taste of this tea is absolutely phenomenal. I grew up in southern India(Hyderabad) where tea flows like water and chai wallahs are omnipresent. It was hard for me to appreciate the choices I have in the states as far as tea is concerned (Black tea specifically) because none of the black tea I find here tastes good to me unless I turn it into chai by adding milk and spices. But this tea does not need even a crystal of sugar because the combinations of cinnamon and sweet cloves they use make it naturally sweet and it smells heavenly too. Every time I go back to India, I order a box to take with me.The tea comes in different packages. You can buy the large rectangular bags which come in shiny copper-colored tins which are not value for money compared to these individually wrapped, slightly smaller tea bags. I seep two bags in piping hot water for three minutes to reach the strong taste I like.Keep sipping! :)
I love this cinnamon tea and had a hard time finding it. When I ordered it, it was sent right away. I have no complaints.
I have been obsessed with this tea for several years.  When the nearby coffee shop that sold it in bulk went out of business, I was thrilled to find it on Amazon for a good price.

i thought this was going to be the same taste as the ones in the tin, the satchels, which are basically the most amazing thing ever.  However, I noticed that after my tea cooled down more, I could taste the flavor more.  Still pretty comparable to the ones in the tins, just needs to brew longer and only good for one cup.

If you really, really love cinnamon, then this is the tea for you.  It is delicious both hot and cold.  My sister introduced me to the tea and I haven't stopped drinking it since.  Naturally sweet and delicious.
This cinnamon tea is great- strong, but not to the point of being spicy.  This 50 count box is much more economical than the 20 sachets, and I don't notice a taste difference.

Someone introduced me to this tea and ever since then I am in love with the taste. It has a sweet taste and the hot spice cinnamon is such a treat. I have a new favorite tea, thats for sure. I highly recommend this tea.
This tea is DELICIOUS!  If you love cinnamon and a hint of sweetness this is the one to buy. I drink it when I'm craving something sweet but don't want to indulge in chocolateBravo Harney & Sons!
I LOVE this tea...it is so full of flavor that I look forward to having it first thing in the morning.  Not too sweet, perfect combo of cinnamon and spice...delicious!

column4: Ellen Holtzman Robin "avid fan of historical ...
column10: I came across Harney & Sons Hot Cinnamon Spice Tea while on vacation. It is truly the most delicious tea I've ever had - if you are a lover of cinnamon. I know there are other varieties - but this is my favorite.
Many teas just don't have the flavor you wish for. This Harney & Sons hot cinnamon spice is fragrant and tastes divine!

column9: Possibly the best tea I've had yet.
column10: This tea is just amazing. It has a very unique taste, and if you like cinnamon at all you will love this. It is a bit strong at the recommended 1 cup per tea bag, but I'm guessing 1 & a half will be perfect. It is not overly hot like the (only) bad review says, except for maybe the fact that you may be willing to scald your tongue to drink it, its that good!One thing to note is some of the actual tea bags aren't very secure on the top, and the tea will likely pour into your cup. Might want to staple it down a bit more.
This might be my new favorite tea - the scent is just divine and it needs  very little in the way of sweetening.

This is more than just a tea. It truly is an experience. It has a multi-layered flavor of cinnamon and spices that are luscious. I treat myself to a cup of this tea whenever it is snowy outside, or even when I have just had a tiring day. You will love it (-:
My husband and I love how spicy and sweet this tea is.  It's truly a dessert.  So glad to find this at Amazon at their price.

While I love cinnamon rolls, I'm not a huge fan of red hots, cinnamon gum, etc. but this tea is delicious!  It tastes like a very mild (not hot at all) red hot.  Everyone I have served it to has loved it--even those who aren't fans of hot tea.  Please note that this is not an herbal tea--it is caffeinated and has black tea mixed in, which is delicious.

This is the only cinnamon tea that actually tastes like cinnamon.  It's spicy and sweet.  $0.30 a cup (shipping added) is high for an at home beverage, but I never need to use 2 tea bags for flavor.  The best on the market.

This tea is good if you really like the strong taste of cinnamon and spice. It kind of tasted like the gum, Big Red. I didn't expect the strong taste so that is why I gave it a 4. There is also a sweet after taste which was interesting too.
Most cinnamon teas are herbal. I love the blend with the black tea. It really helps me in the afternoon with a bit of caffeine vs going for coffee. I love it and buy it in bulk!

column9: A Tea That Can Take you Away
column10: I got hooked on Harney & Sons teas some time ago. It started with their Paris tea, and I imagined that I was back in Paris with every sip. So that led me to try the Hot Cinnamon Spice, the heady aroma of the cinnamon made me think of Morocco. The first sip...I was transported by the smooth flavor and yet there was an intense melding of slightly sweet and hot spice. Once again, hooked. My 18 year old son loves it too! If you love tea, these teas are the best out there!

I had this tea once at Einstein Bagel and decided that I NEEDED to find this tea.I found it on Amazon and order 2 boxes. I call it my Hot Tamale tea because it pretty much tastes exactly like the candies of the same name. I am not a tea drinker, especially not unsweetened tea, but this I can drink without adding anything to it. I love it and highly recommend it.

This tea is exactly what I wanted - rich, warm, spicy cinnamon tea!  The tea is so well-packaged that you can't even smell the tea bag without opening the foil pouches, which means they're keeping the tea fresh.  I've brewed this tea in hot milk also for a very nice cinnamon milk tea.  Perfect tea for a chilly night and goes wonderfully with a piece of pumpkin pie.  :)
I stumbled on to the tea and flavor at the JW Marriott. I absolutely love it and was thrilled to find it on Amazon.Mix it with honey - it is fantastic.
tastes like the hot cinnamon candies, good with just sugar, or even better with cream and sugar, perfect winter treat

I had tried this tea at a spa and loved it. They shipped promptly altho 1 box of 50 tea bags arrived in a large box with foam peanuts.I feel postage could have been lowered if tea box was sent in a smaller appropriate size box. the cinnamon spice tea is delicious and as promised I received a sample of one of their other teas. I will order again.

column9: Not a fan of cinnamon, but this was DE-LIC-IOUS!
column10: I had mine in a latte style, made with milk.  SO GOOD.  Would definitely recommend trying it, even if you are not a big cinnamon fan.  I enjoy cinnamon, but I wouldn't say I love it... so don't shy away just because everyone raves about the cinnamon flavor.  It definitely feels like a fall/holiday treat with the cinnamon and spice flavor.
I was going to order Bigelow again, but read the reviews for this and decided to give it a try.  This is SO good! It's like having dessert.  I'm ordering much more right now!!
The seller did everything as promised, I even got a 1 sample of mint tea.

I have purchased this tea at Barnes and Noble after receiving it as a gift from a friend. This tea is on the expensive side but worth it. If you like cinnamon, you will love this tea. I enjoy drinking it with an ounce or so of soy milk and agave sweetener. It's bliss and tastes like a zillion calories when it's not!

column9: TEA SO GOOD, IT CAN MAKE A TEAPOT TASTE LIKE FOOD
column10: My friend raved about this tea. She said it is the best tea on earth, world, wherever. I did not believe a word she said until recently when I personally tried it. I did not know a combination of hot, cinnamon, spice can be so delicious. Once I opened the tea pack, I can smell an aroma of cinnamon. If you love cinnamon, you can't go wrong with this tea. But if you hate cinnamon, you will want to throw this on the ground. As for myself, I love cinnamon. This tea is flavorful and different from other teas. The first sip of the tea, you will taste a bit of cinnamon. The second sip of the tea, you will taste a bit of spice. The third sip of the tea, you will taste a bit of sweetness. It is simply wonderful. You want quality tea? Harney & Sons - Hot Cinnamon Spice will not disappoint you.Okay, it's tea time.

column9: Whoever said this was crack tea they were right
column10: LOVE this tea.  I gave away a bag at work one day and the next thing I knew 3 people came by my office and I got 2 emails wanting to know where the tea with the heavenly scent came from.  JUST BUY IT!!!! I've had at least two dozen people try it and not one has disliked it. If you still uncertain go by Caribou and order their Hot Cinnamon Tea Harney is their distributor.  I must say you need to buy it in the silken sachets it's much better tasting that way but this way is darn good too.  I'm a facebook fan of Harney tea so I posted a concern that they were out and they emailed me the day it was coming back into stock and I bought a 50 ct bag  in decaf for $13.50. Low and Behold I went back the next day to add a bag and it was out again.

What do they put in this tea? Crack? Seriously, I know flavored teas are gimmicky and blah blah fancy heritage oolong is the pinnacle of tea, but I LIKE this. It's totally flavorful and addicting! Plus, unlike chai, it doesn't need the addition of milk or honey. I'm sure they make it with crack because it makes my office smell like potpourri for several days, but I still love it.

This tea is fantastic.  Like another here, I am passing bags out to as many people as I can find.  This has the perfect blend of cinnamon and sweetness (without adding anything additional to the cup).  This is now the only hot tea I want or need.

column9: Harney & Sons Cinnamon Spice tea bags
column10: Shipment was prompt, product is great, shipping is a little high. Very satisfied with overall experience.

This is my favorite tea.  It is beautiful to the senses.  I have passed out this stuff to all my co-workers and they adore it too.  In addition, the guy selling the stuff here gives good customer service.  This tea is best paired with European sugar cubes.  I do not use milk, but I think this tea would be good with it or half and half.  The tea has clarity of taste that outshines other teas.  The quality is tops.Fall is a great time of the year to enjoy this tea.  You can not go wrong with this stuff!
I have never tasted a cinnamon tea as flavorful as this one!  Everyone who drinks it at my house wants to know where they can buy some. It's the best.

rec'd as listed, no problems except that UPS left the box on front porch in the snow, and contents got wet, including the outside box of this tea, which was a Christmas gift - the tea bags themselves are in packages that would not be affected - not at all the senders fault - rec'd quickly and before Christmas, and it was not guaranteed, so this was very nice
it doesn't state artificial flavorings in the ingredients list on Amazon.....but they are listed on the box.  Not for me because of the artificial ingredients, but my husband likes the taste.
I found this tea undrinkable -- the spice flavor is way too strong for me.  "Hot" means "completely numbs your taste buds" here, not hot temperature-wise!
THis the best on the market. Tasts like real sugar..You can just dip a strawberry in it and instant sweet treat..love it

column9: Natural, no calorie, and tastes great
column10: I've been wanting to try stevia (the plant that is used in this product) for a long time, and finally picked up this container at the grocery store.  I didn't buy it on Amazon but wanted to share my impression with other shoppers.The little jar is rather expensive, but stevia is very concentrated and you only need a tiny bit for most uses.  I like the container, with the flip top lid that allow me to use a spoon without screwing off a lid.The product itself is very nice!  I've used it for several weeks in my morning tea, and I'm a convert.  It gives my tea a nicely sweetened taste and I haven't detected any aftertaste.  I only use about 1/4 teaspoon in two cups of hot water (I have a big mug for my tea).I'm going to explore Amazon and the rest of the Internet for a bulk sized package of this sweetener.  Unfortunately it would be nearly impossible to grow my own stevia in my herb garden, so I'll have to buy it instead.
Excellent coffee and great vendor.  I had this coffee when I was in the DR and I love that I can still drink it here at home.

column9: Super seller- very fast shipping and great product
column10: This is the most amazing coffee actually grown and processed in the Dominican Republic.  I tried it while in the DR and can't live without it since then.  It has a natural sweetness to it and is not bitter like a lot of arabica coffees can be.  This seller is great- fast shipping and excellent prices.  Thank you to the seller and for Amazon for offering this great product.

I ordered "Harika Ribbon Pakoda" from amazon but instead they shipped me this product. I opened the first one and was greatly disappointed because it tasted STALE and yucky. I think it must have been in their shelves for a long time. While I love to see more Indian snacks added to amazon, I would be a repeat buyer only if the quality is there.
This was a step back in time for my daughter.It was there on time.Wrapped very nice and she just loved it. this company does a very good job in presenting this product.

I really, really liked these nuggets! These are akin to boneless nuggets you would find at a restaurant, but without the messy sauce. Of course, these are bagged, shelf stable nuggets - so they are a bit salty (which means you won't risk death upon eating them). I love the size of this bag as it is great for snacking - only 90 calories! The shelf life was great as mine don't expire until Dec. of 2011 (purchased Feb. of 2011). I will be keeping a pack in the car, a pack in my desk at work, and they are great for grabbing on the run for a quick snack. These are buffalo, so there is a good and HOT spice with them.Another big thing for me is having something yummy, fun, and interesting to eat in case of an emergency (like a weather event that takes out the power). What would you want to eat - canned tuna or buffalo nuggets to get you through a power outage? See, reason enough to order - you can add them to your emergency preparedness bag - LOL.It looks expensive, but the price is actually really good. Less than you would pay in the grocery store and the smaller size bag means you don't have to refrigerate leftovers or over indulge (there is a lot of salt). I can imagine taking these camping, to sporting events, or anywhere that a "semi" healthy snack is warranted or you just get a craving for buffalo nuggets! Will definitely be purchasing more of these!
These are perfectly spiced and absolutely addictive.  Plus, they are a great source of low-fat protein.  Yum - this is a great product!
Microwave Hamburger Buns are tasty, fast and easy.I am now able to have bread for family, with special diet needs, at the same time as dinner is ready.

This mix makes great hamburger buns.  It is very easy to use.  Also, you only make one at a time so you eat it fresh, then make another one the next time.  With a lot of mixes you make it and then have a lot to freeze.
Personally I find the products put out by Food Tek a welcome change to some of the horrible gluten free foods I have eaten.  Thanks Food Tek!!

column9: SUGAR IS NUMBER 2 INGREDIENT. A SUGAR BAKING MIX THAT HAS NO GLUTEN
column10: THIS CAN ONLY BE REFERRED TO AS A SUGAR BAKING MIX. The point that it has no gluten, is ridiculous when it is STOCKPILED OF SUGAR!!!!!!!!! So, instead of gluten, an individual can FATTEN THEMSELVES UP with sugar! Further, if you suffer from a sugar addiction, and gluten--- THIS IS definitely a huge let down. Sugar in any form such as malto dextrin, dextrose, organic sugar (I love it when they nickname this one as being organic as if the chemical composition is any different on the body!), WHEN ARE THE MANUFACTURERS GOING TO MAKE REAL healtlhy products that have ingredients that ARE TRULY FOR THE HEALTH CONSCIOUS. By omitting one ingredient such as gluten, you have done NOTHING to help consumers with health allergies---- instead you have dumped humongous amounts of the number ONE SUBSTANCE IN THE U.S. THAT Americans are addicted to;  sugar

column9: Ghastly Sponges in Mouth-Burning Sugar Syrup
column10: This tastes like I imagine a regular sponge would.  They look that way too.  Indeed, I am suspicious that these aren't really "cottage cheese patties" or paneer at all.  I've bought paneer for years and I know what it looks, feels and tastes like.  I've no idea what the heck this is, but I think this company is engaged in some funny business in what it's putting in the product.Beyond that, these sponges are soaked in an uber sweet sugar syrup with a slight hint of rose.  That's to be expected for an Indian sweet of this type; however, this stuff actually not only burns your tongue and throat, but mine was still burning 8 HOURS AFTER CONSUMING ONE PATTY, WHICH I HAD SQUEEZED AND RINSED WITH WATER TO REMOVE AS MUCH SYRUP AS POSSIBLE.I would strongly advise others not to purchase this product.  I was expecting something completely different than what I received.  Oh and also all the cans were heavily dented upon arrival.

Smaller than I thought but still very delicious and creamy.  Smooth tecture and excelant taste. a smoother version of liverwurst but mildly spicey --a lighter spiced liverwust for those who like less spice. Sometimes liverwurst can be quite spicey.
Have you ever had canned corned beef hash?  Ever open it right up and just taste it right out of the can?  This tastes like that.... Unheated, canned corned beef hash.... Without the hash part.
If you enjoy liver pate, this one is smooth and delicious.  I like it very much, almost as much as goose liver pate!

My holistic vet recommended this dry food for my cat, despite it being intended for dogs.  She said this is the only dry food she would ever recommend for any older dog or cat, based on its excellent nutritional balance and anti-inflammatory qualities. Following that advice, I purchased the food for my 15 year old cat, who seems to adore the flavor of it, but it's a bit too large for him to chew easily.  I'm holding out for a cat version, but until then, I will keep smashing it up for him ;)

column9: Great taste gourmet treat on a budget!
column10: First off if you are looking for one of the super dark 70%+ chocolateThe bars this is NOT for you.  The chocolate is dark, however not bitter at all and has a slightly sweet taste.  The dark, rich, full chocolate flavor is apparent and is complimented well by the creamy texture and smooth taste in the mouth.The dark chocolate bars are made in the USA in Novato, CA.  Torn Ranch is a company that supplys high end treats mainly in the hospitality market.  Might be difficult to find unless you fly first class or stay at a 5 star hotel.  You can direct order online at tornranch.com.  Though if you do these are going to set you back $3 each plus taxand shipping with a 6 bar minimum.  Amazon was 31 for 24 and no tax plus Prime as a shipping option.  A GREAT deal.Package was interesting.  The 24 came in a large, ugly, cardboard box that had been directly sent by itself to amazon,  Basically 24 loose bars in a Torn Ranch shipping box.  So if you are looking at giving this whole as a gift the package will be lacking.  They are individually packaged with each bar having a sealed plastic inner sleeve that is surrounded by a nice printed light cardboard outer box.  The chocolate is sectinal - unlike the other review these are now three piece to a bar.Very, very tastey treat that I will reorder once these 24 are gone.  However, would not reccomend youy buy this as a gift to send (all 24 at once anyway) as the packaging for ther 24 is pretty rough and not eye pleasing.

Torn Ranch offers the absolute best chocolate/nut products on the market.  USA-made means a lot.  Good customer service.  I am a huge fan of their Pure Dark offering, Jumbo Cashews and #1 for me is the Sea Salt Chocolate.  A great gift item.

I love dark chocolate and have tried and enjoyed many of the well known brands.  I had never heard of Splendid Specialties before and there were no reviews here on Amazon to go by but I took a chance and ordered these and I'm glad I did.  These dark chocolate bars are two ounces each.  One half of the bar (a one ounce serving) is only one hundred and forty calories. The bars are thick and have a nice snap to them when you break them apart and the taste is rich, not too sweet, not bitter and very satisfying. column9: Where's The Cardamon?  Prepare for the Cloveaload!
column10: If the only chai you know is from a chai flavored latte at a coffee shop, this might be a good tea for you.  If you have an Indo-Pakistani family like me, the first thing you'll say after tasting this is "this is NOT chai tea."  There isn't even the slightest hint of cardamon in this tea.  As it is, it should be called "spicy clove tea."  This tea is heavily seasoned with cloves--I can't agree with any of the reviews that talk about cinnamon or other spices.  It's just cloves, cloves, and more cloves.  I guess that's what I get for looking for a simple chai-flavored tea. Real chai contains Milk, Sugar, loose black tea, cardamon, and a tiny amount of other spices according to region.  Cardamon and strong tea should be the dominant flavors.  Check the wikipedia article on Masala Chai for the original chai and how the American chai is a just a strange revision.  I'm sure that my fellow sugar-loving Americans would love to have a cup of super-sweet traditional chai, so I don't really understand why the flavor has been changed so drastically.I was hoping to add milk and sugar to this to get a "traditional" Indian Chai, but I'm going to have to try again with another brand.  For all the people out there who know what Indo-Pakistani Chai tastes like, I'll be reviewing each of the "chai" K-Cups according to how they resemble the original.
